秦王政十三年，桓齮受命攻打赵国平阳邑，秦王收拾行李，携奉常徐福同行，也往平阳邑而去。
等徐福一行人都行到城门口，一骑侍从疾驰而来，“徐奉常，等一等……”
因嬴政出行低调，那侍从并不敢开口直接呼“王上”，于是便只喊了徐福。
徐福掀起车帘朝外看去，“何事如此惊慌？”
周围人已经注意到了这个方向，他们看着徐福的脸庞，发出了阵阵惊叹声。但他们出于对徐福的敬畏，倒是没敢大呼小叫起来。
侍从难得失了分寸，脸上的惊慌之色几乎掩盖不住。
“徐奉常，你刚走，胡亥公子便跟出来了，在殿外狠狠摔了一跤，如今哭得上气不接下气，谁也哄不住……”那侍从一脸为难。
宫中知晓胡亥并非嬴政亲生的人，少之又少，现在见胡亥摔跤又大哭不止，谁敢放纵胡亥哭下去？若是胡亥公子出了事，他们就等着被王上扒皮拆骨，施以重刑吧……
徐福怔了怔，很快便想到了当年胡亥未及周岁，半夜哭喊不止，险些丧命……徐福脑子里几乎还能还原出当时的画面，胡亥哭得像是从水里捞出来似的，那软绵绵的身子，无力地蜷在一起，多惹人怜惜啊。
此时扶苏也从里头探头出来了，扶苏眉头皱得更紧，问道：“胡亥哭了吗？”
侍从连连点头，“是，口中还喊着扶苏公子呢。”
徐福和扶苏几乎是同时想到了胡亥，可怜巴巴喊“哥哥”的模样。
之前扶苏在嬴政跟前目的达成，也就直接将胡亥抛到脑后去了，全然没去想若是自己离去，胡亥会是个什么反应。反正胡亥年纪小，他们不带他去，他应当也是不会记得这事的，顶多难过一会儿就好了……
他们都是这样想的，但却忘记了这样的常理在胡亥身上根本行不通。
“回宫。”嬴政不得不出声道。
侍从面上一喜，忙调转了马头。
等他们又赶回到王宫中去后，还未走近便听见了胡亥近乎嘶哑的哭声，哭得都有些绝望了……
徐福心底抽痛了一下。
这和那一次是全然不同的感受，那一次他只是个旁观者，而这一次徐福倒是有了点儿揪心的感觉。
而扶苏脸色比他变得更快，几乎是疾步跨了进去，将胡亥从嬷嬷手中接过，将他直接带了出来。
徐福此时已经冷静下来了，他低声道：“准备些药物和胡亥能吃的食物，再收拾好他的衣物，一同带走。”
宫人和侍从们都愣了愣。
嬴政出声道：“按徐奉常说的去做。”嬴政的声音打破了凝滞的气氛，众人顿时醒神，忙按照吩咐去办了。
待到半个时辰后，哭得累了的胡亥趴在了徐福的怀里，眉头纠结在一块儿，五官都变得有些皱巴巴的了。
等他们再坐着马车出咸阳城时，他们的车厢里就又多了一个豆丁。
随行的侍从们忧虑不已。
原本带了一位扶苏公子，他们就已经压力十分大了，如今又多了个更为年幼的公子，他们的脸色实在愉悦不起来。
但是很快，他们忧虑就被打破了。
因为扶苏和胡亥实在太省心了，胡亥年纪小但却不瞎胡闹，基本上一个扶苏就可以搞定他。反倒是的旅途中，徐福偶尔觉得没事做了，便逗一逗胡亥，胡亥俨然成了车队中吉祥物般的存在。
这样轻松有趣的行程，实在难见！
就连嬴政也没想到。
胡亥丝毫也不抵触马车生活，他和扶苏不同，扶苏早熟，习惯马车生活并不令人惊奇，但胡亥才多大？他竟然也半句怨言也无，整日凑在徐福和扶苏的身旁，偶尔被嬴政捞起来玩一玩，他还能笑嘻嘻的。
就这样慢慢的，他们仿佛出来春游的一家四口，优哉游哉便到了平阳邑。
桓齮率领的大军驻扎在城外二十里地的位置。
许是赵军被秦军欺压得过了头，打到平阳邑来的时候，平阳邑中的赵军反倒被激起了几分血性，加上平阳邑本身防御不错，因而桓齮还未能将它轻松攻下。桓齮接到嬴政前来的消息后，便心中忐忑不已，忧心嬴政怪罪自己。
终于到了这一日……
桓齮听人来报，王上到了，他忙带着人亲自迎接过去。
一群将领兵士，小心地等在路口处，不久之后，他们终于见到了……一辆马车，那马车慢吞吞地到了跟前，桓齮以为路途遥远，连马儿也疲惫至极了。桓齮脑子飞快地转动起来，想着要如何给王上也解解乏才好。
此时却见车帘掀起，里头当先下来一人，着白袍，散着发，气质高洁，容颜说不出的俊美！好个相貌！
桓齮很快便将此人和脑中的名字对上了号，忙上前笑道：“徐奉常，王上呢？”
徐福指了指马车里，先回转身抱了胡亥在怀中。
众人见状，结结实实地愣住了。
怎么回事？不是说王上在里头吗？怎么一转手抱了个娃出来？那一瞬间，众人都以为自己脑子出问题了，或者眼睛出问题了。
他们小心地打量着徐福怀中的小孩儿，见那小孩儿面容精致乖巧，只牢牢抓着徐福的袖袍，半句话也不说。他们急得抓心挠肺，死活猜不出这小孩儿的身份，同时心中还觉得万分怪异。
好好的，怎么连个几岁的小娃娃都带来战场上了？但是思及这或许是王上的手笔，他们便多的也不敢抱怨。
那车帘又动了动，众人将心提到了嗓子眼儿，心道这下总能见着王上了吧。
他们都做好跪地拜叩的准备了，谁知道他们膝盖刚弯到一半，里头跳出来小少年，十岁不到的年纪，打扮贵气，面容清俊，眉目间有几分肖似王上。众人不自觉地咽了咽口水，心底大约都有了个猜测。
之后嬴政才慢慢从马车中出来了。
众人方才受了不小的刺激，这个时候嬴政真的出来了，他们却反应不及了，忘记了叩拜，只能马上躬身补救。
而嬴政淡淡地瞥了一眼桓齮，“先为寡人安排营帐，寡人同徐奉常一处便是。”
桓齮点点头，忙道：“王上，营帐早已备妥，只是……”桓齮看向了徐福，心中有些纠结，但面上半分异色也不显。他也曾听说过不少这位徐奉常的传闻，听说做了王上身旁的男宠。
但是此人与王上共处一营帐，合适吗？何况还有扶苏公子在！
营帐并不知桓齮心中的弯弯绕绕，他点头道：“带路，寡人与徐奉常前去瞧一瞧。”
见嬴政开口，嘴边处处挂着徐奉常，桓齮顿时明白过来，若是另外给徐奉常安置，恐怕并不会得一个体贴的名声，更可能的是，反招王上不满。
一行人根本没时间寒暄，也没时间凑着上前在嬴政面前露脸，短短的时间内，桓齮便直接引着他们到备好的营帐去了。
嬴政粗略扫了一遍，刚想说“如此便好”，最后却又生生地打住了，他转头看着徐福，眉梢眼角不自觉地温和了几分，问道：“你觉得此处如何？”
“很好。”徐福本也不是挑剔的人，当即便点了点头。
胡亥在他怀中懒洋洋地打了个呵欠，叫了声“哥哥”，扶苏朝徐福张开手臂，道：“老师将胡亥给我吧。”
徐福托得手臂有些累了，便弯腰将胡亥交给了扶苏。
而其他人在一旁，已经快要惊呆了。
原来这个小孩子，也是王上的儿子！
那便只有那胡姬所出的二子胡亥公子了！早就听闻王上极为重视后嗣，亲自将扶苏和胡亥接到身边，安置在自己的寝宫旁，手把手教导……
这三位几乎是秦国最尊贵的人物了啊……
他们竟然就集中在一个营帐里！
众人觉得自己呼吸都快要不顺畅了。
而桓齮更先考虑到的却是，这么多贵重人物……安危如何能维持周全？桓齮在心底重重地叹了口气。如此可是个麻烦啊。
嬴政招手将桓齮叫到跟前，“如今形势如何？”
桓齮目光所及，瞥见徐福、扶苏还有胡亥都看着自己，桓齮这员厮杀无数的大将，竟然有些紧张了。
chapters.title: 第129章
chapters.translated_text:
A sense of crisis suddenly welled up in Xu Fu's heart, and he couldn't help but recall the time in Sanchuan Commandery when Ying Zheng was furious and treated him with a cold face. He really didn't like it when Ying Zheng treated him that way.

Xu Fu made a countermeasure that was favorable to himself almost instantly.

Without even thinking, he lifted his leg and hooked it around Ying Zheng's waist. Although his expression remained cool, the words that came out of his mouth were inexplicably filled with a touch of seduction, "Not just half, there's a lot."

A brazier was burning in the palace, and the temperature was climbing steadily. Xu Fu and Ying Zheng were pressed tightly together, and saying such things made it easy for one's thoughts to wander.

Xu Fu tilted his head slightly, and their gazes met.

The warm, dim firelight shone on their faces, making Xu Fu's brows and eyes look beautiful. Ying Zheng felt a fire ignite in his heart, scorching his lungs, making him wish he could pin the person in front of him down. Thinking this, Ying Zheng really followed his heart and did it. He held Xu Fu and brought him to the side of the bed.

Xu Fu's mind was full of the "seventy times," and seeing Ying Zheng's actions, he was not only incredibly compliant, but also faintly carried two parts of enthusiasm.

As a result, the fire in Ying Zheng's belly hadn't even been released before it was doused by Xu Fu.

...

The morning light was faint.

A fair arm slowly stretched out from under the quilt, forming a sharp contrast with the dark-colored bedding. Fearing he would catch a cold, the palace maid hurriedly grabbed his robe and stepped forward.

When Xu Fu sat up slowly, the palace maid happened to drape the robe over him, covering the beautiful scenery underneath completely.

Xu Fu was served by the palace maid to wash up, and then changed into a brand-new robe. The palace maid carefully tied the leather belt for him and smiled, "This was just ordered by the King. Only Master Xu could wear it with such grace." The palace maid kept spouting compliments as if they were free.

Everyone in the palace was sharp; they could see that Xu Fu's current status was not just that of a male favorite of the King of Qin. He held an official position, and more importantly, he had a very high reputation among the common people, and his friends and senior fellow apprentices were all officials of the Qin State. The palace maid glanced obscurely outside the palace...

Even Young Master Fusu and Young Master Huhai were very close to Master Xu. How could they not put in more effort to leave a great impression in front of Master Xu?

After Xu Fu finished getting ready, he was about to move to another hall to eat. Who would have thought that as soon as he reached the palace entrance, he would see the two children, Fusu and Huhai, standing there eagerly, clearly having waited for him for a long time.

"Teacher." Fusu's eyes lit up as he called out, the longing on his face not seeming fake.

Huhai glanced at Fusu, learned to call him "Teacher," but after calling it, he felt something was wrong and carefully changed his words, "...Father."

Hearing this, the palace attendants almost felt their legs go weak and were about to kneel to Huhai.

...The King's son calling Master Xu "Father"?

Xu Fu was also a bit surprised at this moment. Although Huhai was considered his godson, Huhai was young after all, and he and Ying Zheng rarely mentioned the concepts of "Father" and "King Father" in front of Huhai. The last time he let Huhai learn to call him "Father" seemed to be when Huhai was two years old.

So much time has passed, and Huhai actually still remembers?

Isn't it said that children have the worst memory?

Xu Fu put away the strange feeling in his heart, only feeling that although Fusu and Huhai were young, they were not comparable to other people's children. Perhaps it was because their genes were better? Xu Fu collected his thoughts, bowed slightly, and asked, "How long have you been standing here?"

Huhai held up his fingers, "Half an hour."

Xu Fu took his hand and squeezed it; it was a bit cold. So Xu Fu had to give up his original plan, took Fusu and Huhai by the hand, brought them into the hall, and then ordered the palace attendants to bring the food into the hall.

With one on his left and one on his right, Xu Fu rarely felt like a parent.

Although Fusu and Huhai had also eaten some in the morning, it had to be said that the effort Ying Zheng spent on them was indeed not as indulgent as it was for Xu Fu. As long as Xu Fu was hungry, he could eat at any time. With one order, someone would rush to prepare food. Any dining rules were completely ineffective for Xu Fu.

As for Fusu and Huhai, partly because they had to learn some etiquette, they couldn't eat too much. Their two meals a day were fixed. But children were in the period of growing up, and now was the time when they could eat. Seeing food being brought to the table again, they couldn't help but eat some more.

Xu Fu ate relatively little; most of his stomach was filled with tonic soup.

After he and Fusu both stopped, they saw Huhai still stuffing things into his mouth, his small cheeks bulging, looking indescribably silly.

Xu Fu was a little worried.

Can he really learn divination and fortune-telling from him later like this? Moreover, Huhai's personality was much more lively than Fusu's. Fusu could sit quietly and recite to him, but would Huhai hold the bamboo slips and bite them?

"Hiccup!" Huhai covered his mouth, but the sound of the hiccup still leaked out from between his fingers.

Huhai didn't even blush. He put his hand down and looked at Xu Fu and then at Fusu with extreme innocence, "I'm full."

Xu Fu had a bit of a parent's worry. How much should a child this big eat?

He hesitated for a moment and asked Fusu, "Why don't you take Huhai out for a walk?"

Fusu suppressed the helplessness in his eyes and nodded, "Then Fusu will come to see Teacher in a while."

"Hmm, go ahead." Xu Fu waved his hand, watching their two small figures slowly move out of the palace.

It wasn't until they were far away that Xu Fu suddenly realized that his awareness as a parent was still not enough. In this situation, he should have been the one to take them out for a walk, but he had actually handed Huhai over to Fusu, almost out of habit, directly elevating Fusu to the level of an adult.

Just as Xu Fu was reflecting on himself, an attendant carefully stepped into the hall and whispered, "Master Xu, the King requests your presence."

Distracted by this, Xu Fu naturally cast all his thoughts aside. He had always been open-minded, only secretly thinking that Fusu taking care of Huhai like this would also cultivate brotherly love between the two and avoid them killing each other in the future, destroying Ying Zheng's hard work! The more he thought about it, the more Xu Fu felt that he was right not to interfere. Free-range parenting could also raise good children!

The not-at-all-qualified new father, Xu Fu, readily followed the attendant to Ying Zheng's side.

Ying Zheng was waiting for him in the hall where he handled state affairs. When Xu Fu entered, he caught a glimpse of two familiar figures in the hall. They were Meng Tian and Wei Liao.

The two of them stood on opposite sides, looking a bit like they didn't care for each other.

Xu Fu didn't quite understand what kind of grievance there could be between these two, so he simply withdrew his gaze and walked to Ying Zheng's side without squinting. The whole process was smooth and natural, as natural as it could be.

Wei Liao looked up at Xu Fu and sighed involuntarily.

Meng Tian, however, stared at Xu Fu for a while. In Dongjun, he could see Xu Fu almost all the time. After returning to Xianyang, General Meng Tian felt a little unaccustomed to it.

Seeing that Xu Fu had arrived, Ying Zheng said directly, "I have ordered Huan Yi to continue attacking the Zhao State."

Xu Fu nodded slightly. Was Ying Zheng going to talk about him accompanying the army? Having just returned to Xianyang, and now suddenly mentioning accompanying Huan Yi to attack Zhao, Xu Fu felt a bit at a loss, his gaze sticking to Ying Zheng involuntarily. If he left so soon, would the debt he owed keep accumulating?

A feeling of reluctance welled up in Xu Fu's heart.

Meng Tian couldn't help but say, "King, Meng Tian requests to go to battle."

Ying Zheng shook his head, "You and the Minister of War stay in Xianyang to manage the safety of Xianyang."

Xu Fu heard a different flavor in Ying Zheng's words... Was Ying Zheng also leaving Xianyang? Could it be that he was going with him?

"I will go with A-Fu to boost morale." Ying Zheng then revealed their arrangements.

The expression on Xu Fu's face relaxed quite a bit, "Good."

As for Meng Tian and Wei Liao, hearing Ying Zheng address Xu Fu like that, their expressions were a bit awkward.

Ying Zheng seemed unaware, continuing to show his intimacy with Xu Fu in front of these two. He turned his head and spoke to Xu Fu in a low voice, making Wei Liao and Meng Tian look redundant for a moment.

"The drought has just passed, and you were not in Xianyang during the Wax Sacrifice. After the Grand Nuo, I will take you to Pingyang. You have a great reputation in the Qin State now. Going out with me will surely gain more support and also put the people at ease."

"How long will the King be away this time?" Xu Fu thought of this first.

"I'm afraid it will take half a year." Ying Zheng sighed softly, "I want to inspect all the commanderies and counties of the Qin State. If everything is safe and sound, I will have more confidence in conscripting troops and fighting wars."

Only when the people of Qin live and work in peace and contentment can the logistics of the Qin State be worry-free. Xu Fu understood this truth, and he was also happy to go out with Ying Zheng. Apart from the fact that the carriages were not very good, it felt a bit like going on a trip.

"Good." Xu Fu replied, not even realizing that his gaze at Ying Zheng was full of "I'll listen to whatever you say."

Ying Zheng enjoyed this gaze from Xu Fu very much, which greatly satisfied his unspeakable desires.

He was powerful, but Xu Fu was not weak either. Being relied upon with such absolute trust by Xu Fu was truly the most beautiful feeling!

The two of them chatted in low voices for a long time. Meng Tian, who was below, couldn't stand it anymore and couldn't help but say, "King, Meng Tian is really not suitable to take over the safety of Xianyang City with the Minister of War. Please allow Meng Tian to accompany the army to battle."

"No need." Ying Zheng still rejected him ruthlessly, "Huan Yi is enough. Last year, the Qin State won a great victory, but a natural disaster occurred. This year, we will slow down and only attack the Zhao and Wei states. We don't need you to go out. You've already beaten the King of Wei back, haven't you had enough?"

Ying Zheng and Meng Tian had some friendship when they were young, so Ying Zheng teased Meng Tian a few words at this time.

Meng Tian's face turned red, but because his determined face had been tanned a bit dark from his trip to Dongjun, it wasn't very noticeable. However, Wei Liao was always good at observing people's facial expressions, and seeing Meng Tian like this, he knew that he was unhappy about dealing with him.

Wei Liao was dissatisfied and smiled, "King, please withdraw your order. The General and I are probably really hard to work together."

How could Ying Zheng take back what he had said?

He retorted lightly, "What is the Minister of War saying? General Meng has always admired the talent of the Minister of War. In the past, when the Minister of War wanted to leave Qin, it was General Meng who personally visited to beg the Minister of War to stay. It seems that the Minister of War and General Meng should have a deep friendship. I am most at ease with the two of you working together to guard Xianyang..."

Admire... work together... Xu Fu always felt that the words Ying Zheng used were really a bit subtle.

Meng Tian was a bit dazed when he heard this. The matter of him asking Wei Liao to stay seemed like it had been several years ago; he didn't remember it clearly. Since Wei Liao became the Minister of War, Meng Tian rarely interacted with him. To say there was any friendship between them was absolute nonsense. Back then, Wei Liao even wanted to kill him with his gaze!

So now, Wei Liao couldn't give him a good look when he saw him, and Meng Tian gradually stopped being pleasant to Wei Liao. Thus, the atmosphere between the two reached this point.

Anyone with a discerning eye could see that they didn't get along, but the King could actually lie with his eyes open...

Meng Tian sighed softly, secretly thinking, but the King was right. In the past, he really admired Wei Liao's great talent, which was why he spent so much effort trying to keep this person for the Qin State.

If he couldn't keep Wei Liao back then, he probably would have killed him. Fortunately... Wei Liao stayed, and he didn't kill him. Wei Liao was Master Xu's senior fellow apprentice after all. Meng Tian couldn't help but glance in Xu Fu's direction.

Ying Zheng felt a bit uncomfortable in his heart.

Ever since Xu Fu entered the hall, Meng Tian had been looking at him intentionally or unintentionally. They had only gone to Dongjun together, and Meng Tian's reaction had become so strange. It was hard for Ying Zheng not to think in a certain direction.

Wei Liao felt that Ying Zheng's words were really shameful; this was simply a humiliation from the past! Wei Liao gritted his teeth secretly, but his face was extremely calm, "Then so be it. Since my junior brother is going on a trip, I will go back and pack some things for him."

Xu Fu blinked.

He didn't live at Wei Liao's place, what could Wei Liao pack for him? Was Wei Liao... afraid of being poked in the lungs by Ying Zheng's words again and getting himself angry to death?

"I'll see my senior brother out." Anyway, the grudge of Wei Liao accusing Ying Zheng had been settled, and now Xu Fu would play the role of a loving junior brother. Ying Zheng was responsible for making people angry, and he was responsible for soothing them.

Xu Fu walked away from Ying Zheng's side and sent Wei Liao out.

As soon as they stepped out of the palace gate, Wei Liao couldn't help but say, "To what extent has the King indulged you? You have no rules at all by his side. If he no longer has feelings for you in the future, all of today's actions will become reasons for him to abandon you..."

"Hmm." Xu Fu replied lightly, clearly not taking it to heart.

Wei Liao felt even more uncomfortable.

Xu Fu noticed the expression on his face and whispered, "It's enough that I'm happy for now, why bother suppressing myself?" In fact, Xu Fu had really forgotten those etiquette rules. Ying Zheng never cared about this in front of him. Since that was the case, why should he keep remembering it and wronging himself? Fortunately, this era was not as strict with monarch-subject etiquette as later dynasties.

Wei Liao was left speechless by Xu Fu and could only close his mouth gloomily. The person who usually looked extremely sharp was a bit tired at this moment, and then he walked out of the palace quickly.

If the servants in the Minister of War's mansion saw this, they would definitely sigh again and say, "Poor Minister of War, he must be feeling empty, lonely, and cold again..."

Just after Wei Liao left, Meng Tian couldn't stay and quickly came out.

Xu Fu happened to run into him on his way back.

Meng Tian had a smile on his face, walked straight to Xu Fu, and asked, "Did Master Xu rest well yesterday?" Originally, Meng Tian asked this just out of concern, just like meeting in modern times and asking, "Have you eaten? What did you eat?"

Xu Fu blurted out, "Not very well." At this moment, the passionate scene with Ying Zheng last night was still flashing in his mind.

"How could it be not well?" Meng Tian didn't know the inside story and immediately became concerned, hurriedly asking a few more questions, "Did you see a physician? Was it because you were too tired on the way back to Xianyang?"

Xu Fu didn't expect him to be so concerned about his body, so he couldn't help but feel a bit awkward. He kept his distance from Meng Tian with a cold expression, "No need, I'll be fine after a rest."

Seeing that Xu Fu's answer was very brief, Meng Tian thought it was because he hadn't rested well, so he didn't pursue the questioning.

"General Meng Tian has been very busy in Dongjun, you should also have a good rest after returning." Xu Fu also asked out of casual concern.

The smile on Meng Tian's face thickened a bit, and looking at Xu Fu's outstanding face, he felt his heartbeat getting faster and faster.

Xu Fu didn't know how much impact his words had on the other person, and similarly, Meng Tian didn't notice the strangeness on Xu Fu at all, such as his demeanor like the master of the palace, and his tone of caring for subordinates on behalf of Ying Zheng...

Xu Fu turned to leave, and because the movement was a bit large, Meng Tian inadvertently caught a glimpse of the red mark on his neck.

Meng Tian was not a young boy anymore, so he naturally saw at a glance that it was a hickey.

Meng Tian suddenly felt a bit terrified.

He was not a stupid person. In this instant, those details he had ignored were quickly connected in his mind. By the time he came back to his senses and that guess clearly appeared in his mind, Xu Fu had already walked into the hall, and he could only vaguely see Xu Fu's back.

Slender and upright, cool yet alluring.

How could I have such thoughts about Master Xu?

Meng Tian's expression was a bit dazed. The impact he received in an instant was really too great. He had to turn around, quicken his pace, and walked out of the palace with a murderous aura.

Only he himself knew that at that moment, even lifting his legs seemed to have become a bit difficult.

After being blocked in his heart, it felt like it was weighed down by a thousand gold, extremely uncomfortable.

Meng Tian involuntarily thought of Xu Fu sitting up from the bed, his hair disheveled, his cool face mixed with a trace of laziness... Only the King was qualified to see this appearance... Meng Tian hid the complex emotions on his face. He always had a serious face, so even if he returned to the General's mansion like this, no one would suspect that anything was wrong.

But Meng Tian didn't expect that when he left the palace with a murderous aura, he was inadvertently seen by someone. As a result, the next day, the news that he was at odds with Wei Liao and had a big scene in front of the King of Qin, leaving unhappily, spread throughout Xianyang City...

Just at this time, in the palace, Fusu was kneeling in front of Ying Zheng, carefully observing his expression, and said, "Fusu wants to go with Father and Teacher to take a look at the territory of the Qin State."

Huhai, with a pastry in his mouth, turned his head blankly, raised his short arms, and blindly followed suit, "Huhai wants to go too."

Ying Zheng's face sank, "What do you want?"

Huhai turned to look at Xu Fu.

Huhai's small face, combined with his pitiful eyes, was still able to move Xu Fu's heart. So Xu Fu held Huhai's chubby little hand, played with it, and said, "If we take Young Master Fusu and Huhai, it is also feasible... What does the King think?"

If they left Fusu and Huhai behind again, these two children would almost become left-behind children.

If they were left in the huge palace, waiting for him and Ying Zheng to come home every day, that pitiful feeling—just thinking about it, Xu Fu felt that he and Ying Zheng couldn't be so irresponsible.

He and Ying Zheng already spent little time with these two children. If they spent even less, would the children who couldn't feel family love and care grow up even more crooked? It's not certain that in a few years, Huhai would enter a rebellious phase, doing whatever he was told not to do, and then killing his brother, killing his father, and finally destroying the Qin Dynasty.

This domino effect is very scary...

Ying Zheng frowned slightly, but he seriously considered Xu Fu's words. His direction of thinking was completely different from Xu Fu's. Fusu was bound to be his future successor. Staying in the palace all the time was definitely not the way. Even if he arranged the best teachers for Fusu, it would not be as good as the gains from experiencing reality. As the future Crown Prince, Fusu could not be trapped in Xianyang like a frog in a well.

He should take him out for a walk. Although such behavior would destroy his trip with Xu Fu.

As for Huhai...

"Then Fusu will go with us." Ying Zheng finally relented.

Fusu also breathed a sigh of relief.

Huhai tugged at Fusu's sleeve, "Brother, play..."

Because Xu Fu and Ying Zheng were on the side, Fusu was very patient and really went to play with Huhai.

The matter of this inspection was considered set in stone, with no changes.

Before leaving, Ying Zheng made careful deployments in Xianyang City to ensure that he would not easily make the same mistakes as before, and then the Qin State held the Grand Nuo.

Xu Fu held the ceremony in grand attire and was once again worshipped by ten thousand people. The people of Xianyang City almost gave Xu Fu absolute trust.

Wei Liao stood on the side and watched from afar, watching this junior brother who used to be extremely immature become more and more outstanding, excellent, and dazzling. Suddenly, Wei Liao realized that perhaps he really thought too much, and Ying Zheng might not abandon Xu Fu in the future.

Look, Xu Fu is worshipped by so many people, who dares to enjoy such a great ceremony?

Look again, so many people trust Xu Fu so much. Holding such an invisible power in his hands, it would be too easy to cause trouble in Xianyang City. Which monarch would dare to give his male favorite such an opportunity to deal with him?

Such a big hidden danger really doesn't look like something a smart person like the King of Qin would do.

Therefore, there is only one possibility: because the King of Qin knows the hidden dangers, but he is happy to hand over such great power to Xu Fu.

Wei Liao felt terrified by his own guess.

Can a person like the King of Qin... really talk about deep love?

The Grand Nuo ended quickly. Wei Liao collected his thoughts, but happened to meet Ying Zheng's gaze, a light glance, extremely majestic. For some reason, a strange thought suddenly rose in Wei Liao's heart.

His excellent junior brother seems to be the only one worthy of a man like Ying Zheng...

As for women, Wei Liao couldn't think of that at all.

·

In the 13th year of King Zheng of Qin, Huan Yi was ordered to attack Pingyang City in the Zhao State. The King of Qin packed his luggage and took Master Xu Fu with him, heading towards Pingyang City.

When Xu Fu and his party reached the city gate, an attendant rode over at full speed, "Master Xu, wait a moment..."

Because Ying Zheng was traveling low-key, the attendant didn't dare to call out "King" directly, so he only shouted for Xu Fu.

Xu Fu lifted the carriage curtain and looked out, "What's the matter, why so panicked?"

People around already noticed this direction. They looked at Xu Fu's face and let out bursts of exclamation. But out of awe for Xu Fu, they didn't dare to shout.

The attendant rarely lost his composure, and the panic on his face could hardly be hidden.

"Master Xu, just after you left, Young Master Huhai followed out. He fell heavily outside the palace and is now crying so hard that he can't catch his breath, and no one can coax him..." The attendant looked troubled.

Very few people in the palace knew that Huhai was not Ying Zheng's biological son. Now that they saw Huhai fall and cry uncontrollably, who would dare to let Huhai cry? If something happened to Young Master Huhai, they would just wait to be skinned and dismantled by the King and punished with severe penalties...

Xu Fu was stunned, and soon thought of the time when Huhai was not yet a year old, crying in the middle of the night and almost losing his life... Xu Fu could almost reconstruct the scene in his mind. Huhai cried as if he had been fished out of water. That soft body, curled up powerlessly, was so pitiful.

At this time, Fusu also poked his head out from inside. Fusu frowned even tighter and asked, "Is Huhai crying?"

The attendant nodded repeatedly, "Yes, he is even calling for Young Master Fusu."

Xu Fu and Fusu thought of Huhai, pitifully calling "Brother," almost at the same time.

Previously, Fusu had achieved his goal in front of Ying Zheng and directly threw Huhai to the back of his mind, not thinking at all about what Huhai's reaction would be if he left. Anyway, Huhai was young, and if they didn't take him, he probably wouldn't remember this, at most he would be sad for a while...

They all thought so, but forgot that such common sense didn't work on Huhai at all.

"Return to the palace." Ying Zheng had to speak.

The attendant was overjoyed and hurriedly turned the horse's head.

When they rushed back to the palace, they heard Huhai's almost hoarse crying before they even got close. He was crying so desperately...

Xu Fu's heart ached.

This was a completely different feeling from that time. That time he was just a bystander, but this time Xu Fu felt a bit heartbroken.

And Fusu's face changed faster than his. He almost strode in, took Huhai from the nurse's arms, and brought him out directly.

Xu Fu had calmed down by now. He whispered, "Prepare some medicine and food that Huhai can eat, and pack his clothes, and take them with us."

The palace attendants and servants were all stunned.

Ying Zheng said, "Do as Master Xu says." Ying Zheng's voice broke the stagnant atmosphere, and everyone woke up and hurriedly did as they were told.

Half an hour later, Huhai, tired from crying, lay in Xu Fu's arms, his brows knotted together, and his features became a bit wrinkled.

When they took the carriage out of Xianyang City again, there was an extra little bean in their carriage.

The accompanying attendants were very worried.

They were already under great pressure with Young Master Fusu, and now with an even younger young master, their faces really couldn't be happy.

But soon, their worries were broken.

Because Fusu and Huhai were really too easy to take care of. Huhai was young but didn't make trouble. Basically, one Fusu could handle him. On the contrary, during the journey, Xu Fu occasionally felt bored and would tease Huhai. Huhai became like a mascot in the motorcade.

Such a relaxed and interesting journey was really rare!

Even Ying Zheng didn't expect it.

Huhai didn't resist carriage life at all. He was different from Fusu. Fusu was precocious, and it was not surprising that he was used to carriage life, but how old was Huhai? He actually had no complaints, huddled beside Xu Fu and Fusu all day, and occasionally was picked up by Ying Zheng to play, and he could still giggle.

Just like this, slowly, they were like a family of four out for a spring outing, leisurely arriving at Pingyang City.

The army led by Huan Yi was stationed twenty miles outside the city.

Perhaps the Zhao army had been bullied by the Qin army too much. When they fought to Pingyang City, the Zhao army in Pingyang City was instead aroused with some bloodiness. Coupled with the good defense of Pingyang City itself, Huan Yi had not been able to capture it easily. After receiving the news that Ying Zheng was coming, Huan Yi was very uneasy, worried that Ying Zheng would blame him.

Finally, this day arrived...

Huan Yi heard that the King had arrived, so he hurriedly took people to welcome him personally.

A group of generals and soldiers waited carefully at the intersection. Soon after, they finally saw... a carriage. The carriage arrived slowly. Huan Yi thought that the journey was long, and even the horses were extremely tired. Huan Yi's brain turned rapidly, thinking about how to relieve the King's fatigue.

At this time, the carriage curtain was lifted, and a person came down first, wearing a white robe, hair loose, temperament noble, and the face was indescribably handsome! What a look!

Huan Yi quickly matched this person with the name in his mind and hurriedly stepped forward and smiled, "Master Xu, where is the King?"

Xu Fu pointed to the carriage, turned around, and held Huhai in his arms first.

Everyone was stunned when they saw this.

What's going on? Wasn't it said that the King was inside? How did he turn around and hold a baby out? At that moment, everyone thought their brains had problems, or their eyes had problems.

They carefully looked at the child in Xu Fu's arms, seeing that the child had a delicate and well-behaved face, only clutching Xu Fu's sleeve tightly, not saying a word. They were anxious and couldn't guess the child's identity, and at the same time felt extremely strange.

Why bring a child of a few years old to the battlefield? But thinking that this might be the King's handiwork, they didn't dare to complain.

The carriage curtain moved again, and everyone's heart was in their throats, thinking that they could finally see the King now.

They were all ready to kneel and kowtow. Who knew that just as their knees were half bent, a little boy jumped out, less than ten years old, dressed in luxury, with a handsome face, and his brows and eyes somewhat resembled the King. Everyone swallowed their saliva involuntarily, and they all had a guess in their hearts.

Only then did Ying Zheng slowly come out of the carriage.

Everyone had just been stimulated, and now that Ying Zheng had really come out, they couldn't react in time, forgot to kowtow, and could only bow immediately to make up for it.

And Ying Zheng glanced at Huan Yi lightly, "Arrange a camp for me first, I will be with Master Xu."

Huan Yi nodded and hurriedly said, "King, the camp is already prepared, but..." Huan Yi looked at Xu Fu, feeling a bit conflicted in his heart, but no strange color appeared on his face. He had also heard many rumors about this Master Xu, saying that he had become a male favorite by the King's side.

But was it appropriate for this person to share a camp with the King? Not to mention Young Master Fusu was there!

Ying Zheng didn't know the twists and turns in Huan Yi's heart. He nodded and said, "Lead the way, I will go and take a look with Master Xu."

Seeing Ying Zheng speak, mentioning Master Xu everywhere, Huan Yi immediately understood that if he arranged another place for Master Xu, he would probably not get a reputation for being considerate, and it was more likely to incur the King's dissatisfaction.

The group had no time for small talk, and no time to show their faces in front of Ying Zheng. In a short time, Huan Yi led them directly to the prepared camp.

Ying Zheng scanned it roughly, just wanted to say "This is good," but finally stopped abruptly. He turned to look at Xu Fu, his brows and eyes softened involuntarily, and asked, "What do you think of this place?"

"Very good." Xu Fu was not a picky person, so he nodded immediately.

Huhai yawned lazily in his arms and called "Brother." Fusu opened his arms to Xu Fu and said, "Teacher, give Huhai to me."

Xu Fu's arms were a bit tired from holding him, so he bent down and handed Huhai to Fusu.

And the others on the side were almost stunned.

So this child was also the King's son!

Then it could only be Young Master Huhai, the second son born to the Hu woman! It had long been heard that the King attached great importance to his heirs, personally taking Fusu and Huhai to his side, placing them next to his own bedroom, and teaching them hand in hand...

These three were almost the most noble figures in the Qin State...

They were actually concentrated in one camp!

Everyone felt that their breathing was about to become unsmooth.

And Huan Yi considered first that so many precious figures... how could their safety be maintained? Huan Yi sighed heavily in his heart. This is a trouble.

Ying Zheng beckoned Huan Yi to his side, "How is the situation now?"

As far as Huan Yi's eyes could see, he caught a glimpse of Xu Fu, Fusu, and Huhai all looking at him. Huan Yi, a great general who had fought countless battles, was actually a bit nervous.

“……一切听从仲父吩咐。”
徐福从来没有听到过嬴政语气如此温和的时候，他转头看了一眼赵高，有些犹豫自己应不应该在这个时候进去。但赵高却面色平淡，脚下不带一丝停顿地往里走了，徐福也只能跟上。
走进殿内。
嬴政并没有如往常一样坐在案前释放着自己的王者霸气。相反的，他将自身的气息收敛了个干干净净。虽然还是一身黑色常服尽显贵气，但相比之下，他现在看上去就仅仅只像是个贵公子了。尤其是当他露出强压少年意气的笑容时，不免让人觉得他是个没有心机城府的人。
秦始皇会没有心机城府吗？
当然不可能！
只是因为他对面的人比较特殊罢了。
徐福微微一转头，便看到了嬴政面前站着的中年男子，面孔威严，站在嬴政面前佯装高贵。
正是吕不韦。
吕不韦竟然上身也着黑袍，而下身则着红裳，穿得恍然就跟秦国王室一个规格了。这野心实在是够昭然若揭的啊！
恐怕他更想穿的还是嬴政身上的袍子吧。不过么，以吕不韦那身高，哪怕是穿着龙袍那也不像太子啊。光是气质，嬴政就足够将他甩到天边去。
徐福暗自心惊，光是这样的小小细节，便足以见吕不韦的嚣张。吕不韦以“仲父”自居，他还真的将自己当成嬴政的老爹了。看这老爹教训儿子的做派。
啧啧……
就在徐福看吕不韦的时候，吕不韦也注意到了他，若不是徐福容貌太过鲜明，见之难忘，吕不韦也不会想起他是谁。
“这等小官，怎能入殿来？”吕不韦皱了皱眉，转头便斥责赵高，“赵高，如今什么人也能带进殿内来吗？王上不知事便罢了，难道你也能如此不知事，丝毫不将王上放在眼中吗？”
徐福有点惊讶，连见礼都忘记做了。
这是什么套路？吕不韦在挑拨嬴政和赵高？还是在借赵高讽刺嬴政势弱？
太费脑子，徐福觉得自己有点看不懂。
而赵高的反应也超出了徐福的理解。
赵高马上跪地请罪，脸上的表情分明带着不忿和不屑。
吕不韦脸上的笑容隐隐浓了几分，只是嘴里依旧责怪道：“王上可万万不能纵容这等小人啊，臣这便先行离开了。”他端足了仲父的姿态，享受尽了在王宫里挞伐的快感，这才准备离开。
而离开前，吕不韦还冷飕飕地瞥了一眼徐福。
徐福被瞥得一脸莫名其妙。
真的只能怪徐福这张脸生得太好，别说胡姬了，现在看见徐福出现在殿内，吕不韦也只当是秦王年纪轻，想要尝一尝别般滋味，就看中了徐福，将他纳为男宠了。不然的话，徐福凭什么能站在这里呢？吕不韦对徐福的出现很高兴。嬴政越是无能昏聩，他才更好掌控嬴政。
等走到殿外，吕不韦已经毫不掩饰地露出了得意的笑容。
之前有门客向他说秦王政羽翼渐丰，要多加防范，如今看来，就是个笑话。误宠小人，后宫被赵姬把持，喜好美色，身边宦官还嚣张……嬴政能有什么出息？
吕不韦离开之后，嬴政这才缓缓地走到了案前坐下，而赵高也从地上迅速爬了起来。徐福顿时明白了一点，刚才这对主仆是一齐在演戏，不管他们是想营造出什么形象，肯定都是为了让吕不韦降低戒心，对嬴政更为不屑。只有这样，年少隐忍的雄才帝王，才能在后面一蹴而起。
徐福却疏漏了一点。
嬴政为什么会让他目睹这一幕？为什么会让他知道这么多？知道越多死得越快，这句话完全没被徐福放在心中。
他微微躬身，递上竹简。原本他是打算在嬴政面前直接张嘴说日期的，但是后面几天等不来赵高，他就抽空整理了一下资料，竹简上，引瞎凑），旁征博引（瞎编），写出了这篇论文用以佐证自己选出的吉日。
嬴政没想到徐福做得这样详细，他简单翻阅了一下，倒是有些惊讶。
说实话，徐福总是张口就来的那破脾性，总会给人不靠谱的感觉，嬴政都做好准备听他张口胡扯了。
“你认为九月三日最合适？”嬴政挑了挑眉。
不知道是不是之前面对吕不韦的态度还没能瞬间改变过来，嬴政脸上还带着两分笑意。徐福一见他的表情，顿时心里更有底了，点点头，“九月三日，青龙值日，无风无雨，宜出行，宜冠笄，宜祭祀……”
原本测算吉日中还有个冲煞的说法，但是徐福又不知道嬴政八字，他也没资格去询问，当然这一项就被免去了。反正徐福觉得，嬴政龙气笼罩，紫气升腾，这样一个得上天眷顾的人，怎么可能那么不走运就撞上倒霉事儿呢？
嬴政听过之后点了点头，随后招来赵高，“将东西给他。”
赵高拱手又送了一个竹简到徐福的手中，徐福打开一看，发现上面竟然是有关吉日测算的信息，而且写得比他要详细多了。不过中间的观点能明显看出，是几人共同写出来的。徐福有点不高兴了，你让小爷算了，还让别人算？搞半天，是你忽悠我呢。
“这是太史、太卜、太祝共同推算出来的日期，你瞧日期以为如何呢？”嬴政端起手边的杯盏，神色清冷漠然，语气也十分的寡淡。不愧是未来要做的千古一帝的人，哪怕是不动声色，也能彰显出自己的气势来。
“九月九日，也算是吉日。但是……”徐福将手伸出宽大的袖袍，掐指算了起来。
嬴政的目光不自觉地跟随着他的手指动了起来。
徐福手指纤长白皙，但是指头却微微红肿，似乎还带着伤口。嬴政联想到之前赵高所说，徐福在奉常寺遭人嫉恨的事情，心里竟然有些怒意。难道徐福被人欺负得无法招架了？他这个太史令都被打发去做苦活儿了？
徐福不知道嬴政的注意力全在自己手指上，一会儿后，他合上手指，收回袖袍内。
嬴政的目光顿时没了着落点，莫名觉得一分遗憾。
“九月九日，的确是有好预兆，但也是有讲究的。九日，二十八星宿北官玄武当值，玄武危室，为月为燕，为北方第五星宿。危者，高而险也。又有虚危室壁震雷惊的说法。所以这日应当是灾祸多过吉兆。稍有不慎，北方便有危祸，大事恐将不成。”
“北方吗？”嬴政的脸上竟然浮现了几丝兴味，“取堪舆图来。”
宫人连忙奉上。
嬴政瞥了一眼，“北方，寡人加冠的旧都雍城，不是便在北方吗？”

"...... Everything shall be as Zhongfu (Second Father) commands."

Xu Fu had never heard Ying Zheng speak in such a gentle tone. He glanced sideways at Zhao Gao, hesitating whether he should enter at this moment. However, Zhao Gao's expression remained calm, and without a single pause in his stride, he walked inside, leaving Xu Fu with no choice but to follow.

Stepping into the hall,

Ying Zheng was not sitting at his desk radiating his royal dominance as he usually did. Instead, he had completely restrained his aura. Although he was still dressed in the black casual attire that reeked of nobility, by comparison, he now looked merely like a young nobleman. Especially when he flashed a smile that forcefully suppressed his youthful vigor, it was hard not to feel that he was a person devoid of scheming or political depth.

Could Emperor Qin Shi Huang possibly lack scheming and political depth?

Of course impossible!

It was simply because the person sitting opposite him was rather special.

Xu Fu turned his head slightly and saw a middle-aged man standing before Ying Zheng, his face stern as he feigned nobility right in front of the king.

It was none other than Lü Buwei.

Lü Buwei actually wore a black robe on his upper body and a red skirt on his lower body, dressed practically to the exact specifications of the Qin royal family. This ambition was truly brazen enough!

Perhaps what he wanted to wear even more was the robe on Ying Zheng's body. However, given Lü Buwei's height, even if he wore a dragon robe, he wouldn't look like the crown prince. Just in terms of sheer presence, Ying Zheng was enough to leave him miles behind.

Xu Fu was inwardly alarmed; even such minor details were enough to show Lü Buwei's arrogance. Lü Buwei styled himself as "Zhongfu," truly taking himself for Ying Zheng's actual father. Just look at this father's demeanor in disciplining his son.

Tsk tsk...

Just as Xu Fu was observing Lü Buwei, Lü Buwei also noticed him. Had Xu Fu's appearance not been too striking and unforgettable at first glance, Lü Buwei wouldn't even have remembered who he was.

"How can such a lowly official enter the hall?" Lü Buwei frowned, turned his head, and rebuked Zhao Gao, "Zhao Gao, can any casual person be brought into the hall nowadays? It's one thing that the King is young and ignorant, but could you also be so clueless and show not the slightest regard for the King in your eyes?"

Xu Fu was somewhat surprised, even forgetting to offer a greeting.

What kind of routine was this? Was Lü Buwei driving a wedge between Ying Zheng and Zhao Gao? Or was he using Zhao Gao to satirize Ying Zheng's weakness?

It was too brain-consuming; Xu Fu felt he couldn't quite understand.

And Zhao Gao's reaction also exceeded Xu Fu's comprehension.

Zhao Gao immediately dropped to his knees to plead guilty, though the expression on his face clearly carried resentment and disdain.

The smile on Lü Buwei's face deepened faintly, though his mouth still chided, "The King must on no account indulge such base individuals; this minister will take his leave first." Having fully put on the airs of a Second Father and thoroughly enjoyed the thrill of lording over the royal palace, he prepared to take his leave.

Before leaving, Lü Buwei also cast a chilling glance at Xu Fu.

Xu Fu was left utterly baffled by the glare.

Truly, one could only blame Xu Fu for having a face that was far too attractive. Leaving aside foreign beauties, seeing Xu Fu appear in the hall now, Lü Buwei simply assumed that the King of Qin was young and wanted to taste a different flavor, thus taking a fancy to Xu Fu and making him a male favorite. Otherwise, by what right could Xu Fu be standing here? Lü Buwei was quite pleased with Xu Fu's presence. The more incompetent and muddle-headed Ying Zheng was, the easier it would be for him to control the King.

Once outside the hall, Lü Buwei unreservedly revealed a smug smile.

Previously, retainers had told him that King Zheng of Qin's wings were growing full and that he needed to be heavily guarded against; looking at it now, that was an absolute joke. Indulging base minions, having the inner palace controlled by Lady Zhao, being fond of beauty, and having arrogant eunuchs around... What kind of future could Ying Zheng possibly have?

After Lü Buwei left, Ying Zheng slowly walked over to his desk and sat down, while Zhao Gao quickly scrambled up from the floor. Xu Fu instantly understood a thing or two: the master and servant just now had been acting out a scene together. Regardless of what image they wanted to project, it was certainly intended to lower Lü Buwei's guard and make him hold Ying Zheng in even greater contempt. Only by doing this could the young, forbearing, and ambitious monarch rise up all at once in the future.

Yet Xu Fu had overlooked one point.

Why would Ying Zheng let him witness this scene? Why would he let him know so much? The saying "the more you know, the faster you die" completely failed to cross Xu Fu's mind.

He bowed slightly and handed over the bamboo slips. Originally, he had planned to just blurt out the date directly in front of Ying Zheng, but when Zhao Gao failed to show up for the next few days, he took some time to organize his materials. On the bamboo slips, he used far-fetched reasoning and quoted wildly (fabricated things) to write this thesis supporting the auspicious day he had chosen.

Ying Zheng hadn't expected Xu Fu to be so thorough. After skimming through it briefly, he was somewhat surprised.

To be honest, Xu Fu's habitual tendency to blurt things out carelessly always gave people an unreliable impression, and Ying Zheng had already prepared himself to listen to him spout nonsense.

"You think the third day of the ninth month is the most suitable?" Ying Zheng raised an eyebrow.

Perhaps because he hadn't yet instantly shaken off the attitude he had maintained facing Lü Buwei, a trace of a smile still lingered on Ying Zheng's face. The moment Xu Fu caught his expression, he felt even more confident and nodded, "The third day of the ninth month, the Azure Dragon is on duty, no wind and no rain, auspicious for travel, auspicious for the capping ceremony, auspicious for sacrifices..."

Originally, calculating an auspicious day also involved the concept of astrological clashes, but since Xu Fu didn't know Ying Zheng's Eight Characters of birth and wasn't qualified to ask, this item was naturally omitted. Anyway, Xu Fu felt that with Ying Zheng shrouded in dragon aura and soaring purple vapor, how could someone favored by the heavens possibly be so unlucky as to run into bad luck?

Hearing this, Ying Zheng nodded, then summoned Zhao Gao, "Give the thing to him."

Zhao Gao cupped his hands and handed another bamboo slip into Xu Fu's hands. Upon opening it, Xu Fu discovered that it actually contained information regarding the calculation of auspicious dates, and it was written much more detailed than his own. However, one could clearly see from the core arguments in the middle that it had been co-authored by multiple people. Xu Fu was somewhat displeased: you asked me to calculate it, yet you still had others calculate it too? After all this time, you were playing me for a fool.

"This is a date jointly deduced by the Grand Historian, the Grand Diviner, and the Grand Prayer Master. How do you view this date?" Ying Zheng picked up the cup beside his hand, his expression cold and aloof, his tone extremely bland. As expected of someone destined to be an eternal emperor through the ages, even while remaining entirely calm, he could still manifest his imposing momentum.

"The ninth day of the ninth month is also considered an auspicious day. But..." Xu Fu extended his hand out of his wide sleeve and began pinching his fingers to calculate.

Ying Zheng's gaze involuntarily followed the movement of his fingers.

Xu Fu's fingers were slender and fair, yet the fingertips were slightly red and swollen, seemingly still bearing wounds. Reminded of what Zhao Gao had said earlier about Xu Fu being targeted with jealousy at the Bureau of Fengchang, a trace of anger actually welled up in Ying Zheng's heart. Could it be that Xu Fu was being bullied to the point of being unable to defend himself? That even he, a Grand Historian, had been relegated to doing grueling labor?

Unaware that all of Ying Zheng's attention was focused on his fingers, Xu Fu closed his hand a moment later and withdrew it back into his sleeve.

Ying Zheng's gaze instantly lost its landing point, inexplicably feeling a sense of disappointment.

"The ninth day of the ninth month indeed has good omens, but it also comes with complications. On the ninth day, the Black Tortoise of the Northern Palace among the Twenty-Eight Mansions is on duty; the Tortoise is at the Danger and Room lodges, representing the moon and the swallow, and is the fifth northern mansion. 'Danger' implies towering and perilous. There is also the saying that Danger, Room, and Wall bring roaring thunder and startling shocks. Therefore, this day should have more disasters than auspicious omens. If one is even slightly careless, the North will suffer perils and disasters, and major undertakings are likely to fail."

"The North?" A trace of intrigued interest unexpectedly surfaced on Ying Zheng's face, "Fetch the terrain map."

The palace attendants hurriedly presented it.

Ying Zheng glanced at it, "The North—isn't Yongcheng, the former capital where I underwent my capping ceremony, located in the North?"

赵军龟缩城中不出，桓齮使尽了手段，也没办法将这乌龟壳破开，长驱直入占据平阳邑。
桓齮征战经验并不少，因而眼下虽然陷入困境，但他却不惊慌，还能稳坐帐中调兵遣将，并沉下心来，细细与手下演练阵法。
嬴政信任他的本事，不然也不会将这个差事交付于他了。
此时听嬴政问起情况，桓齮毫不隐瞒，据实禀告，因为说到了打仗一事上，他总算没有刚才那般拘束了。
扶苏站在一旁，仰着头听得一脸认真，而胡亥也有样学样，仰着头，一脸蠢。
徐福本来对行兵打仗也没甚兴趣，干脆就撩起帷帐，大步走了出去，想要先将这个驻扎地熟悉一遍，免得再像之前那样，稀里糊涂便被刺客绑架了。
军中士兵有些人听过他的名头，但毕竟只是听说他如何厉害，如何玄妙，活生生将他吹成了一个能呼风唤雨的神仙人物。如今见着真人，士兵们不可否认这位徐奉常的俊美，但他们却难以相信，这个瞧上去纤弱的美人儿，真的有那么厉害？
会不会是鼓吹过头的结果？
士兵们看向徐福的目光里，掩不住轻视之色。
徐福视若无睹，他挥手叫来一名士兵，士兵慌慌忙忙收起脸上外露的表情，快步走到了徐福的身边，“您有何吩咐？”
“带我在军中走一走……”
还不待徐福将话说完，士兵就连忙出声拒绝了，“不不不……这不行的，军中不能随意行走……”
正好此时扶苏掀起帷帐也出来了，他见着徐福的身影，一愣，“原来老师在这里，老师是觉得帐子里无聊了些吗？不如扶苏陪老师走一走？”扶苏心思细腻，发现徐福不见后就立刻跟了出来，他小小年纪却带着大人口吻，像是要哄徐福一样。
他来陪自己走一走？徐福觉得有些好笑，但是对上扶苏那张小脸，心头莫名觉得暖了暖。
那士兵顿时紧张不已，生怕徐福因为自己刚才的拒绝，在扶苏公子跟前告上一状。
其他人面色也跟着紧张了起来，不由为这士兵捏了一把汗。
士兵结结巴巴道：“扶苏公子要在营地里走一走吗？”
面对士兵的时候，扶苏的姿态顿时就变了，孺慕和柔和从他的脸上消失，只剩下属于王室的贵气和冷傲，这与徐福脑子里所认为的扶苏形象，实在有几分不符。但是不得不说，徐福觉得扶苏这个模样，实在气势十足，颇有嬴政的风范。
“带路。”扶苏简洁地吐出两个字。
明明跟前站着的只是个不足十岁的孩子，但士兵还是感觉到了压迫感，他不自觉地将腰躬得更深了一些，憋了半天，只说了一个字，“请。”谁都能拦，但王上的儿子敢拦吗？整个秦国都是他爹的，巡视个营地算什么？
但扶苏却没有立即迈出步子，而是先攀住了徐福的手腕，跟着徐福一起，慢慢前行。
士兵面色臊红，小心地瞥了一眼徐福，确认他并没有露出不满之色后，才稍稍松了口气。
不过这时候，营地内的士兵们对于这位徐奉常的地位，又有了一个全新的认识，并且暗暗在心里默念了几句，一定不能得罪了徐奉常。
能得秦国王室的青睐，又掌着一个奉常寺，还受百姓追捧，这样的人……就算他们并没有亲眼见到，他身上的本事应该也是毋庸置疑的。
营地算不上有多大，但他们驻扎的地方足够广阔，徐福和扶苏二人在周围走了一圈下来，已经是一个多时辰以后了，他们的身后跟着小心翼翼的士兵及侍从，时刻注意着他们的脸色，一旦徐福和扶苏稍有不满，他们就要体贴地上前询问。
徐福望着远处连绵的山脉，感觉到了一阵酸痛，疲倦的感觉渐渐蔓延了全身。
毕竟今日刚到营地，他们都还没来得及休息，再走上一个多时辰，尽管只是慢悠悠地晃一会儿，也令人觉得难以忍受了。
“走吧，回去吧，时辰也差不多了。”
“嗯。”扶苏应了一声。
听见他稚嫩的声音，徐福突然反应过来，自己尚且觉得疲倦了，扶苏年纪还小，他岂不是更加疲累？也不知道他的腿会有多酸痛！徐福不自觉地皱了皱眉，顿时意识到自己果然缺乏与孩子相处的经验。
徐福微微弯腰，捏了捏扶苏的腿。
扶苏瞬间瞪大了眼，脸颊上飞速蹿过两抹薄红，还不自觉地结巴了一下，“老、老师？”
扶苏常年见到的都是徐福冷傲的模样，实在太少见到徐福弯下笔直的背脊了，徐福突如其来的举动，让他有点儿受宠若惊的感觉。
扶苏的目光有些飘忽，他一直觉得，在老师的眼中就只能看进去一个父王的。就算平时老师对他和胡亥多有照拂，但还不如说是因为父王的缘故，才对他们上心了一些，许多关照爱护都只是随手做的。
徐福可不知道扶苏在想什么，他又稍微用力捏了捏扶苏的腿，扶苏毫不设防，发出“咝”的一声，然后双腿一软，如果不是徐福做好了准备，将顺手捞住，他就摔倒在地上了。
身后的士兵和侍从们慌忙上前，“扶苏公子？”
“腿酸难受，为什么不说？”徐福眉头微皱，手却没有立即放开。
扶苏小声道：“扶苏不能破坏老师的兴致。”他的脸颊微微泛红，看上去有了点小孩儿的样子。
什么兴致？又不是来春游的，本来只是为了将四周环境收入眼底而已，并不急在这一时，哪有兴致可破坏？
徐福突然觉得自己的手指有些蠢蠢欲动，于是他冷着脸，装作极为自然的，抬起手，掐了一把扶苏的脸颊，“实话实说，才是好孩子。”扶苏一直绷着大人的模样，不会觉得累吗？以前徐福是真讨厌熊孩子，师门里收养的师弟师妹都难获得他一个关注的眼神。但是像扶苏这样乖巧到极点，甚至处处为长辈考量的模样，又让他反倒心疼起来了。
徐福的脑子里飞快地溜走了一个想法。
就好像他幼年的时候一样……
这句话飞快地掠过，没有在徐福的脑子里留下痕迹，他很快将注意力重新挪到了扶苏的身上。
“要我抱你回去吗？”
扶苏听得心惊胆战，连忙拒绝了，“老师，不用了。”等老师将他抱回去，他就等着被父王扔出去吧。
原本想要好好补偿扶苏，做个好家长的徐福有些失望。
侍从适当地插入了声音，“公子劳累，我来背公子回去吧。”
扶苏面上露出了犹豫之色。
徐福看了他一眼，几乎是瞬间就想到了扶苏的心思。扶苏心思太过玲珑了，他肯定在想，被侍从背着回去，会不会在嬴政面前落下个太娇气的印象。徐福暗暗摇头，想着一定要将这事儿跟嬴政提一提。随后他收起思绪，直接吩咐那名侍从将扶苏背了起来。扶苏这下拒绝不能，就只能停在侍从的背上，任他带着自己健步如飞了。
短短一段对话结束，却让那些跟随的士兵更为心惊了。
连王上的儿子，在这徐奉常的面前，都如同普通的小辈一样……
之前阻拦过徐福的那个士兵，此时已经悔不当初了。
他们回到营帐中去的时候，桓齮已经带着手下离开了，胡亥歪歪倒倒地靠在床榻上，已经酣然入睡了。只有嬴政端坐在桌案之前，手边摆放着桓齮送来的竹简。
徐福掀起帷帐走进去，借着帐外漏进去的光，他就瞥见了嬴政冰冷的侧脸。
不过冰冷也就是一瞬间的，嬴政抬起头瞥见他以后，五官都跟着变得柔和了许多。
“饿不饿？”嬴政出声问。因为侍从走在后面，嬴政倒是第一时间将他儿子给忘了。
“饿了。”徐福一边说着一边转身，动作自然地将扶苏从侍从的背上接了下来。
嬴政看见他的动作，不由得微微挑眉，随即大步上前，将扶苏从徐福的手里夺了过来。扶苏年纪不算小了，抱着他可一点也不轻，徐福抱个胡亥都有几分吃力，更别说扶苏了，嬴政当然不舍得让徐福受累。
扶苏一脸就知道会如此的表情，哪怕嬴政将他拎得有点勒，他也半句话都没说。
不久之后有人送来了食物，比起王宫里的食物还要更为粗糙，不过徐福也没什么可挑剔，三个人围坐在一起，迅速消灭掉了食物。与在王宫时全然不同。
扶苏不自觉地打了个饱嗝，他抬手捂了捂嘴。
徐福和嬴政都看向了他。徐福真没想到扶苏还会有吃撑的时候……毕竟扶苏平时在吃食上是极为克制的，克制得不像个孩子。
扶苏有些羞窘地放下了手。他居然学了胡亥的蠢动作！
嬴政面上的笑意明显了一些，他和徐福一样喜欢扶苏的乖顺，但是又担心他的太过乖顺，他和郑妃一起住时，养成了这样的性子，有好有坏，适时的放纵至少能让纾解一下心中的抑郁面。
嬴政的目光动了动，落在徐福的脸上。
“看我做什么？”徐福压住打呵欠的冲动，反问嬴政。
“觉得你比寡人更像个好父亲。”
扶苏非常捧场地在旁边道：“是的。”
嬴政瞥了他一眼，突然出声，“阿福，不如你将扶苏也认作儿子？”
“嗯？”徐福有些错愕。胡亥可以认作儿子没关系，因为胡亥并非嬴政亲子，而且地位摆在那里，他以后不会成为嬴政的继承人。但扶苏是什么身份？给他做儿子？嬴政怎么突然想起这样说了。
扶苏也笑眯眯地道：“好呀。”
嬴政盯着徐福。
扶苏也盯着他。
徐福被两人盯得有些发毛，“嗯，这样不会惹来非议？”
不待嬴政开口，扶苏已经先笑了，“以老师和父王现在的关系，本来也算作是扶苏的父亲了，该有的非议也早就有了。”
惊讶褪去过后，徐福就恢复了镇定，“那叫声‘父亲’来听听。”
扶苏立马出声，“父亲。”
床榻上的胡亥似有所感，他翻了个滚儿，迷迷糊糊也跟着叫了声“父亲”。
白捡两儿子的徐福，心中隐隐有什么情绪在翻滚。
其实……还是挺划算的，白捡一个秦始皇，再附赠两个儿子，而这两个儿子也不是什么简单人物，都是史书上赫赫有名的两位公子。徐福的眼眸里漾开了两分喜色。
嬴政看着他的模样，顿时有些心猿意马。
扶苏非常识相地站起了身，顺带还将睡得满面口水的胡亥打包带了出去。
外面的士兵见他出来，忙问道：“扶苏公子有何吩咐？”
“给我另外备个营帐。”他可不敢打扰父王的性福生活。
徐福有些困顿，拉过嬴政的臂膀，舒舒服服地靠了上去，没有人在跟前的徐福，褪去了他清冷的伪装，这点让嬴政觉得心头格外的舒爽。每当这种时候，他的占有欲就得到了极大的满足。
嬴政将徐福搂在怀里，下巴搁在他的额头上，两个人都懒洋洋地靠着休息了会儿。
很快，天色渐渐暗沉下来，他们才洗漱一番上了床榻。原本徐福脑子里还记得那个三十次，但是一沾上床榻，困倦就席卷了他，嬴政倒是兴致勃勃，但是等他的手滑进徐福的深衣，徐福半点反应也没有，目光往上挪一挪，就只能看见徐福双眼紧闭，轻轻呼吸的模样了。嬴政只能干脆揽住徐福的腰身，紧紧和他贴合在一起，也闭目睡了起来。
他们要睡个懒觉，谁也不敢来打扰，待到二人睡足以后起身，十分神清气爽。
徐福倒是还真有了几分出来旅游的感觉。
嬴政与桓齮等人谈事的时候，徐福就独自在营地里晃荡，偶尔带上扶苏或胡亥。
很快，桓齮率军再次对平阳发动了进攻，这一夜灯火未熄，哪怕是在帐中，也能隐隐听见远处的喊杀声。扶苏和胡亥都待在了营帐中，扶苏面色镇定，胡亥刚开始抓紧了扶苏的袖袍，扶苏的袖子都被抓得皱巴巴的了，胡亥才松开，再之后胡亥也变得轻松了起来。这两个小孩儿的适应力实在够强。
徐福担心无聊，命人做了个简陋古代七巧板出来，然后扔给扶苏，让他陪着胡亥一块儿玩了。
徐福和嬴政则是倚在床榻边上，翻动着手中的书简，各自看得入迷，倒是和在王宫时没有什么区别。
扶苏玩了一会儿，忍不住问道：“父王，桓齮将军带兵攻城，父王为何不亲自督战呢？”
嬴政连头也未抬，淡淡道：“督战带兵乃是桓齮该做的事，寡人为何要插手？身为君王，不是事事都要亲自去做的。”
徐福也才骤然想起，这几日虽然嬴政都有过问出战的事，但他却从未插手过桓齮的任何决定，包括战术上也很少给出自己的意见，他始终在营地里做着高高在上的秦王，士兵们不敢轻易来打扰他，心怀敬畏，但同样的，军中的将领和士兵也松了一口气。毕竟正是这样的王上，没有带给他们过分的压力，可以让他们保持平常心态，更有自信地出战。
徐福心跳突然变得快了一些，他不自觉地转头看了嬴政一眼，总觉得这一刻仿佛尽在掌控的嬴政，身上迸发出的睥睨傲气，让他觉得有点迷醉的感觉。
徐福不自在地收起了目光，尽力将心神都放在面前的竹简上，但是这样却并没有什么效果，他的眼前还是不住地浮现着嬴政的模样，耳边仿佛还能听见嬴政低沉的声音，轻轻地抚弄过耳膜，带来让人难以抵抗的惑人感。
徐福轻咳一声，动作有些粗暴地合上了竹简，一股脑儿塞进了身旁嬴政的怀中，随后便挪动身体，往下滑了滑，露出倦色道：“我有些困了。”
嬴政见状立即收起了竹简，将侍从叫了进来，“送扶苏公子和胡亥公子回去。”
“喏。”侍从小心地将胡亥从地上抱起，送着二人离开。
正巧这时桓齮也收兵回营了，他翻身下马，走到营帐外求见嬴政，却被侍从拦住了，“将军请明日再来吧。”
桓齮不敢硬闯，只能先回去了。
帐中的徐福听见了声音，低声问道：“你说这场仗，结果如何？”
“不输不赢。”嬴政淡淡道，声音里带着肯定的味道，他很相信自己给出的结果。
“你怎么知道？”徐福将被子往上拢了拢，”难道王上也学会卜卦了吗？”虽然徐福的面色没有什么变化，但后面一句分明带着几分调侃的意味。
“寡人自然知道。”嬴政将竹简放置好，陪着徐福一起拢在了被子里。
徐福的目光不自觉地在嬴政脸庞上打了个转儿。
徐福靠在嬴政的怀中，不一会儿，困倦又袭上了心头，他闭了闭眼，迷迷糊糊地闪过一个念头。好像嬴政还挺迷人的……
嬴政可不知道徐福脑子里在想什么，他就这样拥着徐福，脑子里已经开始规划接下来要做什么了。平阳邑只是他们停留的一个地方，接下来，或许徐福会很乐意和他一同到三川走一趟……
