"You're going to make money? How will you make money?" After confirming he hadn't misheard, Ying Zheng's face darkened, and his tone became suddenly stern. He thought Xu Fu was overestimating himself.

"That's what I should ask you. Ah-Zheng, how will you make money?"

Ying Zheng didn't understand the meaning of his question and replied immediately, "Naturally, as the old man said, I can find work at the tavern or the tofu shop." Although Ying Zheng had lived in luxury for a long time, he was not someone who couldn't let go of his pride. Now, with only Xu Fu and the two children by his side, the task of earning money naturally fell on his shoulders.

Xu Fu shook his head. "No, Ah-Zheng cannot go."

Fusu whispered in agreement, "Father is the King of Qin, how can he..."

"Why not?" Ying Zheng cut him off. He didn't care about the labor. If he didn't go, would he let Xu Fu go instead? The mere thought of Xu Fu's frail frame made him feel immense reluctance. In the palace, he couldn't bear to let him do any labor; even if they were stranded here, it was the same.

Xu Fu blurted out, "But I can't bear it."

That's right, he couldn't bear it. The dignified King of Qin, the future First Emperor, doing manual labor for others? Don't joke!

Besides, wasn't it just making money? Was his experience setting up a stall under the overpass in his previous life for nothing?

"Ah-Zheng, have you forgotten what I do?" Xu Fu glanced at him sideways and then turned to walk toward the street. Ying Zheng hadn't recovered from Xu Fu's previous sentence. When had he ever heard such words from Xu Fu? Just those few words seemed to melt into his heart.

Ying Zheng had once heard of how King Zhou of Shang doted on his concubine Daji, and at the time, he had scoffed at it. But now, thinking about it, if it were Xu Fu, he would certainly be willing to dote on him to the extreme.

Fusu coughed lightly. "Fa-Father, Teacher has already walked far away." Fusu felt bitter; it was one thing for these two to say ambiguous things regardless of the occasion, but he had to endure the embarrassment and remind them.

"Mm." Ying Zheng regained his focus and calmly followed. He was curious about what Xu Fu would do.

Once they reached the street, Xu Fu found a spot and sat down on the ground.

Everyone around couldn't help but look at him with surprise.

How could someone so handsome suddenly sit down on the street? What was he doing?

Xu Fu's actions immediately attracted many gazes.

Xu Fu didn't care about these scrutinizing eyes. When he set up his stall under the overpass in his previous life, were there few people looking at him with strange eyes? Not to mention the bold and unrestrained girls who would take out their phones and snap photos of him.

With the composure of a divine being performing magic, Xu Fu made some things appear out of thin air.

Exclamations of wonder arose around him.

In truth, Xu Fu was just using a small sleight of hand, taking advantage of people's visual blind spots to quickly retrieve his belongings.

Tortoise shells, divination sticks, a Bagua plate... they were all placed on the ground just like that.

"What is this kid doing?" someone couldn't help but ask.

Anyone who saw such a handsome figure would naturally have more curiosity and patience. Even if Xu Fu's actions were strange, they wouldn't immediately label him a madman.

"Divination, fortune-telling."

"What is divination? What is fortune-telling?" the person asked again.

"Since the Shang and Zhou dynasties, the art of divination has flourished. My divination and fortune-telling stem from this," Xu Fu said calmly, adjusting his sleeves.

His appearance and temperament were highly deceptive, and even his voice was intoxicating, making people feel that whatever he said was correct, without a shred of doubt.

But not questioning didn't mean they wanted to patronize his business. They thought the items on display looked interesting, but no one had ever played with them, so who would dare to try?

Xu Fu knew their thoughts well. For him, winning these people over was too simple.

When Ying Zheng "dragged his family" over, this was the scene he saw.

Xu Fu was in a white robe, and even though it was stained with dust, it didn't hinder his temperament in the slightest. He sat steadily by the street, surrounded by countless curious onlookers. This scene overlapped with one from the streets of Xianyang. Only then, it was the first time he had met Xu Fu; he had been disdainful, while Xu Fu had been inscrutable. Xu Fu had praised his good looks, and he, in a fit of rage, had thrown Xu Fu into prison.

Recalling that scene now, it was still vivid, as if it had happened yesterday.

Ying Zheng stood there, staring fixedly at Xu Fu, watching how he displayed his extraordinary skills before the crowd. This dazzling and eye-catching appearance made one love and hate him—loving his grace, yet hating not being able to hide him away so no one else could see.

Ying Zheng's expression was serious, a deep light flashing in his eyes.

Fusu looked up and inadvertently caught the look in Ying Zheng's eyes. He shuddered involuntarily; he shouldn't have seen anything, he didn't want to know what his father was thinking...

On this side, Xu Fu decided to follow his usual routine, using the fastest way to shock the people around him.

Reading faces!

His gaze swept around and finally landed on a woman.

The woman smiled at him.

Wasn't this woman the one from the medical clinic? Then he would start with her...

"Could I ask the lady to step forward?" Xu Fu said.

The woman smiled gently and, following his request, stepped forward. "What is the young man trying to do?"

"Does the lady have any wishes in her heart?" Xu Fu asked as per his custom.

In reality, who would tell a stranger their inner thoughts? Sure enough, the woman smiled and said, "Naturally, I have none." One could tell she was lying. In this world, except for those who have seen through the mortal world and have no distracting thoughts, from the white-haired old man to the young child, everyone has wishes in their hearts, though they all differ.

Seeing the woman wouldn't say, Xu Fu didn't press her. He nodded and said, "Then please forgive my offense."

A look of curiosity appeared on the woman's face; she was curious about what Xu Fu was going to do.

The crowd stretched their necks, wanting to see clearly how someone who dared to claim mastery of divination would use these strange tools to tell fortunes. How would he offend her?

But soon, Xu Fu disappointed them.

Because they stood on tiptoe and stretched their necks for a long time, yet they didn't see Xu Fu do anything.

It was just that the woman's cheeks turned slightly red because the handsome young man in front of her was staring at her intently, his gaze not moving an inch. Although there was no strict separation between men and women at this time, any woman would blush if stared at like that by a handsome youth.

The woman couldn't help it and wanted to ask what the youth was doing.

And at this moment, Ying Zheng, who was standing far away, couldn't help it either. He clenched his fists, suppressing his surging emotions. Xu Fu's gaze should naturally be on him; how could he look at another woman so ardently? The sea of jealousy in Ying Zheng's heart was churning, threatening to drown him.

The woman opened her mouth to speak, but Xu Fu withdrew his gaze.

"Would the lady like to hear me say a few words?"

The woman smiled. "Go ahead."

"Observing the lady's face..."

Before Xu Fu could continue, the woman's cheeks flushed red again.

Xu Fu remained calm, ignoring the woman's blushing, and said, "The lady's eyes are delicate, the upper and lower eyelids have double ripples, the pupils are dark, and the gaze is peaceful—this is the 'Goose Eye'."

Someone nearby couldn't hold back and whispered, "What's a 'Goose Eye'? Is this divination?" The man's tone was inevitably contemptuous. Of course, the speaker was a man who likely looked down on Xu Fu's handsomeness, which had attracted so much attention, and coupled with Xu Fu's mysterious posturing, it was inevitable that some would dislike his attitude.

Xu Fu ignored the man and continued, "Those with 'Goose Eyes' tend to have a very gentle personality and are well-liked. If there are siblings, the bond is usually harmonious. This is a good face."

The woman pursed her lips and smiled but said nothing.

The owner of the neighboring stall laughed heartily, "This kid is right. Madam Zhou is indeed very kind to others."

Only then did the woman nod and say, "That's true, I have a younger sister, and we are very close."

Xu Fu showed no pride or complacency. He nodded faintly and continued, "The lady's cheekbones are slightly wide, the forehead is full, and the nose bridge is high—a profound face. It is a pity, however, that this is a 'Three-Power' fate, which tends to clash with one's husband."

The woman's eyes flickered, the smile faded from her face, and there was no trace of shyness left. The crowd also fell silent.

The woman opened her mouth and said hoarsely, "What you say is true. Everyone in town knows that my husband died early, leaving the large medical clinic to me, a lone woman."

The cheekbones, forehead, and nose bridge are all symbols of power. If all three are too full, it becomes a 'Three-Power' fate. Because such a face is too domineering, it easily forms a face that clashes with one's husband. It seems this woman only looks kind, but inside, she is not a weak woman who can be bullied. Otherwise, as she said, with her husband dead early and leaving her a clinic, if she didn't have some ability, how could a woman manage it?

Remembering when they entered the clinic today, Xu Fu recalled that the staff were extremely respectful to this woman.

This showed her ability to manage subordinates.

"The lady's lips and eyes have fine lines, showing that you are not only overworked but often troubled by trivial matters. If you continue to work this hard, I fear your complexion will become even worse."

"Does the lady have a daughter?"

"...Yes," the woman replied hesitantly. "How did you know, Sir?" The woman followed suit and changed her address for Xu Fu, showing she had recognized his ability.

"The lady's philtrum is slightly protruding, and there is a withered-grass color around the ears, indicating that you are physically weak and were originally unlikely to conceive children. If you were able to conceive, it should be a daughter." In reality, reading a face to determine the gender of offspring wasn't reliable; Xu Fu was just noticing the silk flowers for girls that the woman's attendant was carrying. However, he could indeed tell she was weak and had few children.

Half-guessing and half-cleverness naturally led to this, and he rarely made mistakes.

"The lady must be careful," Xu Fu whispered.

This was also a common tactic in fortune-telling: praise first, then criticize, bringing down the mood you just lifted. The person would inevitably panic and believe you deeply. However, this trick might not work on the woman in front of him, so Xu Fu had no intention of acting like a charlatan and deliberately exaggerating. He just told the truth, which he thought would be more effective.

"Careful of what?" The woman frowned, her expression turning serious.

"Be careful not to let your daughter suffer from the same deficiency as you."

The woman looked at Xu Fu with a half-smile, her gaze fixed tightly on him, fearing she would miss the slightest change in his expression. "I didn't expect you to be a doctor as well, Sir?"

"Whether I can practice medicine, the lady should know. This is not medicine; this is fortune-telling." Xu Fu raised his hand, his finger like a scallion, and tapped lightly in front of the woman.

The woman said in a deep voice, "If you aren't a doctor, how do you know I have a deficiency?"

Xu Fu wasn't a doctor, but he could observe a person's complexion and read their destiny. This woman blushed easily, not because she was truly shy, but because her body was weak; her skin was as white as snow, and any movement caused her blood to surge. If the mother is deficient, the children born are naturally prone to illness. Seeing the woman's expression change drastically when her daughter was mentioned, with deep pity in her eyes, it was clear the daughter must be very frail.

This deduction and confirmation took only a split second in his mind.

Xu Fu didn't want to waste more time on the woman. It was getting late, and he needed to earn money soon so he and Ying Zheng could stay at an inn.

He just said one last thing, "The lady's eyebrows are shorter than her eyes. Although you draw them with black pigment, your destiny does not change. You should take care of yourself to avoid the fate of having a thin bond with your children."

He only told her to be careful without saying how to avoid it. The woman's expression was tense, a mix of worry and shock. By the time she came to her senses, Xu Fu was already looking for his next customer.

"I just used this lady as an example. Is there anyone else who wants a divination? You can ask for anything. If, like this lady, you have no specific request and just want me to read your face, that is also fine."

As soon as Xu Fu said this, some people were already eager to move. They had witnessed the skill he had just displayed and were inwardly shocked, but their awe of divination still made them afraid to step forward rashly.

Xu Fu sighed inwardly. Did he have to read another person's face for free to shock them again?

Just as he was thinking this, a young woman suddenly stepped forward, bowed gracefully, and said, "Sir, let me have a divination."

"What are you asking for?" With business arriving, Xu Fu's voice had more strength, unlike before.

The woman stared at him, smiling even more brightly. "I ask you, Sir, will you be my husband in the future?"

Xu Fu: ...

He hadn't seen such a bold woman in a long time. After all, in front of Ying Zheng, no one would dare say such things to him! Xu Fu couldn't help but feel a little guilty. He carefully shifted his gaze toward Ying Zheng and then quickly turned it away.

Ying Zheng's face was as dark as water, his eyes staring coldly at the woman, wishing he could turn his gaze into sharp arrows and poke countless holes in her back.

But the woman was truly thick-skinned. Ying Zheng's gaze, which could almost cut, had no effect on her whatsoever.

People around couldn't help but stifle their laughter, clearly enjoying the show.

Xu Fu muttered to himself that he would deal with his own "rotten peach blossoms." He put away his guilt and said coldly, "Divination and fortune-telling do not predict matters related to oneself."

The woman sighed. "Fine, then tell me, when will I find a good man..."

Xu Fu glanced at her and said, "Within three months."

This woman clearly had "peach blossom luck," and more than just one or two. It was evident how many admirers she had. Although the woman wasn't moved yet, the joy in her eyes showed she enjoyed the feeling of being admired. People's hearts weren't made of iron; within three months, as some admirers gave up due to lack of response, the woman's restless heart would eventually settle, and she would pick a suitable one.

This woman's face didn't look like that of a flirt; she wouldn't be indecisive or toy with her admirers when the time came.

The woman was surprised and somewhat reluctant. "That fast?"

"Naturally that fast. Young lady, it's time to pay." Even such vulgar talk about money, coming from Xu Fu, made people feel that, yes, it was exactly like that. There was nothing out of place.

The woman pouted and could only take out coins and throw them into his palm.

"Is there anyone else?"

Seeing that the woman had gone, others naturally dared to step out.

Once there was one, there were two, even if just out of herd mentality. Before long, people asking about marriage, when their illnesses would heal, travel safety, or when they would get rich... all swarmed in, almost surrounding Xu Fu completely.

Originally, Ying Zheng could watch from afar and even feel proud of Xu Fu's excellence. But seeing these people acting so recklessly, his face turned cold, and he pushed through the crowd to walk over.

Fusu and Fusu were held in his arms, calling out to the people with soft, tender voices, "Make way, please make way..."

These people felt their hearts soften and naturally didn't dare to crowd them. Thus, Ying Zheng easily squeezed to Xu Fu's side.

A middle-aged man who had been pushed aside—he had been asking about marriage—wasn't happy about being shoved. He turned and glared fiercely at Ying Zheng, saying, "What are you doing? Pushing in like that!"

Ying Zheng's gaze was sharp, looking at him coldly, his voice even colder. "You are crowding too much! Everyone step back!"

The man met his gaze and shuddered involuntarily. When he came to his senses, he felt incredibly embarrassed, his lips trembling as he tried to think of something harsh to say to scold the cold man opposite him.

Others couldn't help but speak up: "Who are you? Suddenly pushing in and then blaming us!"

Xu Fu heard Ying Zheng's voice and looked up at him. Just as the people around finished expressing their dissatisfaction, before Ying Zheng could speak, Xu Fu spoke calmly, blocking all their words.

"Who is he? He is my man."

Who is he?

He is my man.

A single sentence, said in such an understated tone, stunned everyone. Yes, including Ying Zheng.

Ying Zheng never expected Xu Fu to introduce his status so openly in front of everyone. Given Xu Fu's personality, wouldn't he usually be secretive about their relationship? No, that was right. Xu Fu's personality wasn't secretive; he had always been frank. Even in matters of love, no matter how ignorant he was, when it came to intimacy or saying he liked someone, Xu Fu never dragged his feet.

Ying Zheng's breathing became slightly rougher.

Something seemed to be leaping in his chest, *thump, thump, thump*, very strongly.

Xu Fu didn't think his words had caused such a shock to everyone. He adjusted the tools that had been knocked over and asked coldly, "Who's next?"

The crowd came to their senses and gasped. Hearing Xu Fu's cold tone, they assumed it was because they had accidentally offended the teacher's man, so the teacher was being so unwelcoming. They blushed and retreated several steps, not daring to crowd forward again.

This was someone's man, after all; naturally, he had the right to be in charge.

"I, I'll go first..." The middle-aged man who had just scolded Ying Zheng walked cautiously to Xu Fu, awkwardly smiling at Ying Zheng.

Ying Zheng's mood was soothed, and his gaze wasn't as cold as before. He glanced at the middle-aged man, who breathed a sigh of relief and began to explain what he wanted.

Ying Zheng put down Fusu and Fusu, letting them play at Xu Fu's feet, while he transformed into a personal guard, standing firmly by Xu Fu's side.

These people, who had previously thought Ying Zheng was rude and overbearing, now couldn't help but look at him and whisper among themselves.

"Such a man may not be handsome, but looking at his powerful arms, being by his side must be very reassuring."

"Yes, yes, looking at him, he must be a deeply affectionate man..."

"Wait, no, he is the teacher's man, then this teacher... is this teacher a man or a woman..."

Ying Zheng heard this conversation and found it quite funny. The remaining bit of displeasure completely vanished.

Soon, the sky grew dark, and the crowd had to disperse. However, having witnessed Xu Fu's formidable skills, they didn't forget to say before leaving: "Sir, please come again tomorrow. We will come to seek your advice again tomorrow." It sounded as if Xu Fu were a respected teacher, and he seemed quite beloved. But in reality, he was just a fortune-teller.

Fusu yawned lazily, hugging Fusu's arm and rubbing against it. "Brother, sleepy."

Xu Fu looked at them, packed his belongings into a cloth bag, and along with the money earned today, stood up. "Let's go, find an inn." His originally cold voice was tinged with a hint of excitement.

Ying Zheng looked at him, unable to stop the corners of his mouth from rising.

This version of Xu Fu was something one could never get enough of.

Fusu happily repeated, "Go! Find an inn!"

Then the two little tag-alongs, not needing anyone to carry them, followed energetically, walking slowly with their short legs.

Others who saw this family of four couldn't help but smile knowingly and praise, "What lovely children!"

Ying Zheng couldn't help but reach out and pull Xu Fu to his side, leaning into his ear and whispering, "Ah-Fu stole the show today; you looked so alluring sitting there."

Xu Fu glanced at him sideways. "I was just sitting there seriously reading fortunes; how was that alluring?" Xu Fu wanted to say that what one thinks is what one sees in others; it must be that Ying Zheng had too many lewd thoughts, which was why he found him alluring. Hmph.

But catching sight of the two little radishes in front, Xu Fu had to swallow his words.

He couldn't corrupt the children.

The upper beam must be straight for the lower beam to not be crooked!

The four of them happily found an inn, paid the money, took only one room, and ordered the waiter to bring water and food.

The waiter led them into the room. Compared to the palace, it was small, but none of them were picky at this moment, because compared to that thatched hut, it was already much better.

The room was kept clean, and the bedding felt very warm.

Because the four of them had an extraordinary air, the waiter didn't dare to be negligent and brought extra bedding, worrying that Xu Fu and the others wouldn't have enough. After eating, Ying Zheng helped Xu Fu bathe the two children. Fusu and Fusu squeezed into a wooden tub together, and Fusu's eyes crinkled with laughter. He felt no discomfort or grievance; on the contrary, he thought this trip was great fun and had experienced many interesting things.

Only Fusu's face turned red, his body stiff as he was washed clean. Halfway through, even when Fusu caused trouble by splashing water on him, he forgot to scold him.

After sending the two to sleep on the small couch behind the screen, Ying Zheng and Xu Fu bathed together. Because the children were there, they didn't do anything overly passionate, and being extremely exhausted, they washed quickly and couldn't care about anything else.

After washing, Xu Fu was exhausted to the extreme and didn't want to get up, leaning against the wooden tub. Ying Zheng had no choice but to reach out and pick him up. Xu Fu leaned obediently against Ying Zheng's chest, using great effort to suppress the urge to yawn. He rubbed against Ying Zheng's chest unconsciously, and Ying Zheng held him tighter. The two got onto the bed, wrapped themselves tightly in the quilt, skin to skin. Xu Fu let out a sigh of comfort, and by the time he realized his voice was too seductive, it was too late.

Ying Zheng pinched his chin and leaned down for a kiss.

Xu Fu tensed up, thinking Ying Zheng wanted to do something shameful behind the screen while the children were there. Who knew that after the kiss, Ying Zheng raised his large hand, covered his eyes, and whispered like coaxing a child, "Sleep."

Xu Fu felt a bit awkward but also felt an irresistible warmth. His mind was muddled, and he couldn't muster any energy. He unconsciously reached out and hugged Ying Zheng's waist, holding on tight...

When they woke up the next day, the waiter brought food and water again. They washed up, ate a simple meal, and went behind the screen to see Fusu and Fusu tangled together like octopuses, sleeping soundly. Xu Fu couldn't bear to wake them, so he left them at the inn.

Xu Fu walked out, and Ying Zheng naturally followed.

Xu Fu stopped and looked back at him. "Why are you following me?"

"I naturally have to follow you." Ying Zheng pursed his lips.

"No, how can we be at ease leaving Fusu and Fusu at the inn? Ah-Zheng, stay at the inn to take care of them. I'll be back by noon." Ignoring Ying Zheng's dark expression, Xu Fu pushed open the door. After walking out, he couldn't help but squint his eyes.

Ordering the First Emperor of Qin to stay home and babysit felt amazing!

At this moment, the waiter walked up and smiled, "Sir, a Madam Zhou is waiting for you."

Madam Zhou? Which Madam Zhou? Xu Fu was confused for a moment before remembering it was the woman from the medical clinic!

Was she... here because of his prophecy?
chapters.source_text:
王宫里若是受了风寒，有侍医马不停蹄，四下奔走，熬制各种药来，小心调理主子的身体。而在民间，民间则是自有自己的一番手段。百姓病不起，耗不起时辰，因而民间多有些快速退热的法子，如今便被用在了胡亥的身上。
嬴政看见的时候，皱了皱眉，不过倒也没阻拦对方使用这样的法子。
入乡要随俗，这个道理嬴政还是懂的。现在他们可不是王宫里的王上和徐奉常，在这里想要救胡亥，显然还是先遵从本地的办法更好。
“好了。”一老叟给胡亥灌了半碗汤药下去，随后便直起了身子。
“钱……”
还不待嬴政将话说完，那老叟已经摆了摆手道：“这个是不要钱的，不过你拿了药回去，之后就得将钱补上。”
徐福出声道：“可宽限几日？”
老叟看了他一眼，见徐福样貌生得好，只当他是不幸落难于此，顿时心生怜惜，忍不住喟叹一声，问道：“可是家里遭了灾？一路逃难而来？”
徐福突然想起此时赵国正在闹饥荒呢，也不知此时他们是否在赵国境内……
徐福含糊地应了一声。
老叟见他不欲多说的模样，顿时更认为他是心中难过，不愿再自揭伤疤，于是拍了拍他的肩，道：“城南有个无人居住的茅草屋，你们初到此地，将就将就应当是无妨的。不过之后便要自己寻些谋生的手段。城南的酒馆，门外的豆腐铺子，还有城中几处富户的府邸中……都是在招人手的。”
老叟唠唠叨叨，竟是不知不觉间说出了这么多有用的信息。
嬴政虽然不喜老叟将手搭在徐福肩上后，便再也不挪开了，不过嬴政目光锐利，好歹还是能分清的，这老叟也只是淳朴热情了些，倒是并无别的心思。
“多谢。”嬴政简短地表达了谢意。
老叟扫了他一眼，见他面色冷硬，瞧上去跟个闷葫芦似的，倒也不在乎嬴政的态度冷漠了，摆摆手便快步出去了。没一会儿，便有医馆伙计拿了药来。
嬴政很自觉地将药提在手中，侍从不在，便是他来出力了。
徐福三人站在一旁等了会儿，胡亥眨了眨眼，小声道：“不热了，你摸摸。”
徐福伸手摸了摸他的额头，果然已经没有那么烫了。
胡亥扭了扭身子，伸长了脖子，蹭到扶苏的手底下，“哥哥，摸摸。”
扶苏敷衍地抬手揉了揉他的脖子，“嗯，不烫了。”
胡亥挣扎着爬起来，“那可以走了吗？”
徐福一眼就看出了胡亥的小心思，大约小孩儿都不爱喝药。现在烧已经退了，他们的确也应该离开了。嬴政将胡亥抱了起来。原本他是想夹在胳膊底下的，但是思及那个老大娘的指责，嬴政也只有好生将胡亥抱着了，免得等下走在街上，又被人当做禽兽父亲。
胡亥如今的重量并不轻，何况他们一路走来，都有些疲倦呢？徐福接过了嬴政手中的药，一手牵住扶苏，倒是没有和嬴政争着去抱胡亥。
徐福很清楚自己的力气有多大，干脆便不去添乱了。
待出了医馆，询问路人，他们很快便找到了那老叟口中的城南茅草屋。
三人立在茅草屋前，呆了呆。
这草屋实在不是一般的破败，它独自立在一小山坡后，前面不远处有条小溪，周围杂草丛生。那草屋顶上的茅草或许是风吹日晒后，便变得黑乎乎的了，瞧上去实在有些脏得过分。再看那布做的门帘，随风飘动，瞧上去也是脏兮兮的。还不知里头又是个什么模样……
莫怪他们娇气，实在是住惯了王宫，出行都是自带奢华版马车，更处处住客栈，住营地。
他们何曾这样狼狈过？
堂堂秦国王室……竟是只能落到住茅草屋的地步。
谁让秦王的名头在这个地儿也没法用呢，换不来钱，也换不来屋子。
嬴政最先恢复了镇定，“走吧。”说完，便当先抱着胡亥朝那方去了。
扶苏脸色微微发白，但他还是乖顺地跟着徐福一同往前走，徐福瞥了他一眼，顿觉扶苏这模样才像小孩子呢。
嬴政掀起草屋的门帘，一股霉味儿立时从里面冲了出来，四个人都不约而同地皱起了眉，半天都没能舒展开。一阵凉风吹过，显得他们的背影十分萧瑟。徐福觉得他高估了自己的承受能力。
那草屋里就剩下一堆茅草，和两只锈掉的器皿。
这能住吗？当然不能。
徐福抬手抓住了嬴政的手腕，“走吧。”
嬴政一愣，“去哪里？”
“去赚钱。”徐福说完，一指嬴政怀中的胡亥，“你带孩子。”言简意赅地说完，徐福心里有了点儿莫名的舒爽。他去赚钱，秦始皇在家带孩子，这种滋味实在有些美妙！
那瞬间嬴政以为自己听错了。
“你去赚钱？你如何赚钱？”嬴政确认自己没听错以后，不由得面色一沉，语气骤然严厉了起来。他以为徐福在逞能。
“这话该我问你，阿政如何赚钱？”
嬴政不明白他问这话的意思，当即答道：“自然是如那老叟所说，在酒馆、豆腐坊都可寻到活儿来赚钱。”嬴政虽然养尊处优已久，但是他也并非放不下架子的人，如今身边除了徐福便是两个孩子，要赚钱的任务自然是落到他的肩上。
徐福却摇了摇头，“不行，阿政不能去。”
扶苏低声附和道：“父王是秦王，怎么能……”
“有何不能？”嬴政一口截断。他并不在意这点劳累付出，他若不去，难道还让徐福去吗？嬴政一想到徐福那小身板，便觉得不舍至极了。在王宫中时，寡人都舍不得让他操劳半分，哪怕是流落在此，便也是一样。
徐福脱口而出，“可我舍不得。”
对啊，他是舍不得啊，堂堂秦王，未来的秦始皇，能去给人做杂役？莫开玩笑了！
不就是赚钱么？他上辈子在天桥底下摆摊的经验，是白来的么？
“阿政忘记我是做什么的了吗？”徐福斜睨了他一眼，随即当先转身朝街道上走去，嬴政还没能从徐福上一句中回过神来。他何时从徐福口中听过这样的话？只短短几个字，便仿佛酥到了心底里去。
嬴政曾听那商纣王如何宠爱姬妾妲己，那时他是嗜之以鼻的，但如今想一想，若是换在徐福身上，他定是也愿意宠他到极致的。
扶苏轻咳一声，“父、父亲，老师已经走远了。”扶苏觉得心里苦，这二人不分场合说上两句暧昧话也就罢了，自己还要在一旁忍着脸红，提醒他们。
“嗯。”嬴政回神，随即淡定地跟了上去。他心中有些好奇，徐福会如何做。
等到了街上，徐福随意寻了个地方，席地而坐。
旁边的人都免不了用惊奇的目光打量他。
长得这样好看的人，怎么好端端突然在街上坐下来了？他要做什么？
徐福的动作顿时便吸引了不少人的目光。
对于这些打量的目光，徐福浑不在意，上辈子在天桥底下摆摊的时候，用怪异目光瞧他的人还少了吗？别说那时还有大胆奔放的女孩子，掏出手机来对着他咔嚓咔嚓拍照了。
徐福从容的，如同神仙施法术般的，凭空变出了些东西来。
身边顿时响起了惊叹声。
其实徐福不过是使了个小小的障眼法罢了，借用人的视觉盲区，动作迅速地取出自己那些家当。
龟甲、签、八卦盘……就这样随手被放在了地面上。
“小子这是做什么？”有人忍不住上前问道。
任谁见了个好相貌的人物，都会平白多出几分好奇，也顺带多出几分耐心，哪怕徐福的举动再奇怪，他们也不会先将徐福看做疯子。
“卜卦，算命。”
“何为卜卦？何为算命？”那人又问。
“商周时起，卜筮之术盛行，我这卜卦与算命，便是由此而来。”徐福拢了拢袖袍，淡淡道。
他的面容和气质都极具欺骗性，就连嗓音也令人忍不住为之沉醉，只觉得他说什么话都是对的，连半分想要质疑的心思都生不起。
但是不质疑，并不代表他们就想要来光顾徐福的生意了。他们只觉得眼前摆着的玩意儿，瞧上去有些好玩儿，但谁也没玩过，谁敢贸然来试呢？
徐福深知这些人的心思，对于他来说，要拿下这些人，实在太简单不过了。
待嬴政“拖家带口”地走近，瞧见的便是这样一幕。
徐福一袭白袍，哪怕沾染了尘埃，但也并不会妨碍他的气质半分。他稳坐在街道边，周围围上来了无数好奇的人。这一幕与曾经咸阳街头的一幕相重叠。只是那时，他与徐福才见了第一面，他心中不屑，而徐福则是一脸高深莫测。徐福夸了一番他的好相貌，而他却怒极之下，将徐福关进了大牢。
那一幕如今忆起，倒还颜色鲜亮，仿佛是昨日发生的一般。
嬴政就站在那里，定定地看着徐福，看着他如何在众人跟前，展露自己出众的本事，这般耀眼又夺目的模样，实在教人又爱又恨，爱他的风采，却恨不能将他遮掩起来，再不给旁人看见。
嬴政的面色严肃，眼底闪过深沉的光芒。
扶苏抬起头，无意间瞥见嬴政眼底的神色，扶苏不自觉地打了个寒颤，他应当是什么也没看见吧，他才不明白父王此时在想什么呢……
这一头，徐福还是决定按照老样子，先用最快的方式来震慑住周围的人。
看面相！
他的目光在周围扫了一圈，最后落在了一个妇人的身上。
妇人冲他笑了笑。
这妇人不正是医馆中的那一位吗？那便就从她开始吧……
“能否请夫人上前一些？”徐福出声道。
妇人笑容温柔，顺着他的意思，往前走了走，“小哥这是要做什么？”
“夫人心中可有所求？”徐福按照惯例问了一句。
但实际上，哪有人随便见了个陌生人，便将自己心中的想法告知对方的呢？果然，那妇人盈盈一笑，道：“自是没有的。”想也知道她这是在撒谎了。人生在世，除却那些看破红尘，心无杂念的人，上至鹤发老翁，下至垂髫小童，他们心中都是有所求的，只是众人所求皆有不同罢了。
见妇人不说出来，徐福也没有立即刨根问底，他点了点头，道：“那便恕我冒犯了。”
妇人脸上浮现几分好奇之色，她好奇徐福要做什么。
众人也不由得往前伸长了脖子，都想瞧个清楚，胆敢妄言通卜筮之术的人，要如何用面前奇怪的用具，给人卜卦算命？他会如何冒犯？
不过很快徐福就令他们失望了。
因为他们踮着脚，伸着脖子瞧了半天，却没瞧见徐福有什么动作。
只是那妇人却忍不住脸颊微微泛红，盖因面前的俊美少年，竟然是目光灼灼地盯着自己，视线半分也不肯挪开。虽然这时还没有男女大防之说，但任是女子，突然被一俊美少年这样瞧着，都会忍不住脸红的。
妇人有些忍不住了，想要出声问少年要做什么。
而此时站得远远的嬴政，也有些忍不住了。他捏紧了拳头，强忍住澎湃的心绪。徐福的目光自然应当是落在他身上的，怎么能这样炙热地瞧着别的女子？嬴政心中的醋海已经翻腾得快要将他淹没了。
妇人张了张嘴，正要说话，徐福却已经收起了目光。
“夫人可愿听我随意说上几句？”
妇人笑道：“你说便是。”
“观夫人面颊……”
还不待徐福往下说，那妇人已经脸颊又泛起红了。
徐福镇定自若，忽视掉妇人的脸红之状，道：“夫人的眼形清秀，上下眼皮为双波纹，瞳孔黑绌，眼神祥和，是为雁眼。”
旁边已经有人沉不住气了，低声道：“啥叫雁眼？这就是卜筮？”那人口气免不了有些轻蔑，当然，说着话的是个男子，想来是瞧不上徐福俊美，一来便吸引走了不少目光，加之徐福又故意做得神秘莫测，当然免不了有人不待见他这副姿态。
徐福根本不理会那人，继续道：“生有雁眼的人，性格往往极为温纯，人缘颇佳，若有兄弟姊妹，手足之情必然也较为和睦。这是好相貌。”
妇人抿唇一笑，却未说话。
旁边摊子的主人，爽朗一笑，“你这小子说得倒也不错，周夫人的确是与人和善得很。”
这时妇人才点头道：“不错，我家中有一妹子，与我感情甚好。”
徐福面上半点骄傲自满也无，他淡淡点头，继续往下说道：“夫人颧骨略宽，天庭饱满，鼻梁高耸，好深邃的相貌，只可惜，此为三权命，主克丈夫。”
那妇人眸光闪了闪，脸上笑容褪去，更无半点羞色，众人也立时安静了起来。
妇人张了张嘴，哑声道：“你所言不错，镇中人皆知，我那丈夫早亡，偌大医馆便留于我一妇人。”
颧骨，天庭，鼻梁，三处皆是主权的象征，三处都过于饱满，便为三权命。因这样的面相过于霸道，所以极易形成克夫之相。想来这妇人只是瞧上去和善，但内里并非软弱好欺的女人。不然依她所言，丈夫早亡，留下一个医馆给她，她若是没有点本事，一个女人家，如何能掌得住医馆？
想起今日进医馆时，徐福记得医馆中人对这妇人可是极为尊敬的。
可见其驭下的手段。
“夫人唇眼带有细纹，可见平日不仅操劳过度，还常为琐事惹得自己不快。若夫人还这样劳累下去，恐怕面色要更加难看了。”
“夫人可是膝下有一女？”
“……是。”妇人迟疑地应道，“先生如何看出？”妇人从善如流地换了对徐福的称呼，可见她已经认可了徐福的本事。
“夫人人中微突，耳边多有枯草色，可见夫人体弱，本是难孕育子女，若能偶能孕育出子息，也应当为女儿。”实际上瞧人面相，能否瞧出子嗣为男为女，并不靠谱，徐福不过是瞧这妇人，身后随从还带着女孩儿爱的绢花罢了。倒是体弱和子嗣多少，徐福是确实能瞧出来的。
半分推测加耍机灵，自然也就将这话给说出来了，还少有出错的时候。
“夫人可要小心了。”徐福低声道。
这也是算命的惯用的手段，先夸后贬，将你刚刚扬起来的心情，重重摔落下去，你必然惊慌失措，深信不疑。不过这一招用在面前妇人身上，不一定行得通，所以徐福丝毫不打算学那些江湖骗子，故意将情况夸大。他只实话实说，想来更有效。
“小心什么？”妇人皱眉，面色严肃了些。
“要小心莫让夫人的女儿，也同夫人一样，患上些不足之症。”
妇人似笑非笑地看着徐福，实则目光已经紧紧盯着徐福了，生怕错过他脸上一丝一毫的神色变化，“未曾想到，先生还是会看病的？”
“我会不会看病，夫人应当是知晓的，这并非看病，而是算命。”徐福抬手，如水葱般的食指在妇人跟前轻点了一下。
妇人沉声道：“若是不会看病，那先生如何知道我有不足之症？”
徐福不见得会看病，但他会观人气色啊，更能瞧见的人命理啊，这妇人极容易脸红，并非她当真那样羞涩，而是她身子弱，肤白如雪，稍有动作，便会气血上涌。母体不足，产下的子女，自然也容易体弱多病。见提及她那女儿时，妇人骤然变色，眸中疼惜不已，想来这个女儿，应当体弱得紧。
如此推理确认一番，也不过就是瞬间的功夫便在脑内完成了。
徐福并不欲在妇人身上多浪费时间，如今时辰不早了，他要早些赚到钱，好同嬴政在客栈下榻。
他只淡淡说了最后一句，“夫人眉不及目长，虽以黛黑描之，但命理不改，夫人自己多加注意，避开子女福缘淡薄的命运便是。”
他只让人注意，却不说如何能避过，那妇人面色紧张，又是担忧，又是惊诧，好生复杂，待她回过神来时，徐福已经在物色自己的顾客了。
“我不过以这位夫人为例，可有人愿在我这里算上一卦的？求什么都可以，若是像这位夫人这样，别无所求，只让我瞧一瞧面相，那也是成的。”
徐福这话一出，已经有人蠢蠢欲动了，他们见识到了方才徐福不动声色露出的那一手，心中早已掀起了惊骇的巨浪，但是对于卜筮的敬畏，还是令他们不敢贸然上前。
徐福在心底轻叹一口气，难道还要他再免费为谁瞧个面相，以此来在震慑众人吗？
正想着呢，便见一妙龄女子突然上前，盈盈一拜，道：“先生，我来求一卦吧。”
“求什么？”生意上门，徐福的声音都有力度了一些，不像刚才那样连力气都没有。
女子盯着他，笑得越发灿烂，“我问先生，先生未来可会成我夫君么？”
徐福：……
他已经很久没有见过这样剽悍的女子了，毕竟在嬴政的跟前，谁那样不知死活对他说这样的话！徐福忍不住有点心虚，他小心地挪动着目光，朝嬴政的方向瞟了一眼，又飞速转开。
嬴政面沉如水，目光冰冷地盯着那女子，恨不得将目光化作利箭，在她背上戳出无数道窟窿出来才好。
但是那女子神经实在粗糙得很，嬴政恨不得切了她的目光，都快要凝为实质了，但女子硬是半点反应也没有。
周围的人已经忍不住憋笑出声，明显一脸看好戏的表情。
徐福在心中默念一句，自己的烂桃花自己处置，于是收起心虚，冷声道：“卜卦算命，不卜与自身相关的事。”
女子叹了口气，“好吧，那便卜一卜，我何时能寻觅到良人吧……”
徐福只瞥了一眼，便道：“不出三月。”
这女子分明面带桃花，而且还不止一两朵，可见其背后爱慕的人何其多，女子眼下虽未动心，但见她眉梢眼角都带着喜色，可见她十分享受被人爱慕的滋味。人的心都不是铁做的，不到三月，那些爱慕她的人因为得不到回应，有些便会忍不住退缩，女子眼看着爱慕者散去，最后浮躁的心定然会慢慢沉静下来，从中挑一合适的人。
这女子的面相并非轻佻之人，她不会到了时候还举棋不定，玩弄爱慕者的。
女子惊讶不已，有些不舍，“这样快？”
“自是这样快，姑娘，该给钱了。”明明这样铜臭气的话，从徐福口中说出来，便令人觉得，没错，就是这样的。并没有什么违和的地方。
女子瘪了瘪嘴，只能拿出钱币扔到他的掌心。
“可还有他人？”
见那女子都上了，此时自然有人也敢踏出来了。
有一就有二，哪怕是出于从众的心理呢？不多时，问姻缘的，问病症何时痊愈的，问出行安全的，问何时发财的……全都涌了上来，几乎将徐福围了个水泄不通。
原本嬴政还能远远瞧着，甚至隐隐为徐福的出色而自豪，此时见那些人这般鲁莽，顿时面色冰冷，拨开人群大步走了过去。
扶苏和胡亥被他同时抱在怀中，用软嫩的声音唤那些人，“让一让，请让一让……”
这些人心中一软，自然不敢与他们挤。于是嬴政很轻松地便挤到了徐福的旁边。
有个中年男子被挤到了一边去，他是来问姻缘的，此时突然被挤开，立马就不乐意了，转头恶狠狠地看着嬴政，道：“你要做什么？胡乱往里头挤！”
嬴政目光锐利，冷冰冰地看着他，声音则更冷，“你们挤得太过了！全部退后！”
男子对上他的目光，不自觉地打了个寒颤，回过神来又觉得丢脸无比，喏嗫着嘴唇正琢磨着说句什么狠话，将对面阴冷的人，好好骂上一通。
其他人也忍不住出声道：“你是什么人啊？突然间挤进来，倒是指责起我们了！”
徐福听见嬴政的声音，抬头看了他一眼，刚巧这时周围的人刚抒发完不满之情，不等嬴政出声，徐福就先淡然开口，将那些人的话统统堵了回去。
“他是什么人？他是我的男人啊。”
他是什么人？
他是我的男人啊。
一句话，这样轻描淡写的语气，但是却叫所有人都呆住了。没错，包括嬴政在内。
嬴政怎么也没想到，徐福会这样大大方方在众人跟前，如此介绍自己的身份。按照徐福的性子，难道不是会对自己的身份遮遮掩掩吗？不，没错。徐福的性子不是遮遮掩掩的，他向来坦率。就算在情之一道上，再为懵懂，但是在行云雨时，说喜欢时，徐福都从来不拖泥带水的。
嬴政的气息微微粗急了些。
他的胸口仿佛有什么在跃动，咚咚咚，极为强烈。
徐福压根不觉得自己一句话，能给众人带来多么大的冲击，他摆弄了一下面前被撞乱的道具，冷声问：“谁先来？”
众人回过神来，倒吸了一口气，此时听徐福口吻冰冷，只当是他们方才不小心冒犯了先生的男人，所以先生才这般不客气，他们顿时脸红不已，往后连退了好几步，不敢再往前挤。
这是人家的男人啊，自然是有权利管的。
“我、我先来吧……”方才出声斥责嬴政的中年男子，小心翼翼地走到徐福跟前，还尴尬地冲嬴政笑了笑。
嬴政此时心情得到了安抚，目光也不似方才那样冰冷了，他瞧了一眼中年男子，男子顿时松了口气，这才交代起自己所求的事来。
嬴政放下胡亥和扶苏，让他们俩围在徐福脚边，而自己则是化身贴身侍从，牢牢护卫在徐福身旁。
这些人之前还觉得嬴政粗鲁，管得宽，此时这些人倒是忍不住瞧着嬴政，小声议论起来。
“这样的男人虽不够俊美，但瞧他臂膀有力的模样，跟在他身旁，定是极为安心的。”
“是啊是啊，瞧他这模样，应当是个深情的男子吧……”
“不对呀，他是先生的男人，那这先生……这先生究竟是男是女啊……”
嬴政听见这番对话，心底顿时觉得有些好笑，刚才剩下的那点儿不愉，倒是彻底烟消云散了。
很快，天色渐渐晚下来，众人不得不逐渐散去，不过他们见识到了徐福的厉害手段，散去前都还没忘记与徐福说：“先生明日可要再来啊，我等明日再来向先生讨教。”听起来徐福就跟那教书先生似的，还一副颇受人爱戴尊崇的感觉。而其实上呢，就是一算命的。
胡亥懒洋洋地打了个呵欠，抱着扶苏的手臂蹭了蹭，“哥哥，困。”
徐福看了他们一眼，收起家当，用一块布包起，连同今日赚的钱，起身道：“走，找客栈。”原本清冷的嗓音，染上了些许的激动。
嬴政看了他一眼，忍不住嘴角上扬了一些。
这模样的徐福，倒是教人怎么看也看不够。
胡亥高兴地跟着重复了一句，“走！找客栈！”
然后两个跟屁虫加拖油瓶，也不要谁抱，便精力十足地跟在后面，迈着小短腿慢慢走着了。
旁人见了他们这一家四口的模样，都忍不住会心一笑，还夸上一句，“好生可爱的孩子！”
嬴政忍不住伸手将徐福揽到身旁，凑到他耳畔，低声道：“阿福今日出尽风头，坐在那里模样好生勾人。”
徐福斜睨他一眼，“不过坐下来认真与人算个卦，哪里勾人了？”徐福本想说他，心里想着什么，才见别人也是什么，定是嬴政心中淫秽思想过多，所以才会瞧自己觉得勾人。哼。
不过目光触及到面前的两个小萝卜头，徐福也只能把话憋回去了。
不能把孩子带坏。
上梁得正，下梁才能不歪！
四人欢欢喜喜地找到了客栈，交了钱，只要了一间房，再命伙计送水和吃食来。
伙计领着他们进了屋子，屋子比起寝宫，实在狭小得不能再狭小，不过他们谁都不会在此时挑剔，因为比起那茅草屋，已经不知道强出多少倍了。
这屋子收拾得还算干净，被褥摸上去暖和极了。
因着他们四人皆是气度出色，那伙计也不敢怠慢，还另外取了被褥来，担心徐福等人不够用。待用了饭食之后，嬴政帮着徐福，先给俩小孩儿洗了澡，扶苏和胡亥挤在一个木桶里，胡亥笑得眼睛都眯了起来，他丝毫没有难受没有委屈，相反的，还觉得此行好玩儿极了，体验了许多有趣的生活。
只有扶苏面色发红，僵着身子被洗干净了，中途连胡亥捣乱，往他身上噗一头水，他都忘记斥责了。
将那二人先送到围屏后小榻上睡着以后，嬴政和徐福这才一同沐浴起来，因为有小孩子在的缘故，他们倒还没做出什么情动的事，加上确实疲惫至极，便匆匆洗了洗，别的倒是顾不上了。
徐福洗完后，懒惫到了极点，靠着木桶就不想起身了，嬴政无奈，只能伸手将徐福抱了起来，徐福格外乖顺地靠着嬴政的胸前，费了极大的劲儿，才忍住了打呵欠的冲动。他不自觉地嬴政胸前蹭了蹭，嬴政伸手将他揽得更紧，二人上了床榻，将被子裹得极紧，彼此肌肤相贴，徐福不自觉地发出了一声舒服的喟叹声，等他意识到自己这声音太诱人的时候，已经来不及了。
嬴政捏住他的下巴，俯身一吻。
徐福手脚都紧紧绷住了，以为嬴政要隔着围屏，背着俩小孩儿，要来玩什么羞耻play呢，谁知道嬴政吻完后，便大手一抬，捂住了他的眼睛，跟哄孩子似的，低声道：“睡吧。”
徐福觉得有些别扭，但又觉得有点儿难以抵挡的暖意，脑子里迷迷糊糊地思考了会儿，就什么精神也提不起了，他不自觉地伸手抱住了嬴政的腰，抓紧……
待到第二日醒来，伙计再次送来吃食和水，他们洗漱干净，简单用了饭食，转到围屏后，见扶苏和胡亥彼此缠得跟八爪鱼似的，还睡得格外的香，徐福不忍心叫醒他们，就先将他们留在了客栈中。
徐福抬脚往外走，嬴政自然要跟上。
徐福顿住脚步回头看他，“你跟着我做什么？”
“我自然是要跟着你的。”嬴政抿了抿唇角。
“不了，扶苏和胡亥留在客栈中怎么能放心？阿政便留在客栈中照顾他们吧，待到午时我便回来。”不顾脸色黑沉的嬴政，徐福推开了屋门，等大步走出去之后，徐福忍不住眯了眯眼。
命令秦始皇在家带孩子，感觉棒呆了！
此时伙计走上前来，笑道：“先生，有位周夫人在等你呢。”
周夫人？哪个周夫人？徐福懵了一会儿，才想起是那医馆中的妇人！
她……是为了自己的那句批语？

chapters.title: 第133章
chapters.translated_text:
"Spending money to avert disaster"—one of the professional skills of a wandering Taoist.

As for this skill, Xu Fu wasn't truly proficient in it. Are many things really something that can be changed by a single piece of talisman paper? That would be far too ridiculous!

However, the woman had done him a favor, and since she had specifically come to seek his help, Xu Fu naturally couldn't ignore her.

Xu Fu called out to the waiter and had him lead him to the side of the woman from the Zhou family. The woman was sitting in a corner of the lobby, her expression still looking as kind and gentle as before, though her eyes were heavy. It was clear that after hearing Xu Fu’s reading, she must have thought about it more and more upon returning home, eventually becoming too uneasy to let it go, and thus choosing to believe what Xu Fu had said.

"Madam Zhou," the waiter called out in a low voice.

Madam Zhou looked up, and upon catching sight of Xu Fu, she immediately stood up and took two steps forward to greet him. Xu Fu nodded faintly at her, "Please, have a seat, Madam."

Madam Zhou ordered some food to be placed on the table before speaking to Xu Fu: "May I ask, sir, is there a way to resolve what you mentioned yesterday?"

"Your daughter is frail, and I truly cannot help in the slightest. Everyone knows that if one is sick, one must see a doctor. If you are willing, you may bring the young girl to me, and I shall take a look at her physiognomy to see if there is any chance for her fortune to turn in the future. How about that?" Facing a loving mother, Xu Fu didn't want to exaggerate his abilities too much; there was no need to fill her with hope only for her to be even more disappointed in the end.

It was only to have her daughter seen; what harm could there be in that? If it could be resolved, that would naturally be for the best! Madam Zhou agreed without a second thought.

"My daughter has been frail since birth. Our family runs a medical clinic, yet we have no way to help her body. Later, we sought out renowned physicians everywhere, but to no avail..." Madam Zhou hadn't taken it to heart at first. Her daughter was just a bit weak but looked no different from anyone else. She had long planned to find her a good husband in the future. She had thought it was a hopeless matter, but she hadn't expected Xu Fu to point it out in a single sentence.

At the time, Madam Zhou had felt a slight flicker of anger.

In the State of Zhao today, women are often treated as commodities; many men treat their concubines like goods, trading them back and forth.

Her daughter has the medical clinic to rely on, and she could eventually marry a decent husband who would move into their home. But if the reputation of her being frail were to spread, and some man with evil intentions were to plan to marry her and then worry her to death just to seize the clinic, what would they do then?

Not to mention that, if the rumor of her daughter's frailty spread and became a laughingstock, how would her daughter face the world?

It took a long time for Madam Zhou to calm down. After thinking it over carefully, she suddenly saw a glimmer of hope in Xu Fu. Since he could see it, he must be highly skilled, and surely he would have a way to resolve it! Having changed her mindset, Madam Zhou now looked at Xu Fu as someone she absolutely must not offend, but rather someone she should earnestly entreat.

"No cure to be found?" Xu Fu frowned slightly. This was troublesome.

Logically speaking, Jiang You might have a way, but since Jiang You left Xianyang, how would Xu Fu know where he is now? Calling someone from thousands of miles away would certainly be a huge favor! Not to mention that, right now, he and Ying Zheng were in a difficult situation; it was already good enough to look after themselves, let alone someone else's family.

The idea of finding Jiang You spun through Xu Fu's mind, but he eventually set it aside for the time being.

It would be perfectly fine to wait until he saw the young girl's face before deciding.

After seeing Madam Zhou off, Xu Fu went out to the same spot as yesterday, set up his stall, and continued his grand career of fortune-telling.

With the groundwork laid yesterday, how could he worry about business today?

People came to ask for readings, to draw lots out of curiosity, or to have their fortunes told using the Bagua plate... one after another. However, no one dared to touch the tortoise shell; in the eyes of the common folk, that was something used only for royal divination. If they were to use it, wouldn't it shorten their lives?

These people had already secretly concluded that Xu Fu must have an extraordinary background and a noble status.

Some young women, while moved when facing him, could only retreat in disappointment when they thought of the man he had mentioned. They didn't want to be a concubine, let alone have to compete for a man's favor.

A man with such a handsome appearance was better off being watched from afar, cherished in one's heart as a beautiful encounter from one's youth—that was enough.

Xu Fu quite liked the forthrightness and lack of affectation of these young women, and interacting with them was much more relaxed.

The women in the small town were very generous with their money; whether seeking children or a good marriage, they didn't hesitate to spend. In just over an hour, Xu Fu already had enough money to pay back the medical clinic.

Xu Fu looked up at the sky.

Hmm, it was almost noon. He should pack up his things and head back to the inn. Leaving Ying Zheng at the inn to look after Fusu and Huhai—Xu Fu felt that... it wasn't very reliable.

Just as Xu Fu picked up the tortoise shell, a pair of shoes suddenly entered his line of sight.

"Could you cast a lot for me, sir?"

With business at hand, Xu Fu couldn't refuse. He had to put down the tortoise shell and look up to size up the person before him.

The man in front of him was dressed in flashy, gaudy clothes and had mismatched eyes. He was clutching a money bag in his hand, and it was bulging. He was intentionally showing off in front of Xu Fu.

Xu Fu had seen plenty of such people, so there wasn't even a hint of a change in his expression.

"Please," Xu Fu said in a low voice.

Regardless of the other person's temperament or whether they were easy to get along with, at this moment, they were just his customer.

The man grinned.

Countless gazes, filled with either caution or fear, were cast from the side.

Xu Fu took in the reactions of the crowd. Could the person in front of him be some troublesome playboy? Was he here to pick a fight on purpose? Otherwise, why would the owners of the nearby shops be casting sympathetic looks at him?

The man ignored the surrounding gazes, squatted down in front of Xu Fu, pointed at the Bagua plate, then at the tortoise shell, and said with extreme disdain: "Just these trinkets? Can they determine life and death? See through one's destiny?"

"Yes," Xu Fu said, not the least bit angry.

In his previous life, when he set up a stall under the pedestrian bridge, he had heard things far more unpleasant than this. Even when he was at the Fengchang Temple, he hadn't heard fewer disparaging remarks. For him, any amount of cold looks or mockery was like a light itch.

In his past life, some people would point at him and curse, asking why he didn't do something proper instead of coming out to swindle people, calling him truly sick! Some even told their children that if they didn't study hard, they would end up like him, setting up a stall to swindle people.

Whenever that happened, Xu Fu could only sigh in his heart that no one appreciated his purity.

He wasn't like those beggars who had hands and feet but went around begging, nor did he concoct scams to extort money. He set up a stall, told fortunes, and earned his own living; what did he have to feel guilty about? If others wanted to blame him, let them blame him.

Seeing Xu Fu's indifferent reaction, the man couldn't help but feel a bit disappointed.

Weren't these wandering sorcerers most afraid of people not believing them? After such a provocation, he hadn't even changed his expression.

The man's interest grew even more; he wanted to see what kind of extraordinary skills this fortune-teller actually had.

"Take a look for me—how is my future?" The man lifted his chin proudly, his eyebrows almost flying up to the sky.

What was there to look at with this appearance?

"You will have enough food and clothing, but you have no real future," Xu Fu said without a second thought, not even pausing for a moment.

The man was stunned. When he realized what Xu Fu had said, he couldn't help but look angry. He stood up, looked down at Xu Fu, ground his teeth, and said in a chilling tone, "What did you say?"

Xu Fu really wasn't afraid of him. So what if he stood tall? His aura was leaking, his face was ferocious—it was clear he was just bluffing. People like this were mostly empty shells on the inside, relying entirely on a fierce exterior to intimidate others. If such a person stood in front of Ying Zheng, he would probably be scared to the point of wetting himself.

Xu Fu didn't intend to give the man any face. His readings yesterday and today had mostly been gentle, which might make people think he was soft. So now, he would demonstrate his own mettle, whether to intimidate this person or to put on a show for the others.

He looked calm, lifted his eyelids, looked at the man in front of him, and said: "I said, not only do you have no future, but I fear you will also face a bloody disaster."

After saying this, Xu Fu rolled the four words "bloody disaster" around on his tongue.

It had been a long time since he had said these words to anyone; he had truly missed them. Saying them now gave him an inexplicable sense of pleasure.

The onlookers who were watching for fun couldn't help but widen their eyes, frequently looking at the man, as if they wanted to see clearly if he was really going to have a bloody disaster. After all, among so many who had come for a reading, he was the only one to receive such a terrible prophecy!

Most of the townspeople didn't like this man, so they couldn't help but feel a bit expectant. If he really did have a bloody disaster, that would be truly amusing!

Seeing more and more gazes fixed on him, the man became angry and embarrassed. He raised his foot to kick the things in front of Xu Fu. Xu Fu moved nimbly, pulling up the cloth spread on the ground; with a pull and a fold, the items were gathered inside. Not only did the man fail to kick anything, but because he used too much force, his foot slipped with a "swish," and he fell flat on his back right in front of Xu Fu.

Everyone was stunned, their expressions complex. This man had a bad reputation in town, and no one liked him, but he had a wealthy father, so ordinary people didn't want to provoke him. Yet, such a person had so easily... made a fool of himself in front of everyone?

The man's face turned red. Frustrated, he cursed, "You scoundrel! You... you actually sabotaged me!"

Sabotaged? Did I pull your pants down? Or put nails under your feet? Xu Fu glanced at him and said coldly, "A bloody disaster has occurred once, and I fear there will be a second. If you are not careful, I fear you will have another bloody disaster."

The man struggled to crawl up from the ground. A few servants ran over from not far away, hurriedly helping him up, all casting angry glares at Xu Fu.

The others couldn't bother watching the fun anymore; they were all shocked.

A bloody disaster...

They watched the man stand up, and because he had fallen so unexpectedly, he had bitten himself, and blood was flowing from his mouth. This... wasn't this exactly a bloody disaster? Was this a coincidence? Was it something Mr. Xu had done on purpose? Or had Mr. Xu already predicted it?

"You... you're talking nonsense! I'm going to have a bloody disaster? Ha! You must have plotted against me on purpose!"

"If you don't believe me, then just wait, sir. Perhaps it will befall you before long," Xu Fu said unhurriedly, and he also stood up. He didn't know until he stood up—he was startled. Xu Fu discovered that the other person was actually... shorter than him? The fierce aura from just a moment ago, set against his height and temperament, instantly crumbled into dust.

The man's face turned even redder, and he couldn't help but take a step back. This step back pulled at his backside. Perhaps it had been bruised from the fall earlier, and the man's face twisted, and he couldn't help but hiss.

"You... you... I..." The man was so frustrated he couldn't speak. No matter how imposing he usually was, at this moment in front of Xu Fu, he felt as if he couldn't exert any power at all.

"Excuse me, move your feet. I should be heading back." People here probably didn't have the habit of eating lunch, but Xu Fu had long been spoiled, so even when he was out, he naturally had to have lunch, otherwise his stomach would have a hard time adapting.

The man not only didn't move his feet but instead blocked Xu Fu's path, arrogantly saying: "Let me tell you, if you don't want me to seek revenge, you'd better find a way to please me right now, otherwise..."

Did this person have a habit of talking to himself? Xu Fu didn't even look at him and simply walked around him.

Seeing this, how could the man let him go easily? He immediately ordered his servants to step forward and surround Xu Fu.

Seeing the servants surround Xu Fu, the man couldn't help but reveal an evil grin. But his appearance was truly... a bit clumsy, as if he were imitating the image of a bully from a storybook, but the imitation was a bit stiff. Could this playboy be a newcomer, not yet skilled in his trade?

"If you... if you follow me, I won't hold today's events against you..."

"What did you say?" Xu Fu turned back, looking at the man with indifferent eyes.

The man trembled involuntarily, "I, I said..."

Xu Fu's flower-like face entered his vision; even just a cold look made the man's mouth go dry. He had had no interest in fortune-telling at all; he had only heard people say that someone had come to town who was incredibly handsome, and that this person was actually fond of men! The speaker had no intention, but the listener did. The man had immediately taken it to heart, and so he had come to see Xu Fu today.

Once he saw the person in the flesh, the man's heart was stirred, and he couldn't hold back, immediately using the most low-level tactics.

A hint of covetousness finally appeared in the man's eyes. Xu Fu was a bit unhappy—was homosexuality rampant everywhere? How could there be men in such a remote town who dared to covet him?

"What are you doing?!"

Before Xu Fu could act, a sharp shout suddenly rang out.

"I was wondering where you had gone! Are you out here causing trouble with people again?" The person's voice was deep and had quite a bit of deterrent power. Even though Xu Fu didn't turn around to look at the person's appearance, he could feel that this person truly had an imposing manner.

"Father, I..." Before the man could finish his sentence, the voice interrupted him again: "Get back here!"

The servants hurriedly stepped forward and grabbed the man. Without caring about status, they were all as obedient as mice seeing a cat, dragging him away.

People on the side of the road greeted the man warmly, calling out, "Boss Yang..."

Xu Fu turned back and took a hurried glance. Boss Yang had a kind face, a medium build, and a touch of dignity between his brows, but when facing the common people, he was surprisingly gentle. This father and son were truly as different as night and day!

Since someone had automatically cleared the way, Xu Fu didn't intend to stay any longer and immediately turned to leave. However, the gazes of the townspeople looking at him were filled with more awe than the day before.

When Xu Fu reached a corner, he suddenly felt as if someone was staring at him closely from behind.

Xu Fu turned around abruptly, but he saw nothing.

The man had already been taken away; who else could be lurking behind him? Xu Fu frowned slightly. But no matter how sharp his eyes were, he couldn't pick that person out from the crowd, so Xu Fu had to give up and walk away quickly.

Upon returning to the inn, Xu Fu immediately called the waiter and ordered food. The waiter opened his mouth, "...Eating now?"

"Don't ask about anything else, just go."

Seeing Xu Fu's indifferent expression, the waiter didn't dare ask any more questions for fear of offending him, so he could only nod submissively and leave quickly.

Xu Fu went upstairs and pushed open the door, but seeing no one there, his heart sank. Could it be... that they had encountered some danger? He hurried forward two steps, then suddenly heard Hu Hai let out a giggle, and the heavy stone that had been hanging in Xu Fu's heart suddenly dropped. He turned around the folding screen and finally saw the three of them. Hu Hai was sitting on the couch, insisting on dragging Fu Su to play with him.

As for Ying Zheng, he was standing by the window, his gaze cold and distant as he looked outside, though it was unclear what he was watching.

On the contrary, some women passing by downstairs, as well as the gaudily dressed courtesans in the women's quarters across the street, couldn't help but glance at Ying Zheng frequently. Ying Zheng might not have been as pleasing to the eye as Xu Fu, but he excelled in his tall and sturdy stature, which inevitably caught people's attention.

Xu Fu happened to witness this scene, and for some reason, he felt a bit awkward. However, he had always maintained a cold and detached expression, so whether his face was cold or not at this moment made no difference.

"I'm back," Xu Fu said in a low voice.

As soon as the words left his mouth, Xu Fu recalled the crazy Taoist priest on the mountain from his previous life who loved watching soap operas; often, when a husband returned home, he would say exactly this, and then his little wife would come forward to take his coat and bag...

Little wife...

Ying Zheng happened to turn around, and that resolute, handsome face overlapped with the words "little wife" in Xu Fu's mind.

Xu Fu shivered involuntarily.

Oh, this is truly terrifying.

Ying Zheng stepped forward to take the cloth bag from his hand and said in a low voice, "You were gone too long." A faint crease appeared between Ying Zheng's brows.

Having Xu Fu out of his sight for too long made Ying Zheng feel uneasy. After all, they were currently in the Zhao State, and there were dangers everywhere; if they were the slightest bit careless, no one could say what might happen.

"Once I finish earning enough money this afternoon, I won't go anymore." Xu Fu really didn't need to go anymore.

Over the past two days, the people in town had been flocking to him; in less than two days, he would have finished fortune-telling for everyone who needed it, and then there would be no more business. He might as well just rest at the inn.

The fees he had collected yesterday and today were not low, and combined, they should amount to a considerable sum. Of course, it couldn't compare to being in Xianyang City. At this moment, Xu Fu actually missed his senior brother, Jiang You, who was wealthy and generous, always afraid that Xu Fu would suffer, and would casually pull out large sums of money.

Ying Zheng's expression softened slightly. "That is good." Seeing Xu Fu distracted, he assumed he was hungry, so after putting down the cloth bag, he prepared to go out to find a waiter.

Xu Fu stopped him. "I have already ordered from the waiter."

Ying Zheng nodded, but suddenly felt a bit frustrated.

Originally, he was the one who was supposed to protect Xu Fu everywhere, so how was it that after leaving the palace, it was Xu Fu who ended up handling everything? A subtle sense of weirdness arose in Ying Zheng's heart; he wished he could keep Xu Fu in the palm of his hand, letting him worry about nothing and handling everything himself.

However, Ying Zheng could only think about it. Even if he didn't want to admit it, the current situation was that Xu Fu was supporting him, the King of Qin, by setting up a stall to tell fortunes...

The waiter knocked and entered, setting the food on the table, and couldn't help but glance at Ying Zheng with curiosity.

The town was small, and the news that Xu Fu and Ying Zheng were a couple had spread quickly; the waiter had naturally heard about it and couldn't help but be curious.

Seeing the envy on the waiter's face, both Xu Fu and Ying Zheng were stunned.

"What is he envious of?" Xu Fu asked in astonishment.

Fu Su pushed aside his troublesome younger brother, slid down from the couch, put on his little-adult face again, and said seriously, "Perhaps it is because that waiter has not yet taken a wife..."

Xu Fu let out an "Hmm."

Was it because he had been invisibly "dog-abused" (made to feel like a single person watching a couple)?

Ying Zheng also understood the meaning behind Fu Su's words. He curled his lips involuntarily and suddenly felt that, in fact, being "supported" by Xu Fu like this should be sweet.

Xu Fu buried his head in his meal and didn't say another word.

If he knew what Ying Zheng was thinking, he would definitely have said, "The heart of the First Emperor is like a needle at the bottom of the sea! A man who changes his face faster than turning a page!"

After the meal, Xu Fu rested for a while leaning against Ying Zheng. Having fully enjoyed the warmth, Ying Zheng readily let Xu Fu go out to set up his stall. Anyway, Xu Fu had already given his promise; after the afternoon, Xu Fu would continue to stay by his side.

The King of Qin, Zheng, was rarely eating "soft rice" (being supported by his partner)...

After Xu Fu set up his stall, the number of people coming to find him had indeed decreased significantly, and that man did not come to cause trouble again.

However, after Xu Fu sat there for a while, he finally caught the person who had been secretly observing him from behind.

It was a man dressed in simple clothes, under thirty, in the prime of his life, but he had prematurely graying hair and a face full of weathering, with only a pair of eyes that were exceptionally firm and clear. Setting aside everything else about him, just looking at his demeanor, one felt he was quite extraordinary. Could such a person exist in such a small town?

The man sat at a small stall not far away, ordering only a bowl of soup, and sat there for the whole afternoon. He seemed to have noticed that Xu Fu was watching him, so he looked at Xu Fu even more openly. This thick skin... was truly not ordinary!

What should have been a sleazy and annoying act was done by him with such natural ease that Xu Fu couldn't even get angry and had to let him watch.

It couldn't be that this man was also interested in men, could it?

The woman opposite Xu Fu looked back and whispered, "That man's surname is Yao. He's an idle fellow who can't even afford a meal, wandering around all day without even a wife. Not many people in town know him. Sir, don't pay him any mind; he acts very strangely."

So he was an outsider too.

Xu Fu nodded, withdrew his gaze, and carefully examined the woman.

Soon, the sun set behind the mountains. Xu Fu realized it was getting late and immediately stood up to pack his things. The stall owner next to him asked with a smile, "Sir, will you come tomorrow?"

Xu Fu shook his head. "If I calculate too much, it won't be accurate anymore. I won't come tomorrow." After saying that, he took his things and headed toward the medical clinic. Because he wasn't familiar with the clinic, Xu Fu even had to ask for directions.

The man surnamed Yao didn't follow him, which made Xu Fu breathe a sigh of relief.

That man was different from others; his gaze carried a bit of aggression and a bit of scrutiny, which always made Xu Fu feel vigilant.

Xu Fu shook his head, cast the man out of his mind, and stepped into the medical clinic.

Madam Zhou came out to greet him personally.

She smiled and said, "Sir, why have you come? I will have someone bring my little daughter out right away."

"I've come to repay the money," Xu Fu said very naturally.

Madam Zhou was stunned. "This, this is not necessary..."

"Repaying money is only right. If you want to trouble me, that money will be calculated separately," Xu Fu said. It was better to keep the accounts clear. That she was willing to help him was due to her kindness, but since he had money, he should naturally repay the debt.

Upon hearing this, Madam Zhou was startled for a moment, then smiled gently. "Very well, then we shall listen to you, Sir."

At this moment, a wail came from the inner room.

A rather familiar person walked out from inside and asked, "Is the medicine ready? Hurry! My young master is in so much pain he's about to die!"

The clinic assistant curled his lip and handed over the medicine.

The man's gaze inadvertently swept over Xu Fu, and he screamed, "It's you!" He paused, then immediately added, "It's you, you harmed my young master, he was beaten so badly he can't even get out of bed!"

Xu Fu immediately guessed the origin of the other party.

This was the servant of the man who had come to find trouble. The one wailing inside was likely the man who had been taken back by his father and given a sound thrashing.

Xu Fu raised an eyebrow slightly and walked toward that direction.

The servant was immediately nervous and hurriedly tried to raise his hand to stop him. "You, you, what are you doing? What are you going to do to my young master?"

Xu Fu glanced at him lightly. "What could I possibly do?" He was just here to see a joke.

As he spoke, Xu Fu lifted the curtain and easily saw the person lying on the small couch inside. He had half his buttocks exposed, looking somewhat bloodied and mangled. Xu Fu really couldn't bear to look, so he quickly turned his head, but the man quickly noticed him and couldn't help but shout loudly, "Beauty!"

The man didn't know his name, so he followed his heart and called him that.

This shout was truly loud, and half the people in the clinic heard it. Madam Zhou's expression was extremely awkward, and the servant was on high alert, fearing that Xu Fu would suddenly explode and pin his young master to the ground to beat him up again.

Xu Fu sneered, "Looking at it now, the 'bloody disaster' you suffered wasn't enough, was it..." Xu Fu used the polite term "Zunjia" (Your Excellency) repeatedly, but it was merely to mock the other party. How could this person be worthy of being called "Your Excellency"?

Hearing this, the man shivered involuntarily. "You, you, you... do you know witchcraft?" Without waiting for Xu Fu to answer, he hugged his servant's thigh and sobbed, "I heard long ago that some sorcerers are extremely beautiful but have vicious hearts, are ruthless in their actions, and can cast curses. Sure enough, he said I would have a bloody disaster... and then I fell, and was beaten by my father..."

After finishing, he glared at Xu Fu with bloodshot eyes, gritting his teeth. "Tell me, what other bloody disaster do you want me to suffer next?"

Xu Fu was so dizzy from his crying.

Aren't you a playboy? Didn't you want to take advantage of me? How are you so cowardly! You're crying already? And it was clearly your own fate that destined you to suffer these bloody disasters, yet you turn it around and accuse me of cursing you!

Xu Fu had never seen such a shameless and cowardly person, and for a moment, he didn't know whether to laugh or be angry.

"Come here, help me up!" the man shouted loudly.

The servant hurried forward, made a crutch for him, and the man leaned on the servant's shoulder, barely standing up, and even walked to in front of Xu Fu.

As soon as the man saw Xu Fu, he couldn't help but blush, but mixed with his snot and tears, his appearance, which wasn't great to begin with, looked even more ridiculous.

"You..." the man cleared his throat and said, "Although you have a vicious heart and treated me like this, I am kind-hearted, so I will allow you to follow me!"

Xu Fu was almost laughed to anger by him.

Where did he get such nerve?

"Who gave you the qualification to allow it?" A cold, chilling voice suddenly rang out.

Xu Fu turned to look and immediately saw Ying Zheng walking in from outside with a dark face. Ying Zheng was tall and had a resolute face; when he got closer, compared to that man, he even appeared somewhat imposing. The man was like a little chick in front of him, truly weak. The man carefully raised his head and locked eyes with Ying Zheng. He wanted to show off, but before he could speak, he was already shaking uncontrollably.

Ying Zheng only released a little of his aura, and the man couldn't withstand it.

"Come here, I have something to say to you." Ying Zheng crooked his finger at the man.

"Say what?"

"About him." Ying Zheng pointed at Xu Fu.

The man believed it to be true and called his servant to help him out of the clinic.

Xu Fu's mouth twitched; what a truly simple-minded playboy!

"The third bloody disaster... will also harm others... if you had listened to my words earlier, wouldn't it have been better?" Xu Fu shook his head and turned to look at Madam Zhou. "Then please have the young lady come out."

The woman nodded.

As for the young daughter Madam Zhou mentioned, Xu Fu had wondered how young she was, but after she came out, Xu Fu realized she was already fourteen or fifteen. Her hair was braided into double buns, and her features were delicate, but her gaze was a bit weak, giving one a sense of lethargy at first glance. She was indeed suffering from an illness.

The young girl saw Xu Fu and bowed, saying, "Sir, my name is Shu Qiu."

Xu Fu nodded. "Sit."

Shu Qiu looked at her mother, and after receiving permission, she sat down.

Madam Zhou let out a slow breath and said, "Recently, I don't know why, but her complexion has been getting worse than before, which has me terribly worried."

Shu Qiu's cheeks flushed slightly, as if she were embarrassed by her mother talking about her condition in front of a stranger.

This young girl seemed to have a good temperament and should have a very open and broad mind; how could such a congenital deficiency easily worsen?

"Let me take a closer look."

First, look at the face, then the palm; if that doesn't yield a result, then set up the Bagua plate and offer the fortune sticks.

Xu Fu had plenty of methods.

Shu Qiu was stared at until her face turned even redder; at first glance, the two looked as if they were staring at each other with deep affection.

At this moment, a wailing sound rang out. "Quick, quick, help me in!" Such a familiar voice. Back so soon? Xu Fu turned to look at the door; the man was bruised and swollen, leaning on his servant, looking miserable, and even his servant hadn't fared well. After these three bloody disasters... the man's appearance was almost beaten beyond recognition; it was possible that when he returned to the mansion, his father wouldn't even recognize him.

If this man was determined to be a playboy bully, after today, he would probably have psychological trauma.

The clinic assistant hurried to greet him and re-apply medicine.

And Ying Zheng walked in slowly with his sleeves tucked. But his nonchalant expression changed the moment he saw the girl opposite Xu Fu; he became like a crouching leopard, instantly exploding into action upon encountering danger.

How could an ordinary person withstand his oppressive force?

Shu Qiu couldn't help but shiver in front of him, her face turning slightly pale.

Seeing this, Xu Fu had no choice but to take the initiative and squeeze Ying Zheng's wrist.

If this little girl had a heart condition and was scared to death by Ying Zheng, what would he do?

Ying Zheng pursed his lips, his expression softened slightly, and he held Xu Fu's wrist in return, guarding by his side.

Madam Zhou breathed a sigh of relief, fearing that Ying Zheng would make trouble again.

Shu Qiu asked in a low voice, "Is, is he the Sir's husband?"

Madam Zhou's body suddenly tensed up, thinking to herself, why is my daughter so rude, asking such a private question?

And Ying Zheng narrowed his eyes at this moment, but instead laughed. "That's right!" As he spoke, he held Xu Fu's wrist even tighter.

How could Xu Fu lose face for Ying Zheng in front of outsiders? Besides, he had said himself the day before that Ying Zheng was his man, so Xu Fu nodded along.

Shu Qiu nodded, thoughtfully saying, "So this is what is written on the bamboo slips..."

Madam Zhou's expression darkened. "Shu Qiu, what have you been reading all day?"

Shu Qiu pouted and didn't speak to her.

From Shu Qiu's attitude, Xu Fu felt he had caught a glimpse of something.

However, he temporarily pushed that guess aside and turned to continue looking at Shu Qiu's face. Because Ying Zheng was by his side, Shu Qiu couldn't blush anymore; she bit her lip hard, her face turning slightly pale, and perhaps because she was too nervous, Xu Fu noticed her breathing was actually somewhat rapid.

Madam Zhou stepped forward with heartache and rubbed her chest.

Xu Fu was a bit surprised.

This... could this be an ancient version of heart disease?

Author's note: Xu Xiao Fu: From today on, I am the head of the household! Look, the money I earned supports the whole family!

Fu Su clapped his hands very cooperatively: Father is amazing!

Hu Hai followed suit without knowing why: Father is amazing!

The sturdy First Emperor, who was inexplicably crowned with the title of "little wife": ...As long as you are happy.
