作家仆打扮的男子快步跑上前来，气喘吁吁道：“先生、先生可会捉鬼？”
“你这人，怎么突然便跑来与我们抢人！”先前问巫术的人，见状立即竖起了眉毛，面色不善地骂道。
那家仆看也不看他，满面焦急地求道：“先生，我们府中的姑娘，像是被魇住了一般，这四下求救无门，求先生施一施援手……”
“先生，我先求到你这里的……”
“先生、先生……”不多时，又有人急忙跨进了客栈中，显然都是朝着徐福而来的。
徐福不自觉地将左手掌贴合在右手腕上，微微摩挲。
他原本只是随手一试，却没想到那布条当真能有这样大的作用。那布条自己不能化作人形，却能贴在人身上，接过人身的主导权，令人做出许多奇怪的行为，仿佛化身提线木偶。
这在巫术上也是有记载的，徐福没想到，乍一用，效果竟然就是这样的好。
他的精血，算是没白给那布条！
徐福脑子里想着布条，便免不了有一些走神，只是他神色漠然，眸光清冷，常人都不敢与他对视，因而这些人并未发觉他的走神，反倒还因为他的沉默不语，顿时心下忐忑，面上更为尊敬。
“先生……”
面前的一干人都露出了苦色。
明明之前面前这位也是给钱就给算卦的人，怎么如今反倒不摆摊子了，架子也拿捏起来了，瞧这模样，竟是轻易不能打动。
但他们谁也不敢发怒。
镇子小，镇上能找过的人，他们提前都找过了，这也是突然间想起，镇上来了个特别精通卜筮之道的神仙人物，因而这些人抱着最后的侥幸，匆匆找上门来。
若是这人真有本事，他们一鲁莽，坏了事，那就糟糕了！
徐福终于回了神，抬手轻点面前的人，“你先来，那你先与我进来吧。”说完，徐福没再看那人一脸欣喜若狂的表情，而是转头看向其他人，在他们脸上变色之前，出声道：“我知你们心急，但既然你们后来，那便要按照这个顺序来，若是心急等不了，去寻他人便是。”
这镇上哪里还有个他人可以寻？他们甚至都派人到附近去寻有本事的方士了，但死活就是寻不到。
不就是按照顺序来等一等吗？这些人暗暗一咬牙，齐齐露出笑容来，作宽宏状，道：“是是，先生说得对，我们愿意等的。”
徐福转身将那人带进了屋子。
进了屋后，那人倒也不敢视线乱飘，他甚至都不敢在徐福面前落座，徐福坐下来后，他忙躬着腰，姿态摆得极低与徐福交谈。
徐福虽然因为坐下来，看上去比他矮了许多，但那人却惊觉，自己在对方的面前，气势仿佛被碾压到了泥土里去。
那人暗暗惊心。
这位先生说不定真的有大本事！他定了定神，这才将危急的情况一一道来。
“家中姑娘从昨日起，便一句话也不说，目光木呆呆的，谁叫也不理，食物不吃，水也不喝……这就是铁打的人也受不了啊……”那人越说脸上的悲苦色越加浓重。
可见那姑娘突然表现出的诡异，将家中人实在吓得够呛。
“可有撞过什么邪祟？”徐福不急不忙地问道。
这还是他头一次，正儿八经地假装成捉鬼驱邪的神棍。业务不够熟练的徐福，很努力地装着专业。大约是他那一身气质信服力实在太强，那人全然没发现徐福的不专业。
“未、未曾啊，家中姑娘平日里出门较少，只是前两天，因为家中郎君染病，姑娘便替郎君到周家妇人那里去求了药。”
徐福点了点头，“姑娘如今可能见人？单从你的描述，我并不能贸然断定是出了什么问题，最好便是再见一见人，我方能对着症状去下手解决。”
“能的，先生要见，那定然是能见的！”那人激动地道。
“走吧，我过去瞧一瞧，此事恐有些棘手。”
听见“棘手”两个字，那人脸色白了白，但还是强撑着脸上殷切的笑意，请徐福出了屋门。
见徐福一出来，其他还守在旁边的人顿时又涌了上来，“先生可好了？先生可能听我说一说？”
走在徐福身侧的人脸色大变，怒道：“先生现在要与我回去，你们急什么？”
其他人虽有不满，但毕竟不敢在徐福跟前闹腾，于是只得将心中的不满都憋了回去。
“你们在这里做什么？”嬴政带着两三侍从，从外面走进来，脸色黑沉，极具威慑力。
众人不自觉地打了个哆嗦，暗暗道，这先生的男人，脾气怎的这样不好？而且面色厉起来，竟然这样可怖……这样的人，竟然也能与先生走到一处去……那些人心中腹诽不已，面上却是笑眯眯的，“我们是来求先生施个援手的。”
“施什么援手？”嬴政面色更冷，他称职地扮着黑脸。
这也是他与徐福早早便商量好了的，此举不过是加重人们的印象，让他们清楚记得，当初是他们求徐福去的，而不是徐福自己要去的。自然也不可能有人会将这些事，往徐福头上去联想。
哪怕到时候那杨老板聪明一回，找出背后操纵的大手，知道害得他计划失败的人是谁，他说出来也并不会有人相信。
“家中有人出了事，求先生过去解救……”他们尴尬地笑笑道。
嬴政看向徐福这方，语气陡然柔和了不少，两相对比，简直是完完全全的两副面孔，“你要随他们去看一看？”
徐福点头，“救人也算是功德。”
嬴政皱了皱眉，不悦道：“那我陪你前去。”
“这……”徐福迟疑地看向身旁的人。
嬴政顺着他的目光看过去，冷冷地看着那人道：“如何？”
那人很努力地控制住让自己不要腿软，笑道：“那、那自然是行的。”
“那走吧。”嬴政伸手，将徐福拉到自己身侧来，随后吩咐身后的侍从，“你们去看着那俩小家伙。”
“喏。”侍从的目光凉凉地从众人身上扫过，直将他们扫得鸡皮疙瘩都起来了，随后才上了楼。
众人心中忍不住犯嘀咕，这人到底什么来头？明明之前到镇上来的时候看上去还有些落魄，听人说还差点落到去住草屋的境地，怎么现在又变得排场如此大？众人想不出个结果，只能暗暗在心中告诫自己。
要更尊敬那徐先生……
徐福一行人很快出了客栈，有嬴政在侧，那人在路上连一句话也不敢与徐福说，不仅如此，还全程都绷紧了心，出于本能地对着嬴政畏惧不已。
他们进了府，府中家仆将他们请到了院子中去，那院子里呆呆地站着一人。
那是个年轻姑娘，尚未及笄的年纪，头发披散在身后，大大的眼睛呆滞地瞧着前方，像是还没能从梦魇中摆脱出来。
徐福走上前去，发现布条应该已经不在她身上了。
姑娘之所以会这样，只是被上身的后遗症而已。
你想啊，一块布条儿附到身上。
那布条儿本来就算是死物，只吃过徐福的精血，那布条儿又怎么可能会吃人的食物，怎么会说话，怎么会搭理人呢？布条在得到徐福的指示后，本来是打算做一些更能吓住人的事，谁能想到，那布条儿只是按照本性，拒绝吃喝说话，就已经将家中人吓得不轻了。
徐福觉得，这个程度倒也刚好合适。
这样刚好能弄得人心惶惶，但又不至于将人吓得方寸大乱，甚至做出些极端的事来。
“如、如何？”不多时，这姑娘的家里人便跟着出来了，他们围在徐福的身旁，小心地出声问着这姑娘的情况。
因为徐福身侧还站着一个嬴政，这些人就是心中再惶然，也不敢挤到徐福身边去。
这时徐福立刻感觉到了，带着嬴政在身旁的好处，至少他可以不用被吵得心慌，被挤得难受了。
“像是被谁上身了一样……”徐福皱眉，装模作样地思考起来。
旁边的人连忙道：“可不是吗？现在这模样就跟被谁上了身一样！”
“但这并非上身。”徐福肯定道。
“那、那这是什么？”旁人一脸迷茫。
“若是上身，你家姑娘的神魂定然都没了，但现在她的三魂七魄分明都还在。只是她精神呆滞，倒像是接触了何物后的后遗症。如今我只能暂时给她施个法，让她不拒吃喝，但若要恢复到从前的模样，我还得仔细琢磨一番。”
“好好！先这样也好……”
只要能吃喝，那至少不会让人饿死或渴死。
“过来。”徐福对姑娘招了招手。
那姑娘突然转过头来，瞥了徐福一眼，不自不觉便往他这个方向走了过来。
旁边的人见状，瞪大了眼，不自觉地屏住了呼吸。
他们哪里知道，若是他们有人能长着徐福这样的一张脸，足够夺目，那也能将那姑娘吸引过来了。
巫书上记载的是，在出现后遗症后，用那人平日喜好的东西，唤回她的注意力就好。
徐福不知她喜欢什么，也就先出声叫她试试了，没想到那姑娘定定地看着自己的脸，竟是真的就这样走过来了。
可见……大约……人就算没了知觉……也是本能喜好美色的。
只是嬴政瞧着这一幕，脸色黑了黑，和周围满面喜悦的人形成了鲜明的对比。
“取露水，雨水，井水来。”徐福略略一思虑，随口胡诌了一句。
“这是做什么？”问的人将声音压得降低，生怕冒犯了徐福。
“露水、雨水、井水乃是汇合天下灵气的存在，它们将能起到极大的作用。”
别的这些人都听不懂，但他们能听出，“汇合天下灵气”，那一定是个好东西！于是他们匆匆忙忙的去找露水和井水，只有那雨水，平日里谁会去收集啊？一时间倒是拿不出的。
青铜器中装着水，被盛到徐福的跟前来。
徐福沾了些水，点在那姑娘的太阳穴和眼皮之上。
其实就是让那姑娘受凉意，好早些清醒过来。若是徐福手头有瓶风油精，那定然能将那姑娘直接给熏醒。
所以看上去逼格极高，仿佛真的汇聚灵气的玩意儿，拿来也就只有这么个作用，糊弄一下这些人罢了。
“然后呢？”他们紧张地问，同时目光紧紧地盯着徐福，似乎生怕错过任何一个大场面。
然后……然后其实我也不知道。
徐福面上淡定，装作迟疑地道：“其实这样已经足以，那水被我加持过后，便具有镇压邪祟的作用，但、但姑娘瞧上去，似乎并非撞了邪祟。倒像是失了体内的精气，……”
“那这精气如何寻回来啊？”
“暂时寻不回来，只能以物代替。”
“以何物？只要先生开口说，那我们定然给先生找来！”
“你们之中，何人与她有直系血缘的关系？”
“我，我乃是她的兄长。”一年轻男子直接站了出来，他目光热灼地看着徐福，其中掩藏着一点不信任的色彩。
不过徐福并不在意，不管这些人信不信他能解决此事，反正他的目的都已经达到了。
“那便劳烦阁下割开手指，我只要一滴血。”
“一滴血？”
“是，这一滴血，便代表你体内的精气了，用它来代替令妹体内的精血，以假乱真，身体被欺骗过去后，短期内是可以用的。至于找回她本身的精气，那便要去寻找到源头方能成功。”徐福虽然说得复杂又困难，但正是因为这一番复杂，才让这家的人深信不疑。
若是徐福一上来，便轻松解决了，那才令人觉得奇怪呢。
那年轻男子虽然不是绝对信任徐福的本事，但一滴血用来救妹妹，他还是不吝啬的，他当机立断地用小刀割开了手指。
“点在她唇上。”徐福并不打算自己沾了血再去碰那姑娘的唇，若是这样的话，肯定会引起嬴政的不快。
徐福可没有打算让嬴政不快。
“好。”男子挤出指尖的血，点在那姑娘的唇上。
布条儿是极耗精血的，它缠在姑娘身上的时候，也难免带走一些那姑娘的精气，如今用血替以精气，也算勉强能顶个用处。
血滴在那姑娘的唇边晕开，她不自觉地眨了眨眼，突然倒了下去，众人被她吓了一跳，年轻男子匆忙捞住她的身体，怒道：“这是怎么回事？”
他面色不善地瞪着徐福，若非怀中还抱着他的妹妹，他恐怕就忍不住冲上前来揪住徐福的衣领，厉声质问他了。
“这、这……”其他人也有些慌了。
嬴政直接挡在了徐福的跟前，冷冷地看着年轻男子，他的气势更强，那男子瞪了半天，最后却是自己心里受到的压迫更大，于是不得不撤回了目光。
“你且再看看。”徐福伸手拨开嬴政的身体，冷声道。
年轻男子冷哼一声，又低头去看。
出乎人意料的，那姑娘的脸庞由苍白，一点点，在众人的眼皮子底下，变得红润起来，虽然她还未睁开双眼，却已经传达给了众人，她在恢复良好的信息。
“再等上一段时间，她就能醒来了。”徐福说着转身欲走。
年轻男子以为自己方才的质疑，得罪了徐福，但是碍于怀中还抱着妹妹，又无法上前去阻拦徐福，于是只能憋红了脸，口中无力地叫道：“先生，方才无意冒犯先生的意思……还请先生勿要与我计较……”
“我并不欲与你计较，但我不可能一直守在此处，还有人请我前去，我不便多留了。”徐福的话已经说得极为委婉了，若是更直白的说，他的意思就是，想要将我留在这里一直等，你的脸是不是太大了？
男子面色臊红，道了声“多谢”，随后便命家仆准备酬金，交予徐福。
这家人倒是大方，那酬金接到手中还沉甸甸的，于是徐福顺手就交给了嬴政。
嬴政接住钱囊后，眸光闪了闪，脸上的神色都柔软了不少。徐福能如此大方将钱财交到他的手中，也算是极大的信任了。嬴政至今还小心眼地记着，当初姜游给徐福送了钱，好让他有资本随时离开自己的事。
……
从徐福进府后，半个时辰不到，二人就顶着府中人崇拜又敬畏的目光走了出去。
跨出大门的时候，徐福突然间皱起了眉。
徐福眉头皱着便一直没有松开，嬴政瞥了他一眼，不由得出声问道:“还在为那人的无礼生气？”嬴政说这话的时候带着点儿煞气，像是徐福一旦肯定，他就会掉头回去，将那男子宰了给徐福出气一般。
徐福看见了嬴政眼底真切的担忧，立即摇头道:“不，我是在想，我刚才的表现是不是太简单了？唔，我应该再做一些复杂的仪式，这样才能诓住人啊……”
以为徐福心情不快的嬴政:……
见徐福将这个问题思考得极为认真，嬴政只得安慰道:“去下一家的时候，我们做得复杂一些就是了。”
徐福连连点头，“你说得不错。”
不如等一会儿他再假装念个咒语，念什么呢？就……就念日语好了……虽然他恰好只会那么几句，左右谁也听不懂，能给自身增加极大的神秘感。
嬴政一转头便见徐福又陷入沉思中去了。
嬴政心中无奈，不知是该笑还是该哭。
徐福这样坦诚地在他面前说起装仙风道骨的事，可见当初他在自己跟前也没少装……
徐福就这样暴露出来自己的本性，是当真对自己毫不设防了吗？尽管嬴政已经尽力去忽略，但他还是从心底感觉到一阵被信任被倚靠的舒适感觉。
等他们回到客栈不久，徐福便马不停蹄地被请到了下一个地点。
这些中招的女子，大都是家中小有家财的，徐福这么一趟跑下来，出乎意料的，还赚了一笔不菲的酬金。这些女子症状有相同的，也有不同的，但徐福几乎都可以确定，她们的确都是被布条上身过后，产生了后遗症，而后遗症只要几日后就能消退，消退之后并不会再有任何问题。
纵然如那个姑娘一样，被小布条蹭走一些精气，但只要补上一段时日，便能恢复如初。
等徐福走完这么多家，一天也就差不多过去了。到这时，徐福不得不感叹，小布条实在动作够快，这样虽然太迅猛了一点，不过从另一个好的方面来想，这又何尝不是一次性将所有人都打蒙呢？等他们都蒙了之后，脑子自然不会想到更多，就算过程中有诸多漏洞，也就不一定会被一一注意到了。
夕阳西下，徐福勉强压下身上的疲倦感，和嬴政一同走在街道上。
镇上的人都听闻了多家年轻女子出事，不得不邀请徐福前去帮忙的消息。镇子只有那么大，传播消息的速度是极快的，到这时，众人看着徐福的目光敬畏无比，比之从前，又上了一个高的台阶。
徐福无视了那些目光，快步走回了客栈，随后便告知伙计，之后无论谁来，一律不见，说完他还凉凉地扫了一眼那客栈老板。要知道上次杨老板过来时，便是那客栈老板亲自带的路。
客栈老板尴尬地笑了笑，马上抬起手做了个发誓的动作。
徐福倒也不在乎他拦不拦得住杨老板，只是他该威胁的时候要威胁，不然这些人就真拿他当软柿子好捏了。
徐福和嬴政回到屋中的时候，胡亥和扶苏两个年纪小的已经用过饭食在睡觉了。
侍从推门进来，低声道：“那杨老板有些问题，他是三年前住到镇上来的，初步推测，他或许是犯下什么大事，才逃到这里来的。”
“这能查到？”徐福有些惊讶。
侍从点头笑道：“这自然是能查到的，只是这里毕竟是赵国，多有不便，这两日能查到的东西极少。”
他的话音刚落下，门又再次被推开，甘棠风风火火地走进来，道：“我倒是发现了一些有趣的事。”甘棠虽然嘴上这样说着，但脸上的表情，真看不出有何处有趣了。
“什么有趣的事？”徐福看向他。
在嬴政的跟前，甘棠哪里敢卖关子？当即便将自己在杨府中的见闻说了出来，“那杨老板实在有些变态，年纪不小了，却好美丽的女子，他那儿子倒是与他相似，曾经多次在女闾中，看上了些美丽的妓子，多数妓子被他看上后便没了踪影，实则是被拘在府中了，杨老板在自己的后院筑起高院墙，将她们困在其中，自己则俨然作君主般，享受无数佳丽服侍。”
徐福听得都有些咂舌。
这……嬴政这个正经君主，都比不上他啊！
他这是打算后宫佳丽三千？在镇上做个土皇帝？
甘棠却还没说完，他顿了顿，歇口气，随后才又道：“这不算什么，那杨老板在外面目慈善，曾经还出钱救过几个乞丐堆里的小姑娘，哦，那几个小姑娘如今也在杨府。”
“这么多人失踪，难道没人发现吗？”徐福皱眉。
“不过妓子、乞丐，谁人会去注意？就算注意到，也不会有人去理会。”
徐福只得叹气，这次伪装，最早做的铺垫，便是妓子失踪，再到其他的正经姑娘生癔症。但徐福可没想到，那杨老板竟然还真的拐了不少妓子。
自己还真是一点也没冤枉他！
这样的人，徐福多想上一会儿都觉得实在恶心。
“他还有做什么？”见甘棠眸光冰冷闪烁，徐福本能地觉得，他还有些话没说完。
甘棠抿了抿唇，果然又说起来，“他性子暴躁，喜好打人，打女人，打家仆，连自己儿子也打，次次都下狠手。昨夜我还见他将一弱质女子，打得不成样子……”
不仅好色，还有暴力倾向，道貌岸然的男人。
徐福顿时觉得，自己从到了这个时代以后，见过最恶心的人，非他莫属了，或许也就只有在三川郡的那两个男人，能与他比一比谁更贱了。
听甘棠说完之后，徐福心里的想法顿时就发生了改变。
从前不过是帮书秋一个忙，能撕掉杨老板脸上的伪装，做一做这等有挑战性的事，徐福觉得很有兴致。但现在，杨老板的身上还拴着那么多人，徐福立时觉得，那杨老板死了才能抵债。
“既如此，那这杨老板若是丢了性命，也是理所应当了。”嬴政冷声道。他与徐福倒是想到一处去了。
甘棠嘴角微微上翘，“是的。”
不过很快他嘴角的弧度就又垂了下来，“王上，方才我回来时，见那杨老板带着人向客栈来了。”
徐福浑不在意，“他应当到楼下了。”
甘棠刚想说是否要我前去处置，但见徐福神色淡定非常，便将那话咽了回去。也是，先生那样有本事的人，怎么会惧那杨老板？想来，先生应当是早就安排好了一切。
徐福也的确是早就安排好了。
杨老板带着人一进来，客栈老板就忍不住变了脸色。
杨老板上前，笑了笑，“我来见徐先生。”
客栈老板咬咬牙，心中对杨老板难免已经有了几分怨怼，他脸色不大好地道：“徐先生此时正在休息，不便打扰。”
杨老板并未发现客栈老板的态度转变，依旧笑道：“我寻徐先生有事，你带我前去，我在门外等候就是。”
客栈老板却一狠心，态度坚定地摇了摇头。那杨老板屡屡前来，都故意借地位财力欺压威胁自己。那杨老板既然半点不肯体会他的不易，那他还理会那杨老板做什么？
杨老板的脸色微微变了，没想到会在这处碰壁，他不死心地又让客栈老板带自己前去，而客栈老板心中不爽到了极点，认为这杨老板实在颐指气使了些，随后便全然不搭理他了。
杨老板脸色微沉，终于反应过来，这客栈老板，是不打算配合自己了。
杨老板一向将自己的名声经营得很好，此时哪怕心头再恼怒，他也还是没有直接冲上楼去，将徐福从屋子里揪出来。
他转身往外走，等走出之后，目光立时便阴沉了下来。
若说心中也不确定这徐先生是否与书秋失踪有关，但如今依他看来，哪有那样的巧合，数次都碰不上这徐先生。
他或许是故意避开了我……
杨老板心中恨极，脑中浮现徐福的面庞之后，忍不住发出了一声轻笑，“那么好的一张脸，不如以后剥下来贴在月姬的脸上。”
杨老板身后的家仆闻言，不自觉地打了个哆嗦。
杨老板见状，脸上露出了满意的笑容。
旁人乍一看，还只会觉得，今日杨老板也是这般笑容满面，平易近人啊……
·
镇上妓子出事，并没有谁会去关注，顶多便是在饭后聊上一聊，聊完就立刻抛到脑后去了。而其他那些请了徐福前去的人家，家中的姑娘很快就恢复了，只是突然间这么多人都出问题，这个消息被汇集起来之后，镇子上的人难免有些慌乱，他们开始推测起出了何事，究竟为什么会这样。
这些人都很默契地开始从暗地里调查，家中姑娘之前都接触了谁，吃了什么不该吃的东西。
还没等这些人查出个所以然来。
一夜过去。
有个乞丐疯疯癫癫地跑过街道，口中喊着“火、火、天火”。
镇上百姓迷惑不已，直到他们看见了城南被烧成灰黑色、多年无人居住的草屋。
那火实在太得诡异，听人讲，昨夜他恰好未曾入眠，便见空中有什么东西迅疾飞过，待他定睛看时，便见那玩意儿落了下去。
紧接着又有无数点火苗落下去，乍一看，还以为天上的星宿坠落下来了。
当时那人惶恐不已，跪地祈求神灵，勿要降罪。
这人如此绘声绘色地一说，有人顿觉身临其境、惊恐不已，也有人笑骂他故意编故事来吓人，但等那镇上的疯乞丐都口中喊“火”，众人便不敢将这事当做小事了。
一天过去，没有人查出个所以然来。
这一夜，有心人想要证明并无天火的存在，于是他们打起精神静静等待。而人在某个时间段，往往是极度疲劳的，他们的戒心也会大大降低。等这些人回过神来，天上已经如同下雨一般，下着火苗了。
这样一幕，许多人都瞧见了，等到天亮之后，镇上的人沸腾了。
为什么会降火？那是好的征兆，还是坏的征兆？
神灵会降罪吗？
众人惶惶不安，终于，他们等来了第三日的“天火”。
他们眼睁睁地看着那火苗嗖嗖地落下来，只是今日不同了……他们看着火苗从空中滑落，最后竟然是落在了杨老板的府邸之中，杨府上下匆匆救火。
当时乔装打扮以后的书秋，就站在远远的地方，躲在阴影之下，瞧着杨老板愁苦着脸，指挥府中上下去灭火。
那些家仆刚去打了水来，那些火却又很快熄灭了。
这样诡异的一幕，莫说是其他人了，就连杨老板本人，都忍不住浑身发寒。
好端端的，怎么会起火？
……
徐福和嬴政坐在大堂之中，听人口中讲述着昨日杨老板府上落下火来的事。两人忍不住对视了一眼，十分默契。
坐在一旁的扶苏见状，顿时觉得口中的面饼都难吃了起来。
他默默地低下头，抚了抚胡亥的头。
胡亥天真不知事，乖巧地吃着自己口中的食物，听见大堂里的人说着话，他拉了拉徐福的袖子，问：“这个人是不是犯错了呀，不然为什么会有好多火落下去烧他啊？”
胡亥自以为声音很小，但实际上他一开口，就满堂寂静了。
那些人瞧了他一眼，本想说小孩子你懂什么，但随即看到一旁的徐福和嬴政，他们谁也不敢得罪，于是匆匆转过头去，等转过头之后，冷静下来的众人，惊愕地觉得，那小孩儿说得……似乎并没错。
天降异火，其实是神灵的警告和惩罚……
可杨老板是出了名的大好人，神灵为何要惩罚于他？
从这些人思考这个问题开始，这些人的思想便已经由徐福握在掌心，牵着走了……
chapters.translated_text:
A man dressed as a servant hurried forward, panting, "Sir, sir, do you know how to catch ghosts?"

"You fellow, how can you suddenly run over and snatch someone from us!" The person who had previously asked about witchcraft immediately raised his eyebrows and scolded with an unfriendly expression.

The servant didn't even look at him, begging with a face full of anxiety, "Sir, the young lady in our manor seems to have been possessed by a nightmare. We have nowhere else to turn for help, please, sir, lend us a hand..."

"Sir, I asked you first..."

"Sir, sir..." Not long after, more people hurried into the inn, clearly all coming for Xu Fu.

Xu Fu subconsciously placed his left palm over his right wrist, rubbing it slightly.

He had originally just tried it out of curiosity, but he hadn't expected that the cloth strip could actually have such a great effect. The cloth strip itself could not transform into a human form, but it could attach itself to a person, take over their body's control, and make them perform many strange behaviors, as if they had become a marionette.

This was also recorded in witchcraft, but Xu Fu hadn't expected that upon first use, the effect would be this good.

His essence blood had not been given to the cloth strip in vain!

With his mind on the cloth strip, Xu Fu couldn't help but be a little distracted. However, his expression was indifferent and his gaze cold, so ordinary people dared not meet his eyes. Consequently, these people did not notice his distraction; instead, because of his silence, they felt anxious and became even more respectful on the surface.

"Sir..."

Everyone in front of him showed a bitter expression.

It was clear that this person used to tell fortunes for money, so why was he not setting up a stall now, and why was he putting on such airs? Looking at him, it seemed he could not be easily moved.

But none of them dared to get angry.

The town was small, and they had already sought out everyone they could find in town beforehand. This was why they suddenly remembered that a divine personage, exceptionally proficient in the art of divination, had come to town. Thus, holding onto their last shred of luck, they had hurried to find him.

If this person truly had the ability, and they were reckless and ruined things, that would be terrible!

Xu Fu finally regained his focus and lightly pointed at the person in front of him, "You came first, so you come in with me first." After speaking, Xu Fu did not look at the man's ecstatic expression, but turned to look at the others. Before their expressions could change, he said, "I know you are anxious, but since you came later, you must follow this order. If you are too anxious to wait, go find someone else."

Where else in this town could they find someone else? They had even sent people to nearby areas to look for capable fangshi (alchemists/mystics), but they just couldn't find any.

Isn't it just waiting in order? These people secretly gritted their teeth, all put on a smile, acting magnanimous, and said, "Yes, yes, sir is right, we are willing to wait."

Xu Fu turned and brought the man into the room.

After entering the room, the man didn't dare let his gaze wander. He didn't even dare to sit down in front of Xu Fu. After Xu Fu sat down, he hurriedly bowed, keeping his posture very low as he spoke with Xu Fu.

Although Xu Fu looked much shorter because he was sitting, the man was shocked to realize that in front of the other party, his own aura seemed to be crushed into the dirt.

The man was secretly alarmed.

This sir might truly have great abilities! He steadied himself and then recounted the critical situation one by one.

"Since yesterday, the young lady in our house hasn't said a word. Her gaze is dull, she doesn't respond to anyone calling her, she doesn't eat food, and she doesn't drink water... Even a person made of iron couldn't stand this..." The more the man spoke, the heavier the sorrow on his face became.

It was evident that the strange behavior the young lady suddenly displayed had truly frightened the people in the household.

"Has she encountered any evil spirits?" Xu Fu asked unhurriedly.

This was his first time properly pretending to be a ghost-catching, evil-exorcising charlatan. Not being very skilled in the business, Xu Fu tried very hard to act professional. Perhaps because his temperament was so convincing, the man didn't notice Xu Fu's lack of professionalism at all.

"No, no, she hasn't. The young lady rarely goes out, but two days ago, because the master of the house fell ill, she went to the Zhou family's woman to seek medicine on his behalf."

Xu Fu nodded, "Can the young lady see people now? Based on your description alone, I cannot rashly conclude what the problem is. It would be best to see her again so I can address the symptoms."

"Yes, if you want to see her, sir, then she can certainly be seen!" the man said excitedly.

"Let's go, I will go and take a look. This matter may be a bit tricky."

Hearing the word "tricky," the man's face paled, but he still forced an eager smile and invited Xu Fu out of the room.

Seeing Xu Fu come out, the others who were still waiting nearby immediately surged forward again, "Is the sir finished? Can the sir listen to me?"

The person walking beside Xu Fu's face changed drastically, and he angrily said, "The sir is going back with me now, what are you all rushing for?"

Although the others were dissatisfied, they dared not cause a scene in front of Xu Fu, so they had to suppress their dissatisfaction.

"What are you all doing here?" Ying Zheng walked in from outside with two or three attendants, his face dark and extremely intimidating.

Everyone shivered involuntarily, thinking to themselves, why is this sir's man so ill-tempered? And when his face turns fierce, he is actually so terrifying... How could such a person be with the sir... They complained inwardly, but on the surface, they were all smiles, "We came to ask the sir to lend a hand."

"Lend a hand with what?" Ying Zheng's expression was even colder; he was playing the "bad cop" role dutifully.

This was something he and Xu Fu had discussed early on. This act was merely to reinforce people's impression, making them clearly remember that it was they who begged Xu Fu to go, not that Xu Fu wanted to go himself. Naturally, no one would associate these events with Xu Fu.

Even if Boss Yang were to be smart for once and find out who was the mastermind behind the scenes, knowing who caused his plan to fail, no one would believe him if he said it.

"Someone in our house had an accident, we are begging the sir to go and save them..." they said with awkward smiles.

Ying Zheng looked toward Xu Fu, his tone suddenly softening quite a bit. Compared to before, it was like two completely different faces, "You want to go with them to take a look?"

Xu Fu nodded, "Saving people is also a merit."

Ying Zheng frowned and said unhappily, "Then I will accompany you."

"This..." Xu Fu looked at the person beside him hesitantly.

Ying Zheng followed his gaze and looked coldly at the man, saying, "How about it?"

The man tried very hard to control himself so his legs wouldn't go weak, and smiled, "That, that is naturally fine."

"Then let's go." Ying Zheng reached out and pulled Xu Fu to his side, then instructed the attendants behind him, "You go and watch those two little ones."

"Yes." The attendants' gazes swept coldly over the crowd, giving them goosebumps, before they went upstairs.

Everyone couldn't help but mutter in their hearts, what is this person's background? When he first came to town, he looked a bit down-and-out, and people said he almost ended up living in a thatched hut. How did he become so grand now? Unable to come to a conclusion, they could only secretly warn themselves.

To be more respectful to that Mr. Xu...

Xu Fu's group soon left the inn. With Ying Zheng at his side, the man didn't dare say a word to Xu Fu on the way. Not only that, he remained tense the whole time, instinctively fearful of Ying Zheng.

They entered the manor, and the servants led them into the courtyard, where a person was standing blankly.

It was a young girl, not yet of age, her hair draped behind her, her large eyes staring blankly ahead, as if she hadn't been able to shake off the nightmare.

Xu Fu walked up and found that the cloth strip should no longer be on her.

The reason the girl was like this was just the aftereffect of being possessed.

Think about it, a cloth strip attaching itself to a body.

The cloth strip was originally a dead object that had only consumed Xu Fu's essence blood. How could it eat human food, talk, or respond to people? After receiving Xu Fu's instructions, the cloth strip had originally intended to do something more frightening, but who would have thought that by simply following its nature and refusing to eat, drink, or speak, it would have already scared the family quite a bit.

Xu Fu felt that this degree was just right.

It was enough to make people feel uneasy, but not enough to scare them into losing their composure or doing something extreme.

"Ho, how is it?" Not long after, the girl's family followed them out. They surrounded Xu Fu and asked cautiously about the girl's condition.

Because Ying Zheng was standing beside Xu Fu, no matter how anxious they were, they didn't dare crowd around Xu Fu.

At this moment, Xu Fu immediately felt the benefit of having Ying Zheng by his side; at least he didn't have to be annoyed by the noise or feel uncomfortable from being crowded.

"It looks like someone has possessed her..." Xu Fu frowned, pretending to think.

The person next to him quickly said, "Isn't that so? She looks just like she's been possessed by someone!"

"But this is not possession," Xu Fu stated firmly.

"Then, then what is this?" The others looked confused.

"If it were possession, your young lady's soul would definitely be gone, but her three souls and seven spirits are clearly still there. It's just that her spirit is dull, which looks like an aftereffect of coming into contact with something. For now, I can only cast a spell to stop her from refusing food and drink, but to restore her to her former self, I need to ponder it carefully."

"Good, good! This is fine for now..."

As long as she can eat and drink, at least she won't starve or die of thirst.

"Come here." Xu Fu beckoned to the girl.

The girl suddenly turned her head, glanced at Xu Fu, and subconsciously walked in his direction.

Seeing this, the people nearby widened their eyes and held their breath involuntarily.

How would they know that if any of them had a face like Xu Fu's, eye-catching enough, they could also attract the girl?

The witchcraft book recorded that after the aftereffects appear, using things the person usually likes will call back their attention.

Xu Fu didn't know what she liked, so he just tried calling her. He didn't expect the girl to stare fixedly at his face and actually walk over just like that.

It can be seen... perhaps... even if a person loses consciousness... they still have an instinctive preference for beauty.

Only, Ying Zheng's face darkened as he watched this scene, forming a sharp contrast with the joy-filled people around him.

"Get dew, rainwater, and well water." Xu Fu pondered for a moment and blurted out a fabrication.

"What is this for?" The person asking lowered his voice, fearing to offend Xu Fu.

"Dew, rainwater, and well water are things that gather the spiritual energy of the world; they will play a great role."

The others didn't understand, but they could hear that "gathering the spiritual energy of the world" must be a good thing! So they rushed off to find dew and well water. Only the rainwater—who would collect that on a normal day? For a moment, they couldn't produce any.

Water in a bronze vessel was brought to Xu Fu.

Xu Fu dipped some water and touched it to the girl's temples and eyelids.

Actually, it was just to let the girl feel the cold so she would wake up sooner. If Xu Fu had a bottle of essential balm on hand, he could definitely have woken the girl up directly.

So, it looked very high-class, as if it were truly something that gathered spiritual energy, but its only use was to fool these people.

"And then?" they asked nervously, their eyes fixed on Xu Fu, as if afraid to miss any big scene.

And then... and then I actually don't know.

Xu Fu remained calm on the surface and said hesitantly, "Actually, this is enough. After the water has been blessed by me, it has the effect of suppressing evil spirits. But, but the young lady doesn't seem to have encountered an evil spirit. It looks more like she has lost her internal essence..."

"Then how can this essence be recovered?"

"It cannot be recovered for the time being, it can only be replaced by something else."

"With what? As long as you say it, sir, we will definitely find it for you!"

"Among you, who has a direct blood relationship with her?"

"I, I am her older brother." A young man stood out directly. He looked at Xu Fu with burning eyes, hiding a bit of distrust.

However, Xu Fu didn't care. Whether these people believed he could solve the matter or not, his goal had already been achieved.

"Then I must trouble you to cut your finger; I only need one drop of blood."

"One drop of blood?"

"Yes, this drop of blood represents the essence in your body. Using it to replace the essence in your sister's body, to pass off the fake as the real, the body can be deceived and it can be used in the short term. As for finding her own essence, that requires finding the source to succeed." Although Xu Fu spoke in a complex and difficult way, it was precisely because of this complexity that the family was deeply convinced.

If Xu Fu had solved it easily from the start, that would have been the strange thing.

Although the young man didn't absolutely trust Xu Fu's ability, he wasn't stingy with a drop of blood to save his sister. He decisively cut his finger with a small knife.

"Dot it on her lips." Xu Fu didn't intend to touch the girl's lips himself after getting blood on his hands; if he did that, it would certainly cause Ying Zheng's displeasure.

Xu Fu had no intention of making Ying Zheng unhappy.

"Good." The man squeezed the blood from his fingertip and dotted it on the girl's lips.

The cloth strip consumed a lot of essence blood. When it was wrapped around the girl, it inevitably took away some of her essence. Now, using blood to replace the essence could barely serve a purpose.

The blood dripped and blurred on the girl's lips. She blinked involuntarily and suddenly fell down. Everyone was startled, and the young man hurriedly caught her body, angrily saying, "What is going on?"

He glared at Xu Fu with an unfriendly expression. If he weren't holding his sister in his arms, he might have rushed up to grab Xu Fu by the collar and sternly questioned him.

"This, this..." The others were also a bit panicked.

Ying Zheng blocked Xu Fu directly, looking coldly at the young man. His aura was even stronger. The man glared for a long time, but in the end, he felt the greater pressure himself, so he had to withdraw his gaze.

"Take another look." Xu Fu reached out and pushed Ying Zheng's body aside, saying coldly.

The young man snorted coldly and looked down again.

Unexpectedly, the girl's face turned from pale to rosy, bit by bit, right before everyone's eyes. Although she hadn't opened her eyes yet, she had already conveyed to everyone the message that she was recovering well.

"Wait a while longer, and she will wake up." Xu Fu said, turning to leave.

The young man thought his previous questioning had offended Xu Fu, but because he was still holding his sister, he couldn't step forward to stop Xu Fu. He could only flush red and call out weakly, "Sir, I didn't mean to offend you just now... please don't hold it against me..."

"I have no intention of holding it against you, but I cannot stay here forever. There are others waiting for me to go, so I cannot stay long." Xu Fu's words were already extremely tactful. If he were more blunt, he would mean: Do you think your face is so big that I should stay here and wait for you?

The man's face flushed, he said "Thank you," and then ordered his servants to prepare the payment for Xu Fu.

This family was quite generous, and the payment was heavy in his hand, so Xu Fu handed it to Ying Zheng.

After Ying Zheng caught the money bag, his eyes flickered, and his expression softened significantly. That Xu Fu could hand over the money to him so generously was a sign of great trust. Ying Zheng still pettily remembered that Jiang You had once given Xu Fu money so he would have the capital to leave him at any time.

...

Less than half an hour after Xu Fu entered the manor, the two of them walked out under the admiring and awe-filled gazes of the people in the manor.

As he stepped out of the gate, Xu Fu suddenly frowned.

Xu Fu's frown didn't relax. Ying Zheng glanced at him and couldn't help but ask, "Still angry about that man's rudeness?" Ying Zheng said this with a hint of murderous intent, as if if Xu Fu confirmed it, he would turn back and slaughter the man to vent Xu Fu's anger.

Xu Fu saw the genuine worry in Ying Zheng's eyes and immediately shook his head, "No, I was thinking, was my performance just now too simple? Hmm, I should do some more complex rituals so I can fool people..."

Ying Zheng, who thought Xu Fu was unhappy: ...

Seeing that Xu Fu was thinking about this problem very seriously, Ying Zheng could only comfort him, "When we go to the next house, we'll just make it more complex."

Xu Fu nodded repeatedly, "You are right."

How about he pretends to chant a spell later? What should he chant? Just... just chant in Japanese... Although he only happened to know those few sentences, no one could understand it anyway, and it could add a great sense of mystery to himself.

Ying Zheng turned his head and saw Xu Fu deep in thought again.

Ying Zheng felt helpless, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.

That Xu Fu could talk so frankly about pretending to be an immortal in front of him showed that he hadn't pretended any less in front of him before...

That Xu Fu exposed his true nature like this, was he truly not guarding against him at all? Although Ying Zheng tried his best to ignore it, he felt a sense of comfort from being trusted and relied upon from the bottom of his heart.

Not long after they returned to the inn, Xu Fu was rushed to the next location.

Most of these afflicted women were from families with some wealth. After running this route, Xu Fu unexpectedly earned a considerable amount of money. The symptoms of these women were sometimes the same and sometimes different, but Xu Fu could almost be certain that they had all been possessed by the cloth strip and had aftereffects, and the aftereffects would fade away after a few days, and there would be no problems after that.

Even if, like that girl, some essence was rubbed away by the small cloth strip, as long as she was nourished for a period of time, she would recover as before.

By the time Xu Fu finished visiting so many families, the day was almost over. At this point, Xu Fu had to sigh that the small cloth strip was really fast. Although it was a bit too fierce, thinking about it from another good perspective, wasn't this a way to stun everyone at once? After they were all stunned, their minds naturally wouldn't think of more, and even if there were many loopholes in the process, they wouldn't necessarily be noticed one by one.

As the sun set, Xu Fu suppressed the fatigue on his body and walked on the street with Ying Zheng.

The people in town had heard the news that many young women had accidents and had to invite Xu Fu to help. The town was only so big, and the speed of spreading news was very fast. By now, the gazes of the people looking at Xu Fu were extremely respectful, reaching a higher level than before.

Xu Fu ignored those gazes and walked quickly back to the inn, then told the waiter that no matter who came later, he would not see them. After speaking, he swept a cold glance at the innkeeper. You know, when Boss Yang came last time, it was the innkeeper who led the way.

The innkeeper smiled awkwardly and immediately raised his hand to make a swearing gesture.

Xu Fu didn't care whether he could stop Boss Yang or not, but he had to threaten when he should, otherwise these people would really treat him as a soft persimmon.

When Xu Fu and Ying Zheng returned to the room, Fusu and Huhai, who were young, had already eaten and were sleeping.

The attendant pushed the door open and said in a low voice, "That Boss Yang has some problems. He moved to the town three years ago. Preliminary speculation is that he might have committed some major crime before fleeing here."

"Can this be found out?" Xu Fu was a little surprised.

The attendant nodded and smiled, "This is naturally findable, but after all, this is the Zhao State, and there are many inconveniences. Very little could be found in these two days."

Just as his voice fell, the door was pushed open again, and Gantang walked in hurriedly, saying, "I did find some interesting things." Although Gantang said so, the expression on his face really didn't show what was interesting.

"What interesting things?" Xu Fu looked at him.

In front of Ying Zheng, how could Gantang dare to be coy? He immediately told what he had seen and heard in the Yang Mansion, "That Boss Yang is really a bit perverted. He is not young, but he likes beautiful women. His son is similar to him, having many times taken a fancy to beautiful prostitutes in the brothels. Most of the prostitutes disappeared after being spotted by him. In fact, they were detained in the manor. Boss Yang built high walls in his backyard to trap them, and he himself acted like a monarch, enjoying the service of countless beauties."

Xu Fu was a little dumbfounded.

This... Ying Zheng, a proper monarch, couldn't compare to him!

Is he planning to have three thousand beauties in his harem? To be a local emperor in the town?

Gantang hadn't finished yet. He paused to catch his breath, then said, "This is nothing. That Boss Yang looks charitable on the outside and once spent money to save a few little girls from the beggars. Oh, those little girls are now in the Yang Mansion too."

"With so many people missing, didn't anyone notice?" Xu Fu frowned.

"Just prostitutes and beggars, who would pay attention? Even if they noticed, no one would care."

Xu Fu could only sigh. This time, the disguise and the earliest foreshadowing were about the disappearance of prostitutes, and then the hysteria of other proper girls. But Xu Fu didn't expect that Boss Yang had really abducted quite a few prostitutes.

He really didn't wrong him at all!

For such a person, Xu Fu felt disgusted just thinking about it for a while longer.

"What else did he do?" Seeing Gantang's cold and flickering eyes, Xu Fu instinctively felt that he had more to say.

Gantang pursed his lips and sure enough, he said, "He has a violent temper and likes to hit people—hitting women, hitting servants, even hitting his own son, and every time he uses a heavy hand. Last night I even saw him beat a weak woman until she was unrecognizable..."

Not only lustful, but also having violent tendencies—a hypocritical man.

Xu Fu immediately felt that since he arrived in this era, the most disgusting person he had ever seen was none other than him. Perhaps only the two men in Sanchuan County could compare with him in who was more despicable.

After hearing what Gantang said, Xu Fu's thoughts changed immediately.

Before, it was just helping Shuqiu, and Xu Fu felt interested in tearing off Boss Yang's mask and doing such a challenging thing. But now, with so many people tied to Boss Yang, Xu Fu immediately felt that Boss Yang had to die to pay his debts.

"Since that's the case, then if this Boss Yang loses his life, it is only right and proper." Ying Zheng said coldly. He and Xu Fu thought of the same thing.

Gantang's mouth curled slightly, "Yes."

But soon the arc of his mouth drooped again, "Your Majesty, when I came back just now, I saw Boss Yang bringing people to the inn."

Xu Fu didn't care, "He should be downstairs."

Gantang wanted to ask if he should go and deal with it, but seeing Xu Fu's calm expression, he swallowed the words. That's right, how could a person as capable as the sir be afraid of Boss Yang? It seems that the sir must have arranged everything long ago.

Xu Fu had indeed arranged everything long ago.

As soon as Boss Yang brought people in, the innkeeper couldn't help but change his expression.

Boss Yang stepped forward and smiled, "I'm here to see Mr. Xu."

The innkeeper gritted his teeth, and he couldn't help but feel some resentment towards Boss Yang. He said with a bad expression, "Mr. Xu is resting now and it is inconvenient to disturb him."

Boss Yang didn't notice the change in the innkeeper's attitude and still smiled, "I have something to find Mr. Xu for. You take me there, and I'll wait outside the door."

The innkeeper hardened his heart and shook his head firmly. Boss Yang had come repeatedly and deliberately used his status and wealth to bully and threaten him. Since Boss Yang was unwilling to understand his difficulties at all, why should he care about Boss Yang?

Boss Yang's face changed slightly. He didn't expect to hit a wall here. He was unwilling to give up and asked the innkeeper to take him there again, but the innkeeper was extremely unhappy, thinking that Boss Yang was too bossy, and then he ignored him completely.

Boss Yang's face darkened, and he finally realized that the innkeeper didn't intend to cooperate with him.

Boss Yang had always managed his reputation well. Even if he was angry, he didn't rush upstairs directly to drag Xu Fu out of the room.

He turned and walked out. After walking out, his gaze immediately became gloomy.

If he wasn't sure whether this Mr. Xu was related to Shuqiu's disappearance, but now in his opinion, how could there be such a coincidence that he couldn't meet this Mr. Xu several times.

He might be deliberately avoiding me...

Boss Yang hated him extremely. After Xu Fu's face appeared in his mind, he couldn't help but let out a soft laugh, "Such a good face, it would be better to peel it off later and stick it on Yueji's face."

The servant behind Boss Yang shivered involuntarily when he heard this.

Seeing this, Boss Yang showed a satisfied smile on his face.

At first glance, others would only think that Boss Yang was still smiling and approachable today...

·

No one would pay attention to the accidents of prostitutes in the town, at most they would chat about it after a meal and forget about it immediately after chatting. As for the other families who invited Xu Fu to go, the girls in their homes recovered quickly. However, after the news that so many people had problems suddenly was gathered, the people in the town were inevitably a little panicked. They began to speculate about what had happened and why it was like this.

These people tacitly began to investigate from the dark who the girls in their homes had come into contact with and what they had eaten that they shouldn't have.

Before these people could find out why.

A night passed.

A beggar ran through the street, crazy, shouting "Fire, fire, heavenly fire."

The people in the town were confused until they saw the thatched hut in the south of the city that had been burned to ash and black, and had been uninhabited for many years.

The fire was too strange. According to people, he happened not to have fallen asleep last night, and saw something flying past in the sky. When he looked closely, he saw that thing fall down.

Immediately after, countless sparks fell down. At first glance, he thought it was the stars in the sky falling.

At that time, the man was terrified and knelt down to pray to the gods not to punish him.

When this person described it so vividly, some people felt immersive and terrified, and some people laughed at him for deliberately making up stories to scare people. But when the crazy beggar in the town shouted "fire," everyone didn't dare to treat this as a small matter.

A day passed, and no one found out why.

This night, interested people wanted to prove that there was no such thing as heavenly fire, so they gathered their spirits and waited quietly. And people are often extremely tired at a certain period of time, and their vigilance will be greatly reduced. By the time these people came back to their senses, fire was falling from the sky like rain.

Many people saw such a scene, and after dawn, the people in the town were boiling.

Why did fire descend? Was it a good omen or a bad omen?

Would the gods punish them?

Everyone was panicked, and finally, they waited for the third day of "heavenly fire."

They watched the sparks fall down, but today was different... They watched the sparks slide down from the sky, and finally, they fell into Boss Yang's mansion. The Yang mansion was busy putting out the fire.

At that time, Shuqiu, who had disguised himself, stood far away, hiding in the shadows, watching Boss Yang with a sorrowful face, directing the mansion to put out the fire.

The servants had just fetched water, but the fire went out quickly.

Such a strange scene, let alone others, even Boss Yang himself couldn't help but feel cold all over.

How could a fire start for no reason?

...

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng sat in the hall, listening to people telling the story of the fire falling on Boss Yang's mansion yesterday. The two couldn't help but look at each other, very tacitly.

Fusu, who was sitting on the side, saw this and suddenly felt that the pancake in his mouth tasted bad.

He lowered his head silently and stroked Huhai's head.

Huhai was innocent and didn't know anything, eating the food in his mouth obediently. Hearing the people in the hall talking, he pulled Xu Fu's sleeve and asked, "Did this person make a mistake? Otherwise, why would there be so much fire falling down to burn him?"

Huhai thought his voice was very small, but in fact, as soon as he spoke, the whole hall was silent.

Those people glanced at him, wanting to say what a child knows, but then saw Xu Fu and Ying Zheng on the side, and none of them dared to offend them, so they turned their heads away in a hurry. After turning their heads, the people who calmed down felt astonished that what the child said... seemed to be correct.

The heavenly fire is actually a warning and punishment from the gods...

But Boss Yang is a well-known good person, why would the gods punish him?

From the moment these people started thinking about this problem, their thoughts were already held in Xu Fu's palm and led away...

chapters.title: 第138章
chapters.translated_text:
After finishing his meal, Xu Fu took a stroll outside the inn.

The townspeople were already growing anxious.

Xu Fu thought rather unkindly, when the plans are implemented one by one, will these people be able to withstand it?

As Xu Fu walked along, lost in thought, the clamor reaching his ears gradually grew louder. He looked up and followed the noise in that direction.

What an unfortunate coincidence! The figure of Boss Yang was imprinted in Xu Fu's eyes.

Boss Yang was looking coldly at someone kneeling on the ground.

It was only because of the angle that Xu Fu could see the expression on Boss Yang's face; if it were anyone else, they likely wouldn't have been able to see the look on his face clearly.

What is he doing?

Xu Fu’s heart stirred, and he walked a little closer.

That figure kneeling on the ground looked so familiar!

After all, Xu Fu had once watched Ying Zheng beat the other person until they had no power to fight back, eventually leaving in a dejected state.

Isn't this Boss Yang's son? What is going on? Questions swirled in Xu Fu's mind.

He mingled with the crowd outside, unable to see the expression on the playboy's face, and could only hear his pleas for mercy.

Seeing more and more people gathering around, Boss Yang smiled awkwardly at those nearby, "An unfilial son, causing trouble everywhere. I’ll take him back right now."

The others quickly smiled, "Yes, yes, Boss Yang, go ahead, go ahead."

These people all wore expressions of schadenfreude.

Boss Yang had a good reputation in town, while his son had a notoriously bad one. Naturally, the townspeople chuckled to see his son being disciplined, while pretending to offer a few words of advice, saying things like "don't hit him too hard"... and the like.

Watching this scene, the sense of strangeness in Xu Fu's heart reached its peak.

Wouldn't these people think there was something wrong with Boss Yang? That playboy was his son, after all. If Boss Yang were truly a strict disciplinarian, how could he have raised such a son? If Boss Yang had indulged him in his early years, leading the son astray, and now wanted to treat him strictly to lead him onto the right path, he shouldn't just walk up and start beating him the moment he saw him...

That was his own flesh and blood!

Even if Boss Yang were kind-hearted and wanted to vent for the townspeople, he wouldn't go so far as to beat his own son into such a state without a word of explanation...

Xu Fu couldn't help but observe the expression on Boss Yang's face closely. Just as he lowered his head to help his son up, Xu Fu noticed a momentary flash of gloom on his face, but once he helped the person up, that expression vanished, and he seemed to be the gentle, kind-hearted Boss Yang once again.

People on the roadside saw him and even laughingly asked about his marriage to the widow from the Zhou family, praising them as both kind-hearted people who were a perfect match for each other!

Hearing this, Xu Fu sneered inwardly.

That Zhou widow was truly a kind person; this Boss Yang was merely a skilled actor.

Boss Yang seemed to notice the overly focused gazes and looked up in this direction. Xu Fu immediately ducked behind a tree. Because it was getting late, it was hard to see clearly, and Boss Yang only glanced over briefly before looking away. He seemed to have something urgent to attend to; he exchanged a few brief pleasantries and immediately ordered his servants to haul his son away. The way he did it... it really didn't look like he was the boy's own father!

Of course, it was also possible that Boss Yang's violent tendencies were already so severe that he would beat anyone, even his own son.

For such a person, it might be fine to pretend to be calm for a while, but once the desires in his heart became increasingly tyrannical and he couldn't help but lash out at those around him, he would become a complete, dangerous reactionary who would harm society. If such a person wasn't killed, leaving him behind would be a massive hidden danger, and everyone's life in the vicinity would be at risk.

Xu Fu suddenly felt the burden on his shoulders grow heavier.

Xu Fu turned to walk back, and not long after, he heard footsteps behind him. Xu Fu paused involuntarily and looked back, only to see a black shadow flash by. He was so startled he almost cried out, but in the end, he bit his lip hard and showed no trace of his composure being lost.

"Sir, it's me."

Xu Fu's heart, which had been hanging high, dropped with a heavy thud.

Xu Fu’s face still held a pallor that hadn't fully faded, but because of the night, the other person couldn't see it. The person only saw Xu Fu's calm and composed posture with cold, steady eyes, and secretly admired him for it.

"Sir, I have come to ask for the medicine." The man took another step forward, the firelight reflecting on his face, illuminating his delicate features.

It was Gan Tang.

Xu Fu calmly took the cloth bag from his sleeve and stuffed it into Gan Tang's palm, then continued walking as if nothing had happened, and Gan Tang soon disappeared from sight.

Xu Fu walked alone on the street, listening to people on both sides discussing whether heaven's fire would descend again tonight.

Xu Fu swept his gaze over their worried faces and sighed slightly in his heart. By tomorrow, would they still be able to take it? Was he making things happen too densely? But then Xu Fu thought of Ying Zheng. He couldn't waste Ying Zheng's time accompanying him to finish this "game," so ending it quickly would be better, and then they could leave sooner.

"Come here." A deep voice sounded not far ahead, suddenly pulling Xu Fu out of his thoughts.

He lifted his eyelids and saw Ying Zheng standing there against the light. Because his figure was so tall and he was standing nearby, blocking the candlelight, he gave off an overwhelming sense of power that seemed to blot out the sky. Xu Fu didn't feel afraid, only finding that seeing him like this gave him an extra sense of security.

The two slowly returned to the inn, washing up and resting as usual, acting as calmly as if the chaos outside hadn't been caused by their own hands.

This was where the advantage of having attendants showed; they followed Ying Zheng's orders, quickly dividing the work and setting everything up. Xu Fu was like the commander-in-chief; whatever instructions he gave, the attendants would quickly carry them out.

The next day, heaven's fire descended again, burning the outer courtyard of the Yang residence. It stopped halfway through, with no casualties.

But after several such fires, everyone's taut nerves were reaching a breaking point.

At this time, those families whose daughters had acted strangely began to investigate who their daughters had met and what commonalities existed among those people... They exchanged the information they had gathered in private. On this day, they happened to reach a unanimous discovery.

Their daughters had either been to the Zhou widow's medical clinic, had contact with people from the Yang residence, or Boss Yang had visited their homes as a guest.

Almost everything revolved around the Yang residence.

These people looked grave; no one dared to rashly pin this on Boss Yang.

Now, they were just waiting for one more family.

They didn't yet know who that family's daughter had met. If it was still related to the Yang residence, then they wouldn't be able to deny it... With the truth laid out before them, who could refuse to believe it?

They sat anxiously in the hall, constantly rubbing the water vessels in their hands.

At this moment, a man hurried into the room and said, "The results are in!"

"Is it also related to the Yang residence?"

The man didn't nod or shake his head, but instead said, "Listen to me first. Do you know that a prostitute in town has gone missing?"

"We know," one person replied impatiently. "What does this prostitute have to do with this matter?"

The man sneered, "Then do you know that if our daughters weren't from respectable families, they might have ended up just like those prostitutes!"

"What did you say?" The person who had been impatient just now turned pale, stood up in a panic, his expression a mix of anger, anxiety, and disbelief.

"Someone is specifically targeting women!" the man gritted his teeth. "Shuqiu from the Zhou family went missing; perhaps it's related to this too. Boss Yang said Shuqiu didn't like him marrying the Zhou widow and left home in a fit of anger, but everyone in town knows that the Zhou girl is a quiet person who never likes to go out and has a very close relationship with her mother. How could she do something so reckless? And as a young girl, if she really left home on her own, would Boss Yang be unable to find her? Would none of us have seen her? In my opinion, there is only one possibility: Shuqiu has also been detained, and that person, to avoid suspicion, made up an excuse and deliberately let the whole town know that Shuqiu had run away, while he is 'desperately' searching for her..."

"So you mean the person who committed this evil deed is Boss Yang!"

"Exactly. And look at what has been happening in town lately..."

These people chatted heatedly in the hall, and the more they talked, the more they felt it must be the case.

To be honest, this guidance wasn't very subtle, and there were many loopholes because their time was short and much of the setup was very crude. But in such a short time, it was enough to muddle the minds of the townspeople. No one would go deep into the problems, and once Boss Yang was caught and his true face exposed, no one would even think about the loopholes in these events.

At this moment, Xu Fu was sitting in the inn, eating his dinner in a leisurely manner.

Hu Hai played by the window for a while, yawned, and whispered, "Outside, rain."

Xu Fu glanced outside; it was indeed starting to drizzle.

Downstairs, someone was cursing, "Why are these rats acting like they're crazy? Suddenly darting out from that hole, they scared the life out of me!"

"Yeah, all the rats have come out lately, running wild all over the street..." someone echoed.

"I even heard that in the beggar's den, the rats are going crazy, trying to gnaw on human flesh..."

"You say this... could this be some kind of bad omen? Could it be... that heaven is about to bring down some disaster?"

The sound of their discussion gradually faded into the distance.

Xu Fu involuntarily raised his hand to support his forehead, tilted his head, and the corners of his mouth lifted slightly. The coldness on his face faded, appearing unexpectedly charming and bewitching. Ying Zheng suddenly felt the food on the table lose its flavor. He put down his utensils and, for once, waved Hu Hai over with a pleasant expression.

As he grew a little older, Hu Hai finally didn't drool, spit, or pee on Ying Zheng like he did when he was a child.

Now he obediently played the role of the little son, blinking his eyes innocently and staring fixedly at Ying Zheng.

"Go find your brother to play; Father has no time to accompany you."

Hu Hai nodded and happily went out. Just one sentence was enough to send him away smoothly.

Xu Fu glanced sideways at the door, watching Hu Hai's little body wiggle as he crossed the threshold, soon to be picked up by an attendant and taken to Fusu next door.

Ying Zheng pushed the table a little further away, stood up, walked to Xu Fu's side, crouched down, and asked in his ear, "Do you want me to hold you too?"

Things were going smoothly, and Xu Fu was in a very pleasant mood. The only way to maintain this pleasure and share it... Xu Fu felt, was indeed only through intimacy. He also pushed the table away and generously spread his arms, "I'm very tired, can you carry me?"

Ying Zheng certainly wouldn't tolerate Xu Fu questioning his strength. He decisively picked Xu Fu up horizontally. His gaze touched the window where Hu Hai had been leaning, and then he held Xu Fu even tighter in his arms. Xu Fu lowered his head, not noticing the dazzling light in Ying Zheng's eyes. He lifted his legs and wrapped them around Ying Zheng's strong, powerful waist, and was then carried by Ying Zheng toward the window.

Xu Fu felt himself rubbing against his private parts as Ying Zheng walked, a faint sense of pleasure washing over him.

By the time he savored that pleasure, Ying Zheng had already pinned him against the window frame.

The cool rain from outside drifted in. Looking up, one could see the pitch-black night sky, the faint moon, and the flickering candlelight not far away. Ying Zheng's face was wrapped in light and shadow, appearing exceptionally charming.

Ying Zheng leaned down to kiss him, while reaching out to pull at his robes.

The window frame pressed against his waist, and Xu Fu couldn't help but let out a muffled groan, reaching out to push Ying Zheng away.

Ying Zheng seemed not to feel his resistance, but instead leaned in closer and held Xu Fu even tighter. His deep, powerful voice drifted into Xu Fu's ear, "How about I let everyone see that you belong to me?"

The word "pervert" couldn't help but pop into Xu Fu's mind.

As their movements became increasingly intimate, the young man outside walked up quickly. Just as he was about to push the door open, he keenly heard the sounds from inside and had to turn around and sit at the top of the stairs. The other attendants saw this and laughed, "Gan Tang, what are you doing?"

Gan Tang rubbed his chin, his face feeling slightly hot, as was his heart.

Ah, although spring had passed, he should find a lover...

On the second floor of the inn, the atmosphere was perfect, but even the best atmosphere eventually comes to an end. Another day passed, and someone came to find Xu Fu again.

"Sir, I think I've found the source of why my daughter was targeted." The man said this while gritting his teeth fiercely, clearly hating the "culprit" very much.

Hearing this, Xu Fu pulled his robes together, "Tell me about it."

Even though the tone was still indifferent, the man felt that the handsome man in front of him seemed to exude a sense of allure. He hurriedly shook the erotic thoughts out of his head and whispered, "Sir, I have discussed it privately with the other families, and we found that most of the girls have seen people from the Yang family and have been to the clinic. Now that the Zhou widow is going to marry Boss Yang, it can be said that everyone is related to the Yang family. We... suspect Boss Yang." After saying this, the man looked at Xu Fu nervously.

After all, Boss Yang's reputation in town was well-known. If they suddenly accused him of being problematic, would people believe them? Not to mention others, even they themselves found it hard to believe when they first found out.

The man was anxious, not knowing that all of this had been orchestrated by Xu Fu and Ying Zheng.

Anyone might believe in Boss Yang's innocence, but Xu Fu was the one person who absolutely wouldn't.

Moreover, the town was so small that it wasn't strange for these girls to go to the clinic or see people from the Yang family. But people have preconceived notions; sometimes the more they think about it, the more they feel it must be true. Now that these people had been guided to think of Boss Yang, from that moment on, they subconsciously affirmed that Boss Yang was the villain.

Xu Fu was silent for a moment, then asked coldly, "And then?"

"We suspect that Shuqiu might have also fallen victim to Boss Yang." The man became more anxious as he spoke. He carefully examined Xu Fu's expression, trying hard to get some information from his face, but unfortunately, he failed.

"Is there any evidence?" Xu Fu asked again.

The more composed he was, the more unfathomable he appeared in the eyes of others. It would be easier for Xu Fu to clear his name later, as in front of everyone, he hadn't done anything.

The man gritted his teeth, fearing Xu Fu wouldn't believe him, and hurriedly said, "We have already sent people to get evidence."

Ying Zheng, hiding behind the screen, watched Xu Fu deal with the man in a lukewarm, vague manner, and watched the man show an anxious expression, and couldn't help but laugh. Xu Fu had learned how to tease people now, and the other party was completely unaware. He wondered if Xu Fu was secretly laughing to himself...

"Alright, I understand." Xu Fu pursed his lips and frowned slightly, "Actually... the Zhou widow once begged me to find a way to locate Shuqiu, so I cast a hexagram. The hexagram was indeed extraordinary..."

The man asked blankly, "How extraordinary?"

"Do you know about the heaven's fire these past few days? I discovered that the fire came to punish someone, but I don't know who. If that person refuses to confess and isn't rooted out, I fear that in a few days, an even greater disaster will descend..." Xu Fu then showed a compassionate expression, "The town is in danger..."

Xu Fu didn't speak with certainty; he deliberately spoke vaguely, leaving plenty of room for the other party to imagine.

People only firmly believe in the "truth" they discover themselves, so Xu Fu was guiding them to discover it without leaving a trace.

After hearing this, the man's expression changed several times, and finally, he said in a hoarse voice, "Is it because Boss Yang did such evil things that he brought down heaven's punishment?"

"I don't know who that person is yet. Without clear evidence, no one can draw a conclusion. I will continue to observe. The reason I told you is to provide you with a direction to investigate and to remind you to be careful." Xu Fu said lightly.

The man looked at Xu Fu's immortal-like appearance, feeling both worshipful and moved, "Thank you, thank you for your guidance, Sir. We will certainly not let your kindness go to waste. I will go back and discuss it with them..." After saying this, the man left with a complex mood, both happy and angry.

Ying Zheng watched this scene and almost couldn't hold back his laughter.

Xu Xiaofu's skills have grown!

And grown quite a bit!

Not only was the other party deceived into believing him deeply, but he was also full of gratitude, completely unaware that the person operating behind the scenes was Xu Fu.

Ying Zheng's gaze toward Xu Fu unknowingly carried a look of indulgence and deep affection, which even he himself didn't notice.

Xu Fu turned to look at the screen, "Tell me, how many more days can we stay here?"

Ying Zheng slowly walked out from behind the screen, "What? Are you in a hurry?"

Xu Fu shook his head, just about to say that he was worried about wasting his time, when someone said, "Sir, the Zhou widow is here."

He could refuse to see anyone, but the Zhou widow had to be seen. Xu Fu immediately told the attendant to invite her in. Ying Zheng, who still had many things to say, was inevitably a little unhappy. Although he indulged Xu Fu and satisfied him, he had to watch Xu Fu busy himself with other people's affairs. Ying Zheng couldn't help but feel a bit sour...

When the Zhou widow was brought to Xu Fu's room by the attendant, she was stunned for a moment, but ultimately, her daughter's matter was more important, so she didn't stand on ceremony in such a place.

The Zhou widow stepped into the room, her face pale, bloodshot eyes, and even her lips were dry and peeling. She looked in terrible shape. She seemed to realize she looked disheveled and smiled, "I've let you see a joke, Sir."

Xu Fu shook his head, "It's nothing."

"I came to ask you, Sir, if you have divined the whereabouts of Shuqiu? I don't mean to rush you, but Shuqiu has been missing for so long, I... I really can't find peace in my heart." After saying this, the Zhou widow gritted her teeth, "For so many years, I have held her in the palm of my hand, like a pearl, and even refused to remarry for her sake, yet she treats me like this..."

Sadness and worry were about to crush the woman in front of him. Her words were even incoherent. She embarrassedly raised her hand to cover her face, her shoulders trembling slightly, as if she might fall to the ground at any moment.

Xu Fu wasn't in a hurry to comfort her, but instead asked her a question, "What kind of girl do you think your daughter is?"

The Zhou widow raised her face, her expression dazed for a moment, "She... she is a well-behaved girl, always listening to me, but she just wouldn't agree to my remarriage. Why did she have to make things difficult for me over this? I... she was clearly very obedient before..."

Listening to these words, Xu Fu felt a bit awkward, feeling as if he had suddenly jumped from being a charlatan to a psychological counselor.

But no matter how awkward it was, he still had to continue to fool the Zhou widow.

"Have you ever talked to her carefully about the remarriage? If you kept it from her, it's normal for her to be sad and resist you. However, you also said she was an obedient girl before; how could she do something so imprudent? Have you ever looked into the reasons behind it? Simply categorizing it as her running away because she didn't want you to remarry is probably not fair to her." Xu Fu said lightly.

The Zhou widow was a smart person. Before, she was too panicked, anxious, and angry, so she had a preconceived notion that Shuqiu must have gone missing because of this. But Xu Fu's sentence, "Have you ever looked into the reasons behind it?", opened another door in the Zhou widow's heart. As if enlightened, she seized on this sentence and thought about it carefully.

The reasons behind it...

If Shuqiu didn't run away...

The Zhou widow's face turned pale instantly, "Could it be... could she have met with some misfortune? But she was living with me at the Yang residence before, what could have happened?" The Zhou widow panicked. This unknown danger made her feel even worse; it would have been better to know that Shuqiu had run away.

Xu Fu still didn't give her a definite answer, only saying, "Many girls in town have had accidents lately; you can go and ask around..."

The Zhou widow's face turned even paler. She nodded, stood up, and walked out in a daze.

Not long after the Zhou widow left, some small beggars in town went through the streets and alleys, chanting a nursery rhyme.

Snakes, rats, insects, and ants, scattering everywhere,

Heaven and earth are dark, disaster flies in,

The earth dragon turns over, the nest is destroyed.

At first, the adults just listened casually, but the more they listened, the more they felt their hair stand on end. What was this singing? The earth dragon is going to turn over, the town is going to be overturned, and everyone in town is going to die? Why are these beggars singing such nonsense? Someone angrily prepared to teach the beggars a lesson, but just as they were about to act, they suddenly noticed rats darting past the street corner and ants gathering on the ground to escape...

How abnormal...

They were horrified. The hands they had raised to hit the beggars suddenly went limp. The beggars took the opportunity to break free and ran away quickly, continuing to sing the rhyme with a laugh. In just one day, everyone in the whole town had heard this rhyme.

The slightly more prestigious elders in town dug out ancient books and found that the strange things happening in town were indeed like the precursors to an earthquake. Once this news spread, the whole town was shrouded in panic.

First, people went missing, some seemed to be possessed, then heaven's fire descended, and now there were signs of an earthquake... Who could not be panicked?

When Boss Yang heard this, he scoffed, "Truly ignorant!"

The Zhou widow sat to one side, her face not looking good. Her already irritable mood deepened upon hearing Boss Yang's voice, so she pulled a long face and walked out. A few days ago, Boss Yang's help in finding Shuqiu seemed genuine, but later he urged her every day not to care about this daughter anymore. If she liked children, they could have more in the future. Since Shuqiu had let her down, why should she, a mother who had sacrificed so much for Shuqiu, care about her? Did she have to sacrifice her own happiness for Shuqiu?

At that time, the Zhou widow was in the heat of anger, and the more she listened, the more she felt he was right. Shuqiu was ungrateful, and as a mother who had sacrificed so much, if Shuqiu didn't care at all, then she should just be heartless and ignore her...

But now, thinking about it again, the Zhou widow wondered what his intentions were.

How could these words come out of his mouth!

When the Zhou widow looked at Boss Yang, she unconsciously carried a layer of detachment. The Zhou widow didn't notice it herself, but Boss Yang did. After noticing it, a flash of cruelty crossed Boss Yang's eyes.

If something is disobedient, just destroy it.

Boss Yang was a bit anxious. After calling someone to find Shuqiu, he decided to break her limbs and bring her back to torture her properly. And as for the Zhou widow, Boss Yang sneered; if it weren't for the many things happening in town recently, he would have already dealt with her too.

After Boss Yang finished his orders, he heard a report that his son was being disobedient. Boss Yang's face looked even worse. He let his servant lead the way, going to see the son he had locked up. After walking out of the hall, he passed a pond.

Just then, Boss Yang heard someone shout, "Oh no, an earthquake!"

It was late, and the ground was pitch black. Boss Yang couldn't see clearly; he only felt his body sway violently, and then he fell headlong into the pond. The servants shouted and splashed as they jumped into the water one after another.

When they finally managed to fish Boss Yang out, he had a bump on one side of his forehead and blood streaming down the other. Boss Yang could no longer maintain his scholarly demeanor. He kicked the nearest servant, "Get out! You are all blind!"

Blood flowed down, and some smeared into his eyes, making his expression look truly ferocious.

The servants, seeing him like this, trembled with fear and knelt to beg for mercy.

After this ordeal, Boss Yang didn't want to see his son anymore, so he went back to his room and ordered someone to invite the Zhou widow.

Don't look at the Zhou widow as just a woman; she had learned medicine from her late husband, had considerable knowledge herself, and had been influenced by the clinic for years. Treating Boss Yang's forehead was really nothing for her.

But the Zhou widow couldn't be invited over no matter what.

That night, Boss Yang flew into a great rage.

Soon, the night passed, and the townspeople were very panicked. There had been an earthquake last night. Although they were asleep, they discovered after waking up that many things in their rooms had moved. They also heard that Boss Yang had been shaken into the pond. Why wasn't anyone else so miserable, but Boss Yang was injured? People secretly speculated, and when they saw Boss Yang during the day, they still smiled.

But Boss Yang never imagined that these people had already begun to suspect him.

The townspeople personally begged Xu Fu to solve this matter, promising a generous reward. The old man, who was not young, almost knelt to Xu Fu. There were others in town who did the same profession as Xu Fu, but they were no match for him. Xu Fu hadn't been in town long, but his name was already incredibly loud. Moreover, after the earthquake, the man who had visited for his daughter spread the prophecy that Xu Fu said there might be more disasters. The townspeople spread it more and more outrageously, almost calling Xu Fu a living immortal who knew astronomy and geography, and knew the past and future for five hundred years.

This will not be repeated here. Let's just say that the old man requested with teary eyes, and Xu Fu had no choice but to stand up and help the old man up.

Xu Fu showed a helpless expression, "This matter is really hard to solve."

The old man asked hurriedly, "Why?"

"Strange things have been happening in town lately. Have you ever thought about why?"

"This, why is that?" The old man looked blank.

"I fear there is a disaster star lurking in someone. It didn't show early on, but..." Xu Fu sneered coldly. His handsome face, even covered in ice, was enough to make people intoxicated, "I happen to have a tripod here. That tripod is formed by gathering the spiritual energy of the world. Any ordinary evil spirits, as long as they interact with me, will inevitably interact with my tripod, and the evil energy on them will naturally leak out."

Xu Fu spoke very mysteriously, but the old man believed it deeply. As Xu Fu continued to explain, his expression became more and more grave, as if he had really seen a disaster star.

"You must first tell me, how do you want me to solve it?" Xu Fu continued, "Is it to temporarily overcome the immediate danger, or to go all out, root out the disaster star, and drive it out of town, so that the town will never be disturbed again."

Xu Fu knew the old man would definitely choose the second option, but Xu Fu still had to pretend to ask for his opinion.

The old man indeed chose the second option.

Xu Fu immediately frowned, "I have already said that this matter is very difficult to solve... The disaster star's power is very strong and it is extremely good at disguising itself..."

As Xu Fu said this, the old man's face changed slightly.

"What?" Xu Fu paused and looked at the old man, "Did you think of something?"

The old man's face turned pale, he swallowed his saliva, and said hoarsely, "Sir, I think I might know who the disaster star you are talking about is."

"Who is it?" Xu Fu asked, pretending to be serious. He leaned forward slightly, looking faintly anxious, but without losing his own momentum and posture. This performance was exactly in line with the persona he had created in front of others.

The old man didn't doubt it at all, and said with a bitter face, "Since you asked, Sir, I won't hide it from you. I suspect it is Boss Yang... Sir, please don't disbelieve me..." The old man choked, then looked at Xu Fu eagerly and sincerely, fearing that Xu Fu wouldn't believe him.

Ying Zheng, peeking from behind the screen, couldn't help but laugh again.

Another person worried that Xu Fu wouldn't believe him...
