The old man known as "Elder Zhang" had prepared for the sacrificial rites well in advance. After an initial moment of hesitation, he was now absolutely firm in his resolve to send Boss Yang to the sacrificial altar.

Boss Yang had no leverage over the Zhou family woman; his servants had either fled or been captured, and even his own son had abandoned him. Filled with resentment and frustration, he could only endure being beaten until his face was bruised and swollen before being hoisted up like a chick by a group of people, who then marched him in a grand procession out of the Yang estate.

These people walked behind Xu Fu with a sense of self-consciousness. They looked at Xu Fu with great caution, and by extension, they were also extremely careful when glancing at Ying Zheng.

The sight of the sparks falling onto Boss Yang earlier had led everyone to equate offending Mr. Xu with suffering divine retribution. They believed Mr. Xu was not to be trifled with—perhaps he truly was the incarnation of a deity. Though they didn't know why he had come to their town, it should have been a blessing for the town; after all, who had ever seen a god? Yet, this blessing had been ruined by Boss Yang. To ensure the town didn't incur the wrath of the gods, they had to be even more respectful toward Mr. Xu to pray for divine protection. Furthermore, they had to deal with Boss Yang severely, and the best way to do so was to ask Mr. Xu to handle him.

With their minds full of different thoughts, the crowd soon arrived at the altar in silence.

Xu Fu had to be grateful that he had specifically studied sacrificial rites due to Lord Changping's previous obstruction. Now, it was just a matter of repeating what he had done last time, only with much faster movements and a much smaller scale.

He did not wear ceremonial robes, as people in such a small place were not particular about these things. They simply stared blankly at Xu Fu in his white robes as he walked to the altar, his expression exuding an inviolable dignity, his exquisite features making people afraid to look directly at him.

Only Ying Zheng could stand steadily by his side.

At this moment, Ying Zheng felt a bit dissatisfied. If they were in the State of Qin, he could naturally stand with Xu Fu without any hesitation, but now Xu Fu could stand on the altar while he could only stand at the foot of it. However, upon reflection, this was just a one-time occurrence. Looking up at Xu Fu from the foot of the altar and feeling his transcendent aura along with everyone else was also quite a unique experience. Besides, once they returned to Qin, they would be standing together for a long, long time.

Boss Yang, with his mouth gagged and his limbs bound, was placed before the altar like a lamb waiting for slaughter. He struggled violently, his eyes bloodshot, saliva dripping from his grimacing mouth. He breathed heavily through his nose, the approach of death stripping him of all composure.

Yet, not a single person looked at him with sympathy.

As Xu Fu began to recite the sacrificial prayers to heaven and earth, the dry, monotonous words suddenly took on a captivating charm when spoken by him. The crowd stared at him, entranced, unable to look away for a long time.

Only such an outstanding person could shine so brightly on the sacrificial altar.

There was no one more suited to stand there than him.

The townspeople unconsciously displayed looks of worship, even feeling a fanatical urge to kneel and kowtow.

"Light the fire."

"Place him in the cauldron for the sacrifice."

Xu Fu said softly, his lips parting.

As his cold, clear voice echoed slowly in their ears, they saw a man lift Boss Yang with one hand and push him into the great cauldron. Because his mouth was gagged, they could only hear the sound of him frantically slamming against the cauldron; no screams could be heard at all. Only after the ropes on his body and the gag in his mouth were burned away did he let out a shrill, wheezing cry from his throat, as if a hole had been scorched through it, making even his screams sound incoherent.

Xu Fu turned his face away, refusing to look any longer. Ying Zheng reached out his hand, took Xu Fu's, and led him down from the altar.

The torches on both sides of the altar burned brighter and brighter. While this was a common phenomenon, to the biased townspeople, it was the gods rejoicing in the punishment of Boss Yang, and the leaping flames were celebrating the event.

Ying Zheng didn't see any of this; he only saw the firelight reflecting on Xu Fu's face, making it look slightly flushed, as if he had applied a thin layer of rouge, adding a touch of beauty. However, this was something only Ying Zheng would notice.

Even if others saw it, they would only think Mr. Xu was truly handsome, making one feel envious and reverent... the list of countless praises goes on.

Ying Zheng's attendants stood guard on both sides of the cauldron. If Boss Yang could endure the excruciating pain and find the strength to crawl to the rim, they were responsible for kicking him back in without mercy. These attendants were not cold-blooded, but they certainly wouldn't waste their sympathy on scum like Boss Yang.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng walked away hand in hand, while the townspeople bowed their heads in silence.

A gust of wind blew past, and Boss Yang's screams ceased completely. The only sound left in the cauldron was the roaring of the fire.

The townspeople shivered and left in a hurry, not daring to look back. Yet, at this moment, they all breathed a collective sigh of relief in their hearts.

That scourge was finally dead. There would be no more heavenly fires, earthquakes, or vengeful spirits in the town. Boss Yang had received the punishment he deserved, and they no longer had to worry about their daughters meeting with misfortune.

After the Zhou family woman woke up and crawled out of the Yang estate, she found it empty and devoid of life, so she panicked and rushed out. Xu Fu, Ying Zheng, and the others had not walked far from the altar when they bumped into the dazed woman.

Gan Tang stepped forward and grabbed the woman. She blinked, and upon seeing Xu Fu, her face filled with bitterness. "Mr. Xu..."

Xu Fu also took two steps forward. "Come with us." He was speaking to the woman.

The woman was stunned again. Although she didn't quite understand what Xu Fu meant, she trusted him enough not to question him, and she followed him in a daze.

Xu Fu was heading back to the inn, and the others naturally couldn't follow him inside, so they could only watch as he went in and closed the door.

Someone wondered why the Zhou family woman had been called inside. Elder Zhang sighed and said, "I suppose he is going to find Shuqiu for her."

The crowd suddenly realized, and immediately began to praise Xu Fu as a truly kind man. However, they suddenly remembered that they had praised Boss Yang in the same way back then. They felt incredibly awkward and shut their mouths after exchanging glances.

Elder Zhang shook his head and sighed. After this, the people in the town would probably be extremely cautious and wouldn't dare to relax easily.

The woman was led into the room by Gan Tang, who held her arm. Xu Fu turned to face them and sat down, then said, "Don't worry, Shuqiu is not missing."

"W-what do you mean?" For a moment, the woman's mind was a complete mess. The series of blows she had suffered recently had made it difficult for her to think.

"Shuqiu is living near the Yang estate." Xu Fu paused. "When Boss Yang tried to hunt her down, she fled to me. That was when I started investigating, and subsequently discovered Boss Yang's crimes..." Xu Fu recounted the process to her simply, omitting any mention of the man-made heavenly fire and earthquakes. If too many people knew about that, it would only lead to trouble.

After hearing this, the woman's eyes filled with tears.

She and Shuqiu had been suffering from mutual misunderstandings, but now there was no need to say anything; all conflicts had been resolved.

Gan Tang took her to see Shuqiu, and in an instant, only Xu Fu and Ying Zheng remained in the room.

Xu Fu toyed with the tableware in front of him. "Are we heading to Sanchuan Commandery tomorrow?"

"Yes."

"Have we delayed for too long?" Xu Fu remembered that they had set out to inspect and offer condolences along the Henan region. Who would have thought that after just one visit to the military camp, they would be stuck here for over half a month?

"It's fine. After we leave Sanchuan Commandery, I'll take you to Shu Commandery."

Ying Zheng noticed that although Xu Fu didn't say it, he enjoyed the sense of accomplishment that came from successfully helping others.

Sanchuan and Shu Commanderies were both places where Xu Fu had intervened to help, so it would be perfect to take him there for a visit.

"Alright." Xu Fu guessed that Ying Zheng must have other plans, so he readily agreed. Since Ying Zheng was taking him, he would just treat it as a vacation without any burden.

Exhausted from a busy day, Xu Fu soon felt tired. He and Ying Zheng washed up briefly and went to bed. The next day, the attendants had already packed their meager luggage. They were curious about how they had managed to stay at the inn without any money. But seeing how much the townspeople trusted and worshipped Xu Fu, they felt they had caught a glimpse of something.

They even heard from the townspeople that Ying Zheng was just a man who followed Xu Fu around, eating and drinking for free, and looking after the children every day.

The attendants' expressions cracked, and they didn't dare to listen any further, scurrying away like mice seeing a cat, fearing they would lose their lives if they heard one more word.

"Sir! Mr. Xu..." the waiter called from outside. An attendant opened the door, and upon seeing that everyone had packed their luggage, the waiter was stunned and stammered, "Sir, are you... are you leaving?"

"Yes." Xu Fu nodded. "Is there anything else?" He had even dealt with Boss Yang for them; what else could there be in this town?

"The Zhou family woman is here." The waiter said, his face beaming. "Miss Shuqiu has been found; she was almost harmed by that Boss Yang."

Xu Fu didn't say anything upon hearing this.

Just as the waiter finished speaking, the woman had already brought Shuqiu up from downstairs. Shuqiu wore a smile, looking relaxed and even more beautiful than before, likely because she was free from those terrible emotions. The woman also wore a smile, the fine lines between her brows having smoothed out significantly.

"Mr. Xu." When the woman looked at Xu Fu, her eyes were filled with gratitude.

Xu Fu paused in his steps but signaled the attendants to keep the door open and invited them in.

"Thank you, Mr. Xu." After the woman sincerely thanked him, she couldn't help but smile, "If you were a bit older, and my Shuqiu were a bit older, I would be unable to resist marrying her to you."

People always loved to use the phrase "You are such a good person, I can't help but want to marry my daughter to you" when praising someone. Xu Fu didn't think much of it; after all, the woman said "if," which meant such a thing would never happen. Once they left this town, Xu Fu might never see them again.

But for Ying Zheng, even a hypothetical scenario that would never come to pass was enough to make him unhappy.

"Unless you want to make an enemy, it would be better for the woman not to say such things." Ying Zheng said with a cold face. In that instant, his full aura was unleashed, pressing down heavily on everyone's hearts. Everyone felt their knees go weak, and they felt inferior, unable to even muster the thought of resistance.

The attendants breathed a sigh of relief upon seeing this.

They had wondered, how could the King be as those people described?

The King was still as majestic as ever!

The smile on the woman's face froze, and she then apologized to Xu Fu and Ying Zheng gracefully, "It was my impropriety; such words should not have been spoken."

Although Shuqiu looked delicate, seeing how she had managed to escape from Boss Yang's clutches showed she was not a timid person. She followed her mother's lead and apologized to Ying Zheng, then smiled generously, "Only a person like you is worthy of standing alongside Mr. Xu." Although Shuqiu didn't know what abilities Ying Zheng possessed, she instinctively felt that a man with such a powerful aura was definitely extraordinary.

Shuqiu's words happened to hit the mark with Ying Zheng. Any lingering unhappiness vanished completely.

He restrained his aura slightly and nodded, "You are right."

No one thought Ying Zheng was thick-skinned; the attendants felt it was only natural. If one were to talk about being a match, only the King could be a match for the Grand Astrologer Xu. The King was noble; how could this be called arrogance?

After thanking Xu Fu, the woman prepared to leave.

Just as they were getting up, Xu Fu suddenly caught sight of the bandage on Shuqiu's right hand.

A thought suddenly crossed Xu Fu's mind. "Shuqiu, I have seen your illness in a bamboo slip before." Xu Fu had indeed seen it, and it was something he had happened to recall in the past few days. When Ying Zheng was searching for books on alchemy for him, one of them mentioned a medicine that could treat physical weakness and heart ailments. The description in the bamboo slip was very mysterious. Regardless of whether it was useful or not, Xu Fu decided to write down the prescription for them. In such times, he would rather try everything than miss a chance.

The woman's face was filled with ecstasy, her heart pounding. "Sir, do you mean... does that bamboo slip record how to treat this illness?"

"Yes, I have noted down a prescription, but I cannot be certain if it will be effective."

"Whether it's useful or not, we must try to know! I beg for the prescription! We cannot repay your great kindness, but we will definitely pray for your health before the gods every day. I hope you will not despise us for being useless." The woman said this in one excited breath. In fact, she didn't doubt for a second that the prescription Xu Fu gave would be ineffective.

Mr. Xu was so miraculous; the prescription he gave must be effective!

The woman was on the verge of kneeling and worshipping Xu Fu as a god.

Shuqiu was also slightly excited.

Xu Fu turned and told Gan Tang to find some bamboo slips. The woman hurriedly said, "No, no need to trouble the young man, I will have someone fetch them." With that, she hurried out of the room, her heavy skirt making her look as if she were walking on air.

After the woman left, Shuqiu carefully observed the attendants behind them and asked in a low voice, "Will Mr. Xu come back to the town in the future?"

"If fate allows, we shall meet again."

Hearing Xu Fu say this, Shuqiu immediately knew they would never meet again.

"Thank you, Mr. Xu, for helping me. I thought I would just drag out my sickly body and live one day at a time..." The expression on Shuqiu's face changed suddenly, becoming incredibly firm. "But now I know that I can live more freely and be more useful. I only hope that one day I can be as impressive as you." Shuqiu looked at him with burning eyes.

Xu Fu was slightly bewildered after hearing this. Had he touched Shuqiu in some way?

Ying Zheng's face darkened; he really disliked the way Shuqiu was looking at Xu Fu.

Shuqiu seemed to sense something, smiled at Ying Zheng, withdrew her gaze, and didn't say anything like that again.

Not long after, the woman returned with bamboo slips and a stylus.

After Xu Fu took them, he intended to carve the characters himself, but he suddenly remembered that his handwriting was not very good. To avoid ruining his mysterious and lofty image in the eyes of the townspeople, Xu Fu immediately turned to Ying Zheng and said, "I will recite it, can Ah Zheng carve it for me?"

The attendants looked at Xu Fu and Ying Zheng in horror.

Let the majestic King of Qin write a prescription?

The King of Qin's handwriting! How precious is the King of Qin's handwriting! Could it be given away so casually?

Under the gaze of everyone, Ying Zheng nodded, spread the bamboo slip in front of him, and picked up the stylus. His strong, powerful fingers gripped the stylus, the cold blade contrasting sharply with his warm fingers. Xu Fu stared at it for a while before looking away uncomfortably.

"Recite." Ying Zheng's face showed undisguised indulgence.

Shuqiu watched this scene and smiled unconsciously.

"Zhi Gancao Tang (Licorice Decoction)..." Xu Fu recited while recalling the contents he had seen in the bamboo slip.

Ying Zheng moved the stylus with force and speed, the vigorous characters quickly taking shape under his hand. Xu Fu glanced at it from time to time, and with just one glance, he immediately noticed that the seal script being written was slightly different from the Qin seal script. This was... Zhao script? It was not surprising that Ying Zheng, having lived in Zhao, could write Zhao script. Fortunately, he could write it... otherwise, if he had let Ying Zheng write the prescription, wouldn't it have exposed their identities?

Soon, Xu Fu stopped speaking, and Ying Zheng also stopped his movements.

Ying Zheng put down the stylus, closed the bamboo slip, and handed it to the woman. The woman didn't even look at it, nodding repeatedly in excitement. "Thank you! Thank you!"

"Take it. Ah Zheng and I are leaving, we shall meet again." Xu Fu stood up from the table, and Gan Tang quickly went out to fetch the horses.

The woman also looked reluctant, but she knew very well that a small town like this could not keep an extraordinary person like Xu Fu.

Xu Fu was about to walk out the door with Ying Zheng when a thought suddenly flashed through his mind. "Shuqiu, may I see the wound on your hand?"

Although Shuqiu was puzzled, she didn't refuse Xu Fu's request. She quickly unwrapped the bandage, revealing the wound on her palm, and said in a low voice, "A few days ago, I was curious about the heavenly fire that fell in the Yang estate, so I touched it, and accidentally got burned..."

Her palm was covered in blisters, some of which had burst, looking red and swollen. Xu Fu narrowed his eyes, ignoring Ying Zheng's unhappy gaze, and carefully lifted the back of Shuqiu's hand. He soon discovered something strange. The parts where the blisters had burst actually formed a winding line on her palm, and this line faintly connected to her life line, effectively lengthening it. Visually, it looked as if her line had been completed. The fate line remained unchanged, but with the lengthened life line, it no longer looked out of place.

Xu Fu's heart stirred, thinking of the theory of innate versus acquired palmistry.

Perhaps this was the wonderful aspect of humans taking charge of their own destiny?

Fate, indeed, could be changed! It all depended on whether one had the opportunity!

Xu Fu could now boldly say that he might be the noble person in Shuqiu's fate; without him, Shuqiu might not have had today. The prescription he gave might truly work... but those were things for the future.

Xu Fu took one last complex look. "Alright, take good care of your wound."

"Eh? Alright."

After saying this, Xu Fu immediately turned back and generously took Ying Zheng's hand. Ying Zheng was startled, the line of his tightly pressed lips changing slightly. He held Xu Fu's hand back and walked past Shuqiu.

As the group walked out the door and down the stairs, Xu Fu could still hear the discussions of the guests below.

"That Huan Yi is truly troublesome; the State of Zhao is in danger!"

"It's all because of the brutal King of Qin. It's a pity that Zhao was once a long-time ally by marriage to Qin!"

"Indeed..."

Hearing this conversation, Xu Fu couldn't help but look strange. He turned to look at Ying Zheng, only to see him looking extremely calm. Well, if he could be easily influenced by such rumors, he wouldn't be Ying Zheng.

People in the lobby saw them coming down, and when they saw Xu Fu, they all shut their mouths and stopped talking about what they had just said. Only when they saw Xu Fu walk out of the inn did they couldn't help but ask in low voices, "Is the Sir leaving?" "Is the Sir leaving so soon?"

The townspeople, who had been waiting for the heavenly fire and earthquakes, still felt a lingering sense of unease.

They didn't know that the heavenly fire, earthquakes, and vengeful spirits were all created by Xu Fu and Ying Zheng together.

After Xu Fu walked out, even many passersby stopped to look at them repeatedly. There was some reluctance in their eyes, but they didn't dare to stop Xu Fu, remembering firmly never to offend him.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng got into the carriage together, soon cutting off their gazes. The woman and Shuqiu stood at the door, watching them leave. Not long after, Elder Zhang also brought many townspeople to follow the carriage, the procession even becoming quite grand.

Xu Fu found it quite funny. They spoke of how hateful Qin was behind their backs, not knowing that the person they worshipped could also be called a "lackey of Qin."

"The town will forever remember the great kindness of Mr. Xu today! Please tell us your name, so we may pass it on to future generations!"

The carriage stopped, and Xu Fu lifted the curtain. Thinking of how he had casually told others his surname was Xu when he was in the State of Wei, he did the same this time. His gaze swept over them one by one, and they all held their breath, waiting for him to say his name.

Xu Fu, however, shook his head. "Names are illusory things." With that, he lowered the curtain.

What was originally just a precaution to avoid trouble if recognized became, in their eyes, proof of his transcendence. Only an immortal would disregard fame and fortune, even treating their own name as nothing!

The crowd was filled with excitement, and they watched the carriage disappear for a long time, unable to calm down.

Ah, they had all forgotten that when Xu Fu first arrived in town, he had set up a stall and made a tidy profit from them.

Disregarding fame and fortune? What a joke!

The carriage wobbled out of the small town. About a day later, night fell, and they immediately found a place to set up camp.

The courtesan named "An Niang" was also traveling with them; after all, they couldn't just abandon her after bringing her to testify.

After getting off the carriage, the attendants set up a place to rest and looked for firewood and food. Having people to serve them was a world of difference compared to the miserable days they had experienced recently!

An Niang was meticulous, and having been born into a farming family, she was quite knowledgeable about wild plants and fruits, and was skilled at finding water and spices. When the attendants hunted a wild boar, An Niang immediately helped Gan Tang skin and butcher it, then skillfully roasted it.

With meat to eat outside, Fusu stared intently at the roasting rack, drooling.

Fusu couldn't bear to look, perhaps thinking he looked too foolish. As the person looking after Fusu, he couldn't help but reach out and wipe away his drool. "What's there to stare at?"

Fusu licked his lips. "It smells so good, better than in the palace..."

That was the truth.

An Niang couldn't help but smile, but she cruelly handed the roasted meat in her hand to Xu Fu. "Mr. Xu, please have a taste." An Niang was also extremely grateful to Xu Fu, especially after witnessing how Boss Yang died. At this moment, she was still a bit nervous, worried that Xu Fu wouldn't like it.

Xu Fu accepted it gracefully. If it weren't for Fusu's foolish look, Xu Fu would have tried his best to restrain himself; otherwise, he might have shown a look of craving as well.

An Niang seemed to be very skilled at handling this, and in this era where gourmet food was scarce, she could easily stand out.

While everyone was happily eating, Ying Zheng's expression was not very good.

Xu Fu might not always pay attention to everything around him, but he could quickly detect changes in Ying Zheng's expression.

"What's wrong?" Xu Fu temporarily set aside the food in front of him.

Ying Zheng reached out and covered the back of his hand, but spoke to Gan Tang: "Someone is following us. Go and see whose people they are."

Gan Tang took two or three people and pretended to look for firewood, and soon their figures were swallowed by the woods.

Xu Fu was initially worried, but then thought that since the other party had already been discovered by Ying Zheng, a sneak attack would definitely not work, and with so many people here, there was really nothing to worry about.

Not long after, Gan Tang returned, followed by a man. The man was dressed neatly but was covered in mud, looking as if he had just been beaten by Gan Tang. As he approached and his face was illuminated by the firelight, Xu Fu recognized him.

"You were following us?" Xu Fu's expression turned cold, his gaze becoming sharp in an instant.

But the man met his gaze without panic. Even though he was in a sorry state, he didn't even bend his back, and instead cheekily said, "I was not following you, but rather bringing you a gift."

"What gift?" Ying Zheng looked at him with cold eyes.

The man in front of them was stubborn, resilient, and knew how to bend and stretch, looking like someone who would say whatever was needed to whoever he met. Ying Zheng didn't have a good impression of him. Moreover, this man clearly saw their extraordinary nature but still dared to follow them, showing his boldness. Such a person was shrewd enough to be a sharp blade in the hands of a superior, or a thorn in the side.

The man turned around and pointed at the person Gan Tang was holding. "Her."

Xu Fu took a look; it was a young girl with a pretty face and panicked eyes, struggling constantly in Gan Tang's grip.

"What do you mean by this?" Xu Fu frowned even more tightly.

"Judging by your expression, you must not know who this is." The man surnamed Yao smiled slightly. "Do you know why Boss Yang was able to escape to the town in the first place? It was because of her. She looks young, but in reality..."

Ying Zheng interrupted him. "Is this the daughter of that city official?"

A look of surprise flashed across the man's face. "How did you know?"

Xu Fu was also surprised. He quickly recalled the story the attendant had told, where Boss Yang had been hunted down after molesting the daughter of a city official, and had fled to the small town. Hearing the man's meaning, it seemed that the official had wanted to kill Boss Yang, but his daughter had protected him in every way, helped him escape, and followed him to the town? Thinking of this, Xu Fu couldn't help but be shocked.

Boss Yang still had such charm that an official's daughter would be devoted to him? And even elope with him? And now she could calmly watch him marry and toy with other girls? If this woman didn't have Stockholm syndrome, then she really wasn't a good person either!

The woman struggled violently in Gan Tang's grip, seemingly having a strong reaction to Ying Zheng's words.

The man regained his composure and said, "If I didn't bring her to you, she would cause you trouble in the future."

Xu Fu understood what he meant. If this woman was truly devoted to Boss Yang, then not cutting the weeds and eliminating the roots would lead to big trouble.

The attendant on the side also realized what the man meant and immediately knelt down, saying, "The official's daughter had been missing for several years. It was my negligence that led to this mistake."

Ying Zheng glanced at the woman again and said, "If you want to make amends, then go and interrogate this woman yourself."

Xu Fu nodded slightly at the man. "Come over." He had specifically brought this woman here, so it couldn't just be to remind them; he must have had a precise purpose. Perhaps he wanted him to tell his fortune again, or perhaps he wanted to get closer to Ying Zheng more directly.

This was a man with great ambition; his eyes were filled with a desire for power.

Seeing that his goal had been achieved, the man immediately smiled.

"I have given you a gift, Sir. Are you now willing to tell my fortune?" The man's face was bright with a smile.

"Name?" Xu Fu sat down by the fire and asked this first.

The man shook his head. "Why do you need a name to tell a fortune? Please read my face, Sir."

Xu Fu said without even looking, "A life full of twists and turns."

The expression on the man's face stiffened, but he wasn't angry, or rather, with so many people around, he didn't dare to be.

"What? Not convinced?" Xu Fu looked at him coldly. "If your life wasn't full of twists and turns, how could you have fallen from being a high official in a state to your current state? Even the people in the town look down on you..."

The man's face changed. "How did you know I was once a high official?"

"The face of an official is written on your face." When it came to scheming, Xu Fu couldn't beat him, but when it came to physiognomy, no one could beat him.

"Then may I ask, Sir, is there no way to change my fate of twists and turns?"

"How do you want to change it? Change it back to your former position?" Xu Fu asked lazily.

The man shook his head and smiled. "Naturally not. The past is the past; what use is it to me? I want to be reborn from the ashes, I want to open up a new life, I want to find a new master and plan for the future!"

He said this with great passion. Xu Fu could have ignored him, but at this moment, he couldn't help but look toward Ying Zheng. The State of Qin needed talent. If this man was truly useful, bringing him back to Qin and using him where he was needed would be a good way to not waste his value.

Moreover, this man had one advantage: he had had a major falling out with his former master. Once he defected to Qin, he would definitely not think of the past again.

"You want me to change your fate?"

"Yes."

"This is a big matter... but it's not impossible." Xu Fu paused for effect. "If you want it, well, chop wood, wash clothes, and cook. If I find you pleasing to the eye, I will naturally change your fate."

A variety of surprises flashed across the man's face.

The attendants, upon hearing this, felt a bit of envy, jealousy, and hatred toward the man. The Grand Astrologer Xu's abilities were remarkable; to have him change one's fate, let alone chopping wood, washing clothes, and cooking, even more arduous requirements would be worth it!

The man took in the attendants' gazes, gritted his teeth, and said, "Then I will obey your wishes, Sir."

chapters.source_text:
“那么，现在第一件事，告诉我你叫什么名字。”徐福看着他慢条斯理地说。
男子一愣。
“若你与我做个仆人，告知主人自己的名字，难道不是应该的吗？”徐福说出来的话实在令人无从反驳。
男子看了看他，又看了一眼旁边的嬴政，再度咬牙，“姚贾。”
“姚贾啊。”徐福将这个名字在舌尖过了一遍，照旧只是觉得有几分耳熟，却实在想不起这是历史上的谁，不过既然能让感觉到耳熟，想来在历史上也是极有名气的人物，将来说不定是会办出些大事的。
这样的人，收到秦国倒也是个好事。
徐福踢了踢脚边的木头，“方才你发出动静时，我们正巧在用食物，正是因为你的出现才打断了我的进食，现在你得重新给我烤制食物。”
姚贾此人正应了嬴政对他的印象，极为能屈能伸。不过烤个食物，有何难？哪怕这对于他来说，是非常生疏的。
侍从将工具交到他的手中，很快姚贾便蹲在了火堆旁，任劳任怨地继续给徐福烤食物。
胡亥盯着他手中的食物目不转睛，等姚贾在一片烟熏火燎中，快要忍受不了的时候，安娘在旁边提醒了他一声，“快焦了……”
姚贾手忙脚乱地拿起来，转头正对上胡亥水灵灵的目光，“可以吃吗？”
姚贾看向了徐福。
徐福只看了一眼就知道他烤出来的东西并不好吃，徐福摇了摇头，“你自己吃吧。”说完徐福又冲胡亥招了招手，“过来，安娘给你做。”
胡亥很快便被哄过来了，姚贾一脸沉痛地将食物塞进嘴里，险些被自己毒出两行热泪。
但是徐福让他自己吃啊……
哪怕再难吃，姚贾也要装作异常好吃，一口一口，咽下去。这是对方在表达自己的不快吗？姚贾决心以后定然再也不要算计他了。
……
烤制食物并不算什么，徐福说的让他洗衣做饭，那是当真洗衣做饭。
徐福丝毫不客气地将自己的衣衫抛给了姚贾，姚贾也接住了，并且认认真真，老老实实地洗了起来。
之后驾马车，铺床，烧火……他更是一样没落。
虽然日日做着这些事，但姚贾却奇异地发现，自己并不累，不仅如此，他的心是平静的，不会再有半分暴躁和抑郁肆虐着内心。
对方就算再如何整治他，却从未表现出过半分轻视鄙夷，他们扫过来时，目光都是清澈而坦然的，甚至让姚贾感觉到了前所未有的放松，尽管他知道，这些人似乎从头到尾，都并没将他放在眼中。
姚贾心中的情绪微微澎湃。
他会用自己的本事来向他们证明的！

转眼便快要到三川郡了。
之后徐福便再也没见过那个女子，徐福也根本没兴趣去过问。而一路上也再没有了那些刺客的踪影。
这个时候，找刺客做好无数准备，并且跨地域杀人，成本还是较大的，一击不中，后面就很难再找到机会。更何况桓齮将军对赵国步步紧逼，赵国如今也是分身乏术，难以再耍这等阴招了，而其他国家的君主，此时还不知嬴政到了何处，他们又如何能派人来刺杀？
一旦进了三川郡内，那些人自然便再也没有机会了。
从上次在三川回咸阳的路上，正因嬴政遭遇了刺杀，所以他对秦国境内的把控就变得更严了。
马车在三川郡的治所城外停住，甘棠掀起车帘跳了下去，由士兵检查过后，他们很快便入了城。
城中难免还有两分萧条之色，毕竟旱灾过去才小半年的功夫，三川居要完全恢复到从前的模样，那需要一些时日。
不过徐福发现，这些人的脸上倒是不见郁郁之色了。
看来三川郡的郡守换成刘子训后，还是有几分起色的。
嬴政此行前来，三川郡上下都并不知晓，不过因着他们队伍稍微大了些，从进城后，还是吸引住了不少的目光。
甘棠与安娘二人前去寻找客栈下榻。
安娘之所以还没有离开他们，不过是因为胡亥馋她的手艺，多带一人也并不麻烦，嬴政毫不吝啬地同意了。
徐福同嬴政坐在马车里慢悠悠地走着。
徐福掀起车帘往外瞧了瞧。
他心中还是颇有几分满足的，毕竟此处能得救，他同嬴政也是出了力的。
不知不觉间便到了客栈外，他们从马车内出来，那客栈中人也是少见如此人物，乍一见徐福，只觉得容貌俊美，惊艳不已，仿佛在哪里见过，但偏生就是想不起来，究竟在何处见过对方。
徐福冲对方点了点头，便神色淡漠地和嬴政一同进屋子去了。
客栈大堂中有一人挠了挠头，“哎，我怎么觉得，那二人的模样，十分像从前来到三川的王上和那位什么……什么奉常啊？”
旁边有一人闻言，顿时嗤笑出声，“瞎说什么？此处能见到王上？王上此时应当在咸阳！如今我大秦正值攻打赵国的时候，王上无端来到三川做什么？就算是王上来了，那他也应当是去住郡守府，而不是咱们这个简陋之所！”
“你说得倒也有理……”
那二人低下头来，细细聊了会儿，没多久，话题便拐向了别处。
想一想也是，有时候真相摆在你的面前，你反而不敢去相信了，正所谓“灯下黑”，便是如此了。
徐福和嬴政这般大张旗鼓，却硬是没人认为，他们便是应当坐在咸阳宫中的人物。
进了屋子后，徐福便立即在桌案前坐下了，若不是等一会儿侍从还要回来禀报事情，他便不顾形象躺倒在床上了。
正想着呢，便有侍从前来敲门了。
“先生令我去问的那对母女……”
“如何？”
“二人都活下来了，郡守刘子训在城中给她们二人寻了个住处，如今那个妇人，应当是在城中帮人卖东西来谋生。生活倒也算不错了。”
徐福闻言，心头顿时愉悦了不少。
没了渣男，又治好了疫病，她们母女二人又能脱离那个小村子，生活自然不错！
“我走时，令人埋下的那两名男子呢？”徐福又追问了一句。送佛送到西，既然他都命人把那两个人渣给埋了，现在当然是要过问一下，看死透了没。
侍从皱起了眉，道：“他们二人的消息倒是并未听到，不过有人到那个村子去问了。”
徐福点头。
嬴政挥退了侍从，正欲洗漱一番同徐福休息，胡亥便光着脚闯过来了，身后还跟着一个一脸生无可恋的扶苏。
见胡亥拼尽了全身力气，硬是将门推开了，嬴政顿时有种不知是该笑还该怒的感觉。
胡亥一张脸红彤彤的，他一边摸着小肚皮，一边水汪汪地看着徐福，“饿饿，父亲，好饿……”
徐福对家庭的概念也较浅，与胡亥、扶苏相比之下，他不得不说嬴政是更重要的，嬴政不乐意打扰，徐福也不见得就能忍受胡亥来打扰他们二人休息的时间了。
徐福毫不心虚地指派扶苏，“带他去寻安娘吧。”
一听“安娘”二字，哪怕胡亥说不定连对方的面孔都记不清，但他至少记得住对方手里食物的气味儿。
扶苏无奈地向徐福和嬴政告了罪，随后便牵着胡亥出去了。
徐福同嬴政躺上床榻之后，十分心安理得地在心底道了一句。
兄弟情的培养，便是从小事开始的。
瞧如今扶苏对胡亥那般好，以后胡亥长大了，难道还会想着弑兄吗？虽然徐福觉得胡亥或许还会想着弑爹。但嬴政是什么人物？这一点徐福倒是丝毫都不担心。
一觉睡到天明，徐福终于解了疲乏。
起身洗漱后，很快便有伙计送来了食物，胡亥顺着食物的香气摸了进来，一边咽口水，一边小声说：“昨晚，甘棠哥哥，这样……这样……和安娘这样……”
徐福：“……什么这样和这样？”
原来秦二世小时候还爱瞧八卦？
“就是像父王对父亲，这样这样……”胡亥竖起胖乎乎的软指头，往前点了点，圆润的指尖凑在了一起。
胡亥这番话倒是让嬴政觉得有些好笑。
嬴政单手撑住额头，瞧着胡亥笑了笑，“是在亲吻吗？”
胡亥皱眉想了会儿，“像，像哥哥亲我那样。”
他话音一落，徐福和嬴政都同时惊讶地看向了扶苏。
扶苏一脸懵逼。
“我、我，我什么也没做过啊……”扶苏快要欲哭无泪了，“是胡亥小时候喝了奶就爱往我脸上蹭，我生病那段日子，我喝药，胡亥瞧着以为是好喝的，也非要来舔我嘴里的药……”
徐福的目光更诡异了。
扶苏顿觉越抹越黑，于是干脆闭了嘴，回头本想瞪胡亥一眼，但又见他一脸的天真无邪，扶苏内心气得呕血，只能在心底暗骂，他当真与胡亥是天生仇人！
原来是年幼的胡亥硬凑着占了扶苏的便宜。
徐福朝扶苏投去了一道隐晦的歉意的目光。的确是为难他了……
胡亥这段惊人之语暂且揭过，不过他们用过饭食后，刚出了屋子，徐福便发觉到了气氛的不对劲之处。
甘棠平日里神色是冷冰冰的，瞧着如同一块木头，虽然是块长得好的木头。
今日他却是拉着脸的，眉目间还透着股萎靡之气。
徐福很快便从姚贾口中听到了甘棠的八卦。
他喜欢上了安娘。
原来胡亥说的话还真算不得假……
安娘比甘棠年长出十几岁，这放在古代，不是谁都能接受的配对，甘棠这性子倒是放荡不羁，短短不过小半月，便能对人家产生好感，但安娘从前过的什么的日子，稍微想一想便能知道，她对甘棠定然没有多少信任的。
对于安娘这样的女子来说，爱情、男人恐怕都是可有可无的东西了。
所以甘棠如今之所以会这副模样，应当是情路受挫了。
姚贾讲这些八卦的时候，嬴政也在一旁。
明明是这样的八卦，但从姚贾口中说出来，却丝毫不显猥琐，反倒还极为自然，就如同在叙述普通的事件一样。
他面上更是连一点报告小道消息的羞愧都没有。
嬴政听完这些话后，心中倒是升起了诡异的自豪感。
甘棠如此便是全然不能与他相比了，他可是轻轻松松（历经艰险）地将徐福拐上了床啊。
果然是比不得寡人的……
徐福让姚贾退下，正琢磨着要不要关怀一会儿甘棠的情感生活，不多时便听见有人说安娘回客栈来了，还准备向众人辞别。
甘棠马不停蹄地跑了过去。
而徐福和嬴政也有那么一丁点儿坏心眼地，跟了过去。
安娘跨进大堂来，此时大堂内除了他们一行人，便再无其他人。因而安娘身后跟着的人，便显得极为打眼了。
徐福这一瞧，还发现对方竟然是自己认识。
那不正是那对母女中的妇人吗？她怎么会随安娘而来？
因着这次并未带桑中、蒹葭前来，女子左右一瞧都是陌生人，所以也并不知自己的恩人已经到三川来了，并且此时正在楼上瞧着她们。
甘棠和安娘独自到另一边说话去了，因为什么也听不清，更看不真切，徐福便觉得没甚意思了。
不过有些侍从倒是看出了端倪，低声交谈道：“安娘不会愿意嫁人的，说不定是要跟着这个妇人留在城中了……”
“是啊是啊，甘棠喜欢上比他大这么多的女子，也实在弄不明白……”
“或许是安娘自认地位不相当吧。若我日后爱上个女子，那女子比我出色许多，我应当也不敢同她在一起的……”
徐福听着听着，忍不住低声道：“我与阿政倒是相当的。”
身后的侍从们乍然偷听到这么一句话，都不免同时一惊。
嗯？
与王上相当？
这……
徐奉常是不是稍微夸大了些……
侍从们却不曾想到，他们的王上轻微地一点头，嗓音低沉有力，“阿福说得不错。”
侍从们：？？？
哪里不错了？

"Now, for the first thing, tell me your name," Xu Fu said to him, taking his time.

The man was stunned.

"If you are to serve me as a servant, isn't it only right to tell your master your name?" Xu Fu's words were truly impossible to refute.

The man looked at him, then glanced at Ying Zheng beside him, and gritted his teeth again, "Yao Jia."

"Yao Jia, is it?" Xu Fu rolled the name over his tongue. It still sounded somewhat familiar, though he really couldn't recall who this was in history. However, since it sounded familiar, he must have been a fairly famous figure in history; perhaps he would accomplish great things in the future.

Having such a person join the State of Qin was a good thing.

Xu Fu kicked the wood at his feet, "When you made that noise earlier, we happened to be eating. It was your appearance that interrupted my meal. Now, you must roast food for me again."

Yao Jia was exactly as Ying Zheng had perceived him: extremely capable of bending and stretching. What was so difficult about roasting food? Even if it was something he was very unfamiliar with.

A servant handed the tools to him, and soon Yao Jia was squatting by the fire, dutifully continuing to roast food for Xu Fu.

Hu Hai stared unblinkingly at the food in his hands. Just as Yao Jia was about to lose his patience amidst the smoke and fire, An Niang reminded him from the side, "It's about to burn..."

Yao Jia scrambled to pick it up, turning his head to meet Hu Hai's bright, watery eyes, "Can I eat it?"

Yao Jia looked at Xu Fu.

Xu Fu only had to take one look to know that what he had roasted wouldn't taste good. Xu Fu shook his head, "You eat it yourself." After saying this, Xu Fu beckoned to Hu Hai, "Come here, An Niang will make some for you."

Hu Hai was quickly coaxed over, while Yao Jia stuffed the food into his mouth with a pained expression, nearly shedding two lines of hot tears from the "poison."

But Xu Fu told him to eat it himself...

No matter how terrible it tasted, Yao Jia had to pretend it was exceptionally delicious, swallowing it bite by bite. Was this the other party expressing his displeasure? Yao Jia resolved that he would definitely never scheme against him again.

...

Roasting food was nothing; when Xu Fu told him to wash clothes and cook, he truly meant washing clothes and cooking.

Xu Fu threw his clothes to Yao Jia without the slightest hesitation. Yao Jia caught them and began washing them earnestly and honestly.

Afterward, driving the carriage, making the bed, tending the fire... he didn't miss a single task.

Although he did these things every day, Yao Jia strangely discovered that he wasn't tired. Moreover, his heart was at peace; no longer was it ravaged by irritability and depression.

No matter how the other party disciplined him, they never showed the slightest contempt or disdain. When they glanced at him, their gazes were clear and calm, which even made Yao Jia feel an unprecedented sense of relaxation, even though he knew these people seemed to have never truly regarded him as anything from the very beginning.

The emotions in Yao Jia's heart surged slightly.

He would use his own abilities to prove himself to them!
