军营中的日子过起来也极快，桓齮白日里看上去仍旧不见起色，但实际上，他的身体已经在逐渐好转了，而且恢复的速度大大超过了徐福的预料。是他的方子有奇效？徐福觉得不是的。他的目光隐隐落在了那几个鼎上。这不正就是他将鼎带来的原因吗？它们才能炼出最成功的药丸。也只有它们熬出的药，才具备了愈合更快的奇效。
徐福不由得想到了上次瘟疫的时候，熬制出的第一批药，也是从他手底下随手用小鼎操作的。
徐福先暂时将这件事放到了脑后。
那刘军医留得也差不多了，等桓齮神智清醒的时候，他也就该死了。
正想着呢，刘军医便进来了，他的面容有些憔悴，只因这段时间他被折腾得够呛。徐福等人视他为无物，只有勒令他好生照顾桓齮的时候，才会与他说话。而伺候桓齮也不是个好差事，刘军医感受到了伺候病人的痛苦，他睡不能睡好，吃不能吃好，还要忍受周围冷漠的气氛。刘军医哪里会想到，自己还有这样的时刻？要知道，按照原本的计划里，这个时候他早就走了。
这些压力刘军医也并不是不能承受，最让他焦虑的还是桓齮。
明明都到这个地步了，他应该死了。但为什么他还能活着？哪怕就这样半死不活地躺在床榻上，那他也始终还没死啊！怎么会这样？随着一件一件事都超脱出自己的掌控，刘军医心头的压力越来越大。他不知道自己所做的事，一旦被发现后会遭遇什么。他只能在每日前来帐子前，都祈祷一番。
让他死吧。
让他快点死吧！
刘军医今日也在心底默念了这样的话，然后和往常一样走进了帐子，只是他才刚刚走进来，便听见了有人大叫一声，“将军！”
刘军医费尽了力气，才压住了自己的嘴角不要上翘。
哦……
桓齮死了吧。
他脚步轻快地走进帐子里，听着那些杂乱的脚步声，仿佛成为了世间最美妙的音乐，这段时间憔悴许多的刘军医，脸上竟然不自觉地笼上了一层光。
军营里很快就乱了，有人大呼小叫地赶过来，脚步声轰隆隆，甚至跺得地面都在响。
刘军医觉得这个声音也极为美妙。
就在这个时候，徐福往他的方向看了一眼。
刘军医接收到了徐福冰冷的目光，但他今日一点也不害怕了，桓齮死了，他们又没有证据，能拿他怎么样呢？这位徐都尉再厉害，也不能说杀就杀了他啊。刘军医目光温和地迎上了徐福。
徐福忍不住想要笑出声来。
刘军医怎么这么天真呢？
他面色一冷，冰冷的嗓音在帐子里格外的清晰，“刘军医，大家都面色苍白眼带血丝，怎么唯独你一脸容光焕发呢？”
龙阳君接了句嘴，“难道刘军医有什么喜悦的事吗？”
刘军医眼底的笑容僵住了。
作者有话要说：　　《纲目》：水银，若撒失在地，但以川椒末或茶末收之。 《本经逢原》：水银，阴毒重着，不可入人腹。今有误食水银，腹中重坠，用猪脂二斤，切作小块焙熟，入生蜜拌食得下，亦一法也。
chapters.translated_text:
The soldier, looking panicked, clutched the small, battered tripod in his arms and bolted out like a gust of wind. Seeing this, the other soldiers looked in that direction with suspicion and unease, completely unaware of what had happened.

Seeing the grim expression on Xu Fu's face, Sang Zhong couldn't help but ask, "What is that?"

"Mercury."

"...What is that?" Sang Zhong asked cautiously.

Xu Fu was stunned. That was true; it seemed the term "mercury" didn't exist yet, and they certainly wouldn't know what mercury poisoning was.

Xu Fu immediately changed his explanation. "Do you know cinnabar? That is liquid cinnabar." There were records that the cinnabar used before the time of Qin Shi Huang was natural mercury, and from that time on, nobles and aristocrats had used it in their tombs.

Sang Zhong didn't find it particularly terrifying. Instead, he asked in confusion, "Since it is cinnabar, why can't it be touched? Isn't it used in alchemy and medicine-making?"

A jolt of electricity flashed through Xu Fu's mind. He always felt as if someone had died from being poisoned by pills laced with cinnabar while obsessively seeking immortality. However, there were many such records in history, and Xu Fu couldn't recall exactly who it was for a moment, so he pushed the thought to the back of his mind.

He knew that in this era, cinnabar was deified and always associated with alchemy. When Ying Zheng first thought he was practicing alchemy, he had ordered people to find cinnabar.

Xu Fu patiently explained to Sang Zhong, "Liquid cinnabar releases a scent. Inhaling too much leads to poisoning, and direct contact makes it even easier to be poisoned. If someone mixes it into food, the toxicity is even deeper. In severe cases, it leads to kidney... it leads to bodily failure."

That was it. Mercury poisoning. The initial stages were vomiting and diarrhea; the later stages involved oral ulcers, skin necrosis, organ failure, tremors, and blurred senses.

Xu Fu desperately searched his brain for information on mercury poisoning, but all he could think of were friendly reminders from public service announcements in his past life: Please leave the scene immediately, send the patient to the hospital, induce vomiting, administer intramuscular injections of sodium dimercaptopropanesulfonate, and remember to replenish electrolytes.

...

None of that was useful!

Moreover, Huan Yi looked like he had been suffering from chronic poisoning for a long time. Leaving the scene or inducing vomiting was useless, there was no hospital to send him to, and there was no sodium dimercaptopropanesulfonate to inject. Electrolytes could be replenished, though, and looking at Huan Yi's emaciated and weak state, he certainly needed them.

He didn't know how he had managed to hold on for over half a month.

"Go get some salt water," Xu Fu turned and instructed Sang Zhong.

Sang Zhong looked at Bo Zhou, and seeing him nod, he left with peace of mind.

Xu Fu knew that the salt water of this era was certainly different from the saline solution used for electrolyte replenishment in later generations, but it was worth a try.

Shortly after Sang Zhong left, Xu Fu gradually calmed down. He called over a soldier and ordered him to search the area for any other small tripods of the same appearance, or anything that looked strange or had a pungent odor, and to collect them all without allowing anyone else to touch them.

This thing was truly hard to guard against; once you inhaled too much, you were done for. Fortunately, the culprit had only targeted Huan Yi first. Xu Fu guessed that the person behind this probably didn't know that one only needed to smell this stuff to get poisoned, so they had added it directly to Huan Yi's food, never intending to cause mass casualties.

It could be considered a clumsy attempt that backfired.

Sang Zhong soon returned with the salt water, walked to the bedside, helped Huan Yi up, and forced the salt water down his throat. When the salt water touched his wounds, Huan Yi frowned tightly in pain, emitting broken cries from his throat. His body trembled, and a moment later, he clutched Sang Zhong's sleeve tightly, followed by a large amount of turbid fluid gushing from his mouth, mixed with blood and bits of flesh.

It looked truly terrifying.

Sang Zhong couldn't dodge in time and got covered in it.

Xu Fu watched this scene, stunned for a moment, then immediately spoke to comfort him: "Bear with it, it'll be fine after a wash. Don't hold it against the patient."

Sang Zhong's "good guy" face immediately lengthened; he could no longer maintain that godforsaken gentle temperament!

Once Huan Yi had vomited everything out, he collapsed weakly back onto the bed.

The smell in the tent wasn't very pleasant, but fortunately, Xu Fu had ordered the curtains to be propped open for ventilation early on, so it wasn't entirely unbearable.

"Bring me my bamboo slips," Xu Fu turned and ordered. Bo Zhou nodded and left the tent to fetch the slips Xu Fu had brought. There was a small pile of them, and Bo Zhou stacked them in front of Xu Fu. If they weren't so precious, one might have thought Xu Fu was going to use them as firewood to boil medicine.

Xu Fu stared at the small tripod while reaching out to flip through the slips, managing both tasks at once.

Divination was very mentally taxing. Aside from the occasional distraction when talking to people, Xu Fu's mental focus in special situations was extremely sharp, far stronger than others. Just like now, he could easily manage making medicine while reading the slips.

Bo Zhou took the pills Xu Fu had made and handed them to Sang Zhong. Sang Zhong, with a sour face, grabbed the pills and shoved them into Huan Yi's mouth. Huan Yi choked, but managed to swallow them, which was better than the medicine-feeding process that took forever and resulted in half the bowl being spilled.

Bo Zhou watched his movements and reminded him, "You still need to feed him some water, otherwise he'll choke to death."

Sang Zhong thought that was true, so he continued to feed Huan Yi water, feeling aggrieved.

Xu Fu found a relevant record in the bamboo slips.

"Chanu (Toad Woman), odorless; when vaporized, the smell is pungent; do not ingest directly."

In Taoism, "Chanu" meant mercury; Taoist alchemists often referred to it as Chanu.

Xu Fu flipped further.

"If spilled on the ground, collect it with pepper powder."

Pepper powder? Xu Fu remembered that when they left the Di-Qiang tribe's village last time, the things A-Yi had given him to take included pepper powder—which was actually the Sichuan pepper of later generations.

Xu Fu had a habit of carrying these miscellaneous items, so he found it easily.

When it came time to dispose of it, he might be able to use it.

Xu Fu closed the slips and continued searching for others.

"If cinnabar is accidentally ingested, causing a heavy, sinking feeling in the abdomen, use two catties of lard, cut into small pieces and roasted until cooked, mix with raw honey and eat; this is also a method."

"Call a soldier in," Xu Fu said, then continued flipping through the slips. Unfortunately, he couldn't find any more information; the rest were mostly records on how to use mercury in medicine and alchemy.

During the Warring States period, using mercury in medicine was not uncommon; it was even used in cosmetics for women.

Every time he saw such records, Xu Fu found it incredibly novel. How could something so highly toxic be used in such a way?

"Captain, what are your orders?" The soldier stepped into the tent, bowed, and looked at Xu Fu with great eagerness.

His gaze carefully drifted toward the small tripod in front of Xu Fu. Seeing the black pills placed nearby, the soldier's eyes lit up, and he swallowed involuntarily. That... that must be the legendary elixir... As a person like Captain Xu, who was like a living immortal, the pills he refined must be extraordinary. Perhaps in a few days, they would see the General recover.

It was a pity he hadn't tasted what an elixir was like yet...

The soldier swallowed again.

"Can you read?"

The soldier shook his head.

Xu Fu grabbed the bamboo slips, intending to transcribe them for him character by character, when Sang Zhong suddenly stood up. "I'll do it. I'll go out with you and tell you on the way. You take me to change my clothes first."

The soldier looked at the miserable state of Sang Zhong's clothes and felt immense admiration.

As expected of someone by Captain Xu's side, no matter what happens, he can remain so calm and still take such good care of the General. He truly is a good man!

Xu Fu and Sang Zhong were unaware of the praise in the soldier's heart.

In the blink of an eye, Xu Fu had finished reading all the bamboo slips. He didn't know he could be so efficient at reading. He didn't gain any more useful information. Xu Fu pushed the slips aside and began to focus on refining the medicine.

He hadn't learned from Jiang You in vain, the books Ying Zheng found for him hadn't been read in vain, and his own tinkering with the tripod hadn't been for nothing.

Xu Fu felt there was still some hope that he could make medicine to save Huan Yi's life. It would be a pity if a talent like Huan Yi died. Even if he couldn't do it, the people he had sent out early on should have discovered traces of Senior Brother Jiang You by now. He wondered if Senior Brother Jiang You would run another errand...

Xu Fu stopped his train of thought and pushed these lingering worries to the back of his mind.

The smell in the tent was gradually being masked by the scent of medicine. The medicine Xu Fu was boiling was so strong that even people outside the tent couldn't help but twitch their noses when they smelled it.

"Sir, I hope this medicine doesn't end up poisoning the person to death instead," Lord Longyang said in a very serious tone, though his words were mocking.

As the words fell, Xu Fu turned to see Lord Longyang and Jianjia striding in. Lord Longyang's expression was unreadable, while Jianjia clearly and directly expressed his displeasure.

"Where is he?" Xu Fu didn't take Lord Longyang's bait, turning instead to ask about the whereabouts of the military doctor, Liu.

Lord Longyang showed a hint of guilt. "I couldn't catch him."

This time it was Xu Fu's turn to mock back. He shook his head and said lightly, "If even Lord Longyang couldn't catch him, I wonder what kind of formidable person he really is."

Lord Longyang said unhurriedly, "No matter how formidable, how could he be more formidable than you, Sir?" He was referring to the behavior of the seven states, which had praised him to the extreme. In the hearts of many, Xu Fu was truly one of the most formidable people in the world.

"Then we shall wait," Xu Fu still didn't take Lord Longyang's bait.

Lord Longyang wasn't angry, just curiously asked, "How does Sir know that waiting will definitely result in catching him?"

"If you've gone to such great lengths to kill someone, and you don't watch them draw their last breath, wouldn't it be a shame if all your efforts were wasted due to a moment of carelessness?" Xu Fu was just reasoning according to common sense. If the other party didn't follow common sense, it didn't matter; either way, Huan Yi would be saved, and the person who would be more frustrated would definitely be the enemy, not him. Eventually, one day, he would know who was behind this.

Lord Longyang nodded, his eyes brightening, and his gaze toward Xu Fu held a bit more unspoken appreciation.

Soon, the sky turned dark. Xu Fu naturally couldn't stay in the tent; he had to go back to rest. Forcing himself to refine medicine didn't guarantee success; it was better to keep a clear head and sufficient strength. And all of that required rest.

After Xu Fu returned to his tent, Sang Zhong and Bo Zhou stood guard behind the screen. Having experienced Xu Fu's disappearance before, Sang Zhong didn't dare to leave Xu Fu alone easily.

That night, with the prescription Xu Fu had found in the ancient texts, the soldiers used it directly on Huan Yi, supplemented by the pills Sang Zhong had fed him earlier. Huan Yi vomited again, becoming even weaker, but the pain on his face lessened significantly. The soldiers surrounded his bed, looking at Huan Yi's state with anxiety. They wanted to ask Xu Fu but didn't dare. So, they held it in until the next morning.

Xu Fu woke up early, changed his robes, washed, and went straight to Huan Yi's tent.

The soldiers were anxiously pacing behind him, showing the depth of their feelings for Huan Yi. It was no wonder people said the bonds on the battlefield were the deepest. Although Xu Fu himself didn't possess such things, he admired them greatly, and thus he cared even more about Huan Yi's current situation.

Based on his deductions and what he had learned from Jiang You, Xu Fu combined them and wrote out several more prescriptions in one go, leaving them there to be verified one by one.

But before he could verify them, someone walked in quickly and said, "Military Doctor Liu has returned." It was Jianjia speaking, his expression cold, but his eyes clearly held a smile. If Military Doctor Liu truly had a problem, and he had managed to slip past Jianjia's eyes, he would be firmly remembered by Jianjia.

Xu Fu knew Jianjia had immense strength, and he wondered if Jianjia would punch Military Doctor Liu into the wall.

"Let's go." Xu Fu left the medicine and walked out with Jianjia. He also wanted to see which of the two military doctors was the mole.

Military Doctor Liu was extremely calm. He stood in the tent waiting for someone to come. As soon as he heard footsteps, he turned around. Xu Fu looked down and saw that Military Doctor Liu was still clutching herbs in his hands. Because they hadn't been carefully selected, the herbs looked messy, just like wild grass from the side of the road.

"What was Military Doctor Liu doing last night? You didn't even return to the camp." At times like this, Xu Fu had to maintain his stature, so Jianjia became the one to speak for him.

The surrounding soldiers also felt very conflicted.

Not to mention whether Military Doctor Liu was related to Huan Yi's poisoning, just leaving the camp without permission and not returning for a long time was enough of a reason to kill him. There were rules in the military camp, and the rule was that one could not leave at will; those who left would face severe torture.

When Xu Fu heard the soldiers talk about it, he could roughly guess how harsh that torture was.

In the Qin State, which valued strict laws, the punishments were not just severe but cold-blooded! Military Doctor Liu would at least lose half his life.

The soldiers felt conflicted and regretful. They had all liked Military Doctor Liu, but he had indeed broken a taboo. He should never have left without permission at such a sensitive time. According to the rules, his actions were suspicious of collusion with the enemy. Following the rules, he should be detained, interrogated, and then it would be decided how to deal with him.

The soldiers sighed. Military Doctor Liu was usually such a rule-abiding person; why did he have to be so unlucky today?

How could they know that Military Doctor Liu had been so rule-abiding for so long just for this one act of defiance today?

Military Doctor Liu ignored the gazes of the surrounding soldiers. He lifted his robes and knelt in front of Xu Fu. He was neither anxious nor panicked, looking like a silent, honest man. He held up the herbs in his hands and said in a low voice, "The General is seriously ill. As a military doctor, I was unable to treat him, and I felt very uneasy. I vaguely remembered seeing relevant records in ancient books, and I thought these herbs might be useful to the General, so I went up the mountain overnight and only just returned."

Military Doctor Liu didn't deliberately sensationalize the atmosphere, nor did he brag about what good deeds he had done. His attitude was very flat, easily winning the trust of these soldiers.

Because the flatter the tone, the more it made people feel how much he had silently done for the General. Just on this point, Military Doctor Liu was streets ahead of that Military Doctor Hu.

The soldiers were quite moved and were easily stirred by him.

Look, what a great technique. It was no wonder Military Doctor Hu was misunderstood, because the difference between him and Military Doctor Liu was just too great. Military Doctor Liu was someone who knew how to read the situation and secure an advantageous position for himself. He must be a smart person. But Xu Fu didn't like it when intelligence was used in the wrong place.

Since he wanted to stand on the opposite side of the Qin State, he would have to pay the price for harming a Qin general.

While Military Doctor Liu was speaking, Xu Fu watched him coldly, his gaze indifferent, showing no emotion. But it was this very lack of emotion that made Military Doctor Liu feel a sense of oppression in his heart.

Military Doctor Liu suppressed the strange feeling in his heart and said in a low voice, "I know the rules of the army. Since I have committed a mistake, I should be punished."

The soldiers couldn't bear it and looked at Xu Fu repeatedly. Now, Xu Fu was the only one left who could make decisions.

Xu Fu's face was cold. "According to the rules, you are already a dead man." Xu Fu's temperament and expression were very intimidating, and his tone imitated Ying Zheng's. This sentence indeed had a good effect; he saw Military Doctor Liu shiver involuntarily, and his face turned somewhat strange. Xu Fu's eyesight was getting better and better, and he saw through the fear in Military Doctor Liu's eyes at a glance.

It seemed he was right; it was him.

Being able to act so well and being so smart—not like an ordinary person—if such a person wasn't suitable to be a mole, then who was?

Military Doctor Liu opened his mouth and lowered his head, looking dejected. This fit the image he had always cultivated in the military camp: silent, obsessed with medicine, helpful, and when bullied by others, he would at most show such an expression.

How pitiful...

Some soldiers were already finding it hard to restrain themselves, but only a few of those with higher military ranks felt a faint sense of doubt rising in their hearts.

Why would Commandant Xu suddenly say such things to Military Physician Liu? Based on their interactions, Commandant Xu was not a cruel man. Moreover, they felt something was strange, right up until the moment Military Physician Liu lowered his head, his expression desolate, remaining silent just as he had done several times before when Military Physician Hu had stolen his thunder. That’s it! That’s what’s wrong! Those few men snapped to their senses and exchanged glances.

Having one's thunder stolen by Military Physician Hu and being about to become a dead man were two things that simply could not be compared.

If Military Physician Liu was unwilling to compete with Military Physician Hu and let himself be bullied, one could call it being indifferent to fame and wealth, a disdain for vying for the spotlight. But now that his life was in danger, could he still remain so indifferent? Could he still continue to show weakness and retreat? If Military Physician Liu were a cowardly person, they wouldn't have held him in high regard. It was because while Military Physician Hu was a petty man who loved to show off, Military Physician Liu acted like a true gentleman in every way. He showed the soldiers his backbone, indicating he disdained to compete with Military Physician Hu, while patiently getting along with the soldiers and treating their illnesses well, which quickly won the favor of these rough men.

A person with a backbone, not saying a single word of resistance even when facing the threat of death?

If Military Physician Liu wasn't truly scared silly, then... he was overacting.

These men felt a sinking sensation in their hearts. They couldn't help but look toward Xu Fu. Could Commandant Xu’s behavior just now be because he had discovered something wrong with Military Physician Liu? They exchanged glances again, and in each other's eyes, they saw admiration for Xu Fu.

If they had previously held Xu Fu in high regard only because of the General’s influence and the rumors, now they were genuinely impressed.

Commandant Xu is indeed a formidable person!

They had been blinded for so long, yet as soon as Commandant Xu arrived, he was able to lift the veil covering the other party and see through their true nature!

They hid the light in their eyes and waited quietly for developments, fearing they might disrupt Xu Fu’s arrangements.

In fact, Xu Fu hadn't made any arrangements, because once he was certain this person was problematic, making everyone stop trusting Military Physician Liu would be too easy.

Seeing that Xu Fu remained silent for a long time and no one around dared to stand up and plead for him, a dark glint flashed in the depths of Military Physician Liu’s eyes. It seemed this Commandant Xu was too capable; everyone in the military camp feared him.

Military Physician Liu gritted his teeth and knelt on the ground, "I have broken the rules, and I have nothing to say for myself, but these herbs were gathered for the General. I truly hope they can save the General's life."

"Sang Zhong, go take them."

"Yes." Sang Zhong walked over, took the messy herbs into his hands, and walked back to Xu Fu’s side.

"Since that is the case, I can spare your life; you can be considered as having the General’s best interests at heart, but there must still be a punishment. Tell me, what kind of punishment are you willing to accept?" Xu Fu asked with feigned nonchalance, his gaze even fixed on the utensils at his side, his eyes shimmering with interest. In reality, Xu Fu’s gaze was subtly fixed on Military Physician Liu.

He watched as a subtle look of joy flashed across Military Physician Liu’s face, and then he heard Military Physician Liu say in a mournful tone, "I... I have broken military rules, so... so just banish me from the camp."

Look, you’ve exposed yourself again.

Xu Fu sighed inwardly, thinking to himself if this Military Physician Liu took them all for fools who were easy to deceive. He scanned the surrounding soldiers; they were extremely agitated, showing reluctance and wanting to speak up for Military Physician Liu, but they dared not do so because of Xu Fu. They all knew the General’s life was still in Xu Fu’s hands, and besides, they themselves had a very good impression of Xu Fu and secretly held him in high esteem.

But now, they were caught in a dilemma...

Xu Fu took in the expressions of the soldiers.

Sure enough, they had been fooled. Xu Fu shifted his gaze to the side; fortunately, there were still a few who weren't stupid.

"Banish him?" Lord Longyang strode in, his tone surprised, "What is this? Why the sudden commotion?"

Upon hearing this, Military Physician Liu felt a faint sense of triumph. He was proud that he had played these Qin soldiers in the palm of his hand; they had been tricked by him and were now turning around to defend him. His original goal was to be banished from the camp. He knew these soldiers would plead for him, and then he would go along with it and request to be banished from the camp himself; this Commandant Xu would certainly agree. At that time, he would be leaving openly and aboveboard, and who would ever link him to the internal traitor afterward? In the end, the one to take the fall would still be that Military Physician Hu!

Xu Fu took up Lord Longyang’s words and followed along, "I am also very curious. Everything was fine, so why would Military Physician Liu suddenly request to be banished himself..."

Military Physician Liu met his gaze and blurted out, "Naturally, it is because I broke the rules."

"Military Physician Liu says he is devoted to the General, which is why he broke the rules. Since you are devoted to the General, why would you immediately request to be banished after I spared your life? Shouldn't you be relieved to have survived and be determined to continue taking good care of the General, watching him be cured by your herbs? Military Physician Liu, why do you want to leave?" In the process of saying this string of words, Xu Fu cleverly converted Military Physician Liu’s self-requested banishment into "Why do you want to leave," directly stamping the label of "wanting to leave voluntarily" onto Military Physician Liu.

Wanting to leave oneself and being driven away are two completely different things.

As soon as Xu Fu said this, everyone was stunned.

It seemed... it seemed that what he said was correct. If he truly valued the General, he should have chosen to accept some minor punishment and stay to take care of the General! Why, after being spared, was he so eager to request banishment?

This logic, there was definitely something that didn't add up.

Military Physician Liu’s complexion did not change, but the slightly strained veins on his neck and the fine beads of sweat on his forehead exposed his true emotions. Having been sailing smoothly for too long, Military Physician Liu was suddenly faced with such questioning and couldn't think of how to answer in such a short time.

Xu Fu hadn't intended to peel off his skin so quickly. Xu Fu intended to let the people in the army discover the strange parts themselves; that way, they would believe more in what they saw with their own eyes and would never waver again. At this time, if he rashly told them that Military Physician Liu was no good, who knew if it would cause a rebellious psychological reaction?

"Military Physician Liu, you should stay. Oh, just stay by my side. Military Physician Liu is devoted to the General, so naturally, you should stay by his side and serve him well these few days." After Xu Fu finished speaking, he walked past Military Physician Liu toward the outside. He didn't even look at Military Physician Liu’s face. Bo Zhou glanced coldly at Military Physician Liu and said in a cold voice, "Follow."

Military Physician Liu shivered involuntarily; he instinctively felt that something was wrong.

From the moment this Commandant of the Guard arrived at the camp, Military Physician Liu had been on guard, but the other party was, after all, just a young man, and he himself had long been thriving in the military camp. How could Military Physician Liu have taken him seriously? But he never expected that the person he hadn't taken seriously would, in the end, at the very last step of his plan, hold him back. If the final step couldn't be completed, could he still survive?

Military Physician Liu’s heart was in chaos, but he dared not show the slightest bit of it on his face. If he showed something was wrong now, he might lose his life immediately.

Xu Fu led him toward Huan Yi’s tent.

The soldiers watched Xu Fu’s receding figure and grinned, "Commandant Xu is truly a good man!"

"Yes, yes..."

The few who had already seen the inside story exchanged helpless glances. What they were more worried about now was, would Commandant Xu letting Military Physician Liu get close to the General again... cause trouble?

While everyone had different thoughts, Xu Fu had already brought Military Physician Liu inside.

Military Physician Liu glanced at the person on the bed, a look of satisfaction flashing rapidly across his eyes.

Not long to live...

Little did he know that all his expressions at this moment had fallen into Xu Fu’s eyes.

"Sang Zhong, for these few days, you will instruct him on how to take care of the General." Xu Fu raised his chin and ordered.

Sang Zhong suppressed the joy on his face and agreed happily; finally, he wouldn't have to take care of General Huan Yi! At this moment, Sang Zhong felt that Military Physician Liu’s face was adorable. Military Physician Liu felt his skin crawl under Sang Zhong’s gaze and shivered involuntarily. Had this person already seen through him? Military Physician Liu broke into a cold sweat and forced himself to move his gaze back to Huan Yi’s face.

Sang Zhong walked closer and told Military Physician Liu with a gentle expression what he should do.

Military Physician Liu only felt that the other person’s gentle face was truly terrifying; this person was even better at pretending than he was! Military Physician Liu cursed in his heart.

Afterward, Xu Fu continued to tinker with his medicine, with Sang Zhong guarding at his side.

Military Physician Liu was left at Huan Yi’s side. He looked at Huan Yi’s sallow face, feeling somewhat nervous. It took Military Physician Liu a long time to calm down, but who knew that Huan Yi would suddenly start coughing? Sang Zhong pointed to the container beside him, "Feed him water."

Military Physician Liu could only obediently feed Huan Yi water.

Huan Yi drank quite a bit, but before long, he vomited it all back out, just like he had vomited on Sang Zhong before. At this moment, Military Physician Liu was also covered in it.

Military Physician Liu froze completely. He was so disgusted he wanted to vomit, but he dared not, and he didn't even dare to move. These people in front of him were too cunning; if he left, they might find another excuse to blame him. Military Physician Liu endured the humiliation and anger in his heart and continued to guard at Huan Yi’s side. After finally waiting until Xu Fu left with the others, Military Physician Liu breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly came out of the tent, wishing he could go and change his robes immediately.

But just as he stepped out, he heard a voice, "That Military Physician Liu is too sloppy, too unhygienic, too disgusting. He got covered in vomit, and he could actually just stay there out of laziness without moving a step. He didn't go take a bath and change his robes; I was almost sick from the smell..."

Military Physician Liu froze again.

He opened his mouth, his expression dazed, as if he had suffered a major blow.

Was this his fault? Military Physician Liu gritted his teeth viciously. Just wait, after Huan Yi dies, what use will these people be? What Commandant Xu! By then, he’ll just be another ghost on the battlefield! Thinking of this, Military Physician Liu walked away with long strides, his expression inadvertently revealing a hint of viciousness.

A passing soldier rubbed his eyes in disbelief, "...Did, did I see that wrong?"

Over here, Xu Fu entered the tent and said in a low voice, "The herbs that Military Physician Liu sent over are actually somewhat useful."

Sang Zhong was very surprised, "How could he be willing to do that? Isn't he wishing for General Huan Yi to die?"

"According to his plan, he should have been smoothly banished from the camp. When the people in the camp discovered that those herbs were somewhat useful, they would believe from the bottom of their hearts that he was a good person, perhaps even feeling extremely regretful, and then who would ever suspect him? These herbs are useful, but only somewhat. If I hadn't come, even if Huan Yi had taken the herbs, he would have died just the same." Xu Fu toyed with the dirty-looking herbs in his hand, which still had soil on them.

Someone strode into the tent from outside, looking agitated, "Then according to the Commandant, the General can still be saved, right?"

Xu Fu looked at the man with some displeasure.

There were a few others outside the tent, carefully looking in, but they weren't as bold as this person to just barge in.

These few people were the only ones who had remained clear-headed at the time.

The person who walked into the tent was glanced at by Xu Fu and immediately realized his mistake, hurriedly apologizing to Xu Fu, "Please forgive me, Commandant. I was just anxious about the General’s condition. I happened to be walking outside the tent and heard the Commandant’s voice, so I... so I..." The man smiled awkwardly.

There were people guarding outside the tent who knew to stop people like Military Physician Liu, but they wouldn't stop other people in the camp, so they coincidentally let him in.

"That Military Physician Liu also used anxiety as an excuse." Xu Fu stated calmly.

The man became even more embarrassed and hurriedly retreated outside the tent, looking at Xu Fu carefully and whispering, "Commandant, I really know I was wrong. Can I come in now?" Not only him, but everyone behind him had an anxious, restless look.

"Come in." Xu Fu looked at them, and before they could get close, Xu Fu added, "But even if you come in, I have nothing to tell you."

They all widened their eyes in unison.

Were... were they played?

Xu Fu couldn't be bothered to pay attention to them. Having overused his mental energy these past few days, Xu Fu’s temper had inevitably become a bit foul. He handed a prescription to Sang Zhong and told him to go with the soldiers to prepare the medicine.

Those few people were immediately ignored. They lingered awkwardly for a while and then left immediately. However, their mood remained pleasant; they felt that Xu Fu definitely had a way.

He is Xu Fu, after all!

·

Days in the military camp passed quickly. During the day, Huan Yi still didn't look like he was improving, but in reality, his body was gradually getting better, and the speed of recovery far exceeded Xu Fu’s expectations. Was it his prescription that had miraculous effects? Xu Fu didn't think so. His gaze fell subtly on those few cauldrons. Wasn't this the reason he brought the cauldrons? They were the only ones that could refine the most successful pills. And only the medicine boiled in them possessed the miraculous effect of healing faster.

Xu Fu couldn't help but think of the first batch of medicine boiled during the last plague, which was also operated by him using a small cauldron.

Xu Fu temporarily put this matter to the back of his mind.

Military Physician Liu had stayed long enough; once Huan Yi regained consciousness, it would be time for him to die.

Just as he was thinking about it, Military Physician Liu came in. His face was somewhat haggard because he had been tortured quite a bit during this time. Xu Fu and the others treated him as if he didn't exist, only speaking to him when ordering him to take good care of Huan Yi. And serving Huan Yi was not a good job. Military Physician Liu felt the pain of serving a patient; he couldn't sleep well, couldn't eat well, and had to endure the cold atmosphere around him. How could Military Physician Liu have imagined that he would have such a moment? You know, according to the original plan, he should have left by now.

Military Physician Liu could endure these pressures, but what made him most anxious was Huan Yi.

It was clearly at this point, he should have died. But why was he still alive? Even if he was just lying on the bed half-dead, he still hadn't died! How could this be? As one thing after another went out of his control, the pressure in Military Physician Liu’s heart grew greater and greater. He didn't know what would happen once what he had done was discovered. He could only pray every day before coming to the tent.

Let him die.

Let him die quickly!

Military Physician Liu was silently reciting these words in his heart today as well, and walked into the tent as usual, but just as he had stepped in, he heard someone shout, "General!"

Military Physician Liu used all his strength to suppress the corners of his mouth from turning up.

Oh...

Huan Yi must be dead.

He walked into the tent with light steps, listening to the chaotic footsteps, which seemed to become the most wonderful music in the world. Military Physician Liu, who had become much more haggard during this time, had a layer of radiance unconsciously cover his face.

The military camp was soon in chaos. People came rushing over, shouting, the sound of footsteps rumbling, even making the ground shake.

Military Physician Liu felt that this sound was also extremely wonderful.

Just at this moment, Xu Fu looked in his direction.

Military Physician Liu received Xu Fu’s cold gaze, but he wasn't afraid at all today. Huan Yi was dead, and they had no evidence, so what could they do to him? No matter how capable this Commandant Xu was, he couldn't just kill him as he pleased. Military Physician Liu met Xu Fu’s gaze with a gentle expression.

Xu Fu couldn't help but want to laugh out loud.

How could Military Physician Liu be so naive?

His expression turned cold, and his icy voice was exceptionally clear in the tent, "Military Physician Liu, everyone is pale with bloodshot eyes, how come you are the only one looking so radiant?"

Lord Longyang added, "Could it be that Military Physician Liu has some joyous news?"

The smile in the depths of Military Physician Liu’s eyes froze.

Author's note: "Compendium of Materia Medica": Mercury, if spilled on the ground, can be collected with Sichuan peppercorn powder or tea powder. "Bencao Fengyuan": Mercury, if the yin poison is heavy, it must not enter the human abdomen. If one accidentally ingests mercury and feels a heavy, sinking sensation in the abdomen, use two catties of lard, cut into small pieces, roast until cooked, mix with raw honey and eat it to pass it out; this is also a method.
chapters.title: 第151章

chapters.translated_text:
"I am clearly looking haggard, so how on earth did you conclude that I am glowing with health?" Military Physician Liu roared in his heart.

Physician Liu had no choice but to try his best to put on a sorrowful expression. He even pinched himself, hesitating whether to shed a few hot tears to make it look more sincere.

"I am extremely worried about the General, how could I be glowing with health? Why must the Commandant insist on twisting my pain and claiming it is joy! Does the Commandant hold such deep prejudice against me?" Physician Liu delivered these words with a mix of pathos and indignation, his pauses perfectly timed. After finishing, he immediately made a move to step forward, "Now that the General is on the verge of death, what is the meaning of the Commandant ignoring the General's condition just to make things difficult for me? Please step aside, Commandant, I must check on the General!"

This should be fine now, right? Physician Liu thought to himself.

He had been acting in the military camp for so long without ever making a mistake; it was only this Commandant of the Guard who was always picking at him. Truly troublesome! Physician Liu glanced at Xu Fu, hiding the hatred in his eyes.

Just as Physician Liu was about to breathe a sigh of relief, he found himself stuck.

Because Xu Fu was looking at him coldly, his tone filled with surprise, "I am very curious, you suddenly look so sorrowful, what is the meaning of this? Who told you the General is dying?"

The information in this sentence was too heavy. Physician Liu was stunned for a moment, then quickly adjusted his expression to show joy, "The General is alright?" But in reality, his heart was burning with anxiety. If he wasn't dying, why were so many people running over here shouting? Could it be that Huan Yi had actually woken up?

Physician Liu refused to believe it. He knew the power of the strange water very well; if not for Physician Hu constantly interfering, Huan Yi should have been dead long ago.

"The General is naturally fine." As Xu Fu's voice fell, Huan Yi was helped up from the bed by others.

"Is that Physician Liu there? Let him come over." As if to confirm Xu Fu's words, Huan Yi's deep voice suddenly rang out in the tent.

The person he had seen with his own eyes on the brink of death had suddenly woken up, and his voice was so steady and powerful that Physician Liu couldn't stop trembling inside. This is hellish... He forcibly suppressed the rolling chill in his heart and put on a smile, "So the General is truly alright..."

"Please." A soldier walked up to him and invited him to approach Huan Yi.

Physician Liu recited self-soothing words in his heart several times before moving his feet toward the bedside.

The crowd parted, and Physician Liu saw Huan Yi sitting on the bed, his eyes clear and showing no signs of illness. Physician Liu's heart sank. It's impossible... it's impossible... His mind denied the current situation over and over again.

"I heard that Physician Liu broke military rules to find medicine for me?" Huan Yi asked in a deep voice.

Only when he saw Huan Yi speaking in front of him again did Physician Liu realize that he was truly not dead, and he was truly recovering.

"I..." Even though he had been able to put on a righteous act for the General in front of everyone before, now facing Huan Yi, Physician Liu couldn't say anything. He couldn't help but feel a bit guilty.

Without waiting for his answer, Huan Yi continued, "You have worked hard."

They were such short words, and there was nothing wrong with them, yet Physician Liu felt a sense of panic in his heart.

No, that's not right...

Physician Liu's mind suddenly cleared.

When Huan Yi looked at him while speaking, he was expressionless. How could this be? Did he know there was something wrong with him? Physician Liu shuddered.

"As long as the General can wake up, it is enough." Physician Liu managed to finish this sentence.

Only then did Xu Fu walk over slowly, "It is good that the General can wake up, but Physician Liu is not doing so well."

"How am I not doing well?"

Xu Fu was actually quite impressed that Physician Liu could maintain his composure even now.

Generally speaking, people who have done evil deeds are exceptionally guilty. Seeing Huan Yi awake and their plan failing, they would usually collapse, yet Physician Liu was still holding on.

Xu Fu shook his head secretly, but whether he was holding on or not, it was time to expose him.

Xu Fu glanced at Huan Yi, and Huan Yi spoke at the right moment: "There is nothing wrong. Physician Liu is fine; do not mind the Commandant's words." This sounded as if Huan Yi was protecting Physician Liu in front of Xu Fu.

Physician Liu naturally breathed a sigh of relief and even felt a bit of secret joy. This Commandant Xu had been making things difficult for him everywhere; now that the General was awake, he was being reprimanded, right?

"To thank you for your careful care of me these past few days, men, bring the prepared items to Physician Liu."

As Huan Yi's voice fell, two soldiers walked up holding two bronze tripods. Because of the distance and the soldiers shielding them with their hands, Physician Liu couldn't see exactly what they were for a moment.

The soldiers said loudly, "Please, Physician Liu, drink up!"

Huan Yi smiled, "This item was carefully sought out by me; it is extremely beneficial to the body after drinking."

Physician Liu secretly thought, it couldn't be that Huan Yi drank this stuff and that's why he woke up, right? What kind of magical thing could save Huan Yi's life when he was nearly dead? Physician Liu felt both anxious and curious.

The soldiers moved their hands away, revealing the true appearance of the small tripods.

In that instant, Physician Liu's face turned pale, and he couldn't control it.

...How could these, how could these appear here? Did Huan Yi find out? Physician Liu could no longer maintain his calm. Few people can calmly pretend nothing happened when the evidence of their wrongdoing is placed right in front of them.

Physician Liu could still remember how cunningly he had hidden these things at Physician Hu's place.

Physician Hu was too stupid; using him as a cover was a very good choice, so for such a long time, he hadn't been discovered. But where did it go wrong? Where did it go wrong that allowed Huan Yi to find out?

Seeing Physician Liu not moving, the soldiers said in unison again, "Please, Physician Liu, drink up!"

Drink up?

Can these things be drunk? If he drank it all in one go, he would die much faster than Huan Yi! The chill in Physician Liu's heart grew even more intense.

"Why doesn't Physician Liu drink? This item was indeed sought out by me with great difficulty... Physician Liu has been working very hard these past few days, so you should drink this." Huan Yi urged.

Physician Liu suppressed the panic in his heart. Perhaps... perhaps it just looks the same on the outside... maybe the inside is different... He tremblingly opened the lid, and a foul smell wafted out.

The last shred of hope in Physician Liu's heart was shattered.

That was the thing he had hidden with his own hands! He couldn't be mistaken! This smell, even more so, couldn't be wrong!

Physician Liu's legs were already weak, but soldiers were standing all around him. He was surrounded by Qin soldiers; he couldn't run even if he wanted to! Physician Liu squeezed out a smile, "This, can it be drunk?"

"Why wouldn't it be drinkable?" Huan Yi countered, his gaze toward Physician Liu becoming meaningful.

Physician Liu felt increasingly insecure. Now, every glance or movement from the people around him seemed to have hidden meaning. It was as if they had seen through everything and were deliberately toying with him.

"Yes, why wouldn't it be drinkable? You even fed it to the General!" A gloating voice rang out from outside the tent, and Physician Hu lifted the curtain and walked in.

Seeing him, Physician Liu's face changed instantly.

How did Physician Hu know?

Physician Hu sneered, "Did you think I didn't see what you did?" It was a twist of fate; at that time, Physician Hu thought Physician Liu was deliberately avoiding him to use a secret recipe to make medicine, and the things in the tripod were Physician Liu's secret recipe. Physician Hu had secretly noted it down, planning to steal it later to study it himself.

Neither of them had good intentions. By comparison, Physician Liu wanted to kill, while Physician Hu was much simpler; he only wanted fame and fortune.

When Physician Hu found out that the stuff was searched from under his own bed and was poisonous, he spilled everything without hesitation.

That led to this moment, with Physician Hu standing in front of Physician Liu, accusing him of his malicious intent.

Physician Hu was a very easily satisfied person. As long as he could show his face in front of Commandant Xu, he was happy to stand up and testify against Physician Liu.

Physician Liu usually mocked Physician Hu as a fool, never thinking that he who toys with others would one day be toyed with by others. Only at this moment did Physician Liu truly look at his opponent. Physician Liu's expression turned cold, and he shouted angrily, "What is the meaning of this? Are you splashing dirty water on me?"

"Do you even need me to splash it?" Physician Hu was not eloquent and couldn't win an argument against him, so he could only huff twice. But even if he couldn't win a verbal battle, he could still bully him with power. Physician Hu sneered, "If you dare to say you are innocent, then drink! Drink it!"

If he drank it, half his life would be gone. Only a fool would drink it! Physician Liu gritted his teeth and shouted angrily, "Are you determined to frame me?"

"Don't change the subject, just tell me if you'll drink it!" Physician Hu wouldn't be foolish enough to fall for his trap and continue the verbal sparring.

Xu Fu was also looking forward to seeing if Physician Liu would drink it.

If he drank it, he wouldn't have to settle scores with him, as it was uncertain if he could even survive drinking it. If he didn't drink, the evidence would be confirmed, and there would be plenty of punishments waiting for him. The punishments in the Qin army were never light.

"I..." Physician Liu's mind was in chaos; he couldn't even say half a sentence.

If I'm going to die, I'll die...

Physician Liu gritted his teeth and snatched the small tripod. He simulated in his mind how to quickly force it down Huan Yi's throat after taking it... No, that wouldn't work; Huan Yi was still some distance away. I've got it... Even if Huan Yi doesn't die, this person must die!

Physician Liu sneered in his heart and successfully snatched the tripod into his hands.

The soldier was knocked aside and glared at him, urging, "Drink quickly!" They all thought he had snatched the tripod to drink it.

Physician Liu smiled. At this moment, a sudden change occurred; he reached out, attempting to grab Xu Fu's arm.

His target was Xu Fu. He wanted to make Xu Fu drink this thing. Because Xu Fu looked the easiest to subdue, and he was a Commandant, a high-ranking position. Dragging him down with him would be worth it! If handled correctly, he might even be able to cause a rift between Huan Yi and the King of Qin. The death of the Commandant of the Guard in the military camp would be great news that could make the King of Qin die of anger...

Lord Longyang, who had been standing behind Xu Fu, had never spoken or made any moves. Similarly, Physician Liu had not taken him seriously.

Lord Longyang was the same kind of person as Xu Fu; they were handsome and often gave the first impression of being "vases," but Lord Longyang's martial arts were much stronger than Xu Fu's, not to mention he had the incredibly strong Jianjia standing beside him.

In a flash.

Jianjia reached out and quickly pulled Xu Fu away, while Lord Longyang drew his sword at the same time.

With a "pfft" sound, the blade pierced through clothes and skin. Physician Liu was run through, and a mouthful of blood sprayed out. Lord Longyang withdrew his sword and dodged to avoid being sprayed. Physician Liu fell weakly to the ground, and as the small tripod in his hand was about to fall, Xu Fu glanced at Sang Zhong. Sang Zhong understood, caught the tripod with lightning speed, and then handed it to the soldier beside him.

The soldiers who had previously trusted Physician Liu were now convinced he was a traitor. Their faces were ugly, and the anger of being deceived surged in their hearts. The eyes glaring at Physician Liu were full of murderous intent. No one likes to be fooled. These soldiers were already hot-tempered, and after realizing they had been used and deceived, they, who had previously protected Physician Liu everywhere, now couldn't wait to kill him immediately to vent their anger.

With so many pairs of eyes glaring at him with hatred, and the invisible murderous aura rushing toward him, Physician Liu's emotions fluctuated violently, and he couldn't help but spray another mouthful of blood.

He lay weakly on the ground, thinking he was going to die.

"It was only after you came that things started to change..." Physician Liu lay on the ground, enduring the severe pain, and said coldly and slowly, "If it weren't for you... if it weren't for you..."

Xu Fu really wanted to tell him that unfortunately, there were no "ifs." However, Xu Fu always maintained a cold and aloof posture, looking at Physician Liu indifferently, as if despising an ant, watching him talk to himself, and watching him finally tear off his disguise and speak his true thoughts after thinking he was going to die.

"I find it hard to accept, why hasn't he died yet?" Physician Liu muttered, "That was clearly a deadly poison..."

Hearing Physician Liu say this, the soldiers nearby became even more furious.

"We also find it hard to accept that we actually protected such a thing as you for so long!" A soldier couldn't help but curse.

Physician Liu smiled triumphantly instead, his voice hoarse, "It was just your own stupidity that you trusted me; how can you blame me?"

Even at this point, Physician Liu was still spouting twisted logic. It was no wonder that, as he said, before Xu Fu came, everything he did went smoothly, just because this Physician Liu knew how to talk, how to act, and how to disguise himself. No one could find a fault in him.

"You have ended up in this state only because you are truly stupid and your methods are inferior." Xu Fu blocked his words coldly.

Where does a defeated person get the courage to mock others?

Physician Liu's face turned pale, and he could not refute.

Is he stupid?

Physician Liu would never admit it!

Before, he had accused the people in the camp of being stupid, and his sense of superiority was very high at that time. Now that he was being accused of being stupid by others in the same tone, Physician Liu almost vomited another mouthful of blood from anger.

"Tie him up. Who among you knows how to interrogate?" Xu Fu turned to ask the soldiers.

"You won't get anything out of me." Physician Liu grinned, his face full of mockery, "I'm about to die."

"Who said that?" Xu Fu smiled along.

This was a rare smile from him, but it was cold and contemptuous. Before everyone could marvel at the charm of this smile, they couldn't help but shudder.

To Physician Liu, it was even more terrifying.

Xu Fu said the second half of his sentence slowly, "Only when I let you die can you die." Anyway, in the eyes of everyone, Xu Fu was already almost a living immortal, so he didn't mind disguising himself as even more mysterious.

Everyone first felt a jolt, and then looked at Xu Fu with great admiration.

"Who do you think you are? I am a military physician; I know that the sword strike that person just gave me..."

Lord Longyang also smiled slightly, "I also know very well that the sword strike I gave you was neither off-center nor biased, and the measure was just right. It won't take your life. Next, you can fully experience how cruel the punishments in the Qin army are."

Physician Liu's face changed. He never thought of himself as someone who could stubbornly endure torture, so when death was imminent, he generally wouldn't easily admit his guilt, because he knew that once he admitted it, he would definitely confess under pressure.

When he was stabbed, he was still thinking that it would be better to die... but he never expected that these people wouldn't let him die!

"Take him away." Xu Fu ordered.

The soldiers no longer hesitated. They stepped forward, grabbed Physician Liu, and dragged him out.

Physician Liu, who had been walking on thin ice and being tormented every day for this period, finally realized a problem: this Commandant Xu had suspected him long ago! Commandant Xu letting him stay by the General's side to serve was just to observe him in secret, or rather, to deliberately torture him. Realizing this, Physician Liu's face turned gray, as if he had suffered a huge blow.

Could it be that he was really stupider than that Commandant Xu?

Thinking of this, Physician Liu felt it was more uncomfortable than death. But soon he would know that being alive is more uncomfortable than death.

He had fooled these soldiers; how could the soldiers show him any mercy? They probably couldn't wait to use all eighteen kinds of torture on him.

After Physician Liu was taken away, Physician Hu immediately came up and asked, "Commandant Xu, how did I perform just now?"

"Not bad." Xu Fu replied coldly.

Seeing his cold expression and thinking of the imposing manner Xu Fu had just shown, Physician Hu couldn't help but shudder. Such a person... forget it, he couldn't afford to provoke him. Physician Hu retreated awkwardly.

Only then did Huan Yi, who had been holding on, collapse again.

He was much better, but after all, he couldn't recover that quickly, so he could only hold on for a while. Just now, he just didn't want to show weakness in front of that traitor.

"Thank you, Commandant Xu." Huan Yi leaned on the bed and thanked him sincerely. After finishing, he couldn't help but pull the corners of his mouth and smile, "I didn't expect that after begging the King so many times, it was only after I fell ill that I finally got Commandant Xu to come."

"What did you want me to come to the army for before?" Xu Fu asked the question in his heart. Huan Yi hadn't had such thoughts before, so why did he suddenly have them?

"The results of the Commandant's divination are always very accurate. The Commandant probably doesn't remember, but you once said that although I would have hardships on the battlefield, I would eventually get what I wanted. It was because of these words from the Commandant that I was able to persist. No matter what kind of predicament I encountered, I would think of the Commandant's words. In order to achieve the final victory, I persisted in every step, which is why I have today's victory. It is precisely because of this that the people of Zhao could not sit still and sent people to try to harm me." Huan Yi smiled, "...Commandant Xu's divination skills are too powerful, so I couldn't help but have the idea of hoping the Commandant would come to the army to perform divination again, so that I could have peace of mind."

Xu Fu was puzzled.

What he said about experiencing hardships but eventually winning could actually be a cliché.

How many fortune tellers setting up stalls under overpasses in his past life would say that? They tell everyone, "You have a disaster, but don't worry, you will eventually get what you want." This is a cliché! But Huan Yi actually believed it! Not only did he believe it, but he also treated it as a guiding motto, believing in it while working hard without admitting defeat.

This feeling of being worshipped and respected for no reason...

It was actually quite nice.

Xu Fu felt very complicated in his heart.

"You don't have to take it so seriously. Being able to take several cities in a row and expand the territory for the Qin State is inherently due to General Huan Yi's own ability, not my credit. Divination is, after all, only an aid. If one is obsessed with it every day, wouldn't one lose one's original intention? General Huan Yi being able to reach this point is already enough to be admired. Even without my prophecy, the cities of Zhao would still be conquered by General Huan Yi. The General should have confidence in himself." Xu Fu poured him a bowl of "chicken soup."

Huan Yi, who had just been saved by Xu Fu, could finally live, and was in a great mood, felt very moved.

"The Commandant is truly admirable! No one can deny the Commandant's talent. But the Commandant refuses to take even half the credit and instead praises me everywhere. I am ashamed. The Commandant's indifference to fame and fortune is worthy of my respect!" Huan Yi said excitedly.

It was actually just the same principle.

Xu Fu was a little good to him, then a little better...

With so many little bits of kindness piled up, Huan Yi had already deified Xu Fu's image in his heart. Now that he thought about it, he felt even more that Xu Fu was the greatest good person in the world.

Xu Fu was a bit dumbfounded.

Huh? Did I say anything? How did you connect my words just now to me being indifferent to fame and fortune and refusing to take half the credit?
chapters.source_text:
我明明一脸憔悴，你究竟怎么看出来，我容光焕发的？刘军医在心里咆哮。
刘军医只得竭力做出悲伤的表情，他甚至还掐了自己一把，犹豫着要不要再添点儿热泪，看上去或许更为真挚。
“我极为忧心将军，怎会容光焕发？都尉为何偏要捏着我的痛苦，强说这是在欢喜！难道都尉对我有着这样深的偏见吗？”一番话被刘军医说得既悲怆，又气愤，语调停顿真是恰当好处。待说完后，他还随即拔腿要往前凑，“如今将军都要死了，都尉不顾着将军，非要为难我是何意？请都尉让开，我要瞧一瞧将军！”
这下总该没问题了吧？刘军医心想。
他在军营里演了这么久的戏，从来没出过差错，也就只有这个护军都尉，总是要在他的身上挑刺。实在麻烦！刘军医看了一眼徐福，隐下眼中的憎恶之色。
刘军医刚要松口气，谁知道紧接着便生生卡住了。
因为徐福冷冷地看着他，口吻诧异，“我可好奇得很呢，你突然面带悲怆，这是何意？谁告诉你，将军要死了？”
这句话里信息量太大，刘军医懵了懵，他迅速调整好表情，露出欣喜的表情，“将军无事了？”但实际上，他的心底已经万分焦灼了。若不是快死了，这么多人大呼小叫地跑过来做什么？难不成还是桓齮醒过来了吗？
刘军医不肯相信。他很清楚怪水的威力，若非有胡军医处处捣乱，桓齮早就该死了。
“将军自然无事了。”徐福的话音落下，桓齮由人扶着从床榻上坐了起来。
“可是刘军医在那里？让他过来。”似乎为了印证徐福的话，桓齮低沉的声音陡然在帐子里响起。
原本他亲眼看着快要死了的人，突然间清醒了，声音还这样的沉稳有力，刘军医内心止不住地颤抖。真是见鬼了……他强制压下心中滚滚的寒意，面上露出笑容，“原来将军真的无事了啊……”
“请。”有士兵走到了他的面前，请他到桓齮的跟前去。
刘军医在心底默念了好几遍自我安抚的话，随后才挪动步子走到了床榻边上去。
人群向两边分开，然后刘军医看见了坐在床榻上，目光清亮，半点病态都不显的桓齮。刘军医心中一沉，不可能啊……不可能啊……他的脑子里一遍遍否定着现在的状况。
“我听闻刘军医为了替我寻药，还触犯了军中的规矩？”桓齮沉声问道。
直到再度看着桓齮在自己面前开口说话，刘军医才知道，他是真的没死，他真的在恢复了。
“我……”明明之前还可以在众人面前，演出一副大义凛然为将军的模样，但此刻面对着桓齮，刘军医却又什么都说不出来了，他控制不住地有些心虚。
桓齮不等他回答，又继续道：“真是辛苦你了。”
明明是分外简短的几个字，也并无什么不对劲的地方，但刘军医就是觉得心里有些慌。
不，不对……
刘军医脑中陡然清明起来。
桓齮看着他说话的时候，是面无表情的。怎么会这样？难道他知道自己有问题？刘军医打了个寒颤。
“只要将军能醒来就好。”刘军医勉强说完了这句话。
徐福这才慢悠悠地走了过去，“将军能醒来固然好，不过刘军医可就不大好了。”
“我哪里不好？”
刘军医到了这时都还能维持住镇定，徐福还挺佩服他的。
一般来说，做了坏事的人可都是格外心虚的，在见到桓齮清醒，自己计划失败之后，会忍不住崩溃的，可刘军医还在强撑。
徐福暗自摇头，可不管他强撑不强撑，现在都到了该戳穿他的时候了。
徐福看了一眼桓齮，桓齮适时地出声道：“没什么不好的，刘军医很好，不必在意都尉之言。”这话听上去，是表明了桓齮要在徐福面前护着刘军医。
刘军医自然松了口气，心中还有些暗喜，这徐都尉处处为难他，现在将军醒来，被斥责了吧？
“为了谢谢你近日来悉心照顾我，来人，将准备好的东西送给刘军医。”
桓齮的话音落下，随后有两名士兵捧着两只青铜鼎上前来了，因为距离远，士兵又用手护着，一时间刘军医没能看清楚，那究竟是什么玩意儿。
士兵们高声道：“请刘军医饮下！”
桓齮笑道：“此物乃是我精心寻来，饮下后对身体极有好处。”
刘军医暗暗心想，总不会是桓齮喝了这东西，才清醒过来了吧？得是怎么样神奇的东西，才能将桓齮快死的那条命给救回来了？刘军医心中忐忑又好奇。
士兵放开了遮挡住的手，露出了手中小鼎的真面目。
那瞬间，刘军医的脸色再也控制不住地白了。
……这些，怎么会，怎么会出现在这里？桓齮发现了？刘军医再难维持冷静。少有人在自己作恶的证据摆在跟前的时候，还能继续冷静地装作什么事也未发生。
刘军医还能想起，这些东西自己是如何狡猾地藏在胡军医那里的。
胡军医太蠢了，用他来打个掩护，是个非常好的选择，所以这么久的时间过去了，他一直都没能被发现，但是，是哪里出了问题你呃？是哪里出了问题，才会让桓齮发现呢？
士兵们见刘军医动也不动，齐声又道：“请刘军医饮下！”
饮下？
这些东西能饮下吗？若是一口气饮下，他比桓齮可要死得快多了！刘军医心中的寒意越发地浓烈了。
“刘军医为何不饮下？此物确为我千辛万苦寻来的……刘军医这几日万分操劳，就该饮下此物才是。”桓齮出声催促道。
刘军医压下心中的慌张，或许……或许只是外表看上去一样吧……里面或许是不一样的吧……他颤抖着揭开了盖子，一股难闻的气味飘了出来。
刘军医心中最后的侥幸被打碎了。
那就是他亲手藏起来的东西！他不会认错！这股味道，更不可能错！
刘军医已经有些腿软了，但是四周还站着士兵，他就置身在秦兵之中，他就算是跑也跑不掉啊！刘军医挤出一个笑容，“这个，能喝吗？”
“怎么会不能喝呢？”桓齮反问道，他看着刘军医的目光变得意味深长起来。
刘军医心中越发没底了，如今身边人随意的一个眼神，一个动作，在他看来，都是别有意味的。他们像是已经洞悉了一切，他们像是在故意耍他。
“是啊，怎么会不能喝呢？你可是把它给将军都喝过！”一道幸灾乐祸的声音在帐子外响起，紧接着胡军医撩起帷帐走了进来。
刘军医见着他，脸色顿时变了。
胡军医怎么会知道？
胡军医冷笑道：“你以为你做的事，我没看见吗？”说来也是阴差阳错，那个时候胡军医以为刘军医故意背着自己，用特殊的秘方来制药，而那小鼎里放着的东西，就是刘军医的秘方，胡军医暗暗记在心中，打算等过段日子，就将东西偷过来自己好好研究一下。
两个人谁都没怀好心，相比一下，不过是刘军医想要杀人，而胡军医则单纯多了，他只是想要名利。
等到胡军医知道，那玩意儿从自己的床榻下搜出来，并且是有毒之物后，他便毫不客气地全抖落出来了。
也就有了这一刻，胡军医站在刘军医的面前，指责他的祸心。
胡军医实在是个太好满足的人，只要能在徐福这个都尉跟前露个脸，他就乐得站出来指证刘军医。
刘军医平日里将胡军医当做个傻子嘲弄，却不成想自己玩弄他人，总有一日也会被他人玩弄。直到这一刻，刘军医才正视起对方。刘军医面色一冷，怒道：“你这是何意？往我身上泼脏水吗？”
“你还用泼吗？”胡军医口拙，根本说不过他，也就只能哼哼两声便作罢。不过嘴仗不会打，仗势欺人一下他还是会的。胡军医冷笑道：“你要是敢说你自己是清白的，那你就喝！喝下去！”
喝下去，他就半条命都没了，傻子才喝！刘军医咬紧了牙关，怒道：“你是铁了心要诬陷我吗？”
“你别往别处扯，你就说你喝吗！”胡军医才不会傻的上当，和他继续打嘴仗。
徐福也很期待，刘军医到底会不会喝。
若是他喝了，自己可以不跟他算账，毕竟喝下去，他能不能保住命都不好说。如果不喝，证据便会坐实，到时候多的是刑罚等着他。秦军中的刑罚，可从来都不轻。
“我……”刘军医心乱如麻，已经半句话都说不出来了。
死就死吧……
刘军医咬咬牙，劈手去夺那小鼎，他在脑中模拟着，度过小鼎后，如何才能快速给桓齮再灌下去……不，不行，桓齮离他还有些距离。有了……哪怕桓齮不死，这个人也要死！
刘军医心头冷笑，顺利将小鼎夺到手中。
士兵被他撞得一偏，对着他怒目而视，同时还催促道：“快喝！”他们都以为他夺过小鼎，是要喝下去了。
刘军医笑了笑，就在此时，异变陡生，他伸手企图去抓徐福的胳膊。
他瞄准的对象正是徐福，他要让徐福把这个东西喝下去。因为只有徐福看上去最好制服了，刚刚好，他又是都尉，这个职位可不低，拖着他下水，那也值了！若是操作得当，说不准还能让桓齮与秦王起嫌隙。派来的护军都尉死在军营里，这可真是个能让秦王气死的好消息啊……
一直站在徐福身后的龙阳君从未开口说话，也没有过什么动作。同样的，刘军医也并未将他看在眼中。
龙阳君和徐福是一样的人，他们容貌俊美，常给人先入为主的花瓶印象，而龙阳君的武力可比徐福强悍多了，何况他身旁还站着一个力大无比的蒹葭？
电光石火间。
蒹葭伸手快速拉过徐福，龙阳君同时抽出剑来。
“噗嗤”一声，剑刃刺穿衣帛和皮肤，刘军医被捅了个对穿，一口鲜血喷出，龙阳君抽剑闪身，避免被喷个正着。刘军医无力地摔倒在了地上，眼看着手中的小鼎就要落地，徐福看了一眼桑中，桑中会意，动作极快地接住了小鼎，然后顺手还给了一旁的士兵。
从前十分信任刘军医的士兵们，此时都已经确认刘军医是内贼了，他们面色难看，被欺骗的气愤涌上了心头，瞪着刘军医的眼中充满了杀气。没有人是喜欢被愚弄的。这些士兵们本来就性子急躁，在发觉自己被利用欺骗过后，他们从前是处处护着刘军医，如今便是恨不得即可杀了刘军医，才能泄愤。
这么多双眼睛同时愤恨地看着自己，无形中杀气扑面而来，刘军医情绪剧烈波动，不由得再度喷出了一口血。
他无力地趴在地面上，以为自己要死了。
“就是从你来了后，事情才开始变的……”刘军医趴在地上，忍着剧痛，冷声缓缓道，“若不是你……若不是你……”
徐福是很想对他说一句，可惜没如果的。不过始终徐福都只是保持着高冷的姿态，如同蔑视一只蝼蚁一般，漠然地瞧着刘军医，看着他自说自话，看着他以为自己要死了后，终于撕去伪装的面孔，说出了真心话。
“我难以服气，他为何还没有死？”刘军医喃喃道，“明明那是剧毒之物啊……”
听着刘军医如此说，一旁的士兵顿时更加气愤了。
“我们也觉得难以服气，竟是护了你这么个东西，白护了那么久！”有士兵忍不住骂出声。
刘军医反倒得意一笑，哑声道：“本就是你们愚蠢，信任了我，何来怪我之说？”
刘军医都到这时了，还会扯歪理，也怪不得如他所说，在徐福没来之前，他一切都达成得很顺利了，只因为这刘军医会说话，会做人，会伪装。谁也揪不出个错处来。
“你会落得如此地步，也不过是因为你实在蠢，又手段低劣罢了。”徐福不冷不热地将他的话给堵了回去。
败了的人，哪来的勇气去嘲笑别人？
刘军医面色一白，无可辩驳。
是他蠢吗？
刘军医哪肯承认！
之前他指责军营众人蠢笨，那时他的优越感是极高的，现在却反被人用同样的口气来指责为蠢，刘军医差点没被气得又吐出一口血来。
“将人绑起来，你们谁会审问？”徐福转头问士兵。
“你们从我口中是什么也问不到了。”刘军医咧嘴一笑，面带嘲讽之色，“我就快死了。”
“谁说的？”徐福跟着笑了笑。
这是他难得露出的笑容，但这抹笑容是冰冷的，轻蔑的，众人还没来及感叹这抹笑容的迷人，便不自觉地打了个冷颤。
看在刘军医的眼中，更令他觉得恐怖。
徐福慢吞吞地说出后半句话来，“我让你死，你才能死。”反正徐福在众人的眼中已经差不多是个活神仙了，那他也不介意将自己伪装得更神秘一些。
众人先是一个激灵，紧接着便十分崇拜地看着徐福。
“你以为你是谁？我是军医，我清楚刚才那个人捅我的一剑……”
龙阳君也微微笑了，“我也很清楚，我捅的那一剑，不偏不倚，分寸正好。不会让你丢命。接下来你还可以充分感受一下秦军中的刑罚，有多么残酷。”
刘军医的脸色变了，他从不觉得自己是个能顽强扛着刑罚的人，所以死到临头，他一般都不会轻易承认自己的罪责，因为一旦承认了，他知道，自己面对逼问，是肯定会交代出来的。
被捅中的时候，他都还在想死了也好……可他怎么也没想到，这些人竟然不让他死！
“带走吧。”徐福下令。
士兵们不再犹豫，他们大步走上前，将刘军医拎在手中提了出去。
这段时间提心吊胆，日日被磋磨的刘军医，终于发觉到了一个问题，这个徐都尉，早就怀疑自己了！徐都尉让他守在将军身边伺候，就是在暗地里观察他，或者说故意折磨他。意识到这一点之后，刘军医面色灰白，仿佛受了巨大的打击。
难道他真的比那徐都尉要蠢吗？
一想到这一点，刘军医便觉得比死还难受。不过接下来他就会知道，比死还难受的是活着。
他愚弄了这些士兵，士兵们哪里还会对他手下留情呢？恐怕只恨不得十八般手段都统统用到他的身上来。
刘军医被带下去之后，胡军医马上凑了上来，问道：“徐都尉，我刚才表现得如何？”
“不错。”徐福冷淡地回了一句。
胡军医见他面色冷漠，再一想到方才徐福气势逼人的模样，胡军医心中也忍不住打了个寒颤，这样的人，算了，他招惹不起，胡军医讷讷地退了出去。
直到这时，一直绷着的桓齮才重新倒了下去。
他是好了不少，但毕竟好得没那么快，所以也只能支撑一会儿罢了，刚才他不过是不想在那内贼的面前，露了弱。
“多谢徐都尉。”桓齮靠在床榻上，真挚地感谢道，说完，他忍不住扯了扯嘴角，笑道：“没想到，求了王上那么多次，最后却是在我病倒之后，还真的将徐都尉求来了。”
“你之前想要我到军中来做什么？”徐福问出了心中的疑惑。之前桓齮都没过这样的心思，怎么突然间就动心思了呢？
“都尉卜筮出的结果都很准，都尉恐是不记得了吧，您说过我在战场上虽有磨砺，但最后必然会得到想要的，就是因着都尉这句话，我才能坚持下来，无论遭遇何样的困境，我都会想到都尉的话。为了得到最后的胜利，我每一步都坚持下来了，所以才有了今日的胜利，也正是如此，才会让赵国的人按捺不住，派出人想要谋害我。”桓齮笑了笑，“……徐都尉卜筮之术太厉害，难免我动了心思，希望都尉来到军中，再行卜筮，好让我心中安心。”
徐福也就纳闷了。
他说的，什么经历磨难，但最后终会得到胜利，这其实都可以成为套路了。
上辈子多少天桥下摆摊的算命先生都会说啊。他们见人都是说，你有灾祸，不过不要担心，最后你还是会得到自己想要的。这就是个套路啊！但是桓齮还真信了！不仅信了，还将其当做了指示的格言，一边坚信着，一边不服输地努力着。
这种莫名其妙也能被人膜拜尊崇的滋味……
其实还是很不错的。
徐福心中倍感情绪复杂。
“你不必如此在意，能连拿下几城，为秦国开辟疆土，本就是桓齮将军自身的本身厉害，并非我的功劳。卜筮一道，终究只是辅助。若是日日执着于此，岂不是反倒失了本心？桓齮将军能做到这一步，已经足够令人敬服。哪怕没有我的箴言，赵国城池也会被桓齮将军所收服。将军应当对自己有信心才是。”徐福给他灌了一碗鸡汤下去。
刚刚被徐福救了，此时终于可以活命，并且因此心情大好的桓齮，心中十分感动。
“都尉才是真令人敬服！都尉之才，无人可否认。但都尉却不肯担半分功劳，反而处处夸奖我。桓齮羞愧。都尉淡泊名利之心，值得桓齮崇敬！”桓齮激动地道。
其实也就是一个道理。
徐福对他好了一点，之后再对他好了一点……
这么多一点一点的好堆积在一起，桓齮心中本就有些神化徐福的形象，如今想来，便更觉得徐福是个天底下最大的好人。
徐福却有些目瞪口呆。
嗯？我说什么了吗？你是怎么样从我刚才那番话中，联想到我淡泊名利，不肯担半分功劳的？
chapters.title: 第152章
第153章
chapters.source_text:
“是啊是啊，都尉实在令我等敬佩不已！”副将甲如此说道。
“是啊是啊，都尉不愧被称为神仙人物！”副将乙如此说道。
“是啊是啊，都尉真是个好人！”憋了半天发现形容词都被用光了的小兵如此说道。
“不错，若无都尉，这次桓齮便丢了性命了，更别说抓住此贼人了。”桓齮轻叹一口气，再度抒发了一遍心中的感激之情。
刘军医并不蠢，桓齮也不蠢，只是他们谁也没对水银产生提防之心，他们日日跟军医打交道，军医救过他们多少人的性命，他们也更是先入为主，不会去怀疑刘军医有问题。而徐福却不同，刘军医没救过他，他又知晓水银的厉害之处，他并未身在局中，因而看得也就更清楚罢了。
而且徐福身边还有龙阳君这个聪明人呢，刘军医再如何能装，也难以同时骗过徐福和龙阳君。
桓齮和将士们的一腔谢意全部都冲着徐福去，徐福心中还不大好意思。
不过紧接着桓齮就转头感谢了龙阳君和蒹葭，他不知龙阳君的身份，只夸道：“壮士好剑法。”
尽管知道“壮士”只是用以夸奖武艺高的人，徐福还是憋不住脸色有一瞬间的扭曲。
壮士哈哈哈哈哈哈??
龙阳君是个壮士哈哈哈哈哈??
龙阳君面色淡然地朝桓齮点了点头，算是承了他的谢意。
“这段时日辛苦徐都尉了，我听闻我吃的药也是徐都尉制出来的？”
“嗯不错。”制药这点功劳，徐福倒是毫不客气地认了。因为就连他自己都觉自己有点儿厉害，光是靠着从姜游那里学来的东西，再自己翻一翻古籍，还真被他误打误撞弄出了救治桓齮的药。竟是半点没用上姜游。
若没有他这一手，等姜游来的时候，说不准桓齮真的连尸体都凉了。
想到这里，徐福心中忍不住一笑。哦对，还得感谢那刘军医，正是他寻来的草药给自己提供了灵感。刘军医本以为桓齮的死亡是板上钉钉的事了，他为了洗清自己的嫌疑亲手送上了能救命的东西。若没有徐福横插一杠子，他目的的确已经达到了。
缘分命运，当真奇妙。
“徐都尉救命之恩，桓齮无以为报，日后都尉若是有言，桓齮定为都尉去做，不会有半分犹豫。”
这话说得分外诚挚。
但徐福觉得稍微有那么些暧昧。
毕竟放在上辈子，很少有人会随随便便说这样的话，只是放在这个时代背景之下，有人因为情义深重，为了谢恩或是其它缘故，说出这样的话来，实在是太常见不过。
徐福点了点头，却没接着这个话说下去。
依他看来，如今他也没什么需要桓齮去做的，毕竟他想要什么，嬴政便会备好送到他手边来了。除非有一日，他跟嬴政情感破裂??
回过神来，徐福发觉自己着实想得有些远。他出声道：“桓齮将军才刚刚清醒过来，需要多加休息，我这便带人先过去瞧一瞧那刘军医。”
“好，请。”听徐福如此说，桓齮心中更觉得一阵暖意。徐都尉实在是太会关心人了啊??虽然徐都尉瞧上去难以近人，但心底其实是善良的啊！
桓齮如此误解着，然后抱着被子，闭眼休息去了。
这头徐福带着众人出了帐子，有士兵领着他往关押刘军医的地方而去。
帐子里有些阴沉沉的，因为不透光的缘故，徐福一踏进去便嗅到了一股血腥气，再一看周遭环境，便顿觉阴森可怖之感扑面而来。正巧此时他听见了刘军医痛哭的声音，痛哭之中还时不时夹杂两声痛苦的嚎叫，实在令人一身鸡皮疙瘩。
等走近之后，徐福只隐约能瞧见刘军医的人形还是完整的，只不过他身下已经一大滩的血了。
见徐福进来了，有个士兵忙道：“人已经招了，还当是个硬骨头呢??”士兵语气不屑。
被绑起来的刘军医颇受刺激，只剧烈地挣扎了两下，但随即因为太痛又焉下去了。
士兵见状，嗤笑得更加厉害。
刘军医心中不忿，却又不得不忍耐。
等到士兵按照徐福的吩咐，对他说，全靠他送来的草药，才救了桓齮的时候，刘军医如遭重击，面无血色地靠在柱子上，半天都说不出话来，喉咙里只能发出咯咯的声音，那是他因为气愤想要出声，但是气急之后又说不出话来，只有血块和气流撞击喉咙的声音。
气急攻心。
刘军医剧烈地哆嗦了一会儿，竟是直接昏死了过去。
士兵转头问：“都尉可还有话要问他？若是要问，命人将他泼醒便是。”
徐福又不擅长审讯之事，要问的话想来士兵也已经都问清楚了，如今已经过去小半个月了，他也不用再将心思放在桓齮中毒之事上了，现在他更应该去操心李信失踪的事才是。
“走吧。”刘军医都被自己刺激晕了，他也该出去了，这帐子里的气味实在不好闻。
徐福发话，众人忙将他送了出去。
回到帐子里后，徐福便命人去将李信的手下请了过来。
李信的手下听闻徐福要询问那日发生的事，个个都激动不已，忙抢着要过来。
他们都听闻过徐都尉的本事，此次将军中毒也是这位徐都尉解决的，那说不定李将军的事，他也能解决！满怀期待的心情，李信的手下挤到了徐福的帐子里来。
看着面前个子都很高，身材都很壮的男人，个个都用灼热又期待的目光望着自己。
徐福顿觉有些头疼。
挡光线也就罢了，这么多人，还挡空气啊。
“出去，只进来两人便可。”
他们相视一眼，只得陆续退出去，最后只余了两人。
留两人，徐福是觉得，他们方便互相补充，有时候也可以避免有一人说谎，虽然这种可能性不大。
秦军军营又不是小猫小狗都能来的，一个刘军医会是内贼已经出乎大家意料了，若是还藏了个内贼，那就不大可能了。
“那一日发生了何时，细细说来给我听听。”
那两人也不犹豫，立即便说了起来，“那日李将军带我们前去查探敌情，走到一处林子，李将军说林子中不大对劲，担忧有埋伏，李将军身手极好，便当先往前去了，就在他往前走了没几步的时候，有一道绿光闪过。我们只觉得眼睛刺痛不已，便匆忙后退了。等往后退着退着，大家就发现，李将军的身影没了。”
“那时可是白日？”
“是，正因为是白日，所以才觉得诡异，大白天的，一个人怎么会突然消失呢？”另一士兵纳闷地接口道。
徐福却知道要做到这些并不难，若是让上辈子的魔术师来看，他们都觉得这样的把戏实在太入门级。
“那时你们可闻到什么气味？”徐福本来也不过是为了让了解的细节更全面一些，因而才有此问。
但那两人却是骤然想起了什么，对视一眼后，齐声道：“有的，说起来，那味道，与那两个小鼎中的味道，很是相似。”
也是水银？
看来是一拨人了？
也对，桓齮有摆兵布阵的大才，而李信则是悍勇无比，这二人若是死了，那岂不是赵国的压力便就此骤减？
那两人滔滔不绝了起来，“往日我们都还未曾想到这一茬呢，今日若非徐都尉问起，我们也不会想到呢，那日的气味的确是有些古怪的??那时我们还当是见鬼了呢，但现在想起来，应该也是人为吧??”
“当然是人为。”徐福肯定地道：“李信身上经验丰富，他怀疑林中有埋伏，那林中应当就是藏着人，那些人不知在做什么，害怕被李信撞见。或者说他们本就是在那里等着你们前去，所以正好将人抓个正着带走。”
“李将军，岂不是性命危矣??”那两名士兵大惊失色，眼眶都红了。
士兵之间往往情谊深厚，骤然知晓李信恐有生命危险，他们自然难以接受。
“还没见到人，我们也不可就此轻易断定。近日来，为了桓齮将军之事，我也未能休息好，今日大家都休息一日，明日你们带我前去，到李信失踪的地方去，我先瞧一瞧再做打算。”
士兵们激动地点了点头。仿佛只要徐福去瞧上一眼，便能火眼金睛看出不对劲的地方，随即再发现李信身在何处。
徐福对于军营众人对自己的崇拜，已经见怪不怪了。如今桓齮好转，刘军医又被揪了出来，军营中的人对他的崇拜只会愈来愈深，说不定以后都会变成盲目崇拜了。
徐福淡定地一挥手，示意他们可以离开了，然后才取出了绢布和笔来。
桑中好奇地问道：“这是要做什么？”
“桑中，赐我一字吧。”
蒹葭反应过来，徐福这是又要用新奇的方式来进行卜筮了，当即便拉着龙阳君凑了上去。就连沉稳的柏舟也忍不住上前目光灼灼地盯着徐福。
桑中一急，生怕他们抢了自己的活儿，脱口而出道：“先生。”
徐福抬头看着他，淡淡提醒道：“这是两个字了。”
桑中被众人盯着，顿时面颊爆红。
