This maid was truly unrestrained in her speech. It had been a long time since anyone dared to speak to Xu Fu like that. Xu Fu frowned in displeasure, then let go of the carriage curtain, clearly showing he did not want to see the faces of those two.

"Horses cannot turn, but people can," Xu Fu said coldly, then signaled the driver to continue forward.

Seeing this, the maid was so angry she wanted to rush forward. Zhao Yan's expression changed drastically, and she quickly reached out to pull her back. "What are you doing? Have you lost all sense of propriety? Since the Commandant Xu has asked us to move, we shall move."

Her words seemed to be scolding the maid, but in reality, she wanted to imply that Xu Fu didn't know the rules—a mere Commandant making a Princess of a state yield the road to his horses, wasn't that a complete lack of manners? She called him "Commandant Xu" only to suggest that Xu Fu was self-righteous and bullied others by relying on his power.

This statement was quite artistic, but for Xu Fu, playing these word games was useless; he didn't take it to heart at all. Xu Fu closed his eyes, listening to the sound of the horse's hooves, and only then did the stifled feeling in his chest begin to ease.

...

The maid said indignantly, "Princess, he..."

"Shut up. This is the State of Qin; be smarter. When have you ever seen someone who dares to ride a carriage freely in the palace? This Xu Fu holds a very high position before the King of Qin; he is not someone you can offend!" Zhao Yan turned back and glared at the maid.

The maid stammered, "B-but... he embarrassed the Princess like this... in the future, the Princess's dignity..."

Zhao Yan was a smart person. She smiled helplessly and said, "In the Qin palace, where would a Princess of Zhao find dignity?"

The maid lowered her head, unconvinced, unwilling to admit this fact.

Once the Princess married the King of Qin and became the Queen, that so-called Commandant—a man who served the King with his looks—would eventually be cast aside. How could a man be better than a woman? No matter how glorious he was, could he become the Queen? Thinking of this, the maid felt incredibly refreshed and, smiling, helped Zhao Yan continue walking forward.

They soon arrived outside the main hall, where the guards blocked them coldly and ruthlessly.

The maid's anger, which had just subsided, almost flared up again.

Zhao Yan frowned. Why did she bring such a stupid maid? Forget it... Zhao Yan withdrew her gaze, looked at the guard, and said softly, "Zhao Yan requests an audience with the King of Qin."

The guard shook his head and said, "Princess of Zhao, without a summons, you cannot come here. Please leave quickly."

Zhao Yan looked at the guard with pleading eyes and whispered, "I have been in Qin for several days and have yet to see the King of Qin. Why is the King unwilling to see me? Please, tell me."

While Zhao Yan was still trying every possible way to enter the hall, Xu Fu had already arrived at the King of Qin's sleeping quarters.

The attendants and palace servants outside the sleeping quarters were overjoyed when they saw Xu Fu and knelt down. The servants, who were usually very composed, found it hard to remain so upon seeing Xu Fu.

"We have finally waited for your return, sir!" The servants hurried up with smiles on their faces.

Because Xu Fu had resigned from the position of Fengchang, the servants went back to calling him "Sir."

"Where is the King?" Xu Fu looked around the sleeping quarters. Although he could roughly guess that Ying Zheng was busy with state affairs, Xu Fu, feeling a bit unhappy, chose to ask anyway.

"He is in the Hall of State Affairs."

"Where are Huhai and Fusu?" Xu Fu suppressed the slight unhappiness in his heart. To distract himself, he decided it would be better to go see his "cheap" sons first.

The servant smiled and said, "Prince Fusu should still be reading, and Prince Huhai should be resting."

The servant spoke tactfully, but Xu Fu knew that with Huhai's personality, he was likely playing. Xu Fu took a bath, changed into fresh robes, and then went to the side hall to find Huhai. As he entered the hall, he signaled the servants not to speak, then strode inside.

The servants quickly shut their mouths, not daring to make a sound.

Xu Fu walked in quietly and saw Huhai lying on the floor, ignoring all etiquette, his shoulders heaving as he did something. When Xu Fu got closer, he realized Huhai was holding a charcoal pencil and writing on silk. It started with: Father, Father King bullied me again today...

The tail of the character "me" was dragged out so long that it was sloppily miserable to look at.

Xu Fu's heart softened, and he found it quite funny, so he reached out and scooped Huhai up. Huhai screamed in fright, but perhaps feeling the embrace behind him—which was completely different from Ying Zheng's hard, rigid embrace—Huhai's face lit up with joy, and he immediately threw himself into Xu Fu's arms.

"Father!" The soft little dumpling filled Xu Fu's arms completely.

They say children have poor memories and rarely remember things from when they were young, and they are fickle, forgetting you if they don't see you for a while. This was why Xu Fu found it hard to like children much. However, he found that neither Huhai nor Fusu were like that.

Xu Fu thought to himself, it must be because they follow me, so they learned my good memory and long-lasting affection.

He raised his hand to rub Huhai's cheeks, his cold expression finally fading to reveal a faint smile. Huhai raised his chubby little hands, cupped Xu Fu's face, leaned forward, and smeared Xu Fu's face with saliva. Even though he wasn't a baby anymore, Huhai still couldn't break the habit of expressing his likes and dislikes this way. Xu Fu, helpless, could only rub him again.

Huhai let go at the right moment and rubbed against Xu Fu's chest. "Where is Father going? I want to go, I want to go, don't take Brother."

Xu Fu had been hesitating about whether to go see Ying Zheng, but hearing Huhai say this, he immediately made up his mind.

He would take Huhai to see Ying Zheng first, and later, he would have the servants bring Fusu over so they could all eat together. If it were the old Xu Fu, he would never have thought of this, but now, Xu Fu felt more and more like they were a family of four.

A home, perhaps, is just like this...

Huhai leaned obediently in Xu Fu's arms as he headed toward Ying Zheng's location. The piece of silk was naturally left there, but no one dared to touch it. Now that Huhai was increasingly favored by Ying Zheng, he was no longer the child who could be treated coldly by the servants.

Xu Fu found it a bit strenuous to carry him, so after a few steps, he put Huhai down and let him walk on his own.

The servant led the way, and they soon arrived outside the main hall.

Xu Fu caught a glimpse of two figures. Hmm, they looked a bit familiar.

Huhai was young and full of energy, running ahead quickly. He ran to the guards outside the hall first, and as soon as they saw him, they immediately said, "Prince Huhai." Huhai smiled and stopped to wait for Xu Fu.

"Prince Huhai?" A woman's voice sounded above his head.

Huhai looked up and saw two women. Huhai said indifferently, "Where did these palace maids come from? Why are you standing here?"

Both women's expressions changed.

The two were Zhao Yan and her maid.

Zhao Yan felt quite uncomfortable, and after Xu Fu approached, she felt even worse.

The maid thought triumphantly, "Just wait, in a moment you will be blocked just like us."

Xu Fu walked toward them.

The maid felt even more triumphant. "Look, he still has to come over and stand here..."

But Xu Fu didn't look at them at all. His gaze fell on Huhai, and he reached out to him. "Come here."

Huhai immediately trotted to his side, climbed onto Xu Fu's hand with great obedience, and the two, big hand holding small hand, turned and walked inside without even glancing at them.

Seeing that things were not unfolding as she had imagined, the maid panicked, pointed at Xu Fu's back, and said angrily, "Why can he go in? But my Princess cannot?"

Zhao Yan hesitated but did not stop her maid.

Because she was also extremely curious: did the King of Qin really dote on his lover so much? Could he enter any hall freely? And as a noble Princess of Zhao, when she arrived here, he wouldn't even look at her?

The guard felt utter disdain, but on the surface, he said respectfully, "Commandant Xu is different from others." You others should have some self-awareness and move aside.

Zhao Yan bit her lip. Her lips were neither thin nor thick, and after a light bite, they took on a crimson hue. It was a pair of lips that would make one want to kiss them.

But the guard didn't even look twice.

What did it matter if she was beautiful? The King still wouldn't like her!

Zhao Yan was not resigned, but what could she do? She could only watch the back of Xu Fu leading Huhai inside. That back was noble and cold, stabbing deeply into Zhao Yan's eyes, making her heart feel as if it were being fried in hot oil—it was truly unbearable.

She was born beautiful, which was why she was sent to Qin. But who would have thought that beauty... was not something everyone could appreciate? Zhao Yan couldn't help but reveal a sarcastic smile.

The maid beside her asked helplessly, "Princess, what... what should we do?"

Yes, what should they do? Zhao Yan felt a moment of confusion, but the State of Zhao could not afford any more turmoil! Zhao Yan stopped hesitating, gritted her teeth, and said, "Wait." She would wait for the King of Qin to come out!

·

When Xu Fu entered the hall, the attendant announced him, but Ying Zheng was focused on his work and didn't hear clearly. Even after they had entered, he kept his head down, his hand unconsciously gripping the stylus. Even in his calm state, he was still shrouded in an aura of majesty.

Huhai instinctively put away his playfulness and leaned firmly against Xu Fu's leg, so obedient that he looked nothing like the cruel Second Emperor of Qin from later history.

The sound of footsteps grew closer, finally catching Ying Zheng's attention.

Ying Zheng looked up abruptly, but there was no one in the hall.

Ying Zheng looked down and saw Huhai lying at his feet, hugging his leg and smiling, looking a bit silly.

When did Huhai come? Ying Zheng was just thinking about this when his back suddenly felt warm. His heart skipped a beat, and he reached back to scoop the person up.

Xu Fu, who hadn't had a chance to surprise Ying Zheng before being ruthlessly betrayed by Huhai: ...

It was rare for Xu Fu to come looking for him immediately after returning to the palace. Ying Zheng, unable to suppress the ecstasy in his heart, pulled Xu Fu into his arms and kissed him passionately. Xu Fu hadn't even caught his breath before his mouth was blocked. He gave a very perfunctory kiss back to Ying Zheng, which finally made Ying Zheng loosen his grip. Xu Fu immediately pushed him away, sat up, and looked at Huhai.

Young Huhai was already dumbfounded.

He stammered, "Chew... chew... chewing mouths..."

Xu Fu: ...

If Huhai were ever truly led astray, it would all be Ying Zheng's fault!

Ying Zheng reached out and touched Huhai's head as if nothing had happened. "This is how Father expresses his longing."

Huhai nodded blankly.

Xu Fu breathed a sigh of relief.

As long as he could smooth it over... but... in the future, wouldn't one lie lead to countless mistakes?

Ying Zheng had indeed not seen Xu Fu for too long, and he longed to press him onto the bed immediately to satisfy his hunger for him. But with state affairs at hand and Huhai sitting by his leg, Ying Zheng couldn't just rudely carry Xu Fu away. He suppressed the surging emotions in his heart, pulled Xu Fu into his arms, and continued to handle the bamboo slips in this strange posture.

The attendants' faces were written with the words, "I see nothing."

Xu Fu suddenly felt that he was one step closer to the title of a treacherous official who bewitched the monarch.

It was recorded that Qin Shi Huang had extraordinary energy, reviewing over 120 jin of bamboo slips every day, and some calculated that his daily reading volume exceeded 300,000 characters. Seeing it with his own eyes, Xu Fu felt it didn't seem like an exaggeration. Ying Zheng was indeed a diligent ruler, and his mind moved quickly, able to judge how to handle the bamboo slips before him. Watching those slips being opened and closed by Ying Zheng, they disappeared from the desk little by little.

On the tray beside them, the bamboo slips gradually piled up.

"Are you tired? I will accompany you back now." Ying Zheng put down the last bamboo slip and lifted Xu Fu up, half-embracing him.

"I ordered someone to call Fusu before I came. Shall we go eat together in a while?"

"Good." Ying Zheng was in a good mood, so naturally, whatever Xu Fu said was fine.

In the days when Xu Fu was not in the palace, Ying Zheng almost felt like a concubine waiting at the palace gate for the monarch to visit... For the King of Qin to fall to this point, thinking about it was truly pathetic.

Ying Zheng embraced Xu Fu as they walked down the steps, with Huhai following closely by Xu Fu's leg.

When they reached the hall door, Ying Zheng let go. Although he liked to use this method to assert his sovereignty, doing so outside would make people think he treated Xu Fu like a plaything, and how could that be? Naturally, it was better to let Xu Fu walk freely by his side.

They stepped out of the hall.

A figure suddenly moved in the deepening twilight. She called out loudly, "King of Qin, Zhao Yan requests an audience with the King of Qin!"

Who is Zhao Yan?

Ying Zheng frowned.

Xu Fu's brow furrowed even more deeply. Why was this Princess of Zhao still staying here, unresigned? Was she trying to move heaven and earth and, incidentally, the King of Qin?

Xu Fu felt unhappy, and his expression turned even colder.

But when was Xu Fu not wearing a cold face? So few people noticed the change in his expression.

Ying Zheng turned to look at the two women blocked by the guards and asked, "Who are you?"

Zhao Yan was choked up, and her maid hurriedly interjected, "Greetings, King of Qin. My Princess and I have come specifically to request an audience with the King of Qin."

Princess?

Ying Zheng finally remembered her identity. Oh, that Princess of Zhao.

"I have no time to grant you an audience. Go back." Ying Zheng turned and left without mercy.

But how could Zhao Yan bear to watch Ying Zheng leave like this? She had originally thought she could maintain her dignity as a Princess and wait quietly for the King of Qin to come to her, but who knew that after the first time they met, the King of Qin had forgotten her and never seen her again. There wasn't much time left... Zhao Yan didn't dare to wait, and she didn't want to wait.

She spoke again: "Why is the King of Qin unwilling to grant Zhao Yan an audience? I came to Qin to marry the King of Qin. The King is heroic, and I have admired you for a long time! Why are you unwilling to give me a chance?" Could a beautiful woman who spoke so directly be met with a heart of stone?

Yes, he could!

Heroic...

If Xu Fu praised him like this, he would certainly be overjoyed, but coming from such a woman, Ying Zheng felt no fluctuation at all.

As the King of Qin, could there be a shortage of people flattering him? Ying Zheng was tired of hearing these words. Men and women had no privileges before him. Could being a woman make him soft-hearted? If Ying Zheng were truly soft-hearted, he wouldn't have become the Qin Shi Huang of history.

"Someone, send her back." Ying Zheng really didn't want to waste words with her. With that time, he might as well go eat with Xu Fu.

Zhao Yan was stunned.

Her maid was also stunned. The maid refused to give up, secretly cheering herself on. It must be because the twilight was dim, and the King of Qin hadn't seen how beautiful the Princess was! Yes, that must be it! Perhaps it was also because Commandant Xu was standing to the side, which was why the King of Qin didn't show his favor to the Princess. Hmph, that treacherous favorite!

The guards stepped forward to drive Zhao Yan and her maid away. Zhao Yan eventually had to consider her dignity as a Princess; she shook off the guards and turned to walk back herself.

Ying Zheng turned back and continued to walk with Xu Fu toward the place where they would eat.

Xu Fu's expression was neither happy nor angry; he just glanced lightly at the departing Zhao Yan, then glanced lightly at Ying Zheng. Ying Zheng instinctively felt something was wrong, but when he tried to feel it carefully, he couldn't sense anything.

Before Xu Fu left, Zhao Yan was in the palace, but she was like a vase, placed there without moving. No one would mistreat her, but no one would pay attention to her either. After Xu Fu left, the Princess of Han also left, but Zhao Yan, no matter how much cold treatment she received, was unwilling to leave. She even went to great lengths to try to hook Ying Zheng.

Xu Fu could outline this entire process just by closing his eyes.

He thought Ying Zheng had arranged for the Princess of Zhao properly, but he didn't expect that as soon as he left, the Princess of Zhao would start acting like the future Queen.

Heh!

Xu Fu sat down expressionlessly and ate his food expressionlessly.

An attendant served fresh fish sashimi. Xu Fu's hand paused, and he turned to ask the attendant beside him, "Is there a small knife?"

The attendant was stunned and didn't react.

Fusu, who had just entered the hall, respectfully handed over the small knife from his waist. "Teacher." Because there were others around, Fusu didn't have the thick skin of Huhai and couldn't happily call Xu Fu "Father."

Xu Fu took the knife and chopped down on the fish sashimi.

The fresh fish was immediately split into two halves.

For some reason, Fusu noticed himself swallowing; it wasn't because he was greedy, but because he felt the aura from Xu Fu at that moment, and then he unconsciously made that movement.

Ying Zheng also glanced at Xu Fu, the feeling of something being wrong deepening.

Only Huhai was the most calm. He sucked in his saliva. "Father, split half for me, okay?" Children had delicate stomachs and might not be able to adapt to raw food, but thinking that Huhai had been particularly fond of fish sashimi before, Xu Fu hesitated and gave him half.

Ying Zheng hadn't even been able to get a share from Xu Fu's bowl before seeing Huhai get such treatment. His face sank, and he glared coldly at Huhai.

Unfortunately, Huhai, who usually knew how to read the room, seemed to have lost all perception and ignored his father's dark face.

Fusu laughed dryly, barely livening up the atmosphere, and then everyone continued to eat.

About half an hour later, Xu Fu put down his chopsticks.

The other three followed suit.

"Let's go back." Xu Fu was a bit sleepy and stood up, leaning on the table.

Seeing his appearance, Ying Zheng suddenly realized. No wonder Xu Fu was acting strangely; he must have been forcing himself to stay awake to come to the hall to see him, right? Ying Zheng felt happy again. He was about to reach out to embrace Xu Fu, but Xu Fu had already bypassed him and walked out first.

After walking out of the palace, the cold wind blew on his face, and Xu Fu immediately became much more awake.

Oh, he had actually walked in front of the King of Qin! To make up for this mistake, Xu Fu paused, and after Ying Zheng came out, he walked alongside him.

Fusu and Huhai walked behind. Fusu couldn't help but look back at the place where Xu Fu had just sat.

The fish sashimi on Teacher's plate... had turned into meat paste... Fusu lowered his head with a complex expression. Beneath Teacher's indifferent exterior, there was actually a heart that could be quite ruthless.

Huhai looked up at him curiously. "Brother, what's wrong?"

Fusu shook his head quickly. "Nothing."

The adults returned to the adult's sleeping quarters to do what adults do; the children also returned to their respective side halls to rest, read, and sleep.

Ying Zheng had been busy all day, and after returning to the sleeping quarters, he planned to just embrace Xu Fu and go to sleep, with neither of them considering anything else, just resting well.

The plan was excellent.

After Ying Zheng returned from bathing, he saw that all the attendants had been dismissed by Xu Fu.

The curtains around the bed were drawn, and one could only vaguely glimpse the figure inside. Ying Zheng walked up, lifted the curtain, and saw Xu Fu leaning on the bed, holding a piece of silk.

Xu Fu was wearing a white deep robe, which was slightly oversized, leaving part of his shoulder exposed.

That bit of skin was fair, and when reflected by the candlelight, it seemed as if light was shimmering on it. Ying Zheng looked up slightly and saw Xu Fu with his hair draped down, his posture somewhat lazy, and with a touch of charm rarely seen on weekdays.

He was reading very intently, not even lifting his head.

His serious appearance gave his features a unique, charming flavor.

Ying Zheng's heart stirred, and the sleep he had planned was instantly thrown far away. Why sleep? Ying Zheng no longer suppressed the restlessness in his heart. He walked to Xu Fu's side. Because of the angle, he could see deeper into the skin through the wide deep robe, and at the same time, he saw what Xu Fu was holding—a spring palace painting.

Ying Zheng's breathing grew heavy; he was almost certain that Xu Fu was seducing him.

Being seduced by Xu Fu was something Ying Zheng almost dared not think about, but now it was right in front of him. The fire in his chest burned brighter, and Ying Zheng could no longer endure it.

Let's do this: pin him to the bed and use the positions in the painting to practice with him properly.

Ying Zheng followed his desires and reached out to hook Xu Fu's waist. Xu Fu looked up at him, his eyes blurred and ignorant. The silk in his hand slipped, and Ying Zheng leaned forward, reaching into Xu Fu's deep robe.

The deep robe was too wide, so he easily touched Xu Fu's skin.

It was at this moment that Ying Zheng suddenly realized.

Xu Fu was wearing his deep robe.

That's why it was so wide!

Upon realizing this, the fire of desire almost burned away Ying Zheng's sanity in an instant. He gripped Xu Fu's waist, his other hand caressing his inner thigh, while he lowered his head to kiss Xu Fu's lips. That beautiful little mouth, when kissed by him, would become flushed from the pressure...

Every time he imagined it, Ying Zheng felt he could endure it less and less.

And at this moment, Xu Fu clearly felt the hard object pressing against him from below.

Xu Fu seemed to unconsciously stick out his tongue and suck on Ying Zheng's lips. Ying Zheng couldn't help but kiss him deeply; the harder he kissed, the more his body clamored.

Ying Zheng wished he could strip off his robes immediately.

Xu Fu reached out to touch his lower body and asked hoarsely, "Does it feel good?"

Of course it felt good!

Ying Zheng nodded immediately.

"Oh." Xu Fu responded indifferently, and then he kicked Ying Zheng. Ying Zheng hadn't reacted yet, thinking it was just a bit of fun. He held Xu Fu's foot in his hand and felt his desire become even harder and more erect.

Xu Fu turned over, but couldn't move.

"I'm very sleepy, let me sleep." Xu Fu said with a sour face, very unhappy.

Seeing Ying Zheng standing there like a wooden stake, Xu Fu had to repeat himself, "I'm very tired, very sleepy, I want to sleep. Ying Zheng, do you not want me to sleep?"

Ying Zheng, who had been seduced and teased for half a day: ...???

What did I do wrong???
chapters.title: 第159章
chapters.source_text:
说话的女子，模样娇美，五官底子可见是很好的，就是面上的妆容……实在不太好。她的身材是极好的，腰间轻柔地一勒，便勾出了窈窕细腰来，让看见的人，忍不住去想，若是伸手勾住，该是何等的滋味。
徐福隐约猜出了对方的身份，“可是赵国公主？”他还真不大喜欢对方说话的口吻。因为不知道你是谁，所以冒犯了你，你宽厚一点，原谅我这宫女吧。这是什么逻辑？因为不知道你是谁，所以就可以冒犯你了？有教养的人，应当是不管面对地位高或低的人物，都是有礼貌的吧？
女子面上闪过惊讶之色，点头道：“正是，敢问先生是？”赵嫣之所以会拦住手下的宫女，也是突然想起，宫中不能行马车的，而此人却敢在宫中肆意行走，可见其在秦王跟前的荣宠。
这个人不能得罪！
“徐福。”
赵嫣心中顿时重重一跳。徐福的大名，如今谁还会没听过？哪怕她如今身在秦王宫中，也没少听过这个名字。
王宫之中，诸多宫人侍从都对这个名字极为推崇，几乎是走到哪里便能听到哪里。赵嫣得知听闻此人极擅卜筮之术，刚刚辞去奉常一职，前往秦军中担任护军都尉。此人出自鬼谷，师兄乃是国尉尉缭。客卿李斯，将军蒙恬也与他交好。公子扶苏、胡亥尊其为师。最重要的是，徐福此人打从几年前住进宫中，便也再未出宫开过府。
他们传闻，徐福是秦王的情人。
抛开前面的不说，光是这一点，就足够让赵嫣在面对徐福的时候，心惊肉跳了。
她细细打量起了徐福的样貌，并未注意到自己的举动有多么放肆。
眼前的青年跽坐在马车内，面如霜雪，眉眼精致，因他坐在马车里较她高出不少的缘故，他的目光低俯下来时，顿给人以高高在上，教人不敢仰望的感觉。
赵嫣心中顿时便觉得不大舒服了。
身为女子，却比不过这样的男子，容貌不及他，气度不及他。赵嫣心中难免有些自卑。但总归是赵国公主，这样的情绪也只是一瞬便消失了。
“公主若是无事，烦请让个路。”徐福淡漠地看了她一眼。
这一眼还是极有威慑力的，赵嫣不自觉地地往后缩了缩，而她身旁的宫女便不是那样识趣了。
她怒道：“你这人好大的胆子，竟敢让我们公主为你让路！要让也应当是你先让才是。”
那宫女方才被喝止还心中不满呢，如今一听眼前的人就是徐福，就是那个勾引秦王、以色侍君的人，那以后可是要与公主成为敌人的啊！眼下当然要将他的面子狠狠踩下去！不然如何佑得赵国王室的尊严？
那宫女却是忘记了，赵国将公主送来，便早已没了什么尊严可言了。她哪来的胆子敢在秦王宫里来找她赵国的尊严？
这宫女实在口无遮拦得很，已经许久无人敢这样与徐福说话了，徐福不喜地皱了皱眉，随后手一松放下车帘，摆明了是不想见那二人的脸。
“马不会转弯，但人却是会转弯的。”徐福冷淡地说完，就示意那车夫继续前行。
宫女见他此举，顿时愤怒地便要往上冲，赵嫣脸色大变，赶紧伸手拉住了她，“做什么？半点规矩也没了吗？自然徐都尉让我们让开，我们让开便是。”
她的话看似是在教训那宫女，但实际上是想说徐福不懂规矩，一个都尉，偏生让一国公主给马儿让道，可不是半点规矩也没么？她口中称着“徐都尉”，不过是想说徐福自以为是，仗势欺人。
这段话说得还是很有艺术的，但是对徐福来说，玩这点文字游戏真没用，他根本没放在心上。徐福闭上眼，听着耳边传来马蹄声哒哒哒的声音，心头的郁气才觉得舒缓了许多。
……
宫女不服气地道：“公主，他……”
“闭嘴，这是在秦国，你放聪明些。你何时见过敢在王宫里坐着马车自由来去的人？徐福此人，在秦王跟前的地位还高着呢，不是你能冒犯的！”赵嫣回头瞪了那宫女一眼。
宫女结结巴巴，“可、可是……他这样给公主难堪……日后公主的威严……”
赵嫣倒是个聪明人，她无奈一笑，道：“赵国公主在秦国王宫，哪里来的威严？”
宫女不服气地低下头，不愿承认这个事实。
待公主嫁给秦王做了王后，那什么都尉，身为男子却以色侍君，终有一日会被厌弃，男子哪有女子好？再风光，他能做得了王后吗？想到这里，宫女顿觉心情舒畅无比，笑盈盈地扶着赵嫣继续往前走去。
她们很快便走到了大殿外，守卫冷酷无情地拦住了她们。
宫女原本才平息下去的怒火，差点又升腾了上来。
赵嫣皱了皱眉，怎么带了这样一个笨宫女过来呢？算了……赵嫣收起目光，看向那守卫，柔声道：“赵嫣求见秦王。”
那守卫摇头道：“赵国公主，若无传召，您是不能到此处来的，还请快快离去。”
赵嫣目光哀求地看着那守卫，低声道：“来秦数日，难以得见秦王一面，秦王为何不愿见我？也请秦王告知赵嫣才好。”
这头赵嫣还在想尽法子地试图进到那大殿中去，另一头徐福已经到了秦王寝宫。
寝宫外的侍从宫人一见着徐福，便欣喜若狂地跪了下来。原本应当是极为稳重的宫人们，如今见了徐福，倒是难以稳重起来了。
“终于等到先生归来了！”宫人忙笑盈盈地迎了上来。
因徐福辞了奉常之位，宫人便又叫回了“先生”的称呼。
“王上呢？”徐福环视了一圈寝宫，虽然大约能猜到嬴政此时正在处理政务，但心头不大痛快的徐福，还是选择问了一句。
“在政务殿中呢。”
“胡亥和扶苏呢？”徐福将心头冒出来的那点儿不快压下去，为了转移注意力，他觉得自己还是先去看看便宜儿子比较好。
宫人笑道：“扶苏公子此时应当还在看书，胡亥公子应当是在休息。”
宫人说得委婉，不过徐福也知道以胡亥的性子，他此时应当是在玩还差不多。徐福沐了个浴，再换上新的衣袍，随后才去偏殿寻胡亥了。进殿门时，他示意宫人们不要开口，然后便大步走了进去。
宫人忙闭了嘴，愣是半点声响也不敢发出。
徐福悄声走了进去，只见胡亥半点礼仪也不顾地趴在了地面上，肩膀一怂一怂，也不知道在做什么。待徐福走近了，他才发现胡亥是捏着炭笔，在绢布上写字呢，开头是，父亲，父王今天又欺负我……
那个“我”字的尾巴拖了老长，潦草得有些惨不忍睹。
徐福心中软了软，顿觉有些好笑，于是伸手将胡亥捞了起来，胡亥吓得惊叫一声，或许是感觉到背后的怀抱，和嬴政那个硬邦邦的怀抱全然不同，胡亥面上一喜，立刻扑到了徐福的怀中去。
“父亲！”软糯糯团子将徐福的怀抱塞得满满的。
都说小孩子记性不好，年幼时的事少能记住的，而且他们喜新厌旧得快，过段日子不见你了，便能忘记你了。这也是徐福对小孩子难以有多么喜欢的缘故。不过他发现胡亥和扶苏都不是如此。
徐福暗自道，一定是跟着我，所以学了我的好记性和长情。
他抬手揉了揉胡亥的脸蛋儿，脸上冰冷的表情终于撤去，露出了浅淡的笑意，胡亥抬起小肥手，捧着徐福的脸颊，凑上前去，糊了徐福一脸的口水。明明已经不是小时候那样了，但胡亥仍旧改不掉这样表达喜恶的习惯，徐福无奈，只能再次揉了揉他。
胡亥适时地撒开手，在徐福怀中蹭了蹭，“父亲去哪里？我要去，我要去，不带哥哥。”
徐福原本也迟疑着要不要去看嬴政，此时听胡亥这么一说，便立时决定了下来。
他带着胡亥先去看嬴政，等迟一些，再让宫人带着扶苏过来，他们便能一起用饭了。若是换做以前的徐福，全然不会想到这些，不过现在徐福心中倒是越发有点儿一家四口的概念了。
家么，约莫就是这样的吧……
胡亥乖巧地靠在徐福怀里，跟着他一块儿往嬴政那边去，那块绢布自然就被搁在那儿了，不过没有人敢去擅动，如今越发得嬴政喜爱的胡亥，已经不是过去那样，可以受宫人冷待了。
徐福抱得有点吃力，没走几步就将胡亥放下来，让他自力更生了。
宫人在前引路，很快便走到了大殿外。
徐福隐隐瞥见了两道身影，唔，还有点儿熟悉。
胡亥年纪小，精力足，在前面跑得很快，他先跑到了殿外的守卫跟前去，守卫一见他，便立即道了声“胡亥公子”。胡亥笑了笑，顿住脚步等徐福。
“胡亥公子？”一道女声在他的头顶上响起。
胡亥仰头看去，便看见了两名女子，胡亥浑不在意地道：“哪里来的宫女吗？杵在这里做什么？”
那两名女子脸色皆是一变。
那二人正是赵嫣同她的宫女。
赵嫣心头颇不是滋味，待徐福走近之后，赵嫣心头便更觉难受了。
那宫女还心中得意道。瞧着吧，一会儿你也如我们一样被拦着。
徐福朝她们走了过来。
宫女心中更得意了。瞧瞧，还不是只能过来站着……
但徐福却根本没看他们，他的目光落在胡亥的身上，他朝胡亥伸出手，“过来。”
胡亥便立即小跑到他的脚边，万分乖巧地攀住了徐福的手掌，两个人大手牵小手，连看也没看他们一眼，便立即转身往里走去。
眼看着事情的发展没有按照自己心中所想的那样来上演，那宫女一急，忙指着徐福的背影，怒道：“为何他能进去？而我家公主却不能进？”
赵嫣犹豫了一下，还是没有拉住自己的宫女。
因为她也万分好奇，秦王难道就这样宠爱自己的情人？能让他自由出入任何一座大殿？而自己贵为赵国公主，到了此处，他却连看也不愿看一眼？
那守卫心中不屑至极，但面上还是毕恭毕敬道：“徐都尉与旁人是不同的。”你们这些旁人就赶快有点自知之明，闪到一边去吧。
赵嫣咬了咬唇。她的唇不薄不厚，轻咬过后，便透着嫣红的色泽。会让人忍不住想要亲吻的一张唇。
但是那守卫连多看一眼也无。
这样的模样就算再美好又如何？王上也依旧不会喜欢！
赵嫣并不死心，但不死心又如何？她依旧只能看着徐福牵着胡亥走进去的背影，那背影高贵又冷漠，深深扎进赵嫣的眼眸中，让她心中如被烈火热油烹炸一般，实在难受得紧。
她生得貌美，才会被派来秦国。但谁能想到貌美……也并非是谁人都能瞧得进眼的呢？赵嫣一时忍不住露出了讽刺的笑容。
她身旁的宫女茫然无措地问道：“公主，那我们……我们怎么办啊？”
是啊，我们怎么办啊？赵嫣也有一瞬间的茫然，但是赵国经不起折腾了啊！赵嫣不再犹豫，咬着牙，道：“等。”她便等着秦王出来！
·
徐福进殿门的时候，内侍提醒了一声，但嬴政专注于手头的事务，实在没听清，等人都进来了，他还依旧低着头，手无意识地捏紧了笔刀。哪怕是沉静下来，他的身上也依旧笼罩着一层威严的气势。
胡亥不自觉地收起了顽皮的表现，牢牢靠在徐福的腿边，乖巧得哪里像后世那个残暴的秦二世啊？
脚步声越来越近，总算叩动了嬴政的注意力。
嬴政猛地抬起头，殿中却没人。
嬴政一低头，就见胡亥趴在他的脚边，抱了抱腿，笑了笑，表情有点蠢。
胡亥何时来的？嬴政正思考着呢，背上突然一热，嬴政心中重重一跳，反手将人从背后捞了过来。
完全还没来得及给嬴政一个出其不意，便被胡亥无情出卖的徐福：……
少有徐福回宫后，便立即来寻自己的时候，嬴政按捺不住心头的狂喜，将徐福扣在怀中，便立即热情地吻了上去，徐福气儿都还没喘匀，就立即被堵住了嘴，他十分敷衍地回吻了一下嬴政，这才让嬴政松开了手。徐福立即推开他，坐起身来，再看胡亥。
年幼的胡亥已经是一脸的目瞪口呆了。
他结结巴巴的，“啃……啃……啃嘴巴……”
徐福：……
要是哪一天胡亥当真被教歪了，这都全是嬴政的错啊！
嬴政若无其事地伸手摸了摸胡亥的头，“这是父王表达想念的方式。”
胡亥懵懂地点着头。
徐福松了口气。
能圆过去就好，不过……以后应当不会因为一个谎言而出现无数个错误吧？
嬴政确实太久未见徐福了，此时恨不得立即将人摁倒在床上，先来一解思念的饥渴。但是政务还摆在手边，胡亥还坐在腿边，嬴政还真不能粗暴地抱着徐福走人。他压下心中攒动的心绪，将徐福搂在怀中，就着这样诡异的姿势继续处理跟前的竹简。
内侍们脸上写着几个大字，“我什么也看不见”。
徐福忽然觉得，自己大约离媚惑君上的奸佞之名……又近了一步。
曾经有记载说，秦始皇精力分外充沛，每日都要批阅超过一百二十斤重的竹简，更有人换算得出，认为他每日的阅读量超过三十万字。徐福亲眼看见，便觉得，似乎也不算夸张。嬴政的确是个勤政的人，他的脑子转动也很快，能够迅速判断出面前的竹简该如何处理。眼瞅着那些竹简被嬴政翻开再合上，一点点就这样从桌案上消失了。
旁边的托盘之上，竹简倒是渐渐堆得高了起来。
“可觉得累了？寡人这便陪你回去。”嬴政搁下最后一个竹简，半搂半抱地将徐福带了起来。
“我来之前便命人去叫扶苏了，等一会儿我们一同去用饭食？”
“好。”嬴政心情正舒畅，自然徐福说什么都好。
徐福不在宫中的日子，嬴政都快觉得自己如同那等候在宫门口，等着君王来临幸的姬妾了……秦王落到这地步，想一想，也着实心酸。
嬴政拥着徐福走下台阶，胡亥紧跟在徐福的腿旁。
待走到殿门口时，嬴政才松开了手，他虽喜爱用这样的方式来宣誓主权，但是毕竟在外如此，会令人觉得他视徐福如娈宠，那如何能成？自然还是让徐福自如地走在他身侧更好。
他们跨出了殿门。
一个身影突然在沉下来的暮色之中动了动，她高声唤道：“秦王，赵嫣求见秦王！”
赵嫣是谁？
嬴政皱了皱眉。
这边徐福的眉头皱得更加厉害。怎么这赵国公主还不死心地留在这里了？她是要感动天感动地顺便感动秦王吗？
徐福心头不痛快，面上的神色便更冷了。
不过徐福什么时候不是冷着一张脸的？因而倒是没多少人注意到他脸上的变化。
嬴政转身去看那两名被守卫拦住的女子，问道：“你是何人？”
赵嫣被噎了噎，她身边的宫女忙抢声道：“见过秦王，我与我家公主，特来求见秦王。”
公主？
嬴政总算是想起来对方的身份了。哦，那个赵国公主啊。
“寡人没空召见你们，回去罢。”嬴政毫不留情转身便走。
但赵嫣哪里舍得就这样看着嬴政走？她原以为自己可以维持住公主的矜持，静静等待秦王来找她，但谁知道，秦王愣是从第一次见过之后，便将她忘却到了脑后，此后再也未曾见过她。所剩的时日不长了……赵嫣不敢等了，也不想等了。
她再度出声道：“秦王为何不愿召见赵嫣？赵嫣前来秦国，本也是为嫁给秦王的，秦王英武，许久之前，赵嫣便心慕秦王了！秦王为何不肯给赵嫣一个机会呢？”模样娇美的女子，能将话说到这样直白的地步，难道对方还能继续铁石心肠吗？
能！
什么英武……
若是徐福如此夸他，他定然心中欢喜不已，但换做这样一个女人来夸他，嬴政心中还真无丝毫波动。
身为秦王，奉承他的人难道还会少吗？这些个词，嬴政都快听腻了。男子和女子在他跟前本就是谁都没有特权的。身为女子，难道就能换得他心软了吗？若嬴政当真心软，那他也不会成为历史上的秦始皇了。
“来人，送她回去。”嬴政实在不愿与她浪费口舌，有这功夫，还不如他与徐福去用饭食了。
赵嫣懵住了。
她身边的宫女也懵住了，宫女不肯死心，还在暗暗自我打气，定是因着暮色沉沉，那秦王还未看清公主生得如何的娇美模样吧？对，定是如此！或许还因为那徐都尉就站在一旁，所以秦王才不会直接表露出对公主的好感。呵，这个佞宠！
守卫上前，将赵嫣和她的宫女驱走，赵嫣终究还是要顾及到自己的公主尊严，她摆脱了守卫，自己转身走了回去。
嬴政转身回来，和徐福一同继续往用饭的地方走去。
徐福面上不喜不怒，只是轻飘飘地瞥了一眼那远去的赵嫣，又轻飘飘地瞥了一眼嬴政，嬴政本能地觉得哪里不大对劲，但是等细细去感受时，又什么都感受不到了。
徐福走之前，那赵嫣便在宫中了，但她就跟一个花瓶似的，被人放在那里动也不动，不会有人亏待了她，但也不会有人去理会她。徐福走后，韩国公主也走了，赵嫣哪怕受再多的冷待，她也不愿离去。她甚至动了百般心思，想要勾上嬴政。
这样的一段历程，徐福闭闭眼就能勾勒出来。
他还当嬴政都将那赵国公主安排妥帖了呢，没成想，他一走，那赵国公主便拿自己当未来王后了。
呵呵！
徐福面无表情地落座，面无表情地吃着食物。
有宫女送上了新鲜的鱼脍，徐福手上的动作顿了顿，转头问身边的内侍，“可有小刀？”
内侍愣了愣没反应过来。
倒是走进殿内的扶苏恭敬地递上了腰间的小刀，“老师。”碍于周围还有其他人，扶苏倒是没胡亥那样厚的脸皮，也能喜滋滋管徐福叫“父亲”。
徐福接过小刀，一刀剁在鱼脍之上。
那鲜美的鱼脍，便立即分作了两半。
不知为何，扶苏发觉到自己咽了咽口水，不是馋的，而是那瞬间感受到徐福身上的气势，随后不自觉地就做了个这样的动作。
嬴政也瞥了瞥徐福，心中不对劲的感觉更深了。
只有胡亥最为淡定，他吸了吸口水，“父亲，分一半，给我好不好？”小孩子肠胃幼嫩，不一定能适应吃生食，不过想到之前胡亥便格外喜欢鱼脍，徐福犹豫一下，拨了一半给他。
嬴政都还没能从徐福的碗中分食走呢，就见胡亥得了这样的待遇，顿时面色一沉，冷睨了一眼胡亥。
可惜往日里会察言观色的胡亥，此时就跟失去了所有感知一样，根本不搭理他的黑脸父王。
扶苏干巴巴地笑了笑，勉强将气氛活跃了一些，然后众人继续用饭食。
约莫半个时辰后，徐福才放下了手中的筷子。
其余三个也跟着放了筷子。
“回吧。”徐福有些困倦了，撑着桌案站起了身。
嬴政见他的模样，顿时心中恍然大悟，怪不得徐福不对劲，应当是强撑着困倦疲累，来殿中见自己的吧？嬴政心中顿时又喜滋滋的了。他正要伸手去搂徐福，徐福却已经绕过他先往外走了。
走出宫殿后，冷风照头一吹，徐福顿时便清醒了不少。
哦，他竟然走在了秦王的前头！为了弥补这样的错误，徐福顿住了脚步，等嬴政出来后，才和他同行在了一起。
扶苏和胡亥走在后头，扶苏忍不住回头看了一眼徐福方才坐的位置。
老师盘子里的鱼脍啊……变成肉泥了啊……扶苏面色复杂地低下了头，老师那淡漠的外表之下，实则隐藏着一颗分外手狠的心啊。
胡亥好奇地抬头看他，“哥哥，怎么了？”
扶苏连忙摇头，“无事。”
大人回了大人的寝宫，去做大人要做的事；小孩子也各自回了自己的偏殿，休息休息就可以看书睡觉了。
嬴政今日忙了一天，回到寝宫后，便打算着就这样拥着徐福入睡，两人都不再考虑其它，就这样好生休息一下。
计划是极好的。
嬴政去沐浴回来后，便见宫人们都被徐福挥退了。
床榻边上的帷帘落了下来，只能隐约瞥见里头的身影。嬴政走上前去，撩起帷帘，便见徐福倚坐在床榻上，手里抓着绢布。
徐福身上穿着白色深衣，深衣略微有些宽大，肩膀处不由得裸了一部分皮肤在外头。
就是那点儿皮肤，白皙的，由烛光映着的时候，便觉得有光华在上头转动着似的。嬴政微微抬头，见徐福披散着发丝，姿态有些慵懒，还有几分平日里难见到的妩媚情态。
他看得很认真，连头都没抬。
他认真的模样，使他的眉眼之间覆上了一层独特的迷人味道。
嬴政心中大动，什么原本计划好的睡觉瞬间便被他抛远了。还睡什么？嬴政不再压抑心头的躁意，他走到了徐福的身旁，因为角度的缘故，他一眼就能从那宽大的深衣间，窥见里头更深处的皮肤，同时他也看清了徐福手中捧着的东西——春宫图。
嬴政呼吸一重，几乎肯定了徐福是在引诱他。
能被徐福引诱，那是嬴政几乎不敢去想的事儿，但是如今就这样摆在自己跟前了。胸口的那把火燃烧得越发旺了，嬴政已经不能再忍了。
就这样吧，将他扣倒在床榻上，用那图上姿势，好好与他来演习一遍。
嬴政遵从了自己的欲望，伸手勾住徐福的腰，徐福抬起头看他，目光迷离懵懂，他手中的绢布滑落，嬴政欺身上前，伸手摸入了徐福的深衣之中。
深衣实在太宽大了，他很轻松地便触到了徐福的皮肤。
也就是在这个时候，嬴政才突然反应过来。
徐福穿的是他的深衣。
所以才会如此宽大！
在意识到这一点之后，那一把欲火几乎在顷刻间便将嬴政的神智燃烧殆尽，他扣住了徐福的腰身，另一只手摩挲到了他的腿间，同时低头去吻徐福的唇。那张漂亮的小嘴，被自己吻住的时候，会因为用力而变得红润起来……
每想象一些，嬴政便觉得自己越发地难以忍受。
而此时徐福也清晰地感受到，硬邦邦顶在自己身下的物事。
徐福仿佛无意识般地伸出舌头，吸吮了一下嬴政的唇，嬴政忍不住和他深吻起来，吻得越用力，身体里便叫嚣得越加厉害。
嬴政恨不得即刻扒掉他身上的衣袍。
徐福伸手摸了摸他的下身，哑声问：“舒服吗？”
当然舒服！
嬴政立即点了点头。
“哦。”徐福淡淡地应了一声，然后他踹了嬴政一脚，嬴政还没反应过来，只当是情趣，他将徐福的脚捏在手中，顿觉欲望更加硬,挺。
徐福翻了个身，没能翻动。
“我很困了，让我睡觉。”徐福臭着脸，很不高兴地说。
徐福见嬴政如同木桩子一样愣在那里，于是不得不又重复一遍，“我很累，很困，很想睡觉，嬴政，你不想让我睡觉了吗？”
被引诱撩拨半天的嬴政：……？？？
寡人做错了什么？？？

chapters.translated_text:
There were many beauties in Ying Zheng’s inner palace. Some were chosen to enter the palace because they caught Empress Zhao’s eye, while others were sent to his side by Lü Buwei. Among them was Huji, who possessed Hu ancestry and an alluring appearance. Ying Zheng did not necessarily like her all that much, but to put on a show for Lü Buwei, Ying Zheng bestowed a bit of favor upon Huji. Ying Zheng was young and rarely visited the inner palace, and Huji, having received this favor, grew arrogant and presumptuous.

Ying Zheng’s gaze swept over Xu Fu, and then he reined in his deep, unfathomable expression. "Have her return. There is no need for her to come and wait on me before we leave for Yongcheng."

Since someone had already misunderstood his relationship with Xu Fu, there was no longer any use for Huji.

Zhao Gao was startled upon hearing this, his gaze repeatedly sweeping over Xu Fu.

Xu Fu was completely unaware of the strangeness in Zhao Gao’s gaze. He turned slightly to the side to mask an urge to yawn, and when he turned back around, his eyes were once again shimmering with moisture.

A palace attendant went out to reply to Huji, but failed to stop her.

The self-righteous exclusive favor she imagined had worn away all the caution she ought to have had.

"Your Majesty, why do you treat me thus?" Huji dragged her skirt and barged in furiously. The bedchamber was quiet, and the moment Huji burst in, she came face-to-face with Zhao Gao’s indifferent expression, which was entirely different from his usual amiable demeanor.

Huji’s heart trembled. When she looked up again toward Ying Zheng’s direction, she noticed that Ying Zheng was also staring at her with an icy gaze. Her heart drummed wildly against her ribs, and her legs grew faintly weak.

"Hmm?" Seeing that no one was speaking, Xu Fu looked around and couldn't help letting out a sound, instantly drawing Huji's gaze to him.

Huji, who had still harbored fear just a moment ago, let jealousy take the upper hand the moment she saw Xu Fu.

"Why must Your Majesty deceive me? Even if Your Majesty wishes to favor another, you only need to tell Huji." Huji lowered her brows and lashes, her soft, charming voice tinged with grievance.

Xu Fu frowned. Why did it feel to him just now that Huji had glared at him with bitter resentment? Huji’s voice was simply too syrupy and sweet; it was a miracle the First Emperor of Qin could stomach it, but as for him, he felt his goosebumps rising in discomfort.

Ying Zheng lost his patience with Huji. "Take her out. Confine her to her quarters."

Huji suddenly widened her eyes. "Your Majesty..." Her expression was on the verge of tears.

Looking at her appearance, Ying Zheng couldn't help thinking of Empress Zhao, who was becoming increasingly absurd these days. Since both came from Lü Buwei's hands, his expression instantly grew even colder. Attendants stepped across the palace threshold and forcefully dragged Huji out.

Huji’s figure vanished before the bedchamber doors.

Surely she didn't still take him for a male concubine, did she? Xu Fu furrowed his brows slightly, his expression also turning somewhat cool and detached, making him look remarkably like the Ying Zheng beside him.

"Fetch water." Ying Zheng flicked his sleeves and turned to face Xu Fu. His gaze rested on Xu Fu’s face, but his words were addressed to the palace attendants.

The attendants in Xianyang Palace had long since been thoroughly subdued by Ying Zheng. Fearing that Ying Zheng would fly into a rage, they lowered their heads and hurried out to prepare hot water.

Xu Fu snapped out of his own thoughts, meeting Ying Zheng’s gaze head-on. "What is Your Majesty looking at me for?"

"I feel that you are of great help to me."

Although he was praised out of nowhere, Xu Fu accepted it without the slightest bit of modesty. "Thank you, Your Majesty."

After the two of them washed up, Xu Fu’s gaze began wandering around the bedchamber again. Seeing his expression, Ying Zheng couldn't help asking, "What are you looking for?"

"Is there no bed for me?" Could it be that the First Emperor of Qin expected him to sleep on the floor?

Ying Zheng pointed at the massive bed, which could easily accommodate six people. "Naturally, you sleep with me."

Xu Fu suppressed the astonishment in his heart.

The First Emperor of Qin wanted to share a bed and sleep feet-to-feet with him too?

Come to think of it, it certainly sounded much better than monarchs and ministers eating together. Who knew, maybe he, Xu Fu, could also catch some reflected glory and get recorded in history books: *In the XX year, Xu Fu and the First Emperor slept feet-to-feet as ruler and subject within the imperial bedchamber.* It was no wonder the First Emperor wasn't worried that leaving him in the palace would result in him wearing a green hat—he was practically becoming a twenty-four-hour personal shadow. But on second thought, it seemed the First Emperor's nightlife had also been stripped away by him.

After pondering it and deciding that he hadn't gotten the short end of the stick anyway, Xu Fu walked over to the bedside as naturally as could be.

Who would dare let the First Emperor sleep on the edge of the bed? Xu Fu stood very consciously by the bedside. If not for the fact that his aura of cold detachment was far too obvious, just looking at him standing there obediently, he almost looked like he was about to wait on Ying Zheng to sleep.

Ying Zheng glanced at Xu Fu, his tone flat yet laced with a trace of majesty that brooked no refusal. "You sleep on the inside. I am tall and large, so I will sleep on the outside."

Xu Fu didn't feel touched in the least.

So the First Emperor was mocking him for not being as tall, handsome, and dashing as him?

Xu Fu sat upon this so-called "dragon bed," spun around, and lay down.

Ying Zheng walked over to the edge of the bed. The men of Qin were mostly robust and sturdy, and Ying Zheng was even more martial and heroic. His figure blocked almost the majority of the candlelight, and Xu Fu suddenly felt the space before his eyes darken. Looking up, he could only catch a glimpse of Ying Zheng’s handsome face, which, due to the "lighting," appeared intensely oppressive. Facing this First Emperor of Qin, whose imposing aura practically enveloped his entire person, Xu Fu raised a hand to cover his lips, thinking he was doing it inconspicuously as he let out a yawn, his eyelashes fluttering along with it.

Ying Zheng didn't think this action was rude at all.

A sliver of candlelight leaked past Ying Zheng, falling upon Xu Fu and making his eyes appear even brighter.

For some inexplicable reason, Ying Zheng felt the turbulent anger in his chest soothe quite a bit.

An attendant stepped forward with bowed waist and shook out the blanket, and only then did Ying Zheng lie down.

The candlelight beside the bed was extinguished, and a bone-weary Xu Fu quickly fell asleep.

Ever since his youth, this was the first time Ying Zheng had shared a bed and slept with someone else. Originally, he thought Xu Fu might toss and turn, finding it difficult to fall asleep with him sleeping right next to him. After a long while, Ying Zheng rolled over and happened to catch sight of Xu Fu’s soundly sleeping face, stripped of three parts of its detachment.

Ying Zheng: ......

At this moment, the moonlight outside the window was just right.

*

There were still several days before their departure for Yongcheng. Ying Zheng made it a daily routine to practice martial arts in the early morning, and after breakfast, he would read ancient texts and examine topographical maps. Sometimes Xu Fu would sit in the lower seat below Ying Zheng, watching his movements.

Ying Zheng was a man of excessive self-discipline. He was so strict with himself to a terrifying degree—no wonder he was able to grow into a great monarch. Even Xu Fu occasionally found it terrifying to watch. As expected, he was only suited to be a charlatan who excelled at bluffing and cared only for having good food and drink.

September 1st.

Ying Zheng sat at his desk handling official business.

Xu Fu was hiding behind a folding screen taking a nap, draped in a thick cloak that Ying Zheng had ordered someone to find for him.

"Your Majesty, what are you still waiting for? If this person is not eliminated, I fear disaster will strike!" A harsh voice suddenly exploded inside the hall.

Xu Fu started violently awake. The cloak slipped from his shoulders, but he didn't bother to pick it up, carefully listening to the commotion coming from outside.

That was Lü Buwei’s voice!

Was he actually reprimanding the First Emperor of Qin?!
chapters.title: 第16章
chapters.source_text:
嬴政后宫之中美人众多，有的美人因为合了赵太后的眼缘而被选入宫，有的美人却是被吕不韦送到身边的，其中就包括了拥有胡人血统、容貌美艳的胡姬。嬴政未必见得有多么喜欢她，但是为了做个模样给吕不韦看，嬴政便施予了胡姬些许宠爱。嬴政年少，少入后宫，得到宠爱的胡姬便恃宠而骄了。
嬴政的目光从徐福身上扫过，随后收敛起深沉的目光，“让她回去，去雍城之前，都不必来伺候了。”
既然已经有人误会他和徐福的关系了，那也就用不上胡姬了。
赵高闻言怔了怔，目光连连往徐福身上扫去。
徐福完全没察觉到赵高目光里的异样，他微微侧过身子，掩饰了一下自己想要打呵欠的冲动，等将身子再扭过来的时候，他的双眼又是水光潋滟的了。
宫人出去回了胡姬，却没能拦住胡姬。
她自以为是的独宠已经将她应有的小心翼翼都磨掉了。
“王上，王上为何如此待我？”胡姬拖着裙摆，风风火火地闯进来。寝殿内一片安静，胡姬一闯进来便正对上赵高那张冷漠的脸，与平时的和乐模样全然不同。
胡姬心中一颤，再抬头去看嬴政的方向，便发觉嬴政也正目光冷然地盯着她，胡姬心中直打鼓，腿也隐隐有些发软。
“嗯？”谁都不说话，徐福左右打量一番，忍不住发出了个音节，瞬间就将胡姬的目光吸引到他身上去了。
原本还心存畏惧的胡姬，一见徐福便顿时嫉妒心占了上风。
“王上何苦骗我？就算王上要宠幸他人，告诉胡姬便是。”胡姬眉眼低垂，柔媚的声音透着委屈的味道。
徐福皱了皱眉，他怎么觉得刚才胡姬似乎恨恨地瞥了他一眼？胡姬的声音实在柔媚过头了，也亏得秦始皇能消受，反正他是觉得一身鸡皮疙瘩难受死了。
嬴政对胡姬失去了耐性，“带她出去，禁足。”
胡姬陡然瞪大双眼，“王上……”模样泫然欲泣。
嬴政看着她的模样，就不由得想到如今越发荒唐的赵太后，都是从吕不韦手里出来的，他的脸色登时变得更为冷漠了。侍从跨进宫门来，生生将胡姬拖了出去。
胡姬的身影消失在了寝殿门前。
她不会还当他是男宠吧？徐福眉头微蹙，神色也清冷了几分，看上去倒是和旁边的嬴政如出一辙。
“打水来。”嬴政一甩袖袍，转身面对徐福。他的目光是放在徐福脸上的，话却是对宫人说的。
咸阳宫中的宫人早就被嬴政收服得服服帖帖，他们害怕嬴政发怒，低着头连忙出去准备热水了。
徐福从自己的思绪中醒过神来，正对上嬴政的目光，“王上看我做什么？”
“寡人觉得你对寡人的助益很大。”
虽然是平白被夸，但徐福还是非常不客气地收下了，“多谢王上。”
两人洗漱过后，徐福的目光又在寝殿里转悠起来了，嬴政见他模样，忍不住问：“你在找什么？”
“没有我的床吗？”难道秦始皇要让他打地铺？
嬴政一指那张完全可以容纳六人的大床，“自然是与寡人同眠。”
徐福压下心中的惊异。
秦始皇要和他也来个抵足而眠？
想一想，的确是比君臣同吃好听多了。说不定他徐福也能沾光，跟着载入史册，写上XX年，徐福与始皇君臣抵足而眠与帝王寝宫之中。也怪不得秦始皇并不担心将自己留在王宫里，会给他戴绿帽子呢，自己都快成二十四小时贴身了。不过另外一想，秦始皇的夜生活好像也被他剥夺了。
徐福思忖过后觉得反正自己也没吃亏，便无比自然地往床边走了。
谁敢让始皇帝睡床沿上呢？徐福很自觉地站在床边，要不是他那一身清冷气质太过明显，不然光看他乖乖站在那里，倒像是要伺候嬴政睡下一样。
嬴政看了一眼徐福，口气淡淡，却夹杂着几丝威严味道，不容拒绝，“你睡里面去，寡人身量高大，便睡外侧。”
徐福却一点也不觉得感动。
所以秦始皇是在嘲笑自己没他高大英俊风流吗？
徐福坐上这张所谓的“龙床”，打个旋儿就转上去躺下了。
嬴政方才走到床沿旁。秦人身材多魁梧，嬴政更是英武，他的身影几乎挡住了大半的烛光，徐福顿觉眼前一暗，抬头只能瞥见嬴政英俊的脸，因为“打光”的原因，显得极具压迫感。而面对这样气势浩瀚，几乎将徐福整个人都罩在里面的秦始皇，徐福抬起手，掩唇，自以为不着痕迹地打了个呵欠，眼睫还跟着动了动。
嬴政倒并没觉得这个动作无礼。
些微烛光从嬴政身后漏过，落在徐福的身上，更衬得他的眼眸明亮。
嬴政莫名觉得胸中的戾气被抚平了不少。
宫人躬着腰上前抖开被子，嬴政这才躺了上去。
床畔的烛火熄灭，困得要命的徐福很快就睡着了。
这是除去年少时，嬴政第一次和别人躺在一张床上共眠，本来他以为徐福或许会因为他睡在旁边而辗转难以入睡，良久过后，嬴政翻了个身，正好瞥见徐福熟睡的脸，褪去三分清冷。
嬴政：……
此时，窗外月光正好。
*
距离前往雍城还有好几日，嬴政每日必要晨起练武，用过早膳后还要读古籍，查堪舆图。有的时候徐福就坐在嬴政的下首位置，看着他的动作。
嬴政是个过分自律的人，他对自己严厉到了一种可怕的地步，也怪不得他能成长为一位伟大的帝王。徐福偶尔看着都觉得可怕，果然他还是只能当个擅长忽悠，有吃喝便好的神棍。
九月一日。
嬴政坐于案前处理事务。
徐福躲在围屏后小憩，身上还盖着嬴政命人找来的厚披风。
“王上，你还在等什么？此人若不除去？恐生大祸！”一道厉声突然在殿内炸开。
徐福陡然惊醒，身上的披风滑落，他却没有去捡，他小心翼翼地听着外面传来的动静。
那是吕不韦的声音！
他竟然是在斥责秦始皇？！

chapters.title: 第160章
chapters.translated_text:
Troubled by desire, the King of Qin tossed and turned, tossed and turned, tossed and turned... After failing to fall asleep several times, Xu Fu, whose sweet dreams had been disturbed, was very unhappy. He turned over, wrapped his arms around Ying Zheng’s waist, pinned him down to keep him from moving, and grumbled unhappily, "Sleepy..."

The sensation at his waist made Ying Zheng tremble involuntarily. Ying Zheng deeply felt that, at this moment, his and Xu Fu’s roles seemed to have been reversed.

However, upon seeing the weariness on Xu Fu’s face, the displeasure Ying Zheng had been bottling up dissipated instantly.

Because he had tossed and turned for most of the night and failed to sleep, Ying Zheng had a rare headache when he woke up the next day. There was no morning court today, so Ying Zheng lay on the bed, rubbing his temples to soothe the pain, while reaching out to pull Xu Fu toward him—only to find that he grabbed nothing but air.

He opened his eyes abruptly and looked beside him; the bedding was empty, and there was no sign of Xu Fu.

Ying Zheng’s expression darkened, and he summoned an attendant, "Where is Xu Fu?"

The attendant did not know what had happened in the palace last night and assumed that the King and Master Xu had spent a night of passion and that the King was in a good mood. Thus, he smiled brilliantly and said, "Master left the bedchamber early; perhaps he went to the side hall to see the two young princes."

Sleep-deprived and sexually frustrated, Ying Zheng’s expression grew even uglier. He rose from the bed, washed, changed into his robes, ate some food, and went to the side hall to look for Xu Fu.

No matter how Ying Zheng thought about it, Xu Fu’s demeanor yesterday had clearly been seductive, but for him to turn hostile in the blink of an eye was something Ying Zheng really couldn't fathom. Where exactly had he displeased Xu Fu, causing him to set aside his pride to act this way?

While lost in thought, Ying Zheng stepped into Huhai’s side hall.

Fusu should be studying right now; it was unlikely that Xu Fu would go looking for him.

Who would have thought that the confident Ying Zheng, upon stepping into the hall, would be greeted by an empty room? Ying Zheng’s brows furrowed even tighter. He turned and walked outside the hall, asking the attendant at the entrance, "Where are they?" The attendant rarely had the opportunity to speak to the King. Hearing the King’s sudden question, he felt anxious. When he looked up and saw Ying Zheng’s grim expression and sharp aura, his legs nearly gave way, and he almost knelt down.

The attendant barely managed to maintain his composure and not make a fool of himself. He stammered, "Prince Huhai and Master Xu have gone to the garden together."

Knowing their exact location, Ying Zheng’s expression finally looked a little less grim.

However, he would soon discover that he was truly... too! Naive!

·

At this time of year, there wasn't much fun to be had in the garden. There were too many mosquitoes; one could go for a stroll and return covered in red bumps.

But since the garden was filled with colorful flowers, it still held a strong attraction for young children.

Huhai wanted to go, and Xu Fu, feeling soft-hearted for a moment, agreed.

When the morning light first broke, after they had finished their meal, they went to the garden together.

Xu Fu ordered someone to light incense in the pavilion and casually fed Huhai a pill, which was said to repel mosquitoes. Only then did he sit down in the pavilion and place bamboo slips in front of him. While Huhai was busy destroying flowers nearby, Xu Fu quietly flipped through the witchcraft bamboo slips in front of him.

He was studying very seriously—how to cast a curse.

Last time, when he was trapped in Xiong Yi’s mansion, he had seriously wanted to learn how to cast curses.

At times like these, divination was useless; witchcraft was what mattered! As expected, he would have to let Huhai learn witchcraft in the future!

The palace servants stood to the side, finding the scene exceptionally pleasing to the eye, but before long, this scene was broken.

A woman’s voice cut in.

"Princess, the King of Qin is occupied by that Xu Fu every single day. What are we to do?"

Another female voice sighed softly, "We don't have many days left to wait, what else can we do? Let's just think of another way."

The mistress and her servant were completely unaware that the subjects of their conversation were in the pavilion not far from them.

Hearing this dialogue, the palace servants’ expressions turned incredibly strange.

What a truly shameless pair of mistress and servant... To be able to smear Master Xu behind his back like this was truly despicable!

"In this palace, although our freedom is not restricted, if I cannot gain the favor of the King of Qin, I will have come here in vain." Zhao Yan’s tone was not dejected; she was likely still planning in her heart how to get closer to Ying Zheng.

Xu Fu could no longer focus on any curses. He pushed the bamboo slips aside and said, "Someone, go and invite the Princess of Zhao."

The palace servants looked up and carefully observed Xu Fu. Seeing his cold expression with no emotions leaking out, they couldn't help but feel their hearts sink in unison.

"Yes," a palace maid replied and hurried toward the Princess of Zhao.

Xu Fu also detested the act of judging people behind their backs. Since they wanted to talk, they might as well come and say it to his face.

"Ah!" Not long after the maid went around, a woman’s shriek rang out, followed by a rustling sound. Seeing the maid suddenly appear, they must have been startled into a panic.

After a while, Zhao Yan and her maid walked over from that direction, both looking quite displeased.

Zhao Yan was usually a very composed person, but at a time like this, no one could remain calm. Especially when Zhao Yan thought about how, as a Princess of Zhao, she had been bad-mouthing someone behind their back and had been so unfortunately overheard, she felt incredibly ashamed.

"Xu, Commandant Xu." As soon as Zhao Yan saw Xu Fu, she couldn't help but blush.

Although everyone knew that Zhao Yan was blushing because she had just been bad-mouthing someone and finally felt shame, some people didn't know that.

Ying Zheng had finally found Xu Fu and was striding into the garden. Just as he was about to reach Xu Fu’s side, two women emerged, and one of them was blushing as she approached Xu Fu. Oh, this woman was the Princess of Zhao.

The Princess of Zhao...

Ying Zheng’s brows furrowed tightly.

The Princess of Zhao, daring to approach Xu Fu? How bold!

Ying Zheng did not hesitate; he immediately quickened his pace and walked to the pavilion. As soon as the palace servants saw him, they knelt down and called out, "Your Majesty."

Zhao Yan’s heart sank instantly.

It was over. She didn't know if the King of Qin had seen or heard just now. The image she had painstakingly cultivated for so long was going to be ruined just because she couldn't keep her mouth shut today? Zhao Yan bit her lip, her eyes shimmering. She regretted it deeply, but at this moment, she could only think of the fastest way to salvage her image. Cry; when a woman shows weakness, it can always evoke some pity.

In the past, Zhao Yan would have disdained such tactics, but now she had no choice but to use them.

Xu Fu glanced at the approaching Ying Zheng and lifted his chin, his posture so cold and arrogant that he didn't even spare him an extra look.

Ying Zheng: Did I do something wrong again???

Thinking of this, Ying Zheng was incredibly annoyed. I should be the one who is angry! It was one thing to tease me yesterday, but to leave me behind first thing this morning and then secretly come to the garden to meet the Princess of Zhao!

I just came to interrupt for a moment, and you’re giving me the cold shoulder?!

Ying Zheng looked at the Princess of Zhao, finding her more of an eyesore the more he looked. Thinking of how the concubines in the palace used to have a fondness for Xu Fu—those women now stayed obediently in the inner palace, eating and drinking all day, not coming out easily unless there was a reason—but this Princess of Zhao wanted to rely on her status to do as she pleased in the palace?

She didn't even look to see whose place this was! This was his, Ying Zheng’s, place!

Because both Ying Zheng and Xu Fu remained silent for a long time, the atmosphere became extremely awkward. Zhao Yan was trembling under Ying Zheng’s cold gaze, and she couldn't help but call out softly, "Your Majesty?"

Ying Zheng didn't even look at her. He turned around, looked coldly at Xu Fu, and said, "Someone, drive them away."

Last time it was to invite them away; this time it was to drive them away. It was clear that Ying Zheng had lost all courtesy toward them.

As intelligent as Zhao Yan was, she naturally heard the difference immediately. Her face turned deathly pale, and she gripped her maid’s sleeve tightly. He really had heard! He really had heard!

"Your, Your Majesty, I do not know what I have done wrong to make Your Majesty so merciless..." Zhao Yan asked with trembling lips.

Ying Zheng’s impatience had reached its peak. Zhao Yan’s weak voice sounded to him like a tactic to seduce Xu Fu. Heh, such a woman might even be more cunning than the Hu women. How could someone as simple (?) as Xu Fu resist? It was better for him to simply banish her from Xu Fu’s side.

Ying Zheng snorted coldly, "Princess of Zhao, this is not the place for you. If you continue to wander about so recklessly, I will order someone to send you back to Zhao." Thinking of this, the more he thought about it, the more he felt she should be sent back.

It was the ministers of Qin who wanted the Princess of Zhao, but they wouldn't marry her themselves; they were all counting on him to marry her. In reality, his determination to destroy Zhao would not change. To avoid people saying that he attacked Zhao even after they sent a princess, he would simply send the princess back, clearly indicating: no matter what you send, I will still beat you.

Ying Zheng frowned and said, "Someone, inform the Zhao envoys to come and take their princess back."

The attendants moved at his command, surrounding them.

Zhao Yan’s expression changed completely now. Her hand gripping the maid’s sleeve lost its grip, and she collapsed to the ground.

Her head was buzzing, and for a moment, even breathing became difficult. She dared not imagine what kind of treatment she would face after being sent back to her country. The favorite concubines of her father would certainly use this opportunity to crush her into the mud.

"No, Your Majesty... I..."

Zhao Yan’s lips trembled, and she couldn't form a sentence.

Xu Fu was also stunned.

This change happened so fast that even Xu Fu was unprepared. Was Ying Zheng truly willing to send her away just like that? Xu Fu, feeling the impact, had complicated feelings. It seemed like he should be happy, but there was also surprise and a faint sense of awkwardness.

"Your Majesty, Zhao and Qin have always been allied through marriage. Why, why must Your Majesty go to such lengths? Even if I am lacking in beauty and virtue, can I not be a concubine to Your Majesty?" Her fingernails dug deep into her palms, her expression miserable and pleading; it could be said that she had laid down all her dignity.

Her maid was somewhat panicked. She had originally wanted to blame Xu Fu, but no matter how foolish she was, she knew that the King of Qin was present and could not be provoked. She could only look at Zhao Yan dryly, "Princess..." The maid had originally had such high hopes.

Zhao Yan was a princess, beautiful, and capable of bearing heirs.

Xu Fu only had outstanding looks, but how long could beauty last? He couldn't bear sons, had no proper status; what could he do?

The maid hadn't stopped to think: for whom was Ying Zheng’s harem currently existing in name only? If one were to talk about beauty not lasting, it should be Ying Zheng, as he was older than Xu Fu. As for sons, there was no need to worry; Huhai and Fusu had already accepted Xu Fu as their father. Would Ying Zheng need other sons?

It was fortunate she didn't say these things out loud. If she hadn't been able to stop herself, they might have been able to stay—but the thing that would stay would be their lives.

Ying Zheng was overbearing by nature; how could he allow others to comment on the relationship between him and Xu Fu?

...

"Please, Your Majesty, retract your previous words..." Zhao Yan said with tears streaming down her face.

Xu Fu sat back in the pavilion, expressionlessly fiddling with the bamboo slips, watching how Ying Zheng would handle it. The Princess of Zhao was pitiful for coming all this way to sacrifice herself to save her country from destruction. But pity was pity; Xu Fu would not let her annoy him because of it.

His relationship with Ying Zheng was a serious romance! Could he allow others to interfere?

With their positions being different, Xu Fu wouldn't feel even a shred of pity for the Princess of Zhao, and he certainly wouldn't plead for her in front of Ying Zheng. Moreover, since Ying Zheng could order the Princess of Zhao away so mercilessly, if he were to step in and ask Ying Zheng to show mercy, wouldn't that be like slapping Ying Zheng in the face? Xu Fu didn't consider himself sick, so he simply didn't intervene.

"Even if your father were here, he wouldn't dare ask me to retract my words," Ying Zheng said expressionlessly. "There is no marriage alliance between Zhao and Qin. From my reign onwards, there never will be."

Zhao Yan stared with teary eyes, slumped on the ground, truly not knowing what words could make Ying Zheng change his mind.

It was a joke to think Ying Zheng would welcome Zhao.

Although Zhao and Qin shared some blood ties, look at how Zhao had treated Qin in the past? Both Ying Zheng and Ying Yiren had been hostages in Zhao. Ying Yiren was fine, but Ying Zheng had been subjected to constant oppression. That was a very bad memory.

Now that Zhao Yan was trying to build a relationship with Ying Zheng, it would be strange if Ying Zheng weren't angry.

Xu Fu also thought of this. He turned to look at Ying Zheng’s expression; it was gloomy and cold, clearly recalling that unpleasant memory.

Xu Fu hesitated for a moment, stood up, walked to Ying Zheng’s side, and reached out to grab the back of his hand.

Ying Zheng was startled, and the anger in his heart subsided quite a bit. However, he still thought with some displeasure: Xu Fu wouldn't plead for this Princess of Zhao, would he?

Naturally, Xu Fu said nothing.

After Ying Zheng noticed this, his expression softened even more.

Zhao Yan looked up at their joined hands, then hardened her heart and kowtowed in Xu Fu’s direction, "Commandant Xu, I have offended you greatly before. Please, Commandant Xu, let me stay in the palace... If I return to Zhao, it will be a dead end."

Failing to beg Ying Zheng, she was now begging him? Xu Fu was surprised and stepped back unobtrusively. He dared not accept this gesture from the Princess of Zhao, nor did he want to.

"Commandant Xu..." Zhao Yan looked at him with teary eyes, attempting to gain a shred of Xu Fu’s sympathy.

Ying Zheng, however, was furious. He pulled Xu Fu behind him and looked at the attendants, "Cover their mouths and take them away."

Hearing this, the attendants knew the King was truly angry and that there would be no room for negotiation. They stepped forward, efficiently seized the two women, covered their mouths, and began dragging them away.

The maid could no longer hold back. She suddenly lunged forward and shrieked, "Why does the King of Qin treat the Princess like this? Is it because of what he said?" The maid pointed at Xu Fu, saying with extreme hatred, "Such a sycophant, who cannot even bear heirs for the King of Qin in the future, the King of Qin..." The maid’s voice came to an abrupt halt.

The attendant was quick-witted; he kicked the woman to the ground, grabbed her by the throat, lifted her up, and dragged her out with lightning speed.

Zhao Yan was so terrified she went numb. Her mouth opened and closed, unable to speak another word, and she could only watch helplessly as the attendant covered her mouth and dragged her away.

Ying Zheng watched with a murderous aura in the direction the maid had been dragged. After a long while, he withdrew his gaze and held Xu Fu’s hand back.

Xu Fu was stunned.

That maid was so bold; how dare she say such things in front of Ying Zheng?

Was he a sycophant?

Xu Fu felt there was nothing to deny; Ying Zheng did indeed favor him to the extreme. In the eyes of others, he inevitably became a sycophant, but none of Ying Zheng’s harem concubines had ever said a word against him; how could it be the turn of a Zhao palace maid to criticize him?

"Father..." Huhai’s timid voice sounded not far away.

Xu Fu looked over and realized Huhai had been standing there for a while. He beckoned to Huhai, who quickly ran to his side and whispered, "Father already has sons; he won't want anyone else to bear them."

Ying Zheng’s expression slowly relaxed, and he nodded, "That is natural. I have Fusu and Huhai; that is enough."

Even if the maid hadn't finished her sentence, Ying Zheng could guess what she was thinking.

When the world was unified, he would naturally let these people know who could sit as his Queen.

Who would talk to him about rules?

Which of the past Kings of Qin were people who cared about rules?

Xu Fu squeezed Huhai’s chubby little hand and asked calmly, "Besides a Princess of Zhao, are there any other princesses in the palace now? Will anyone else run up to me, revealing their intention to marry you, either directly or indirectly?"

Ying Zheng shivered involuntarily.

He... seemed to, seemed to understand where Xu Fu’s odd behavior was coming from?
chapters.source_text:
被欲望所困扰的秦王，辗转反侧、辗转反侧、辗转反侧……数次之后难以入睡，被扰到清梦的徐福很是不高兴，转身抱着嬴政的腰身，箍着他不让动，嘴里不悦道：“困……”
腰间的触感让嬴政浑身不自觉地一颤，嬴政深深觉得，此刻自己和徐福的角色仿佛颠倒了一般。
不过目光触及到徐福面上的倦色后，嬴政心头憋着的不快，顿时全都消散了。
因为折腾了大半宿都没能入睡的缘故，第二日嬴政醒来时，难得有了些头疼。今日不朝，嬴政便躺在了床榻上，揉着额角舒缓疼痛，同时伸手去揽徐福，谁知却一揽一个空。
他霎地睁开眼，一看自己身侧，被窝空空，并不见徐福人影。
嬴政面色一沉，唤来内侍，“徐福呢？”
内侍并不知昨晚殿中发生了何事，还当王上与徐先生一夜春宵，现在心情正好，遂笑得无比灿烂道：“先生早早便出了寝宫，或许是偏殿瞧两位公子了吧。”
睡眠不足以及欲求不满的嬴政，此时面色更为难看了，他从床榻上起身，洗漱过后换上衣袍，用了些食物便去偏殿寻徐福的身影了。
嬴政怎么思考，都觉得昨日徐福的姿态明明是在引诱他，但一转眼就翻脸，嬴政就实在不大能想得明白了，他可是何处引得徐福不满了？才让徐福能舍下面子这样做。
正思虑间，嬴政就已经踏进胡亥的偏殿了。
扶苏此时应当正在读书，徐福不大可能会去寻他。
谁知晓，信心满满的嬴政一踏进殿中，迎接他的就是一个空空如也的偏殿。嬴政眉头皱得更紧，他转身走到殿外，问那殿门口的内侍：“人呢？”那内侍平日里哪里有机会能同王上说话啊，骤然听见王上发问，他心中还忐忑着呢，一抬头，见嬴政面色难看，气质凌厉，差点双腿一软跪倒下去。
内侍好不容易才维持住了没让自己出丑，他哆嗦着道：“胡亥公子与徐先生一同，到花园去了。”
知道准确方位的嬴政，脸色总算没有那般难看了。
不过他很快就会发现，自己真是……太！天！真！了！
·
这个时节，花园里实在没甚好玩儿的，蚊虫实在多，出去逛一圈，回来便能收获一身的红疙瘩。
但奈何花园里开满了姹紫嫣红的花，对于小孩子来说，还是有着较强吸引力的。
胡亥想去，徐福一时心软，就答应了。
清晨天光初亮时分，他们用过饭食后，就一同到了花园之中。
徐福命人在亭中点上香，又顺手给胡亥喂了颗药丸，据说是能驱蚊虫的。然后他才在亭中落座，面前摆上书简。胡亥在一旁辣手摧花，徐福就安静地翻阅着面前的巫术竹简。
他很认真地在看着，如何下诅咒呢。
上次被困在熊义府中，他是很认真地想要学习诅咒啊。
在这样的时候，卜筮什么用也没有啊，还是巫术有用！以后果然得让胡亥学巫术才是！
宫人们退居一边，只觉得这样一幕分外的赏心悦目，偏偏没过多久，这样一幕就被人打破了。
有女子的声音插了进来。
“公主，秦王日日被那徐福霸占，我们可如何是好？”
另一道女声轻叹了一声，“我们所能等的时日不多了，还能如何？且再想一想办法就是。”
那对主仆全然不知就在距离她们不远的亭子里，便有她们对话中的主人公。
宫人们听着这段对话，脸色顿时变得万分诡异。
真是好生厚颜无耻的一对主仆啊……还能在背后抹黑徐先生，实在是令人不齿啊！
“在这王宫之中，虽我们的自由并未禁锢，但是若不能得到秦王看中，我便是白来一回了。”赵嫣的语气并不低落，估摸着她还在心中打算，如何才能接近嬴政。
徐福顿时什么诅咒也看不进去了，他将手边的竹简推远，“来人，去请赵国公主。”
宫人们抬起头来，小心地打量徐福，见徐福面色冰冷，毫无情绪外泄，忍不住齐齐心下一沉。
“喏。”有宫女应了一声，快步往赵国公主那边去了。
徐福也极为厌恶在背后评判人的举动，既然要说，那不如便请她们到自己跟前来说好了。
“啊！”那宫女绕过去之后没一会儿，便有女子的惊叫声响起，紧接着便是一阵窸窸窣窣的声音。突然看见宫女出来的她们，应当是被吓了个惊慌失措。
又过了一会儿，赵嫣才和她的宫女从那边走了过来，二人面色都不大好看。
赵嫣本来是极为镇定的性子了，但是在这样的时候，谁也镇定不起来。尤其是赵嫣想到，自己身为赵国公主，竟是这样在背后说人家，还那么不凑巧被人听到了，便顿时觉得羞耻无比。
“徐、徐都尉。”赵嫣一见了徐福，便忍不住面颊泛红。
虽然众人都知道，赵嫣脸红是因为她刚才在背后说了人坏话，如今终于知道羞耻了。但是有的人是不知道的啊。
嬴政好不容易寻到徐福的身影，于是大步走进花园之中，眼看着便要走到徐福身旁去了，偏偏此时钻出了两个女人来，其中一个女人还面颊发红地迎向徐福。哦，这个女人是赵国公主。
赵国公主……
嬴政眉头紧皱。
赵国公主，竟敢接近徐福？好大的胆子！
嬴政不再犹豫，当即加快了脚步，走到亭子前去，宫人们一见了他，当即便跪了下来，口呼“王上”。
赵嫣心中顿时就沉了下去。
完了，不知刚才秦王是否也看见听见了。她苦心经营许久的形象，竟是因为今日一时没能把住嘴，就要这样没了吗？赵嫣咬了咬唇，眼眸里波光点点。她心中后悔不已，但这个时候她只能想着如何用最快的方式来为自己挽回形象。哭吧，女人示弱的时候，总是能让人怜惜几分的。
以前赵嫣不屑这样的手段，但此时她却不得不用了。
徐福扫了一眼走上前来的嬴政，抬了抬下巴，姿态冷傲得连多余的眼神都不分给他一个。
嬴政：寡人又错了？？？
思及此，嬴政心中恼怒无比。该是寡人生气才对吧！昨日戏耍寡人也就罢了，今日一早便将寡人扔下不见人影，竟然还私到花园来会赵国公主！
寡人不就是来打断了一下吗？你还给寡人脸色看？！
嬴政瞧着那赵国公主，越瞧越觉得碍眼。想一想从前宫中姬妾便对徐福多有好感，那些女人如今都乖觉地待在后宫里，整日吃吃喝喝，无事不会轻易出来，但这个赵国公主，却是要仗着自己的身份，便要在王宫中为所欲为吗？
也不瞧一瞧，这是什么地方！这是他嬴政的地方！
因为嬴政、徐福都久久未开口，气氛一时间尴尬到了极点，赵嫣被嬴政冰冷的目光打量得浑身颤抖，她实在忍不住出声轻唤了一声，“秦王？”
嬴政看也不看她，直接回转身来，目光冷冷地看着徐福，道：“来人，将她们赶走。”
上次是请走，这次是赶走。可见嬴政已经对她们失去了客气。
赵嫣如何聪慧的人，当然也是立时便听出了其中的差异，她的面色煞白，紧紧攥住了身边宫女的衣袖，他果然是听见了！果然听见了！
“秦、秦王，不知赵嫣何处有错，才让秦王这般毫不留情……”赵嫣嘴唇哆嗦着问道。
嬴政心中的不耐已经升到了极点。赵嫣如此柔弱的声音，在他耳中都成了要勾引徐福的手段，呵，这样的女人，说不定比胡姬都要有手段多了。徐福这样单纯（？）的性子怎能抵挡？还是让寡人来干脆将她从徐福跟前驱逐吧。
嬴政冷哼道：“赵国公主，你应该待的地方不是此处，若是再这样肆意行走，寡人便命人送你回赵国去。”说到这里，嬴政越想越觉得就该送回去。
想要赵国公主的是秦国一干大臣，但他们又不会娶这位公主，全是指望着自己去娶。而实际上，自己想要灭掉赵国的心是不会改变的。未免有人说赵国送来公主，自己却还攻打赵国，那就干脆将公主送回去，明确表示，你送什么来，寡人都要揍你。
嬴政皱了皱眉，道：“来人，告知赵国使臣，将他们的公主接回去。”
侍从闻声而动，将她们围在了中间。
赵嫣的脸色这下是彻底变了，她抓着宫女衣袖的手一个不稳，顿时便软倒在了地上。
她的脑子里嗡嗡作响，那瞬间连呼吸都变得困难了起来，她不敢想象等自己被送回国之后，会遭遇什么样的对待。父王身边的宠姬定然会利用这个机会，将她打入泥土之中。
“不，秦王……我……”
赵嫣嘴唇哆嗦着，语不成句。
徐福也愣了愣。
这一瞬间的变化来得太快了，连徐福都毫无准备。嬴政是当真舍得，就这样将人送走？受到冲击的徐福，心中的滋味有些复杂。好像是该喜悦，但还有惊讶，还有种淡淡的别扭。
“秦王，赵国秦国素来都是姻亲之国，为何，为何秦王定要做到如此地步？赵嫣虽然无貌无德，但与秦王做个姬妾，也不成吗？”她的指甲死死掐进掌心，面色凄楚哀求，可以说是放下了她全部的尊严。
她身边的宫女有些慌乱，原本不服气地想要指责徐福之过，但是她就算再愚笨，也知道秦王在跟前，是不能招惹的。她只能干巴巴地看着赵嫣，“公主……”原本那宫女想得多好啊。
赵嫣是公主，长得美丽，又能生下子嗣。
徐福不过容貌出众，但容色能维持几载？他生不下儿子，没有正经的名分，他能如何？
那宫女倒是不曾想一想，嬴政如今的后宫名存实亡是为谁？要说容色维持不了几载的，那应当是说嬴政吧，毕竟他比徐福年纪大。儿子就更不用操心了，胡亥和扶苏都默认徐福为父亲了，嬴政还会需要其他儿子吗？
也幸好她没将这些话说出来，若是一个收不住说出来了，到时候说不定她们就能留下了，只不过留下的却是那条命了。
嬴政性子霸道，怎会允许他人这样评论他和徐福之间的感情？
……
“请秦王收回方才的话吧……”赵嫣泪水涟涟地道。
徐福坐回亭子中，面无表情地摆弄着面前的竹简，他就看嬴政如何处理。赵国公主为了不亡国，千里迢迢来献身，是很可怜。但是可怜归可怜，徐福不会因此就放纵她来膈应自己。
他和嬴政的关系都成正经谈恋爱的了！他还能容许别人插足吗？
立场不同，徐福便不会为赵国公主心软半分，他更不会在嬴政面前为之求情了。何况嬴政能这样毫不留情地命人送走赵国公主，他还凑上前去让嬴政留个情，那他不是有病到去打嬴政的脸吗？徐福自认没病，所以他干脆不插手。
“就算你老子到了这里，也不敢让寡人收回说过的话。”嬴政面无表情地道，“赵秦两国也并无什么姻亲关系，从寡人之后，永世不会再有。”
赵嫣瞪大泪眼，瘫坐在地，实在不知该用什么话才能让嬴政回心转意了。
嬴政会待见赵国那还真是笑话。
赵国与秦国虽然有部分的血缘关系，但是瞧一瞧从前赵国是如何对秦国的？嬴政和嬴异人，可都是在赵国做了质子的。嬴异人还好，而嬴政却是饱受欺压。那是一段极为不好的记忆。
如今赵嫣还试图来与嬴政拉关系，嬴政不怒才奇怪。
徐福也想到了这一点，他转头看了看嬴政的面色，阴沉冰冷，显然是想到了那段令他不快的记忆。
徐福犹豫了一下，站起身走到嬴政的身旁，伸手抓住了他的手背。
嬴政一怔，心头的怒火已经平息了不少，但是他心中还有些不虞地想着，徐福总不会为了这赵国公主向他求情吧？
徐福自然是什么也没说。
嬴政察觉到这一点之后，面色越加和缓。
赵嫣抬起头，看了看两人交握的手，顿时一狠心，冲着徐福的方向磕了个头，“徐都尉，之前是我多有冒犯，求徐都尉留我在宫中吧……赵嫣若是回国，便是死路。”
求嬴政不成，这是求到自己跟前来了？徐福心中惊讶，不着痕迹地往后退了退。赵国公主这一礼，他不敢受，也并不想受。
“徐都尉……”赵嫣泪眼朦胧地看着他，企图换得徐福一丝心软。
嬴政此时却是怒不可遏，他将徐福拉到身后去，看向一旁的侍从，“堵上嘴，把人送走。”
侍从闻言，知道王上是当真怒了，不会再有一丝转圜的余地了，侍从上前，动作利落地将那二人押了起来，捂着嘴便要往外拖。
那宫女再也忍不住了，突然一下子蹿了起来，尖声道：“秦王为何如此对公主？可是因为他说了什么？”那宫女抬手指着徐福的方向，无比愤恨道：“这等佞宠，日后又不能为秦王产下子嗣，秦王……”那宫女的声音戛然而止。
侍从眼疾手快，将人踹翻在地，然后掐住脖子提了起来，动作极快地将人拖了出去。
赵嫣吓得整个人都木了，嘴巴张张合合，再也说不出话来，只能无力地看着侍从捂着自己的嘴，将自己拖了出去。
嬴政面带煞气地看着那宫女被拖走的方向，好半晌才收回了目光，反握住了徐福的手。
徐福都呆住了。
那个宫女好大的胆子，竟然敢在嬴政跟前说出这些话来？
他是佞宠？
徐福觉得也没什么好否认的，嬴政的确待他荣宠至极，在别人眼中难免成为奸佞，但是嬴政那一干后宫姬妾都未曾说过一句不是，怎么轮得到一个赵国的宫女来指责？
“父王……”胡亥怯怯的声音在不远处响起。
徐福看过去，才发现胡亥已经站在那里有一会儿了。他冲胡亥招了招手，胡亥连忙跑到了他的腿边，低声道：“父王有儿子了，不会再要别人生了。”
嬴政的面色慢慢放松下来，他点头应道：“这是自然，寡人有扶苏、胡亥足以。”
那宫女就算话没能说完，嬴政也能猜到她在想什么。
等到天下一统，他自然会让这些人知晓，他嬴政的王后，只有谁才能来坐。
谁若和他说规矩？
历任秦王哪个是好讲规矩的人？
徐福捏了捏胡亥的小肥手，淡淡地问道：“除了一个赵国公主，如今宫中可还有什么公主？可还会有人跑到我的跟前来，明里暗里透露要嫁给你的意思？”
嬴政不自觉地打了个寒颤。
他……好像、好像明白徐福的不对劲从何而来了？
