Crossbows had long existed during the Warring States period and were already being used in warfare. However, due to manufacturing limitations, standard crossbows had a range of only about a hundred meters, and heavy crossbows were unsuitable for carrying during rapid marches. Furthermore, they were not easy to construct. Although the Qin army had brought crossbows this time, they were far inferior in power to the one that had just fired that arrow.

Xu Fu vaguely knew that the crossbow reached its peak during the Song Dynasty. The Song Dynasty had a wide variety of crossbows, the most famous being the "bed crossbow" (chuangzi nu) and the "divine arm crossbow" (shenbi nu). He didn't know much about the divine arm crossbow, but he knew of the bed crossbow because it had been mentioned by too many people and appeared frequently in literary works. Surely Zheng You'an wouldn't be insane enough to bring a bed crossbow to the Warring States period, would he?

Xu Fu pushed away Ying Zheng’s arm and struggled to sit up, but Ying Zheng gripped his waist tightly. "Don't move around."

Xu Fu’s gaze went past the chariot, looking toward where the long arrow had landed.

The general who had been riding alongside them just moments ago was pinned to the ground by the long arrow—and it had pinned three people together in one shot.

The nearby Qin soldiers were stunned, but after the initial shock, they reacted.

The pent-up frustration and fear from before burned fiercely, turning into a raging fire in their hearts. The Qin army was inherently brave and fearless; their momentary retreat had only stemmed from their awe of the unknown. It did not mean they were truly willing to back down. The ferocity of the Qin army was carved into their bones; once their bloodlust was stirred, how could they retreat?

The sounds of slaughter shook the heavens as the Qin army charged toward the Zhao army.

Meng Tian’s expression was cold and stern as he also drew his long spear and moved forward.

The attendants guarding the chariot also looked grim, but they were wary of the Qin King’s safety and dared not leave their posts. Xu Fu and Ying Zheng stood up. Xu Fu opened his mouth to speak, but Ying Zheng spoke first: "It is nothing, do not worry. Although that heavy crossbow is powerful, it must be operated by several people simultaneously and is difficult to reload quickly. Now is the perfect time to attack."

That was exactly what Xu Fu had wanted to say. He had heard that the Song Dynasty's bed crossbows sometimes required dozens of men to draw; the Zhao army wouldn't be able to fire again so quickly. Moreover, while this weapon had great lethality, it was absolutely impossible for it to wipe out a whole area in one go. It was a good choice for sniping enemy leaders, though. He wondered if Xiong Yi had made repeating crossbows, or something that could fire a volley... such things would be much more practical on the battlefield.

Ying Zheng called over a small soldier. "Do you have a bow and arrows?"

It was the soldier's first time speaking to the King of Qin at such close range, and he stuttered as he finished his sentence: "Y-yes, I will go g-get them for you immediately." With that, the soldier ran off like a wisp of smoke.

Xu Fu’s heart began to beat rapidly. He remembered the scene where Zheng You'an had failed to hit Wang Jian with an arrow and had been shot in return. Xu Fu had to admit that he was looking forward to seeing Ying Zheng shoot an arrow; what a heroic sight that must be.

The soldier soon returned with the bow and arrows.

The attendants dispersed around them, their expressions filled with excitement. There wasn't one among them who wasn't looking forward to seeing the heroic posture of the King of Qin; this might even become the most precious memory of their lives!

Xu Fu had a rough estimate of Ying Zheng’s combat prowess.

That set of abs couldn't have grown for nothing... and he remembered that every time he touched Ying Zheng’s arms, he could clearly feel the hard muscles beneath.

Xu Fu realized his thoughts were becoming increasingly lewd, so he quickly stopped the urge to continue that line of thinking.

When he looked up at Ying Zheng again, Ying Zheng already held the bow in his hand. He placed his right hand on the string, his muscles tensing. Xu Fu could catch a glimpse of the focused and cold expression on his face. Xu Fu shifted his gaze uncomfortably, finally following the direction the arrowhead was pointing. Xu Fu didn't know if his eyes were playing tricks on him, but that direction... was it Xiong Yi? It turned out he had been hiding in the crowd the whole time, but because he was being supported in the middle, he didn't look very conspicuous. That arrow just now must have been ordered by him, and that arrow... if Ying Zheng hadn't tackled him to dodge it, it would have been aimed at both of them, and it would have been them pinned to the ground.

Xu Fu knew very well that he and Xiong Yi had long since reached a point of no return; neither would feel any sympathy for the other.

Ying Zheng drew the bow and released the arrow. He didn't aim excessively, nor was he overly cautious. When Xu Fu heard the "swish" of the arrow breaking through the air, it flew out with such speed that it only left a blur in Xu Fu’s eyes.

Ying Zheng had immense arm strength, and the arrow flew toward Xiong Yi.

The next moment, Xu Fu saw the soldier supporting Xiong Yi being carried to the ground by the arrow. Xu Fu didn't need to look to know that the soldier had definitely been pierced through the heart.

Ying Zheng did not stop; he drew the bow and shot again.

The soldiers behind Xiong Yi rushed to fill the gap, trying to support him and retreat, but the moment the soldier stepped in, another arrow flew out. Xu Fu felt that under the sunlight, he could catch the cold glint on the arrowhead, carrying a sharp, murderous aura.

Xu Fu’s heart tightened, and his breathing became involuntarily rapid.

He rarely felt such slight nervousness, but it wasn't a nervousness born of fear; it was nervousness from being overly excited.

This image of Ying Zheng was deeply imprinted in his eyes. He felt that at this moment, Ying Zheng could command all of his attention. It was the complete release of masculine charm.

Only at this moment did Xu Fu have the realization: Ah, so I really am gay.

Xu Fu steadied himself and looked toward the Zhao army. The soldier beside Xiong Yi had fallen again, forcing Xiong Yi’s group to retreat repeatedly. Even if Xu Fu couldn't see the expression on Xiong Yi’s face, he could guess that it was livid. Ying Zheng’s actions were a fierce slap to his face.

Drawing a bow and shooting was extremely exhausting. After firing several arrows, Ying Zheng ordered someone to bring him another long arrow.

The muscles in his arms tensed again, and the long arrow flew from his hand.

It looked like just a casual shot, but that arrow seemed to have eyes, striking straight at Xiong Yi. Xu Fu vaguely caught a glimpse of blood splashing as Xiong Yi fell backward. The soldiers behind him were caught off guard and scrambled to support him. With their commander injured again, Xu Fu could imagine how chaotic the Zhao army must be.

Meanwhile, the Qin army fought with increasing courage. Under the shifting maneuvers and pincer attacks, the Zhao army’s formation was almost crushed and unable to hold its shape.

Someone shouted "Retreat," and the Zhao army had no choice but to scatter from the battlefield once again.

The Qin army pursued for a while, killed some Zhao soldiers, and then returned.

Meng Tian’s eyes flickered. He jumped off his horse and smiled at Ying Zheng: "The King is as heroic and fierce as ever."

Ying Zheng only smiled faintly and said nothing more. It was only when he turned his head and noticed the slight admiration in Xu Fu’s eyes that the smile on Ying Zheng’s face suddenly widened.

As they withdrew to the camp, Meng Tian spoke to Xu Fu and Ying Zheng about the strange things they had seen earlier.

"I discovered that their horses had some very strange things on them, covering the horse's back, which actually allowed people to steady their posture... truly strange..." Meng Tian’s face couldn't hide his amazement.

Xu Fu was speechless.

Another invention from later generations.

It must be stirrups and saddles.

These two things didn't exist yet, which was why there was no such thing as cavalry. Xu Fu also disliked riding horses of this era because it was truly too difficult to fix yourself on the horse's back; you never knew when you might be thrown off. If cavalry were prevalent at this time, perhaps the Qin State could have conquered the other states much earlier. Although Xu Fu didn't know much about military affairs, he knew the power of cavalry.

Both Meng Tian and Ying Zheng noticed the change in Xu Fu’s expression. They stared at him, and Meng Tian was the first to ask in a low voice: "Does the Shu-zhang know what those are?"

"Stirrups and saddles. They make it easier to mount a horse and can fix a person onto the horse's back, allowing the rider to free up both hands to hold weapons," Xu Fu said in a low voice. He paused, not forgetting to add: "However, I do not know the production process for these two things, and I can't even draw a diagram."

"So we must still obtain the things recorded by Zheng You'an," Ying Zheng said in a low voice.

If it were this, it could actually pique his interest. If such divine artifacts really existed and could be crafted for the Qin army, what kind of force would the Qin army become? Ying Zheng felt full of anticipation just thinking about it; his heart was racing deep inside.

That was the instinctive craving of his ambition for such things.

Xu Fu also saw what Ying Zheng was thinking. But that thing wasn't something you could just get your hands on immediately just because you knew where it was. Xiong Yi knew the benefits of that thing, so naturally, he wouldn't leave it lying around. When he was guarding it so carefully, how could Xu Fu manage to get his hands on it?

After returning to the military camp, Jianjia immediately crowded around and asked about Xiong Yi again.

Xu Fu frowned slightly. "Jianjia, have you still not given up?"

Jianjia nodded eagerly, his face full of excitement: "Since the first strike didn't hit, I naturally cannot give up. Having failed with Xiong Yi, I must succeed next time!"

"Lord Longyang is not here..." Xu Fu hesitated.

Jianjia interrupted him with some excitement: "Even if Lord Longyang were here, he would definitely agree!"

Xu Fu thought Jianjia was talking nonsense; if Lord Longyang were here, he wouldn't even dare to say such things.

Bo Zhou said in a deep voice: "If Jianjia is willing to go, let him go." The four of them had been together for a long time, and he knew Jianjia’s personality very well. After all, Jianjia was still young. Although he wouldn't have the slightest hesitation when killing someone, his nature was essentially innocent and impulsive. The more you forbade him from doing something, the more stubborn he might become.

Xu Fu frowned and remained silent.

Jianjia didn't say anything more. Seeing his expression, Bo Zhou felt it was a bad sign and immediately spoke up: "Sir, Jianjia has a wild temper; I’ve troubled you..." This was a subtle way of telling Xu Fu that Jianjia was wild, and if he were forced not to go, he might just go on his own.

Xu Fu immediately felt a headache, just like when he looked at Hu Hai. At least Hu Hai was sensible, but Jianjia was young and arrogant, and with his not-insignificant skills, he was probably truly hard to discipline.

"You can go, but listen to my words and you must remember them."

Jianjia’s eyes lit up, and he looked at him with eager eyes. If he had a tail, it would definitely be wagging right now.

"Prioritize finding the recorded items—either bamboo slips or silk. I suspect it’s silk, as it’s easier to carry. Once you find it, bring it back to the camp immediately. Only if you have absolute certainty can you make a move on Xiong Yi. If you don't find the slips or silk but find an opportunity to kill Xiong Yi first, then kill him and return immediately; do not linger," Xu Fu said with a serious expression. "If you do not follow this, I will inform the King in the future and have you sent back to your previous place. After that, you need not follow me anymore."

Upon hearing the first part, Jianjia was all smiles and didn't think much of it, but when he heard the second half, the smile on his face faded, revealing a slightly dazed and timid expression.

Jianjia had a youthful face and was naturally very likable. Seeing him like this made one’s heart soften, but Xu Fu said nothing. No matter how strong Jianjia was, he had to learn to protect himself.

Ying Zheng had been impatient listening from the side.

The more likable Jianjia looked, the more unhappy he felt. He immediately stepped forward, put his arm around Xu Fu, and walked away. After a few steps, he turned back and said to Jianjia: "Did you remember what the Shu-zhang said? Go."

Jianjia finally felt constrained in his heart.

Jianjia had no parents and had been without discipline since he was young. When he and Bo Zhou and the others were assigned to Xu Fu, he was still ignorant in terms of emotions. Over the years, Jianjia had long since come to view Xu Fu as a close person; how could he bear to hear Xu Fu say such things? He could only nod dumbly, repeat Xu Fu’s words in his heart, and then turn to leave, though he no longer felt the excitement he had just moments ago.

After Xu Fu returned to the tent, Ying Zheng suddenly collapsed onto his back from behind, almost leaning his entire weight on him.

Xu Fu struggled to turn his head and cast a sidelong glance at Ying Zheng’s face.

His expression was normal.

"What's wrong?" Xu Fu felt a faint worry. "Did you exert yourself too much on the battlefield?" Although Ying Zheng’s moves looked incredibly handsome, Xu Fu couldn't imagine how much force was required. Just watching it felt terrifying enough. He rarely saw Ying Zheng practicing archery or martial arts in the palace; surely he hadn't pulled a muscle today? In that instant, many thoughts flashed through Xu Fu’s mind.

Ying Zheng had intended to trick him, just to see if Xu Fu would worry about him. The expression on Xu Fu’s face at such times must be the most charming. But halfway through the ruse, seeing Xu Fu’s brow slightly furrowed and his eyes filled with worry, Ying Zheng couldn't bear it anymore. If he let himself watch Xu Fu show such an expression, his heart would surely melt.

How could he bear to make Xu Fu worry?

Let such things be borne by me alone.

Ying Zheng helplessly pulled Xu Fu tightly into his arms. "If you are worried that I exerted myself too much, why not accompany me to check it out in a while?"

"How to check?"

Ying Zheng thrust his lower body forward. "Naturally, checking it like this."

Xu Fu pushed his hand away with an expressionless face. "No need. You are in such high spirits; in my opinion, you are still very robust."

"I am indeed robust." Ying Zheng raised an eyebrow, scooped Xu Fu up with one arm, and carried him. Xu Fu felt the world spin, his stomach was jostled, and he felt a wave of nausea. He twisted his face, about to lose his temper, but Ying Zheng placed him on the bed with one hand, leaned over, and began to unbutton his clothes without a word.

It’s daytime!

And this is a military camp!

In his agitation, Xu Fu kicked Ying Zheng in the cheek.

When he realized that the warm sensation under his foot was Ying Zheng’s cheek, Xu Fu’s movements froze.

Hmm... has anyone ever seen a male concubine kick a monarch? Probably not... by slapping Ying Zheng’s face like this, by trampling on his dignity and face as a monarch... would he be angry? Xu Fu carefully observed the expression on Ying Zheng’s face, forgetting for a moment to take his foot down.

Ying Zheng narrowed his eyes, his expression somewhat gloomy, and the flicker in his eyes carried a dangerous meaning.

"A-Fu..." he called out in a low, husky voice, then suddenly reached out, grabbed Xu Fu’s foot, and pulled him sharply toward himself. Caught off guard, Xu Fu fell into Ying Zheng’s arms.

Xu Fu was still a bit lost.

He kicked Ying Zheng... and it sparked a fire?

Xu Fu’s mind was suddenly filled with the image of Ying Zheng gritting his teeth and saying to him: You little troublemaker, you started this fire, so you are responsible for putting it out for me.

Xu Fu shuddered inwardly, and all his desire went limp.

...

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng slept until the next day. The following day, when Xu Fu got up wearing his robe, he saw Sang Zhong outside the tent. Sang Zhong had dark circles under his eyes and looked as if he hadn't slept well for days. Xu Fu frowned involuntarily, feeling quite heartbroken. He was the one who had been kidnapped, yet it was Sang Zhong who ended up with psychological trauma. If this continued, even an iron man would be worn down. Did he have such an obsession with guarding his tent?

Xu Fu stood in front of Sang Zhong, slightly distracted.

Sang Zhong said in a low voice: "Sir, Jianjia has already left the camp."

Xu Fu’s thoughts immediately returned. "So fast?"

Sang Zhong nodded. "Jianjia wanted to scout the location first."

...Why does that sound like he's going to steal something?

Xu Fu turned back and waved his hand at Sang Zhong behind him. "You don't need to follow me. Look at how tired you are; go back and rest. I'm going to cast a divination for Jianjia."

Sang Zhong asked in a low voice: "If... if the divination is bad?"

Xu Fu’s tone was indifferent. "What is there to fear? I am still here. If the divination is bad, I will just change it into a good one."

The corners of Sang Zhong’s mouth lifted involuntarily, and his gaze toward Xu Fu became even more focused.

见徐福回到帐中，嬴政就知道他要卜筮。
“可要寡人给你一字？”嬴政分外主动地问道。
“不必。”
被拒绝的嬴政有些遗憾，正巧此时蒙恬派人来请，嬴政便先出帐去了。徐福摸出了龟甲，又摸出了竹签……还不等他再摸出东西来，帷帐突然被人急匆匆地撩开了。
徐福看向来人，皱起眉，“何事？”怎么这样莽撞就进来了。
那人喘了喘气，“……庶长，赵军派了使臣来了。”
徐福心下惊讶，面上不显，“赵军……要言和？”
那人茫然摇头，“这……这，不知。”
徐福将那人上下打量一眼，“是谁让你来请我的？”
“蒙将军。”
徐福却忍不住再度暗自皱眉。
刚才嬴政才被请走，怎么好端端的，却又来了一人说要请他前去？如果真的要请，为什么不刚才一起请？徐福心底的疑虑越发地重了。
“桑中，陪我过去。”徐福高声冲帐外喊了一声。他方才让桑中回去休息了，也不知道此时他走了没有。徐福暂时没空去想，这样别有用心的人，是怎么混进军营来的，既然有问题的人已经出现在他跟前了，他现在就必须得想尽办法，从这个人的手底下逃过去。
下一刻，帷帐被猛地掀起了。
桑中走了进来，语气温和，“喏。”
那人笑了笑，“庶长，请。”
徐福对桑中点了点下巴，“走到我身边来。”
桑中面上闪过喜色，当即就走到了徐福的身后去，那人笑着往桑中身上瞥了一眼。桑中容貌气质都趋于温和无害的类型，不管是横看竖看，都不像是会给人造成威胁的样子，徐福敏锐地注意到那人隐隐松了一口气。
徐福几乎是立即就确定了心中的预感。
这个人绝对不是秦军中人！
“你在前面带路吧。”徐福抬了抬下巴，姿态冷傲地道。
对方大约也知道徐福的脾气，也并不觉得奇怪，他狗腿地笑了笑，躬着腰走在了前面。而徐福则是立时将手背在背后，朝桑中打了个手势。桑中本也是聪明的人，他对徐福的安危又一直倍加警惕，发觉到徐福的不对劲之后，他就立即知道是这个带路的人有问题了。桑中面上的表情依旧温和，只是手却暗自抓住了匕首。
他的目光从那人的身上轻飘飘地扫过，他甚至想好了，要从什么样的方向，用什么样的手法，从那人身上的哪个部位去下手。
他们走到了帐外。
帐外的士兵仍旧驻守着，像是并未发现哪里不对劲。
徐福暗自挑眉。如此看来，这带路的人在秦军之中还是个熟面孔了，难道是赵军安插下来的？或者说是被赵军收买了的？若是徐福没有看着嬴政被请走，那说不定徐福还真的上这个当了。
桑中袖子底下的手动了动，徐福立即抬手按住了他。
桑中按捺住了自己的动作，紧紧跟在徐福的身后，步子不敢挪远。
那人带着他们营地的边上走了过去，旁边的士兵虽然有些好奇，但是也并未出声询问。等快要走出营地范围的时候，徐福才顿住了脚步，同时收回了按捺桑中的手。
“主帐不在这个方向吧？”出声问话的是桑中。
那人还是没将桑中放在眼里，他极为敷衍地笑道：“就是在这个方向啊……”
“是吗？”徐福冷漠地看了他一眼。
那人这才身子微微打颤，脸上稍微变了色，“……自然是的，庶长、庶长可是觉得何处不对？”
桑中上前两步，手搭在了那人的肩膀上，那人面色不动，身体也不动了，下一刻那人就感觉到了腰上一痛，桑中藏在袖中的匕首已经划破了他的衣帛，刺进了他的腰间，鲜血溅了桑中一手，那人惨白着脸回过头来，正对上桑中面无表情的脸，他忍不住打了个哆嗦，身子一歪就倒了下去，然后就被桑中一脚踩住了。
这个时候他才知道，他所看见的男人，根本就不是什么善茬。但是现在后悔也来不及了……
此时驻守的士兵们一拥而上，将营地之外埋伏下的三个人捉了出来。
在那个人只顾着一边带路一边紧张的时候，徐福就已经叫上营地中的士兵们，在他还以为自己胜券在握的时候，实际上已经被人盯上了，本来徐福也只是猜测外面或许有人埋伏，没想到还真的一抓就抓住了好几个人。
“带走。”徐福转身。
桑中盯着地上的人呆滞了一会儿，然后才抽出了匕首，因为他的动作，鲜血又溅出来了一些，鲜红的颜色或许刺激了桑中的眼球，他总算是从呆滞中回过神来了。因为之前自己的疏忽，而导致徐福被掳走的心理阴影，似乎在这一瞬间消散了不少。因为这一次，他的确守住了徐福。
徐福回头催促了一声，“桑中，跟上。”
桑中脸上的神色逐渐又恢复了温和的色彩，但与之前相比，此时他脸上的温暖更为真实了。他点了点头，快步跟上去，那个图谋不轨的人就这样被他抛在了身后，随后被士兵架了起来。
徐福往着蒙恬的主帐而去，心中实在是忍不住嘲笑那赵军派来的人。
他们以为自己整日宅在帐中，便不知蒙恬的主帐在何处吗？他们却不想一想，从前桓齮还在时，自己便已经将军营摸个透了，如何还会被这样一个人诓骗住？就算是想要骗他，那也应当是找个更靠谱的借口才是。
蒙恬主帐外的士兵见他近了，当即便撩起了帷帐。
徐福进去时，里头的人正在议事，见他进来，他们也并未显露什么惊奇之色，只是嬴政脸上的表情陡然柔和了不少，而蒙恬也极为热情地将徐福迎了过去。
嬴政低声问：“如何？”
徐福知道他问的是卜筮的结果。徐福摇摇头，“卜筮无结果，但是却抓住了一个有趣的人。”
旁人见他说“有趣”二字，不知为何竟是打了个寒颤。
“抓住了一个有趣的人？何人？”嬴政立即问道。其他人当然便没了插话的权利，一时间便只剩下了嬴政与徐福交谈的声音。
“将人带进来。”徐福对帐外道。
话音落下，便有士兵带着人进来了。
那人匍匐在地，帐中却有一将领忍不住惊呼道：“这不是我的兵吗？”
徐福也并不急着斥责那将领，只是淡淡道：“他是赵军派来诓骗我的人，方才他来跟我说要请我到蒙将军这里来，但是待出了帐子后，他却是带着我拐向了另外的方向。并且试图令我相信那个方向才是将军主帐。”
将领已经慌了，急得满头大汗地解释道：“我、我并不知是怎么回事……我真的不知……”
嬴政的脸色已经极为冰冷了。他没想到在他前脚离去之后，后脚就有人上前来，想要将徐福骗走。嬴政走上前去，一脚将那人踹翻了，那人仰头栽倒下去，腰间的血洞还往外冒着血，他的脸色惨白，看上去下一刻就会丢了性命似的。而嬴政的确也不想让此人活下去了，胆敢觊觎徐福，能让他就此死去那都是太轻不过的惩罚了。
那人狠狠地瞪着嬴政，躺在地上无力挣扎。
“与他接应的人也抓来了。”徐福低声道。
他的话音落下，很快士兵们就又扭送了三个人进来，那三人虽然身上衣着不起眼，但能看得出是赵军中人。
如今赵军和秦军对垒，双方都是杀红了眼，仇人见面，那可不都是红着眼睛，满面仇恨吗？
“留一人便可。”嬴政低声道。言下之意便是其他人的性命都不用留着了，徐福不置可否。对于要害他的人，他还没有那样伟大的情操可以为他们求情。
地上的人已经因为失血过多而有些神志不清了，哪怕是听见嬴政的话，他也没有什么过多的反应，而其他三人就在惊惧之下，狠命挣扎了起来。但是押解他们的士兵手劲极大，又将他们死死捆住了，连嘴都堵了起来，他们想要从秦军中逃命，还不如交代些有用的东西来换一命简单。
嬴政的手指就这样虚空一点，从他们三人的身上滑过，“先杀了他们。”
那三人呆了呆，马上又挣扎了起来。
“那这人……”一旁的将领呆了呆，忙看向那个倒在血泊里的小兵。
“能做出这等大胆的事，岂能便宜了他？”嬴政冷笑道，“自然是要教他生死不能才好。”
在场众人并不觉得残忍，心中只有叫好的，就是这般狠辣的君王，才对他们这些常年在战场上的人的胃口，才能令他们愈发地心悦诚服。
徐福倒并未觉得嬴政残忍，大约是上辈子历史书上对嬴政的记载实在太过夸张，将他写成了一个残暴君王，如今一对比，徐福倒是什么感觉也没了。
那挣扎不停的三人被带了下去，倒在血泊里的人也被带了下去，区别只在于，前三个人很快就死了，而后一个人还在苟延残喘。留着他，也能作为日后赵军使出这等手段的证据了。
将这四人处理掉以后，还不等他们继续商谈正事，便有士兵步履匆匆地跑来。
“赵军……赵军使臣来了……”
多么耳熟的一句话，徐福怔了怔，赵军还真的派使臣来了？
“让他进来。”嬴政发话，士兵们当然不会再拦着赵军使臣。
帷帐被掀起，外面走进来一个吊儿郎当的人物，那人笑嘻嘻地见过了众人，然后才道：“我们将军说，要与徐庶长做个交易。”
徐福目光冷淡地瞥了他一眼，连一个字都懒得说出口。
那人原本姿态伪装得不错，但被徐福那一眼轻飘飘地瞥了下，登时倒是什么话都说不出来了，脸上的表情甚至差点维持不住，他勉强地笑了笑，道：“徐庶长，将军说，您要什么，就得亲自去拿，何必派人过去呢？”
徐福的脸上没有半分感情变化，但他心中实际上已经掀起了风浪。蒹葭被抓住了？徐福还是很相信蒹葭的本事的，他怎么可能会被抓住呢？想到这里，徐福不由得呆了呆。对啊，他怎么忘了，现在的熊义已经不是过去的熊义了，他手中不知道还有什么厉害的技术，若是这个时代未出现的东西，能将蒹葭唬住也并不奇怪。
徐福顿时后悔不已，他怎么光想着熊义会将这些东西用到战场上，却没想到有可能也用到蒹葭的身上呢。
那使臣的口吻实在太过暧昧，嬴政花了极大的力气，才没让自己上前将那使臣活活卸成八块。嬴政一直便不喜熊义对徐福的觊觎，但他未曾想到熊义侥幸活下来，竟然还对此心怀念想。
徐福倒是很快就做出了决定。
蒹葭虽是因自己的执拗非要前去的，但蒹葭前去也是为了替他将记载的东西取回来。
徐福不会对一个害自己的人心软，但他会对帮过自己的人心软，何况他与蒹葭相处的时日已然五年了。
徐福走到嬴政的身旁，安抚性地摩挲了两下嬴政的手背。效果的确很好，嬴政的脸色好看了很多，至少看着那使臣的目光，不会像是要将他切割成数片一样了。
“如何亲自去拿？随你到赵军中去吗？”徐福的姿态太过平静了，使臣心中有些打鼓，但是徐福能松口实在不容易，他抛开心底的警惕心，忙点了点头。
“好啊，我去赵军中瞧一瞧，就看你们将军是否愿意给我了？”徐福低声道。
他的语气实在太过寡淡，使臣半晌没能反应过来，“……这、这……”还不等那使臣将舌头捋顺，嬴政已然恼怒了。见熊义？开什么玩笑！且看那个意图诓骗徐福的人，落到他们手中是个什么下场，就能知晓徐福进了赵军之中，还能否出来了。这样等同将徐福送入虎口的举动，嬴政是如何也不会应的。
徐福抓着嬴政的掌心搔了搔，然后继续维持着一脸淡定的表情，转头与蒙恬道：“蒙将军不是有话要与使臣说吗？”
蒙恬懵了懵，然后很快反应过来，忙走上前，将那使臣拉到一边去了。之前在战场上蒙恬如何斩杀赵国士兵的，那使臣是瞧得一清二楚的。这蒙恬就是个活生生的杀神啊！使臣惊出了一身冷汗，生怕蒙恬一言不合就拧了他的脑袋。“杀神”蒙恬与那使臣瞎扯了起来，使臣在回答的过程中，声音都是不断颤抖着的。
徐福偏转过头，低声与嬴政道：“我想杀了熊义。”
听出徐福对于熊义的不待见，嬴政的心情放松了些，但他的语气依旧是严肃的，“你如何杀他？”
“阿政何时见我是没有丝毫准备的人？”徐福反问了他一句。
说完，徐福就直直走到了那使臣的身边，抬手在他肩上拍了一下，那使臣打了个哆嗦，差点吓尿裤子。他还以为蒙恬受不了了，准备把他给剁了。
“走吧。”
“现、现在？”使臣又懵了懵。将军不是说徐庶长极难劝服吗？为什么如今，他竟是那样轻易就答应了？
徐福冷冷地看了他一眼，“如何？使臣不愿走了吗？”
蒙恬也冷冰冰地看了他一眼，嬴政更是想要把这使臣给做成肉片。
使臣又打了个哆嗦，“不，不，庶长请。”
徐福当即就抬腿朝外走去，那使臣跟上去，因为气势差距过大，看上去就跟徐福的小跟班似的，哪里像是他前来胁迫了徐福。
徐福走到一半的时候，回头唤了一声“桑中”，“从前我的那个小鼎呢？给我取来。”徐福的目光与桑中相接，桑中愣了愣，“好，先生且等一等我。”
徐福顿住脚步，使臣也只有跟着顿住脚步，而且憋屈的是，他什么话也不敢说，额上反倒还往外冒着层层冷汗。那都是嬴政和蒙恬身上的气势都太强了的缘故，直接对他进行了心理上的绝对压迫。
不久后，桑中抱着一只小鼎回来了，那鼎上封着一个丑陋的盖子，看上去实在太其貌不扬了。
见使臣的目光落在小鼎上，徐福才漫不经心地道：“此物用于卜筮。”
使臣露出恍然大悟的表情，如今所有人知晓秦国的徐福极擅卜筮之术，所以使臣也并未对此觉得奇怪。
徐福要跟他到赵军中去，而秦军其他人一直一言未发。使臣暗暗道，这徐庶长在军中说的话，分量可够重的。他们很快出了帐子，徐福并未带上任何一人随行，而桑中等人也不敢贸然说随行，若是搭上他们也就罢了，但若是因为搭上他们，反而给徐福拖了后腿，那罪过便大了。
到了帐外，那使臣登时便活了过来，脸上的表情也总算是恢复自如了。
嬴政沉着脸看了一眼他们的背影。转头便吩咐蒙恬又安排了人下去。
熊义此人，是定然要死的。
……
从秦军军营走出来以后，使臣便加快了步子，所幸徐福昨夜休息得还不错，此时体力充足，倒也能加快脚步。等他们走上约莫小半个时辰后，终于抵达了赵军的营地。
使臣笑着冲上前去，道：“快去告知将军，徐庶长已至。”
赵军中人，都忍不住好奇地打量徐福。都怪徐福的声名实在太过响亮，他们对徐福的卜筮充满了好奇。但他们怎么也没想到，就是这样一个，让他们以为会是中年男子的人，竟是长得分外年轻，且十分美貌。也是，传言中能给秦王做男宠的人，怎会长得丑呢？赵兵们目视着徐福走进了主帐之中。
和在秦军营地中全然不同，主帐之中并不见其他将领的痕迹。
赵国这是连多的将领都拿不出手了吗？徐福心中颇不厚道地想。
使臣将他带到以后便迅速退下了，只余下徐福一人站在主帐的口子前，身姿挺拔，怀中却抱着一个瞧上去破破烂烂的鼎。
主帐的围屏突然动了动，后面被扶着走出来一人。
……是熊义。
熊义面色惨白，眼神阴鸷，旁边扶着他的随从战战兢兢，连头也不敢抬。熊义是真的大病了一场，他的气色明显十分糟糕。但他的目光却不改锐利，像是要将徐福刺穿一样。徐福不慌不忙地站在那里，连动也不动一下，熊义的目光对他并没有造成什么实质性的伤害。眼刀又不是当真能割人！
熊义的目光从徐福的头顶一直梭巡到了脚上去。
他冷冷地笑了，“为一个侍从便能送上门来，当初怎么不见你对我这样好上一些？”
“各为其主。”徐福懒得与他说话，便从嘴里蹦出了这样四个字，简单有力地概括。
“各为其主不过是现在……”
熊义的话还未说完便被徐福打断了，“从前我为的是秦王，而你为的……是楚国。”“如今你便更加离谱了，你为的是赵国。你与我本就站在敌对的面上，何谈我待你好不好？”不管熊义脸上的表情如何可怕，行为如何偏执，徐福的表情都是始终如一的。
熊义被噎了一下，铁青着脸，半晌说不出话来。
“蒹葭呢？”熊义不开口，徐福也不能跟着不开口，于是他直接将话题转走了。
自觉抓住把柄的熊义，脸上并不带开心之色，“若非此次，我倒是还不会发现……邯郸城中的赵姑娘，可是徐庶长扮成的？”
“徐庶长”三字在熊义的口中，生生带出了一股嘲讽的味道。
徐福心中一惊，估计之前在邯郸时，熊义就已经见过蒹葭的面了，只是一时未曾想起，直到这个时候，熊义才终于意识到蒹葭就是当年对他下杀手的人。到了这个地步，熊义哪里还会不知道，那被他误以为是哑巴的赵姑娘，便是徐福了！
他没想到徐福为了伪装，能做到那样的地步。一想到徐福的所有行动，都是为了嬴政的大业，熊义便觉得越发的怒火中烧。
他对赵政，当真爱到这种地步了吗？
已经失去的熊义，便越发嫉妒嬴政能得到徐福的“深爱”，熊义哪里知道，“深爱”固然有，但那是嬴政对徐福，而并非徐福对嬴政。
“你将我骗得好苦。”熊义面色越加地冷了。瞧着他咬牙切齿的模样，徐福甚至觉得他会扑上来狠狠咬自己两口，才肯罢休。
徐福依旧站在那里一句话也不说。他知道这个时候熊义情绪汹涌澎湃，根本不需要他说什么，熊义便会一股脑儿地将心绪都倒出来。
“不管是徐福还是赵姑娘，如今你都在我手里了，拥有你的是我了。”熊义挑了挑眉，面上闪过兴奋之色，口吻像是将徐福视作了比赛的胜利品一般。他这副模样，已经与在奉常寺中时的形象，相去甚远了。
这就是徐福厌恶熊义的原因所在。
熊义嘴上说着如何喜欢他，但实际上便就是将他当做一个小玩意儿，一个物品。哪怕熊义已经不再拥有从前的地位了，他依旧没将徐福放在和自己平等的位置上。嬴政虽为君王，但从来都是尊重徐福的。不止徐福，哪怕是他的臣子，嬴政也从未以高高在上，我瞧不上你的姿态相对过。在这一点上，徐福觉得熊义完全无法与嬴政相比。
“蒹葭呢？”熊义说了半天，徐福才慢悠悠地掀了掀眼皮，开口就问自己前来的目的。
熊义差点气得脸都变色了。他方才与徐福说了这么得多，他竟是半点感动也没有吗？
徐福摩挲着怀中小鼎的花纹，又重复地问了一遍蒹葭的下落。
熊义恶意地笑了笑，“寻蒹葭？那你得先将我伺候好了。”
徐福问他：“怎么伺候？”
熊义以为徐福因为害怕而松动了态度，忍不住上前就想要将徐福拉到自己怀中来，但是熊义激动之下，刚往徐福的方向迈了一步，就险些摔倒下去。他身上带着伤，又失血过多，双腿发软的确是走不了几步。徐福立刻就放心了，就瞧熊义这副模样，也什么都做不了啊。
熊义对上徐福的目光，面上忍不住浮现恼怒的神情，他挣扎着从地上爬起来，顿时说不出话了。徐福猜得不错，就他这副模样，的确是就算想做什么，那也是有心无力的。
“先将他带下去安置。”恼羞成怒的熊义只能先这样沉声安排了。
帐外进来了两名士兵，将徐福请了出去，徐福心情大好地捧着鼎出去了，而且一边走，还一边不动声色地打量着军营中的情况。很快，徐福就发现军中确实没有别的将领了，看来如今的赵军已经俨然成为了熊义的一言堂。那赵王知道自己养着这么厉害的一只老虎吗？
当日徐福毫不吝啬去折腾赵国士兵。
打水，寻食物……有他们的伺候，徐福十分舒适地入睡了。
当夜徐福什么梦也没有做，连关于蒹葭的梦都没有做。徐福虽然不知道蒹葭如今如何了，但他既然来了，自然便是要将蒹葭完好无损带回去的。
因熊义受伤确实太严重了，他没办法立即再次出兵，而且熊义就算是再自负，他也知道蒙恬的名头有多么厉害，若是正面与蒙恬对上，他命丧当场也不奇怪。于是这几日熊义便收敛了起来，也算是误打误撞让徐福处在了一个安全的环境中。
几日过去后，熊义依旧没有带着徐福去见蒹葭，不过熊义身上的伤总算好了些，眼看着赵秦两军开战，徐福心中的情绪久久难以平复，这一战，熊义又会拿出什么？
熊义上战场，自然是不会带着徐福的，徐福被留在了帐中，他只能听见赵军离开的脚步声，等过去一个时辰后，徐福觉得似乎还听见了厮杀声。
然后他的帐中就进来了几个士兵，凶神恶煞地就要将他往外带。徐福冷眼看着他们，“你们要做什么？”
士兵们面色冷漠，一言不发，将徐福直接带了出去。徐福非常不喜欢有人这般粗暴地对待自己，脸色登时就冷了下来，士兵们毫无所觉一般，带着他就出了的营地，应该是要带他上战场。带他上战场做什么？还是在这样的时候。总不会熊义认为可以用他来要挟住秦军吧？
徐福实在不想前去，就顿住了脚步。
那几人皱着眉，冷声道：“走。”
话刚说完，他们突然觉得好像闻见了什么灼烧的气味儿。他们搜寻着气味儿低下头，发现脚边有燃烧着的花草，就很普通的，像是路边随便的花草一样。
他们本能地觉得有些怪异，将那花草踩了两脚，然后带着徐福便要继续往前走。
徐福指了一个方向，“我要出恭。”
士兵们的脸色顿时极为难看。
徐福瞧着他们动也不动。
他们咬咬牙，将徐福带到了一旁的小树林去。
徐福背对着他们，站在那里压根没动。
士兵们看着他的姿势，不耐地等了一会儿，实在忍不住上前，厉声问道：“好了吗？”
“嗯。”徐福对上士兵的目光，“我好了。”
士兵忽然觉得胸中有些喘不过气，视线也跟着发昏，整个人有点摇摇欲坠的感觉，“你……”士兵本想出声斥责，但是刚说了一个字，整个人就摇摇晃晃，站不太稳了。
他身后的其他人发觉到不对劲，连忙凑了上来，但是刚迈出两步，也感觉到了眼前一阵眩晕。
他们总算发觉到了不对劲，怒瞪着徐福的方向，摇摇晃晃，摇摇晃晃……然后一头栽倒下去了。一个接一个。徐福就站在那里看他们一个个倒下去，确认他们不会醒来以后，徐福才慢悠悠地拔腿往回走。徐福很快就走到了赵军营地外。徐福摩挲了一下手腕上的布条，半天也没有什么反应，瞧来是指望不上了。徐福干脆在赵军营地外打起了转。
徐福也不知道过了多久，总算听见了赵军回营的时候。没一会儿，赵军军营中就嘈杂了起来，应该是发现他不见了。
徐福也没有刻意躲藏，自然是很快便被找到了。
熊义面色铁青地跑了出来，额上的青筋爆突，目光瞪向徐福的时候，徐福甚至有种他想要杀了自己的感觉。熊义看着徐福平复了很久的心情，然后才快步上前，紧紧抓住了徐福的手臂，“想跑？”
徐福：“……”
熊义冷笑两声，“走吧，我带你去见蒹葭。”
徐福没想到经过这么一折腾，熊义反倒还松口带他去见蒹葭了。徐福什么话也没说，被熊义带着进了赵军营地中。等进去以后，熊义才冷声问他，“你没有见到我派出来接你的人？”
见到了，现在他们还在树林子和野兽昆虫作伴呢。
徐福摇了摇头。
熊义皱起了眉，心情极度不悦，他对赵军的信任度并不高，所以第一时间他想到的是赵军不听他的号令，却完全没想到他派来的人都被徐福给搞死了。或许在他心中，徐福就是个空有高冷壳子，但实际上万分柔弱的人。
走了几步，徐福才低声道：“你派人来接我去战场？以我威胁秦王？”
熊义面上的表情僵了僵，“怎么会呢？”他是的确不想拿徐福去做威胁，但是他想要在秦王跟前炫耀，想要刺激他，想要让他看见，如今徐福是跟着谁的，徐福的性命掌握在谁的手中。
徐福冷冷地瞥了他一眼。
那一眼让熊义心中有些难受，又有些愤怒，他整个人都如同精神分裂了一般，情绪喜忧交杂，面上的神色也是种种闪过，看上去一会儿红一会儿白。
徐福不知道他在想什么，只觉得熊义的眼神，实在瘆人得很。
不知不觉间，熊义就带着他停在了一个帐子外。
熊义撩起帷帐，带着徐福走了进去。
徐福一眼就看见了被绑起来的蒹葭，他将蒹葭迅速从头扫到了脚，幸好，没有受伤。徐福微微松了一口气。而蒹葭在看见徐福之后，先是双眼一亮，紧接着眸中的光芒就暗淡了下来，因为他看见了熊义。
熊义指着蒹葭对徐福说：“总有一日，赵政也会如此被我绑起来，秦国也会如此落在我的手中……”
“而事实上是，你现在只是个还要瞧赵王脸色的普通将军。”徐福不冷不热地出声提醒道。
熊义不怒反笑。
徐福：“……”熊义是当真被变态成受虐狂了吗？自己冷淡待他，他反倒还一脸享受。
chapters.title: 第179章
chapters.translated_text:
Seeing Xu Fu return to his tent, Ying Zheng knew he was about to perform divination.

"Do you need a character from me?" Ying Zheng asked, being exceptionally proactive.

"No need."

Ying Zheng, having been rejected, felt a bit regretful. Just then, Meng Tian sent someone to invite him, so Ying Zheng left the tent first. Xu Fu took out the tortoise shell and then the bamboo slips... Before he could take out anything else, the tent flap was suddenly and hurriedly lifted.

Xu Fu looked at the person who entered and frowned, "What is it?" Why enter so recklessly?

The man panted, "...Shuzhang, the Zhao army has sent an envoy."

Xu Fu was surprised internally but did not show it on his face, "The Zhao army... wants to make peace?"

The man shook his head blankly, "This... this, I do not know."

Xu Fu looked the man up and down, "Who sent you to invite me?"

"General Meng."

Xu Fu couldn't help but secretly frown again.

Ying Zheng had just been invited away, so why, out of the blue, did another person come to invite him? If they really wanted to invite him, why not invite them together earlier? Xu Fu's suspicions grew even heavier.

"Sang Zhong, accompany me," Xu Fu called out loudly toward the outside of the tent. He had just let Sang Zhong go back to rest, and he didn't know if he had left yet. Xu Fu had no time to think about how such a person with ulterior motives had managed to sneak into the military camp. Since the problematic person was already in front of him, he had to think of every possible way to escape from this person's clutches.

The next moment, the tent flap was violently lifted.

Sang Zhong walked in, his tone gentle, "Yes."

The man smiled, "Shuzhang, please."

Xu Fu nodded his chin toward Sang Zhong, "Come to my side."

A look of joy flashed across Sang Zhong's face, and he immediately walked behind Xu Fu. The man smiled and glanced at Sang Zhong. Sang Zhong's appearance and temperament were of the gentle and harmless type; no matter how one looked at him, he didn't seem like someone who would pose a threat. Xu Fu keenly noticed that the man breathed a subtle sigh of relief.

Xu Fu was almost immediately certain of his premonition.

This person was definitely not from the Qin army!

"You lead the way in front," Xu Fu lifted his chin and said with a cold and arrogant posture.

The other party probably knew Xu Fu's temper and didn't find it strange. He smiled obsequiously and walked in front with his waist hunched. Xu Fu immediately put his hands behind his back and signaled to Sang Zhong. Sang Zhong was also a smart person, and he had always been extra vigilant about Xu Fu's safety. After realizing that something was wrong with Xu Fu, he immediately knew that this guide was problematic. The expression on Sang Zhong's face remained gentle, but his hand had secretly gripped his dagger.

His gaze swept lightly over the man's body; he had even figured out from what direction, with what technique, and at which part of the man's body he should strike.

They walked outside the tent.

The soldiers outside the tent were still standing guard, as if they hadn't noticed anything wrong.

Xu Fu secretly raised an eyebrow. Looking at it this way, this guide was still a familiar face in the Qin army. Could it be that he was planted by the Zhao army? Or perhaps he had been bribed by the Zhao army? If Xu Fu hadn't watched Ying Zheng being invited away, he might have really fallen for this trick.

The hand under Sang Zhong's sleeve moved, and Xu Fu immediately reached out to press it down.

Sang Zhong restrained his movements and followed closely behind Xu Fu, not daring to move too far away.

The man led them toward the edge of the camp. Although the soldiers nearby were a little curious, they didn't ask any questions. It wasn't until they were about to walk out of the camp's perimeter that Xu Fu stopped his steps and simultaneously withdrew the hand that was restraining Sang Zhong.

"The main tent is not in this direction, is it?" It was Sang Zhong who spoke up.

The man still didn't take Sang Zhong seriously, and he smiled perfunctorily: "It is in this direction..."

"Is it?" Xu Fu gave him a cold look.

Only then did the man's body tremble slightly, and his face changed color, "...Naturally it is. Shuzhang, Shuzhang, do you feel something is wrong?"

Sang Zhong took two steps forward and placed his hand on the man's shoulder. The man didn't move his face or his body. The next moment, he felt a pain in his waist. The dagger hidden in Sang Zhong's sleeve had already torn his clothes and pierced into his waist. Fresh blood splattered onto Sang Zhong's hand. The man turned back with a pale face, meeting Sang Zhong's expressionless face. He couldn't help but shiver, his body tilted and he fell down, only to be stepped on by Sang Zhong.

Only then did he realize that the man he saw was not a pushover at all. But it was too late to regret it now...

At this moment, the stationed soldiers swarmed up and captured the three people who had been lying in ambush outside the camp.

While the man was busy leading the way and feeling nervous, Xu Fu had already called the soldiers in the camp. While the man thought he had the victory in his grasp, he had actually been watched. Originally, Xu Fu had only guessed that there might be an ambush outside, but he didn't expect to catch several people at once.

"Take them away," Xu Fu turned around.

Sang Zhong stared at the person on the ground in a daze for a while before pulling out his dagger. Because of his movement, some blood splattered out again. Perhaps the bright red color stimulated Sang Zhong's eyes, and he finally recovered from his daze. The psychological trauma caused by his previous negligence, which led to Xu Fu being kidnapped, seemed to have dissipated a lot at this moment. Because this time, he had indeed protected Xu Fu.

Xu Fu turned back and urged, "Sang Zhong, keep up."

The expression on Sang Zhong's face gradually returned to a gentle color, but compared to before, the warmth on his face was more genuine now. He nodded and followed quickly. The person with ill intentions was left behind by him and was subsequently hoisted up by the soldiers.

Xu Fu headed toward Meng Tian's main tent, truly unable to help but mock the person sent by the Zhao army.

Did they think that because he stayed in his tent all day, he wouldn't know where Meng Tian's main tent was? They didn't stop to think that even when Huan Yi was still there, he had already thoroughly explored the military camp. How could he be deceived by such a person? Even if they wanted to deceive him, they should have found a more reliable excuse.

The soldiers outside Meng Tian's main tent saw him approaching and immediately lifted the tent flap.

When Xu Fu entered, the people inside were discussing matters. Seeing him enter, they didn't show any surprise, but the expression on Ying Zheng's face suddenly softened a lot, and Meng Tian also welcomed Xu Fu with great enthusiasm.

Ying Zheng asked in a low voice, "How was it?"

Xu Fu knew he was asking about the result of the divination. Xu Fu shook his head, "The divination had no result, but I caught an interesting person."

Others, seeing him use the word "interesting," didn't know why they shivered.

"Caught an interesting person? Who?" Ying Zheng asked immediately. Others naturally had no right to interrupt, and for a time, only the voices of Ying Zheng and Xu Fu remained.

"Bring the person in," Xu Fu said toward the outside of the tent.

As the words fell, soldiers brought the person in.

The man crawled on the ground, but a general in the tent couldn't help but exclaim, "Isn't this my soldier?"

Xu Fu was not in a hurry to reprimand the general, but said lightly, "He was sent by the Zhao army to deceive me. Just now he came to tell me that he wanted to invite me to General Meng's place, but after leaving the tent, he led me toward another direction, and tried to make me believe that that direction was the General's main tent."

The general was already panicked, sweating profusely as he explained, "I, I don't know what's going on... I really don't know..."

Ying Zheng's face was already extremely cold. He didn't expect that after he left, someone would come forward to try and trick Xu Fu away. Ying Zheng walked up and kicked the man over. The man fell backward, the blood hole in his waist still oozing blood. His face was pale, and he looked like he would lose his life the next moment. And Ying Zheng indeed didn't want to let this person live. Daring to covet Xu Fu, letting him die just like this was too light a punishment.

The man glared fiercely at Ying Zheng, lying on the ground unable to struggle.

"The people who were coordinating with him were also caught," Xu Fu said in a low voice.

As his words fell, soldiers soon escorted three more people in. Although those three were dressed inconspicuously, it could be seen that they were from the Zhao army.

Now that the Zhao army and the Qin army were confronting each other, both sides were blinded by hatred. When enemies met, weren't they all red-eyed and full of hatred?

"Keeping one is enough," Ying Zheng said in a low voice. The implication was that there was no need to keep the lives of the others. Xu Fu was noncommittal. For those who wanted to harm him, he didn't have such great sentiments to plead for them.

The person on the ground was already delirious due to excessive blood loss. Even if he heard Ying Zheng's words, he didn't have much of a reaction. The other three struggled desperately in fear. But the soldiers who escorted them had great strength and tied them up tightly, even gagging them. If they wanted to escape from the Qin army, it would be easier to confess something useful to save their lives.

Ying Zheng's fingers pointed into the void, sliding over the three of them, "Kill them first."

The three were stunned and immediately struggled again.

"Then this person..." The general on the side was stunned and hurriedly looked at the little soldier lying in a pool of blood.

"To be able to do such a bold thing, how can I let him off easily?" Ying Zheng sneered, "Naturally, I must teach him that life is worse than death."

The people present didn't feel it was cruel; they only felt it was good. Only such a ruthless monarch suited the appetites of those of them who had been on the battlefield for years and could make them increasingly convinced.

Xu Fu didn't think Ying Zheng was cruel. Perhaps the records of Ying Zheng in history books in his previous life were too exaggerated, writing him as a tyrannical monarch. Now, by comparison, Xu Fu didn't feel anything at all.

The three who were struggling were taken away, and the person lying in a pool of blood was also taken away. The only difference was that the first three died quickly, while the latter was still lingering on his last breath. Keeping him could also serve as evidence for the Zhao army's use of such tactics in the future.

After dealing with these four, before they could continue discussing serious matters, a soldier ran over in a hurry.

"The Zhao army... the Zhao army envoy has arrived..."

What a familiar sentence. Xu Fu was stunned. Did the Zhao army really send an envoy?

"Let him in," Ying Zheng ordered. The soldiers naturally wouldn't stop the Zhao envoy anymore.

The tent flap was lifted, and a slouching figure walked in. The man greeted everyone with a grin and then said, "Our General says he wants to make a deal with Shuzhang Xu."

Xu Fu glanced at him with a cold gaze, too lazy to even say a word.

The man had disguised his posture well, but after being glanced at lightly by Xu Fu, he couldn't say a word. The expression on his face almost couldn't be maintained. He smiled reluctantly and said, "Shuzhang Xu, the General says, whatever you want, you have to go and get it yourself, why send someone else?"

There was no change in emotion on Xu Fu's face, but he was actually in turmoil. Was Jianjia captured? Xu Fu still believed in Jianjia's abilities. How could he be captured? Thinking of this, Xu Fu couldn't help but be stunned. Yes, how could he forget that the current Xiong Yi was no longer the Xiong Yi of the past? He didn't know what powerful technology he had in his hands. If it was something that hadn't appeared in this era, it wouldn't be strange if it could fool Jianjia.

Xu Fu immediately regretted it. How could he only think that Xiong Yi would use these things on the battlefield, but didn't expect that it might also be used on Jianjia?

The envoy's tone was too ambiguous. Ying Zheng spent a great deal of effort not to rush up and tear the envoy into eight pieces. Ying Zheng had never liked Xiong Yi's covetousness for Xu Fu, but he didn't expect that Xiong Yi, having survived by luck, would still harbor such thoughts.

Xu Fu made a decision very quickly.

Although Jianjia went because of his own stubbornness, Jianjia went to retrieve the recorded things for him.

Xu Fu wouldn't soften his heart toward someone who harmed him, but he would soften his heart toward someone who had helped him, not to mention that he had been with Jianjia for five years.

Xu Fu walked to Ying Zheng's side and stroked the back of Ying Zheng's hand soothingly. The effect was indeed very good. Ying Zheng's complexion looked much better; at least his gaze toward the envoy didn't look like he wanted to cut him into pieces.

"How to go and get it yourself? Follow you to the Zhao army?" Xu Fu's posture was too calm, and the envoy felt a bit nervous. But it wasn't easy for Xu Fu to agree. He pushed aside his inner vigilance and nodded hurriedly.

"Alright, I'll go to the Zhao army and take a look, to see if your General is willing to give it to me?" Xu Fu said in a low voice.

His tone was too bland, and the envoy couldn't react for a long time, "...This, this..." Before the envoy could straighten his tongue, Ying Zheng was already angry. See Xiong Yi? What a joke! Just look at the end of the person who tried to deceive Xu Fu, and you would know if Xu Fu could come back after entering the Zhao army. Such an act equivalent to sending Xu Fu into the tiger's den was something Ying Zheng would never agree to.

Xu Fu scratched Ying Zheng's palm, then continued to maintain a calm expression, turned his head and said to Meng Tian, "Doesn't General Meng have something to say to the envoy?"

Meng Tian was stunned, then quickly reacted, hurried forward, and pulled the envoy to the side. The envoy had seen clearly how Meng Tian slaughtered Zhao soldiers on the battlefield. This Meng Tian was a living god of death! The envoy broke out in a cold sweat, fearing that Meng Tian would twist his head off if they didn't agree. The "God of Death" Meng Tian started chatting with the envoy, and the envoy's voice kept trembling while answering.

Xu Fu turned his head and whispered to Ying Zheng, "I want to kill Xiong Yi."

Hearing Xu Fu's dislike for Xiong Yi, Ying Zheng's mood relaxed, but his tone remained serious, "How will you kill him?"

"When has Ah Zheng ever seen me without any preparation?" Xu Fu asked him back.

After speaking, Xu Fu walked straight to the envoy and patted him on the shoulder. The envoy shivered and almost peed his pants. He thought Meng Tian couldn't take it anymore and was ready to chop him up.

"Let's go."

"N-now?" The envoy was stunned again. Didn't the General say that Shuzhang Xu was extremely difficult to persuade? Why did he agree so easily now?

Xu Fu looked at him coldly, "What? Is the envoy unwilling to leave?"

Meng Tian also looked at him coldly, and Ying Zheng wanted to turn this envoy into meat slices.

The envoy shivered again, "No, no, Shuzhang, please."

Xu Fu immediately lifted his legs and walked out. The envoy followed. Because the gap in momentum was too large, he looked like Xu Fu's little follower. Where did it look like he came to coerce Xu Fu?

When Xu Fu walked halfway, he turned back and called "Sang Zhong," "Where is my little tripod from before? Bring it to me." Xu Fu's gaze met Sang Zhong's. Sang Zhong was stunned, "Okay, Sir, please wait for me."

Xu Fu stopped his steps, and the envoy had to stop as well. What was frustrating was that he didn't dare to say anything, and cold sweat kept breaking out on his forehead. It was all because the momentum of Ying Zheng and Meng Tian was too strong, directly exerting absolute psychological pressure on him.

Not long after, Sang Zhong returned holding a small tripod. The tripod was sealed with an ugly lid and looked very unremarkable.

Seeing the envoy's gaze fall on the small tripod, Xu Fu said nonchalantly, "This object is used for divination."

The envoy showed an expression of sudden realization. Nowadays, everyone knew that Xu Fu of the Qin State was very good at divination, so the envoy didn't find it strange.

Xu Fu was going to follow him to the Zhao army, and the other Qin soldiers didn't say a word. The envoy secretly thought that the weight of Shuzhang Xu's words in the army was heavy enough. They soon left the tent. Xu Fu didn't take anyone with him, and Sang Zhong and others didn't dare to rashly say they would follow. If they went, it would be one thing, but if they became a burden to Xu Fu because of it, that would be a great sin.

Arriving outside the tent, the envoy immediately came back to life, and the expression on his face finally returned to normal.

Ying Zheng looked at their backs with a dark face. He turned and ordered Meng Tian to arrange for more people to follow.

This person, Xiong Yi, must die.

...

After walking out of the Qin army camp, the envoy quickened his pace. Fortunately, Xu Fu had rested well last night, and his physical strength was sufficient, so he could also quicken his pace. After they walked for about half an hour, they finally arrived at the Zhao army camp.

The envoy smiled and rushed forward, saying, "Go and tell the General that Shuzhang Xu has arrived."

The people in the Zhao army couldn't help but curiously look at Xu Fu. It was all because Xu Fu's reputation was too loud, and they were full of curiosity about Xu Fu's divination. But they never thought that such a person, whom they thought would be a middle-aged man, would be so young and very beautiful. Also, in the rumors, how could someone who could be a male pet for the Qin King look ugly? The Zhao soldiers watched as Xu Fu walked into the main tent.

Completely different from the Qin army camp, there were no traces of other generals in the main tent.

Was the Zhao State unable to even produce extra generals? Xu Fu thought rather unkindly.

The envoy retreated quickly after bringing him there, leaving only Xu Fu standing at the entrance of the main tent, his posture upright, while he held a ragged-looking tripod in his arms.

The screen of the main tent suddenly moved, and a person was helped out from behind.

...It was Xiong Yi.

Xiong Yi's face was pale, his eyes were sinister, and the attendant helping him was trembling, not even daring to lift his head. Xiong Yi had indeed been seriously ill, and his complexion was obviously very bad. But his gaze remained sharp, as if he wanted to pierce through Xu Fu. Xu Fu stood there unhurriedly, not even moving an inch. Xiong Yi's gaze didn't cause any substantial harm to him. Eye knives couldn't really cut people!

Xiong Yi's gaze scanned from the top of Xu Fu's head to his feet.

He smiled coldly, "To be able to deliver yourself to the door for a servant, why weren't you this good to me back then?"

"Each serves their own master." Xu Fu was too lazy to talk to him, so he spat out these four words, simple and powerful.

"Each serves their own master is only for now..."

Before Xiong Yi could finish his words, he was interrupted by Xu Fu, "In the past, I served the Qin King, and you served... the Chu State." "Now you are even more outrageous; you serve the Zhao State. You and I are already on opposing sides, so how can we talk about whether I treated you well or not?" No matter how terrifying the expression on Xiong Yi's face was or how paranoid his behavior was, Xu Fu's expression remained consistent.

Xiong Yi was choked, his face livid, and he couldn't speak for a long time.

"Where is Jianjia?" Xiong Yi didn't speak, and Xu Fu couldn't stay silent either, so he directly changed the subject.

Xiong Yi, who felt he had grasped a handle, didn't have a happy look on his face, "If not for this time, I wouldn't have discovered... Was the Zhao girl in Handan city played by Shuzhang Xu?"

The words "Shuzhang Xu" in Xiong Yi's mouth carried a hint of sarcasm.

Xu Fu was shocked. He estimated that when he was in Handan before, Xiong Yi had already seen Jianjia's face, but he didn't remember it for a moment. Until this time, Xiong Yi finally realized that Jianjia was the one who had tried to kill him back then. At this point, how could Xiong Yi not know that the Zhao girl he mistook for a mute was Xu Fu!

He didn't expect that Xu Fu could go to such lengths for disguise. Thinking that all of Xu Fu's actions were for Ying Zheng's great cause, Xiong Yi felt even more furious.

Did he really love Zhao Zheng to this extent?

Having lost, Xiong Yi became even more jealous that Ying Zheng could get Xu Fu's "deep love." How could Xiong Yi know that "deep love" certainly existed, but it was Ying Zheng's for Xu Fu, not Xu Fu's for Ying Zheng.

"You deceived me so bitterly." Xiong Yi's face became even colder. Looking at his gnashing teeth, Xu Fu even felt that he would pounce on him and bite him twice before he would be satisfied.

Xu Fu still stood there without saying a word. He knew that Xiong Yi's emotions were surging at this time, and he didn't need to say anything; Xiong Yi would pour out all his thoughts.

"Whether it's Xu Fu or the Zhao girl, you are in my hands now, and it is I who possess you." Xiong Yi raised his eyebrows, a look of excitement flashing across his face, his tone as if he regarded Xu Fu as the winner's trophy. His appearance was far from his image in the Fengchang Temple.

This was the reason why Xu Fu loathed Xiong Yi.

Xiong Yi said how much he liked him, but in reality, he just treated him as a little toy, an object. Even if Xiong Yi no longer had his former status, he still didn't put Xu Fu on an equal footing with himself. Although Ying Zheng was a monarch, he always respected Xu Fu. Not just Xu Fu, even his ministers, Ying Zheng had never treated them with a high and mighty, "I look down on you" attitude. On this point, Xu Fu felt that Xiong Yi was completely incomparable to Ying Zheng.

"Where is Jianjia?" After Xiong Yi talked for a long time, Xu Fu slowly lifted his eyelids and asked about the purpose of his arrival.

Xiong Yi was so angry that his face almost changed color. He had said so much to Xu Fu just now, and he wasn't moved at all?

Xu Fu stroked the patterns on the small tripod in his arms and repeated the question about Jianjia's whereabouts.

Xiong Yi smiled maliciously, "Looking for Jianjia? Then you have to serve me well first."

Xu Fu asked him, "How to serve?"

Xiong Yi thought that Xu Fu had softened his attitude because of fear, and couldn't help but want to pull Xu Fu into his arms. But in his excitement, just as he took a step toward Xu Fu, he almost fell. He was injured and had lost too much blood; his legs were weak, and he really couldn't walk a few steps. Xu Fu was immediately relieved. Looking at Xiong Yi's appearance, he couldn't do anything anyway.

Xiong Yi met Xu Fu's gaze, and an angry expression couldn't help but appear on his face. He struggled to crawl up from the ground and was suddenly speechless. Xu Fu guessed right; in his current state, even if he wanted to do something, he was powerless.

"Take him down to settle in first." The embarrassed and angry Xiong Yi could only arrange it in a deep voice.

Two soldiers entered from outside the tent and invited Xu Fu out. Xu Fu walked out holding the tripod in a great mood, and while walking, he calmly observed the situation in the military camp. Soon, Xu Fu discovered that there were indeed no other generals in the army. It seemed that the current Zhao army had become Xiong Yi's one-man show. Did that Zhao King know that he was raising such a powerful tiger?

That day, Xu Fu did not hesitate to torment the Zhao soldiers.

Fetching water, looking for food... With their service, Xu Fu fell asleep very comfortably.

That night, Xu Fu didn't have any dreams, not even dreams about Jianjia. Although Xu Fu didn't know how Jianjia was doing now, since he had come, he would naturally bring Jianjia back intact.

Because Xiong Yi's injury was indeed too serious, he couldn't send troops again immediately. And no matter how conceited Xiong Yi was, he knew how powerful Meng Tian's reputation was. If he confronted Meng Tian head-on, it wouldn't be strange if he died on the spot. So for the past few days, Xiong Yi had restrained himself, which, by mistake, put Xu Fu in a safe environment.

A few days passed, and Xiong Yi still didn't take Xu Fu to see Jianjia. However, the wounds on Xiong Yi's body finally healed a little. Watching the Zhao and Qin armies go to war, the emotions in Xu Fu's heart were hard to calm down for a long time. In this battle, what would Xiong Yi bring out again?

Xiong Yi naturally wouldn't take Xu Fu to the battlefield. Xu Fu was left in the tent. He could only hear the sound of the Zhao army leaving. After an hour passed, Xu Fu felt that he seemed to hear the sound of fighting.

Then several soldiers entered his tent, looking fierce and murderous, and were about to take him out. Xu Fu looked at them coldly, "What are you doing?"

The soldiers looked indifferent and didn't say a word, taking Xu Fu directly out. Xu Fu really didn't like anyone treating him so rudely, and his face immediately turned cold. The soldiers seemed to be unaware and took him out of the camp. They should be taking him to the battlefield. What was the point of taking him to the battlefield? And at such a time. It couldn't be that Xiong Yi thought he could use him to hold the Qin army hostage, right?

Xu Fu really didn't want to go, so he stopped his steps.

Those few people frowned and said coldly, "Walk."

As soon as they finished speaking, they suddenly felt like they smelled something burning. They searched for the smell and looked down, finding burning flowers and plants by their feet. They were very ordinary, just like random flowers and plants on the side of the road.

They instinctively felt that something was strange, stepped on the flowers and plants twice, and then were about to continue walking forward with Xu Fu.

Xu Fu pointed in a direction, "I want to relieve myself."

The soldiers' faces turned extremely ugly.

Xu Fu watched them without moving.

They gritted their teeth and took Xu Fu to a small forest nearby.

Xu Fu stood there with his back to them, not moving at all.

The soldiers looked at his posture, waited impatiently for a while, and couldn't help but step forward, asking sharply, "Are you done?"

"Yes," Xu Fu met the soldiers' gaze, "I'm done."

The soldier suddenly felt that he couldn't breathe in his chest, and his vision became dizzy. The whole person felt a bit shaky, "You..." The soldier wanted to scold him, but as soon as he said one word, the whole person swayed and couldn't stand still.

The others behind him noticed something was wrong and hurried over, but after taking two steps, they also felt a wave of dizziness in front of their eyes.

They finally realized that something was wrong, glaring at Xu Fu's direction, swaying, swaying... and then fell down headfirst. One after another. Xu Fu stood there and watched them fall one by one. After confirming that they wouldn't wake up, Xu Fu walked back slowly. Xu Fu soon reached the outside of the Zhao army camp. Xu Fu rubbed the cloth strip on his wrist, but there was no reaction for a long time. It seemed he couldn't count on it. Xu Fu simply started pacing outside the Zhao army camp.

Xu Fu didn't know how long it had been, but he finally heard the Zhao army returning to the camp. Not long after, the Zhao army camp became noisy. They must have discovered that he was missing.

Xu Fu didn't deliberately hide, so he was naturally found very quickly.

Xiong Yi ran out with a livid face, the veins on his forehead bulging. When his gaze glared at Xu Fu, Xu Fu even had the feeling that he wanted to kill himself. Xiong Yi looked at Xu Fu for a long time to calm his mood, then walked up quickly and grabbed Xu Fu's arm tightly, "Want to run?"

Xu Fu: "..."

Xiong Yi sneered twice, "Let's go, I'll take you to see Jianjia."

Xu Fu didn't expect that after such a toss, Xiong Yi would actually agree to take him to see Jianjia. Xu Fu didn't say a word and was taken into the Zhao army camp by Xiong Yi. After entering, Xiong Yi asked him coldly, "Didn't you see the person I sent to pick you up?"

He saw them. Now they were still in the woods keeping company with wild beasts and insects.

Xu Fu shook his head.

Xiong Yi frowned, his mood extremely unpleasant. His trust in the Zhao army was not high, so the first thing he thought of was that the Zhao army didn't listen to his orders, but he never thought that the people he sent were all killed by Xu Fu. Perhaps in his heart, Xu Fu was just a person with a cold shell but actually extremely weak.

After walking a few steps, Xu Fu said in a low voice, "You sent someone to pick me up to the battlefield? To threaten the Qin King with me?"

The expression on Xiong Yi's face stiffened, "How could that be?" He really didn't want to use Xu Fu as a threat, but he wanted to show off in front of the Qin King, wanted to stimulate him, wanted to let him see who Xu Fu was following now, and in whose hands Xu Fu's life was held.

Xu Fu glanced at him coldly.

That look made Xiong Yi feel a bit uncomfortable and angry. He was like a split personality, his emotions mixed with joy and sorrow, and the expressions on his face flashed in various ways, looking red one moment and white the next.

Xu Fu didn't know what he was thinking, only feeling that Xiong Yi's eyes were truly creepy.

Unknowingly, Xiong Yi stopped outside a tent with him.

Xiong Yi lifted the tent flap and took Xu Fu inside.

Xu Fu saw Jianjia tied up at a glance. He quickly scanned Jianjia from head to toe. Fortunately, he was not injured. Xu Fu breathed a slight sigh of relief. And Jianjia, after seeing Xu Fu, first had his eyes light up, and then the light in his eyes dimmed because he saw Xiong Yi.

Xiong Yi pointed at Jianjia and said to Xu Fu, "One day, Zhao Zheng will also be tied up by me like this, and the Qin State will also fall into my hands like this..."

"And the fact is, you are just an ordinary general who still has to look at the Zhao King's face," Xu Fu reminded him coldly.

Xiong Yi laughed instead of getting angry.

Xu Fu: "..." Had Xiong Yi really been perverted into a masochist? He treated him coldly, but he seemed to enjoy it.
