chapters.source_text:
宫人跪在地面上，小心翼翼地清理着残灰，一点也不敢漏下，其余宫人小心地在殿内来来往往。
徐福就是在这样的窸窣声中清醒过来的，睁开眼看见黑沉沉的帐顶时，他还愣了一会儿。或许是近日来他不知不觉习惯了每日清晨，是被身边嬴政起时的动静吵醒的，之后嬴政起身穿衣洗漱，他便也不得不跟着起床。但是今天嬴政竟然破天荒地没有令他一同起床？
“王上呢？”徐福踢开被子，从床上起来，因为动作幅度稍大，宽松的裤管直接撩了起来，露出半截雪白的小腿。
宫人原本抬起头正要答话，见状又惊恐地低下了头，“奴婢不知。”就算知道，也不能胡乱透露秦王的行踪啊，除非他们不要命了。
徐福也没为难他们，他知道在这个时代，下是不能妄言上的。
他起身下床，穿着鞋履，明明姿态慵懒，却叫人不敢直视。宫人双手捧着白袍递上，“这是王上留给太史的。”
徐福伸手摸了摸，面料竟然十分细滑，在这个时候能做到如此精美的面料，也是不容易了。
“这是给我换洗的衣服？”
那头赵高不疾不徐地走进来，笑道：“徐先生官服换下之后，暂时无法及时从衣冠署取来新的袍服，王上便特令宫人翻出王上年少时的袍服给徐先生。请徐先生先试试，可否合身？”
徐福咋舌。
把我年少时的衣服给你的这种戏码，那不是经典的君臣相得的互动象征吗？
秦始皇给他的这个荣耀有点大啊！
徐福克制住想要抓起衣服先闻一闻的冲动，他矜持地点点头，张开双手等待宫人替自己换上。
王室的袍服是相当讲究的，但嬴政命人找给徐福的这一套却并无特别之处，只是做工精良，用料上乘。这套白袍，若是穿在俗人的身上自然就显得跟粗布麻衣没什么区别，但穿在仙人身上，或许也就平添几分仙气。
宫人站起身将衣袍为徐福穿好，又为他洁面漱口。
赵高在一边看得惊叹不已。
这是秦王年十二时穿的衣袍，那时秦王身量已经不小了，秦王又生得比较黑，偏偏有人因他是赵姬的儿子怠慢于他，故意令人做了白色袍服送来，秦王只穿了一次便没再穿过。后来年岁渐长，嬴政登秦王位，身材越发魁梧，面容越发英俊。有赵太后和华阳太后把着关，秦王虽年少，但谁还敢怠慢？这套袍服自然便被压箱底了。
就这样的少年衣服，套在徐福的身板儿上，下摆虽然短了些，不过肩倒是合适。
这时已经入秋，外面凉风吹拂还是有些凉意，宫人害怕怠慢了徐福，便取来了披风，也是雪白一片，罩在徐福身上，徐福觉得自己就跟个移动靶子似的，白晃晃的。
倒是赵高脸上笑容更甚，夸道：“徐先生风姿卓绝，令我等俗子仰望。”
虽然是在夸自己，但徐福怎么听都怎么觉得奇怪。大概是因为他身处王宫，夸他的又恰好是秦始皇身边的内侍？就好像宫女夸自家娘娘貌美如花一样……哦呸呸！他想到哪里去了？
其他宫人偷偷打量了徐福几眼。
不得不说，红色袍服虽然将人衬得面如桃花，眉眼绯红。但白色袍服却更能衬托他的气质，尤其是披风那么一托，就显得又年纪轻又气质清，倒像是原本就该生在王宫里锦衣玉食的人了。
徐福可不知道这些人在想什么，他眼尖，一眼就看见了赵高身后那宫人手中捧着的大盒子。
“这是什么？”徐福指了指。
赵高转身将盒子拿过来，随后打开了盖子，露出里面的东西来。正是当初徐福刚穿越过来的时候，在那个卦摊上看见的东西。他本来可以不用如此执着的，但他也是突然想起，那天匆匆一瞥桌案上的东西，竟然和他上辈子用的差不多。
他上辈子用的那些道具，基本都是从师门里拿出来的，而其它充数的才是直接网购的。没办法，那个时候他要装一下全才嘛，所以才准备了那么多东西。而这个盒子里的东西却更不了得，不仅有与他之前用的道具一模一样的，还有另外的道具，但是只需要看一眼就知道，这些玩意儿可不是随便什么材料做出来的。
徐福忍不住蹲下身去摸了摸。
龟甲触手冰凉，八卦盘仿佛浑然天成，黑白色如同游鱼一般在盘上缓缓流动，签筒也打磨得十分细致，就连那块被收起来的幡布，摸上去都感觉不一般。
都是好东西！
“麻烦了。”徐福冲赵高微微勾了勾嘴角，表示个笑意，随后将里面的东西都取了出来，然后赵高等人就目瞪口呆地看着徐福将这些玩意儿，一个一个，塞进了衣袍里，仿佛里面放了个兜布口袋似的。
其实兜布口袋是没有的，不过那个时候男人也有胸兜这玩意儿嘛。白袍宽大，徐福要往里装个东西太容易了。
嬴政跨进殿门来的时候，恰好瞧见徐福一只手伸进胸前的动作，乍一看，还以为他欲脱不脱的呢，再看他那因为偏转身子而露出半截的雪白下巴，嬴政突然觉得自己心里有点憋得慌。
“做什么？”嬴政开口嗓音十分低沉，像是受了风寒一样。
徐福吓了一跳，连忙抽出手，他双手叫交握于前，哪里还有刚才半分不拘小节的模样，“……我收东西。王上的声音怎么那么哑？”
难得能看见嬴政愣了愣，“是么？寡人昨夜未能入睡，便起了，或许是吹了凉风吧。”
徐福点点头，“我东西都准备好了，但是……王上不用准备吗？”徐福的意思是，秦王出行难道不是要很大阵仗吗？为什么好像整个王宫什么动静都没有的样子？
“准备什么？”嬴政眼睑低垂，不知道视线放在何方，甚至模样还有点儿漫不经心的味道。
“自然是仪仗一类的……”
“寡人已经派人先行前往雍城了。”嬴政突然抬起头，看着徐福的双眼道，“明日寅时，你随寡人出发。”
徐福不太懂古代加冠的礼仪，于是只能点点头。先答应秦始皇再说。
“随寡人到前殿去。”说着嬴政便转身先往外走了。
徐福连忙跟上去，却在跨过脚下门槛的时候，他突然注意到嬴政的脖子后面有一道红痕。
这是搁哪儿撞了？
不可能吧，秦始皇会蠢到撞了脖子？倒像是指甲掐的。
徐福突然福至心灵，哦，难道是每晚跟他睡觉太无趣，秦始皇终于忍不住半夜偷偷去临幸他的美丽妃子们了？
chapters.translated_text:
The palace attendants knelt on the floor, carefully cleaning up the residual ash without daring to miss a single speck, while others moved back and forth cautiously inside the hall.

Xu Fu woke up amidst this rustling sound. Opening his eyes to see the dark, heavy canopy of the bed, he remained dazed for a moment. Perhaps recently he had unconsciously grown accustomed to waking up every morning to the sound of Ying Zheng moving around beside him, after which Ying Zheng would get up, dress, and wash, leaving him with no choice but to get up as well. But today, against all expectations, Ying Zheng had not ordered him to get up together?

"Where is the King?" Xu Fu kicked off the quilt and got out of bed. Because his movement was a bit too wide, his loose trouser legs pulled right up, revealing the lower half of his snow-white calves.

The palace attendant, who had just raised his head to reply, looked down in terror at the sight and said, "This humble servant does not know." Even if they knew, how could they casually reveal the Qin King's whereabouts unless they had tired of living?

Xu Fu did not make things difficult for them; he knew that in this era, subordinates were not permitted to speak presumptuously about their superiors.

He got up, put on his shoes, and though his posture was lazy, it made people not dare to look him in the eye. A palace attendant presented a white robe with both hands, saying, "This is what the King left for the Grand Historian."

Xu Fu reached out and touched it. The fabric was exceptionally smooth and fine; to produce such exquisite material in this era was no easy feat.

"Is this a change of clothes for me?"

Over there, Zhao Gao walked in at a leisurely pace and smiled, saying, "After Mister Xu's official robes were taken off, new ones could not be retrieved from the Bureau of Dress in time. Therefore, the King specially ordered the attendants to unearth the robes from the King's youth for Mister Xu. Please try them on, Mister Xu, to see if they fit."

Xu Fu clicked his tongue.

This trope of 'giving you the clothes I wore in my youth'—wasn't that a classic symbolic interaction of a monarch and his subjects in deep harmony?

The honor Emperor Qin Shi Huang was bestowing upon him was a bit too grand!

Xu Fu suppressed the urge to grab the clothes and sniff them first. He nodded with restrained dignity and opened his arms, waiting for the attendants to help him change.

Royal robes were extremely particular, but the set Ying Zheng had ordered people to find for Xu Fu had nothing special about it other than fine workmanship and superior materials. If worn by an ordinary person, this white robe would naturally look no different from coarse hemp clothing, but worn by an immortal, perhaps it added a touch of celestial aura.

The attendants stood up and dressed Xu Fu in the robe, then helped him wash his face and rinse his mouth.

Zhao Gao watched from the side in amazement.

This was a robe the Qin King wore when he was twelve years old. At that time, the Qin King's stature was already quite large, and he also had a relatively dark complexion. Moreover, because he was Lady Zhao’s son, some people slighted him and intentionally ordered white robes to be made and sent over. The Qin King wore it only once and never again. Later, as he grew older and ascended the Qin throne, his figure became increasingly robust and his facial features more handsome. With Queen Dowager Zhao and Queen Dowager Huayang keeping watch, who would still dare to slight the young Qin King? Naturally, this robe ended up locked away at the bottom of a chest.

Yet this kind of youthful clothing, when draped over Xu Fu's frame, had a hemline that was a bit short, but the shoulders were a good fit.

Autumn had already arrived by this time, and the cool wind blowing outside still carried a hint of chill. Fearing that they might neglect Xu Fu, the attendants fetched a cloak—also pure white—and draped it over Xu Fu. Xu Fu felt just like a moving target, all glowing white.

Zhao Gao's smile only grew wider, and he praised, "Mister Xu possesses transcendent grace and bearing, making ordinary mortals like us look up in awe."

Although he was praising himself, no matter how Xu Fu listened to it, it felt strange. Probably because he was in the royal palace, and the one praising him happened to be Emperor Qin Shi Huang's personal eunuch? It felt just like a palace maid praising her own mistress for being as beautiful as a flower... Oh, pui pui pui! Where was his mind wandering?

The other attendants cast a few sneaky glances at Xu Fu.

It had to be said that while red robes made one's face look like peach blossoms with flushed brows and eyes, white robes could set off his temperament even better. Especially with the cloak draped over him, it made him look both youthful and ethereal, entirely like someone who should have been born in the royal palace amidst a life of luxury and fine food.

Xu Fu had no idea what these people were thinking. With his sharp eyes, he immediately caught sight of the large box held in the hands of the attendant behind Zhao Gao.

"What is this?" Xu Fu pointed at it.

Zhao Gao turned around, brought the box over, and opened the lid to reveal the contents inside. It was precisely the things Xu Fu had seen at that fortune-telling stall when he had first time-traveled. He might not have needed to be so attached to them, but he suddenly remembered that his brief glance at the items on the table that day showed they were surprisingly similar to the ones he used in his past life.

The props he used in his past life were basically taken from his sect, while the ones used as filler were directly bought online. There was no help for it; at that time, he wanted to put on an act of being a master of all trades, which was why he had prepared so many things. Yet the items in this box were even more extraordinary: not only were there items identical to the props he used before, but there were also other tools, and just a single glance told him that these gadgets were not made from ordinary materials.

Xu Fu couldn't help squatting down to touch them.

The tortoise shell felt ice-cold to the touch, the Bagua compass seemed naturally formed with black and white colors slowly flowing across it like swimming fish, the bamboo slip cylinder was polished with extreme care, and even the folded cloth banner felt unusual to the touch.

They were all good things!

"Sorry to trouble you." Xu Fu curled the corners of his mouth slightly toward Zhao Gao to show a smile, and then took out all the items inside. Zhao Gao and the others then watched in dumbfounded silence as Xu Fu shoved these gadgets, one by one, into his robe, as if there were a hidden cloth pocket inside.

Actually, there was no cloth pocket, but men of that era did have things like chest pouches. The white robe was loose and wide, making it too easy for Xu Fu to stuff things inside.

When Ying Zheng stepped through the hall threshold, he happened to catch Xu Fu reaching one hand into his chest. At first glance, it looked as if he was in the middle of undressing, but when he looked closer at the snow-white chin half-exposed by his turned body, Ying Zheng suddenly felt a stifling sensation in his heart.

"What are you doing?" Ying Zheng's voice was very deep when he spoke, sounding as if he had caught a cold.

Xu Fu was startled and quickly withdrew his hand. He clasped his hands in front of him, retaining none of his previous unrestrained manner. "...I was packing my things. Why is the King's voice so hoarse?"

It was rare to see Ying Zheng stunned for a moment. "Is that so? We were unable to sleep last night and got up early; perhaps We caught a chill from the cold wind."

Xu Fu nodded. "I've packed all my things, but... does the King not need to prepare?" What Xu Fu meant was, shouldn't the Qin King's journey involve a massive procession? Why did it look as if the entire palace was completely quiet without a single stir?

"Prepare what?" Ying Zheng lowered his eyelids, unsure where his gaze was resting, his demeanor even carrying a hint of casual indifference.

"Naturally, the grand procession and such..."

"We have already sent people ahead to Yongcheng." Ying Zheng suddenly raised his head, looked into Xu Fu's eyes, and said, "Tomorrow at the Hour of Yin, you will set out with Us."

Xu Fu didn't quite understand the etiquette of ancient capping ceremonies, so he could only nod and agree with the First Emperor of Qin first.

"Accompany Us to the front hall." With that, Ying Zheng turned and walked out first.

Xu Fu quickly followed, but as he stepped over the threshold, he suddenly noticed a red mark on the back of Ying Zheng's neck.

Where on earth did he bump himself?

Impossible, right? Would the First Emperor of Qin be foolish enough to bump his own neck? It looked more like scratch marks from fingernails.

A flash of inspiration struck Xu Fu. Oh, could it be that sleeping with him every night was so boring that the First Emperor of Qin finally couldn't help sneaking out in the middle of the night to favor his beautiful concubines?

chapters.title: 第190章
chapters.translated_text:
The King of Yan, however, suddenly laughed, his gaze dark and unreadable as he looked at Xu Fu. "The State Preceptor has misunderstood my intentions. Ji Dan is my son, no matter what; how could I possibly kill him?" The King of Yan composed his expression and said in a deep voice, "Why not send Ji Dan to the Qin State as a hostage?"

Xu Fu looked at the King of Yan several times, confirming he was truly not joking, before he spoke: "...In that case, is the King of Yan willing to part with him?"

The King of Yan smiled and said in a deep voice, "Why would I not be willing?" A look of melancholy flashed across his face. "I am doing this to preserve Ji Dan's life. As soon as the fortunes of the Yan State grow more prosperous, I will naturally bring him back from Qin."

These words were truly hypocritical.

Is the Qin State a place one can just go to and leave whenever one pleases? Once Ji Dan goes, it is equivalent to being abandoned. Why must the King of Yan continue to put on such a show in front of him? After doing the dirty work, he still has to feign helplessness, claiming he only made the best choice...

"If the King of Yan is willing, then that is for the best, though it is a pity for the Prince..." Xu Fu said with an expressionless sigh.

The King of Yan was long accustomed to this demeanor of his, so he did not find it strange. He sighed lightly, "It is a bargain for that King of Qin, then..."

Xu Fu frowned inwardly. A bargain for Ying Zheng? Sending Ji Dan over is just adding trouble for Ying Zheng! How is that a bargain?

"Once Ji Dan leaves, where will the State Preceptor reside?" the King of Yan asked in a low voice. Judging by his demeanor, it seemed he hoped Xu Fu would move into the royal palace. But no matter where Xu Fu lived, he had no desire to live in the royal palace.

"When Ji Dan leaves, I shall move to Prince Qiu's residence."

Hearing Xu Fu suddenly mention Prince Qiu, a look of surprise flashed across the King of Yan's face, but then he laughed. "Good, once Ji Dan departs, you may move into Zi Qiu's residence." The expression on the King of Yan's face was meaningful; Xu Fu knew what he was thinking. He must have assumed that Xu Fu had taken a fancy to Prince Qiu, and Xu Fu did not intend to explain. He guessed that the King of Yan must feel much more at ease now.

To keep someone so devotedly working for the Yan State, what is the sacrifice of one mediocre son?

Prince Qiu might appear favored by the King of Yan, but in reality, if even Ji Dan can be discarded by the King of Yan at a moment's notice, what more of him?

Seeing that Xu Fu had no objections to his decision, the King of Yan felt much more at ease. He seemed to already see the scene of his fortunes rising after Ji Dan's departure. The future of the Yan State would surely be a smooth path... What is the Qin State? One day, he would trample that brat Ying Zheng under his feet.

The King of Yan looked at Xu Fu with increasing fervor. He stared at Xu Fu for a long while before waving his hand to summon an attendant.

The attendant entered the room and respectfully led Xu Fu out.

Just as they exited the palace gates, they saw a woman walking slowly from afar. Although her appearance was not particularly outstanding, her attire was extremely luxurious. The woman glanced in Xu Fu's direction with a hint of coldness and disgust.

The attendant beside him whispered, "That is the Queen."

So, that is Ji Dan's mother?

Xu Fu did not take her hateful gaze to heart. Ever since he began to thrive in the Yan State, many people had been hating him in secret, but so what? It was enough that he was living well; why would he care how others viewed him? Even if they considered him a sycophant, it was not worth his concern.

Oh, he had sabotaged Ji Dan, so it was only right for the Queen of Yan to hate him. Xu Fu calmly brushed past the Queen.

Seeing that Xu Fu did not even pause his stride, as if she were invisible, the Queen of Yan's face turned extremely ugly. She turned around, wanting to call out to stop Xu Fu, but the palace maids beside her quickly reached out to pull her back, whispering, "Your Majesty..."

Nowadays, the State Preceptor held a distinguished position in the Yan State; even as the Queen, she probably could not afford to provoke him.

The Queen of Yan naturally knew this, but the more she knew, the more resentment she felt. She watched Xu Fu leave and snorted coldly, saying, "One day, I will surely have Ji Dan kill this man. Leaving him in the state is nothing but a disaster!"

The palace maid hurriedly tugged at her.

The Queen of Yan turned around and saw the King of Yan standing behind her. She was startled and quickly bowed her head.

The King of Yan looked at her deeply and turned to leave.

Xu Fu stayed at Ji Dan's residence for a few more days, meeting with Li Xin once in the middle. Li Xin was getting impatient to take Xu Fu away, and Xu Fu had indeed stayed in the Yan State for too long.

"Go back and wait with peace of mind. It won't be long before we can leave the Yan State safely."

Li Xin moved his lips and asked in a low voice, "What method will the Shuzhang use?"

"I cannot say yet. I will find a way to notify you when the time comes. Just wait outside the city." Xu Fu still needed Li Xin by his side; Li Xin had martial prowess, which would make things easier later, whereas he himself had no strength to truss a chicken, and the plan would not work otherwise.

Perhaps due to guilt, Li Xin was extremely obedient to Xu Fu at this time. Since Xu Fu told him not to ask, he did not dare to ask another word.

After sending Li Xin away, the King of Yan invited Xu Fu to the palace again, mostly to introduce him to Yan's generals or to have him calculate the weather and look at the fortunes of high-ranking officials... Among the Yan ministers, some were extremely disdainful or even hostile toward Xu Fu, while others were secretly fearful. Xu Fu did not care at all; he had never intended to stay in the Yan State for long, and these people could not do anything to him. Xu Fu understood the King of Yan's character well: extremely selfish and self-interested, and highly valuing the Yan State and his own royal power. As long as Xu Fu could make the King of Yan value him, no one else would have the chance to harm him.

During this period, Xu Fu either went to the palace or to Prince Qiu's residence. The joy on Prince Qiu's face grew more and more intense, looking every bit like a man in his prime. The King of Yan assumed the two had already hooked up and deliberately indulged them, not asking any questions.

Soon, the envoy sent by the King of Yan arrived in the Qin State, conveying the King's intention to send Ji Dan as a hostage.

The ministers of Qin were all stunned. Is the King of Yan's brain broken? We haven't even attacked yet, and he's already rushing to send his favorite son over? The ministers suddenly thought of Xu Fu, who was serving as the State Preceptor in Yan. Could it be that Xu Fu had bamboozled the King of Yan into sending his son? The ministers all shuddered, and thinking back to how Xu Fu was when he was in Qin, they suddenly felt that this was not impossible...

At this point, they no longer dared to think that Xu Fu had betrayed Qin and defected to Yan.

They couldn't help but sympathize with the Yan State... Sigh, will they really not be ruined by Xu Fu? Sigh, Commander-in-Chief, your junior brother is truly terrifying...

Ying Zheng, at this moment, had no time to care what the ministers were thinking. His heart was filled with Xu Fu.

Even while in the Yan State, he was thinking of him in every way... Thinking of this, Ying Zheng's heartbeat quickened, as if it wanted to jump out of his chest. Ying Zheng had learned the meaning of the phrase "thinking of someone until one goes mad." If there were truly supernatural powers in the world, he would wish he could fly to Xu Fu's side and protect him in his arms to feel at ease.

Ying Zheng forced himself to calm down, looked at the Yan envoy, and accepted the Yan State's request.

After the Yan envoy left, Ying Zheng worked tirelessly to handle the remaining affairs, and soon the matter of the Wei State offering land was also dealt with completely. Ying Zheng took his men and set out from Xianyang toward the Yan State.

Whether the Yan Prince comes or not, he didn't care at all; now he was going to pick up Xu Fu himself.

To intimidate the Yan State, Ying Zheng also brought a large army, accompanied by Meng Tian and Fu Su.

The way Ying Zheng looked, it was almost like he was bringing his whole family to pick up his wife.

When the Yan envoy left the Qin State, the news that the King of Yan was sending Prince Dan to Qin as a hostage spread throughout the Yan State. The common people did not understand the underlying reasons; they only knew that Prince Dan was sacrificing himself for the Yan State. Most of them felt great respect for this Prince Dan, and for a time, Prince Dan's reputation among the people grew even higher. This made the King of Yan somewhat unhappy, but he would not voice his displeasure.

After the Queen of Yan heard the news, she collapsed to the ground, completely disregarding her composure.

After a long while, she regained her senses and, with her palace maids, marched aggressively toward the King of Yan's quarters.

It must be that State Preceptor Xu Junfang!

It must be him!

The Queen of Yan, with red eyes, burst into the great hall...

Not long after, the Queen of Yan came out, stumbling with the help of her maids. She gritted her teeth hard and viciously spat out Xu Fu's name, "...A fine Xu Junfang indeed!"

At this moment, Xu Fu had just parted ways with Prince Qiu and returned to Ji Dan's residence. Ji Dan stood at the door, looking at him approach with a complex expression, and stepped forward to whisper, "The State Preceptor went to see Zi Qiu again?"

"Why?" Xu Fu looked up to observe and found that there was still some jealousy on Ji Dan's face. Oh, jealous that he was chatting happily with the younger brother he looked down upon, but unwilling to associate more with him? It doesn't matter; soon you won't have the energy to be jealous.

Just as Xu Fu was thinking this, he saw a servant from the residence stumble in, crying out miserably, "...Prince! Prince!" Once he got close and saw Xu Fu, he suddenly couldn't say a word. His face turned bright red, and he stammered for a long time, almost unable to catch his breath.

"What is it?" Ji Dan frowned at him.

The man stammered for a while, breaking into a cold sweat as he looked in Xu Fu's direction. Everyone believed the State Preceptor had pulled the strings to get the Prince sent away; now that he was in front of the State Preceptor, how could he dare to speak?

"What is the matter? Why don't you speak?" Xu Fu also turned to look at him.

That glance from Xu Fu became a threatening look in the servant's eyes. The servant trembled all over and had to whisper honestly, "News has come from the palace that, that... the Prince will be sent to the Qin State as a hostage."

Ji Dan was completely stunned.

Ji Dan naturally had his own informants and men, but this time he hadn't received any news, and it was a servant who came to report it, which showed how many people already knew about it.

Why would this happen? Ji Dan couldn't figure it out no matter how he tried. He was the King of Yan's most outstanding son; what could possibly be worth the King of Yan sending him to the Qin State? Ji Dan was not entirely oblivious; he often felt the King of Yan observing him, but as a son, it is hard to speculate about one's parents with malicious thoughts. Ji Dan, of course, would not have thought of this.

And it was precisely when he didn't expect it that the King of Yan dealt him a heavy blow.

Going to the Qin State... would he ever have a chance to return to the Yan State? Ji Dan felt a chill throughout his body and couldn't say a word for a long time.

Ji Dan looked in Xu Fu's direction, his gaze dazed. "...The State Preceptor frequently associated with Prince Qiu because you knew the King was going to send me to the Qin State and felt there was nothing left to gain from me?" Ji Dan's voice was cold in a way he didn't even realize.

Xu Fu really wanted to tell him that there was indeed nothing for him to gain from him.

Nowadays, Xu Fu wanted power—didn't he have it? Gold and silver—didn't he have them? Beauties... Ying Zheng could count as one, perhaps...

So, in summary, what else did he need to get from Ji Dan?

"The Prince is mistaken." Xu Fu's voice was calm and cold, like a basin of ice water poured over Ji Dan's head. Compared to this, Ji Dan's earlier loss of composure inevitably seemed somewhat ridiculous.

Ji Dan was indeed mistaken.

How could Xu Fu be frequently associating with Prince Qiu just because he was leaving? Xu Fu was going to accompany him.

Xu Fu smiled silently in his heart, then turned and left with a cold expression. From beginning to end, no one discovered his calculations. They certainly wouldn't see through his true emotions either.

Ji Dan lost all his strength, leaning on his servant as he stood there, watching Xu Fu's retreating figure. A thought suddenly arose in his heart: was it a mistake from the very beginning to help his father bring Xu Junfang to the Yan State?

"Prince? Prince?" The servant, seeing Ji Dan's terrifying expression, couldn't help but tremble as he called out to him twice.

"...Let's go." Ji Dan could not bear the way Xu Fu had looked at him just now. Ji Dan loathed Prince Qiu and really disliked Xu Fu interacting with him.

Now Ji Dan was about to leave...

Why not take the State Preceptor with him, so that he would end up with nothing after all his efforts?

Ji Dan had already concluded from the bottom of his heart that Xu Fu intended to stay in the Yan State to support Prince Qiu.

Having suffered too much stimulation, Ji Dan had walked into a dead end. There was even a voice in his heart subtly seducing him, "Take the State Preceptor with you... just take the State Preceptor with you..."

After a long while, Ji Dan finally moved his feet and left the place.

The news that Ji Dan was to be sent to the Qin State as a hostage also reached the ears of the other Yan princes. They were first surprised, and then they couldn't help but gloat. Everyone knew the King of Yan intended to make Ji Dan the Crown Prince; Ji Dan was too outstanding, keeping them suppressed so firmly that they didn't even have a chance to stand out. Now Ji Dan was leaving.

...Their chance had come!

The Yan princes could barely contain their joy.

The Queen of Yan was naturally even more furious.

In the blink of an eye, the day for Ji Dan's departure arrived. Ji Dan hadn't slept all night, sitting in his room for the entire night. Until the next day, when his maid entered the room, her eyes red, serving him as he dressed and washed, full of reluctance.

"Where is the State Preceptor?" Ji Dan's voice was somewhat hoarse.

"...The State Preceptor went to Prince Qiu's residence," the maid whispered.

Ji Dan's expression became even uglier.

The Yan envoy's entourage was already waiting outside Ji Dan's residence. Ji Dan changed his robes, stepped out of the residence, and boarded the carriage. The residence where he had lived for many years gradually turned into a black dot in his eyes.

By the time the Queen of Yan arrived outside the residence, Ji Dan was nowhere to be seen. The Queen of Yan almost collapsed to the ground on the spot.

Meanwhile, Xu Fu had already rendezvoused with Li Xin.

The people who had been by his side had been tricked away by Xu Fu.

The King of Yan trusted Xu Fu more and more now, so he naturally wouldn't order people to watch Xu Fu every moment like in the beginning, making sure he didn't leave his sight.

"Let's go, wait outside the city," Xu Fu glanced at Li Xin and whispered.

Xu Fu had undergone a small disguise.

He couldn't help it; who told him to have such an outstanding appearance? Walking out like this, he didn't know how many gazes he would attract. And it wasn't realistic for Xu Fu to dress ugly. The safest way was to dress as a woman, pretend to be a wealthy household, board a carriage, and leave Ji City safely.

Upon reaching outside the city, Xu Fu stopped the carriage and waited in the bushes with Li Xin.

"When that carriage gets close, I will give the order, and you will step forward to block it, deal with the other attendants, and then we can seize Ji Dan."

Li Xin nodded and waited quietly on the side.

Not long after, a team of people came out, full of momentum. But no matter how strong the momentum was, it couldn't change the fact that they were sending a Yan prince to be a hostage.

Li Xin was about to rush forward but was grabbed by Xu Fu. "Wait honestly," Xu Fu said in a stern tone.

Li Xin wasn't angry and, upon hearing this, waited honestly.

The team actually stopped as they were walking, and they stopped for quite a while before starting again. When the team moved forward again, there was a carriage trailing far behind the team.

The team moved forward slowly, and seeing that they were about to leave, Li Xin became a bit anxious.

Xu Fu, however, calmly pointed to the gray carriage not far from the city gate. "When that one comes over, we will go up."

"Is Ji Dan in there?"

Xu Fu nodded.

"How does the Shuzhang know?"

"The King of Yan told me himself. How could he have thought that I would come to hijack his son?" From everyone's perspective, it felt like there was no need for Xu Fu to leave the Yan State. After all, the King of Yan honored him as the State Preceptor, trusted him extremely, bestowed upon him countless gold and silver treasures, and even his own son could be discarded to him. What a great honor! What reason did he have to leave? And in terms of reputation abroad, the Yan State was much better than the Qin State. Just regarding the versions of the King of Qin's cruelty, there were more than a dozen outside.

So who could have guessed that Xu Fu had never set his heart on the Yan State?

Now, the thread of longing in Xu Fu's heart was still hanging in the Xianyang Palace of the Qin State.

Li Xin smiled lowly, hiding the look of admiration in his eyes.

It was he who had overthought it; the other party could live well no matter where he was.

They waited a while longer, and the carriage slowly approached. "Go!"

Li Xin acted upon hearing the sound, lunging forward. Because they were already some distance from the city gate, no one noticed what was happening here. The few attendants were startled and immediately rushed up to fight with Li Xin, but Li Xin's methods were those used for killing on the battlefield, and these few attendants weren't even enough to fill his teeth.

After only a few rounds, the attendants were beaten to the ground.

Li Xin, as Xu Fu had said, pried open their mouths and fed them each a pill, telling them that if they messed around, his master would trigger the pill, and they would explode and die. The attendants naturally didn't believe it, but Li Xin made them feel if their lower abdomens were burning intensely, and their throats and tongues were extremely uncomfortable...

The few of them felt it carefully and were almost scared out of their wits.

Who isn't afraid of death? Except for one who resisted stubbornly, the others became honest. Li Xin walked up and lifted the curtain of the carriage. The person sitting inside opened his eyes. "Who are you?" Ji Dan asked sharply.

"Does the Prince not recognize me?" Li Xin sneered, dropped the curtain, and shouted lowly toward Xu Fu's side, "Shuzhang."

Ji Dan's heart sank suddenly. He suddenly had a bad guess.

The curtain was lifted again, and Xu Fu, who had changed back into men's clothing, boarded the carriage. Ji Dan saw Xu Fu's cold and calm face, his heart pounding, unable to calm down for a long time. His brain was filled with various thoughts; he had vaguely grasped something, but he hadn't been able to grasp anything.

"Prince, you have been captured," Xu Fu said faintly, then said to Li Xin, "Give him one too."

Li Xin nodded, stepped forward, and chopped at Ji Dan's neck. Ji Dan's body went limp, he collapsed inside the carriage, and then his mouth was pried open, and a pill was stuffed into it. Ji Dan excitedly wanted to vomit it out, but unfortunately, his actions were all in vain. Li Xin let go, and Ji Dan fell softly into the carriage, where was the demeanor of a Yan prince?

"Let's go," Xu Fu said.

Li Xin nodded and immediately ordered someone to drive the carriage, while he guarded inside the carriage to prevent Ji Dan from doing anything in a fit of rage.

It took Ji Dan a long time to give up the action of vomiting outward. He knew that Xu Fu's alchemy was also extremely famous, and he didn't know what would happen after taking that medicine. Ji Dan was both terrified and angry. Having suffered too much stimulation during this period, Ji Dan couldn't say a word for a long time.

He leaned against the carriage wall, resting for a long time before recovering, his voice becoming even hoarser. "...Why? Why did the State Preceptor do this?"

Li Xin said very unhappily, "What State Preceptor? He is the Si-Che Shuzhang of our Great Qin! A tiny Yan State! How could the Shuzhang look upon it?" Although Li Xin wasn't a good person, he remembered to defend the Qin State at this time. Of course, to a greater extent, Li Xin just didn't like hearing Ji Dan say that Xu Fu was from the Yan State.

Ji Dan was furious at Li Xin, and because his emotions were too agitated, his cheeks quickly turned red. "Why? Why!" By the end, his voice was close to a roar.

Is Ji Dan's heart so fragile? Xu Fu looked at him with surprise.

"No reason," Xu Fu glanced at him coldly. "At the beginning, when the Prince abducted me to the Yan State, why didn't you ask yourself, why!"

Ji Dan's face turned even redder, and he couldn't say a word for a long time.

He seemed to really have no position to blame Xu Fu.

Ji Dan closed his eyes, his emotions surging in his chest. Was he wrong? So now there is nothing to complain about?

Ji Dan was once again led into a dead end by Xu Fu's few words.

In fact, the distinction between right and wrong is sometimes not that easy to distinguish. After all, each is in a different state, serving their own masters. Ji Dan, for the sake of the King of Yan, took the risk to capture Xu Fu. In the eyes of the Yan people, Ji Dan is filial, loyal, and a warrior who is not afraid of danger. But in Xu Fu's eyes—where did this idiot come from to take me away from the Qin State!

Xu Fu not killing him was already Ji Dan's good luck.

After all, Xu Fu was living a good life, who wanted to run to the Yan State to be a State Preceptor!

Violating other people's wishes, in Xu Fu's eyes, is wrong!

Xu Fu snorted coldly, leaning in the carriage to rest, letting Ji Dan spin in a dead end by himself.

Under Li Xin's urging, the coachman drove the carriage at a gallop, and gradually, they moved away from Ji City...

Xu Fu was too casual in Ji City; he never notified anyone in advance when he wanted to see Prince Qiu, saying he would come when he wanted, and wouldn't come if he didn't want to. Gradually, Prince Qiu also got used to his temperament. For several consecutive days, he didn't see Xu Fu come to the door, and Prince Qiu didn't care, assuming that since Ji Dan had left, Xu Fu still had some things to deal with, so he didn't come in time.

And the King of Yan had always assumed that Xu Fu was at Prince Qiu's residence.

It wasn't until the King of Yan sent someone to invite Xu Fu to the palace again, and the attendant couldn't find Xu Fu's whereabouts everywhere, that he panicked and hurried to the palace to report.

The King of Yan didn't take it to heart when he first heard it, but laughed instead: "Did you look carefully? Maybe the State Preceptor went out to play with Zi Qiu?" The King of Yan had already concluded that Xu Fu had taken a fancy to Prince Qiu, so of course, he thought in this direction first. For intimacy and affection, the two of them dismissed the attendants and went out to play casually, which was possible.

But the attendant's face turned pale, and he trembled: "...The servant has looked, only, only Prince Qiu is in the residence."

The King of Yan then took it to heart. He hurriedly sat up straight and asked in a deep voice: "Where else? At Ji Dan's residence?"

"...Also no."

"What about the attendant I assigned to the State Preceptor?" the King of Yan asked coldly.

"Can, can't see him anymore." The attendant's body trembled even more violently.

The King of Yan was so angry that he threw the bamboo slips in his hand, "Then what are you still standing there for? Go find him!"

"Can't find him." This sentence reached the attendant's mouth, but he never had the courage to say it. In the end, he could only retreat and lead people to search for Xu Fu's whereabouts all over Ji City.

The King of Yan sat in the hall, the more he thought about it, the more wrong it felt. He wanted to believe in Xu Fu, but he was extremely afraid that Xu Fu was deceiving him. He had revealed quite a few things to the other party... If the other party wanted to use them...

The King of Yan was secretly shocked and really didn't dare to gamble, so he called people to lead troops to search for Xu Fu.

He didn't dare to use the word "arrest" yet. He was worried that if he misunderstood Xu Fu, and after catching him, offended him, wouldn't that cause trouble instead?

The generals sent out led troops to search outside Ji City, but they couldn't find him either.

...

On the other side, Xu Fu and his party had already walked a long way, but they hadn't found a single person searching. Xu Fu was a bit surprised. Had the King of Yan not discovered his disappearance yet?

How could Xu Fu know that the few attendants he had tricked away, if they had told the King of Yan in time after discovering his disappearance, the King of Yan would naturally have sent people to search. But the King of Yan's prestige was very heavy, and the attendants didn't dare to report to him that Xu Fu had disappeared. Who isn't afraid of death? While the King of Yan hadn't discovered it yet, everyone should quickly pack their things and run for their lives. So by the time the King of Yan came to his senses and discovered that Xu Fu was gone, it was already several days later. Even if he sent out more people, he couldn't find Xu Fu.

"Didn't expect things to go so smoothly," Xu Fu whispered.

Ji Dan's expression was dim, and he didn't speak to Xu Fu.

Li Xin said on the side: "It's all the Shuzhang's wisdom."

Xu Fu didn't want to say anything to Li Xin either, so after finishing his exclamation, he simply closed his mouth.

The carriage suddenly became quiet, but Li Xin didn't have the self-awareness that Xu Fu didn't want to bother with him. He leaned forward and whispered to Xu Fu, "How did the Shuzhang think of this method?"

Ji Dan, hearing this, also pricked up his ears.

Ji Dan was also curious about how Xu Fu thought of this method.

"Does this need thinking?" Xu Fu asked back. "Ji Dan abducted me to the Yan State, I was unhappy, so I just sabotaged him. I just guessed that the King of Yan would send him away, so I thought of mixing into the team. No one would think that we would hide in Ji Dan's carriage."

In fact, if the King of Yan hadn't thought of sending Ji Dan away, Xu Fu naturally wouldn't have taken this opportunity to run away.

Ji Dan, upon hearing this, immediately gritted his teeth hard, and even his lips were bitten until they bled. Thinking about it, he must be extremely resentful in his heart, but it was his father, what else could he be dissatisfied with?

In the blink of an eye, they were about to leave the territory of the Yan State.

Thinking of Ying Zheng in Xianyang, Xu Fu had no dissatisfaction, only full of longing. Xu Fu even couldn't help but outline in his brain the appearance of Ying Zheng about to stand into a stone statue of a wife waiting for her husband.

Being a man himself, Xu Fu naturally wouldn't just wait for Ying Zheng to come and save him.

When Ying Zheng sees him, he should be surprised, right?

At that time, he disappeared under his nose, um, when he goes back, he can use this to ask for some convenience. Xu Fu's head was full of things in the Xianyang Palace, and he couldn't think of anything else.

On the way, they passed through Zhao and Wei, and Xu Fu could occasionally hear these people mentioning his name. Xu Fu, who had been a celebrity for many years, was calm.

They chose an inn to rest. Xu Fu had just walked in when he heard someone say: "Heard the King of Qin went to the Yan State?"

"What for? To pick up the Yan hostage?"

"...Doesn't look like it, I'm afraid it's to go and use the Yan son to exchange for that Yan State Preceptor."

"Oh! Him..."

"This person is really powerful..."

Xu Fu's eyelids jumped, and his mood suddenly sank. No way? He just left the Yan State, and Ying Zheng went to the Yan State? Although when he was in the Yan State, Xu Fu also hoped for Ying Zheng to go, but rationally speaking, he didn't want Ying Zheng to go to the Yan State at all. What's more, he had already escaped from the Yan State now? The original good mood was suddenly shattered completely.

And Ji Dan was still immersed in his own emotions. His face was pale and white, and he always felt that those people's words were mocking him for not being as important as Xu Fu.

Ji Dan wouldn't have compared himself with Xu Fu, but hearing others say suddenly that the King of Qin didn't care about him as a hostage at all and wanted to take him to exchange for the State Preceptor, wasn't Ji Dan's self-esteem being stripped off and thrown on the ground to be trampled hard?

Then what was the move of his father easily sending him away? Even the Qin State didn't care!

Ji Dan gritted his teeth hard.

His face had been torn bloody in this gossip discussion.

Xu Fu wouldn't care about Ji Dan's mood.

If it were in the past, Xu Fu would also be quite open-minded, maybe he would be too lazy to care about Ji Dan, but now, if there is a grudge, it must be repaid! Xu Fu didn't know when his thoughts had changed. Perhaps he was originally like this in his bones, or perhaps he was slightly influenced by Ying Zheng, but Xu Fu felt it was quite good.

Because Ying Zheng was not in Xianyang, Xu Fu immediately lost the passion to rush back to Xianyang. He signaled Li Xin to slow down, and the party looked like they were out for a trip.

Only Ji Dan was anxious, but he had to restrain his temper and play with Xu Fu well.

By this time, Ji Dan finally determined that he shouldn't have brought Xu Fu back to the Yan State in the first place.

This one, where is he so easy to provoke? Just hope that his father hasn't been deceived by him to a terrible extent.

·

Ying Zheng and his party arrived in Ji City. What kind of status did Ying Zheng have? Naturally, he wouldn't enter the city. Entering the city were Meng Tian and Fu Su. It was Fu Su's first time going to another country's territory, and Ying Zheng's move was precisely to hone Fu Su.

After Fu Su and Meng Tian entered the palace, they demanded to see the State Preceptor.

The King of Yan was searching for Xu Fu in a state of desperation; where could he conjure a State Preceptor to give them? The King of Yan refused very unhappily. Fu Su was even more unhappy than him. Xu Fu is a person of the Qin State, you Yan State are so despicable, took the person away, and now you dare to hide him!

Fu Su already held a grudge against Ji Dan in his heart.

Poor Ji Dan didn't know yet that he had offended another person. When he arrived at the Qin King's Palace, where would there be any good fruit to eat?

Meng Tian's momentum was strong, and he insisted on seeing Xu Fu. In extreme anger, the King of Yan pointed to Prince Qiu on the side and said: "Ask him for it!"

Prince Qiu was also stunned; how did he get dragged into the water?

The King of Yan said coldly: "The State Preceptor disappeared in Ji City, and before he disappeared, he associated a lot with this rebellious son of mine. Why don't you ask him? I also want to know."

Prince Qiu opened his mouth wide, truly having bitterness that he couldn't speak of.

He was also full of resentment toward the State Preceptor now, where could he ask him to hand over a State Preceptor? He didn't know anything at all!

Xu Fu, who was far away on the other side, didn't know that his original intention was to use Prince Qiu as a cover so that people wouldn't suspect his whereabouts. Who knew that he had invisibly pitted Prince Qiu, making the King of Yan extremely suspicious of Prince Qiu, and almost killed Prince Qiu directly.

...

Prince Qiu opened his mouth but hadn't defended himself yet, when Fu Su had already drawn his sword and stepped forward: "Where is he?"

Even Meng Tian was startled.

Prince Qiu was so scared that he fell down, looking disheveled.

The King of Yan was dissatisfied: "This is the Yan State. Prince Fu Su, doing this, I'm afraid it's extremely inappropriate." Whether Prince Qiu was injured or not, the King of Yan didn't care, but what he cared about was that Fu Su's move was equivalent to slapping his Yan King's face.

燕王却是突然笑了起来，目光晦暗不明地看着徐福，“国师可是误解寡人的意思了，姬丹无论如何都是寡人之子，寡人怎么会杀了他？”燕王整了整脸色，沉声道：“不如将姬丹送到秦国为质吧。”
徐福看了燕王好几眼，确认他是当真没有开玩笑，这才出声道：“……如此，燕王舍得？”
燕王笑笑，沉声道：“寡人为何不舍？”他面上闪过怅惘之色，“寡人如此，也是为了保住姬丹的性命，只要等到燕国气运越发昌盛了，寡人自然便会将他从秦国接回来。”
这话可就实在伪善了些。
秦国哪里是说去就去，说走就能走的地方？姬丹这一去，便等同被放弃了。燕王何必还在自己跟前苦作姿态？恶事做完，还要装一装逼不得已，寡人只是做出了最好的选择……
“燕王若能舍得，那便是再好不过，只可惜了公子……”徐福面无表情地说着叹惋的话。
燕王早就习惯了他这模样，因而也并不觉得惊奇，他轻叹一声，“倒是便宜那秦王了……”
徐福暗暗皱眉。便宜嬴政什么？送个姬丹过去，那都是给嬴政添麻烦的！哪里得了便宜了？
“姬丹一走，国师宿于何处呢？”燕王低声问，瞧他的模样，倒像是希望徐福住进王宫。但徐福不管住在哪里，都不会想要住在王宫。
“到姬丹走时，我便到公子丘府上吧。”
听徐福突然提起公子丘，燕王面上闪过惊讶之色，不过随后他就笑了起来，“好，待姬丹离去，你只管住到子丘府上去就是。”燕王面上的表情有些意味深长，徐福知道他想到何处去了，他定然是以为自己瞧上公子丘了，徐福并不打算解释。他猜测这个时候燕王心底肯定安心多了。
能留得死心塌地在燕国为他效力，牺牲一个并不算出色的儿子算什么。
公子丘看似在燕王处受宠，但实际上，连姬丹都能被燕王说丢弃就丢弃，更遑逞他呢？
见徐福对自己的决定都没有异议，燕王就安心多了，他仿佛已经见到姬丹离去后，他气运回升的场面了。燕国的未来定然是一片坦途……秦国算什么？终有一日，他要将嬴政那小儿踩在脚下。
燕王看向徐福的目光越发热切，他就这样盯着徐福看了好一会儿，然后才挥手叫来了内侍。
内侍进门来，恭敬地引着徐福出去了。
刚出了殿门，远远的就见一女子缓步而来，容貌虽算不得多么出色，但她的打扮却极为华贵。女子往徐福的方向瞥了一眼，带着几分冰冷和厌憎。
一旁的内侍低声道：“那是王后。”
也就是姬丹的母亲了？
徐福并未将对方憎恶的目光放在心上，从徐福在燕国混得风生水起的时候，就已经不少人在暗地里憎恶他了，但是那又如何？他过得好就够了，哪会去管人家都如何看他呢？哪怕他们将他当成奸佞也不值得他去关心啊。
哦，自己坑了姬丹，燕国王后憎恶自己倒也没错。徐福淡定地与王后擦肩而过。
见徐福的步子顿都不顿一下，仿佛视自己为无物，燕王后的脸色极为难看，她转过身来，想要喝止住徐福，她身旁的宫人连忙伸手去拉她，口中低声劝慰地叫道：“王后……”
如今国师在燕国地位卓然，就算身为王后，怕也是不能惹的。
燕王后自然也知道这一点，但越是知道，她心中的不忿才更多，她看着徐福离去，心中冷哼一声，道：“日后，我必然让姬丹杀了此人。此人留于国中，不过是个祸害罢了！”
宫人忙拉了拉她。
燕王后回转身来，正见燕王站在身后，她惊了一跳，连忙俯下身去。
燕王深深地看她一眼，转身离去。
徐福在姬丹府中又待了几日，中途又和李信见了一次面。李信有些等不及想要将徐福带走了，徐福在燕国留的时间也的确太久了。
“回去放心等着吧，要不了多久的功夫，我们就能平安离开燕国了。”
李信动了动唇，低声问：“庶长要用什么法子？”
“现在还不能说，到时我会想办法通知你的，你只管在城外等着便是。”徐福现在还需要李信在身边，李信有一身武力，到时候下手方便，而自己手无缚鸡之力，计划根本行不通。
李信或许心中有愧的缘故，这时候倒是极为听徐福的话，徐福不让他再问，他就不敢多问半句。
送走李信之后，燕王又请徐福到了宫中，多是带他去见燕国的大将，又或是请徐福来算一算天气，为燕国重臣瞧一瞧祸福……燕国大臣中，有对徐福万分不屑甚至是敌视的，也有对徐福隐隐畏惧的。徐福根本不在意，他从未打算在燕国久留，这些人又不能拿他怎么样。徐福很清楚燕王的性子，极端的自私自利，极为重视燕国和自己手中的王权。只要徐福能令燕王重视他，旁的任何人都没机会对他下手。
这段时日，徐福不是到王宫中去，便是到公子丘府中去，公子丘脸上的喜色越来越浓，可谓是好一副春风得意的模样。燕王只当这二人已然勾搭上了，便故意放纵，并不过问。
很快，燕王派出的使臣抵达了秦国，传达了燕王要送姬丹前去为质的意思。
秦国大臣们都呆了呆。那燕王脑子没毛病吧？咱们这还没打过去呢，他就忙不迭把自己宠爱的儿子给送来了？大臣们陡然想到了在燕国做国师的徐福，总不会是徐福将燕王生生忽悠得送儿子了吧？大臣们齐齐打了个激灵，再想到昔日徐福在秦国时的模样，突然间觉得，这样倒也不是不可能啊……
这时他们哪里还敢认为徐福是背弃秦国，转投了燕国。
他们不自觉地同情起了燕国……唉，真的不会被徐福玩坏吗？唉，国尉啊，你的师弟真可怕啊……
嬴政此时哪里顾得上大臣们在想什么？他满心都是徐福。
哪怕身在燕国，他也处处为寡人着想……想到这里，嬴政的心跳加快，直恨不得从胸腔里跳出来。嬴政领教到了思之如狂这句话的含义。若是当真世间有神通，他真恨不得飞到徐福身边去，将他护佑入怀方能安心。
嬴政强制冷静下来，看向燕国使臣，允了燕国的请求。
待燕国使臣离去之后，嬴政便不眠不休地处理起了剩下的事务，很快魏国献地的事也被处理了个干净。嬴政带上了人，从咸阳出发，往燕国而去。
燕国公子来不来，他根本不在乎，如今他要亲自去接徐福了。
为了以慑燕国，嬴政还带上了大军，身边跟随蒙恬及扶苏。
嬴政这模样，还颇有点拖家带口去接媳妇儿的意思。
在燕国使臣离开秦国的时候，燕王要将公子丹送往秦国为质的消息在燕国上下传开了，百姓们不懂个中内里，他们只知公子丹要为燕国牺牲了，他们心中大都对这位公子丹敬服不已，一时间公子丹在民间的声望更高了，这一点令燕王心中有些不喜，但他却不会说出自己的不快。
燕王后听闻了消息之后，直接跌坐到了地上，什么仪态，已是全然不顾了。
半晌后回过神来，燕王后带着宫人气势汹汹往燕王处走了过去。
定然是那国师徐君房！
定然是他！
燕王后双眼通红地闯进了大殿……
没一会儿的功夫，燕王后便由宫人扶着，步履踉跄地出来了，她死死地咬着牙，恶狠狠地喊出徐福的名字，“……好一个徐君房！”
此时徐福才刚与公子丘分开，然后回到了姬丹的府中，姬丹站在门口，神色复杂地看着他走近，上前低声道：“国师又去见子丘了？”
“怎么？”徐福抬头去打量，发现姬丹脸上还有些妒色。哦，嫉妒自己跟他那个瞧不起的弟弟聊得欢，却独独不愿和他多来往吗？没关系，很快你就没力气嫉妒了。
徐福正想着呢，就见府中的下人跌跌撞撞地跑了进来，口中凄厉地喊着，“……公子！公子！”等近了，下人一见了徐福，顿时又什么话都说不出来了，他的脸憋得通红，支支吾吾半天，差点喘不过气来。
“怎么了？”姬丹皱眉看向他。
那人结结巴巴了一阵，看着徐福的方向直冒冷汗。公子被送走，大家都认为是国师动了手脚，如今当着国师的面，他哪里敢说呢？
“何事？怎么不说？”徐福也转头看了他一眼。
徐福那一眼在下人的眼中就变成了威胁的眼神，下人浑身哆嗦，不得不低声老实道：“宫中传来消息，说，说……说公子将被送往秦国为质。”
姬丹结结实实地呆住了。
姬丹当然也有自己的眼线和人手，但这一次却什么消息也没能得知，竟是下人前来禀报的，可见这件事已经传得多少人知晓了。
为什么会这样？姬丹怎么也想不明白，他是燕王最优秀的儿子，是什么事才值得燕王将自己送到秦国去？姬丹也并不是全然没有感觉的，他时常会感觉到燕王在打量他，但是凡为人子，都很难会用恶毒的心思去揣测父母。姬丹当然也不会想到这一点。
也就是在他没想到的时候，燕王给了他重重的一击。
去了秦国……他还会有机会回到燕国吗？姬丹浑身上下一阵冰寒，半晌说不出一句话来。
姬丹看向了徐福的方向，目光恍惚，“……国师与公子丘频频来往，是因为知晓父王要将我送往秦国，觉得我身上已无处可图了吗？”姬丹的声音是连他自己都未察觉到的冰寒。
徐福很想告诉他，你身上还真没什么可让我图的。
如今徐福要权势，没有吗？要金银，他没有吗？要美人……嬴政也算一个吧……
所以综上所述，他还有什么是需要从姬丹这里得到的？
“公子想错了。”徐福的声音又沉着又冷淡，如同一盆冰水，瞬间从姬丹的头上浇了下来，姬丹刚才的失态与之一对比，就难免显得有些可笑了。
姬丹还真是想错了。
徐福怎么会是趁着他要走，就和公子丘频频来往呢？徐福可是要陪他一同去的。
徐福在心底默默微笑，然后面上冷淡地转身离开。至始至终，没有一个人发现他心底的盘算。他们当然也不会看穿他的真实情绪了。
姬丹浑身失了力气，扶着下人站在那里，看着徐福远去的背影，心底突然间生出了一个想法，是不是从一开始他帮助父王将徐君房带到燕国……就是个错误？
“公子？公子？”下人见姬丹的神情可怖，不由得颤抖着出声叫了他两声。
“……走吧。”姬丹非常不能忍受刚才徐福看着他的模样。姬丹厌恶公子丘，非常不喜徐福与公子丘打交道。
现在姬丹就要离去了……
不如便将国师也带走，让他费尽功夫也一场空吧？
姬丹已经从心底认定，徐福是要留在燕国支持公子丘了。
遭受的刺激太大，姬丹走进了死胡同里，他的心底甚至有一个声音隐隐蛊惑着他，“把国师也带走……把国师也带走吧……”
许久过后，姬丹才挪动步子离开了这里。
姬丹要被送往秦国为质的消息，也传入了其他几位燕国公子的耳中，他们先是惊讶，而后便免不了幸灾乐祸了。谁都知道燕王有意立姬丹为太子，姬丹太过出色，将他们压在下面压得死死的，他们连个冒头的机会都没有。现在姬丹要走了。
……他们的机会来了！
燕国公子们恨不得拍手称快。
燕王后自然气得更狠。
转眼便到了姬丹该离去的这一日，姬丹一夜未眠，在屋中生生坐了一宿，直到第二日，他的侍女走进门来，红着眼眶服侍他穿衣洗漱，满面不舍。
“国师呢？”姬丹的声音有些嘶哑。
“……国师到公子丘府上去了。”那侍女低声道。
姬丹面色更为难看。
燕国的使臣队伍已经等在姬丹的府外了，姬丹换好衣袍跨到府外，然后上了马车。他曾经住过多年的府邸，渐渐在他眼中化作一记黑点。
等燕王后来到府外时，已不见姬丹的身影了，燕王后差点当场哭倒在地。
而此时徐福已经和李信会合了。
跟在他身边的人被徐福给忽悠到一边去了。
燕王如今越发信任徐福，自然不会再像初期那样，命人时时刻刻都盯着徐福，勿要让他从眼皮子底下离开。
“走吧，去城外等着。”徐福瞥了一眼李信，低声道。
徐福小小地变了个装。
无法，谁叫他容貌出色呢？这样走出去，还不知道要吸引来多少目光。而徐福要扮丑也不现实。最稳妥的莫过于扮作女子，装作富户，乘上马车，从蓟城中平安离去。
到了城外，徐福却停住了马车，带着李信守在树丛之中。
“待那马车近了，我下令，你便上前拦住，处理掉其他随从，我等便可以挟住姬丹。”
李信点头，安静地守在一旁。
不多时一队人马出来了，气势十足。不过气势就算再强，也改变不了他们是送燕国公子去当质子的事实。
李信正要往前冲，却被徐福一把拽住，“老实等着。”徐福口吻严厉。
李信也不生气，闻言也就老老实实地等着。
那队伍竟是行着行着就停住了，而且还停了好一会儿，才又重新启程，等队伍再往前行的时候，队伍最后就远远地坠了一辆马车。
队伍慢慢往前走去，眼看着就快要离开了，李信有些焦急了。
徐福却不慌不忙地指了指那离城门不远的灰色马车，“等那一辆走过来，我们再上去。”
“姬丹在上面？”
徐福点头。
“庶长怎会知晓？”
“燕王亲口告知我的，他哪里会想到，我会来劫他的儿子。”用所有人的目光来看，都觉得徐福留在燕国，已经没有必要离去了。毕竟燕王尊他为国师，待他极为信任，又赐他无数金银财宝，甚至连自己的儿子都可以丢给他。这是何等大的尊崇！他还有什么理由离去呢？而且在外的名声，燕国可比秦国好多了。光是关于秦王残暴的版本，在外面就有十来多个。
所以他们谁能想到，徐福从来就没对燕国动过心呢？
如今徐福心里头那根思念的线，一头还悬在秦国咸阳宫里头呢。
李信低低一笑，掩下了眼中拜服的目光。
原是他多想了，对方不管在何处，都能活得好好的。
他们又等了一会儿，那马车才慢悠悠地近了，“上！”
李信闻声而动，猛地蹿了上去，因为距离城门已经有一段距离了，压根没有人注意到这边发生的事。那几个随从被惊了一跳，立即冲了上来与李信拼杀在一起，但李信的手段都是在战场上杀人用的，这几个随从还不够他塞牙缝的。
不过几个回合的功夫，随从们就被打趴下了。
李信按照徐福说的那样，掰开他们的嘴挨个喂下一颗药丸，告诉他们，如果他们乱来，那么他的主人便会催动药丸，他们会爆体而亡。那几个随从自是不信，但李信让他们感受一下小腹是不是灼热非常，喉道口舌都难受得紧……
那几人细细一感受，差点吓得魂都没了。
谁不是怕死的？除了负隅顽抗的一人，其他人都老实了。李信走上前掀起了车帘，里面坐着的人睁开了双眼，“你是谁？”姬丹厉声问。
“公子认不出我吗？”李信冷笑一声，甩下车帘，冲徐福这头低低地喊了一声，“庶长。”
姬丹的心陡然沉了下去，他突然间有了个不好的猜想。
车帘再度被掀起，已经换回男装的徐福上了马车，姬丹见到徐福那张冷淡平静的脸，心中一阵狂跳，久久难以平静下来，脑子里挤满了各种的思绪，他隐隐抓住了什么，但却又什么都没能抓到。
“公子，你被俘虏了。”徐福淡淡地说完，对李信道：“给他也吃一粒吧。”
李信点头，上前劈了一下姬丹的脖颈，姬丹浑身一软，趴倒在马车内，然后被掰开嘴，往嘴里塞了一粒药。姬丹激动地想要呕出来，只可惜他的动作都成了徒劳。李信松开手，姬丹软绵绵地倒在车厢内，哪里还有半分燕国公子的气度？
“走吧。”徐福出声道。
李信点头，立即命人驾车，而他则是守在了马车内，避免那姬丹被激怒之下，做出什么事来。
姬丹好半天才放弃了往外呕吐的动作。他知道徐福的炼药也极为出名，那药吃下去还指不准会怎么样，姬丹心中又是惶恐又是愤怒。这段时间经受了太多的刺激，姬丹半晌都说不出一句话来。
他靠在车厢壁上，休息了好半天才缓过神来，他的声音越发地嘶哑了，“……为何？国师为何如此？”
李信十分不快地道：“什么国师？他乃是我大秦的驷车庶长！小小燕国！庶长怎么会看在眼中？”李信虽然不是个东西，但这个时候倒是记得维护秦国。当然从更大程度上来说，李信就是不乐意听见姬丹说，徐福是燕国的。
姬丹被李信气得够呛，因为情绪过于激动，他的面颊很快就泛红了，“为何？为何！”到了后面，他的声音已经接近嘶吼了。
姬丹的心灵这样脆弱？徐福诧异地看了他一眼。
“不为何。”徐福冷冷地扫了他一眼，“初时公子将我掳至燕国，怎的没有问你自己，为何！”
姬丹面色涨红得更加厉害，半晌说不出一句话来。
他似乎还当真没有指责徐福的立场。
姬丹闭了闭眼，胸中情绪翻涌，是他错了吗？所以现在也没什么可怨尤的吗？
姬丹又被徐福三两句给弄进了死胡同里去。
其实对错之分有时候还真没什么那样好分辨的，毕竟各自在不同的国家，各为其主，姬丹为了燕王，冒着风险来抓徐福，放在燕国人眼中，姬丹便是孝顺的，忠义的，更是不惧危险的勇士。但是在徐福眼中——哪里来的傻逼把我从秦国给带走了！
徐福没弄死他，已经是姬丹好运气了。
毕竟徐福小日子过得好好的，谁想跑到燕国去当国师了！
违背他人意愿，在徐福眼中，就是错的！
徐福冷哼一声，靠在马车内休息，任由姬丹自己在死胡同里打转。
车夫在李信的催促之下，驾着马车疾驰狂奔，渐渐的，他们远离了蓟城……
徐福在蓟城中太过随性，他要去见公子丘从不提前告知，都是说要上门便要上门，说不来便不会来。渐渐的，公子丘也就习惯了他的脾性。连续几日，都不见徐福上门来，公子丘也并不在意，只当是姬丹离去，徐福还有些事要处理，便未及时上前来。
而燕王也一直以为徐福在公子丘府中。
直到燕王又派人来请徐福进宫，那内侍四处都寻不着徐福的下落，这才慌忙了，赶紧到宫中去禀报。
燕王初时听闻，还并不放在心上，反而笑道：“你可仔细去瞧了？说不准国师与子丘一同出门游玩了呢？”燕王已经认定徐福看上公子丘了，当然是先往这方面想。为了亲密恩爱，这二人屏退左右，就单独随性游玩，那也是有可能的嘛。
但那内侍却脸色都白了，哆嗦道：“……奴婢去瞧过了，只、只公子丘一人在府中。”
燕王这才上了心，他忙坐直了身子，沉声问：“别处呢？姬丹的府上呢？”
“……也无。”
“寡人派给国师的那个随从呢？”燕王冷声问。
“见、见不着人了。”内侍的身体哆嗦得更厉害了。
燕王气得摔了手中的竹简，“那还愣着干什么？去找啊！”
“找不到啊。”这句话到了内侍的口中，但他始终没胆子说出来，最后只能退出去，领了人在蓟城中四处寻找徐福的下落。
燕王坐在殿中，越想越不对劲，心中想要相信徐福，但又极为畏惧徐福在欺骗自己，他可是向对方透露了不少东西……若是对方想要利用起来……
燕王心中暗惊，实在不敢赌，于是叫来了人带兵去寻找徐福。
他现在还不敢用“捉拿”二字，他担心万一是自己误会了徐福，等将人捉来了，再得罪了他，那岂不是反倒惹出麻烦。
被派出去的将领带兵在蓟城外搜寻，但是也没能搜到。
……
另一头徐福一行人已经走出老远了，但是半个来搜查的人都没发现。徐福有些惊讶，燕王难道还没发现他失踪了吗？
徐福哪里知道，被他忽悠走的那几个随从，若是在发现他失踪之后，及时告诉燕王，燕王当然会派出搜查的人。但是燕王积威甚重，随从们根本不敢禀告他徐福失踪了，谁不怕死啊？趁着燕王还没发现，大家还是快收拾东西逃命吧。于是等燕王回神一发现徐福没了，那已经是好几天之后的事了，他就算派出再多的人也找不到徐福了。
“没想到事情这样顺利。”徐福低声道。
姬丹神色黯淡，并不与徐福说话。
李信在旁出声道：“都是庶长英明。”
徐福也不想跟李信说什么话，于是等发表完感慨，也就干脆闭了嘴。
车厢内陡然安静了下来，偏偏李信还没有徐福不想搭理他的自觉，他凑上前来低声与徐福交谈了起来，“庶长是如何想到这个法子的？”
那头姬丹闻言，也竖起了耳朵。
姬丹也好奇，徐福是怎么想到这个法子的。
“这还需要想？”徐福反问，“姬丹拐我到燕国，我心中不快，不过随手坑了他一把。我不过是猜到燕王会送走他，这才想着混入队伍来罢了。不会有任何人想到，我们会躲在姬丹的马车之中。”
其实若是燕王没有动过将姬丹送走的想法，徐福自然也就不会借此机会跑掉了。
姬丹闻言，当即狠狠咬牙，连唇都被他咬得出了血。想来他心中定然万分愤恨，但偏偏那又是他的父王，他还能有什么不满呢？
一转眼，他们也快要离开燕国境内了。
想到咸阳中的嬴政，徐福没有任何不满，只剩下满腔的思念，徐福甚至还不由自主地在脑子里，勾勒出了嬴政快要站成望夫石的模样。
同为男儿，徐福自然不会一味等着嬴政来救自己。
等嬴政瞧见自己的时候，应当会吓一跳吧？
当初自己在他的眼皮子底下没了踪影，唔，回去还可以利用这一点，讨要点便利。徐福满脑子都是咸阳宫里的事，已经想不到其它了。
路途之中，他们经过了赵魏，徐福偶尔还能听见这些人提起自己的名字，当名人当了很多年的徐福淡定不已。
他们选了一处客栈歇下，徐福才刚走进去，便听人道：“听闻秦王往燕国去了？”
“去做什么？接燕国质子吗？”
“……不像吧，恐怕是前去用燕国之子换那燕国国师的。”
“噢！他啊……”
“此人也实在厉害啊……”
徐福眼皮一跳，心情陡然沉了下去。不是吧？他刚离开燕国，嬴政便往燕国去了？虽然在燕国时，徐福也有盼着嬴政去的时候，但从理智上来讲，他根本不希望嬴政到燕国去。更何况现在他都已经从燕国逃出来了呢？原本的好心情顿时被打碎了个干净。
而姬丹还沉浸在自己的情绪之中，他面色青白，总觉得那些人言语间，在讽刺自己比不上徐福的重要性。
姬丹本也不会与徐福去比较，但是乍然听闻旁人说起，秦王根本不稀罕他这个质子，想要拿他去换回国师，姬丹的自尊可不是被人扒下来，再扔到地上狠狠地踩么？
那么自己父王轻易将自己送出的举动又算什么呢？连人秦国都不稀罕！
姬丹死死地咬住了牙。
他的脸面已经在这场八卦的议论中，被撕了个鲜血淋漓。
徐福可不会去管姬丹的心情如何。
若是换做从前吧，徐福也是挺豁达的，说不定就懒得与姬丹计较了，但是现在，有仇就得报回去啊！徐福不知道自己的想法什么时候发生了改变。或许他骨子里原本就是这样的，也或许是受到了嬴政轻微的影响，不过徐福觉得挺好的。
因为嬴政不在咸阳的缘故，徐福便登时没了急着回咸阳的激情了，他示意李信放慢了脚步，一行人倒像是出来游玩的一样。
只姬丹一人急得不行，偏还要敛起脾气，好好给徐福陪玩。
到这时，姬丹终于确定，当初他就不该带徐福回到燕国。
这一位，哪里是那样好招惹的？只盼父王没有被他诓骗到一个可怕的地步。
·
嬴政一行人抵达了蓟城，嬴政何等身份？自然不会进城去。进城乃是蒙恬与扶苏。扶苏头一次去到别国的地盘上，嬴政此举也正是为了磨砺扶苏。
扶苏与蒙恬进宫后，便要求面见国师。
燕王找徐福正找得焦头烂额，从哪里变一个国师出来给他们？燕王非常不高兴地回绝了。扶苏比他更不高兴。徐福是秦国的人，你燕国如此卑鄙，把人带走，现在还敢藏起来！
扶苏心中已经记恨上了姬丹。
可怜的姬丹还尚且不知道，自己又多得罪了一个人，等他到了秦王宫，哪里还有好果子吃？
蒙恬气势强盛，非要见徐福，燕王气极之下，指着一旁的公子丘道：“问他要吧！”
公子丘也懵了懵，怎么将自己拉下水了？
燕王冷声道：“国师在蓟城失踪，失踪前与寡人这逆子来往甚多，不如你们便问一问他，寡人也正想知道呢。”
公子丘张大了嘴，当真是有苦说不出。
他如今对国师也是满腹怨气呢，叫他从哪里交出个国师来？他可是什么都不知道啊！
远在另一头的徐福都不知道，自己本意是想用公子丘来作掩护，叫人不要对他的行踪起疑，谁知道，反倒无形中把公子丘也给坑了，让燕王对公子丘万分怀疑，甚至差点将公子丘直接杀了。
……
公子丘张口还未辩解，扶苏已然拔剑上前，“他在何处？”
蒙恬都被惊了一跳。
公子丘被吓得摔了一跤，模样狼狈。
燕王不满了，“此处乃燕国，扶苏公子如此，怕是极为不妥。”公子丘受伤不受伤，燕王都不上心，但他上心的是，扶苏此举，等同打他燕王的脸。
