那田味被内侍带走之后，消息便立即在宫中传开了。人人都知，有一个方士来了咸阳，竟然大胆自荐到了王上的跟前，哇，还说要与庶长论高低，哇！这人好大的胆子！对于宫中众人来说，也就多了这样一个谈资罢了。
徐福听过之后，也只是在心底一笑置之。
那田味究竟本事如何，还得再看，反正不是这一时。
徐福没想到，没过几日，那田味便又来求见嬴政了。嬴政以为他已经卜出了结果，与徐福对视一眼后，便放人进来了。
田味没想到会在殿中又见到徐福，眼底闪过了惊讶之色，不过他很快便收拾好了自己的情绪，朝着嬴政躬身，道：“秦王。”
“你卜出来了？”
“并未，但我想请秦王见一见，我所炼的丹药。”田味献上了手中的盒子，内侍上前，接过盒子，一打开，发现里面正躺着两颗药丸，比起徐福平日里做的，看上去要大了不少。
“这是何物？”
“不过低级丹药罢了，它们能治病。头疼，风寒，皆可治。”
嗯，像感冒药。徐福默默道，这样的药，他也制了不少，不过瞧田味这般郑重的模样，徐福登时便放了心。这药几年前他就制出来了，并不是什么值得这般提起的玩意儿。田味拿出来这样献宝，可见是并不知自己的水平。
“还有呢？”嬴政问道。
田味小心打量了一眼嬴政的模样，见嬴政面色平静，心中更是佩服不已。难怪秦王能走到如今的位置上……
田味笑了笑，突然朝着嬴政跪地，口中道：“有，我还有更为神奇的丹药。”
“什么丹药？”
“延年益寿。”田味说完，见其他人面上半点情绪也无，他就知晓他们不信。
田味又道：“但我的炼丹术并不止于此。像您这样的国君，像这样强盛的秦国，应当是千秋万代下去的。不待几年，我便能制出长生不老之药。而这，正是您将需要的。”
若是早期的嬴政早将田味给驱逐出去了，什么长生不老？哪有这样可笑的玩意儿？但是同徐福一起待得久了，对这些未曾接触过的东西，嬴政倒不会立即一口否决。他只是似笑非笑地看着田味，“你说丹药能治病，能延年益寿，能长生不老，寡人便能信了吗？”
徐福在这头，看着田味的目光却渐渐冷了起来。
难道历史上撺掇秦始皇追求长生不老的方士，便是此人？！
他倒要看看，田味从何处变个长生不老药出来？还是说这田味便要似他当初欺骗燕王、太子迁一般，也这般欺骗嬴政？不，嬴政不可能这般好欺骗！徐福暗暗咬牙，心中已经对田味生起了抵制之心。不管如何，从他宣扬长生不老开始，徐福就已经认定，此人不怀好意了！
但是同样徐福也觉得怪异。
田味生了那样好的面相，却心怀恶意，这说不通啊！
都道，相由心生，是确有道理的。一个人内心如何，便会呈现在脸上。田味生了副好皮相并不奇怪，哪怕是坏人也有可能长得不错。但是长相和面相是不一样的。面相囊括一个人精气神，目光清与浊，甚至包括人的命格、气运种种……
若是心思邪恶，那么他的目光便必定是阴沉浑浊的，面相也会给人以不舒服的感觉。
而田味的面相太干净了，甚至是趋于完美，令人挑不出错处来。拥有这样的面相，田味怎么会有这样的心思呢？他怎么敢大言不惭地在嬴政跟前，蛊惑嬴政相信他的长生不老药呢？
不管如何……
徐福都不会听他再说下去。
徐福面上闪过怒色，高声道：“来人，将此人驱出去！”“你若本分卜筮，届时与我一较高低也未必不可。但是宣扬什么长生不老？你是何居心？这世上何来长生不老？”
侍从们进到殿内，将田味从地上提了起来。
田味不慌不忙地拍了拍身上的灰，沉声道：“庶长怎么能这样说呢？庶长怎么知晓世上没有长生不老呢？”他深沉地看了徐福一眼，又道：“秦王会需要我的，那丹药，田味便进献给秦王了，秦王可以试用在他人的身上。”说罢，他便顺从地任由侍从将他驱赶出去了。
嬴政全程未发一言。
徐福发完火之后，骤然想起，自己似乎直接越过了嬴政，这样……不大好。他转头看向了嬴政，嬴政对上他的目光，回以温柔的笑。
“世上并无长生不老的药，不知那田味说出这话来，是想做什么。”徐福皱眉，“许多方士惯用丹砂炼药，但长久服食丹砂却会令人致死，我实在不希望见到田味也拿此法来欺骗阿政。”
嬴政点头，温柔道：“寡人知晓阿福的心。”
嬴政这样一说，反倒换做徐福觉得不大好意思了。
旁边的内侍们已经惊呆了。
丹砂有毒……有毒……那玩意儿炼丹会死人……会死人……
将田味驱走以后，徐福本以为就此便可告一段落了。但他未曾想到没几日，那田味便又去求见嬴政了，这次倒是说他卜出结果来了。嬴政并未召见他，田味也不气馁，反而安心在宫中住了起来。
徐福颇有些哭笑不得，这人实在太过韧性了！
难道说他误会了田味，田味不过是一心追求长生不老的人，而并非有什么企图？
不过就算如此，徐福也不打算让他接近嬴政。方士，卜筮即可，他要去奉常寺都可以，但要宣扬长生不老，绝对不可！
徐福冷眼旁观几日，见田味安分下来，便也不再将他放在心上了，回头去继续专注于胡亥的心理健康。
秋季转眼即逝。
待到入冬后，徐福便极容易困乏了，尤其是窝在暖融融的被子里，他便不愿起身。生活倒是渐渐跟混吃等死差不多。没有烦恼，不愁吃喝，用的也都是好物。徐福费了好半天的劲儿，才想起来……啊，几年前，他似乎是想当国师的……这样骄奢淫逸的生活过下去，他都险些忘记自己最初的想法了。
再等等吧，没几年了……
应当没几年，秦便能统一六国了。
徐福想着想着就睡过去了。
恍恍惚惚间，徐福望见嬴政又坐在殿中，跟前站了一人，对他道：“您辛苦打下这般功绩，可传千秋。难道您不希望长生不老，永远执掌权柄吗？”
“您应当是长生不老的……”
徐福怒从心起！
怎么梦中，这田味都不安生！
徐福本能地想要出声，但是突然间那说话的人转了个身，看着徐福，笑了笑，“怎么没有呢？你不就是吗？”
……什么？
徐福脑子里混乱得很，瞬间惊醒过来。
此时已经是深夜了，一股凉风扑面而来，冻得徐福不自觉地打了个哆嗦。
殿中烛火摇曳，徐福借着烛光，才看清不远处的窗户没有关上。而床榻边上，也不见嬴政的身影。徐福怔了怔，披上衣袍起身，他往那边走去，只见嬴政高大的身影挡在了那窗户前。
“不困？”徐福出声道。
或许是因为寒冷的缘故，徐福的声音还有些嘶哑。
嬴政错愕回头，没想到徐福会醒来，他直接脱下身上的外袍，罩在了徐福的身上。
“寡人在想王翦将军何时才能胜利归朝。”
说到这里，徐福不由得问：“那田味卜的是何时？”
“不出两月。”
徐福轻笑一声，“他卜错了。”
“嗯。”嬴政将他轻笑的模样收入眼底，自己脸上的笑容也不由得深了深，他抬起手抚了抚徐福的面颊，眼眸深沉，在黑夜中，眼底就像是承载着化不开的浓墨，徐福与他对视一会儿，便有种说不出的滋味从心底慢慢攀爬上来……久久之后，有些酥痒和心颤。
“睡吧。”嬴政将徐福揽进怀中，将人裹着带回到床榻上去了。
徐福感受到温暖之后，困意便又袭上来了。但是迷迷糊糊中，他总觉得嬴政有何处不对。
……
咸阳落了雪，徐福懒洋洋地喝了热水，拍拍胡亥的头，就带着他一块儿出宫去了。他去到了尉缭的府上，管家熟门熟路地引了他进去。而这一天，徐福的身后跟了个不起眼的大个子。管家诧异地瞥了一眼这个大个子，问道：“庶长身后的侍从换人了？”
徐福点头。
管家笑道：“瞧上去是个厉害的。这位侍从可要来点热水？”
他摇了摇头，并不言语。
管家也不敢就此退下，就在一边费尽心思地找着话题与徐福说话，徐福虽然表现冷淡，但是管家与他说话，他都应了，有一搭没一搭的，倒也将话题进行下去了。
不多时，尉缭便回来了。
徐福近来到他府上的次数多了些，尉缭瞧着徐福的身影，眼眶都热了。
哎呀师弟长大了……终于知道多来看看师兄了。
徐福让人放了暖炉到亭中，然后裹着厚厚的袍子，就和尉缭一同坐在户外了。
“今日来见师兄，是想请师兄给一些建议。”
“什么建议？”一声“师兄”已经让尉缭找不到边儿了。师弟有求于他，尉缭心底都快膨胀起来了。
“师兄可觉得如今秦律严苛了些？”
尉缭心中嘀咕，秦律严苛，这话也只有你敢说了。
“怎么？”尉缭不敢贸然应声，而是先反问了一句。瞧师弟身后那个黑个子，说不准就是秦王的人……万一他张嘴说错话，师弟不会怎么样，他却要遭殃了。
“我总觉得秦律有些部分过于严苛了，日后难免引起不满……”
尉缭严肃道，“师弟，此道我并不精通啊。”
这句话让徐福脑子里顿时灵光一闪，对，尉缭通兵法，而韩非通律法啊！
徐福双眼微亮，道：“师兄提点了我，多谢师兄。”说完他便要起身。
尉缭呆了呆，忙道：“你那袍子找到了吗？”
“还未。”
尉缭叹了口气，道：“我已令人传信回去，在鬼谷中寻你从前留下的记录，若是寻到了，定然会送过来的。”尉缭不知为何徐福突然要了解起从前的事，但既然徐福需要，他帮上一把便是。
徐福此时已经站了起来，他居高临下地看着尉缭。心中突地有点感动。
想了想，徐福又坐了下来，转而问起尉缭别的事，二人坐在那里断断续续聊了不少。尉缭突然顿了顿，说起徐福从前的事，“你幼时，格外沉静，一个人捧着书简能坐上许久，谁叫也不理。”
徐福心道，这倒是有些像他小时候。
“后头大了些，便整日独来独去，还曾要与我比试高低。”尉缭平淡地讲起来，“姜游来问你怎么了，你说是……是……”尉缭皱起眉，似乎在努力回忆那个时候徐福说了什么。
“你说是……青春期到了，不用管你。”
徐福手上动作猛地一滞，整个人如遭雷击，再也说不出话来。
chapters.title: 第226章
chapters.translated_text:
Jing Ke’s life was worthless in Ying Zheng’s eyes; if not for the reputation of being a master swordsman hanging over his head, Ying Zheng wouldn't have spared him a second glance. Since Xu Fu wanted to spare his life, then so be it. He knew better than anyone that Xu Fu would never joke about his own safety. Since Xu Fu had decided to let Jing Ke go, he must have been certain that Jing Ke could no longer stir up any trouble. Ying Zheng agreed without a second thought. His accommodating demeanor was completely different from how he had spoken to Zhao Gao just moments before.

Jing Ke, or more accurately, Qing Ke. He was a descendant of the Qi state official Qing Feng, of the Jiang clan, surnamed Qing. For the ancients, a surname was extremely important; once one abandoned their surname, it was equivalent to denying the person themselves. On the day Jing Ke left the small courtyard, he changed his name to "A-Qing." It was simple and easy to remember, and Xu Fu thought it was quite good, even if it lacked the imposing aura of the name "Jing Ke." Jing Ke himself was also satisfied. He was a servant now, what need was there for an imposing aura?

Not long after, in autumn, Huan Yi was executed.

He wasn't torn apart by chariots, nor was his flesh sliced off; this was already a relatively light punishment.

By this time, Xu Fu also faintly noticed that while the Qin laws were legally sound, they did indeed seem too harsh. However, he didn't know much about this area, and even if he wanted to offer suggestions, he wouldn't know where to start. It would be better to discuss it with his senior brother, Wei Liao, another day, and then present it to Ying Zheng.

Xu Fu set his mind at ease for the time being.

After that day, Zhao Gao was truly stripped of the power in his hands, and even his movements within the palace were reduced. Yet, Xu Fu always felt uneasy. When he first arrived in the Qin state and couldn't remember how much harm the other party would eventually cause, he could stand on the other side and feel Zhao Gao’s goodwill, but now it was becoming increasingly difficult to return to the past. Yet, Zhao Gao was extremely clever and never crossed the line again. In other words, it was difficult for Xu Fu to pick out a single fault in him. This immediately made Xu Fu feel as if he had a fishbone stuck in his throat; on one hand, he suspected the other party had ulterior motives, but on the other, he couldn't find anything wrong.

Xu Fu’s contact with Zhao Gao was now limited to moments like the present.

The autumn sunlight shone in from outside the hall, and Xu Fu, standing by the window, felt much warmer. He turned around and stared at Zhao Gao and Hu Hai sitting there. Zhao Gao seemed to notice his gaze but didn't move, focusing intently on teaching Hu Hai how to write.

Xu Fu couldn't help but walk over to take a look...

Zhao Gao did indeed write a fine seal script!

The ancients loved to compare a person to their calligraphy; how the writing was reflected the person. Looking at this handwriting, Xu Fu found it truly difficult to connect him with his historical image.

At this moment, Xu Fu wished he had X-ray vision to see through Zhao Gao completely—whether he was good or bad... anything would be better than this feeling of being left in limbo.

After Zhao Gao finished teaching Hu Hai calligraphy, he bowed and retreated.

Xu Fu sighed softly, unconsciously.

Hu Hai looked up hurriedly and asked in a low voice, "Father, did I not write well?"

"You wrote very well." Hu Hai’s calligraphy was still immature, but it had taken shape, which was already quite remarkable for his age. So thought Xu Fu. In his heart, Hu Hai still seemed to be the chubby, gluttonous, sleepy little dumpling from a few years ago who would blink pitifully while hugging Fusu’s leg or Xu Fu’s arm. It was precisely because of this that Xu Fu felt angry at Zhao Gao’s teaching methods.

Xu Fu grabbed Hu Hai’s palm and pulled him up. "You're tired from practicing calligraphy today; come out for a walk with me."

Hu Hai nodded and happily followed Xu Fu out.

In truth, Hu Hai had only been practicing for a short while... but as a parent, Xu Fu was probably the type prone to spoiling children.

Nowadays, Fusu was so busy he was nowhere to be seen, and they could only see Ying Zheng; they couldn't just run off to the backyard. Xu Fu was also worried that taking Hu Hai to refine medicine and read books all day would turn him into an introverted person. Xu Fu felt that he himself had been stifled by reading too much in his youth.

Xu Fu took Hu Hai directly to find Ying Zheng. After entering the hall, Xu Fu saw a familiar person: Feng Quji.

Feng Quji was recommending someone to Ying Zheng.

Xu Fu let go of Hu Hai’s hand and asked in a low voice, "Who is Chancellor Feng recommending?"

By this time, Feng Quji had been promoted to Right Chancellor. Seeing Xu Fu, he bowed and said, "There is a fangshi who has come from afar. A few days ago, he first visited my residence. After meeting him, I had to marvel at his exquisite mind and noble temperament. He is extremely outstanding in divination and astronomy, and can even discuss military and political affairs to some extent. He is young, knowledgeable, open-minded, and humble, hoping only to realize his ambitions in Qin. Seeing that he has the air of Senior Scribe Xu, I have recommended him to the King."

Young?

And so capable?

The only thing left in Xu Fu’s mind was the title of a TV show he had once watched, "Chancellor Little Gan Luo." But thinking about it, that was impossible.

That Gan Luo had been a retainer of Lu Buwei and was not a fangshi. Although he hadn't seen this person since arriving in Qin, he figured it shouldn't be the person Feng Quji was talking about. However, Xu Fu was still astonished that he could receive such high praise from Feng Quji. He began to wonder who this person was in history. Being so outstanding, he should have been mentioned in historical records.

Seeing the look of interest on Xu Fu’s face, Feng Quji praised Xu Fu further in his speech. Only then did Ying Zheng respond, "Bring this person into the palace tomorrow."

Feng Quji bowed and saluted, "As you command."

The next day, after Ying Zheng finished handling state affairs, Xu Fu led Hu Hai over. Not long after, Feng Quji arrived with the person he had recommended.

Xu Fu sat below Ying Zheng and watched a young man walk in from the door, wearing the white cloth robes that he himself often wore. At first glance, he did indeed look a bit like Xu Fu back then. After the man approached, he followed Feng Quji in saluting Ying Zheng, saying, "Fangshi Tian Wei greets the King of Qin." Only then did he look up, and Xu Fu took the opportunity to size him up.

The man noticed Xu Fu’s gaze and returned a faint smile.

The more Xu Fu studied his face, the more alarmed he felt.

No one spoke at this moment. Ying Zheng knew that Xu Fu must be reading the man’s physiognomy, so he didn't make a sound to disturb Xu Fu’s thoughts.

Tian Wei’s physiognomy was truly too outstanding. How outstanding was it?

Observing his bearing, he was dignified and stood like a pine. Observing the "five mountains and three stops," they were smooth and balanced. Observing the five sense organs and six mansions, they were upright and clear; his eyes were calm and clean, his nose like a hanging gall, his lips red and teeth white, his cheeks thin but not giving a sense of sharpness.

Observing his waist and back, they were straight, and his temperament was noble. Observing his bones and flesh, they were well-proportioned. His five elements were of the metal type, presenting the appearance of wealth and nobility.

People often say, "the finishing touch," which shows the importance of the eyes to a person. And when Xu Fu read physiognomy, he indeed liked to look at a person’s eyes. The Tian Wei before him had a pair of phoenix eyes—long and narrow, with large black pupils, full eyelids, and fine lines at the corners of his eyes that turned upward like a phoenix spreading its wings to fly, a symbol of good fortune. His gaze was clear and bright; such people mostly came from excellent backgrounds, were gentle in nature, and were extremely gifted in certain areas.

In just a brief encounter, Xu Fu could see that his physiognomy matched Feng Quji’s description of him perfectly.

Such physiognomy... was truly rarely seen by Xu Fu, outstanding to a terrifying degree.

But precisely because the other party was too outstanding, and his line of work overlapped with his own, Xu Fu felt an instinctive repulsion between peers. He could now roughly imagine Hou Sheng’s mentality back then.

After a long while, Xu Fu gathered his thoughts and was about to say "good physiognomy" when Tian Wei spoke first. He smiled and said, "Is the Senior Scribe reading my physiognomy? As it happens, I can also read physiognomy. I see the Senior Scribe’s physiognomy is..."

Ying Zheng frowned slightly and interrupted him, "There is no need for you to speak of the Senior Scribe’s physiognomy." How could Xu Fu’s physiognomy be something for others to hear at will?

Tian Wei was stunned, then nodded and replied, "The King of Qin is right; then I shall not speak of it." He paused, then suddenly changed his tone: "However, I have long admired the Senior Scribe’s style. Seeing him today, I cannot help but wish to spar and compete with him immediately. I also want to learn what a fangshi even more excellent than me looks like."

Tian Wei’s voice was pleasant, and he spoke slowly, making it hard to feel resentment toward him. Even his challenge was not at all as unpleasant as Hou Sheng’s had been.

"Compete in what?" Xu Fu said indifferently. He hadn't expected that the first thing Tian Wei would say upon coming to the palace was to challenge him. Of course, Xu Fu was not afraid; he also longed to compete with capable people. Moreover, call him petty or possessive, but Xu Fu truly didn't like having other fangshi beside Ying Zheng besides himself.

Tian Wei said unhurriedly, "The Senior Scribe may choose. Whatever the Senior Scribe excels at, I excel at."

Xu Fu was startled. Tian Wei’s words were truly provocative, but looking at his expression, he appeared extremely humble and indifferent, without a hint of arrogance.

For a moment, Xu Fu didn't know how to judge his character.

Feng Quji, seeing that Tian Wei wanted to challenge Xu Fu the moment he arrived, frowned and felt some regret for recommending him so rashly. By comparison, although Feng Quji admired Tian Wei, he knew full well Xu Fu’s status and significance in the Qin state; Tian Wei’s rash collision with Xu Fu was truly not good.

Even Ying Zheng frowned slightly. "Whatever A-Fu excels at, he excels at"—what big words!

"Will the Senior Scribe not choose?" Tian Wei asked.

Even though the tone was still bland, it made Xu Fu feel the other party’s contempt.

Xu Fu shook his head. "Not everyone is qualified to compete with me. Since you have requested to see the King, you must first demonstrate your own abilities."

Tian Wei nodded. "The Senior Scribe is right. May I ask what ability the Senior Scribe relied on to gain the King of Qin’s favor when you first met him?" Tian Wei smiled gracefully. "Today, I shall imitate the Senior Scribe."

Ying Zheng’s gaze toward Tian Wei turned cold. "The Si Che Senior Scribe is unique in the Qin state; who can imitate him? Since you say you can do everything he can, then divine for me when I shall take the Yan state?" Ying Zheng looked at him with a half-smile, his eyes cold. He didn't hold this person in any regard.

Tian Wei was not panicked and nodded. "This matter cannot be divined in a single day. I ask the King of Qin to wait for a period of time."

Ying Zheng laughed. "And you dare to compare yourself to the Senior Scribe with this? If it were the Senior Scribe, would he need such a long time?"

"Is that so?" Tian Wei smiled as if he had a good temper; his mood did not drop, let alone show any feelings of inferiority.

Xu Fu spoke up, "What else can you do, sir?"

"Alchemy."

He could also refine pills? A strange feeling surged in Xu Fu’s heart. This person seemed like a replica of himself; whatever he could do, the other party dared to claim he could do as well.

Ying Zheng already had Xu Fu by his side, so how could he be interested in other fangshi? Moreover, this person’s tone was exaggerated, and every sentence he spoke involved Xu Fu, which made Ying Zheng quite displeased. He called over an attendant, "Invite the gentleman to stay in the palace. If he has true ability, I will certainly keep him to contribute to the Qin state. But if the gentleman is deceiving me..." Ying Zheng smiled coldly, "I fear the gentleman cannot afford the price."

Unexpectedly, Tian Wei remained unpanicked, as if he truly had real ability and was confident he could stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Xu Fu.

He nodded and replied, "If Tian Wei deceives the King of Qin, I will naturally submit to the King’s disposal."

The attendant stepped into the room and invited Tian Wei out.

Feng Quji bowed to Xu Fu and said, "It was my lack of consideration. I didn't expect him to..."

"It is fine." Actually, Tian Wei’s behavior was understandable. Those who truly had accomplishments in the way of divination would certainly be eager to meet more people, spar with them, and see the world beyond their own. If Xu Fu were in Tian Wei’s position, he might have done the same.

It was just that Tian Wei was too similar to him.

Even Tian Wei’s eyes were somewhat similar to Xu Fu’s. This gave Xu Fu a feeling of being suddenly choked, neither up nor down, which was quite uncomfortable.

Tian Wei’s figure gradually disappeared from Xu Fu’s sight.

However, thinking that Ying Zheng didn't hold him in any regard, Xu Fu felt much more at ease.

Having seen the person, Xu Fu felt it was quite boring, so he took Hu Hai out again. Once Xu Fu left, Ying Zheng’s expression collapsed. Feng Quji, fearing he would offend the King further, hurriedly found an excuse to leave, secretly wondering in his heart: the man had given him a good impression before, so why did he cause trouble as soon as he entered the palace? Feng Quji sighed and quickened his pace.

After coming out, Hu Hai tugged on Xu Fu’s hem. "Father, do you not like that Tian Wei?" "I don't like him either!" Hu Hai wrinkled his nose and said unhappily, "He is like Father in many ways. We cannot let Father King like him!"

Xu Fu: "..."

After Hu Hai said this, Xu Fu felt a bit awkward himself. Could it be that his rejection of Tian Wei was because he had... jealousy in his heart?

Xu Fu shivered unconsciously. Was he the type to be jealous for no reason? Just seeing a beautiful young man and feeling worried? He was not!

·

After Tian Wei was taken away by the attendant, the news immediately spread through the palace. Everyone knew that a fangshi had come to Xianyang and had boldly recommended himself to the King. Wow, and he even said he wanted to compare himself to the Senior Scribe. Wow! This person had such great courage! For everyone in the palace, it was just another topic of conversation.

After hearing it, Xu Fu just smiled it off in his heart.

What Tian Wei’s true abilities were remained to be seen; in any case, it wouldn't be decided in a moment.

Xu Fu didn't expect that a few days later, Tian Wei would come to request an audience with Ying Zheng again. Ying Zheng thought he had divined the result, so after exchanging a look with Xu Fu, he let him in.

Tian Wei didn't expect to see Xu Fu in the hall again, and a look of surprise flashed in his eyes, but he quickly composed himself, bowed to Ying Zheng, and said, "King of Qin."

"Have you divined it?"

"Not yet, but I would like to ask the King of Qin to see the pills I have refined." Tian Wei presented the box in his hand. The attendant stepped forward, took the box, and opened it to find two pills lying inside. They looked quite a bit larger than the ones Xu Fu usually made.

"What is this?"

"Just low-level pills. They can cure illnesses. Headaches, colds, all can be cured."

Hmm, like cold medicine. Xu Fu thought silently. He had made plenty of such medicine, but seeing Tian Wei’s solemn appearance, Xu Fu immediately felt relieved. He had made this medicine years ago; it wasn't anything worth mentioning like this. That Tian Wei brought it out like a treasure showed he didn't know his own level.

"Anything else?" Ying Zheng asked.

Tian Wei carefully observed Ying Zheng’s expression. Seeing that Ying Zheng’s face was calm, he admired him even more in his heart. No wonder the King of Qin could reach his current position...

Tian Wei smiled, suddenly knelt before Ying Zheng, and said, "Yes, I have even more miraculous pills."

"What kind of pills?"

"To prolong life." After Tian Wei finished speaking, seeing that the others had no reaction, he knew they didn't believe him.

Tian Wei added, "But my alchemy does not stop there. A monarch like you, and a powerful Qin state like this, should last for thousands of generations. In a few years, I will be able to produce the elixir of immortality. And this is exactly what you will need."

If it were the early Ying Zheng, he would have long since banished Tian Wei. What immortality? How could there be such a ridiculous thing? But having spent a long time with Xu Fu, Ying Zheng would not immediately dismiss things he hadn't encountered before. He just looked at Tian Wei with a half-smile, "You say the pills can cure illnesses, prolong life, and grant immortality; can I believe you?"

Xu Fu, on the side, watched Tian Wei with a gaze that gradually turned cold.

Could it be that the fangshi who incited the First Emperor of Qin to pursue immortality in history was this person?!

He wanted to see where Tian Wei would conjure an elixir of immortality from. Or was this Tian Wei going to deceive Ying Zheng just as he had deceived the King of Yan and Crown Prince Qian back then? No, Ying Zheng could not be so easily deceived! Xu Fu gritted his teeth secretly, his heart already filled with resistance toward Tian Wei. Regardless, from the moment he started promoting immortality, Xu Fu had already determined that this person had ill intentions!

But at the same time, Xu Fu also felt it was strange.

Tian Wei had such good physiognomy, yet he harbored malice; this didn't make sense!

It is said that "physiognomy is born from the heart," and there is truth to it. How a person is inside will be reflected on their face. It was not strange for Tian Wei to have a good appearance; even bad people could look good. But appearance and physiognomy were different. Physiognomy encompasses a person’s spirit, the clarity or turbidity of their gaze, and even includes a person’s fate and luck...

If one’s thoughts were evil, then their gaze would inevitably be gloomy and turbid, and their physiognomy would also give people an uncomfortable feeling.

Yet Tian Wei’s physiognomy was too clean, even tending toward perfection, leaving one unable to find any fault. Possessing such physiognomy, how could Tian Wei have such thoughts? How could he dare to brazenly bewitch Ying Zheng into believing in his elixir of immortality?

Regardless...

Xu Fu would not listen to him any longer.

A look of anger flashed across Xu Fu’s face, and he said loudly, "Someone, drive this person out!" "If you had stuck to divination, it might not have been impossible to compete with me. But promoting immortality? What are your intentions? Where in this world is there immortality?"

The attendants entered the hall and lifted Tian Wei from the ground.

Tian Wei patted the dust off his body unhurriedly and said in a deep voice, "How can the Senior Scribe say that? How does the Senior Scribe know there is no immortality in the world?" He looked at Xu Fu deeply and added, "The King of Qin will need me. I will offer those pills to the King of Qin; the King can try them on others." After speaking, he obediently let the attendants drive him out.

Ying Zheng did not say a word throughout.

After Xu Fu finished venting his anger, he suddenly realized that he seemed to have bypassed Ying Zheng, which... was not very good. He turned to look at Ying Zheng, who met his gaze and returned a gentle smile.

"There is no elixir of immortality in the world. I don't know what Tian Wei intends by saying such things." Xu Fu frowned. "Many fangshi are accustomed to using cinnabar to refine medicine, but long-term consumption of cinnabar will lead to death. I truly do not wish to see Tian Wei use this method to deceive A-Zheng."

Ying Zheng nodded and said gently, "I know A-Fu’s heart."

When Ying Zheng said this, it was Xu Fu who felt embarrassed instead.

The attendants nearby were already stunned.

Cinnabar is poisonous... poisonous... that stuff kills people when used for alchemy... kills people...

After driving Tian Wei away, Xu Fu thought it would come to an end. But he didn't expect that a few days later, Tian Wei would go to request an audience with Ying Zheng again, this time saying he had divined a result. Ying Zheng did not summon him, but Tian Wei was not discouraged and instead settled down in the palace.

Xu Fu was somewhat dumbfounded; this person was truly too resilient!

Could it be that he had misunderstood Tian Wei, and Tian Wei was just someone single-mindedly pursuing immortality, without any ulterior motives?

But even so, Xu Fu did not intend to let him get close to Ying Zheng. A fangshi could divine; he could go to the Fengchang Temple, but he absolutely must not promote immortality!

Xu Fu watched coldly for a few days, and seeing that Tian Wei had calmed down, he stopped keeping him in mind and went back to focusing on Hu Hai’s mental health.

Autumn passed in the blink of an eye.

After winter arrived, Xu Fu became easily drowsy, especially when curled up in a warm quilt; he didn't want to get up. Life was gradually becoming like "eating and waiting to die." There were no worries, no lack of food or drink, and everything he used was of the best quality. It took Xu Fu a long time to remember... ah, a few years ago, he seemed to want to be a State Preceptor... Living such a luxurious life, he had almost forgotten his original intentions.

Wait a little longer, it won't be many years...

It shouldn't be many years before Qin unifies the six states.

Xu Fu fell asleep while thinking.

In a daze, Xu Fu saw Ying Zheng sitting in the hall again, with someone standing in front of him, saying, "You have worked hard to achieve such merits, which can be passed down for thousands of years. Do you not wish for immortality, to hold power forever?"

"You should be immortal..."

Anger surged in Xu Fu’s heart!

How could this Tian Wei not be at peace even in his dreams!

Xu Fu instinctively wanted to speak, but suddenly the person speaking turned around, looked at Xu Fu, and smiled, "Why not? Aren't you?"

...What?

Xu Fu’s mind was in chaos, and he woke up instantly.

It was already late at night, and a cold breeze blew in, making Xu Fu shiver unconsciously.

The candles in the hall flickered, and Xu Fu saw by the candlelight that the window not far away was not closed. And by the bedside, Ying Zheng’s figure was nowhere to be seen. Xu Fu paused, put on his robe, and got up. He walked over and saw Ying Zheng’s tall figure blocking the window.

"Not sleepy?" Xu Fu said.

Perhaps because of the cold, Xu Fu’s voice was still a bit hoarse.

Ying Zheng turned around in surprise, not expecting Xu Fu to wake up. He took off his outer robe and draped it over Xu Fu.

"I was wondering when General Wang Jian would return in victory."

Speaking of this, Xu Fu couldn't help but ask, "When did that Tian Wei divine?"

"Within two months."

Xu Fu chuckled, "He divined wrong."

"Hmm." Ying Zheng took in the sight of his chuckle, and the smile on his own face couldn't help but deepen. He raised his hand to stroke Xu Fu’s cheek, his eyes deep; in the dark night, his eyes looked as if they held thick, indelible ink. Xu Fu met his gaze for a while, and an indescribable feeling slowly climbed up from the bottom of his heart... After a long time, there was a tingling and a trembling.

"Sleep." Ying Zheng pulled Xu Fu into his arms and wrapped him up, taking him back to the bed.

After Xu Fu felt the warmth, sleepiness attacked him again. But in his drowsiness, he always felt something was wrong with Ying Zheng.

...

Snow fell in Xianyang. Xu Fu lazily drank hot water, patted Hu Hai’s head, and took him out of the palace. He went to Wei Liao’s residence, and the butler led him in, familiar with the routine. On this day, a nondescript big man followed behind Xu Fu. The butler glanced at this big man in surprise and asked, "Has the attendant behind the Senior Scribe changed?"

Xu Fu nodded.

The butler smiled, "He looks like a capable one. Would this attendant like some hot water?"

He shook his head and said nothing.

The butler didn't dare to retreat just like that, so he tried his best to find topics to talk to Xu Fu about on the side. Although Xu Fu appeared cold, he responded whenever the butler spoke to him, and they managed to keep the conversation going.

Before long, Wei Liao returned.

Xu Fu had been visiting his residence more often lately, and Wei Liao’s eyes grew hot at the sight of Xu Fu.

Oh my, the junior brother has grown up... finally knowing to come see his senior brother more often.

Xu Fu had someone place a heater in the pavilion, and then, wrapped in a thick robe, he sat outdoors with Wei Liao.

"I came to see you today, Senior Brother, because I wanted to ask for some advice."

"What advice?" The word "Senior Brother" had already made Wei Liao lose his bearings. His junior brother was asking him for something; Wei Liao’s heart was almost swelling up.

"Do you think the Qin laws are a bit too harsh now, Senior Brother?"

Wei Liao muttered to himself, "The Qin laws are harsh"—only you would dare to say that.

"Why?" Wei Liao didn't dare to respond rashly, but asked a question in return instead. Looking at the black man behind his junior brother, he might be one of the King of Qin’s men... If he said the wrong thing, his junior brother wouldn't be affected, but he would be the one in trouble.

"I always feel that some parts of the Qin laws are too harsh, and it will inevitably lead to dissatisfaction in the future..."

Wei Liao said seriously, "Junior Brother, I am not proficient in this area."

This sentence made a flash of inspiration hit Xu Fu’s mind. Right, Wei Liao was proficient in military strategy, while Han Fei was proficient in law!

Xu Fu’s eyes brightened slightly, "You have enlightened me, Senior Brother. Thank you." After speaking, he prepared to get up.

Wei Liao was stunned and hurriedly said, "Have you found that robe of yours?"

"Not yet."

Wei Liao sighed and said, "I have already sent a message back to search for the records you left behind in Guigu. If they are found, they will certainly be sent over." Wei Liao didn't know why Xu Fu suddenly wanted to learn about the past, but since Xu Fu needed it, he would help.

Xu Fu was already standing up, looking down at Wei Liao. He felt a sudden touch of emotion in his heart.

After thinking for a moment, Xu Fu sat back down and turned to ask Wei Liao about other things. The two sat there and chatted intermittently for a while. Wei Liao suddenly paused and spoke of Xu Fu’s past, "When you were young, you were exceptionally quiet. You could sit for a long time holding bamboo slips, ignoring anyone who called you."

Xu Fu thought to himself, that was a bit like him when he was young.

"Later, as you grew older, you were always alone, and you even once wanted to compete with me." Wei Liao talked about it calmly. "Jiang You came to ask what was wrong with you, and you said... you said..." Wei Liao frowned, seemingly trying hard to recall what Xu Fu had said at that time.

"You said... your puberty had arrived, and there was no need to worry about you."

Xu Fu’s hand movements suddenly stopped. He was struck as if by lightning and could no longer speak a word.

chapters.title: 第227章
chapters.translated_text:
Stepping out of Wei Liao’s residence, Xu Fu was covered in snow.

The attendant and Jing Ke were standing by the carriage. Seeing Xu Fu emerge, they couldn't help but startle. For a moment, they both felt Xu Fu’s expression was somewhat strange, but upon closer inspection, they found his expression as cold as ever, revealing nothing else.

Xu Fu leaned on the attendant’s arm to board the carriage. Only after sitting down did he feel a wave of weakness.

He unconsciously fell into deep thought.

Puberty?

Could you find such a term in the Warring States period thousands of years ago? No.

Yet this word had come out of Wei Liao’s mouth. Xu Junfang... what kind of person was he exactly? He would suffer from periodic amnesia, speak words from a thousand years later, and was also extremely gifted... Two hypotheses formed in Xu Fu’s mind. The first was that Xu Junfang, like him, also came from a thousand years later, only perhaps one was a "rebirth into a fetus" while he himself had his soul enter this body. The second was that... he... belonged here from the very beginning, there was no black-market boss who killed him, and he hadn't died in the river only to wake up again. Perhaps from the moment he opened his eyes and saw Ying Zheng for the first time, his memory had been wiped clean again.

But the second hypothesis was truly terrifying, making Xu Fu’s skin crawl.

If it were truly the second, then he could potentially lose his memory again at any time. If it were the first, then the possibility of overcoming the amnesia was still quite high.

Xu Fu really disliked this feeling, as if he had fallen into a giant web, his mind filled with doubts, yet each one was tied into a dead knot that couldn't be undone. He could only wait until he obtained the records of the past to understand the life of the former Xu Junfang.

Xu Fu fell asleep without realizing it.

He was prone to sleepiness in winter, and Xu Fu didn't mind; he knew that once he exhausted too much mental energy, he easily became drowsy. Hadn't this situation occurred frequently in the past few years?

Not long after, the attendant woke Xu Fu up.

Xu Fu stepped off the carriage. The sleeping quarters were not far away, and he walked slowly toward them, immediately catching sight of a tall, upright figure. It was Fusu standing there. Having not seen him for some time, Xu Fu noticed that Fusu had grown quite a bit taller.

Seeing Xu Fu approach, the expression on Fusu’s face softened instantly. "Father."

Nowadays, when Fusu called him "Father," there was no longer any awkwardness. Fusu had grown into a young teenager, carrying quite a bit of Ying Zheng’s demeanor.

Xu Fu opened his mouth to speak to him, but suddenly his legs went weak, and he collapsed. Fusu hurriedly reached out to catch him. However, Xu Fu was ultimately much taller than him, and Fusu struggled a bit after catching him. Everything went black before Xu Fu’s eyes; he didn't know if he had fainted or fallen asleep, but he lost all consciousness of what happened afterward.

Less than half an hour later, Ying Zheng hurried over.

"A-Fu?" Ying Zheng couldn't wake Xu Fu.

The summoned court physician was also completely helpless regarding Xu Fu.

Ying Zheng had seen Xu Fu’s fainting symptoms before, so he wasn't particularly anxious this time. He ordered people to move the bamboo slips, silk fabrics, and his own desk into the sleeping quarters, and then Ying Zheng kept watch by Xu Fu’s bedside.

Fusu pressed his lips tightly together. "Could it be... a lingering effect from Father's time in the State of Yan?"

Ying Zheng’s hand holding the stylus paused. "Someone, send a message to the Si Che Shu Zhang’s senior fellow apprentice, Jiang You."

"Will Jiang You have a way?" Fine beads of sweat seeped onto Fusu’s forehead; he was truly anxious. Seeing Xu Fu collapse into his arms had been a huge shock.

"I don't know." Ying Zheng suddenly had a thought. "Someone, invite Tian Wei over."

Although the palace servants were surprised, they didn't ask questions. Xu Fu had spent ten years in the palace, and these servants had accompanied him to this day. At this moment, not only were the King and Young Master Fusu feeling distressed, but they themselves were not feeling any better.

The sky gradually turned gray as night fell.

When Tian Wei was invited out of his courtyard, he was quite surprised. He had been staying in this old, dilapidated courtyard for some time, and basically, no one paid him any mind, with palace servants occasionally bringing some food so he wouldn't starve to death. Today... why would someone come to invite him?

Tian Wei followed the palace servant to the outside of the palace.

Above the palace, the sky was shrouded in a gray color. Tian Wei looked up involuntarily and immediately felt that the sky looked like the mouth of a monster, ferociously devouring something. Tian Wei shivered involuntarily. It was an omen! It was an omen! This shiver wasn't from fear, but from excitement. It had come! It had finally come! The gentle smile on Tian Wei’s face deepened.

The palace servants didn't have a good impression of Tian Wei, but since he was a guest with a higher status than them, they suppressed their displeasure and said, "Sir, please."

Tian Wei turned back, meeting the cold gaze of the palace servant, and quickened his pace into the palace.

The candles in the hall flickered, and Tian Wei caught a glimpse of the man sitting at the desk.

"King of Qin." Tian Wei bowed from a distance. "Why has the King of Qin invited me here today? Is it for that elixir? Or for the matter of the State of Yan?"

Fusu frowned. "Where did this person come from? So lacking in manners."

He didn't like this person; he appeared too perfect, but his speech and movements made Fusu feel extremely discordant.

"Since you claim you can refine elixirs and have great abilities, then show me today." Ying Zheng looked up, the flickering candlelight reflecting on his face. Tian Wei immediately felt a sense of oppression. He swallowed involuntarily, then acted as usual and asked, "Do what?"

Ying Zheng pointed to the bed behind him.

"Go and see what is wrong with the Shu Zhang."

Tian Wei was startled. "Is the Shu Zhang ill?"

"That is for you to check, not for me to tell you." Ying Zheng’s face darkened.

Tian Wei felt the pressure on him grow even heavier. He nodded. "You are right." After saying this, he walked toward the bedside. Tian Wei’s gaze couldn't help but glance to the side. It was a majestic palace he had never seen before, the utensils in the hall were all exquisite, and also... the bed Xu Junfang was lying on was something Tian Wei had never experienced but yearned for.

But what did it matter?

Tian Wei suppressed the light in his eyes.

In the future, he would replace the other, become the most powerful fangshi in the State of Qin, become the King of Qin’s confidant, and become an "immortal" recorded in history.

This time when Xu Fu fell asleep, he had no dreams. He had a comfortable sleep, and he had woken up while Tian Wei was talking to the King of Qin. As Tian Wei approached, Xu Fu felt the aura on him.

Has it finally changed?

Xu Fu’s heart skipped a beat.

He felt this whole thing was truly bizarre.

During the day, Tian Wei was flawless, with no flaws to be found in his appearance, but once night fell, Xu Fu could clearly feel the hidden malice on Tian Wei. This aura was mysterious to describe, but having physiognomized many people and seen so many faces, Xu Fu could naturally distinguish the aura coming from a person. Whether it was malice or goodwill, whether it was a blessing or a curse.

Tian Wei had no idea that the moment his inner desires stirred, he exposed what shouldn't have been exposed. He grabbed Xu Fu’s hand and pretended to take his pulse for a while. "...It should be a cold. If the King of Qin has tested my medicine, giving it to him will make him better."

Xu Fu was laughing inside.

A cold? Absolutely impossible! Anyone with even a little medical knowledge would know he definitely didn't have a cold. Yet Tian Wei said such things. Either Tian Wei was doing it on purpose, or he didn't know how to treat illnesses at all. He had boasted that he knew everything the other knew, but now he had exposed himself.

Was he trying to use his pill as a cure-all?

Ying Zheng wasn't stupid; he had already reached the same conclusion as Xu Fu. He put down the stylus in his hand. "Oh, is that so? I have invited so many court physicians, and even they cannot detect a minor cold, yet as soon as Master Tian Wei arrives, he sees that the Shu Zhang is suffering from a cold. How severe is this cold that only Master Tian Wei can detect it?" Ying Zheng’s voice was steady, without even a hint of coldness, but as soon as Tian Wei met Ying Zheng’s eyes, he felt his whole body go weak, and his heart curled into a ball of tension.

Too terrifying...

Tian Wei’s gaze toward Ying Zheng changed. He tried his best to suppress the fanaticism in his eyes, but his voice was calm as he argued, "Does the King of Qin not believe me? Although the court physicians are skilled, there are some things they cannot see. I haven't finished what I was saying. He has caught a cold, but it is because he has been thinking too much and has exhausted too much mental energy on the art of divination, which is why he caught the cold. This cold is naturally different from other colds."

This mouth is even better at talking than mine, Xu Fu sneered internally, I almost believed it.

"Is that so?"

"Yes, King of Qin, please give him the medicine."

Tian Wei was facing away from Xu Fu and couldn't see Xu Fu hooking his finger at Ying Zheng. Ying Zheng’s eyelids twitched, and he said, "Someone, bring the medicine that Tian Wei presented the other day."

After the medicine was presented, Ying Zheng hadn't even looked at it twice, and the palace servants had naturally cast it aside. Now that they suddenly heard Ying Zheng mention it, the palace servants hurried to find it, and it took a while before they found the box.

At this moment, Tian Wei also realized that Ying Zheng hadn't cared about him at all before. Tian Wei’s heart sank, but he didn't show it on his face.

Ying Zheng opened the box, walked to the bedside, and helped Xu Fu up. Xu Fu grabbed the pill, toyed with it in his palm, and then lay back down. Tian Wei didn't even notice whether he had woken up or not, which showed he really didn't have much skill.

Xu Fu tugged on Ying Zheng’s sleeve, pretending to have just opened his eyes. He looked at Tian Wei and said coldly, "Why is he here?" It was simple to make Tian Wei reveal his ultimate goal; Xu Fu only needed to show that he was at odds with him.

Ying Zheng’s expression softened, and he said, "You saved the Shu Zhang, and I have a reward for you. Is there anything you want?"

Tian Wei wore an expression of being detached from worldly affairs and bowed to Ying Zheng. "It was just a small effort, the King of Qin need not worry about it. If the King of Qin truly wants to reward me, then let me stay in the palace and contribute to the King of Qin."

Xu Fu almost vomited listening to this.

Tian Wei really had the nerve to take credit for himself.

Xu Fu squeezed the pill in his hand. If it were his previous life, he could have taken it to a hospital to be tested and known what it was, but unfortunately, in this life, he would have to spend a lot of effort to test it. For this period, he would let Tian Wei be smug for now.

The higher they are lifted, the harder they fall.

Xu Fu pulled the blanket up, not caring at all. Drowsiness struck again, and thinking that Ying Zheng was right beside him, he had nothing to worry about. Relaxing his mind, Xu Fu continued to drift into his dreams...

Over the next few days, the area where Tian Wei could move freely in the palace expanded. Some in the palace couldn't help but discuss whether this person would also become a Grand Diviner, how much skill he really had, and if he could really save the Shu Zhang. After all, in the hearts of most, Xu Fu had become so powerful that no poison could touch him and no illness could enter. With Xu Fu’s prowess, where would anyone else be needed? However, there were also those who felt Tian Wei had a noble temperament that made people respect him involuntarily, so they couldn't help but cast admiring glances.

Xu Fu flipped through Fusu’s seal script, his thoughts drifting away.

Under such circumstances, could Tian Wei really be as Feng Quji described, indifferent to fame and wealth, and continue to maintain his noble temperament?

Those who are pursued and praised can fall into an abyss if they are not careful.

Xu Fu was no longer in a hurry. Whatever his memory was, whatever Tian Wei wanted to do, what was meant to come would come eventually.

Just as he was thinking, a palace servant suddenly brought over yarrow stalks, saying that new ones had grown.

That yarrow stalks could grow at this time was thanks to the low-quality greenhouse Xu Fu had cobbled together. Xu Fu held the yarrow stalks, and seeing Fusu reach out, he hurriedly avoided him. "Don't mess around." If it were like last time, where Fusu took them to play, he didn't know how long he would have to wait again.

"How about learning divination from me today?" Xu Fu asked Fusu.

Fusu nodded reluctantly. "Oh."

Xu Fu ruffled his hair.

Ah, he's not as cute as when he was a child.

Once Xu Fu became familiar with the yarrow stalks, divination became very fast.

After a while, Fusu looked up in confusion. With so many stalks, he had no idea how to divine...

And Xu Fu had already obtained the final result.

An ominous hexagram... ah...

Xu Fu threw the yarrow stalks aside. "Put them away, don't throw them."

"Yes." The palace servants carefully observed Xu Fu’s expression and whispered, "Is the Shu Zhang troubled by that Tian Wei? The Shu Zhang needn't be; that Tian Wei isn't even a fraction as good as you."

Xu Fu looked at the palace servant with a softer gaze. "Hmm."

At this moment, an attendant ran in hurriedly, and due to his momentum, he knelt down in front of Xu Fu with a thud. "Shu Zhang, the robe the Shu Zhang wanted has been found!"

It was actually found? Xu Fu was quite surprised; this could be considered a pleasant surprise.

"Where was it found?"

"At the office of Wang Fengchang in the Fengchang Temple."

Wang Fengchang? It took Xu Fu a while to realize that he was referring to Wang Liu. Why would his robe be with Wang Liu?

"Let's go, to the Fengchang Temple." Xu Fu stood up immediately.

Fusu lay on the ground. "Father, you go, I'm not going... sleepy... ah..." Fusu said, rolling on the ground.

Xu Fu knew he wasn't sleepy at all; it was just that yarrow divination was too boring. Perhaps after he left, he would immediately take out the bamboo slips and continue experimenting with his witchcraft. Xu Fu sighed helplessly, paused, untied the ugly cloth strip on his wrist, and tied it onto Fusu. "Play with this for a while."

Fusu touched the cloth strip and nodded heavily. The bright light in his eyes gave Xu Fu the illusion that he wanted to gnaw on the cloth strip.

Xu Fu turned and walked out.

Not long after, Xu Fu arrived at the Fengchang Temple. Upon entering, Xu Fu heard the whispers of those people. Xu Fu suddenly felt a bit nostalgic; when he was here in the past, he always caused a buzz of discussion, humming in his ears.

Slowly, Xu Fu heard clearly what they were saying.

They were talking about Tian Wei.

"What is the background of that Tian Wei? As soon as he arrived, he gained the King’s favor. He was so arrogant when he came to our Fengchang Temple today. I really don't know what he has to be arrogant about? Can he even compare to half of what Shu Zhang Xu was back then?"

Hearing this, Xu Fu almost laughed out loud.

He never expected that, without realizing it, he had become a legendary figure in the Fengchang Temple. In their words, he was being held in high esteem...

The feeling of being subtly defended by the people in the Fengchang Temple was quite strange, but it didn't feel bad.

The person behind Xu Fu had a strange expression. The person who was gossiping suddenly heard footsteps approaching, turned around, and was so scared he almost lost his soul, stammering, "...So it's, it's the Shu Zhang..."

Xu Fu swept a faint glance at them and continued forward without stopping.

The gossiper gradually came to his senses. "I didn't expect... I didn't expect the Shu Zhang to come to the Fengchang Temple. Is he here for that Tian Wei?"

"The Shu Zhang’s demeanor is as elegant as ever!"

"Yes, if you hadn't mentioned it, I wouldn't have noticed. Ten years have passed, and apart from growing taller, the Shu Zhang is still the same as he was ten years ago..."

"That natural good looks, you can't envy it..."

"Stop talking, stop talking, let's go watch the excitement. What if the Shu Zhang and that Tian Wei start a duel later?"

...

Xu Fu entered the office area of the Fengchang and caught sight of Wang Liu and Tian Wei in the room. Wang Liu’s expression was not very good. Xu Fu didn't need to get closer to guess the reason. Wang Liu’s temper was extremely arrogant; it would take a lot of effort to make him submit. And although Tian Wei didn't show it on his face, the things he said were actually extremely provocative. It would be strange if these two didn't have a conflict.

The person behind Xu Fu stepped forward and knocked on the door.

Wang Liu inside immediately stood up, his expression much better. "Shu Zhang, please."

At this time, someone brought a robe, and Wang Liu handed it to the attendant behind Xu Fu. "This is the robe." Wang Liu didn't ask why Xu Fu had gone to such lengths to find this thing. In front of Tian Wei, Wang Liu had nothing to say for a moment, and the room was silent to the extreme.

Xu Fu asked in a low voice, "Why was this item with you?"

An embarrassed look flashed across Wang Liu’s face. "Have you forgotten? When you first entered the Fengchang Temple, I once cleaned your room for you."

Xu Fu suddenly realized. At that time, he returned to the Fengchang Temple and found the room incredibly dirty. He eventually found a way to trick Wang Liu into cleaning the room for him and acting as a servant. It must have been at that time that his robe was left with Wang Liu.

"Thank you," Xu Fu said.

Wang Liu pressed his lips together. "You are too polite, Shu Zhang."

At this time, Tian Wei interjected, "So the Shu Zhang was also a Grand Diviner in the Fengchang Temple before?" Tian Wei smiled. "I thought that a person as powerful as the Shu Zhang would have been favored by the King of Qin from the very beginning."

Wang Liu curled his lips, his face clearly saying four words: "You idiot."

Xu Fu also felt that Tian Wei’s words were not very clever, so he simply ignored him.

Tian Wei then changed the subject. "Wang Fengchang seems to have great talent in the art of divination as well, with much potential. Why don't we exchange pointers?"

Wang Liu was arrogant and didn't look down on Tian Wei, a person who had popped up from who knows where. He sneered, "What are you? You have no official position, and you had no famous reputation in the Six States before. How dare you ask to exchange pointers with me?"

Wang Liu was a tough nut to crack; Xu Fu had known that for a long time. But Tian Wei didn't know that, and his face stiffened, almost unable to continue the conversation.

Tian Wei sighed regretfully. "You will regret this."

Wang Liu still sneered, not giving Tian Wei any face at all. "Oh, then I'll wait to see how you make me regret it. Don't just focus on bragging. If you really have the ability, then go and become a State Preceptor!"

Tian Wei smiled. "I am not as good as the Shu Zhang; how could I be like the Shu Zhang, who could become a State Preceptor even after going to the State of Yan?"

These words were quite grating, and Xu Fu was truly disgusted by Tian Wei’s tone, so he said, "Since you know you have no real ability, why do you say so much?"

Tian Wei’s face stiffened again. "Whether I have ability or not, doesn't the Shu Zhang know very well? Don't forget, the Shu Zhang only woke up that day after taking my medicine."

Xu Fu felt that talking to someone who was so self-satisfied was truly painful. Did Tian Wei really take his medicine as a treasure?

"Oh. Is that so?" Xu Fu asked back coldly, showing no other emotions.

But Tian Wei felt a deep sense of contempt from him. Tian Wei lowered his head and responded softly, "Yes." After saying that, he added, "The Shu Zhang should be careful recently. From observing your physiognomy, I fear there is a disaster coming."

Wang Liu couldn't help but laugh. "You know how to read faces? You are showing off your little physiognomy skills in front of the Shu Zhang? It's truly hilarious!"

Tian Wei pressed his lips tightly and looked at Xu Fu. That gaze made Xu Fu feel a sense of gloom for a moment.

Xu Fu couldn't be bothered to talk to Tian Wei anymore. He ordered the attendant to pack the robe and said, "Return to the palace."

Once Xu Fu left, Wang Liu completely ignored Tian Wei as well.

Tian Wei stood up and walked out. Standing outside the door, he smiled faintly, "The god in your eyes will always have a day when he falls."

Wang Liu didn't understand what Tian Wei meant, but he was truly annoyed by this person, so he sneered, "You have always been at the bottom of the pit, never even climbing out, and you have the nerve to talk about others?"

Tian Wei looked at Xu Fu’s back. "Believe it or not."
