那男子模样长得极为丑陋，口眼歪斜，脸上遍布脓疮。风吹过的时候，他头上罩着的面巾彻底飞远了，徐福立即便闻见了一股臭味儿。
这对于徐福来说，简直是莫大的折磨！
见徐福面容冰冷，眉头紧皱，男子便斜着眼看了过来，登时更显一脸凶相。徐福好歹上辈子见过不少怪异的人，因而恶心过那个劲儿之后，便也觉得还好了。他若是心灵稍微脆弱上一些，恐怕就给吓晕过去了。
男子冲着他咧嘴一笑，“庶长不必知道我是谁，不过一个小民，哪值得庶长知晓呢？”
徐福的心往下沉了沉。从这男子说的话，可见他是知道自己身份的，这出绑架，是有预谋的。
他出宫时纵然身边只跟了一名侍从，但实际上暗地里还跟了人，那些人跟脱了？没发现异常？还是说这名男子另有帮手？
“你想做什么？”徐福厉声道。
虽然他知道，眼前的男子多半也不会回答他。
男子大笑一声，挥鞭抽在马屁股上，马儿吃痛，当即撒足狂奔，徐福顿时被陡然加速的后坐力带得撞回了马车里，头还在车壁上磕了一下。
徐福的脸色登时就阴了下来。
他多久没吃过这样的苦了？
那男子又大笑了两声，穿过马车传入徐福的耳中，实在刺耳！
他细胳膊细腿，近来又颇为嗜睡，体力不足，徐福知道这时逃跑都是徒劳的。还不如省一省力气……
徐福干脆就靠着马车壁休息了起来，时不时他会往窗外瞥上一眼，尽力将能记住的路过的地方特征，统统记下来。不过他的精力实在没能支撑多久，不过一会儿的功夫，徐福就闭上眼，又再度入睡了。
徐福这一觉睡得几乎不分日月，醒来后，马车已经停住了。
他舒展了一下酸软的四肢，起身撩起车帘，入目的便是低垂的夜幕，还有零星点缀着的星子。
很明显，他们今晚是住野外。
“醒了？”男子抱着一捆柴大步走了过来，另一只手，还拎着野鸟。徐福看了一眼他背后的山林，影影绰绰，像是潜伏着无数凶兽。荒郊野岭，就他和这个男人，徐福本能地不愿再多看黑夜一眼，心情大约就跟深海恐惧症患者差不多。
他收起目光，然后撑着马车壁下了车。
男子扔了个袍子给他，徐福伸手去接，却被袍子直接笼在了头上。
这样实在太失气度！徐福黑了黑脸，将那袍子拽拉下来，就听男子道：“夜深寒气重，若是冻坏庶长，我这等小人可是赔不起的。”
徐福冷漠地瞥了他一眼，将袍子拢得紧了些。
那袍子应当是新买的，闻起来倒是没别的异味，全然不似男子身上的味道。
徐福松了一口气。虽然在这样的环境下，他也没什么可挑剔的，但是从心里来讲，他也并不想穿别人的衣服。幸好……
裹着袍子坐在点燃的火堆旁，夜晚的寒意立即便被驱散了。
男子将那小鸟迅速拔了毛，再剥掉皮，掏空内脏，清洗干净，欲架在火上烤。徐福光是看着都觉得难吃，他忍不住道：“就这样烤？”
男子斜睨了他一眼，“不如此，还待如何？”
徐福说着从胸前掏出了佐料，“试试这个？”里面有花椒，还有变异种辣椒，还有其它稀奇古怪的调料……这还得归功于徐福已经拿他们当整人必备的玩意儿来看待了，不然的话，徐福根本不会将它们和龟甲放在一起。
男子接过那个绢布小包，面上露出了似笑非笑的表情，“庶长确实不一样，拿出来的玩意儿，竟是我等从未见过的。说吧，庶长吃饭还有什么讲究？我能满足的，就满足了。”
男子面容实在生得太骇人了，露出笑容来，都给人以狰狞的感觉，光看脸不声音的，恐怕还以为男子是在威胁徐福。
“将里面的小包取出来，均匀涂抹在食物之上，过一会儿后再置于火上烤。”徐福根本不理会他讽刺的语气，只淡淡说完便住了嘴。
男子轻笑一声，没想到徐福竟是半点也不发作脾气，他按照徐福所说，将佐料抹在其上，然后过了许久，徐福出声道：“好了。”
男子倒也不觉得手举得酸麻，他将野鸟串好，然后架在了火上开始烤。
这个过程当然有些漫长，徐福等得有些饿了，一时间还有点儿惆怅。若是还在王宫中，此时他要做的就是坐在桌案前，等着宫人将饭食呈上来。两相对比，实在一个天上一个地下。
想一想，徐福觉得更惆怅了……
男子抽空转头看了一眼徐福，他大约也感受到了徐福的饥饿，发出了一声意味不明的轻笑。
或许是在取笑徐福自找麻烦，如今也只能饿着了。
徐福不知道等了有多久，他盯着黑漆漆的天空，听着树林中传来的虫鸣声，渐渐就麻木了。
“好了。”直到男子的声音骤然响起。
徐福转头去看，便看见了男子手中已经烤至金黄的食物，徐福将食物接过来，扑鼻而来一股香气。
徐福缓缓舒出一口气，这才觉得舒服了些。
而那男子则是从包袱中取出了普通的干粮，那饼捏在手中的时候，还在往下掉渣，看上去实在让人没什么想要吃的欲望。徐福光是瞧一眼，都觉得噎得慌。这个时候徐福也明白过来，这只野鸟是男子专门烤给自己的了，而他明显并不准备吃这个东西。
说徐福是多疑也好，不识好歹也好，但他还是出声问道：“你不吃？”
男子骤然听见他开口，不由得眯了眯眼，“我不能吃。”
“为什么？”
“放心，里面没毒。但我吃了，却会死。”
徐福目光闪了闪。
男子应当是有病在身，这种病令他无法吃肉食，或者是油腻带脂肪和调料的食物。
徐福拉了拉身上的袍子，为防意外，还是先塞了个药丸到嘴里，然后才吃起了食物。
食物本身味道一般，肉有些柴，不过外面烤得很酥，加上调味料很入味，算是难得的美味了。不知不觉吃了大半下去，徐福顿觉自己从饥饿的感觉中活过来了。
等徐福艰难地塞下最后一点食物，男子用容器盛了水回来，他将水递到徐福的跟前，徐福却并未接，而是道：“放在火上煮沸。”
“煮沸？”男子挑眉，不明白徐福的用意。
“水脏，若是煮一煮，喝下去就不容易生病了。”虽然现在是被绑架的人，但徐福的气势半点不弱，该要的，他也会尽力要求到手，而不是一个劲儿委屈自己。
男子又忍不住嗤笑了一声，不过别的话他倒是没有说，他还是按照徐福所说的那样，将水煮沸后，才取出来，然后放置在一旁，等它变凉。
待到水变得温热之后，徐福才取起那容器饮了水。
男子似乎知道自己的面容会招人嫌弃，他从容器中分了些水出来，然后才仰头一口饮尽。他大笑道：“似乎的确比之前要干净些。”
徐福没应声，他小小地打了个呵欠。不过徐福向来不会让这样毁形象的动作，出现在人前。因而他是背对着男子的，但是男子似乎知道他做什么，于是出声问道：“庶长这般体弱吗？怎的又困了？”
徐福没搭理他。
男子也并不觉得窘迫，他深知自己的绑匪身份，是不可能取得半点温和以待的。
徐福拢了拢身上的袍子，站起身来，冷声道：“我不休息，难道还与你闲话吗？”
“哈哈，世上能有几人能与庶长闲话？庶长若是与我闲话，那便是我之幸了！”
徐福头也不回地朝着马车过去了。
他其实吃得有点撑，但是也没法儿消食啊，加上人吃过饭之后本来就容易困倦，徐福就干脆选择回马车休息了。
现在还不是打探的好时机，也不是逃跑的好时机，他再蓄一蓄力。
徐福掀起车帘，正要踏上去，忽然，他想起了什么，于是顿了顿，回过头道：“你叫什么？”
这次那男子倒是没说什么“小的贱名不足一提，说出来恐污了庶长的耳朵”。男子爽快道：“阿武。”
徐福钻进马车里，放下车帘，脚突然被什么东西硌了一下。
徐福骤然想起，他的马车都是嬴政令人特制的，甚至为了让徐福避免无聊，马车里还有特制的柜子，用以放书简。现在抽出来，徐福都还能看见里面放着的书简，整整齐齐码在一起。徐福都快喜极而泣了。
终于有能打发时间的了。
睡觉固然好，但他也不能从早睡到晚，又从晚睡到早啊，这样下去，不等他的能力消退，他这个人就已经先废了。
徐福舒服地靠着马车，看起了书简，累了就睡，渴了就拿起旁边放着的水。
虽然比起王宫生活简朴了许多，但是大体上没有什么差别。
就是马车里有点颠。
如此持续几日后，阿武终于在一日发现了徐福的惬意。阿武面皮抽了抽，对着马车内舒服躺着的徐福，有些说不出话来。
“到何地了？”徐福头也不抬地问道。
阿武似乎是憋不住了，他终于问出了内心憋闷了许久的问题，“难道庶长就不惊慌担忧吗？”遭人绑架，离咸阳越来越远，他将不再是那个坐在咸阳城中的驷车庶长。难道他不会因此而惊慌担忧吗？
“莫非我惊慌担忧，你便会将我送回咸阳去了？”徐福依旧头也不抬，显然并未将阿武看在眼中。
“自然不会。”
“那就是了。”徐福淡淡道。
阿武仔细盯着徐福的面容，见他脸上确实没有展露出什么惊慌的端倪。他是真的全然不在乎，也不害怕，冷静理智到了极点。难怪能在秦王身旁坐到驷车庶长的位置，得百姓敬重。
阿武轻笑一声，似乎也觉得自己刚才问的问题，太过没水平了，他转过头去，继续驾车向前。
前方，隐隐出现了一座城池的身影。
没多久，马车便又停住了。
徐福心道，那阿武难道又有什么要问他？
不过渐渐的，马车又动了起来，而且徐福听见了嘈杂的人声，那人声越来越响亮。
……他们进城了？
徐福这次啊放下手中的书简，撩起了车帘往外一看，果然，他们的马车已经行在了城中的街道上，两旁的人并未注意到他们。
这马车在城中显得太正常不过了。
徐福心道，要是他坐驷车庶长规格的马车，阿武还能连人带马车地抢吗？
不过现在也就只能想想罢了。
“我饿了。”徐福低声道。
他知道坐在外面驾车的阿武能听清。阿武果然跳下了马车，二话不说，便去路边摊上买了些食物，拿回来给了徐福。徐福也不知道那阿武身上究竟有多少钱财，总之在这个时候倒是显极是大方。
也该大方一些。徐福心道。他可是很值价的，这点付出算什么呢？
徐福小口地咬着食物，看着马车最后停在了客栈前。
阿武掀起车帘探头进来。
他身上的异味登时便充盈了整个空间。
“将头蒙上。”阿武道。
“你想憋死我？”徐福抬眼看他，目光极为冷漠。
阿武辩解道：“不敢，只是庶长容貌气质皆是出众，还是遮挡一二为好。”
徐福直接伸手推开了他，然后绕过他下了车，干脆利落一个字，“不。”
蒙着头算什么？徐福绝对不会干！
阿武歪着身子坐在马车边上，还维持着刚才被徐福推开的姿势，他有些懵，懵得好一会儿没能说出话来。他是的确没想到徐福会粗暴地直接推开他，然后走下去。
这时客栈中，客栈外的人，都注意到徐福了。
一身黑袍子，瞧上去便贵气不凡。
这样的人物，怎么会出现在此处呢？众人又是好奇，又免不了心生向往。
风采出众的人物，无论走到哪里，都总是受欢迎和仰慕的。徐福那张俊美的脸，再次为他夺得了关注度，行走在街道上的女子，都朝他望了过来，一边暗暗在心中发出惊叹。
因为徐福受瞩目的缘故，连带着，他身后那马车上的车夫也受到了关注，大家都想瞧一瞧那车夫该是什么模样，谁知这一瞧，众人便惊恐又厌恶地收回了目光。
那个人的脸……
太可怕了！
那迎出来的客栈老板，也不由得顿了顿脚步，迟疑着看向这对“主仆”，“这……阁下的仆人，可是身怀怪病？这，怕是、怕是不能进来的。”
客栈内的人，望着这个方向，也露出了惊恐和抗拒的表情。
徐福回头看了一眼阿武，这个男人目光变得阴冷了几分，他跳下马车，直直地走到了客栈老板的跟前，“此病不会传染，若是会传给其他人，那我这主子岂不是早将我打死了。”
客栈老板觉得浑身有些冷，不自觉地打了哆嗦，但他嘴上还是道：“这……这，不行，还是不行。”面前这张脸带来的冲击力实在太大，客栈老板深觉自己承受不来。
徐福抿了抿唇，没有开口说话。
而此时阿武却是暴怒地一把揪住了客栈老板的衣领，“你再说一次？”
客栈老板可以近距离地看到阿武那张脸，他心中的惊恐几乎要将他整个人吞没，“不、不能……真的不能进去啊……”
阿武从腰间抽出刀来，抵在客栈老板的脖子上，“现在也不能吗？”
那老板腿一软，“来！来啊，请，请这两位贵客，进去……”
伙计赶紧跑了出来，与那老板相比起来，伙计见着阿武的面孔之后，还要镇定多了，他点头哈腰地请两人进门去了。
阿武手一松，老板便立即摔倒在了地上。
因为阿武个子极高的缘故，刚才他挟持住那老板，竟是除了徐福外，便再没其他人看见了。其他人只知老板不知为何，突然更改了主意，而且还在那男子走后，一下子跌坐在了地上。
众人暗道，若是换做他们，他们也会腿软吧……毕竟那男子长得可实在太可怖了！
跨进客栈之后，阿武便落后了徐福半步，做出了仆人的模样。
客栈中人一见阿武，便立即退避开来，倒是让徐福的路变得宽阔了许多。这时候，徐福也说不清心底是什么滋味儿了。阿武那模样，瞧上去是挺可怜的，但是他绑架了自己，那就不可怜了。
阿武就定了一间房，徐福微微惊奇，“一间？”
阿武看也不看他，冷淡道：“我守在你屋中便是了。”说完，他恶意地笑了笑，“若是庶长畏惧我这张脸，那也只能忍受了。”
伙计在旁边噤若寒蝉，听见二人对话，连头都不敢抬。
徐福轻嗤一声，没说话。
阿武方才被气得不轻，这会儿都有点阴阳怪气的，不过他倒是没对徐福发作什么。
那伙计送着他们进了屋子，然后又送了热水和食物来。
徐福一边解衣带，一边道：“我沐浴，你也要看吗？”一路上可都没什么条件洗澡，快憋死他了！现在徐福就恨不得将自己整个儿给埋进去。
阿武脸上的表情变了变，转身去推开了门，“我在门边等。”
徐福这才干脆利落地扒掉了自己的衣服，然后进了浴桶中，当水蔓延过全身的时候，徐福忍不住发出了舒服的喟叹声。
守在门外的阿武忍不住身子抖了抖。
徐福差不多耗了小半个时辰，然后才从浴桶里出来了。没办法，水凉了，再泡下去，他担心自己着凉。
擦干净身上的水珠，徐福穿上了新的衣袍，这也是阿武备给他的。
徐福慢腾腾地走到门边，他敲响了门板，“你要洗澡吗？”
外面响起了窸窸窣窣的声音，徐福猜测可能是蹲着的阿武站了起来。阿武推开了门，他冷着脸走进来，看了一眼徐福，冷笑道：“我就不用了，我没你们这样的娇贵身子。”
徐福将革带系好，淡淡道：“我不管你娇贵不娇贵，你得为我的鼻子考虑，去洗个澡，我相信你身上的味道会好闻很多。”阿武担心他逃跑，肯定会守在屋子里，但是徐福也并不想让阿武身上的味道，一直伴随着自己入梦。
阿武似乎被他这句话激怒了，但是恼怒也只是一瞬间，没一会儿，阿武就平静下来了，他点头，“好。”
徐福打开门出去，叫伙计又送了水来。
紧接着阿武沐浴，徐福就开始吃桌案上的食物了。因为窗户开着，屋内的味道倒还不算太难闻，徐福一心投入食物中，很快便忘记了屋子里还有个人。
等徐福吃饱了，他直起腰缓缓吐了一口气。
然后阿武从围屏后走了出来。
徐福见他出来，便起身了，“剩下的食物留给你了，若是你觉得不好，自己再叫就是。”徐福说着走到了床榻边，“我先休息了。”
阿武坐到了之前徐福坐过的位置上，拣起筷子简单吃了些食物。
后来阿武做了什么，徐福就不知道了，洗过澡，又吃了个饱之后，一躺在床榻上便火速入了睡。
徐福不知道自己离开咸阳有多久了，但他迷迷糊糊中，似乎梦见了嬴政。
嬴政的脸庞在他面前晃动个不停，让徐福心中升起了恨不得立即见到嬴政的焦灼感。
这种感觉，有点儿新奇，但是又不坏。
徐福一边难受着，一边又享受着，就在两种感觉交织之下，他缓缓醒来了。
他没想到，自己睁开眼看见的会是黑夜。
……看来他是半夜醒了？
徐福起身去喝水，却猛地看见就靠在门边入睡的阿武。阿武那张脸在黑夜中还真有些惊悚，徐福死死掐断了嗓子里差点发出来的惊叫声。
徐福取水的动静惊动了阿武，阿武立时睁开了双眼，他那双眼在黑夜中显得格外的耀眼灼灼。
“庶长做什么？”他哑着嗓子道。大概是以为徐福想要跑。
徐福扬了扬手中盛水的容器，“口渴。”
然后他走回到了床榻边，就这样坐在床上慢吞吞地喝着水。阿武似乎被惊动之后便没困意了，他盯着徐福，问道：“我听闻咸阳中人，都称庶长为神仙，我心中颇为好奇，庶长究竟有什么本事？既是神仙，那能救我这样的人吗？”
阿武的口吻有些讥讽。
“你想要我救你什么？”
“救我脱离苦海啊！”
徐福心中暗自吐槽，那是秃驴该干的事儿。
阿武见他不语，嗤笑一声，“庶长也做不到吗？想来，什么神仙也救不了我这张脸了！”
徐福认真地盯着他的脸看了一会儿。
因为脸上的妨碍因素太多，徐福只能得到他一个大致的面相。
英眉俊目，鼻梁高挺。
眸光沉着坚韧。
这类人……
再过个几年，那说不好就发展成反社会人格了啊！
“庶长怎么不说话了？”阿武冷声道。
面相本身不错。徐福暗暗在心中下了评语。但是……缘何会命运多舛呢？
徐福按下心中的疑惑，抬头对上阿武的目光，道：“可救。”
“什么？”阿武一怔。
徐福不得不重复一遍，“我说，你，可救。”
阿武呆了呆，没能从徐福这简短的五个字中回过神来，他嚅动着嘴唇，声音还是哑的，但是里面似乎含上了几丝复杂的情绪，他重复问道：“你说什么……”

chapters.title: 第237章
chapters.source_text:
徐福的口吻极是轻描淡写，“你这般模样，我是能救的。”
当然……是瞎掰的。
徐福口中笃定，但心底却并非如此。他只是发觉到了阿武面相不对劲的地方罢了，但若说治好他的病，并不是嘴上过两句那样简单。但是徐福向来有让人笃信不疑的能力，阿武对上徐福的双眼，怔了会儿，才猛地醒过神来，方才那些失态的情绪都从他身上消失了。
阿武沉声道：“庶长可不要骗我。”他的目光落在徐福身上，里面明显带着威胁之意。
“你再睡一觉，等你清醒了，再来与我说话。”徐福又喝了两口水，随后便回转身去，重新睡到床榻上去了。徐福极为宽心，哪怕是拿那阿武的脸没有办法，他也总能想出办法来。办法都是人想的嘛。
徐福毫不留情的转身，倒是阿武更为深信了。他深信徐福是真的有法子可以救他。
阿武靠在门边，许久都未能闭上眼。
徐福还能安然入睡，但他却睡不着了。他也不知道这样的折磨跟随他有多久，到后来只要能有缓解的法子，他都尽力去试过了。他已经全然放弃了可能治愈的念头。这样痛苦又麻木的日子，他不知道还要过上多久……
但是他没想到，他会从徐福的口中听到这样的话。
可救吗？
阿武握了握拳头，一双眼在黑夜中越发的明亮。
徐福有意先冷落一下阿武，毕竟现在换做是阿武即将有求于他了，为了之后不被阿武捏于掌心，徐福觉得，从一开始，他就要先将架子端足。
阿武就用灼热的目光紧紧盯着徐福，洗漱、用早饭，直到一系列动作做完，阿武才在徐福的对面坐了下来。
“庶长可愿与我细说？”阿武忍不住了，主动问道。
“你先说。”徐福头也不抬地道。
“我先？”
“说一说你这病是如何得来的。”
阿武抿紧了唇，并未马上开口。徐福也不急，就静静等着，他巴不得阿武多发会儿呆呢。这客栈中待着，比颠簸的马车上待着舒服多了。如果能拖延下时间，让咸阳的人顺着摸过来，那就更好了。
“……我是楚国人，十七那年误食了毒药，得了一场大病，险些死去。后来家中来了个方士。我并不知他做了些什么，只知道没几日我便渐渐转好了。但是从那之后，我的脸变得极为脆弱，若是在外面晒上一日，脸便会溃烂，而且症状一日重过一日。我父亲命人再去寻那方士，却怎么也寻不到了。城中谁也治不好我的病，我便只有独自一人辗转多地，只为治好这怪病。”
“方士？”徐福插了句嘴。
阿武点了点头，继续往下说：“我这般模样，无论走到何处，都令人畏惧厌恶，他们不敢与我说话的，甚至对我避而远之。连客栈我也进不去。不过倒也有个好处，那便是连乞丐窃贼见了我都绕道走，我方能保全身上的钱财。后头我也知晓医治无望了，满腔孤愤之下，便寻了位剑术高手，拜他为师，以此来止心底的痛苦。”
徐福暗自咂了咂嘴。
无人能治好啊，可见要治好这病的难度，绝非一般啊。但是话已经放出去了，徐福当然得上。眼下维持和阿武的友好相处，只有好处，没有坏处。
阿武忍不住讥笑道：“这般，你还能治？”
听阿武的描述，他之前的家境应当并不差，而且他的谈吐也并不显粗俗。之前刚将徐福绑走的时候，一口一个“小人”，估计也只是故意为之。毕竟要装粗俗简单，要装谈吐得体、腹有诗书可不简单。
现在徐福好奇的便是，阿武好端端的，为何会来绑架他？
“之后又发生了什么？是什么驱使你决定来掳走我？”徐福冷声问道，那瞬间，竟是直直将阿武的气势压下去了。
阿武滞了滞，“这我不能说。”
徐福冷冷地看着他，“治病，说出实话，二者选一。世上没有那样好的事，你绑了我，我还要尽心尽力地医治你。我没有要求你立即送我回咸阳，已是厚待你了。”
阿武面色有些难看，“若是我将刀架在你脖子上，你也能如此说吗？”
徐福不屑道：“你敢吗？你根本不敢动我分毫，那人难道不是要你将我完好无损地带过去吗？”这一点当然也是徐福推测出来的，从阿武将他绑走后，是如何对待他的，便可看出，阿武不希望他出半点意外，因而尽心尽力地待他，未曾让他吃一点苦。
阿武脸上的表情消失了，他紧紧盯着徐福，试图以目光作威慑。但是要和徐福比气势压人，那就实在是选错了对象。
徐福淡定地该做什么做什么，全然没将阿武放在眼中。
阿武微微变了脸色，良久之后，他才沉声道：“有人来邀我刺杀秦王，但我不想死，便没应下。后来又过了两月，有人拿了药给我，说不用我刺杀秦王，只消绑了一人回去便可。后来，我还见着了那个失踪许久的方士……”阿武的眼底带着厉色，“于是我便应下了。”
“那方士是谁？”
“我不知。”
徐福取出两粒药丸给他，“吃了。”
阿武有些迟疑地看了一眼徐福。
徐福冷声道：“吃与不吃全看你自己。”
阿武将药丸放了起来，站起身，道：“我们该上路了。”
这话可听着实在不太吉利。徐福暗暗吐槽一句，但还是起身随阿武出去了。他们在店中又买了些东西，方才离开。走出客栈的时候，那客栈老板几乎压抑不住脸上的喜色，高兴于终于送走了这尊瘟神。
阿武走出去后，冷哼一声，那客栈老板惊得差点又腿一软摔倒下去。
马车很快就驶出了这座城池，徐福有点失望，他都没能找到机会，借机问一问这是在何地，好歹让他找一找方向。
回到马车上，徐福便又继续进行了优哉游哉的旅途生活。
这一夜，他们只能又在野外露宿。
徐福坐在火堆旁，问阿武：“药丸吃了吗？”
阿武取出包裹起来的药丸，因为放在胸口，被捂得有点变形了。
徐福看着变形的药丸，嘴角抽了抽。
“再不吃，怕是就要化掉了。”最重要的是，徐福难以想象，那药丸外面裹着的绢布，被汗浸湿的话，那该是何等酸爽的滋味。
阿武不再犹豫，仰头吃下了药丸。
此时徐福还是觉得有些可惜的，他的药丸多半都没有什么致死的作用，也更没有胡亥施的巫术那样神奇，想要借此胁迫阿武都不成了。
那药丸有个排毒的功效，可治便秘、痘痘。
虽然没什么大用，但是徐福觉得先给阿武来两颗是不错的。
阿武吃了过后，当夜就拉了肚子。
徐福睡在马车里隐隐听见了动静，他翻了个身，裹着被子继续睡觉。啊，当然，此时他的心里还是有一点点畅快的。
等白天徐福起床的时候，阿武坐在熄灭的火堆旁，面如菜色，一见徐福从马车上下来，阿武便立即怒声道：“你故意给了我那药丸？那药丸究竟有何作用？”
“排毒。”
“排毒？”阿武拧起眉，面上带着疑惑之色，显然并不能理解，这是药丸究竟是做什么用的。
“你病了这么久，加之心情郁结，这么久以来，你可有细细打理过自己？这样久的放纵，体内自然难保有什么毒素，在治病之前，我当然要先让你排毒。”徐福顿了顿，道：“你昨夜可是腹泻了？”
阿武点点头，“是……”而且还拉得有些厉害，但这话阿武不会说出来。
“我们要赶到下座城池，还有多远的距离？”
阿武不解他为何突然问起了这个，但还是答道：“三日。”
“那三日后，到了城中寻个客栈住下，我再为你继续治病。”在荒郊野外，毕竟还是太脏了，卫生状况无法保障，徐福担心他发炎感染。
到时候自己又不认路，身上又没钱，还没点儿武力值，那可真是大麻烦！所以现在，阿武还得活着！有用！
阿武点了点头。
之后一日，阿武又拉了肚子。
本来五谷轮回就是再正常不过的事，便秘也确实折磨了不少人。腹泻之后，自然轻松无比。加之心情上的转变，三日后抵达下一座城池的时候，阿武的面色已经变得好太多了，甚至整个人的精神面貌都给人以焕然一新的感觉。
依旧是进城，住客栈。
阿武面不改色地顶着旁人畏惧的目光进了屋子。
“你的刀呢？”徐福问道。
“干什么？”阿武登时紧张了起来。
“拿来。”徐福朝他伸出手。
阿武盯着徐福那白皙的手掌瞧了会儿，最后还是交出了小刀。
徐福令伙计端来火盆，然后将小刀洗干净，放在火盆上炙烤，直至达到消毒作用，他转过身，踹了阿武一脚，“先去洗把脸，将你的脸洗干净。”徐福强调了“洗干净” 三个字。
转过身来。
啊，他刚才是不是一脚踹在了阿武的屁股上？
chapters.translated_text:
Xu Fu’s tone was extremely nonchalant, "Your condition is something I can cure."

Of course... he was just bluffing.

Xu Fu spoke with certainty, but he didn't feel that way inside. He had merely noticed something off about A-Wu's facial features, but curing his illness was not as simple as just saying a few words. However, Xu Fu had always possessed the ability to make people believe him implicitly. A-Wu met Xu Fu's gaze, stunned for a moment, before suddenly snapping back to reality; the previous display of emotional instability had vanished from him.

A-Wu said in a deep voice, "The Shuzhang had better not be lying to me." His gaze landed on Xu Fu, clearly carrying a sense of threat.

"Go get some more sleep. When you've cleared your head, come talk to me again." Xu Fu drank a bit more water, then turned around and went back to sleep on the bed. Xu Fu was remarkably at ease; even if he couldn't do anything about A-Wu's face, he would always be able to come up with a solution. Where there's a will, there's a way.

Xu Fu’s ruthless dismissal only made A-Wu believe him even more. He was convinced that Xu Fu truly had a way to save him.

A-Wu leaned against the doorframe, unable to close his eyes for a long time.

Xu Fu could sleep soundly, but he could not. He didn't know how long this torment had followed him; eventually, he had tried every possible method to find relief. He had completely given up on the idea of a cure. He didn't know how much longer he would have to endure these painful and numbing days...

But he never expected to hear such words from Xu Fu.

Can it be cured?

A-Wu clenched his fists, his eyes growing brighter in the dark night.

Xu Fu intended to give A-Wu the cold shoulder for a while. After all, it was now A-Wu who was about to beg him for help. To avoid being under A-Wu's thumb later, Xu Fu felt he needed to put on airs from the very beginning.

A-Wu stared at Xu Fu with burning intensity. He watched him wash up and eat breakfast, and only after the series of actions were finished did A-Wu sit down opposite Xu Fu.

"Would the Shuzhang be willing to tell me in detail?" A-Wu couldn't hold back anymore and asked proactively.

"You speak first," Xu Fu said without looking up.

"I go first?"

"Tell me how you contracted this illness."

A-Wu pressed his lips together, not speaking immediately. Xu Fu wasn't in a hurry; he just waited quietly. He would have been happy if A-Wu stared blankly for even longer. Staying in this inn was much more comfortable than being in a bumpy carriage. If he could drag things out and let the people from Xianyang track them down, that would be even better.

"...I am from the State of Chu. When I was seventeen, I accidentally ingested poison and fell into a serious illness, nearly dying. Later, a fangshi (alchemist/mystic) came to my home. I don't know what he did, only that I began to recover after a few days. But ever since then, my face became extremely fragile. If I were exposed to the sun for a single day, my face would fester, and the symptoms grew worse each day. My father ordered people to find that fangshi, but he could never be found again. No one in the city could cure my illness, so I had to wander from place to place alone, just to heal this strange disease."

"A fangshi?" Xu Fu interjected.

A-Wu nodded and continued, "With my appearance, no matter where I go, I am feared and loathed. People dare not speak to me, and they even avoid me. I can't even enter an inn. However, there is one benefit: even beggars and thieves steer clear of me, which allows me to keep my money. Later, knowing there was no hope for a cure, I was filled with lonely indignation and sought out a master of swordsmanship to become his apprentice, using that to stop the pain in my heart."

Xu Fu clicked his tongue inwardly.

No one could cure it; it was clear that the difficulty of treating this illness was far from ordinary. But since he had already made the claim, Xu Fu naturally had to follow through. Maintaining a friendly relationship with A-Wu now had only benefits and no drawbacks.

A-Wu couldn't help but sneer, "In that case, can you still cure it?"

Judging by A-Wu's description, his family background shouldn't have been bad, and his manner of speaking didn't seem vulgar. When he first kidnapped Xu Fu, calling him "scoundrel" at every turn, it was likely just an act. After all, it's easy to pretend to be vulgar, but pretending to be well-spoken and educated is not simple.

Now, what Xu Fu was curious about was why A-Wu, who was doing just fine, would come to kidnap him?

"What happened after that? What drove you to decide to abduct me?" Xu Fu asked coldly. In that instant, he actually suppressed A-Wu's aura completely.

A-Wu hesitated, "I cannot say."

Xu Fu looked at him coldly, "Curing the illness or telling the truth—choose one. There is no such thing as a free lunch in this world. You kidnapped me, and yet you expect me to treat you with all my heart? The fact that I haven't demanded you take me back to Xianyang immediately is already being generous to you."

A-Wu’s expression turned ugly, "If I held a blade to your throat, could you still say that?"

Xu Fu said disdainfully, "Do you dare? You don't dare to touch a hair on my head, do you? Isn't that person requiring you to bring me back unharmed?" This was, of course, something Xu Fu had deduced. From how A-Wu had treated him since the kidnapping, it was clear that A-Wu didn't want any accidents to happen to him, so he had taken care of him diligently and never let him suffer.

The expression on A-Wu's face vanished. He stared intently at Xu Fu, trying to use his gaze as a deterrent. But trying to out-intimidate Xu Fu was the wrong choice.

Xu Fu calmly went about his business, completely ignoring A-Wu.

A-Wu’s expression shifted slightly. After a long while, he said in a deep voice, "Someone came to invite me to assassinate the King of Qin, but I didn't want to die, so I didn't agree. Two months later, someone brought me medicine and said I didn't need to assassinate the King of Qin, just kidnap one person and bring them back. Later, I even saw that long-lost fangshi..." A-Wu’s eyes held a fierce glint, "...so I agreed."

"Who was that fangshi?"

"I don't know."

Xu Fu took out two pills and gave them to him, "Eat them."

A-Wu looked at Xu Fu with some hesitation.

Xu Fu said coldly, "Whether you eat them or not is entirely up to you."

A-Wu put the pills away, stood up, and said, "We should be on our way."

That sounded really ominous. Xu Fu muttered to himself, but he still got up and followed A-Wu out. They bought some more things at the shop before leaving. As they walked out of the inn, the innkeeper could barely suppress the joy on his face, happy to finally be rid of this plague god.

After A-Wu walked out, he snorted coldly, and the innkeeper was so startled his legs nearly gave out again.

The carriage soon drove out of the city. Xu Fu was a bit disappointed; he hadn't found an opportunity to ask where they were, just to get his bearings.

Back in the carriage, Xu Fu continued his leisurely travel life.

That night, they had to camp in the wilderness again.

Xu Fu sat by the campfire and asked A-Wu, "Did you eat the pills?"

A-Wu took out the wrapped pills; because they had been kept against his chest, they were a bit misshapen.

Xu Fu twitched his mouth as he looked at the deformed pills.

"If you don't eat them soon, they might melt." Most importantly, Xu Fu couldn't imagine how disgusting it would be if the silk cloth wrapping the pills got soaked in sweat.

A-Wu no longer hesitated and tilted his head back to swallow the pills.

At this moment, Xu Fu still felt a bit of regret. Most of his pills didn't have any lethal effects, nor were they as magical as the sorcery Fusu's brother Hu Hai practiced, so he couldn't use them to coerce A-Wu.

Those pills had a detoxifying effect and could treat constipation and acne.

Although they weren't very useful, Xu Fu felt that giving A-Wu two was a good start.

After A-Wu ate them, he had diarrhea that very night.

Xu Fu, sleeping in the carriage, faintly heard the commotion. He turned over, wrapped himself in his quilt, and continued sleeping. Ah, of course, he felt a tiny bit of satisfaction in his heart.

When Xu Fu woke up the next day, A-Wu was sitting by the extinguished campfire, his face sallow. As soon as he saw Xu Fu get out of the carriage, A-Wu immediately shouted angrily, "Did you give me those pills on purpose? What exactly is the effect of those pills?"

"Detoxification."

"Detoxification?" A-Wu furrowed his brows, his face filled with confusion. Clearly, he didn't understand what these pills were for.

"You've been ill for so long, and combined with your pent-up emotions, have you taken good care of yourself for all this time? With such long-term indulgence, it's natural that your body would have toxins. Before treating the illness, I naturally have to let you detoxify first." Xu Fu paused and said, "Did you have diarrhea last night?"

A-Wu nodded, "Yes..." And it was quite severe, but A-Wu wouldn't say that out loud.

"How much further until we reach the next city?"

A-Wu didn't understand why he suddenly asked this, but he replied, "Three days."

"Then in three days, when we reach the city and find an inn, I will continue your treatment." In the wilderness, it was simply too dirty, and hygiene couldn't be guaranteed; Xu Fu was worried about infection.

If he didn't know the way, had no money, and lacked any combat ability, that would be a huge problem! So for now, A-Wu had to stay alive! He was useful!

A-Wu nodded.

The next day, A-Wu had diarrhea again.

Naturally, the body's digestive cycle is normal, and constipation does indeed torment many people. After the diarrhea, he naturally felt incredibly light. Combined with the shift in his mood, by the time they arrived at the next city three days later, A-Wu's complexion had improved significantly, and his entire demeanor felt refreshed.

They entered the city and stayed at an inn as before.

A-Wu entered the room, unfazed by the fearful gazes of others.

"Where is your knife?" Xu Fu asked.

"What for?" A-Wu became nervous immediately.

"Give it to me." Xu Fu reached out his hand toward him.

A-Wu stared at Xu Fu's fair palm for a while, then finally handed over the small knife.

Xu Fu ordered the waiter to bring a brazier, then washed the knife clean and placed it over the fire to disinfect it. He turned around and kicked A-Wu, "Go wash your face first. Wash your face clean." Xu Fu emphasized the words "wash clean."

Turning around.

Ah, did he just kick A-Wu in the butt?

chapters.source_text:
当阿武重新站在徐福面前的时候，瞧上去要顺眼多了。加上他背对着光源，脸上阴影遮盖，便只能让人看见一个轮廓，还会令人乍然生出英俊的错觉。
他身上的异味也随着清洗和排毒而减轻了不少。
徐福在心底松了一口气。
对着这样一个人，他才终于有了一颗想要医治的心啊！
徐福很怀疑，会不会是阿武之前太过不修边幅，那些行医的人，还不等看他的病情便先被他臭走了。
大约是徐福看着他久久不说话的缘故，阿武有些紧张，“……还、还不够吗？”
“够了，坐下吧。”徐福冲他点点头。
阿武一直不愿意捯饬自己，很大一部分原因是来自于，他认为就算自己捯饬了，也没什么作用，只是让他脸上的伤暴露得更明显了而已。既如此，那就破罐破摔，任由它下去好了。但是到这个时候，洗净了脸，阿武自己也有了点儿别样的感觉，好像一直压在面上，压得他呼吸都不畅的东西，瞬间消失了。
徐福手中捏着刀，在烛光下晃了晃，那冰冷的刀锋显得有些骇人。
阿武心中一惊，但他还是压下了本能的抗拒，在徐福面前坐下来了。
徐福将他往烛光下带了带，顺手又塞给了他一块布条，“要是疼就咬着。”
阿武点了点头。
然后徐福就拿刀子将他脸上的脓疮都割破了，脓水都被放了出来，徐福拿起布条一一擦去，然后给伤口挨个上药。
说实话，整个过程中的味道都不太好，不过忍一忍也就过去了。相比之下，阿武反倒是稳坐如山，半点反应也没有，任由刀子在他的脸上飞舞。
待全部处理完毕之后，徐福又拿了药丸给他，“吃了。”
那药是止痛用的，徐福很想做点消炎的药，但是消炎药并不是这个时代能做出来的产物。徐福也就只能打消这个念头了。倒是补血、回力的药丸，徐福也顺便搜了些出来，一起塞给阿武了。
阿武看着手中奇奇怪怪的药丸，什么也没说，又用布包裹了起来。
阿武不知道是不是他的心理作用，他觉得脸上冰冰凉凉，舒服了很多。甚至连照镜子的时候，他都觉得自己没那么狰狞了。
徐福站在一旁，默默无语。
当然不狰狞了，因为阿武的脑袋被他包起来了，跟个粽子似的，伤口都看不见，哪里还会有狰狞的效果呢？不过吓人的效果估计还是不减。毕竟很少有人作阿武这样的打扮。
果不其然，当阿武出去叫伙计的时候，那伙计被他吓得差点摔一个跟头。
因为心情愉悦了，这一夜，二人睡得都很香甜。第二日，他们还在城中稍微多停留了一会儿，阿武还给徐福多采购了一点吃的，虽然味道不如王宫中特制的，但此时也足以让徐福满足了。
之后几日又是在野外露宿。只不过这几日里，阿武都格外注重自己的脸，会时不时地在什么小溪边啊，小河边啊，照一照自己的脸。这个变化还着实吓了徐福一跳，感觉就像是阿武生生在自己的面前，从糙汉变成了娘炮一样。
阿武脸上的伤，之前多是恶心人，但实际上打理一下，就已经有明显的好转了。
阿武的步子都变得轻快了不少。
只是在面对徐福的时候，阿武脸上总算带点赧然了。虽然不管他做什么表情徐福都看不见。
一转眼，又在一座城池停住了脚步。而这一次，阿武在客栈投宿的时候，明显没有那么多人对他避之不及了，这样的变化对于阿武来说，简直就是天大的变化，徐福能瞥见他的手在微微颤抖，大约是激动的。
用饭的时候，阿武在沉默许久之后，对徐福道：“这里，已经是楚国了。”
徐福愣了愣。这么快就进入楚境了？他不着痕迹地皱了皱眉，害他半点准备也无，不知道现在趁机策反阿武还来得及吗？
正想着呢，突然徐福察觉到自己踩着的地面晃了晃，紧接着便是较为剧烈的摇晃了，桌案上的东西震动不已，而此时客栈中也响起了尖叫声、怒吼声、呼救声、脚步声……全部交织在一起，这一刻，谁都想要活下来，徐福几乎能想象得到他们争相往外挣扎奔跑的情景。
此刻，徐福倒是出奇的镇定。
以他之前去地动受灾地区救灾的经验，这点震幅还不算什么。不会危及到他的性命。
阿武原本也是惊了一跳，几乎是整个人从位置上弹了起来，但是他的目光触及到徐福之后，又莫名跟着镇定了下来，他翻身从窗户出去，“我去瞧一瞧发生了何事。”
“应是地动……”徐福心说这还用瞧吗？但是等他开口时，阿武已经没影儿了，动作实在快得不一般。
外面嘈杂声密集，阿武久久也不见回来，徐福这才慢条斯理地拎上包袱，从屋子里出去了。此时客栈里已经没人影了，正好方便了徐福往外走，也免得与那些人挤来挤去，最后没被地动害死，却先被人踩死或是挤死了。毕竟这样的事并不少见，生死关头谁都是先顾着自己，于是可想而知。
当徐福从客栈里踏出来的时候，地动又开始了。
这是一阵余波，比之刚才，并不算强烈，但是对于百姓们来说，已经是足够大的刺激了，他们尖叫着四下逃窜，口中高呼，“老天饶命！”听上去很好笑，但是在这一刻，百姓们所能倚靠的便只有“老天”。他们认为这一切都是天上降下来的灾祸。
徐福就站在客栈的门口，没有加入逃散的大军，他看着这些人慌乱的模样，心底轻叹了一口气。
直到余波停下，才有城中的守卫姗姗来迟，开始疏散百姓。
徐福就夹在其中，被这么给疏散出去了。
这座城很快就空了下来，谁也不敢贸贸然回去。
这些百姓倒是都不笨，知道只有在城外空旷的地带，才更容易保下性命，因而被疏散的时候，大家虽然面色难看又狼狈，但是谁也没有提出反对意见，他们顺从地到了郊外，靠着树木休息了起来。
徐福因为相貌太过出众，加之他全然没有狼狈之色，站在这么些百姓中间，可实在太显眼不过。
徐福在那儿站了会儿，还是没等到阿武主动上前来找他。是因为阿武没在人群中，还是说阿武主动放他走？徐福有点郁卒，就算这个时候主动放他走，他也走不了啊。他连回咸阳的路都找不到，他怎么回去？
他又等了一会儿，还是没能等来阿武。徐福无奈之下，就只能先跟着这些人安置在郊外了。郊外不比马车，更不比客栈，没有了阿武伺候着，徐福就再难惬意起来了。徐福原本都做好帮忙烧个火啊，抹个佐料做个饭啊的准备了，谁知晓那些人见他打扮、模样皆是不俗，竟是没一人敢上前来叫他帮忙。
男人们很快结伴去寻食物了，女人们则是留在了原地，生火烧水。
徐福走上前，问道：“可有我能帮忙的地方？”
那一圈儿的女子扬起头来瞥了他一眼，脸立即就红了，“没、没有。”
徐福：……
徐福站在那里，一时间倒有些无所适从了，犹豫一下，他干脆掉头离开，绕开把守的士兵，去寻阿武的下落了。徐福绕着城外走了两圈，并不见阿武的踪影。但此时城中应该又没人了，尽管阿武还在城中，徐福也进不去了。城门口有守卫，不允许百姓在此时返回。这一手算是极为聪明了，至少避免了百姓们再度受灾的可能，而且还迅速统一起了城中的百姓，方便看管照顾。
徐福也不知该说是好还是坏了。
他又站在百姓中徘徊了一会儿，等他们做了些食物，徐福就走上前帮忙端了些，他刚一接过来，那女子便又羞红了脸，此时正好那女子的丈夫归来了，一瞧见徐福，还狠狠瞪了他一眼。
徐福：……
最后徐福干脆坐到一边去了。
一个小姑娘跳到了他的跟前，顺着他的目光往遥远的方向看了看，问：“你在看什么呀？”
徐福歪了歪头，看了一眼那小姑娘，“看远方的人。”
“远方没有人呀，只有云。”小姑娘诧异地道。
徐福没说话。
那小姑娘的家人在不远处看见了，畏缩地走上前来，将小姑娘往后拽了拽，随后朝着徐福不安地躬身道：“小女儿不懂事，请勿怪。”那家人见徐福穿着模样皆是不凡，便以为徐福是什么大人物，哪里敢得罪，瞧着徐福的目光都是胆战心惊的。
徐福冲他们摆了摆手。
那家人见徐福并没有拒人于千里外，这才松了口气，便就在徐福附近坐下休息了。
小姑娘的母亲皱紧了眉，哀声叹道：“是上天发怒了，我们才会有此灾祸啊……”
她的丈夫闻言，紧紧搂住了她和女儿，同样愁眉苦脸，却没说话。面对这样的天灾，他们也的确说不出什么话来。
“我们离开这里吧。”徐福突然听见小姑娘的母亲小声说。
“你疯了？”她的丈夫瞪大了眼，满脸震惊，还带着惊惶。百姓不是说离开就能离开的，他们的祖辈可能都生活在这里，一旦离开这里，他们就什么都没有了。
小姑娘的母亲揪住了丈夫的衣领，低声与他说了些什么。
旁边谁也没有注意到他们，毕竟刚刚经历一场“灾难”，大家此时都惊惶得很，正彼此寻找着亲人的抚慰。
之后食物分发到了徐福这边来，徐福却没有要，方才他什么忙也没能帮上，这个时候再去吃白食，徐福实在不大好意思，何况他从客栈离开时，极为悠哉，还特地带了些食物走，此时拿出来，也足以果腹了。只是有点渴。徐福想到这里，不由舔了舔唇。
“你喝吗？”一道稚嫩的声音陡然在徐福耳边响起。
徐福抬头去看，才发现那小姑娘盛了水给他，水是烧热后晾凉了的。徐福也不讲究什么了，端起那容器饮了水，然后才还给了那小姑娘，“多谢。”
小姑娘红了红脸，声若蚊讷，“不、不谢。”
待到吃饱喝足后，徐福便寻了个地方，在地上铺了层袍子，再将自己裹紧，然后便就这样躺下了。这个时候，若是不保持充足的体力，那一准得完蛋。这点经验，徐福上辈子是很充足的。这辈子虽然过的全是优越生活，但是这些他也并未忘却。
徐福躺下后，那小姑娘都还忍不住频频向他打量过来。
徐福很快便入睡了，夜风拂面，徐福恍惚中又梦见了嬴政，不过他只来得及梦见嬴政的轮廓，一转眼便惊醒过来了，此时天微微亮，他身旁的夫妇已经开始收拾东西了，唯有那小姑娘还靠在母亲的腿上睡得正香。
徐福犹豫了一下，低声问道：“你们要去何处？”
那二人对视一眼，或许是出于小心谨慎的缘故，并未开口应答。
“我也想要离开这里，结伴同行如何？”徐福道。
小姑娘的母亲当先犹豫了起来。看徐福的穿着打扮，也不像是会坑他们的人，他们对于这样的人，也本能地有些敬畏和相信。小姑娘的母亲甚至认为，若是将面前这人带上，说不定能给他们指点一二，好让他们安全逃到另一个地方去。
“我们……要去秦国。”先说话的倒是那丈夫。
徐福愣了愣。
这算是误打误撞碰上的好事儿吗？
徐福压了压忍不住往上翘的唇角。看来梦见嬴政就是个好征兆啊！
“正巧了，我也要去秦国，我有师兄在秦国为官，若是你们信得过我，便与我作伴，届时定能减去不少的麻烦。”
其实在别国的境内，说自己的亲人在秦国为官，还是有几分风险的。不过战国时期，常有本国人到别国做官的例子，因而倒也不显得多么令人震惊。
那对夫妇对视了一眼，最后道：“那……那便一起吧。”说这话的时候他们都还有些瑟缩。
徐福这才收敛起了身上的冷淡气息，以防将对方给吓走了。
待他们收拾好东西之后，徐福便跟着他们一块儿上路了。这对夫妇倒还知道一些路，所以他们很快便离开了这座城的范围。但是全靠双腿徒步，实在折磨人。徐福这时忍不住无比地怀念，嬴政为他特制的马车了。若是坐在马车上，慢是慢了些，但该是何等的悠哉啊！
徐福转过头瞥了一眼那小姑娘，小姑娘满头大汗，不时咬一咬唇，倒是表现得分外坚韧。
小姑娘都这般坚韧，他还能如何？
徐福整了整衣袍，只得继续往前走。
他们在途中走走停停好几日，中途又遇见了一次地动余波，多亏徐福的指挥，才令他们冷静下来，安然无恙。事后，那对夫妇面对徐福时，便更加恭谨了，甚至恨不得事事都替徐福做了才好，徐福也是一阵无语。这二人倒是淳朴得很，这样便被他们引为大恩人了。
那小姑娘大约是受父母的影响，也时不时眨着眼，可爱地瞧着徐福。
徐福顿时更思念宫中的胡亥和扶苏了。
他缓缓吐出一口气，突然听到小姑娘一声尖叫，“啊！我们到了！”
徐福往前看去，原来前方就是一座城了。
待他们走得再近一些，徐福方才看清了那城池之上写着的城名——舆城。
……舆城吗？！
chapters.title: 第238章
chapters.translated_text:
When A-Wu stood before Xu Fu again, he looked much more pleasing to the eye. With his back to the light, his face was cast in shadow, revealing only a silhouette that gave the sudden, illusory impression of him being handsome.

The strange odor on his body had also lessened significantly following the cleaning and detoxification.

Xu Fu felt a sense of relief in his heart.

Only when facing a person like this did he finally have the desire to treat him!

Xu Fu highly suspected that perhaps A-Wu had been too unkempt before, and those other physicians had been scared off by his stench before even examining his condition.

Perhaps because Xu Fu had been staring at him in silence for a long time, A-Wu felt a bit nervous. "...Is... is it still not enough?"

"It's enough, sit down." Xu Fu nodded at him.

A large part of the reason A-Wu had always been unwilling to groom himself was that he believed it was useless; it only made the scars on his face more obvious. Since that was the case, he might as well let himself go and leave it be. But at this moment, with his face washed clean, A-Wu himself felt something different—as if the weight that had been pressing on his face, stifling his breath, had vanished in an instant.

Xu Fu held a knife in his hand and flicked it under the candlelight; the cold blade looked somewhat daunting.

A-Wu felt a jolt of alarm, but he suppressed his instinctive resistance and sat down before Xu Fu.

Xu Fu brought him closer to the candlelight and handed him a strip of cloth. "Bite on this if it hurts."

A-Wu nodded.

Then, Xu Fu used the knife to pierce the pustules on his face, drained the pus, wiped it away with the cloth strip, and applied medicine to each wound one by one.

To be honest, the smell throughout the process was not very pleasant, but it was bearable. In contrast, A-Wu sat as steady as a mountain, showing no reaction at all as the knife danced across his face.

Once everything was treated, Xu Fu took out some pills and gave them to him. "Eat these."

The medicine was for pain relief. Xu Fu really wanted to make some anti-inflammatory medicine, but such things could not be produced in this era. Xu Fu had to abandon that thought. However, he had also searched for and gathered some blood-tonifying and strength-restoring pills, which he stuffed into A-Wu's hand as well.

A-Wu looked at the strange pills in his hand, said nothing, and wrapped them back up in a cloth.

A-Wu didn't know if it was just psychological, but he felt his face was cool and much more comfortable. Even when he looked in the mirror, he felt he didn't look as hideous as before.

Xu Fu stood to the side, silent.

Of course he didn't look hideous, because A-Wu’s head was wrapped up like a rice dumpling, hiding the wounds entirely—how could he look hideous? However, the frightening effect probably remained undiminished. After all, few people dressed like A-Wu.

Sure enough, when A-Wu went out to call the waiter, the man was so frightened he nearly tripped over himself.

Because they were in better spirits, both slept soundly that night. The next day, they stayed in the city a little longer, and A-Wu even bought some extra food for Xu Fu. Although the taste wasn't as good as the special preparations in the palace, it was enough to satisfy Xu Fu for now.

The following days were spent camping in the wild. However, during these days, A-Wu paid extra attention to his face, frequently checking his reflection by streams or rivers. This change actually gave Xu Fu a start; it felt as if A-Wu had transformed right before his eyes from a rough brute into a delicate sissy.

The wounds on A-Wu's face had mostly been repulsive before, but in reality, with a little care, they had already shown significant improvement.

Even A-Wu's steps had become much lighter.

It was just that when facing Xu Fu, A-Wu finally showed a hint of shyness, though Xu Fu couldn't see his expressions regardless of what he did.

In the blink of an eye, they stopped at another city. This time, when A-Wu checked into the inn, it was clear that fewer people were avoiding him. For A-Wu, this change was monumental; Xu Fu could see his hands trembling slightly, likely from excitement.

While eating, after a long silence, A-Wu said to Xu Fu, "We are already in the State of Chu."

Xu Fu was stunned. They had entered Chu territory so quickly? He frowned imperceptibly. This left him with no preparation at all. He wondered if it was still possible to take this opportunity to turn A-Wu against his masters.

Just as he was thinking, Xu Fu suddenly felt the ground beneath him sway, followed by a more violent shaking. Items on the table rattled incessantly, and the inn was filled with screams, roars, cries for help, and the sound of footsteps... all intertwined. At this moment, everyone wanted to survive; Xu Fu could almost imagine them struggling and running outside.

At this moment, Xu Fu was surprisingly calm.

Based on his previous experience in disaster relief in earthquake-stricken areas, this magnitude was nothing. It wouldn't endanger his life.

A-Wu had also been startled and had practically sprung from his seat, but when his gaze met Xu Fu's, he inexplicably calmed down. He leaped out the window, saying, "I'll go see what happened."

"It should be an earthquake..." Xu Fu thought to himself, *is there any need to check?* But by the time he spoke, A-Wu had already vanished; his movements were truly extraordinary.

The noise outside was intense, and A-Wu did not return for a long time. Only then did Xu Fu leisurely pick up his bundle and leave the room. At this point, the inn was empty, which made it easier for Xu Fu to walk out, avoiding the need to squeeze through the crowds and risk being trampled to death instead of dying in the earthquake. After all, such things were not uncommon; in life-or-death moments, everyone looked out for themselves.

As Xu Fu stepped out of the inn, the earthquake began again.

This was an aftershock, not as intense as the first, but for the common people, it was a huge shock. They screamed and fled in all directions, crying out, "Heaven, have mercy!" It sounded ridiculous, but at this moment, the only thing the people could rely on was "Heaven." They believed this was a disaster sent from above.

Xu Fu stood at the entrance of the inn, not joining the fleeing crowd. He watched their panicked state and sighed inwardly.

It wasn't until the aftershocks stopped that the city guards arrived late to begin evacuating the people.

Xu Fu was caught in the middle and was evacuated along with them.

The city soon became empty; no one dared to return rashly.

These commoners were not stupid; they knew that only in the open areas outside the city could they better preserve their lives. Therefore, when being evacuated, although everyone looked haggard and disheveled, no one raised an objection. They obediently went to the outskirts and rested against the trees.

Because Xu Fu’s appearance was too outstanding, and he lacked any signs of dishevelment, he was far too conspicuous standing among the crowd.

Xu Fu stood there for a while, but A-Wu still didn't come to find him. Was A-Wu not in the crowd, or had he intentionally let him go? Xu Fu felt a bit depressed. Even if he were let go now, he couldn't leave. He couldn't even find the road back to Xianyang, so how could he return?

He waited a while longer, but A-Wu still didn't appear. Helpless, Xu Fu had to settle down with the people in the outskirts. The outskirts were not like a carriage, let alone an inn. Without A-Wu to serve him, it was hard for Xu Fu to be comfortable. Xu Fu had been prepared to help start a fire or season the food, but when those people saw his refined appearance and attire, not a single one dared to come forward and ask for his help.

The men soon went in groups to find food, while the women stayed behind to light fires and boil water.

Xu Fu walked up and asked, "Is there anything I can help with?"

The circle of women looked up at him, and their faces immediately turned red. "N-no."

Xu Fu: ...

Xu Fu stood there, feeling a bit out of place. After hesitating, he simply turned and left, bypassing the guards to search for A-Wu. Xu Fu circled the city twice but saw no sign of him. But by now, the city was empty, and even if A-Wu were inside, Xu Fu couldn't get back in. There were guards at the gates, forbidding people from returning at this time. This was actually a very smart move; it at least avoided the possibility of the people suffering further disaster and quickly unified the city's populace for easier management and care.

Xu Fu didn't know whether to call it good or bad.

He wandered among the people for a while longer. When they prepared some food, Xu Fu went up to help carry some. As soon as he took it, the woman blushed again. Just then, the woman's husband returned, and upon seeing Xu Fu, he glared at him fiercely.

Xu Fu: ...

In the end, Xu Fu simply sat to the side.

A little girl hopped over to him, followed his gaze toward the distance, and asked, "What are you looking at?"

Xu Fu tilted his head and looked at the little girl. "Looking at people in the distance."

"There is no one in the distance, only clouds," the little girl said in surprise.

Xu Fu said nothing.

The little girl's family saw this from nearby and approached timidly. They pulled the girl back and bowed to Xu Fu uneasily. "My little daughter is ignorant, please don't take offense." Seeing Xu Fu’s extraordinary appearance and dress, they assumed he was some big shot and didn't dare to offend him, their eyes filled with trepidation.

Xu Fu waved his hand at them.

Seeing that Xu Fu was not aloof or distant, the family breathed a sigh of relief and sat down to rest near him.

The little girl's mother frowned and sighed mournfully, "It is Heaven’s wrath that has brought us this disaster..."

Her husband, hearing this, held her and their daughter tightly, looking equally miserable but saying nothing. Faced with such a natural disaster, they truly had nothing to say.

"Let's leave this place," Xu Fu suddenly heard the little girl's mother whisper.

"Are you crazy?" Her husband’s eyes widened, full of shock and panic. Commoners couldn't just leave as they pleased; their ancestors had lived here for generations. Once they left, they would have nothing.

The little girl's mother grabbed her husband's collar and whispered something to him.

No one nearby noticed them; after all, having just experienced a "disaster," everyone was terrified and seeking comfort from their loved ones.

Later, food was distributed to Xu Fu's side, but he didn't take any. He hadn't helped with anything, and he felt too embarrassed to eat for free. Besides, when he left the inn, he had been very relaxed and had specifically brought some food with him, which was enough to fill his stomach. He was just a bit thirsty. Thinking of this, Xu Fu couldn't help but lick his lips.

"Do you want a drink?" A childish voice suddenly sounded in Xu Fu's ear.

Xu Fu looked up and saw that the little girl had brought him water, which had been boiled and then cooled. Xu Fu didn't stand on ceremony, took the container, drank the water, and then returned it to the little girl. "Thank you."

The little girl blushed, her voice as soft as a mosquito's. "Y-you're welcome."

After eating and drinking his fill, Xu Fu found a spot, spread his robe on the ground, wrapped himself tightly, and lay down. At times like this, if one didn't maintain sufficient energy, one was sure to be finished. Xu Fu had plenty of experience with this in his past life. Although he had lived a life of luxury in this life, he hadn't forgotten these things.

After Xu Fu lay down, the little girl couldn't help but glance at him frequently.

Xu Fu soon fell asleep. With the night breeze on his face, he dreamed of Ying Zheng in a daze, but he only managed to see Ying Zheng's silhouette before waking up in a start. It was just dawn, and the couple beside him had already started packing their things, while only the little girl was still sleeping soundly against her mother's lap.

Xu Fu hesitated for a moment and asked in a low voice, "Where are you going?"

The two looked at each other, perhaps out of caution, and did not answer.

"I also want to leave this place. How about we travel together?" Xu Fu said.

The little girl's mother hesitated first. Looking at Xu Fu's attire and bearing, he didn't seem like someone who would harm them. They had an instinctive awe and trust for such people. The little girl's mother even thought that if they brought this person along, he might be able to offer some guidance to help them safely escape to another place.

"We... are going to the State of Qin," the husband said first.

Xu Fu was stunned.

Was this a stroke of luck?

Xu Fu suppressed the corners of his mouth that wanted to curl upward. It seemed that dreaming of Ying Zheng was a good omen!

"What a coincidence, I am also going to the State of Qin. I have a senior fellow apprentice who is an official in Qin. If you trust me, you can accompany me, and it will surely save us a lot of trouble."

Actually, within the territory of another state, claiming that one's relative was an official in Qin carried some risk. However, during the Warring States period, it was common for people of one state to serve as officials in another, so it didn't seem too shocking.

The couple looked at each other and finally said, "Then... then let's go together." They still looked a bit timid when saying this.

Only then did Xu Fu soften his cold demeanor to avoid scaring them away.

After they packed their things, Xu Fu set off with them. The couple knew some of the roads, so they soon left the vicinity of the city. But traveling entirely on foot was truly torturous. Xu Fu couldn't help but miss the carriage Ying Zheng had specially made for him. If he were sitting in that carriage, even if it were slow, how leisurely it would be!

Xu Fu turned his head and glanced at the little girl. She was covered in sweat and biting her lip from time to time, but she appeared remarkably resilient.

If the little girl could be this resilient, what else could he do?

Xu Fu straightened his robes and had no choice but to keep walking forward.

They walked and stopped for several days along the way. They encountered another aftershock, but thanks to Xu Fu's direction, they stayed calm and remained unharmed. Afterward, the couple became even more respectful toward Xu Fu, wanting to do everything for him. Xu Fu was speechless. These two were truly simple-minded; they had already adopted him as their great benefactor.

The little girl, likely influenced by her parents, would also blink her eyes and look at Xu Fu cutely from time to time.

Xu Fu suddenly missed Hu Hai and Fu Su in the palace even more.

He let out a long breath and suddenly heard the little girl scream, "Ah! We're here!"

Xu Fu looked forward and saw a city ahead.

As they got closer, Xu Fu finally saw the name written on the city wall—Yu City.

...Yu City?!

chapters.title: 第239章
chapters.source_text:
徐福脑子里翻来覆去地转着，他的绢布上记载的日记。
舆城、舆城。
算是得来全不费工夫吗？徐福怎么也没想到，他会是在这样的时候，来到了舆城。徐福缓缓吐出一口气，倒也正好，若是此时能弄到一些线索，那么日后也就不必再到此地来了。
“大哥哥？”那小姑娘疑惑地回头看着徐福出声。
徐福这才发觉自己盯着那城门瞧了许久，都忘记往前挪步子了。
“走吧。”徐福出声道。
那家人这才收回目光，带着兴奋之色往前继续走了。
两座城相距并不算太远，那座城能感受得到的震动，这座城必然也能感受到，只可能有小程度上的减轻。但是舆城则是全然不同的，他们在城外看不见百姓。再往前走，他们便能从大开的城门，看见城中的情景。一派平和，哪里像是刚刚经历过地动的模样？
那家人不自觉地咽了咽口水，胆战心惊地进城去了。
徐福则是坠在他们身后，走进了城。
舆城中一派正常是好事，这样他就不必再露宿在外了，至少可以有个地方歇息了，还能趁机洗漱一下。若是舆城中人也被驱散到城外去了，到时候徐福想要调查过去的事，恐怕都不容易。
只是没了阿武跟在身边，他哪来的钱住客栈？
徐福郁卒了一下，突然捏到了手中的包袱，他不死心地将包袱搜了一遍，阿武并没有将钱财放在其中。
那家人见徐福站在城门口翻包袱，忙出声道：“你做什么呀？快进来！”
……对，他差点忘记了这是在外面了。那么多双眼睛盯着，他怎么能随意翻包袱呢？若是被小偷盯上就麻烦了。徐福装作若无其事地合上了包袱。就在这时，徐福仿佛听见了清脆的碰撞声。徐福先是疑惑，而后则变成了了然。
里面似乎……是钱币碰撞的声音？夹在包袱中间？
徐福决心要找个地方，好好翻找一番。
走了没一会儿，那家人便有些心焦了。
“不久便要入夜了，我们该寻个地方落脚才好啊。”说话的是那妇人。
她的丈夫有些六神无主，“这、这哪里能歇息？”
“客栈。”说话的是徐福。
妇人面露苦色，“客栈我们哪里能住得上？”
“我出钱便是。”徐福淡淡道，天知道他现在其实还没摸到钱呢。
那妇人面色震惊，忙道：“这、这怎么行？”
“我本不认得路，是跟随你们过来，才得以入城。我邀你们一同住客栈算不得什么。”其实徐福是有点儿愧疚的，他估摸着自己应当要留在舆城，不会再随他们往秦国去。原本说好的承诺，此时要销毁，徐福还是要对他们有所补偿才好。
徐福说完，便带着路径直往前走了。徐福对别的都不敏感，但对于城中的客栈极是敏感，毕竟他每次出远门，除了在野外，便是住在客栈，这些客栈都被他摸熟了。徐福当先进了客栈后，那家人对视一眼，犹豫了一会儿，这才小心翼翼地踏进了客栈。
而此时徐福已经将包袱提到了面前，从包袱中间夹着的绢布中，取出了金银钱币。
钱币是秦半两，当然不能用。
但是其中却有金子，而黄金在楚国是称量货币，可以作货币流通，只是大部分都在贵族之间使用。当然，此时徐福摆了一小块儿出来，那老板见了之后自是不会拒绝的。
那家人在后面瞥见这一幕，不由得瞪大了眼。他们暗暗咽下口水，看着徐福的目光更为敬畏。
徐福订了两个房间，一个是自己的，另一个自然是那家人的。
那家人穿得实在不如何，长相普通，再加上畏畏缩缩。他们站在徐福的身后，简直和徐福就是两个画风，让人毫不怀疑地认为，他们是徐福的家仆。
没有了阿武，身边也没有侍从，徐福便只有自己吩咐，让那伙计送水和食物来了。
“你们先好生歇息吧，这几日也累了。”
那家人惶恐地点着头，护着女儿，小心地进了房间。
徐福进到自己的房间之后，便立即关上了屋门。他在桌案前坐下，这才摊开了包袱，包袱里的东西散落出来，一一摆开在了桌案上。徐福陡然想起来，他失踪的时候，胸前还抱着尉缭塞给他的东西。这包袱里的衣物和其它物品，都是后来阿武采购了，徐福才将其放置在包袱中的。也就是说，那些钱币金银，都是来自……尉缭？
徐福不由得想到了当年，姜游离开咸阳的时候，给他塞了一包的钱财。
热气陡然熏上来，徐福觉得有些眼酸。
他与过去离开咸阳时，已经全然不同了。他脑中会不断想着嬴政，还会思念胡亥、扶苏，还会为想到师兄尉缭、姜游，而觉得心中触动。
徐福在桌案前怔忡地坐了一会儿。
这都几年了……尉缭还担心他跟在嬴政身边会吃苦吗？
如今再想一想当初尉缭在他跟前贬低嬴政的那些话，竟然好似几十年前说的一样。他过去对尉缭偏颇的不喜，渐渐已经消散了。
这时，门被敲响了。
“进。”
门推开，伙计从外面走进来，费力地将抬着的水放下，然后才是放下食物。
徐福往那木桶中看了一眼，“怎么水都这样浑？”
那伙计擦了擦汗，笑道：“近来城中的水都是这般？前段时候，地动了，水就浑了嘛。”
徐福诧异地看了一眼那伙计，“地动了，你们都不走吗？”
“走？”那伙计一愣，“走到哪里去？”
徐福没想到这城中的人竟是这样镇定，地动来了，半点反应也无。
“无事了，我只是随口问两句。”徐福也不再问了。这地动也确实危害不到他们的性命，他也就不必去质疑人家的选择了。
沐浴过后，徐福很快用了食物，随后便抱着包袱躺到床榻上去了，借着烛光，他拿出了鬼谷传来的东西。里面也都是徐君房过去的日记，统统都记载于绢布之上，而这些绢布则保存得好多了，字迹少有模糊的地方，只是绢布看上去有些旧了。光是看着这些日记保存的模样，徐福差不多就能感受到鬼谷是个什么样的地步。
他闭了闭眼，做好心理准备之后，才打开了记录。
这些绢布都被绑成了一札札，徐福只先拆了其中一札。
而令他失望的是，其中记录的并不是什么太过重要的信息，只是些琐碎的时光。再说得直白一些，就是一些日常，干巴巴的。不过徐福倒是从过去的记录中，获知徐君房和尉缭过去的关系并不大好。当然这一点尉缭和姜游也曾经提到过，所以徐福也不诧异。
这些绢布散落在徐福的身上，徐福看着他们，忽然有种怪异的感觉，好像将自己从中剥离开来，以上帝视角来看着另一个人的故事一般。但是这些故事隐隐又让他觉得熟悉。
就好比……
日记中写到，徐君房曾经因为桀骜不驯，与尉缭对上过，可惜后来输在了尉缭的手中，徐君房输了难过，姜游便上前劝架安慰，最后尉缭憋着憋着给徐君房道了歉。
徐福闭上眼，仿佛能回到那个下午，阳光笼罩在身上，暖洋洋的。尉缭躺倒在大石上，却被他拉了起来。姜游见势不好，赶紧围了上来。那一日，他们似乎能闻见花香，听见流水潺潺的声音。
这一幕带着极为强烈的熟悉感，在徐福的脑海中跃动着，画面甚是鲜活。
是属于原身的记忆吗？
徐福揉了揉脑袋，不知不觉地便睡着了，睡着后，他像是回到了鬼谷中一般，隐隐能听见耳边有人说话的声音。
“他又忘了？”
“……是啊。”
“他脑子不会是有病吧？”
“缭莫要胡说！”
……
徐福做了一夜的梦，第二日早早的，他便从混沌的状态中醒过来了，他难耐地揉着额头，从床榻上爬了起来，绢布从他的身上掉下来，有些还落到了地上去。徐福不得不弯腰捡起来，一一放好。
绢布上一无所获，不知舆城中是否能有消息。徐福有些无奈。
他干脆起身洗漱了，然后便出门用了食物。等他回来时，就见那家人正在门口等他。他们的模样有些憔悴，半点不像是休息好了的样子。徐福心中疑惑不已，“可是有事？”
“这……我们、我们还不住这里了。”妇人尴尬道：“没住过这样的地方，反倒、反倒睡不着了。”
徐福见他们缩手缩脚的模样，半点都不畅快，这才意识到，是自己想漏了这一点。
对于他们来说，这里恐怕还不如城外住着舒服。何况他们此时脸上还带着畏惧，他们应该还在担忧地动吧。这座城半点措施也不做，恐怕比起之前那座城，更让他们没有安全感。
想到这些之后，徐福转身取了点儿秦半两和一块金子出来，塞到了那小姑娘的手里，小姑娘脸红了红，“这是什么呀？”
“这个，楚境内用，这个，进入秦国用。”徐福分别指了指，他顿了下，才又道：“之后的路只有你们一起走了，我突然想起来在舆城还有些事要处理，因而要在此处停留不短的时间，你们不必等我，直接离去吧。”
“不、不……”那妇人结结巴巴地抓起小姑娘的手，便要将里面的东西掏出来还给徐福。
“拿着吧，这是我感谢你们的，就算你们不需要，她也是需要的。”徐福站在那里动也不动，明明口气平淡，但却教人莫名不敢反驳他的话，只能出于本能地顺从。
这对夫妇涨红了脸，最后还是丈夫当先点了头，“敢问您的姓名？日后，日后我们也好知晓，是哪位与我们施了恩？”
“我……徐君房。”徐福鬼使神差地说了这个名字。
那对夫妇瞪大了眼，“您的名字好生耳熟。”
徐福心中一动，“是吗？你们何时何处听过？”徐福觉得他们在之前应当是没见过自己的。说句过分自恋的话，他的容貌已然位列顶尖，他身上的气质又极为特殊，若是有谁见过他，怎么会轻易忘记？
夫妇冥思苦想半天，却摇了摇头，面露歉色。
“无事，你们去吧，记得用些食物再走。”徐福本也没打算，怎么容易就找到徐君房过去经历的记忆。
那家人郑重地告辞了徐福，这才离开了。
徐福给他们的钱并不多，他担忧他们拿了过多的钱，却因没有能力庇佑反倒丢了性命。何况升米恩斗米仇，如此便足以了。再多，那便是过犹不及了。
那家人倒是给了他一点儿启发，既然以前徐君房来过舆城，那这里总有人是记得他的。有什么比他重操旧业，更能唤醒那些人的记忆了呢？徐福收拾一番，带上包袱，出门令那老板给自己留住房间，又问了问伙计，哪里可以摆摊，那伙计虽然不明所以，但还是领徐福去了。
“您可要小心些，这处常有些乞丐来抢地方。”见徐福模样生得虽好，但就是因为太好了，才给人以脆弱之感，那伙计实在担心徐福在这里受了什么伤。
“我知晓了，多谢。”徐福轻飘飘地将那伙计堵了回去。
伙计暗暗摇头，回转身去，嘴里嘟哝着，“长得这般好，又有钱，怎么脑子想不开来做这个？倒也不怕出事儿。”
徐福熟门熟路地拿出自己的家当，摆好了摊子。
因为徐福的容貌实在是太出众了，从他在那里站定开始，就不断有人打量他了，等到他摆下东西之后，打量他的人就更多了。等看到徐福摆出龟甲等物，那些人便立时瞪大了眼。平时他们可没什么机会见着这玩意儿，此时能不惊异吗？
但是他们也就仅限于惊异了。他们光看却不上前。
相比之下，倒是有些热情大胆的女子，想要往徐福这边挪步子。
徐福根本就不急，这次和从前都不相同，从前他或是为了迅速令城中人信任他，又或是为了赚钱以求生活，目的性都是极为强烈的。而这一次，他就是假装来摆个摊，目的不过是唤起某些见过他的人的记忆罢了，他自然不心急了。何况他还有师兄尉缭的金钱援助呢。
就这样，一上午都没什么人来。
徐福回去用了食物，又接着摆摊。
依旧没什么人上前来找他卜卦，倒是旁边摊位的人，看见徐福拉走了不少的注意力，忙往他身边挪了挪。嘿，蹭个热度嘛！好卖！
转眼，到了第二日，徐福拿着东西再度前往，却发现自己的位置被人占领了。
正是几名乞丐！
那几名乞丐，目光不善地看向徐福，他们可不管徐福长得好看不好看，饱眼福又不能饱肚子。昨日这人在此处出尽了风头，想来今日肯定也会有很多人过来。对于这些乞丐来说，那就是绝佳的乞讨机会。徐福虽然很想夸他们一句，真聪明，但是奈何他们现在占了他的位置，而他这个外来户，想要再寻个地方可就不容易了。于是徐福只得主动走上前去了。
乞丐们对视一眼，颇有些紧张，于是一紧张就抠脚。
徐福：“……”
他收回目光，背对那些乞丐，站定了，然后竖起杆子。
“占卜。”
卜筮、算卦之类的字，太过复杂，徐福担心他们看不懂，便换了个简单的。当然，更重要的是，徐福担心文字沟通的问题。
见徐福全然不将他们放在眼中，这回轮到乞丐：“……”
作者有话要说：
*小剧场*
有人看见路边算卦的徐福，背后还蹲着一打乞丐，那人悚然变色，“我的天！秦王和徐君房分手辣！徐君房和乞丐扎堆讨生活啦！谁要带走的快来带走哇！”
尉缭闻言大怒：“我师弟竟然跟乞丐蹲在一起！这日子不过了回鬼谷！”
姜游闻言宽面条泪：“嘤嘤嘤我可怜的师弟弟……不要怕，师兄兄来救你了……”
公子迁：“哼，早说秦王不靠谱！早跟着孤多好……”
chapters.translated_text:
Xu Fu’s mind was spinning with the contents of the diary recorded on the silk cloth.

Yu City, Yu City.

Could it be considered effortless? Xu Fu never expected that he would arrive at Yu City at such a time. Xu Fu slowly exhaled; it was just as well. If he could find some clues now, he wouldn’t need to come back here in the future.

"Big brother?" The little girl looked back at Xu Fu in confusion.

Only then did Xu Fu realize he had been staring at the city gate for so long that he had forgotten to move forward.

"Let's go," Xu Fu said.

The family then withdrew their gaze and continued forward with excitement.

The two cities were not very far apart; the tremors that could be felt in that city would surely be felt in this one, perhaps only slightly lessened. But Yu City was completely different—they couldn't see any commoners outside the city walls. Moving further ahead, they could see the scene inside the city through the wide-open gates. It was peaceful; how could it look like a place that had just experienced an earthquake?

The family swallowed involuntarily and entered the city, trembling with fear.

Xu Fu followed behind them and walked into the city.

It was a good thing that Yu City was normal; this way he wouldn't have to sleep in the open, and at least he would have a place to rest and a chance to wash up. If the people of Yu City had also been driven out of the city, it would likely be difficult for Xu Fu to investigate past events.

But without A-Wu by his side, where would he get the money to stay at an inn?

Xu Fu felt a bit dejected. Suddenly, he felt the bundle in his hand. He searched through it without giving up, but A-Wu hadn't put any money inside.

Seeing Xu Fu standing at the city gate rummaging through his bundle, the family hurriedly said, "What are you doing? Come in quickly!"

...Right, he almost forgot he was out in public. With so many eyes watching, how could he rummage through his bundle so carelessly? It would be troublesome if he were targeted by a thief. Xu Fu pretended nothing was wrong and closed the bundle. Just then, he seemed to hear a crisp clinking sound. Xu Fu was puzzled at first, then realization dawned on him.

It seemed... like the sound of coins clinking? Tucked away inside the bundle?

Xu Fu decided to find a place to have a good look.

After walking for a while, the family became a bit anxious.

"It will be night soon; we should find a place to stay," said the woman.

Her husband was at a loss, "This... where can we rest here?"

"An inn," Xu Fu said.

The woman looked troubled, "How could we afford to stay at an inn?"

"I will pay," Xu Fu said calmly, though heaven knows he hadn't even touched the money yet.

The woman looked shocked and hurriedly said, "This... how can that be?"

"I didn't know the way and only managed to enter the city by following you. Inviting you to stay at an inn is nothing." In truth, Xu Fu felt a bit guilty. He figured he would have to stay in Yu City and would no longer follow them to the Qin State. Since he had to break his original promise, he felt he should compensate them.

After saying this, Xu Fu led the way forward. Xu Fu wasn't sensitive to much, but he was very sensitive to inns in cities. After all, every time he traveled far, he stayed in inns when not in the wilderness, and he was well-acquainted with them. Xu Fu entered the inn first, and the family exchanged glances, hesitated for a moment, and then carefully stepped inside.

By this time, Xu Fu had already brought the bundle in front of him and took out gold and silver coins from the silk cloth tucked inside.

The coins were Qin Banliang, which naturally couldn't be used.

However, there was gold among them, and gold was a weighed currency in the Chu State that could circulate as money, though it was mostly used among the nobility. Of course, Xu Fu placed a small piece out, and the innkeeper naturally wouldn't refuse after seeing it.

The family, catching a glimpse of this from behind, couldn't help but widen their eyes. They swallowed hard, looking at Xu Fu with even more awe.

Xu Fu booked two rooms—one for himself and the other, naturally, for the family.

The family was poorly dressed, plain-looking, and timid. Standing behind Xu Fu, they were so different in style that one couldn't help but assume they were Xu Fu's servants.

Without A-Wu or any attendants, Xu Fu had to order the waiter to bring water and food himself.

"You should rest well; you've been tired these past few days."

The family nodded fearfully, protected their daughter, and carefully entered their room.

After entering his own room, Xu Fu immediately closed the door. He sat at the table and spread out his bundle, the items inside scattering across the desk. Xu Fu suddenly remembered that when he went missing, he was holding the things Wei Liao had stuffed into his arms. The clothes and other items in this bundle had been purchased by A-Wu later and placed there by Xu Fu. This meant that the money and gold all came from... Wei Liao?

Xu Fu couldn't help but think back to when Jiang You left Xianyang and stuffed a bag of money into his hands.

Heat suddenly rose, and Xu Fu felt his eyes sting.

He was completely different from when he left Xianyang in the past. His mind would constantly dwell on Ying Zheng; he would miss Hu Hai and Fu Su, and he would feel moved when thinking of his senior brothers, Wei Liao and Jiang You.

Xu Fu sat dazed at the table for a while.

How many years had it been... was Wei Liao still worried that he would suffer while by Ying Zheng's side?

Thinking back now on the words Wei Liao used to belittle Ying Zheng in front of him, it felt as if they had been spoken decades ago. His past biased dislike for Wei Liao had gradually dissipated.

Just then, there was a knock at the door.

"Come in."

The door opened, and the waiter walked in, laboriously putting down the water he was carrying, followed by the food.

Xu Fu looked at the wooden bucket, "Why is the water so murky?"

The waiter wiped his sweat and smiled, "Is the water in the city like this lately? The earthquake happened a while ago, so the water became murky."

Xu Fu looked at the waiter in surprise, "The earthquake happened, and you didn't leave?"

"Leave?" The waiter was stunned, "Where to?"

Xu Fu hadn't expected the people in this city to be so calm; the earthquake had come, and they had no reaction at all.

"It's nothing, I was just asking," Xu Fu stopped questioning. The earthquake really didn't threaten their lives, so he didn't need to challenge their choices.

After bathing, Xu Fu quickly ate his food, then lay on the bed holding the bundle. By the candlelight, he took out the items sent from Guigu. They were all Xu Junfang's past diaries, all recorded on silk cloth. These silk cloths were much better preserved, with few blurred characters, though the silk looked a bit old. Just by looking at how these diaries were preserved, Xu Fu could almost feel what kind of place Guigu was.

He closed his eyes, and after preparing himself mentally, he opened the records.

These silk cloths were tied into bundles, and Xu Fu only untied one of them first.

To his disappointment, the information recorded wasn't very important; it was just trivial moments. To put it bluntly, it was just daily life, dry and boring. However, Xu Fu did learn from the past records that Xu Junfang and Wei Liao’s relationship hadn't been very good. Of course, Wei Liao and Jiang You had mentioned this before, so Xu Fu wasn't surprised.

The silk cloths were scattered over Xu Fu. Looking at them, he suddenly had a strange feeling, as if he had detached himself and was watching another person's story from a god's-eye view. Yet, these stories made him feel vaguely familiar.

For instance...

The diary wrote that Xu Junfang had once clashed with Wei Liao because of his unruly nature, but unfortunately lost to Wei Liao. Xu Junfang was sad, so Jiang You came over to mediate and comfort him, and in the end, Wei Liao apologized to Xu Junfang after holding it in for a while.

Xu Fu closed his eyes, as if he could return to that afternoon, the sunlight bathing him, warm and cozy. Wei Liao was lying on a large rock but was pulled up by him. Jiang You, sensing something was wrong, hurriedly gathered around. That day, they seemed to smell the fragrance of flowers and hear the sound of flowing water.

This scene carried a very strong sense of familiarity, leaping in Xu Fu's mind, the image vivid and alive.

Was it a memory belonging to the original body?

Xu Fu rubbed his head and fell asleep without realizing it. After falling asleep, it was as if he had returned to Guigu, and he could vaguely hear voices speaking in his ears.

"He forgot again?"

"...Yeah."

"Is there something wrong with his brain?"

"Liao, don't talk nonsense!"

...

Xu Fu had dreams all night. The next day, he woke up early from a chaotic state. He rubbed his forehead in discomfort and climbed off the bed. The silk cloths fell off him, some landing on the floor. Xu Fu had to bend down to pick them up and put them away one by one.

There was nothing to be gained from the silk cloths; he wondered if there would be any news in Yu City. Xu Fu felt a bit helpless.

He simply got up to wash and then went out to eat. When he returned, he saw the family waiting at the door. They looked haggard, not at all like they had rested well. Xu Fu was puzzled, "Is something the matter?"

"This... we... we won't stay here anymore," the woman said awkwardly. "We've never stayed in such a place, and we couldn't sleep at all."

Seeing them acting so timid and uncomfortable, Xu Fu realized he had overlooked this point.

For them, this place was probably not as comfortable as staying outside the city. Moreover, they still had fear on their faces; they were probably still worried about the earthquake. This city didn't take any measures, which likely made them feel even less secure than the previous city.

Thinking of this, Xu Fu turned around, took out some Qin Banliang and a piece of gold, and stuffed them into the little girl's hand. The girl blushed, "What is this?"

"This is for use within Chu, and this is for entering the Qin State," Xu Fu pointed to them respectively. He paused before adding, "You will have to walk the rest of the way together. I suddenly remembered I have some things to handle in Yu City, so I will be staying here for quite some time. You don't need to wait for me; just leave."

"No, no..." The woman stammered, grabbing the girl's hand to take the items out and return them to Xu Fu.

"Keep them. This is my thanks to you. Even if you don't need them, she does." Xu Fu stood there without moving. Even though his tone was calm, it made people feel inexplicably unable to refute him, and they could only obey by instinct.

The couple blushed, and finally, the husband nodded first, "May I ask your name? So that in the future, we will know who bestowed this kindness upon us?"

"I am... Xu Junfang." Xu Fu said the name on impulse.

The couple widened their eyes, "Your name sounds so familiar."

Xu Fu felt a stir in his heart, "Really? Where and when have you heard it?" Xu Fu felt they shouldn't have seen him before. To be overly narcissistic, his appearance was already top-tier, and his temperament was very unique. If anyone had seen him, how could they easily forget?

The couple racked their brains for a long time but shook their heads, looking apologetic.

"It's fine, you go. Remember to eat something before you leave." Xu Fu hadn't intended to find memories of Xu Junfang's past so easily anyway.

The family solemnly bid farewell to Xu Fu and then left.

The money Xu Fu gave them wasn't much; he worried that if they had too much money without the ability to protect it, they might lose their lives. Besides, a little help is a kindness, but too much can breed resentment. This was enough. Any more would be counterproductive.

The family gave him a bit of inspiration. Since Xu Junfang had been to Yu City before, there must be someone here who remembered him. What better way to awaken those memories than by returning to his old profession? Xu Fu tidied up, took his bundle, and went out to ask the innkeeper to keep his room. He also asked the waiter where he could set up a stall. Although the waiter didn't understand why, he still led Xu Fu there.

"You should be careful; some beggars often come here to snatch spots." Seeing that Xu Fu looked good, but precisely because he looked too good, he gave off a sense of fragility, and the waiter was genuinely worried that Xu Fu might get hurt here.

"I know, thank you." Xu Fu lightly brushed the waiter off.

The waiter shook his head, turned around, and muttered, "Looking so good and having money, why is his brain not working right to do this? He's not even afraid of trouble."

Xu Fu set up his stall with practiced ease.

Because Xu Fu's appearance was so outstanding, people kept looking at him from the moment he stood there. Once he set out his items, even more people stared. When they saw Xu Fu lay out turtle shells and other objects, those people immediately widened their eyes. They didn't usually have a chance to see such things, so how could they not be surprised?

But they were limited to just being surprised. They watched but didn't come forward.

In contrast, some enthusiastic and bold women wanted to move closer to Xu Fu.

Xu Fu was not in a hurry at all. This time was different from before. In the past, whether he wanted to quickly gain the trust of the people in the city or earn money to survive, his purpose was very strong. But this time, he was just pretending to set up a stall, and his purpose was merely to awaken the memories of those who had seen him before. Naturally, he wasn't anxious. Besides, he had the financial support of his senior brother Wei Liao.

Just like that, no one came all morning.

Xu Fu went back to eat and then continued to set up his stall.

Still, no one came forward to ask him for divination, but the person at the neighboring stall, seeing that Xu Fu had attracted a lot of attention, hurriedly moved closer to him. Hey, piggybacking on the popularity! Easier to sell!

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day. Xu Fu went again with his things, only to find his spot had been occupied.

It was a few beggars!

The beggars looked at Xu Fu with unkind eyes. They didn't care if Xu Fu looked good or not; feasting one's eyes couldn't fill one's stomach. This person had stolen the spotlight here yesterday, so they figured many people would come today. For these beggars, it was an excellent opportunity to beg. Although Xu Fu wanted to compliment them on being smart, they were occupying his spot, and it wouldn't be easy for an outsider like him to find another place. So, Xu Fu had to walk up to them.

The beggars exchanged glances, quite nervous, and in their nervousness, they started picking at their feet.

Xu Fu: "..."

He withdrew his gaze, stood with his back to the beggars, and set up his pole.

"Divination."

Words like "fortune-telling" or "divination" were too complicated, and Xu Fu worried they wouldn't understand, so he changed it to something simple. Of course, more importantly, Xu Fu was worried about communication issues.

Seeing that Xu Fu didn't take them seriously at all, it was the beggars' turn: "..."

Author's Note:

*Short Skit*

Someone saw Xu Fu fortune-telling on the side of the road with a dozen beggars squatting behind him. The person was horrified, "My god! The Qin King and Xu Junfang have broken up! Xu Junfang is living with beggars! Whoever wants to take him away, come quickly!"

Wei Liao was furious upon hearing this: "My junior brother is actually squatting with beggars! I can't live like this, I'm going back to Guigu!"

Jiang You wailed with wide noodles of tears: "Wuwuwu, my poor junior brother... don't be afraid, senior brother is coming to save you..."

Prince Qian: "Hmph, I said long ago the Qin King was unreliable! It would have been better to follow me earlier..."

沉寂半晌，徐福才听见嬴政开口说话的声音，“走。”单单一个字，却像是费了大力气从他的喉咙里挤出来一样。徐福不自觉地抬头去看嬴政，却正好对上嬴政阴鸷的双眼。
嫪毐与赵姬走远，徐福和嬴政也转身朝着另一个方向悄然离开。
离开长信侯府的时候，徐福回头看了一眼。
喧嚣繁华还未散尽。
此刻嫪毐想必正搂着赵姬，做着他的春秋大梦，欣喜于富足商贾对他伸出了援手，为他的造反大计提供了资金支持。他又怎么会想得到，所谓的援手，其实不过一把悬在他头上的利剑，只等时间一到，便会叫他血溅三尺。
*
九月三日。
徐福早早地起床了，随后沐浴，焚香，自己顺手拿布和炭条画了个八卦图案，然后放在了胸前揣好。再推开窗户，深呼吸一下。代表吸入天地之气。
一切都准备好了。
徐福摩拳擦掌，跃跃欲试。
他步履轻快地走到了厅堂，只见嬴政正端坐在桌案前，赵高正在为他摆早膳，动作还相当的缓慢惬意。
他们竟然一点都不着急？
“徐先生请。”见徐福跨过门槛进了厅堂，赵高还露出笑容，将徐福也请到了嬴政身旁坐下。
徐福压下心中的疑问，坐下来享用饭食。
味道还不错。
但这不是重点。重点在于，他们难道不应该准备出发去加冠大礼了吗？
用过早膳之后，嬴政依旧是稳坐如山的模样。徐福忍不住了，低声问：“王上，今日……”
嬴政似乎早就看出了徐福心中所想，他漫不经心地说：“慢慢等吧。九月九日，就快来了。”
九月九日？
“王上还是要遵循那个日期？”徐福惊讶得脸色微变。他实在没想明白嬴政的打算。不是已经证实那天并非吉日了吗？为什么嬴政丝毫没有要做出改变的意思呢？难道是他会错意了？
嬴政点了点身边的位置。
徐福立刻起身走过去坐下。
这时他才听见嬴政开口，慢慢说道：“有人精心为寡人挑选的，当然不能浪费这番心意。”
徐福总觉得嬴政说这番话的时候，莫名透着一股阴恻恻的味道。忍住浑身发寒的同时，徐福也登时想通了前后关节。
秦始皇费尽心力在吕不韦面前演戏，又悄然离开咸阳宫提前来到雍城，无非就是不希望被人知道他早有准备。九月九日秦王行加冠礼，这是秦国人都知晓的事情，嫪毐已经择定在那日动手，吕不韦或许也会选择在那天浑水摸鱼。
秦始皇在暗，他们却在明，不管加冠礼最后会如何，秦始皇手里都已经拿着网了，只等瓮中捉鳖。
……所以到底是为什么还要让自己来测算吉日呢？
徐福的脸色黑了黑。
秦始皇命人取来火盆，将手边的竹简扔进去烧了，随后将目光移到徐福的身上，等他注意到徐福脸色微冷的时候，嬴政怔了一下。
原本将徐福叫到身边来，嬴政一是为了看看九月九日究竟是个什么日子；二是为了试验徐福，看他究竟与吕不韦或嫪毐有没有关系；三么，扰乱视线罢了。
他的确是没有真心实意地去求这个吉日。
毕竟在嬴政心中，吉日算得再好又有何用？如何拿下嫪毐与吕不韦，那才是头等大事！当他真正掌握朝中大权时，那便是吉日！
这些话嬴政当然不可能解释给徐福听。
赵高是个人精，初时没想明白，后来就想清楚了，只是他暗藏于心并未点破，只默默做着嬴政的一只手。
被蒙在鼓里的徐福会有怒意，那也是正常的。
嬴政犹豫了一下，沉声道：“寡人并非有意瞒你。”能说出这么一句解释的话来，对于堂堂秦王来说，已是相当了不得了。
徐福兴致却怎么也提不起来了。原本他以为自己有大展拳脚的时候，谁知道，这压根就是个铺着稻草的坑，丫中间是空的！他兴致盎然做了那么多准备，结果一点也用不上。
徐福推开面前的桌案，起身，淡淡道：“身体不适，容我回去歇息。”
赵高打门外进来，瞥见徐福与嬴政之间僵硬的气氛，脸上的笑容登时就僵住了。
徐福说完之后就快速出去了，等回了自己房间，他很快将之前准备好的东西，统统取了出来，该扔的扔，该烧的烧。越想徐福越觉得自己有点蠢。如果秦始皇真心有意要他随行，那应该是早早为他准备好加冠礼上的物事，怎么还会需要他自己去准备呢？
这口怨气堵在徐福的喉咙里，上不去，下不来，难受得紧。
如果全是秦始皇的错，他自然可以背地里痛骂秦始皇一番，并在心中抹黑这位千古一帝。偏偏前一天他才见了嫪毐与着急的无耻嚣张，吕不韦的肆意斥责也还历历在目。他又怎么怪得了小心翼翼、步步为营只为了能掌握原本属于自身权利的秦始皇？
这个年少吃了不少苦楚，长大还要忍受母亲做出那等昏事，并时时担心自己王位和性命的年轻帝王。
他怎么去迁怒怪罪？
徐福烦躁地踢飞了脚上的鞋履，躺上床榻，拉起被子将自己裹住。
眼不见心不烦，正好他为了早起还没睡饱，现在干脆就睡觉好了。
那头嬴政看着徐福快速离去，胸口仿佛被什么东西闷了闷。
赵高小心附在他耳边，低语道：“人已经赶往那边了，那日定能万无一失。”
嬴政“嗯”了一声，随后顿了顿，竟是脱口而出，“寡人错了吗？”
谁人敢言帝王错？
赵高当即跪地，小心道：“王上有何错？王上雄才伟略，怎会有错？”
嬴政又“嗯”了一声，却是站起身来，“徐福对寡人倒是赤子之心。”说完，他便朝外走去，吩咐一旁的侍女，“去徐先生那里。”
等嬴政推门而入时，瞧见的便是徐福安安静静睡在榻上，眉目柔和秀美的模样。哪里还有半分冷意和恼怒？
嬴政：……
作者有话要说：
哦，集中解释一下，扶苏和胡亥是被蝴蝶后的产物，不要纠结始皇大大会不会出轨这事儿，怎么会让他出轨呢！
chapters.translated_text:
After a long silence, Xu Fu heard Ying Zheng speak, "Let's go." The single word sounded as if it had been forced out of his throat with great effort. Xu Fu subconsciously raised his head to look at Ying Zheng, only to meet Ying Zheng's gloomy eyes.

Lao Ai and Lady Zhao walked far away, and Xu Fu and Ying Zheng also turned and quietly left in the other direction.

When leaving the Changxin Marquis Estate, Xu Fu looked back.

The bustling noise and prosperity had not yet dissipated.

At this moment, Lao Ai was probably holding Lady Zhao in his arms, dreaming his grand dreams, rejoicing that the wealthy merchants had extended a helping hand to him and provided financial support for his rebellion master plan. How could he possibly imagine that the so-called helping hand was actually just a sharp sword hanging over his head, waiting only for the time to come to make him bleed three chi?

*

September 3rd.

Xu Fu woke up early, then bathed, burned incense, and casually used a piece of cloth and a charcoal stick to draw a Bagua pattern, which he then stuffed into his chest. Then he pushed open the window and took a deep breath, representing inhaling the breath of heaven and earth.

Everything was ready.

Xu Fu rubbed his hands, eager to try.

He walked briskly into the hall and saw Ying Zheng sitting squarely at the desk, with Zhao Gao serving him breakfast in a rather leisurely and unhurried manner.

Were they actually not in a hurry at all?

"Please, Mr. Xu." Seeing Xu Fu cross the threshold into the hall, Zhao Gao even smiled and invited Xu Fu to sit next to Ying Zheng.

Xu Fu suppressed the doubts in his heart and sat down to enjoy the meal.

The taste wasn't bad.

But that wasn't the point. The point was, shouldn't they be preparing to set off for the capping ceremony?

After breakfast, Ying Zheng still sat as steady as a mountain. Xu Fu couldn't help it and asked in a low voice, "Your Majesty, today..."

Ying Zheng seemed to have seen through what Xu Fu was thinking long ago, and he said casually, "Wait slowly. September 9th is coming soon."

September 9th?

"Does Your Majesty still intend to follow that date?" Xu Fu's face changed slightly with surprise. He really couldn't figure out Ying Zheng's plan. Wasn't it already verified that that day was not an auspicious one? Why did Ying Zheng have no intention of changing it at all? Could it be that he had misinterpreted?

Ying Zheng pointed at the empty seat beside him.

Xu Fu immediately got up, walked over, and sat down.

Only then did he hear Ying Zheng open his mouth and slowly say, "Since someone painstakingly chose it for Us, of course we cannot waste this kind intention."

Xu Fu always felt that when Ying Zheng said these words, there was inexplicably an eerie undertone to them. While suppressing the chill all over his body, Xu Fu also instantly figured out the connection between the events.

Emperor Qin Shi Huang went to great lengths to act out a play in front of Lü Buwei, and then quietly left Xianyang Palace to arrive in雍城 (Yongcheng) ahead of time, simply because he didn't want people to know he had been prepared all along. The Qin King's capping ceremony on September 9th was something all people of Qin knew; Lao Ai had already chosen to make his move on that day, and Lü Buwei might also choose to fish in troubled waters that day.

Emperor Qin Shi Huang was in the dark while they were in the light. No matter how the capping ceremony turned out in the end, Emperor Qin Shi Huang already held the net in his hands, just waiting to catch turtles in a jar.

...Then why on earth did he still ask him to calculate an auspicious day?

Xu Fu's face turned dark.

Emperor Qin Shi Huang had someone fetch a brazier, threw the bamboo slips at hand in to burn them, and then shifted his gaze to Xu Fu. When he noticed Xu Fu's slightly cold expression, Ying Zheng was momentarily stunned.

Originally, calling Xu Fu to his side was, first, for Ying Zheng to see what kind of day September 9th actually was; second, to test Xu Fu and see whether he had any connection with Lü Buwei or Lao Ai; and third, just to create a distraction.

He truly hadn't sincerely sought this auspicious date.

After all, in Ying Zheng's heart, no matter how well an auspicious day was calculated, what use was it? How to take down Lao Ai and Lü Buwei—that was the top priority! When he truly grasped supreme power in the court, that would be the auspicious day!

Of course, Ying Zheng could never explain these words to Xu Fu.

Zhao Gao was a slippery fellow; he hadn't figured it out at first, but later he understood. He simply kept it hidden in his heart without pointing it out, and silently acted as one of Ying Zheng's hands.

It was normal for Xu Fu, who was kept in the dark, to feel angry.

Ying Zheng hesitated for a moment, and said in a deep voice, "We did not mean to deceive you." Being able to say such an explanatory sentence was already quite remarkable for the dignified King of Qin.

Yet Xu Fu could not muster any enthusiasm whatsoever. Originally, he thought he would have a chance to show off his skills; who would have known that this was simply a pit covered with straw, and empty in the middle! He had made so many preparations with high spirits, only to find they were of no use at all.

Xu Fu pushed away the desk in front of him, stood up, and said indifferently, "I am feeling unwell. Allow me to go back and rest."

Zhao Gao walked in from outside the door, caught a glimpse of the stiff atmosphere between Xu Fu and Ying Zheng, and the smile on his face instantly froze.

After speaking, Xu Fu quickly walked out. Once he returned to his room, he promptly took out all the things he had prepared earlier, throwing away what needed to be thrown and burning what needed to be burned. The more he thought about it, the more Xu Fu felt he had been a bit foolish. If Emperor Qin Shi Huang had truly intended for him to accompany him, he should have prepared the items for the capping ceremony for him early on; why would he still need to prepare them himself?

This grievance was stuck in Xu Fu's throat, neither going up nor down, extremely uncomfortable.

If it were entirely Emperor Qin Shi Huang's fault, he could naturally curse Emperor Qin Shi Huang in secret and blacken this emperor through the ages in his heart. Yet just the day before, he had witnessed the shameless arrogance of Lao Ai and Lady Zhao, and Lü Buwei's wanton reprimands were still vivid in his mind. How could he blame Emperor Qin Shi Huang, who was cautious and moved step by step solely to seize the power that originally belonged to him?

This young emperor had suffered a lot in his youth, and upon growing up had to endure his mother committing such foolish deeds, while constantly worrying about his throne and his life.

How could he hold a grudge or blame him?

Irritated, Xu Fu kicked off the shoes on his feet, climbed onto the bed, and wrapped himself up in the quilt.

Out of sight, out of mind. Since he hadn't slept enough due to waking up early, he might as well just sleep now.

On the other side, Ying Zheng watched Xu Fu leave quickly, his chest feeling as if it were stuffy with something.

Zhao Gao carefully leaned close to his ear and whispered, "People have already rushed over there. Everything will surely go without a hitch on that day."

Ying Zheng let out an "en", then paused for a moment, and blurted out, "Was We wrong?"

Who would dare to say an emperor was wrong?

Zhao Gao immediately dropped to his knees and cautiously said, "How could Your Majesty be wrong? Your Majesty possesses grand talents and great vision, how could you be wrong?"

Ying Zheng let out another "en", but stood up instead. "Xu Fu indeed holds a pure heart toward Us." With that, he walked outside and instructed the maidservant beside him, "Go to Mr. Xu's quarters."

When Ying Zheng pushed open the door and entered, what he saw was Xu Fu sleeping quietly on the couch, his brows and eyes looking gentle and delicate. Where was there even a shred of coldness and annoyance left?

Ying Zheng:……

Author's note:

Oh, to explain collectively, Fusu and Huhai are the products of the butterfly effect. Don't get tangled up over whether Emperor Shi Huang will cheat or not—how could I possibly let him cheat!
