徐福对这个时代如何报官半点也不了解，那府衙开在何方，他更是不清楚。所以从草屋出来之后，徐福不得不又找到了之前那个老头儿。老头儿见他走过来，马上扔了手中的伙计，搓了搓手，问道：“先生可找到想要的东西了？”
徐福摇了摇头。
老头儿面露可惜之色，不过紧接着他脸上的表情就发生了变化，因为徐福对他说：“我在屋中发现了尸骨。”
老头儿惊了惊，张大嘴，没有说话，过了会儿功夫，他才反应过来，摇头道：“看来那个疯子还是死在里头了，这么久都没人去看过，那也不知道变成什么模样了……”
“里面的尸骨不止一具。”徐福不得不打断了老头儿的感慨。
“什、什么？那是死了几个人？”
“两人，现在并不能确定其中有那疯子的尸骨，我也不知该如何处置，便只能前来找你了，要劳烦你去通知人来处理尸骨了。”徐福淡淡道。
老头儿愣愣地点着头，“您、您等着，我……我这便去喊人过来。”老头儿又一次将饼摊托付给了旁边的人，随后便拔腿疾走离开了，他的腿脚到了这个时候，变得极为灵便了起来。
那个被托付了饼摊的人，扬了扬眉，“又弄什么呢？跑得这样快！”说完，他摇摇头，转头看向了徐福，他好奇地问道：“你不是舆城人？”
“不是。”
“那你到舆城来做什么？”
徐福没应他的话。
那人也不以为意，只低声地自言自语道：“老头儿什么时候认识这样的人了？奇怪！奇怪！”
没一会儿的功夫，老头儿便带着人回来了，他身后的人穿着普通的衣服，徐福打量一番，半点看不出来像是官府的制服。这些人是楚国的公务人员吗？
那些人瞥了一眼徐福，并未将徐福放在心上，只对那老头儿道：“在何处？带我们过去！”
老头儿喘了两口气，便又急急往前走起来，徐福一言不发地跟了上去，那些人见了倒也未出言斥责。很快，他们就走到了草屋外，老头儿指了指里面，“尸骨，就在里面了。”
因为草屋外来了不少人，这一块地方的人都被惊动了，他们忍不住探出头来，好奇地打量着徐福一行人，甚至还指着这边窃窃私语了起来。
那些人进去检查了一会儿，很快就出来了，他们皱着眉，露出厌恶的表情，冷冰冰地说：“看来死的就是王河。”
王河？徐福估摸着这应当是那个疯子的名字。但这些人是如何笃定死的人一定是王河？
正疑惑着，徐福便听他们又道：“另外一具尸骨应该就是外乡人了！”
徐福这下子明白过来了，这几人分明就是在肆意胡说。
“阁下如何断定那死掉的便是王河，和外乡来的人呢？”徐福实在忍不住了。他是当真没见过这样粗暴的办案方式。
而事实告诉徐福，这些人还有更粗暴的。
被徐福询问的那人，冷冰冰地看了他一眼，道：“死在王河草屋中的，不是王河，能是何人？”
徐福：“……”你说得好有道理。
“舆城中又并无失踪的人，那另外一个自然就是外乡来的人了。”
徐福这下是彻底服气了。草屋里死的究竟是什么人，对于他们来说，根本就不重要吧，怎么死的，也不重要。反正迅速给他们定了身份就算是妥了。
“这两具尸骨掩埋了便是。”那人说了结束性的话语。
跟在他身后的人闻言，便立即要去抬那尸骨。
徐福这下实在是无奈了。如果让他们就这样掩埋了，那自己就别想从尸骨上得到半点讯息了，毕竟他没有挖坟的技能。
“能否允我再看一次？”徐福出声道。
那些人疑惑地看了徐福一眼，厉声问道：“你怎么对此事这般好奇？难道你……”
在对方怀疑他是杀人凶手之前，徐福就已经先用气势压倒了对方，并且打断了他，“我只是来寻王河的，他可以为我作证。”徐福指了指一旁的老头儿。
老头儿连连点头。
那些人虽然不相信徐福这个生面孔，但是对于老头儿，他们还是相信的。于是那人冷哼一声，只道：“哦，瞧你这模样，也是外乡来的吧。可要小心些，莫成了这个样子。”这句话明显是故意为难徐福了。
徐福装作听不出他语气中的嘲讽，直接绕开他们，再度走进了草屋。他强忍着呕吐的欲望，凑近了细细打量那两具尸骨。
尸骨因为遭啃噬过的原因，而极为残缺不全，但是徐福仍旧发现，这两具尸体在未被啃噬之前，就已经残缺了，尤其是在脸部，可以看见下巴的骨头都是被砍过的，鼻子等部位也有程度不同的损害。这让徐福不得不又想到了，梦境中疯子王河对他说的话。或许那不算是个梦，那就是属于徐君房的回忆，真真切切的回忆。
“好了吗？”外面的人催促道。
徐福站直身体，呼出一口气，拔腿走了出去。
那个疯子的模样现在想起来，徐福都还觉得毛骨悚然，他甚至有些不敢深思，这些尸骨为何会造成这般模样。
那两具尸骨很快就被那些人收走了，他们应该很快就会被下葬，徐福不可能指望从中获得更多的信息了。等他们走后，老头儿不自觉地走到了徐福的身边，低声道：“先生很失望吗？”
“无事，多谢你了，你回去吧。”徐福说完，顿了顿，又掏出了些钱币，交给了那老头儿，“拿着。”他确实麻烦了人家很多，老头儿连自己的饼摊都顾不上了。他怎么能就这样平白消受人家的好呢？
老头儿不敢伸手去接那钱，连连摇头道：“不、不必了。”
“拿着。”徐福的语气强硬，老头儿愣了愣，不敢反驳一句话，只得接过了钱币。
“你可以回去了。”徐福又道。
老头儿不自觉地听从了他的话，老老实实地往回走了。
等他们这些人都走了之后，其他看热闹的人，也都各自散场了。死了两个人，在之后的时间里已经足够成为他们的谈资了，他们没必要再继续看下去。
而且这些人都一致地认为，那个站在草屋前长相俊美的人，不好惹。还是不要多看了。
很快，徐福周围就重归了安静。
他在草屋外站了一会儿，忍不住又走回了草屋，他还想看一看，里面还有什么留下来的线索。或许他应该多谢那些不负责任的楚人，他们干脆地收走了尸骨，对于草屋中的东西半点都没动，此时正方便了徐福。
徐福艰难地从这个遍地狼藉的草屋中，搜寻着他想要的东西。
他小心地挪动着步子，但是草屋里的地面实在太烂了，他不知道自己踩中了什么东西，还险些滑倒，惊得徐福的魂都差点从体内飞出来。他一点也不希望自己滑倒，他不希望自己触到地面上去，这里可躺过狰狞的尸体！
徐福堪堪抓住了旁边破烂不堪的桌案，他支撑住身体，赶紧站起了身。这个时候他才能低下头，去打量方才差点致使他滑倒的东西。那像是一块被揉成一团的绢布，黑乎乎，有一半陷入了泥土之中。
王河能拥有得起绢布吗？徐福很怀疑。
不过若真是绢布，那么多半都是用来记载东西的。会出现在这里的绢布，那上面一定记载着徐福正需要的东西！徐福有些激动，他小心地躬下身，将那绢布拾了起来。
徐福缓缓展开了绢布。
他失望了。
绢布的保存性实在不如何，或许是经历过了泥土的糅杂，经历过了风雨的打磨……徐福什么也看不清了。
徐福正要将绢布丢弃，那绢布突然滑开，落了一张下去。
是两张？
徐福将那块绢布又捡了起来。
不如取回去用水洗一洗，看看上面是否还有残存的字迹？徐福正想着，他的目光突然被绢布上不同寻常的一块地方吸引住了。
那上面粘连着的，一小团，暗红色的……
徐福将绢布拿得更近了一些，仔细地又看了一遍。徐福顿时毛骨悚然，他手一松，绢布全部掉在了地上。
不！那根本就不是什么绢布！
上面还粘连着残存的血肉，因为年岁有些久了，上面的血迹都变成了暗红色。徐福几乎可以想象得出，这个东西，当初是如何被人从另一个人的脸上，剥落下来的。
这是两张人的面皮！
其中一张上面还粘连着眼珠！
徐福越想越觉得恶心。他已经经历过不少奇异的事了，阿武那张脸都没令他呕吐出来，而此刻，徐福却觉得自己胃里一阵翻江倒海。
他再也忍不住了！
徐福快步冲出了草屋，头一次这般不顾礼仪气质，当然，此时也根本不会有什么人注意到他。
徐福到了草屋外，想要吐却偏偏又吐不出来，他的眼前仿佛蒙上了一层血色，脑海中不自觉地联想起了，那两具尸体还活着的时候，是如何被人剥掉脸皮的，其中一个，因为力道太大，他的眼珠甚至被生生一同剥落了下来。
何等血腥！何等残忍！
这就是王河口中的改面相吗？
他果然是个疯子！
徐福在那里站了好一会儿，才平复住了心情。
冷静下来之后，徐福就能进行正常的猜测了，他认为那两具尸骨应该都不是王河。这两具尸骨为什么会缺少某些部位，缺少五官和脸皮？这都和王河曾经对徐君房说的话不谋而合。他们又恰好出现在王河的草屋之中。这哪里会是巧合呢？最好的解释就是，当初王河被他拒绝以后，就自己动手进行了改造。他将人弄到了他的草屋里，趁他们还活着的时候，企图用他们完美的部位，来替换自己丑陋的部位。
但是为什么取下来的人皮，最后他又不曾使用，而是留在了草屋中呢？
难道是王河在最后清醒了？发现人皮不能用？
王河总不至于，是在清醒的状态下，剥掉了对方的脸皮，再剥掉自己的脸皮，最后还没来得及换到脸上，就因失血过多死亡了吧？
徐福觉得自己一时间都有些难以思考了。
但他可以确定的是，改面相绝对不是通过这样粗暴的方法。那么只要王河的命运，还如同当初徐君房为他相的那样，那么王河也不可能活到今日。
那王河，究竟是死了，还是改命成功，活到了现在呢？
徐福迫切地想要见到这个疯子。
但是找人可不是他的特长。如果这舆城中再翻不出别的东西来，他就只有离开舆城，先回到咸阳，再托嬴政派人去寻这个王河了。王河能躲得过他，但绝对躲不过权利之下的追捕。
徐福轻叹一口气，转过身盯着那草屋许久，最后，他还是没勇气再一次踏入那间草屋，他想，他需要平复一下心情才行。
徐福从草屋离开，直接回到陈阿婆的府邸。
他刚一进入府邸，玥儿就走了过来，“先生，阿婆在等您。”玥儿小声说道。
徐福看也没有看她一眼，直接走了进去。
玥儿咬了咬唇，倒是没说什么。
徐福心底也松了一口气，冷漠地拒人于千里之外才好，这样就可以避免一些状况出现了。
陈阿婆坐在厅中，一见徐福踏进门来，她便立即扶着香儿的手臂站了起来，“我听闻城中死了两个人，您在外没遇见什么祸事吧？”陈阿婆脸上的担忧不似作伪。
“我去找了那个疯子，最后发现他的屋子里有两具尸体。”徐福淡淡道。
旁边的两名女子闻言，立即抬起手捂住了嘴，满面震惊害怕之色。
“怎、怎么会这样呢？”陈阿婆也骇得不轻，“城中多少年没死过人了。”
“那二人应该是很早之前死的了，或许就是在那疯子失踪了之后。”
陈阿婆好半天都说不出话来，良久，她才张了张嘴道：“您要多加注意安危才好。您也累了吧？可要备些食物？我记得，您这时候是要用些吃食的。”陈阿婆笑了笑，将尸体的事抛到了脑后去。
听着陈阿婆明显怀念的口吻，徐福心中又觉得有些怪异了。
对，吃午饭是他的习惯，但是徐君房也有这样的习惯？徐福很清楚，这个时代多是一日两餐，绝不会有像他这样的习惯。
当然，徐君房若是也来自现代，或许也会选择和他一样，将现代的饮食习惯带到这个时候来。
徐福将这些乱七八糟的猜测从脑子里挤了出去。
他总能慢慢验证到，他和徐君房之间的联系究竟是什么。
“吃吧。”徐福淡淡道。
陈阿婆闻言，开怀地笑了笑，马上令人取来了食物。
这时徐福才注意到，府中也并不是全然没有下人的。那送食物来的，便是个中年男子，只是昨日徐福没有见过罢了。
男子将食物放在徐福跟前的桌案上，随后他扬起头看了徐福一眼，脸上闪过了惊讶之色，他忍不住出声道：“是您啊！”
看来这个人，在府中做了很久的下人了？不然怎么也会记得他呢？
徐福点了点头，那男子倒是没多说什么，只是眼眸中闪过了亮光，然后他才躬着腰退出去了。徐福并未对男子上心，男子眼中的亮光他再熟悉不过了。那是崇敬的目光。
徐福用了食物之后，便迅速回到自己的屋中休息了。陈阿婆以为他是疲累了，便吩咐人不要去打扰他。
徐福回到屋中，再无其它的头绪，最后他干脆躺在了床榻之上。最好再做一个梦……至少让他梦到，之后王河还说了什么、做了什么。他当时又是怎么离开的舆城？
徐福闭上了眼，脑中一直盘旋着这几个问题。
但可惜的是，徐福什么也没能梦见，反倒是嬴政在他的脑子里强势出镜，也就一个眨眼的功夫，然后便没了。醒来之后，夕阳西下，徐福脑子里深深印刻下的，便是他对嬴政那惊鸿一瞥时，嬴政眼底透出的冰寒之色，如今哪怕只是回忆一下，徐福都能鲜明地感受到嬴政那强盛的气势，还有被他一眼看过来的时候，仿佛整个人都被钉在原地的震慑感。
徐福并不觉得畏惧，他心底反倒是浮起了难言的滋味，大约……有那么点儿甘甜吧？
嬴政的强大令他不自觉地感觉到欢喜。
徐福撑着床榻起身，洗漱一番后，便走出了屋子。他这一觉睡得有些久，中午吃下的食物都未能完全消化，于是徐福不得不出了府，在外面多走几步，以借此消食。
他走在了舆城的街道上，吸引来了无数的目光，虽然徐福对这些目光向来没什么感觉，但在此时，徐福却觉得有些说不出的烦躁。大概是脑子里纠缠了太多的谜团，偏偏他又不通解密推理，实在令他如鲠在喉吧。
会被情绪影响，这对于徐福来说，太难得了。
他犹豫一下，选择了走上另一条小道，这边没有多少人，他总算可以避开那些目光了。
他的目光渐渐扫过这条街道。
舆城，对于他来说，原本应该是熟悉的地方，但现在，这一切在他眼中都极为的陌生。失忆，实在是个太可怕的东西。
走着走着，徐福就转入了一个死角。
徐福惊觉不好，立即转身，厉声道：“谁在跟着我？”
一个人从拐角处走了出来，冲徐福笑了笑，“先生，我……我来请先生为我卜卦。”
徐福微微松了一口气。不是什么歹徒就好。看来是今日他没有前去摆摊，结果反倒有人找到他求他算卦了。徐福心中觉得好笑，不过还是认真地看向了跟前的男子，“你要卜什么？”
男子咧了咧嘴，“先生会相面吗？先生为我相面吧。”
徐福听他这样一说，便不大想开口了。
这男子的面相，他根本不消细看，就能说出对方的面向并不好，甚至可以说是有些糟糕的。徐福很是犹豫，要不要将这话说出来的。人的面相是可以变的，但是对于成年人来说，是极难改变的。因为人在幼年的时候，是一张白纸，什么东西都可以改变，而一旦成年，很多东西就都定型了，也就再难改变了。
面前的男子，面相这样糟糕，徐福若是说出来，岂不是会让对方觉得，他很可能一辈子都翻不了身吗？
徐福一时间想得多了点儿。或许是从前，他还会毫无顾忌，直接说实话。但是现在一想到疯子王河，徐福便无法直言了。
见徐福并不说话，那男子有些着急了，他伸长了脖子，焦急地说：“我的面相，是不是不好？”
徐福还是没说话。
而那男子已经自顾自地往下说了，“是！我的面相不好！我就知道！不论我做什么都会赔！都是我的面相……我的面相……我如今还变成了一个人，妻儿都抛下了我……都是因为我这面相！”他的情绪颇有些激动，于是连带着，他的表情都变得有些狰狞，甚至在嘴唇的开合之间激动地喷出了唾沫。
徐福不自觉地往后退了一步，暗地里拧了拧眉。
怎么又是一个疯子？
徐福真的恨不得骂出声了。
这男子这般激动，他就更不能说了。从男子说的话，就可以得出，男子将什么生活中所有的不顺，都归结到了他的面相之上，这样怨天尤人，可见他的性格，懦弱、冲动、没有担当，并且情绪偏于极端。这样的人，能有什么好的面相？就算初时面相不错，到了后来也会渐渐被戾气所改变。
一个人的面相要变好很难，但是要变坏却再容易不过。
男子激动地发泄完了情绪，然后他抬头看向了徐福，他死死地盯着徐福，目光与梦境中的疯子相重叠。
他沉声道：“我找了你好久了，先生，你为我改命吧。”
徐福心中“咯噔”一下，这人不会就是王河吧？
“先生，你为什么不说话了？”男子的身体微微颤抖着，当然，他并不是因为恐惧，而是因为激动和兴奋。他看着徐福的双眼放着光，徐福感觉自己在他眼中化身了香饽饽。
“说什么？”徐福冷声道，“什么改命？我并不知晓你在说什么。”
“先生怎么会不知晓呢？”男子更激动了，他的双手挥舞着，像是下一刻就会扑倒在徐福的身上，“你怎么会不知晓呢！怎么会！你在骗我！”
徐福又往后退了退，他看似盯着男子，实际上他的目光却是在看这条路，如果男子真的疯了起来，他要怎么从这条路出去。
虽然他刚才走错了路，不过徐福现在都能听见外面的人声，也就是说这条小道，距离外面的大道很近，外面的人能够注意到这边的响动。
徐福暗暗道，下次他再也不在陌生的地方胡乱走了。这不仅没勾起半点回忆，反倒是勾来了一个疯子。
“你在骗我！我都看见了！”男子如是说。
“看见什么了？”徐福依旧语调冷静，他试图用这样的语气，来同化对面的男子。不过很可惜，对面的男子似乎全然陷入了自己的世界之中，他根本没有感受到徐福的冷静和淡漠。
他激动地叫嚷道：“我都看见了，我看见了王河！那个时候，王河也来找你改命了！他来找你改命了！是你给他改了命！”
徐福脑子里一阵晕眩，差点冷静不下来。
什么叫做“是你给他改了命”？这个男人说的，究竟是真是假？难道当初王河被拒绝之后，不死心又找到了徐君房，而徐君房也真的给王河改命了吗？徐福想一想就觉得自己整个人都不好了。
如果是他，他绝对不会给王河改命！
就那样的疯子，和今天的男子一样，他们不从自己的根本上找问题，反倒将一切都赖与面相，难道真的面相变了，人就会变了吗？那田味不就是个最好的道理吗？他拥有一张近乎完美无缺的脸，但是田味的性格所使，现在他的面相也隐隐有变化了，他在往糟糕的方向变动。
不……等等！
徐福咬了咬唇，好用疼痛来让自己的脑子保持清醒。
田味……
对啊！
就好像田味！
田味为什么会有那样的一张脸，他的面相为什么和他本人透着一股诡异感，会不会是，田味的面相本来不是这样的呢？这个近乎完美无缺的面相，其实都是改了面相后的结果呢？
“你可以给王河改，为什么不能给我改呢？我可以给你钱！只要等我的面相改了，之后我可以一直给你钱！”男子一边说还一边朝徐福靠近了。
“你当真想要知道你的面相好不好吗？”徐福出声打断了他。
其实最好的解决办法，就是徐福现在告诉他，你的面相非常好，然后再用自己的知识，将对方忽悠一遍，将他夸上天。不过这也是有风险的。因为从男子的表现来看，他已经笃定自己的面相不好了，如果徐福出言欺骗他，也许他会默认为是徐福不愿意给他改面相，从而恼羞成怒，会做出什么事来，徐福都不敢想象。
何况徐福一般也不爱骗人。
除了倒霉催的燕王被他唬了个彻底。
“想！我想知道我的面相如何？我比王河，谁更糟糕？”男子咬着牙道。
徐福：……
都这个时候了，这男人还想着和王河比较呢？
“王河。”徐福道。当然是王河更糟糕了，当初王河到他跟前来的时候，那面相都是将死之兆了。而跟前的男子，虽然面相丑陋，精神萎靡，目光浑浊，一看便知道是糟糕的面相外，至少他并没有将死的征兆啊。
男子咧嘴笑了笑，但随后又狂热地道：“先生，为我改面相吧！我要摆脱我这该死的命格！我现在的命烂透了！我不想过这样的日子！当初你都为王河改了面相，现在为我改一改，又有何不可呢？”
“我没有为王河改过面相，我并不擅此道。”徐福淡淡道：“你们城中不是还有个方士吗？你为何不去寻他？”
“那个骗子已经离开舆城了！”男子激动地说，“我找过他，但是他没用！我知道，只有你了，只有你才能改。我见过的！我什么都看见了，你为王河改了面相……”男子低下头，神经质地重复着最后一句话。
“我亲眼看见的……”
“你为他改了面相，我知道，王河还活着，他活得很好，都是你做的，你也可以为我改面相啊，你为什么不做呢？为什么不帮我呢！”
男子如是说道。
徐福越听越觉得一阵鸡皮疙瘩，再听下去，他觉得自己脑子里的猜测，都就会被男子推翻，搅乱。
“够了！此事……我再思虑一番。改面相之事，非同小可，你先回去吧。”徐福将架子端得十足，他抬了抬下巴，极为冷傲地瞥了男子一眼。
而男子激动的情绪却诡异地被这一眼安抚下来了，他声音颤抖地道：“你说得对，你说得没错……这是大事……对……我，我等着……我等着您。”
“我等着您。”这四个字，仿佛被他含在了舌尖一般，说得极为轻巧，同时，他看着徐福的目光更为狂热了。
徐福压住鸡皮疙瘩冒起来的冲动，在心底骂了句疯子。这舆城是盛产疯子吗？
男子微笑着转身走了出去，他就像是得了糖果的孩子，极为开怀地离开了，全然看不出方才他发起疯来的模样，是多么的骇人。
徐福微微松了一口气，这才拔腿往外走。
在那里肌肉紧绷地站了许久，徐福都觉得自己走起路来，有些酸软。
这一路上，徐福的心情都难以平静下来，男子的咆哮声不断地在他耳边重复上演，他反反复复地在舌尖咀嚼着那句话——“我都看见了，是你为王河改了面相”。
是……我吗？
徐福手掌紧握成拳，实在有点难以接受这个结果。
如果他当初真的为王河改了面相，那田味呢？田味总不会也是他改的吧？徐福有种说不出的荒谬感，就好像是他费尽了力气去找背后捣鬼的反派，最后却发现自己就是那个反派一样的荒谬。
他走在街上的时候，都还有人忍不住向他走来，或许也是想要请他卜卦的，但是现在徐福实在对卜卦有点阴影了，他半点也不想再给舆城中的人卜卦，而且他此时的心境不平，怎么给人卜卦？徐福直接无视了那些人，一路走回到陈阿婆的府中。
徐福刚一进门，陈阿婆等人就跑了出来。
“先生到哪里去了？久久不见先生归来？我们可吓死了。”香儿嘴快，先一步道。
“抱歉，我下午睡得久了些，便想在舆城中走一走，或许能勾起一点记忆。”徐福的脸色有些难看，“谁承想，我又遇见了一个疯子。”
“又一个疯子？”陈阿婆攥紧了衣襟，“这，这怎么会如此呢？先生可有受伤？先生……先生明日带个人一起吧，这样，这样便会避开那疯子了。”
徐福摇了摇头，脱口而出，“不，我要走了。”
是，他该走了。
这里有用的东西他已经握在手中了，而剩下的，却是危险。他身边没有阿武，更没有侍从，若是出了什么事……不，他根本不敢想象若是自己出了事，那会是什么模样。
一旦想到，他若是死在此处，嬴政都不会知晓，徐福便觉得胸口揪着一般的疼。
这一刻，徐福无比地想念嬴政，想念咸阳，想念王宫中的一切……其实过去，哪怕他外出没有嬴政的陪伴，但实际上嬴政也相当于陪在他的身边了。因为他身边的侍从、内侍都是来自嬴政。他们都是在嬴政的嘱咐下，跟在了自己的身边，就为了照顾自己。所以徐福才能一直后顾无忧，一直舒心地去做自己想要做的事。
但这一次，他身边一个人也没有。
他的本事半点也派不上用场。
徐福觉得自己此刻的情绪很糟糕，就像是在外受了委屈，迫不及待想要回到大人怀抱中寻求抚慰的小孩儿一样。
徐福微微出神了，陈阿婆激动地在他耳边说了些什么，他一句话都没听清。
陈阿婆并未注意到徐福的走神，她看着徐福冷漠不变的表情，叹了口气。
“我就知道，您在这里是不会停留太久的。”陈阿婆有些伤心，大约是人的年纪大了，便无比的怀念过去，也害怕分别。
徐福的目光变得温和了些，他的目光落在了陈阿婆的身上，“多谢你这段时日的照顾。”
陈阿婆无奈道，“不过两日……先生这么急便要离去，真是……唉……”
“我要避开那个疯子。”
陈阿婆闻言，便也不敢再劝，只道：“您要小心。”
“嗯，我会的。”徐福点头。
陈阿婆让人摆了晚饭，徐福跟他们一起坐下来，吃过了晚饭。陈阿婆脸上伤心的表情减轻了不少。她亲自将徐福送回了屋子，“能与您在十多年后，共用一次饭，已是难得了。想来死的时候，我也能记着您的模样死去。”
徐福听了这话，并不觉得多么开心，反而有点儿寒意笼罩。
您死的时候，就不用念着我了。
想一想便觉得浑身发寒的徐福心道。
徐福想要避开那个疯子，便决定翌日一早，直接就从舆城离开，希望那时城门已开。
这个时候没有闹钟，也不会有人来唤徐福起床，于是徐福决定早睡，如此方能早起。他洗漱过后，便躺在了床榻上，他强行压下脑中万千思绪，嘴边念着嬴政的名字，渐渐就睡着了。
第二日徐福醒来的时候，天还未大亮，但他也未再继续睡下去了，他起身洗漱，收拾好行李包袱，谁也没打招呼，直接就往府门口走了。只是走到那府门口的时候，徐福看见了玥儿，玥儿双眼微肿，看上去昨夜并未歇息好，她看着徐福，有些不舍地道：“先生一定要走吗？”
“嗯。”
玥儿咬了咬唇，“可……可我心中倾慕先生啊……”
徐福想也不想，便道：“我家在秦国咸阳，我不可能留在舆城。”
玥儿已然自动解读了徐福的话，她瞪大了眼，努力让眼眶中的眼泪不要掉落下来，她道：“啊，原来先生已然有妻眷了吗？”
妻……眷？
妻……嬴政？
眷……扶苏、胡亥？
哦，或许还有师兄尉缭……
“是。”徐福低声道。
“我……我知晓了，那、那先生请吧。”玥儿知晓后，倒是并未对徐福说什么，我愿为妾之类的话。想来陈阿婆应当是将她教很好的。
女子恋慕男子，本是世间再正常不过的事，她及时退回去，也正将她显得优秀聪慧了。
跟这样的姑娘打交道，徐福在心底松了口气。
他辞别玥儿，从打开的府门口走了出去。
此时远方已经隐隐有了光亮。
日出了……
徐福顿觉心情被抚慰了不少。只不过他的好心情根本没能维持多久。
“你骗我！”一个咬牙切齿的声音在距离他不远的地方响起，徐福扭头一看。
……又是那个疯狂的男子！
他怎么会知道自己要走？

Xu Fu did not know what kind of magic changing one's destiny held for a person. Driven by this magic, the man opposite him had already charged toward him.

The round sun gradually rose from the horizon, illuminating the man's hideous face.

"What do you want?" Xu Fu shouted sharply.

The man ignored him, his footsteps never faltering as he rushed at Xu Fu. "If you can change Wang He's physiognomy, you can naturally change mine too!" His hands curled into claws. Xu Fu had no doubt that if the man pounced on him, he might pin his neck, cause him to suffocate, and make him pass out right there, after which he would never be able to leave Yu City.

Without a second thought, Xu Fu turned and ran.

To hell with composure and grace!

Having lived a life of luxury in Xianyang, Xu Fu’s stamina was indeed lacking. On the morning streets, many people were coming out and beginning to set up their stalls. They stared in astonishment at the person running past, completely unaware of what was happening.

The further Xu Fu ran, the more desperate he felt.

He was completely unfamiliar with the layout of Yu City, and it would be effortless for the man to catch him. Just as he was thinking this, Xu Fu realized that not far ahead was a dead end.

He had no choice but to stop and turn around, one hand reaching for his waist. There was a knife there, taken from Granny Chen’s residence, said to be for self-defense. Although Xu Fu was not skilled with a blade, having a defensive weapon was better than having none at all.

He could not go any further; once he entered the dead end ahead, it would not be easy to escape, as the opponent could completely block him inside. Scenes from horror movies flashed rapidly through Xu Fu's mind. It could be said that this was the greatest crisis he had ever encountered.

After all, people like Xiong Yi were still open to negotiation and trickery.

But the person in front of him was purely a madman obsessed with fate and physiognomy.

Unless he promised the man to change his physiognomy. But that could only be an expedient measure.

Xu Fu’s brain worked rapidly. He squeezed the small knife at his waist. Where should he stab the man? If he killed someone in the State of Chu, would he be in trouble? Of course, the most important question was, could he kill him?

The man had already caught up. He took two breaths, then gave a sinister laugh and said, "Sir, come with me!" As he spoke, he stepped forward quickly and reached out to grab Xu Fu. The strength in his hand was so great that as soon as he gripped Xu Fu's wrist, Xu Fu felt as if his wrist were about to be crushed.

At the critical moment, Xu Fu pulled out his knife.

A black shadow suddenly leaped down from above, slamming heavily into the man, who let out a wail and fell to the ground.

The knife in Xu Fu's hand instantly became useless. He steadied himself and then saw that the shadow that had fallen was a person—a tall, sturdy man.

The man seemed to notice Xu Fu’s scrutinizing gaze and turned his head.

"A-Wu?" Xu Fu had never expected to see A-Wu here, especially at such a moment. He suppressed the suspicion in his heart, not rushing to reveal it. After all, A-Wu was a powerful asset at this time, and he had to use A-Wu's strength to deal with the man first.

When A-Wu jumped down from the wall just now, he had hit the man squarely. Just hearing the sound, Xu Fu felt that the man must have had some part of his body broken, and hearing the man’s wailing now, Xu Fu was even more certain of this guess.

A-Wu picked the man up from the ground. "I followed you all the way, and when I saw you had disappeared, I had no choice but to climb the wall."

Just in time, Xu Fu added in his heart.

"How should he be dealt with?" A-Wu asked.

"Take him away, out of the city," Xu Fu said.

A-Wu nodded. "Coincidentally, the carriage is right at the city gate."

Xu Fu knew there was no rush to ask A-Wu what had happened; now was clearly not the best time.

When the man heard they were taking him out of the city, he immediately began to struggle. "What, what are you doing? Are you going to kill me?" It must be said that the man was not only cowardly and irresponsible, but also a thorough pessimist, and even a bit paranoid.

"I'm taking you to find Wang He," Xu Fu said calmly.

The man paused and asked in a low voice, "Really? Have you decided to change my physiognomy?"

"Yes." Xu Fu was, of course, only trying to appease him to avoid any trouble while leaving the city. Only after leaving Yu City would Xu Fu dare to interrogate this man with A-Wu without any reservations.

The man was truly obsessed; as soon as he heard Xu Fu’s reply, he was overjoyed, without a shred of suspicion, and even danced around a bit before cooperating as they walked toward the city gate. By this time, the city gate had already opened, and some commoners were leaving the city one after another.

The carriage A-Wu had driven was handed over to the guards at the city gate, and of course, they were given money. When they reached the gate, Xu Fu immediately boarded the carriage, while A-Wu led the man and pulled the carriage out.

The man had no idea that A-Wu’s hand was kept tightly clenched into a fist; if he made any suspicious move, he would be knocked out by A-Wu with a single punch.

At this moment, Xu Fu sat in the carriage, put down his luggage, and slowly stroked the seats and the table inside. He hadn't expected A-Wu to have driven this carriage, which Ying Zheng had ordered to be built. Looking at the familiar interior, Xu Fu finally felt a part of his chest being filled, and his whole being seemed to be relieved from tension and exhaustion.

While passing through the city gate, Xu Fu even leisurely took out some bamboo slips and slowly unfolded them.

He still needed to get back to Xianyang as soon as possible.

If Tian Wei had truly changed his physiognomy as well, Xu Fu had to suspect that Tian Wei had some greater conspiracy in coming to Xianyang. Although he knew in his heart that Ying Zheng was smart and powerful enough not to be deceived by Tian Wei.

"Should we keep moving forward?" A-Wu’s low voice came from outside the carriage.

"Keep going straight, get a distance away from Yu City, and then find a place to rest."

"Alright." A-Wu did not ask why; he just executed Xu Fu’s order with a grim face. The man walking beside him couldn't help but glance at him repeatedly. Even as stupid as the man was, he had some instinctive perception; he knew the situation didn't seem right, but his obsession with changing his fate had overridden his inner fear.

They walked like this for about half an hour. By now, they were a long distance from Yu City. The man was sweating profusely from exhaustion, while A-Wu’s breathing remained steady.

"Where, where are we going?" The man couldn't help but ask. He looked at A-Wu’s face, and the fear in his heart grew deeper.

"Stop here," Xu Fu said, lifting the carriage curtain.

A-Wu stopped, and Xu Fu hurriedly jumped out of the carriage. "Go over there," Xu Fu pointed to a small forest not far away.

A-Wu nodded, drove the carriage to the side, tied it up, and then dragged the man to a large tree and tied him to it. Because the forest here was somewhat dense, even if they tied him inside, people passing by on the road would not discover what they were doing.

"What, what are you doing?" The man couldn't help but howl.

Xu Fu glanced at him coldly; he was clearly a bully who feared the strong.

After A-Wu tied him up, he slapped the man’s cheek directly. The force was quite strong, and the man’s face turned to the side, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth; it was likely his mouth had been cut. "Shut up," A-Wu warned coldly.

The man shivered, the light in his eyes dimming; he was cowardly to the extreme.

"I ask you, how did you see me change Wang He's physiognomy? Did you see it with your own eyes? When, and where?" Xu Fu asked sternly. He still didn't quite believe that Xu Junfang would change Wang He's physiognomy. For so long, based on his understanding, Xu Junfang should have been extremely close to his own personality and way of doing things. He couldn't have done such a thing on his own, so Xu Junfang definitely wouldn't have either!

The man stammered, "...I, I saw Wang He go to find you, he asked you to change his physiognomy, and then, then he came out... Later, you left Yu City, and he left Yu City too. When he left, he was perfectly fine, not looking like he was suffering from any illness at all. If it wasn't you who changed his physiognomy, who else could it be?"

Xu Fu suddenly breathed a sigh of relief, looking at the man as if he were looking at a pig's head.

This man was so certain that he had changed Wang He's physiognomy that he had thought he had actually done such a thing and had been quite scared. Now he knew that everything was just this guy's imagination.

He wasn't the only fangshi in Yu City. Wang He's physiognomy must have been changed by someone else later. The most likely possibility was the other fangshi in Yu City. "Do you know the name of the other fangshi in Yu City?"

"I, I know." Seeing A-Wu raise his hand nearby, the man immediately surrendered. "He, he is called... Han Zhong."

Han Zhong?

Xu Fu’s eyes flickered.

It was actually him!

But Han Zhong was already dead now, so there was no way to verify it. However, Xu Fu didn't believe this was a coincidence. Thinking about the feeling Han Zhong had given him before, and Han Zhong's actions targeting him, it was very likely that they had already dealt with each other back in Yu City. Perhaps there was no need to verify; Xu Fu was almost certain it was Han Zhong.

"Did Han Zhong disappear later too?"

"Yes..." the man replied weakly.

"Look at his face," Xu Fu pointed to A-Wu beside him. "Does it look familiar?"

The man shivered as he faced A-Wu’s face, resisting the urge to turn away. "It seems... it seems like Wang He's face..."

"The features? Or what is similar?" Xu Fu asked again.

A-Wu pressed his lips together, his face full of confusion. He didn't know what Xu Fu had discovered during the time they were separated that would lead him to ask this.

"No, it's... it's like he looks like Wang He after he was plagued by that terrible illness..."

Xu Fu was finally able to fully confirm what was going on.

The man was both surprised and afraid, but after these emotions faded, he showed ecstasy. "He... his appearance... was, was his physiognomy changed? It really is possible to change physiognomy!" the man shouted crazily.

At this point, the man had lost his usefulness to Xu Fu. He gave A-Wu a look, and A-Wu struck without mercy, knocking the man unconscious.

"Come here," Xu Fu beckoned to A-Wu.

A-Wu walked up to him. "What did he mean by all that?" A-Wu instinctively felt that the secret hidden behind it would make him shudder.

"Why didn't you come back after you left the inn earlier?" Xu Fu didn't answer his question directly, but chose to ask this first. He had to get a clear answer from A-Wu before he could eliminate his suspicion of him.

"I went back," A-Wu said, pressing his lips together. "I came out of the inn and was swept away by the crowd. Seeing that they were all going to leave the city, I could only try my best to avoid the guards and return to the inn, but there were too many people. By the time I finally returned to the inn, you were already gone. I had no choice but to lurk in the city and wait. After the danger in the city was lifted, I still couldn't wait for you. I knew you must have left, so I asked around and learned that you had left with a family. I drove the carriage to Yu City, and as soon as I searched the city, I found your tracks."

A-Wu spoke in an orderly manner, and it sounded like he wasn't lying.

Xu Fu nodded.

"I see. How is your face these past few days?"

"I used the medicine, it's not as painful anymore." But that was all. The symptoms hadn't improved much. However, A-Wu had already chosen to trust the other person.

Besides Xu Junfang, who else could save him?

"This man attacked me to make me change his physiognomy. Have you ever heard of such a thing before?"

"No," A-Wu shook his head.

Changing physiognomy could be said to be too heaven-defying; to put it seriously, this was a crooked path. Of course, it couldn't be spread among many people, which was why Xu Junfang was so surprised when he heard Wang He ask him to change his fate.

Only some people in this industry would know about it. How did Wang He know? Of course, Xu Fu could now suspect that Han Zhong had told him.

"I can read people's faces; you should have heard of that. A person's destiny is reflected in their physiognomy, and even a person's personality and way of behaving are reflected in it. Whether a person is lucky or unlucky is also shown in their physiognomy. There was a man named Wang He in Yu City who suffered from a terrible illness, and his illness was similar to your symptoms. More than ten years ago, I read his face and said he wouldn't live long, so he asked me to change his physiognomy, which I refused. Later, he left Yu City. And a fangshi appeared in your home who saved your life but caused you to suffer from a terrible illness. An illness doesn't come without a reason, so there is only one possibility: this illness was transferred to you by someone else."

Xu Fu paused. "I suspect that Wang He eventually used other means to change his physiognomy. He obtained your physiognomy, while you obtained his. Of course, because your own destiny was very good, even though you swapped physiognomy with someone through such a sinister method, you didn't die from the terrible illness. And if Wang He obtained your physiognomy, he might have extended his life and occupied your fortune."

By the time Xu Fu finished speaking, A-Wu’s face was icy, and he was clenching his fists tightly.

If Wang He were in front of A-Wu right now, Xu Fu felt that Wang He would likely be knocked out with a single punch. No one could remain calm at such a time. A-Wu originally had a bright future, but his future had been stolen by someone. Not only that, he had also contracted a terrible illness and had endured the cold looks of others until now. Xu Fu couldn't help but admire A-Wu for being able to hold on until now.

"What you said... is it true?" A-Wu asked in a low voice.

"It's true," Xu Fu said. "Now we must find Wang He so you can truly recover. With just the two of us, we naturally can't find him."

"So I have to take you back to Xianyang, is that it?" A-Wu looked up at him with deep eyes.

"Yes."

"..." A-Wu didn't rush to speak.

"You haven't been home for a long time, have you? You're afraid your illness will infect your parents and family, you're afraid your face will scare your young sister at home... but once you're cured, you won't have to worry about these problems anymore. If you're worried about the State of Chu blaming you, I will have news of your death spread. Once you are cured, you can return home, and no one will know you are A-Wu. You will still be your former handsome and dashing self. Your parents will be overjoyed to see you again in their lifetime."

Xu Fu’s tone was very cold, but it could not be denied that what he said held a great attraction for A-Wu.

When a person who has experienced ten years of torture and is about to lose all hope suddenly learns that they can return to the past, can punish the person who harmed them, and can return safely to their family, how could they not be tempted?

A light that hadn't been seen for a long time penetrated the darkness...

A-Wu finally confirmed that he could not refuse.

What State of Chu, what State of Qin... how they fought had nothing to do with him; he just wanted to return to the past.

"Alright," A-Wu finally replied.

Xu Fu breathed a slight sigh of relief.

It was good that A-Wu was willing to agree.

"Then let's rest. Rest for the night, and we'll leave tomorrow."

"And him..." A-Wu looked at the man.

"Just leave him here." Xu Fu had no sympathy for that man; if he could survive, that was his own fortune.

After reuniting with A-Wu, Xu Fu once again enjoyed the feeling of being served. Xu Fu relaxed quite a bit and had a good night's sleep. However, he had been dreaming more frequently lately, and he dreamed that he seemed to have seen Han Zhong somewhere.

Han Zhong cast a jealous and resentful look at him, and at that moment, someone pulled him from behind.

"Ignore him, let's go." The person speaking was the stern-faced Wei Liao.

Perhaps the pull was a bit strong, and Xu Fu woke up from the dream. He rubbed his neck, sat up in the carriage, washed up simply with the water A-Wu had brought, ate some dry rations, and waited to set off again.

A-Wu had wandered outside for a long time and had a very strong sense of direction. With him, Xu Fu felt much more at ease.

Sitting in the carriage, Xu Fu took out the "diary" from his luggage again.

The things recorded in it were trivial and boring.

When Xu Fu got tired of reading, he would flip through it quickly.

Since he had come to Yu City, he had likely been to the subsequent cities as well. Perhaps he could still recover quite a few memories along the way.

Just as he was thinking this, the carriage suddenly jolted violently. The silk cloth in Xu Fu’s hand fell, and his whole body rolled forward with the force. Fortunately, he stretched out his leg and braced himself with his knee, so he didn't roll out of the carriage.

"What happened?" Xu Fu asked coldly.

"There's... a dead person ahead," A-Wu’s voice was somewhat chilling.

Xu Fu was a bit confused. He lifted the carriage curtain and glanced outside. With just one look, Xu Fu immediately pulled his head back. The corpse was lying across the road, and they had just driven over it.

"We need to leave here quickly," A-Wu said.

Xu Fu and A-Wu thought of the same thing; the appearance of a corpse on the road meant there was no telling what kind of danger might be lurking in the shadows. A-Wu drove the carriage at a breakneck pace, and the jolting kept Xu Fu wide awake. Soon, they entered the city. There were very few people in this city, and the streets lacked any sign of liveliness.

Even if Xu Fu was curious about what had happened in the city, he wouldn't go to investigate. With only two of them, it was better not to overestimate their own strength.

"Go!" Xu Fu said, concise and forceful.

A-Wu understood, immediately turned the carriage around to leave the city, and then continued to gallop forward.

It wasn't until nightfall that they found a place to stop. Having missed this city, they would have to go to the next one if they wanted supplies.

However, both of them had decent survival skills, and they could handle this much time without supplies.

For the next few days, they didn't dare to relax in the slightest. With great difficulty, they finally arrived at a new city. As the carriage drove in, Xu Fu heard the sound of people.

This was what normal felt like.

Xu Fu felt relieved.

They quickly found an inn to stay at, and soon after, they heard from other guests about what had happened in the previous city.

"The people in that city caught a terrible disease; they're almost all dead. Who would dare go there now? I heard the King of Chu is even going to send men to burn the city to the ground."

"Don't talk nonsense..."

"I'm not talking nonsense..."

A terrible disease? It must be an epidemic. Only an epidemic was contagious, and only an epidemic would make an ancient monarch abandon his subjects without hesitation. Xu Fu couldn't help but think of the cities he had once saved. He didn't dare to imagine what kind of dead city it would become after being razed by a great fire; how horrifying and cruel it must be.

Xu Fu snapped back to reality and said to A-Wu beside him, "We need to disinfect."

A-Wu didn't understand what "disinfect" meant. He thought it meant "detoxify," so he said, "I've already detoxified. Do I need to do it again?"

"We entered that city. To avoid catching a disease we shouldn't, I think it's better to disinfect." Xu Fu wrote down a list of medicinal ingredients and ordered A-Wu to buy them. Once bought, Xu Fu immediately put them into a wooden tub. Afterward, both of them took turns changing the water and soaking in a medicinal bath.

Later, Xu Fu gave A-Wu a pill, which A-Wu swallowed without hesitation.

This was purely for preventative purposes.

It probably had about the same effect as Ban Lan Gen.

Only after all this did Xu Fu feel at ease. After the ordeal, he felt utterly exhausted. He soon fell asleep on the bed, while A-Wu kept watch in his room, acting as his protector. Xu Fu didn't say anything about it. Having been mentally tortured by a madman, Xu Fu felt he needed someone to guard him to feel secure.

This journey had been truly difficult.

Xu Fu could no longer control his longing for Ying Zheng, and with this longing, he dreamt of Ying Zheng once again.

Upon waking, Xu Fu's mind was a chaotic mess; he couldn't quite recall the dream from today. He rubbed his head, stood up, and went to eat with A-Wu. In the lobby, other guests were chatting again.

"He brought two more beautiful concubines into his estate. His wife is probably furious."

"Haha, let's see if she tries to hang herself or slit her throat this time..."

From their tone, it was clear that such things had happened many times in the city.

"If you had money, you could do the same! Countless concubines for your pleasure," someone chuckled wickedly.

Hearing these voices, Xu Fu felt his appetite diminish significantly. He ate a little and was just about to return to his room when he suddenly remembered the silk cloth he had dropped in the carriage; he seemed to have forgotten to pick it up, and he didn't know if it was still there.

Xu Fu left A-Wu behind and went to find the carriage alone. He searched through it and finally found it under the cushion. Although the things recorded on it weren't of much use, they were memories after all, and Xu Fu didn't want to lose them. He folded the silk and jumped down from the carriage.

Just then, he saw two people walking down the street.

Of course, ordinary people wouldn't be enough to catch Xu Fu's eye. What caught his attention was that the man walking beside the beautiful woman was a round, fat man, and his physiognomy was surprisingly good!

Looking closely, one couldn't point out exactly what was good about his features, but the aura of fortune surrounding him was excellent—a sign of great wealth and status. Moreover, a layer of indescribable temperament flowed across his face, which inexplicably elevated his entire presence.

If he had seen such a person before, Xu Fu would only have thought his physiognomy was remarkable, but seeing it now, Xu Fu instinctively felt something was wrong.

So, he took the initiative and walked up. "I observe that you have an outstanding physiognomy. May I take a look for you?"

Xu Fu's voice was clear and melodious. The man looked up at him, a flash of smugness on his face. However, upon seeing Xu Fu, the man's eyes flickered, and a look of clear terror appeared in the depths of his gaze.

Without thinking, the man hugged the woman beside him and shouted sharply, "Who are you? How dare you try to swindle my money? Get lost!"

After saying this, the man turned and walked away first.

His shout immediately drew the attention of everyone on the street toward Xu Fu. Xu Fu hadn't expected such a reaction. His expression turned cold, and he said, "You slandered me! How can I let you leave?"

The man, while walking away quickly, shouted loudly, "You... you guys, help me stop this villain! I'll reward whoever stops him!"

Xu Fu's coldness deepened. "Who dares?"

He was dressed in fine clothes, his temperament was extremely distinguished, and his handsome face was something the townspeople rarely saw. For a moment, everyone was intimidated and didn't dare to come forward to help the man.

At this moment, A-Wu heard the commotion and stepped out quickly. "Sir, what is it?" A-Wu asked.

His imposing physique intimidated the others even more. The commoners spontaneously stepped back to both sides. Xu Fu had already determined that there was something wrong with the man's physiognomy—not only was there something wrong, but the man had also seen him before!

"Catch him!" Xu Fu pointed in the direction the man had fled.

A-Wu didn't ask questions; he moved with lightning speed toward the man. The man was so scared he ran for his life, pushing the beautiful woman beside him aside, caring nothing for chivalry.

How could a fat man compare to A-Wu's speed and strength? Soon, the man was tackled to the ground by A-Wu and held down tightly. The sound of the man's pig-like squealing could be heard throughout the street.

The commoners on the street widened their eyes, silent as cicadas in winter.

A-Wu brought the man back. The woman wailed, "What are you doing, brave man? Let us go, we'll give you money."

A-Wu shot a glance at the woman, and she immediately shrank back, not daring to speak.

The man cursed and struggled. Seeing the woman didn't come to save him, he began to curse even more viciously.

A-Wu used his old method, slapping the man heavily across the face. "Be quiet."

"You... you dare to grab people on the street? Do you know the consequences?" The man shrank his neck, not daring to use foul language anymore, but weakly retorted.

"You slandered me just now; how should that be settled?" Xu Fu said coldly.

"I... I'll apologize to you, is that not enough?"

Xu Fu examined his face and physique closely, making the man break out in a cold sweat. He even couldn't help but rub his hands together to relieve his inner anxiety. Only then did Xu Fu say indifferently, "Let him go."

A-Wu complied and let go. The man hit the ground with a "thud," his flesh trembling. "Let's go." Xu Fu turned and walked into the inn with A-Wu.

The man didn't make any threats; he scrambled up from the ground and ran away, leaving behind the beautiful woman he had been holding.

A bystander said weakly, "That person... that person looks familiar..."

"It's... it's Master Xu!" someone exclaimed in surprise.

"Is it really him? Didn't Master Xu say he would never come back?"

"Yes, yes, it's been over ten years. The Master has only grown taller; his face hasn't changed at all."

"That's a living immortal." Someone said softly, and the others fell silent, unable to help but think carefully: had they offended him just now?

If Xu Fu had heard their conversation, he would have surely laughed. Was there really a "living immortal" legend here too?

As Xu Fu entered the inn, the people inside became cautious even when looking at him and A-Wu. It seemed their performance outside had frightened quite a few people.

"That person might be Wang He," Xu Fu said calmly.

His physiognomy was strange, he was not far from Yu City, and he ran upon seeing him, acting as if he had seen a ghost when he saw A-Wu.

There was a high probability that he was Wang He. Xu Fu had examined him closely just now mainly to compare him with the image in his mind.

"Wait a while, when no one is looking, go and abduct him," Xu Fu said in a low voice. After saying this, he added, "Do you think it will be difficult?"

A-Wu shook his head, his anger simmering beneath his skin. "Not difficult." His voice was low and resilient.

The pain and resentment of so long were knotted in his chest, waiting to be unleashed upon Wang He once he was captured.

Xu Fu nodded and waited quietly in the room. He still trusted A-Wu's combat prowess.

About an hour passed, and Xu Fu was starting to feel sleepy. To wake himself up, he grabbed the silk cloth and organized it again. The silk he had picked up from the carriage during the day was also gently unfolded under his fingers.

He didn't seem to have read this piece of silk yet. Xu Fu focused and scanned it.

"Had another dream today, the dream was chaotic. It's probably going to be bad again."

Xu Fu caught this sentence, and his heart skipped a beat. His fingers clutching the silk curled. He hesitated, then found the continuous records on the silk.

Xu Fu knew that his dreams usually fell into two categories: one was meaningless, and the other was predictive. The dream mentioned in the diary should be a meaningless one. It wasn't that Xu Fu was overthinking, but there had been too many incidents lately, and he couldn't help but be cautious.

He took out all the silk pieces, organized and categorized them... finally capturing the pieces that mentioned dreams and other such words, placing them together and arranging them by date.

Just as he finished organizing, there was a knock on the door.

"Sir." A-Wu's voice sounded from outside.

Xu Fu immediately got up to open the door. The man suspected to be Wang He was being carried on A-Wu's shoulder, making no sound at all; he was likely knocked unconscious.

"You came in so openly, did anyone notice?"

A-Wu was also helpless. "He's too heavy; I couldn't jump over the wall while carrying him."

As soon as he finished speaking, Xu Fu saw the waiter outside staring at them in a daze.

A-Wu glanced back at the waiter, his gaze so icy that the waiter swallowed hard. "I didn't see anything..." he said, turning and walking away.

Xu Fu: "..." He figured they wouldn't be staying in this city for much longer. Even if the Chu officials were useless, they wouldn't just watch them abduct someone, would they?

Xu Fu quickly closed the door, turned around, and watched A-Wu throw the man onto the floor.

A-Wu skillfully splashed water on the man. The man shivered and slowly opened his eyes. The first thing he saw was Xu Fu's face. For many, that face inspired admiration, but for this man, it inspired terror.

"Are you that afraid to see me?" Xu Fu said coolly. "Or is it because you saw him that you feel afraid?"

The man swallowed, forgetting even to scream.

He was about forty years old now, far different from the image in Xu Fu's mind, but Xu Fu confirmed it was him! It must be Wang He!

The various emotions flashing across the man's face undoubtedly confirmed Xu Fu's suspicions.

A-Wu happened to lean in at this moment, his gaze dark and fixed on the man's face. A-Wu didn't need to say a word; the man was already sweating profusely, his face turning purple, as if he were about to lose control of his bladder.

"Wang He, do you have nothing to say?" Xu Fu said coldly.

The man finally opened his mouth. "...H-how did you find me?" The man was on the verge of a breakdown. "I clearly changed it! I already changed my fate! Why, why can you still find me?"

It really was Wang He!

Xu Fu felt a sense of "it was easier than expected."

"When I want to find you, you can never escape," Xu Fu said indifferently.

Hearing this, Wang He felt a chill run down his spine, looking at Xu Fu with growing terror. "What do you want by finding me? Do you want me to return his physiognomy to him?" After saying this, he glared viciously at A-Wu.

This glare completely verified Xu Fu's guess.

The reason A-Wu had become like this was indeed because of Wang He!

A-Wu was innocent, harmed to such a state by Wang He. Even if Wang He paid with his life, which should have ended long ago, it would be hard to compensate.

At the mention of physiognomy, Wang He became agitated, his figure overlapping with that of the madman from years ago.

Did physiognomy really have such magic, enough to drive people to such madness? A flash of disgust crossed Xu Fu's eyes.

"I won't return it to him! You said back then I would die young, but look, haven't I lived until now? Not only did I survive, but I have a vast fortune and countless concubines! I won't allow anyone to take all this away!" Wang He roared excitedly, gasping for air afterward.

Compared to the thin, crazy figure from before, the current Wang He had become much fatter, bearing no resemblance to his past self. But the more so, the more hateful Xu Fu found him. Everything he possessed now was stripped from A-Wu, while A-Wu suffered so much in his place. This man felt no remorse, only a reluctance to part with fame and fortune—his face was truly disgusting!

A-Wu pulled out his blade without a word.

"You changed my physiognomy and took it for yourself. Is my physiognomy something anyone can just take?" A-Wu smiled grimly. "I'll send you to your death right now."

Wang He was so scared his legs trembled, and a pungent smell soon filled the air.

He had been scared into wetting himself.

Xu Fu grabbed A-Wu's arm. "You can't touch him now."

A-Wu's expression darkened further, and he gritted his teeth. "Why?"

Xu Fu knew that even if A-Wu chopped Wang He up right now, it wouldn't be excessive, but would it be useful? Wang He was still useful; Xu Fu wanted to swap their physiognomies back.

A-Wu had only been driven by the resentment in his heart to kill Wang He. After so many days of working with Xu Fu, their coordination was excellent. Now, he suppressed his desire to kill and sheathed his blade.

"You brought two new beautiful concubines into your estate?" Xu Fu connected the gossip from the lobby earlier to Wang He.

Wang He sat surrounded by beauties, squandering money.

What was A-Wu doing at that time? He was pulling his robes tight, trying his best to avoid the disgusted stares cast upon him.

Wang He didn't speak; he just stared viciously at A-Wu, muttering, "I won't give it to you, I won't return it to you..."

"Knock him out. Tomorrow morning, we'll take him out of the city," Xu Fu looked at A-Wu. "Only by taking him with us can I know how to swap your physiognomies back. What originally belonged to you should ultimately return to you."

At this moment, in Xu Fu's heart, he no longer weighed whether A-Wu had kidnapped him or whether he should treat him this way. Only four words remained in Xu Fu's mind: "Righting the wrongs."

Things that shouldn't exist should be destroyed one by one. No one should be able to enjoy someone else's life with peace of mind.

He would help return what belonged to A-Wu back to him. One thing at a time; A-Wu would naturally have to pay for his own mistakes later.

"Good."

Just as Wang He was about to scream at the top of his lungs, A-Wu delivered another heavy blow, knocking him unconscious.

A-Wu piled Wang He behind the screen and opened the door to have the waiter bring food. The waiter was still trembling at the sight of A-Wu; the murderous aura on A-Wu was at its peak, and the waiter couldn't bear to look for more than a second before running off. When he returned with the food, he was still shaking, nearly dropping it all.

After eating and bathing, the ordeal was finally over.

The waiter came in to clean the water on the floor; he was smart enough not to ask about Wang He's whereabouts, and after cleaning, he left while hugging the wall.

A-Wu rested on the small couch, his expression icy, lost in thought. Xu Fu didn't have time to look at him; he began to read the silk cloth he had organized on the table in order again.

After tallying, Xu Fu discovered something from the diary...

Every time Xu Junfang lost his memory, it wasn't without a pattern.

Starting with chaotic dreams, it was like a memory rewind, signaling that he was about to lose his memory again.

Xu Fu recalled the recent dreams. After ten years, the memory loss was probably... about to reappear. Should he say it was fortunate he wasn't in Xianyang, or that it was damnably unfortunate he wasn't in Xianyang?

Xu Fu suddenly felt a sense of urgency.
