翌日，晨起时分，徐福是被一阵暴雨雷鸣声吵醒的，继昨日短暂的停雨过后，又继续下起了暴雨。徐福一边艰难地从嬴政怀中挣脱，一边忍不住想，希望那些农户，没有在雨停后，便急着撤去那些保护的东西。
此时，在城外，有些农户的确是懵住了，他们完全没有想到，第二日还会下起这样大的雨，昨日听见府衙来人提醒的人，他们都还觉得县令说得夸张了些，毕竟他们常年与农事打交道，还有谁会比他们更了解这些，他们都没能看出有什么接连不歇的暴雨要来。因而昨日雨停后，他们便立即收了护住田地的木头棚子。
谁知这第二日起来，有的田地便遭殃了，全被水泡住了。
那些种了菜的，全然不知该如何是好了。
而此时在城里的其它府邸中，那些早早从徐福口中听闻会下暴雨的侍从、士兵们，都忍不住笑了。
庶长果真神人也！
再一想到之前徐福在郢都，如何让郢都百姓迅速转变态度……大家忍不住齐齐打了个寒颤，庶长是不能得罪的。
他们若是知晓，当初徐福在一处小镇上，如何坑整个小镇人的，他们定然会觉得更可怕。
因着暴雨，他们自然也无法急着离开了，于是徐福便和嬴政一同，呆在屋中看起了他们自带的书简。
吕公倒是有些坐立不安了，深觉怠慢了他们，于是还特地寻到了他们休息的院中来，敲开门，开口便是致歉，“未曾想到竟是这样突然地下起了大雨，本欲带着尊驾出行，见一见单父县的风光。此时却是不成了。”吕公满脸憾色。
嬴政倒并不觉得遗憾，与徐福待在一处，便已经足够了，于是他淡淡道：“不必了，我们在此处歇一歇就足够了。”
吕公看出了徐福和嬴政的拒绝之意，也不敢再劝，便连忙离去了。只是吕公离去后，徐福和嬴政才享受了片刻的安宁，便又有人上前来了。
他们的门被敲响了，门外传来的是昨日那少女的声音。
“客人在否？”
徐福不解地与嬴政对视一眼，出声道：“何事？”
“外面暴雨天寒，我娘担心客人受凉，便令我送来了衣袍。”
“不必了。”嬴政直截了当地拒绝了。
外面的少女顿时被噎住了，“……客人，客人若是受了风寒，我们……我们怕是不知该如何是好了。”
嬴政转头看向身边的侍从：“去将门开了。”他便瞧一瞧，这个人想做什么。
侍从点了点头，走上前去将门打开，门外的少女立时露出了惊喜的表情，只是这个表情并未能维持多久。她看着桌案前动也未动的两人，喉咙里仿佛堵了什么，差点说不出话来。
过了会儿，嬴政才抬起头，看了她一眼，道：“昨日便想说，姑娘似乎有些像我二人的一位故人。”
对方只以为这是拉近乎的一种方式，于是少女抿唇一笑，道：“是吗？”
嬴政点头，遂问她：“你可认识一名为‘凤姑娘’的女子？”
少女脸上的表情僵了僵，黝黑的眼底瞬间便没了光芒。
“看来是认识了。”
少女又抿了抿唇，过了会儿，才笑道：“不错，那是我的长姐，只是她已经死了。”
“死了？”这时徐福也抬起头来了。
嬴政都说那凤姑娘是他的故人了，哪怕徐福没有了记忆，但也本能地为其觉得怜惜。
“是的。”少女垂下眼眸，应了一声。
嬴政沉声道：“我们既然已经知晓故人的下落，那姑娘便回去吧。”
少女有些错愕地抬了抬手中的包袱，“可是……可是这衣袍？”
嬴政道：“去打开瞧瞧。”
侍从闻言，顺从地上前打开了包袱，里面的衣袍被抖落了出来。嬴政只淡淡瞥上了一眼，便道：“收起来吧，我们并不需要。”
侍从只听从嬴政的话，哪里会管那少女尴尬不尴尬，于是马上又将衣袍叠好，放回到了包袱之中。少女抱着包袱，哪能感受不到，对方那一系列动作时传出的淡淡的，轻蔑意味呢？
“我，我知晓了。”对方一定是看不上吧。少女颇有些狼狈地低下了头，转身便要离去，只是走的时候，她突然又想起什么似的，顿住脚步，回过头来，道：“我……我叫吕娥姁。”说完，她方才快步离开了。
吕娥姁？
不认识。
徐福连都未曾听说过。
想来也应当不是什么重要人物了。
徐福都不在意那少女叫什么，嬴政又怎么会在意？
只是二人因这少女想到了那凤姑娘。
“那凤姑娘是做什么的？”
“开医馆的。”
“可惜了……”徐福对这样的人物向来都颇具好感，此时听闻她的死讯，难免觉得心中往下坠坠的。
而嬴政此时却道：“那吕家姑娘着实奇怪。”
“为何？”
“她的亲姐死了，但她的口吻却极为淡漠，甚至……”甚至还带着一丝恶意。
徐福闻言，不由得皱了皱眉，回想了一下方才吕娥姁的模样，似乎……似乎的确如此。“怎会有这样的人？难道她与凤姑娘不合？”一个是故人，一个是陌生人，徐福自然心中偏向那个凤姑娘。
“你说，那吕娥姁来是为了什么？”
“不是冲着你，便是冲着我了。”
嬴政一笑，“说不定她怀的心思是，撞上谁便是谁。”
徐福暗暗摇头，年纪小，心思倒大。
嬴政虽当初极为不喜那凤姑娘倾心于徐福，但嬴政不得不承认，凤姑娘进退得体，并不留给他人尴尬，而且斩断决绝，毫不拖泥带水，知晓他们的关系后，凤姑娘便没再对徐福表露过心思。
再与今日这吕娥姁一对比，嬴政便实在好奇，这吕公是如何教出两个截然不同的女儿来了。
徐福问道：“我与那凤姑娘关系如何？”若非瞧嬴政毫无芥蒂，徐福也不会问出来。
嬴政道：“君子之交。”
徐福心下会意，“那不如问一问吕公，她是如何死的吧。”
别人口中，才会轻易说起“死”字，而吕娥姁身为凤姑娘的亲妹，未曾用“长姐不幸过世”的字眼，反而是用了“只是她已经死了”这样的描述。
不怪吗？
作者有话要说：　　还有谁记得凤姑娘吗？嗯，吕娥姁不一定有人知道，但说吕雉一定有人知道啦！娥姁是她的字，她曾随父亲吕公住在砀郡单父县，后来为了躲避仇家，才到了沛县。
chapters.translated_text:
Before leaving Yingdu, Xu Fu met with Wang Jian one last time. Wang Jian’s complexion was ruddy, and the gray pallor had dissipated.

Xu Fu couldn't help but ask, "How has General Wang Jian been feeling lately?"

Xu Fu had spent over half a year finding ways to nourish his stomach, and now it was naturally showing some results. Wang Jian laughed, "I am well, but it is a pity that I cannot taste even a morsel of the food the Shuzhang brought."

Originally, those items were intended for Xu Fu to add to his meals during the journey to adjust the flavor, so he wouldn't lose too much weight by the end of the trip. Now, however, most of them had been used to pique the interest of the people of Chu. Wang Jian had also been tempted, but unfortunately, like the people of Chu, he had no fortune to enjoy them. His only sense of superiority came from watching the people of Yingdu constantly guessing what the Qin people were actually eating...

"There will be opportunities in the future," Xu Fu said calmly. Although Wang Jian was no longer young and carried old injuries that would inevitably shorten his lifespan, as long as he waited until after the six states were conquered and found Jiang You to treat him, he should be able to live longer. Who knew what other foods the Qin state might come up with in the future?

Wang Jian smiled again and said, "Then I shall take the Shuzhang's auspicious words." Nowadays, in the eyes of the people of Qin, receiving a word from Xu Fu was no different from receiving an omen of good fortune. They could fully expect Xu Fu's words to come true.

Wang Jian still needed to remain in Yingdu to recuperate for a while, so Xu Fu and Ying Zheng packed their belongings and set off from Yingdu.

The people of Yingdu had no idea that the legendary Shuzhang of the Qin state had come and gone right under their noses...

To accommodate Xu Fu's health, their pace had been relatively slow.

If it were in the past, they might not have dared to travel like this, because in ancient times, it was very easy to die on the road. Acclimatization issues, accidental infections, natural disasters, etc., could all lead to death. Moreover, on the road, there was no medicine and no doctors; once sick, it was equivalent to a death sentence. But now, with the pills Xu Fu had prepared and carried with him, plus the fact that Xu Fu had been extremely attentive to safety and hygiene throughout the journey and had taken many protective measures, the risks were greatly reduced.

Only in this way could they travel leisurely along the road.

The journey was uneventful until they entered Dang Commandery. Xu Fu estimated that a heavy rainstorm was coming. How could their group withstand a storm on the road? Naturally, they had to find a town to take shelter as soon as possible.

Hearing Xu Fu's words, Ying Zheng immediately gave the order to speed up and head toward the nearest town.

They traveled for about two hours, and as the sky grew increasingly dark, the scouts who had gone ahead returned and said, "There is a town not far ahead."

Upon hearing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

They had deep faith in Xu Fu's abilities; since Xu Fu said there would be a storm later, there would certainly be a storm.

The group hurried along and finally arrived at the town before the storm broke.

This place had also been designated as Qin territory following the fall of the Wei state. Their large group arriving at the city gate naturally caught the attention of the guards. The guards did not dare to let them in easily; they swallowed hard, stared at the carriages, and hurriedly said, "You may only enter the city after we report to the County Magistrate."

"Then go and tell your Magistrate that if he is slow to welcome us, he might lose his position," an attendant standing in front of the carriage said calmly.

Although the guard felt this group was truly arrogant, they were intimidated by the display. After all, guards in small places had not seen much of the world; how could they not be flustered when suddenly seeing such a group of people exuding such a fierce aura?

The soldier guarding the gate quickly went to report to the Magistrate. At that moment, the Magistrate felt the same as the guards—he also thought these outsiders were incredibly arrogant. But what the soldier said next immediately changed his mind.

"They... they have many people with them, and some are dressed like, like Qin soldiers." There were still some soldiers guarding the city who were originally from Wei, and they hadn't yet broken the habit of calling them Qin soldiers.

The Magistrate was suddenly terrified and hurriedly stammered, "Go, go to the city gate!"

Who could bring Qin soldiers with them? It was likely one of the great generals under the Qin King. How could the Magistrate dare to be negligent? Although he couldn't figure out why a general under the Qin King would be in Dang Commandery at this time.

It was with such chaotic thoughts that the Magistrate arrived at the city gate. Upon seeing the formation outside, he couldn't help but be shocked.

"May I ask who you are?" The Magistrate stepped forward, lowered his posture, and said in a low voice.

The attendant threw a token to the Magistrate and whispered, "The Qin King and the Shuzhang of the Qin state are traveling here. You must not make a scene."

"The Qin, Qin King? And the Shuzhang?" The Magistrate was almost stunned by this pie falling from the sky. He would never see such figures in his entire life, but today... these people had actually come to him? The Magistrate thought he was dreaming.

"Why haven't you let us into the city yet!" the attendant said impatiently.

The Magistrate dared not be negligent any longer and immediately cleared the way.

Thus, the people in the city watched with caution and wonder as such a large group entered the city under the Magistrate's respectful welcome. Of course, they wouldn't know that the Qin King had arrived; they only knew that a very important person had come to the city, and they couldn't help but spread the news everywhere. Soon, everyone in the city knew about this important person. Some people scoffed, thinking it impossible for such a person to come here, but others felt a flutter in their hearts, wanting to try to get close to this important figure. Who knew what benefits might come? If even the Magistrate was fawning over them, they couldn't go wrong by doing the same!

The carriage soon stopped outside the government office. The Magistrate walked up and smiled at the attendant, saying, "I have something to say to the King."

The attendant then cleared the way, and the Magistrate, far from feeling slighted, was actually filled with awe. As expected of the Qin King, such a formation was truly rare to see.

The bumpkin Magistrate came to the carriage, bowed, and said, "Your Majesty, the government office is likely not fit for you to stay in. If Your Majesty does not mind, I shall find another place for you."

"Not fit to stay in? Why?" Ying Zheng lifted the carriage curtain. How could there be a government office not fit to live in? He frowned and looked over. Who knew that what met his eyes was a rather dilapidated government office. Looking at the Magistrate again, he was indeed dressed poorly, and the others behind him also looked rather shabby. In short, standing with Ying Zheng's group, they were completely different styles. This group of government officials looked exactly like country bumpkins.

Whatever displeasure Ying Zheng had in his heart, it all vanished at this moment.

Since the Magistrate was in such a state, what more could he ask for?

The Magistrate looked embarrassed and said, "Danfu County has never been wealthy, so... so..." The Magistrate couldn't continue.

Xu Fu also poked his head out of the carriage. He took a look at the government office in front of him; it was indeed in a sorry state, so he couldn't help but ask, "Then where is fit to stay?"

The Magistrate was almost stupefied when he first saw Xu Fu. "That... the Lu residence. Master Lu of the Lu residence has great wealth, and he is extremely hospitable. He will surely be able to serve Your Majesty well."

Lu?

Hearing this surname, Ying Zheng frowned imperceptibly.

"Then let us go," Ying Zheng was indeed unwilling to let Xu Fu suffer by staying in such a place. If the Lu residence was decent, they would stay there; if the Lu residence was not much better, they would continue searching. In such a large town, they would surely find a place to stay!

The Magistrate breathed a sigh of relief, hurriedly ordered someone to go and notify Master Lu, and then walked in front to lead the way for Xu Fu's group.

At this moment, Xu Fu suddenly remembered something. He lifted the carriage curtain and beckoned to the Magistrate. The Magistrate was stunned, hesitated for a moment, and then hurriedly caught up. "What are your instructions?" The Magistrate saw that Xu Fu was extremely handsome and was sitting with the Qin King, so he couldn't gauge Xu Fu's status and didn't dare to address him rashly, only vaguely calling him "you."

"Are there farmlands outside the city?"

"Yes, yes there are." The Magistrate looked at Xu Fu in confusion, having no idea why this noble person would ask about farmland. Looking at him, he didn't seem like someone interested in farmland.

"Then in a while, remember to remind the farmers outside the city to do everything possible to protect their crops within an hour. There will be a heavy rainstorm today, and it may last for several days without stopping. If the crops are not protected, next year's harvest will be in jeopardy."

The Magistrate listened, completely bewildered.

This... how did this person know there would be a heavy rainstorm?

Before the Magistrate could open his mouth to ask, Xu Fu had already lowered the curtain and sat back. Using the Magistrate to pass the message was undoubtedly the best way. For these commoners, the names of the Qin King and the Shuzhang might be shocking, but they were too far away. It was more effective for the local Magistrate to convey the message, and they were more willing to believe their local official.

Because of what Xu Fu said, the Magistrate's heart was in a mess, his mind filled with thoughts of the rainstorm. It wasn't until he brought the group outside the Lu residence that the people in the Lu residence came out to welcome them, showing they were quite sensible.

Even if this Magistrate was poor, the local merchants knew that officials could not be offended. Thus, Master Lu led the crowd to wait at the door personally. At first, he only saw the Magistrate's figure, but after a while, Master Lu caught a glimpse of the long procession behind him. Master Lu was instantly stunned.

Was this the important person the people in the city were talking about?

What kind of important person could have such a formation? Master Lu still had some experience, and it was precisely because of this experience that he felt even more amazed.

Master Lu didn't dare to stand there anymore. He immediately walked down, first greeted the Magistrate, and then asked in a low voice, "May I ask who these are?"

The Magistrate looked extremely nervous, his voice even hoarse. He said, "This... this is from Xianyang. Do not ask anything else. You only need to know that if you are the slightest bit negligent, then... you will lose your life. But if you serve them well, you will receive great benefits."

If Xu Fu were listening nearby, he would surely have said, the more you say that, doesn't it expose Ying Zheng's identity even more?

Master Lu was also a shrewd person. He vaguely guessed something, but he didn't say anything. He hurriedly nodded and smiled, "Thank you, Magistrate, for bringing me such a benefit."

Although the Magistrate made it sound terrifying—that failing to serve them well would cost him his life—Master Lu knew very well that great benefits were tied to risks. This little risk was nothing. He couldn't wait to serve the people in the carriage well to obtain the benefits behind it.

After the Magistrate finished instructing Master Lu, he turned back to Xu Fu and Ying Zheng in the carriage and said, "Please... please disembark, we have arrived at the residence."

The carriage curtain was lifted in response.

Master Lu considered himself to have a keen eye. At this moment, he glanced at the carriage, and this one glance left him terrified.

Master Lu had learned some superficial physiognomy in his early years. Although this knowledge was superficial, it was enough for the moment. Master Lu knew very well that neither of the two people in the carriage was an ordinary person. But for Master Lu to explain it in detail, that was not possible. He could only see this much. Master Lu had always relied on his own judgment, so he concluded that this was a huge opportunity.

After Xu Fu and Ying Zheng got off the carriage and walked up, Master Lu immediately bowed and addressed them as "Your Excellencies."

This Master Lu had some discernment, Xu Fu thought to himself. However, as he looked at the man in front of him, some information flashed through his mind. Xu Fu guessed it might be related to his memory, but it wasn't convenient for him to think about it carefully at the moment, so he had to let it go.

"Please." Master Lu was respectful but not sycophantic, and his demeanor made people feel comfortable.

Ying Zheng didn't pay any attention to Master Lu at all; his gaze was always on Xu Fu. Seeing Xu Fu nod slightly, Ying Zheng withdrew his gaze. If Xu Fu was satisfied, he had no other opinions.

Master Lu also noticed this detail. He couldn't help but boldly look up and examine Xu Fu again. Upon closer inspection, Master Lu was shocked. This person... had an appearance more outstanding than anything Master Lu had ever seen in his life! His temperament was also one in ten thousand!

These two were... not to be underestimated!

Master Lu's heart beat like a drum, and he even had a vague guess.

The person in front of him was truly too outstanding; there were few such outstanding people in the world... unless he was... he was the Shuzhang of the Qin state, Xu Junfang... Thinking of them coming from Xianyang, Master Lu became more certain of his guess. He suppressed the excitement in his heart and welcomed them inside.

The women of the household did not retreat directly; the bold ones hid behind pillars and screens to peek.

Who could blame them when this group was so eye-catching? It was impossible for no one to watch.

Master Lu personally led them around the courtyard and accompanied them, saying in a low voice, "No matter which place you fancy, you may stay there." The implication was that even if they took a fancy to the master's own courtyard, it was acceptable.

However, Xu Fu had no interest in staying in a place where others had lived for a long time. He casually found a place that looked quiet and clean and pointed, "Let it be here."

Master Lu smiled until his eyes narrowed, "Yes, I will immediately order people to tidy this place up for you."

The Lu residence acted quickly, and the place was soon cleared. The people Ying Zheng brought were also arranged in several nearby residences. Although those wealthy families didn't know who had come to the city, since the Magistrate personally delivered them, how could they not accept? Not only did they have to accept, but they had to do so well!

On this day, the atmosphere in the entire city changed significantly.

The people in the city became cautious but inexplicably expectant. They had never seen any important figures, and now they wanted to broaden their horizons.

The Magistrate had no time to think about these things. After finishing his work, he suddenly remembered that the man said to find a way to protect the farmland within an hour... farmland! Although the Magistrate didn't quite believe what the man said, he dared not joke about it. Anything could be neglected, but not this! This concerned the people's harvest for the coming year! So, as soon as he finished his work, without even taking a breath, he immediately summoned his subordinates and told them to pass the message on, making sure the farmers took it to heart.

The subordinates looked up at the sky and found it a bit overcast, but hadn't that happened before? Was it just a rainstorm? Was it worth changing his expression like that? They found it hard to understand the Magistrate's strange order.

The Magistrate noticed their slackness and immediately looked stern, reprimanding them all. Only then did they take the matter to heart and hurry off.

The Magistrate sat in the government office and waited quietly for a while, looking up at the sky from time to time, but he saw nothing. The Magistrate was puzzled. Would there really be a heavy rainstorm later? Just as the Magistrate thought this, he heard a loud thunderclap in the sky, followed by bean-sized raindrops falling. The Magistrate, standing at the door, was splashed with water. He was stunned, and it took him a long time to wipe his face, muttering, "Truly divine..."

Before long, the subordinates returned.

"Magistrate, how did you know... there would be such a heavy rain?" The people in front of him were shaking off quite a bit of water from their bodies, showing they had been soaked.

"It wasn't me..." the Magistrate said in a daze, "It was that person..." That person must be... the Shuzhang...

·

After Xu Fu and Ying Zheng settled down in the Lu residence, the first thing they did was bathe and change into fresh robes. Just then, a servant from the Lu residence came to invite them to a banquet. It turned out that Master Lu had specially prepared a banquet to welcome them. However, Master Lu didn't know if they liked lively crowds, so he didn't dare to invite others.

This suited Ying Zheng's wishes perfectly. He didn't want people to be constantly staring at Xu Fu during the meal, which would make him feel extremely displeased.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng arrived in the courtyard.

The rain had stopped, and the banquet was set in the courtyard, surrounded by trees and flowers, which looked quite pleasant. Unfortunately, Xu Fu first thought about whether insects would be flying onto the table during the meal. To prevent insects, Xu Fu stuffed a silk bag filled with herbs into Ying Zheng's palm, which could repel mosquitoes and insects and was highly effective. They inevitably had times when they had to camp outdoors, so they naturally had to carry such things.

Soon, food was placed on the table.

Ying Zheng stood there without sitting down.

Master Lu became anxious. Was the guest dissatisfied with his arrangements? Also, how could people from the Xianyang Palace be easily satisfied with such arrangements? What should he do? Master Lu was anxious but asked calmly, "Is there anything that makes you feel uncomfortable?"

"Put them together," Ying Zheng pointed to the tables on either side of the main seat.

Of course, he knew one was prepared for him and the other for Xu Fu. But they had long been accustomed to sharing a table, so how could they be separated like this?

Master Lu was stunned, then suddenly realized. That's right, there had long been rumors that the Shuzhang was the apple of the Qin King's eye... but he hadn't expected that they would even sit together during meals. If this were in an ordinary family, it would be considered lacking in rules, but coming from the Qin King, it only made people feel that the Qin King was a man who valued affection.

Master Lu immediately called people to move the tables.

The servants of the Lu residence curiously examined the two. They all thought these two were very strange, but they were also very handsome, and Master Lu respected them so much.

For excellent people, many people generally develop feelings of reverence or admiration.

Whether it was appearance or other capital, it was enough to move a person in an instant. At this moment in the Lu residence, there were many who had developed feelings for Xu Fu and Ying Zheng.

The tables were soon placed together, and Xu Fu and Ying Zheng sat down. Master Lu finally breathed a sigh of relief. Afterward, Master Lu tentatively asked, "My wife and daughter have never seen noble guests from Xianyang. May I ask if they can join the banquet?"

Ying Zheng didn't care about this. Xu Fu felt that regardless of gender, they should sit together, so he said, "Please invite them out."

Before long, a middle-aged beautiful woman came out with a young girl.

When he saw the young girl, Xu Fu inexplicably felt she looked familiar, but he didn't hold out much hope for his memory, so he didn't think deeply about it. Ying Zheng, however, took a look and said, "She looks a bit like an old acquaintance of yours?"

"Who?"

"That girl in her teens."

Xu Fu couldn't help but say, "I shouldn't have such an acquaintance, should I?"

"She is indeed not, but she looks a bit like her. When you went to the Shu region, I went to find you for your safety. There was a woman there who admired you, named 'Miss Feng.' This little girl looks seventy percent like her."

Xu Fu was surprised. He didn't expect Ying Zheng to speak so unreservedly about a woman who had admired him. Xu Fu himself felt a faint awkwardness, as if he had inexplicably done something to wrong Ying Zheng.

At this time, Xu Fu didn't know that back then, there was no affection between him and Ying Zheng.

"Perhaps it's just a coincidence," Xu Fu said calmly. Since he was in front of Ying Zheng and had no memory, he couldn't mention Miss Feng again; it wasn't appropriate. Moreover, looking alike was very common. Besides, that girl was in the Shu region, thousands of miles away from here.

Seeing that Xu Fu didn't mention it again, Ying Zheng smiled slightly and said nothing more. The reason he was so honest with Xu Fu was just to advance by retreating, and it seemed to be a brilliant move.

After the wife and daughter of Master Lu came out, they only looked at Xu Fu and Ying Zheng cautiously at first, and then didn't dare to look at them again.

During the meal, Master Lu talked incessantly about things in the town, interesting places, and where the scenery was good... Master Lu mentioned them all.

Dealing with noble guests required skills. What kind of words had they not heard? Flattery, praise... they were probably useless. It was better to talk about food, drink, and play, which might pique their interest.

It must be said that Master Lu had hit the mark.

At this point, Xu Fu also knew what kind of place this was. This was Danfu County in Dang Commandery.

This place name made Xu Fu feel familiar again, as if he had glimpsed it in some history book, but unfortunately, his memory stalled again at this moment.

After Xu Fu and Ying Zheng had a simple meal, they prepared to return to their room to rest.

But when they left the small courtyard, the young girl looked at Xu Fu and Ying Zheng again. This time, she didn't shyly turn her face away but smiled at them generously.

Xu Fu frowned unconsciously, and Ying Zheng frowned as well.

No matter who the girl was smiling at, neither of them could be happy. So they ignored the girl's smile and turned to walk away quickly.

After Xu Fu and the others had gone far away, Master Lu sighed and said, "What a pity."

The girl leaned against him and whispered, "Father, why do you say it's a pity?"

Master Lu laughed, "You don't understand."

The girl pouted unhappily, "Does only my sister understand?"

Master Lu glared at her but couldn't bear to scold her, "If your sister were here, I could boldly recommend her to these two guests."

"Then why can't I?"

Master Lu didn't answer her.

The girl lowered her head, a shadow falling over her face. She whispered, "Then why can't I?"

·

The next morning, Xu Fu was awakened by the sound of heavy rain and thunder. After the brief pause in the rain yesterday, the heavy rain continued. As Xu Fu struggled to break free from Ying Zheng's embrace, he couldn't help but hope that the farmers hadn't been in a hurry to remove the protective coverings after the rain stopped.

At this moment, outside the city, some farmers were indeed bewildered. They hadn't expected such heavy rain to fall again the next day. Those who had heard the warning from the government office yesterday felt the Magistrate was exaggerating. After all, they dealt with farming all year round; who could know more about this than them? They hadn't seen any signs of a continuous storm. Therefore, after the rain stopped yesterday, they immediately removed the wooden sheds protecting the fields.

Who knew that when they woke up the next day, some fields were in trouble, completely soaked by water.

Those who had planted vegetables didn't know what to do.

Meanwhile, in other residences in the city, the attendants and soldiers who had heard from Xu Fu early on that there would be a storm couldn't help but smile.

The Shuzhang was truly a divine man!

Thinking back to how Xu Fu had quickly changed the attitude of the people of Yingdu... everyone couldn't help but shudder. The Shuzhang could not be offended.

If they knew how Xu Fu had once tricked an entire small town, they would surely find him even more terrifying.

Because of the heavy rain, they naturally couldn't leave in a hurry, so Xu Fu and Ying Zheng stayed in the room and read the bamboo slips they had brought with them.

Master Lu was restless, feeling he had neglected them, so he specially found the courtyard where they were resting, knocked on the door, and apologized, "I didn't expect such a sudden heavy rain. I intended to take you out to see the scenery of Danfu County. But now it's impossible." Master Lu looked full of regret.

Ying Zheng didn't feel regret; staying with Xu Fu was enough. So he said calmly, "No need, it's enough for us to rest here."

Master Lu saw the refusal in Xu Fu and Ying Zheng's eyes and didn't dare to persuade them further, so he left hurriedly. But after Master Lu left, Xu Fu and Ying Zheng had only enjoyed a moment of peace when someone else came up.

Their door was knocked on, and the voice of the girl from yesterday came from outside.

"Are the guests in?"

Xu Fu looked at Ying Zheng in confusion and said, "What is it?"

"It's cold and rainy outside, and my mother is worried that the guests might catch a cold, so she asked me to bring some robes."

"No need," Ying Zheng refused directly.

The girl outside was choked, "...Guests, if you catch a cold, we... we are afraid we wouldn't know what to do."

Ying Zheng turned to the attendant beside him: "Go and open the door." He wanted to see what this person wanted to do.

The attendant nodded and walked up to open the door. The girl outside immediately showed a look of surprise, but this expression didn't last long. She looked at the two people who hadn't moved at the table, as if something was stuck in her throat, and she couldn't speak.

After a while, Ying Zheng looked up at her and said, "I wanted to say yesterday that you look a bit like an old acquaintance of ours."

The other party thought this was a way to get close, so the girl smiled and said, "Is that so?"

Ying Zheng nodded and asked her, "Do you know a woman named 'Miss Feng'?"

The expression on the girl's face stiffened, and the light in her dark eyes vanished instantly.

"It seems you do know her."

The girl pursed her lips again, and after a while, she smiled, "Yes, that was my elder sister, but she is already dead."

"Dead?" Xu Fu looked up at this moment.

Ying Zheng had said Miss Feng was his acquaintance, and even though Xu Fu had no memory, he instinctively felt pity for her.

"Yes." The girl lowered her eyes and replied.

Ying Zheng said in a deep voice, "Since we know the whereabouts of our old acquaintance, you may go back."

The girl raised the bundle in her hand in confusion, "But... but these robes?"

Ying Zheng said, "Go and open it."

The attendant obeyed and opened the bundle, and the robes inside were shaken out. Ying Zheng just glanced at them and said, "Put them away, we don't need them."

The attendant only listened to Ying Zheng and didn't care if the girl was embarrassed, so he immediately folded the robes and put them back into the bundle. Holding the bundle, how could the girl not feel the faint contempt in the other party's series of actions?

"I, I understand." They must look down on it. The girl lowered her head in embarrassment, turned, and was about to leave. But as she walked, she suddenly remembered something, stopped, turned back, and said, "I... my name is Lu E'xu." After saying this, she hurried away.

Lu E'xu?

Never heard of her.

Xu Fu hadn't even heard of her.

It shouldn't be anyone important.

Xu Fu didn't care what the girl's name was, and how could Ying Zheng care?

But the two of them thought of Miss Feng because of this girl.

"What did Miss Feng do?"

"She ran a medical clinic."

"What a pity..." Xu Fu always had a good impression of such people, and hearing the news of her death, he couldn't help but feel a sinking feeling in his heart.

Ying Zheng said, "That Lu girl is truly strange."

"Why?"

"Her own sister died, but her tone was extremely indifferent, and even..." and even carried a hint of malice.

Hearing this, Xu Fu couldn't help but frown, recalling Lu E'xu's appearance just now. It seemed... it seemed indeed so. "How could there be such a person? Could it be that she didn't get along with Miss Feng?" One was an acquaintance, and one was a stranger; Xu Fu naturally leaned toward Miss Feng.

"What do you think Lu E'xu came here for?"

"Either for you or for me."

Ying Zheng smiled, "Maybe she thought, whoever I run into, it's for them."

Xu Fu shook his head secretly; young age, but big thoughts.

Although Ying Zheng didn't like that Miss Feng had fallen for Xu Fu, he had to admit that Miss Feng was proper in her conduct, didn't leave others embarrassed, and was decisive. After knowing their relationship, Miss Feng never expressed her feelings to Xu Fu again.

Comparing her with Lu E'xu today, Ying Zheng was truly curious how Master Lu had raised two such different daughters.

Xu Fu asked, "What was my relationship with Miss Feng?" If he hadn't seen Ying Zheng without any resentment, Xu Fu wouldn't have asked.

Ying Zheng said, "A friendship between gentlemen."

Xu Fu understood, "Then why not ask Master Lu how she died?"

Others would easily say the word "dead," but Lu E'xu, as Miss Feng's own sister, didn't use the words "my elder sister unfortunately passed away," but instead used the description "she is already dead."

Isn't that strange?

Author's note: Does anyone still remember Miss Feng? Well, not everyone might know Lu E'xu, but everyone must know Lu Zhi! E'xu is her courtesy name. She once lived in Danfu County, Dang Commandery with her father, Master Lu. Later, to avoid enemies, she went to Pei County.

The torrential rain had been falling for an entire day without showing any signs of stopping. Unable to contain his impatience, Master Lü went to Xu Fu’s door once more. Originally, Xu Fu had found the sound of the rain quite hypnotic, but now that Master Lü had arrived, he found himself involuntarily waking up.

An attendant opened the door and let Master Lü in.

Xu Fu glanced at Master Lü; it seemed he was unaware that his daughter had already come to curry favor with them.

Master Lü bowed and said, "Since this rain will not stop, why don't I invite some performers to put on a jiaodi show for your esteemed selves?"

A jiaodi show? Xu Fu turned his head toward Ying Zheng, puzzled.

Ying Zheng did not reply to Master Lü, but instead leaned down and whispered into Xu Fu’s ear, "A jiaodi show is just a collection of miscellaneous performances—acrobatics, plate-spinning, sword dancing, and the like... they are all considered jiaodi."

Just hearing this, Xu Fu felt that the cost would certainly not be low. That Master Lü could be so generous showed that his family’s wealth was not insignificant.

Master Lü secretly took in the intimate posture of the two men and felt a weight lift from his heart. He thought to himself, fortunately, he hadn't summoned any dancing girls or musicians to please them yesterday. Otherwise, he might have ended up displeasing them instead.

At this moment, Master Lü had no idea that his daughter had already nearly ruined everything.

After Xu Fu and Ying Zheng finished whispering, Master Lü looked at them again with expectant eyes. He did not expect that what would follow from their mouths would be neither an acceptance nor a refusal.

"Master Lü has an eldest daughter?" the one who asked was Ying Zheng.

Master Lü was startled, feeling a bit uneasy, "...Yes."

"Does her name contain the character 'Feng'?"

"Yes." Master Lü replied with even more nervousness.

"We once had a bit of a friendship with Master Lü’s eldest daughter. Yesterday, we happened to find Master Lü’s second daughter quite familiar, which is why we couldn't help but ask. Where is Miss Feng now?"

Master Lü was truly shocked by Ying Zheng’s words. His eldest daughter had lived away from home for years. While he was proud of her independence and capability, he was also angry that a woman would insist on wandering the world. Consequently, Master Lü rarely paid attention to this eldest daughter. He never imagined that his daughter would... would be spoken of by the King of Qin as having a friendship with them.

That bit of friendship—was that something just anyone could compare to?

To receive such a comment from the King of Qin, what kind of future should his eldest daughter have had... but...

Mentioning Miss Feng, a look of gloom immediately fell upon Master Lü’s face, "My eldest daughter passed away from illness a few months ago."

"Passed away from illness?" Xu Fu’s cold, clear voice rang out.

Master Lü met Xu Fu’s indifferent gaze and, for some reason, suddenly felt that Xu Fu’s appearance made one instinctively feel a sense of awe.

"Yes... yes, she passed away from illness. I don't even know what kind of illness it was. In our family, she was the only one who began studying under a master in her childhood, learning the arts of medicine. A few years later, she left home. A few years ago, she returned to Shanfu County, but she lived alone on the side. My wife and I would often go to visit her. But just a few months ago, I returned from a long trip, and my wife told me she was gone." Master Lü let out a long sigh.

Xu Fu surmised that the "wife" Master Lü referred to was a term for his spouse.

After hearing this, Xu Fu felt somewhat lost.

Having lost his memory, he naturally couldn't remember this Miss Feng, but the impression Lü E'xu had left on him was truly not good. Xu Fu couldn't help but wonder what was behind Lü E'xu’s strange attitude.

But hearing Master Lü speak of it now, there didn't seem to be anything amiss.

Perhaps because the topic of his daughter had been raised, Master Lü rambled on about Miss Feng.

Only then did Xu Fu learn that her name was Lü Feng, but her courtesy name was Chanjuan. By rights, they should have addressed her by her courtesy name.

This family was quite skilled at naming; Miss Feng’s courtesy name, Chanjuan, symbolized a beautiful woman and contained a lovely blessing. The same went for Lü E'xu—'E' was used to describe a beautiful appearance, and 'Xu' meant a woman; the general meaning was a woman of beautiful appearance, also full of lovely connotations.

But if the eldest daughter was named "Feng" (Phoenix), what could Lü E'xu be called?

Xu Fu couldn't help but ask: "The eldest daughter is named Lü Feng, may I ask about Master Lü’s second daughter?"

If anyone else had asked this, Master Lü would certainly have been enraged. After all, inquiring about a daughter’s name so recklessly was as serious as harassment.

But standing before him were Ying Zheng and Xu Fu. Although Master Lü was puzzled as to why they would ask, he knew they certainly meant no harm, and to be asked for her name was already his daughter’s honor.

So Master Lü said honestly: "My second daughter is named Lü Zhi."

Lü Zhi?

Xu Fu almost couldn't control his shock.

Lü Zhi! How could it be Lü Zhi? Although there weren't many historical figures stuffed into Xu Fu’s brain, he happened to know Lü Zhi. After all, few people didn't know this capable helpmeet of Liu Bang. Without Lü Zhi’s support, Liu Bang might not have had such a glorious future. Putting other things aside, Xu Fu had once quite admired a woman like Lü Zhi. Back then, he felt that Lü Zhi’s father was truly a piece of work. At the time, although Liu Bang was a village head, he was more like a disreputable street hoodlum. And yet, just because Lü’s father took one look at Liu Bang and decided he would surely have a bright future, he rashly married his daughter Lü Zhi to him.

After Lü Zhi became Liu Bang’s wife, she suffered quite a lot.

...

And that young girl from yesterday was actually Lü Zhi!

When she mentioned her courtesy name, Xu Fu had been too unfamiliar with it to react. Who could have guessed that she possessed such a shocking identity?

Xu Fu’s gaze toward Master Lü shifted slightly.

Seeing Master Lü’s respect and fawning toward the two of them, it was clear he was a clever man with a keen eye—or to use a derogatory term, a man who trimmed his sails to the wind. It wasn't hard to understand why Master Lü would marry Lü Zhi to Liu Bang. But could Master Lü also read faces? To be so certain that Liu Bang would achieve great things in the future.

What a pity... Master Lü’s son-in-law would be the one to overthrow the Qin Dynasty in the future.

Xu Fu’s thoughts churned, and he remained silent for a long time.

Since Xu Fu didn't speak, Ying Zheng naturally wouldn't either. Now Master Lü began to panic, wondering what he had said wrong.

He had no idea that Xu Fu was currently undergoing an intense internal struggle.

"This... is there something wrong?" Master Lü asked hesitantly. The sight of Xu Fu and Ying Zheng both being silent truly scared him. Master Lü wanted to please these two, but he was also afraid that one careless move would cost him his life.

Only then did Xu Fu look at Master Lü again and say: "Your eldest daughter is named Feng, yet your second is Zhi. Do they not feel unhappy because of this?" Or was it that in Master Lü’s heart, the eldest daughter was someone who could become a phoenix, while the second was like a wild pheasant? Originally, the courtesy names didn't sound like much, but when their names were placed together, the gap was quite large.

Thinking about it now, Xu Fu wasn't surprised why Lü Zhi’s attitude was so strange when she mentioned that Miss Feng had died.

Master Lü was quite composed. Being asked this by Xu Fu didn't anger him, though Xu Fu caught a flicker of embarrassment in his eyes. It seemed Master Lü knew his naming choices weren't the best.

"This... when my eldest daughter was born, my wife and I regarded her as the apple of our eye, so we were very careful when naming her, wishing we could give her a unique name. But later, my wife gave birth to another daughter, and she thought of 'Zhi'. Both sisters were named after birds. At the time, we didn't think there was anything wrong with it."

Xu Fu didn't press the matter of the names any further.

He said in a low voice: "If the rain stops tomorrow, could you send someone to lead us to Miss Feng’s former residence to take a look?"

Master Lü naturally had no reason to refuse, but he found it strange. His eldest daughter had once gained such favor from these two, and now they even wanted to visit her former residence. What kind of relationship did they have? Master Lü had already secretly imagined a romantic connection.

Although his daughter was dead and it wasn't great to dwell on it, Master Lü couldn't help but think about it. He had known early on that his eldest daughter was extraordinary, which was why he had spent so much effort raising her. That was why, when she went off to study medicine, he had been so angry that he had hardened his heart and didn't want to see her again, focusing all his efforts on raising Lü Zhi instead. But if he had known his eldest daughter would be so extraordinary as to get involved with the King of Qin and the Si-che Shuzhang, how could he have treated her that way? If he had taken good care of her, who knows how much fortune she could have brought the Lü family by now.

People are greedy. Originally, Master Lü felt that being able to host them in his manor was already a heaven-sent opportunity! But now, thinking about it, there was an even better opportunity that he hadn't grasped, letting it slip away.

How could Master Lü not feel stifled and resentful?

The more he thought, the more he felt he could have had so much more!

He even imagined that his eldest daughter, Chanjuan, might have even entered the King of Qin’s harem...

As he thought, a look of regret inevitably appeared in Master Lü’s eyes. With a sorrowful expression, he nodded and said: "Since your esteemed self says so, I will send someone to guide you tomorrow. It’s just... it’s just that when I think of my eldest daughter now, I still feel such grief, I fear I cannot accompany you."

Xu Fu took in his sorrowful expression and nodded.

Only then did Ying Zheng say: "Weren't we going to watch the jiaodi show?"

Master Lü hurriedly nodded and said: "Then please move to the hall."

"Lead the way." Ying Zheng’s tone was cold, with a rather haughty air. Seeing Master Lü’s demeanor, he knew Master Lü must have guessed their identities. Since that was the case, Ying Zheng simply adopted the posture of a monarch.

Clearly, Master Lü was very susceptible to this.

Even if Ying Zheng and Xu Fu were cold to him, his attitude only became more respectful.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng deliberately walked at the back. Master Lü knew they didn't like being disturbed, so he tactfully walked ahead with quick steps.

At this point, Xu Fu lowered his voice and asked Ying Zheng: "Are we really going to watch the jiaodi show?"

Ying Zheng’s tone was quite indifferent, "Didn't you say you hadn't seen one?" After a pause, Ying Zheng added with a smile: "Besides, Master Lü wants to curry favor with us to take advantage of the situation, so naturally, he must pay the price first."

Xu Fu couldn't help but add in his heart: —But even if Master Lü pays the price, he still won't be able to curry favor with us.

As they spoke, they entered the main hall.

When Master Lü had asked them earlier, he had actually already prepared the jiaodi show, waiting only for a word from Xu Fu and Ying Zheng. It had to be said that Master Lü was quite capable in the art of hospitality; at the very least, he easily gave people the impression of being thorough in every detail.

But it was precisely because he was too thorough that Xu Fu felt a sense of resistance toward him.

A jiaodi show was essentially the same as acrobatics.

Xu Fu rarely watched jiaodi shows from this era. Listening to the sound of the rain outside while watching the performance, it was quite a unique experience.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng took their seats in the place of honor, and Master Lü tactfully retreated.

Not long after, Master Lü’s wife came out with Lü Zhi. Perhaps because she had already boldly sought them out yesterday, Lü Zhi smiled charmingly at Xu Fu and Ying Zheng, as if she had completely forgotten the embarrassment of being rejected the day before.

Lü Zhi and her mother sat together, naturally at some distance from Xu Fu and the others.

Although the segregation of men and women was not strict in this era, generally speaking, many women still did not have high status and could not easily approach guests.

Just as the performers of the jiaodi show arrived at the hall, Lü Zhi suddenly tugged at her skirt and smiled: "Mother, I have already delivered the items you asked me to give to the two guests yesterday."

Ying Zheng’s gaze immediately turned cold.

This daughter of the Lü family actually liked to lie?

Xu Fu immediately heard that Lü Zhi’s sentence could be interpreted in two ways: one was that she had merely delivered them, without mentioning whether they were accepted; the second was that she had delivered them, and Xu Fu and Ying Zheng had accepted them. Undoubtedly, once Lü Zhi said this, those nearby would certainly assume the latter.

Was Lü Zhi saying this for someone to hear on purpose? She was quite bold; was she not worried that they would be enraged and cause her trouble? Oh, right, that was it. Since Lü Zhi’s words could be interpreted in two ways, they could naturally serve as her excuse for self-defense.

Lü Zhi was a clever person.

Although she didn't use any sophisticated methods, one could see the clues in the details. Truly worthy of being the historically famous Empress Lü!

She was just too clever!

Xu Fu appreciated clever people, but he certainly didn't appreciate clever people in the enemy camp. Xu Fu was slightly conflicted; how should he tell Ying Zheng that they couldn't leave Lü Zhi behind, as she would cause great disaster in the future? Just looking at Lü Zhi’s current ambition, Xu Fu felt he couldn't let her continue to grow.

After his thoughts churned, Xu Fu pulled on Ying Zheng’s arm. Ying Zheng held Xu Fu’s wrist in return, swept a cold glance over Lü Zhi, and whispered: "A clever person, it's just a pity she isn't clever enough."

They spoke in very low voices, so they wouldn't be overheard by others.

"Why?" Xu Fu couldn't help but ask. Was Lü Zhi not clever enough?

"If I want to kill someone, tell me... do I need a reason? And who would dare argue justice with me?" Ying Zheng turned his head, looked at Xu Fu, and said calmly, with no self-awareness that he was talking about something bloody.

Xu Fu was speechless, but he had to say, "...You are right." So, in fact, whatever tricks Lü Zhi played were useless.

She had no power, no status; the only thing she could rely on was her brain. But in the face of absolute power, brains were sometimes useless.

The Lü family looked very powerful in Shanfu County, but in Ying Zheng’s eyes, they were nothing.

It could be said that if the Lü father and daughter had any plans, they were likely going to be wrong.

Soon, food was brought to the tables, and the jiaodi show began.

Ying Zheng knew Xu Fu had lost his memory, so he whispered in his ear: "It is said that in ancient times, people fought with beasts and, inspired by them, attached horns to their weapons to butt against people. But by the pre-Qin period, butting against people evolved into two people wrestling, and later it derived into performances like lifting tripods, tightrope walking, and sword dancing. It is very popular among the common people and in the homes of many officials. It’s just that the best performers are naturally in my palace, but you never liked watching these, so I rarely called people to perform."

Xu Fu’s interest had been piqued.

"If it were dancing and music, I naturally wouldn't have much interest, but this... I am interested," Xu Fu whispered.

Ying Zheng couldn't help but reach out and stroke the top of his head, "Mm, before you lost your memory, you always told me you didn't like watching dance and music."

Xu Fu’s heart trembled slightly, as if something deep inside had broken through the soil and was desperately trying to crawl out.

Xu Fu’s heartbeat was a bit fast.

Was... was it something Ying Zheng said that touched the memories that had slipped away from his brain?

"What's wrong? Didn't you say you were interested? Why aren't you watching anymore?" Ying Zheng held Xu Fu’s hand, the warm touch transferring directly to the back of Xu Fu’s hand. Xu Fu glanced at the performers who were already working hard.

Xu Fu was a bit disappointed.

When he heard Ying Zheng describe it, he felt it was truly interesting. The jiaodi show fully embodied the art and culture of ancient times!

But as someone who had seen quite a few acrobatics in his previous life, he didn't feel it was that amazing; it didn't reflect much ancient art and culture. And it had to be said, there were no safety measures for the performances at this time. The skill wasn't impressive enough; instead, the danger they were in was what held the viewers' hearts.

Seeing Xu Fu staring silently, Ying Zheng whispered: "Do you find their performance a bit dull? When we return to Xianyang, I will have people perform a proper jiaodi show for you."

Xu Fu turned his head to look at him. For some reason, Xu Fu felt that Ying Zheng sounded a bit strange when he said this, as if he were harboring some secret joy. But then, Xu Fu thought he must have misheard.

How could Ying Zheng harbor secret joy? Such an emotion appearing on him was just too incongruous.

Xu Fu collected his thoughts and focused on the performance.

Eating some food while watching the show, the sky darkened before they knew it, and the heavy rain outside still hadn't stopped.

The performers gradually dispersed. Master Lü stood up, looked at the drizzling rain in the courtyard, and sighed: "I fear the rain won't stop tomorrow, and you won't be able to go to my eldest daughter’s former residence."

"It will," Xu Fu calmly cut off Master Lü’s words. "The rain won't be this heavy tomorrow, at least... it will stop for an hour." Calculating the time, it was already shocking that the rain had lasted this long.

Generally speaking, even if a torrential rain fell continuously, there would actually be pauses in between. Sometimes it would stop for an hour, sometimes even for several hours before continuing.

After a long rain, there wouldn't be that many clouds left in the sky to turn into raindrops.

Master Lü looked at Xu Fu in surprise. He naturally wanted to refute it, but he didn't dare. He just gave a faint smile, intending to personally see them back to their room.

At this moment, Lü Zhi spoke up: "Father, are the guests going to my sister’s former residence?"

"That's right." Master Lü said, his eyes crinkling with a smile, "They are old acquaintances of your eldest sister."

Saying this out loud made Master Lü feel very face-conscious.

Their stay at the Lü manor could only be called a chance encounter, but his eldest daughter truly had a friendship with them!

But Lü Zhi’s face turned pale. She smiled with a dark look in her eyes and said: "I didn't expect the guests to know my sister. Are the guests going to the place where my sister used to live tomorrow? Why don't I lead the way?"

She hadn't used such an intimate tone yesterday, calling her "sister" every other word. At this moment, she really looked like an innocent younger sister.

Master Lü seemed to notice that something was wrong with Lü Zhi. He frowned and scolded: "What are you making a fuss about? There are servants to do these things!"

Lü Zhi looked steadily at Master Lü and said unhurriedly: "Father is wrong. Both guests are extremely precious; how can we leave it to the servants? Since Father is not convenient to go out, I will accompany them."

"But you..."

"But I am a young woman?" Lü Zhi cut off Master Lü’s words. "What does that matter? Didn't my sister walk alone outside?"

Master Lü naturally couldn't speak ill of Miss Feng in front of Xu Fu and Ying Zheng, so he could only grit his teeth and agree with a dark face.

Master Lü probably never expected that his daughter had a nature that refused to yield to the bone. For a moment, he couldn't accept this realization, so his gaze trembled, finally settling on shock and annoyance.

Perhaps afraid of exposing his emotions, Master Lü didn't say anything more and hurried to say: "I will see you back first."

Xu Fu nodded and walked ahead with Ying Zheng.

Master Lü walked behind, unable to help but glance back at Lü Zhi. But Lü Zhi gave her father a faint smile, looking for all the world like a well-behaved daughter.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng were full and satisfied, and their entertainment was over, so they bathed and went to sleep early, embracing each other. As for anything else, they didn't do it; Xu Fu really didn't like the Lü manor. He couldn't imagine being intimate with someone in Lü Zhi’s home; what a bizarre feeling that would be.

Ying Zheng naturally followed his lead.

Anyway, during the time Xu Fu had lost his memory, Ying Zheng had had his fill. Now it was time to step back appropriately, so he wouldn't have a hard time explaining himself when Xu Fu regained his memory.

This night passed peacefully.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng both had attendants with them, so the service was naturally handled by them. After all, even for such trivial matters, they didn't dare let others do it.

So, as the attendants served them while they washed, they whispered about what they had heard in the manor.

"The servants of the Lü family didn't even know there was an eldest daughter."

"Lü E'xu is highly valued by Master Lü, and her mother loves her very much. In contrast, Miss Feng was rarely mentioned."

"Some people speculate that Lü E'xu and Miss Feng didn't get along. It is said that in the past, Master Lü doted on Miss Feng, and Lü E'xu didn't seem to be favored..."

"What was the attitude of Lü E'xu’s mother toward the two sisters?" Xu Fu asked in a low voice after washing his hands.

The attendant shook his head, "I couldn't find that out. I only know that Lü E'xu’s mother rarely came out to see people in the past, but... it is strange, after Miss Feng left home to study medicine, her mother started coming out to walk around more often..."

After all, the Lü family wasn't a powerful place, so it was easy to find things out from the servants. But things from long ago couldn't be found out, because some things weren't for the servants to know.

Xu Fu was basically certain that Lü Zhi and Miss Feng did not get along, and it was even possible that Lü Zhi harbored great resentment toward her.

Xu Fu had already made up his mind. He turned to Ying Zheng and said: "After we visit Miss Feng’s residence, if we don't find anything, we must keep an eye on Lü Zhi."

"Do you think Lü Zhi harmed her?" Ying Zheng was surprised.

In reality, Xu Fu’s focus wasn't there at all. After all, he had lost his memory, and while he felt regret for Miss Feng, it wasn't enough to make him obsessed with the matter. What truly made him obsessed was Lü Zhi herself. So going to take a look was a gesture for the deceased, but keeping an eye on Lü Zhi was to keep her under control.

"Yes." But Xu Fu couldn't tell Ying Zheng that her future husband would overthrow his rule. Even if he heard someone else say that, he would definitely think it was a joke, let alone Ying Zheng. So he defaulted to suspecting that Lü Zhi had harmed Miss Feng.

Anyway, when they left Shanfu County, Xu Fu would find a way to make Ying Zheng take Lü Zhi with them.

At that time, perhaps Master Lü wouldn't stop them at all.

But once Lü Zhi was taken away by them, wouldn't she be at their mercy? Then Liu Bang could wait by the Si River for a lifetime and never wait for a Lü Zhi.

Ying Zheng didn't say anything more. After they washed up, they went to the hall to eat. Before long, Lü Zhi came out fully dressed; it was clear she had dressed up specially. Master Lü only took one look, and his face darkened involuntarily.

But in the end, Master Lü didn't say anything, because if he scolded Lü Zhi now, he would easily offend Xu Fu and Ying Zheng. Master Lü knew this, so he could only watch with stifled anger. However, before long, the stifled feeling in Master Lü’s heart vanished.

He pointed at the curtain of rain outside with a worried face and said: "What should we do? The rain hasn't stopped yet."

Lü Zhi said: "It's just a rain, why would the two guests care?" In fact, when Lü Zhi said this, she was secretly observing the expressions of Xu Fu and Ying Zheng. Xu Fu naturally noticed this; he knew Lü Zhi was mostly trying to observe whether they valued Miss Feng or not. If they were willing to go out in the rain, then they must indeed have some friendship.

So Xu Fu said: "We must go today."

Hearing Xu Fu say this, Ying Zheng spoke up at the right moment: "Mm, then let it be so."

With both of them saying so, what else could Master Lü say? His face became even more worried. At this moment, Lü Zhi’s mood was much more complex. She didn't expect them to really care about Lü Feng, but looking at it from another angle, it was a good thing they valued Lü Feng. After all, she was her own sister...

Lü Zhi regretted showing her dislike for her sister in front of them earlier. But it didn't matter; she could just make up a backstory.

Lü Zhi was confident in her methods, so she raised a smile and said: "Then please, two guests, go ahead."

"Wait a moment," Xu Fu said unhurriedly.

Lü Zhi had to stop. In fact, she, like Master Lü, was full of doubts. Why did they insist on going in the rain? Why did they say to wait?

Xu Fu didn't speak. He stood at the hall entrance with Ying Zheng, looking toward the courtyard.

And just at this moment, the rain gradually began to decrease, and in the end, the sound of the rain stopped abruptly. The entire Lü family stared in wide-eyed amazement.

"This... this rain, did it really stop?" Master Lü asked, trembling.

"Mm," Xu Fu nodded, then said: "Let's go."

Hearing this, how could Master Lü not understand? It seemed they had known all along that the rain would stop. When he heard them mention it yesterday, Master Lü thought they were just speaking casually, hoping the rain would stop the next day. Who knew they had so bluntly predicted the next day’s weather?

Even after Xu Fu and Ying Zheng had walked out, Master Lü was still in a daze.

"The first time I’ve seen the power of that Si-che Shuzhang, it’s truly not an empty reputation!" Master Lü sighed. It seemed that from now on, he must never question their words, or he would incur their displeasure.

Meanwhile, Xu Fu and Ying Zheng walked out of the Lü manor, and under Lü Zhi’s guidance, they walked toward the south of the city. Finally, they arrived in front of a residence that looked quite desolate.

Lü Zhi said: "After my sister left, no one lived in the house." As she spoke, Lü Zhi took out a key and opened the door. A gust of wind carrying dust rushed toward them. Ying Zheng pulled Xu Fu away with quick reflexes, avoiding the dust, but Lü Zhi, standing there, got a face full of it.

Xu Fu glanced at Lü Zhi’s carefully applied makeup; it changed appearance just by opening a door, and he couldn't help but find it a bit funny.

But Lü Zhi quickly regained her composure and led them inside.

The attendants followed behind, responsible for clearing the way and cleaning, so as not to trip Xu Fu and Ying Zheng. Lü Zhi was the only one walking in front alone. She walked as if she were very familiar with the place, not even caring that her skirt was stained with dust, her posture generous and not at all coy.

In this respect, she was a bit like that Miss Feng, Xu Fu and Ying Zheng thought in unison.

It was just that for one, it was her nature, while for the other, it was deliberately displayed.

"Where do the two of you want to look?" Lü Zhi turned around and asked.

In all fairness, Lü Zhi was very beautiful, with a very upright and grand appearance.

It was just not as stunning as Miss Feng.

This sentence popped into Xu Fu’s head, and he froze, realizing that the memories in his brain seemed to be vaguely recovering. He could actually recall the outline and appearance of Miss Feng.

Xu Fu collected his thoughts and said calmly: "Let’s walk around casually and go through the whole courtyard."

Lü Zhi nodded and continued to lead the way.

With this posture, plus her face and sufficient means, Lü Zhi should have been invincible. It was just a pity that in front of Xu Fu and Ying Zheng, it was destined to be useless.

They walked along, touring most of the courtyard.

Finally, Xu Fu said: "Which room did your sister live in?"

Lü Zhi hesitated, as if she were very considerate of Miss Feng, and said: "Do you want to see the room too?" The implication was that it wasn't very appropriate to enter a young woman’s room.

Xu Fu seemed not to notice her expression at all and nodded: "Mm."

Lü Zhi had no choice but to lead them over. After pushing the door open and entering, Xu Fu could see at a glance that the furnishings were still complete; he could almost imagine the traces of someone living here.

Xu Fu swept a glance and walked to the dressing table.

Of course, Xu Fu was just putting on a show. He suddenly turned to Lü Zhi and said: "When she was ill, did you often come to visit her?"

Lü Zhi nodded, "Sometimes I came by myself, sometimes with my mother."

"Did you bring her food?"

Lü Zhi was stunned, then nodded, "Mm."

Xu Fu didn't say anything more. He glanced at the insects crawling under the dressing table and felt it was truly disgusting.

A room that hadn't been lived in for so long really shouldn't be visited.

Xu Fu turned and went out. Seeing that Xu Fu didn't want to stay, Ying Zheng naturally took him away immediately. Lü Zhi, on the other hand, was a bit lost. Did these two really value her sister? To just take such a hurried look? She had been waiting for them to ask more questions so she could take the opportunity to show her respect and love for her sister, but who knew she wouldn't have the chance!

...

After Xu Fu left the residence, an attendant walked to his side and whispered: "Shuzhang, there are dead people in the house, that’s why there are so many insects that like to eat rotting corpses."

Xu Fu was almost disgusted to the point of vomiting. He had thought those insects were attracted by the food left in the room, but now it seemed that this food was not that food.

Xu Fu ordered the attendant to dig up the corpse in the middle of the night, and then, enduring the disgust with a blank face, he quickly returned to the Lü manor with Ying Zheng.

Lü Zhi breathed a sigh of relief, but their quick departure was a good thing.

Just as she was thinking this, Master Lü called her over.

"What do you want to do?" After Master Lü called Lü Zhi away, the first thing he asked angrily was this.

Lü Zhi said calmly: "Both guests are extremely outstanding, I admire them, what is wrong with that?"

Master Lü had never heard Lü Zhi say such bold words. He widened his eyes, stroked his chest, and said: "Do you want to anger me just like your sister? I tell you, these two are not ordinary people. If you play tricks, I fear they will secretly despise you!"

Lü Zhi smiled sweetly, returning to the appearance of a young girl, and said: "Exactly, my sister is dead, she can no longer anger you. Of course, I will not die. Not only will I not die, I will be even more capable than her. What she couldn't grasp, I will be able to grasp."

Author's note:

Jiaodi show: Also known as Baixi, a folk entertainment performance art of the Han people with a long history. It was popular during the Qin and Han dynasties.
