暴雨整整下了一日也不见停，吕公按捺不住，便又到了徐福的门外，原本徐福正觉得雨声实在催眠得很，现在吕公来了，徐福倒是不自觉地清醒了起来。
侍从打开门让吕公走了进来。
徐福瞧了一眼吕公，看上去他并不知晓，他的女儿来他们这里献过殷勤了。
吕公躬身道：“这雨一直下不停，不如我请些人来，让尊驾看一出角抵戏？”
角抵戏？徐福不解地转头看向了嬴政。
嬴政并未回吕公，而是低头附在徐福的耳边，道：“角抵戏便是些杂乱的表演罢了，马戏、盘鼓舞、跳剑等……都是角抵戏。”
光是听一听，徐福便觉得背后花费定然不少，吕公能如此大方，可见其家产不薄。
吕公暗暗将二人的亲密姿态收入眼底，心底松了一口气，暗道，幸好昨日没有唤些舞姬、乐师来，讨好对方。不然届时，怕是的反倒惹得对方不快。
这时吕公哪里知道，他那女儿，差不多已经将事情都搞砸了。
待到徐福与嬴政耳语完，吕公才用期待的目光再度看向了二人。吕公没有想到，紧接着从他们口中说出来的，却并非答应或拒绝的话。
“吕公有个长女？”问话的是嬴政。
吕公一怔，心下有些忐忑，“……是。”
“名中可有‘凤’字？”
“是。”吕公应的时候更为紧张了。
“我们与吕公长女曾有两分交情，昨日偶见吕公的次女颇为眼熟，这才忍不住询问了起来。如今凤姑娘何在？”
吕公着实被嬴政口中的话惊了一跳，他那长女常年离家在外，他虽自豪长女的独立和能干，但一面又气愤身为女子硬要在外闯荡，因而吕公极少关注这个长女，他怎么也没想到，自己女儿竟然会……竟然会在秦王的口中，与他们两分交情。
那两分交情，岂是谁人都能比的？
能得秦王这样一句话，他那长女本该是获得怎样的未来……只是……
提起凤姑娘，吕公脸上顿时落下了一片黯然之色，“我那长女在几月前因病而逝了。”
“病逝？”徐福清冷的嗓音响起了。
吕公对上徐福淡漠的目光，陡然间不知为何，竟是觉得徐福这般模样看上去，让人本能地觉得敬畏。
“是……是病逝，我也不知是什么病，我们家中，唯有她一人，幼年便开始拜了人为老师，开始学习岐黄术。后头没几年她便离家了。几年前她回到了单父县，但是却独自居住在一旁。我同细君倒是常会去瞧一瞧她。只是就在几月前，我出了趟远门回来，细君便告知我，她去了。”吕公长叹了一口气。
徐福估摸着吕公口中的“细君”，应当是对他妻子的称呼。
徐福听罢，有些茫然。
他的记忆一丢，自然也记不住这位凤姑娘了，但是那吕娥姁给他的感官又实在不太好。徐福难免去思考，那吕娥姁奇怪的态度背后是如何一回事。
只是如今听吕公说起来，倒是也没什么不对之处。
或许是因为说起了女儿的缘故，吕公便也多嘴说起了凤姑娘的事。
徐福这才知晓，人家的名字叫吕凤，但是凤姑娘的字却是婵娟，按理来说，他们应当称呼人家的字才对。
这家人起名字倒是有些水平，凤姑娘的字是婵娟，象征美人，含有美好的祝愿。而吕娥姁也是一样，娥，用以形容姿容美好，姁为女子，那大意便是姿容美好的女子，也是饱含美好的寓意。
只是凤姑娘名为“凤”，那吕娥姁又能叫什么呢？
徐福不由得问道：“长女名吕凤，敢问吕公次女呢？”
若是换做其他人这样问，吕公定然已经发怒了，毕竟这般毫不顾忌地询问女儿家的名字，那便好比调戏般严重。
但是面前站着的是嬴政和徐福，吕公虽然疑惑对方为何会如此问，但他也知晓，对方定然没有别的意思，而且能被问及姓名，那已是女儿的荣幸。
于是吕公便老实地道：“我那次女名吕雉。”
吕雉？
徐福差点控制不住自己的震惊。
吕雉！怎么会是吕雉？徐福脑子里塞的历史人物虽不多，但恰好有个吕雉，毕竟少有人不知道刘邦的这位贤内助，若无吕雉帮扶，刘邦还真不一定有那样辉煌的以后。抛开其它来看，曾经徐福还是挺欣赏吕雉这样的女子。那时他便觉得吕雉的父亲实在不是个东西，那时刘邦虽为亭长，但却更像是个人品不端的市井混混。而吕父就因为看了刘邦一眼，认为他日后必然有出息，便贸然将女儿吕雉嫁给了刘邦。
吕雉与刘邦为妻或，可吃了不少苦楚。
……
而昨日那个少女，竟然就是吕雉！
她说起字的时候，徐福实在太过陌生，因而才没能反应过来，谁能想到，对方竟是有着这样令人震惊的身份呢？
徐福看着吕公的目光微微变了。
看吕公对他们二人的尊敬讨好，便知吕公是个有眼光的聪明人，换个贬义词，那便是见风使舵。吕公会将吕雉嫁给刘邦，并不难理解。只是吕公还会相面？竟是那样笃定刘邦日后会有大成就。
可惜了……吕公的女婿，便是以后要推翻秦朝的人。
徐福心底百转千回，久久都没有说话。
徐福不说话，嬴政当然也就不会开口了，这下吕公就有些慌了，暗自琢磨着自己说错了什么话。
他哪里知道，徐福此刻内心正在进行激烈的斗争。
“这……可是有何不妥？”吕公还是犹豫着问出了声，徐福和嬴政都沉默的模样，实在将他吓得够呛。吕公想要讨好这二人，也害怕自己一着不慎没了性命。
徐福这才重新看向了吕公，道：“你的长女名为凤，次女却为雉。她们不会因而觉得不快吗？”还是说在吕公心中，原本的长女就是可以成凤的人物，而次女却如野鸡。原本听表字倒是没什么，但是她们的名字摆在一起，差距可就有些大了啊。
现在一想，徐福也就不奇怪，为何吕雉说起凤姑娘死了的时候，态度那样奇怪了。
吕公倒也沉得住气，被徐福这样问起，倒也不生气，只是徐福眼尖地瞥见吕公眼底闪过了一抹尴尬之色。看来吕公也知道他这名字没起好。
“这……长女出生时，被我和细君视为掌中珍宝，起名时便小心细致了许多，恨不得能给以无二的名字。但是后来细君又生下一女，细君便想到了‘雉’，姐妹都是取自鸟儿的名字。当初觉得并未有不妥之处。”
徐福也没再揪着名字问下去了。
他低声道：“若是明日雨停，可否请吕公派人领我们到凤姑娘故居瞧一瞧？”
吕公当然没什么好拒绝的，他只是觉得奇怪。自己的长女当初得了这二人这般青睐，现在他们甚至还要去看她的故居，那当初他们间是什么关系，吕公已然暗自脑补了一出香艳的关系。
虽然女儿死了，如今再去想总归不大好，但是吕公实在忍不住去想，他早就知道他那长女未来是不一般的，因而在她幼时才花了心血去培养，因而后头她去学岐黄术了，吕公才实在气得够呛，甚至狠下心来不想再见她，一心只能再着手培养吕雉。可他若是知道长女会不一般到，和秦王、驷车庶长搭上关系，他又怎会那样待她？若是小心照料着，那她活到现在便不知能为吕家带来多少福气了。
人都是贪心的，原本吕公觉得能接他们二人入府住下，就已经是天赐的宝贵机遇了！可现在想一想，还有更好的机遇，他却没能抓住，任由其溜走了。
吕公胸中如何不觉得憋气不甘？
越想便越觉得当初他可以拥有更多的！
甚至他还联想到长女婵娟，说不定还能入秦王的后宫……
想着想着，吕公的眼眸里难免就流露出了憾色。他面带悲痛，点了点头道：“尊驾如此说，那我明日便派人为尊驾引路。只是……只是我如今想起长女，心中都仍觉得悲痛，恐无法陪尊驾前去了。”
徐福将他的悲痛表情收入眼底，点了点头。
这时嬴政才道：“不是要看角抵戏吗？”
吕公忙点了点头，道：“那便请移驾到厅中。”
“带路吧。”嬴政口吻冷淡，颇有些高高在上的味道。看吕公做派，他就知道吕公应当已经猜出他们的身份了，既然如此，那嬴政也就直接了当地摆出国君的架势了。
很明显，吕公很吃这一套。
哪怕嬴政和徐福对他再冷漠，他的态度只会更为恭谨。
徐福和嬴政刻意走在了后头，吕公知晓他们不喜有人轻易来打扰，便识趣地快步走在了前头。
此时，徐福压低了声音问嬴政：“真要去看角抵戏？”
嬴政的口吻颇为无所谓，“你不是说没看过吗？”顿了顿，嬴政接着笑道：“何况那吕公想要巴结我们，好占便宜，那自然要他先付出代价来了。”
徐福忍不住在心底补了一句。——可是就算吕公付出了代价，也巴结不上他们啊。
说着，他们便入了大厅。
吕公来询问他们的时候，其实就已经将角抵戏都准备好了，只待徐福和嬴政一句话而已。不得不说，吕公在招待人这一方面，还是极有一手的，至少很容易便能给人留下面面周到的感觉。
但正是因为太过面面周到，徐福反而对他有种抵触感。
角抵戏实质上便与杂耍差不多。
徐福很少观看这个时代的角抵戏，这时听着外头哗啦的雨声，再瞧着角抵戏，也算是别有一番滋味了。
徐福和嬴政在主位落座，吕公自觉地退居了。
不久后，吕公的妻子携着吕雉也出来了。大约是因为她昨日已经大着胆子上门来找过，此时吕雉见了徐福、嬴政二人，便落落大方地冲着他们娇俏一笑，像是全然忘记了昨日被拒的尴尬一样。
吕雉和她的母亲坐在了一处，当然离徐福等人有些距离。
虽然这个时代男女大防不严，但总归来说，许多女性地位仍旧不高，因而不能轻易近客。
这时角抵戏的角者刚走到堂前来，吕雉突然拉了拉裙摆，笑道：“母亲，昨日你让我交给两位客人的东西，我已经送去了。”
嬴政立时便眸光冷了冷。
这吕家女儿竟是还爱撒谎？
徐福倒是一下子就听出了吕雉那句话，可以判作两个意思：一个是只是送去了，但是收没收，便没有提及；而第二个，那便是送到了，而徐福和嬴政也收下了。无疑，吕雉将这话一说，旁边的人定然会以为是第二种。
吕雉是故意说给谁听的吗？她倒是胆子大，不担心他们震怒之下，找她的麻烦吗？哦，对，也是。吕雉那句话既然可以看作两个意思，那自然也能成为吕雉为自己辩解的借口。
吕雉是个聪明人。
虽然并不见吕雉使什么高明手段，可从细微处窥见端倪了。果然不愧是历史上赫赫有名的吕后！
她实在太聪明了！
徐福欣赏聪明的人，但实在不欣赏敌方阵营中聪明的人。徐福微微有些纠结，他该如何告知嬴政，不能留下吕雉，日后她会酿成大祸呢？单看吕雉现在的野心，徐福就觉得不能再放纵她成长下去了。
心思百转千回之后，徐福拉了一把嬴政的胳膊，嬴政反握住徐福的手腕，冷眼扫过了吕雉，低声道：“是个聪明人，只可惜还不够聪明。”
他们说的声音自然极低，不会被旁人听了去。
“为什么？”徐福不由得问。吕雉还不够聪明吗？
“寡人若是要杀人，你说……需要理由吗？又有谁敢与寡人论公道呢？”嬴政转过头来，看着徐福，淡淡道，全然没有在说血腥之事的自觉。
徐福无语凝噎，但他不得不说，“……你说的是。”所以其实吕雉耍什么心眼儿都没用。
她没有权势，没有地位，唯一可以依靠的就是她的头脑，但是在绝对的权势跟前，头脑有时候也没用。
吕家看起来在单父县极为厉害，但是在嬴政眼中什么都算什么。
可以说吕家父女若是有什么打算，怕是就要打算错了。
很快，食物被送上桌案，角抵戏也开始了。
嬴政知晓徐福没了记忆，便在他耳边低声道：“据传上古的时候，有人与兽斗，从兽处得到启发，便在武器上装上角，以角抵人。但到了先秦的时候，以角抵人便演变成为了两两相抵，也就是二人相抵角力，后来又衍生出了扛鼎、走索、舞剑等表演。民间和不少官员家中都甚是流行，只是好的角者自然都在寡人的王宫之中，只是你从前不爱看这些，寡人便极少叫人来表演。”
徐福此时已经被勾起了兴趣。
“若是跳舞奏乐，我自然没甚兴趣，但这……我还是感兴趣的。”徐福低声道。
嬴政忍不住抬手抚了下他的头顶，“嗯，你失忆前，便总与寡人说，不爱瞧什么舞乐。”
徐福心底微微一颤，好像深处有什么地方，渐渐有东西破了土，拼了命地想要钻出来。
徐福的心跳有些快。
是……是嬴政的什么话，触动到他脑子里溜走的记忆了吗？
“怎么了？不是说感兴趣吗？怎么又不看了？”嬴政握了握徐福的手，温热的触感很直接地传递到了徐福的手背上。徐福扫了一眼已经卖力表演起来的角者。
徐福有些失望。
听嬴政说起来的时候，他觉得实在太有意思了。角抵戏完全承载了古代的艺术文化啊！
但是作为一个在上辈子，见识过不少杂技的人，便觉得没那样惊奇了，并没有体现到多少的古代艺术文化。而且不得不说，这时候表演起来，更没有什么安全措施，技艺不够精彩，反倒是他们身上的危险吊住了观看者的心。
嬴政见徐福默默盯着不语，于是低声道：“可是觉得他们表演得无趣了些？等回到咸阳后，寡人便让人为你好好表演一出角抵戏。”
徐福转头看了他一眼，不知道为什么，徐福觉得嬴政说这句话的时候，有些怪怪的，像是带着几分窃喜一样。不过转过头来，徐福又觉得应当是自己听错了。
嬴政怎么可能会窃喜呢？这样的情绪出现在他的身上，就太违和了。
徐福收敛起心神，还是先专心投入了这场表演中。
一边吃些食物，一边看着角抵戏，不知不觉天色便黑了下来，而外面的大雨竟然还没停。
角者渐渐散去，吕公起身，看了眼庭院中淅沥的雨水，叹了口气道：“明日怕是雨也不会停了，尊驾恐怕也去不了我那长女的故居了。”
“不会。”徐福淡淡地截断了吕公的话，“明日不会再继续下这样大的雨，至少……能停上一个时辰。”算一算时日，暴雨能下这样久就已经较为骇人了。
一般来说，就算是接连不断地下起暴雨，而实际上，中间也是会有停顿的。有时候会停上一个时辰，有时候甚至停上几个时辰方才继续下雨。
暴雨下得久了，那天上也没有那样多的云来化作雨滴啊。
吕公诧异地看了徐福一眼，心底自然是想反驳，只可惜他没敢反驳，只是淡淡一笑，正欲亲自送他们回屋。
此时吕雉出声了，“父亲，客人要去姐姐从前的住处？”
“不错。”吕公说着便忍不住笑得双眼眯了起来，“他们乃是你长姐的旧识。”
这说出去，吕公倒是觉得极有面子的。
对方入住到吕府，也不过只能说是萍水之交，但是他那长女与他们是当真有交情在的！
而吕雉此时的脸色却有些发白，她眸光沉黯地笑了笑，道：“没想到客人竟与姐姐是认识的。客人明日要去姐姐从前住的地方吗？不如我来带路好了。”
昨日可没见她用这样亲昵的口吻，还一口一个“姐姐”，此刻看上去倒真像是个天真的妹妹。
吕公似乎看出了吕雉的不对劲，他皱眉斥道：“胡闹什么？这些事自然有下人去做！”
吕雉却定定地看向吕公，不紧不慢地道：“父亲说错了，两位客人都极为贵重，怎能交给下人呢？父亲不便出门，那我陪同便是。”
“可你……”
“可我是女儿家？”吕雉截断了吕公的话，“这又有何妨？姐姐不曾也在外独自行走吗？”
吕公自然不好在徐福和嬴政的面前说凤姑娘的不好，便也只有沉着脸咬牙应了。
大约吕公根本没想到，自己的女儿竟然骨子里都带着不肯屈服的特质，一时间吕公还有点没能接受这个认知，于是眸光颤颤巍巍，最后定格在了震惊和恼怒之上。
许是害怕将情绪曝于人前，吕公便没再多说，忙道：“我先送尊驾回去吧。”
徐福点了点头，和嬴政走在了前。
吕公走在后，此时忍不住回头瞥了一眼吕雉。而吕雉却是对她的父亲淡淡一笑，看上去仿佛只是个乖巧的女儿。
徐福和嬴政吃饱喝足，娱乐活动也进行完了，于是二人沐浴一番，便早早相拥入眠了。至于别的，他们倒是没有做，实在是徐福不太喜欢吕府，他很难想象自己在吕雉的府上，和人啪啪啪，那该是怎样的一种诡异滋味。
嬴政自然也就随了他。
反正前段时间趁着徐福失忆，嬴政已经爽了个够，现在也该适当地后退了，免得日后徐福恢复了记忆，他就实在不好交代了。
这一夜平静地过去了。
徐福和嬴政都是带了内侍在身边的，自然伺候便由他们接手。毕竟哪怕是这样的琐碎小事，他们也不敢交给他人来进行。
于是内侍一边服侍着他们洗漱，一边低声说起了，他们在府中听来的话。
“从前吕家下人都不知晓，还有个大姑娘。”
“吕娥姁很受吕公的重视，她母亲也很疼爱她，相比之下，凤姑娘便很少有人提起了。”
“也有人猜测，吕娥姁与凤姑娘不合。据说从前，吕公一心疼爱凤姑娘，吕娥姁似乎不得什么宠爱……”
“那吕娥姁的母亲对这对姐妹有什么不同的态度？”徐福洗净了手，低声问道。
内侍摇头，“这就打听不到了，只知吕娥姁的母亲从前很少出来见人，不过……不过说来也怪，凤姑娘离家去学岐黄术了，她的母亲便常出来走动了……”
这吕家毕竟不是什么厉害地方，要从府中下人口中打听些什么，实在太容易不过，只是年代久远的事儿，便打听不来了，因为有些事儿，那也不是下人能知道的啊。
而徐福基本上已经可以确定，吕雉和凤姑娘的确不合了，甚至有可能吕雉极为仇视她。
徐福脑中已经有了决断，他转头对嬴政道：“待去过凤姑娘的住处后，若是没发现什么，我们也要盯住吕雉。”
“你觉得是吕雉害了她？”嬴政惊讶。
而实际上徐福的重点根本不在这里，他毕竟没了记忆，对凤姑娘的遗憾虽有，但并不足以让他对这件事执着到底，真正让他执着的是吕雉本人。所以去看一眼，是为亡人出一份心意，而盯着吕雉，却是为了让吕雉在掌控之中。
“嗯。”但是徐福又不能对嬴政说，她日后的丈夫会推翻你的统治，就算是他听见别人如此说，肯定都会觉得实在是个笑话，又何况嬴政呢？所以他便默认是怀疑吕雉害了凤姑娘了。
反正等到离开单父县的时候，徐福也会想办法，让嬴政将吕雉带在一起。
那时说不定吕公半点也不会阻拦。
但是吕雉被他们带走，那还不是任由宰割？那刘邦就是在泗水苦等一辈子，也不会再等来一个吕雉了。
嬴政没再多说什么，他们洗漱过后，便到厅中去用了食物了。没一会儿，吕雉便穿戴周全地出来了，可以瞧得出来是特意打扮过的。吕公只看了一眼，脸色便不自觉地黑了黑。
只是最后吕公也未多说什么，因为此时他一旦开口斥责吕雉，反而容易得罪了徐福和嬴政。吕公心知这一点，便也只能憋闷地看着了。不过没一会儿，吕公心底的憋闷就消了。
他满面忧虑地指着外面的雨帘，道：“这如何是好？雨还未停呢。”
吕雉道：“不过一场雨罢了，两位客人又怎会在意呢？”其实吕雉说这话的时候，在暗暗打量徐福和嬴政的表情，徐福自然察觉到了这一点，他知道吕雉多半是想观察到他们对凤姑娘，究竟看重与否。若是愿意冒雨前去，那就应当是的确有几分交情了。
于是徐福道：“今日定然要去。”
听徐福如此说，嬴政便适时地出声，道：“嗯，那便如此吧。”
他们二人都如此说了，那吕公还能说什么？他的脸色便更加忧虑了。此时吕雉的心情就复杂多了。她没想到他们还当真对吕凤上了心，但是，若换个角度来看，他们看重吕凤也是件好事，毕竟自己是她的亲妹妹啊……
吕雉此时有些后悔，之前在他们面前，露出自己对姐姐的不喜了。不过没关系，编一下背后的故事便没问题了。
吕雉对自己的手段很自信，于是她扬起笑容，道：“那二位客人先请。”
“再等等。”徐福不紧不慢地出声道。
吕雉不得不顿住了脚步，而实际上她和吕公一样，都是充满了疑惑。为何说冒雨也要去？为何又说要等等？
徐福没有说话，他与嬴政并肩站在厅门口，往庭院中望去。
而就在这个时候，雨水渐渐开始减少了，到最后雨声更是戛然而止。看得吕家上下都瞪大了眼。
“这……这雨，当真停了？”吕公颤抖着问。
“嗯。”徐福点了点头，方才道：“走吧。”
如此一听，吕公哪里还有不明白的？看来对方早就知晓，这雨会停。昨日听闻对方说起的时候，吕公只当是对方随口说起，不过是希望第二日雨停的意思，谁知道对方就是这样粗暴地预言了第二日的天气。
直到徐福和嬴政都已经走出去了，吕公都还是有些恍惚的。
“头一次见到那驷车庶长的厉害，果真并非虚传啊！”吕公叹了口气。看来这之后，是万不能质疑对方的话了，否则还会引得对方不快。
这头徐福和嬴政走出了吕家，然后他们便在吕雉的带领下，往着城南走去。最后来到了一处瞧上去便荒凉不少的宅子前。
吕雉道：“姐姐离开之后，宅子里便没人住了。”说着吕雉掏出了钥匙，将门打开了，里面一道风携着灰尘扑面而来，嬴政眼疾手快地拽了徐福一把，方才没有波及到他，反倒是吕雉站在那里，刚好被扑了一脸的灰。
徐福看了一眼吕雉精心描绘的妆容，开个门就变了模样，心底忍不住觉得有些好笑。
不过吕雉很快就恢复了自如，她领着他们走了进去。
侍从们跟在后面，负责开路清扫，免得不小心绊了徐福和嬴政。吕雉倒只有一人独自走在前头了，吕雉走得很是熟门熟路，连裙摆沾了灰她都不顾，姿态大方丝毫不扭捏。
这一点上倒是有些像那位凤姑娘，徐福和嬴政不约而同地想道。
只不过一个人是本性，一个人却是故意展露出来的。
“二位要瞧哪里呢？”吕雉转过身来问道。
平心而论，吕雉长得很漂亮，而且是很端正大气的容貌。
只是没凤姑娘那样美艳。
徐福脑子里登时蹦出了这句话，他愣了愣，这才意识到自己脑中的记忆，似乎隐隐复苏了一些，他竟是大约能忆起那凤姑娘的轮廓样貌了。
徐福收住思绪，淡淡道：“先随处走一走，将院子都走上一遍吧。”
吕雉点了点头，继续带路。
这副姿态，再加上她那张脸，和足够的手段，吕雉本该是无往不利的，只可惜，在徐福和嬴政的跟前，便注定什么也没用了。
他们一路前行，将院子逛了大半。
最后徐福道：“你姐姐住在哪个屋子？”
吕雉犹豫了一下，似乎很为凤姑娘着想一般，道：“屋子也要看吗？”言下之意表示，女儿家的屋子，总是不大好进去的。
徐福却仿佛根本没注意到她的表情一样，点头：“嗯。”
吕雉便也只有带着他们过去了。推门而入之后，徐福一眼就可以看见，里面的摆设都还是齐全的，几乎能想象得出一个人在这里生活过的轨迹。
徐福匆匆扫了一眼，然后走到了梳妆台前。
当然，徐福也不过是装装样子来瞧一瞧罢了，他忽然转头对着吕雉道：“她生病的时候，你常来探望她吗？”
吕雉点了点头，“有时候是我自己来，有时候是跟母亲一同。”
“你会给她带吃的？”
吕雉一愣，点点头，“嗯。”
徐福没再说什么了，他瞥了一眼梳妆台下，那些爬过的虫子。顿觉实在有些恶心。
这样久不住人的屋子，果然不能来。
徐福转身便出去了，嬴政见徐福不想待下去，自然就直接带着他离开了。反倒是吕雉此时有些迷茫了，那这二人究竟是不是看重姐姐呢？竟然只是这样匆匆看一眼吗？她原本还等着这二人询问更多的事，她好再借机表现一番，自己对姐姐的敬爱呢，谁知竟是没了机会！
……
等徐福出了宅子，有个侍从走到了他的身边，小声说：“庶长，宅子里有死人，才会有许多爱吃腐尸的虫子。”
徐福差点被恶心得吐出来，他本以为那些虫子，是之前遗留在那屋子里的食物招来的，但现在看来此食物非彼食物啊。
徐福让那侍从半夜去挖尸体，然后便忍着恶心，瘫着一张脸，和嬴政迅速回到吕府去了。
吕雉微微松了一口气，不过他们迅速离开也是好事。
正想着呢，谁知吕公叫住了她。
“你想做什么？”吕公将吕雉叫走后，怒声问出来的第一句话便是如此。
吕雉淡淡道：“这二位客人都极为出色，我心生爱慕，有何不可？”
吕公从未听吕雉说过这样大胆的话，他瞪大了眼，抚了抚胸口，道：“你也要如你姐姐一样气我吗？我告诉你，这二人并非什么一般人，你若是卖弄手段，恐人家暗地里厌恶了你！”
吕雉甜甜一笑，又恢复了少女的模样，道：“正好，姐姐死了，她已经不能气你了。当然，我是不会死的，我不仅不会死，我还会比她更厉害，她抓不住的，我都能抓住。”
作者有话要说：
角抵戏：又称百戏，一种历史悠久的汉族民俗娱乐表演艺术。秦汉时期盛行。
chapters.title: 第252章

chapters.translated_text:
The torrential rain that Xu Fu had anticipated continued for two more days before stopping. The villages in the low-lying areas outside the city were flooded, and the guards within the city had all been dispatched for disaster relief. The county magistrate breathed a long sigh of relief; had he not trusted the other party and instead just gone through the motions, the disaster would have been far worse. Coincidentally, the King was right here, and having witnessed such a catastrophe with his own eyes, would he not have dismissed the magistrate in a fit of rage?

As soon as the heavy rain ceased, Xu Fu and his party naturally prepared to leave.

While Master Lü was still racking his brains, plotting how to continue currying favor with the two, he was completely unaware that they had already planned to take his daughter and leave.

An attendant searched the residence where Lady Feng had previously lived once more before returning to Xu Fu’s side.

"Lady Feng does not seem to have been buried," the attendant said, frowning in confusion. "After all, no one would simply bury a corpse in the courtyard."

"Then how did she die?" Xu Fu asked in a low voice.

"She was poisoned."

"Did Lü E'xu do it?" Xu Fu could only associate this with her; after all, no matter how one looked at it, only she possessed such ruthless methods.

Xu Fu turned to Ying Zheng and said, "Why don't we take this Lady Lü with us when we leave?"

Ying Zheng assumed he wanted to seek justice for Lady Feng, so he nodded.

Soon, the attendants had finished packing.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng stepped out of the house, casually called over a servant, and said, "Go tell Master Lü that we are departing."

The servant was stunned, dropped the broom in his hand, and hurried off to find Master Lü.

At that moment, the county magistrate had just arrived at the Lü residence. He and Master Lü were sitting together, just inquiring about the situation over the past few days, when they saw a servant running over in a panic, loudly reporting the news. The expressions of both Master Lü and the magistrate changed instantly. Their first thought was whether they had offended the King somewhere. Their hearts were immediately filled with trepidation.

"This... quickly, invite them to the main hall," Master Lü stood up abruptly.

Lü Zhi, who was walking outside the hall, also had a slight change in expression and hurried inside. She had thought she had enough means to get close to them, but she never imagined that the other party would just leave like this! If that were the case, no matter how capable she was, she wouldn't be able to display it! Lü Zhi, who had been in a pleasant mood just moments ago, felt her mood plummet to the depths of despair.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng were led into the hall by the servant.

The magistrate dared not openly kneel and address him as "King," so he simply performed a brief bow.

"Since the rain has stopped, it is time for us to depart," Xu Fu was the first to speak.

Master Lü hurriedly bowed and said, "Is there any way in which my hospitality has been lacking?"

Ying Zheng gave him a mocking look. "No matter how much Master Lü does, it would be hard to be thorough enough."

Master Lü suddenly realized that the other party was the King of Qin. As the ruler of the Qin State, what had he not seen? Even if he offered more flattery, it was truly insignificant in the eyes of the other party. Master Lü felt a sense of unwillingness; if they had stayed longer, he would have had absolute confidence in keeping them.

"However, we would like to borrow someone from Master Lü." This time it was Xu Fu’s turn to speak. As soon as he spoke, the mockery on Ying Zheng’s face vanished, and Master Lü, seeing this, immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

"Who?" Master Lü asked, while secretly harboring a guess. Who else could they possibly mention? His eldest daughter, Chanjuan, had passed away, so it could only be his second daughter, E'xu.

"Lady Lü."

Lü Zhi was also standing in the hall. Hearing Xu Fu mention her, she was momentarily stunned, barely able to react.

They wanted to take her away?

Lü Zhi’s heart beat a little faster. To "borrow" a woman... naturally, there were other implications in that.

Master Lü opened his mouth, and after a long while, suppressing the shock on his face, he said, "Why would you want to borrow my daughter?"

Lü Zhi pursed her lips and lowered her head.

Xu Fu did not give a reason, merely asking, "Well, is Master Lü unwilling?"

He felt it was awkward enough to have to pretend to praise Lü Zhi, so he decided to be overbearing and decisive. He believed Master Lü would not be willing to miss such an opportunity. Historically, Master Lü’s ability to marry his daughter to Liu Bang without hesitation showed that when Master Lü needed to be ruthless, he was absolutely capable of it.

"No..." Master Lü replied reflexively, then hesitated before smiling. "To be valued by you is my daughter’s good fortune. E'xu, what do you think?" Master Lü, of course, had to play the part, pretending to ask Lü Zhi, though only he knew how impatient Lü Zhi was for such an outcome.

Lü Zhi smiled and said, "It is E'xu’s fortune."

Although she still didn't know their specific identities, she knew that following these two was the moment her fate would change!

For the past ten years or so, Lü Zhi had wondered why her sister could become a phoenix while she could only be a pheasant, but from now on, she would be completely different from her sister, Lü Feng.

Although he had been mentally prepared, seeing Master Lü and Lü Zhi agree so readily made Xu Fu feel a bit ironic.

"Lady Lü, go pack your things. We will be departing shortly," Xu Fu said indifferently.

Lü Zhi nodded and stepped out of the hall with a light gait.

At this point, the county magistrate was stunned. After finally coming to his senses, he could only watch helplessly as Xu Fu and his party departed.

He could only hope that... his decisive handling of the situation during the heavy rain would catch the King’s eye... or at least that he would be remembered...

The Lü family and the magistrate personally saw Xu Fu and his party off.

Soon, Lü Zhi came out with her things packed, followed by Mother Lü. Mother Lü walked up and whispered something to Master Lü. After a while, Master Lü respectfully walked up to Xu Fu and said in a low voice, "I have something to gift you."

"What is it?" In truth, Xu Fu was not interested in his belongings, but since Master Lü wanted to give it, he would accept it. But why wasn't he giving it to Ying Zheng?

Just as he was thinking this, he saw Master Lü take a scroll of silk from his sleeve. He handed it to Xu Fu and said, "You will surely like this. From now on, I must trouble you to take good care of my daughter."

Xu Fu took the silk, not knowing what to expect, but after just one glance, his pupils shrank sharply.

He lowered his eyelids to hide his emotions, then tucked the silk into his sleeve. Xu Fu said indifferently, "This item is very much to my liking. I have troubled you, Master Lü."

"You are too kind." Master Lü felt he had profited, as he might soon become a relative of the King of Qin. If he couldn't become a relative of the King, being a relative of the Si Che Shu Zhang (a high-ranking official) would also suffice. As for the romantic relationship between the two, in Master Lü’s view, it didn't matter. After all, how could men compare to women? In the end, didn't they still have to marry women? The fact that they could appreciate E'xu meant she had definitely caught their eye and had a great future ahead.

The more Master Lü thought about it, the more pleasant his expression became. He and the magistrate bowed together, watching Xu Fu’s party leave.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng sat inside a carriage, while Lü Zhi sat in another. The two carriages looked identical on the outside, but this one had been specially built by Ying Zheng for Xu Fu, so it was naturally different.

Lü Zhi was still filled with the surprise of having been struck by a windfall.

It was only because Lü Zhi was still in her youth and not yet as sophisticated as she would later become that she could be hooked by Xu Fu.

Lü Zhi rested in the carriage, already beginning to imagine her wonderful life ahead.

Meanwhile, Xu Fu took out the silk Master Lü had given him and slowly unfolded it in front of Ying Zheng. "Look."

Ying Zheng leaned over to look, his gaze shifting slightly. "...This is your handwriting."

"Indeed, this must be a hand-copied version of my manuscript," Xu Fu said indifferently. In truth, he was joyful at heart; after all, this hand-copied manuscript had come to him on its own, and he hadn't expected the Lü residence to possess such a thing. Upon reflection, he felt it was only natural. Where did Master Lü learn his physiognomy skills? Now that he thought about it, it was from learning shallow bits from the manuscript, thinking he could rely on these tricks to achieve great fortune.

However, it was fortunate that Master Lü only knew how to use these, and he didn't understand the more profound parts.

One had to know, if he had understood them and used them for evil, it would have become a huge problem! Given Master Lü’s character, Xu Fu had no doubt he might have done such things.

Moreover, Xu Fu was also very glad that Master Lü, worried that Lü Zhi didn't have enough leverage, had given this item away. If they hadn't taken Lü Zhi, and even less known about this manuscript, Xu Fu could hardly imagine what would have happened when the manuscript eventually fell into Lü Zhi’s hands. Lü Zhi’s ambition was greater than Master Lü’s, and she was smarter and more resourceful. Furthermore, Lü Zhi was still very young; she had plenty of time to realize her ambitions.

Ying Zheng watched Xu Fu, who was lost in thought, and couldn't help but reach out to stroke his head, smiling. "A-Fu is truly lucky."

"It is indeed good luck." Xu Fu also felt this was incredibly fortunate.

If even the slightest mistake had occurred, Xu Fu dared not imagine what kind of enemy would have been left behind.

"Do you think if I force Lü Zhi to tell me how Lady Feng died, she will speak?" Xu Fu asked in a low voice. Once Lü Zhi confessed, he would tell Ying Zheng that he wanted to avenge Lady Feng, using Lü Zhi’s life as the price.

Ying Zheng said indifferently, "As long as you want to force a result out of her, it is naturally very easy."

If torture were applied, how could she not confess?

"Then bring Lü Zhi over." Xu Fu still felt a slight tension in his heart; this seemed to be an unavoidable emotion. He couldn't wait for Lü Zhi to die; after all, such matters were always prone to complications, and if they could be resolved early, they should never be dragged out until the next day.

If possible, he even felt that resolving Liu Bang and Xiang Yu early would be good too.

After all, they were not Hu Hai.

Hu Hai still had a chance to be corrected, but they did not.

Xu Fu’s expression remained cold, but Ying Zheng noticed a hint of excitement in his eyes. What was there to be excited about? Ying Zheng didn't understand. Ying Zheng had someone call for Lü Zhi.

Thus, their party made a brief stop on the road.

Lü Zhi was sitting in the carriage when she suddenly saw someone lift the curtain. She looked over with a smile: "Is something the matter?"

"The King summons you," the man said coldly.

The King?

Lü Zhi almost thought her ears had deceived her!

The King? What King could there be now? Naturally, it was the King of Qin!

Lü Zhi’s heart suddenly beat faster. She was so excited she couldn't say a word. She barely managed to maintain a calm expression on her face, stepped out of the carriage, and followed the attendant to the other carriage.

Lü Zhi couldn't help but reach out to cover her chest.

Why would the King of Qin call her over? Lü Zhi was almost eager to try. Xu Fu was naturally excluded by her; in her eyes and mind, only the King of Qin remained. She wasn't stupid; of course, she knew how to choose the better option.

At this moment, Xu Fu lifted the carriage curtain. "Come in."

Lü Zhi glanced at Xu Fu’s face.

He was also an extremely handsome person, but unfortunately, nothing could compare to the King of Qin.

Thus, Lü Zhi turned to look at Ying Zheng, and couldn't help but think to herself, *As expected of the King of Qin, his presence is far stronger than others.*

Lü Zhi opened her mouth, but in the end, said nothing. She waited quietly for the other party to speak first.

Of course, Lü Zhi would never have guessed that the first thing Xu Fu would say to her was, "Why wasn't Lü Feng buried?"

"What?" Lü Zhi was startled. Her smiling expression was shattered instantly. The smile disappeared from her face for several seconds before reappearing. Only then did she begin to ask Xu Fu back: "What are you talking about? My sister was buried long ago."

Xu Fu would certainly not be stupid enough to continue arguing based on Lü Zhi’s logic. He had no need to argue with her; he only needed to intimidate her directly, letting her know that every evil deed she had committed was known to someone.

"How did you kill her? Poison? Putting it in food and bringing it to her? A younger sister who had been on bad terms with her for years suddenly started to reconcile. She was suspicious, but more than that, she was happy. She ate the food, and then she died."

"Why kill her? Because you were jealous of her. Is that it?" Xu Fu said indifferently. Although Xu Fu felt this reason didn't seem sufficient, because if it were just jealousy, Lü Zhi could have acted years ago when Lady Feng returned to Shanfu County. Why wait until a few months ago?

Lü Zhi could no longer maintain the smile on her face. She looked at Xu Fu coldly. "Why are you slandering me?" After speaking, she turned to look at Ying Zheng. "Do you also allow others to slander me?" Lü Zhi was still able to rebut Xu Fu calmly, not forgetting to speak to Ying Zheng; her mental fortitude was indeed strong.

But Xu Fu’s gaze became even colder.

How could he not see what Lü Zhi was intending? Was she hoping that Ying Zheng would appreciate her, pity her, and then intervene? Xu Fu felt extreme displeasure in his heart.

And Ying Zheng, as if he hadn't heard what Lü Zhi said, glanced at her coldly but said nothing.

Lü Zhi finally began to panic.

She was very confident in herself, to the point of extreme self-assurance, which was why she had been able to be relaxed earlier. But now, she finally realized a beat too late that there seemed to be no one here who could be her helper. The King’s attitude toward her was too cold. What was she to do? At this moment, Lü Zhi remembered the person sitting next to the King of Qin, who was perhaps the legendary Si Che Shu Zhang. With him there, how could she fare well?

"How can you compare yourself to your sister? You are far behind her. Do you think we asked to take you away for any other reason? It was only to ask you for the truth about your sister’s death!"

Xu Fu’s words instantly shattered all of Lü Zhi’s previous fantasies.

They were doing this for Lü Feng?

Lü Zhi’s expression gradually changed, and a surge of uncontrollable hatred and unwillingness welled up in her eyes.

Lü Zhi knew that arguing at this point seemed useless, so she could only grit her teeth and say nothing. Could the other party really be ruthless enough to kill her directly?

Just as she thought this, she heard Ying Zheng say, "Someone, bring a blade."

Hearing this, Lü Zhi couldn't help but tremble.

An attendant lifted the carriage curtain and actually handed a blade inside. Lü Zhi couldn't help but shrink back.

"Now, if you choose to confess one truth, you can live a little longer. If you tell a single lie, you will have a finger chopped off. Do you understand?" This time, it was Ying Zheng who spoke.

Lü Zhi raised her head blankly, meeting Ying Zheng’s face. It was still handsome and imposing, but now Lü Zhi could no longer view it with admiration or worship. Facing this face, she only felt terror and fear.

"Will you speak?" Ying Zheng stuck the blade into the table beside him, urging her.

Lü Zhi’s gaze followed his movement.

Only then did she realize the interior of the carriage was so exquisite, even containing things she had never seen before. Such a comfortable carriage, compared to the one she had been in before... Lü Zhi’s heart sank. Yes, from the very beginning, they wanted to take her away not out of appreciation for her beauty; they were only doing it for Lü Feng, for that damned Lü Feng.

Lü Zhi gritted her teeth.

"A-Qing," Xu Fu called out in a low voice. "Come in."

As the words fell, another man entered the carriage. The man looked menacing. He took the small blade from the table and reached out to grab Lü Zhi’s fingers.

Under heavy stimulation and pressure, Lü Zhi finally couldn't bear the mental strain. She screamed, curled her fingers in a panic, and hurriedly shrank back.

"Will you speak now? Start from the beginning, tell it bit by bit," Xu Fu said coldly.

He, Ying Zheng, and A-Qing looked like three fierce gods.

Xu Fu felt that no matter how capable Lü Zhi was, she probably couldn't play any tricks now.

"I..." It is indeed very difficult for an unrepentant person to speak of their own crimes. Especially someone like Lü Zhi, who would not easily admit defeat until the very last moment.

"I think you need to speak a little faster," Xu Fu reminded her indifferently.

A-Qing timely moved the blade in his hand forward.

Lü Zhi was startled, took a breath, and said, "Fine, I don't like my sister. She is several years older than me. By rights, I am the youngest daughter in the family, and my father should have loved me more. But that’s not it! My father actually liked her more! My father had no eyes for me, never spoke to me, and only praised others, praising my sister for being smart and beautiful. But am I not smart? Am I not beautiful? You are right, why is my sister a phoenix while I am just a pheasant!"

Xu Fu saw it clearly; Master Lü didn't dote on Lady Feng, he only doted on the daughter who was useful and easy to control. Previously, Lady Feng was excellent, so in his eyes, she could be well-utilized, and naturally, he had to cultivate her carefully. Later, when Lady Feng didn't listen to him, he abandoned her. And the favor Lü Zhi received later, wasn't it also for a purpose? Master Lü treated her the same as he treated Lady Feng. The only difference was that Xu Fu discovered that Mother Lü did indeed love Lü Zhi dearly. When Master Lü only cared about Lady Feng in her childhood, at least there was Mother Lü whose heart was tied to Lü Zhi.

Of course, Xu Fu did not interrupt her to say these things.

In any case, Lü Zhi’s heart had long been filled with jealousy, and saying more wouldn't save Lady Feng.

"After she left home, my life was much easier, but it would have been better if she had never returned. But she did return. Although my father didn't like that her temperament had become wild, after she came back, my father went to see her once, and when he returned, he often said that my sister was still smart, that my sister was still more outstanding, but it was a pity. What was a pity? Was I not good enough?" Lü Zhi couldn't help but sneer.

"I just couldn't understand where I was inferior to her." Lü Zhi paused, as if lost in memory, and after a long while said, "Later I finally understood, it was because my fate was not as good as hers. My father learned the skill of physiognomy from the manuscript. He said Lü Feng’s fate was noble, different from mine in the future. What was different? How did I not know? I was furious, I wanted to steal the manuscript and burn it!"

Xu Fu felt quite helpless.

So it seemed his manuscript had ruined people? But if there weren't so much desire and ambition in a person’s heart, why would they want to use his manuscript to achieve evil deeds?

Thinking now of Master Lü using physiognomy skills to do such things, Xu Fu felt an indescribable disgust.

"I had my mother steal it for me." Lü Zhi bit her lip, but a strange expression appeared on her face. "Originally I was going to burn it, but I couldn't help but open it. I wanted to know what it could teach people. And then, I saw it. It turns out that a person’s fate can be determined by physiognomy. It turns out my face was not as good as Lü Feng’s. But what does that have to do with me? My face is natural! I was born by them, do I have the right to change it?"

Generally speaking, Lü Zhi was not wrong; some physiognomy is born that way and cannot be changed. But some physiognomy can be changed later in life. As the saying goes, "Knowledge and culture bring out the inner beauty"; if you read more books and have self-cultivation, your temperament will change, and as your temperament changes, your physiognomy will naturally change as well. But if Lü Zhi’s heart became increasingly narrow, trapped in jealousy every day, then the originally good physiognomy would also become bad.

"The manuscript recorded many things, and it was so coincidental that I happened to flip to it: it turns out that physiognomy can be swapped."

Xu Fu’s heart skipped a beat.

Did Lü Zhi also use his manuscript to do such evil? Xu Fu vaguely felt he had understood the entire process of Lü Feng’s death.

From the moment Lü Zhi said this, even Ying Zheng’s gaze toward her changed.

Another person who had swapped their physiognomy.

Lü Zhi said, "I used this method to swap Lü Feng’s physiognomy. It seems her luck really did transfer to me. My father rarely went to see her anymore, became increasingly dissatisfied with her, and even wanted to force her to marry. Lü Feng refused, so she stayed behind closed doors all year round, and only I occasionally brought her food, drink, and things to play with."

"My father discovered the manuscript was missing, and I could only hurriedly have my mother return it. I was worried about people finding out about the physiognomy swap..."

"So you killed Lü Feng?"

"Perhaps so. In any case, she is dead, and her physiognomy still belongs to me." Speaking of this, Lü Zhi miraculously regained her calm. Her gaze was terrifyingly cold, giving people a sense of extreme evil.

Murder is just a thought, but after killing someone, to have no remorse and instead happily use what originally belonged to others, that is truly terrifying!

If Lü Zhi had learned more from it and found ways to implement and use it... then there would probably be more trouble. Xu Fu even felt that perhaps the historical Lü Zhi had been helped by such things.

Of course, these were all just random guesses.

Xu Fu said, "Since you have admitted it, then only your blood can be used to sacrifice to Lady Feng."

Hearing this, Lü Zhi stopped abruptly. "You still want to kill me?"

"Of course," Xu Fu said nonchalantly. "Asking you to tell the truth was just so you wouldn't have your fingers chopped off; you will have a complete corpse."

Lü Zhi finally realized she had been played, but now, facing such a group of people, with no helpers and no one to speak for her, she could only be at their mercy.

"Don't you want that manuscript? That manuscript has records of swapping physiognomy! You are Xu Junfang, right? Aren't you obsessed with the way of divination? Don't you want to see it?" Lü Zhi said in a panic.

Xu Fu took an item from his sleeve and waved it in front of Lü Zhi. "Are you talking about this?"

Lü Zhi stared at the object, completely stunned. "How? How could it be in your hands?"

"When we left, you were already in the carriage, and your father gave this to me."

This sentence was like a heavy hammer, smashing down on Lü Zhi’s heart.

Lü Zhi couldn't help but gasp for air; her breathing was no longer smooth. Struck by this, the changes in her heart were naturally intense. She hadn't expected her father to so easily give away her last bargaining chip.

Xu Fu felt it wasn't enough. He thought for a moment and added, "Of course, this thing is of no use to me." As Xu Fu said this, he took another item from his sleeve and placed it in front of Lü Zhi.

Lü Zhi leaned down to look, supporting herself on the carriage, which barely allowed her to steady her body.

But this item also made her expression turn uglier the more she looked at it.

"This... how is it possible? This is? This is the same?" It was an identical manuscript, only the handwriting was older, and the silk looked like better material.

Xu Fu then said nonchalantly, "Because these things were written by me. After they were stolen by thieves in my early years, I hand-copied a few copies, and they drifted into the world. Even if your father hadn't given this to me, I wouldn't have cared for it in the slightest."

Because these things were written by me.

A light sentence almost sent Lü Zhi to hell.

Lü Zhi collapsed on the floor, unable to say a word. The thing she had originally thought she could hold in her palm as a threat was now worthless. The feeling of suddenly falling from the sky to the ground was truly painful. And she had been lifted up and dropped again.

Lü Zhi blinked numbly. "Oh. So that’s how it is."

If a perfectly good young girl had a normal family, didn't obsessively calculate other things, and had a healthy psychology shaped, what would she have been like? Xu Fu felt it was a real pity. If he hadn't appeared in this life, perhaps Lü Zhi could have lived well, continuing until she became Empress Lü. Unfortunately, everything was now cut off.

Ying Zheng said in a low voice, "Take her away."

A-Qing nodded and dragged Lü Zhi away. When they left, the carefully applied makeup was now completely ruined.

Lü Zhi didn't say any more resentful words. As she was being dragged away, she just muttered, "Next... who else can gain his favor? No one. Never again. The Lü family... no more..."

When A-Qing glanced at her face, he noticed that Lü Zhi actually had a mocking, eerie smile on her face.

After the carriage stopped for a while, it set off again.

Xu Fu didn't hear Lü Zhi’s voice again, and he breathed a slow sigh of relief in his heart.

The biggest pity was Lady Feng...

Lü Zhi was dead, but her life could not be recovered.

Xu Fu rubbed his temples, and Lady Feng’s smiling face vaguely flashed in his mind.

His memory... seemed to be flashing more and more frequently. Could he now capture memories without even having to dream?

Ying Zheng didn't notice Xu Fu’s abnormality. He fiddled with the manuscript on the table and said in a low voice, "Killing Lü Zhi wasn't just to avenge Lady Feng, right? What other reason is there?" Ying Zheng’s voice was very soft, and when Xu Fu heard it suddenly, he was truly startled.

Xu Fu pursed his lips, feeling that saying "no" was too deliberate, so he compromised. "I'll tell you later."

Let his memory recover. If, after his memory recovered, his body still possessed the memory of this experience, then he would choose a time to tell Ying Zheng. After all, these things couldn't be hidden forever. Telling Ying Zheng in advance was also a good thing; at least he would know who to guard against.

"Good." Ying Zheng responded, reaching out to pull Xu Fu over. "Rest for a while?"

Xu Fu nodded hesitantly, then leaned into Ying Zheng’s arms. The carriage jolted as it moved forward, and he fell asleep without realizing it.

On the rest of the journey, nothing else happened.

Time passed, and it was the end of the year again.

But Xu Fu fell into a deep sleep again before even stepping into Xianyang.

They hurriedly found a town to rest in. Fortunately, they had brought a physician with them, and now the physician finally had a chance to show his face. But he had only been there for a short while before being dismissed.

"King, this... the Shu Zhang’s condition is truly too strange..." The physician knelt before Ying Zheng, stammering.

Ying Zheng’s expression was gloomy, and he gave the physician a deep look. The physician immediately felt his legs trembling. The words he had wanted to say—that perhaps the Shu Zhang had just fallen asleep—were swallowed back. He dared not say them. And even if he said them to himself, he felt they were ridiculous.

Asleep? Who would sleep for so long?

An attendant on the side suddenly remembered something and hurriedly bowed. "King, when the Shu Zhang returned to Xianyang from the Chu State, didn't the person who kidnapped him say that the Shu Zhang had been in a deep sleep for several months on the road?"

Ying Zheng’s heart tightened instantly, and he couldn't help but clench his fists.

Was it like this?

Then, after waking up from this deep sleep, would he lose his memory again, or regain his memory? Ying Zheng knew Xu Fu had been trying to find his memories, but were those methods really effective? And what kind of memories would be awakened?

Ying Zheng felt his throat was extremely dry. He had to admit that he had fallen into anxiety.

"Go."

The attendant looked worriedly toward the bed and silently retreated.

Ying Zheng waited another day, but Xu Fu still didn't wake up. Ying Zheng had no choice but to keep him by his side and continue back to Xianyang. As his anxious mood accumulated, his state of mind gradually calmed down. In fact, nothing could be worse. Even if Xu Fu lost his memory again, the first person he would see when he woke up would be him. Ying Zheng could still keep him by his side.

Xu Fu remained in a coma all the way back to Xianyang.

When Hu Hai heard that Xu Fu was ill, he volunteered to serve him. Although "serving" just meant that while Ying Zheng was at court, Hu Hai would cling to the side of Xu Fu’s bed, whispering things no one could understand, and being particularly long-winded. Fusu came several times, intending to take care of him with Hu Hai, but was eventually talked away by Hu Hai’s chatter.

Not long after, Wei Liao also learned that Xu Fu was in a deep sleep.

He couldn't help but sigh. "...The set date is almost here."

Last year, Ying Zheng had asked Xu Fu to calculate a date.

At that time, Xu Fu didn't know what it was for; Ying Zheng just asked him to choose a good day, so Xu Fu obediently chose one. How could he have known that Ying Zheng had kept this date, intending it to be the date of their wedding?

But now that the "Queen" hadn't woken up, what was to be done?

Wei Liao’s heart was full of anxiety, while the other naive ministers were still full of joy, thinking, *Haha, I heard the King of Qin brought back a lady from the Chu State... to marry as his Queen...*
