Xu Fu was incredibly fragile; he would drown if pushed into a river, and the old man was the same. He was just as frail, unable to survive even a single night before passing away just like that.

When the attendant came to report the news, Xu Fu had only just risen and was still sitting at the table, having his breakfast.

Upon hearing the attendant’s words, Xu Fu immediately lost his appetite.

Having traversed three lifetimes, they had both been played by an old man, yet who would have thought that this old man was so fragile that he died at the slightest touch. He didn't even leave them a chance to properly torture or punish him. The anger that had been bottled up inside them just leaked away like that.

It was truly indescribably stifling.

Xu Fu pushed the cups and plates in front of him forward. "Take them away."

However, Xu Fu didn't stay stifled for long, because soon, Hu Hai came to find him carrying a stack of bamboo slips. The palace servants following behind him all wore bitter expressions, wanting to take the load from Hu Hai’s hands, but Hu Hai wouldn't give them to anyone. Once he got close, he dumped them all in front of Xu Fu with a clatter, then blinked and said, "These, all of these, I have already read."

The corners of Xu Fu’s mouth relaxed slightly. "Did you find it?"

Hu Hai looked distressed. "Not yet..."

"Then let's look for it together." Xu Fu patted his head and pulled Hu Hai down to sit properly.

The two sat together, slowly sorting through the bamboo slips in front of them. In truth, Xu Fu couldn't really focus on reading, but seeing Hu Hai so enthusiastic, Xu Fu naturally couldn't show any lack of interest. Both of them held the slips, and as they read, they gradually became absorbed in the task. Xu Fu actually began searching for records regarding that kind of rope.

When Ying Zheng returned to the hall, he caught a glimpse of the two sitting together, flipping through the bamboo slips.

The icy expression on Ying Zheng’s face eased somewhat. He strode over and sat down in front of them. "A-Fu, have you heard the news of that man’s death?"

Xu Fu nodded. Hu Hai hurriedly nodded as well.

Ying Zheng gave a soft huff. "He got off too easily."

It was indeed getting off easily. Xu Fu agreed in his heart. However, he felt that given Ying Zheng’s temperament, he wouldn't have let the old man off easily anyway. Even if the old man was already dead, it was highly likely that Ying Zheng would have had his body dismembered, ensuring he would never be reincarnated for eternity.

But seeing that Ying Zheng didn't bring it up, Xu Fu didn't ask further. Perhaps it was Ying Zheng’s instinct to spare him from seeing such bloody scenes, so Xu Fu would just pretend not to notice.

Ying Zheng turned to ask Hu Hai, "Did you find anything?"

Hu Hai shook his head cautiously. "No... nothing."

Ying Zheng wasn't disappointed; instead, when he looked at Hu Hai, he showed a hint of fatherly kindness. It seemed that keeping Hu Hai back then hadn't been a mistake after all.

"Life is still long, just take your time," Ying Zheng said.

Although Hu Hai nodded, his brows remained furrowed.

"Has Fu Su returned?" Xu Fu interrupted.

"He has."

Nowadays, Fu Su had already replaced Ying Zheng in handling many affairs; this was Ying Zheng openly delegating power. Having regained the memories of his past life, Ying Zheng no longer had the intense craving for power he once possessed. He had already possessed everything he should have in his previous life, and the only thing he hadn't attained was Xu Fu, whom he now held in his hands in this lifetime. Naturally, he wouldn't cling to power as tightly as he had before.

Moreover, the Fu Su of this lifetime perfectly met his requirements for an heir, so Ying Zheng simply delegated the power.

Ying Zheng was much more relaxed because of this, but Fu Su became increasingly busy. Although he returned to the palace often, they rarely had the chance to eat together.

"Then call him over; we shall eat together in a while."

Ying Zheng nodded and summoned a palace servant. The servant bowed and then retreated to invite Fu Su.

Not long after, Fu Su arrived. He strode into the hall and offered a respectful salute. When he straightened up, Xu Fu suddenly noticed that the current Fu Su already had a sense of upright elegance. He had grown taller, and when Hu Hai stood in front of him, he was completely dwarfed.

Only then did Xu Fu have the feeling that so much time had actually passed.

After Fu Su arrived, Ying Zheng habitually asked him about government affairs. Once finished, he tossed Fu Su to Hu Hai. Fu Su stood there stiffly, accompanying Hu Hai in flipping through the books.

Fu Su knew nothing about the old man, so seeing Hu Hai bring so many bamboo slips, he assumed Hu Hai was just acting up again.

The palace servants soon brought the food. Fu Su couldn't help but be startled. "We are eating here?"

"Yes, we won't stand on ceremony today," Ying Zheng said.

The palace servants set up the tables, which were arranged in a faint circle.

From then on, the atmosphere during their meals felt much more like a family.

In the days that followed, whenever they ate together, it was always like this. Of course, that is a matter for the future, and will not be mentioned here.

After the meal, Hu Hai grabbed Fu Su and headed out.

Ying Zheng picked up his cup, sipped some water, and asked in a low voice, "What were you thinking about just now during the meal?"

Xu Fu shook his head. "I just felt that it doesn't matter whether we untie that rope or not."

Ying Zheng was startled. "How could it not matter?" He frowned tightly, his eyes showing signs of being moved; he likely thought Xu Fu was trying to comfort him.

But that was not what Xu Fu meant at all.

He blinked and asked in return, "But that old man is dead, isn't he? Since he is dead, it naturally has no effect."

Ying Zheng shook his head. "I cannot gamble like that. Even if the old man is dead, what if the rope continues to extract your soul on its own?"

"As long as I don't die, I won't be reincarnated, and naturally, this cycle can be curbed."

Ying Zheng gripped Xu Fu’s hand tighter. He asked in a low voice, "A-Fu, although you will live forever, I cannot. When I die, what will you do?"

"Then we shall die together," Xu Fu blurted out. Only after realizing what he had said did he pause.

Ying Zheng suddenly felt his fingers twitching. He couldn't help but reach out and pull Xu Fu into his arms, holding him tightly. He gave a helpless smile and said in a low, husky voice, "Look, if you choose to do that, what am I to do?"

"..." Xu Fu was silent for a moment. "Didn't the old man say the secret to immortality lies with me? If we can't find a way to undo it, finding this is also good; then you can be immortal with me."

Ying Zheng only gave a low chuckle and said nothing more.

Xu Fu subconsciously clutched the robes at Ying Zheng’s waist. What was his true origin? Although he had memories, he wasn't powerful enough to know things from before his own birth. So who were his parents, and why exactly was he created? Why did he become someone who would live forever?

Since his first life was the one in the Qin Dynasty, he wondered if anyone in Guigu knew his background.

Or perhaps he should ask his senior brother, Wei Liao, first?

Xu Fu pushed Ying Zheng away and asked in a low voice, "A-Zheng, do you have any unfinished business?"

"Why?" Ying Zheng looked puzzled, not understanding what Xu Fu meant.

"If I cannot find out my origins from Senior Brother, then I will have to ask you... to accompany me to Guigu," Xu Fu said softly. "If we find nothing in the end, then I will have to ask you to travel across the Great Qin with me. At the very least, if I cannot have eternal life or a complete soul, I will grasp this remaining time."

"...Very well."

Ying Zheng kissed his forehead.

In this lifetime, he had no other desires. If he were to hand over the Qin Dynasty to Fu Su now, it would actually make him feel more at ease.

And he had never been able to refuse Xu Fu’s requests.

Two days later, Xu Fu visited the National Defense Minister's residence.

Wei Liao was sitting in the courtyard reading bamboo slips. Seeing the steward lead Xu Fu through the door, Wei Liao’s expression was somewhat strange, unlike before when he would joyfully welcome Xu Fu.

"Senior Brother, is General Meng not here?" Xu Fu looked around, and not seeing Meng Tian, he couldn't help but ask out of concern.

Who knew that after he said this, Wei Liao’s expression became even uglier. "How would I know?" After saying this, the way Wei Liao looked at Xu Fu seemed to convey four words: "Disrespectful Junior Brother."

Only then did Xu Fu remember that the last time they got married, Senior Brother Wei Liao seemed extremely displeased. But you’ve already taken advantage of General Meng Tian, so how can you abandon him now?

"Senior Brother, how... how can you be so mean?" Xu Fu couldn't help but say.

Wei Liao was so angry that his face changed color, and he huffed, "Are you looking for Meng Tian? Meng Tian is in the room!"

So, even though his senior brother wasn't very willing, General Meng Tian had still moved in.

Xu Fu decided not to provoke Wei Liao’s temper any further. He changed his tone: "Senior Brother, I came to see you."

Wei Liao lowered his head to read the slips and didn't speak.

This was a rare instance of Wei Liao ignoring Xu Fu. One must know that in the past, out of guilt, Wei Liao had always been very protective of Xu Fu and would grant his every request.

"Senior Brother?"

"..."

Xu Fu had to squat down and try acting spoiled with his poker face. "Senior Brother, I really need you."

Wei Liao almost couldn't keep a straight face. He stiffened and said, "What is it? Speak."

Even his anger lasted only a moment. Xu Fu sighed softly in his heart, then couldn't help but ask, "Senior Brother, do you know if I... have parents?"

Wei Liao frowned. "What kind of talk is that? Everyone has parents; don't tell me you fell from the sky?"

"Then who... are my parents? Do you know, Senior Brother?" Xu Fu asked cautiously, feeling unusually nervous.

Wei Liao shook his head.

Xu Fu’s heart sank instantly.

"I only know you were picked up outside the valley; I truly don't know who your parents were."

"Then how was I dressed at the time? Were there any keepsakes?"

Wei Liao said, "You were stark naked..."

Xu Fu: "..."

Wei Liao could clearly feel the disappointment radiating from Xu Fu, which meant he was extremely let down. Wei Liao couldn't help but reach out and pat the squatting Xu Fu. "Since you never asked before, don't ask in the future; it's better to be ignorant. How many people in this world don't know who their parents are? Do they not go on living?" Although he said this, Wei Liao couldn't really understand it. He couldn't figure out why someone with Xu Fu’s temperament would be troubled by such things.

And Xu Fu was also in a difficult position.

He didn't want to tell Wei Liao about such fantastical things; even if he did, it would only add another person to worry.

Seeing he couldn't find out his origins, Xu Fu could only fulfill the other purpose of his visit.

"Senior Brother, I came here to bid you farewell."

"Farewell?" Wei Liao was so startled that the bamboo slips in his arms fell to the ground, but he didn't care to pick them up. He grabbed Xu Fu’s arm and asked in a low voice, "Did you... have a conflict with His Majesty?"

"No, I just feel that being the National Master is no longer interesting, and it would be nice to travel the world."

Wei Liao frowned. "Is being the National Master not good? In the Great Qin, who can match your status? How can you be so willful and leave His Majesty behind?" Wei Liao had always had a bad impression of Ying Zheng, but at this moment, even from the perspective of a senior brother, he felt that their Emperor was truly pitiful.

Xu Fu was between laughter and tears. Was the bad impression he had left behind so deep? Why was Wei Liao’s first reaction that he was abandoning Ying Zheng?

Xu Fu defended himself: "I am going with His Majesty."

"Another tour?" Wei Liao finally breathed a sigh of relief.

"You could say that for now."

The expression on Wei Liao’s face relaxed completely. "That's good."

"But I don't know when I will return to Xianyang."

Wei Liao was startled. "What does this mean? Is this tour going to be very long?"

Xu Fu nodded.

Wei Liao felt an indescribable sensation. He couldn't help but say, "His Majesty treats you... truly, truly... too indulgently." Even now, Wei Liao still thought Xu Fu was just being too playful.

Xu Fu nodded. "I know." He knew how Ying Zheng treated him in this life, which was why he hoped that either he would face the end of life with Ying Zheng, or he would try everything to make Ying Zheng live forever with him.

Wei Liao nodded. "Then go." After saying this, Wei Liao couldn't help but nag one more time: "Be cautious in all things; do not be too reckless just because of His Majesty’s favor." Even at a time like this, Wei Liao couldn't help but give this advice he had repeated a thousand times.

But hearing it now, Xu Fu felt an indescribable warmth.

This was the care that Wei Liao could give him.

It was just a pity that he probably wouldn't see Senior Brother Jiang You before leaving.

Xu Fu said, "If Senior Brother Jiang You asks about me, I will have to trouble you to bid him farewell for me."

"Very well."

"Senior Brother, I shall return to the palace now."

"Mm, go." Only then did Wei Liao bend down to pick up the bamboo slips from the floor.

Xu Fu gave Wei Liao a faint smile. "After I leave, Senior Brother, you must not treat General Meng Tian as you did before. Since you are already married, you must take responsibility." After saying this, Xu Fu turned and left.

Wei Liao stood stunned, his mind constantly replaying that faint smile of Xu Fu’s.

It was no wonder Wei Liao was like this; Xu Fu had rarely smiled at him since he was a child. Seeing Xu Fu smile was like seeing red rain fall from the sky.

It was just...

Why did Jun Fang have such a tone? It always gave him a thick sense of strangeness.

But then, Meng Tian came out of the room, interrupting Wei Liao’s thoughts.

·

After seeing Wei Liao, Xu Fu didn't hide anything from Ying Zheng. He relayed what Wei Liao had said, and Ying Zheng just gave a faint smile after hearing it. "I understand. I will prepare the remaining matters, and then we shall leave Xianyang."

Xu Fu nodded, feeling relieved to leave the rest to Ying Zheng.

That day, Ying Zheng dismissed the alchemists in the palace who were refining immortality pills and announced to the world that these people were frauds! They were expelled because they had no real skills.

This didn't cause any waves among the common people, as they didn't know that their Emperor had been seeking these people to pursue immortality.

Afterward, Ying Zheng gave instructions to Fu Su and Hu Hai, then summoned the Meng brothers, Wei Liao, Yao Jia, and others to the court, assigning them duties while ensuring they kept each other in check. As for who was most trusted, it was naturally the Meng brothers, with Wei Liao added to the list.

Once everything was prepared, Ying Zheng took Xu Fu and left Xianyang with a light retinue.

Everyone thought Ying Zheng had gone on a tour.

Only Hu Hai cried and clung to Fu Su’s leg, refusing to let go when they left the palace.

Wei Liao didn't pay much attention either. Even if Xu Fu said he didn't know when he would return to Xianyang, he would return eventually, just like many times before; no matter how long Xu Fu stayed away, he would always come back to Xianyang.

He never thought that from then on, they would never meet again.

...

Within the territory of the Qin Dynasty, without the threat of people like Liu Bang and Xiang Yu, even if there were people like Chen Sheng and Wu Guang in the future, they wouldn't amount to much. It was rare for a talent of an emperor to appear in a century; with Liu Bang dead and Xiang Yu surrendered, there was naturally no one else. And Hu Hai, Li Si, Zhao Gao, and others were still under control.

At this point, all of Xu Fu’s worries dissipated.

To avoid a trajectory completely different from history, Xu Fu intentionally avoided the area of Shaqiu. He and Ying Zheng left Xianyang and headed toward Langye Mountain, where they had once lived. They would rest there for a while before heading to Guigu.

This time was different from the past. They had cast everything aside, with no large entourage, only Bo Zhou and A Qing following as attendants, along with two palace servants and a few soldiers.

Setting out, it looked just like the entourage of a wealthy family.

They soon arrived at Langye Mountain. They climbed the Langye Terrace, but in the end, they lived on the mountainside, dwelling with the common people.

They stayed there for half a month before heading to the next place.

The carriage traveled slowly along the way...

If they encountered a place with water, Xu Fu would cast aside all shame and have a wild encounter with Ying Zheng, which gradually became a common occurrence.

The desires inherent in humans were thus unleashed to their heart's content.

It often even gave one a feeling that the many years before were not as pleasurable as this moment.

Traveling like this, the weather turned to winter, snow began to fall, and they arrived at Guigu.

Xu Fu knew the location of Guigu, so he naturally didn't need anyone to show him the way.

But at this moment, Xu Fu stood in the heavy snow, unable to stop pacing in circles. His brows furrowed involuntarily. "It should... it should be right here..."

Ying Zheng grabbed his hand, rubbed it, and said, "Do not be anxious. Bo Zhou, A Qing, you go and investigate."

The two received the order and naturally went to investigate.

But they searched the entire area and couldn't find the secret entrance Xu Fu had mentioned.

At this time, the snow fell even harder, as if it were going to bury them.

"Find a cave," Ying Zheng ordered with a frown.

In such heavy snow, they had to find shelter.

But something even worse happened.

Bo Zhou and A Qing searched everywhere, but they couldn't even find a single cave.

The snow grew heavier, and everything within sight became a vast expanse of white. Xu Fu squinted and subconsciously gripped Ying Zheng’s hand tightly.

"Let's go, shall we look while we walk?" Xu Fu suggested.

That was all they could do now.

Ying Zheng pulled Xu Fu into his arms, and the group struggled forward through the snow.

Because everything in their line of sight was white, eventually, they didn't know how long they had been walking or where they were. They could only hope to see signs of human life soon, take a rest, and come back in the spring.

Perhaps because of their sincerity, they hadn't walked long before they actually ran into someone.

They hurried forward and grabbed the person to ask, "Sir, may I ask where this place is?" The man smiled. "This is Shaqiu."

This is Shaqiu!

The five words crashed into Xu Fu’s mind. He and Ying Zheng looked at each other, both in disbelief.

They had clearly tried to avoid Shaqiu, so how could they have stumbled upon it?

But this person had never met them and didn't know what they were avoiding, so it was impossible for him to be lying.

Xu Fu’s heart sank abruptly.

After answering, the man brushed off Bo Zhou and continued on his way. Because Xu Fu and Ying Zheng gave no orders, they could only watch the man walk away and gradually disappear from sight. The snow continued to fall.

In that instant, everyone felt the chill creeping over them.

It was too cold...

And yet, everything was still a vast white.

This could easily lead one into despair.

Xu Fu vaguely felt he had grasped something in his mind. He couldn't help but grip Ying Zheng tighter.

The group stood in the snow, letting the heavy flakes envelop them.

Gradually, they seemed to lose consciousness and the ability to move.

Xu Fu only had a sliver of awareness left in his daze. He instinctively leaned against Ying Zheng. Xu Fu looked up and saw the sky with snow falling in swirling flakes.

Was... was he lying down?

At this moment, Xu Fu was not afraid.

If he had truly changed everything, yet could not change the ending of dying at Shaqiu, then he would just die together with him.

Ying Zheng gripped Xu Fu’s hand tightly; in the wind and snow, his sigh seemed to echo faintly.

Xu Fu’s consciousness gradually faded.

If in the past it was always you who was devoted to me, now it should be my turn to be devoted to you.

Xu Fu closed his eyes.

The process was quite miraculous. Xu Fu felt as if he had been reborn. When he opened his eyes again, thinking it was all a dream, he found that everything in his sight was still a vast white.

Only Bo Zhou, A Qing, and the others were nowhere to be seen.

Then... what about A-Zheng?!

Xu Fu turned his head in a hurry, only to see Ying Zheng just opening his eyes as well.

Xu Fu breathed a sigh of relief and called out in a hoarse voice, "A-Zheng."

Ying Zheng grabbed his wrist and sat up, the snow on his body falling off with a rustle.

The snow suddenly stopped.

When Xu Fu looked at Ying Zheng again, he felt something was strange.

It was as if something about Ying Zheng had changed.

And Ying Zheng didn't know it himself. After looking around, he said angrily, "Where are Bo Zhou and the others? How could they be gone? Such audacity!"

Xu Fu could no longer care about such things. He couldn't help but reach out and cup Ying Zheng’s face, then slowly wiped away the snowflakes on it. "A-Zheng..."

Ying Zheng turned his head and met Xu Fu’s gaze.

"A-Zheng... you..."

"Me?"

"You have become younger."

Ying Zheng raised his hand to touch his face, feeling nothing, but he could vaguely see his own reflection in Xu Fu’s dark pupils.

Xu Fu was still young and handsome.

And Ying Zheng also seemed to have returned to his youth, his face cold, stern, and heroic.

Shaqiu.

Life after death.

Is not the place of death also the place of life?

Only after a new round of rebirth could one be truly immortal.

Xu Fu felt he had stumbled upon a secret in his confusion.

But none of that mattered anymore.

Whether they were dead or alive, he and Ying Zheng were together, and that was enough.

Love sprouted in his heart, stirring, and Xu Fu couldn't help but take the initiative to embrace Ying Zheng.

"A-Zheng, I think I understand what an obsession is."

This journey was exactly the obsession he had to be with Ying Zheng without any worries.

Xu Fu closed his eyes, his mind replaying the voice of Ying Zheng from his dream: Will there be a day when you and I meet, with no such grievances mixed in?

Yes.

Look, this is that day.

·

On the other side of the snow, the group was rescued and returned to Xianyang, but they no longer had any memory of that journey.

In the thirty-first year of the First Emperor, Crown Prince Fu Su, following the decree of the First Emperor, succeeded to the throne as the Second Emperor.

Summing up the First Emperor’s life achievements: pacifying the six states, unifying the world, standardizing currency, weights, measures, and writing, establishing the commandery-county system, promoting water conservancy, building the Great Wall... his power reached the four seas... He established the first centralized dynasty in history, and from then on, the monarchy continued for thousands of years.

These are all records in history.

For the First Emperor himself, his life’s achievement was only one thing: he once stopped before the National Master Xu Junfang and asked him to cast a fortune for him, and from then on, the Great Qin had an extra National Master. Hmm, and from then on, there was also an extra Empress.

It is said that there is an Epang Palace in history, built for Xu Junfang.

Do you believe it?

Author's note: Yes, the main story is finished! From having no outline to writing nearly two million words, I’m almost ready to kneel to myself. QWQ The soul-binding rope is actually useless here. But because this is from Xu Xiaofu’s perspective, it’s hard for him to notice, so both immortality and the soul-binding rope are written very vaguely. The side stories below will cover things a thousand years later, and at that time, after experiencing long ages, Xu Xiaofu will gradually understand what immortality and the soul-binding rope were all about.

After the thousand-year side story, there will be the side story of the previous life, followed by the stories of the senior brothers, Han Fei and Yao Jia’s story, the story of Lord Longyang who hasn't appeared for a long time but has always lived in everyone’s mouths, and perhaps Li Xin’s story will also be written. As for daily life, when I have inspiration, I will post it directly on Weibo. In other words, by next Thursday, all the side stories posted in the V chapters will also be finished.

chapters.title: 第277章 【番外】徐福东渡（一）
chapters.translated_text:
The heavy snow at Shaqiu came quickly and left just as fast.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng looked up, witnessing with their own eyes the sky before them change its appearance.

Xu Fu even began to suspect that the place they were in was nothing more than an illusion.

The sun rose, its golden light illuminating the earth. Xu Fu and Ying Zheng squinted in unison, and when they opened their eyes again, their vision cleared.

The snowy ground remained, but with one difference: a large expanse of messy footprints now covered the snow, including horse hoofprints and cart tracks. It was clear that a group of people had passed through here, traveling with horses and carriages.

Xu Fu pondered for a long while before asking, "A-Zheng, have you ever heard of illusions?"

"Illusions? What do you mean?"

"It is when a person is deceived by what their eyes see; what they experience is one thing, but what they truly see is another."

"Does A-Fu mean that we just experienced an illusion?"

"It is highly likely. Otherwise, how could these messy footprints and cart tracks have appeared?"

Ying Zheng pulled Xu Fu to his feet and frowned, "But if, as you say, illusions exist, then how can one distinguish between an illusion and reality? If it is difficult to tell them apart, wouldn't that be... bone-chilling?"

"If it is an illusion, there will naturally be things that defy common sense."

"Like how we traveled for so long earlier but saw no signs of human life?"

"Yes." Xu Fu sighed, "And another very strange thing—I hadn't noticed it at all until now. The golden crow only appeared after the snow stopped."

The golden crow, of course, refers to the sun.

When it snows heavily, even the sun is hidden, which is clearly contrary to common sense. If the sun cannot be seen, where does the light come from? Amidst the vast expanse of white snow, the pervasive white light seemed to have no source. Comparing this to the current environment, the unusual nature of it became clear.

When they were trapped in the illusion, others were trapped as well. They could not see one another, so when those people were rescued, no one noticed the two of them. Once the illusion dissipated, those people left, and Xu Fu and Ying Zheng saw the sun and the traces left behind on the snow.

Ying Zheng frowned, "Then what we saw before was also an illusion?"

Xu Fu knew he was referring to what he saw while in the cold, as if on the verge of death. Xu Fu examined him carefully, shook his head, and said in a low voice, "No." Ying Zheng’s appearance had truly changed.

It was just that Xu Fu could not understand why immortality would be gifted to Ying Zheng in such a manner.

After the illusion vanished, was this still Shaqiu?

While Xu Fu was lost in thought, Ying Zheng had already taken his hand, "Let’s go. Let us walk out of the snow and see what lies ahead."

Xu Fu nodded, allowing Ying Zheng to lead him forward.

As they walked further, they soon saw human figures, and in the distance, the faint outline of a city could be glimpsed.

Ying Zheng strode forward and blocked the path of a passerby.

The man was truly startled; he stared blankly at Ying Zheng, his face showing fear.

Ying Zheng was much taller than him, and his mere presence was intimidating. The man could not help but feel afraid, "W-what are you doing? Are you... are you robbing me?"

Ying Zheng frowned, never imagining that one day he would be mistaken for a common robber.

Xu Fu coughed lightly and had to step forward to replace Ying Zheng. Although Xu Fu’s expression was colder, his appearance did not naturally give off an aggressive vibe, nor did he carry such intense pressure, making him the most suitable for asking questions.

Seeing Xu Fu, the man stopped resisting and instead widened his eyes, asking enthusiastically, "W-what do you want?"

Ying Zheng watched from the side, feeling extremely annoyed, wishing he could just shove this man into the bushes.

The joy of having just attained immortality hadn't even had a chance to spread before this man ruined it.

"Where is this place?" Xu Fu asked.

The man’s expression suddenly relaxed, and he smiled, "This is Shaqiu."

Xu Fu frowned slightly. Was this really Shaqiu? But they were clearly heading in the direction of Guigu (Ghost Valley), weren't they? As Xu Fu furrowed his brows, the man couldn't help but steal glances at him.

Xu Fu was still suspicious—surely they weren't still in an illusion, were they?

Seeing Xu Fu silent for so long, Ying Zheng hurried over to ask, "What is it?"

Xu Fu pointed at the man who was still peeking at him, "Beat him up."

Ying Zheng sneered, "Perfect!" He had wanted to do just that. As he spoke, he strode forward and grabbed the man by the collar.

The man was terrified, his speech becoming involuntarily stuttered, "W-w-what are you doing? You want to hit someone? You really are robbers!" By the end, his voice had changed pitch.

"You lied to us. This is not Shaqiu; I remember clearly that this is Qi County."

Qi County was where Guigu was located.

The man stammered in defense, "W-what Qi County? This really is Shaqiu, I... I didn't lie to you... Qi County and Shaqiu are in completely different directions... Why would I lie to you?"

The man’s reactions were too vivid and flexible; it really didn't seem like something an illusion could create.

Moreover, he was right. Looking at it from the perspective of later generations, Shaqiu was in Hebei, while the other Guigu was in Henan—weren't they in completely different directions?

That could only mean that from the very beginning, they had been misled into heading toward Shaqiu.

Thinking about it, Xu Fu felt a chill run down his spine. It was as if a great hand of fate had easily toyed with and altered the course of their lives.

"C-can you let go now?" The man raised his hands to carefully pry at Ying Zheng’s grip, looking as if he were about to cry.

Ying Zheng really didn't want him to actually cry and get tears all over his hands.

So, Ying Zheng let go with a look of disgust, "You may go."

The man nodded and hurried away.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng watched him leave, then looked at each other. Ying Zheng said helplessly, "Let’s go."

Xu Fu nodded, and the two entered the city together.

Once inside, they confirmed that this was indeed Shaqiu.

And after speaking with several people in the city, Xu Fu was fully convinced that they had indeed exited the illusion.

Only after they settled into an inn did a deep sense of unreality slowly rise in their hearts.

They had spent a lifetime seeking it in that previous life, and had longed for it for so long in this one, yet they never expected that immortality would come so difficultly, and yet so easily.

Xu Fu was truly tired.

Recalling the feeling of being on the verge of death in the snow, he still felt a chill.

Xu Fu pulled the quilt up and lay flat on the inn’s bed. The warmth of the quilt felt wonderful. Just as he was about to drift off, he suddenly remembered something and snapped his eyes open, "A-Zheng, when are we returning to Xianyang?"

Ying Zheng opened his eyes, looking quite alert; it seemed he hadn't been asleep at all.

He said very calmly, "There is no need to return."

Xu Fu was stunned, "Why?"

"Long before I left Xianyang, I left instructions for Fusu. If you and I disappeared, it would be his time to ascend as the Second Emperor. Since we went missing in the snow, Fusu should have received the news by now."

Xu Fu was stunned again. He hadn't expected Ying Zheng to have considered such consequences. From the moment he agreed to leave with him, Ying Zheng had already prepared for the worst.

Xu Fu couldn't help but be moved. He turned over unconsciously and leaned against Ying Zheng’s shoulder, "Then, from now on..."

"Don't you want to go to sea?"

Xu Fu’s heart beat a little faster, and he nodded.

"Then we shall go to sea and search for the Immortal Mountain." Ying Zheng pursed his lips and reached out to cover Xu Fu’s cheek, "Only this time, there are no three thousand boys and girls—only me."

Xu Fu also pursed his lips and whispered, "You alone are worth more than three thousand."

A smile appeared on Ying Zheng’s face, and he couldn't help but reach out and pull Xu Fu tightly into his arms.

Since his obsession from his past life had been fulfilled, he would take Xu Fu to do everything he wanted to do. Searching for the Immortal Mountain was to fulfill Xu Fu’s wish, to understand what immortality really was, and to see for himself if such a thing as an Immortal Mountain truly existed in this world.

"Sleep now." Ying Zheng patted Xu Fu’s forehead gently.

Xu Fu said nothing, simply closing his eyes. The cold he had felt in the snow had completely left him.

The next day, after waking up, they left that place and headed toward the coastal region.

Just as history recorded.

Xu Fu did indeed sail to the East.

Only this time, they traveled on a large ship, employing many laborers who made their living on the water. And this time, there were no boys and girls on board, only Ying Zheng accompanying him.

The large ship sailed on the ocean for several months.

They searched for that aimless Immortal Mountain, but neither felt discouraged.

The ship was well-stocked with food; if they still couldn't find it, they would have plenty of time to return.

Xu Fu stood at the bow, occasionally looking into the distance.

He certainly didn't want to go off course and end up in Japan.

Several months later, one morning, everyone woke from their sleep to find the ship had come to a standstill. No matter how the sailors urged it, the ship refused to move forward. The hoisted sails would not billow. They seemed to have entered a stagnant space; there was no sea breeze brushing against their cheeks, and naturally, there was nothing to push the large ship.

Ying Zheng immediately ordered a small boat to be lowered, then took Xu Fu onto it and rowed. After only a few strokes, everyone on the small boat saw ahead of them clouds and mist swirling, shadows flickering, and amidst the flowing auspicious clouds, the outline of a mountain seemed to emerge. The mountain was lush and green, appearing on the sea surface, giving the impression of a mirage.

Xu Fu gazed at the mountain, feeling somewhat dazed.

Was there... really an Immortal Mountain?
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 277: [Extra] Xu Fu’s Voyage to the East (I)
chapters.source_text:
沙丘的这一场大雪，来得快，去得也快。
徐福和嬴政扬起头，亲眼看着眼前的天空变了模样。
徐福甚至怀疑，他们所处之地不过是幻境。
日出了，金光照射大地，徐福和嬴政不约而同地眯了眯眼，等到再睁开眼之后，徐福和嬴政眼前的视线就清明起来了。
雪地还是那片雪地，只不同的是，雪地上多出一大片凌乱的脚印，其中甚至还有马蹄印和车辙印。可想而知，这里走过了一行人，他们有马有车。
徐福沉吟半晌，不由得道：“阿政听说过幻境么？”
“幻境？何解？”
“也就是人被眼睛里看到的画面所欺骗，他实际上经历的是一回事，而真正见到的是另一回事。”
“阿福的意思是，方才我们经历了一番幻境？”
“极有可能，不然这些乱七八糟的脚印车辙印，是如何出来的呢？”
嬴政揽着徐福站起身来，皱眉道：“可若是如你所说，有幻境的存在，那么人有如何分辨幻境与现实呢？若是难以分辨清楚，那岂不是……会令人毛骨悚然吗？”
“若为幻境，那自然有与常理不同的地方。”
“比如之前我们行了许久，却见不到人烟吗？”
“嗯。”徐福叹了口气，“还有很奇怪的一点，方才我竟是半点不曾发觉。金乌是从雪停了之后才出现的。”
金乌，自是指太阳。
下大雪的时候，连太阳都不见，这显然是不大符合常理的。若是见不着太阳，那光从何处来？一片白雪皑皑之中，那漫天的白光竟是找不到光源。再对比如今四周的环境，便可见不寻常之处。
在他们陷入幻境的时候，其他人也陷入了幻境，他们彼此看不见彼此，于是那些人被救走的时候，没有人发现他们俩。等到幻境消失，那些人离开了这里，而徐福和嬴政也看见了太阳，看见了雪地上遗留下的痕迹。
嬴政皱眉，“那我们之前所见，也是幻觉了？”
徐福知道他指的是在寒冷之中，仿佛濒死的时候所看见的徐福仔细打量了他一番，摇了摇头，沉声道：“不是。”嬴政的模样是当真变了。
只是徐福想不明白，为什么长生不老会是以这样的方式，被馈赠到嬴政的身上？
在幻境消失之后，这里还是沙丘吗？
在徐福走神的时候，嬴政已经抓住了他的手，“走吧，我们先走出雪地，再瞧一瞧前方是什么。”
徐福点头，由着嬴政将自己带着向前走。
等他们往前走上一些，便很快看见了人影，再远一些的地方，还能隐隐瞥见城池的轮廓。
嬴政大步上前去，拦住了走在道上的人。
那人着实被惊了一跳，他怔怔地看着嬴政，面露惧色。
嬴政比他高大许多，往跟前一站便生出了威慑感。那人自然免不了心生恐惧，“你、你你们做什么？打、打劫么？”
嬴政皱了皱眉，全然没想到，自己竟有一日，会被当做打劫的强盗。
徐福轻咳一声，只得上前换下了嬴政。徐福虽然面容更显冷酷，但他的容貌天生不会给人以攻击性的感觉，身上又不带极强的压迫性，此时问话最合适不过。
那人见了徐福果然不再抗拒，反而还两眼瞪大，热情地道：“你、你要做什么？”
嬴政在旁边看得极为恼火，恨不得将此人直接摁到草丛里去。
方才获知长生不老的喜悦还没来得及扩散开来呢，就被这人给破坏干净了。
“此处位于何地？”徐福问道。
那人神色陡然轻松下来，笑道：“这里便是沙丘了。”
徐福微微拧眉，这里果然是沙丘吗？可他们分明是朝着鬼谷的方向而去的啊？徐福微微拧眉的时候。那人已经忍不住偷看起徐福了。
徐福心中还在疑惑，总不至于此时还在幻境之中吧？
嬴政见徐福久久不语，忙上前来问：“怎么了？”
徐福一指那个还在偷看自己的人，“揍他一顿。”
嬴政冷笑一声，“正好！”他方才就想揍了。嬴政说着大步上前揪住了那人的衣领。
那人大惊失色，连说话都不自觉地跟着结巴了起来，“你你你们要做什么？你们要打人？你们真是强盗！”到后头，那人的声音更是变了调。
“你骗了我们，这里不是沙丘，我记得这里明明是淇县。”
淇县，便是鬼谷所在的地方。
那人结结巴巴地辩驳，“什、什么淇县？这里真是沙丘，我、我没骗你们……淇县和沙丘两个方向全然不同啊……我作什么要骗你们？”
这人表现得太过生动灵活，实在不像是幻境能制造出来的。
而且他说的也不错，换在后世来看，那沙丘是在河北，而另一个鬼谷却是在河南，可不是方向全然不同么？
那也只有说明，从一开始他们就受误导，开始往着沙丘的方向来了。
想一想，徐福还真觉得有几分毛骨悚然。就像是有一双命运的大手，轻而易举地拨弄着改掉了他们的人生命运。
“你、你可以松手了吗？”那人抬手小心地去拨嬴政的手，一脸快要哭出来的模样。
嬴政实在不希望他真哭出来，待会儿还流自己一手的眼泪。
于是嬴政嫌弃地松开了手，“你走吧。”
那人点点头，赶紧走了。
徐福和嬴政看着那人走远，随后相视一眼，嬴政无奈地道：“走吧。”
徐福点头，二人一起进了城。
进入到城中之后，他们更确认了这里的确是沙丘。
而在与城中多人交谈之后，徐福也可以完全确定，他们已然走出幻境了。
当他们落脚在客栈之后，心底才缓缓升起了一股浓浓的不真实感。
那一世求了一辈子，这一世也为之挂恋许久，但他们却从没想到过，长生不老来得这样艰难，又来得这样轻易。
徐福是真的有些累了。
现在回想起之前在雪地里濒死的滋味，他都还觉得一阵寒意。
徐福揽了揽被子，平躺在了客栈的床榻之上，被子的暖意让他觉得舒服极了，当他不自觉快要闭上眼之后，徐福突然想起了一事，他骤然睁开了双眼，“阿政，我们何时回咸阳？”
嬴政睁开眼来，模样很是清醒，看来方才便没睡着。
他很是冷静地道：“不必回了。”
徐福一怔，“为何？”
“我早在离开咸阳之时，便留给了扶苏旨意，若我与你没了踪迹，便是他承二世之位的时候。我们在雪地中失踪，想来扶苏也该收到消息了。”
徐福再次怔住，他没想到嬴政连这样的后果都考虑好了，所以从他答应自己要一同出门开始，嬴政便已经做好最坏的打算了。
徐福心底不免有些触动，他甚至是无意识地翻了个身，靠在了嬴政的肩上，“那此后……”
“你不是想出海吗？”
徐福心跳微微加快，点了点头。
“那我们便出海吧，出海寻仙山。”嬴政抿了抿唇，伸手盖住了徐福的侧脸，“只是这一次没有三千童男童女了，只有我一人。”
徐福也跟着抿了抿唇，低声道：“你一人就抵得过三千了。”
嬴政脸上涌现了笑意，忍不住将伸手将徐福紧紧搂在了怀中。
既然他前世的执念都已经得到圆满，那便让他带着徐福去做他想做的每一件事。寻仙山，是圆满徐福的心思，也是为了弄清楚长生不老究竟一回事，也让他瞧一瞧，这世间，究竟有没有仙山。
“睡吧。”嬴政轻轻拍了拍徐福的额头。
徐福没说话，只是闭上了眼，之前在雪地里所感受到的寒冷，已经彻底离他远去了。
第二日醒来后，他们便离开了这处，朝着沿海地区而去。
正如历史所记载的一样。
徐福还是东渡去了。
只是这一次，他们乘坐的乃是大船，大船之上雇佣了不少以水为生的雇工。而这一次，船上也没有什么童男童女，唯嬴政相伴之。
大船在海上航行了数月。
他们寻着那漫无目的的仙山，但是谁都并不沮丧。
船上储存的食物足够多，若是依旧寻不着，他们返航都还来得及。
徐福站在船头，偶尔会看向远方。
他可不希望偏离航线，真到日本去了。
如此数月之后，一日清晨，众人从睡梦中醒来，却见船停滞不前了。不管船工如何驱使，船都不肯再前进。扬起的帆鼓不起来了。他们仿佛进入了一块停滞的空间，没有刮过脸颊的海风，自然也就推不动这艘大船。
嬴政当即令人放下小船，而后带着徐福上了小船，以桨划之，没有多少下，小船上的众人，便见前方，云雾缭绕，影影憧憧，祥云流动之间，似乎露出了山的轮廓，那山十分青翠，出现在海面之上，竟给人以海市蜃楼之感。
徐福望着那山，有些怔忡。
还……真有仙山？

徐福初以为，那仙山便真如海市蜃楼一般，看得见，却怎么也接近不了。谁知晓，他们的小船往前划着划着，还真就挨着了这仙山。
他们顺利地上了岸。
徐福看着眼前的奇景，忍不住发出了惊叹。
若是后世的魔幻剧和仙侠剧能照着这副画面来做个特效，那定然是吸人眼球的。
徐福和嬴政往前走了几步，很快便置身于林子之中。
“背后怎么没声音了？”徐福突然顿住了脚步，并回头去看，只是他什么也没看见。
跟随他们一同上来的船员，消失了！
但是这一刻徐福却并不惊异。早已经习惯了雪地之上发生的异状，现在再来一次，又有什么好奇怪的？
嬴政抬手爱抚了两下徐福的肩颈，低声道：“莫非他们无法上这仙山？”
“或许吧。”徐福倒也不担心他们，船上的食物储备充足，完全足够他们返航归去。这些人应当也不笨，不会拿自己的性命来开玩笑。相比之下，也幸好只是雇佣的人。若是嬴政从大秦抽调来士兵或侍从，这些人哪敢舍下始皇帝和国师而离开？怕是要生生等在船上捱死。
“走吧，我们便来瞧一瞧，这究竟是不是仙山。”嬴政揽着徐福继续往前走。
其实这仙山之上看起来，除却景色格外美丽之外，别的倒是与普通的山也没什么区别。
徐福和嬴政一路向上，然后见着了一座宫殿。
那座宫殿被祥云遮盖，偶尔方才露出完整的真面目。宫殿没有名字，只是在祥云之下，显得金光闪闪。
徐福二人也不犹豫，直接走进了宫殿之中。
进入宫殿，内里摆设竟与咸阳宫无二。
见状，嬴政笑道：“我想起来，我们离开咸阳时，我为你修建的宫殿还未完工，也不知此时如何了，怕是要便宜扶苏那小子用来装妃嫔了。”
徐福关注的重点自然不在后半句。他记得自己之前与嬴政说过，不要再建什么宫殿，徐福真不想日后以这样的方式上历史。他记得那一世，就有个阿房宫，这一世不会还有吧？
徐福目光灼灼地盯着嬴政，步子也不往前挪动了。
嬴政装作若无其事地和他对上了目光，“阿福，怎了？”
“你还是修建了阿房宫？”徐福眯起眼，语气有些危险。
“是。”嬴政斩钉截铁地承认了，而后又语气温和，甚至近乎温柔地道：“便当做是圆我一个梦啊。”
“什么梦？”
嬴政理直气壮地道：“那一世想要将你锁在阿房宫的美梦。”
徐福嘴角一抽，“那现在你也没机会实现了。”
嬴政道：“无事，毕竟在我心中你最为重要。”
徐福：“……”嬴政说情话怎么越来越溜了呢？是他的错觉吗？
徐福抬脚便往里走，嬴政紧跟上来，低声道：“其实若能与你住在此处，倒也算是圆满了。”
徐福穿过一道门，进入了后面的大殿，然后见到了满大殿的书。
而且更令人觉得奇异的是，这里的书，虽有竹简，但也多有纸质的书，这可实在像是后世才会有的东西了。
徐福快步走上前去，只是心念一动，上面的书便自动飘了下来，且悬浮在徐福的跟前，好方便他抓住。
嬴政在其后都不由得露出了惊异的表情。
“这也是……书？”嬴政走上前，将那些装订精美的书打开了。
“嗯。”徐福将书交到了他的手中，而后又拿了一本下来。
只见那书上，用简体字书写着“成神手札”。
徐福有些无语。这怎么就跟外面地摊上忽悠人的那样不靠谱。
他又取下几本，这几本的名字也大都是《炼丹100天速成》《问道》《巫蛊之术》《咒语大全》《教你如何成功筑基》《灵植宝鉴》……
其种类繁多，简直让徐福看得眼花缭乱，却又觉得好气又好笑。
这些跟后世一些胡扯出来的励志书籍有什么区别？
比如什么《教你如何摆脱拖延症》《100天速成写作法》……
仙山的神秘登时就被这摞书给毁了个一干二净。
“这些书有些意思，竟是有些像之前郑有安留下的手札上的字。阿福，你会认对吗？”
徐福点头，也不掩藏，毕竟他早就和嬴政说过他来自后世了。
“这是后世统一使用的字体。”
“原来如此，笔画减少了，看上去是要清爽许多，下笔写的时候，定然也轻省不少。”嬴政看着上面的字体发出了惊叹声。
他却不知，后世的人，看着在他手底下统一的篆体，也发出了这样的惊叹，认为古人的智慧实在太高了。
他们暂且放下书，又继续往后走。
这一走，徐福便发现了书房，炼丹房等地，甚至还有一个屋子专门被开辟出来作洗浴用。
这山上的温泉被引入了屋子，在那浴池之中泡上一泡，定然分外舒适。
在宫殿之后，徐福还见到了圈出来的两片地，一片种有果蔬，一片种有灵药。
而这个园子上用简体字书写“灵植园”三个金光闪闪的大字。
“此处着实神奇。”徐福忍不住再度发出了赞叹声。
嬴政微微一笑，“既是仙家福地，不如我与阿福便住于此吧。”
徐福也觉得这个地方很好，但听嬴政这样说起，他却是有些迟疑。毕竟此时他们初到此地，一切都是新鲜的，神奇的。但谁又能忍受在这样的地方一直待下去呢？待在此地，便真如隐居山林一般了。而且这里还不能轻易离开。
“且不说其它，阿福，你现在回去再看一看，怕是船都已经走了。”
“……”徐福全然没想到这一点，此时听嬴政提醒，他才骤然想了起来。
那如今，他们是不留也得留了？
徐福迅速调整了一下心态，仔细将此处打量一番，“灵气十足，是个好地方。”
嬴政哈哈一笑，“有阿福在的地方，便是好地方。”
徐福别过头没搭理他，但是耳根却觉得有些发麻。
两人又将整个仙山都走了一遭，消耗了不少体力，按理来说他们应该感觉到饥饿了，但此时徐福竟是没甚感觉。
难道入了仙山，连食物也不用吃了？
徐福总觉得嘴里有些不太自在，于是他拉着嬴政回了宫殿，采了些果蔬，又顺利在一个偏僻的小屋子里，找到了佐料。
这可真是奇了，仙山之上还会有这样接地气的东西？难道仙人也都需要进食吗？
不管仙人需不需要，此刻徐福和嬴政都不大习惯，他们都是还需要进食的。于是徐福洗净了手，开始准备做食物。只是徐福忘记了，他已经不再是那个从现代穿越过来的，自己亲手做过不少食物的徐福了。自打他到了秦国，便未曾自己动手过。
于是这时候做出的食物，有多难吃，可想而知。
待到食物做成以后，徐福和嬴政便一同做下来吃饭了，只是他们同时吃进嘴里，又同时吐了出来。
“味道不是很好。”嬴政神色怪异地道。
徐福臭着脸收拾了食物，嬴政见状，立即道：“那便我来吧……”
嬴政转身进了厨房，捣鼓了一阵子出来。
徐福将食物吃进去，没一会儿也面无表情地吐出来。
比他还难吃！
两人做得实在都不好吃。
干脆一齐在厨房里捣鼓了起来，若是连一顿像样的饭菜都做不出，他们还是早些离开为好。
两人一同在厨房里捣鼓了一整天。
往外看去，才发觉已然是入夜了，天空呈现墨蓝色，他们能瞥见天空之上闪烁的星，却唯独看不见月亮。
两人收拾好食物，便去浴池泡澡了。
渐渐的，两人倒也体会到了一点儿仿佛度蜜月的滋味。
第二日，嬴政陪着徐福下了山，他想要去看一看那山下的船还在否。
谁知晓等到了山脚，弥漫在眼前的却是一片浓雾，根本看不清方向，更看不见海。
那些船员上不来，他们又何尝不是出不去呢？
徐福微微拧眉，心头有些不快。
这仙山倒像是强制性将他们留住了一般。
嬴政安抚地摸了摸他的头发，“下山的法子，或许在那些书中有记载呢？”
“说得也是。”徐福抓上嬴政的手，二人一同回到了山上。
待进了藏书的大殿之后，徐福开始翻找了起来。只是里头的书实在太多了，哪里是一时间就能找得到的？徐福只得无奈地放弃。
嬴政瞥见他脸上的神色，忍不住道：“阿福不愿与我在一处吗？”
徐福一怔，“怎会？”
“可你这般……”嬴政顿了顿，低声道：“我是希望能和你留在此处的。哪怕什么事也不做，也是好的。”可不是好吗？那一世没能锁得住徐福，这一世可终于有机会了！
嬴政这番话，反倒说得徐福有些脸红了。
当然，他若是知晓嬴政此时心中在想什么，脸不黑都是好的。
徐福斟酌了一下语句，道：“我只是觉得，此处或许不大适合你。”曾经手握权势，身上压着无数朝政事务，一朝就能全然放下？何况这里没有半点娱乐活动，只能看书消遣……那岂不是更显无趣？
难道他真的错了？是他太以自己的想法去揣度嬴政了？
“你……不会觉得无趣吗？”徐福忍不住问。
“怎会？”嬴政眸色深了深，看向徐福的时候，总给人一种，缱绻和情色的味道，“有你便不会无趣了。
徐福：“……”
他怎么觉得有点不好的预感呢？
作者有话要说：　　从此以后，他们在仙山住了下来。
之后仙山日常就是：
#啪啪啪##再啪啪啪##温泉啪啪##灵植园啪啪##书殿啪啪##野外啪啪#……~\(≧▽≦)/~
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 278: [Extra] Xu Fu’s Voyage to the East (Part 2)
chapters.title: 第278章 【番外】徐福东渡（二）
chapters.translated_text:
Xu Fu had initially thought that the immortal mountain was truly like a mirage—visible, yet impossible to reach. Who would have guessed that as their small boat kept rowing forward, it would actually brush against the immortal mountain.

They successfully went ashore.

Looking at the wondrous scenery before him, Xu Fu couldn't help but gasp in amazement.

If the fantasy and xianxia dramas of later generations could use special effects based on this scene, they would certainly be eye-catching.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng walked forward a few steps and soon found themselves in the middle of a forest.

"Why is there no sound behind us anymore?" Xu Fu suddenly stopped in his tracks and looked back, but he saw nothing at all.

The crew members who had come up with them had vanished!

Yet, at this moment, Xu Fu was not surprised. Having already grown accustomed to the strange occurrences in the snowy lands, what was there to be surprised about now that it had happened again?

Ying Zheng raised his hand to caress Xu Fu’s neck and shoulder, whispering, "Could it be that they are unable to step onto this immortal mountain?"

"Perhaps." Xu Fu wasn't worried about them; the food supplies on the ship were plentiful, more than enough for them to return. These people shouldn't be foolish enough to gamble with their own lives. By comparison, it was fortunate that they were just hired hands. If Ying Zheng had dispatched soldiers or attendants from the Great Qin, how would they have dared to leave the First Emperor and the State Preceptor behind? They would likely have waited on the ship until they starved to death.

"Let's go. Let us see if this truly is an immortal mountain." Ying Zheng put his arm around Xu Fu and continued walking forward.

In truth, apart from the exceptionally beautiful scenery, this immortal mountain didn't look much different from an ordinary mountain.

Xu Fu and Ying Zheng headed upward and soon encountered a palace.

The palace was shrouded in auspicious clouds, only occasionally revealing its full appearance. The palace had no name, but under the auspicious clouds, it appeared to shimmer with golden light.

Neither Xu Fu nor Ying Zheng hesitated and walked straight into the palace.

Upon entering, they found the interior furnishings were identical to those of the Xianyang Palace.

Seeing this, Ying Zheng laughed, "I recall that when we left Xianyang, the palace I was building for you wasn't finished yet. I wonder how it is now; I fear it will be left for that boy Fusu to use for his concubines."

Xu Fu’s focus was naturally not on the latter half of the sentence. He remembered telling Ying Zheng before not to build any more palaces; Xu Fu really didn't want to go down in history that way. He remembered that in that other life, there was an Epang Palace—surely there wouldn't be one in this life too, right?

Xu Fu stared intensely at Ying Zheng, his feet no longer moving forward.

Ying Zheng pretended to be nonchalant as he met his gaze, "A-Fu, what is it?"

"You still built the Epang Palace?" Xu Fu narrowed his eyes, his tone somewhat dangerous.

"Yes." Ying Zheng admitted it firmly, then added in a gentle, almost tender tone, "Consider it fulfilling a dream of mine."

"What dream?"

Ying Zheng said righteously, "The beautiful dream from that lifetime of wanting to lock you away in the Epang Palace."

Xu Fu’s mouth twitched, "Well, you don't have the chance to realize that now."

Ying Zheng replied, "It matters not, for in my heart, you are the most important."

Xu Fu: "..." How was Ying Zheng getting so smooth at saying sweet nothings? Was it just his imagination?

Xu Fu lifted his feet and walked inside. Ying Zheng followed closely, whispering, "Actually, if I could live here with you, that would also be considered fulfilling."

Xu Fu passed through a doorway into the great hall behind it and saw the entire hall filled with books.

And what was even more strange was that the books here, while including bamboo slips, also consisted largely of paper books—things that really seemed like they should only exist in later generations.

Xu Fu walked up quickly, and with just a thought, the books above floated down automatically, hovering right in front of him for easy access.

Even Ying Zheng behind him couldn't help but show an expression of astonishment.

"These are also... books?" Ying Zheng walked up and opened the beautifully bound volumes.

"Yes." Xu Fu handed the book to him and took down another one.

He saw that the book was written in simplified characters: "A Handbook for Becoming a God."

Xu Fu was speechless. How was this any less unreliable than the swindlers at a street stall?

He took down a few more, and their titles were mostly "100-Day Crash Course in Alchemy," "Seeking the Dao," "The Art of Witchcraft and Gu," "A Complete Collection of Spells," "Teaching You How to Successfully Build a Foundation," "A Precious Guide to Spirit Plants"...

The variety was so vast that it dazzled Xu Fu, leaving him feeling both angry and amused.

How were these any different from the nonsense self-help books of later generations?

Like, for example, "How to Overcome Procrastination" or "100-Day Crash Course in Writing"...

The mystery of the immortal mountain was instantly ruined by this pile of books.

"These books are quite interesting; they actually resemble the characters in the notes Zheng You'an left behind. A-Fu, can you read them?"

Xu Fu nodded, not bothering to hide it, as he had long since told Ying Zheng that he came from a later generation.

"This is the standardized script used in later generations."

"So that is how it is. The strokes are reduced, and it looks much cleaner. It must be much easier to write as well." Ying Zheng looked at the characters and exclaimed in admiration.

He did not know that people in later generations, looking at the seal script he had standardized, also sighed in such admiration, believing the wisdom of the ancients to be truly profound.

They set the books aside for now and continued walking further in.

As they walked, Xu Fu discovered a study, an alchemy room, and other areas, and even a room specifically set aside for bathing.

The hot springs on the mountain were channeled into the room; soaking in that bath would surely be exceptionally comfortable.

Behind the palace, Xu Fu also saw two fenced-off plots of land, one planted with fruits and vegetables, and the other with spirit herbs.

And on this garden, the words "Spirit Plant Garden" were written in shimmering, golden simplified characters.

"This place is truly magical." Xu Fu couldn't help but exclaim in wonder once more.

Ying Zheng smiled slightly, "Since this is a blessed land of immortals, why don't you and I just live here, A-Fu?"

Xu Fu also felt this place was wonderful, but hearing Ying Zheng say this, he hesitated. After all, they had just arrived, and everything was fresh and magical. But who could endure staying in such a place forever? Staying here would be like living as a hermit in the mountains. And it wasn't as if they could easily leave.

"Not to mention anything else, A-Fu, if you go back and look now, I fear the ships have already departed."

"..." Xu Fu hadn't considered this at all. Only when reminded by Ying Zheng did he suddenly realize it.

So now, they had to stay whether they wanted to or not?

Xu Fu quickly adjusted his mindset and carefully surveyed the area, "Full of spiritual energy; it is a good place."

Ying Zheng laughed heartily, "Any place where A-Fu is, is a good place."

Xu Fu turned his head away and ignored him, but his ears felt a little numb.

The two of them walked around the entire immortal mountain, consuming quite a bit of energy. Logically, they should have felt hungry, but Xu Fu felt nothing of the sort.

Could it be that once you enter the immortal mountain, you don't even need to eat?

Xu Fu still felt a bit uncomfortable in his mouth, so he pulled Ying Zheng back to the palace, picked some fruits and vegetables, and successfully found seasonings in a secluded little room.

This was truly strange; how could such down-to-earth things exist on an immortal mountain? Did immortals need to eat as well?

Whether immortals needed to or not, Xu Fu and Ying Zheng were not used to it; they still needed to eat. So, Xu Fu washed his hands and began to prepare food. However, Xu Fu forgot that he was no longer the Xu Fu who had traveled from the modern era and had cooked many meals himself. Ever since he arrived in the Qin State, he had never cooked for himself.

Thus, one could imagine how terrible the food he made at that moment tasted.

Once the food was ready, Xu Fu and Ying Zheng sat down to eat, but they both took a bite and spat it out at the same time.

"The taste is not very good." Ying Zheng said with a strange expression.

Xu Fu cleaned up the food with a sour face. Seeing this, Ying Zheng immediately said, "Then let me..."

Ying Zheng turned and went into the kitchen, tinkering for a while before coming out.

Xu Fu ate the food, and before long, he spat it out with a blank expression.

It was even worse than his!

Both of them were truly terrible at cooking.

They decided to just tinker in the kitchen together; if they couldn't even make a decent meal, they might as well leave early.

The two of them spent the entire day tinkering in the kitchen together.

Looking outside, they realized it was already night. The sky was an ink-blue color; they could glimpse the stars twinkling in the sky, but they could not see the moon.

After cleaning up the food, the two went to the bathhouse to soak.

Gradually, the two of them began to experience a bit of what felt like a honeymoon.

The next day, Ying Zheng accompanied Xu Fu down the mountain; he wanted to see if the ships at the foot of the mountain were still there.

Who would have known that upon reaching the foot of the mountain, they were met with a thick fog, making it impossible to see the direction, let alone the sea.

If those crew members couldn't come up, how could they get out?

Xu Fu frowned slightly, feeling a bit unhappy.

This immortal mountain seemed to be keeping them here by force.

Ying Zheng stroked his hair soothingly, "Perhaps the way down is recorded in those books?"

"That is true." Xu Fu grabbed Ying Zheng’s hand, and the two returned to the mountain together.

After entering the great hall of books, Xu Fu began to search. But there were simply too many books inside; how could he find it in a short time? Xu Fu had to give up helplessly.

Ying Zheng caught the expression on his face and couldn't help but say, "Does A-Fu not wish to be with me?"

Xu Fu was startled, "How could that be?"

"But you look like this..." Ying Zheng paused and whispered, "I hope to stay here with you. Even if we do nothing, it is good." And why wouldn't it be good? He hadn't been able to lock Xu Fu away in that other life, but in this life, he finally had the chance!

Ying Zheng’s words actually made Xu Fu blush a little.

Of course, if he knew what Ying Zheng was thinking at that moment, it would be a miracle if his face didn't turn black.

Xu Fu weighed his words and said, "I just feel that this place might not be suitable for you." Having once held power and carried the burden of countless state affairs, could he just let it all go in an instant? Besides, there were no entertainment activities here, only books to pass the time... wouldn't that be even more boring?

Was he really wrong? Had he been judging Ying Zheng too much by his own thoughts?

"You... won't you feel bored?" Xu Fu couldn't help but ask.

"How could I?" Ying Zheng’s eyes deepened, and when he looked at Xu Fu, it always gave off a lingering, erotic feeling, "With you here, it will not be boring."

Xu Fu: "..."

Why did he have a bad premonition?

Author's Note: From then on, they lived on the immortal mountain.

The daily life on the immortal mountain afterwards was:

#Sex##MoreSex##HotSpringSex##SpiritPlantGardenSex##BookHallSex##WildernessSex#...~\(≧▽≦)/~

chapters.title: 第279章 【番外】徐福东渡（三）
chapters.translated_text:
Xu Fu and Ying Zheng settled down on the immortal mountain. Every day was a repetition of the same series of activities: sleeping, waking up in the morning, reading, eating, and soaking in the hot springs. Later on, they began to experiment with what the books taught, so they added cultivation to their daily routine, and Xu Fu added alchemy. The only pity, he felt, was that the books on witchcraft and sorcery could not be given to Hu Hai. If they were given to Hu Hai, they would surely be put to better use in his hands, and Hu Hai would probably be very happy too.

Setting these thoughts aside for now, life was still fulfilling.

Spiritual food and physical food... well, never mind, let’s not talk about that.

The spiritual food was quite sufficient, which was basically enough.

As for physical food, their skills still needed improvement. Fortunately, sometimes eating simple fruits and vegetables was enough to satisfy their cravings.

As for things like the wild chickens caught on the mountain, they could only watch them scurry away.

Ying Zheng would lie through his teeth, claiming that those chickens might turn into phoenixes one day, so it would be a pity to eat them now.

Xu Fu was too tired to retort; since everything they cooked tasted terrible anyway, neither of them had any room to talk.

Because of the reading, Xu Fu taught Ying Zheng many simplified characters. Ying Zheng had an extremely strong ability to draw inferences from one instance, and over time, he could read easily on his own.

Ying Zheng could even use a charcoal pencil dipped in ink to write simplified characters, and his handwriting was quite vigorous!

On the immortal mountain, they had initially kept track of the days, but later on, they lost count. Xu Fu and Ying Zheng simply let go.

The so-called "living in the deep mountains, unaware of the passage of time"—this was likely what it meant.

By now, more than half of the books in the hall had been read.

After waking up, Xu Fu, as usual, threw on his robe and walked barefoot to the library hall.

Today, he found a very strange book on the shelf with a golden cover; when he opened it, there was nothing inside.

Ying Zheng had washed some fruits and, carrying a small tray, found his way to the library hall. Seeing Xu Fu frowning at the book in his hands, Ying Zheng couldn't help but ask, "What kind of book has stumped you?"

Xu Fu waved the light, fluttering book, "A wordless heavenly book."

After saying this, Xu Fu couldn't help but give it a look of disdain.

It was precisely because of this look of disdain that the pages suddenly rippled, and ink-colored characters began to appear slowly.

Xu Fu: "..."

Could this book actually sense his disdain?

Regardless of whether it appeared because he had disdained it, Xu Fu found a comfortable spot to sit down and began to slowly unfold the book to read.

Ying Zheng had no choice but to step forward and sit down, then held a fruit to Xu Fu’s mouth; Xu Fu would take an unconscious bite, and that was that.

At first, Xu Fu could still diligently take a few bites of fruit, but later on, he almost forgot to chew and swallow.

Xu Fu never expected that the answer he had been looking for was right in this book!

The more Xu Fu read, the more astonished he became.

After hurriedly flipping through the whole thing, Xu Fu was stunned for a long while before he came back to his senses.

Ying Zheng also sensed that something was wrong and had to put down the small tray, "Is there something wrong with this book?"

Xu Fu shook his head, but then couldn't help but nod.

It was rare for Ying Zheng to see Xu Fu like this, and he couldn't help but laugh, "What on earth is the matter?"

Xu Fu was still reeling from the shock to his worldview, his whole person in a daze, "Do... do you believe it? Here... this immortal mountain, originally... originally belonged to me."

Ying Zheng was startled, "What does this mean?" As he spoke, he reached out to take the book, but miraculously, once the book was in Ying Zheng's hands, the characters disappeared again. Xu Fu had to reach out and support the book for the characters to reappear.

Ying Zheng lowered his head to read along, and the more he read, the more astonished he became.

Why did Xu Fu have the ability to be immortal? Because he belonged to a certain type of person: an outsider. He had experienced more than just these three lifetimes; it was just that he didn't necessarily remember every lifetime clearly. Therefore, he had left behind the immortal mountain and the scrolls in its palace to remind his future self.

He was not guided by the rules of nature to follow the normal cycle of birth, aging, illness, and death. As long as no external force caused him harm, he could live forever, and even if an external force killed him, he would be no different after his rebirth.

Such an ability could be called heaven-defying.

And this ability to be immortal was like a skill firmly grasped in Xu Fu's hands, but he had never been able to figure out how to freely control it. Perhaps it was because once this ability was mastered, it would become extremely terrifying, which was why Xu Fu had never grasped the knack of it. However, after thousands and ten thousands of years, Xu Fu had finally caught a glimpse of something different, so he had recorded it in the book.

That old man was really not wrong.

If Ying Zheng killed him, perhaps he really could obtain immortality.

Because immortality was something that only erupted in a desperate situation whenever Xu Fu was on the verge of death. Including the time they were in the snow, the so-called illusion was actually something Xu Fu had unconsciously manifested in a moment of agitation; he wanted Ying Zheng to survive, and he wanted himself and Ying Zheng to survive together. Thus, he had achieved his goal unconsciously through his willpower.

And the scroll at this moment didn't clearly state what exactly immortality was. Did it have substance? Could it be obtained through other means? Nothing was known.

It only stated that he was the key to immortality.

At this moment, Xu Fu recalled the time in the snow and still felt a sense of terror, not knowing where a pair of great hands were or when they would appear to manipulate their fate.

Who would have thought that after all this time, those great hands came from him?

It was because his subconscious wanted something, so that thing appeared through an illusion. Then, he subconsciously wanted to find the immortal mountain, so the mountain appeared in response; he subconsciously wanted to be alone with Ying Zheng, so the crew members were repelled by his willpower and blocked outside the immortal mountain...

The more Xu Fu thought about it, the more complex his feelings became.

It was as if he had thought he was a weakling being bullied by a villain, only to suddenly discover that he was actually the sleeping Demon King.

It took a long time for Xu Fu’s brain to process such a massive shock.

After reading it, Ying Zheng let go and let out a long sigh of relief, "So that’s how it is." Now he could rest easy. In his eyes, it didn't matter who Xu Fu was, what his background was, or how many times he had reincarnated; he only wanted Xu Fu to be with him in the future, including all his subsequent reincarnations.

And Xu Fu gradually found some records about the past in the book.

It seemed that no matter which period he was in, he had the habit of keeping a diary to avoid forgetting things.

Upon reading this, Xu Fu discovered that a long time ago, he had no desire for life. After learning everything he was interested in, he would deliberately seek death, letting life start over from zero, which was how he found some fun in the days of immortality and eternal life.

Therefore, from now on, as long as he was careful, he naturally wouldn't need to seek death and reincarnation again. Things were good as they were now. He was too lazy to start over from zero with Ying Zheng again.

Xu Fu put down the scroll and said calmly, "That rope can no longer trap me." Although he was speaking quite seriously, after he finished, Xu Fu felt something was a bit off, like he was talking about a dog leash. He suppressed the strange feeling in his heart and continued, "Even if it could tie me, it could only tie me for three lifetimes."

So, in the next life, regardless of whether he reincarnated or not, that rope would be useless.

If that thing were truly useful, he wouldn't have reincarnated and lived forever so many times.

Ying Zheng’s eyes brightened slightly.

Whatever immortality was, it wasn't important; what was important was this point.

After all, the matter started because of him; how could he bear for Xu Fu to be harmed because of it?

He had been anxious for a long time, but he hadn't expected it to be resolved so easily in the end. Ying Zheng opened his mouth, but in the end, no words came out.

Xu Fu mistook his expression for disappointment. Xu Fu pouted and said, "If you don't feel at ease, I'll look through the old books again to see if there are any relevant records. We can create a new one that doesn't absorb souls, but only seeks to be together for every lifetime."

Ying Zheng was a bit stunned.

He hadn't said anything just now, so why did Xu Fu suddenly say such things?

Ying Zheng revealed a smile, albeit a beat slow.

Ecstasy almost drowned him completely.

To hear such words from Xu Fu was enough for anything.

"Okay," Ying Zheng replied in a deep voice.

Xu Fu closed the book and tossed it aside, "Where’s the fruit?"

Ying Zheng hurriedly brought the small tray to him and even picked up a piece to feed him, his service exceptionally attentive.

Xu Fu leaned against the tall bookshelf behind him, feeling extremely comfortable.

By now, all the troubles had vanished from his mind.

Feeling a sense of relief, Xu Fu didn't take more than a few bites before he couldn't help but lean into Ying Zheng’s arms.

Ying Zheng held him and began to eat the fruit Xu Fu hadn't finished.

The light from outside the hall fell in, casting long shadows behind them.

Perhaps in the days to come, they would focus on cultivation.

Perhaps one day, they would truly become immortals themselves...

Who knows.
chapters.source_text:
徐福和嬴政在仙山上住了下来。整日里重复着，睡觉、晨起、看书、吃饭、泡温泉这一系列活动。到后来，他们开始尝试书上教授的东西，于是每日多了个修炼，而徐福还多了个炼丹。他只觉得可惜的是，那些讲巫蛊咒术的书，却不能带给胡亥，若是给了胡亥，应该能在他的手中得到更好的发挥，而且胡亥也会很开心吧。
暂且抛开这些不想，生活还是充实的。
精神食粮和生活食粮……呃，算了，这个不提也罢。
就精神食粮就挺充足的，那基本就够了。
生活食粮么，二人技艺还有待提升。幸而有时候吃些简单处理过的果蔬，也能解一解馋。
山上捕捉到的肉鸡之类的玩意儿，就只能干脆看着它们溜走了。
嬴政睁着眼说瞎话，表示那肉鸡说不准日后还能成凤凰呢，现在吃了多可惜。
徐福也就无力吐槽了，反正都弄得挺难吃，也就谁也不说谁了。
因着要看书的缘故，徐福倒是教着嬴政认了不少的简体字，嬴政举一反三的能力极强，久而久之，他已经能轻松地自己进行阅读了。
甚至嬴政还能用着炭笔蘸了墨写简体字，一手字还挺劲道！
在仙山之上，初时他们还特意记了日子，到了后头，日子就已然记不清了。徐福和嬴政也就干脆放开手了。
所谓深山之中，不知日月，大抵便是如此了。
殿中的藏书到此时也已然被看了大半了。
徐福起床后，照例披着衣袍赤着脚便到藏书的大殿去了。
今日他在书架之上找见了一本很怪异的书，金黄的封皮，翻开之后什么也没有。
嬴政洗净了果子，托着一个小盘子，找到了藏书殿来。见徐福盯着手头的书皱眉，嬴政不由得问道：“什么书难倒你了？”
徐福挥了挥手头轻飘飘的书，“无字天书。”
说完，徐福便不由得嫌弃地看了它一眼。
也就是这嫌弃的一眼，那书页之上忽然间波动了两下，墨色的字迹开始缓缓展现。
徐福：“……”
这本书还能感受到他的嫌弃？
不管是不是因为被他嫌弃方才展现了出来，徐福都还是寻了个舒服的位置坐下来，慢慢展开书看了起来。
嬴政无奈，只得上前跟着坐下，然后一手拿着果子往徐福嘴边塞，徐福就无意识地啃上一口便好。
刚开始徐福还能认真地啃两口果子，到后来他差点都忘记咀嚼和往下咽了。
徐福没想到，他一直想要找的答案，就在这本书里！
上面的内容越往下看越让徐福觉得惊异。
匆匆翻遍之后，徐福呆愣了好一会儿才回过神来。
嬴政也发觉到了不对劲，他不得不放下了手中的小盘子，“这书有什么不对吗？”
徐福摇了摇头，却又忍不住点了点头。
嬴政实在难得看见徐福这般模样，忍不住笑出了声，“到底是怎么了”
徐福这会儿还在接受世界观的冲击之中，整个人都处于飘忽的状态之中，“你、你相信吗？这里……这座仙山，原本……原本就是属于我的。”
嬴政一怔，“这是何意？”说着他也伸手拿过了那本书，但奇迹的是，当这本书到了嬴政手中之后，便又看不见字了，徐福只能风跟着伸手，扶住书，书上的字方才又显现了出来。
嬴政低头顺着往下看，越看嬴政便越是免不了惊异。
为什么徐福会拥有长生不老的能力呢？因为他属于一类人，方外之人。他所经历过的不止这三世，只是未必每一世都能记得清楚而已。因而他留下仙山，在仙山的宫殿之中留下了书卷，以便提醒以后的自己。
他可以不受大自然规则的引导，进行正常的生老病死的循环。只要没有外力对他造成伤害，他就可以一直不死，就算外力将他杀死了，他重生之后也是别无二样的。
这样的能力，堪称逆天。
而长生不老的能力，就好像一项技能一样，牢牢把握在徐福的手中，只是他是始终钻研不开，如何自由掌控这项能力。或许是因为一旦掌控这项能力之后，就会变得极为可怕，因而徐福才一直未能领会到个中窍门。不过千年万年过去，徐福总算抓住了一点不同之处，于是他记在了书册之上。
那老叟可真没说错。
若是嬴政杀了他，说不定当真也能获得长生不老。
因为长生不老这个东西，每到徐福濒临死亡的时候，他才会在绝境中爆发。包括之前他们在雪地里的时候，所谓的幻境其实就是徐福一个激动之下，便无意识地幻化出来了，然后他想要嬴政活下来，想要自己和嬴政一同活下来。于是便通过意念，无意识地达到了目的。
而此时的书卷上也都没写清楚，长生不老究竟是什么样的东西，它有实质吗？可以通过其它方式得到吗？一概不知。
上面只写着他就是长生不老的契机。
这时候，徐福再回想当时在雪地里，他还觉得甚为恐惧，不知道有一双大手在哪里，何时会出现，然后来操控他们的命运。
谁知道弄了半天，那双大手就来自于他呢？
是因为他的潜意识里想要有什么样的东西，于是那样东西便通过幻境出现了。而后他潜意识地想要找到仙山，于是仙山受到感应也出现了，他潜意识里想要和嬴政独自在一起，于是船员们被他的意念所排斥，直接被阻挡在了仙山之外……
徐福越想越觉得说不出的滋味复杂。
就好像一开始以为自己是被反派欺负的弱者，最后却陡然发现自己只是沉睡的大魔王一样。
徐福的脑子好半天才从这样大的冲击之中，转过弯儿来。
嬴政看完，松开了手，他长舒一口气，“原是如此。”如此他也可以放心了。在他眼中，他不管徐福究竟是什么人，什么来历，轮回了多少世，他只要徐福日后，包括以后的转世都是同他在一处。
而徐福渐渐地也从书上找到了一些关于过去的记载。
看来不管是哪个时期的他，都有写日记以免忘记的习惯。
这一看，徐福就发现，在很久以前，他对生命没有渴望，待学尽了感兴趣的东西之后，便会刻意寻求死亡，让人生从零点再来一次，这样方才为长生不老、永生不灭的日子里找了点儿乐趣。
因而这之后，只要他注意一些，自然便不必再送死轮回。现在这样就很好。他也懒得再从零点和嬴政来一遍了。
徐福放下了书卷，淡淡道：“那个绳子也套不住我了。”虽然是很正经地说话，但是说完之后，徐福总觉得哪里有点儿不对味儿，就跟说狗链子似的。他压下心底的怪异感，接着道：“就算是拴也只能拴住我三世。”
所以下一世管他投胎不投胎，那个绳子都没什么用了。
要是这个东西真能有用，他也就不会轮回长生这么多次了。
嬴政双眼微亮。
什么长生都不重要，重要的是这一点。
毕竟事情由他而起，他怎么舍得徐福因此而受到伤害
心中一直提心吊胆许久，却没想到最后这样轻而易举地解决了。嬴政张了张嘴，最后什么话也没能说出来。
徐福将他这模样误以成为了是失望，徐福扁了扁嘴，道：“若是你觉得不够安心，我再找找从前的书是否有相关记载，我们改造一个新的出来，不吸魂魄，但求世世相随。”
嬴政有点儿呆住。
方才他可什么都没说，怎么徐福突然就说出了这样的话来？
嬴政有些慢半拍地露出了笑容。
狂喜几乎将他整个人都淹没。
能得徐福这样一句话，什么都足够了。
“好。”嬴政沉声应道。
徐福合上书，随手丢到一旁，“果子呢？”
嬴政连忙将小盘子托到了他跟前，还顺便拿了起来喂，服务异常的周到。
徐福靠着背后高大的书架，觉得舒服极了。
到此为止，所有的烦扰都已经从脑海中消失了。
如释重负之后的徐福，咬了没几口，就忍不住歪倒在了嬴政的怀里。
嬴政搂住了他，就着徐福没吃完的果子啃了起来。
殿外的光落了进来，在他们的身后拉出了长长的影子。
也许接下来的日子，他们便操心修炼了。
也许真有一日，他们自己就变成了神仙……
谁知道呢。
