Xu Fu felt that the King of Wei currently looked quite mentally challenged...

He lifted his eyelids and took the initiative to speak: "Since the King of Wei summoned me, is there a message you wish for me to convey to the King?"

Of course, that wasn't the King of Wei's true purpose, but since he had used that as an excuse, he had to at least mention it to keep up appearances.

"I haven't asked for the envoy's name yet..." The King of Wei pushed aside Lord Longyang, who was at his side, and leaned forward slightly. If not for the table blocking his way, Xu Fu felt he might have leaned right into his face.

Just thinking about it made goosebumps rise all over Xu Fu's body.

As expected, it really comes down to looks.

When Qin Shi Huang had pinned him directly onto a desk, he hadn't felt any sense of nausea, yet just seeing the King of Wei's face made his stomach churn with discomfort, let alone telling him his name.

Xu Fu glanced at the King of Wei coldly and said, "I am a nameless person, why trouble the King of Wei to remember me? An envoy is an envoy; there is no need to ask for a name."

Although the wording was relatively humble, these words were certainly enough to stir a monarch's anger.

It was just that the King of Wei’s brain was wired a bit strangely; even with Xu Fu speaking like this, he only felt that the beauty before him appeared even more cold and elegant.

A cold and elegant beauty is naturally different from others. Being unwilling to state his name and disdaining the favor of the King of Wei only proved that his character was noble...

The King of Wei had forgotten Xu Fu's status; first and foremost, he was an envoy, and an envoy meeting a monarch should always state his name. Xu Fu’s refusal was simply because the King was too nauseating.

Xu Fu glanced at Lord Longyang beside the King of Wei and sighed inwardly at the pity of it.

How could such a brilliant person be ruined by the King of Wei?

Lord Longyang noticed the gaze Xu Fu cast his way, his expression cooling as he calmly deflected the look.

"...Since that is the case, then I shall not ask for the envoy's name anymore." The King of Wei thought he was showing a gentle smile; he called for an attendant to place a cushion before the table. "I am deeply enamored by the envoy's demeanor, which is why I invited you here. I wish to talk with you through the night..."

Lord Longyang lowered his eyes to hide his disdain. "Through the night" was probably what the King of Wei really wanted to say.

Jianjia could not help but clench her fingers.

Enamored?

How could such words come from the mouth of a monarch? So inappropriate...

"Is the King of Wei not here to discuss the alliance?" Xu Fu’s words reminded the King.

A look of embarrassment flashed across the King of Wei’s face; he would always forget this matter whenever he saw Xu Fu.

A flash of inspiration hit the King of Wei, and he said, "Regarding the alliance, please have the envoy present the bamboo slips."

Xu Fu and his group weren't here to seriously form an alliance with the State of Wei at all, so where would they get bamboo slips?

However, this was nothing; Xu Fu started to stand up, saying, "Then I shall return to prepare the bamboo slips and bring them to the King of Wei."

The King of Wei was stunned, not expecting to have shot himself in the foot. He hurriedly said, "Ah, that is not necessary. Bringing them tomorrow will be the same." The King of Wei’s eyes darted around, and he called for an attendant, "Serve the food." He turned to Xu Fu and said, "Today, let me invite the envoy to dine with me. The envoy should drink heartily later..."

Just by looking at the King of Wei’s eyes, one could glimpse his intentions.

Jianjia frowned secretly, her hands feeling increasingly itchy.

While the King of Wei turned to speak with Lord Longyang, Jianjia stuffed a cloth ball into Xu Fu’s hand. Feeling the texture of the cloth, Xu Fu didn't even need to look to understand Jianjia’s meaning.

When ancients drank, they would raise their sleeves to cover their faces; he could just pour the wine into the cloth ball then.

The King of Wei did not know that Xu Fu had a backup plan, and was currently feeling smug, even imagining the scene of pushing Xu Fu down.

If Xu Fu knew what the King of Wei was thinking, he would immediately recall those witchcraft spells to place a proper curse on him.

It was unclear what the King of Wei said to Lord Longyang, but shortly after, Lord Longyang nodded.

Soon, food was brought up by the attendants and placed before Xu Fu.

The smile on the King of Wei’s face grew even more intense.

Once the food was served, the King of Wei repeatedly found excuses to drink with Xu Fu, attempting to get him drunk. However, Xu Fu’s ability to bluff was no joke; in a few words, he made the King of Wei drink quite a bit himself. After three rounds of drinks, Xu Fu’s cheeks were slightly flushed, though only from the aroma of the wine. The King of Wei, assuming Xu Fu was already drunk, wore a tipsy smile that made him look even more lecherous.

"Pour the wine!" the King of Wei shouted loudly.

The attendant hurried forward to pour wine for Xu Fu, but because he was moving in a panic, he tripped after only one step. The wine vessel naturally smashed against Xu Fu, soaking a large portion of his outer robe.

The King of Wei shouted sternly, "Bold! How dare you spill wine on the envoy? Someone, drag him away!"

The attendant was terrified, hurriedly prostrating himself on the ground and begging the King of Wei for mercy.

Jianjia’s eyes widened, thinking the King of Wei was incredibly cruel. To kill an attendant just for accidentally tripping, breaking a vessel, and spilling wine on a guest?

Yet Xu Fu sat as steady as a mountain, not saying a word to plead for the attendant.

From his angle, it was far too easy to observe.

He could see clearly that when the attendant tripped, it was obviously intentional. The expression on his face was even somewhat stiff, the fall was not fluid, and he fell so lightly—unless he knew beforehand that he would fall, an ordinary person would have fallen heavily.

Based on the attendant’s performance, Xu Fu easily guessed the King of Wei’s intentions.

He had deliberately ordered the attendant to soak his robe, intending to lead him to change it; perhaps it was during this change that something uncontrollable would happen.

Xu Fu sneered inwardly.

Was he stupid?

Why would he obediently follow someone?

The attendant was dragged away, screaming.

The King of Wei immediately put on an apologetic look, saying, "I did not expect such an accident to occur. The envoy and Longyang have similar builds; I shall have Longyang lead the envoy to change into a new robe, and then we shall continue the banquet, how about that?"

Xu Fu’s mind was not on what the King of Wei was trying to express at all.

His ears had automatically captured the two words "Longyang."

Longyang? Could it be *that* Longyang? Although Xu Fu knew little about the figures of this era, he knew of this person, simply because the term "Longyang's fondness" originated from him.

Xu Fu suddenly became curious.

He didn't know what fate befell Longyang in history, but based on his physiognomy just now, this Lord Longyang probably not only had a difficult life, but might not have a good ending either.

Having just had a romp with Qin Shi Huang, Xu Fu felt that he might eventually become a figure as famous as Lord Longyang.

He wondered if there would be a "Xu Fu's fondness"...

*Cough.*

Xu Fu hurriedly pulled back his thoughts, meeting Longyang’s face, which resembled that of a beautiful woman, and said, "Then many thanks." As he spoke, Xu Fu stood up. A wet robe was indeed uncomfortable.

Moreover, due to the attraction of like-minded people, Xu Fu had a bit of a favorable impression of Longyang. Furthermore, out of professional ethics, since he had discovered Lord Longyang’s impending disaster, he naturally had to tell him. As for whether Lord Longyang listened or not, that was none of his business.

Longyang stood up and invited Xu Fu out of the palace hall.

Jianjia pinched her palm and hurriedly followed.

The King of Wei was originally displeased, but then he thought that perhaps in a moment he would see two beauties passed out on the bed, and his displeasure immediately turned into joy.

There were few in the harem who could compare to that envoy...

I am blessed to be able to taste such beauty!

The King of Wei felt smug and couldn't help but laugh out loud twice.

Xu Fu walked with Lord Longyang for a while, eventually arriving at a small courtyard.

This courtyard was not even in the same league as the one where Consort Zheng lived.

This small courtyard was truly tiny, and outside there were only withered flowers and dead grass, giving it a dilapidated feel. Consort Zheng’s courtyard at least had carefully planted flowers, trees, rows of palace maids, and clean stone paths.

This courtyard looked almost like a deserted one.

Did Lord Longyang live here?

Or did Lord Longyang deliberately bring him to such a place to ambush him?

Xu Fu immediately became vigilant.

At this moment, a sound of footsteps approached rapidly. Xu Fu turned his head quickly to see Jianjia walking over briskly. Xu Fu felt a wave of relief; with Jianjia by his side, he shouldn't need to be so afraid. He trusted Jianjia’s skills quite a bit.

After Jianjia approached, she cast a cold glance at Lord Longyang, making no effort to hide her hostility.

Since they were no longer in front of the King of Wei, she naturally didn't need to fear anything.

Lord Longyang’s expression remained indifferent, as if he hadn't felt the hostility Jianjia was projecting at all. He walked forward, pushed open the door, turned, and said, "Envoy, please."

Jianjia said bluntly, "This courtyard looks so dilapidated, I must check for the envoy to see if there is dust inside, or if it will get into your eyes..." As she spoke, Jianjia walked in first. However, after entering, she paused, then turned back and said, "Envoy, there is no dust inside."

Xu Fu was curious about what she had seen, so he didn't hesitate and walked in.

He saw that there were clear traces of someone living there.

A bed, quilts, a table... everything was there, though it looked somewhat simple.

Lord Longyang walked to the side to open a cabinet, then knelt down to take out a robe. His expression was indifferent as he said, "My residence is simple, please do not take offense, Envoy. Why don't you try this robe?" As he spoke, he stood up and handed over the robe.

It was a cyan robe, which did not look particularly luxurious.

It was far inferior to the robe Qin Shi Huang had specially ordered for him while in the palace.

Wasn't Lord Longyang a male favorite of the King of Wei? Was this the treatment a male favorite received? Thinking about it, Qin Shi Huang had never treated him like this... Could it be that all men in the world were the same—once they got what they wanted, they became incredibly nasty?

Xu Fu couldn't help but frown.

Lord Longyang did not miss Xu Fu’s facial expression. He said coldly, "You see it now—those in the King of Wei’s harem live in such courtyards, eat such cold food, and wear such thin robes..." Lord Longyang sneered, "Can the envoy not see what the King of Wei wants? If you insist on accommodating him, could it be that you also want to come and keep me company?"

Lord Longyang’s words were truly unpleasant. Jianjia’s expression changed immediately; she stepped forward, ready to roll up her sleeves and have a fierce fight with Lord Longyang.

Xu Fu, however, was neither shocked nor angry.

Longyang’s words were likely said to him on purpose, right?

What did the King of Wei and Longyang whisper about earlier? It must have been to bring him here and then use some method to keep him here, waiting for the King of Wei to arrive, so the King could get what he wanted. But Longyang hadn't done that; instead, he used words to sting him. Was he just trying to anger him into leaving? Or was it that Longyang was truly unhappy and couldn't help but vent it on him?

Xu Fu didn't dwell on it.

He said unhurriedly, "I followed you here not because I was stupid enough to fall for the King of Wei’s trap. I came here for your sake, Lord Longyang."

Upon hearing this, Jianjia stopped her sleeve-rolling motion. Her expression was somewhat dumbfounded.

*This, this, this... is he trying to cheat on the King behind his back?*

Lord Longyang’s expression changed slightly, and a faint blush even appeared on his cheeks, but then he sneered again, "What nonsense is the envoy spouting? For me? What for me?" The blush on his face faded quickly, like a flash in the pan.

"You are about to have a major illness." After saying this, Xu Fu paused, then added, "I came specifically to warn you, Lord Longyang."

Lord Longyang laughed even harder. "You say I will have a major illness? You are an envoy of Qin, not a royal physician; how do you know I will have a major illness? Are you saying that you, Envoy, also possess the skills of a charlatan? Have you divined my future?"

Xu Fu was not angry, nor did he answer the question, but directly asked, "Does Lord Longyang come from a wealthy family?"

Lord Longyang was stunned, then laughed, "Is the envoy really going to play the part of a charlatan?"

"Before the age of ten, you were very mischievous, but after ten, you were often very quiet and no longer active, right?"

Lord Longyang nodded, "When a person grows up, they naturally stop being mischievous."

"Is that really so?" Xu Fu suddenly reached out to grab Lord Longyang’s wrist.

Lord Longyang did not expect such a sudden move, so he could only watch as Xu Fu grabbed his wrist.

"What are you doing?" Lord Longyang frowned in annoyance. He didn't know what the person in front of him was trying to do, but the other party was also extremely good-looking; could he be trying to take advantage of him? That shouldn't be it!

Jianjia, standing nearby, was also startled and stammered, "Envoy..."

Xu Fu forcibly spread open Lord Longyang’s palm and looked at his palm lines.

Xu Fu pointed to one of the lines and said, "Why did you change so much after the age of ten? Because that year, a major event happened in your family, the family declined, and you fell into a major illness. After the illness, you no longer had your former stamina, so you naturally couldn't be mischievous anymore. Not only that, but you had to struggle to push the family back to its former status. Is that so?"

Lord Longyang’s expression finally changed slightly, but he quickly pulled his hand back and said coldly, "It seems the envoy really has some skills as a charlatan, but why grab my palm for no reason?"

Xu Fu had already memorized Lord Longyang’s palm lines and didn't need to look again. He said confidently, "This major illness left you with some sequelae. Every year, when winter turns to spring, you fall ill and require precious medicinal herbs to recover."

"Why did I say you will have a major illness? It is because in recent years, you have paid less and less attention to your health, and you are gradually becoming less favored in the Wei palace. Under such wear and tear, that chronic illness is about to turn into another major illness."

Lord Longyang could no longer maintain his facade of calmness.

"You... why are you telling me these things? Just to warn me?" Lord Longyang’s heart was a mix of emotions. He couldn't understand why someone he had just met would be so concerned about him. Little did Lord Longyang know, it was only because of the rumors about him from later generations and his physiognomy that he had attracted Xu Fu’s attention.

"To warn you to be careful." As soon as Xu Fu’s voice fell, he heard noisy sounds coming from outside.

Lord Longyang’s expression changed, "The King of Wei is here!"

A danger signal flashed in Xu Fu’s mind. Without thinking, he grabbed Lord Longyang’s wrist and called to Jianjia, "Go!"

"Where to?" Lord Longyang was dumbfounded.

Xu Fu ignored him and turned to ask Jianjia, "Do you remember the way we came? Can we avoid the King of Wei?"

Jianjia smiled, "Naturally." Jianjia walked in front, leading Xu Fu and Lord Longyang out of the courtyard first.

Lord Longyang was a bit confused.

Why was he running out with the envoy? Why was he running? If he were caught by the King of Wei, there would be more trouble.

While leading Lord Longyang forward, Xu Fu couldn't help but frown. He always felt that Lord Longyang’s physiognomy carried an eerie air.

What exactly was eerie about it?

Xu Fu suddenly turned his head, "Lord Longyang, you know you will have a major illness, don't you?"

Lord Longyang was frank this time, "Yes, I have known for a long time."

"Do you not intend to make any preparations? When you get sick, you just wait for death?"

Lord Longyang nodded, "What interest is there in the King of Wei’s palace? Since life has no interest, death is not bad." His demeanor appeared exceptionally detached.

"What is good about death?" Xu Fu couldn't understand. If you die, you can't eat anything, you can't see anything. Death means you disappear. How could that be interesting?

"It is hard to survive in the palace; better to die early than late."

"What kind of twisted logic is that? Won't everyone eventually die? Should everyone just go die early?" Xu Fu let go of Lord Longyang’s wrist. If this was someone seeking death, he didn't need to say more. Today’s reading would just be him being a busybody.

It was just that his impression of Lord Longyang in his mind had been somewhat shattered.

Jianjia whispered a reminder, "Envoy, we have already brought Lord Longyang out..." If they returned him, wouldn't that create a lot of hatred?

Xu Fu also thought of another point.

"I heard the King of Wei favors Lord Longyang..."

Lord Longyang’s expression was slightly ugly; clearly, he did not like being mentioned in such a way.

Xu Fu also saw that Lord Longyang was very dissatisfied with the King of Wei. That was good; it wouldn't be going against the person's wishes...

So Xu Fu said, "It just so happens that I find the King of Wei extremely unpleasant, so I invite Lord Longyang to come with me and let the King of Wei be angry to death on his own." As he spoke, Xu Fu gave Jianjia a wink, "Take him away."

Jianjia nodded and took a package out of her bosom.

The three hid in a corner, and Jianjia applied the contents to Lord Longyang’s face and had him change into a different robe.

In fact, those things were just ancient cosmetics, but because they were somewhat crude and low-quality, the makeup was thick, and one really couldn't tell he was the same Lord Longyang as before.

Thinking of the palace consorts who wore these things, Xu Fu had to say, no wonder the King of Wei liked Lord Longyang; those consorts, once they applied this, must look truly terrifying—where would there be any desire to get close?

After the disguise, Lord Longyang became a tall woman, full of charm when he lowered his eyes.

Coupled with his fair skin, one could barely say... he was quite moving.

Xu Fu ordered him to walk by his side, and the three quickened their pace to the palace gate.

At this time, the guards at the gate did not know what had happened in the palace. Seeing someone approaching, they were about to stop them when they saw a person walk forward with a powerful aura and a cold voice, "I am leaving the palace."

The guards were stunned and hurriedly lowered their heads, "Envoy, please."

Who would dare offend an envoy from the State of Qin?

This must be the end of the banquet with the King of Wei... Thinking of how the King of Wei’s attendant had personally invited this envoy into the palace, the guards knew this was not someone they could easily offend.

Even when the guards saw an extra person beside the envoy, they didn't think much of it; they habitually assumed the person was the envoy’s female attendant.

Who would have thought it was the King of Wei’s Lord Longyang?

Xu Fu was very calm, Lord Longyang’s acting was top-notch, and Jianjia kept her head down, so no one could find anything wrong with them. The three left the palace without any danger, and outside the palace, a carriage was waiting. Suddenly, someone jumped off the carriage.

Lord Longyang was startled and hurriedly shrank behind Xu Fu.

Xu Fu looked at the person and called out, "Sang Zhong."

Sang Zhong’s gaze fell on Lord Longyang, and he frowned, "Did the King of Wei bestow this upon you, sir?"

Xu Fu lied through his teeth, "Yes."

Sang Zhong suppressed the urge to chase the person away, lifted the carriage curtain, and invited Xu Fu to board.

But Xu Fu pushed Lord Longyang up first.

Now that Lord Longyang was dressed as a woman, Xu Fu naturally had to be a bit more polite.

Sang Zhong’s expression became even uglier, thinking to himself, *A huge crisis! What to do? Won't the King tear us apart when we get back?*

Xu Fu and Lord Longyang sat inside the carriage, while Jianjia sat outside with Sang Zhong to drive.

Sang Zhong, while driving, asked Jianjia in a low voice, "Why didn't you help refuse?"

Jianjia shook her head, "Whatever the master says, that is what it is."

Sang Zhong looked at her with frustration, "You are still so calm? Aren't you worried that when we return to Xianyang, we will all face the King’s wrath?"

Jianjia: "...Uh, why would we face the King’s wrath?"

Sang Zhong met Jianjia’s confused eyes and felt even more heartbroken. Why did the master choose such a blockhead to bring along?

Unknowingly, the carriage stopped outside the guesthouse.

Xu Fu lifted the curtain and stepped down.

The people in charge of guarding the guesthouse hurriedly came forward to fawningly help Xu Fu down.

Seeing someone following Xu Fu, they were stunned, then praised, "Congratulations to the envoy for obtaining a beauty." They also assumed Lord Longyang was a "woman" bestowed upon Xu Fu by the King of Wei, and thus began to flatter him.

Xu Fu ignored them and walked straight in with Lord Longyang.

The man didn't feel embarrassed, but after Xu Fu had walked far away, he sighed, *That beauty is a bit tall.*

Once inside the room, Xu Fu turned around. He didn't have time to deal with Lord Longyang, so he just said to Sang Zhong, "Tell them to get ready; we are leaving Daliang tonight."

Sang Zhong was stunned, "So fast?" *Haven't we done anything since arriving in Daliang? Why are we leaving already?* However, Sang Zhong wasn't very curious about the reason; they just needed to follow orders. Sang Zhong asked, "When are we leaving tonight?"

"As soon as Li Changshi returns, we leave immediately."

Sang Zhong nodded and pushed the door open to leave.

The room suddenly became quiet, with only the sound of somewhat heavy breathing.

...Coming from Lord Longyang.

Xu Fu couldn't help but turn to look.

He saw Lord Longyang leaning against the bedpost, his face pale, breathing somewhat rapidly.

"Are you alright?" Xu Fu asked with concern.

Lord Longyang waved his hand, and after a long while, he said, "...I just never thought that the King of Wei’s palace, which had trapped me for so long, would be so easy to leave." He had truly thought there was no hope for him in this life, but the moment he stepped out of the palace, he realized that he had drawn a line between his past and present self. His heart felt empty, as if his original persistence and sorrow had been blown away in an instant.

He felt somewhat lost.

The King of Wei’s palace was not as hard to leave as he had imagined, and the King of Wei was not as hard to escape as he had thought. So now... was he reborn?

Seeing Lord Longyang lost in thought again, Xu Fu did not disturb him.

Originally, Xu Fu didn't like Lord Longyang’s world-weary attitude, but seeing his current performance, Xu Fu couldn't help but be moved. He had cast many divinations and seen many people—some lucky, some miserable. He rarely had major emotional fluctuations for other people’s lives because he knew that his eyes had seen so many people and would see many more. If he were to be sad or happy for every single one of them, how could he maintain an objective mindset to observe everyone’s fate?

Come to think of it, he seemed to have only one exception...

Only Qin Shi Huang’s fate had caused him to show so many emotions.

Xu Fu poured a cup of water and handed it to Lord Longyang.

His hand was a bit cold, and Lord Longyang shivered involuntarily.

"Are you coming with us?" Xu Fu asked.

Lord Longyang smiled, "Naturally, I must go. If I don't go with you, having heard so much of your conversation, wouldn't you kill me?"

Xu Fu nodded, "You are very smart."

Lord Longyang straightened his body and looked deeply at Xu Fu, "Thank you."

"Thank you for what? I am not a royal physician." Xu Fu used Lord Longyang’s own words to block him.

Lord Longyang showed a faint smile, "I also want to see how angry the King of Wei will be..."

·

Li Si had been visiting Wei officials for several days; did the King of Wei not know? He naturally knew. But he hadn't obtained any useful information, so he let it be.

Li Si brought gifts to their doors; officials wouldn't hit a smiling face, especially when the person was there to give gifts.

They hurriedly welcomed Li Si in.

However, the officials didn't expect that Li Si would start by criticizing the envoy traveling with him.

"That man is a *Taibu* (diviner) of our Qin State. A mere *Taibu*, relying on whispering in the King’s ear, was able to follow me on this mission to Wei... Look at his demeanor, as if he is a grade higher than me. But as a *Changshi* (Chief Clerk), what is he? He truly does not put me in his eyes! I find this person extremely unpleasant! But I suffer from having no achievements before the King of Qin..."

"Now that I have come to Wei, I am shamelessly asking you, sir, to work with me..."

"I heard that you, sir, also have someone in Wei who does not get along with you, and that person is even a grade higher than you. Now that our situations are similar, if we don't cooperate now, when will we?"

"Sir, please listen to me..."

"...With just a little provocation, that person will never have a chance to show his face before the King of Wei again."

"If you and I become allies, wouldn't that be wonderful?"

After Li Si’s combination of moves, the Wei officials were stunned, and in their confusion, they were stirred up by Li Si to take down the official pressing down on them and conspire with Li Si for the future!

Afterward, Wang Liu stepped in, pretending to tell fortunes and giving these officials prophecies, praising them and saying things like they would be promoted in the future...

Those officials didn't quite believe it at first, but Wang Liu could hit the mark on many things, so the officials naturally believed him. The two worked together and took down quite a few people.

After finishing, Li Si had Wang Liu ride out of Daliang first, and then Li Si drove back to the guesthouse.

As soon as he returned to the guesthouse, Xu Fu received the news immediately.

At this time, the King of Wei was still throwing a tantrum in the palace, completely unaware that his own corner was about to be pried away.

The King of Wei had no idea that Lord Longyang would have the guts to leave him, and he had no idea that the Qin envoy would have the guts to take his male favorite away, so he just ordered people to search the palace... The Wei palace was not small, so it took time.

Xu Fu, taking advantage of the time before the curfew, hurriedly took his people and left the guesthouse quietly.

By the time their group left Daliang, the King of Wei had just learned that after searching the entire palace, he could not find Lord Longyang.

The King of Wei was furious, smashing the wine vessel at his side and cursing, "Find him for me, and when you do, hang him up and give him a good lesson..."

The palace servants lowered their heads, not daring to say a word.

Ever since the King of Wei had grown older, his temper had become worse. In the past, Lord Longyang had been the one to bear such anger, but now that Lord Longyang was missing, it was their turn to be unlucky.

The King of Wei clenched his fists, "And that envoy... I must get my hands on him. Once I have him, since Lord Longyang is so disobedient, I will just bestow him to someone else."

The palace servants were terrified and felt even less inclined to provoke the King of Wei.

...

Wang Liu rode his horse out of the city and ran for a long distance before stopping.

There was no forest outside the city, only hillsides. With the shadows of the hills, his horse-riding didn't look too conspicuous.

Why let Wang Liu leave the city first? It was to meet them.

That day, Wang Liu hadn't been able to enter the palace with Xu Fu, and he had kept a low profile since entering Daliang. Although some commoners had him tell their fortunes, the city guards hadn't seen him, so they wouldn't notice that the envoy had run out.

Wang Liu waited for a while, feeling bored, and couldn't help but take out the cloth strip from his bosom.

That cloth strip was written by Xu Fu for him.

He still remembered the crooked characters Xu Fu had carved on bamboo slips, but the characters on this cloth strip seemed to be from a different person. When he saw them, he was even amazed—first at how much Xu Fu’s handwriting had changed, and second that he could think of writing on cloth, making it much easier to carry.

The content on the cloth strip was exactly what he had said to those Wei officials.

Why was he able to intimidate those Wei officials? It was all thanks to Xu Fu.

Xu Fu’s physiognomy ability was amazing; not only could it scare the people of Qin, but the people of Wei were naturally also taken in.

Wang Liu was completely unskilled in this, and using divination was too slow. If he just bluffed, it would be hard to gain trust. So before setting out, Li Si had specifically communicated with Xu Fu. Xu Fu knew which ministers Li Si was going to visit, so he recalled what those ministers looked like during the banquet.

After recalling, Xu Fu wrote the prophecies on the cloth strip and gave it to Wang Liu. Wang Liu only needed to memorize the prophecies and combine them with some bluffing to take down the Wei officials.

Now looking at the cloth strip in his hand, Wang Liu’s expression was very complex.

...Xu Dian-shi’s current level had become very refined; he was afraid he would truly never be able to catch up.

Such a wonderful method was truly amazing!

He had actually thought that by telling more fortunes, he could learn Xu Dian-shi’s skills. Who knew he was still completely clueless!

Wang Liu sighed.

Two carriages and a few horses approached from the side.

Wang Liu hurriedly tucked the cloth strip into his bosom and looked up.

The carriages drew near. Xu Fu lifted the curtain, and the first thing he saw was Wang Liu’s dazed look. He frowned slightly, "What are you dazing for? Let’s go."

Wang Liu nodded and hurriedly drove his horse to catch up. After the horse had worn out its butt and thighs for a long time, Wang Liu suddenly remembered that the carriage... also had a spot for him! As an envoy, he could sit too!

...

At this time, inside the carriage, Lord Longyang stroked the ornaments inside and said, "Qin must be wealthy..."

"You will know when you go."

Lord Longyang nodded, "If I go to Qin, may I trouble the envoy to take me in?"

Sang Zhong, who was driving, was startled and hurriedly lifted the curtain, "No!"

Lord Longyang tilted his head and glanced at Jianjia.

Jianjia immediately shut his mouth and lowered the carriage curtain. Xu Fu was the one in charge; regardless of the circumstances, he shouldn't have said such things.

Xu Fu nodded, "I truly have nowhere to house Lord Longyang." The royal palace was not his residence, and he had no authority to bring Lord Longyang inside. It was only then that Xu Fu realized that bringing Lord Longyang along on a whim had become a nuisance.

Xu Fu couldn't help but look at Jianjia.

Crouching at the carriage entrance, Jianjia looked back at Xu Fu with an innocent expression.

He didn't care about the consequences of taking Lord Longyang away.

...He only cared about taking the person.

At this moment, Lord Longyang said slowly, "Longyang has already left Daliang City with the envoy. Does the envoy now intend to take no responsibility at all?"

Responsibility?

Jianjia and Sangzhong pricked up their ears almost simultaneously.

Was Xu Fu someone easily provoked? No matter what Longyang said, he wouldn't be moved in the slightest. Xu Fu lifted his eyelids indifferently, "I brought you out of the Wei palace partly to see how your fate might change, and partly to annoy the King of Wei. But can you say that you didn't have a shred of initiative in your heart at the time? If I had forced you to come, I would naturally take responsibility for you."

Ever since entering the guesthouse, Xu Fu had felt that the aura around Lord Longyang was a bit off. Once they were in the carriage and Lord Longyang spoke those words slowly, Xu Fu finally realized where the incongruity lay.

The coldness, the aloofness—it was all an act.

This current appearance was likely the true face hidden beneath.

Whether that courtyard was truly Lord Longyang's residence was also open to question.

Lord Longyang sensed that Xu Fu's gaze had turned cold, so he nodded and said, "In that case, I shall have to find a place to stay on my own."

Giving in so easily? Xu Fu immediately felt that his guess must be correct.

However, it was indeed he who had brought the person out; Xu Fu wasn't so heartless as to take someone away and then abandon them.

Xu Fu pointed to Jianjia beside him, "If Jianjia agrees, Lord Longyang may stay at Jianjia's residence."

Jianjia was a bit dazed, never expecting that as a bystander watching the show, he would suddenly be dragged onto the battlefield.

Lord Longyang's gaze followed Xu Fu's gesture and landed on Jianjia, "Then I shall trouble you..."

Jianjia hesitated for a moment, then nodded.

He lived alone, so an extra person wouldn't be a problem.

Although Lord Longyang's destination was settled, Xu Fu felt even more curious and vigilant about this person recorded in history. Lord Longyang—"Lord" was a title. Only royal relatives were typically called "Lord." To be able to rise from a male favorite of the King of Wei to the Lord Longyang of Wei, he shouldn't be as one-dimensional as he appeared.

However, Xu Fu didn't know much about the historical records of Lord Longyang.

Even before coming to the State of Wei, he hadn't expected that Lord Longyang was the King of Wei's male favorite.

Placing Lord Longyang beside Jianjia was the most appropriate choice.

Jianjia and his three companions were all highly vigilant people; if Lord Longyang made any moves, Jianjia would surely notice quickly.

Xu Fu could be curious about Lord Longyang, but he couldn't let a Lord Longyang jeopardize Qin Shi Huang. So, it was better to be on guard.

Lord Longyang seemed not to notice Xu Fu's gaze. He leaned against the carriage wall with a faint expression, his charming face appearing even more mesmerizing due to the suddenly cold demeanor.

Xu Fu couldn't help but let his gaze fall on Lord Longyang's face again.

Lord Longyang was somewhat similar to Consort Zheng.

Both were people with turbulent fates and drastic changes, but while Consort Zheng was clearly seeing signs of good fortune, Lord Longyang was the exact opposite—it was an omen of disaster.

If it weren't for the pity of seeing such a beauty potentially dying young from a major illness, how could Xu Fu have been so meddlesome as to say those words?

Perhaps because Xu Fu had been staring for too long, Lord Longyang turned his head and couldn't help but ask, "Envoy, do you have more to say?"

Xu Fu kept a straight face and spouted nonsense, "Looking at the heavy makeup on your face, it's a bit dazzling."

Lord Longyang smiled, "In that case, it seems that in the future, the envoy will not like women, but will prefer men instead."

Xu Fu nodded; it wasn't "in the future," he had already been bent.

"The envoy himself is so outstanding; where would you find a man worthy of you in the future?"

"It certainly wouldn't be someone like Lord Longyang."

Lord Longyang shook his head, a look of regret flashing across his face.

...

Their group galloped toward another small city. The carriage jolted along the way, and Xu Fu watched as Lord Longyang removed the makeup from his face and took off the simple long dress, suddenly changing his entire appearance.

Without realizing it, the carriage stopped.

Lord Longyang lowered his sleeves, once again stunning everyone.

Lord Longyang's appearance was truly too good.

Xu Fu sighed inwardly.

Jianjia lifted the carriage curtain and invited them to get off.

The carriage stopped outside a small inn. When the innkeeper saw their group, his eyes lit up instantly. Even a thousand years ago, innkeepers knew the "celebrity effect" without being taught. Although Xu Fu and Lord Longyang weren't celebrities, they were outstanding in appearance; just standing at the door was enough to attract countless people.

Li Si got off the carriage, paid the money with a swagger, and led the group into the inn.

Seeing this, Lord Longyang asked curiously, "You are so high-profile, are you not worried that the King of Wei will come looking for you?"

This had long been planned by Xu Fu and Li Si. Xu Fu replied indifferently, "Only those with a guilty conscience worry. We have no guilty conscience, so why should we worry?" Xu Fu paused and suddenly turned his head, "It is your face that should be covered up a bit."

Hearing this, Lord Longyang nodded and suddenly leaned into Xu Fu's arms, "This way, no one will see..."

Lord Longyang was even taller than Xu Fu, but perhaps because both of them were so outstanding in appearance, there was no sense of incongruity at all.

Someone sighed.

To be born so handsome, yet to have a penchant for men.

Xu Fu was caught off guard and couldn't push Lord Longyang away in time. The expressions of the four attendants behind him had already changed, and they almost couldn't help but step forward to pull Lord Longyang away directly.

Xu Fu had originally wanted to push Lord Longyang away, but after hesitating for a moment, he kept Lord Longyang close, and the two walked in together.

"It seems that it is better for Lord Longyang to dress as a woman."

Lord Longyang retorted, "Won't the envoy feel uncomfortable looking at the makeup on my face?"

Xu Fu didn't speak; he led Lord Longyang straight upstairs and into the room.

Then Li Si hurried in. Upon seeing Lord Longyang, a look of horror flashed across his face—yes, horror, not admiration. There were few people in the State of Wei who could be born so striking.

Li Si's expression was grave, and he hurriedly asked Xu Fu, "Who is this?"

Lord Longyang glanced at Li Si, not hiding his identity at all, "Longyang."

...Longyang?

Li Si was so startled he almost stumbled.

"...Lord Longyang?" Li Si's voice even changed slightly. Xu Fu might not know, but Li Si was clearly more aware of the status this Lord Longyang held beside the King of Wei. He had once been the sole favorite in the Wei palace, easily gained the King of Wei's trust, and was later even granted a title and sent to other countries as an envoy.

The world praised his charming demeanor and unparalleled wisdom, but also loathed his monopoly on the King's favor and his use of male beauty to serve the monarch—he was not a good person.

Opinions on Lord Longyang were mixed.

This was also the first time Li Si had seen this Lord Longyang.

Although in recent years, because the internal situation in Wei was not stable and the King of Wei had become increasingly muddled and fond of beauties, Lord Longyang had gradually lost favor. Some in Wei might even applaud his departure. But Lord Longyang wasn't someone you could just take away!

How did he suddenly appear beside them?

And Director Xu had snatched him directly from the King of Wei's side?

Really...

Really...

What great courage! After holding it in for a long time, Li Si finally squeezed this thought out from the bottom of his heart.

It must be said that kidnapping Lord Longyang was a heavy blow to the King of Wei. One must know that the State of Wei was no longer solely under the King's control; within Wei, Lord Longyang and Lord Xinling were both gradually growing in power. Only the King of Wei still treated Lord Longyang as a male favorite to be summoned and dismissed at will, while conversely, he harbored much distrust toward Lord Xinling.

Li Si pondered secretly, could Director Xu have some hidden agenda in doing this?

...

Lord Longyang looked at Li Si and asked Xu Fu, "Who is this person?"

"The envoy who came with me, Grand Historian Li Si."

Lord Longyang nodded, not taking it to heart.

At this time, he was already quite famous among the seven states, while Li Si was unknown, so naturally, he looked down on Li Si.

Li Si, convinced that Xu Fu had other plans, didn't ask about Lord Longyang again. The group ate, bathed, and rested at the inn. Before dawn the next day, everyone got up, drove the carriages, and left the inn.

Meanwhile, the King of Wei was still sending people to search everywhere for the whereabouts of the envoy and Lord Longyang.

The King of Wei couldn't help but think of one possibility, "Could the Qin envoy have abducted my Lord Longyang? What great audacity!" In a fit of rage, the King of Wei declared in the imperial court that he would seek justice from the State of Qin.

At this time, Lord Xinling stood up and gently persuaded him, suggesting that the King of Wei should find the person first; it would be bad if there were any misunderstandings if they clashed with the State of Qin rashly at this time.

In his rage, the King of Wei wouldn't listen and asked the court officials if anyone was willing to go as an envoy to the State of Qin.

One person stepped forward, willing to share the King of Wei's burdens.

If Li Si were here, he would recognize that person as one of the officials he had spoken with.

This person happily accepted the order from the King of Wei.

Lord Xinling, however, frowned and stopped getting involved.

·

Inside the carriage, Xu Fu took the disguise kit from Jianjia's arms, "Why does Jianjia carry these with you?"

Jianjia said, "They are needed at all times."

Xu Fu immediately thought of himself.

Didn't he also carry all his tools in his chest whenever he went out? Only in this way could he feel free from worry; it seemed Jianjia was the same.

It was all due to professional habits.

Xu Fu placed the disguise kit in front of Lord Longyang.

Lord Longyang glanced at Jianjia, "Do I have to disguise myself today?"

Xu Fu shook his head, "No, I will apply the makeup for Lord Longyang."

Lord Longyang was stunned, then smiled, "It would be my greatest honor."
