chapters.title: 第101章 疯狂攻击「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_text:
Seeing the vines about to coil around Wang Chao and the others, Zhou Pan hurriedly unleashed several wind blades, "swish-swish" slicing away the vines in front of them.

"Screech—!" Injured by the attack, the mutated Boston ivy grew furious. The entire vine body shuddered with a rustling sound, and as the wall—already riddled with large cracks—shook, chunks of brick and stone fell to the ground with a "pitter-patter."

"What's that sound?" Jiang Ye and his team, who were clearing the fifth floor, turned to look around. Jiang Ye probed the surroundings with his mental energy, and—holy crap! A massive Boston ivy, a mutated plant, was entrenched behind the back wall. If it hadn't created several gaps in the wall just now, he wouldn't have even noticed it.

"There's a mutated Boston ivy over there that's at least Level 5. The boss and the others are clashing with it," he gasped, turning back to tell the other team members.

"What? Level 5? Holy crap! Where did such a huge boss come from? How is its level so high?" The other team members were also startled.

Everyone looked toward the wall, only to see several cracks running through the hospital's concrete surface. Through the gaps, they could vaguely see some green vegetation thrashing wildly, causing the constant "pitter-patter" of falling bricks and stones.

"Should we go help? A Level 5 mutated plant isn't easy to deal with. Can the boss and the others hold on?" Tu Sheng frowned.

Cheng Ang surveyed the area. This floor was the operating room section, not frequently used, and they had already cleared out most of the zombies. Going down to help was feasible. He beckoned, "Let's go," and led the way toward that wall, intending to attack from above.

"Wait for us!" The other team members quickly followed.

Wang Chao and the others were lower in level than Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu, and their mental strength wasn't high either. For a moment, they struggled to break free from the mutated mental control of the Boston ivy. Although Zhou Pan intercepted them, they continued to walk toward the vine body, unwilling to give up. Zhou Pan blocked one, only to lose another, becoming flustered and overwhelmed.

Jing Chengsu, having regained his composure, stepped forward and cleanly chopped the back of their necks, knocking them unconscious. The two then carried them to a place far away from the mutated Boston ivy.

Sensing its prey disappearing one by one, the mutated Boston ivy grew anxious. With a "screech" from its mental entity, it launched waves of mental attacks at the two men.

"Not good." Upstairs, Jiang Ye felt his mind struck by something and felt a wave of dizziness. He shook his head vigorously to steady himself. Realizing something was wrong, he turned to look and, sure enough, saw that his team members were acting strangely, walking toward the wall in a trance like wandering souls being summoned.

He tried to stop them, but they were like people who had lost their souls, ignoring his interference. Helpless, he had to resort to the same action as Jing Chengsu.

He dragged the fallen team members one by one into an empty operating room, locked the door, and tried to find a way to wake them up.

Jing Chengsu had almost been controlled by the mutated plant's mental entity, and his expression was grim. His eyes darkened, and lightning crackled on his hands; countless thin, willow-like bolts of electricity struck the surrounding vines like meteors.

"Sizzle, sizzle." As the electricity coursed through the vines, the originally green branches were instantly charred black.

Trees, flowers, and grasses are naturally afraid of lightning and fire. Even though the mutated Boston ivy was high-level, it couldn't escape this rule. Once attacked by the lightning, the entire vine body shrank back with a rustling sound.

Seeing the effectiveness of his lightning ability, Jing Chengsu immediately increased his output, sending bolts of lightning straight at the vine body. Zhou Pan, on the side, wasn't idle either; he cast several tornadoes directly at the base of the ivy, attempting to uproot it entirely. No matter how powerful a plant is, without the protection of the soil, it is nothing more than a paper tiger.

The roots of the mutated Boston ivy were one of its weaknesses. Zhou Pan's attack on its roots undoubtedly touched a raw nerve, and the entire vine body went berserk. All the curled-up vines exploded outward, ignoring Jing Chengsu's lightning to attack the two men frantically. Even the roots buried deep underground emerged from the surface, moving as flexibly as octopus tentacles to attack them.

The roots of the mutated Boston ivy occupied all the open space behind the hospital. As soon as they emerged, they immediately surrounded Zhou Pan, Jing Chengsu, and the others. Wang Chao and his group, still unconscious and unable to struggle, were coiled by the roots and dragged toward the ground.
chapters.source_text:
眼看藤蔓将要卷住王超几人，周磐赶紧甩出几道风刃，将他们身前的藤蔓都“刷刷”削掉。
“吡——”枝体受创变异爬山虎怒了，整棵藤体沙沙颤动，原本就就就裂缝很大的墙体，随着藤体抖动，不少砖石碎片都“噼里啪啦”的掉到地上。
“什么声音？”正在清理五层的江烨等人，转头四顾，江烨探出精神力往四周一探，卧槽！好大一颗爬山虎这异植雄踞在后墙后面，要不是此刻将墙面弄出好几道空隙，他还发现不了。
“那边有棵起码五级的变异爬山虎，老大他们跟它对上了。”他倒抽口凉气，回头对其他队员说。
“什么？五级？卧槽！哪来的大BOSS？等级这么高？”其他队员也吓了一跳。
大家往那边墙面看去，只见医院的水泥墙面裂出数道裂缝，透过裂缝隐隐约约看到有什么绿色植物在疯狂的甩动。带动着墙面不断有砖石“噼里啪啦”掉落的声音。
“我们要不要去帮忙？五级异植可不好对付老大他们撑的住吗？”图升皱眉道。
成昂打量一下四周，这层楼是手术室，并不经常用到，丧尸被他们清理的差不多了，下去帮忙也行，他一招手“走。”就率先往那面墙壁处走去，打算从上往下攻击。
“等等我们。”其他队员赶紧跟上。
王超几个等级比周磐和荆成夙低，精神力也不高。一时之间难以脱离变异爬山虎的变异精神体掌控，虽然被周磐拦截住了却不死心的继续要往藤体那边走。周磐拦了这个，拦不住那个，一时之间手忙脚乱。
回过神的荆成夙上前干净利落的几个手刀将几人劈晕，两人将他们扶到远离变异爬山虎的地方。
感觉到猎物一个个消失，变异爬山虎顿时急了，精神体“吡”的一声，一道道精神光波攻击向两人。
“不好。”楼上的江烨感觉自己的精神被什么击打了一下，一阵眩晕，他使劲摇摇头，定定神，心知不妙的他转头一看，果然见队员们都很不对劲，一个个像游魂被召唤似的，精神恍惚的要朝墙面走去。
他连忙阻止，可惜一个个像失了魂似的，根本就不顾他的阻拦，无奈的他，只好做了荆成夙一样的动作。
将倒地的队员一个个都拖到一个空制的手术室里，关上门，他试着想办法唤醒他们。
荆成夙差点被一棵异植的精神体给控制了，脸色有点不好看，他眼神一沉，手上霹雳闪烁无数条细如柳枝的电流如流星似得攻向周周的藤蔓。
“嗤嗤”电流流转藤蔓之间，原本青绿的枝条，顿时被劈成一根根黑炭。
树木花草之类的植物，本来就怕雷火这两样东西，变异爬山虎等级虽高，也逃不过这个规则，一被雷电攻击，整棵藤体沙沙沙的一个劲往里龟缩。
荆成夙一见雷电异能的效果，顿时加大输出异能，一道道雷电直劈它的藤体而去。一旁的周磐也不闲着，他抛出几道龙卷风直卷向爬山虎的根部，企图将它连根拔起。不管什么植物再强大，没了土壤的保护也不过是纸老虎。
变异爬山虎的根部就是它的弱点之一，周磐朝它根部攻击，无疑犯了它的逆鳞，整棵藤体都暴躁了。所有蜷缩起来的藤体都炸了起来，不顾荆成夙的雷电加身也要疯狂的朝两人攻击过来，还有埋在地底下的根须，也从地表冒出来一根根犹如章鱼触手似的灵活的攻向两人。
变异爬山虎的根部，占据了医院后方区域的所有空地之下，一冒出头，顿时将周磐两人以及王超他们都包围了起来，王超几个昏迷着，无力挣扎，被根须卷住身体要往地底下拖。

chapters.title: 第102章 精神异核「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.source_text:
遭了！周磐和荆成夙见状，连忙一边格挡变异爬山虎根须的攻击，一边赶去救援王超四个人。
王超几个人昏迷着，被卷住拉扯也没有苏醒过来，眼看要被根须卷着拖到地底当肥料，周磐两人大急，王超他们可没有蚯蚓似的有在地下生存的能力。要是被拖到底下，不出十分钟就会窒息而亡。
“嗤嗤嗤”几根根须被斩落，从根须断口处，流下的液体，将地面腐蚀出一个个小小的坑洼。
“好险！”早一步捞住从斩断的根须上落下的几人的周磐两人，看到滴落的酸性液体，后怕的急退几步，靠！腐蚀性这么强，要是滴到人类身上不会也像地面的坑洼一样吧？
自己的根须也受创，变异爬山虎更怒了，整棵藤体瑟瑟发抖藤蔓根须张牙舞爪的攻向荆成夙他们，它的变异精神体也不断放射精神光波。
有了头次的中招，周磐和荆成夙都提高了警惕，两人撑起一个一丈大的灵气护盾，将几人都笼罩在其中，一边往外放大招。
荆成夙将雷电异能聚成一颗篮球大的能量光球，朝藤体主干砸去。“轰”变异爬山虎藤体主干被轰成焦炭，主干被毁，上面的藤蔓顿时萎靡了。虽然藤体受创，但它的根须更加疯狂，纷纷露出地表要缠住两人的手脚身体。
“这样不行，想要完全杀死这异植，必须找到它的异核挖出来，才能让它真正毁灭，我先拦住它的攻击，小磐你用神识找一下它的异核所在。”异植的异核就跟丧尸的晶核一样，是它的能量载体，异核之处也是异植的死穴所在。
“好！”周磐探出神识，搜索四周，神识虽然也算是精神力，但绝对比精神力强悍，假如一个人躲在一个密闭的房里，精神力不可能透墙而过，看到里面的情景，除非精神力等级已经到达很高的地方。而神识却可以，他的神识在藤体四周找了一圈没找到，地面上没有，地底下总该有吧？他的神识往地下探去。
他的神识也不是万能，以他现在的等级，神识最多探测到地下三米范围内的情景，他一寸寸搜索，终于在荆成夙劈成渣的主体根部下面一米处，一个特别硕大的巨大根须上发现了一枚晶莹的异核，在根部还有不少的丧尸晶核，难怪异植等级升级这么快。
周磐试着用神识撬动了一下异核，可惜异核连动都没有动，他现在的神识还没有达到具象化的地步，能够模拟什么东西摘取异核，只好亲自出手。
周磐飞快的闪过像触手似得根须，扑到焦黑的主体处，运功一剑刺到地底下，一搅，异核被搅出根部，没有异核等于没了能量输出，变异爬山虎不甘心的最后发出一波精神光波后，枝干枯萎，绿叶变黄掉落，如触手的根须，也像没了骨头似的软趴趴的倒在地面上。
周磐将主体根部下的土壤挖开，刨出不少的晶核，一颗颗放在地上，都成一小堆了，他最后挖出那颗比晶核大很多看起来有点像水晶的异核。这异核是银色的，异核同样也跟晶核似的有各种属性，看变异爬山虎的光波那么强，这异核应该是一颗精神系的异核吧？他的神识也不比变异爬山虎的精神体弱多少，异核对他没什么作用，不过夙哥的神识还弱一点，先前不小心还中招了，倒是可以给他修炼神识用。他满意的将异核收起，又收了地上的晶核，虽然不多，但都是三、四级的，价值不菲。
刚想走，眼睛瞄到变异爬山虎的根茎，想起这根茎的药用价值，据说可以破淤血，消肿毒，也不知这变异后的根茎价值有没有改变，搞不明白的他也不管了，干脆将根茎通通挖出来，拿回去给人研究一下不就知道了。
chapters.translated_text:
Oh no! Seeing this, Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu hurriedly blocked the attacks of the mutant creeper's roots while rushing to rescue Wang Chao and the other three.

Wang Chao and the others were unconscious and did not wake up even as they were coiled and dragged away. Seeing them about to be pulled underground to be used as fertilizer, Zhou Pan and the other were extremely anxious. Wang Chao and his team didn't have the ability to survive underground like earthworms. If they were dragged down, they would suffocate to death within ten minutes.

"Sss, sss, sss"—several roots were severed. The liquid dripping from the broken ends corroded the ground, creating small pits.

"That was close!" Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu, who had just managed to catch the people falling from the severed roots, retreated several steps in lingering fear after seeing the acidic liquid drip. Damn! The corrosion was so strong; if it dripped onto a human, wouldn't they end up like those pits in the ground?

Having its roots injured, the mutant creeper became even more enraged. The entire vine body shuddered, its vines and roots lashing out wildly at Jing Chengsu and the others, while its mutant psychic body continuously emitted psychic waves.

Having been hit once, Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu were now on high alert. The two of them erected a ten-foot-wide spiritual energy shield, enveloping everyone inside while unleashing powerful attacks outward.

Jing Chengsu gathered his lightning ability into a basketball-sized ball of light and smashed it into the main trunk of the vine. "Boom!" The main trunk of the mutant creeper was blasted into charred remains. With the main trunk destroyed, the vines above immediately withered. Although the vine body was damaged, its roots became even more frantic, breaking through the surface to entangle the two men's limbs and bodies.

"This won't work. To completely kill this mutant plant, we must find its mutant core and dig it out; only then will it truly be destroyed. I'll hold off its attacks; Xiao Pan, use your divine sense to find where its mutant core is." A mutant plant's core is like a zombie's crystal core—it is its energy carrier, and the location of the core is the plant's fatal weak point.

"Alright!" Zhou Pan extended his divine sense to search the surroundings. Although divine sense is a form of psychic power, it is definitely more powerful. If a person were hiding in a sealed room, ordinary psychic power couldn't penetrate the walls to see what was inside unless the psychic level was extremely high. But divine sense could. He searched around the vine body, but found nothing. If it wasn't on the ground, it had to be underground, right? He probed his divine sense into the earth.

His divine sense wasn't omnipotent either. At his current level, he could only detect things within a range of three meters underground. He searched inch by inch and finally discovered a crystal-clear mutant core on a particularly large root, one meter below the base of the main trunk that Jing Chengsu had blasted to bits. There were also quite a few zombie crystal cores near the roots; no wonder the mutant plant leveled up so quickly.

Zhou Pan tried to pry the mutant core loose with his divine sense, but unfortunately, the core didn't even budge. His divine sense hadn't yet reached the level of materialization where he could simulate an object to pluck the core, so he had to do it himself.

Zhou Pan swiftly dodged the tentacle-like roots and lunged at the charred main body. He channeled his energy and thrust his sword into the ground, giving it a stir. The mutant core was dislodged from the roots. Without the core, there was no energy output. After the mutant creeper emitted one final, unwilling wave of psychic energy, its branches withered, its green leaves turned yellow and fell off, and its tentacle-like roots collapsed limply onto the ground as if they had lost their bones.

Zhou Pan dug up the soil beneath the main root, unearthing quite a few crystal cores. He placed them on the ground one by one until they formed a small pile. Finally, he dug out the mutant core, which was much larger than the crystal cores and looked somewhat like a crystal. This core was silver. Mutant cores, like crystal cores, also had various attributes. Seeing how strong the mutant creeper's psychic waves were, this core should be a psychic-type core, right? His own divine sense wasn't much weaker than the mutant creeper's psychic body, so the core wasn't of much use to him. However, Brother Su's divine sense was still a bit weak—he had accidentally been hit earlier—so it could be used for him to cultivate his divine sense. He satisfiedly put away the core and collected the crystal cores from the ground. Although there weren't many, they were all level three or four and quite valuable.

Just as he was about to leave, his eyes caught the rhizome of the mutant creeper. He remembered its medicinal value—it was said to break up blood stasis and reduce swelling and toxins. He didn't know if the value of this rhizome had changed after mutation, but since he couldn't figure it out, he didn't care. He simply dug up all the rhizomes; he could just take them back for someone to study, and he'd find out soon enough.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 102: Psychic Mutant Core "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"

chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan dug up and collected all the roots of the mutant creeper before turning toward Jing Chengsu. Jing Chengsu had tried many methods and finally managed to wake up Wang Chao and the other two. As for Zhou Yuanyuan, since men and women should keep a respectful distance, he didn't feel comfortable touching her, so he let her remain unconscious. Besides, judging by the state of the three men when they woke up, the coma was merely a deep sleep with no lasting harm to the body.

When Wang Chao and the others woke up and saw that Zhou Yuanyuan was still unconscious, they gathered around her, wanting to pick her up. Zhou Pan hurried over and shooed them away; they hadn't even established a relationship yet, so what kind of indecency was all this hugging and carrying! As her younger brother, Zhou Pan took it upon himself to carry Zhou Yuanyuan on his back.

Although Zhou Pan was very strong, he was about the same height as Zhou Yuanyuan, and watching him carry her made people feel uneasy.

Wang Chao and the others followed behind, trembling with fear, terrified that Zhou Pan wouldn't have enough strength and would drop their beloved. They kept nagging him from behind, trying to get him to put her down so they could take over.

Zhou Pan rolled his eyes at them, ignored them, and walked straight through the hospital's back exit passage toward the interior.

Inside was the safety stairwell. Jing Chengsu decided to reunite with Jiang Ye and the others before making any further plans.

Once inside the hospital, Wang Chao and the others quickly shut their mouths to avoid attracting zombies with their noise.

As they walked up the safety stairwell, they occasionally encountered zombies, which they eliminated one by one.

After climbing several floors without seeing any signs of a struggle, Jing Chengsu frowned slightly. He extended his spiritual sense to search the floors above and below before finally finding Jiang Ye and the others in an empty room on the fifth floor. Seeing many of them lying on the ground in the same state as Wang Chao’s group, he realized they had also been hit.

The group hurried up to the fifth floor.

Jiang Ye had been shouting, slapping, and pinching philtrums to finally wake a few people up. With that experience, he used the same methods to wake the others. By the time Jing Chengsu and his group arrived, most of them were already standing up, albeit shakily.

"Boss!" Everyone shook their groggy heads, and upon seeing Jing Chengsu and the others arrive, they all perked up.

"Boss, are you all okay? Didn't you say there was a Level 5 mutant plant? How did it go?" A Level 5 mutant plant was higher in level than all of them and possessed powerful mental abilities; it must have been difficult to deal with. But seeing the relaxed expressions on the boss and the others, could it be that they had already taken care of it?

"It has been eliminated," Jing Chengsu nodded. Seeing that everyone seemed unharmed aside from the mental attack, he felt relieved.

Seeing that everyone was still a bit lethargic, he told them to rest in the room while he and Zhou Pan went to collect the equipment on that floor. After working for a while, when they returned to the room, Zhou Yuanyuan had already regained consciousness.

"Sister Yuanyuan, are you okay?" Zhou Pan ran up to her happily.

Zhou Yuanyuan looked around the room, which was full of people. Seeing them all turn to look at her as she woke up, she couldn't help but blush, lowering her head and shaking it in embarrassment.

Seeing that everyone was awake and it was getting late, Jing Chengsu gave the order to continue clearing the hospital.

The Provincial Hospital covered a vast area, and clearing it floor by floor was quite time-consuming. The lower they went, the more zombies there were. The first floor, in particular, had many zombies wandering about, including not only elemental-ability zombies but also troublesome, thick-skinned mutant zombies. By the time they finished clearing everything, it was nearly evening.

After digging out the crystals and collecting the equipment, they ensured everything was in order before getting into the vehicles and heading back to the base.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 103: Clearing the Hospital "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.source_text:
周磐将变异爬山虎的根茎都挖出收好才转向荆成夙那边。荆成夙试了很多种办法，终于唤醒了王超三个，至于周媛媛男女有别，他也不好在她身上动手动脚的，就任由她继续昏迷，反正看王超三个清醒的状况，昏迷也不过是深度睡眠，对身体没其他大碍。
王超三个醒来看周媛媛还昏迷不醒，都纷纷聚集在她身旁，想要抱她起来。周磐赶紧过去将他们赶开，还没确定关系呢，搂搂抱抱成何体统！好歹他也算是媛媛姐的弟弟，周磐自己将周媛媛给背起。
周磐虽然力气很大，但是个头跟周媛媛差不多，背起她来，总让看的人不放心。
王超三人在后面提心吊胆的，生怕周磐力气不够，把他们的心上人给甩了，一个劲的在后面唠叨，企图让周磐放下，让他们来背。
周磐甩他们几个白眼，不理他们，直接穿过医院后门通道，朝里走去。
里面是安全通道，荆成夙决定先跟江烨他们汇合，再做打算。
到了医院里面，王超几个也赶忙闭嘴，免得声音太吵招来丧尸。
沿着安全通道往上走，偶尔会遇到在安全通道上的丧尸，被他们一一铲除。
往上走了几楼也没看到打斗的痕迹，荆成夙有点皱眉，他探出神识楼上楼下搜索了一遍，才在五楼一处空房间里找到江烨他们。看他们有不少倒在地上，状况跟王超他们一样，就知道他们也中招了。
几人赶紧走上五楼。
江烨又是叫喊，又是拍打，又是掐人中的终于唤醒了几个人，有了经验，其他的人也被他用同样的方法唤醒，等到荆成夙他们走到上面的时候，大部分人已经摇摇晃晃的站起身。
“老大！”大家摇着昏沉的脑袋，一看到荆成夙他们上来，都是精神一震。
“老大，你们没事吧？不是说有五级异植吗？怎么样了？”五级异植比他们所有人等级都高，又有强大的精神力，一定很难缠，可是看老大他们轻松的表情，不会已经将它解决了吧？
“已经消灭了。”荆成夙点头道，他见大家除了被精神体攻击了一下之外，似乎都没有什么损伤，也就放心了。
看大家还有点精神萎靡，就让他们现在房间里休息，他和周磐先去将这层楼的设备给收了，忙了一会儿，回到房间时，周媛媛也已经清醒过来。
“媛媛姐，你没事吧？”周磐高兴的跑上前。
周媛媛环顾四周，这房间里都是人，见她醒来都转过头来看着她，她不由涨红脸，低头不好意思的摇头。
见大家都已经清醒了，时间也不早，荆成夙下令继续清理这座医院。
省立医院占地面积十分宽广，这一层楼一层楼的清理也相当费时间，越往下楼层丧尸越多，尤其是一楼，就有不少丧尸在游荡，不但有各种属性的异能丧尸，还有难缠皮厚的变异丧尸，等他们全部清理完毕，都快傍晚了，
将晶核挖的挖，设备收的收，一切妥当了，才上车往基地赶。
chapters.title: 第103章 清理医院「求推荐，求收藏」
第104章 第一代抗毒血清「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 104: First-Generation Antivenom "Seeking recommendations, seeking favorites"
chapters.source_text:
隔离室中有三个被丧尸抓伤，即将变异的人倒在病床上，手脚被东西绑缚着，随着丧尸病毒的侵入，一个个开始痉挛似得抽搐，力气增加很多，绑缚的手脚不断挣扎，单薄的病床在蛮力下开始“咔哒咔哒”作响。
隔离室外不少基地上层都在透明的玻璃窗外看着。看到一个个病患青筋鼓胀，皮肤渐渐往青黑色发展，庞隆转过头看着秦昕，“现在可以注射了吧，再等下去，就要成丧尸了。”
秦昕点点头，隔离室门被打开，几个全副武装的医护人员在异能者保护之下，走进隔离室。掏出预备好的针剂，一个个扎入病患的血管。
确定每个病患都打了针剂后，大家纷纷退出，都等在隔离室外面观察着病患打完针剂后的结果。
起初并没有明显的效果，病患们依然挣扎抽搐，其中有一个病患抽搐的最严重，皮肤青黑腐烂脱皮，溢出恶臭，手指甲变长很多，脸上肌肉僵硬，牙齿暴突长出獠牙，很不幸的这个病患进化为丧尸，刚进化的丧尸手脚被绑缚着无法移动，只朝着旁边躺着的血肉咆哮。
外面等待的人个个神情紧张的注视着另外两个病患，生怕他们也转化为丧尸，在等待中时间慢慢的过去，一分钟，两分钟，三分钟过去，直到十五分钟后，其他两个病患皮肤没有转为青黑色，二十分钟后，痉挛慢慢停止，又过了半个小时，两个即将变异的病患睁开眼睛，被隔壁“咔哒咔哒”作响，朝他们咆哮流口水的吓了一跳。
外面的人眉开眼笑，秦昕带着几个人在人保护之下走入隔离室，几个异能者将化为丧尸的病患给解决了，其他人都凑在另外两个人旁边，看秦昕检查。
秦昕认真检查了两遍，确定两个人以没什么大碍，再卧床观察一个晚上，病情没复发就可以出去了。
“好，虽然这第一代抗毒血清没有百分百的祛毒，但是百分之七十已经很不错，秦医生果然不愧是医学天才。”庞隆很高兴，有了这抗毒血清，他们基地的损失就大大减少了。
“哪里都是大家一起的功劳，要是没有其他人的帮忙我也不可能这么快做出这第一代抗毒血清来，只是这抗毒血清还不够完善，还要研究研究才行。”秦昕眼睛看向另一张病床，那里原本进化成丧尸的病患已被人带走。
这还有缺陷的第一代抗毒血清比不怎么让他满意。
“行，你研究吧，不过这第一代抗毒血清也可以先做出一批来。”庞隆对于能够请到秦昕这样的医学天才非常高兴。
听到基地领导的请求秦昕点点头。第一代抗毒血清可以先做一点出来，可是他更希望使用的是完善后的药剂。看来又要有几个不眠之夜，他要尽快研制出更完美的第二代抗毒血清才行。
整个基地由于第一代抗毒血清的研制成功都处于兴奋状态，有了这东西等于拥有了第二条性命，大家对基地的向心力更强了，附近其他地方的幸存者听到这个消息都疯狂的往F市基地赶，迫不及待的想要加入基地。
chapters.translated_text:
In the isolation room, three people who had been scratched by zombies and were on the verge of mutation lay on hospital beds, their hands and feet bound. As the zombie virus invaded their systems, they began to convulse as if in spasms, their strength increasing significantly. They struggled against their restraints, and the flimsy hospital beds began to rattle and creak under their brute force.

Outside the isolation room, many of the base's upper-level officials watched through the transparent glass window. Seeing the patients' veins bulge and their skin gradually turning a bruised, dark color, Pang Long turned to look at Qin Xin. "Can we inject them now? If we wait any longer, they'll turn into zombies."

Qin Xin nodded. The door to the isolation room was opened, and several fully armed medical personnel, protected by ability users, walked inside. They took out the prepared injections and plunged them into the patients' veins one by one.

After confirming that every patient had received the injection, everyone retreated and waited outside the isolation room to observe the results.

At first, there was no obvious effect; the patients continued to struggle and convulse. One patient suffered the worst seizures, his skin turning dark, rotting, and peeling, emitting a foul stench. His fingernails grew longer, his facial muscles stiffened, and his teeth protruded into fangs. Unfortunately, this patient evolved into a zombie. Bound hand and foot, the newly evolved zombie couldn't move, only roaring at the living flesh lying nearby.

Those waiting outside watched the other two patients with tense expressions, terrified that they, too, would turn into zombies. Time passed slowly as they waited—one minute, two minutes, three minutes. After fifteen minutes, the other two patients' skin had not turned dark. Twenty minutes later, the spasms slowly stopped. After another half hour, the two patients on the verge of mutation opened their eyes, startled by the rattling and the drooling, roaring zombie in the next bed.

The people outside beamed with joy. Qin Xin, accompanied by several people under guard, walked into the isolation room. A few ability users took care of the patient who had turned into a zombie, while the others gathered around the other two to watch Qin Xin perform his examination.

Qin Xin checked them carefully twice, confirming that the two were no longer in any serious danger. After another night of observation in bed, they could be discharged if the condition did not recur.

"Good. Although this first-generation antivenom didn't have a one-hundred-percent success rate, seventy percent is already quite impressive. Dr. Qin is truly worthy of being called a medical genius." Pang Long was very pleased; with this antivenom, the base's losses would be greatly reduced.

"It's nothing; it's everyone's hard work. If it weren't for the help of others, I wouldn't have been able to create this first-generation antivenom so quickly. It's just that this antivenom isn't perfect yet; it still needs more research." Qin Xin looked toward the other hospital bed, where the patient who had evolved into a zombie had already been removed.

This flawed first-generation antivenom did not satisfy him much.

"Fine, you go ahead and research. However, we can start producing a batch of this first-generation antivenom." Pang Long was very happy to have been able to recruit a medical genius like Qin Xin.

Hearing the base leader's request, Qin Xin nodded. They could produce some of the first-generation antivenom first, but he preferred to use a perfected version. It seemed there would be a few more sleepless nights; he had to develop a more perfect second-generation antivenom as soon as possible.

The entire base was in a state of excitement due to the successful development of the first-generation antivenom. Having this was equivalent to having a second life, and the survivors' sense of loyalty to the base grew stronger. Survivors in nearby areas who heard the news rushed frantically toward the F City base, eager to join.

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 105: Other Bases "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.source_text:
末世后全世界各地的幸存者都进行了自救行动，各处都遍地开花似的建立起不少幸存者基地，光华国的大大小小幸存者基地就有无数个。最大的几个基地分别是B市的京都基地，东省的光明基地，西方的安宁基地和南方的江泷基地。而F市基地只能算是一个中等基地。
末世后虽然通讯设施只有传真机和录音机可以使用，但是F市基地研制出抗毒血清的消息还是很快传播开来。F市基地虽然不是大基地，可是这个基地却是最早发现晶核并使用的基地，也因为F市基地的净化晶核，各个基地才特别重视净化异能者，最初被视为废材异能的净化异能者受到保护，不像上辈子一样，末世初就消亡掉。
也因为F市基地老是有新的发现，受到各个基地的关注，一有什么消息就被他们得知。
第一代抗毒血清，百分之七十的痊愈几率，每个字眼都让看到资料的人兴奋万分，秦昕这个研制出血清的医学天才的大名，也很快流传到各个基地，大家都对他的人和研制出的抗毒血清非常感兴趣，纷纷派遣人员去F市基地邀请他或购买抗毒血清的药剂配方。
有些野心勃勃的人倒是想威胁利诱掠夺绑架什么的，可惜看到异能高手等级排行榜上那一溜的F市基地高手，就不得不打消这个念头。
现在道路不通畅，天空上方磁场改变飞机之类的不能运行，大家只好各自派遣了一支支队伍朝F市基地赶去。
对于各个基地将要有人到来的消息，庞隆等人相当的淡定，他们不是最大基地又怎么样？别的基地物资有他们齐吗？强者有他们多吗？这世道拳头大才是硬道理，在他们的地盘上，再强的龙他们也能打成软脚虾。
为了迎接各个基地的人员，F市基地能沸腾一片，打扫街道的打扫街道，清理垃圾的清理垃圾，务必更的基地一个好印象。
在这期间王溯他们的科研院也成功的研制出病毒红外线感应器，试用过后，就研制出几个感应器装设在基地的各个路口，想要进去基地的人，只要在病毒红外线感应器的扫描之下，没有发现问题，就可以进入基地，再也不用每次都要在旁边的屋子待一个晚上已做观察。
路途遥远，各个路段上又有各种危机存在，想要安全的到达F市基地并不容易，各个基地都牺牲了不少人手，有的基地干脆全军覆没，最后赶到F市基地的只有四大基地以及十几个中等基地两个小基地的人员。
最先赶到F市基地的是在南方区域的基地，毕竟都在一个区域以内，距离比较近。到了F市基地附近，大家明显感觉到了生机勃勃的生活气氛，末世后各种各样的事让人心性都麻木了，很多人都是得过且过，活一天过一天，都不知道明天会怎样了。
可F市基地似乎有让人重新开始的魔力，大家清理城市，打杀丧尸……一切都干的如火如荼，好像一点都不受末世影响。
越走近F市基地，这种感觉越明显。
chapters.title: 第105章 其他基地「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_text:
After the apocalypse, survivors all over the world carried out self-rescue operations, and survivor bases sprang up everywhere like wildflowers. In China alone, there are countless survivor bases of all sizes. The largest ones are the Jingdu Base in City B, the Guangming Base in Dong Province, the Anning Base in the West, and the Jianglong Base in the South. The City F base can only be considered a medium-sized base.

Although only fax machines and tape recorders were available for communication after the apocalypse, the news that the City F base had developed an anti-venom serum spread quickly. Although City F base is not a large base, it was the first to discover and use crystal nuclei. It was also because of the purification of crystal nuclei at the City F base that other bases began to attach great importance to purification-type ability users. These ability users, who were initially regarded as useless, were protected and did not die out early in the apocalypse as they did in the previous life.

Because the City F base was always making new discoveries, it attracted the attention of all other bases, and any news about it would immediately reach them.

The first generation of anti-venom serum, with a seventy percent recovery rate—every word made those who saw the data extremely excited. The name of Qin Xin, the medical genius who developed the serum, also quickly spread to all the bases. Everyone was very interested in him and the anti-venom serum formula he developed, and they sent personnel to the City F base one after another to invite him or purchase the formula.

Some ambitious people wanted to use threats, bribery, looting, or kidnapping, but after seeing the long list of experts from the City F base on the ability user ranking, they had to abandon these thoughts.

Now that the roads are impassable and the magnetic field in the sky has changed, making aircraft and the like unable to operate, everyone had to dispatch teams to rush to the City F base.

Regarding the news that people from various bases were coming, Pang Long and the others were quite calm. So what if they weren't the largest base? Did other bases have as complete supplies as they did? Did they have as many strong people? In this world, might makes right. On their turf, they could turn even the strongest dragon into a weakling.

In order to welcome the personnel from various bases, the City F base was in a frenzy; those who were supposed to sweep the streets did so, and those who were supposed to clear the trash did so, all to ensure they left a good impression on the other bases.

During this period, Wang Su and his research institute also successfully developed a virus infrared sensor. After testing, they produced several sensors and installed them at various intersections of the base. Anyone wanting to enter the base only needed to pass the scan of the virus infrared sensor; if no problems were found, they could enter the base, and there was no longer a need to spend a night in the adjacent room for observation every time.

The journey was long, and there were various crises on every road segment. It was not easy to reach the City F base safely. Each base sacrificed quite a few people, and some bases were completely wiped out. In the end, only personnel from the four major bases, a dozen medium-sized bases, and two small bases arrived at the City F base.

The first to arrive at the City F base were the bases in the southern region; after all, they were in the same region and the distance was relatively close. Upon arriving near the City F base, everyone clearly felt a vibrant atmosphere of life. After the apocalypse, various events had made people's hearts numb; many people were just muddling along, living one day at a time, not knowing what tomorrow would bring.

But the City F base seemed to have a magic that allowed people to start over. Everyone was clearing the city, killing zombies... everything was done in full swing, as if they were not affected by the apocalypse at all.

The closer they got to the City F base, the more obvious this feeling became.

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 106: The Hierarchy "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.source_text:
先赶到F市基地的是南方区域的苏市基地和宁城基地这两个一个是和F市基地差不多大的中等基地，一个是幸存者只有几十万的小基地，宁城这个小基地其实距离F市基地更近，只是派出的人手少，路上为了躲避各种危机，才磨蹭到跟苏城基地差不多的时间。
他们到了F市基地，在F市基地门口并没有多少人聚集，大家好像都是在一个电话亭似的地方，站上几秒钟就可以进去基地了，这让习惯了各个基地门口拥挤场面的两个基地的人员感到格外惊奇。
他们也走到基地门口，在那个电话亭似的地方排队，不一会儿，一个个就轮流走近里面，只见一进去就有红外线的光圈上下扫描他们的身体，确定没有带有病毒，门口顶上亮起绿灯，就可以进入基地。
两个基地的人一个个轮流检查，一旦有病毒体出现，门口的灯立刻变红。
这一路走来，路上也不是那么顺利，多少都有经过打斗，受点伤什么的不可能避免，不一会儿两个基地的人都被测出几个身上带有病毒体的人，他们都被带到一边的房子，打抗毒血清，存活几率没有百分之百，能不能活，看他们自己了。
其他人也不能扔下自己的队友不管，都在旁边看着，正好也可以看看这抗毒血清的效果。
有的人感染的丧尸病毒较严重，即使打了针剂，也依然进化成了丧尸，有人在旁边看着一发现不对，就无奈的将他们解决了。
另外伤势轻感染不严重的等待了几个多小时，病毒并没有发作，再去用红外线感应器检查了一下，身体的病毒体已经消失，也许是因为发现的较早，病毒体还来不及蔓延，就被消灭了。
耳听为虚，眼见为实。他们确切的感受了一下第一代抗毒血清的效果，对于此行的目的更加期待。
走进F市基地，就看到F市基地与众不同的精神面貌，这里即使是普通人也是生活积极向上的人，走路昂首挺胸，并不曾因为看到异能者，变异者这些强者就底气不足。
“据说F市基地内并没有分三六九等人，异能者不能无缘无故欺压普通人，否则会有严重惩罚，在基地普通人的地位跟异能者一样，只要肯付出劳力，得到的积分跟异能者没什么区别呢。”有些了解内情的两个基地的人，用不知是羡慕还是讽刺的语气说着。
他们的基地哪个不是强者为尊，异能者的地位最高，变异者是附庸，普通人只配被强者奴役糟蹋。不管是谁，家里都不可能每个人都是异能者，变异者，对于只会吃闲饭，给他们拖后腿的普通人，地位低下，很多强者都是鄙视冷漠对待的，习惯了这种行为，在F市基地居然看到三者相安无事，彼此相处融洽的生活着，感觉很大的不适应。
虽然不适应，他们也不得不收拾起往日对待普通人的那一套，不然若是犯了F市基地的忌讳，可得不偿失。
chapters.translated_text:
The first to arrive at the F City Base were the Su City Base and the Ningcheng Base from the southern region. One was a medium-sized base similar in scale to the F City Base, while the other was a small base with only a few hundred thousand survivors. Ningcheng, the smaller base, was actually closer to the F City Base, but because they sent fewer personnel and had to dodge various crises along the way, they ended up arriving around the same time as the Su City Base.

When they arrived at the entrance of the F City Base, there wasn't much of a crowd gathered. Everyone seemed to step into a phone booth-like structure for a few seconds before being allowed into the base, which surprised the personnel from the two bases who were accustomed to the crowded entrances of other bases.

They also walked to the entrance and queued up at the phone booth-like structures. Before long, they took turns stepping inside. As soon as they entered, an infrared beam scanned their bodies up and down to ensure they weren't carrying any viruses. Once a green light lit up above the entrance, they were permitted to enter the base.

The people from the two bases were checked one by one, and whenever a carrier of the virus appeared, the light at the entrance would immediately turn red.

The journey here hadn't been entirely smooth; they had all experienced some fighting, and sustaining minor injuries was unavoidable. Before long, several people from the two bases were detected as virus carriers. They were taken to a building on the side to be injected with anti-virus serum. The survival rate wasn't one hundred percent, so whether they lived or died depended on themselves.

The others couldn't just abandon their teammates, so they waited nearby, which also gave them a chance to observe the effectiveness of the anti-virus serum.

Some had been more severely infected with the zombie virus; even after the injection, they still turned into zombies. Those watching nearby would helplessly put them down as soon as they noticed something was wrong.

On the other hand, those with lighter injuries and less severe infections waited for several hours. The virus did not manifest, and after being checked again by the infrared sensor, the virus in their bodies had disappeared. Perhaps because it was discovered early, the virus had been eliminated before it could spread.

Hearing is believing, but seeing is reality. Having personally witnessed the effectiveness of the first-generation anti-virus serum, they became even more expectant about the purpose of their trip.

Upon entering the F City Base, they saw the unique spirit of the place. Even the ordinary people here lived with a positive outlook, walking with their heads held high, never feeling inferior just because they saw superpowered individuals or mutants.

"It is said that there is no hierarchy in the F City Base. Superpowered individuals cannot bully ordinary people without cause, or they will face severe punishment. In this base, the status of ordinary people is the same as that of superpowered individuals; as long as they are willing to put in the labor, the points they earn are no different from those of the superpowered." Some from the two bases who were privy to the inside information spoke in a tone that was hard to tell if it was envy or sarcasm.

In their own bases, strength was everything. Superpowered individuals held the highest status, mutants were subordinates, and ordinary people were only fit to be enslaved and abused by the strong. No matter who it was, not everyone in a family could be a superpowered individual or a mutant. For ordinary people who only ate and held them back, their status was low, and many strong individuals treated them with contempt and indifference. Accustomed to such behavior, they felt extremely uncomfortable seeing the three groups living together in peace and harmony in the F City Base.

Although they were uncomfortable, they had to put away their usual way of treating ordinary people, otherwise, it would be a huge loss if they violated the taboos of the F City Base.
chapters.title: 第106章 三六九等「求推荐，求收藏」

chapters.source_text:
陆陆续续的经过两个多月，该赶来的人都来了，没来的那些人怕也是路上蒙难来不了了。
大家的目的最主要的目的都是抗毒血清的配方，其次当然是结交秦昕这个医学天才，看看能不能邀请到他去他们的基地。还有刚进基地大家都被方便快捷的病毒红外线感应器煞到了，要是能购买到制作方法最好，没有的话能买到几个感应器也行啊。
想要邀请秦昕是别想了，他挺喜欢F市基地的氛围，再说了别的基地也没有F市基地的宽松条件，他热爱研究东西，可是却不想被人强压的利用。
第一代抗毒血清并不完善，要是他自己是不打算卖的，可是这么多基地来求，F市基地再强也不可能愿意引发众怒，倒不如用这东西换取一些对基地有利的东西，经过几天的讨价还价，各个基地得到了第一代抗毒血清配方，基地方面也得到了需要的东西，双方都很满意。
几个基地还购买了病毒红外线感应器，制作方法没卖，反正一个基地也最多装设七八个感应器就够了，买了制作方法也没用。
将配方卖完了，F市基地还开办了宴会，邀请来F市基地的各个基地的人员来参加，宴席上各种美味佳肴，酒水果子让几个基地的人瞪圆了眼睛，好久没吃到这些东西，大家哈喇子都快流出来，F市基地果然财大气粗。什么都也不说了，大家一个劲的吃吃吃！
虽然心里也有不少不为人知的想法，可是看到在宴席上坐着的那一溜高手排名榜上有名的人物，什么想法也没了，其他基地的高层羡慕嫉妒恨的看着这些人，F市基地真是运气太好了，全国高手榜上的前五十名高手，居然有十七名都在这个小小的基地中，让人不妒忌都难。
“多吃点。”荆成夙将肉菜夹到周磐碗里。
大家都以为荆成夙是全国第一高手，但是他觉得论综合实力其实周磐才是第一高手，只是他这人懒，没什么大志向，在异能记载上大家都以为他是三级空间异能和三级净化异能者，连高手榜的五十名都没入。除了荆成夙的一些熟悉队员，他又没在旁人面前露过脸，知道他实力的人并不多。
周磐觉得当第一高手什么的没意思，他又不想当什么英雄，只要能跟在荆成夙身边，他才懒的去计较什么名次。
“谢谢夙哥。”周磐甜笑一下，将肉放到嘴里，这是为了举报宴席基地里的人特意去打的变异兽肉，一头肉牛变异的变异兽，兽肉紧致有韧性，牙口不好的人不爱吃，但是牙口好的吃起来就十分过瘾了。调味还放了点辣椒，又香又辣，周磐吃的都停不下口。
“很好吃，你也吃一点。”周磐吃的满意，顺手夹起一块兽肉放到荆成夙嘴边。
荆成夙眼底闪过笑意，低头将他筷子上的肉吃了。
全国第一高手的名头还是很大的，几个基地的人也有几个优秀的女异能者跟来，早早就盯上了这第一高手夫人的位置，看到荆成夙和周磐他们两个这么亲密，原本对他有意的人狠狠瞪向靠荆成夙那么近的周磐。
chapters.title: 第107章 购买配方「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_text:
Over the course of more than two months, those who were supposed to arrive had arrived one after another; those who hadn't shown up were likely lost on the road and would not be coming.

Everyone's primary goal was the formula for the anti-venom serum; secondarily, of course, was to befriend the medical genius Qin Xin and see if they could invite him to their own bases. Furthermore, upon entering the base, everyone had been struck by the convenient and efficient infrared virus sensors. If they could purchase the manufacturing method, that would be best, but if not, buying a few sensors would suffice.

As for inviting Qin Xin, that was out of the question. He quite liked the atmosphere of F City Base, and besides, no other base offered the same relaxed conditions. He loved researching things, but he didn't want to be forced or exploited by others.

The first-generation anti-venom serum was not perfect, and if it were up to him, he wouldn't have sold it. However, with so many bases begging for it, F City Base—no matter how strong—couldn't afford to provoke public outrage. It was better to trade the item for things beneficial to the base. After several days of bargaining, the various bases obtained the first-generation anti-venom serum formula, and the base received the supplies it needed; both sides were very satisfied.

Several bases also purchased the infrared virus sensors. The manufacturing method wasn't sold, but since a base only needed at most seven or eight sensors, buying the production method would have been useless anyway.

After selling the formulas, F City Base held a banquet and invited the personnel from the various bases to attend. The feast featured all kinds of delicacies, wine, and fruit, making the people from the other bases widen their eyes. Having not eaten such things for a long time, everyone was practically drooling; F City Base was truly wealthy and generous. Without saying another word, everyone just kept eating and eating!

Although they had many unspoken thoughts in their hearts, once they saw the row of figures from the top experts' ranking list sitting at the banquet, those thoughts vanished. The high-level officials from the other bases looked at these people with envy, jealousy, and hatred. F City Base was truly lucky; of the top fifty experts on the national ranking list, seventeen were actually in this small base, making it hard not to be jealous.

"Eat more." Jing Chengsu placed some meat into Zhou Pan's bowl.

Everyone thought Jing Chengsu was the number one expert in the country, but he felt that in terms of comprehensive strength, Zhou Pan was actually the top expert. It was just that Zhou Pan was lazy and lacked grand ambitions. In the records of abilities, everyone thought he was a Level 3 space ability user and a Level 3 purification ability user, not even making it into the top fifty of the expert rankings. Aside from a few of Jing Chengsu's familiar teammates, he hadn't shown his face to others, so not many people knew his true strength.

Zhou Pan felt that being the number one expert was meaningless; he didn't want to be any kind of hero. As long as he could stay by Jing Chengsu's side, he couldn't be bothered to care about rankings.

"Thank you, Brother Su." Zhou Pan smiled sweetly and put the meat into his mouth. This was mutant beast meat specifically hunted by the base for the banquet—a mutant ox. The meat was firm and chewy; those with bad teeth didn't like it, but those with good teeth found it very satisfying. It was seasoned with a bit of chili, making it both fragrant and spicy, and Zhou Pan couldn't stop eating.

"It's delicious, you should have some too." Satisfied with his meal, Zhou Pan picked up a piece of meat and held it to Jing Chengsu's lips.

A smile flashed in Jing Chengsu's eyes as he lowered his head and ate the meat from his chopsticks.

The title of the nation's number one expert carried a lot of weight. Among the people from the various bases were several excellent female ability users who had come along, and they had long since set their sights on the position of the number one expert's partner. Seeing how intimate Jing Chengsu and Zhou Pan were, those who had been interested in him glared fiercely at Zhou Pan, who was sitting so close to Jing Chengsu.
