他知道军人的口头禅就是“为人民服务”，这话在和平年代用用无所谓，可到了末世，那真的是做死啊。十几亿的民众，军人才多少，顾得过来吗？上辈子把这话记在心头的人都牺牲了，留下的只剩下经过献血洗练，心肠比较硬实的人了。
当然如果站在民众的立场，这些拿着纳税人的钱，为他们服务牺牲也是应该的，但是周磐的朋友都是军人，自然会为他们担忧，悬心，末世了，那种关念是不是先改一改，至少要先保住自己的性命，再说其他吧？
他苦恼的整张包子脸都皱巴了。
他的心思荆成夙都看在眼里，其实他们只是习惯使然罢了，他们还没完全接受末世的法则，等适应过来，肯定也不会傻傻的当肉盾，当挡剑牌，毕竟社会是相互的，他们得到百姓的尊敬爱戴，为他们提供帮助心甘情愿，但是若是得到的是背后捅刀，倒戈相向，面对的自然不是春风拂面，而是雷霆战火。
不过他知道周磐的脑袋瓜只能想这么多，能想出这问题已经算是不容易，“不用担心，我们只是要有个适应的过程。”
严大婶端出刚沏的茶水，滚热的茶杯里，轻烟袅袅。“快喝口热茶，外头冷着呢。”
现在气温都低到零下二三十度，也难为这些孩子一路而来，这路上可不太平。
捧着热茶，吹了吹，喝着热乎乎的茶水，几人有点冰凉的心稍微回暖了些。
严大婶又回到厨房去开始做饭，加了七八个人的饭，做起饭来还是有点吃力，周磐最近都是自己做饭，手脚麻利了很多，连忙进厨房帮忙，周媛媛正在烧火，她们家也喜欢用灶台烧饭，虽然有不少现代化的厨具，可总感觉不对味。还是依然用着这历史悠久的灶台。
三人忙了一个小时，就烧出八菜一汤，加满满的两锅饭，足够所有人饱餐一顿。
饭菜端出来，王超等人早就饥肠辘辘，中午就没有吃啥东西，如今闻到饭菜香，全都腹中大鼓了。客气一通，抓起筷子，立马开始扫荡饭菜。严大婶的手艺不错，吃的大家伙嘴角流油，满足不已。
吃了半个小时才吃完，现在天色已晚，他们想要现在赶回去已经不可能了，毕竟晚上丧尸的活动更加激烈，他们回返的话，危险会增加好几倍。
今晚大概要在这过夜了，周琦家的房间不多，卧室都被他的家人瓜分了，总共五六个房间，即使挤一挤，也最多空出两间房，勉强睡下他的几个队友。荆成夙和王超就到周磐那边去睡。
周磐就带着荆成夙和王超往家里去。
chapters.translated_text:
"Xiao Pan!"

"Panzi!"

Aside from Jing Chengsu, Wang Chao, and Zhou Qi, the others were also familiar with Zhou Pan and called out greetings the moment they saw him.

"Brother Su, Brother Qi, Brother Chao, Brother Dajun, Brother Sanshi..." Zhou Pan cheerfully greeted each of them in turn.

Seeing him smile, Jing Chengsu and the others relaxed. Back on the hill, every one of them had seen how he'd vomited endlessly after killing a zombie, and they'd been worried he wouldn't be able to get over it. Seeing that he could still smile put their minds at ease.

"Da Qi, these must be your comrades! Quick, come inside and have a seat—it's freezing out there!" Zhou Jianguo hurried to welcome them.

"Yes, yes, please come in," Aunt Yan said with a smile as she held the door open.

The soldiers exchanged glances, unable to resist such warmth, and filed into Zhou Qi's house.

Aunt Yan and Zhou Yuanyuan headed to the kitchen to brew tea and pour hot water, while everyone sat down on the living room sofa.

Zhou Pan glanced around and noticed that their clothes were covered in stains and grime, leaving them looking utterly disheveled. The journey here must have been grueling.

He quickly leaned toward Jing Chengsu and asked in a low voice, "Brother Su, are you guys okay? Did anyone get hurt?"

Getting hurt would be disastrous. Antiviral serums and other antitoxins hadn't been developed yet; even a minor wound could be a death sentence.

"We're fine. Everyone was being careful." Jing Chengsu ruffled his hair, feeling a surge of warmth at his concern.

"Yeah, we used makeshift shields to block them and barely let the zombies get close," Wang Chao and the others chimed in from the side. Recalling the perilous situation back then, lingering fear still stirred within them. If they hadn't been quick on their feet, whether they could have made it out in one piece would have been a real question.

Zhou Pan's heart pounded as he listened. Having already experienced the darker side of human nature in the apocalypse, he really didn't know what to say seeing how these soldiers maintained virtually no guard against others.

He knew the military's motto was "serve the people." Using that in times of peace was fine, but in the apocalypse, it was practically courting death. With well over a billion citizens and so few soldiers, how could they possibly protect everyone? In his previous life, those who kept that phrase close to their hearts had all perished, leaving behind only those tempered by blood and hardened by reality.

Of course, from the perspective of ordinary citizens, since these soldiers were paid with taxpayer money, it was only natural for them to serve and sacrifice. But Zhou Pan's friends were soldiers, so naturally he worried and fretted for them. It was the apocalypse now—shouldn't that mindset change a bit? At the very least, they should secure their own survival before worrying about anything else, right?

Troubled, his round, bun-like face scrunched up completely.

Jing Chengsu took in his expressions. In truth, it was merely force of habit; they hadn't fully adapted to the rules of the apocalypse yet. Once they adjusted, they certainly wouldn't blindly act as human shields or cannon fodder. Society, after all, was built on reciprocity: if they received the people's respect and love, they were more than willing to lend a hand. But if what they got in return was a stab in the back or betrayal, what met them would naturally not be a gentle spring breeze, but thunderous wrath.

Still, he knew that Zhou Pan's simple brain could only process so much, and the fact that he'd even thought of this was already commendable. "Don't worry. We just need time to adapt."

Aunt Yan came out carrying freshly brewed tea, wisps of steam curling from the piping-hot cups. "Hurry and drink some hot tea. It's freezing outside."

The temperature had already dropped to twenty or thirty degrees below zero. It must have been rough on these kids to travel all this way, especially when the roads were far from peaceful.

Cupping the hot tea and blowing on it before taking a sip, the warmth seeped into their slightly chilled hearts.

Aunt Yan returned to the kitchen to start cooking. Making food for seven or eight extra people was no small feat. Having been cooking for himself lately, Zhou Pan had grown quite deft, so he hurried into the kitchen to help. Zhou Yuanyuan was tending the fire. Their family preferred using a traditional brick stove to cook; despite having plenty of modern cookware, food just never tasted quite right without it, so they continued using this time-honored hearth.

After an hour of bustling, the three of them turned out eight dishes and a soup, plus two full pots of rice—more than enough for everyone to eat their fill.

When the food was served, Wang Chao and the others were already starving. They hadn't eaten anything at noon, and now the aroma of the meal made their stomachs rumble loudly. After a round of polite courtesies, they snatched up their chopsticks and immediately tore into the feast. Aunt Yan was a great cook, and everyone ate until their lips glistened with grease, completely satisfied.

The meal lasted half an hour. By now, night had fallen, making it impossible for them to head back. After all, zombies were much more active at night, and the danger of traveling back would multiply several times over.

They would likely have to spend the night here. Zhou Qi's house didn't have many rooms, and the bedrooms were already taken up by his family. With only five or six rooms in total, even by squeezing in, they could at most free up two rooms, just barely enough to squeeze in a few of his teammates. Jing Chengsu and Wang Chao would go sleep at Zhou Pan's place instead.

With that settled, Zhou Pan led Jing Chengsu and Wang Chao back toward his own home.

chapters.translated_text:
Back at his own house, Zhou Pan first went to boil hot water so Jing Chengsu and Wang Chao could take baths, and he needed one himself too. He had killed zombies today and gotten some filthy grime on him; he had long been unable to stand the stench.

The cast-iron pot conducted heat very quickly. In just seven or eight minutes, the water was scalding hot. They took turns using the bathroom to wash up. His bathroom was merely a small stall partitioned off under the eaves outside the kitchen using a few wooden planks. He only ever used it for winter baths; during warmer seasons, he always washed outside by the well in the courtyard. In any case, he was the only one in the house, and the view from outside was blocked by his multi-story home, so he wasn't afraid of being exposed.

Jing Chengsu and Wang Chao hadn't brought spare clothes, so he dug out some well-preserved clothes left behind by his father for them to make do with for the night. Tonight, he would wash their clothes and hang them to dry in his space, where they would dry very quickly.

After taking a hot bath, Jing Chengsu and Wang Chao felt as though they had come back to life. Their nerves had been strung tight all day long, constantly on guard against zombies that might pop out from any corner, exhausting them to the bone.

Zhou Pan quickly took a combat-speed shower as well, then took the laundry to wash it by the well. Jing Chengsu hurriedly followed to help, while Wang Chao also tried to step forward, only to be glared at by Jing Chengsu.

"Fine, I won't go! I couldn't be bothered to touch cold water anyway!" Wang Chao grumbled. He grabbed an apple from the kitchen table and began crunching loudly on it. He hadn't eaten fruit for days and truly couldn't stop himself.

"Xiao Pan, how have you been these past few days? Did anything happen?" Jing Chengsu remembered that the apocalypse had arrived early, and he didn't know how Zhou Pan had managed back then.

"Pretty good, nothing really happened—except I've developed an ability too." Speaking of this, Zhou Pan's face instantly lit up with excitement as he brought out his achievement to share with Jing Chengsu. "Look, this is my ability. Impressive, right?"

A miniature tornado spun in the palm of his hand. In just a few days, what had originally been a faint wisp of gentle breeze had been cultivated by him into a tangible, powerful gale. With a flick of his wrist, the tornado swept out and struck a boulder the size of a millstone in the yard, pulverizing it into dust in an instant.

*Hiss—* this was several times stronger than his own ability. How could this be? Zhou Pan couldn't possibly have leveled up using crystal cores; his hands had still been trembling when killing zombies earlier.

"This is...?" Jing Chengsu looked at him quizzically.

Zhou Pan put down the laundry and glanced around. Wang Chao was still in the kitchen and hadn't come out, so no one was paying attention to him. With a wave of his hand, he conjured a bottle of water out of thin air. In any case, Jing Chengsu had already guessed his secret, so there was nothing left to hide. He could sense that Jing Chengsu harbored no ill intentions toward him.

"It's this water. Drinking it is much safer than using crystal cores, and it doesn't leave any impurities, so the effect is even better." He usually drank the spiritual spring water and knew it was good for the body, but he hadn't expected that taking a sip while practicing his ability would also aid his advancement. It had propelled him straight to level three in one go. He dared say he was the strongest person in the apocalypse right now, and he couldn't help feeling smug in front of Jing Chengsu, the previously undisputed strongest person of the apocalypse.

The fact that crystal cores could be used to advance was already enough to cause a global sensation, but a power stronger than crystal cores would be enough to drive the whole world mad. Jing Chengsu hadn't expected him to disclose such a secret so casually. Jing Chengsu tapped him on the head with an exasperated sigh, "You, really... blabbing about everything! If I were to sell you out, what would you do then?!"

"Brother Su isn't that kind of person! Here, take it and drink it to level up. I'm much stronger than you right now!" Zhou Pan urged. He didn't want to be the strongest person in the apocalypse at all; with greater power came greater responsibility, and he had no grand ambitions to be a savior. He only wanted to be a small sapling beneath a giant tree, contributing whatever little warmth he could.

Jing Chengsu took the water but didn't leave immediately; instead, he helped Zhou Pan wash the clothes first. Under his cover, Zhou Pan slipped into his space to hang the laundry before calling Wang Chao to head upstairs to rest.

His three-meter-wide king bed was more than large enough for three people. Zhou Pan had custom-ordered such a huge bed only because his sleeping posture was terrible and he kept rolling off, so he had it specially made. Now with three people, he would sleep in the middle. He figured that no matter how bad his sleeping posture was, he couldn't possibly roll over someone else's body and tumble off the bed, which meant he wouldn't be woken up by a fall in the middle of the night.

Wang Chao was utterly exhausted today. The moment he lay down, he began snoring like thunder, making it impossible for Zhou Pan to sleep, so Zhou Pan simply watched Jing Chengsu practice his ability instead.

Jing Chengsu took a few sips of the water and was just about to begin practicing when an unbearable pain suddenly struck his abdomen.

Zhou Pan clapped a hand to his forehead. *Holy crap, oh no!* How could he have forgotten that side effect of the spiritual spring? He watched as Jing Chengsu rushed downstairs with an ashen face. Zhou Pan quickly followed him down and put more water on to boil; after undergoing marrow-cleansing, Jing Chengsu would definitely need to bathe again.

Sure enough, by the time he brought the water to a boil, Jing Chengsu returned reeking of a foul stench, carrying the hot water away to scrub himself without saying a single word.

Holding back his laughter, Zhou Pan dug out another set of clothes and brought them over.

While waiting for him to dress, Zhou Pan thought of his rare, flustered predicament and hid in a corner, giggling secretly.

"Very funny, isn't it?"

"Yeah, it's so rare to see—" Just as the words left his mouth, he sensed something amiss. Turning around, he saw Jing Chengsu staring at him with a deadpan expression. He quickly offered a fawning, silly grin. "Um, Brother Su, I'm sorry! I forgot that when you drink this water for the first time, the effect is rather intense."

Intense didn't begin to cover it. Recalling that sensation, Jing Chengsu found it hard to put into words. However, the spiritual water's effects were indeed remarkably good; even before he had begun meditating, he already felt the bottlenecks in both his ability and his martial arts loosening up.

The two of them went back upstairs, and Jing Chengsu channeled his ability to begin cultivating.

Zhou Pan lay on his side, his gaze fixed on the intently meditating Jing Chengsu. A handsome guy was indeed a handsome guy; even viewed from the side like this, he was still exceptionally handsome. His facial features were sharply defined, with regal brows and phoenix eyes, a straight and tall nose bridge, and somewhat thin lips that were shaped gorgeously. Zhou Pan wondered what they would taste like to kiss. As he watched, his face grew redder and redder, his mind wandering into wild fancies as his thoughts drifted farther and farther away...

chapters.source_text:
回自己家，周磐先去烧热水，给荆成夙和王超洗澡，他自己也要洗，他今天可是杀了丧尸，身上也沾了点脏东西，早就受不了了那个味道了。
铁锅传热很快，不过七八分钟，水就很烫了，他们一个个去洗澡间洗澡，他家的洗澡间不过是用几块木板在厨房外头的屋檐下隔了一个小小的隔间。他只有冬天洗澡的时候用一用，其他比较暖和的季节，他都是在井边院子里洗，反正这家里就他一个人，别人的视线又被他家的楼房给挡住了也不怕会曝露。
荆成夙两人没带换洗衣服，他就掏出保存完好的他爸的衣服，勉强凑合一晚上吧，晚上他把衣服洗了，放空间里晾晒很快就能干了。
洗了把热水澡，荆成夙两人感觉重新活过来了，今天一整天他们的精神都是绷着，时时要提防从哪个角落里冒出来的丧尸，可把他们累的够呛。
周磐也快速的去洗个战斗澡，拿着衣服要去井边洗衣服。荆成夙赶紧也跟去帮忙，王超也想迈步，被他瞪了眼。
“不去就不去，我还懒得沾冷水呢！”王超咕哝，他从厨房桌上拿了个苹果咔嚓咔嚓咬起来，好几天没吃水果了，他还真停不下嘴。
“小磐，你这几天过的好吗？有没有发生什么事？”荆成夙可是记得这末世提前了，也不知道周磐当时怎么过的。
“挺好没发生什么事，不过就是我也有异能了。”一说到这个周磐立马眉飞色舞的拿出他的收获给荆成夙分享。“你看这是我的异能厉害吧？”
只见一道龙卷风在他手心旋转，不过几天功夫，原本只有淡淡的一缕轻风，被他培养出一道有形有力的强风，他手一甩龙卷风刮过，击中院子里一块石磨大的石头，一下子就被卷成粉碎。
嘶，这可比他的异能强了好几倍，这是怎么回事？周磐不可能是用晶核晋级的，他杀丧尸还手抖呢。
“这？”荆成夙疑问的看着他。
周磐放下衣服，四下看看，王超还在厨房里没出来，没人注意他，他手一招平空招出一瓶水，反正他的秘密荆成夙也猜到了，也没什么好瞒的。他能感觉的到荆成夙对他没有恶意。
“就是这个水，喝了比使用晶核安全多了，而且不会有杂质，效果更好。”他平常都有喝灵泉，知道对身体有好处，可没想到无意在练习异能的时候，喝了口灵泉，居然对晋级异能也有好处，一下子既然晋级到了三级，他敢说现在在末世里他算是最强者了，在原先末世最强者荆成夙面前，忍不住得意洋洋。
晶核能晋级已经能让世界轰动了，还有比晶核更强的力量，足够整个世界发疯。没想到他连这样的秘密都随便漏出来，荆成夙头痛的拍拍他，“你呀，怎么什么都说，要是我把你卖了看你怎么办！”
“夙哥才不是那种人，呐，给你，快喝了晋级，我现在都比你强多了呢！”周磐催促，他才不想当什么末世最强者，能力越强，责任越大，他可没有当救世主的胸怀壮志，他只想当大树下的小树苗，发点余热就够了。
荆成夙拿着水并没有马上就离开，而是先帮周磐把衣服洗了，周磐在他掩护下，跑空间里晒了衣服，才叫了王超一起上楼休息。
他的三米大床睡三个人足够了，周磐定这么大的床，不过是他睡相实在不好，老掉床，才特意打造的，现在三个人，他睡中间，他想就算他睡相再差，也不可能翻过旁边的身体再掉下床，今晚不用半夜再摔醒了。
王超今天累坏了，一躺下就打起呼噜，跟打雷似的，弄的周磐睡不着，他索性就看荆成夙练异能。
荆成夙喝了几口水，正准备练习，却突然腹痛难忍。
周磐一拍脑袋，卧槽，遭了！他怎么忘了灵泉那个效果了，只见荆成夙面色铁青的冲下楼，他赶紧也跟着下去，重新烧了热水，洗筋炼髓之后，荆成夙肯定是要重新洗澡了。
果然等他把热水烧开，荆成夙夹杂着一身臭气进来，一言不发的提着水去洗刷。
周磐忍着笑，又翻出一套衣服给他送入。
等待他穿衣的空挡，想起他难得的狼狈，躲在角落偷笑一通。
“很好笑是吧？”
“对啊，好难得！”他刚说完感觉有点不对，回头见荆成夙木着脸看着他，赶紧讨好的傻笑，“那个夙哥对不起啊，我忘了这水第一次喝的时候，效果比较大。”
何止大？想到那个滋味，荆成夙一言难尽，不过这灵水作用的确挺好的，他还没有打坐，就感觉体内异能和他练的武术的屏障都松动了。
两人上楼，荆成夙调动异能修炼起来。
周磐侧身躺着，眼睛注视着全神贯注打坐的荆成夙，帅哥就是帅哥，这样侧着看还是很帅，五官菱角分明，龙眉凤眼，鼻梁笔挺，嘴唇有点薄，但唇型特别好看，也不知道亲起来是什么滋味，他看着看着脸色越来越红，脑中胡想翩翩，思绪越飘越远……

chapters.translated_text:
Recently, there has been some big news in Zhou Family Village.

Zhou Pan, the "Big Fatty" who was lazy, idle, and spent his days at home just putting on weight, has actually been getting up early for several days in a row to jog around the village to lose weight.

The villagers, who knew his true nature, were all stunned and dumbfounded, looking up countless times to confirm if the sun had risen in the wrong direction. The superstitious grandpas and grandmas even whispered among themselves, wondering if he had been possessed by an evil spirit.

Especially when he encountered the uncles and aunties heading out to work in the fields early in the morning, he would politely greet them. This caught those who had previously endured the brat's foul language so off guard that they almost tripped into the ditches.

At first, Zhou Pan was a bit uncomfortable with the villagers' astonished gazes, but over time, he stopped caring. Time waited for no one; with a crisis looming, he couldn't afford to worry about what others thought.

He had been getting up early to run for several days straight. At first, he couldn't even manage more than three laps, but later he increased the number of laps day by day. Combined with drinking spiritual spring water to nourish his body and practicing his cultivation technique non-stop at night—though he hadn't reached the entry level yet, he had absorbed some spiritual energy—he could now run twenty laps in one go without even panting.

Eight days had passed since he started running. With both methods combined, his weight loss plan was remarkably effective. He had lost almost a full size, his facial features were finally visible on his round face, and his belly, which used to be larger than a pregnant woman carrying twins, had shrunk to the size of a basketball. If the villagers hadn't watched him lose the weight, they might have thought he was a completely different person.

Zhou Pan finished his laps for the day, breathing slightly heavily, and reached up to wipe the sweat from his forehead. The summer sun rose early; it was only 6:30, but the sunlight had already pierced through the treetops and shone into the village. The scorching rays felt quite prickly on his skin.

Today it was the carpenter Zhou Dafa’s turn to provide his meals, so Zhou Pan headed straight to his house to eat after his run.

Zhou Dafa was a very skilled carpenter. The cabinets, beds, and vanity tables he made were exquisite and durable, highly favored by people from all the surrounding villages. Whenever someone was getting married, they were always happy to come to him to have furniture custom-made.

When Zhou Pan entered Zhou Dafa’s home, both he and his wife were already up. Zhou Dafa was sanding a finished cabinet, smoothing out the rough edges before applying a coat of varnish. Once that dried, he would apply paint, and after the paint dried, he would apply another coat of varnish. It was meticulous work; those without patience couldn't make a living at it.

In the past, when Zhou Pan was bored, he would come here to watch Zhou Dafa make furniture. Watching him plane logs into boards and assemble them into various pieces of furniture without using a single iron nail was truly turning decay into magic, something that always left him in awe.

Over time, Zhou Dafa, who originally didn't care for him, couldn't stand his laziness and idleness. He couldn't help but advise him to learn a trade while the villagers were still feeding him, so that when no one was looking after him anymore, he would have a skill to make a living.

Zhou Pan had lost his parents early and had no elders to guide him. He wasn't very bright and couldn't think too far ahead; the only thing he could think of was not going hungry. Although Zhou Dafa’s tone was blunt, he could tell he meant well. He had once wanted to learn carpentry, but he had absolutely no talent for it, wasting several of Zhou Dafa’s good pieces of wood, and eventually had to give up. In his past life, he felt he couldn't do other jobs, but he had some talent for cooking. He had planned to find a restaurant to work as an apprentice once he got his ID card. Unexpectedly, he had just turned sixteen and hadn't even had time to apply for it when the apocalypse arrived.

"Brother Dafa, you’re up early again, aren't you?" Seeing that the rough edges on the cabinet were almost gone, it must have taken at least an hour, meaning Zhou Dafa had been up since at least five.

"Oh, it's little Pan!" Zhou Dafa looked up and sized him up. There had been a lot of gossip in the village recently. He was busy rushing to finish a set of furniture for a client and didn't have time to chat, but he had heard his wife mention that after not seeing him for a while, Zhou Pan had changed a lot. He had lost quite a bit of weight, and he could finally see what Zhou Pan actually looked like. "Not bad, you look quite spirited. You should have lost this weight a long time ago; you look much more comfortable now. Keep it up."

"I will," Zhou Pan answered honestly.

There weren't many people in the village willing to talk to or guide him. Only Zhou Dafa, with his excellent skills and eccentric temper, would say a few words. Others felt that giving him a meal was doing their duty.

Zhou Pan also respected Zhou Dafa as an elder. Although he called him "Brother," there was actually a thirty-year age gap between them; it was just that the villagers valued seniority, and they happened to be in the same generation. When Zhou Pan was little, he was originally called Zhou Dapan—Zhou Da-Pang (Big Fatty). In elementary school, his name was a laughingstock. Later, he cried and begged his father to change it, but in the end, only one character was changed. He felt "Zhou Pan" sounded much better; at least it didn't sound so "fat," and he finally stopped crying. But in the end, he couldn't escape the word "fat." After his family fell apart, his only joy was filling his stomach, eating and sleeping all day. "Zhou Pan" was eventually eaten into "Zhou Da-Pang."

When Zhou Dafa’s wife saw him arrive, she brought out the large bowl she had prepared. She had cooked porridge for breakfast. Besides the overflowing porridge, there was a delicious side dish made of dried bamboo shoots from the spring, stir-fried with pork slices and red yeast rice, which went perfectly with the porridge.

"Thank you, Sister-in-law." Zhou Pan took the large bowl, sat on the stone steps of the courtyard, and began to slurp it down.

"My, this kid has really changed a lot lately!" Sister-in-law Dafa said to Zhou Dafa in surprise. In the past, when she gave him food, let alone a thank you, she was lucky if he didn't complain about this or that.

"Isn't that a good thing? He's almost an adult. If he doesn't grow up and become sensible, he'll suffer in the future." Feeling that his years of education had finally paid off, Zhou Dafa put down the sandpaper with satisfaction, sat on a low stool nearby, took out a cigarette, and enjoyed a puff.

Seeing him puffing away, Sister-in-law Dafa glared at him unhappily, "Smoke less of that! It's not like it's anything good!"

"Alright, alright, don't be such a nag, go away, go away." His greatest hobby in life was this smoke; Zhou Dafa didn't want to hear her nagging.

"Oh, so I can't even talk now? If you're so capable, don't come looking for me when your throat hurts from smoking!" Sister-in-law Dafa huffed and walked into the kitchen.

"I won't look for you then!" Zhou Dafa muttered stubbornly, holding the cigarette in his hand, feeling conflicted. He wanted to smoke, but he also really wanted the pear and pork lung soup his wife made to soothe his liver and lungs!

Oh no! Was his attitude just now too harsh? What if his wife stopped cooking for him? Zhou Dafa’s stern face began to wrinkle with worry.

A man should be looked at with new eyes after three days apart. After drinking the spiritual spring water and practicing the cultivation technique, although the results were still minimal, Zhou Pan’s body had been slightly transformed. Now, his hearing and vision were sharp. The courtyard wasn't that big, and they weren't far away, so he heard the commotion clearly. People always said marriage should be free, based on love, not old-fashioned matchmaking. Zhou Pan didn't know about others, but looking at the "free love" examples he had seen, like his parents—his mother was the most famous beauty in the neighboring village, and his father had a hard time chasing her. Fortunately, his father was a bit handsome when he was young, and he finally won her over. Having finally married such a beautiful wife, Zhou Fugui spoiled her to the heavens. They had a sweet period at first, but later his mother became increasingly dissatisfied, complaining that he didn't earn enough money or that he was tanned like charcoal from working on construction sites and was too ugly. They couldn't go a day without arguing. His father would often hang his head, letting his wife scold him endlessly. From Zhou Pan’s shallow life experience, he couldn't see where the happiness was.

As for Zhou Dafa’s family, it was said to be a matchmade marriage. Before they married, they only saw each other once, and only started to really know each other after they were wed. They had their bumps at the beginning, with small frictions in life, but they gradually adjusted to each other. After decades together, they supported each other. They didn't know what "love" was; they only knew they were each other's closest family, and it would be painful to be without the other. Zhou Pan, as an observer, could feel that subtle warmth and felt a glow in his heart. He thought, maybe this was happiness.

Zhou Pan was envious. He also wanted a companion. It didn't need to be all about love; just being able to accompany each other until old age like Zhou Dafa and his wife would be the greatest happiness.

But in his past life—well, it was only a few months more than his current age—when he died, he had only been sixteen for half a year. He wasn't even fully an adult yet; where was he supposed to find a wife?

Indeed, just envying others was useless. It was more important to think about how to protect his life. After finishing breakfast, Zhou Pan put the bowl in the sink in the courtyard, turned on the tap, and washed it in a few quick motions. Nowadays, every household used convenient tap water; only his family still used the primitive well water.

Zhou Pan took the clean bowl into the kitchen. Sister-in-law Dafa was tidying up and wiping the stove. Seeing him bring the bowl in, she said, "Just put it on the table."

"Thank you, Sister-in-law, the breakfast was delicious!" He placed the bowl on the table. "I'll head back now."

"Alright! Oh, by the way, what do you want for lunch? I'll make it for you." Seeing Zhou Pan gradually improving, Sister-in-law Dafa was happy to put some effort into his meals.

He could order food? Zhou Pan was a bit excited. Many delicious dishes were hidden in his mind, and he could easily rattle off a list. However, he held back. People had only just started to change their impression of him; it wouldn't be good to be ignorant and push his luck.

"Anything is fine. I think it's delicious just like breakfast," he answered honestly.

"Oh! Alright then! I'll figure it out." Seeing his expression, Sister-in-law Dafa knew he was too embarrassed to ask, so she didn't say anything more. She would just make a couple of good dishes and send them over later.

Zhou Pan bid farewell to Zhou Dafa and his wife. When he walked out the door, the sun had already risen above the treetops, beginning to exert its scorching rays. Feeling the heat uncomfortably, he hurried home.
chapters.title: 第3章 他成新闻了
chapters.source_text:
最近周家村可出大新闻了。
四体不勤，五谷不分，好吃懒做，整天宅在家里养膘的周大胖子周磐，居然连续好几天一大早起来，绕着村子周边跑步减肥。
熟知他本性的村民们，个个惊讶的目瞪口呆，无数次抬头确认头上的太阳有没有跑错方向。迷信的阿公阿嫲，都纷纷嘀咕他是不是中邪了。
尤其是跑步时遇到一大早就要去干农活的大叔大婶，竟然还礼貌的向人问好，让这些领教过这熊孩子污言秽语的大叔大婶，讶异的没注意脚下，差点走到沟里。
对于村里人的惊诧的目光，周磐开头还有点不适应，时间久了，也就不在意了，时间不等人，眼看危机将临，他哪还顾得上别人怎么看。
连着几天他都早早起来跑步，开头最多只跑了三圈就跑不动了，后来一天天增加圈数，加上每天喝灵泉水调养身体，晚上不间断的练习心法，虽然还未入门，确也吸收了一点灵气，现在他能一口气跑个二十圈不带喘气。
从他开始跑步那天算起，已经过了八天，双管齐下，他的减肥计划收效显著，整个人几乎瘦了一圈，大饼脸上五官终于露出来，原先比双胞胎孕肚还大的大肚腩，如今也缩小到只有蓝球大，几天功夫要不是看着他减肥的，村民怕是还以为换了个人了。
周磐气息微喘的跑完今天的圈数，伸手擦掉额头上的汗，这夏天太阳出的早，现在不过六点半，阳光已经穿过树稍，照射到村子里。燥热的光线照到身上，颇为扎人。
今天轮到木匠周大发家给他做饭，周磐跑完就直接去他家吃饭。
周大发的木匠手艺很不错，做的柜子，寝具，梳妆台等都十分别致，用的也长久，深受十里八乡的人们喜爱，谁家结婚嫁人都乐意跑到他这来定制家具。
周磐进周大发门的时候，他跟他媳妇都早早起来了。周大发正在打磨做好的柜子，要把那些毛刺磨掉，再刷上清漆，等清漆干了再涂上油漆，等油漆干了，还要再刷清漆，总之是精细活，没耐性的人可吃不着这碗饭。
周磐以前无聊的时候也会跑到这里来看周大发做家具，看他将一根根木头刨成木条木板，不用一根铁钉的就将这些木条木板组合成各种家具，真是化腐朽为神奇，每每让他惊叹不已。
时间久了，原本不待见他的周大发，也看不过他好逸恶劳，游手好闲的行径，忍不住劝他，趁村里人还管他饭的时候，赶紧学点手艺，等以后没人管他了，也有个能糊口的本领。
周磐早早没了父母，没有长辈教导他，脑子笨不聪明，想不到太远，唯一能想到的就是不能饿肚子。周大发语气虽然生硬，但他也听的出好歹，也曾想学学这感兴趣的木匠活计，可惜他完全没有那个木工天赋，白白糟蹋了周大发好几根好木头，最后只能无奈做罢。上辈子他觉得自己其它活也干不了，倒是对做吃的有点天赋，原本打算等拿到身份证，就去找个饭馆做学徒来着。没想到刚满十六岁，还来不及办理身份证，末世就来临了。
“大发哥你又很早就起来了吧？”看那柜子的毛刺都快磨完，少说也用了一个小时，周大发起码五点多就起来了。
“是磐小子啊！”周大发抬头打量了他一眼，最近村内的风言风语不少，有人定了一套家具，他正赶工，没时间出去闲聊，倒是听他媳妇提过，一段时间没见，周磐的变化果然很大，瘦了挺多，他终于能从周磐脸上知道他到底长的什么样了。“不错挺精神的，你这身板早该减减，现在看着舒服多了，好好保持。”
“我会的。”周磐老实的回答。
这村里愿意搭理教导他的人不多，也只有手艺出众，脾气怪异的周大发才会说几句，其他人给口饭吃，就觉得对他仁至义尽了。
周磐也把周大发当做尊敬的长辈敬仰，他虽然叫周大发哥，其实两人整整差了三十多岁，只不过村里人都讲究个辈分，而他两人就是同一辈分的。周磐小的时候，原本叫周大磐，周大磐——周大胖，上小学的时候他的名字被人笑死了，后来他哭着叫他爸爸改名，最后也只改了一个字，只叫“周磐”他感觉好听多了，至少听来没那么“胖”了，他才破涕而笑。结果他终究没摆脱“胖”这个字，家不成家后，他唯一的乐趣只剩下填饱肚子，整天吃了睡睡了吃，“周磐”最终还是被他硬吃成“周大胖”。
周大发媳妇见他来了，就将准备好的大海碗端出来，早上煮的是稀饭，大海碗里除了快满出来的稀饭，还有春天时晒的笋干和着肉片、红糟，一起炒了一道美味的小菜，配着稀饭正好吃。
“谢谢嫂子。”周磐接过大海碗，跑到院子的石阶上坐下，开始呼噜呼噜吃起来。
“嗨！这小子最近可真是变化大呀！”大发嫂在周大发旁边惊奇的道，以前给他吃的，别说谢，只要他不嫌这嫌那就阿弥陀额了。
“这不是好事嘛！眼看要成年了，再不长大懂事，以后就有苦头吃了。”觉得自己几年的教育终于有成效，周大发欣慰的放下打磨用的砂纸，在一旁的矮凳子上坐下，掏出一根烟，美美的抽了起来。
看他吞云吐雾，大发嫂不乐意的瞪他，“你给我少抽两口，这又不是什么好东西！”
“好了，好了，别娘们唧唧的，一边去，一边去。”平生最大爱好就是这口烟，周大发一听唠叨这个就不想听。
“哎呦，还不让说了，有本事等你抽烟抽的喉咙难受的时候，就别找我。”大发嫂气呼呼的甩手走进厨房。
“不找就不找！”周大发嘴硬的嘀咕，手里夹着烟举棋不定，这烟他想抽，可他媳妇煮的那个清肝润肺的雪梨猪肺汤也好想吃啊！
哎呀！他刚才的态度不会太差了吧？要是以后他媳妇不给他煮了怎么办？周大发冷硬的脸开始皱巴起来，愁眉不展。
士别三日，刮目相待。喝了灵泉水，练了法诀，虽然现在还收效甚微，但是周磐的身体也稍稍改造了一下，如今他耳聪目明，院子就怎么大，隔的又不远，他将那边的动静听的一清二楚。都说婚姻自由，要自由恋爱，不要旧式相亲。周磐不知道别人怎么样，就以他见过的自由恋爱的比如他爸妈，他妈当初也是邻村鼎鼎大名的村花，他爸追的时候老费劲了，还好当初年轻的时候也有点小帅，他妈最终还是被他拿下了。好不容易娶到如花似玉的老婆，周富贵简直将自己媳妇宠上天，开始也甜蜜过一阵，后来他妈越来越不满足，不是嫌他钱赚的少，不够花，就是嫌他在工地上跑，晒的黑炭似的，太丑。整天不吵上一吵，都不叫过日子。他爸经常低着头，任凭媳妇数落个不停。以周磐浅薄的人生经历来看，他看不到幸福在哪里。
而周大发家据说是相亲的，结婚以前，两人就看了一眼，结婚了才开始正式认识，开头磕磕碰碰，生活中总有些小摩擦，慢慢的彼此磨合，几十年走过来，相濡以沫，相互扶持，他们之间不知道啥叫爱情，只知道彼此是最亲近的家人亲人，离了谁都难受。周磐这个围观的人，都能感受到那淡淡的温馨，心里暖暖的，他想这个就是幸福吧？
周磐好羡慕，他也想有个伴，不要什么爱来爱去的，只要能像周大发夫妻一样彼此相伴到老，就是最大的幸福。
可惜上辈子，说是上辈子，其实也就是多几个月，他死的时候，十六岁生日才过了半年，他自己都没完全成年呢，去哪找媳妇去？
果然光羡慕是没用的，还是想想怎么保护他的小命要紧。周磐吃完早饭，把碗放在院子里的水池里，打开水龙头，三两下，将碗洗净。现在家家户户用水都是用快捷方便的自来水，只有他家还在用原始的井水。
周磐将洗净的碗拿进厨房，大发嫂正在整理厨房，擦洗灶台，见他拿碗进来，就说，“放桌子上就行。”
“谢谢嫂子，早饭很好吃！”他将碗放在桌子上。“那我先回去了。”
“好！哎，对了，你午饭想吃什么，我给你做。”见周磐渐渐变好了，大发嫂也乐意用点心对他。
还可以点餐？周磐有点激动，好多爱吃的美味藏在脑海里，他随便便可以吐出一串菜名，不过他还是按捺住了，人家才对他印象稍稍有点改变，他不知所谓，得寸进尺就不好了。
“都可以，我觉得像早饭一样就很好吃。”他老实的答道。
“哦！那行吧！我看着煮。”大发嫂一看到他表情，也知道他不好意思开口，也没说什么，到时候好好弄两道菜，给他送去就是了。
周磐告别周大发夫妻，走出大门时，太阳已升到树稍上空，开始发挥它热辣的光线。火辣辣的被晒着难受，他赶紧急步朝家赶。

chapters.title: 第30章 伪装异能「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan spent the night lost in erotic dreams, and when he woke up in the morning to feel the aftermath, his face instantly flushed crimson. Especially when he looked up and saw the subject of his dreams right there in the room, his heart raced, his cheeks burned, and he was completely at a loss.

Jing Chengsu was standing in front of the only table in the room, looking down at something. Hearing movement behind him, he turned around.

"What's wrong? Why is your face so red?" Seeing that Zhou Pan was blushing so hard he looked ready to steam, Jing Chengsu thought he had a fever and reached out to feel his forehead.

"I... I'm fine." The moment his hand touched Zhou Pan's forehead, Zhou Pan blushed even deeper, shyly and squirmingly wrapping the quilt tighter around himself.

Hm? Jing Chengsu's eyes flickered, realizing what was going on, and a faint smile tugged at the corner of his lips.

"Wh-what are you smiling at?" Zhou Pan's embarrassed gaze was darting all over the place. Catching the smile on the other man's lips from the corner of his eye, he sensitively realized that what he was trying to hide had been exposed, and he barked in flustered irritation.

"All right, I won't smile. Hurry up and get out of bed; Da Chao has already made breakfast." Seeing that Zhou Pan was in such a fluster that he was ready to throw a pillow, Jing Chengsu quickly reined in his amusement. If he laughed any more, he was afraid the young man would be too mortified to speak to him for the rest of the day.

Zhou Pan bit his lip, gave him an annoyed, embarrassed glare, and vanished into his space.

The smile in Jing Chengsu's eyes was impossible to suppress. In the middle of the night, he had been rubbed awake—turned out Zhou Pan was having a wet dream. He was no saint, and the person in his arms was someone he had designs on, his chosen future wife. He wouldn't be a man if he didn't react. Vigorous and full of vitality, with Zhou Pan wriggling against him in his arms, if it weren't for the fact that Zhou Pan was still young and someone else was sleeping nearby, he almost wouldn't have been able to stop himself.

He had endured the torment of desire with all his might, wanting to push him away, only for Zhou Pan to wrap around him like an octopus, grinding and rubbing against him. That intoxicating sensation was simply beyond words. Especially when the boy was squirming all over him while softly murmuring his name, he felt like he was so worked up he would lose control.

Who knew how long he had endured that sweet torture, but when the person in his arms finally settled down, he could no longer hold back and dashed downstairs to take a cold shower.

When he returned upstairs, the thought that Xiao Pan's dream partner had actually been him broke his usually stern expression into a beaming smile. He pulled him contentedly into his arms; it seemed his pursuit wouldn't be so rugged and difficult after all—there was plenty of hope.

Perhaps it was because good spirits follow good tidings, but he woke up early full of energy, casually hauled Wang Chao out of bed to cook, and began testing the idea that had sparked in his mind yesterday.

He had been at it until Zhou Pan, who had been sound asleep, finally woke up.

The spirit spring water he drank yesterday indeed had a powerful effect on cultivation. Last night, he had smoothly advanced a level, nearly reaching Level 2. Moreover, the absorbed energy was extremely gentle, unlike crystal cores which caused a faint, uncomfortable prickling sensation in the meridians.

Furthermore, the spirit spring seemed to possess a purifying and cleansing effect; the impurities left in his meridians from absorbing crystal cores had also been cleansed away, removing the previous feeling of blockage. He figured that since the spirit spring could purge impurities within the body, might it also work on crystal cores? Thus, he decided to conduct an experiment this morning.

Zhou Pan popped out of his space, having not only changed his clothes but also taken a bath. He emerged smelling fresh and fragrant, his hair still damp. At first, he found it difficult to face Jing Chengsu, but seeing him staring with rapt attention at a water-filled bowl on the table, Zhou Pan couldn't help feeling puzzled and approached curiously.

"What are you doing?" His eyes widened as he saw that the bowl held not only water, but also several transparent crystal cores "taking a bath" inside.

"These crystal cores contain impurities. I wanted to see if the spirit spring water could remove them." Jing Chengsu fished out a crystal core from the bowl and absorbed a bit of its energy. He immediately felt the difference; it flowed much smoother, without any sluggishness.

"How is it?" Zhou Pan asked eagerly.

"Not bad. After soaking for a while, the impurities seem to have been filtered out." Jing Chengsu was quite pleased.

"That's wonderful! In my past life, I heard that it became very difficult to advance once cultivating with crystal cores reached the fourth tier. If the spirit spring can filter out the substances harmful to the body, there will be far more high-level ability users." Zhou Pan clapped his hands in delight.

In his past life, higher-tier zombies appeared more and more frequently, while human experts were scarce and struggled to advance. Without powerful figures stationed to protect them, more and more bases fell one after another, and an immense number of humans perished!

"You want to contribute this spirit spring water?" Jing Chengsu frowned in disapproval. He had experienced firsthand just how potent the spirit spring was; if others learned of such powerful water, it would be utterly impossible for Zhou Pan to stay safe.

"Uh? Can't I?" Zhou Pan asked naively. "At worst, I can just pretend to have a water ability."

"How could that work? Your water is completely different from ordinary water abilities." Jing Chengsu lightly tapped him on the head, exasperated.

"Then what should we do?" Could they really have a way to help yet sit by and watch humanity go extinct?

"We need to consider this carefully and think it through." Jing Chengsu had a bit of a headache as well. It wasn't that he was cold-hearted, but if the spirit spring water were exposed, Zhou Pan would be in grave danger. Before having a foolproof plan, he did not advise revealing this secret.

"Yeah..." Zhou Pan was a bit dejected. He looked down at the bowl on the table, and his eyes suddenly lit up. "Why don't we soak more crystal cores? We can't expose the spirit spring water, but we can pretend to have a purification ability!"

Purification abilities were exceedingly rare in the apocalypse; in his past life, he heard there were only two in the Capital. Although their combat capability against zombies was weak, they could purify crystal cores. In his past life, many ability users were trapped in the agony of being unable to advance, so they flocked to purification ability users who could purge crystal core impurities. Consequently, purification ability users were extremely popular in the apocalypse and doted on by many.

Speaking of this, Zhou Pan couldn't help shooting Jing Chengsu a strange, disgruntled glare. Word had it that in his past life, there was a purification ability user by Jing Chengsu's side, and their relationship had been anything but ordinary!

Being glared at left Jing Chengsu somewhat bewildered, but hearing about this purification ability, it was indeed worth trying—at least far better than exposing the spirit spring water directly.

After discussing it, the two agreed on this approach, with Zhou Pan posing as a purification ability user.

Just then, Wang Chao called from downstairs that breakfast was ready, and having settled their plan, the two hurried down.
chapters.source_text:
周磐做了一晚上绮丽的梦，早上醒来感觉到，顿时红潮满面。尤其当他抬眼看到梦中的对象也在屋里的时候，更是脸红心跳，不知所措。
荆成夙正站在屋内唯一的一张桌子前，低头看着什么，听到背后有动静，转过身来。
“你怎么了？脸这么红？”他见周磐脸红的都快冒烟了，以为他发烧了，伸手在他额上探了探。
“我……我没事。”他手刚触到周磐额上，周磐的脸更红了，神情羞涩行为扭捏的将身上的被子卷的更紧。
嗯？荆成夙眼一转，就想到了什么，嘴角勾起一抹笑意。
“你……你笑什么？”周磐正害羞的眼神到处转，余光扫到他嘴上的笑意，敏感的感觉到自己要隐藏的事，被曝光了，恼羞成怒的吼。
“好了我不笑，你快起来，大超已经做了早饭了。”见他心慌意乱的都要用枕头砸人了，荆成夙连忙收敛起嘴角的笑，再笑他怕他要羞窟的一整天也不理他了。
周磐咬咬唇，羞恼的瞪他一眼，闪入空间。
荆成夙眼底笑意难抑，昨晚他睡到半夜被人蹭醒了，原来周磐半夜做他又不是柳下惠，怀里的人又是他打算打主意的人，他未来媳妇的人选，没反应就不是男人，血气方刚的他被在他怀里要不是顾及他还小，旁边还睡的旁人，他差点就要忍不住将。
他强忍着情欲的折磨，想将他推开，却被他八爪鱼似得缠住手脚，在他身上又磨又蹭的那种销魂的滋味简直了。尤其在他身上做乱时，嘴里还似得叫着他的名字的时候，他感觉自己激动的都要
也不知道忍受了多久的甜蜜折磨，等怀中人终于消停下来，他再也忍不住冲下楼洗了个冷水澡。
重新回到楼上，想到小磐做的对象竟然是他，冷硬的五官也绷不住满脸的笑意，满足的将他揽在怀里，看来他的追求之路也不是那么崎岖难走，还是很有希望的。
也不知是不是人逢喜事精神爽，他一大早就精神百倍的起床，随便把王超也给拽了起来，让他去做饭，而他在实验昨天灵光一闪的实验。
直到睡的很沉的周磐醒来。
昨天他喝的灵泉对修炼果然有很强的效果，他昨晚顺利晋级一级差点就到二级了，而且吸收的能量十分温和，不像晶核一样，筋脉有微微的刺痛感，不是很舒服。
而且灵泉好像还有洗炼的效果，他身上吸收晶核留在筋脉中的杂质，也被洗炼出来，没了先前的阻塞感。他想竟然灵泉能洗炼身体内的杂质，那么对晶核有没有作用呢？于是他早上做了个实验。
周磐从空间内闪了出来，不但换了衣服，还顺便洗了澡。一身香喷喷的出来，头发湿湿的，本来他还有点难以面对荆成夙，但是见他一直全神贯注的盯着桌上一个装了水的碗，不由感到奇怪，忍不住好奇的上前。
“这是做什么？”他瞪大眼见碗里不但有水，还有几个透明的晶核在里面“泡澡”。
“这晶核里面含有杂质，我想看看有灵泉水，能不能除去杂质。”荆成夙从碗里捞出一枚晶核，吸收了一下，顿觉不同，感觉顺畅了很多，也没有什么停滞感了。
“怎么样？”周磐急巴巴的问。
“不错，泡了一会儿，杂质好像都被过滤出来了。”荆成夙有点满意。
“太好了！上辈子我就听说用晶核修炼到第四层的时候很难晋级呢，如果能用灵泉过滤掉对身体有害的东西，那异能高手也会多一些。”周磐高兴的拍手。
上辈子丧尸中出现越来越多高等级的丧尸，而人类的高手却没多少，晋级又困难，越来越多的基地由于没有高手驻扎，覆灭了一个又一个基地，人类灭亡了很多呢！
“你要把这灵泉水贡献出来？”荆成夙不赞同的皱眉。这灵泉水的功效有多强，他可是深有体会，要是别人得知有这么强的灵泉水，那周磐想安全脱身根本就不可能。
“呃？不行吗？”周磐傻乎乎的问，“大不了，我可以装成水异能嘛。”
“那怎么成，你这水根本就跟水异能的水不一样。”荆成夙没好气的拍下他的头。
“那怎么办？”难道明明有助人的法子不用，却要眼睁睁看着人类灭亡？
“这事还是要从长计议，我们再想想。”荆成夙也有点头痛，不是他心狠，只是若这灵泉水曝光，周磐就太危险了。再没万全之策前，他不见意将这秘密曝光。
“是！”周磐有点沮丧，他低头看了一下桌上的碗，他眼一转，“不如我们多泡点这晶核，灵泉水不能暴露，不过可以伪装有净化异能嘛！”
净化异能末世出现的很少，上辈子听说只有京都有两个，虽然攻击丧尸的能力不强，不过却可以净化晶核，上辈子很多异能者深陷无法晋级的苦恼，对能清除晶核杂质的净化异能者趋之如骛，因此净化异能者在末世很受欢迎有很多人捧着。
说到这里，周磐忍不住古怪又不满的瞪了眼荆成夙，听说上辈子他身边就有一个净化异能者，而且关系非浅！
被他瞪了一眼，荆成夙有点莫名其妙，不过听他说的净化异能，倒是可以一试，至少比直接暴露灵泉水要强多了。
两人商量一下就用这个法子，由周磐来伪装净化异能者。
这时王超在楼下叫吃饭了，商量好的两人赶紧下去。
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 30: Disguising an Ability [Please Recommend and Bookmark]

chapters.translated_text:
The military is a place that really trains a person. Even if you’ve never done a lick of housework, after spending some time in the army, you’ll at least be proficient in life skills—from washing and folding laundry to chopping vegetables and cooking, you’ll be capable at everything.

When Zhou Pan went downstairs, the food was already set on the kitchen table. He glanced at it; although he didn't know how it tasted, it certainly looked and smelled appetizing.

He sat down and took a bite. It was good—quite tasty. While it hadn't reached the level of a master chef, it had a unique flavor of its own.

"How is it?" Wang Chao served the rice and sat down. His hometown’s palate was on the heavier side, always favoring heavy sauces and oils, and he wasn't sure if Zhou Pan would be used to it.

"It's delicious. It's different from what we have around here, but the taste is quite good." Zhou Pan ate without even lifting his head.

Seeing that he could accept it, Wang Chao was very happy and began to eat heartily as well. The three of them ate for half an hour before cleaning up, ready to leave for the city.

Zhou Pan stored most of their belongings into his space, even packing away his beloved three-meter-wide bed. He only packed three woven bags worth of items as a gesture, and then they were ready to go.

When they went to Zhou Qi’s house, the family was still moving pile after pile of things. Having lived here for most of her life, Auntie Yan was reluctant to leave anything behind.

However, they only had one truck to carry everything, and it simply couldn't fit so much. Furthermore, if the truck were severely overloaded, it would be very inconvenient on the road and pose a great danger to everyone. No matter how much Zhou Qi insisted they couldn't take so much, the whole family remained at a stalemate.

Seeing this, Zhou Pan bit his lip, his face showing a moment of hesitation. He looked toward Jing Chengsu for advice.

"What are you planning to do?" Jing Chengsu had a bad premonition.

"Can I... reveal my space ability?" Not the space world, but the ability.

He felt that the space was an incredibly useful tool; it was convenient for carrying things and essential for collecting supplies. Once they reached the base, they would surely have to go out on missions frequently, and without a space, they wouldn't be able to carry much back.

Besides, space abilities weren't rare; in his memories, there were several people in F City who had them.

Seeing that he wanted to feign a space ability, Jing Chengsu thought about it and agreed. After all, having a space ability would be much more convenient—at the very least, they wouldn't end up like yesterday, where the car was driven away and not even a single item was left behind.

Seeing his agreement, Zhou Pan happily walked toward the mother and son who were still at a standstill. "Auntie Yan, Brother Qi, don't worry, I have a way."

"What way could you have? Do you have another vehicle?" Zhou Qi looked around and didn't see any other cars.

"It’s not that. I have a space ability. Look—" As soon as his hand touched the items in front of him, they were instantly stored away, leaving the ground empty.

"This is?" Zhou Qi had also read post-apocalyptic novels and was very familiar with the concept of a "space," so he couldn't help but widen his eyes.

Auntie Yan grabbed Zhou Pan’s hand in amazement, looking left and right. "Oh my, where did these things go?"

The people nearby also crowded around to take a look.

"It's a space ability. This is the ability I awakened; I can carry a small, invisible room with me to store things," he explained internally.

Most of them only half-understood, but they realized they no longer had to worry about not having enough room for their belongings. Zhou Pan had the ability to take everything with them.

Zhou Yuanyuan frowned in confusion. Wasn't Zhou Pan a wind-element user? How did he suddenly have a space ability? Could it be that he had two abilities?

With Zhou Pan’s space, the items on the ground were quickly cleared away.

Everyone suddenly felt a sense of relief and got into the vehicles, ready to depart. As Zhou Qi and his family watched their home recede into the distance, they felt melancholic, wondering when they would ever be able to return to their homeland.

When the car reached the center of the village, Zhou Pan thought of the couple Zhou Dafa and his wife. They were ordinary people, and he wondered what they would do in the future. Now that the village was devoid of zombies, there were still mutated trees and wild beasts in the mountains. The villagers would likely have to leave eventually; would they be able to reach the base safely?

"What's wrong?" Jing Chengsu asked, seeing his troubled expression.

"Brother Dafa in the village has been very good to me. I'm a bit worried about them staying in the village." Zhou Pan hesitated before asking, "Can we take them with us?"

In his heart, Zhou Dafa was almost like another elder to him; he really didn't want to see anything happen to him.

"Then let's go pick them up," Jing Chengsu said decisively. It was only two people, after all; their BMW could certainly fit two more passengers.

"Really? Thank you, Brother Su." Zhou Pan was very happy.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 31: Space Ability "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.source_text:
部队是个很锻炼人的地方，即使十指不沾阳春水，进部队一段时间不说十项全能，至少生活技能是满贯的，什么洗衣叠被，切菜做饭，样样在行。
周磐下楼的时候，厨房桌上早已摆好饭菜，扫一眼，味道虽不知如何，但色香是肯定俱全了。
他坐好尝了一口，不错，挺好吃的虽然没到大厨的水平，但也别有滋味。
“怎么样？”王超盛饭坐下，他家乡那边的口味比较重，向来重酱重油，也不知道周磐会不会吃不惯。
“挺好吃的，跟我们这边的不一样，不过味道满不错的。”周磐吃的头都不抬。
见他还能接受，王超很高兴，也开始大口大口的吃饭，三人吃了半个小时，收拾一下就要离开去城里了。
周磐将大多东西都收进空间里，连他最爱的三米大床也收了起来，其他的意思意思装了三个编织袋，就准备离开。
去周琦家的时候，他们还在搬一堆又一堆的东西，在这里生活了大半辈子，严大婶是这也舍不得，那也舍不得。
只是他们只有一辆卡车可以装载，根本就装不下这么多东西，况且要是卡车严重超载的话，路上会很不方便，会给大家带来很大危险。周琦怎么也不同意带这么多东西，一家人都僵在那里了。
周磐见状咬咬唇，脸上纠结了一下，他征询的看向荆成夙。
“你要做什么？”荆成夙又有不好的预感了。
“那个我可以暴露空间异能吗？”不是空间世界。
他觉得空间实在是很有用的东西，携带方便，收集物资少不了它，到时候基地肯定要经常出外做任务，没有空间可收集不了多少东西。
而且空间异能并不稀有，在他的记忆里连F市都有好几个呢。
见他要伪装空间异能，荆成夙想了想还是同意了，毕竟有空间异能的话会方便很多，至少不会像昨天那样车被人开走，连东西都一点不留。
见他同意周磐高兴的朝正在僵持的母子走去，“严大婶，琦哥不用担心我有办法。”
“你有什么办法，难道还有其他的车子？”周琦打量四周并未见到其他车辆。
“不是我有空间异能。你们看——”他手一触摸面前的东西，一下子就被收进去了，地上空了一块。
“这？”周琦也是看过末世小说的人，对空间可是耳熟能详，不由瞪大眼。
严大婶惊奇的抓着周磐的手，左看右看，“哎呦，这东西到哪去了？”
旁边的人也凑过来打量。
“是空间异能，空间异能了，这是我觉醒的能力，可以随身携带一个看不见的小房间，可以装东西。”他内心的解释了一遍。
大多数人是懂非懂，不过还是了解他们在也不用犯愁东西装不下了，周磐有能力能将所有的东西带走。
周媛媛疑惑的皱眉，周磐不是风异能吗？怎么又有了空间异能？难道他有两个异能？
有了周磐的空间，地上的东西很快都被他收走了。
大家一下子感到轻松了，坐上车子准备出发，周琦他们看着越来越远去的家，心情惆怅，不知道什么时候还能回到家园。
当车子开到村中心的时候，周磐想起周大发两口子，他们两个是普通人，也不知道以后要怎么办？这村里没了丧尸还有变异的树木和山上的异兽，村里人到时候恐怕又要离开，他们能安全到达基地吗？
“怎么了？”荆成夙见他愁眉不展，问道。
“村里的大发哥对我提好的，他们留在村里我不太放心。”周磐犹豫一下的问道，“我们能把他们带上吗？”
周大发在他心里几乎是另一个长辈了，他实在不愿意看到他发生什么意外。
“那我们去接他们吧。”荆成夙干脆道，反正就两个人，他们这辆宝马车坐两个人还是做的到的。
“真的，谢谢夙哥。”周磐很高兴。
chapters.title: 第31章 空间异能「求推荐，求收藏」

chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Ya sat in her room, continuously absorbing supernatural energy. The feeling of comfort left her intoxicated, and as an endless stream of energy was drawn into her body, a "crack" sound was heard—she had leveled up to a Level 1 supernatural user.

The apocalypse had only been going on for a few days, and having leveled up to Level 1 so quickly, she considered herself ahead of many other supernatural users, and she couldn't help but feel smug and satisfied.

She stood up, brushed off the crystal core that had turned into powder, and was just about to go downstairs to eat when she suddenly heard the sound of a car parking outside. She couldn't help but lean toward the window to look down.

She saw a sapphire blue BMW parked in front of Zhou Dafa's house, and three people stepped out of the car.

One was Zhou Pan, and the other two looked somewhat familiar, especially that cold and handsome man—why did she feel like she had seen him somewhere before?

She widened her eyes and looked carefully. Hiss, wasn't that Jing Chengsu, the strongest person in the apocalypse? She had occasionally seen him in Kyoto in her past life.

In her past life, F City hadn't lasted long before it was overrun by zombies. Many people perished, and the few who survived all fled to Kyoto. It was said that the strongest people were there, and everyone ran there seeking refuge.

She had also followed the flow of people to Kyoto. The powerful man she had latched onto in F City was unlucky enough to be killed by zombies on the way to Kyoto, but relying on her looks, she quickly found another powerful man in Kyoto and began a glamorous life until she was killed.

During that time, she had also seen Jing Chengsu at high-level banquets. She had wanted to seduce him back then, but unfortunately, he was gay and had no interest in women. He was often followed by a purification-type supernatural user, and it was rumored that they had something going on. However, with her experience in reading people, that purification user was purely wishful thinking. Although Jing Chengsu was gay, he wasn't very interested in him. Who told that supernatural user to start a harem and think he was a heartthrob? How could a powerhouse like Jing Chengsu accept that?

If it weren't for his special ability, he probably would have been kicked away long ago.

But why was Jing Chengsu here? And with Zhou Pan? Could it be that Zhou Pan was truly reborn, and with his foresight, had latched onto this future number one powerhouse? How could he be so lucky?

Zhou Ya felt a bit unwilling. Why wasn't she a man? Otherwise, she might have been able to use that to climb onto this golden thigh!

She watched eagerly from the window for a long time. She saw Zhou Pan enter Zhou Dafa's house and soon bring out the couple, Zhou Dafa and his wife. They got into the car, and the BMW drove away quickly. Where were they going?

She watched the car leave the village entrance and head out of the village. Were they leaving Zhou Village? But why didn't they bring any luggage? She thought about it with suspicion, and suddenly, a thought occurred to her. She quickly went downstairs and ran to Zhou Dafa's house. Sure enough, things were missing. This was a space ability; it had to be a space ability!

This was the ability she dreamed of. Although its attack power wasn't strong in the early stages, the mere fact that it could carry items around was enough to make many people feel envy, jealousy, and hatred. At the very least, she had never heard of a space-type supernatural user going hungry.

Why was Zhou Pan so lucky? She thought with a bitter heart. Although she couldn't help but have some malicious thoughts, she wouldn't do anything stupid until she was sure of Zhou Pan's status in front of Jing Chengsu. Otherwise, wouldn't she just be courting death like in her past life?

Zhou Ya walked back home. She couldn't stay in this village forever. In a couple of days, after a rainstorm, even the trees and wild beasts would mutate. She had to find a way to leave quickly, though she needed to reconsider whether to bring along the burdens in her family.

"Xiao Ya, come and eat," her mother called from the kitchen. For the past few days, she hadn't been keeping regular meal times because she was cultivating her ability. However, her mother, who used to nag her until she couldn't sleep if she ever saw her sleeping in, hadn't bothered her at all these past few days, which was a bit strange.

She walked into the kitchen, where many good dishes were placed on the table.

She stared greedily at the food on the table and soon immersed herself in the delicious meal. She didn't notice Zhou Ji, who usually pounced on meat the moment he saw it, being dragged out of the kitchen by her mother, who was covering his mouth in a state of terror.
