"Oh ho?!" Seeing the two of them carrying plates in one hand while tightly holding hands with the other, Wang Chao and the other team members started hooting and teasing.

Zhou Pan blushed with embarrassment and hid behind Jing Chengsu.

"Are your skins itching for a beating one by one?" Jing Chengsu glared at them a few times. Everyone quickly forced back their smiles, lowered their heads to shovel down their food, and secretly exchanged ambiguous glances left and right.

"Don't pay attention to them, a bunch of military ruffians." Jing Chengsu pulled Zhou Pan down to sit.

Jiang Ye shrank his head and hid beside the big guy Cheng Ang, dodging the boss's sweeping gaze. This was bad, really bad. He had messed up the boss's plan—was the boss going to tear him apart with his bare hands?

He cautiously poked his head out to look. The boss and Xiaopan seemed to have gotten even closer, which meant his assist was quite successful, right? The boss shouldn't blame him anymore, right? He breathed a sigh of relief.

"What's wrong? No appetite?" Seeing him eating absent-mindedly, Cheng Ang asked with concern.

Everyone at the table turned their heads at his words.

Jiang Ye, who had just breathed a sigh of relief, caught the stern X-ray gaze coming from the boss diagonally across. He couldn't help but glare at the blockhead beside him: What kind of look was that? Didn't he see he was hiding from the boss? Seriously!

Cheng Ang felt a bit wronged. Was he wrong to show concern?!

Jing Chengsu's phoenix eyes narrowed. He hadn't even settled accounts with this guy yet!

"Sui-ge, what's wrong?" Seeing that Jing Chengsu hadn't moved his chopsticks for a long time, Zhou Pan looked at him questioningly.

"It's nothing, hurry up and eat." Jing Chengsu snapped back to his senses and picked some of his favorite food for him.

Zhou Pan ate the delicious food in big mouthfuls. As expected, to feel truly satisfied, one had to eat regular rice. Those biscuits and things, although delicious, left you feeling like you hadn't eaten anything after finishing them.

"Right, Boss, I heard Da Chao say there's something that can improve our abilities. What is it?" A team member asked curiously.

"Crystal cores, an energy stone mined from zombies. Absorbing them allows you to level up." Jing Chengsu ate gracefully while occasionally taking care of Zhou Pan.

"Who would've thought that thing could drop something so useful?" Everyone sighed in amazement.

"Find me or Da Chao later, and he'll tell you about it. I've already reported it to the superiors, and notice should come down soon." Talking about zombie crystal cores while eating was a bit unappetizing, considering where they came from... Jing Chengsu stopped at that.

"Right, come find me later." Wang Chao, who was burying his face in his food, quickly looked up.

"Yes." Everyone went back to eating their own food.

Zhou Pan ate single-mindedly and quickly filled his stomach. He rubbed his round, bulging belly—the feeling of being full was truly great.

"Right, Sui-ge, what are we going to do in the afternoon? Collect supplies?" In the past, the troops would do drills and things like that, but now they probably didn't have time for that, right?

Jing Chengsu turned his head to look at the people beside him.

"Collect supplies," Cheng Ang replied.

"I'm going to help build the base. They're short on earth-type ability users over there," Wang Chao also answered.

"Clear out the surrounding area," Pan Cheng answered as well.

"Let's go collect supplies too!" Jing Chengsu felt that since Zhou Pan had space "abilities," going to collect supplies would best utilize his ability. Besides, the population of the base was growing larger by the day, so collecting more food and provisions would prevent them from being caught short-handed later.

"Okay!" Zhou Pan nodded quickly.

Having just entered the military, the commander was about to give him such a big title, which made him feel rather unworthy. He was very happy to accept tasks within his capability that he could actually accomplish.

Since the mission was decided, the few of them didn't dawdle. They quickly finished the food in their bowls, packed up, and prepared to set off.

Cheng Ang drove out a large truck. There were thirty people in total, including Jing Chengsu, Zhou Pan, and other team members. They decided to go to the East Street intersection in City F. That area had many shopping malls, large supermarkets, and a heavy flow of people, so there should be quite a few zombies, meaning it wouldn't have been completely scavenged clean by others.

Driving all the way down the mountain, the road from Qishan Station to the military district originally had no residential homes, but now various architectural facilities were being built along it. The base would accommodate more and more people in the future, and the existing houses within the base were gradually becoming insufficient. If they didn't build quickly, the people coming later would only have open-air spaces to live in. Many ordinary people had no abilities, hadn't mutated, and didn't dare to kill zombies; now there just happened to be manual labor for them to earn contribution points, preventing too many people from crowding together in one place with nothing to do, which easily stirred up trouble.

The vehicle quickly drove out of the base gates. The five-mile perimeter outside the base had been cleared time and time again, so no zombies were in sight, but once they crossed that boundary, zombies gradually increased.

Along the way, everyone also learned about the function of crystal cores. The team members, who had initially been somewhat resistant to killing zombies, all became excited. Their eyes glowed as they stared at the zombies, rubbing their hands together, just waiting for the car to stop so they could go all out.

Being in the same city, the inside of the base and the outside of the base were truly the difference between heaven and hell. The originally clean and orderly city was now in complete chaos everywhere. All sorts of messy things were scattered across the streets, and skeletons that no one bothered to clean up could be seen lying on the ground from time to time in street corners and alleys—and those weren't necessarily gnawed on by zombies. Many storefronts had their doors wide open and hollowed out, the items inside completely scavenged.

Sitting in the truck facing the scene before them, everyone's excited mood gradually quieted. Zombies were certainly terrifying, but the human heart in the apocalypse was even more daunting.

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 42: Sweeping the Supermarket ( 求推荐，求收藏 )
chapters.title: 第42章 扫荡超市「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_text:
F City's East Street is the city's largest commercial center, housing a telecommunications company, department stores, and supermarkets. On normal days, it was a bustling place crowded with people and traffic. However, after the apocalypse, it became a gathering place for zombies, with many of them roaming around here. Because there were too many zombies, the supplies inside these department stores and supermarkets remained largely intact and well-preserved within the buildings.

Jing Chengsu's team got out of their vehicle at an intersection before East Street. Zhou Pan put the car away, and they approached East Street through a narrow alley, dealing with quite a few zombies along the way.

Aside from Jing Chengsu and Zhou Pan, the other team members had never seen crystal cores and were very curious. However, learning that this stuff had to be dug out of zombies' skulls made them feel a bit disgusted. Later, when they saw Jing Chengsu extract a somewhat transparent, gelatinous crystal from the brains, they suddenly understood. Although its origin was a bit nauseating, its use was simply too great, so everyone gritted their teeth and dug out the crystal cores one by one. Stopping and going like this, they managed to unearth quite a few crystal cores.

The closest place was Yongfeng Supermarket. The front entrance was surrounded by zombies, so they planned to enter through the back. The back door had an employee entrance and was locked, but for their special forces team, this was not a problem.

They simply had one person fiddle with the keyhole for a moment, and the door quickly opened.

So awesome! Zhou Pan looked curiously at the door, then at the special ops member, feeling immense admiration in his heart.

There were many zombies outside the supermarket's main entrance, but none inside. This was probably because the supermarket hadn't opened yet when the apocalypse descended.

Passing through the employee entrance, they arrived at the fresh produce section. The water hadn't been changed in days; some of the seafood had already died, though fortunately the weather wasn't hot yet, so it didn't smell too foul. Some fish were still alive, but they had grown much larger, and each slap of their tails was so powerful that it almost smashed through the aquarium tanks.

These fish were mostly likely mutated. Mutated animals and fish were edible; in his past life, Zhou Pan had seen people eat them, though he had never eaten them himself and didn't know what they tasted like.

At a glance from Jing Chengsu, someone fetched a few oversized buckets, scooped out the fish, and put them inside. Whether they were edible could be tested once they took them back.

Storing the fish along with the buckets into his space, they walked to the frozen section. There were still plenty of frozen meats, frozen fish, and frozen seafood in the freezers, and Zhou Pan stored them away along with the display freezers.

Next to that were vegetables and fruits. Some vegetables had rotted while others still looked fresh. The fruits fared better, with many remaining in good condition, and Zhou Pan stored all the good ones.

Against the wall near the fruits and vegetables were rows of seasonings and hot pot bases. These were good stuff, and Zhou Pan quickly swept them into his space!

Passing through the fresh produce section, they reached the area for dried goods—dried red dates, dried cuttlefish, dried kelp, as well as rice, and various kinds of red beans, mung beans, and soybeans. These items could be kept for quite a long time, and Zhou Pan stored both the goods and the shelves into his space.

Nearby, there were also sweet treats like bread and pastries, and beverages like milk and fruit juice. With a wave of Zhou Pan's hand, they were all collected into his space.

After clearing out everything downstairs, they began heading upstairs. Upstairs were the snack section, household goods section, school supplies section, bedding section, and clothing section. Wherever Zhou Pan's eyes could reach, he simply kept collecting, collecting, collecting.

Once the entire supermarket was swept clean, Zhou Pan and the others were very satisfied and prepared to go downstairs. Because many items had been stored away, the ground floor had become completely empty.

Having only seen Zhou Pan busy by himself all this time, the rest of the team was itching to get in on the action. Since the downstairs area was now empty, they could lure some zombies in and wipe them out in batches.

Opening a crack in the main entrance, Jing Chengsu used his old trick, blocking the zombies' paths with various objects so that the incoming zombies were funneled into three spots. Divided into three small teams, they eliminated them one by one.

Zhou Pan followed behind Jing Chengsu with a short sword. Whenever the zombies were dazed by Jing Chengsu's lightning strikes, he would thrust a few times with swishing sounds, and in a short while, he managed to kill quite a few zombies.

The zombies were still in their early stage and weren't very agile; killing them felt like stabbing watermelons with a knife, and Zhou Pan hit his mark every time.

It took a few hours to lure all the zombies outside the supermarket in and kill them one by one. After several hours, everyone harvested a rich reward. It was just that too many corpses lying on the ground were an eyesore. They decided to test whether the fire ability could burn away these remains. To their surprise, the bones turned out to be quite fragile when exposed to the fire ability, quickly turning to ashes like a pile of burning matches.

"I didn't expect the fire ability to be so useful. We won't have to go through the disgusting process of digging out crystal cores. We can just burn them straight to ashes and pick them up." Zhou Pan felt a bit regretful; you couldn't blame him, as in his past life he had only seen people digging out crystal cores, never burning remains.

Seeing that the fire ability worked, everyone piled the bones together to burn them. Soon, all the corpses were dealt with, except the smell was simply too unpleasant. Everyone couldn't hold back and retreated upstairs, where the air was much more bearable.

Once the smell downstairs had dissipated and there were no more zombies outside the main entrance, they closed the front door. Having worked busy through the afternoon, they were all starving. There were portable stoves and cookware here, so they simply decided to cook hot pot inside. Anyway, there was soup base, vegetables, meat, noodles, and enough to eat their fill. Everyone also cracked open a few cans of beer and bottles of fruit juice to cool off.

By the time they were full and satisfied, they noticed it was already dark outside. The night road was unsafe, so they planned to spend the night in the supermarket and continue scavenging for another day tomorrow before heading back.

Zhou Pan took out several beds and bedding sets that he had stored in his space. There were only a few beds, not enough for so many people to sleep on, but there were also several tents, which would do in a pinch—especially since some people still needed to take turns keeping watch at night.

Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu claimed a tent and went to rest.
chapters.source_text:
F市东街口是F市最大的商业中心，这里有电信公司，百货大楼，商超坐落于此，平日人潮拥挤，车来车往，十分热闹，但是末世之后，这里就成了丧尸聚集地，有很多丧尸在此处流窜。因为丧尸太多，这些百货大楼，超市内的物资反而很多都还完好的保留在大楼里。
荆成夙他们队伍在东街口前一个路口下车，车子被周磐收起来，他们穿过小巷向东街口靠近，一路上还解决了不少在小巷中的丧尸。
除了荆成夙和周磐其他队员还没见过晶核，还十分好奇，不过知道这玩意居然从丧尸脑壳里掏出来都有点恶心，后来看到荆成夙从脑浆里取出一颗有点透明的胶状晶体，才恍然大悟，虽然它的来处有点令人反胃，但它的作用实在太大，大家还是强忍着恶心将晶核一个个挖掘出来，这样走走停停，还挖了不少的晶核。
离这里最近的是永丰超市，前门外头都是丧尸，他们打算从后门进去，这后门有员工通道，门是锁着的，不过这对他们特种队员来说，不是问题。
只见他们分出一个人对着锁孔扒拉了几下，门很快就开了。
好厉害！周磐好奇的看看门，又看看那个特战队员，心里佩服不以。
这超市大门外有很多丧尸，超市里面倒是没有，大概是末世降临的时候，超市还没开门的缘故。
他们穿过了员工通道，就是超市的生鲜区，这都几天没换水了。有的生鲜都死了，幸好现在天气不热，倒也不觉得有多臭。还有些鱼倒是活着，就是个头大了好多，一条条拍起水来，那个力道十分强劲，差点都要打穿水族箱了。
这鱼八成变异了，变异的动物鱼类是可以吃的，上辈子周磐还见人家吃过，他自己倒是没吃过，不知道味道如何。
荆成夙一抬眼，就有人拿了几个超大的水桶，将鱼捞出来放进桶里，能不能吃拿回去试试不就知道了。
将鱼连桶收起来，他们走到冷冻区，冰柜里还有不少的冻肉，冻鱼，冻海鲜，周磐连着冰柜一起将他们收了。
旁边是蔬菜水果，有些菜腐烂了，有些还光鲜着，水果倒还好，很多都保持的不错，周磐将好的都收起来。
在蔬果靠墙的地方摆了很多的调味料，火锅料，这都是好东西，周磐赶紧收进空间！
穿过生鲜蔬果区，就到了很多干货的地方，什么红枣干，墨鱼干，干海带，还有大米，各种红豆绿豆黄豆，这些东西都能保持不少时间，周磐是连东西带柜子都收进空间内。
一旁还有面包西点之类的甜食，牛奶果汁之类的饮料，周磐手一招都收进空间。
将楼下的东西扫荡一空，他们开始往楼上走，楼上有零食区，生活用品区，学习用品区，床上用品区，服装区，凡是周磐能看到的地方，他都只是一个劲的收收收。
等将整个超市扫荡一空，周磐等人都很满意，准备下楼，由于很多东西都被收起来，楼下变的空荡荡的。
一直以来都只见到周磐一个人在忙碌，大伙有点手痒。刚好现在楼下都空了，倒是可以引一些丧尸进来，一批批消灭。
将大门打开一处，荆成夙故技重施，用各种东西格挡丧尸的去路，使进来的丧尸都被引导到三处。被他们分成三小队，一个个消灭。
周磐拿着短剑跟在荆成夙后头，总是趁丧尸们被荆成夙雷电劈的愣头愣脑的时候，刷刷补几剑，一会儿功夫下来，倒让他杀了不少丧尸。
现在丧尸都还在初期，行动不是很流利，杀起来跟用刀捅西瓜似的，周磐一捅一个准。
花了几个小时，将超市外头的丧尸都引进来一一杀掉。几个小时下来，大伙收获颇丰。就是地上躺了太多尸首太碍眼了。大家试着看用火异能看看能不能烧掉这些尸首，没想到这尸骨遇到火异能还挺脆皮，就像燃烧的火柴堆很快就化为灰烬。
“没想到火异能这么好用。我们就不用恶心吧啦的去挖晶核了。直接烧成灰，再去捡得了。”周磐有点懊恼，这也不怪他，他上辈子只见过挖晶核，没见过焚烧尸骸。
见火异能有用，大家把尸骨都堆在一起燃烧了。很快尸首都解决完了，就是味道太不好闻了。大家都憋不住退到楼上，空气才好受一点。
等楼下味道散了，大门外没丧尸了，大伙将大门关上，忙了一个下午，他们都饿扁了，这里有电池炉，还有厨具，大伙干脆在这里面煮起火锅吃，反正有底料，有蔬菜，有肉，有面条等等，足够管饱。大家还各开了几听啤酒和几瓶果汁降火。
等到吃饱喝足，瞧瞧外面天都黑了，晚上路上不安全，大家打算在超市里打发一晚，明天再收集一天再回去。
周磐取出被他收进空间内的几张床和被褥。床才几张，不够这么多人睡，不过还有数顶顶帐篷，凑合一下也差不多了，毕竟晚上还要有些人轮流守夜。
周磐和荆成夙占领了一顶帐篷，就去休息了。

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 43: A Captivating Little Guy "Seeking Recommendations, Seeking Collections"
chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu slipped into the tent, but they didn't go to sleep right away. Instead, they first soaked all the crystal cores they had mined today in spiritual spring water. This soaking would also take time, roughly two hours.

Since they couldn't use the crystal cores, the two simply used the spiritual spring water to cultivate. Anyway, the crystal cores were originally just things they used to pull the wool over people's eyes. Sitting cross-legged to cultivate for a bit, the spiritual spring water flowed down their throats into their bodies, nourishing every part of it and sweeping away the fatigue of the day. After sitting cross-legged for half an hour to finish their cultivation, both of them had gained something.

Zhou Pan collected his aura and opened his eyes. Inside the narrow tent, he only saw Jing Chengsu sitting cross-legged nearby, about to finish his cultivation, and he dazedly remembered that there were only the two of them in this tent. His cheeks heated up, and he suddenly felt the temperature inside the tent rise a lot.

He turned around, pretending to be unconcerned as he took out his bedding and laid it out. Just as he was about to lie down, he noticed how dirty and messy he was. He hadn't taken a bath yet! He hadn't paid attention earlier, but now that he dispersed his mental focus here, he immediately felt that the entire tent was stinky.

He couldn't stand not taking a bath. Anyway, with things blocking the way, others couldn't see him either. He prepared to flash into the space to take a bath.

Just as he was about to flash into the space, the corner of his eye swept past Jing Chengsu, who had already finished his cultivation and was also covered in dirt and grime. For him to run off to take a bath all by himself seemed a bit unbrotherly!

He hurriedly went to ask Jing Chengsu if he wanted to go freshen up.

Jing Chengsu raised an eyebrow, "Can I also enter this space of yours?"

If he could enter the space so easily, it would be far too unsafe for the master of the space.

"Ah?" Zhou Pan hadn't considered this much originally; reminded by him, he only then recalled this matter. "I don't know, shall we try?"

He grabbed Jing Chengsu's hand, wanting to pull him into the space. In a flash, he was inside the space, but there was no one by his hand.

Zhou Pan quickly flashed back out.

"Brother Su, I'm sorry, it seems you can't get in!" He felt a bit apologetic; he had originally wanted to share the space with him, but who would have thought...

"Not being able to get in is the right way! If anyone could casually enter this space of yours, would you still want to keep your life?" Jing Chengsu didn't care about not being able to get in; if he had really ended up inside Zhou Pan's space, he would have had to worry about Zhou Pan's safety instead.

"Brother Su, it's not just anyone," Zhou Pan mumbled.

Since Jing Chengsu couldn't get in, he had no choice but to run off to take a bath by himself. He carefully took off his outer garments and placed them aside; he still had to wear these dirty clothes tomorrow. He couldn't possibly enter the tent all filthy, only to appear bright and clean in front of everyone tomorrow, right?

Taking a bath with cold water, he pondered while washing—taking a cold water bath every day was no solution either. Although it wasn't very cold inside this space, cold water was ultimately not as comfortable as a hot bath.

Changing into newly retrieved undergarments and another set of loungewear, he glanced at that mansion just as he was about to leave the space; perhaps he shouldn't keep leaving this house empty all the time.

Flashing out of the space, he landed on the bedding with a body full of dampness. Jing Chengsu had already undressed and was sitting nearby, observing the crystal cores soaking in the spiritual spring water.

Zhou Pan hurriedly slipped under the covers.

Zhou Pan poked his head out, stealthily glancing at Jing Chengsu with his eyes, feeling flustered, panicked, and faintly expectant all at once. It wasn't like he had never shared a blanket with Jing Chengsu before; last time they had just treated each other like brothers, and sleeping together hadn't felt awkward. But now their relationship had changed, and the mere thought of sleeping together made his face flush and his heart race uncontrollably.

After observing for a while and confirming that the spiritual spring water was working, Jing Chengsu put it aside, covered it with a lid, and then turned back to get ready for sleep.

The moment he turned his head, he saw Zhou Pan with a pair of eyes exposed, blinking at him from time to time.

He couldn't help but smile.

Lifting a corner of the bedding, he lay inside. Though shy, Zhou Pan still immediately huddled close.

The corners of Jing Chengsu's lips curled up as he pulled him into his embrace. Leaning against his chest and listening to his steady heartbeat, Zhou Pan's own rapid heartbeat also gradually calmed down.

Having been tired for a day, Jing Chengsu gently patted his back, coaxing him to sleep.

Being patted so comfortably, Zhou Pan's eyelids slowly drooped. Just as he was about to fall asleep, he suddenly jolted awake—it seemed he hadn't said goodnight yet!

Forcing his drowsy eyes open, he raised his head, planted a damp kiss on Jing Chengsu's face, muttered a "goodnight," and then nestled back into his embrace, falling soundly asleep.

Jing Chengsu was slightly stunned. After being dazed for a moment, he came to his senses, his eyes smiling as he looked at the big darling in his arms.

What a truly captivating little guy! He lowered his head and gently kissed his forehead before contentedly holding him tight and falling asleep.
chapters.title: 第43章 招人的小家伙「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.source_text:
周磐和荆成夙钻进帐篷里，并没有很快睡觉。而是先把今天挖掘的晶核都用灵泉水泡一下。这泡也要时间，大概要两个小时。
没法用晶核，两人就干脆使用灵泉水修炼，反正晶核本来就是他们用来掩人耳目的东西，盘坐着修炼了一番，灵泉水顺着喉咙流入体内，滋润身体每一处，扫荡一天的疲惫，盘坐了半个小时修炼完都各自有收获。
周磐收好气息，睁开眼狭窄的帐篷内只见到荆成夙盘坐一旁正要收功，他才恍惚想起这帐篷内只有他们两人。他脸颊生热，顿时感觉帐篷内的温度升高了很多。
他转过身假装不在意的取出被褥铺上，正要躺下去，却发现一身的脏乱。还没洗澡呢！刚才没注意，现在将精神分散到这边，立马感觉整个帐篷都臭哄哄的。
不洗澡他可受不了，反正有东西阻隔，别人也看不到他。他就准备闪入空间洗澡。
刚要闪入空间，眼角扫到荆成夙已经收功完毕，也是一身的脏乱，他自己一个人跑去洗澡好像有点不地道喔！
他忙去问荆成夙要不要去梳洗一下。
荆成夙挑眉，“你这空间我也可以进来吗？”
如果这么简单就可以进入空间，那对空间主人而言，也太不保险了。
“啊？”周磐原本没考虑这么多，被他一提醒才想起这事。“我不知道，要不试一下？”
他抓着荆成夙的手，想将他拉入空间，他一晃神就到了空间内，可手边并没有人。
周磐赶紧又闪出去。
“夙哥对不起好像进不去啊！”他有点抱歉，他本想将空间分享给他，可谁知……
“进不去才对！如果你这空间随随便便就能让旁人进去，那你还想活命吗？”进不去荆成夙倒是不在意，要是他真的到了周磐的空间内，他倒要担心周磐的安危了。
“夙哥，又不是别人。”周磐嘟哝。
荆成夙进不去，他只好一个人跑去洗澡了，他将外衣小心的脱下来，放在一旁，这脏衣服他明个儿还要穿呢。总不能他脏兮兮的进帐篷，明天却光鲜亮丽的出现在大家面前吧？
就着冷水洗了个澡，他一边洗一边沉思，天天洗冷水澡也不是办法，虽然这空间里并不怎么冷，可是冷水终究没有热水洗的舒服啊。
将新取出来的内衣内裤换上，又穿了一套家居服，临出空间的时候扫了眼那栋宅子，也许他不应该一直空着这房子。
闪出空间，带着一身潮气落在被褥上。荆成夙已经脱衣坐在一旁，观察泡在灵泉中的晶核。
周磐赶忙溜进被窝里。
周磐露出一个脑袋，眼睛偷偷看荆成夙两眼，心里又慌又乱又隐隐的带着期盼。他也不是没跟荆成夙谁一个被窝过，上次只是当做兄弟，一起睡不觉得别扭，可现在关系变了，一想到要睡在一起，他就忍不住脸红心跳。
观察了一会儿，确定灵泉水有在起作用，荆成夙将它放一旁，用盖子盖起来，才回头准备睡觉。
刚一转头就看到周磐露出一对眼睛，正时不时的眨巴的盯着他。
他不由莞尔。
将被褥欣开一角，躺入其中，周磐虽然羞涩但还是立马凑了过来。
荆成夙嘴角勾起，将他揽入怀中，周磐靠着他胸膛听着他规律的心跳声，自己急促的心跳也慢慢平缓下来。
累了一天了，荆成夙轻拍着他的背，哄他睡觉。
被他拍的好舒服，周磐眼睛渐渐垂下来，眼看就要睡着了，他又忽而惊醒，他好像还没说晚安呢！
他强睁着惺忪的眼睛，抬起头，在荆成夙脸上留下一个湿吻，说了句晚安，才又重新躺在他怀里，呼呼大睡。
荆成夙有点愣神，呆了一会儿，才回神眼睛含笑，看着怀里的大宝贝。
真是个招人的小家伙！他低头在他额上轻吻了下，才满足的抱紧他入睡。

chapters.title: 第44章 百货大楼「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.source_text:
周磐睡了个好觉，醒来的时候，并没有看见荆成夙，他赶紧将衣服穿上，洗漱一遍走出帐篷。
他出去的时候发现大多数人都已经起来了，就只有昨晚守到后半夜的人还在睡。
周磐赶紧将昨晚收起的电池炉之类的搬出来，先将锅清洗一下，倒进水准备将水烧开，捞速冻饺子吃。
他将水烧开，打开速冻饺子的包装，将饺子放将开水里盖上锅盖烧开，他打开锅盖。饺子都浮起来，饺子皮生白生白的，还没熟。他倒了点冷水进去，又继续烧。
又烧了三四分钟，打开锅盖，见一个个饺子都浮在水面上饺子皮呈现半透明的颜色，他用盘子装起来。
一锅饺子不够这么多人吃，他又连续烧了几锅。
等他准备好，大伙都饿了，各自捞了饺子，沾点酱油醋吃了起来。
很快吃完早餐，收拾好，大家朝旁边的商场走去。
这个百货商场可不像超市那边空无一人，大门是开着的，商场内有不少丧尸在走动，用昨个儿的办法，怕是行不通了。
他们抬头瞧了瞧上方，底下的丧尸太多了，他们决定从上而下扫除丧尸。
绳子刷刷刷甩上楼，卡住商场后门一处窗户，特种队员都是攀爬的好手，接二连三的爬上楼，楼下就剩周磐和荆成夙。
“上的去吗？”荆成夙问道。
周磐扯扯绳子对他比了个“ok”的姿势，他的功法都到第二层了，这几层楼的距离没问题啦！更何况还用绳子当做借力的工具。
只见他手中一扯绳子，脚尖用力一点地，直向上窜了两米，脚在壁上点了一下，又往上窜了几米，每当气力用尽，要往下沉的时候，他一拉手中的绳子，身体又有了新的力量，让他从新往上窜，不会儿就到了上面。
上面的队员们都看呆了，这是轻功吧？小磐居然会有轻功？
周磐到上面不久，荆成夙也上来了，他虽然没轻功，但他的身手也不弱，攀爬技能又高，并不比他慢多少。
上来的时候看见一伙人都围着周磐询问。
果然人人都有武侠梦，即使大家身上的异能都不错，还是会忍不住向往那飞檐走壁，快意恩仇的日子。
可惜周磐这并不是什么武功技能，而是轻身功法。
一个是武功，一个是修真，根本不一样。
荆成夙赶紧走上前去为他解围。
一见到荆成夙，大伙就不敢开呛了。
他们现在上了六楼，这里一层都是卖文具箱包，周磐进去将东西一一收集起来。
将六层扫荡一空，楼下的丧尸比较多，他们决定先搜索上面的楼层，大家往楼上走，上面有小儿的玩具楼层，小儿衣服，大人的衣服，中老年衣服，床上用品等等。
他们一层层的扫荡干净。才又重新回到六楼，开始往楼下探。
楼下是吃饭的地方，有不少酒楼饭馆都开在这里。可惜现在这里是丧尸的天下。时不时有丧尸冒出来，在各处晃荡。
大家躲在楼梯口，往下瞧了瞧，嗬！起码有一百多个丧尸在来回走动。
他们三十个人，一人差不多要应付四五个丧尸。
荆成夙看了看，决定分而攻击他们。
大家伙又各自分为三队，对丧尸进行扫荡。
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 44: Department Store "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan slept soundly. When he woke up, he didn't see Jing Chengsu. He quickly put on his clothes, washed up, and walked out of the tent.

When he went out, he found that most people were already up, and only those who had kept watch until the late hours of the night were still sleeping.

Zhou Pan quickly moved out the battery stove and other items he had packed away last night, first washed the pot, poured in water to bring it to a boil, and scooped out quick-frozen dumplings to eat.

He brought the water to a boil, opened the package of quick-frozen dumplings, put them into the boiling water, covered the pot, and waited for it to boil again before opening the lid. The dumplings were all floating, their wrappers dead white and not yet cooked. He poured a little cold water in and continued to boil them.

After another three or four minutes, he opened the lid and saw that each dumpling was floating on the water surface with a translucent wrapper. He dished them up onto a plate.

One pot of dumplings wasn't enough for so many people, so he cooked several more pots in succession.

By the time he was ready, everyone was hungry. They each scooped out some dumplings, dipped them in some soy sauce and vinegar, and started eating.

After quickly finishing breakfast and packing up, everyone walked toward the adjacent shopping mall.

This department store wasn't completely empty like the supermarket; the front doors were wide open, and quite a few zombies were wandering around inside. Using yesterday's method probably wouldn't work.

They looked up, and seeing that there were too many zombies at the bottom, they decided to clear out the zombies from top to bottom.

Ropes swished as they were thrown upstairs, catching on a window at the back door of the mall. The special forces members were experts at climbing and went up one after the other, leaving only Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu downstairs.

"Can you make it up?" Jing Chengsu asked.

Zhou Pan tugged on the rope and made an "OK" gesture at him. His cultivation technique had already reached the second tier, so this distance of several floors was no problem at all! Not to mention he was using the rope as a leverage tool.

With a tug of the rope in his hand and a forceful push of his toes against the ground, he shot straight up two meters, tapped his foot against the wall, and leaped up several more meters. Whenever his momentum was spent and he began to sink, he would pull the rope in his hand, giving his body new strength to shoot upward again. In no time, he reached the upper floor.

The team members upstairs were dumbfounded. Was this *qinggong* (lightness skill)? Xiao Pan actually knew *qinggong*?

Not long after Zhou Pan arrived at the top, Jing Chengsu came up as well. Although he didn't know *qinggong*, his physical agility was not weak, and his climbing skills were high, so he wasn't much slower than Zhou Pan.

When he came up, he saw a group of people surrounding Zhou Pan with questions.

Sure enough, everyone has a martial arts hero dream. Even though everyone had pretty good supernatural abilities, they still couldn't help yearning for those days of walking on roofs and vaulting over walls, living unrestrained and exacting swift justice.

Unfortunately, what Zhou Pan used wasn't some martial arts skill, but a body-lightening cultivation technique.

One was martial arts, and the other was cultivation; they were fundamentally different.

Jing Chengsu quickly stepped forward to rescue him from the situation.

As soon as they saw Jing Chengsu, everyone didn't dare to chatter anymore.

They had now reached the sixth floor. This entire floor sold stationery, luggage, and bags. Zhou Pan went in and collected the items one by one.

After sweeping the sixth floor clean, they found there were more zombies on the lower floors, so they decided to search the upper floors first. Everyone headed upstairs, where there were floors for children's toys, children's clothing, adult clothing, middle-aged and elderly clothing, bedding, and so on.

They swept the floors clean one by one before returning to the sixth floor to start exploring downward.

The floor below was a dining area, with quite a few restaurants and eateries located there. Unfortunately, this was now the territory of zombies. From time to time, zombies would pop up and wander around everywhere.

Hiding at the stairwell, they looked down. Whoa! There were at least a hundred zombies wandering back and forth.

With thirty of them, each person would have to deal with about four or five zombies.

Jing Chengsu took a look and decided to divide and attack them.

The group split into three teams again to sweep through the zombies.

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 45: Not Good "Seeking Recommendations, Seeking Collections"
chapters.title: 第45章 不妙了「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_text:
Jing Chengsu and the others divided into three teams and engaged in a life-or-death battle with the zombies on the fifth floor. Their team members totaled only thirty people, while the zombies were four to five times their number, meaning almost everyone had to face four or five enemies alone.

In fact, as special forces members and the elite among elites, their combat skills were already very good. Coupled with the support of powerful abilities, it would be no problem for each of them to deal with ten early-stage zombies. If they weren't afraid of the zombies swarming them all at once and sustaining injuries in the chaos that couldn't be treated, they wouldn't have been so timid and cautious.

With more than a hundred zombies charging over, the scene was quite spectacular. However, they weren't wooden stakes and wouldn't foolishly stand there waiting to be surrounded. They had long since split into three directions, using the storefronts, tables, chairs, and other facilities of the restaurants on the fifth floor to obstruct and harvest the zombies.

Zhou Pan closely followed Jing Chengsu. The two of them were extremely strong; one wielded a sword and the other used abilities with tacit coordination, quickly clearing a circle of zombies in front of them.

Just as they were fighting fiercely, the horde of zombies was continuously shrinking, and it looked like they would soon be completely wiped out. Suddenly, a sharp, piercing, and fierce screech sounded. Jing Chengsu and the others stiffened, their brain nerves and five senses suffering varying degrees of damage. The one who suffered the most was the keenly perceptive Zhou Pan. He let out a muffled groan, with two trails of blood flowing from his ears—his eardrums had been punctured, and he was temporarily deaf.

"Xiaopan, how are you?" Worried, Jing Chengsu immediately unleashed several lightning bolts to beat back the zombies in front of him, then turned back to support him. Several team members also hurriedly filled the gaps, attacking while anxiously glancing at Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu.

Though he couldn't hear any sound, he could roughly guess what had happened. Zhou Pan shook his head with a pale face, "I'm fine. Killing zombies is what matters most. The voice just now seemed to have been emitted by an advanced zombie; we need to be careful."

Jing Chengsu looked at him disapprovingly, but seeing that Zhou Pan was determined to continue fighting, he had no choice but to refocus his attention on the zombies in front of him. It was all these zombies' fault for hurting his precious person! Blazing with fury, his aura soared by several degrees, and with a single move, he unleashed a major attack he had only recently comprehended—Lightning Burst. A basketball-sized lightning ball exploded in the middle of the zombie pile like bursting fireworks. In an instant, zombies within a five-meter radius around them were indiscriminately attacked. With loud bangs, a patch of charred zombies collapsed, emitting wisps of blue smoke. Most died on the spot, while a few twitched slightly, quickly dispatched by Zhou Pan's follow-up strikes.

The zombies facing their team were soon all killed. Two of the members stayed behind to burn the corpses and harvest crystal nuclei, while several others went to help the other members. Zhou Pan was led by Jing Chengsu to a secluded spot, where he took out a bottle of prepared spiritual spring water and drank a few gulps. He left the remaining majority of the spiritual spring water for Jing Chengsu and began practicing his cultivation technique to guide the spiritual spring water to take effect rapidly within his body.

Jing Chengsu stood guard beside him while also drinking a few gulps of the spiritual spring water. The power of the spiritual spring water was gentle and soothing; even without deliberate cultivation, it slowly swept away all the fatigue in his body and replenished his depleted abilities.

Zhou Pan circulated his cultivation technique for one cycle. Wherever the spiritual spring water passed, all his injuries gradually healed, and even his cultivation technique seemed to have improved.

As expected, combat was the quickest method for leveling up. After just a fight, the bottleneck where he had been stuck at the second level of the cultivation technique for days without any movement finally showed a crack. He believed that before long, he would be able to advance to the third level. The third level of the *Miao Miao Lian Shen Jue* was different from the first two. The first two levels were equivalent to the Qi Condensation stage; although their strength was decent, it still fell within the category of mortals. The third level, however, was Foundation Establishment, which could be considered stepping onto the threshold of cultivation.

Zhou Pan happily concluded his cultivation and opened his eyes.

"How are your injuries?" Jing Chengsu asked with concern.

Although his ears were still a bit faintly aching, he could already hear Jing Chengsu's voice. "I'm fine, I've recovered. Let's hurry over and see how the battle is going!"

Seeing that Zhou Pan had a ruddy complexion and a steady breath, Jing Chengsu realized the effect of the spiritual spring water was indeed extraordinary, completely healing his injuries. He felt a bit more relieved.

The two walked out of the secluded spot, originally thinking the zombies should be almost cleared up. But when they came out, they were shocked to see that there were actually many more zombies outside, and a steady stream of zombies was still charging up from the stairwell. The team members had all been forced back onto the stairs between the fifth and sixth floors.

Earlier, one of them had been fully focused on practicing cultivation to heal injuries, while the other had been solely focused on standing guard, failing to pay attention to the movement outside. They hadn't expected such a sudden turn of events.

The positions of Jing Chengsu and Zhou Pan were still a few meters away from the stairs, located on the flank of the zombie horde. To reach the team members, they would have to cut through a large number of zombies. Jing Chengsu saw even more zombies surging up from behind; if they didn't leave now, the two of them would be caught in the middle and surrounded.

The two exchanged a glance, understood each other's intentions, and simultaneously unleashed their major attacks, hacking a path through the zombie horde and charging toward their teammates.
chapters.source_text:
荆成夙他们分成三队与五楼的丧尸展开了殊死搏斗，他们的队员总共加起来才三十号人，而丧尸是他们的四五倍，几乎每个人都独自要面对四五个人。
其实作为特战队员部队精英中的精英，他们的身手本身就很不错，加上还有强悍的异能支撑，每个人对付十个初期的丧尸，都不是问题，要不是怕丧尸一窝蜂的扑上来，混乱间受点什么伤，没法子治疗，他们也不会如此畏手畏脚。
一百多号丧尸冲过来，场景还挺壮观的。不过他们又不是木头可不会傻乎乎的站在那里等围攻，早各自分成三个方向，利用五楼这些餐馆的店面以及桌椅等设施，阻挠并收割丧尸。
周磐紧跟在荆成夙身边，两人的实力很强，一个使剑一个异能配合默契，很快他们面前就消失了一圈丧尸。
正当他们杀的如火如荼，丧尸队伍不断缩小，眼看很快就消灭干净时，一阵尖锐刺耳的戾啸声响起，荆成夙等人一僵，脑神经五官都受到不同程度的损伤。其中受损最严重的就是感官敏锐的周磐，他闷哼一声，耳边留下两道血丝，他的耳膜刺穿了，耳朵暂时失聪。
“小磐，你怎么样？”荆成夙担心的立刻连发几道雷电，打退面前的丧尸，就回身扶住他，几个队员也赶紧补上空位，一边攻击，一边关心的看两眼周磐两人。
耳朵听不到声音，不过也大概猜的出来，周磐苍白着脸摇头，“我没事，杀丧尸要紧，刚才的声音好像是高级丧尸发出的，我们要小心点。”
荆成夙不赞同的看着他，可是周磐执意要继续战斗，只好重新将注意力集中在面前的丧尸上，都是这些丧尸的错，害他的宝贝受伤了，他怒火中烧，气势飙升了好几度，一出手就是个大招，他刚领悟不久的――雷光暴，一颗篮球大的雷电球在丧尸堆里炸开，如爆发的烟火，一刹间，周围五米内的丧尸都被无差别攻击到，砰砰砰，倒下一片炸的焦黑的丧尸，冒着青烟，大多数当场死亡，个别的微微抽搐，也被周磐迅速补刀。
他们这一队面对的丧尸很快都被杀光，几个人留两个焚尸拣晶核，还有几个去帮其他队员。周磐被荆成夙带到僻静处，取出一瓶准备好的灵泉连喝几口，剩下的大半瓶灵泉水留给荆成夙，他运功引导灵泉水在身体内快速发挥作用。
荆成夙在一旁守护他，一边也喝了几口灵泉水，灵泉水的力量温润舒缓，即使不特意去修炼，它也慢慢扫除了他一身的疲惫，补充流失的异能。
周磐运功流转了一圈，灵泉水所过之处，所有的伤势渐渐愈合，连他的功法好像也有了进步。
果然战斗才是最快捷的晋级方法，他不过干了场架，已经卡在第二层功法好几天没动静的关卡，也出现了缝隙，相信在过不久，他就可以晋级第三层了。缥缈炼神诀第三层和前面两层可不一样，前面两层相当于练气期，虽然实力也不错，只能算凡人的范畴，但第三层确是筑基，算是踩上了修真的门槛。
周磐心喜的收功睁开眼睛。
“伤势怎么样了？”荆成夙关心的问。
耳朵虽然还有点隐隐作痛，但已经能听到荆成夙的声音，“没事，我好了。我们赶紧过去看看战况如何了吧？！”
荆成夙见他面色红润，气息平稳，看来灵泉水的效果果然不凡，将他的伤势都痊愈了。他顿时放心了几分。
两人走出僻静处，原以为几个丧尸都差不多该收拾完了，结果出来一看吓一跳，外面居然多了不少丧尸，而且楼梯口好源源不断的有丧尸冲上来，队员们都被逼到五楼到六楼间的楼梯上。
刚才一人聚精会神的运功疗伤，一个光顾着守候他，没注意外头的动静，没想到多了这么个变故。
荆成夙两人的位置离楼梯还有几米，就在丧尸群的侧方，想要到队员那边去，还要穿过不少丧尸。荆成夙看着后面又冲上来不少丧尸，再不离开两人可要成夹心饼干被包操了。
两人对视一眼，明白对方的想法，纷纷使出大招，从丧尸群中劈出一条通道朝队员们冲去。

chapters.title: 第46章 ‘飞檐走壁’「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_text:
Zombies are naturally sensitive to the vitality of living people; the moment Jing Chengsu and his companion appeared, a portion of them immediately split off and lunged toward the pair.

The two were no pushovers. Jing Chengsu had previously drunk a few mouthfuls of spirit spring water, replenishing his ability energy, so he unleashed his ultimate move, "Thunderbolt Blast," right from the start, blowing away several zombies first.

Zhou Pan activated his cultivation technique, channeling his mana into his short sword. What was originally just an ordinary, slightly sharp blade instantly became a divine weapon. Wherever the blade passed, it cut through zombies like tofu, killing several in the blink of an eye. Coupled with his agile and swift footwork, the zombies couldn't even touch the hem of his clothes before being harvested.

The two worked in perfect coordination, carving a bloody path through the swarming zombies.

Seeing the commotion from the stairs, Cheng Ang and the others hurriedly provided support, pulling out their weapons and firearms to attack the zombies.

"Bang! Bang! Bang!" A series of gunshots rang out, and a whole row of zombies with bullet holes in their foreheads collapsed.

It wasn't that they didn't want to use their abilities, but the previous battle had exhausted their energy. They had only just learned to absorb energy crystals, and their abilities were still in the early stages; being able to fire seven or eight times was already quite good.

Fortunately, they had weapons in addition to their abilities, otherwise, they would have been forced to flee long ago by so many zombies; how could they still be holding their ground on the stairs?

As both sides exerted force, just as Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu were about to break out of the encirclement, several fireballs streaked directly toward them.

Zhou Pan, with his keen hearing, immediately sensed something was wrong. "Damn it! Ability zombies."

He shifted his feet and swiftly pulled Jing Chengsu out of the attack range.

"Pfft, pfft, pfft!" The fireballs grazed past them and slammed into the zombies nearby; the unlucky zombies didn't even have time to wail before being blasted into slag.

"Damn! That's powerful, it's more than Level 1!" Zhou Pan was shocked.

After reaching Level 1, some zombies awakened abilities, some mutated, and some remained ordinary, just like the classification for humans.

As the two blocked the zombies lunging at them, they scanned the area. Whoa, several more Level 1 and Level 2 zombies had appeared—some with abilities, some mutated—and were charging toward them.

Ability zombies looked slightly more decent than ordinary zombies. Although they had plenty of rotting flesh on their bodies and faces, and even exposed white bones, at least they weren't missing limbs, disemboweled, or trailing intestines.

Mutated zombies were all massive in size, several times larger than their original frames. Some were "crawlers," moving on the ground with long arms and legs; even so, they stood two or three meters tall, their heads larger than giant pumpkins, and their long, snake-like tongues could retract at will and were incredibly sticky—once swept by their tongues, the consequence was being dragged into their giant maws. Others were "giant zombies," like titans, ten meters tall and immensely huge; just lifting a foot to stomp could crush a group of people.

However, the space between floors was only five or six meters, so the giant zombies that came up were quite cramped and had to adopt the same posture as the crawlers.

"Holy crap! What the hell is that? Isn't it too big?" Cheng Ang and his group on the other side were startled by the new variety of zombies.

Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu exchanged a look, sensing grave danger. Ordinary zombies were one thing, but if they got entangled with these Level 1 and 2 zombies, they would be in trouble. The two looked at the distance to the stairwell—still three or four meters away—but the path ahead was blocked by zombies.

Seeing the path they had cleared being surrounded by zombies again, with many more lunging from behind, the situation was critical. The special operations team members were anxious, their guns firing continuously in an attempt to blast another path. "Boss, hurry over here!"

Seeing this, Zhou Pan grabbed Jing Chengsu’s waist, utilized his "Lightness Technique" in tandem with his wind ability, and the two soared up from the pile of zombies, crossing the several-meter-wide wall of zombies in an instant and landing on the stairs above Cheng Ang and the others.

"Holy crap! Holy crap!" Everyone was dumbfounded. They were flying—they were actually flying! Mom, I've seen real-life 'leaping onto roofs and vaulting over walls.' I never expected Little Pan to be this powerful! Too badass!

"What are you staring at? Do you not want your lives anymore?" Jing Chengsu scolded coldly, firing several bolts of lightning from his hands to strike behind them. Although he felt quite thrilled by the sensation of free flight for the first time, seeing them nearly get attacked by the rushing zombies due to their daze, he couldn't help but break into a cold sweat.

Everyone turned back. Damn, the zombies were imminent; they pulled themselves together and began to attack.
chapters.source_text:
丧尸本就对活人血气敏感，一见荆成夙两人出现，立马分出一部分向他俩扑去。
两人可不是省油的灯，荆成夙先前喝了几口灵泉水，补满了异能力，一上来就甩出大招雷光暴，先炸翻几个丧尸再说。
周磐运起功法，将法力注入短剑内，原本只是一般稍微锋利点的普通凡剑，一下子成了神兵利器，剑刃所过之处，杀丧尸仿若切豆腐，一眨眼功夫连杀数只丧尸。加上他身法灵活迅捷，丧尸压根摸不到他的衣角，就被收割了。
两人配合无间，硬是在蜂蛹而来的丧尸中杀出血路。
楼梯上的成昂等人，见这边动静，也连忙支援，纷纷掏出武器枪械对丧尸攻击。
“砰砰砰”一串串的枪响，脑门子中弹的丧尸倒下一片。
不是他们不用异能，只是刚才一场战斗，将异能都给耗光了，他们才刚学会吸收晶核，异能还在初期，能发七八下异能就算不错了。
幸好他们身上不只有异能，还有武器不然早就被这么多丧尸逼的逃之夭夭了，哪还能在楼梯上对持？
两厢里一起使力，周磐和荆成夙眼看要脱离包围圈时，几团火球直朝他们袭来。
耳朵灵敏的周磐立刻察觉不妙，“糟糕！异能丧尸。”
他脚步一错，飞速将荆成夙扯开攻击范围。
“噗噗噗”火球擦过他们身边，砸到旁边的丧尸身上，倒霉的丧尸连哀嚎都来不及，被轰成渣渣。
“草！威力好强，不只是一级！”周磐大惊。
过了一级的丧尸有的觉醒异能，有的变异，有的只是普通丧尸，跟人类分级一样。
两人一边格挡朝他们扑的丧尸，一边扫眼一看，嗬，又冒出数只一级二级的丧尸，有异能或者变异的，正朝他们冲来。
异能丧尸比普通丧尸长得稍微体面一些，身上脸上有不少的腐肉烂肉，甚至露出深深白骨，但至少不会缺胳膊断腿，开膛破肚肠子外露什么的。
变异丧尸身形都十分的巨大，比原来的躯壳高大了好几倍。有的是爬尸，长手长脚爬在地上行动。但即使这样个头也有两三米高，它的头颅也变的比大南瓜还大，吐出的长舌头犹如蛇信，收缩自如，又粘性十足，一被它舌头扫到，后果就是被它舌头卷入巨口。有的是巨尸，犹如巨人，高十来米，巨大无比，光抬脚一踩，都可能碾死一片人。
不过楼层与楼层之间也只不过五六米，上来的巨尸就比较憋屈了，要跟爬尸一个姿势。
“卧槽！这是啥玩意？也太大了吧？”那头的成昂他们都被新出现的丧尸品种吓了一跳。
周磐和荆成夙一对眼，大感不妙，普通丧尸还好，要是被这些一二级的丧尸纠缠上就遭了。两人看一下楼梯口的距离，还差三四米，但是前面都是丧尸。
眼看被打出的通道又被丧尸围上，后面又有许多丧尸扑上来，情况十分危及。特战队员们急得跳脚，手中枪不断攻击。企图再轰出一条道，“老大快过来。”
周磐见状抱住荆成夙的腰，使出轻身术配合风异能，两人从丧尸堆里飞起，须弥间越过几米宽的丧尸墙，落到成昂他们上方楼梯上。
“卧槽！卧槽！”大家伙目瞪口呆，这是在飞，这是真的在飞，妈妈，看到活的飞檐走壁了。没想到小磐子这么厉害！太牛逼了！
“发什么呆呢？不要命了？”荆成夙冷斥，手上轰下几道雷电打在他们身后。虽然第一次感受自由飞行这种感觉，也满刺激心里暗爽，但是看到因他们的呆愣差点被冲上来的丧尸攻击到，也忍不住狠狠捏把汗。
大家回头，靠，丧尸要迫在眉睫了，感觉打起精神攻击。
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 46: 'Leaping onto Roofs and Vaulting over Walls' [Seeking recommendations, seeking collections]

chapters.source_text:
到嘴的肉跑了，丧尸们十分不甘心，纷纷朝楼梯口扑来。
特战队员们的子弹可不是吃素的，“突突突”一阵枪声，子弹扫射，很快最前头的丧尸倒下不少。
两军对垒初期丧尸相当于炮灰，根本起不了多少风浪。
不过子弹对付初期丧尸还成，像那些异能丧尸变异丧尸就不大见效，子弹不是被异能打落，就是卡在变异丧尸表皮上，根本打穿不进去。
丧尸是没意识的，见肉只晓得往上扑，不过当暗处传来几声短促有节奏的戾啸声，丧尸群突然变得有规律起来，初期丧尸后退，一二级丧尸顶上，直扑向众人。
“靠！那幕后还有指挥者。”周磐皱起眉头，这片区域居然有这么多的高等级丧尸，还这么规律，难道出现丧尸王了？他看向荆成夙，“夙哥咋办？”
“应该是精神系丧尸吧？！”荆成夙想起看的那本末世小说里描述的丧尸猜想。他朝楼梯口看去。只见变异丧尸对攻击到身上的枪火毫无畏惧，直朝这边爬来，庞大高壮的体型，所过之处轰隆隆作响，大伙都感觉楼层地面都在晃动了。他脸色微变，“看来情势不妙，成昂带大家先撤退。”
成昂他们也是脸色大变，没想到他们引以为傲的枪法居然对这些高等级丧尸没用。听荆成夙下令撤退，赶紧边开枪，边往上退。
周磐和荆成夙让开让他们退后，“你们先撤到永丰超市那边，我们很快就到。”
荆成夙发出一招雷光暴，直接攻向爬尸大嘴，爬尸正张着嘴吐着长舌头扫来，雷光暴在它嘴边炸开，轰掉了丧尸半截长舌，流出黑浓腐臭的丧尸血。丧尸虽然没痛感，但长舌算是它的武器了，一下子炸没一半，立刻尖锐的嚎叫。
卧槽，老大就是老大，看来不用担心了。
成昂带着其他队员，从原先爬上来的地方，顺着绳索溜下百货大楼。
等他们都走了，两人也不在掩饰实力，周磐甩出一道强大的龙卷风卷向丧尸群。他的三级异能可不是盖的，龙卷风力道强劲，刹时席卷了很多丧尸，咔咔咔被搅成粉碎。即使一二级丧尸也不能幸免。
荆成夙的异能虽然差点才到二级，但威力并不比周磐的风异能差多少，两人联手，先清空等级低的，再攻向一二级丧尸。
很快低级丧尸都扫荡空了，留下一二级，一级丧尸有十来个，两人不放在眼里，主要的还是二级的那些，变异丧尸有三个，异能的有五个。
他们这边清理丧尸，楼梯口又有新的丧尸冒上来，看来要赶紧将这里的丧尸清完就溜，否则这源源不断，可不太妙。
只见周磐飞身攻向变异丧尸，这丧尸肉身坚硬无比，想要用异能解决他们有点困难，不过周磐短剑附上灵气可就不同了，神兵利器也不过如此，加上他身法了得，直接飞向变异丧尸上空，倒头攻下，一剑扎向巨大的头颅。
荆成夙攻向异能丧尸，一边还要留心别的丧尸袭向周磐。看周磐不顾危险的攻击，心里悬心又惆怅，暗地里有点懊恼，原该他来保护小磐的，可现在终究实力不及，否则哪用小磐如此冒险，回去了他要赶紧加紧提高实力，老是被保护不是他的作风。
两人速度很快一下子消灭了几个二级丧尸，正当他们要攻向一级丧尸时，越来越多丧尸涌上楼梯，随之而来的还有其他一二级丧尸。
看来要赶快撤了！
周磐飞速闪过被解决的几个二级丧尸，将它们的丧尸晶核掏出来，其他被杀的初期丧尸晶核已经来不及挖了，有点遗憾，不过晶核虽重要，还是小命更宝贵，两人准备撤退。
荆成夙甩出两颗雷光暴，趁着丧尸被炸的东倒西歪的空挡，两人飞速冲上楼。闪到窗边往下跳。边跳两人还在奇怪那精神丧尸跑哪去了，有它指挥的话，他们想轻松闪人可不太容易。
chapters.translated_text:
Having had their meal slip away, the zombies were extremely unwilling and swarmed toward the stairwell one after another.

The special forces soldiers' bullets were no joke; with a burst of gunfire and sweeping shots, many of the zombies in the front soon fell.

In the early stages of the confrontation, the basic zombies were merely cannon fodder and couldn't stir up much trouble.

However, while bullets worked against basic zombies, they were not very effective against those powered or mutated zombies. The bullets were either deflected by supernatural abilities or became lodged in the tough skin of the mutated zombies, unable to penetrate at all.

Zombies have no consciousness; they only know to pounce when they see flesh. But when a few short, rhythmic, harsh screeches came from the shadows, the zombie horde suddenly became organized. The basic zombies retreated, while Level 1 and Level 2 zombies moved to the front, lunging straight at the group.

"Damn! There's a commander behind the scenes." Zhou Pan frowned. There were so many high-level zombies in this area, and they were so organized—could a Zombie King have appeared? He looked at Jing Chengsu, "Brother Su, what should we do?"

"It should be a mental-type zombie, right?!" Jing Chengsu recalled the theories about zombies described in the apocalyptic novel he had read. He looked toward the stairwell. He saw the mutated zombies showing no fear of the gunfire hitting them, crawling straight toward them. Their massive, tall frames made a rumbling sound wherever they passed, and everyone felt the floor shaking. His expression shifted slightly, "It looks like the situation is bad. Cheng'ang, take everyone and retreat first."

Cheng'ang and the others also had their expressions change drastically; they hadn't expected their pride-and-joy marksmanship to be useless against these high-level zombies. Hearing Jing Chengsu's order to retreat, they quickly fired while backing away.

Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu stepped aside to let them retreat, "You all head to the Yongfeng Supermarket first; we'll be there soon."

Jing Chengsu unleashed a "Lightning Burst," attacking the gaping maw of a crawling zombie. The zombie was lunging with its long tongue extended, and the Lightning Burst exploded right by its mouth, blowing off half of its long tongue and causing thick, black, foul-smelling zombie blood to flow out. Although zombies feel no pain, the long tongue was its weapon; with half of it blown away, it immediately let out a shrill howl.

Damn, the boss is the boss; it seems there's no need to worry.

Cheng'ang led the other team members, sliding down the department store building along the ropes from where they had originally climbed up.

Once they were all gone, the two no longer hid their strength. Zhou Pan unleashed a powerful tornado toward the zombie horde. His Level 3 ability was no joke; the force of the tornado was immense, instantly sweeping up many zombies and grinding them into pieces with a crunching sound. Even Level 1 and 2 zombies were not spared.

Although Jing Chengsu's ability was just shy of Level 2, its power was not much less than Zhou Pan's wind ability. The two joined forces, first clearing out the low-level ones before attacking the Level 1 and 2 zombies.

Soon, the low-level zombies were wiped out, leaving only the Level 1 and 2 ones. There were over a dozen Level 1 zombies, which the two didn't care much about; the main threats were the Level 2 ones—three mutated zombies and five powered zombies.

As they cleared the zombies, new ones emerged from the stairwell. It seemed they needed to finish off the zombies here quickly and slip away, otherwise, this endless stream would be quite troublesome.

Zhou Pan flew toward a mutated zombie. These zombies had incredibly tough bodies, making them difficult to deal with using abilities alone. However, it was a different story when Zhou Pan's short sword was imbued with spiritual energy—it was as good as any divine weapon. Combined with his superb movement technique, he flew above the mutated zombie, dove down, and plunged his sword into its massive head.

Jing Chengsu attacked the powered zombies while keeping an eye out for any others lunging at Zhou Pan. Seeing Zhou Pan attacking regardless of the danger, he felt both anxious and melancholy. Secretly, he felt annoyed; he should have been the one protecting Xiao Pan, but his strength was ultimately inferior. Otherwise, why would Xiao Pan need to take such risks? Once they returned, he would have to work hard to improve his strength; being protected all the time was not his style.

The two were very fast and quickly eliminated several Level 2 zombies. Just as they were about to attack the Level 1 zombies, more and more zombies flooded up the stairs, followed by other Level 1 and 2 zombies.

It looked like it was time to retreat quickly!

Zhou Pan flashed past the few Level 2 zombies they had just finished off and dug out their zombie cores. It was a pity he didn't have time to dig out the cores of the other basic zombies they had killed, but while cores were important, their lives were more precious. The two prepared to retreat.

Jing Chengsu threw out two Lightning Bursts, and taking advantage of the zombies being sent reeling, the two rushed upstairs at high speed and jumped out the window. As they jumped, they were still wondering where that mental-type zombie had gone. If it were still commanding them, it wouldn't be easy for them to slip away so easily.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 47: Preparing to Retreat [Seeking Recommendations, Seeking Collections]
chapters.title: 第47章 准备撤退「求推荐，求收藏」

chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu rushed swiftly toward Yongfeng Supermarket. Before even entering, they heard the sound of gunfire and fierce shrieks coming from inside, causing their hearts to skip a beat. Thinking of the psychic zombie that had never appeared, an ominous premonition welled up in their minds.

They hurriedly rushed in.

Inside a finance office on the second floor of the supermarket, Cheng Ang and the others had gathered. Several people were holding guns and firing continuously outward, while the others looked with heavy hearts at two severely injured companions on the ground.

"Damn it! I never expected there would be zombies lying in ambush here."

"We were all too careless!"

"Haozi, Da Fan, you must hold on. Boss will be here soon."

Cheng Ang’s face was gloomy and his brows were tightly furrowed. After a fierce battle, they were already exhausted. When they smoothly crossed over from the department store and entered this supermarket that had previously been cleared out, they inevitably let down their guard. They hadn't expected zombies to be lying in ambush here. Hearing the fierce shrieks, they knew something was wrong, but it was already too late. Two team members were severely wounded by the mutant zombie's attack, and many others sustained minor injuries while completely unprepared. The only blessing in disguise was that the first to attack them was an ability zombie; otherwise, if other zombies had gotten close and left a wound or two, it wouldn't have just been a matter of getting injured.

They immediately drew their weapons and fought back fiercely. While they couldn't kill these Level 1 and Level 2 zombies, they could at least stall them a bit. Fighting and retreating, they were unconsciously driven into this small room.

This thin wall couldn't possibly withstand a punch from a mutant zombie. Everyone's heart sank lower and lower. Watching the zombies gradually closing in, cold sweat poured down. Fuck! We're going down here today.

In their hearts, they hoped the boss would arrive quickly, yet they didn't know what the boss could do even if he came. The boss was only one level higher than them; with so many zombies, coming would just be sending another meal. Thinking of this, they hoped the boss wouldn't come after all.

Another burst of short, fierce shrieks came. Looking out from the doorway, everyone found that psychic zombie. Holy shit! It was actually an infant zombie, clinging to the back of a crawler zombie, glaring fiercely at them with shrieks as it met their gaze.

A strong mental fluctuation swept directly toward them, causing everyone's minds to suffer varying degrees of trauma. The two heavily injured team members on the ground, who had previously maintained a weak consciousness, passed out on the spot. The others were startled and rushed over to check, relieved to find they had only fainted.

"Boom!" A fist smashed into the wall, sending chunks of stone and plaster raining down. The team member closest to the wall was also blasted aside by the shockwave, and everyone dragged the two unconscious teammates into the furthest corner.

"Boom!" "Puff, puff, puff!" Aside from the mutant zombie's attacks, ability zombies also periodically hurled a few elemental attacks inside. The room was only so big, leaving absolutely nowhere to dodge. Several more team members fell, their wounded flesh bleeding. The scent of blood further drove the outside zombies into a frenzy, making their attacks even more violent. The walls were crumbling and looked ready to collapse at any moment, leaving the situation in imminent peril.

It was at this exact moment that Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu, who had rushed over with all their might, finally arrived. No longer caring about hiding anything, Zhou Pan unleashed several tornadoes directly targeting the zombies attacking the wall. The fierce, howling winds swept past, sending the zombies at the door of the small room sprawling in all directions, and many zombies sucked into the tornadoes were churned to pieces.

Jing Chengsu also quickly followed up, using lightning to blast the remaining fish that slipped through the net, temporarily resolving the crisis over there.

Having their good deed ruined, the psychic zombie flew into a rage, screaming shrieks over and over. The sharp, piercing cries echoed throughout the entire building, making Zhou Pan's ears ring. Fortunately, he had sealed off his senses the moment he saw the psychic zombie was about to make a sound, otherwise he would have suffered severe trauma once again.

Zhou Pan exchanged a glance with Jing Chengsu. Without eliminating the psychic zombie, the real crisis could not be resolved. As long as this zombie was removed, the rest were nothing more than loose sand and not worth worrying about.

Gripping his short sword tightly, he used the technique "A Bird Flying into the Woods" and lunged straight at the psychic zombie.

This psychic zombie was a Level 2 zombie on the verge of breaking through to Level 3. Its strongest asset was its mental power, while its physical body and speed were quite poor. If it weren't for its ability to control other zombies, it would have been killed by other zombies long ago.

Besides human flesh and blood essence, zombies could actually absorb the crystal cores of their own kind when leveling up, so infighting was inevitable.

Other zombies were strong but lacked consciousness; the psychic zombie was far superior to them. Not only was its consciousness formidable, but it also reverse-controlled them, becoming an uncrowned king.

As Zhou Pan lunged toward it, the cunning psychic zombie immediately panicked, hastily ordering nearby zombies to come to its rescue, while continuously launching mental waves to attack Zhou Pan.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 48: Psychic Zombie "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.source_text:
周磐和荆成夙飞速靠近永丰超市，还没进入超市就听里面传出枪响和戾啸声，心里一下子咯噔一声，想到一直没出现的那只精神丧尸，不详的预感涌上心头。
连忙匆匆闯进去。
超市二楼一处财务室内，成昂等人聚集到一起，几个人端着枪对外不断攻击，其他人心情沉重的看着地上两个深受重伤的伙伴。
“该死！没想到既然有丧尸在这边埋伏。”
“都是我们大意了！”
“耗子，大樊可要坚持住，老大马上来了。”
成昂沉着脸，皱紧眉头，他们这些人经过一场激烈的厮杀，早已疲惫不堪，顺利从百货大楼那边过来，进到这原先被清理过的超市时都不免放松了警惕，没想到这里居然有丧尸埋伏，一听到戾啸声就知道不妙，但是还是来不及，两个队员受到异能丧尸的攻击身受重创，其他人也有不少毫无防备下受了点轻伤，不幸中的大幸，最先攻击他们的是异能丧尸，否则要是被别的丧尸近身留下一两道伤口，那就不是受伤的问题了。
他们当即掏出武器猛烈反击，杀不死这些一二级丧尸，阻挡两下还是可以的。他们且战且退，不知不觉被驱赶到这个小房间来。
这薄薄的墙面根本挡不住变异丧尸一个拳头，大伙的心一个劲的往下沉，看着渐渐围堵过来的丧尸，冷汗直往下流，草！今天要载在这里了。
心中期盼老大快点过来，可又不知道老大过来能干什么，老大也就比他们高一等级，这么多的丧尸，过来也是多一个送菜的，想到此又不希望老大过来了。
又一阵短促的戾啸声传来，大伙从门口往外一望，找到了那只精神丧尸，卧槽！居然是一只婴儿丧尸，趴在一只爬尸背上，迎着他们目光对他们凶悍的戾啸。
强烈的精神波动直扫向这边，大家的精神都受到了不同程度的创伤。地上受伤严重原本保持微弱意识的两个队员，当场晕死过去，其他人吃了一惊，赶紧扑去查看，幸好只是晕过去。
“轰”一拳头砸向墙面，石块石灰“刷刷”往下掉，离墙边最近的队员也被震飞到一旁，大伙拖着两个昏迷的队员直靠到最角落。
“轰”“噗噗噗”除了变异丧尸的攻击，还有异能丧尸也不时甩进几道异能，这房间就这么大，压根没法躲，好几个队员也倒下，受创的伤口留出血花，血腥味更刺激的外面的丧尸发狂，攻击更加猛烈。墙体摇摇欲坠，眼看就要塌方，情势危在旦夕。
就在这时拼力赶到的周磐和荆成夙终于赶到，顾不得在隐瞒什么，周磐几道龙卷风直接攻向不断攻击墙体的丧尸，强劲的风狂刮而过，席卷的小房间门口的丧尸东倒西歪，不少卷入龙卷风的丧尸都被搅碎。
荆成夙也快速补刀将漏网之鱼用雷电劈死，暂时解决了那边的危机。
被破坏了好事，精神丧尸狂怒起来，连连戾啸，尖锐的啸鸣声在整栋楼回荡，震的周磐耳朵一阵轰鸣，幸亏他一见精神丧尸要发出声音就封闭了感官，否则又要受创严重。
周磐对荆成夙使了个眼色，不消灭精神丧尸就解决不了真正的危机，只要除了这只丧尸，别的都不过是一群散沙，不足为虑。
他握紧短剑一招飞鸟入林直扑精神丧尸。
这只精神丧尸是二级眼看要破三级的丧尸，最强的就是精神力，其他肉身速度什么的都很差，要不是它能控制其他丧尸，早被其他丧尸给杀了。
丧尸晋级除了人类的血肉精华其实也可以吸收同类的丧尸晶核，自相残杀是免不了的。
其他丧尸强但是没意识，精神丧尸就比它们强多了，不但意识强悍还反控制了它们，成了无冕之王。
周磐飞扑向它，狡猾的精神丧尸立刻慌了，赶忙命令附近的丧尸过来救援，它也不断发出精神光波袭向周磐。
chapters.title: 第48章 精神丧尸「求推荐，求收藏」

chapters.translated_text:
The psychic zombie's mental wave shot straight toward Zhou Pan.

Zhou Pan had only been injured earlier because he hadn't anticipated a psychic zombie; now that he was prepared, he naturally wouldn't let it have its way so easily again.

Psychic power was equivalent to a cultivator's primordial spirit. Although he had only cultivated his technique to the second tier, his soul was vastly stronger than an ordinary person's. He was fully capable of clashing head-on with the psychic zombie. On top of that, he had sealed off his physical senses, deafening himself to sound so it couldn't affect him. With single-minded focus, he charged to kill the psychic zombie.

Jing Chengsu rushed swiftly outside the accounting office and dispatched the nearby zombies. Without the psychic zombie's control, these zombies were far less obedient, losing their coordination and lunging forward frantically to gorge on flesh.

Jing Chengsu caught the scent of blood drifting from the room. Not good! Someone was injured. Smelling fresh blood, the zombies went nearly mad and swarmed in this direction.

Strong as Jing Chengsu was, two fists were no match for four hands, let alone so many zombies pouncing at once. The situation turned perilous in the extreme.

Zhou Pan focused intently on attacking the psychic zombie, believing that taking it down first would bring the situation under control. With his remarkable footwork and blistering speed, he slipped past the blocking zombies in the blink of an eye, lunging straight for the psychic zombie.

Seeing lethal danger right before its eyes, the psychic zombie panicked and shrieked repeatedly, calling the zombie horde back to protect it.

Having been right on the verge of devouring the fresh food before them only to be forcefully called back, the zombies were utterly reluctant, their eyes locked onto Jing Chengsu's side while drooling with greed.

*Swish!* Zhou Pan landed a sword strike across the psychic zombie. Had it not dodged slightly at the final moment, he could have impaled its skull in a single blow.

A zombie arm dropped to the floor, and the psychic zombie shrieked piercingly. Having nearly been killed, it was terrified to the extreme, frantically urging the other zombies to save it.

Helpless to resist, the zombies—who desperately wanted to refuse yet were forced back by the summons—lingered reluctantly, but their bodies moved beyond their control to go reinforce it.

Jing Chengsu hurried inside to check on his comrades. Several had been injured by the shockwaves and ability attacks. Of the thirty people, nearly half had collapsed.

He immediately told everyone to carry one person each and evacuate the room, taking advantage of the zombies rushing to support the psychic zombie to slip away.

Carrying one person each under Jing Chengsu's cover, they ran straight downstairs. Reaching the ground floor, they darted toward the back door, where the narrow corridor would make pursuit difficult for any zombies.

As Cheng Ang and the others fled, they couldn't help but recall the heroic display back in the hall. Who would have thought the strongest among them was actually Zhou Pan? Truly, looks could be deceiving.

They had assumed Zhou Pan was slight of build and possessed a spatial ability, so he ought to be protected by everyone; earlier, their hearts had been in their throats when they saw him stay behind alone with the Boss in the department store! Who would have guessed that this guy didn't need protection at all? He was a Tyrannosaurus rex in his own right, completely overpowering and thrashing the zombie! Just hearing the psychic zombie's wails was enough to tell how severely it was being beaten.

Zhou Pan, hailed as a Tyrannosaurus rex, was hardly having an easy time either. All the zombies were swarming toward him. Abilities pelted him relentlessly, while a mutated zombie's long tongue flicked toward him like a chameleon snatching insects. Relying on his nimble reflexes, he drifted like a fish through the sea of zombies, dodging attacks at every turn.

His objective was clear: kill this psychic zombie. If it were allowed to gather a horde and evolve in this area, the next time they met, it might very well be known as a Zombie King.

Having escorted his comrades out, Jing Chengsu hurried back to help, hurling lightning bolts into the besieging zombies and slightly relieving the pressure on Zhou Pan.

Zhou Pan glanced around. He was surrounded almost entirely by zombies; it seemed he had to make quick work of this and dispatch the psychic zombie fast.

Flicking his short sword, he locked his eyes firmly onto the psychic zombie, channeled spiritual power into the blade, and tapped his toes to flip onto the crawler zombie's body. For some reason, the crawler's flesh had mutated to become exceptionally tough, unlike the rotting meat and brittle bones of the other zombies.

With light and graceful steps, Zhou Pan flew toward the psychic zombie perched on the very same crawler.

With a merciless slash of his short sword, the psychic zombie was cleaved in two from head to toe. After killing it, he extracted its crystal core. Small as it was, it would likely fetch enough to buy a villa outside. Though he didn't have psychic abilities, Jing Chengsu had so many comrades that there was bound to be a psychic user among them, and bringing it back would help bolster the team's strength.

Having eliminated the psychic zombie, he felt the ominous weight of the hundreds of zombies surrounding him and decided to make a swift exit.

Jing Chengsu kept attacking from the outer perimeter, attempting to blast open a path. Zhou Pan channeled his lightness technique along with his wind ability, vaulting across the heads of the zombies as he charged straight toward him.

Once the two reunited, Jing Chengsu had no time to lecture Zhou Pan. Facing several hundred zombies turning and charging toward them all at once—a truly overwhelming sight—they had no intention of remaining entangled and quickly retreated.
chapters.title: 第49章 大战精神丧尸「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 49: Battling the Psychic Zombie [Please recommend and bookmark]
chapters.source_text:
精神丧尸的精神光波直杀向周磐。
周磐先前会受伤是没防备到有精神丧尸，现在有人准备自然不可能再让他轻易得逞。
精神力相当于修真者的元神，他虽然才修炼功法到二级，但是元神可比普通人强多了。完全可以和精神丧尸对轰。加上他身上的感官又被他封闭了，听不到声音。影响不了他。他心无旁骛的杀向精神丧尸。
荆成夙飞快赶去财物室外面，将附近的丧尸解决掉。没有精神丧尸操控，这些丧尸就没有那么听话，乱了规律，一个劲的要往上扑要吃肉。
荆成夙闻到房间里飘出来的血腥味，糟糕！看来有人受伤了。丧尸闻到鲜血几乎要发狂了，都往这边赶。
荆成夙虽强，但一拳难敌四手，何况这么多的丧尸一起扑，情况险峻到极点。
周磐专心的攻击着精神丧尸，以为先干掉精神丧尸，就能控制局面，他身法了得，速度又快，恍惚间就闪过阻拦的丧尸身边，直扑精神丧尸。
杀机眼瞅就到眼前，精神丧尸慌了，接连戾叫，呼唤丧尸大军回到它身边保护它。
差点就要吃到前面的口粮，硬被叫回去，丧尸们那个不舍啊，眼睛盯着荆成夙这边都垂涎欲滴了。
“刷”周磐在精神丧尸身上留下一剑，要不是最后一刻精神丧尸偏了一下，他完全可以一剑刺穿它的头颅。
一只丧尸手臂掉落地上，精神丧尸尖声戾叫起来，差点被杀，它恐慌到极点，不断催促其余丧尸快来拯救他。
无奈之下，内心想说不，却硬被叫唤回去的丧尸，对这边恋恋不舍，但身体却不受控制的前去支援。
荆成夙赶忙前去看望里面的战友。被震伤异能攻击受伤的有好几个。三十号人，几乎倒了一半。
他立刻叫大家一人背一个退出房间，趁丧尸都去支援精神丧尸，赶紧趁机溜走。
大家一人背一个，在荆成夙掩护下，直往楼下跑。一到楼下就往后门闪，那边通道狭窄，即使有丧尸也很难追击。
成昂等人边跑，边想起场中的英姿，没想到他们之中最强的居然是周磐，真是人不可貌相。
原以为周磐瘦瘦小小，又是空间异能，应该受大家保护才对，先前见他与老大独自留在百货大楼还悬着心呢！没想到这家伙哪里需要别人保护他，他自己就是霸王龙一只，完全压着丧尸揍啊！瞧瞧光听那精神丧尸的嚎叫，就知道被修理的有多惨了。
被称霸王龙的周磐此时也不轻松，全部的丧尸都往他这边围过来了。各种异能不要钱的砸向他，变异丧尸长舌如黏蚊虫似的也时时弹向他这边，他凭着灵活的身手，如鱼般游荡在丧尸群中，不时躲避各种攻击。
他的目标明确，就是要杀死这只精神丧尸，倘若任凭这只丧尸在这一带聚集发展，下次见面这丧尸可就要改身份叫丧尸王了。
荆成夙送走战友们，赶紧过来帮忙，不时雷电劈向围攻的丧尸。稍微缓解了周磐的麻烦。
周磐环顾四周，身边几乎都是丧尸，看来他要速战速决，快点解决掉这只精神丧尸了。
短剑一甩，他眼睛牢牢锁住精神丧尸，将法力注入短剑，脚尖一点翻身到爬尸身上，爬尸的肉身不知怎么变异的十分结实，不像其他丧尸都是腐肉枯骨。
周磐脚步轻盈飘逸的飞扑向同在一只爬尸身上的精神丧尸。
毫不留情的短剑一挥，精神丧尸从头到脚被劈成两半，杀完丧尸取过精神丧尸的晶核，这玩意别看小小一枚，拿到外面去怕是足够抵一栋别墅。虽然他没有精神异能，但荆成夙战友那么多，总会有精神异能者，拿回去正好增加队伍的实力。
解决了精神丧尸，面对周周好几百丧尸，他大感不妙，赶紧闪人。
荆成夙也在外围不断攻击，企图轰出一条通道。周磐运气轻身功法加上风异能，踩着丧尸头颅直向他冲去。
两人会和，荆成夙也顾不得数落周磐。面对转头向他们冲来的丧尸，好几百的丧尸一起冲来，那场面简直了，他们可没空一直与他们纠缠，赶紧撤走。

周磐吃过大发嫂送来的丰盛午饭，睡了一个午觉，等两三点的时候，才抱着冰镇好的大西瓜走去邻居家。
周琦因为幸运的在本省当兵，每个月还能趁休息的时候跑回来一趟。就星期天的白天休息一天，部队到晚上9点还要点名，要是人不在，还有处罚呢！等一会儿，吃完晚饭，他和周媛媛又要赶路城里去。
周媛媛其实要明天下午才有班，本来不用这么早去，但是要是明天再回的话，可没有专车接送她了。
当他走进隔壁大门的时候，严大婶一家已经睡过午觉，正在房间里吹风扇乘凉。他一抱着西瓜出现，几个小的都欢呼的跳了起来。
严大婶一家加上周磐刚好能切八等份，周琦拿过刀，利落的手起刀落，将西瓜切成八块，一人一块，大家坐在风扇底下美美的吃了起来。
周磐本想推辞，被周琦眼一瞪，立马怂了，别看周琦长的斯斯文文，发起脾气来那可是非常恐怖，早就见识过的周磐可不敢与他做对，乖乖拿着西瓜吃了起来。这瓜挑的好，皮薄多汁，脆甜脆甜的，加上他又用井水冰镇过，冰冰凉凉的很是舒爽，咬一口透心凉，仿佛暑热都一扫而空。
大家吃完西瓜，严大婶将瓜皮收走拿去喂猪，周磐跟着大伙一起将沾着西瓜汁的脸手清洗一遍。
对周磐最近的变化，把他当子侄辈的建国大伯很是欣慰，念悼了一番他的父亲，惋惜他过早离世，没来得及教育孩子，无法陪伴孩子成长。也对周磐积极减肥的态度发表了看法，鼓励他继续保持这份毅力，总会把一身肥膘给彻底减掉。
周磐傻呵呵的笑着应是，见周琦要上楼，他也跟着后面走上去。
周琦的房间在二楼，收拾的可比周磐的狗窝干净整洁了好几倍，房间大约十平方大小，放了一张两米宽的大床，靠墙立着一个立柜，一个书架，书架上摆了不少的书籍，都是哲学类的，军事类的。窗户旁放了一张电脑桌，摆着一台台式电脑，电脑桌底下还放了音响之类的，虽然东西多，显得整个房间狭小了很多，但都被他整理的仅仅有条。
周琦打来风扇开关，调到一档，让风轻轻的吹着，他刚要坐下休息，却发现周磐也跟着后面进来了，他眼一转，瞧了一眼旁边的电脑，恍然大悟，“哦，你是要玩电脑是吧？你自己开吧。”
那台电脑还是周琦上中专那会买的，都好几年了，自从当兵之后他就很少用了，只有回家休息的时候，偶尔上上网。部队虽然允许带电脑，但网线要受到统一管制，上什么网，查什么东西都有记录，太麻烦了。如今这台电脑一般都是几个弟妹在用。
“那个，我不是。”虽然很眼馋电脑，但是今个儿，周磐主要还有其他事，“那个琦哥，你们那个部队基地在哪个地方？”
“在F市崎山路那边，怎么你问这个干啥？”周琦坐到床边，放松身体，抬头奇怪的瞧了他一眼。他从小看着他长大，向来把他当做自己的弟弟一样看待。当初他看不过周磐整天游手好闲，无所事事，懒得像头猪似的天天囤在家里养膘，浪费生命。还想带他到部队磨练磨练，说不定能改善他一身臭毛病。结果呢？好吃懒做的他，哪里肯去？鬼哭狼嚎，撒泼打滚耍无赖，就是不答应。两百斤的身板在地上打滚，简直就是一颗肉球在滚动，那场景搞笑极了，就为了拒绝他的提议，那个卖力啊！看的周琦傻眼，哭笑不得，只好作罢。从此以后一提起“部队”两字，周磐都当做耳边风，装傻充愣。没想到他今天居然主动问询，很诡异哦？！
“过几天我想去市里，到时候我能去你们部队玩吗？”周磐选择性的忘掉了当初的丢脸行径问道。
“当然可以啊！不过最好是我有休息的时候去，其他时候我比较忙，大概没时间招待你。”周琦终于确定周磐确实改变了很多，虽然不知道什么原因造成的，但他终于愿意踏出自从家破人亡后自己为自己设置的牢笼，勇敢的踏出一步，也算是一种进步。
眼看他快满十六岁，村里人都不再管他了，他再不振作，以后只能喝西北风。如今见他已经试着往好的一方面发展，周琦很高兴。
周磐初中还没读完就辍学了，原本九年义务教育，他想读完初中是有办法的，可他自己不是读书的那块料，家变后就趁机不读了。没有得到好的教育，又不是个聪明人，思想有局限，想法都很简单天真，几乎是只要能填饱他的肚子，他就感觉幸福满足，虽然小毛病不少，但是在周琦看来他的本性并不坏。因此即使村里人有不少，都不待见周磐，但是周琦依然待他如初。
周琦想着周磐啥活也不会干，还不如等他成年了去部队当兵，也算一条好的出路，不但能磨练他的性子，还能有个饭碗。看他现在能下死力死命减肥，也不像没法吃苦的样子。他乐观的盘算着。
“那好吧，那我就下一周星期天去可以吗？”听到想听的，周磐很高兴。他想一个星期的时间，他应该能再减去几斤肉，到时候就可以修炼缥缈修神录的招式之类的，说不定去部队还能打几招呢！
“可以，下一周星期天大概还有休息。”周琦想最近部队也没有什么重要的大事，除了每天的操练，只要没有突发事件，星期天应该会有休息的时间。
“呃！”解决了心头的事情，周磐眼馋的看了眼电脑，他好久没上网了，心头痒痒的，“那个现在我能玩一下电脑吗？”
“行啊！玩吧。”周琦不在意的摆手，距离吃晚饭还有点时间他自己从书架上拿了本书，看起来。
周磐兴奋的打开电脑，熟练的按开网页，搜索到某点小说网，他点开输入“末世”两字，一霎间，网面出现一长排的末世文，他点进一本末世重生的小说看了起来，小说主人公也是末世中死于非命，重生回末世前，仗着重生的便利，带着金手指，在末世混的风生水起，看的他心潮澎湃，热血沸腾，心里yy个不停，不断将自己代入其中。
“末世重生之人生赢家？你在看这样的小说？”那边看书的周琦，听到这边呼吸越来越粗重，还以为这小子胆大包天的在他眼皮底下看小黄文，本想来抓个现行，结果只是一篇末世小说。
正看的精精有味的周磐被吓了一跳，他回过神，见周琦背着手站在身后，眼珠一转，将他扯过来，又拖了一张椅子让他坐下，“来来来，琦哥快坐下一起看看。这篇文的作者写的可精彩了，内容紧凑，布局分明，写的就好像真有其事一样。”
周琦被按着坐进椅子，他耐不住他不断招呼，无奈的看了起来。
为了让他阅读顺畅，周磐特意调出第一篇重新开始看起来，刚开头讲的是主人公重生后面对末世的重重应对，以及末世爆发后末世初期会有的症状，还有那些异能者出现后的修炼方法，人们面对世界混乱后的种种措施。没错周磐特意选择这篇文，就是因为里面描述的跟他现实所遭遇的实在太过相似了，他都快怀疑作者是不是从末世穿过来的了。
周琦看了一会儿，作者写的的确很吸引人，让人忍不住一看再看。不过上面写的那些末世后的人性毁灭后的种种丑态，让他不由得皱眉头，这要是世界真的伦理道德崩溃成这样，那才是真正的末日。
“琦哥，你相信以后会有世界末日吗？”周磐见他看的差不多了，试探的问。
“这世上无奇不有，什么事情都可能发生！”本来不太相信末日宣言的周琦，看了这篇文，内容残酷到是又有很多合理性，让他看的总觉得心头不安，过去的想法没那么确定了。
“那要是也发生书里的事情怎么办？”周磐的问道。
“要是真的像书里描写的世界末日到来，人性怕是这世上最大的考验，不过我想不管秩序毁灭成什么样，只要有希望最后人类终究会自己立起来的，但是这应该有个过程，也许会有不少人牺牲吧！”周琦也想说什么没事有党有组织，却也知道不太现实，如果真的遇到整个世界的危机，军队政府没有占到主导地位，根本就无法控制局面，谈何拯救世界？
被书中的内容愁了半天，周琦回过神，才想起现在根本没有什么世界末日，他一时不查，被周磐牵着鼻子走了。“好啦好啦，哪有什么世界末日？这些应该都是作者胡编乱造的，末日的预言那么多，什么玛雅预言末日，什么风暴袭击地球，什么世界大瘟疫，传了这么久，不是都没有发生，不用考虑那么多。”
周磐瞅他一眼，现在说的那么笃定，等过几天就要打脸了，不过他也没有辩解，到时候末世到来，看过这篇文的周琦应该会有所防范吧？
等到吃饭时间到了，严大婶在楼下大声叫吃饭，两人走下来，周磐趁机告辞，严大婶喊他吃饭，被他拒绝了，晚上还有人给他送饭呢！
二楼收拾完行李经过哥哥房间的周媛媛，好奇他哥和周磐刚才在看什么，打开了电脑一看，没想到他哥也会看这么中二的小说，她将书名记下，等她回城了可以用手机上网看看到底写了什么。
chapters.title: 第5章 一本末世小说
chapters.translated_text:
After finishing the hearty lunch brought by Aunt Dafai and taking a nap, Zhou Pan walked over to his neighbor's house around two or three in the afternoon, carrying a chilled big watermelon.

Fortunately, Zhou Qi was stationed as a soldier within the province, so he was able to run back for a visit once a month during his breaks. He only had Sunday daytime off to rest, and the military unit held a roll call at 9 PM. If anyone was missing, there would be penalties! Later, after dinner, he and Zhou Yuanyuan would have to rush back to the city.

Zhou Yuanyuan actually didn't have a shift until tomorrow afternoon, so she didn't originally need to go back so early, but if she waited until tomorrow to return, she wouldn't have a dedicated vehicle to pick her up and drop her off.

When he walked through the neighboring gate, Aunt Yan's family had already finished their naps and were in the room enjoying the electric fan to cool off. The moment he appeared holding the watermelon, the younger kids cheered and jumped up.

Aunt Yan's family plus Zhou Pan made it just right to cut into eight equal portions. Zhou Qi grabbed the knife, and with swift and deft motions, cut the watermelon into eight pieces—one for each person. Everyone sat under the fan and happily ate.

Zhou Pan originally wanted to decline, but after catching a glare from Zhou Qi, he immediately cringed. Don't let Zhou Qi's gentle appearance fool you; when he lost his temper, it was terrifying. Zhou Pan, having witnessed it long ago, didn't dare cross him and obediently took a piece of watermelon to eat. This melon was well-chosen—thin-skinned, juicy, crisp, and sweet. Plus, it had been chilled in well water, making it icy, refreshing, and deeply satisfying. A single bite chilled one to the core, as if all the summer heat had been swept away.

After everyone finished the watermelon, Aunt Yan collected the rinds to feed the pigs, and Zhou Pan joined the others in washing the watermelon juice off their faces and hands.

Regarding Zhou Pan's recent changes, Uncle Jianguo, who viewed him like a nephew, was quite gratified. He reminisced about Zhou Pan's father, expressing regret over his premature passing which left him unable to raise his child or accompany him through his growth. He also shared his thoughts on Zhou Pan's active weight-loss attitude, encouraging him to keep up this perseverance and eventually shed all his excess fat completely.

Zhou Pan chuckled stupidly and agreed. Seeing Zhou Qi heading upstairs, he followed right behind him.

Zhou Qi's room was on the second floor and was several times cleaner and neater than Zhou Pan's dog kennel. The room was about ten square meters in size, furnished with a two-meter-wide bed, a wardrobe against the wall, and a bookcase filled with quite a few books, mostly on philosophy and military affairs. A computer desk was placed by the window with a desktop computer on it, and speakers and other items were set under the desk. Although there were many things, making the room look much smaller, everything was organized in perfect order.

Zhou Qi turned on the electric fan, adjusted it to the first setting to let the breeze blow gently. Just as he was about to sit down and rest, he noticed Zhou Pan had followed him in. Rolling his eyes and glancing at the computer nearby, he had a sudden realization. "Oh, you want to play on the computer, right? Turn it on yourself."

That computer was bought when Zhou Qi was in vocational school, several years ago. Ever since he joined the military, he rarely used it, only occasionally surfing the internet when he came home for a break. Although the military allowed soldiers to bring computers, the network cables were subject to unified control; what websites were visited and what information was searched were all recorded, which was too troublesome. Nowadays, this computer was generally used by his younger siblings and cousins.

"Um, actually, no." Although he was drooling over the computer, Zhou Pan had other main business today. "Um, Brother Qi, which area is your military base located in?"

"Over at Qishan Road in City F. Why are you asking about this?" Zhou Qi sat on the edge of the bed, relaxing his body, and raised his head to look at him curiously. He had watched him grow up since childhood and always treated him like his own younger brother. Back then, he couldn't stand Zhou Pan idling around all day, doing nothing, and being as lazy as a pig, hoarding fat at home every day and wasting his life. He had even wanted to take him to the military camp to toughen him up, thinking it might improve his bad habits. And the result? Gluttonous and lazy as he was, how could he possibly be willing to go? He wailed miserably, threw tantrums, rolled on the ground, and acted shamelessly, simply refusing to agree. His two-hundred-jin frame rolled on the floor like a meatball—the scene was utterly hilarious, and he put so much effort into rejecting the proposal! It left Zhou Qi dumbfounded and torn between tears and laughter, so he finally gave up. From then on, whenever the word "military" was mentioned, Zhou Pan turned a deaf ear and played dumb. He never expected him to actually ask about it proactively today—how bizarre?!

"I want to go to the city in a few days. Can I go visit your military base then?" Zhou Pan selectively forgot his previous shameful behavior and asked.

"Of course you can! But it's best if you go when I have time off. At other times I'm quite busy and probably won't have time to host you." Zhou Qi finally confirmed that Zhou Pan had indeed changed a lot. Although he didn't know what caused it, he was finally willing to step out of the cage he had built for himself after his family was ruined and take a brave step forward, which could be considered a kind of progress.

Seeing that he was about to turn sixteen and the villagers no longer bothered with him, if he didn't pull himself together, he would only be drinking northwest wind in the future. Now seeing that he was already trying to develop in a good direction, Zhou Qi was very happy.

Zhou Pan dropped out of school before finishing junior high. Originally, under the nine-year compulsory education, there were ways for him to finish junior high, but he wasn't cut out for studying, and after the family tragedy, he took the opportunity to quit. Without a proper education, and not being a smart person, his thinking was limited, his ideas were very simple and naive, and almost as long as his stomach was filled, he felt happy and satisfied. Although he had quite a few minor flaws, in Zhou Qi's eyes, his fundamental nature was not bad. Therefore, even though many villagers looked down on Zhou Pan, Zhou Qi still treated him just as he always had.

Zhou Qi figured that since Zhou Pan couldn't do any kind of work, he might as well go join the army as a soldier when he became an adult—that could also be considered a good way out, which would not only temper his temperament but also secure him a livelihood. Seeing how he was now exerting his utmost effort to lose weight desperately, he didn't look like someone who couldn't endure hardship. He calculated optimistically.

"Alright then, can I go next Sunday, is that okay?" Hearing what he wanted to hear, Zhou Pan was very happy. He figured that in a week's time, he should be able to lose a few more pounds of flesh, and by then he could practice the moves of the Ethereal Deity Cultivation Record and maybe even throw a few punches and kicks at the military base!

"Sure, next Sunday I should still have time off." Zhou Qi figured there weren't any major events in the military recently; besides daily drills, as long as there were no emergencies, Sunday should be a rest day.

"Uh!" Having resolved the matter on his mind, Zhou Pan cast a longing look at the computer. He hadn't surfed the net for a long time, and his heart was itching. "Um, can I play on the computer for a bit now?"

"Go ahead! Play." Zhou Qi waved his hand dismissively. Since there was still some time before dinner, he picked up a book from the bookshelf and started reading.

Zhou Pan excitedly turned on the computer, skillfully opened the web page, searched for Qidian Chinese Network, and clicked to type in the two characters "End of the World" (Mo Shi). In an instant, a long list of apocalyptic novels appeared on the screen. He clicked into an apocalyptic rebirth novel and started reading. The protagonist of the novel also died a miserable death in the apocalypse, was reborn back to the period before the apocalypse, and relying on the convenience of rebirth with a golden finger, lived like a fish in water during the end times. Reading this made his heart surge, his blood boil, and he kept daydreaming incessantly, constantly projecting himself into the story.

"Apocalyptic Rebirth: Life Winner? You're reading this kind of novel?" Zhou Qi, reading his book over there, heard the breathing on this side getting heavier and heavier. He thought this daring kid was actually reading porn under his nose and wanted to catch him in the act, but it turned out to be just an apocalyptic novel.

Zhou Pan, who was reading with great relish, was startled. Coming back to his senses, he saw Zhou Qi standing behind him with his hands clasped behind his back. With a roll of his eyes, he pulled Zhou Qi over and dragged another chair for him to sit down. "Come, come, Brother Qi, sit down and read together. The author of this piece writes so wonderfully—the plot is tight, the structure is distinct, and it's written as if it really happened."

Zhou Qi was pushed down into the chair. Unable to withstand his constant urging, he helplessly began to read.

To make his reading smooth, Zhou Pan specially pulled up the first chapter to start reading again from the beginning. The very beginning talked about the protagonist's various responses to the apocalypse after his rebirth, the symptoms that would appear in the early stages of the outbreak, the cultivation methods that would emerge after the appearance of those ability users, and the various measures people took after facing the chaos of the world. That's right, Zhou Pan specifically chose this piece because the descriptions in it were far too similar to what he was actually experiencing in reality; he was almost starting to suspect whether the author had time-traveled from the apocalypse.

After reading for a while, Zhou Qi found that what the author wrote was indeed very engaging, making one unable to help reading on and on. However, the various ugly states of human nature destroyed after the apocalypse written above made him frown involuntarily.
