chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu saw that the zombies pressing in on them were too numerous and far from weak, so they unleashed several powerful ultimate moves, blasting down a swathe of zombies before preparing to retreat.

Just as they were about to exit through the hole they had dug, they heard the Zombie King let out a shrill cry, followed by several earth-shaking "bangs." A large number of zombies had surrounded the exit, blocking the way out; there were ability-wielding zombies, as well as massive crawlers and giant zombies. It seemed this Zombie King had planned this all along, and they were trapped with no way out. They wondered how the brothers who had run away were faring.

Zhou Pan regretted that he had been too focused on collecting grain and hadn't continued to observe the surroundings with his spiritual sense; otherwise, it wouldn't have been so easy to fall into an encirclement.

Facing the zombies pouring in from outside the hole and the Zombie King and the many zombies closing in, Jing Chengsu and Zhou Pan stood back-to-back. Zhou Pan was so nervous that cold sweat poured down, soaking the clothes on his back. He licked his dry lips and gripped his long sword tightly, "Brother Su, what should we do?"

Jing Chengsu looked at the Zombie King, which stood out conspicuously among the crowd of rotting flesh and corpses. Judging by its aura, it was at least Level 4 or 5. He felt a bit of regret for letting Zhou Pan stay behind to cover their retreat earlier. "Xiao Pan, if we can't hold them off later, hurry and hide in your space. Don't come out until the zombies here have dispersed."

"Then what about you?" Zhou Pan asked, turning his head, a sense of foreboding filling his heart.

Himself? Jing Chengsu gripped his Tang dao tightly. No matter what, he had to ensure Zhou Pan left this place safely. Looking at the Zombie King standing among the crowd of zombies, still maintaining a well-dressed appearance, he knew its intelligence was certainly not low; even if Zhou Pan retreated into the space, it might not be one hundred percent safe.

Besides, Kangcheng was so close to F City, and with so many zombies gathered here and commanded by a high-level zombie, a zombie tide could occur at any moment. He stared coldly at the Zombie King not far away. Since there was no escape, even if he had to self-destruct, he would drag this Zombie King down with him.

Jing Chengsu swung his blade to force back several zombies lunging at him and charged straight at the Zombie King.

"Brother Su!" Seeing him attack the Zombie King, Zhou Pan grew anxious. The Zombie King's strength was clearly above theirs; wasn't attacking it just asking for death? He hurriedly gave chase; after all, two people attacking together was better than one.

Seeing Jing Chengsu attack, the Zombie King’s narrow, blood-red eyes flashed with a cold light. It opened its mouth and roared to stop the zombies lunging at Jing Chengsu, then excitedly welcomed him. It hadn't encountered a worthy opponent in a long time; it hoped this human could let it play for a while longer.

"Clang!" Sparks flew. Jing Chengsu slashed at the Zombie King, but it blocked the blow with its sharp claws. The blade striking the claws actually produced the metallic sound of iron clashing, showing just how hard its claws were.

When the first strike failed, Jing Chengsu attacked repeatedly. The Zombie King was fast, but its limbs were ultimately not as agile as a human's. Its body was slashed several times by Jing Chengsu, and its once-neat clothes were shredded to rags. Seeing its beloved clothes ruined, the Zombie King's fury erupted. It stopped playing like it was in a game and became much more serious. Extending its claws, its purple-black fingernails grew longer, instantly catching the incoming blade.

Jing Chengsu pulled hard on the Tang dao several times but couldn't retrieve his weapon from the Zombie King's grip. His eyes turned cold, and he channeled his ability. Lightning surged along the blade straight toward the Zombie King. Metal is a conductor, and after several crackling explosions, the Zombie King let out a sharp roar; its black fingernails shattered inch by inch. Even its claws were affected, and purple-black blood flowed continuously.

Not expecting that a moment of carelessness would lead to such a heavy loss, the Zombie King glared at Jing Chengsu with bloodthirsty, crimson eyes. A black light flashed around its body, its fingers returned to their original state, and the black nails grew back. If not for the faint, jagged traces of the explosion still visible on the tips of the nails, one would have thought it hadn't suffered any damage at all from the previous attack.

The Zombie King bared its teeth at Jing Chengsu, its sharp fangs gleaming coldly. With a wave of its hand, it released its full aura, and a black energy ball rotated on its claws, emitting a dim, ominous light.

"Brother Su, look out!" Zhou Pan, who had been chasing close behind, felt a jolt of alarm. Oh no! This was a devouring ability; it could absorb any crystal core, which explained why its leveling speed was so fast. Moreover, the energy it unleashed was highly corrosive. Being injured by it was almost equivalent to being scratched by a zombie—the consequences would be unimaginable.

The Zombie King opened its claw, and the black energy ball smashed straight toward Jing Chengsu. He swung his blade to parry the energy ball, and with a "hissing" sound, the blade lost its luster and became rusted and scarred, as if it had just been dug out of some ancient pit after a long time. If not for the fact that the other half of the blade hadn't been corroded and remained bright and shiny, Jing Chengsu would have thought he was holding a decayed ancient sword instead of a modern Tang dao.

Seeing that the first wave of attacks hadn't worked, the Zombie King immediately unleashed several crescent-shaped black beams, like death-dealing scythes, forcing them straight toward Jing Chengsu.
chapters.source_text:
周磐和荆成夙见威逼过来的丧尸实在太多，而且实力都不弱，他们发出几个大招，轰倒一片丧尸，准备撤离。
他们刚要从挖开的洞口离开，就听丧尸王戾叫一声，“嘭嘭嘭”几声大地震动的巨响，洞口外大批丧尸包围过来，堵住了外头，有异能丧尸，还有巨大的爬尸和巨尸。看来这丧尸王，早有算计，他们是在劫难逃了，也不知跑走的兄弟们怎么样。
周磐后悔刚才只顾收取粮食，没有继续用神识观察四周，否则哪那么容易陷入包围圈。
面对洞外不停涌进的丧尸和逼围过来的丧尸王和许多丧尸，荆成夙两人背靠背，周磐紧张的冷汗直流，浸湿了背后的衣服，他舔舔干涩的唇瓣，握紧手中的长剑，“夙哥，我们该怎么办？”
荆成夙看着一群腐尸烂肉中显得格外显眼的丧尸王，看气势起码在四级五级以上，他有点后悔先前让周磐跟着留下断后了，“小磐等会要是抵抗不了，你赶紧躲进空间里，等这里丧尸散了再出来。”
“那你呢？”周磐闻言回过头，心中有种不详的预感。
他自己？荆成夙捏紧手中的唐刀，不管怎么样他都要让周磐安全离开这里，看着那丧尸王站在一群丧尸中，依然保持衣冠楚楚的样子，就知道它的智商肯定不低，周磐退入空间也未必百分之百安全。
再说亢成距离F市那么近，这里聚集的丧尸这么多，又有高级丧尸指挥，随时有可能会有丧尸潮发生，他冷凝着不远处的丧尸王，竟然逃无可逃，他即使自爆也要拖着这丧尸王一起下去。
荆成夙挥刀逼开扑来的几个丧尸，直朝丧尸王扑去。
“夙哥！”周磐见他攻向丧尸王顿时急了，这丧尸王的实力明显在他们之上，朝它攻击不是找死吗？他赶紧追去，怎么说两个人一起上也比一个人强。
丧尸王见荆成夙朝它攻击过来，狭长的眼中血红的眼珠闪着寒光，它张嘴咆哮一声制止扑向荆成夙的丧尸，自己兴奋的迎向他，好久没遇到对手，希望这次的人能让它多玩一会儿。
“呛”火花四溅，荆成夙一刀劈向丧尸王，被它用利爪挡住，刀刃劈在利爪上，居然发出了铁器相击的吭呛声，可见它利爪的坚硬程度。
一刀没凑效，荆成夙连连攻击，丧尸王速度也很快，但手脚终究没人类灵活，身上被荆成夙劈了不少刀，本来整洁的衣服被划的破烂褴褛，看着自己心爱的衣服被划破，丧尸王的怒火顿时爆发了，不在如游戏一般，态度认真了很多，利爪一伸，紫黑的长指甲暴长几分，一下子卡住了攻来的刀刃。
荆成夙使劲拔了几次唐刀，还是无法从丧尸王手中拔回武器，他眼神一寒，异能连催，雷电顺着刀刃只朝丧尸王涌去，金属本就导电，只听“噼里啪啦”几声炸响，丧尸王尖锐的咆哮几声，它的黑指甲根根寸断。连爪子也受到波及，紫黑的血不断流出。
没想到它一时轻视，竟然吃了这么大亏，丧尸王血红的眼珠嗜血的狠盯着荆成夙，周身黑光一闪，手指恢复原状，黑指甲再度长出，如果不是见指甲尖还有炸裂的不轨痕迹，差点让人以为它刚才的攻击根本没受任何损伤。
丧尸王冲荆成夙呲了呲牙，尖锐的獠牙冷光闪闪，它手一挥，全身气势外放，利爪上一团黑色的异能球旋转着发出晦暗的光芒。
“夙哥，小心！”紧追而来的周磐心下一惊，不好！这是吞噬异能，任何晶核都可以吸收，难怪晋级的速度这么快，而且攻击出的异能具有很强的腐蚀性，被伤到几乎等同于被丧尸抓伤，后果不堪设想。
丧尸王利爪朝前一张，黑色光球直砸向荆成夙，他挥刀直劈异能球，只听“嗤嗤”作响，一折刀刃被腐蚀的褪去宝光，锈迹斑斑，伤痕累累，仿佛年代久远刚从那处坑洼里掏出来似得，要不是见还有半折刀刃还没被腐蚀掉，依然光鲜亮丽，荆成夙都以为自己拿着的不是近代出产的唐刀而是哪来的腐朽古刀了。
丧尸王见第一波攻击没有奏效，立马再次发出几道犹如夺命镰刀的半月形黑光，直朝荆成夙周身逼去。

半月形黑镰刀旋转着直袭荆成夙，攻击的目标分上下左右前后六个方位，几乎堵住了荆成夙所有闪躲的方向。
他眼神一沉，将刀舞的水泄不通，周身雷光莹莹，一层闪电光膜犹如护盾似的护住他的周身。
只听“嗤嗤嗤”几声磨擦声，背后几只丧尸无声无息的倒地，腐蚀成一堆白骨，光膜抵抗了一秒钟就溃散开来，要不是荆成夙眼明手快，又加了几道光膜，后果就要跟身后一样了，即使荆成夙再沉着冷静，见到这么强的腐蚀力，也倒抽了一口冷气。
好险！周磐惊恐的看看白骨，再看看荆成夙，心脏“嘭嘭嘭”跳的飞快，差点跳出嗓子眼。
想要全身撑起闪电光膜，肯定很费劲，周磐连忙掏出一瓶灵泉水扔给荆成夙，让他补充异能，自己灵力覆盖手中长剑，向丧尸王杀去，他身法迅捷无比，丧尸王想要向攻击荆成夙一样攻击他，可没那么容易。
周磐犹如翩翩彩蝶不断围绕丧尸王缠斗攻击。
荆成夙见周磐也不要命的扑上前去，怕他有什么闪失连忙跟上，将灵泉水狠狠灌了几口，震断半折腐朽的刀刃，挥着另外半折唐刀，朝丧尸攻去，他将异能导入刀刃上，普通的刀刃威力立刻增强了数倍，攻击在丧尸王身上，“嗤嗤”的黑烟直冒，犹如生人的丧尸王，完整的皮肉仿佛像被腐蚀似的，刀刃过处烂成腐肉。
“嗷嗷”丧尸王惨嚎一声雷电显然对他的伤害很大，它血红的眼狠戾的瞪向荆成夙，似乎恨极了荆成夙，竟然对周磐的攻击不管不顾，利爪上黑光闪烁，直击向荆成夙。
“夙哥，小心！”周磐大急，连忙灵力全部注入长剑剑身窜起三尺长的剑芒，直斩丧尸王。
“嗤”尽管荆成夙拼力躲闪，终究距离太近，无法全身躲过丧尸王的攻击，手臂被一道黑光闪过，留下一条深深的血痕，“嗤嗤”血肉不断腐蚀，几秒钟不到就露出深深白骨。
“咔嚓”丧尸王注意力都在荆成夙那边，疏于防备，右臂膀连着手臂被周磐剑芒一斩而落。
不只荆成夙的雷电对它威胁很大，周磐的灵力也不予多让，被他剑芒斩过的伤痕，很难再轻松愈合，丧尸王暴戾的对他张开大口，露出尖锐的獠牙，脸上青筋直冒，眼球鼓出眼眶，仇视的直逼周磐。
周磐哪管他如何痛恨，他“刷刷”两剑逼退丧尸王，直扑荆成夙。
“夙哥，你怎么样？”周磐看到他手上的伤口，眼泪都快吓出来了。
荆成夙脸色青白，左臂已有小半段手臂化成白骨，腐肉还在不断蔓延。周磐急的用剑削去腐肉，制止蔓延。
“快走！”荆成夙只觉眼前一黑，昏眩感不断袭来，病毒攻心他知道自己撑不了多久了，只求周磐能听他的话，赶紧离开。
“不，我不走，要走一起走。”周磐抓起他的臂膀，想拖着他一道离开。
“听话，我快变异了。”荆成夙怕自己成丧尸了，会不受控制的伤害周磐，不不停催促，他想在周磐离开后，拖住丧尸王自爆。
丧尸王被斩一条胳膊，哪里能容的下罪魁祸首走掉，咆哮一声，黑光如箭雨似得不断袭向周磐两人，也不再束缚其他丧尸对他们的攻击。
无数黑光直射过来还有前仆后继的丧尸群，周磐两人四面楚歌想要逃走几乎不可能，周磐紧握着荆成夙的手，眼看着他的手逐渐转凉，面白如纸，眼底黑影浮现，身上筋脉暴张，要开始蜕变，焦急的眼泪直流，为什么，为什么空间不能让夙哥一起进去，他不要夙哥离开，不要！要死一起死，要变丧尸一起变！
就在周磐万念俱灰，连各种攻击都失去抵抗之心时，光芒一闪，居然自动进入空间中，手上还拉着荆成夙。
chapters.translated_text:
The crescent-shaped black sickle spun as it struck directly at Jing Chengsu, targeting him from six directions—above, below, left, right, front, and back—effectively blocking almost all of his escape routes.

His eyes darkened, and he swung his blade with such speed that not even a drop of water could pass through. Lightning shimmered around him, forming a film of electric light that shielded his entire body like a barrier.

With a series of "hissing" sounds, several zombies behind him collapsed silently, corroding into piles of white bones. The light barrier shattered after holding for only a second; if not for Jing Chengsu’s quick reflexes in layering on more barriers, he would have ended up just like them. Even as composed and calm as Jing Chengsu was, he couldn't help but gasp at such potent corrosive power.

That was close! Zhou Pan looked at the white bones in terror, then at Jing Chengsu, his heart pounding so fast it felt like it was about to jump out of his throat.

Maintaining a full-body lightning barrier must be exhausting. Zhou Pan hurriedly took out a bottle of spiritual spring water and tossed it to Jing Chengsu to replenish his energy, while he himself channeled spiritual power into his long sword and charged at the Zombie King. His footwork was incredibly swift; it wouldn't be so easy for the Zombie King to attack him the way it had attacked Jing Chengsu.

Zhou Pan moved like a fluttering butterfly, constantly circling and engaging the Zombie King in combat.

Seeing Zhou Pan recklessly throwing himself into the fray, Jing Chengsu feared for his safety and quickly followed. He gulped down the spiritual spring water, snapped off the broken half of his blade, and wielded the remaining half of the Tang sword to attack the zombie. He channeled his ability into the blade, increasing the power of the ordinary steel several times over. As it struck the Zombie King, black smoke hissed and rose; the Zombie King’s intact flesh seemed to corrode upon contact, turning into rotting meat wherever the blade passed.

"Awoo!" The Zombie King let out a miserable howl; the lightning was clearly causing it great damage. Its blood-red eyes glared viciously at Jing Chengsu, seemingly filled with intense hatred. It ignored Zhou Pan’s attacks entirely, black light flickering on its sharp claws as it struck straight at Jing Chengsu.

"Brother Su, watch out!" Zhou Pan was frantic. He poured all his spiritual power into his long sword, causing a three-foot-long blade aura to erupt, and slashed directly at the Zombie King.

"Hiss!" Even though Jing Chengsu tried his best to dodge, he was too close to fully evade the Zombie King’s attack. A streak of black light grazed his arm, leaving a deep, bloody gash. The flesh hissed as it continuously corroded, and within seconds, the white bone was exposed.

"Snap!" The Zombie King, with its attention focused on Jing Chengsu, had let its guard down, and its right arm was severed by the blade aura from Zhou Pan’s sword.

It wasn't just Jing Chengsu’s lightning that posed a major threat; Zhou Pan’s spiritual power was equally formidable. The wounds left by his blade aura were difficult to heal easily. The Zombie King opened its mouth wide at him in a rage, revealing sharp fangs, veins bulging on its face, and its eyeballs protruding from their sockets as it glared at Zhou Pan with hostility.

Zhou Pan didn't care about its hatred; he forced the Zombie King back with two quick slashes and lunged toward Jing Chengsu.

"Brother Su, are you okay?" Zhou Pan saw the wound on his arm, and tears were almost falling from his eyes in fright.

Jing Chengsu’s face was pale, and a small portion of his left forearm had already turned into white bone, with the rotting flesh continuing to spread. Zhou Pan anxiously used his sword to scrape away the decaying flesh to stop the spread.

"Go quickly!" Jing Chengsu felt his vision darken, and waves of dizziness washed over him. He knew the virus was reaching his heart and that he wouldn't last much longer; he only hoped Zhou Pan would listen to him and leave immediately.

"No, I’m not leaving. If we go, we go together." Zhou Pan grabbed his arm, trying to drag him away.

"Be obedient, I’m about to mutate." Jing Chengsu feared that once he turned into a zombie, he would lose control and hurt Zhou Pan. He kept urging him, intending to hold the Zombie King back and self-destruct once Zhou Pan had escaped.

Having lost an arm, the Zombie King wouldn't let the culprit escape. It roared, and black light rained down like arrows toward the two of them, no longer restraining the other zombies from attacking them either.

With countless beams of black light shooting toward them and waves of zombies rushing forward, the two were surrounded with no way out. Zhou Pan gripped Jing Chengsu’s hand tightly, watching as it gradually turned cold, his face white as paper, dark shadows appearing under his eyes, and veins bulging all over his body as he began to transform. Tears streamed down Zhou Pan’s face in desperation. Why? Why couldn't the space allow Brother Su to enter with him? He didn't want Brother Su to leave, he didn't! If they were to die, they would die together; if they were to become zombies, they would become them together!

Just as Zhou Pan was in total despair, having lost the will to resist even the incoming attacks, a flash of light occurred, and he was automatically pulled into the space, still holding onto Jing Chengsu.
