chapters.translated_title: Chapter 78: Dalong Base "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.source_text:
“大哥，不好了，不好了，邙哥他们被人绑了。”大龙基地杨小飞匆匆忙忙跑进一个房间。
两个相拥的人一下子分开。
“草！该死的！”杨大龙火大的低咒一声，他正和他家媳妇亲热呢，这家伙一点眼色都没有，他还特地关了门了，就这样横冲直撞的冲进来。
“啊，大哥，对不起，我，那个，我先出去。”杨小飞见自家老大整张脸都拉下来了，赶紧蹑手蹑脚的准备遛出去。
“站住，臭小子，你最好有个好理由，否则……”杨大龙把拳头握的咔咔作响。
杨小飞吐吐舌头，杨大龙拳头硬的很，除了他媳妇，揍人从不手软，“那个，大哥，我不是故意的，是邙哥他们不知道得罪谁，现在正被人绑着送进基地呢。”
“曹邙？被人绑了？他定是又偷偷干什么坏事了，这帮家伙尽给老子丢脸。”杨大龙没好气的冷笑。
杨大龙是土生土长的临清县城人，自小没念过什么书，十几岁时去学了一手汽车维修的手艺，在别人店里人干了几年，就回自己县城开了家汽车维修店。别看临清县城不大，开车的人还是挺多，他的生意还是不错的。
可惜好景不长，末世无声无息就来了，整个县城都乱了，不说丧尸怎么在县里横行，就连人自己也是各种乱像，什么打砸抢夺强奸的恶事处处都是，杨大龙有心阻止，但是他势单力薄，谁肯听他的？
要不是后来他觉醒了火系异能，拉拔了一帮弟兄，开起了基地，勉强制止那些行为，他还真不知道，这里要乱到什么时候。
杨大龙是个粗人，为人很讲义气，来投他的越来越多，到也让这个不大的基地生存了下来。只是人虽多，但人员掺杂不齐，什么样的人都有。他虽被敬为基地首领，真正听他话的，也只有最初的那帮人，后面来的人，有些实力跟他差不多的，比如曹邙等人，根本就不把他放在眼里，哪天不是想着把他从一把手的位置扯下来！
其实杨大龙对当不当首领无所谓，只要接任的人人品过的去，不是把基地里的人当猪做马的，他完全可以拱手让人。可是要是像曹邙他们那样，把自己当神似的，处处高人一等，看不起普通人，不把人命当回事的，他就算死也不会让给那种人。
曹邙等人一个个心眼毒的很，在基地干了不少恶事，偏偏手脚麻利，杨大龙一直没抓到他们的把柄，否则早就把他们这等人赶出基地。
说到基地，他最佩服的就是F市基地，有哪个基地会像他们一样，高层只有一个势力在管理，少有出现普通人被异能者欺压的场面，不但将基地上下管理的井井有条，还齐心协力将基地建设的十分宏大，据派遣到F市基地的人员回复，那里只要肯使一把子力气，即使是普通人也可以过的很好，难怪人人都向往。
杨大龙其实也想去投F市基地，不说F市基地的作风，光他们用晶核和积分贡献点才能兑换的净化晶核，就足以吸引任何人的目光。
但是大龙基地这么多人，其中普通人就有好几万，他要是一走了之，他们该怎么办？基地其他异能者，比如曹邙等人可不把普通人的人命放在眼里，要是他走了，没人镇压，那这些人岂不是要遭殃了？因此即使心里多次挣扎，还是留了下来。
也不是没想过带着这些人去F市，不说路途安不安全，大家愿不愿意离开，光这几万张嘴，即使到了F市基地，一下子进这么多人也是个难题，想来想去，这事就一拖再拖了。
“还在想什么呢？”旁边传来清朗的声音，这是他媳妇秦昕，是他的邻居兼青梅竹马，他从小就是学渣，他媳妇却跟他相反，自小就是学霸，一直不断跳级上学，二十岁就医科大学硕士毕业，是个医学天才，原本可以在好的城市里当医生，可他偏偏回到了这个小小的县城。
杨大龙一开始不能理解他怎么放着好好的大城不去，却要回到这里。直到末世来临，两人躲在黑暗的地窖里躲避丧尸，前途渺茫的时候，才互相告了白，原来不但杨大龙是暗恋秦昕，就连秦昕也是对他有同样的想法，原先不说，是害怕对方是直男，怕说了连朋友都做不了，可是到了现在，连明日都不知有没有的人，不说怕是连机会都没了。于是不约而同的述说了衷情，结果自然皆大欢喜。
chapters.translated_text:
"Big Brother, it's bad, it's bad! Mang-ge and his men have been captured!" Yang Xiaofei from Dalong Base rushed into a room in a panic.

The two people embracing each other immediately pulled apart.

"Damn it! To hell with it!" Yang Dalong cursed angrily. He had been getting intimate with his wife, and this guy had absolutely no sense of timing. He had even specifically closed the door, yet the guy just barged right in.

"Ah, Big Brother, I'm sorry, I, um, I'll head out first." Seeing his boss's face darken completely, Yang Xiaofei hurriedly prepared to sneak away on tiptoe.

"Stop right there, you brat. You'd better have a good reason, otherwise..." Yang Dalong clenched his fists, making them crackle.

Yang Xiaofei stuck out his tongue. Yang Dalong’s fists were hard, and aside from his wife, he never went easy on anyone he beat up. "Um, Big Brother, I didn't mean to. It's just that Mang-ge and the others don't know who they offended, and now they're being tied up and brought into the base."

"Cao Mang? Captured? He must have been up to some dirty business again. These guys are always embarrassing me." Yang Dalong sneered in annoyance.

Yang Dalong was a native of Linqing County. He hadn't received much schooling growing up; in his teens, he learned auto repair, worked in other people's shops for a few years, and then returned to his own county to open an auto repair shop. Even though Linqing County wasn't large, there were quite a few drivers, so his business was decent.

Unfortunately, good times didn't last. The apocalypse arrived silently, and the entire county fell into chaos. Not to mention how zombies ran rampant, even the people themselves were in a state of disorder, with looting, robbery, and rape occurring everywhere. Yang Dalong had the heart to stop it, but he was alone and powerless; who would listen to him?

If he hadn't awakened his fire-type ability later on and gathered a group of brothers to start a base, barely managing to put an end to those behaviors, he really wouldn't have known how long the chaos would have lasted.

Yang Dalong was a rough man, but he was very loyal, and more and more people came to join him, allowing this small base to survive. However, although there were many people, the group was a mixed bag with all kinds of characters. Even though he was respected as the base leader, the only ones who truly listened to him were the original group. Some of the later arrivals, like Cao Mang and his crew, who had strength similar to his, didn't respect him at all and were always thinking about how to pull him down from his position as the top leader!

In truth, Yang Dalong didn't care about being the leader. As long as the successor had good character and didn't treat the people in the base like livestock, he would gladly hand over the position. But if it were someone like Cao Mang and his lot, who acted like gods, looked down on others, and didn't value human life, he wouldn't hand it over even if it killed him.

Cao Mang and his men were vicious-minded and had committed many evil deeds in the base, but they were clever and quick-handed. Yang Dalong had never managed to catch them in the act; otherwise, he would have driven such people out of the base long ago.

Speaking of bases, the one he admired most was the F City Base. Which other base was managed by a single power structure like theirs? It was rare to see ordinary people being bullied by ability users there. Not only was the base well-organized, but everyone worked together to build it into something grand. According to reports from personnel sent to F City Base, as long as you were willing to put in the effort, even ordinary people could live well there. It was no wonder everyone yearned for it.

Yang Dalong actually wanted to join the F City Base as well. Not to mention their management style, just the fact that they had purified crystals—which could only be exchanged with cores and contribution points—was enough to attract anyone's attention.

But there were so many people in Dalong Base, including several tens of thousands of ordinary people. If he just walked away, what would happen to them? Other ability users in the base, like Cao Mang and his crew, didn't value the lives of ordinary people. If he left and there was no one to keep them in check, wouldn't these people suffer? Therefore, even after struggling with the thought many times, he stayed behind.

It wasn't that he hadn't thought about taking these people to F City, but not to mention whether the journey was safe or if everyone was willing to leave, just the issue of those tens of thousands of mouths to feed made entering the F City Base all at once a difficult problem. After thinking it over and over, the matter kept being delayed.

"What are you still thinking about?" A clear, pleasant voice came from beside him. It was his wife, Qin Xin. She was his neighbor and childhood sweetheart. He had been a poor student since he was young, while his wife was the complete opposite—a top student who kept skipping grades. She graduated with a master's degree from medical school at twenty and was a medical genius. She could have been a doctor in a big city, but she chose to return to this small county for him.

At first, Yang Dalong couldn't understand why she would give up a good life in a big city to return here. It wasn't until the apocalypse arrived and they were hiding from zombies in a dark cellar, with no future in sight, that they confessed their feelings to each other. It turned out that not only was Yang Dalong secretly in love with Qin Xin, but Qin Xin felt the same way about him. She hadn't said anything before because she was afraid he was straight and that if she spoke up, they couldn't even be friends. But at that moment, not knowing if they would even have a tomorrow, she realized that if she didn't speak, she might lose the chance forever. So, they both expressed their true feelings, and the result was naturally a happy one.
chapters.title: 第78章 大龙基地「求推荐，求收藏」
第79章 抗毒血清研制人「求枝枝」
chapters.source_text:
秦昕觉醒的也是精神力，这让原本就是医学天才的他的医术更加高明，最近他整天都在研究怎样制作抗毒血清，都没空搭理杨大龙，今天好不容易有点头绪，出来透风，眼睛都要绿了的杨大龙立马把握住机会，正要和他好好亲热亲热，就被破坏了。
以杨大龙对曹邙的了解，肯定不是去干什么好事！
现在这家伙越来越不把杨大龙放在眼里，勾结了不少基地里以及附近一带的一些与他一样野心勃勃的人，想着法的想把杨大龙拉下马，自己上位。
基地里的人大多都知道他们的为人，要是曹邙上位，还有他们的活路吗？几乎人人反对。
曹邙不在意。末世什么最重要？当然是粮食！只要他手中有粮，他还怕没人支持他当一把手？因此盯着亢城不是一天两天了，一听到有人进出亢城基地，心眼立刻活了。
他出基地的时候压根没通知杨大龙，还不是他怕他分一杯羹，所以带走的都是自己的一群手下。
杨大龙虽然不知他去干了什么，可这次被人绑着送进来，就说明是个机会，正好可以光明正大的将他们赶走。
他整理好衣服，带着媳妇小弟朝基地外走去。
大龙基地虽然被称为基地，但其实只不过是个安全中心，这个小基地是以临清县城的医院为中心向外围了五公里建造的，勉强能住个几万人，他们基地上层无法统一，没法实施F市基地一样的制度。不过愿意跟着他的，杨大龙都会按劳分配，不会让人吃亏，只要肯付出劳动，必然会得到所得。因此大多数人都愿意支持杨大龙当首领。
不过还是有一部分人不太满意他的作为，他们既想得的多，又不想多干活，就会拍马溜须，纷纷支持曹邙等人，觉得只有他上位，搅乱风云，他们才能从中渔利。
杨大龙不在意这些人，只要这基地里没了曹邙等人，那些人也翻不出什么风浪。
他走到楼下，已经有不少收到消息的手下，聚集在下面，他们早就不满曹邙等人，把基地搞得一团乱，多少人在他们手下遭殃。要不是他们实力相当，又抓不到他们的把柄，哪还容的他们一天天在基地里放肆！
走出基地入口，杨大龙一看那显眼的军卡和上面那些人穿的军服，顿时眼睛一亮，这是F市基地的吧？还是军队势力，难怪能凭着几个人就把曹邙等人拿下。
杨大龙可不是曹邙等人那样天王老大，自己第二的狂妄自大。他对F市基地向往已久，时时关注。
晶核的使用方法本就是从F市基地传出来的，最早使用晶核的可是军队，又是用的净化晶核，想也知道他们的实力肯定很强，曹邙等人以为人家人少，就敢大咧咧的冲上去，这不是存心找虐吗？杨大龙幸灾乐祸，一点也不同情他们。
“想必各位是F市基地的吧，快里边请。”他热情的招呼荆成夙等人。
荆成夙等人可没错过杨大龙见到地上这堆鼻青脸肿的人时，那副终于抓住把柄的表情，看来这里面有不少故事。只要确定他们不是一伙的，说不定把这些人交给他们就是最好的处理方法。
他们初见对杨大龙的观感不坏，对他的邀请并没有拒绝，只是地上的这些人他们总得先解决掉。
荆成夙本想用这些人换取一些晶核物资，但是却让周磐拉住，被他告知了一个消息，顿时喜笑颜开。
没想到这里居然发现了一个即将要研制出抗毒血清的天才，只要能把这人带回F市基地，什么条件尽管开，下面这堆人就算作见面礼了。
等到在一处房间里坐定，荆成夙就对秦昕提出了邀请，邀请他去F市基地任职，不过被他拒绝了。
秦昕知道杨大龙放心不下外面的那几万的普通人，害怕他们落到别人手里会没有好下场。
“请问是有什么难处吗？只要你愿意去我们基地，任何事都好商量。”荆成夙见两人举止亲密，知道刚才有点鲁莽了，人家明显是一对，他只邀请一个，岂不是存心要拆散人家？难怪拒绝了。
听他说的诚恳，秦昕和杨大龙面面相觑，身处乱世谁不想找个安稳所在，只是……
“那个可以多带一些人吗？”秦昕知道杨大龙一直很向往去F市基地，要不是被外面的那些普通人绊住手脚，又没有适合的接替首领位置的人员，放心不下，他早就自己去F市基地了。现在听到荆成夙相询，忍不住问道。
“要带人？什么人？多少？”荆成夙想着只要不把那几个碍眼的带去，其他人多少都没关系。
当他听完秦昕说的数量，沉默了许久最终答应。不过是几万张嘴，这跟个能研制出抗毒血清的人才相比，正不算什么，他相信即使是庞隆面对这个问题，也会是肯定答复的。
chapters.translated_text:
Qin Xin had also awakened psychic powers, which made his medical skills—already those of a genius—even more formidable. Recently, he had been spending all his time researching how to create an antivenom serum and had no time to spare for Yang Dalong. Today, having finally made some progress, he came out for some fresh air, only to have his moment ruined by Yang Dalong, who had been waiting for a chance to get intimate with him, his eyes practically glowing with eagerness.

Based on Yang Dalong’s understanding of Cao Mang, he definitely wasn't up to anything good!

Lately, this guy had been showing less and less respect for Yang Dalong. He had colluded with many ambitious people within the base and the surrounding areas, constantly scheming to pull Yang Dalong down and take his place.

Most people in the base knew what they were like. If Cao Mang took over, would they even have a way to survive? Almost everyone was against it.

Cao Mang didn't care. What was most important in the apocalypse? Food, of course! As long as he had food in his hands, why would he fear not having support to become the leader? That was why he had been eyeing Kangcheng for more than a day or two; the moment he heard people were entering or leaving the Kangcheng base, his mind immediately started racing.

He hadn't notified Yang Dalong at all when he left the base, mostly because he was afraid Yang would want a cut of the spoils, so he had taken only his own group of subordinates.

Although Yang Dalong didn't know what he had gone to do, the fact that he was now being tied up and delivered back was a golden opportunity—a perfect chance to openly drive them out.

He straightened his clothes and headed toward the base entrance with his wife and his right-hand man.

Although Dalong Base was called a base, it was actually just a safety center. This small base was built around the Linqing County Hospital, spanning a five-kilometer radius, and could barely house a few tens of thousands of people. The upper management of their base couldn't reach a consensus, so they couldn't implement a system like the one in F City Base. However, Yang Dalong distributed resources based on labor for those willing to follow him, ensuring no one was shortchanged; as long as one was willing to work, they would inevitably get what they deserved. Therefore, most people were willing to support Yang Dalong as their leader.

Still, a portion of the people were dissatisfied with his methods. They wanted to gain more while doing less, so they resorted to sycophancy, throwing their support behind Cao Mang and his ilk, believing that only if he took power and stirred up chaos could they profit from the turmoil.

Yang Dalong didn't care about these people; as long as Cao Mang and his group were gone from the base, the others wouldn't be able to stir up any real trouble.

When he walked downstairs, many of his subordinates who had received the news were already gathered there. They had long been dissatisfied with Cao Mang and his group for turning the base into a mess and causing so many people to suffer under their rule. If it weren't for the fact that their strength was evenly matched and they couldn't catch them in the act, they wouldn't have tolerated their arrogance in the base for so long!

Walking out to the base entrance, Yang Dalong’s eyes lit up the moment he saw the conspicuous military trucks and the uniforms the people were wearing. These must be from the F City Base, right? And they were military personnel—no wonder they were able to take down Cao Mang and his group with just a few people.

Yang Dalong was not arrogant and conceited like Cao Mang and his lot, who thought they were the best in the world. He had long yearned for the F City Base and kept a close eye on it.

The method of using crystal nuclei had originated from the F City Base, and the military was the first to use them, specifically purified ones. It was easy to guess that their strength must be immense. Cao Mang and his group had dared to charge at them just because they looked like a small group—wasn't that just asking for a beating? Yang Dalong gloated, feeling no sympathy for them at all.

"I presume you all are from the F City Base? Please, come inside," he said, warmly greeting Jing Chengsu and the others.

Jing Chengsu and his team didn't miss the expression on Yang Dalong’s face when he saw the pile of bruised and battered people on the ground—it was the look of someone who had finally caught a handle on his rivals. It seemed there was quite a story here. As long as they were sure they weren't in league with them, handing these people over might be the best way to handle the situation.

They didn't have a bad first impression of Yang Dalong and didn't refuse his invitation, though they still had to deal with the people on the ground first.

Jing Chengsu had originally wanted to trade these people for some crystal nuclei and supplies, but Zhou Pan pulled him aside and whispered some news to him, which made his face light up with joy.

Who would have thought they would discover a genius here who was on the verge of developing an antivenom serum? As long as they could bring this person back to F City Base, they could name any condition they wanted; the pile of people below could just be considered a welcoming gift.

Once they were seated in a room, Jing Chengsu extended an invitation to Qin Xin, asking him to take a position at the F City Base, but he was refused.

Qin Xin knew that Yang Dalong couldn't let go of the tens of thousands of ordinary people outside, fearing that if they fell into the hands of others, they wouldn't have a good outcome.

"May I ask if there is some difficulty? As long as you are willing to come to our base, anything can be discussed." Seeing the two acting so intimately, Jing Chengsu realized he had been a bit reckless; they were clearly a couple, and by inviting only one, wasn't he intentionally trying to break them up? No wonder he was refused.

Hearing his sincere tone, Qin Xin and Yang Dalong looked at each other. In these chaotic times, who wouldn't want to find a safe haven? It was just that...

"Is it possible to bring more people along?" Qin Xin knew that Yang Dalong had always yearned to go to the F City Base. If he hadn't been held back by the ordinary people outside and lacked a suitable successor for the leadership position, he would have gone to F City Base long ago. Now, hearing Jing Chengsu's inquiry, he couldn't help but ask.

"Bring people? What kind of people? How many?" Jing Chengsu thought that as long as they didn't bring those eyesores along, the number of others didn't matter.

When he heard the number Qin Xin mentioned, he remained silent for a long time before finally agreeing. It was just a few tens of thousands of mouths to feed; compared to a talent who could develop an antivenom serum, this was nothing. He believed that even if Pang Long were faced with this question, he would give the same answer.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 79: The Developer of the Antivenom Serum "Seeking Flowers"

“嘎吱”一辆越野车在陆军总院大门停下，周磐如受惊的兔子般从车门窜出来，一脸的劫后余生的表情，短短的路程，这两人太会问问题了，什么姓名地址家庭成员多大年纪有无恋爱历史为什么来这里等等问题，差点把他老底都掏光了，尤其是那个长得超级帅的兵哥哥，当那双锐利如鹰的黑沉沉眼睛盯着他的时候，他只感觉头皮发麻，压力山大，根本不敢有半句敷衍。
幸好很快就到了，要不然他差点抵挡不住压力，老实将底儿全招了。
刚下车，周琦匆匆从警卫室里走出来：“臭小子，你跑哪去了？害我急死了！”
他还以为周磐是坐澄临县来F市的班车，一大早就去车站接人，结果等了一早上都没有接到人，打电话回村知道他一大早就出发了，周磐身上又没有什么通讯工具，只好回部队忐忑不安的等待，等待的过程越等越焦躁，他满脑子都是不祥的猜测，差点急的满市找人了。
“对不起，我去城里逛了一会儿，忘了时间。”周磐也知道大半天周琦肯定很焦急，连忙道歉。
“你要逛街怎么不等来了再去，第一次来城里，要是迷路走丢了怎么办？”周琦无奈的瞪他一眼，看他没心没肺的样子，感觉自己白担心了。
“呦！小周也不要太紧张了，小磐都这么大人了哪儿能这么容易走丢？”王超探头道，对于这个能在自己本省当兵的幸运小子，真是羡慕嫉妒恨，哪像他整整跨了大半个华国。
周琦这才注意到一旁停的车子，一见车里坐的人，不由惊喜道，“原来是荆队长，超哥，谢谢你们送磐子上来。”
“不用谢！”荆成夙眼睛直直看向周磐，看的他差点炸毛。
看毛啊看，眼睛大了不起啊？！虽然心里嘀咕，但他嘴巴可不敢讲出来，只好假装找东西低下头，眼睛瞄到手中提的水果，才发觉自己白搭了顺风车还没感谢人家呢，难怪人家要盯着他。
周磐放下手中其他的东西，提着一袋水果讨好的笑着，递到荆成夙车窗前，“谢谢你们送我上来，这些水果给你们吃。”
荆成夙嘴角一弯，冷硬的脸柔和下来，他伸手接过周磐手中的塑料袋，不经意间两人的手碰到一起，一人手上肌肤雪白如玉，一人手上肌肤密色如铜，两只手在同一个画面出现，简直是黑与白的碰撞，显得格外惹眼。
“啊！”周磐一声轻叫，他缩回手，奇怪怎么感觉自己手像被电了一下，感觉麻酥酥的？
荆成夙若有所思的看着了一眼自己的手，眼里闪过一丝笑意，他看向周磐，“如果明天还在这里，就去上面部队玩。只要说找荆成夙就行。”
“呃？哦！好的。”周磐对他的眼神完全没有招架之力，不知不觉就答应了。
荆成夙朝周琦点点头，就招呼王超开车。
“小周回头见，小家伙明天可要上来玩。”王超朝两人挥挥手，就启动车子，朝上开去
两人目视着越野车离开，老半天才回过神。
“臭小子你咋认识荆队长他们的，还开车送你？”周琦激动的一巴掌拍在周磐肩上，害他打了个踉跄。
“在下面路口遇到的呗！不就是搭个便车嘛，用的着这么激动吗？难道他们很厉害？”周磐摸摸火辣辣的肩头，呲牙咧嘴的嘟哝。
“何止厉害，简直是超级厉害！”周琦就犹如刚遇到过偶像的追星族般，迫不及待的对周磐科普起荆成夙的丰功伟绩。
什么竞技比武以一敌百，什么练靶百发百中红心，什么带出的飞鹰战队如何强大……简直夸的天花乱坠，口沫横飞。
周磐从来没见过，一向斯文如谦谦君子的周琦有如此生动的一面。
周磐翻个白眼，骗人如果真那么厉害，末世的时候应该不会籍籍无名，他怎么没在F市高手排行榜上见过荆成夙的名字……等等，荆成夙？这名字怎么这么耳熟？他眉头紧锁想了半天，才想起他上辈子快死的前几天，曾经在那个将他当储备粮的队伍那里听过收音机广播，说B市出了个超强的异能高手荆成夙顺利晋级五级什么的，那个队伍还有人感叹他们F市的高层有眼不识金镶玉，白白错过一个绝世高手的庇佑。毕竟对比刚刚晋级二级就能在F市里称为高手的异能者，简直强的要上天了。
莫非那个荆成夙就是这个荆成夙？周磐两眼一亮。想起先前他让他明天去上面部队玩耍，说不定他还可以借机搞好关系，抱上大腿，那可是未来超级大高手哎，大腿不抱白不抱！
周磐不觉得自己有了缥缈炼神录，就觉得自己高枕无忧了，上辈子说他经历过末世，老实说他只能说见过末世，除了头三个月待在周家村，后三个月被人带走，其实算是被圈养待杀的猪仔，压根没杀过一个丧尸，只是在旁人杀了丧尸后帮忙挖过晶核，其他时候就做做后勤，煮煮饭什么的。这样的他再次经历末世，依然还是一只末世小白。
说到末世，周磐想起先前的事，他一把扯过还在滔滔不绝的周琦，将他往偏僻处拖。
“喂，磐子，你做什么呢？”一时不察，差点被他拖的摔倒。
“琦哥，我发现一件糟糕大事了。”周磐愁眉苦脸的道。
周琦将被扯歪的衣服整理好：“什么大事？”
“你还记不记得上个星期看的那本小说？”周磐眼巴巴的提醒。
“末世重生之人生赢家嘛，都是你这臭小子，害我一整个星期都在想末世问题，差点出操的时候都出状况了。”周琦白他一眼，谁叫那小说写的事情太过残酷真实，他的思绪不免老是被拖入其中。
“这回不是小说的问题了！我今天在车上看到一个人，全身腐臭味，大夏天直打寒颤，四肢僵化，犹如行尸走肉，就跟小说里面写的丧尸异变期一模一样。”周磐满脸天塌地陷的恐慌表情，担惊受怕的问周琦，“你说是不是真的要有末世出现了？”
“胡说八道！”周琦冷斥一声，“这世上哪有世界末日，你怕是末世小说看多了，把一个普通犯病的人给看成中病毒的人了。”
他觉得周磐是被末世小说里的内容给荼毒了，才会疑神疑鬼。
“我说是真的，那个人被送到医院去了，你说他晚上要是变异成丧尸了，那医院里的人岂不是危险了吗？”周磐颇为焦急，他又不能大咧咧的直接说，末世要来临了，这个就是预兆。
显然周琦对他的言辞并不相信，“好了，以后那种小说少看点，就算那个人真的要变成丧尸，也不是我一个小小的当兵的能管的事情。我们还是不要在大门口站着了，快进去吧！”
可恶，既然不相信我！周磐牙齿咬着下唇，不行，要是不趁现在刚露出端儿的时候，采取措施，F市又会陷入一片混乱。只是上辈子政府视异能者为异端，不少初期异能者被送入研究院研究，导致后来晋级变强的异能者对政府高层极为仇视，当军队被各种原因覆灭后，异能者立马推翻了政府部门，自己站上权利顶端，原本不过是个普通人，尝到了权力在握的滋味，哪里会考虑下面百姓的利益，整天就为了那点权力你争我夺，几乎每天都有人不断死去，不是被丧尸咬死，就是饿死，病死，或者被同类杀死。
倘若这个世界再次沦为这样的人间地狱，那他的重生不是没有半点意义了吗？
只是他要是豁出去，将事情曝光，不会也会像上辈子里的异能者一样，被当做异端送去解剖吧？
想到这个可能，周磐就忍不住心里害怕，上辈子被人一刀一刀的割肉，这辈子难道还要经历开膛破肚的滋味？想想就有一股冷气从头直寒到脚。
可是他要是闭紧嘴巴不说，任凭事态发展，不说全世界，就F市就有几千万的生命受到威胁，眼睁睁的看着无数生命坠落，他又觉得自己良心不安。
怎么办呢？周磐垂头丧气的跟着周琦往陆军大门口走，警卫室有人打招呼，“老周这就是你那个邻居弟弟？”
“对！这小子自个儿，跑城里去了，害我担心半天。”周琦苦笑了一下。
周磐朝警卫室里的曹大兵不好意思的笑笑。
“你也担心过度了，现在小孩哪个不识两个字，看看照着站牌坐车，哪儿都丢不了。”曹大兵见他一下午在警卫室坐立难安，颇受煎熬，不由说道。
周琦笑笑，要不是周磐那么小就宅在农村家里，从来没来过城里，害怕他不适应这个日新月异的大城市，他哪用的着担这份心？
周磐掏出一串香蕉递给曹大兵，“让这位大哥也跟着担心了半天，真是劳你伤神了。”
“哎哟，真是太客气了，这怎么好意思？”曹大兵赶紧摆手。
“拿着吧，这里还多着呢！叨唠了一下午，刚好润润嘴。”周琦在一旁说道。
三人聊了会儿，就告别了，周琦带他往自己的宿舍走。周琦的宿舍原本住八个人，刚好有两个老兵退伍了，空出了两个床位，到也不至于让周磐没地方睡。
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 8: The Future Super-Powered Expert "Seeking Recommendations, Seeking Collections"
chapters.translated_text:
"Screech." An off-road vehicle pulled up at the main gate of the Army General Hospital. Zhou Pan scrambled out of the car like a startled rabbit, his face wearing an expression of having just survived a disaster. During the short journey, those two had been far too inquisitive. They asked about his name, address, family members, age, whether he had any dating history, why he came here, and so on—they nearly dug up his entire background. Especially that super-handsome soldier; when those sharp, eagle-like, pitch-black eyes stared at him, he felt his scalp go numb and the pressure was immense, leaving him not daring to give a single perfunctory answer.

Fortunately, they arrived quickly, or he might not have been able to withstand the pressure and would have honestly confessed everything.

Just as he got out of the car, Zhou Qi hurried out from the guardroom: "You brat, where did you run off to? You had me worried to death!"

He had assumed Zhou Pan would take the shuttle bus from Chenglin County to F City, so he went to the station early in the morning to pick him up. However, after waiting all morning, he didn't see him. He called back to the village and learned he had set off early in the morning. Since Zhou Pan didn't have any communication tools, he had no choice but to return to the barracks and wait in anxiety. The longer he waited, the more restless he became; his mind was filled with ominous guesses, and he was nearly frantic enough to search the whole city for him.

"I'm sorry, I went to wander around the city for a while and lost track of time." Zhou Pan also knew Zhou Qi must have been very anxious for most of the day, so he quickly apologized.

"If you wanted to go shopping, why didn't you wait until you arrived? It's your first time in the city; what would you have done if you got lost?" Zhou Qi glared at him helplessly. Seeing his carefree appearance, he felt his worry had been for nothing.

"Yo! Little Zhou, don't be so nervous. Little Pan is a grown man now, how could he get lost so easily?" Wang Chao poked his head out. He felt truly envious, jealous, and hateful toward this lucky kid who could serve in the military in his own province—unlike him, who had to travel across more than half of China.

Only then did Zhou Qi notice the car parked to the side. Upon seeing who was sitting inside, he couldn't help but say with pleasant surprise, "So it's Captain Jing. Brother Chao, thank you for bringing Panzi up here."

"No need to thank us!" Jing Chengsu stared straight at Zhou Pan, making him nearly bristle.

What are you staring at? Is having big eyes a big deal?! Although he muttered this in his heart, he didn't dare say it out loud. He had to pretend to look for something and lowered his head. When his eyes caught the fruit he was carrying, he realized he had taken a free ride without thanking them, which was no wonder they were staring at him.

Zhou Pan put down his other belongings, picked up a bag of fruit, and smiled ingratiatingly as he handed it through Jing Chengsu's car window: "Thank you for bringing me up here. Please, have some of this fruit."

The corners of Jing Chengsu's mouth curved, and his cold, rigid face softened. He reached out and took the plastic bag from Zhou Pan's hand. Inadvertently, their hands brushed against each other—one hand with skin as white as jade, the other with skin as bronze as copper. The two hands appearing in the same frame was a collision of black and white, looking exceptionally striking.

"Ah!" Zhou Pan let out a soft cry. He pulled his hand back, feeling strange—why did his hand feel like it had been shocked, with a tingling sensation?

Jing Chengsu looked at his own hand thoughtfully, a trace of a smile flashing in his eyes. He looked at Zhou Pan: "If you're still here tomorrow, come up to the barracks to hang out. Just say you're looking for Jing Chengsu."

"Uh? Oh! Okay." Zhou Pan had no defense against his gaze and agreed before he even realized it.

Jing Chengsu nodded at Zhou Qi and then signaled for Wang Chao to drive.

"See you later, Little Zhou. Little guy, make sure to come up and hang out tomorrow." Wang Chao waved at the two of them, started the car, and drove upward.

The two watched the off-road vehicle leave, only coming back to their senses after a long while.

"You brat, how do you know Captain Jing and the others? They even drove you here?" Zhou Qi excitedly slapped Zhou Pan on the shoulder, causing him to stumble.

"I just met them at the intersection below! It's just a ride, is there any need to be so excited? Are they really that amazing?" Zhou Pan rubbed his stinging shoulder, muttering with a grimace.

"More than amazing, they're super amazing!" Like a fan who had just met their idol, Zhou Qi couldn't wait to educate Zhou Pan on Jing Chengsu's glorious achievements.

He talked about how he fought a hundred men alone in competitions, how he hit the bullseye every single time at the shooting range, how powerful the Flying Eagle squad he led was... he praised him to the high heavens, spitting as he spoke.

Zhou Pan had never seen Zhou Qi, who was usually as refined as a gentleman, act so vividly.

Zhou Pan rolled his eyes. Liar. If he were really that amazing, he shouldn't have been unknown during the apocalypse. Why hadn't he seen Jing Chengsu's name on the F City top expert rankings... wait, Jing Chengsu? Why did this name sound so familiar? He frowned and thought for a long time before remembering that a few days before he died in his previous life, he had heard a radio broadcast while with the group that treated him as emergency rations. The broadcast said that a super-powerful ability user named Jing Chengsu had emerged in B City and successfully advanced to Level 5 or something. Someone in that group had even lamented that the high-level officials in their F City were blind and had missed out on the protection of a peerless expert. After all, compared to the ability users who were considered experts in F City just for reaching Level 2, he was simply heaven-defyingly strong.

Could that Jing Chengsu be this Jing Chengsu? Zhou Pan's eyes lit up. Remembering that he had invited him to come to the barracks tomorrow, perhaps he could take the opportunity to build a relationship and latch onto a powerful backer. That was a future super-expert; it would be a waste not to latch onto him!

Zhou Pan didn't think that just because he had the Ethereal Refining Manual, he could rest easy. In his previous life, he could only say he had "seen" the apocalypse. Except for the first three months he spent in Zhou Village, the following three months were spent being taken away by others, essentially as a piglet being raised for slaughter. He had never killed a single zombie; he only helped dig out energy cores after others killed them, and the rest of the time he did logistics, cooking, and the like. Having experienced the apocalypse like that, he was still a complete novice.

Speaking of the apocalypse, Zhou Pan remembered the earlier matter. He grabbed Zhou Qi, who was still talking incessantly, and dragged him to a secluded spot.

"Hey, Panzi, what are you doing?" Caught off guard, he was almost dragged to the ground.

"Brother Qi, I've discovered a terrible, major event," Zhou Pan said with a miserable face.

Zhou Qi straightened his clothes, which had been pulled askew: "What major event?"

"Do you remember the novel we read last week?" Zhou Pan reminded him eagerly.

"You mean 'Apocalypse Rebirth: Life Winner'? It's all your fault, you brat, making me think about apocalypse problems all week. I almost messed up during drills." Zhou Qi glared at him. Who told him that the things written in that novel were too cruel and realistic? His thoughts couldn't help but be dragged into it.

"This time it's not about the novel! I saw someone in the car today who smelled of rot, shivering in the middle of summer, with stiff limbs, just like a walking corpse—exactly the same as the zombie mutation phase described in the novel." Zhou Pan had a panicked expression as if the sky were falling, and asked Zhou Qi fearfully, "Do you think the apocalypse is really going to happen?"

"Nonsense!" Zhou Qi scolded coldly. "There's no such thing as the end of the world. You've probably read too many apocalypse novels and mistaken a regular sick person for someone infected with a virus."

He felt that Zhou Pan had been poisoned by the content of apocalypse novels, which was why he was being suspicious.

"I'm telling you, it's real. That person was sent to the hospital. If he mutates into a zombie tonight, wouldn't the people in the hospital be in danger?" Zhou Pan was quite anxious. He couldn't just blurt out that the apocalypse was coming and this was the omen.

Clearly, Zhou Qi didn't believe his words. "Alright, read less of those novels in the future. Even if that person really were to turn into a zombie, it's not something a small soldier like me can handle. Let's not stand at the gate anymore, let's go in!"

Damn it, he doesn't believe me! Zhou Pan bit his lower lip. No, if he didn't take measures now while the signs were just appearing, F City would fall into chaos again. It was just that in his previous life, the government viewed ability users as heretics, and many early ability users were sent to research institutes for study, which led to the later ability users who advanced and became strong being extremely hostile toward the government high-ups. When the military was wiped out for various reasons, the ability users immediately overthrew the government departments and stood at the pinnacle of power themselves. They were originally just ordinary people, and once they tasted the power in their hands, how could they consider the interests of the common people? They spent their days fighting for that bit of power, and almost every day people were dying—either bitten to death by zombies, starved to death, died of illness, or killed by their own kind.

If this world were to fall into such a living hell again, wouldn't his rebirth be completely meaningless?

But if he went all out and exposed the matter, wouldn't he be treated like the ability users in his previous life and sent to be dissected as a heretic?

Thinking of this possibility, Zhou Pan couldn't help but feel afraid. In his previous life, he had been cut piece by piece; did he have to experience the feeling of being disemboweled in this life too? Just thinking about it sent a chill from his head to his feet.

But if he kept his mouth shut and let things develop, not to mention the whole world, just in F City, tens of millions of lives would be threatened. Watching countless lives fall, he felt uneasy in his conscience.

What should he do? Zhou Pan followed Zhou Qi toward the army gate, dejected. Someone in the guardroom greeted them: "Old Zhou, is this that neighbor brother of yours?"

"Yes! This brat ran off to the city by himself, worrying me for half the day." Zhou Qi gave a bitter smile.

Zhou Pan smiled apologetically at Cao, the soldier in the guardroom.

"You're worrying too much. Which kid nowadays doesn't know how to read? Just look at the bus signs and take the bus; they won't get lost anywhere." Seeing him sitting restlessly in the guardroom all afternoon, suffering, Cao couldn't help but say.

Zhou Qi smiled. If it weren't for the fact that Zhou Pan had lived in the countryside since he was small and had never been to the city, fearing he wouldn't adapt to this ever-changing big city, why would he have to worry so much?

Zhou Pan took out a bunch of bananas and handed them to Cao: "Sorry to have made you worry for half the day as well, it really was a lot of trouble for you."

"Oh, you're too polite, how could I accept this?" Cao quickly waved his hand.

"Take them, there's plenty more! Sorry for bothering you all afternoon, just have them to moisten your mouth," Zhou Qi said from the side.

The three chatted for a while before saying goodbye. Zhou Qi took him to his dormitory. Zhou Qi's dormitory originally housed eight people, and since two veterans had just retired, two beds were empty, so at least Zhou Pan wouldn't be without a place to sleep.
chapters.title: 第8章 未来的超级强者「求推荐，求收藏」

chapters.translated_text:
In order to bring Qin Xin back to the base completely, Jing Chengsu and his team stayed at the Tianlong base for a day, preparing to escort them to the F City base once they had finished packing.

Yesterday, Yang Dalong had expelled Cao Mang and his group from the Tianlong base on the grounds that they had offended a major base and would bring disaster upon his own.

Seeing those people walking out of the base supporting each other, despite their bruised and swollen faces but no other injuries, and noticing the resentment in their eyes toward the people of Tianlong base, Jing Chengsu felt that Yang Dalong’s method of handling the situation was too soft-hearted and feared it would lead to trouble.

Sure enough, after midnight, someone actually scattered blood bags outside the base. Jing Chengsu, who had already put people on alert, immediately had an ice ability user freeze the blood and ordered earth ability users to bury the blood-soaked soil deep underground, but it was too late; zombies had already begun to gather one after another, following the scent of blood.

"This must be the work of Cao Mang and his group! Damn it, if I had known, I wouldn't have let them off so easily." Yang Dalong was furious.

He had actually wanted to teach that group a harsh lesson, but seeing them crying and begging, appearing as if they had turned over a new leaf, his heart softened. Despite his rough and burly appearance, Yang Dalong was a very kind-hearted person at his core. He was unwilling to judge others with malice, and seeing them swear oaths and weep pitifully, he couldn't help but feel a sense of compassion, ultimately letting them go.

Facts proved that some people are not worth sympathizing with at all. Vicious-hearted people don't feel grateful when someone lets them go; instead, harboring hatred for the base, they used blood bags to lure a large number of zombies.

Regret was useless for Yang Dalong now; he could only order his men to fight the zombies. Although the base's walls were quite high, they couldn't withstand a single punch or kick if a few climbing zombies or giant zombies were to arrive.

Fortunately, because the blood had been dealt with in time, not many zombies were lured—only about a few thousand. Aside from those who had been driven away, the base still had about a hundred ability users, all of whom were team members Yang Dalong had raised and nurtured himself.

The other tens of thousands were ordinary people. Yang Dalong had always been the one protecting them, and they had little experience facing zombie hordes. Many were frightened pale, and some even spoke recklessly, blaming Yang Dalong for driving Cao Mang away, which was why he had done such a crazy thing.

Yang Dalong’s feelings were complex; this was exactly why he had been unable to let go and had kept delaying his departure. During the day, they had praised him for driving Cao Mang and his group away, but now they had turned around to blame him for doing so. Human nature was indeed the most difficult thing to understand.

With the help of Jing Chengsu and his team, the thousands of zombies didn't cause any real trouble and were wiped out completely.

These thousands of zombies were eliminated, but they left behind a large amount of loot. Yang Dalong distributed it based on contribution, and the lion's share naturally went to Jing Chengsu and his team. Although Yang Dalong and his people only received a small portion, it was still enough to be a pleasant surprise.

Yang Dalong felt a bit disgusted by those people; he had originally been reluctant to see them leave, but now he was somewhat impatient to leave this place himself.

Life had to be lived by oneself eventually. Protecting these people like a nagging mother wasn't saving them; it was harming them.

After cleaning up the mess, dawn was approaching.

Yang Dalong gathered the tens of thousands of people who had packed their luggage, waiting for Jing Chengsu and his team to arrive.

The Dalong base had no space ability users, so all their belongings were packed into vehicles.

The long procession headed toward the F City base. Naturally, such a large group attracted many zombie hordes along the way. However, with experts like Jing Chengsu sitting in command, every bolt of lightning would strike down dozens or hundreds of zombies. Eliminating the zombies that gathered around was just a matter of minutes.

Stopping and going along the way, they finally arrived at the F City base. The area outside the base was still packed with people, and one had to wait in line to enter.
chapters.source_text:
荆成夙等人为了能完全将秦昕带回基地，在天龙基地待了一天，准备等这些人收拾好，就将他们护送去F市基地。
昨天杨大龙以曹邙等人得罪大基地，会给他们基地带来灾难等理由，将他们逐出了天龙基地。
荆成夙见那些人虽然顶着鼻青脸肿的皮外伤，但身上并没有其他损伤，就这么搀扶着走出基地，眼神还带着对天龙基地的人的怨恨。他就觉得杨大龙的处理方法太心慈手软了，怕是还会有什么祸端。
果然过了半夜，居然有人在基地外头撒了血袋。早就让人警惕的荆成夙，连忙见冰异能者冻结了血液，并让土异能者将那些带着血的土，翻到地下去，可还是太迟了，有丧尸顺着血腥味陆陆续续围了过来。
“这肯定是曹邙他们干的！可恶，早知道就不那么轻易放过他们了。”杨大龙大为光火。
他其实也想狠狠修理那帮人，可是让他们又哭又求，一副改过自新的表情，给弄的心软了。别看杨大龙长的五大三粗，可他的内心是个极为善良的人，不愿意去用恶意去揣测别人，见那些人诅咒发肆，痛苦流涕的可怜样，不由起了恻隐之心，最终还是放过了他们。
事实证明有些人是一点都不值得同情，心肠恶毒的人，可不觉得杨大龙放过他们就要感恩，怀着对这个基地的恨意，用血袋引来不少丧尸。
杨大龙再后悔也没用，只能下令对抗丧尸。虽然他们基地的围墙挺高的，但若是来个几只爬尸巨尸，根本就承受不住一拳一脚。
好在急时处理了血液，引来的丧尸不多，大约有数千只，基地除了赶走的那些人，还有百来个异能者。都是杨大龙一手拉巴着出来的队伍成员。
其他的数万人都是普通人，一直以来都是杨大龙在保护他们，没怎么面对丧尸群的经验，不少人都吓的面无人色，有些人还口不择言的怪罪杨大龙赶走了曹邙，才会让他做出这么疯狂的事。
杨大龙的心情很复杂，这就是让他迟迟放心不下，一直拖延留在这里的人。白天的时候还对他赶走曹邙等人大加赞扬，如今却又翻脸指责他不该怎么做，人心果然是最难以理解的东西。
这里有荆成夙等人相助，数千丧尸根本就没翻起什么浪花，就被收拾的一干二净。
这数千丧尸被消灭了，却留下了大笔收获，杨大龙按劳分配，大头自然归了荆成夙他们。杨大龙他们虽然只得了一小部分，但也足够让人惊喜。
杨大龙心里对那些人有些膈应，原本还舍不得他们离开，但是现在他有点迫不及待的想要离开这里。
日子终究要自己过，他像老妈子似的保护这些人，根本不是救他们，而且害了他们。
收拾了满地狼藉，天也快亮了。
杨大龙带着收拾好行礼的几万人，等着荆成夙他们到来。
大龙基地没有空间异能者，东西都是用车子装起来。
一路浩浩荡荡的赶往F市基地，这么多人自然一路吸引人不少丧尸群。但是有荆成夙这样的强者坐镇，每每一道雷电下去，就劈死几十几百只丧尸，消灭完这些围过来的丧尸，不过是分分钟的事。
一路走一路停，终于到达了F市基地。基地外头依然排满了人，想要进入必须排队等待。

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 80: Preparing to Relocate "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"

chapters.source_text:
做为F市基地的异能高手，荆成夙名声在外。这次他接的任务危险万分，据先头一起接任务，无功而返的那些异能者透漏，他们这次居然撞到了丧尸王和一窝高等丧尸，他又两天没出现，基地内议论纷纷，不少人猜测他已遭不测，有的人惋惜哀叹，有的人幸灾乐祸。
惋惜哀叹的都是盼望基地好的，少了一个强者，对基地多少都有些影响。
幸灾乐祸的是那些不安分的，被军区大势力压制，无出头机会，没胆反抗强权，私底下咬咬舌根，抒发心中的不满。
不管心头想法如何，这两天对荆成夙的关注都挺多的，一看到他平安出现在基地大门口，立刻引起骚动。
王超正准备带着人手前往亢城，一到大门口就遇上了归来的荆成夙，大为高兴。
“老大你们回来了？太好了！”王超等人眼睛都有点红，他们都以为荆成夙他们遭到不幸，一脸悲壮的想要去给他们报仇呢。
“已经没事，辛苦你们了。”看他们的脸色，肯定这两天都睡的不安稳觉。
两方寒暄了一会儿，荆成夙让王超他们去安排带回来的这些人，自己和周磐去向首长报道。
“平安无事就好。”看他们安然无恙，庞隆也松了口气。原本以为对于荆成夙来说不过是件有点难度的任务，谁能想到那里居然这么快就发展出那么大一窝丧尸，还有一只强大的丧尸王，听的都让人发毛。
两天没他们的消息，庞隆也很焦急，这次王超等人出发也是他授意，还特意带上了重枪重炮。
没想到刚出门就遇到他们归来。
“让首长担心了。”荆成夙两人敬了礼。
“亢城现在情势如何？”那么多的丧尸，荆成夙他们也能闯出来，庞隆对他们的实力刮目相看。
荆成夙就据这两天的情况说了个遍，当然有些事情比如受伤空间什么的，都被他隐瞒了过去，只说陷入丧尸包围圈的时候，他刚好晋级，实力大增于丧尸王对抗了一天一夜，终于拖的它自爆。
这个理由有点牵强，其中肯定还有些蹊跷，不过庞隆也没追究，他注意力被引到丧尸王已自爆上面，强龙无首，没了首脑，正是消灭的好时机，等会儿他要赶紧发布清剿亢城的任务。
荆成夙还禀报了带回了一个对丧尸抗毒血清有研究的人，以及人家那多带几万张口的条件。
一下子多收纳这么多人，庞隆有点皱眉，但是如果这人能真的研制出抗毒血清，价值可就大了，想想就点头，不就几万张嘴吗？他们基地还出的起口粮。
说到粮食，先前就带回了一大批粮食，不知道后面的周磐又收了多少。
周磐的空间被粮食占去了所有空余空间，他看的也难受，索性到了基地正好可以拿出来。
庞隆亲自去开了基地内最大的仓库，周磐收的粮食太多，为了怕太显眼，荆成夙早就叮咛他谨慎行事，因此他只取了五分之二出来。别看只有五分之二，已经将这大仓库填满了。一眼看去，有三四千吨，足够基地内食用很长时间。
“这……”庞隆知道周磐的空间大，可这也太大了一点吧？他看着满满当当的仓库粮食，惊愕不已。
这空间也大的太反常了点，庞隆心中有猜测，不过也没揭穿，好歹周磐也算自己人，得利的也是他们基地，没什么不好的。
他还不知道周磐只取了一部分出来，要知道还有大部分放在周磐空间中，也许想法就不一样了。
荆成夙捏紧拳头，绷着脸，见庞隆脸上虽惊异，并没有其他表情，松了口气，虽然也知道首长不是那种目光短浅，见利忘义的人，但事关周磐他还是忍不住悬着心。
周磐一次性掏了这么多的粮食出来，精神力再次耗光，无力的靠着荆成夙。精神力用尽，周磐十分难受。荆成夙朝庞隆敬完礼，扶着周磐走出仓库。
chapters.translated_text:
As a top-tier ability user in the F City base, Jing Chengsu was well-known. The mission he took on this time was extremely dangerous. According to the ability users who had gone ahead and returned empty-handed, they had unexpectedly run into a Zombie King and a nest of high-level zombies. Because he hadn't appeared for two days, there was much discussion within the base; many speculated that he had met with an accident, with some sighing in pity while others gloated.

Those who sighed in pity were the ones who hoped for the base's well-being, as the loss of a powerhouse would inevitably affect the base to some extent.

Those who gloated were the restless ones who had been suppressed by the powerful military factions and had no chance to get ahead. Lacking the courage to resist the powers that be, they could only gossip in private to vent their dissatisfaction.

Regardless of their inner thoughts, the attention on Jing Chengsu over the past two days had been intense, and his safe appearance at the base gate immediately caused a stir.

Wang Chao was just preparing to lead his men toward Kang City when he encountered the returning Jing Chengsu at the gate, and he was overjoyed.

"Boss, you're back? That's great!" Wang Chao and the others had slightly red eyes; they had all assumed Jing Chengsu and his team had met with misfortune and were looking grim, ready to go and avenge them.

"Everything is fine now. You've all worked hard." Looking at their complexions, it was clear they hadn't slept well these past two days.

After the two sides exchanged pleasantries for a while, Jing Chengsu asked Wang Chao and the others to arrange for the people they had brought back, while he and Zhou Pan went to report to the Chief.

"It's good that you're safe and sound." Seeing them unharmed, Pang Long also breathed a sigh of relief. He had originally thought it was just a moderately difficult mission for Jing Chengsu, but who could have imagined that a massive nest of zombies and a powerful Zombie King would develop there so quickly? Just hearing about it made one's hair stand on end.

Having had no news of them for two days, Pang Long had also been very anxious. He was the one who had authorized Wang Chao and the others to set out, even specifically having them take heavy guns and artillery.

He hadn't expected to run into them just as they were leaving.

"We made the Chief worry." Jing Chengsu and Zhou Pan saluted.

"What is the situation in Kang City now?" Seeing that Jing Chengsu and his team were able to break out despite so many zombies, Pang Long looked at their strength with newfound respect.

Jing Chengsu recounted everything that had happened over the past two days. Of course, he concealed certain things, such as his injuries and the space ability, only saying that when he was surrounded by zombies, he happened to level up, and his greatly increased strength allowed him to fight the Zombie King for a day and a night, finally dragging it to the point of self-destruction.

This reason was a bit far-fetched, and there were certainly some mysteries involved, but Pang Long didn't press the issue. His attention was drawn to the fact that the Zombie King had self-destructed; with the dragon headless and the leader gone, it was the perfect time to eliminate them. He would have to issue the mission to clear out Kang City immediately.

Jing Chengsu also reported that he had brought back someone who was researching an anti-zombie serum, along with that person's condition of bringing along several tens of thousands of mouths to feed.

Pang Long frowned slightly at the prospect of taking in so many people at once, but if this person could truly develop an anti-serum, the value would be immense. Thinking about it, he nodded; what were a few tens of thousands of mouths? Their base could still afford the rations.

Speaking of food, they had previously brought back a large batch, and he wondered how much more Zhou Pan had collected later on.

Zhou Pan's space had been filled with food, occupying all the remaining room, which made him feel uncomfortable; he figured it was just as well to take it out now that they were at the base.

Pang Long personally went to open the largest warehouse in the base. Zhou Pan had collected so much food that, fearing it would be too conspicuous, Jing Chengsu had long since warned him to be cautious. Therefore, he only took out two-fifths. Even though it was only two-fifths, it had already filled the large warehouse. At a glance, there were three to four thousand tons, enough for the base to consume for a long time.

"This..." Pang Long knew Zhou Pan's space was large, but wasn't this a bit too large? He looked at the warehouse filled to the brim with food, stunned.

This space was abnormally large. Pang Long had his suspicions, but he didn't expose them. After all, Zhou Pan was considered one of their own, and it was their base that benefited, so there was nothing wrong with that.

He didn't know that Zhou Pan had only taken out a portion; if he had known that the majority was still in Zhou Pan's space, his thoughts might have been different.

Jing Chengsu clenched his fists and kept a straight face. Seeing that although Pang Long was surprised, he showed no other expressions, he breathed a sigh of relief. Although he knew the Chief wasn't the type to be short-sighted or profit-driven, he couldn't help but feel anxious when it concerned Zhou Pan.

Having emptied so much food at once, Zhou Pan's mental energy was exhausted again, and he leaned weakly against Jing Chengsu. With his mental energy depleted, Zhou Pan felt extremely uncomfortable. After Jing Chengsu finished saluting Pang Long, he supported Zhou Pan as they walked out of the warehouse.
chapters.title: 第81章 有所猜测「求枝枝」
第82章 洗澡了「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.source_text:
庞隆看着仓库里的粮食，这足够基地里的人吃上个一年半载的，再加上他们平常又想方设法的收集物资，还能再运回些粮食，两两相加，这一两年时间，倒是不用担心食物的问题。
只是虽然打算采用无菌种植技术，末世前这技术倒是容易成功，就不知末世后会不会受其他因素影响。
荆成夙扶着周磐离开领导的视线后，就把他背了起来，周磐今天赶了一天路，一路上经常使用神识探路，回来又用神识搬运了这么多的粮食，感觉全身发软，特别疲累，趴在荆成夙身上，听着他有规律的心跳声，不由自主的眼皮直往下坠，半响睡了过去。
荆成夙背着他踏着沉稳的脚步，慢慢朝宿舍走去。
他们今天的行为还是冒险了点，虽然周磐只取了一部分粮食出来，可暴露的空间还是太大了，哪怕最后庞隆没有对周磐的空间起觊觎之心，可是他知道庞隆至少有一霎那动过心。
荆成夙抿抿嘴，看来他们还是不够谨慎。
回到宿舍，周磐还没睡醒，荆成夙不得不把他叫醒。
杀了半夜的丧尸，加上刚才又搬运了那么多的粮食。虽然不是用手搬的，但一袋袋粮食落地，产生的大量灰尘落到身上，不洗一下澡，睡的怎么舒服？
周磐迷迷糊糊的睁开眼睛，听到要洗澡，就带着荆成夙闪入空间中，外面的水太凉，现在还没到供应热水的时间。
如今空间里开火了，他厨房随时都备着热水，两人都提了热水，跑到浴室洗澡。
这处古宅子里可没有水龙头，蓬蓬头，浴缸等设备，倒是有许多古装剧中会出现的大木桶，大木桶很大，洗两个人的澡完全没问题。
周磐脑袋昏昏沉沉的还没睡清醒，将水注满了大水桶，他就迫不及待的脱衣解带，将自己在荆成夙面前拔光，丝毫没意识到自己走光了，就那么光裸着身子，背对着荆成夙爬进大木桶。
自从周磐修炼以来，身上的赘肉早就一天天减没了，加上修习的缥缈炼神录本来就有美体美颜的功效，他现在的身体曲线发育的十分完美，既不显胖，也不过瘦，匀称有型，白晰的肌肤莹润有光泽，他一只手撑在大木桶边，慢慢跨脚进去半人高的大木桶，圆润挺翘的翘臀毫无知觉的暴露在荆成夙面前，不一会儿随着水波荡漾，隐入热水中，他舒服的轻叹一声，完全忘记了这澡间还有另一个人的存在。
荆成夙一只手保持着解扣子的动作，僵在那里冷峻的脸上有点发烧，鼻头痒痒的，大饱了一番眼福，身体窜起一股熟悉的燥热，有点不确定他是否该继续脱衣服，还是出去散散风，等会儿再洗。
周磐被温热的热水包围着，热水舒缓了全身筋骨他昏沉的神智渐渐清醒过来，好久没好好洗过热水澡，好舒服啊！他开心的捧着热水往脖颈臂膀上泼，一边还忍不住哼着歌。
“咳咳咳……”突然耳边传来几声干咳声。
他吓了一跳，手反射性的捂住胸，转头一看，“轰”他整张脸都红了，哦，天哪！他怎么把夙哥给忘记了？
“夙……夙哥”他羞红着脸，眼睛无措的转来转去。
荆成夙看他那副可爱的模样，原本打算退出的脚步，顿时止住了，他双手慢条斯理的解着身上的衣服扣子。
嗯？夙哥也要跟他一起洗澡？周磐这下子开始慌了手脚。
两人都是男的，一起洗也没什么，谁叫他这只有一只大木桶，他不是没跟男的洗过澡，当初在周琦那个部队可是大澡间呢！（虽然有另外隔了一层隔间。）
可是荆成夙跟他们能一样吗？别人在他眼里，即使光裸着，在他眼里也跟洗白白的白萝卜没啥区别。可荆成夙只不过解开点衣服，露出密色健壮的胸膛，他的心脏就紧张的开始“嘭嘭嘭”剧烈跳动，脸上的红晕越来越深，红的都快滴血了。
眼看着荆成夙身上的衣服越解越少。周磐窘迫的将身形越缩越小，渐渐几乎整个人都缩进了水里，水面上只剩下他鼻子以上的半张脸露在外面。
chapters.translated_text:
Pang Long looked at the grain in the warehouse. It was enough to feed the people in the base for a year or a year and a half. Coupled with the fact that they were always trying their best to collect supplies and could transport more grain back, they wouldn't have to worry about food for the next year or two.

However, although they planned to use sterile cultivation technology, while this technology was easy to succeed before the apocalypse, it was unclear if it would be affected by other factors after the apocalypse.

After Jing Chengsu helped Zhou Pan leave the leader's sight, he carried him on his back. Zhou Pan had been traveling all day, frequently using his divine sense to scout the path, and upon returning, he had used his divine sense to transport so much grain. Feeling his whole body go limp and exceptionally exhausted, he leaned against Jing Chengsu, listening to the rhythmic beating of his heart, and his eyelids couldn't help but droop until he fell asleep.

Jing Chengsu carried him with steady footsteps, slowly walking toward the dormitory.

Their actions today were a bit risky. Although Zhou Pan only took out a portion of the grain, the space he exposed was still too large. Even if Pang Long didn't covet Zhou Pan's space in the end, he knew that Pang Long had been tempted for at least a fleeting moment.

Jing Chengsu pursed his lips; it seemed they still weren't cautious enough.

Returning to the dormitory, Zhou Pan hadn't woken up yet, so Jing Chengsu had to wake him.

After killing zombies for half the night and then transporting so much grain just now—even though he didn't move it by hand, the large amount of dust from the bags hitting the ground had settled on them—how could he sleep comfortably without taking a bath?

Zhou Pan opened his eyes groggily. Hearing that it was time for a bath, he flashed into the space with Jing Chengsu; the water outside was too cold, and it wasn't time for hot water supply yet.

Now that they had a fire going in the space, his kitchen always had hot water ready. Both of them fetched hot water and ran to the bathroom to bathe.

This ancient house didn't have faucets, showerheads, or bathtubs, but it did have many large wooden barrels like those seen in period dramas. The barrel was very large, and it was perfectly fine for two people to bathe in.

Zhou Pan’s head was still foggy and not fully awake. After filling the large barrel with water, he couldn't wait to strip off his clothes, baring himself completely in front of Jing Chengsu. Without realizing he was exposing himself, he climbed into the large wooden barrel with his back to Jing Chengsu, completely naked.

Ever since Zhou Pan began cultivating, the excess fat on his body had gradually disappeared day by day. Plus, the "Ethereal Refining God Record" he practiced had the effect of beautifying the body and skin. His body curves were now perfectly developed—neither too fat nor too thin, well-proportioned and toned. His fair skin was lustrous and glowing. He braced one hand on the edge of the barrel and slowly stepped into the waist-high tub, his round, firm buttocks exposed to Jing Chengsu without a care. A moment later, as the water rippled, he submerged into the hot water and let out a sigh of comfort, completely forgetting that there was another person in the bathroom.

Jing Chengsu, one hand still in the middle of unbuttoning his shirt, froze there. His stern face felt a bit hot, and his nose itched. Having feasted his eyes, a familiar heat surged through his body. He wasn't sure if he should continue undressing or go out for some air and bathe later.

Surrounded by the warm water, the heat soothed his muscles and bones, and his foggy mind gradually cleared. It had been so long since he’d had a proper hot bath; it felt so good! He happily splashed hot water onto his neck and arms, unable to stop himself from humming a tune.

"Cough, cough, cough..." Suddenly, a few dry coughs came from beside him.

He was startled, reflexively covering his chest with his hands. He turned his head and—"Boom"—his entire face turned red. Oh, heaven! How could he have forgotten about Brother Su?

"Su... Brother Su," he said, his face flushed with shame, his eyes darting around in confusion.

Seeing his adorable expression, Jing Chengsu stopped the steps he had intended to take to leave. He began to unbutton his clothes in a leisurely manner.

Huh? Brother Su was going to bathe with him too? Zhou Pan started to panic.

They were both men, so bathing together wasn't a big deal. After all, he only had one large wooden barrel here. It wasn't like he hadn't bathed with men before; back in Zhou Qi's troop, there was a large communal bath! (Although there was a partition.)

But was Jing Chengsu the same as them? In his eyes, others were no different from white radishes even when naked. But with Jing Chengsu, just unbuttoning his clothes a little to reveal his tanned, sturdy chest made his heart start thumping violently. The blush on his face deepened, turning as red as if it were about to drip blood.

Watching as Jing Chengsu's clothes became fewer and fewer, Zhou Pan shrank his body in embarrassment, gradually pulling himself almost entirely into the water, leaving only his face from the nose up exposed on the surface.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 82: Time for a Bath "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"

chapters.title: 第83章 一起洗白白「求枝枝」
chapters.translated_text:
"Hehe," Jing Chengsu's pleasant laughter echoed within the cramped bathroom.

"Silly, how will you breathe if you sink any further? Sit up a bit." Seeing Zhou Pan about to submerge his entire body in the water, he quickly reached out to pull him up.

His long, powerful hand gripped Zhou Pan's bare arm. As their skin touched, it felt as if an electric current surged through his body. Zhou Pan couldn't help but shiver, bowing his head in embarrassment as he shrank back toward the edge of the tub.

Seeing that Zhou Pan was no longer submerging his face in the water, Jing Chengsu let go and continued to strip off his own clothes.

With the sound of the belt hitting the floor, Zhou Pan didn't dare lift his head. Listening to the rustling of fabric in his ears, his nervous heartbeat grew faster and faster.

After undressing, Jing Chengsu walked toward the large wooden tub.

Click-clack. In the silent, narrow bathroom, the sound of footsteps seemed exceptionally loud.

A splashing sound rang out as one foot stepped into the tub. Zhou Pan moved to the side in a panic. As the other foot followed, Jing Chengsu sat down and submerged himself; the water level in the tub rose by a fraction.

The large wooden tub was big, but not so big that two people couldn't touch while sitting inside. Naturally, their feet bumped into each other.

Zhou Pan was so nervous that his entire body stiffened.

The more nervous he became, the deeper the amusement in Jing Chengsu's eyes grew.

Zhou Pan remained stiff for a long while, but hearing only the splashing sounds of bathing, he couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. The heat on his face faded slightly, and his dazed, embarrassed mind gradually calmed down.

Wait, holy crap! He was a man too, right?! It was just a bath, so why was he acting as nervous as a young maiden?

The more he thought about it, the more his tension dissipated. He stole a glance to the side and saw that Jing Chengsu was submerged up to his armpits. While he felt relieved, a faint sense of disappointment lingered in his heart.

Brother Su was bathing so naturally, so why was he being so timid? Zhou Pan lifted his head, his face still flushed, and feigned indifference as he picked up the soap to scrub his body.

After washing the front of his body bit by bit, it became a bit inconvenient to wash his back while inside the wooden tub.

When applying soap, his body leaned forward involuntarily, revealing his slender, elegant neck and sexy collarbones. He frowned slightly in confusion; if he were alone, it wouldn't matter how awkward his movements were, as he would just do whatever was convenient. But he wasn't alone in the bathroom, and his movements while scrubbing his back became stiff.

"Do you need me to scrub your back?" A dry, low voice sounded in his ear as a warm body pressed against his back. A wave of goosebumps erupted across his sensitive skin.

"Ah, um!" Zhou Pan was flustered and chaotic, his whole body turning as red as a cooked shrimp.

With a splash of water, a wet cloth touched his body, rubbing up and down his back. The pressure was gentle yet firm, and it felt so good he almost groaned aloud, forcing him to bite his lip.

After the wet cloth finished scrubbing the upper part of his back, it gradually moved downward.

"Pfft, that tickles, stop it, Brother Su, I'll do it myself." As the cloth reached his lower back, the ticklish Zhou Pan couldn't stop squirming. He couldn't hold back his laughter anymore—his waist was practically his Achilles' heel! After just a few light scrubs, he felt so ticklish he went limp. Leaning against the tub and turning slightly to the side, he laughed uncontrollably while trying to push Jing Chengsu away.
