“呵呵”狭小的澡间内回荡着荆成夙悦耳的笑声。
“傻瓜，再沉下去可怎么呼吸，快坐起来点。”他见周磐要将自己整个人埋入水中了，赶紧伸手将他往上提拉。
修长有力的大掌握在他裸露的臂膀上，肌肤相触，仿佛有电流窜过他的身体，周磐的身体忍不住激灵的打个颤，他低着头羞赧的缩着身子往桶边靠。
荆成夙见他不在把脸也浸在水里就放开他继续褪去身上的衣裤。
随着皮带掉落地的声音，周磐头也不敢抬，听着耳边沙沙的衣料摩擦声，他紧张的心跳越跳越快。
脱完衣服，荆成夙朝大木桶走去。
咔哒咔哒寂静狭窄的澡间里，脚步声显得格外大声。
“哗啦”声响起，一只脚跨入桶中，周磐无措的往旁边移了移，另一只脚也跟着进入桶中，荆成夙坐下浸入桶中，桶中的水随着他的进入，往上涨了两分。
大木桶很大，但也没大到两个人坐在里面连触碰的时候也没有，很自然的两人脚就碰到了一起。
周磐紧张的整个人都僵住了。
他越紧张，旁边的荆成夙眼里的笑意就越浓。
周磐僵了好一会儿，见耳边只有哗啦哗啦洗澡的声音，心里不由松了口气，脸上的燥热去了一点，窘迫的有点发蒙的脑袋渐渐冷静下来。
等等，卧槽！他也是男的好嘛？！不就是那什么一起洗个澡吗，他干嘛紧张的像个大姑娘似得？
越想心里的紧张就越去掉一分，他偷偷的抬眼往旁边瞄了一眼，见旁边的荆成夙腋下都浸在水里，他不由松了口气的同时，心里隐约带着淡淡的失落。
人家夙哥洗的都那么坦然，他干嘛要虚头虚脑的！周磐抬起头，脸上带着还未褪去的红晕，装作淡然的也拿着肥皂往身上抹。
一点一点将前面的身体清洗完了，要洗后背的时候，在木桶里洗就显得有点不方便了。
抹肥皂的时候，身体不由自主的往前倾，露出他纤细优美的脖颈和性感的锁骨。他无措的微拧着眉，如果只有他自己一个人，动作怎么不雅都没什么，反正自己怎么方便怎么来，可是这澡间里不只他自己一个，抹后背的动作有点僵。
“需要我给你擦背吗？”耳边传来一个干哑低沉的声音，一具温热的身体贴上他的后背，敏感的身体一下子从他背部窜起一阵鸡皮疙瘩。
“啊，嗯！”周磐又慌又乱，全身像烫熟的大虾似得。
哗哗水响，一块湿布抹上他的身体，上下磨擦着他的后背，力道轻缓有力，舒服的他差点呻吟出声，他赶紧咬住嘴唇。
湿布擦完他的上部分后背，渐渐往下。
“噗嗤，好痒，不要了，夙哥，我自己来。”布擦到后腰处，怕痒的周磐不停扭动，再也憋不住笑出声，腰部简直是他的死穴啊！只不过轻轻抹擦了几下，他就痒的整个人发软，他靠着木桶，半侧着身，笑的花枝乱颤的想要推拒荆成夙。

chapters.title: 第84章 豆腐大餐「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 84: Tofu Feast "Seeking recommendations, seeking collections"
chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu were already standing very close; as he turned to the side, he bumped directly into Jing Chengsu. Their skin made contact, and the temperature radiating from him was scorching hot.

He shuddered. Could it be? Was he running a fever? He couldn't help but look up. "Brother Su, you..."

Before he could finish his sentence, he found himself lost in a pair of deep, burning eyes...

This bath lasted a long time, until the hot water turned cold. Zhou Pan, his body limp and soft, was carried out horizontally by Jing Chengsu. With the flush still not faded from his face, he buried his head in Jing Chengsu's chest, too embarrassed to look up.

A smile played on Jing Chengsu's face. Although the two of them had allowed him to feast on a "tofu banquet," if it hadn't been for the later realization regarding Zhou Pan...

There were also rooms prepared for resting in the space. In addition to the antique arhat bed, there was a three-meter-wide bed that Zhou Pan had asked Zhou Dafa to build for him; he had brought it along when he left Zhou Village.

Zhou Pan had placed it in a room facing the sun. The room was very bright and kept spotlessly clean by him. He had furnished it with the bed, a wardrobe, a bookshelf, a desk, and two rattan chairs. The decor was very simple; he didn't know much about interior design, so he just hung two landscape paintings on the walls to keep them from looking bare and jarring.

There were other beautifully furnished rooms here, but they were too big and too quiet. The silence made him feel uneasy, and he didn't dare sleep in them. No wonder those young masters and misses in ancient times needed maids and servants to keep watch at night—they were probably terrified too.

Jing Chengsu placed him on the large bed and tucked him in.

Zhou Pan was already exhausted. He had been tired enough from the day outside, and the subsequent tossing and turning inside had drained every last bit of his strength. He barely managed to keep his eyelids open to glance at Jing Chengsu before drifting into a deep sleep in the soft bedding.

Seeing him sleeping comfortably and thinking that since they had just returned to the base, no one would likely come looking for him today, Jing Chengsu decided they could get some good rest. He couldn't help but take off his clothes, climb into bed, and hold him as he drifted off to sleep as well.

"Huh? Isn't that the medical genius Qin Xin?" Zhou Ya had just returned from a mission with her ability squad when she spotted a familiar figure waiting in the queue.

She saw Qin Xin leaning intimately against a burly man, whispering something. Her eyes narrowed. This wasn't right. In her past life, the Qin Xin she knew was a cold, heartless person who kept everyone at a distance. How could she be so close to someone, unless that man was her lover who had unfortunately perished in a pile of zombies?

But wasn't this man supposed to have died in her past life? How could he be here? Things in this life seemed to constantly deviate from the memories of her past life, causing a sense of irritation to rise in Zhou Ya, who had wanted to rely on those memories to gain an advantage.

"Did you hear? Captain Jing, who was said to have perished in Kang City a couple of days ago, actually came back just now?"

"Yeah, aren't those people over there the ones brought back by Captain Jing? There are tens of thousands of them! With so many extra mouths to feed, I wonder if the base has enough rations."

"Wasn't their mission this time to retrieve grain from Kang City? Since they returned safely, it's impossible they came back empty-handed, right?"

"I heard there are many high-level zombies in Kang City. It's a miracle they made it back alive, let alone retrieving grain..."

Kang City? Zhou Ya's face turned pale. She hadn't forgotten that the F City base was destroyed by a zombie horde coming from Kang City. Could it be that she would have to experience it all over again in this life? Thinking back to the time spent fleeing in her past life, a feeling of trepidation washed over her...
chapters.source_text:
周磐和荆成夙两人本来就贴的很近，他一侧过身直接撞到荆成夙身上，肌肤相碰，传来的温度极为火烫。
他一个激灵，这么，难道发烧了？他忍不住抬起头，“夙哥，你……”
话还没说完，就陷入一双深邃火热的眼睛中……
这个澡洗了许久，洗的热水都变凉了，周磐整个人酥软的被荆成夙横抱出来，脸上还带着没散去，他羞红着脸埋在荆成夙的胸膛上，不好意思抬头。
荆成夙脸上带着笑，两人虽然还是让他饱餐了一顿豆腐大餐，要不是后来想起周磐
空间里也有准备有休息的房间，除了古色古香的罗汉床，还有周磐让周大发帮他打的三米大床，离开周家村时，他也顺势带上了它。
周磐将它安放在一处朝阳的房间里，这房间十分亮堂，被他收拾的干干净净，他在房间里摆了床，衣柜，书架，书桌和两把藤椅，摆设的很简单，他也不懂装饰什么的只是在墙上挂了两幅山水画，免得墙壁光秃秃的扎眼睛。
这里倒是有摆设好的漂亮房间，可太大太安静了，静的他心里毛毛的不敢睡，难怪那些古代少爷小姐睡觉都要丫鬟下人守夜什么的怕是心里也悚得慌。
荆成夙将他放在大床上，为他盖好被子。
周磐早就累坏了，原本今天在外面就够累，进了里面又是一番折腾，把身上的气力都掏了个精光，他勉强撑着眼皮看了眼荆成夙，就在揉软的被窝里沉沉睡去。
荆成夙看他睡的舒服，想着刚回基地，今天应该不会有人来找他，可以好好休息，于是也忍不住脱衣服爬上床，抱着他跟着进入梦乡。
“咦？那不是那个医学天才秦昕吗？”周雅刚跟着异能小队出任务回来，就看到在一旁等待排队的眼熟身影。
只见秦昕和一个五大三粗的汉子正亲密的靠在一起不知在说些什么，她眼一眯，不对啊，上辈子见到的秦昕明明是个冷漠无情，拒人与千里之外的心死之人，怎么可能跟人这么接近，除非那个男人就是他那个不幸丧生丧尸堆的爱人？
可是上辈子这个男人不是应该已经死了吗？怎么会在这？这辈子的事情似乎总是脱离上辈子的记忆，让周雅想要仗着上辈子记忆做些什么的人，心里升起一股烦躁的感觉。
“听说前两天那个据说丧生亢城的荆队长没死，刚才又回来了呢？”
“是啊，那边那些人不是也是荆队长带回来的，好几万人呢！这下子多了这么多张口，也不知基地口粮够不够用。”
“他们这次任务不就是去亢城取粮的？既然平安回来，总不可能空手而归吧？”
“听说亢城好多高级丧尸，能活着回来就不错了，还想取粮？”……
亢城？周雅面色苍白了些，她可没忘F市基地就是毁在亢城出来的丧尸潮手中，难道这辈子还会经历一次？想到上辈子逃亡的那段时间，彷徨的情绪袭上心头……

chapters.title: 第85章 古代兵器谱「求枝枝」
chapters.translated_text:
Zhou Pan didn't know how long he had slept, but when he woke up, his depleted mental energy had been fully restored. Sleep was naturally the best way to recover one's spirit. His mental energy was his divine sense, and this sleep had not only filled it up but even increased it slightly.

He was the only one left in the room. He didn't know where Brother Su had gone, and without his guidance, he couldn't leave the space.

Zhou Pan sat up, stretched, and took off his pajamas to change into other clothes. When he looked down, his gaze accidentally swept over his chest, and he discovered it was covered in many blue and red marks, which looked particularly striking against his fair skin.

What was this? He suddenly remembered how these marks were made, and his face was immediately covered in a blush.

He coughed awkwardly twice and hurriedly put on his clothes. He remembered his ears and neck had also been nibbled on for a long time; wouldn't there be marks there too? If someone else saw them...

He opened the wardrobe, rummaged through it, and pulled out a turtleneck sweater to put on. The high collar covered his neck completely, and only then did he breathe a sigh of relief. No one would discover them now, right?

After putting on a coat over it, he opened the door and walked out. He didn't see Jing Chengsu anywhere and didn't know where he had gone. He searched room by room until he finally found him in a room filled with zithers, chess sets, calligraphy, paintings, antiques, and ancient books. These things had been left behind by his cheap master, presumably for his disciple to cultivate his character, but for Zhou Pan, who was both a poor student and lacked any sense of elegance, he had only glanced into the room from the outside back then and couldn't even be bothered to step inside.

He hadn't expected Jing Chengsu to be interested in these. His tall, upright figure standing in this room filled with the scent of books didn't feel out of place at all. Given his family background, he must have been influenced by such things in the past.

Zhou Pan suddenly felt a lot of pressure. Jing Chengsu was much more excellent than him in every way, making him seem ignorant and incompetent. He felt like he wasn't worthy of him at all! He couldn't help but feel inferior in his heart.

"What's wrong? Why are you standing there? Come in." Jing Chengsu looked up, saw Zhou Pan dazed at the door, and called out to him.

"Ah? Oh!" Zhou Pan walked into the room and saw quite a few books placed beside Jing Chengsu. He couldn't help but lean over to take a look.

"Huh? What are these?" He saw titles like "Spring and Autumn Weapon Catalog," "Great Qin Weapon Manual," and so on. They didn't seem to be the elegant poetry or ancient classics he had imagined.

"These are diagrams and manufacturing methods for some ancient weapons. Many have long been lost in the river of history; I didn't expect to see them here." Jing Chengsu was also a martial artist and had always been interested in cold weapons. Seeing so many weapon manuals laid out before him, he couldn't help but feel a bit excited.

Zhou Pan picked up a manual and opened it to find diagrams of many unique and powerful weapons. He also used cold weapons himself, and his eyes lit up when he saw these designs.

"While these weapons might not be more powerful than modern ones, their design alone has a lot of research value. Many of these weapons were actually designed quite well, but it's a pity that ancient smelting technology wasn't up to par, and those who mastered the techniques were unwilling to pass them on to others, guarding their secrets jealously. In the end, many things were lost without anyone knowing." Looking at these manuals, Jing Chengsu was in high spirits and couldn't help but say a lot.

"Then are they useful to us now?" Zhou Pan asked curiously.

"How could they not be? Although our current smelting technology is very advanced, we lack creativity when it comes to cold weapons. These can be given to weapon experts to study; perhaps they can design even more powerful and convenient weapons. That way, ordinary people outside will also have the ability to protect themselves." Jing Chengsu, in high spirits, picked out several less conspicuous manuals that had historical records, intending to show them to the experts in the military.

The two stayed in this room for a while longer before going to the kitchen to eat the food that had already been prepared, and then they flashed out of the space.
chapters.source_text:
周磐也不知睡了多久，当他清醒的时候，被耗去的精神力都补了回来。睡眠本来就是最好的恢复精神的方法。他的精神力就是神识，这一觉可把他的神识给补满了，甚至还增长了几分。
房间里就剩他一个人，不知夙哥去哪了，没有他的带领，他可出不了空间。
周磐坐起身，伸伸懒腰，脱下身上的睡衣，想要换上其他衣服，低头时眼光不小心扫到胸前，却发现上面落满了许多青青红红的印记，在他白晰的肌肤上显得格外显眼。
这是？他猛的想起这些印记是怎么弄成的脸上立刻爬满了红晕。
他尴尬的轻咳了两声，赶紧将衣服穿上。他记得他的耳朵脖子也被啃咬了好久，不会也有这些印记吧？要是被别人看到了……
他打开衣柜，翻找了一番，掏出一件高领的毛衣套上，高高的领子将脖子全盖住了，他才松了口气，这下该没人发现了吧？
在外面又套了一件大衣，他打开房间门走出去。四下没看到荆成夙，也不知他去哪了。他顺着房间一间间找过去，终于在一处摆了许多琴棋书画，古玩古籍的房间找到。这些东西都是他便宜师傅留下的，想必是留给他这个徒弟陶冶情操的，可惜对于既是学渣又没有高雅之心的周磐来说，他当初不过在房间外头扫了一眼，连门都懒的进呢。
没想到荆成夙的对这些倒是感兴趣高大挺拔的身躯处在这充满书香气的房间中，完全不突兀。以他的家世，肯定以前也受过这方面的熏陶。
周磐顿时感觉压力好大，荆成夙处处比他优秀很多，他就显得不学无术了，自己好像完全配不上他啊！他的内心不由的感到自卑。
“怎么了？站在那里干什么？快进来。”荆成夙抬头看见周磐愣在门口，不知发什么呆，就开口招呼他。
“啊？哦！”周磐走进房间，看见荆成夙身旁摆了不少书，他不由的探头一看。
“咦？这是什么？”他看见上面写着《春秋兵器图录》《大秦兵器谱》等等，好像不是他想象的高雅诗文古籍之类的东西。
“这些都是古代的一些兵器图形和制造方法，很多早就流失在历史长河之中，没想到在这里能看到这些。”荆成夙也是练武之人，对这些冷兵器向来都很感兴趣，看到这么多的武器图谱摆在眼前，忍不住有点兴奋。
周磐拿起一本图谱打开看了看上面有许多造型独特威力不凡的武器图形。他自己也是使用的冷兵器，一看这些图形，眼睛也忍不住一亮。
“这些武器虽然不说威力比现在的武器强大，但光设计这方面就有许多研究价值。很多武器设计的其实很不错，只可惜古代冶炼技术不过关，掌握技术的人，又不愿把技术传给旁人，敝帚自珍，到头来很多东西不知不觉就失传了。”看着这些图谱荆成夙情绪有点高昂，忍不住说了许多。
“那它们现在对我们有用吗？”周磐有点好奇。
“怎么没有用，虽然我们现在的冶炼技术很高，但是冷兵器这方面就少了很多创意。这些可以拿给武器专家研究研究，说不定能设计出更强大更方便的武器。这样外面的普通人，也能有能力自保。”荆成夙兴致很高的取了好几本不太显眼，历史有记载的图录，准备拿给部队里这方面的专家看看。
两人在这处房间待了好一会儿，才去厨房吃了些早已备好的饭菜，而后闪出空间。

荆成夙和周磐闪出空间的时候，才发现两人在空间待了一天，从空间出来的时候，已经是第二天早上。荆成夙拿着几本图录匆匆离开房间，周磐将异能、功法都修炼了一遍，才跟着下楼。
好久没看到周五了，原本当初还约定经常一起玩的，结果到现在连面都没见上，也不知他有没有埋怨他。
周五他们也住在部队里，周爷爷改良了异能修炼方法，效果不错，在这里颇受尊敬，日子过得挺滋润的。
周磐找到周五的时候，他和基地普通人一起，跟着部队里的战士一起学习拳脚功夫。
虽然现在人分为了三类人，但是不代表普通人就没有机会拥有异能了，只要豁的出去，危机时刻还是有机会觉醒异能的，当然这机会不是百分百，有点渺茫。
但是不管有没有机会觉醒异能，强身健体多学点东西自保，是没错的。基地高层也不希望基地内的普通人都是一群混吃等死的胆小鬼，只要有人乐意学习拳脚什么的，都免费教授。
周五和他爷爷虽然会点修真功法，但学习的法门还是比较粗浅的，发出来的法术也不比人家一级异能者强大多少，加上虽然修了真，手脚灵活迅捷了点，但是体质却很弱鸡的，要是不用功法的话，随便有点拳脚功夫的人都可能将他们击倒。
为了强身健体，增强体质，一有空余时间，周五也跟着多学点功夫。
“小五。”周磐向在人堆里的小孩招手。
周五侧头瞥了他一眼，又转头不再理睬他。
呦呵，这是生气了？
周磐无奈的在一旁等着人练完一趟拳脚，周五低着头走出人群，捡起放在一边地上的包，背在身上，朝自己宿舍走去。
“对不起啊，小五，哥哥不是故意食言的，这几天哥哥接了不少任务，昨天刚忙完的。”周磐赶紧跟上腆着脸说道。
“哼，都是借口，说话不算话。”周五冷哼一声，赌气踩着重重的脚步朝前走。
“不是，那个，你听我说……”周磐心虚的连忙跟上去解释讨好，打躬作揖了半天，终于让他气消了。
咔嚓咔嚓，周五咬着周磐供上的大红苹果，好久没吃过水果了，几口脆甜的果肉汁水下肚，他脸色才好看了点。
“你今天怎么有空过来？”他也不不是不通情理的人，倘若周磐真的没时间，他也不会强要人家找他玩。只是约好的事没做到，看到当事人心里自然不爽。
“我昨天刚刚做完任务，今天休息一下，对了你们爷俩在这里待的这么样？需要帮忙的吗？”周磐问道。
周五停下咬苹果的动作，要说过的怎么样，其实在基地里挺好的，就是他们实力太低了。他们修炼的功法晋级速度又很慢，又不能像异能者他们一样吸收晶核，让他们一直在底层徘徊。
“那个你能帮我们兑换一下部队里的那些净化晶核吗？”普通的晶核他们吸收了没用，但是部队里流出的经过净化的晶核，对他们却有用，可以当做灵石吸收，他记得周磐当初填了净化异能来着，这净化的晶核应该跟他有关吧？
他们其实可以自己去部队兑换，但是兑换的人实在太多了，又有数量限制，到现在也只兑换了几枚晶核，根本不够修炼啊。
净化晶核？“好啊，要兑换多少？”
他自己就有不少净化过的晶核没用，反正放着也是放着，兑换了他也不吃亏。
听他愿意兑换，周五心情好了起来，太好了这样他和他爷爷终于可以晋级了，一直在底层徘徊，面对一个个强者总是让人不安的。
有了这层媒介，两人关系又和好了许多，很快又称兄道弟融洽起来。
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 86: Catching Up with an Old Friend "Seeking Branches"
chapters.title: 第86章 找人叙旧「求枝枝」
chapters.translated_text:
When Jing Chengsu and Zhou Pan flashed out of the space, they realized they had spent an entire day inside; it was already the next morning when they emerged. Jing Chengsu left the room in a hurry, clutching a few illustrated manuals, while Zhou Pan practiced his abilities and cultivation techniques once through before heading downstairs.

He hadn't seen Zhou Wu in a long time. They had originally promised to hang out often, but they hadn't even met up once since then, and he wondered if the boy held a grudge against him.

Zhou Wu and his grandfather also lived within the military base. Grandpa Zhou had improved the ability cultivation methods, which yielded good results, earning them quite a bit of respect and a comfortable life here.

When Zhou Pan found Zhou Wu, the boy was with other ordinary people in the base, learning martial arts alongside the soldiers.

Although people were now divided into three categories, it didn't mean ordinary people had no chance of possessing abilities. As long as one was willing to take the risk, there was still a chance to awaken an ability during a crisis—though, of course, the odds weren't one hundred percent; they were quite slim.

Regardless of whether they could awaken an ability, there was no harm in strengthening one's body and learning self-defense. The base's high-ranking officials didn't want the ordinary people to be a bunch of cowardly layabouts, so they offered free instruction to anyone willing to learn martial arts.

Although Zhou Wu and his grandfather knew some cultivation techniques, the methods they learned were quite rudimentary. The spells they cast weren't much more powerful than those of a first-level ability user. Furthermore, while their cultivation made them slightly more agile, their physical constitution remained weak; without using their techniques, anyone with a bit of martial arts training could easily knock them down.

To strengthen their bodies and improve their physical condition, Zhou Wu took every spare moment to learn more martial arts.

"Xiao Wu!" Zhou Pan waved at the child in the crowd.

Zhou Wu glanced at him sideways, then turned his head away, ignoring him.

Oh ho, so he’s angry?

Zhou Pan waited helplessly on the sidelines for the boy to finish his practice. Zhou Wu walked out of the crowd with his head down, picked up the bag he had left on the ground, slung it over his shoulder, and headed toward his dormitory.

"I'm sorry, Xiao Wu. Brother didn't mean to break his promise. I've been taking on quite a few missions these past few days and only just finished yesterday," Zhou Pan said, quickly catching up and putting on a fawning expression.

"Hmph, those are all excuses. You didn't keep your word," Zhou Wu snorted, stomping his feet heavily as he walked forward in a huff.

"No, wait, listen to me..." Feeling guilty, Zhou Pan hurriedly followed to explain and appease him. After bowing and scraping for a long time, he finally managed to calm the boy down.

*Crunch, crunch.* Zhou Wu bit into the large red apple Zhou Pan had offered as a peace offering. He hadn't eaten fruit in a long time, and after a few mouthfuls of crisp, sweet juice, his expression softened.

"How come you have time to come over today?" He wasn't an unreasonable person; if Zhou Pan truly didn't have the time, he wouldn't force him to hang out. It was just that when a promise wasn't kept, it was natural to feel unhappy upon seeing the person responsible.

"I just finished a mission yesterday and am taking a break today. By the way, how are you and your grandfather doing here? Do you need any help?" Zhou Pan asked.

Zhou Wu stopped mid-bite. Truth be told, life in the base was actually quite good, but their strength was too low. The cultivation techniques they practiced had a very slow advancement rate, and they couldn't absorb energy crystals like ability users, which left them lingering at the bottom.

"Can you help us exchange for some of those purified crystals from the military?" They couldn't use ordinary crystals, but the purified ones that circulated in the military were useful to them—they could be absorbed like spirit stones. He remembered that Zhou Pan had registered as having a purification ability; these purified crystals must have something to do with him, right?

They could actually go to the military to exchange for them themselves, but there were too many people and strict quantity limits. So far, they had only managed to exchange for a few crystals, which wasn't nearly enough for their cultivation.

Purified crystals? "Sure, how many do you need?"

He had plenty of purified crystals that he wasn't using anyway; they were just sitting there, so he wouldn't be losing anything by trading them.

Hearing that he was willing to trade, Zhou Wu’s mood improved. This was great—he and his grandfather could finally advance. Lingering at the bottom and facing one powerhouse after another was always unsettling.

With this bridge between them, their relationship mended, and soon they were back to being friendly, brotherly, and harmonious.

chapters.title: 第87章 周五爷孙「求推荐，求收藏」
chapters.source_text:
“爷爷，你看这是什么？”周五蹦跳的跑进自己的宿舍。
“嗤”一缕青烟飘起，桌上一张黄色符纸自动烧成灰烬，周五爷爷满脸遗憾，“哎，可惜，差了一点就成功画完这张符了。”
“啊，对不起。”周五见自己似乎闯祸了，赶紧老实的在那边站着。
“没事，是你爷爷我自己心不静，要不然也不会稍微受点影响就失手了。”周五爷爷无奈的捋捋自己的胡子，将手中的符笔放下。
他们学习的的修真功法是老祖宗不知哪里捡的残本，不但粗浅，而且杂乱，跟茅山道术和五雷战法有点关系，会一点画符，炼阵，算命八卦的……都不精通，以前都是躲在深山老林里，那里的灵气比较足，但是自从末世到来，不但人有了变化，连动植物也同样进化，他们这么点法术哪里在深山老林呆的下去，不得不混到人群里来。
时代不同，他们以前仗着点法术在普通人面前还能称称高人，但是现在满地的强者，他们这点能力真不够看，除了顶着道法传承者的名头，画点符箓换晶核，其他就只有跟随部队一起出任务，赚取贡献点积分。
可惜他身上的灵气只有练气初期，相当于异能一级，画符的天赋也不怎么好，老是画坏，十张符箓最多一张画成功的。画符很耗灵气，每画完一张符的时候，要把身上的灵气封到符箓里，这样只要使用的时候，把符箓往攻击目标一扔，就能发挥作用。
周五爷爷一天最多只能画十张完好的符箓，他画出的符箓顶多能挡初级一级的丧尸，但是因为买去的符箓即使是普通人也可以使用，在基地里卖的很畅销，要不是他能力不及，画不出更多的符箓出来，他和周五的日子会更好过。
“你这是去哪了，这么晚才回来？”平常不是跟着晨练完就回来了吗？
“当当当，爷爷，你看这是什么？”听他问起，周五想起手中的东西，立马高兴的将它提到桌子上，打开一看，一大包晶莹剔透的晶核露出来，在白天的光线下散着光泽。
“这么多净化晶核？哪来的？”在基地里兑换一次，也不过一人兑换十颗左右，这里的起码有好几百颗。
“这是小磐哥给我兑换的，他就是净化晶核的人，手里有不少空余的晶核呢。”周五高兴的拿起一颗净化晶核感受了一下，里面果然有不少灵气，这下这么多晶核足够他们爷俩晋级的了。
“原来是他，这事你可别到处嚷嚷，要不然人人都找你小磐哥兑换就惨了。”周磐当初登记的时候，他们当时也在，只是那时注意力都集中到他的空间异能去了，净化异能倒是没怎么注意。
“知道了，爷爷你快试试，这么多晶核，今个儿肯定可以晋级了。”他又不是大嘴巴，哪会到处去说这种事，不过周五也不跟自己爷爷辩论，只催促他赶紧修炼。
爷爷实力太低了，每次跟别人出任务，他都提心吊胆的，现在好了，不但实力可以晋级，灵力多了，也可以多画些符箓防身，他也不用那么担心了。
“好好好，我这就去修炼行了吧，这些晶核给你，你也去晋级吧。”孙儿的资质比他好多了，要不是灵气不足，哪会在这个阶层一直待着？
周五爷爷将晶核分出一些给周五，就提着袋中的晶核赶紧去修炼了。
周五见爷爷沉浸在修炼中了，自己也拿着晶核去一旁晋级。
chapters.translated_text:
"Grandpa, look what this is!" Zhou Wu hopped and skipped into their dormitory.

"Sss," a wisp of blue smoke rose. A yellow talisman on the table spontaneously burned into ash. Zhou Wu's grandfather looked full of regret. "Sigh, what a pity. It was just a hair's breadth away from being completed."

"Ah, I'm sorry." Seeing that he had seemingly caused trouble, Zhou Wu quickly stood there honestly.

"It's alright. It was your grandfather's own heart that wasn't calm; otherwise, I wouldn't have failed just because of a slight disturbance." Zhou Wu's grandfather helplessly stroked his beard and set down the talisman brush in his hand.

The cultivation technique they practiced was an incomplete manual their ancestors had picked up from somewhere. It was not only shallow but also messy, having some connection to Maoshan Taoist arts and the Five Thunder Battle Techniques. They knew a little bit of talisman drawing, array refining, and fortune-telling, but were not proficient in any of them. In the past, they hid in deep mountains and old forests where spiritual energy was more abundant. However, ever since the apocalypse arrived, not only had people changed, but animals and plants had also evolved. With their meager spells, they couldn't survive in the deep mountains anymore and were forced to blend in with the crowds.

Times had changed. In the past, they could rely on their minor spells to pass as experts in front of ordinary people, but now, with powerhouses everywhere, their abilities were truly nothing to look at. Aside from holding the title of Taoist successors and drawing some talismans to trade for crystal cores, they had no choice but to join military missions to earn contribution points.

Unfortunately, his spiritual energy was only at the early stage of Qi Refining, equivalent to a Level 1 ability user, and his talent for drawing talismans wasn't very good either. He often ruined them; at most, one out of ten talismans would be successful. Drawing talismans consumed a lot of spiritual energy. Once a talisman was finished, the spiritual energy had to be sealed inside. That way, when using it, one only needed to throw the talisman at the target to unleash its effect.

Zhou Wu's grandfather could draw at most ten perfect talismans a day. The talismans he produced could at most block a Level 1 zombie, but because even ordinary people could use the talismans he sold, they were very popular in the base. If it weren't for his limited ability to draw more, life for him and Zhou Wu would be much better.

"Where did you go? Why are you back so late?" Didn't you usually come back right after morning exercises?

"Ta-da! Grandpa, look what this is!" Hearing his question, Zhou Wu remembered the item in his hand and happily lifted it onto the table. When he opened it, a large bag of crystal-clear crystal cores was revealed, shimmering in the daylight.

"So many purified crystal cores? Where did you get these?" One could only exchange for about ten at a time in the base; there were at least several hundred here.

"Brother Xiao Pan exchanged them for me. He is the one who purifies the crystal cores, and he has quite a few spares on hand." Zhou Wu happily picked up a purified crystal core and felt it; there was indeed plenty of spiritual energy inside. Now, these cores were enough for both him and his grandfather to level up.

"So it was him. Don't go around blabbing about this, or it will be a disaster if everyone starts looking for Brother Xiao Pan to exchange cores." When Zhou Pan registered, they were there, but their attention had been focused on his space ability, so they hadn't paid much attention to the purification ability.

"I know, Grandpa. Hurry up and try them. With so many cores, we can definitely level up today." He wasn't a blabbermouth, so why would he go around talking about such things? However, Zhou Wu didn't argue with his grandfather and just urged him to cultivate quickly.

His grandfather's strength was too low, and every time he went on a mission with others, he felt anxious. Now it was better; not only could they level up, but with more spiritual power, he could draw more talismans for self-defense, and he wouldn't have to worry so much.

"Alright, alright, alright. I'll go cultivate now, okay? Here, take these cores and go level up yourself." His grandson's aptitude was much better than his; if it weren't for the lack of spiritual energy, he wouldn't have been stuck at this level for so long.

Zhou Wu's grandfather divided some of the cores for Zhou Wu and then took the bag of cores to go cultivate immediately.

Seeing that his grandfather was immersed in cultivation, Zhou Wu also took his cores to the side to level up.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 87: Grandfather and Grandson Zhou Wu [Seeking recommendations, seeking collections]

chapters.source_text:
杨大龙带领着忠于他的一帮弟兄，组成一个异能队，在A区租了一栋别墅。A区的住宅每个月要几千上万的积分贡献点，还好上次被曹邙等人引来的那帮丧尸，被他们在荆成夙的帮忙下解决了，分了不少二级三级的晶核，加上他们有好几个异能者，以及秦昕这个被基地特聘的医学天才，打折优惠了很多，他只用五枚三级晶核就兑换了足够租那栋别墅一年的积分。
跟着向导走在去别墅的路上，看着过往的人群，这里的人很多，但并不显得杂乱。
大街上有很多普通人，F市基地里只要不是懒到家的人，一般想要活下去的人，都能在这里寻找到生活目标。
F市基地并不歧视普通人，甚至有条约规定异能者不可以无缘无故对普通人动手，否则将有严重的惩罚。
这里看不到在其他基地里看到的对生活的麻木不仁，也看不到普通人面对异能强者，卑躬屈膝的样子。
杨大龙等人心里感慨的一路走到所租的别墅，对于基地新的生活多了更多的憧憬。有了安稳的住处，杨大龙等人都情绪高涨，热火朝天的收拾别墅内外。
荆成夙带着两个队员走在大街上，他听说秦昕安顿在别墅区，正想去看看，顺便传达基地高层对他的任职安排。
咦，那个不是？荆成夙走过一个路口时，看到一个眼熟的身影正殷勤的讨好一个邋遢不修边幅的看不出长相的男子，他眼一眯，对跟着他的两个队员耳语了一番，两人点头离开，他才最后扫了一眼那边，继续向目的地前进。
他到达秦昕他们所在的别墅的时候，他们已经将别墅里外收拾妥当，荆成夙打量一下，就对秦昕传达了他的任职命令。
“没问题，我明天就去报道。”虽然上面宽容他休息两天，但秦昕还是决定早点去任职，好将抗毒血清研制出来。他已经做了一半的实验，再加上基地内更优异的设备条件，肯定很快就能将结果弄出来。
“有什么问题尽管去军队找我，我能帮的上忙的绝不推辞。”荆成夙对秦昕杨大龙两个观感挺好的，基地里虽然有军队的势力压制，没出什么大状况，但各个异能小队之间，竞争也是很激烈的，时有摩擦，杨大龙这支新来的外来势力，肯定会受到各方的排斥，倘若有军队做靠山会好过很多。
“好，谢谢，荆队长。”知道他的好意，杨大龙他们也不是不知好歹的，连忙道谢。
见没什么事，荆成夙就告别他们，走出别墅。
“大哥，跟我们来的那些人，想加入我们小队。”杨小飞拉着脸向杨大龙报告。那些人可都是白眼狼，需要老大的时候就好言好语，让老大感动的一心照顾他们。一到危机关头，就把责任都推到老大身上。现在老大为他们找了个好基地，只要他们肯费力，日子也不会难过。他们又眼巴巴的想要巴上来，还想要老大想照顾爹娘老子似得照顾他们？没门！
杨大龙和秦昕对视一眼，他看到秦昕满眼的不赞同，他深吸口气，对于那些人，早在曹邙引来丧尸攻击的那个晚上，好感全失，他又不是圣父，哪能别人扇了你一巴掌，还不在意的将另一边脸送上去。如今已经摆脱了那些人，他哪会再接手过来。
他摇头拒绝。
杨小飞乐的眉开眼笑，老大就是太好心了，老是被他们拿捏，现在醒悟也不晚。那些人有他在，别想再混到他们队伍。
秦昕也很高兴，转头拉着杨大龙讨论对于基地的一些看法，打消了他心里的惆怅。
chapters.title: 第88章 基地安顿「求枝枝」
chapters.translated_text:
Yang Dalong led a group of brothers loyal to him to form an ability-user team, renting a villa in District A. Residential units in District A cost thousands to tens of thousands of contribution points per month. Fortunately, the group of zombies previously lured by Cao Mang and his cohorts had been dealt with by them with Jing Chengsu's help. They had split a significant number of level-two and level-three crystals. Coupled with the fact that they had several ability users and Qin Xin, a medical genius specially hired by the base, they received a hefty discount. He only needed five level-three crystals to exchange for enough points to rent that villa for a year.

Walking along the road to the villa with a guide, they looked at the passing crowds; there were many people here, but it didn't feel chaotic.

There were many ordinary people on the main streets. In the F City Base, as long as one wasn't terminally lazy, anyone who wanted to survive could find a purpose in life here.

The F City Base did not discriminate against ordinary people; there were even regulations stating that ability users could not attack ordinary people without cause, or they would face severe punishment.

One could not see the numbness toward life found in other bases, nor the sight of ordinary people cowering before powerful ability users.

Yang Dalong and the others walked to the rented villa with deep emotions, filled with more anticipation for their new life in the base. Having a stable place to live, everyone was in high spirits, busily cleaning the inside and outside of the villa.

Jing Chengsu was walking down the street with two team members. He had heard that Qin Xin had settled into the villa area and was planning to go see him, while also conveying the base leadership's appointment arrangements for him.

"Huh, isn't that...?" As Jing Chengsu passed an intersection, he saw a familiar figure fawning over a disheveled, unkempt man whose face was indistinguishable. He narrowed his eyes and whispered to the two team members following him. The two nodded and left. Only then did he glance at that side one last time before continuing toward his destination.

By the time he reached the villa where Qin Xin and the others were staying, they had already finished cleaning the place. Jing Chengsu took a look around and then conveyed his appointment orders to Qin Xin.

"No problem, I'll report for duty tomorrow." Although the higher-ups had graciously allowed him two days of rest, Qin Xin decided to start his position earlier so he could develop the anti-toxin serum. He had already completed half of the experiments, and with the superior equipment available in the base, he was sure he could produce results quickly.

"If you have any problems, feel free to come find me in the military. I won't refuse if there's anything I can help with." Jing Chengsu had a good impression of both Qin Xin and Yang Dalong. Although the military's influence in the base kept things under control and prevented major incidents, the competition between various ability-user teams was intense, and friction occurred from time to time. As a newly arrived external force, Yang Dalong's team would certainly be ostracized by various parties; having the military as a backer would make things much easier.

"Alright, thank you, Captain Jing." Knowing his good intentions, Yang Dalong and the others were not ungrateful and quickly thanked him.

Seeing that there was nothing else, Jing Chengsu bid them farewell and walked out of the villa.

"Big Brother, those people who came with us want to join our team." Yang Xiaofei reported to Yang Dalong with a grimace. Those people were ingrates; they were all sweet talk when they needed the boss, making the boss feel moved enough to take care of them wholeheartedly. But the moment a crisis hit, they pushed all the responsibility onto the boss. Now that the boss had found them a good base, they wouldn't have a hard life as long as they were willing to put in the effort. And now they were begging to latch on again, wanting the boss to take care of them like he was their father or mother? No way!

Yang Dalong and Qin Xin exchanged a look. He saw the disapproval in Qin Xin's eyes. He took a deep breath; as for those people, he had lost all goodwill toward them back on the night Cao Mang lured the zombies to attack. He wasn't a saint; how could he let someone slap him and then offer the other cheek without a care? Now that they had finally shaken those people off, there was no way he would take them back.

He shook his head in refusal.

Yang Xiaofei was beaming with joy. The boss was just too kind and had always been manipulated by them; it wasn't too late to wake up now. With him around, those people wouldn't be able to sneak into their team again.

Qin Xin was also very happy. He turned to pull Yang Dalong into a discussion about his views on the base, dispelling the melancholy in his heart.

chapters.translated_text:
Not long after Jing Chengsu left District A, he ran into Qiangzi, who was signaling to him from a street corner.

He walked toward Qiangzi, "How did it go?"

"That man's name is Wang Su. He lives in District C and is an ordinary person. He has a frail younger sister who is often ill, and she lives with him." Qiangzi recounted the information he had gathered.

An ordinary person? Jing Chengsu’s eyes darkened. Would an ordinary person be worth someone like Zhou Ya lowering herself to curry favor? Don't tell him Zhou Ya likes that man; what a joke. Zhou Ya is clearly an ambitious woman. To pass over all the powerful people and set her sights on a down-and-out ordinary man—there must be something fishy going on.

"Let's go, let's take a look." Jing Chengsu crossed the street and headed toward District C.

The environment in District C was truly poor, and with so many people, it seemed exceptionally noisy.

Jing Chengsu followed Qiangzi up a building where many people lived on every floor. There was only one restroom per floor, and the sanitation was inadequate; a foul smell of urine constantly wafted through the air as they climbed up.

The two men frowned, holding their breath as they walked up to the third floor, moved along the passageway to the end of the corridor, and stopped in front of a small room.

"Knock, knock, knock." Qiangzi stepped forward and knocked on the door.

"Who is it?" A hoarse male voice came from inside.

"Hello, is this Mr. Wang Su? We are from the military department, and we have some matters to discuss with Mr. Wang." Qiangzi looked back at his boss and said gently.

"The military department? What would the military want with a nobody like me?" The door opened from the inside, and a disheveled, unkempt man poked his head out. He looked at the two men with suspicion, stared at their military uniforms for a moment, and only after confirming they had no malicious intent did he open the door and invite them in.

Jing Chengsu and his companion walked into the room. It was a tiny space of only five or six square meters, containing nothing but a wooden bed made of planks and some scattered odds and ends. On the bed lay a pale, bloodless girl of about eleven or twelve, who was clutching the corner of her quilt and looking at the two men in fear.

Wang Su hurried to the bedside and patted her gently to soothe her nervous state, "I'm sorry, my sister is timid and a bit shy around strangers."

"It's fine, we were the ones who were abrupt; we came at a bad time." Jing Chengsu could see that there was something off about the little girl; it probably wasn't as simple as being shy, but he didn't have the curiosity to get to the bottom of it.

"May I ask what you need from me?" Wang Su didn't think there was anything about his current self worth anyone coming to find him for, and he felt it was a bit strange.

"This... do you know Zhou Ya?" Jing Chengsu thought for a moment and decided to just ask directly.

"Zhou Ya? Who is Zhou Ya?" Wang Su frowned. When would he have known such a person?

"You don't know her? You met her in an alley not long ago." Jing Chengsu narrowed his eyes at Wang Su; it had only been half an hour, so it was impossible for him not to remember.

"Oh, you mean that inexplicable woman?" At the mention of the woman who had pestered him with a bunch of nonsense, Wang Su’s face turned cold with displeasure. He looked at Jing Chengsu and his companion, "You aren't here because of her, are you? I already told her there is no blueprint for a viral infrared sensor. You've made a wasted trip."

Viral infrared sensor? A dark glint flashed in Jing Chengsu's eyes. That Zhou Ya was a reincarnated person; if she was looking for this Wang Su, she must know that this man was the one who designed that viral sensor.

"Mr. Wang, what are your plans for the future?" Jing Chengsu ignored his stiff expression and asked calmly.

"I..." Wang Su was stunned for a moment, "I am an ordinary person, so naturally, I do the work of an ordinary person."

Jing Chengsu glanced at the equipment piled in the corner, "Mr. Wang must have been a talent in physics, right? I wonder if you have any interest in working at the base's research institute? The benefits there are generous, and your sister's health also needs proper treatment."

"This..." The research institute? Wang Su hesitated as he looked at Jing Chengsu and his companion, then at his deathly pale sister, unable to make up his mind.

"Brother." Wang Xiaoyue called out to her brother in a low voice. She had always known that she was the one holding her brother back; otherwise, with her brother's skills, how could he be doing manual labor like carrying things and moving bricks for others? The research institute sounded like a very prestigious place; if her brother could go there, their lives would at least be secure.

Wang Su looked down at his sister's bright eyes, pondered for a moment, and nodded, "I can go, but my sister..."

"Don't worry, we will arrange your food, clothing, housing, and transportation. The environment here in District C is truly too poor and not suitable for recovery. You should move to the military district first; there is housing specifically for research personnel there." Jing Chengsu was worried that the longer they waited, the more trouble there would be, and that Zhou Ya might stir something up, so he proposed the relocation.

"Alright." Being able to move away from here made Wang Su quite happy. He had long since grown tired of the noise from the floors above and below, which kept his sister from sleeping at night and caused her health to deteriorate further.
chapters.source_text:
荆成夙离开A区不久，就在街头一角遇到跟他打眼色的强子。
他朝强子走去，“怎么样？”
“那个人叫王溯，在C区，是个普通人，有一个身体虚弱，经常生病的妹妹，跟他住在一起。”强子将得到的讯息一一道来。
普通人？荆成夙暗下眼眸，一个普通人会值得让那个周雅放下身段大献殷勤？别告诉他周雅喜欢那个男人，开什么玩笑？周雅一看就是个野心勃勃的女人，放着满地的强者不要，看上一个落魄的普通人，这其中必有蹊跷。
“走，我们看看去。”荆成夙穿过街头，走向C区。
C区的环境真不怎么样，人员又多，显得格外嘈杂。
荆成夙跟着强子走上一栋楼房，这里的每层楼都住着很多人。一层只有一个卫生间，卫生做的不到位，一路上来总飘着一股难闻的尿骚味。
两人皱着眉头，屏着呼吸，走上三楼，沿着过道，朝走廊尽头走去，在一个小房间前停下。
“叩叩叩”强子上前敲响房间的门。
“是谁？”里面传出沙哑的男声。
“你好，是王溯先生吗？我们是军部的，找王先生有些事情。”强子回头看了眼老大，温声道。
“军部，军部找我这小人物做什么？”门从里打开，探出一个不修边幅一身邋遢的男人，他惊疑的打量了两人一番，凝视了他们身上的军装一会，确定两人没有恶意，才打开房门，请两人进去。
荆成夙两人走进房间，这是个只有五六米大的小房间，房间里只摆了一张木板搭的木床和一些零零碎碎的东西，床上躺着一个面色苍白无血色的十一二岁小女孩，此刻正紧抓着被角，惧怕的看着两人。
王溯急步走到床边，轻轻的拍着她，安抚她紧张的情绪，“抱歉，我妹妹胆小，有点怕生。”
“没事，是我们唐突了，来的不是时候。”荆成夙看出这小女孩有点不对劲，恐怕不是怕生那么简单，不过他也没有那个好奇心，去追根究底。
“请问你们找我有什么事吗？”王溯不觉得现在的自己有什么值得别人来找的，感觉有点奇怪。
“这……你认识周雅？”荆成夙想了想，干脆直接问道。
“周雅？谁是周雅？”王溯皱眉，他什么时候认识这个人？
“你不认识？不久前你还和她在一个巷子里碰过面。”荆成夙拧眉看向王溯，才半个小时的事情，他不可能不记得。
“哦，你说的是那个莫名其妙的女人？”提起那个缠着他说了一堆有的没的女人，王溯就不悦的冷下脸，他看着荆成夙两人，“你们不会也是因为她的事来的吧？都说了没有什么病毒红外线感应器的图纸，你们白跑一趟。”
病毒红外线感应器？荆成夙眼底闪过暗光，那个周雅可是重生的，她会找这个王溯，定是知道那个病毒感应器是这个人设计出来的。
“王先生，你今后有什么打算？”荆成夙没将他板着的脸色看在眼里，冷静的问道。
“我……”王溯愣了一下，“我是普通人，自然是做普通人的事。”
荆成夙扫了眼堆在角落的器材，“王先生以前应该是个物理方面的人才吧？不知道有没有兴趣去基地的科研所工作？里面待遇优厚，令妹的身体也要好好治疗才行。”
“这……”科研所？王溯踌躇的看看荆成夙两人，又看看面无人色的妹妹，心里打不定主意。
“哥哥。”王小月低声叫着哥哥，她一直都知道是自己拖累了哥哥，要不然凭着哥哥的本事，怎么会干替人扛东西帮砖头的粗活？科研所一听就是很高大上的地方，倘若哥哥能去那，生活至少有保障。
王溯低头看着妹妹明亮的眼睛，思筹了一下，点头，“我可以去，只是我妹妹……”
“不用担心，我们会安排你们的衣食住行，这边C区的环境实在太差，不适合养病，你们先帮到军区吧，那里有专门给科研人员的住处。”荆成夙担心夜长梦多，那个周雅会搞出什么事来，就提出搬迁的建议。
“行。”能搬离这里，王溯有点高兴，他早就受不了这楼上楼下的吵闹，吵的他妹妹夜不成寐，身体越来越差。

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 9: The People in the Army Are Truly Lovable "Seeking Recommendations, Seeking Collections"
chapters.translated_text:
The off-road vehicle sped along the asphalt road. Wang Chao drove while casting strange, furtive glances at Jing Chengsu, who was staring at his own hands as if they were embedded with treasures.

"Boss, why do you seem so off today?" Usually, he would never take the initiative to ask others for their names or addresses, let alone personal questions like their dating history. This was completely unlike his boss's usual wise and mighty conduct. And that little guy was too naive and innocent; he actually spilled everything.

"What's wrong with it?" The corners of Jing Chengsu’s mouth curved upward, his mood quite good.

"I'm saying, Boss, you... you wouldn't happen to have taken a fancy to that little guy, would you?" Wang Chao asked suspiciously. He remembered that his boss was born gay. Back then, when he came out to his family, his old man forced him to marry a daughter of a prominent family. In a fit of rage, he requested a transfer to City F—several provinces away from Province B—to find some peace and quiet.

"Why not?" Jing Chengsu raised an eyebrow. "He’s very cute, isn't he?"

"Cute is cute!" Wang Chao secretly scanned him up and down and muttered under his breath, "Don't you think you're an old ox eating tender grass?"

The little guy isn't even sixteen yet, okay? The boss is already twenty-eight; that’s a full cycle of the zodiac between them. This is destroying a young sprout of the nation! Could it be that the boss has remained chaste for so many years, ignoring the soldiers in the barracks who were interested in him, because they weren't "young" enough?

Wang Chao’s mind wandered, his imagination running wilder and wilder, and the expression on his face became increasingly bizarre.

"Drive your car properly, what are you daydreaming about?" Jing Chengsu slapped him awake. He wasn't even watching the road and almost drove into a ditch.

"Oh, oh, sorry!" Wang Chao hurriedly focused on driving, but after a while, he couldn't help but ask, "Boss, why did you take a fancy to him? If that little guy isn't gay, are you planning to bend him?"

"Enough, why ask so much?" Jing Chengsu gave him a cold glare. He only had a bit of a favorable impression right now; it hadn't reached that point yet. Of course, if he eventually confirmed that this was the person he wanted, what would it matter if he had to use unscrupulous means?

Wang Chao quickly shut his mouth. He was only able to be chatty because the boss was in a good mood; usually, he wouldn't dare ask such personal questions unless he had a death wish.

The car soon arrived at the special forces base. The guard at the sentry box looked the two over and let them through. Wang Chao drove to the parking lot, and Jing Chengsu got out, carrying a bag of fruit, and strode off on his long legs, minding his own business.

Once Wang Chao parked, he saw his boss was already far ahead. He hurried after him, shouting, "Boss, wait for me! I should at least get a share of the fruit for the sister-in-law, don't you dare hog it all!"

"Alright, there’s enough for you." Jing Chengsu, annoyed by his loud shouting, stopped helplessly. If he didn't answer, this guy would have the ability to yell until the whole troop knew.

Wang Chao quickly caught up with a grin. Once he reached him, Jing Chengsu continued walking, and the two soon turned a corner.

Two people emerged from the woods next to the parking lot.

"Hey, Lao Cheng, did I hear that right? Da Chao mentioned the words 'sister-in-law,' right?" A young man with a slender build, wearing rimless glasses and looking sharp and capable, nudged the person next to him in the chest, his face full of gossip.

"Ah!" The person next to him was burly and tall, with thick eyebrows, large eyes, a prominent nose, and full lips. Combined with a square face, he looked extremely honest and dull. Standing next to the sharp-looking youth, he looked like a silent knight guarding his queen.

"Hey! Why can't you say more than a few sounds? If I didn't know you, I'd think you were reciting 'a-o-e'!" The sharp youth rolled his eyes at him in frustration.

The dull man looked at him honestly, letting him lecture.

"Forget it, forget it. In this world, only I can put up with you." The sharp youth said smugly, "You better treat me well in the future, otherwise where will you find someone who understands you this well?"

"Won't look. Just you!" The dull man stared straight at him and said urgently.

"Alright, I know, I was just joking! Honestly!" The sharp youth’s cheeks flushed red, his eyes darted around, and he gave him a playful glare with a sweet smile on his lips. Although this man was dull, the things he said always made one’s heart feel sweet.

"You heard what Da Chao said just now, right? Let’s go and secretly ask him." The sharp youth grabbed the dull man’s hand and chased after them.

Zhou Pan followed Zhou Qi into a dormitory building and climbed to the third floor. It was past four o'clock, and the sun was still scorching; there was basically no one in the hallways. Zhou Qi opened the door to the room, which contained four bunk beds. Three had signs of being slept in, and the fourth was just an empty frame.

The other five roommates were all in the room. Some were reading, some were sewing a hole in their pants, some were lying on their beds writing something, and others were simply sleeping—since it was a rest day, they could sleep in. When Zhou Qi entered with Zhou Pan, the roommates immediately became alert and looked up.

"Ah! Squad leader, where did this cute little brother come from?" He was chubby-faced, fair, and tender; he looked so adorable. The roommates asked curiously.

The roommates in this room were all members of the 8th Squad of the 2nd Company, led by Zhou Qi, and they usually got along quite well.

"This is my neighbor from home, and also my younger brother, Pan-zi. He wants to come stay with us for a few days, so you guys need to keep an eye on him for me," Zhou Qi said with a smile.

"Hello, brothers. My name is Zhou Pan." Zhou Pan smiled shyly at them. "I’ll be bothering you for a few days."

"No bother at all! The squad leader’s brother is our brother." Especially with such a cute brother, the soldiers’ favorability skyrocketed.

"Pan-zi, my name is Li Liang, call me Brother Liang!"

"Pan-zi, my name is Wang Dahai, call me Brother Dahai!"

"Pan-zi, my name is Pan Lei, you can call me Brother Lei or Brother Sanshi!"

"Pan-zi, my name is Zhang Dajun, call me Brother Dajun!"

"Pan-zi, my name is Huang Siyuan, call me Brother Yuan!"

"Brother Liang, Brother Dahai, Brother Sanshi, Brother Dajun, Brother Yuan, hello everyone. This is some fruit I brought; it’s very delicious, please have some." Zhou Pan felt the warmth of everyone and was very happy, quickly taking out the fruit he brought to share.

He still had quite a bit of fruit left: three or four bunches of bananas, a dozen apples and pears each, and seven or eight small watermelons. If his strength hadn't increased recently, he wouldn't have been able to carry it at all.

On such a hot day, everyone didn't stand on ceremony. Some took a banana, some an apple, some a pear. No one took the small watermelons; they looked expensive, and the guys didn't dare to touch them.

Seeing this, Zhou Qi cut two small watermelons into pieces and shared them, and only then did everyone reach out to take a piece.

"Mmm! This small watermelon is truly delicious! So sweet, and so juicy. Eating it makes me feel so comfortable." After a few bites, the guys couldn't help but praise it. They weren't exaggerating; it wasn't like they hadn't eaten watermelon before, but this was the first time they’d had one this good.

"Is it really that exaggerated?" Zhou Qi, who hadn't eaten any yet, raised an eyebrow and took a piece. He took a bite—it was ice-cold, crisp, sweet, refreshing, and rich in juice. It was indeed much better than what they usually ate. Especially after eating it, he felt as if something was flowing through his body, making him feel very comfortable.

"It is indeed good. Pan-zi, where did you buy this fruit? It’s delicious!" Zhou Qi asked casually.

Zhou Pan’s heart tightened. Fortunately, this fruit didn't have the "cleansing the marrow" effects from those novels. If everyone started having diarrhea or sweating black grime, it would be strange if Zhou Qi, who had read "golden finger" novels, didn't get suspicious!

"Just at the city’s vegetable market. Someone brought them to sell. I saw they were all full of juice and looked like good fruit, and they were selling them very cheaply, so I bought them. But I don't think they were locals; they probably left after selling the fruit," he said, pretending to be nonchalant.

"What a pity. Such delicious fruit is rare in the city," the others lamented, wanting to go to the city during their next leave to see if they could buy some.

The other bunk bed didn't have a mat, so Zhou Qi went to get one and made the bed for Zhou Pan.

The group chatted in the room for a while. By five o'clock, it was time for dinner. Everyone took their plates and utensils and headed to the cafeteria. Along the way, people kept greeting them, curious about the extra boy. Those who were familiar would ask, and Zhou Qi would answer from time to time. In no time, the whole troop knew that Zhou Qi had a fair, cute neighbor brother visiting him.

The army had a tradition: before eating, they had to sing. Each company, platoon, and squad stood in formation, and someone would start a song like "Unity is Strength." With so many people singing the same song, the momentum was magnificent and powerful, making one’s blood boil. Zhou Pan, hiding behind Zhou Qi, secretly sang along, his little face flushed red afterward. After singing for a while, they could finally eat.

Zhou Pan followed them into the cafeteria. Zhou Qi told him to find an empty seat. Zhou Pan found a spot at an empty table that could seat seven or eight people and looked around. There were many people in the cafeteria, but they were very orderly, lining up one by one with their plates to get food; there was no pushing or shoving.

While Zhou Pan was looking around, many people stole glances at him. Most of these weren't new recruits; they had been in the army for a year or two, and all had skin darkened and roughened by the wind and sun. Suddenly seeing such a chubby, fair, and cute young boy, they couldn't help but sneak a peek.

Zhou Qi quickly got his food. It was all "big pot" cooking, and the cafeteria staff were very generous with their scoops. Zhou Qi got four dishes and a soup: braised pork, tiger-skin pork, tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried vegetables, egg soup, and two large bowls of rice. Everything was served in full portions, enough for two people with good appetites to be full.

The other roommates also got their food and came over to sit down.

The food cooked in the army was very delicious, and Zhou Pan’s appetite was wide open. He finished a large bowl of rice with the dishes and couldn't help but let out a burp after eating.

The whole table laughed.

"The food is fragrant, right? You can't find this taste anywhere else," Wang Dahai said happily.

"Exactly. Your Brother Dahai ate so many bowls on his first day as a recruit that he was stuffed. He forgot he had training afterward and ended up with such a stomachache from running!" Pan Lei, who was in the same batch, teased him from the side.

"You were the same! Who was it that scraped the bottom of the rice bucket back then?" Wang Dahai countered.

"I did eat a lot, but I wasn't carried back like you were," Pan Lei rolled his eyes at him.

"Pfft," Zhou Pan laughed. The people in this army were truly good; he couldn't bear the thought of these lovely people being erased by the dust of history.

越野车迅速开在柏油路上，王超一边开车，一边古怪的偷瞅旁边看着自己的手，仿佛手上镶了宝贝的荆成夙。
“老大，我怎么瞅着你今天不太对劲啊？”平常啥时候会主动问旁人姓名地址等问题了，尤其连恋爱历史这种私人问题都问出来了，这完全不像他家老大英明神武的作为。那小家伙也是，太天真小白了，居然真的一五一十的招了。
“哪有什么不对？”荆成夙嘴嘴角微弯，心情很不错。
“我说，那个老大，你……该不会是看上那小家伙了吧？”王超怀疑道，他可是记得他家老大天生是个弯的，当初跟家里摊牌性向，被他家老头子逼着和世家之女结婚，一气之下才会请调到这与B省隔了好几个省会的F市躲清静。
“有何不可？”荆成夙眉一扬，“他很可爱不要吗？”
“可爱是可爱！”王超偷偷的上下扫了他一眼，小声嘟哝，“你不觉得自己老牛吃嫩草了吗？”
小家伙还没满十六岁好吗？老大都二十八了，差了整整一轮，这是要摧残国家幼苗啊！难道老大多年守身如玉，对军营中对他有意的士兵不假辞色，是因为他们不够幼齿？
王超脑中胡想翩翩，脑洞越开越大，脸上表情也越来越诡异。
“好好开你的车，胡思乱想什么呢？”荆成夙一巴掌拍醒他，路也不好好看，差点开沟里去了。
“哦，哦，对不起！”王超赶紧集中精力开车，不过开了会儿，他又忍不住问道，“老大你咋看上他了呢？这小家伙如果不是弯的，你还想掰弯他不成。”
“好了问那么多干什么？”荆成夙冷睨他一眼，他现在不过是有点好感而已，还没到那个地步，当然要是最后确定他是他想要的那个人，即使不折手段又怎么样？
王超赶紧闭嘴，他不过是趁老大心情好，才能多嘴几句，平常哪敢问这些私人问题，又不是不想活了。
车子很快就开到特种部队的基地，警卫室的警卫打量了两人一眼，就放行了。王超将车开到停车场，荆成夙下车提着一袋水果，迈开大长腿自顾自的走了。
王超停好车就见自家老大走了老远，赶忙边追边喊，“老大等等我，大嫂的水果好歹也有我一份，你可不要独吞了！”
“好了，少不了你的。”被他大嗓门喊的荆成夙无奈的停下，要是不应他，他能有本事嚷嚷的满部队都知道。
王超赶紧笑嘻嘻的追上，等他跑到面前，荆成夙才又向前走，两人很快就拐过拐角。
从停车场旁的树林闪出两个人。
“喂，老成，我没听错吧？大超是提了大嫂两字是吧？”一个体型瘦弱修长，带着一副无框眼镜，看起来精明能干的年轻男子，满脸八卦的用手肘顶顶旁边人的胸膛。
“啊！”旁边的人身材魁梧，人高马大，长相粗眉大眼，挺鼻厚唇再配上一张方脸看起来极为老实木纳，此时站在精明青年身边，像个默默无闻的骑士守护着自己的女王陛下。
“哎！你怎么就不能多发两个音，一个字一个字的单音节要不是我了解你，还以为在念aoe呢！”精明青年无奈的白他一眼。
木纳汉子老实的看着他，任凭他说教。
“算了算了，这世上也只有我受的了你。”精明青年沾沾自喜，“以后可得对我好点，不然你去哪找这么了解你的人？”
“不找，就你一个！”木纳汉子眼睛直愣愣的看着他，急迫的说。
“好了，知道了，我是说笑呢！真是的！”精明青年两颊绯红，眼波一转，嗔了他一眼，嘴角挂着甜蜜的笑，这汉子虽然木纳，可说的话，总是让人甜到心里。
“刚才大超说的话你也听到了吧，走咱们去偷偷问问他。”精明青年扯过木纳汉子的手，随后追去。
周磐跟随周琦走进一栋宿舍楼，爬到第三层楼，此时有四点多了，阳光还很灼热，基本上走廊都看不到人。周琦打开房间的门，房间来摆着四张上下铺，三张有人睡的痕迹，另一张床是张空架子。
此时房间令外五个舍友都在，有的在看书，有的在给破了口的裤子缝针，有的趴在床上不知道在写什么，还有的干脆在睡觉，今天休息可以多睡会。当周琦带着周磐一进屋，几个舍友立刻警醒，纷纷抬头看过去。
“啊！班长哪来的可爱小弟弟？”满脸肉乎乎的，白白嫩嫩，看起来真是太萌太可爱了，几个舍友都好奇的问。
这个房间的舍友都是周琦带的二连八班的成员，平常相处挺不错的。
“这是我家隔壁邻居，也是我弟弟，磐子，他想来我们这玩几天，你们可得给我看着点。”周琦笑着说。
“各位哥哥们好，我叫周磐。”周磐不好意思的笑着看着他们，“要叨唠你们几天了。”
“没事，没事，班长的弟弟就是我们弟弟。”尤其是这么可爱的弟弟，几位兵哥哥好感爆棚。
“磐子，我叫李亮，叫我亮哥吧！”
“磐子，我叫王大海，叫我大海哥吧！”
“磐子，我叫潘磊，叫我磊哥或者三石哥也行！”
“磐子，我叫张大军，叫我大军哥吧！”
“磐子，我叫黄思远，叫我远哥吧！”
“亮哥，大海哥，三石哥，大军哥，远哥，你们好，这是我带来的水果很好吃，你们尝尝。”周磐感受到大伙的热情很开心，连忙取出带来的水果要分给大家。
他带的水果还剩下不少，香蕉有三四串，苹果梨各有十几个，还有小西瓜七八个，要不是他最近力气增长了许多，压根提不过来。
大热天的，大伙也没跟他客气，有的拿了一根香蕉，有的拿了一个苹果，有的拿了一个梨，没人拿小西瓜，一看这玩意儿就精贵，大家伙不敢下手。
周琦见状就将两个小西瓜切成块，分给大家，才都伸手拿起一块小西瓜吃起来。
“嗯！这小西瓜真是太好吃了，好甜，汁水又多，吃了感觉很舒服。”吃了几口西瓜，几个人忍不住夸起来，真不是他们夸张，西瓜他们也不是没吃过，可这么好吃的还是第一次。
“有那么夸张吗？”还没吃小西瓜的周琦眉一扬，伸手取了一块，咬一口，透心凉，清甜爽口，丰润多汁，确实比平常吃的好吃很多，尤其吃了，总感觉有什么在体内流动，感觉很舒服。
“的确不错，磐子你这水果哪买的，真好吃！”周琦随口问道。
周磐心一紧，还好这水果没有那些小说里洗筋洗髓的功效，要是来个集体拉肚子，全身排黑汗，看过金手指小说的周琦不起疑才怪！
“就是城里的菜市场，有人拉来卖，我看个个汁水饱满，都是好果子，而且还卖的很便宜就买了。不过我看人家应该不是本地的，大概卖完水果就离开了。”他假装不经意的说道。
“好可惜，这么好吃的水果，这城里可不多见。”几人可惜道，还想有休假的时候，去城里逛逛看看能不能买一点呢！
另一张上下铺没有铺席子，周琦去取了一床，铺好给周磐睡。
几人在房间里聊了会天，到五点多的时候，就要开饭了，大家一起拿着盘子碗筷，朝食堂走去，一路上不断有人打招呼，对多出来的一个少年挺好奇的，相熟的都会问一句，周琦时不时回答，不一会儿功夫，部队里都知道周琦有个白白嫩嫩的可爱邻居弟弟来找他。
部队里有个传统，在开饭前要先唱歌，各连各排各班的人分别站好，就有人开始拉歌唱起“团结就是力量”，这么多人一起唱同一首歌，那气势磅礴，慷锵有力，听的人热血沸腾，躲在周琦背后周磐也偷偷跟着歌声唱起来，唱完小脸红红的。唱了一会儿，终于可以吃饭了。
周磐跟着走进食堂，周琦让他找个空座位坐下，周磐找了个能坐七八个人的空桌子的位置坐着，眼睛四处转动，这食堂里好多人，不过都很遵守秩序，一个个端着盘子排队打饭，没有你争我抢的事情发生。
在周磐打量四周的时候，不少人偷偷的瞧向他，这些人大多都不是新兵蛋子在军队都待上一两年了，哪个不是被风吹日晒的皮肤黝黑粗糙，猛不盯冒出来个肉嘟嘟白嫩嫩的可爱美少年，都忍不住瞄上两眼。
周琦很快就打好了饭菜，都是大锅菜，食堂师傅一勺一勺打的很实诚。周琦打了四菜一汤，有红烧肉，虎皮肉，番茄炒蛋，炒素菜，鸡蛋汤，还有两个大盆碗装的米饭，都打的足足的，足够两个胃口都不错的人吃饱。
其他几个同宿舍的也打好饭菜，走过来，在位置上做下。
部队里烧的饭菜很好吃，周磐吃的胃口大开，一大盆饭配着菜都让他吃光了，吃完还忍不住打了个饱嗝。
一桌人都笑了。
“这饭菜香吧，别处可吃不着这个味。”王大海乐道。
“就是，你大海哥新兵第一天来，忍不住连吃了好几碗饭都吃撑了呢，结果忘了后面还要训练，跑的肚子那个痛啊！”跟他同期的潘磊在一旁调侃。
“你自己还不是一样，当初忘了是谁掏光了饭桶的底儿啦？”王大海反击。
“我是吃了不少，可没向你一样被人抬回来。”潘磊白他一眼。
“噗嗤”周磐笑起来，这部队的人真好，他有些舍不得这些可爱的人，泯灭在历史的尘埃中。
chapters.title: 第9章 部队的人真可爱「求推荐，求收藏」

chapters.source_text:
荆成夙为王溯兄妹搬了家，替他妹妹安排了医院病房疗养，就将他送入正在研究感应器的科研部门。
回到部队，就见他派遣出去的另一个队员王力正在等他。
“老大。”王力看见他，赶紧过来。
“事情调查的怎么样？”荆成夙问道。
“老大你让我查的那个女的叫周雅，住在B区，是个水系异能者，跟大嫂是一个村里出来的，跟她同住的有她的父母弟弟。”王力将调查的消息一一禀报。
“她有什么不寻常举动吗？”
“不寻常举动？没有啊！”王力摇头，“我查了她附近邻居，她生活挺规律的，一般都在家里，隔两天出一趟任务。”
这么正常？不应该啊？荆成夙疑惑不解，那女人怎么可能这么安分？
“就是有一点。”王力也不知该不该讲，“这个周雅的名声特别好，几乎没人不夸她的，好多人同情她有一对不靠谱的父母和一个不省事的弟弟。”
“嗯？”荆成夙感觉有点好笑，原来这女人的野心都拿来装饰名声了，看来自己先前的猜想有点小题大做。
“老大，我还要继续说查吗？”王力问道。
“算了，不用查了，这事就这样，你回去好好修炼吧。”荆成夙随手抛出几颗晶核，当做跑腿费。
“谢谢老大。”王力接过晶核一看，都是三级的，正好让他晋级用，他乐的正想走，又被荆成夙叫住。
“这是强子的份，刚才忘记给他了。”先前让强子去给王溯收拾房间去了，忘了给晶核。
“哦，好，等一会，我拿给他。”王力接过另外的晶核，敬完礼就离开了。
荆成夙朝自己宿舍走去。
周雅捏着鼻子走上楼梯，沿着走廊走到尽头。
“咦？这门怎么开着的？”周雅疑惑的推开没关紧的房门，进去一看，早已人去楼空，里面空荡荡的。
“人去哪了？”她咬着下唇，眉头紧皱，在房间里转圈。
“这位小姐你找谁？怎么在这？”对面的房间打开来，一个年轻男人走出来，看到她在这边屋里，打量了一眼她姣好的身材，眼睛不由一亮。
周雅看了一眼眼前的男人，长得倒是还能入眼。可惜住在C区的，一看就知实力不行。看到人家眼不眨的盯着她，她心里翻个白眼，不过为了打听这里住户的去处，她柔声细语的问道，“你好，你知道住这的人家去哪了吗？”
“这位小姐找这里的住户吗？他们刚刚已经搬走了。”那个年轻男人想起这户人搬去的地方，满脸的羡慕嫉妒恨，“听说是搬去军区了。”
军区？周雅沉下脸，可恶，来迟了一步，那人住进军区，哪还有她的好事？本来想着从那个王溯那里买过图纸，好巴结基地高层，看来是行不通了。
“小姐，小姐，你怎么了？”对面的男人见她脸色不好看，不由的叫道。
“没事，谢谢你啊。”周雅微撤了一下嘴角，露出个僵硬的笑容，走出房间，准备离开这里。
“哎，等等，这位小姐，我们可以交个朋友吗？我叫张俊，弓长张，英俊的俊……”后面传来男人急急的叫喊声。
周雅僵着脸越走越快。
chapters.translated_text:
Jing Chengsu moved Wang Su and his sister to a new place, arranged for his sister to stay in a hospital ward for recuperation, and then sent him to the research department currently working on sensors.

Upon returning to the military base, he saw Wang Li, another team member he had dispatched, waiting for him.

"Boss." Wang Li hurried over when he saw him.

"How did the investigation go?" Jing Chengsu asked.

"The woman you asked me to investigate is named Zhou Ya. She lives in District B, is a water-type ability user, and comes from the same village as your sister-in-law. She lives with her parents and younger brother," Wang Li reported the findings one by one.

"Does she have any unusual behavior?"

"Unusual behavior? None at all!" Wang Li shook his head. "I checked with her neighbors; her life is quite routine. She usually stays at home and goes out on missions every two days."

So normal? That shouldn't be right. Jing Chengsu was puzzled. How could that woman be so well-behaved?

"There is just one thing." Wang Li wasn't sure if he should mention it. "This Zhou Ya has an exceptionally good reputation. Almost everyone praises her, and many people sympathize with her for having unreliable parents and a troublesome younger brother."

"Hmm?" Jing Chengsu felt a bit amused. So, this woman used all her ambition to decorate her reputation. It seemed his previous guess might have been making a mountain out of a molehill.

"Boss, should I continue the investigation?" Wang Li asked.

"Forget it, no need to investigate further. Let it be. Go back and focus on your cultivation." Jing Chengsu casually tossed over a few crystal cores as a reward for his legwork.

"Thank you, Boss." Wang Li caught the cores and saw they were all Level 3, just right for his advancement. He was happy and about to leave when Jing Chengsu called him back.

"This is Qiangzi's share; I forgot to give it to him earlier." He had previously sent Qiangzi to help Wang Su tidy up his room and had forgotten to give him the cores.

"Oh, okay. Wait a moment, I'll give it to him." Wang Li took the extra cores, saluted, and left.

Jing Chengsu walked toward his dormitory.

Zhou Ya pinched her nose as she climbed the stairs and walked to the end of the corridor.

"Huh? Why is this door open?" Zhou Ya curiously pushed open the door that wasn't latched properly. She looked inside and saw that the place was already deserted; it was completely empty.

"Where did they go?" She bit her lower lip, her brows furrowed, and she paced around the room.

"Miss, who are you looking for? Why are you here?" The door across the hall opened, and a young man walked out. Seeing her in the room, he glanced at her attractive figure, and his eyes lit up.

Zhou Ya glanced at the man in front of her; he was decent-looking enough. Unfortunately, he lived in District C, so it was clear his strength wasn't great. Seeing him staring at her without blinking, she rolled her eyes internally. However, in order to find out where the previous tenants had gone, she asked in a soft, gentle voice, "Hello, do you know where the family that lived here went?"

"Are you looking for the tenants here, Miss? They just moved away." The young man recalled where the family had moved to, his face full of envy, jealousy, and resentment. "I heard they moved to the military district."

The military district? Zhou Ya's face darkened. Damn it, she was a step too late. Once that person moved into the military district, how could there be any benefit for her? She had originally planned to buy the blueprints from that Wang Su to curry favor with the base's top brass, but it seemed that wouldn't work now.

"Miss, Miss, what's wrong?" The man opposite saw her expression turn ugly and couldn't help but call out.

"It's nothing, thank you." Zhou Ya twitched the corner of her mouth, revealing a stiff smile, and walked out of the room, preparing to leave.

"Hey, wait! Miss, can we be friends? My name is Zhang Jun, 'Zhang' as in bow and long, 'Jun' as in handsome..." The man's urgent shouting came from behind.

Zhou Ya kept her face stiff and walked away faster.

"What is this?" Grandpa Zhou Wu asked excitedly.

*Crunch, crunch.* Zhou Wu, biting into a crisp, sweet red apple, heard his grandfather's question and looked up, confused. "What's wrong?"

"Where did you get this to eat?" Grandpa Zhou Wu took the apple from Zhou Wu's hand and examined it carefully. That's right! It was spiritual energy.

"Brother Xiao Pan gave it to me." Zhou Wu looked longingly at the apple in his grandfather's hand. "Grandpa, I've already bitten into that one. If you want to eat one, there are more in the bag over there."

"So it was Zhou Pan. To think he would have such fruit, rich in spiritual energy." Grandpa Zhou Wu returned the apple to Zhou Wu. "It seems he is not a simple person either. Could he also be a cultivator? That would explain why those crystal cores had spiritual energy."

"Grandpa, what are you talking about? What's wrong with Brother Xiao Pan?" Zhou Wu asked while eating his fruit, watching his grandfather mutter to himself, unable to understand what he was saying.

"It's nothing. You should spend more time with your Brother Xiao Pan in the future; it will be to your benefit." Grandpa Zhou Wu tapped his little head.

"Oh." Although he didn't quite understand what his grandfather meant, he understood the part about getting along well with Brother Xiao Pan.

Zhou Pan and Jing Chengsu were both busy people. Having just rested for two days, a pile of matters awaited them. Zhou Pan had several mountains of crystal cores waiting for him to purify, and Jing Chengsu had to go command the clearing of the nest of zombies in Kang City. Both became occupied.

Purifying the crystal cores was simple for Zhou Pan; he just had to put them all into his space and soak them in spiritual spring water. However, during the "purification" process, it wasn't convenient for him to walk around openly, so he hid in his space to cultivate. His ability was stuck at the level four bottleneck, which had loosened a few days ago while fighting zombies in Kang City. Now that he had free time, it was the perfect moment to level up.

After spending a day, he successfully advanced his ability to level four. He then turned his attention to cultivating his technique, as the *Piaomiao Refinement Record* was his foundation. He cultivated continuously for half a month before finally mastering the fourth stage.

When he came out of the space, Jing Chengsu had already completed the mission to sweep Kang City. There had been two or three hundred thousand zombies in total in Kang City. Although they had eliminated some last time, it was less than a tenth. This time, they took a third of the base's personnel, and through a continuous barrage of ammunition and abilities, they finally wiped out all the zombies, allowing everyone to let go of the heavy burden on their hearts and breathe a sigh of relief.

Zhou Pan had someone return the "purified" crystal cores and brought Jing Chengsu into the space with him. Jing Chengsu went to cultivate, while he went to the kitchen to cook something delicious. He prepared dish after dish of delicacies, all vegetarian. Zhou Pan felt he had made a mistake; why didn't he remember to collect some animals back then? That way, they would have some meat to eat.

It wasn't easy to get fresh meat now; most of it was mutated beast meat, and there were very few animals left that hadn't mutated and still survived. However, mutated beast meat was still edible. He heard the mutated fish they collected from the city center last time tasted good, but unfortunately, he hadn't managed to get any.

Next time he went on a mission, he had to remember to hunt some mutated beasts to bring into the space, otherwise, whenever he ate alone, it was always just rice and vegetables.

After setting the cooked food on the table, he went to call Jing Chengsu, who was cultivating in the courtyard. That martial cultivation technique was very suitable for Jing Chengsu; he was progressing quickly, and it looked like he was about to reach the Foundation Establishment stage.

Not long after, Jing Chengsu began to wrap up his cultivation. Cultivating the martial technique wasn't as refreshing as Zhou Pan's technique; Jing Chengsu was covered in sweat and felt sticky.

Fortunately, when Zhou Pan was cooking, he had prepared plenty of water in another pot, and it was nice and hot. Jing Chengsu went to take a hot bath first before returning to enjoy the meal.

The two had a hearty meal before slowly flashing out of the space.

“这是什么？”周五爷爷激动的问道。
咔嚓咔嚓，周五咬着脆甜的大红苹果听到爷爷的问话，抬头不解的问道，“怎么了？”
“这吃的是哪来的？”周五爷爷拿过周五手中的苹果，仔细观察了一下，没错！是灵气。
“小磐哥给的。”周五眼巴巴的看着他爷爷手中的苹果，“爷爷，这个我咬过了，你想吃，那边袋子里还有。”
“原来是周磐，他居然会有这样灵气充足的水果。”周五爷爷将苹果还给周五，“看来他也不是个简单的人，难道也是修真者，这就难怪那些晶核会有灵气了。”
“爷爷，你在说什么？小磐哥怎么了？”周五一边吃着水果，一边看他爷爷喃喃自语，不知在说什么。
“没事，你以后跟你小磐哥多多相处，有你的好处。”周五爷爷点点他的小脑袋。
“哦。”虽然爷爷说的不太明白，但跟小磐哥好好相处，这话他听懂了。
周磐和荆成夙都是不得闲的人，刚休息了两天，就有一大堆事找他们，周磐有好几座晶核山，正等着他净化。荆成夙要去指挥清剿亢城的那一窝丧尸，各自都忙碌起来。
周磐净化晶核倒简单，将这些晶核都收入空间内，用灵泉水泡着就行。不过在“净化”晶核期间，他不好大咧咧的出去走动，只好躲在空间里修炼，他的异能卡在四级的关卡，前几天在亢城对抗丧尸的时候已经松动了，刚好现在有空，正好晋级一下。
花了在天的功夫，将异能晋级到四级，他又转头修炼功法，毕竟缥缈炼神录才是他的立身之本，连续修炼了半个月，才将第四层功法练成。
他出空间的时候，荆成夙已经完成扫荡亢城的任务，亢城总共有二三十万的丧尸，上次他们虽然消灭了一些，但是还不到十分之一，这次带了基地内三分之一的人手去，又是弹药，又是异能的连番攻击，终于将那些丧尸消灭的一干二净，让大伙悬在心头的大石落地松了口气。
周磐将“净化”好的晶核，让人送还回去，自己带着荆成夙进空间。荆成夙去修炼，他去下厨煮好吃的。煮了一道道美味出来，都是素食。周磐觉得自己有点失策，他当初怎么就不记得收取一些动物进来呢？这样也有些肉吃。
现在想要再吃新鲜的肉可就不容易了，大多都是变异的兽肉，没有变异还能生存下来的动物真的很少。不过变异兽肉还是可以吃的，上次去市中心收集回来的那些变异鱼，据说味道不错，可惜他没抢到。
下回再去出任务，要记得打些变异兽弄到空间里面，不然吃独食的时候，老是只有米饭蔬菜。
将煮好的饭菜摆上桌，去叫在院子里面修炼的荆成夙，那个武修功大很适合荆成夙，他进展很快，眼看就快修炼到筑基了。
没过多久荆成夙就开始收功，修炼武修功法，可不像周磐的功法那么清爽，荆成夙浑身汗黏黏的，流了不少汗水。
幸好周磐煮饭的时候。另一口锅也备了不少水，现在正热乎着呢。荆成夙先去洗了把热水澡，才回头来享用美食。
两人饱餐一顿，才慢慢闪出空间。

“媛媛姐，小心。”旁边传来惊叫声。
周媛媛迅速的一侧身，一只黑色尖爪从她身前抓过，腐臭味袭来。一只腐烂了半边脸的丧尸，大张着满嘴的獠牙，狰狞的朝她咬来。
“妈呀！太恶心了！”她二话不说十根手指头上的指甲暴长三分，毫不客气的给扑来的丧尸两爪子，莹白半透明的长指甲，犹如利器一般，抓在丧尸头颅上，直接将那丧尸头颅抓个稀巴烂。
“呕——”看着地上被抓爆的像烂西瓜似得丧尸头颅，即使莹白指甲上未留下任何脏污的痕迹，还是让她控制不住肠胃的翻涌，蹲在一旁吐的昏天暗地，连四周扑来的丧尸都不顾了。
“媛媛姐，你没事吧？”周磐匆匆跑过来，刷刷刷几剑解决掉四周的丧尸，关心的问。
“没事，让我先缓缓。”周媛媛青白着脸，摇摇手，对着一处树根又是猛吐，她的指甲变异能力挺强大的每根指甲锋利度都不比任何利器差。可就是使用过的后果太辣眼睛了，她有点接受不良。
“媛媛姐，你还要继续杀丧尸吗？”周磐有点担心的看着周媛媛的状况，才杀一只丧尸而已，就吐的这么厉害，其他的还下的了手吗？
周媛媛的变异指甲异能，修炼进展缓慢，好不容易经过两个多月的不懈努力，终于升级为三级异能，每根指甲都可以伸缩自如的弹出三尺长的指甲，抓任何东西都毫无阻碍。她信心满满的觉得自己可以出外狩猎了。
虽然她等级挺高，但其实还是个未沾染血腥的菜鸟，连异能队都没有参加，想要加入异能队，还需要报名时间，她有些迫不及待的想自己出外地闯闯。
周磐正好来看望他们，见她要出基地历练，就自告奋勇的陪她走一遭，没想到刚杀完第一只丧尸，她的反应就这么大。
“呕——”周媛媛又吐完一轮，拿起身上背着的水壶簌簌口，呸掉满嘴的怪味，掏出手帕擦擦嘴角，她看着附近游荡的丧尸，又看看自己的手，好不容易出来一趟，她可不想窝囊的回去，家里也不能光靠她哥一个人养着，不久就是场面血腥一点吗？恶心就恶心吧，忍忍就好了。
她让周磐压阵，自己上前扑杀丧尸，她杀死的丧尸一个比一个死相凄惨，虽然杀一只就恶心一回，但吐啊吐的慢慢就习惯了。
尤其当她得到从丧尸脑核里掏出的晶核时，那份成就感慢慢压过了那份恶心，杀起丧尸来也没那么排斥。
杀的性起，有着晶核在前边做诱饵，两人走的越来越远，原本只打算在基地外围杀杀丧尸就行，结果越走越远。
周媛媛是杀的头脑发蒙了，而周磐则是艺高人胆大，这附近的丧尸都是一二级的，根本给不了他任何危机感，有他压阵，哪会让两人受到威胁。
两人一路杀着丧尸，所过之处留下一具具死状凄惨的尸骸。
基地外面可不像F市基地里面那么安全，两个年轻男女独自活跃在丧尸群里看着他们挖出一颗颗晶核，在别人眼里就是两个不识人间险恶的大肥羊。
在不远处一对异能小队对渐渐靠近的两个人虎视眈眈，随着他们越离越近，眼睛闪过贪婪的光芒。

chapters.translated_text:
"Yuanyuan-jie, watch out!" A scream came from nearby.

Zhou Yuanyuan quickly sidestepped, and a black, sharp claw swiped past her front, bringing with it a foul stench. A zombie with half its face rotted away, its mouth wide open with fangs, was lunging at her ferociously.

"Oh my god! That's disgusting!" Without a second thought, the nails on her ten fingers grew three inches long. She didn't hold back, giving the lunging zombie two swipes. Her translucent, pearly-white long nails, sharp as weapons, clawed into the zombie's skull, smashing it to pieces.

"Ugh—" Looking at the zombie's head on the ground, which had been smashed like a rotten watermelon, even though no filth remained on her pearly-white nails, she couldn't control the churning in her stomach. She crouched to the side and vomited violently, ignoring even the zombies lunging from all around.

"Yuanyuan-jie, are you okay?" Zhou Pan ran over hurriedly, dispatching the surrounding zombies with a few quick slashes of his sword, and asked with concern.

"I'm fine, let me catch my breath." Zhou Yuanyuan, her face pale, waved her hand and retched violently again at a tree root. Her nail mutation ability was quite powerful; the sharpness of each nail was no less than any sharp weapon. But the aftermath of using it was just too hard on the eyes, and she was having trouble accepting it.

"Yuanyuan-jie, do you still want to continue killing zombies?" Zhou Pan looked at Zhou Yuanyuan's condition with some worry. She had only killed one zombie and was already vomiting this badly; would she be able to bring herself to attack others?

Zhou Yuanyuan's mutated nail ability had progressed slowly in its cultivation. After more than two months of unremitting effort, she had finally upgraded to a Level 3 ability, where each nail could freely extend up to three feet long, allowing her to claw through anything without obstruction. She had been full of confidence, feeling she could go out and hunt.

Although her level was quite high, she was actually still a rookie who hadn't been stained by blood. She hadn't even joined an ability team yet, and since joining one required a registration period, she was too impatient to wait and wanted to go out and venture on her own.

Zhou Pan happened to be visiting them, and seeing that she wanted to leave the base for experience, he volunteered to accompany her. He hadn't expected her to have such a strong reaction after killing just the first zombie.

"Ugh—" After another round of vomiting, Zhou Yuanyuan picked up the canteen she was carrying to rinse her mouth, spat out the strange taste, and took out a handkerchief to wipe the corners of her mouth. She looked at the zombies wandering nearby, then at her own hands. Since she had finally come out, she didn't want to go back like a coward, and her family couldn't rely solely on her brother to support them. Wasn't it just a bit bloody? Disgusting or not, she would just have to endure it.

She had Zhou Pan cover her while she lunged forward to kill the zombies. The zombies she killed each had a more miserable death than the last. Although she felt disgusted every time she killed one, she slowly got used to it after vomiting repeatedly.

Especially when she obtained the crystal cores dug out from the zombies' brains, that sense of accomplishment slowly outweighed the disgust, and she stopped being so repulsed by killing zombies.

Getting carried away with the killing, and with the crystal cores acting as bait, the two wandered further and further. They had originally only intended to kill zombies on the outskirts of the base, but they ended up going further and further away.

Zhou Yuanyuan was killing until her mind went numb, while Zhou Pan was bold because of his high skill level. The zombies nearby were only Level 1 or 2 and couldn't pose any threat to him; with him covering her, there was no way the two would be in danger.

The two continued to kill zombies along the way, leaving behind a trail of corpses with miserable death states.

Outside the base, it wasn't as safe as inside the F City base. Two young people active alone in a horde of zombies, seen digging out crystal cores one by one—in the eyes of others, they were just two fat sheep who didn't know the dangers of the world.

Not far away, an ability team eyed the two approaching figures with hostility. As they got closer and closer, greedy glints flashed in their eyes.

Zhou Pan followed behind Zhou Yuanyuan, occasionally blocking attacks she failed to fend off. They were not far from the city center now, and the zombies were gradually increasing. To avoid capsizing in the gutter, he kept his divine sense constantly focused on Zhou Yuanyuan.

Although he had not yet mastered the fifth level of his cultivation technique to advance to the Golden Core stage, his divine sense was already approaching that level. He could scan a radius of at least 50 miles, and within the range covered by his divine sense, the group of "rats" hiding in the shadows were naturally visible to him.

Hah! They were even acquaintances! A cold light flashed across Zhou Pan's youthful face. He had not forgotten that it was this very group of people who had sliced the flesh from his body, piece by piece, leaving him unable to live and unable to die, until he was tortured to death. Thinking of that lingering, flaying-like pain, a raging fire rose in his heart.

He had thought he was free of hatred and resentment, but only upon seeing them did he realize that the hatred had long since seeped into his marrow, just waiting for a volcanic eruption.

His divine sense swept over the group; there were 27 people in total. Apart from two he didn't recognize, the others were all old acquaintances, each of whom had shared in the flesh and blood of his body.

They were hiding there, and judging by their gazes, they were clearly targeting the two of them, treating them like fat sheep. In his past life, they had done their fair share of murder and robbery.

They were merely a group of level one and two ability users, with the strongest captain only at level three. In this life, because the apocalypse was discovered earlier and there were purified crystals—an energy source harmless to the human body—anyone with some strength had gone to exchange for them, making everyone much stronger than in his previous life. However, compared to Zhou Pan, he still didn't take them seriously.

If they wanted to do something, let them come; he wanted to see who would have the last laugh. He still remembered the events of his past life vividly, and he wished he could tear them into ten thousand pieces immediately.

"Xiao Pan, what's wrong?" Zhou Yuanyuan had finished digging out the crystals from the zombies she killed. They were now at a street intersection, having cleared out most of the wandering zombies along the way. She walked toward Zhou Pan with the crystals in hand, only to notice that his expression seemed off.

"Sister Yuanyuan, it seems we're being watched," Zhou Pan whispered in her ear.

"Watched? By whom?" Although Zhou Yuanyuan had stayed in the base, she wasn't naive enough to think the world was at peace. Based on her years of reading novels, which post-apocalyptic novel didn't depict the degradation of human nature and the complexity of the world?

"They're hiding behind that alley up ahead, there are quite a few of them," Zhou Pan said lightly, a ruthless glint flashing deep within his dark eyes.

"They want to ambush us? Don't be afraid, Xiao Pan, sister will protect you." Having killed zombies all the way here, Zhou Yuanyuan was full of confidence, her fingernails twitching with anticipation. In her eyes, Zhou Pan was still a child. Even though he was stronger than her, he was still someone who needed protection.

"Mm." Zhou Pan felt a warmth in his heart. Although with his strength, he didn't need protection at all, the feeling of being cared for was still very pleasant.

The two pretended to be nonchalant as they swept through the surrounding area for supplies that hadn't been touched yet. Although they didn't find much, even a mosquito's leg is meat, so they didn't mind searching for everything they could find. Zhou Pan even deliberately revealed his spatial ability, collecting the supplies into his space.

A space ability user?! The prying eyes over there stared fixedly at Zhou Pan, their gazes so intense they were almost sparking with greed.

Zhou Pan and Zhou Yuanyuan acted as if they had no sense of danger, gradually moving their search range closer to those people.
chapters.source_text:
周磐跟在周媛媛后面，不时替她隔挡几下没防住的攻击。这里已经离市中心不远了，丧尸也渐渐多了起来，为了不阴沟里翻船，他的神识时时注意周周。
虽然他现在还没练成第五层功法，晋级金丹但是神识却快到金丹期了，扫视出去的范围起码有50里地，在他的神识笼罩的范围之内，那群暗地里躲藏的“老鼠”，自然被他看在眼里。
呵！还是熟人呢！周磐稚嫩的脸上闪过冷光，他可没忘记就是这群人一刀刀割下他身上的肉，让他求生不得，求死不能。活活痛死过去，想到那份凌迟般的痛感，他心头升起汹汹怒火。
他以为自己不恨不怨，可真正看到人，才发现恨意早已深入骨髓，就等着火山爆发。
他的神识扫过那群人，总共有27个人，除了其中两个他不相识之外，其他人都是老熟人，每个人都曾分享过他身上的血肉。
这群人躲在那里，看他们的目光是盯上他的两个了吧？把他们当肥羊了了。杀人抢劫这种事上辈子可没少做。
不过是一群一二级的异能者，最强的那个队长才三级。这辈子由于发现的较早，又有净化晶核这种不会对人体有害的能量，只要有点实力的都会去兑换，一个个实力都比上辈子强了很多。但是对比周磐他还不放在眼里。
他们想要做什么尽管来吧，他倒要看看鹿死谁手。对前世的事情，他还记忆犹新，恨不能立刻将他们碎尸万段。
“小磐，你怎么啦？”周媛媛将杀死的丧尸的晶核都一一掏出来，他们现在在一条街的路口，一路杀过来，将这游荡的丧尸都杀的差不多了，她拿着晶核走进周磐，却见他脸色似乎不对。
“媛媛姐，我们好像被盯上了。”周磐低声在她耳边说到。
“盯上？谁？”皱媛媛虽然一直待在基地里，但是她可不会天真的觉得天下太平了，以她多年看小说的经验，哪本末世小说不是写着人性的沦落，世道的复杂。
“在前边那个小巷子后面躲着，有不少了呢。”周磐说的轻快，黝黑的眼睛深处闪过狠意。
“这是想埋伏我们？小磐你别怕，姐姐保护你。”杀了一路丧尸，周媛媛自信满满，手上的指甲蠢蠢欲动，在她眼里周磐还是孩子。虽然实力比她强，但还是需要保护的对象。
“嗯”周磐心里暖洋洋的，虽然以他的实力，根本不需要保护，但是有人关怀的感觉还是非常不错的。
两人装作若无其事的扫荡四周还没有人光顾过的物资，虽然搜索到的不多，但蚊子虽小也是肉，两人一点也不嫌弃的将他们都找出来。周磐还特意露出空间能力，将物资都收取到空间里头。
一个空间异能者？！那边窥视的眼睛死死盯着周磐，灼热的都快冒出火花开。
周磐两人仿佛毫无危机意识似的，搜索的范围渐渐向那些人靠近。
