chapters.source_text:
所以一个好哥哥的具体标准有哪些？
学校里面为什么不教点这种有用的课呢！？
而陆雪言则忍不住趴在四哥怀里悄悄嗅了嗅，总觉得好像又闻到了淡淡的橘子味。
奶奶最喜欢给自己剥橘子吃了。
身后原本有点担心的保姆们看着这一幕也忍不住露出了笑意，觉得这真是可爱极了。
要知道Alpha兄弟之间能相处的这么和谐，还真是不常见呢。
除了陆霆这个老父亲深深地酸了。
酸到感觉工作事务都没那么让人振奋了。
更可怕的是，陆霆开始控制不住地思索一个问题，最后小家伙不会先学会了喊“哥哥”，都还没学会喊“爸爸”？！
光是想到这一幕，陆霆就很想去公司顶楼的直升机停机坪冷静一下。
“董事长，您要是真的很在意的话，是否可以重新考虑一个新名字？”
事实上，自以为掩饰得很好陆霆，身上这种低气压简直明显到了极点。
辛辣的信息素浓烈到就连办公室里的顾叔都忍不住用手帕优雅地捂住了鼻子。
更何况顾叔觉得这估计跟信息素的味道也有点关系。
陆淮小少爷的信息素是非常清新的柑橘味，但陆霆董事长的信息素却是烟草味。
理论上来讲，烟草味的信息素也不应该太接近幼崽。
否则情绪波动信息素逸散，很容易导致幼崽闻到烟草味？
只不过后面这半句话在嘴里绕了一圈，资深的阅历就足以让顾叔直觉还是别说出来了，否则情况估计能更糟糕。
“当然，这绝对不是因为旧名字欠妥的缘故，而且考虑到被人提前泄露到了网络平台上，一旦被有心人记住了，无疑会对小少爷未来产生不利影响。”
陆家明里暗里的仇家那可绝对不算少。
于是顾叔斟酌了一下，就胡子一颤一颤地开始给陆霆递台阶了。
如果系统444在场的话，一定会惊呼顾叔这反派老总管狗腿子的气质也实在是太经典了！
意识到陆霆单纯是拉不下面子，不愿意主动提及换名字，便迅速替陆霆找到了一个如此合情合理的理由。
“不错。”
陆霆沉默半晌，最终手指在桌面上敲击数下，觉得顾叔这番考虑甚为妥帖。
即便是被肯定了，顾叔也依然面不改色，可谓是一枚相当优雅的反派总管。
虽然顾叔悄悄瞄了一眼董事长的桌面，发现那张在网上泄露的照片果然被冲洗出来摆在了桌子上。
那名宾客的女伴保密意识不强，但拍照技术倒确实相当不错，成功卡在小少爷掉眼泪之前抓拍到了完美照片。
也许这也是董事长最终没有严肃处理的原因之一？
真走运啊。
“算起来，陆巡少爷那边的事情应该也快告一段落了。”
顾叔看着日程表，提醒了一句。
另一边远在Y国纳多尔实验室，刚从实验室结束了这场封闭试验的年轻Alpha，就看见了手机上那张同样的照片。
Alpha的目光久久落在照片上的幼崽眉眼上，以至于完全无视了其余闪烁着的消息提示。
“订机票，立刻回去。”
“是。”
与此同时，系统444正难得有清净时间给自家宿主恶补原书知识。
【虽然不知道这个大哥陆巡什么时候登场，但他总归是我们需要注意的头号危险人物！】
444给这张照片狠狠打上了一个×，示意幼崽一定一定要小心。
关键444想的是，自家宿主都出生几天了，这个所谓的大哥陆巡居然全程露面都没露面，说明什么？
说明这家伙也许冷血到根本不在意家庭成员的多寡！
而且根据原著里的剧情发展，后期老爸陆霆被指控多项罪名面临入狱危机时，正式接管董事会的长子陆巡却直接冷血至极地下令切割风险及资产。
尽管这在当时看来是利益最大化的手段，但同样被外界认为毫无人性，对亲人入狱都无动于衷。
可这好像也完全不是适合讲给幼崽听的剧情啊。
左右为难的444最终看着自家宿主很认真地点了点头
“嗯！”
虽然不知道小家伙在“嗯”什么，但总之就是很能给系统以安慰就是了。
毕竟我们如今可是有着110点积分的大富豪啊。
在此之前系统444从来没有想过积分可以这么轻易地拿到手。
【难道陆霆这大反派真的有心悔改，考虑重新想一个新名字了？】
某种意义上，能够意识到自己取的名字真的烂，愿意重新考虑，也确实称得上稍微没那么傲慢了。
毕竟以陆霆的身份地位，除了家里人还敢提出异议，身边的员工和下属谁会毫无眼力见公然提意见？
相反，恐怕还会争先恐后地附和恭维。
这种久居高位的反派人物在原书里的最终结局，绝对也和这一点特质有着很大的关系。
所以一旦被自家宿主影响到了这一点反派特质，就被主脑判定为了重要影响？
不过陆霆的确在第二天晚上罕见召开了一场家庭会议，脸色正经地表示需要给小家伙重新考虑一个名字。
理由正是之前的名字已经被人在网上公开了，万一被什么有心人记下，显然会有不利因素。
“说得这么好听，我看明明是因为……”
陆淮小声蛐蛐到一半就被老爸陆霆瞥了一眼，瞬间闭嘴了。
“关键怎么没人拍我抱着弟弟的照片？这照片把老爸拍得这么帅，也太具备欺骗性了啊。”
仔细放大又缩小手机里这张在网上掀起轩然大波的照片，陆淮心想应该问问对方还拍没拍到其他照片的。
对此陆菁瞥了一眼老四，怀疑这家伙简直是故意踩着老爸的火气在行走。
“老四，我记得你之前不是想了一堆名字吗，正好还有一本字典，真的要重新想的话，就拿来用吧。”
于是卡在老爸陆霆发作的前一刻，陆菁眉头微微挑起地把人支开了。
老四这家伙还是太得意忘形了。
但柑橘烟草打架的味道可没有那么美妙，一家子Alpha就是这点让人无法忍受。
“字典？噢……那我去拿呗。”
陆淮双手插兜，有些不情不愿地被使唤上楼了。
呵，这群人，明明之前看不上自己取的名字。
陆淮的脾气其实还真一直算不上好。
虽然出生时陆家俨然已经发展成为了不容忽视的庞然大物，兄长们大多也有了各自的事业，但同样导致陆淮成长阶段几乎没有和父亲陆霆等人有太多交流。
回到家更多的不过是空落落的房间罢了。
甚至这段时间接触的次数加起来都快赶上之前一年了。
可就在陆淮抱着字典下楼的时候，突然发现楼梯上多了一道小小的身影，正眼巴巴地在保姆怀里抬头盯着自己。
赫然是陆雪言听到动静，急得让保姆阿姨抱着自己来见四哥了！陆雪言完全没想到可以这么快地用上。
“小少爷听到动静就一直拉着我要来找人，我就猜估计是想您了。”
随后保姆阿姨笑着解释的这句话，更是让幼崽感动得眼睛一亮，努力点头表示：没错，就是这样！
至于原本心情不爽的陆淮，这一瞬间已经春暖花开到可以原谅全世界了。
世界上怎么可以存在弟弟这么完美的小萌物？
直接蹲下伸手一把抱住了扑过来的幼崽，陆淮的姿势熟练得堪称突飞猛进。
很让人怀疑在学校上课的时候，这家伙到底是不是在一直在手机上摸鱼学习一百种照顾幼崽的技巧。
“书你拿着下去。”
陆淮直接示意保姆接过字典，怀里的陆雪言却扯了扯四哥的衣摆。
下一刻自己努力伸手紧紧抱住了这本沉甸甸的字典。
并且从里面“无意中”掏出了一张端端正正的小纸条。
眼看四哥盯着不动，还挥了挥。
陆淮迟疑地接过一看：“雪……言？”
一笔一划的字迹，相当端正认真，甚至让人情不自禁好奇书写者写下这两个字时的神情。
“嗯！”
陆雪言扒拉着四哥的胳膊，就差急得开口说话了。
就要这个名字！
明明是叫陆雪言呀。
作者有话要说：
没错，我们宝宝叫雪言！[奶茶]
谢谢“美人受的亲亲老公”宝贝的火箭炮！是雪言宝宝的第一颗火箭炮~转圈纪念一下[撒花]
以及今天收藏突然涨的好快啊，宝贝们到底是从哪儿找来的？[害怕]
chapters.title: 第7章
chapters.translated_text:
So, what are the specific criteria for a good older brother?

Why doesn't the school teach some useful courses like this!?

Lu Xueyan couldn't help but nuzzle into his fourth brother's arms, feeling like he could smell that faint scent of oranges again.

Grandma loved peeling oranges for him to eat.

The nannies behind them, who had been a bit worried, couldn't help but smile at this scene, finding it absolutely adorable.

You know, it's really not common for Alpha brothers to get along so harmoniously.

Except for Lu Ting, the old father, who was deeply jealous.

So jealous that even work matters didn't feel as exciting anymore.

What’s even worse is that Lu Ting started uncontrollably pondering a question: what if the little one learns to call out "Brother" before he even learns to call out "Dad"?!

Just thinking about this scene made Lu Ting want to head to the company's rooftop helipad to cool off.

"Chairman, if you are really concerned about it, would you like to reconsider a new name?"

In fact, Lu Ting, who thought he was hiding it well, was radiating such an intense low-pressure aura that it was obvious to the extreme.

His spicy pheromones were so thick that even Uncle Gu in the office couldn't help but elegantly cover his nose with a handkerchief.

Furthermore, Uncle Gu felt that this probably had something to do with the scent of the pheromones as well.

Young Master Lu Huai's pheromones were a very fresh citrus scent, but Chairman Lu Ting's were the smell of tobacco.

Theoretically speaking, tobacco-scented pheromones shouldn't be too close to a cub.

Otherwise, if emotional fluctuations cause pheromones to leak, it could easily lead to the cub smelling the tobacco?

However, after turning that second half of the sentence over in his mind, Uncle Gu's extensive experience told him it was better not to say it out loud, or the situation might get even worse.

"Of course, this is absolutely not because the old name was inappropriate; rather, considering it was leaked to online platforms in advance, once it's noted by those with ill intentions, it will undoubtedly have an adverse impact on the young master's future."

The Lu family certainly had no shortage of enemies, both overt and covert.

So, after weighing his words, Uncle Gu began to offer Lu Ting a way out, his beard twitching slightly.

If System 444 were present, it would definitely exclaim that Uncle Gu’s "villainous head butler/sycophant" vibe was truly classic!

Realizing that Lu Ting was simply too proud to take the initiative to mention changing the name, he quickly found such a reasonable and logical excuse for him.

"Not bad."

Lu Ting was silent for a long moment, finally tapping his fingers on the desk a few times, feeling that Uncle Gu's consideration was very appropriate.

Even after being affirmed, Uncle Gu remained composed; he was truly a very elegant villainous butler.

Although Uncle Gu had secretly glanced at the Chairman's desk and discovered that the photo leaked online had indeed been printed and placed there.

The guest's companion might not have had a strong sense of confidentiality, but her photography skills were indeed quite good, successfully capturing the perfect shot right before the young master shed tears.

Perhaps this was one of the reasons why the Chairman didn't deal with it severely in the end?

How lucky.

"Counting the time, the matter regarding Young Master Lu Xun should be coming to an end soon."

Uncle Gu looked at the schedule and gave a reminder.

On the other side, far away at the Nadol Laboratory in Country Y, the young Alpha who had just finished this closed-door experiment saw that same photo on his phone.

The Alpha's gaze lingered on the cub's features in the photo for a long time, so much so that he completely ignored the rest of the flashing message notifications.

"Book a flight, I'm returning immediately."

"Yes."

Meanwhile, System 444 was taking advantage of a rare moment of peace to cram knowledge about the original book into its host.

[Although we don't know when this eldest brother, Lu Xun, will appear, he is definitely the number one dangerous person we need to watch out for!]

444 put a big 'X' over this photo, signaling that the cub must be very, very careful.

The key point for 444 was that its host had been born for several days now, and this so-called eldest brother, Lu Xun, hadn't shown his face at all—what does that mean?

It means this guy might be so cold-blooded that he doesn't care about the size of his family at all!

And according to the plot development in the original book, when their father, Lu Ting, was later accused of multiple crimes and faced the risk of imprisonment, the eldest son, Lu Xun, who had officially taken over the board of directors, directly and cold-bloodedly ordered the cutting of risks and assets.

Although this was seen as a means of maximizing profits at the time, it was also considered by the outside world to be completely inhumane, remaining indifferent even as his own kin went to prison.

But this didn't seem like a plot suitable for telling a cub.

Caught in a dilemma, 444 finally looked at its host, who nodded very seriously.

"Mm!"

Although it didn't know what the little one was "mhm-ing" about, it was very comforting to the system regardless.

After all, we are now wealthy people with 110 points.

Before this, System 444 had never imagined that points could be obtained so easily.

[Could it be that Lu Ting, this big villain, really has a heart to repent and is considering coming up with a new name?]

In a sense, being able to realize that the name he chose was truly terrible and being willing to reconsider does mean he is slightly less arrogant.

After all, with Lu Ting's status, apart from his family who would dare to raise objections, which of the employees and subordinates around him would lack the awareness to openly offer opinions?

On the contrary, they would probably scramble to flatter and agree with him.

The final ending of such a high-ranking villain in the original book definitely had a lot to do with this specific trait.

So, once this villainous trait was influenced by its host, was it judged by the Main Brain as an important impact?

However, Lu Ting did indeed hold a rare family meeting the next evening, stating with a serious expression that he needed to reconsider a name for the little one.

The reason was exactly that the previous name had already been made public online, and if it were noted by someone with ill intentions, there would clearly be adverse factors.

"Saying it so nicely, I think it's clearly because..."

Lu Huai was halfway through his quiet grumbling when he was glanced at by his father, Lu Ting, and immediately shut his mouth.

"The key is, why didn't anyone take a photo of me holding my little brother? This photo makes Dad look so handsome, it's too deceptive."

Carefully zooming in and out on the photo that had caused such a stir online, Lu Huai thought he should ask the other person if they had taken any other pictures.

Regarding this, Lu Jing glanced at the fourth brother, suspecting that this guy was practically walking on his father's temper on purpose.

"Fourth brother, I remember you thought of a bunch of names before; there happens to be a dictionary here, if you really want to rethink it, just use it."

So, just before his father, Lu Ting, could erupt, Lu Jing raised an eyebrow slightly and sent him away.

This guy, the fourth brother, was still too carried away.

But the smell of citrus and tobacco fighting each other wasn't very pleasant; that's the one thing about a family of Alphas that's unbearable.

"A dictionary? Oh... then I'll go get it."

Lu Huai, hands in his pockets, was somewhat reluctantly sent upstairs.

Hah, these people, even though they looked down on the names he came up with before.

Lu Huai's temper actually hadn't been very good for a long time.

Although by the time he was born, the Lu family had already developed into a behemoth that couldn't be ignored, and his older brothers mostly had their own careers, this also led to Lu Huai having almost no interaction with his father, Lu Ting, and the others during his formative years.

Returning home meant nothing more than empty rooms.

Even the number of times he had interacted with them during this period was almost catching up to the previous year.

But just as Lu Huai was walking downstairs with the dictionary, he suddenly noticed a small figure on the stairs, looking up at him expectantly from a nanny's arms.

It was Lu Xueyan, who had heard the commotion and anxiously asked the nanny to carry him to see his fourth brother! Lu Xueyan hadn't expected to be able to use it so quickly.

"The young master heard the noise and kept pulling me to come find someone, so I guessed he must have missed you."

The nanny's explanation, delivered with a smile, made the cub's eyes light up with emotion, and he nodded hard to indicate: That's right, exactly!

As for Lu Huai, who had been in a bad mood, in this instant, everything blossomed into spring, enough to forgive the whole world.

How could such a perfect little cutie of a younger brother exist in the world?

He crouched down and reached out to hug the lunging cub; Lu Huai's posture was so skilled it could be called a rapid improvement.

It makes one wonder if, while in class at school, this guy was actually just slacking off on his phone, learning a hundred ways to take care of a cub.

"You take the book down."

Lu Huai signaled for the nanny to take the dictionary, but Lu Xueyan in his arms tugged at his fourth brother's hem.

The next moment, he tried his best to reach out and hug the heavy dictionary tightly.

And "accidentally" pulled a neatly written little note out from inside.

Seeing his fourth brother staring at it without moving, he even waved it.

Lu Huai hesitantly took it and looked: "Xue... yan?"

The handwriting was stroke by stroke, quite neat and earnest, even making one uncontrollably curious about the expression of the person who wrote these two characters.

"Mm!"

Lu Xueyan clung to his fourth brother's arm, almost anxious enough to start talking.

He wanted this name!

It was clearly meant to be Lu Xueyan.

The author has something to say:

That's right, our baby is named Xueyan! [Milk Tea]

Thank you to the treasure "Beauty Uke's Kissing Husband" for the rocket launcher! It's baby Xueyan's first rocket launcher~ Spinning around to commemorate it [Scattering Flowers]

And the favorites have been growing so fast today, where on earth did you treasures find this? [Scared]

chapters.source_text:
陆淮守着跟自家弟弟的小秘密，€€瑟地挥了挥手，做了个扒饭的动作。
而雪言也抿唇笑了，又被四哥逗得开心起来。
除了陆巡看着眼皮子底下的这一幕，内心那种微妙的失落感更盛了。
说实话，从小到大，陆巡的确一直自认为自己作为家中长子，做什么都应该做到最好，也可以轻而易举地做到最好。
就像哪怕自己最初对公司集团里的这些事务并不那么感兴趣，也同样可以在接手之后，迅速让那些跟在父亲身后多年的元老们心服口服。
唯独在带弟弟这一点上，让陆巡第一次产生了一种落败感。
时间还早，也才上午十点左右。
父子二人带着被笼子关着的小鸟走在集市上，在他们的带动下，裴朔看到了更多的画面。
魔药、魔法卷轴、魔力餐、轻甲、重甲等等花样繁多的摊位。
忽地，年轻男子停下脚步。
裴朔眨巴眨巴眼睛，有些疑惑，下一刻，就见一位看起来三十岁左右的年轻男子牵着一个看起来和陆雪言差不多的男孩走到他的面前，说道：“好巧啊，凯里。”
裴朔想，凯里应该就是浅金色头发小朋友的爸爸。
陆雪言负责提鸟笼，幼崽身高矮，裴朔想要看清现状，它的爪爪紧紧扒在顶上的笼，以躺吊的姿势盯着面前的几个人。
实在是那双斗鸡眼存在感十足，年轻男人与另一个小幼崽目光齐齐看向笼中的白色小鸟。
顺着二人的目光，白色小鸟歪了歪脑壳，一双豆丁眼跟着挪动。
男人牵着的小男孩皱眉，说道：“好丑一只鸡。”
白色小鸟炸毛，“啾啾！”它好生气。
陆雪言安抚一般摸了摸笼中吊起来的小鸟。
顺着陆雪言的动作，白色小鸟小尖嘴一上一下，试图找机会叨幼崽。
陆雪言避开白色小鸡的攻击，一双湛蓝色的眸子直直看着对面的小男孩，声音认真说道：“卡莱尔，它还小，羽管破开，它会非常漂亮。”语毕，他目光一转，礼貌地向年轻男子问候。
两个家长简单聊了聊。
年轻男子说道：“落日小学半个月后就要开学，卡莱尔从几天之前就一直让我带他来买东西，我今天过来，看来你也是。”
凯里点头，“是的。”
年轻男子：“如果我们家的卡莱尔与陆雪言能进同一个班级就好了。”
凯里笑了笑：“随缘。”
鸟笼中的裴朔尝试了好几次，都叨不到陆雪言，它一双斗鸡眼看看年轻男子，又看看凯里，从这两个家长的对话捕捉有用的信息。
落日小学，半个月后开学，如果是同班……
除非落日小学年年分班，那么，很大概率，这两个小幼崽应该是从幼儿园到小学。就像自己完全比不过老四。
但或许也是因为，自己的性格的确太无趣严厉了一点。
陆巡回忆着曾经路过茶水间时，听到手下对自己的悄声议论，只不过当时的陆巡完全没有在意。
单纯冷着脸站在了转角处，看着那群年轻员工吓到魂飞魄散，疯狂道歉鞠躬后才在自己颔首示意下仓皇逃跑了。
事后陆巡也并没有像众人猜测那样，把这几个年轻员工给开除。
因为陆巡觉得这些议论也没什么问题，唯一的问题就是行事不够谨慎，居然被自己听到了。
难道今天自己跟老爸过去抓老四，也会让小家伙觉得自己很凶？甚至……会很畏惧？
向来不在意这一点的陆巡，第一次觉得不可接受起来。
光是想想小家伙看见自己紧张、畏惧的模样，陆巡的内心就非常不虞。
然而就在陆巡沉默不语地走向卧室时，抱着花篮的雪言，就抬头看了看好像在走神的哥哥，伸手摸了一下哥哥的唇角。
“哥哥还在不开心？”
否则怎么会嘴角一直紧绷呢？
虽然哥哥不开心时候的样子，也很好看。
chapters.translated_text:
Lu Huai kept his little secret with his younger brother, waved his hand smugly, and made a gesture of shovelling food into his mouth.

Xueyan also pursed her lips and smiled, cheered up again by the fourth brother.

Only Lu Xun, watching this scene unfold right before his eyes, felt an even stronger sense of subtle disappointment in his heart.

To be honest, growing up, Lu Xun had indeed always believed that as the eldest son of the family, whatever he did should be done to the best of his ability, and he could easily do it to the best of his ability.

Just like how, even though he wasn't initially all that interested in the affairs of the corporate group, he was still able to quickly win the sincere respect of the veterans who had followed his father for many years right after taking over.

It was only in the matter of raising a younger brother that Lu Xun felt a sense of defeat for the first time.

It was still early, only around ten in the morning.

The father and son walked through the market with the caged little bird, and driven by them, Pei Shuo saw even more sights.

A wide variety of stalls selling potions, magic scrolls, magic meals, light armor, heavy armor, and so on.

Suddenly, the young man stopped in his tracks.

Pei Shuo blinked, somewhat puzzled. The next moment, he saw a young man looking to be around thirty years old, holding hands with a boy who looked similar to Lu Xueyan, walk up to him and say, "What a coincidence, Kairui."

Pei Shuo thought that Kairui must be the father of the light-golden-haired little kid.

Lu Xueyan was in charge of carrying the birdcage. Since the cub was short, Pei Shuo wanted to see the current situation clearly, so its claws clung tightly to the top of the cage, staring at the few people in front of it in a hanging, upside-down posture.

Really, those cross-eyes had an overwhelming presence. The young man and the other little cub both turned their gazes simultaneously toward the white little bird in the cage.

Following the two people's gazes, the white little bird tilted its head, and a pair of bead-like eyes moved along with it.

The little boy held by the man frowned and said, "What an ugly chicken."

The white little bird bristled, "Chirp chirp!" It was so angry.

Lu Xueyan stroked the hanging little bird in the cage soothingly.

Following Lu Xueyan's movement, the white little bird's small pointed beak bobbed up and down, trying to find an opportunity to peck the cub.

Lu Xueyan avoided the white little chick's attack, his pair of azure-blue eyes gazing straight at the little boy opposite him, and said in a serious voice, "Carlisle, it's still young. Once its pinfeathers open up, it will be very pretty." With that, his gaze shifted, and he politely greeted the young man.

The two parents chatted briefly.

The young man said, "Sunset Elementary School starts in half a month. Carlisle has been bugging me to bring him here to buy things since a few days ago. Since I came today, it looks like you did too."

Kairui nodded, "Yes."

The young man: "If our Carlisle and Lu Xueyan could get into the same class, that would be great."

Kairui smiled: "It depends on fate."

Pei Shuo in the birdcage tried several times but couldn't reach Lu Xueyan. With his cross-eyes, he looked at the young man, then at Kairui, capturing useful information from the conversation between these two parents.

Sunset Elementary School, starting school in half a month, if they end up in the same class...

Unless Sunset Elementary School shuffles classes every year, then in all likelihood, these two little cubs should have been together from kindergarten through elementary school. It was just like how he completely couldn't compare to the fourth brother.

But perhaps it was also because his own personality was indeed a bit too boring and stern.

Lu Xun recalled the times he had passed by the pantry and overheard his subordinates whispering about him, only back then Lu Xun hadn't cared at all.

He had simply stood with a cold face at the corner, watching that group of young employees get scared out of their wits, frantically apologizing and bowing before fleeing in panic only after he gave a slight nod of acknowledgment.

Afterward, Lu Xun didn't fire those young employees as everyone had guessed.

Because Lu Xun felt that those discussions weren't a problem; the only problem was that they weren't discreet enough to avoid being heard by him.

Would today, as he and his dad went over to catch the fourth brother, also make the little fellow feel that he was very fierce? Even... very fearful of him?

Lu Xun, who had never cared about this before, found it unacceptable for the first time.

Just thinking about the little fellow's nervous and fearful expression upon seeing him filled Lu Xun's heart with intense displeasure.

Yet just as Lu Xun walked toward the bedroom in silence, Xueyan, holding a basket of flowers, looked up at the brother who seemed to be lost in thought, and reached out to gently touch the corner of his brother's lips.

"Is big brother still unhappy?"

Otherwise, why would the corners of his mouth stay tense all this time?

Even though big brother looked very good-looking even when he was unhappy.

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 47: What’s in Brother Huai’s Schoolbag Today
chapters.title: 第47章 今天淮哥的书包里
chapters.source_text:
完全没料到的是，就连班主任申慧敏，都有点PTSD地优先看向了陆淮的书包。
于是在全班再一次响起的笑声里，陆淮直接无语摆烂地给书包展示起来了。
里面除了书其他空空如也，更何况大小也比登山包小少很多很多，申慧敏老师这才松了一口气。
陆淮心想自己倒是想带，这不是目前完全带不出来了吗？
虽然真的带过来了，估计课也别上了，自己肯定每隔三秒亲一口。
“不过陆淮你周末回家，家里人对你还好吧？”
尽管如此，申慧敏老师第一次看向陆淮这孩子的目光里带上了一点同情和关切。
换做以前，能够得到申慧敏这种关注的，只有班上几个家境不太好的优等生。
但是申慧敏一想到陆家那几位家长极其冷酷暴戾的教育手段，就情不自禁对陆淮浮现了几分愧疚之意。
可能出生在这种豪门家庭的陆淮，也是有自身烦恼与不幸的，以前倒是自己太狭隘刻板了。
竹节虫停停走走，大概半个小时后，凯里带着陆雪言下车。
笼中的白色小鸡顿时活跃了起来，它对这个世界拥有很强的探索欲，小爪爪灵活地抓握住笼丝四处挪动，上上下下各个方位打量这一片区域。
果然。
看起来就是一个非常老旧的地方。
街道上行走的人与集市上的人比起来衣着更为破旧，缝缝补补破洞一堆，街道两边还有一些人直接在地上铺上布料售卖一些物品，有蔬菜、甘草，还有手工编织的竹筐等等。
很明显，大家彼此认识，其中有些人向凯里打招呼。
凯里礼貌回应，又或者先与对方打招呼。
大概步行十几分钟，他们进入一个小巷子，是一个群居楼。
楼梯在外，从外就能够看到一个个的房门，就，很标准的贫民区房。
一大一小上楼，在307停下。
白色小鸡伸长脖子去看，每一个楼层住有12户。
人多，肯定乱。
虽然这么想，白色小鸡却仍旧认认真真记路，防止自己飞丢了会找不到回家的路。
头一次被申慧敏老师这么和颜悦色对待的陆淮感觉很怪。
不是，野炊回来一趟自己成大熊猫了？
“淮哥，你生日什么时候啊？”
还有人课下询问了起来。
“干嘛？”陆淮掀起眼皮瞥了一眼。
“你生日的时候，可以邀请班上同学去你家做客么？”
话还没说话，就被陆淮冷笑着接下去了。
“诶，对对对！”
对面顿时大喜。
不过这次的陆淮，倒是罕见没有发火或拒绝。
因为陆淮突然想起来雪言冬天的生日了，虽然还有几个月。
凯里将手上的物品放到地上，打开房间门。
一大一小带着满满当当的物品进入房间。
裴朔精神一振，立刻拉长脖子观察自己未来的地盘。
小两居室的房子，一个客厅，面积60平方左右。
裴朔上辈子在末世苟了很长一段时间，各种脏乱差的环境都住过，倒是不觉得新家不好，至少这里被凯里整理的非常干净，处处都有温馨的痕迹。
白色小鸡在笼中转来转去，全面打量新地盘。
两间卧室的门都开着，南向单边窗，通风不太好，没有餐厅，客厅摆放着一张餐桌，桌上还装点着鲜花。
裴朔第一想法是，这个家庭的男主人很热爱生活，下一刻，他将这个想法抛出脑海。
只有两张餐椅。
从接触这对父子到现在，小幼崽从来没有提过“妈妈”，再加上只有两张餐椅……
裴朔猜测，这个家庭或许并没有男主人。
他有些不太高兴。
而此时普林斯特幼儿园里，姜娴老师正意外地看向班级门外，专业的快递团队往班上送来了一只又一只的小花篮。
“是的，下订单的顾客是这位陆巡先生，吩咐我们给弟弟班上的小朋友们一人送一只，包括每位老师也都有。”
负责人运送完毕后，才让姜老师签单确认收货。
心想这种贵族幼儿园就是不一样的，家长真是大手笔，一看就不便宜的花一送直接送全班。
反倒是雪言有点不好意思，没想到哥哥居然会直接安排人寄到幼儿园来了。
连隔壁几个班的小朋友跟老师都在往这里看。
但今天明明也不是什么特殊的日子。
chapters.translated_text:
What no one expected was that even the homeroom teacher, Shen Huimin, would look at Lu Huai’s schoolbag with a hint of PTSD.

So, amidst the laughter that erupted in the classroom once again, Lu Huai, feeling speechless and resigned, simply opened his bag to show everyone.

Aside from books, it was completely empty, and it was much, much smaller than a hiking backpack anyway, which finally made Teacher Shen Huimin breathe a sigh of relief.

Lu Huai thought to himself that he would have liked to bring it, but it was impossible to take it out at the moment, wasn't it?

Even if he really had brought it, he probably wouldn't be able to attend class anyway, as he would definitely be kissing it every three seconds.

"But Lu Huai, when you go home on the weekend, is your family treating you well?"

Despite everything, for the first time, Teacher Shen Huimin’s gaze toward the boy, Lu Huai, held a touch of sympathy and concern.

In the past, the only students who could receive this kind of attention from Shen Huimin were the top students from less fortunate backgrounds.

But whenever Shen Huimin thought of the extremely cold and brutal educational methods used by the Lu family, she couldn't help but feel a sense of guilt toward Lu Huai.

Perhaps Lu Huai, born into such a wealthy family, had his own troubles and misfortunes; she had been too narrow-minded and rigid before.

The stick insect walked and stopped, and about half an hour later, Kairi and Lu Xueyan got off the vehicle.

The little white chick in the cage suddenly became active; it had a strong desire to explore the world, its little claws nimbly gripping the cage wires as it moved around, looking at this area from every angle, up and down.

As expected.

It looked like a very old place.

The people walking on the street were dressed much more shabbily than those at the market, with piles of patches and holes; on both sides of the street, some people laid cloth directly on the ground to sell items, including vegetables, licorice, and hand-woven bamboo baskets.

It was clear that everyone knew each other, and some of them greeted Kairi.

Kairi responded politely or initiated the greetings himself.

After walking for about ten minutes, they entered a small alleyway, which was a communal housing complex.

The stairs were on the outside, and one could see individual doors from the exterior—it was a very standard slum apartment building.

The big one and the small one went upstairs and stopped at 307.

The little white chick stretched its neck to look; there were 12 households on each floor.

With so many people, it was bound to be chaotic.

Although it thought this, the little white chick still carefully memorized the route to prevent itself from getting lost if it ever flew away and couldn't find its way home.

Lu Huai, who was being treated so kindly by Teacher Shen Huimin for the first time, felt very strange.

No, did he become a giant panda just by going on a picnic?

"Brother Huai, when is your birthday?"

Someone even asked him after class.

"Why?" Lu Huai lifted his eyelids and glanced at them.

"When it's your birthday, can you invite your classmates to your house as guests?"

Before the words were even finished, Lu Huai sneered and cut in.

"Eh, yes, yes, yes!"

The person opposite was overjoyed.

However, this time, Lu Huai rarely didn't get angry or refuse.

Because Lu Huai suddenly remembered Xueyan’s birthday in the winter, even though it was still a few months away.

Kairi placed the items he was carrying on the ground and opened the door to the room.

The big one and the small one entered the room with their hands full of items.

Pei Shuo’s spirits lifted, and he immediately stretched his neck to observe his future territory.

It was a small two-bedroom apartment with a living room, about 60 square meters in size.

In his past life, Pei Shuo had survived for a long time in the apocalypse and had lived in all kinds of dirty and messy environments, so he didn't think the new home was bad at all; at the very least, it was kept very clean by Kairi, and there were traces of warmth everywhere.

The little white chick turned around in the cage, surveying its new territory thoroughly.

The doors to both bedrooms were open, and there was a single south-facing window, though the ventilation wasn't great. There was no dining room, but a dining table was placed in the living room, decorated with fresh flowers.

Pei Shuo’s first thought was that the man of the house loved life, but the next moment, he cast that thought out of his mind.

There were only two dining chairs.

From the time he started interacting with this father and son until now, the little cub had never mentioned a "mom," and coupled with the fact that there were only two chairs...

Pei Shuo guessed that this family might not have a man of the house.

He felt a little unhappy.

Meanwhile, at Prince Kindergarten, Teacher Jiang Xian was looking in surprise outside the classroom door as a professional delivery team delivered one small flower basket after another to the class.

"Yes, the customer who placed the order is this Mr. Lu Xun. He instructed us to send one to every child in his younger brother's class, including every teacher."

After the person in charge finished the delivery, they had Teacher Jiang sign the receipt to confirm the delivery.

She thought to herself that these aristocratic kindergartens were truly different; the parents were so generous, and these flowers, which clearly weren't cheap, were being sent to the entire class.

Xueyan, on the other hand, felt a bit embarrassed, not expecting his brother to arrange for people to send them directly to the kindergarten.

Even the children and teachers from the neighboring classes were looking over.

But today wasn't any special day at all.

chapters.title: 第75章
chapters.source_text:
“哦豁€€€€我收到了，雪言给我的花，哈哈！快看，这是雪言给我的花！一共有25朵，说明雪言爱我！！”
路易举着其中一只小猫花篮顶在脑袋上，就自动忽略了所有人都有这个事实，开心地在班上转圈了。
用妈咪的话来讲，那就是只有互相喜欢的人才会送花。
对比男性，男性比较温柔，善解宠意，并且天然细心，能够更好地照顾宠物，他们还总会忍不住自我内耗，时不时想着“它从小就离开了妈妈来到我的身边”，然后无限纵容，把宠当成自己的亲生崽一般照顾。
白色小鸡不满地“啾”了一声。
陆雪言看向白色小鸡。
一人一鸡目光对上。
白色小鸡蓬毛，不满，用更大的声音叫，“啾啾啾！叽叽啾啾啾！嗷！”
陆雪言询问：“你是有什么需求吗？”顿了下，他问，“是饿了吗？”
小白鸡一双豆丁眼呈斗鸡眼状态，“啾啾叽叽叽！”
陆雪言想了想，捏了一颗种子粮给白色小鸡。
裴朔精神一振，从刚穿越成小白鸡不知道怎么干饭到现在干得特别麻溜也就用了很短的时间，它动作迅速将陆雪言手上捏着的种子粮咬进嘴壳，之后本能地想叨陆雪言一下。
陆雪言对这只白色小鸡的攻击性有些理解，眼疾手快，迅速避开。
白色小鸡盯着陆雪言，这并不影响它将嘴里的食物吃掉。
嘎嘣嘎嘣。
陆雪言又捏出一些种子粮喂白色小鸡。
而自己收到了雪言的花，那就说明雪言喜欢自己€€€€呜呼！自己也要回送~
宋知昂嫌吵地捂住耳朵，对于贺卡落款上的这个大哥陆巡，倒是产生了几分好奇与沉思。
雪言到底有几个哥哥？
自己明明记得自己的偶像叫陆淮，难道还可以改名？自己的偶像究竟是谁？？
“啊€€€€”下午。
陆雪言拿着法杖，尝试使用魔法。
裴朔又来了精神，一双豆丁眼炯炯有神地盯着陆雪言。
陆雪言感觉到裴朔看过来的目光，朝着白色小鸡看去。
一幼崽一鸡目光对视。
白色小鸡：“啾啾啾啾啾啾啾！”它催促陆雪言快点使用魔法，这还是它穿越到现在，将要第一次看到魔法！
微妙地Get到白色小鸡的急切，陆雪言使用魔法。
两分钟。
说两分钟，就是两分钟。
对裴朔来说，这是非常奇怪的体感，伴随陆雪言拿着简陋的木制法杖叽里呱啦说出裴朔完全听不懂的咒语时，它能够感觉得到，周围蓬勃的水元素凝聚。
裴朔能够感觉得到这些富有属性的元素气息。
它们围绕着法杖旋转，之后，变成一个水球。
白色小鸡：“(⊙o⊙)！”
虽然但是……
好小一颗水球。
放到上辈子的末世，这水球要比之刚觉醒异能的水系异能者随便凝聚出的水球都要小。
忍了忍，没忍住，白色小鸡斜眼看向陆雪言→_→。
又一次微妙Get到小白鸡豆丁眼中嘲笑的陆雪言：“……”
但不等宋知昂跑去问问雪言这个大哥又是谁，乐极生悲的路易就发出了一声惨叫。
原来是帮雪言一起抱下一节活动课道具的裴朔，恰好有一根跳绳不小心垂在了地上，让疯狂转圈的路易绊倒在教室里的地毯上了。
“不要啊，雪言给我的花！”
路易瞪圆了蓝色的大眼睛，眼睁睁看着被自己顶在脑袋上的花篮，一下子栽倒地上扁掉了。
嘎嘣嘎嘣。
嘎嘣嘎嘣嘎嘣嘎嘣。
从表面上看起来，一幼崽一鸡相处的还算愉快。
陆雪言喂小白鸡吃了点食物，他说道：“你乖乖在这里等……”顿了下，他又说道，“爸爸现在给你布置大笼子哦。”
嘎嘣声瞬间停止。
白色小鸡瞳孔地震，整只鸡一副不敢置信地模样看向陆雪言。
别说裴朔，就是正在忙的凯里也将目光转移向了陆雪言。
室内忽然诡异的一片安静。
陆雪言察觉到氛围有些奇怪，看看鸡脸震惊的小鸡，又看向凯里，声音乖巧询问：“爸爸？”
凯里眼皮跳了跳，看看小笼子中的蓬松鸡，目光又转移向陆雪言，与他目光对视，说道：“……你刚刚，和这小东西说话时，自称什么？”
陆雪言面上表情认真：“爸爸，我看大家都是这样的，将宠物当孩子养，我想我应该是它的爸爸。”
裴朔：“……”
凯里：“……”
裴朔震惊地看着陆雪言，特别的无语。
从小猫花篮变成小猫饼花篮了。
“路易？别哭呀……”
雪言看见路易漂亮的蓝色大眼睛里顿时全是眼泪了，下意识地想把手里的道具放到一边去安慰。
裴朔顿时一把牵住了雪言。
“也没全坏，就是不是二十五朵了，理一理还能用。”
裴朔蹲下去，非常热心地帮路易捡起来了花篮，眼疾手快地把折掉的全扔了。
刚好剩下十四朵。
14朵！？那不就是自己跟雪言的友谊要死了吗……
路易看着眼前老神在在的裴朔，顿时抱着小猫饼花篮崩溃了。
对此，裴朔直接面无表情地跨过了在地上COS路障的路不易，强行牵着忍不住担忧回头看的陆雪言继续往前走了。
“下个月我生日，你要去我家玩吗？”
在路易嚎哭的背景音中，裴朔轻声邀请了起来。
chapters.translated_text:
"Oh wow! I got it, the flower Xueyan gave me, haha! Look, look, this is the flower Xueyan gave me! There are 25 of them in total, which means Xueyan loves me!!"

Louis held one of the kitten flower baskets on top of his head, conveniently ignoring the fact that everyone else had one too, and happily spun around the classroom.

In Mommy's words, only people who like each other give flowers.

Compared to men, males are gentler, better at understanding the needs of pets, and naturally attentive, making them better at taking care of them. They also can't help but engage in self-internalization, thinking from time to time, "It left its mother to come to me when it was so small," and then indulging it infinitely, taking care of the pet as if it were their own biological child.

The little white chick let out a dissatisfied "chirp."

Lu Xueyan looked at the little white chick.

The person and the chick locked eyes.

The little white chick puffed up its feathers, dissatisfied, and called out even louder, "Chirp, chirp, chirp! Cheep, cheep, chirp! Ow!"

Lu Xueyan asked, "Do you have any needs?" He paused and asked, "Are you hungry?"

The little white chick's bean-sized eyes went cross-eyed, "Chirp, cheep, cheep!"

Lu Xueyan thought for a moment and pinched a piece of seed feed for the little white chick.

Pei Shuo's spirits lifted. It had taken very little time from when he first transmigrated into a little white chick and didn't know how to eat, to now being extremely adept at it. He quickly bit the seed feed Lu Xueyan was holding into his beak, then instinctively wanted to peck at Lu Xueyan.

Lu Xueyan understood the aggressiveness of this little white chick and, with quick eyes and fast hands, dodged it immediately.

The little white chick stared at Lu Xueyan, which didn't stop it from eating the food in its beak.

Crunch, crunch.

Lu Xueyan pinched out some more seed feed to feed the little white chick.

And since he received Xueyan's flower, it means Xueyan likes him—woohoo! He should give one back too~

Song Zhi'ang covered his ears, annoyed by the noise, but felt a bit curious and thoughtful about the name "Big Brother Lu Xun" on the card's signature.

Exactly how many older brothers does Xueyan have?

He clearly remembered his idol was named Lu Huai; could one change their name? Who exactly is his idol??

"Ah—" In the afternoon.

Lu Xueyan held his wand, attempting to use magic.

Pei Shuo perked up again, his bean-sized eyes staring intently at Lu Xueyan.

Lu Xueyan felt Pei Shuo's gaze and looked toward the little white chick.

The cub and the chick locked eyes.

Little white chick: "Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!" It urged Lu Xueyan to hurry up and use magic; this was the first time since he transmigrated that he was about to see magic!

Subtly picking up on the little white chick's eagerness, Lu Xueyan used magic.

Two minutes.

When he said two minutes, he meant two minutes.

To Pei Shuo, this was a very strange physical sensation. As Lu Xueyan held the crude wooden wand and babbled out incantations that Pei Shuo couldn't understand at all, he could feel the vigorous water elements in the surroundings gathering.

Pei Shuo could feel the aura of these elemental attributes.

They swirled around the wand and then turned into a water ball.

Little white chick: "(⊙o⊙)!"

Although, however...

Such a small water ball.

Back in the apocalypse of his previous life, this water ball was smaller than the ones casually condensed by a water-type ability user who had just awakened their powers.

He held it in, but couldn't help it; the little white chick looked at Lu Xueyan sideways →_→.

Lu Xueyan, who once again subtly caught the mockery in the little white chick's bean-sized eyes: "..."

But before Song Zhi'ang could run over to ask who this "Big Brother" was, Louis, whose joy had turned to sorrow, let out a miserable scream.

It turned out that Pei Shuo, who was helping Xueyan carry props for the next activity class, had accidentally left a jump rope dangling on the ground, causing Louis, who was spinning wildly, to trip on the classroom carpet.

"No, the flower Xueyan gave me!"

Louis widened his big blue eyes, watching helplessly as the flower basket he had been balancing on his head fell to the ground and flattened.

Crunch, crunch.

Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch.

On the surface, the cub and the chick seemed to be getting along quite well.

Lu Xueyan fed the little white chick some food and said, "You wait here obediently..." He paused and added, "Daddy is going to set up a big cage for you now."

The crunching sound stopped instantly.

The little white chick's pupils dilated in shock, and the whole chick looked at Lu Xueyan in disbelief.

Not to mention Pei Shuo, even Kairi, who was busy, shifted his gaze toward Lu Xueyan.

The room suddenly fell into an eerie silence.

Lu Xueyan sensed the strange atmosphere, looked at the shocked chick, then at Kairi, and asked in a sweet, obedient voice: "Daddy?"

Kairi's eyelid twitched. He looked at the fluffy chick in the small cage, then shifted his gaze back to Lu Xueyan, locked eyes with him, and said, "...What did you just call yourself when you were talking to this little thing?"

Lu Xueyan's expression was serious: "Daddy. I see everyone doing this, raising pets like children, so I thought I should be its daddy."

Pei Shuo: "..."

Kairi: "..."

Pei Shuo looked at Lu Xueyan in shock, feeling particularly speechless.

The kitten flower basket had turned into a kitten pancake flower basket.

"Louis? Don't cry..."

Seeing that Louis's beautiful big blue eyes were suddenly full of tears, Xueyan instinctively wanted to put down the props in his hands to comfort him.

Pei Shuo immediately grabbed Xueyan.

"It's not all ruined, it's just not twenty-five flowers anymore. It can still be used if you tidy it up."

Pei Shuo squatted down and very enthusiastically helped Louis pick up the flower basket, quickly throwing away all the broken ones with sharp eyes and fast hands.

It just so happened that fourteen remained.

14 flowers!? Doesn't that mean his friendship with Xueyan is dying...

Louis looked at the composed Pei Shuo in front of him and immediately collapsed while hugging the kitten pancake flower basket.

Regarding this, Pei Shuo expressionlessly stepped over Louis, who was acting as a road block on the floor, and forcibly pulled Lu Xueyan, who couldn't help but look back in worry, to continue walking forward.

"My birthday is next month, do you want to come to my house to play?"

Amidst the background noise of Louis's wailing, Pei Shuo extended a soft invitation.

chapters.title: 第48章 如果我是园长！
chapters.translated_text:
Hearing Pei Shuo’s birthday invitation, Xue Yan was momentarily stunned.

Because being invited to a kindergarten classmate’s birthday party was indeed a novel experience.

The most vivid memory in Xue Yan’s mind was from when he was in kindergarten; a classmate had a birthday and very grandly announced he was inviting his classmates to KFC.

The boy’s parents ran a dental clinic in town and had spoiled him since he was little. He was a bit chubby even in kindergarten and had always been a bit arrogant.

His situation was almost the complete opposite of Xue Yan, who was thin and small, with parents who worked away from home all year round.

Even though all the classmates were looking forward to being invited to eat the legendary KFC, that boy only invited a few class monitors and a few little followers who usually hung around him.

What surprised Xue Yan a little was that he, who often had to take leave and couldn't go to kindergarten, was actually invited by him.

As it happened, he had a low-grade fever on the day of the birthday party, so he couldn't make it.

It wasn't until he recovered and returned to kindergarten that Xue Yan looked at the photo of the boy wearing a gold cardstock crown and formed a vague concept of what a kindergarten birthday party was like.

When Pei Shuo has his birthday, will he also wear a gold cardstock crown? And have a three-tiered candle cake?

And there will be a big rooster in a mascot costume to take pictures with!

Thinking about it this way, Xue Yan felt that Pei Shuo would probably look better wearing the cardstock crown.

Because Pei Shuo is quite fair-skinned; even if he wore a gold crown, he wouldn't look a bit dark like that other boy did.

"What! A birthday party?"

However, before Xue Yan could answer, Louis, who was lying on the ground, keenly pricked up his ears and overheard the whisper Pei Shuo shared with Xue Yan.

And this loud, high-pitched shout naturally made all the children in the Little Iris class look over.

Although they were still young, the matter of a birthday was undoubtedly something that could pique the interest of all children.

Because a birthday naturally symbolizes delicious big cakes, countless gifts, a brightly lit banquet hall, and the joy of playing crazily for a whole day.

Not to mention that it was Pei Shuo’s birthday party!

That must be even more luxurious!

No, what kind of creature is this little cub? He actually wants to be its father! By what right does he get to be its father? With that body the size of a booger? That age the size of a booger?

After a moment’s pause, Kaelie said, "That won't do."

Lu Xueyan: "Huh?" He looked at Kaelie with his pair of azure eyes in confusion and asked, "Why?"

Kaelie: "..." He exhaled silently, looked at Lu Xueyan, then at the little white chicken, "On one hand, I don't think you are old enough to be a father; on the other hand, at my current age, I don't want to be a grandfather just yet."

Lu Xueyan: "..."

The little white chicken looked at Kaelie, then at Lu Xueyan.

Kaelie said again, "How about this: from now on, I am the father to you and this little chicken, and you are this little chicken’s big brother."

Pei Shuo: "..." The pupils in his tiny eyes continued to tremble.

Shocking!
chapters.source_text:
听到裴朔的生日邀请，雪言顿时愣了一下。
因为邀请幼儿园同学参加的生日的确是一件新奇的事情。
雪言记忆里印象最深刻的就是以前上幼儿园时，班上有一位小朋友过生日，非常豪气地宣布要邀请同学去肯德基。
对方的父母在镇子上开了一家牙科诊所，从小对儿子很是溺爱，幼儿园就养得有点胖胖的，向来也有点傲气。
几乎跟瘦瘦小小一只，父母还常年在外打工的雪言是两种境遇。
哪怕所有同学都很期待被邀请去吃传说中的肯德基，这位小朋友也还是只肯邀请了几位班上的班委，以及几位平时跟在身后关系不错的小跟班。
让雪言有点意外的是，经常请假去不了幼儿园的自己居然也被对方邀请了。
偏偏参加生日聚会的那一天，自己又发低烧了，所以就没能去得成。
一直到病好了重新回幼儿园的时候，雪言才看着照片上戴着金色卡纸王冠的对方，对幼儿园的生日宴会产生了一种朦朦胧胧的概念。
裴朔过生日的时候，也会戴上金色的卡纸王冠吗？还有三层的蜡烛蛋糕？
身边还会有穿着玩偶服的大公鸡拍照！
这么想的话，雪言觉得裴朔戴卡纸王冠应该会更好看一点。
因为裴朔挺白的，就算戴上金色的王冠，也不会像那位小朋友一样有一点点显黑。
“什么！过生日？”
不过不等雪言回答，躺在地上的路易就敏锐地竖起耳朵，偷听到裴朔跟雪言说的悄悄话了。
而这嘹亮而又高亢的一嗓子，自然也让小鸢尾班的全班小朋友都看了过来。
虽然年纪还小，但是过生日这件事情无疑还是可以让所有小孩子产生兴趣的。
因为生日当然象征着好吃的大蛋糕、数不清的礼物、还有灯火辉煌的宴会厅，以及疯狂玩一整天的快乐时光。
更何况还是裴朔的生日宴会！
那肯定更加豪华了！
不是，这个小幼崽是个什么成分，他竟然想当它的爸爸！它凭什么当他的爸爸？就用这小鼻嘎一样的身体？小鼻嘎一样的年龄吗？
片刻的停顿后，凯里说道：“不行哦。”
陆雪言：“啊？”他一双湛蓝的眸子疑惑地看向凯里，询问，“为什么？”
凯里：“……”他无声吐息，看看陆雪言，又看看小白鸡，“一方面，我认为你这个年龄不适合当爸爸，另一方面，爸爸现在的这个年龄暂时还不想当爷爷。”
陆雪言：“……”
白色小鸡看看凯里，又看看陆雪言。
凯里又说：“这样吧，以后我是你和这只小鸡的爸爸，你就是这只小鸡的哥哥。”
裴朔：“……”豆丁眼中的瞳孔持续地震。
震惊！
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 48: If I Were the Principal!

chapters.source_text:
是道德的沦丧，还是人性的扭曲，父子二人竟争相想成为它的爸爸！
一直都很听话，也显得非常懂事的陆雪言在这件事上并没有立刻同意，他仍旧试图挣扎，说道：“可是，我不想当它的哥哥，我想当它的爸爸。”
凯里笑了笑，眼神温柔：“不可以哦，爸爸不允许哦。”
陆雪言：“爸爸，你要给我一个理由。”
凯里“哦”了一声，面上的表情仍旧温柔，眼神像是月光，乍看起来温柔，再看看，那就是冷凝的冰与霜，“因为六岁这个年龄没办法当爸爸，你只能当哥哥。”
陆雪言：“可是我认为宠物或许并不一样。”
凯里：“爸爸认为一样。”
父子二人目光对视。
最终以幼崽陆雪言的失败来告终，他“唉”地叹息，说道：“好的，以后我就是哥哥了。”他伸手，想摸摸笼中的小白鸡。
白色小鸡精神一振，就是这个熊崽崽，这个小鼻嘎大小的幼崽竟然想当它的爸爸！它全身羽毛蓬松，尾羽抖开，斗鸡眼盯陆雪言靠近的手，叨！
狠狠叨！
陆雪言及时将手收回，小白鸡没能叨到。
虽然但是，小白鸡一双豆丁眼紧紧盯住陆雪言的手指，眼神伴随他手指移动的轨迹，当手指靠近的刹那！
叨叨！
还是没叨到。
陆雪言可能是觉得很好玩，他用食指靠近白色小鸡，又在它将要叨到他的时候迅速将手收起来。
反反复复十几次。
白色小鸡叨不到陆雪言，超生气，小脑壳一上一下砸在笼子上。
陆雪言生怕白色小鸡没有轻重，砸伤自己，拿种子粮喂它。
裴朔想叨陆雪言，不过这并不影响它干饭，先吃再说，等吃过了，真€€小鼻嘎一样的白色小鸡战斗模式全开，就等成功叨到小幼崽，让他康康它的厉害。
叨叨叨！
还是没有叨到。
陆雪言笑了笑，说道：“弟弟真活泼。”他又说，“你要乖乖的，哥哥给你布置笼子哦。”
裴朔的盯视下，陆雪言开始布置笼子。
他年龄虽小，但手脚麻利，将小秋千、小窝、爬梯、食盆、水盆一一安装在笼子内。
一切都弄好，他拿着抹布，将笼子上上下下全部擦了一遍。
好了。
接下来最重要的就是将白色小鸡抓进笼中。
裴朔精神一振。
现在就是最关键的时刻，他要将小白鸡从小笼子中拿出来，放进大笼，但是……
陆雪言：“……”
陆雪言看小白鸡的模样就知道，这个皮皮啾已经做好了时刻叨他的准备。
同样在忙碌的凯里将这一幕看在眼中，说道：“爸爸来吧。”
白色小鸡：“……”
白色小鸡眨巴眨巴眼睛，小表情僵硬地看向凯里。
等它反应过来时，凯里已经将小笼子打开，大手直接抓住小白鸡，将它放入刚布置好的大笼子内，“咔哒”一声，笼门卡扣被关上。
陆雪言看看凯里，又看看白色小鸡。
这一刻，陆雪言意识到一件事情，这似乎并不是错觉，家庭新成员好像特别的欺软怕硬。
比如之前在竹节虫车厢上时，又好像刚刚爸爸将它从小笼中拿出来送进大笼时一般，它真的特别的会看碟下菜，好像不是一只什么好鸡。
小白鸡被放入新笼，它一双豆丁眼四处打量一番，小小的身板开始四处蹦€€，千秋上晃一晃，窝里跳一跳，两只小爪爪围绕着整个笼子爬了一圈，最终盯向关住笼的卡扣。
它觉得，这个笼门很好越狱，轻轻松松就能够越狱。
顿时，裴朔心情无比放松，按照这笼子的情况，它可以随意进进出出。
蹦€€着站在站杆上，干饭鸡开始干饭。
嘎嘣嘎嘣。
嘎嘣嘎嘣嘎嘣嘎嘣。
干几口饭，又蹦€€几下，嘬嘬水，继续干饭。
感觉到陆雪言注视过来的目光，它目光朝着它看过去，全身绒毛蓬起，又做出要叨幼崽的姿态。
凯里的声音传来，“陆雪言，洗手，该吃饭了。”
陆雪言应一声，进入洗手间洗手，他并没有关闭洗手间的门。
白色小鸡立刻在笼子里爬行，一双豆丁眼跟随陆雪言的移动转移，鸡视眈眈盯幼崽。
裴朔有点意外，明明还小，不过陆雪言洗手非常注意，一根一根地清洗手指，时间满20秒，冲刷手上的泡沫，从洗手间走出来。
凯里准备的午餐很简单，面包、鸡蛋，看着……
QAQ看着就很好吃。
裴朔想吃！
上辈子作为人，虽说末世最开始的几年吃了很多苦头，但后几年在他的治愈系异能越来越厉害后，过得还算滋润，没少吃面包与变异鸡下的蛋。
因为想吃，它急的在笼子里爬来爬去，目光眼巴巴地看向父子两人，发出想吃的声音，“啾啾啾啾啾啾啾啾……”
穿越后，裴朔发现了一点。
作为人时，说话说多了会口干舌燥累，但是穿成鸟后，虽说身形小小一只，但是从早叽叽啾啾叫到晚上都不会累。
从某方面来说，叽叽喳喳叫个不停属于鸟类的天赋技能。
陆雪言看向裴朔，说道：“爸爸，弟弟总是叫，它是怎么了？”
白色小鸡：“啾啾啾啾啾啾啾！”想吃想吃给它吃点啾啾啾！
凯里顺着陆雪言的目光看去，顿了下，说道：“它可能是对新环境很满意，是在开心的叫。”
白色小鸡震惊地瞪大眼睛，急的特别想说人话，先不提它对新环境满意不满意，它现在就想吃面包和鸡蛋！
陆雪言笑了笑，说道：“弟弟开心就好。”
凯里面上笑容温柔，“是的。”
裴朔：“啾啾啾啾啾啾！”它不开心！想吃想吃想吃！
小白鸡眼巴巴的目光下，父子二人吃过了午饭，一点残渣都没有剩下。
裴朔失魂落魄，整只鸡都要不好了，站在站架上仰头悲伤地看天花板。
陆雪言帮着凯里一起整理餐桌。
除了已经被裴朔乖乖牵回座位的雪言，对于耳畔响起的提示音，默默思索了一下。
觉得好像哪里不太对劲……
多囤点积分准没错，否则生病发烧的时候怎么兑换道具呢？
最近几次差点生病，那可都是靠着积分过的。
否则被四哥抱着出去躲猫猫出了一身汗还吹了凉风，那确实大概率得出事，所以一开始444就在系统商店里兑换了一份幼崽健康保险。
果然就知道四哥不靠谱，最终派上了大用场~
首先路易的邀请就绝对不可能答应。
自从上次家长会，老爸陆霆直接私下要求姜娴老师把路易这个小洋人调走，印象分可以说早就打成负数了。
连如今还没有太大恩怨的蒙蒂默家族都这样了，更何况最近正在业务版图上针锋相对的裴家。
单独邀请自家宿主去裴家参加生日宴会，老爸知道了绝对得爆炸，怀疑裴家是不是把鬼主意打到自家乖崽儿身上的那种程度。
当然，这些思考系统就不太好跟幼崽明说了。
反派家族的事业肉眼可见做大做强啊！
“雪言！你最后一个上台吧，讲讲你未来的职业理想是什么，可以吗？”
唯独姜娴老师在碎成一地后，已经无力思考这节课结束之后会发生什么了。
只希望下课铃前的最后一个问题能妥善落幕。
身为班长的雪言，无疑是姜老师最放心的一个。
尽管这个问题，还真的让雪言愣住了。
因为小家伙在此之前还真的从来没有奢侈地想过，如果可以一直长大的话，自己能够做什么……
chapters.translated_text:
Is it a moral decay, or a distortion of human nature, that father and son are actually competing to be its father!

Lu Xueyan, who had always been obedient and appeared very sensible, did not immediately agree to this matter. He still tried to struggle, saying, "But I don't want to be its older brother, I want to be its father."

Kairi smiled, his eyes gentle: "No, that's not allowed, Daddy says no."

Lu Xueyan: "Daddy, you have to give me a reason."

Kairi let out an "oh," his expression still gentle, his eyes like moonlight—gentle at first glance, but upon closer inspection, they were cold, frozen ice and frost: "Because at six years old, you can't be a father; you can only be an older brother."

Lu Xueyan: "But I think pets might be different."

Kairi: "Daddy thinks they are the same."

The father and son locked eyes.

It ended with the failure of the cub Lu Xueyan. He sighed "sigh" and said, "Okay, from now on I'll be the older brother." He reached out, wanting to touch the little white chick in the cage.

The little white chick perked up. This was that bratty cub! This tiny, snot-sized cub actually wanted to be its father! Its feathers puffed up, its tail feathers fanned out, and it glared at Lu Xueyan's approaching hand with cross-eyed focus—peck!

A fierce peck!

Lu Xueyan pulled his hand back just in time, and the little white chick missed.

Even so, the little white chick kept its beady eyes fixed on Lu Xueyan's fingers, tracking the trajectory of his hand. The moment the fingers got close!

Peck, peck!

Still missed.

Lu Xueyan probably thought it was fun; he brought his index finger close to the little white chick and quickly pulled it back just as it was about to peck him.

This went back and forth a dozen times.

The little white chick couldn't peck Lu Xueyan and was super angry, banging its little head against the cage.

Fearing that the little white chick might hurt itself without knowing its own strength, Lu Xueyan fed it some seed grain.

Pei Shuo wanted to peck Lu Xueyan, but that didn't stop it from eating. It decided to eat first, and once it was full, this little snot-sized white chick would go into full combat mode, just waiting to successfully peck the little cub and show him its power.

Peck, peck, peck!

Still didn't manage to peck him.

Lu Xueyan smiled and said, "Little brother is so lively." He added, "You have to be good, big brother will decorate your cage for you."

Under Pei Shuo's gaze, Lu Xueyan began to decorate the cage.

Although he was young, he was nimble; he installed the small swing, nest, ladder, food bowl, and water bowl into the cage one by one.

Once everything was set, he took a rag and wiped the cage inside and out.

Done.

The next most important thing was to catch the little white chick and put it into the cage.

Pei Shuo perked up.

Now was the most critical moment. He was going to take the little white chick out of the small cage and put it into the big one, but...

Lu Xueyan: "..."

Lu Xueyan could tell by the look on the little white chick's face that this cheeky bird was ready to peck him at any moment.

Kairi, who was also busy, saw this scene and said, "Let Daddy do it."

Little white chick: "..."

The little white chick blinked its eyes, its little expression stiffening as it looked at Kairi.

By the time it reacted, Kairi had already opened the small cage, grabbed the little white chick with his large hand, and placed it into the newly decorated large cage. With a "click," the cage door latch was closed.

Lu Xueyan looked at Kairi, then at the little white chick.

At this moment, Lu Xueyan realized something. It didn't seem to be an illusion; the new family member seemed particularly prone to bullying the weak and fearing the strong.

For example, when they were on the stick insect carriage earlier, or just now when Daddy took it out of the small cage and put it into the big one—it really knew how to read the room, and it didn't seem like a very good chicken.

The little white chick was put into the new cage. Its beady eyes looked around, and its tiny body began to bounce around. It swayed on the swing, jumped in the nest, climbed around the entire cage with its two little claws, and finally stared at the latch that locked the cage.

It felt that this cage door was easy to break out of; it could escape with ease.

Suddenly, Pei Shuo felt incredibly relaxed. Given the state of this cage, it could come and go as it pleased.

Bouncing onto the perch, the hungry chicken began to eat.

Crunch, crunch.

Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch.

It ate a few bites, bounced a few times, took a sip of water, and continued to eat.

Feeling Lu Xueyan's gaze, it looked toward him, puffed up its downy feathers, and struck a pose ready to peck the cub again.

Kairi's voice came: "Lu Xueyan, wash your hands, it's time to eat."

Lu Xueyan replied and went into the bathroom to wash his hands. He didn't close the bathroom door.

The little white chick immediately crawled around in the cage, its beady eyes following Lu Xueyan's movements, staring at the cub with predatory intent.

Pei Shuo was a bit surprised. Even though he was still young, Lu Xueyan was very careful when washing his hands, cleaning each finger one by one. After a full 20 seconds, he rinsed off the foam and walked out of the bathroom.

The lunch Kairi prepared was simple: bread and eggs, looking...

QAQ, it looked so delicious.

Pei Shuo wanted to eat!

In its past life as a human, although it suffered a lot in the first few years of the apocalypse, in the later years, as its healing ability became more powerful, it lived quite comfortably and ate plenty of bread and eggs laid by mutated chickens.

Because it wanted to eat, it crawled around the cage anxiously, looking at the father and son with longing eyes, making sounds of wanting to eat: "Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp..."

After transmigrating, Pei Shuo discovered something.

As a human, talking too much would make your mouth dry and leave you tired, but after turning into a bird, even though it was tiny, it could chirp from morning until night without getting tired.

In some ways, chirping incessantly was a bird's innate skill.

Lu Xueyan looked at Pei Shuo and said, "Daddy, little brother keeps chirping, what's wrong with it?"

Little white chick: "Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!" I want to eat, I want to eat, give me some, chirp, chirp, chirp!

Kairi looked in the direction of Lu Xueyan's gaze, paused, and said, "It might be very satisfied with the new environment and is chirping happily."

The little white chick widened its eyes in shock, so anxious it really wanted to speak human language. Never mind whether it was satisfied with the new environment or not, it wanted to eat bread and eggs right now!

Lu Xueyan smiled and said, "As long as little brother is happy."

Kairi's expression was gentle: "Yes."

Pei Shuo: "Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!" It's not happy! I want to eat, I want to eat, I want to eat!

Under the little white chick's longing gaze, the father and son finished their lunch without leaving a single crumb.

Pei Shuo was devastated; the whole chicken felt terrible, standing on the perch and looking up at the ceiling in sorrow.

Lu Xueyan helped Kairi clear the table.

Except for Xueyan, who had already been obediently led back to his seat by Pei Shuo, he silently pondered the notification sounds ringing in his ears.

He felt like something wasn't quite right...

It's never wrong to hoard more points; otherwise, how would he redeem items when he gets sick or has a fever?

The few times he almost got sick recently, he survived thanks to those points.

Otherwise, after being carried out by his fourth brother to play hide-and-seek and getting all sweaty before catching a cold, something definitely would have happened. That's why 444 had redeemed a cub health insurance policy from the system store early on.

As expected, the fourth brother was unreliable, but it ended up being very useful~

First of all, it was absolutely impossible to agree to Louis's invitation.

Ever since the last parent-teacher meeting, his dad, Lu Ting, had directly asked Teacher Jiang Xian in private to move Louis, that little foreigner, away. His impression score could be said to have hit negative numbers long ago.

Even the Montimer family, with whom there wasn't much enmity yet, had ended up like this, let alone the Pei family, who were currently at odds in terms of business territory.

If his dad found out about a private invitation for his host to attend a birthday party at the Pei family's, he would definitely explode, suspecting to the point of wondering if the Pei family had some sinister plot against his precious cub.

Of course, the system didn't find it easy to explain these thoughts to the cub.

The villain family's business was visibly growing stronger and stronger!

"Xueyan! You go up last, tell us what your future career ideal is, can you?"

Only Teacher Jiang Xian, after having shattered into pieces, no longer had the energy to think about what would happen after this class ended.

She only hoped that the last question before the bell could be settled properly.

As the class monitor, Xueyan was undoubtedly the one Teacher Jiang felt most at ease with.

Although this question really did leave Xueyan stunned.

Because the little guy had never luxuriously thought about what he could do if he could keep growing up...

chapters.source_text:
当姜老师点名到雪言的时候，班上顿时也有不少小朋友都好奇地看了过来，期待雪言会给出什么的答案。
大家对于小班长雪言的职业理想也是非常好奇的，忍不住脑海里想象雪言未来担任各种职业的模样。
裴朔更是很认真地看向了雪言。
而雪言愣怔茫然的神色，自然没有被姜娴老师错过，姜老师瞬间紧张了一下。
难不成自己点错名了？
雪言并没有准备好自己的职业理想吗？
“如果还没有想好的话也没关系的雪言，我们可以邀请其他小朋友上台……”
姜娴老师刚刚试图给雪言抛一个台阶下，就看见小家伙突然默默地举手，表示自己可以发言的。
“姜老师，雪言有话要讲！”
chapters.title: 第49章 崽卖爷田不心疼
chapters.translated_text:
When Teacher Jiang called on Xueyan, many children in the class immediately looked over with curiosity, eager to see what kind of answer she would give.

Everyone was also very curious about the career aspirations of the little class monitor, Xueyan, and couldn't help but imagine what she would look like in various professions in the future.

Pei Shuo, in particular, looked at Xueyan very earnestly.

Xueyan’s dazed and bewildered expression did not escape Teacher Jiang Xian, who felt a sudden moment of nervousness.

Could it be that she had called the wrong name?

Had Xueyan not prepared her career aspirations?

"It's okay if you haven't thought of it yet, Xueyan. We can invite another student to come up..."

Teacher Jiang Xian had just tried to offer Xueyan a way out when she saw the little one suddenly raise her hand silently, indicating that she was ready to speak.

"Teacher Jiang, Xueyan has something to say!"

Pei Shuo, who had always been a loyal observer of Xueyan in this regard, immediately interrupted Teacher Jiang and ran down to lead him to the podium himself.

The way he finally let go and stood to the side looked as if he would expel anyone on the spot who didn't listen carefully to Xueyan's career aspirations.

Teacher Jiang’s mouth twitched a few times; he really wanted to push Pei Shuo back down.

However, Xueyan, standing in the center of the podium looking a bit shy—like a startled kitten ready to bolt at any moment—forced Teacher Jiang to suppress the urge to immediately discipline Pei Shuo and his group.

Instead, he turned and looked at the cub with an encouraging gaze.

For a moment, the leaders and teachers in the back row also clearly noticed that this beautiful little guy with milky-white hair seemed to hold a very special status within the class.

He didn't have the strong presence of the previous children, yet he naturally became the center of everyone's silent attention and care.

Even the noisy little golden-haired heir of the Montimer family in the audience was watching with rapt attention.

Lu Xueyan, "No additions, thank you for your trouble."

Lu Xueyan was never picky about coffee, but he could taste that today's cup was different; the steam was infused with a fresh floral scent, and it had a faint, refreshing citrus acidity upon the first sip.

Auntie Luo not only brought the coffee but also brought him the latest updates on Xiaobai playing outdoors.

Lu Xueyan couldn't help but marvel once again at Qian Zhong's thoughtfulness. The new friend arranged for today was a pony, and they had even set up a WeChat group.

A bunch of live-streamed photos were taken from various angles, and Lu Xueyan clicked on one at random.

The sky had cleared, the meadow was boundless, and under the sunlight, Xiaobai was sitting on a brown-black pony, beads of sweat on his forehead, his fair little face blooming with a smile. The photo captured the moment: surrounded by the auntie holding a handkerchief waiting to wipe his sweat, the coach leading the horse and instructing him on the essentials, and the coach's assistant standing by to prevent any falls. He was surrounded by people, the sole focus of attention.

No wonder he hadn't made a fuss or come looking for his dad all morning; Lu Xueyan suddenly had the illusion that he was about to lose him.

Auntie Luo couldn't read his thoughts; she took back the phone and added, "Don't worry, Mr. Lu, we will take good care of the young master."

Lu Xueyan nodded faintly and took out his own phone, "Can you add me to the group?"

"Of course, of course you can."

Lu Xueyan joined the group and added Qian Zhong on WeChat.

After finishing his coffee, he took the cup to the bar to rinse it. This was the second-floor water bar that someone had mentioned last night; it was actually right by the terrace, less than ten meters from the bedroom. A refrigerator with an ice-making function was filled with various flavors of sparkling water and bottled mineral water. What Lu Xueyan didn't know was that there hadn't been any mineral water here yesterday.

Following the general description Qian Zhong gave to find the study, Lu Xueyan figured he might as well flip through some magazines since he had nothing else to do.

The thick, soft-padded wooden door was half as tall again as a standard bedroom door. With a gentle push, it was indeed unlocked, and Lu Xueyan was left speechless by the scene before him.

This wasn't a study; it was clearly a library.

The space spanned two floors with a high ceiling, with walls full of books surrounding a giant spiral staircase. It also featured a sunken reading area, complete with a fireplace, sofas, and small desks. On the other side, there was a large, L-shaped, soft-glow leather-covered desk with a triple-monitor setup and a laptop side-by-side.

Nearby were some tools Lu Xueyan didn't recognize or understand. The only decoration was a patchwork vase, which not only didn't match anything else in the room but looked completely out of place.

Lu Xueyan walked into the study along the spiral staircase and, after only a few steps, was drawn to a sign nearby: "Architectural Design."

He pulled one out at random and opened it; the pages were slightly yellowed, with a vintage feel born from the passage of time.

Familiar words jumped into his view.

In fact, the reason the Pei family had been able to stand tall throughout the long years was inextricably linked to the massive patent barriers and solid infrastructure that this family, which had gradually become a behemoth since the founding of the country, had accumulated over generations.

The most famous of these was the Kaiping International Laboratory, the first of its kind in the country, which was established under the leadership of two academicians under the Pei family's banner and had gradually developed into a world-class pharmaceutical research complex today.

This was also the key factor why the Pei family could maintain its industry status even when it became increasingly conservative and stagnant after Pei Yonghuan officially took over in the middle period.

In a word, the family fortune left by their ancestors was so deep that it would be hard to lose it all in a short time, even with mismanagement.

Especially after noticing the threat and ambition of the Lu family’s rise, Pei Yonghuan began to push for technical patent blockades at all costs.

He would rather suffer mutual destruction than compromise or cooperate, which caused the Lu family to be quite constrained in many areas.

Many forces in the industry were forced to take sides between the Pei family, an established hegemon, and the Lu family, an up-and-coming star.

Among them, this Kaiping International Laboratory of the Pei family played a decisive role, as several leading figures within it had clearly stated that they would not support the Lu family.

System 444 became conflicted.

Without even thinking, it was certain that Dad Lu Ting and the others would absolutely never agree to their precious cub being invited to the Pei family alone to attend Pei Shuo's birthday party.

They might even have an extremely bizarre chain reaction if they found out.

No, absolutely not!

Regarding this thought from 444, Xueyan pondered for a long time and also felt that it was indeed the case.

"But I might not be able to attend your birthday party, Pei Shuo... Dad and the others won't easily agree to let me go to a classmate's house alone."

Xueyan thought for a moment and then honestly explained the situation to his little friend, Pei Shuo.

This was to avoid Pei Shuo having expectations that would end in disappointment.

The most critical thing was that Xueyan felt his physical strength was very poor, and didn't birthday parties usually have a lot of games and ceremonies?

"I also have to take medicine, and I might disturb your birthday party, making it so you can't have a good time with everyone."

Strictly speaking, even Xueyan himself didn't feel he was a very suitable companion to be invited to a birthday party.

Not only would he be unable to accompany Pei Shuo in having a very happy birthday, but he might even cause Pei Shuo to be distracted by having to take care of him.

After saying this, Xueyan looked up at Pei Shuo, who hadn't reacted at all.

He realized that Pei Shuo was actually pursing his thin lips and saying nothing, his eyes lowered for the first time to stare at Xueyan, his long, thick eyelashes casting a faint shadow.

He had invited a good friend to his birthday party for the first time, only to be rejected.

In Pei Shuo's not-so-long life so far, this was indeed a first in every sense of the word.

But precisely because the person who rejected him was Xueyan, he couldn't even bring himself to be angry.

He could only sulk fiercely at himself.

Then, a pattering sound grew clearer. Lu Xueyan’s scalp tightened, his body shuddered, and the angle of his flashlight shifted, shining directly onto a decorative deer head on the corridor wall—in the half-light and half-shadow, the deer’s eyes stared straight at him, indescribably eerie and sinister.

Lu Xueyan was so scared he held his breath and, regardless of anything else, turned and ran, the beam of light shaking wildly and aimlessly in the darkness.

He hadn't run far when, "Clang—"

He didn't know what he had bumped into, but this was clearly an empty corridor!

His brain exploded in an instant. Lu Xueyan gasped, stumbled, and fell to the ground. His phone flew out of his hand, rolled once, and landed against the wall two meters away.

He closed his eyes in self-abandonment, waving his hands in front of him, "Don't come over, I have no grudge against you, I'm only staying for one night, I'll leave tomorrow morning."

A sound of *shhh-shhh*, the soft leather soles of slippers moving very lightly. Lu Xueyan couldn't think straight anymore and couldn't guess what the situation was.

The phone was picked up and handed to Lu Xueyan.

Lu Xueyan still had his eyes closed, but he felt something approaching and could see the light brighten through his eyelids. He reached out, emboldened to grope around; it was warm, and his heart instantly settled, as if he had a sense of relief after surviving a disaster.

Then, a voice without any emotion sounded in his ear: "What are you doing?"

Huh? Why did the voice sound so familiar?

Lu Xueyan tentatively opened a slit of his eyes. In his panic, he let go, his body instinctively leaning backward, his level of shock no less than before, "Why are you here?!"

Pei Shuo handed the phone forward again and asked rhetorically in a nonchalant tone, "It's my house, why can't I be here?"

"No, that's not what I meant..." Realizing he had misspoken, Lu Xueyan took back his phone and subconsciously tried to make amends, "I meant... aren't you on a business trip today..."

Damn it, it meant the same thing. For the first time, he felt powerless because of his own clumsy tongue.

Sure enough, Pei Shuo didn't give him any face and ruthlessly retorted, "One can come home even on a business trip."

The conversation was completely dead.

Until Lu Xueyan heard an even more embarrassing sentence, as Pei Shuo asked him from above, "How long do you intend to sit on the floor?"

Xueyan was left feeling a bit uncertain by Pei Shuo's reaction.

He hadn't expected such a big reaction to just declining an invitation to a birthday party.

Although Pei Shuo didn't usually like to talk much, Xueyan could feel that the two states were different.

Just as he was about to lean over to comfort his good friend, a cheer suddenly erupted from the side.

"Yo-ho—Xueyan rejected you, yay, Pei Shuo got rejected too, hahaha~"

It was Louis, who had been nervously eavesdropping, cheering triumphantly.

So you have days like this too, huh?

"Wise choice! Xueyan, you should just wait a few more months and come to my birthday party! I promise it'll be so much fun~"

"Let's go to Universal Studios for our birthday, how about that? Let Mom book it for us for a day!"

Louis was already on the verge of finding Teacher Jiang Xian to call his mother, Ms. Julia, immediately to ask if he could celebrate his birthday six months early this year.

In any case, he couldn't be slower than Pei Shuo!

The key was that Louis didn't think Pei Shuo's birthday party could be that fun anyway.

Meanwhile, Song Zhiang, who had long sensed the danger and quietly lowered his presence, looked at Louis cheering and jumping around, and subtly raised the picture book in his hand to cover his face.

He couldn't bear to watch what would happen next.

At this moment, Song Zhiang truly suspected that if Pei Shuo ever became the principal, the first person he would expel from Princeton would be Louis.

Pei Shuo: ...

Pei Shuo sneered.

But before Pei Shuo, who had been sulking at himself a second ago, could react, Xueyan, realizing something was wrong, had already grabbed Pei Shuo's hand.

"Then I won't go to Louis's birthday party either, okay?"

It was the same tone the class monitor used to coax a child.

在这方面向来是雪言忠实观察员的裴朔立即打断了姜老师，并且跑下去亲自给人牵上讲台了。
最后松手站在一旁的模样，就像谁不认真听雪言的职业理想，就会当场把谁开除一样。
姜老师嘴角抽搐了几下，很想给裴朔按下去。
奈何有点腼腆地站在讲台中央的雪言，就像受惊了随时会跑掉的小猫，让姜老师不得不按捺住了立刻修理裴朔一行人的冲动。
转而带上了一种鼓励的眼神看向了幼崽。
一时间后排的领导老师们，也显而易见地发现这位有着奶白色发丝的漂亮小家伙，似乎在班级内部有着一种很特殊的地位。
并没有前面几位小朋友那么强势的存在感，却自然而然地成为所有人默默关注在意的中心。
就连台下蒙蒂默家那只吵吵闹闹的首富小金毛，都聚精会神地看了过去。
陆雪言，“不加，麻烦您了。”
陆雪言喝咖啡从不挑剔，也能尝出今天这杯不一样，水汽氤氲着清新花香，入口有淡淡柑橘的酸甜，很爽口。
罗阿姨不仅送了咖啡来，还为他带来小白在户外玩耍的最新动态。
陆雪言不得不再次感叹，钱忠的周道。今天安排的新朋友是一匹小马驹，微信群都拉好了。
现场直播照片各种角度拍了一堆，陆雪言随意点开一张。
天晴了，草甸无垠，言光下小白坐在一匹棕黑色马驹上，额角有汗滴，白皙的小脸蛋笑靥如花。照片定格瞬间，身旁围着举起手帕伺机为他擦汗的阿姨，边牵马边指导动作要领的教练，还有随时警惕防止跌落的教练助理，他被人群簇拥，是唯一的焦点。
难怪一早上不吵也不闹，更没有来找爸爸，陆雪言突然生出一种要失去他的错觉。
罗阿姨看不出他的心思，收回手机又补了一句：“陆先生放心吧，会把小少爷照看好的。”
陆雪言淡淡点了下头，拿出自己的手机，“能拉我进群吗？”
“当然，当然可以。”
陆雪言进了群，又添加了钱忠的微信。
一杯咖啡喝完，顺手把杯子带到吧台冲洗了。就是昨晚某人口中的二楼水吧，其实就在露台边上，距离卧室不足十米的地方。一台带制冰功能的冰箱，被各种口味的气泡水和瓶装矿泉水占满，陆雪言不知道的是，这里昨天还没有矿泉水。
按照钱忠给的大概描述去找书房，陆雪言寻思闲着也是闲着，去翻翻杂志也好。
厚实的软包木门比普通卧室门高出一半，轻轻一推，果然没锁，陆雪言被眼前景象震惊得说不出话来。
这哪是书房，分明是图书馆。
向下两层楼的挑高空间，四周满墙书籍环绕着巨型旋梯，又设下沉式阅读区，壁炉沙发小书桌一应俱全。另一边，一张七字形柔光牛皮全覆盖的大书桌，三连屏电脑屏幕和一台笔记本并排。
旁边有一些陆雪言不认识看不懂的工具，唯一装饰物是一个拼接花瓶，不仅跟周围一切都不搭，反而格格不入。
陆雪言沿着旋梯步入书房，没走出几步就被身边标识牌吸引€€€€€€‘建筑设计类’。
随手抽出一本翻开，内页微黄，有种时间沉淀下的复古感。
似曾相识的字句跳入眼帘。
事实上，裴家之所以能够在漫长的岁月里屹立不倒，跟这个早在建国之初就已经逐渐成为庞然大物的家族，这些年祖祖辈辈积累出来的庞大专利壁垒和雄厚基础建设是有着密不可分关系的。
其中最负盛名的，就是裴家旗下当年由两位院士坐镇，牵头成立的国内第一所开平国际实验所，并且逐步发展成为了如今世界一流的医药科研综合体。
这也是为什么裴家中期在裴永桓正式接管后，日趋保守和止步不前的状态下，依然可以维持业界地位的关键因素。
一句话就是祖上留下的家底实在太厚了，亏起来一时半会都很难亏光。
尤其后期察觉到陆家后来居上的威胁与野心之后，裴永桓更是开始不惜一切代价推动技术专利封锁。
宁可两败俱伤也绝不妥协合作，导致陆家很多地方颇受掣肘。
业内的诸多势力也不得不在裴、陆两家一个守成霸主，一个后起之秀之间开始被迫站队。
其中裴家的这座开平国际实验所就起到了举足轻重的作用，因为里面几位泰斗级人物明确表示了对陆家不予支持。
系统444纠结了起来。
想都不用想，都可以确定老爸陆霆他们是绝对不可能同意自家乖崽儿一个人被邀请去裴家参加裴朔的生日宴的。
甚至说不定知道后还会产生极其诡异的连锁反应。
不行，绝对不行！
对于444的这个想法，雪言思索了半天，也确实觉得是这样的。
“但是你的生日宴会，我不一定能参加的呀，裴朔……爸爸他们很难答应我一个人去同学家里玩的。”
雪言想了想，还是老老实实地跟小伙伴裴朔交代起来了这件事。
以免裴朔期待到最后希望落空。
最关键的是，雪言觉得自己体力也很差，而生日宴会不是一般都会有很多游戏跟仪式么？
“我还得吃药，说不定还会打扰你的生日宴会，让你没法跟大家玩的很开心。”
严格意义上来讲，就连雪言自己也不觉得自己是一名很适合被邀请参加生日宴的小伙伴。
不仅没法陪裴朔过一个很开心的生日，说不定还会让裴朔反过来分心照顾自己。
雪言说完这番话后，抬头看向了一直没反应的裴朔。
才发现裴朔居然抿起薄唇不说话了，眼睛也第一次垂了下来盯着雪言，长而浓密的眼睫毛投落了一片淡淡的阴影。
第一次主动邀请好朋友参加生日宴会，就被拒绝了。
这在裴朔截至目前并不算长的人生里，确实是各种意义上的第一次。
但偏偏因为拒绝自己的人是雪言，所以就连生气不舍得生气。
只能自己狠狠地生自己的闷气。
紧接着踢踏一下，声音逐渐清晰起来，陆雪言头皮一紧，身体跟着抖了下，手电筒角度照歪，正正对上廊边的装饰鹿头€€€€€€半明半暗中鹿眼直勾勾跟他对视，说不出的鬼魅阴森。
陆雪言被吓得屏住呼吸，不管不顾拔腿就跑，光束在黑暗中毫无章法乱摇。
没跑出多远，“咣当€€€€€€”
不知撞上了什么东西，可这明明是条空旷的回廊啊！
脑袋里瞬间炸了，陆雪言惊呼出声，踉跄着跌坐在地上，手机也甩飞出去，滚了一圈摔在离他两米开外的墙边。
他自暴自弃地紧闭双眼，双手在身前来回挥舞，“别过来啊，我跟你无冤无仇，我只借住一晚，明早就走。”
一阵€€€€€€€€，真皮软底拖鞋走动起来声音很轻。陆雪言这时已经无法正常思考，根本推测不出眼下是什么状况。
手机被捡回来递到陆雪言眼前。
陆雪言眼睛仍闭着，感觉到有东西靠近，隔着眼皮能看到光线亮了。探出手，大着胆子摸索了下，温热的，心里瞬间踏实不少，仿佛有种劫后裴生的心安。
继而耳边响起不带任何情绪的一句：“你在干什么？”
€€？声音有点耳熟怎么回事。
陆雪言试探性睁开一条眼缝，惊慌失措中松开手，身体本能地向后倾，惊吓程度不比刚才受到的少，“你为什么在？！”
裴朔拿着手机的手又往前递了递，轻描淡写反问道：“我的家，我为什么不能在？”
“不是，不是这个意思……”自知失言，陆雪言接回手机下意识找补，“我的意思是……你不是今天出差……”
完蛋，还是一个意思，他第一次因自己嘴笨而深感无力。
果然，裴朔不给他一点面子，无情反驳：“出差也可以回家。”
这天彻底聊不下去了。
直到陆雪言听到更丢脸的一句，是裴朔居高临下地问他：“你还要在地上坐到什么时候？”
雪言被裴朔的反应弄得有点不确信了。
没想到拒绝一下生日宴会的邀请，反应会这么大？
虽然裴朔平时也不怎么喜欢说话，但是雪言能感觉得出来两种状态不太一样。
正要凑过去慰问一下自己的好朋友，一旁就突然响起来了一道欢呼声。
“哟嚯€€€€雪言拒绝你喽，耶，裴朔也被拒绝了哈哈哈~”
赫然是原本紧张万分在凑过来偷听的路易，得意地欢呼了起来。
原来你这家伙也有这一天？
“明智的选择！雪言你还是等再过几个月，来参加我的生日宴吧！我保证可好玩了~”
“我们到时候去环球影城过生日，怎么样？让老妈给我们包一天！”
本来路易就差去找姜娴老师立刻打电话问问老妈茱莉娅女士，自己今年到底能不能提前半年过生日了。
总之不可以比裴朔慢！
关键路易根本不觉得裴朔的生日聚会能有多好玩。
而早就察觉到危险，默默降低存在感的宋知昂，冷不丁看着路易在这边欢呼雀跃，顿时微妙地抬高了手里的绘本，把脸给遮住了。
不忍心看接下来会发生的事情。
这一刻的宋知昂是真的怀疑，哪天裴朔当上园长第一个要开除普林斯特学籍的就是路易了。
裴朔：……
裴朔冷笑。
但不等前一秒还在自己生自己闷气的裴朔做出反应，意识到不妙的雪言就已经一把牵住裴朔了。
“那路易的生日聚会我也不去了，好不好？”
就班长跟哄小朋友一样的语气。
