chapters.translated_title: Chapter 50: The Toxic Only-Fans in Kindergarten
chapters.source_text:
难道现在这个机会变成我们陆家的了？
系统444翻了半天，找到了一点蛛丝马迹。
雪言倒是看着手里的表格，觉得裴朔会不会伤心？
chapters.title: 第50章 幼儿园的毒唯粉们
chapters.translated_text:
Could it be that this opportunity has now fallen to our Lu family?

System 444 searched for a long time and finally found a few clues.

Xue Yan, however, looked at the form in her hand and wondered if Pei Shuo would be sad.

chapters.title: 第78章
chapters.translated_text:
Because of his speech during the kindergarten principal election, he wasn't chosen by the principal to participate in the competition.

After all, Pei Shuo had publicly stated that he wanted to snatch the job, which seemed to have genuinely unsettled the principal.

No one wants to be unemployed.

System 444, however, felt that this plot point seemed to be missing a lot of key information.

And when Xueyan retrieved the registration form, Pei Shuo, who was the first to understand the situation, looked sternly at Teacher Jiang behind him: "Teacher Jiang, we must recommend Xueyan to sign up."

This actually amused Teacher Jiang Xian.

"Mr. Leader, you aren't Xueyan's parent, so what's the point of you saying this here?"

Although Teacher Jiang really wanted to accept the work guidance from the "wild Princeton principal" Pei Shuo, unfortunately, Pei Shuo's words carried no weight in this matter.

The phone screen was small, and it was hard on the eyes to read documents on it. After an hour or so, Lu Xueyan felt tired. He exited the interface, and the time on the main screen showed 11:30.

He put down his phone, rubbed his brow, turned to tuck in his son's quilt for the third time, and then got up and walked to the window. No wonder the room was exceptionally quiet; the windows used special triple-layered hollow soundproof glass. As soon as he pushed the window open a crack, the sound of drizzling rain mixed with the wind squeezed through the gap, followed immediately by a loud rumble of thunder.

Lu Xueyan quickly closed the window and licked his slightly dry lower lip.

The late-night snack was a bowl of fermented glutinous rice soup. Qian Zhong, out of his love for the child, assumed that he liked sweets just as much as Xiaobai did, so he specifically instructed Auntie Luo to add two extra spoonfuls of osmanthus honey, making the soup cloyingly sweet. In fact, Lu Xueyan didn't like sweets and almost never ate them, but the consequence of being unable to refuse such kindness was that he was now very thirsty.

After much hesitation, he decided to go downstairs to find water. Before leaving the room, he mentally traced the route: exit the room, turn right, cross a terrace, go down the stairs on the left, pass through the side hall, walk down a long corridor, and at the end was the living room; to the right of the living room was the open kitchen.

However, as soon as he opened the bedroom door, he hesitated. Outside, it was pitch black, and he couldn't see his own hand in front of his face. A collection of famous paintings, antiques, and ornaments were all plunged into deep ink-like darkness; no matter how expensive they were, they were not spared.

Lu Xueyan felt around the nearby wall, but couldn't find the light switch. What kind of decent household has no light at all?

The voice of Geng Le echoed in his ears: "It's like a horror movie; if there's a ghost, you can't even run away."

His Adam's apple bobbed as he swallowed dryly. He had to give himself a pep talk; after all, besides their father and son, the house included, but was not limited to, Qian Zhong and two aunties. Finally, he decided to turn on his phone's flashlight.

The beam of the flashlight could only illuminate a small corner in front of his feet, and the cork floor shimmered with silver light. The light swayed back and forth with his steps, and Lu Xueyan found that if he just focused on his feet, he didn't feel as panicked.

Crossing the terrace and going down the stairs went more smoothly than he had imagined, until he turned into the corridor connecting the main and auxiliary buildings.

Xueyan's health wasn't very good, and Teacher Jiang was indeed worried that the Lu family might not agree to let the little one participate in the competition, as it was quite physically demanding.

Hearing this, Pei Shuo's face instantly turned gloomy.

"Then I'm Louis, Xueyan's best, best friend, and I also demand that Xueyan must sign up! Wow, when the time comes, I'll go and present the award to Xueyan~ I'll have my mom sponsor the competition! She often sponsors various events and gets called to be a guest presenter!"

The bold and generous Louis was thinking that Xueyan would definitely look good standing on stage.

Isn't this much more impressive than some kindergarten performance?

Although Ms. Julia did enjoy funding charity galas or cultural and sports social events as a hobby to pass the time and as a means of socializing, she would occasionally bring her youngest son, Louis, to the scene to play.

As the youngest son of the sponsor, Louis enjoyed treatment that was absolutely no less than that of a little emperor.

"Louis, you should save some money for the family too."

Teacher Jiang Xian was truly impressed; she admired how Louis could come up with ways to spend money everywhere.

When it came to competitions, other children were all thinking about signing up to participate, but this kid was different—he wanted his family to be the sponsor of the competition... It was fortunate he didn't say he wanted his mom to pull strings for Xueyan to win an award directly.

But Louis didn't notice that after he said this, Pei Shuo, who was standing to the side, uncharacteristically didn't mock him, but instead looked over silently.

This time, Pei Shuo suddenly felt that what Louis said made quite a bit of sense.

And it was a little host competition for the TV station, too.

Lu Xueyan stood up decisively, "I'll go carry him out."

"This way." Qian Zhong hurriedly stood up, pretending to lead the way for Lu Xueyan, and dialed a call, "Hello, A-Liang, haven't you finished yet? ... I see, then how much longer will it take? ... Okay, as soon as possible."

Lu Xueyan followed Qian Zhong through the corridor, through the side hall, up to the second floor, and across the hollow terrace, finally stopping in front of a bedroom door. The door was ajar, and inside the room was an auntie slightly younger than Auntie Luo. Seeing Qian Zhong arrive, she walked out on tiptoe and said in a very, very soft voice: "The young master hasn't woken up yet."

Lu Xueyan really wanted to tell her that it wasn't necessary; once he fell asleep, even if the aunties downstairs were performing an opera, it wouldn't wake him up.

At this moment, Qian Zhong spoke up, as if he had just remembered: "By the way, the driver just said that there are still many places on the road where falling rocks haven't been cleared, but they will speed up the inspection."

"?" Lu Xueyan could no longer worry about social boundaries, "Doesn't the car that brought me here have a high enough chassis?"

Qian Zhong changed his approach to persuade him: "But it's so late, and the young master is still sleeping, so why don't you..."

"This... isn't appropriate, is it?" Lu Xueyan was likely triggered by someone's germaphobia; his first reaction to any contact was that it was improper or inappropriate.

Qian Zhong reacted immediately, "It's appropriate, very appropriate, what could be inappropriate about it?"

Seeing that Lu Xueyan hadn't agreed and looked full of concerns, Qian Zhong further elaborated: "There are many rooms here, there is enough private space, and besides, Mr. Pei is not here today."

"What? Today Xueyan was recommended to participate in the children's group little host competition! How wonderful!"

In fact, when Lan Ying, who was busy, heard the latest news about Xueyan from her son during their video call that night, she was indeed immediately interested.

You have to know that Lan Ying had long since become accustomed to her son, Pei Shuo, talking for a long time about "Xueyan..." this and that during their video calls.

She even listened with great interest.

Sometimes when she heard that Xueyan had coughed again today, or had been taken by his parents for a check-up, Ms. Lan Ying would also feel quite worried, wondering if she should find foreign doctors or experts to recommend to the Lu family.

Although if she introduced them herself, she would likely be treated as a spy.

And given the Lu family's level of care and attention, she probably wouldn't even get a chance to recommend anyone? They should have already dug up all the doctors or experts they could find.

"But if Xueyan participates, then your little notebook will have a lot more content in it."

Regarding Pei Shuo's "Xueyan Observation Diary," Lan Ying, although surprised after discovering it, did not stop him.

Instead, when she went back to play with Pei Shuo a few times, she treated it as a parent-child activity and helped her son enrich it together.

As if his thoughts had been guessed, Lu Xueyan froze for a moment.

Qian Zhong seized the opportunity and decisively said to the auntie: "Go downstairs and inform them that Mr. Lu is staying overnight, prepare fresh clothes and a guest room. Also, have the kitchen prepare a late-night snack."

Lu Xueyan: "............"

By the time Lu Xueyan was lying on a spacious, comfortable, yet unfamiliar bed, he realized belatedly that he seemed to have been tricked. Even if he hadn't been overwhelmed by fatherly love and come to pick up his son, he could have spent the night by himself. But it wasn't a complete trick; Xiaobai woke up once in the middle of the night looking for his dad, and seeing Lu Xueyan by his side, he turned over and immediately fell back asleep.

Lu Xueyan was left lying in bed staring at the ceiling. It wasn't even ten o'clock, which was actually not his biological bedtime. He was a late sleeper and often stayed up late to rush work, so he had absolutely no sleepiness right now. He thought about getting up to work, only to realize he had left his computer in Geng Le's car.

He dialed the number, and as soon as the other party picked up, Lu Xueyan said: "Was my computer towed away with your car?"

The other party let out a muffled grunt.

Lu Xueyan said again: "Then send the museum materials to my email." He suddenly realized that the breathing in the receiver was very rapid. Although he had no experience, he was an adult after all, and he blurted out, "What are you doing?"

The other party was silent for a while, then finally returned to a normal tone: "What do you mean what am I doing? Playing with toys that adults should play with at night, is that not allowed? You really have no insight at all; toys are a hundred times more interesting than you. I really haven't favored my toys for too long, which is why I've been having wild thoughts and illusions."

"Sorry, sorry, then you continue." Lu Xueyan was embarrassed beyond measure and couldn't hear any subtext, but before hanging up, he still didn't forget to remind him: "Then remember to send me the email when you're done."

Geng Le: "............"

As for this little host competition... Lan Ying felt that she could indeed arrange for her subordinates to ask which department was in charge.

"But Xueyan refuses to come to my birthday party."

Just as they were finishing their chat, Pei Shuo still said to his mother with some gloom about his biggest annoyance today.

He had been rejected by Xueyan directly.

Hearing Pei Shuo, who had been like a little ice cube all night, finally willing to speak his mind, Lan Ying, who suddenly understood, laughed uncontrollably.

"You invited someone alone and specifically asked them to come to your house to stay overnight. If I were the parent, I wouldn't be very at ease with you going to a classmate's house like that either. Who invites someone to a birthday party like you did?"

Not to mention that the other party was the Lu family; if they found out, it would be a good thing if they didn't beat Pei Shuo up.

However, Pei Shuo had been smooth sailing since he was a child, so it was good for him to encounter some setbacks.

Mocked severely by his own mother, Lan Ying, Pei Shuo pursed his lips and fell into a gloomy contemplation.

Then, if Xueyan's family didn't agree, how should he invite him so that they would agree?

This was indeed a problem that required some brainpower to think about.

During the lunch break, the atmosphere in the general office was relatively relaxed. Some who were quick had already finished lunch and returned; some who were on a diet stayed at their desks eating vegetable salads, chewing on apples and cucumbers; and others were rushing their work progress while gnawing on takeout sandwiches or fast-food burgers.

No matter how serious or rigorous the corporate culture was, it couldn't stop the employees from having a gossiping heart. It was mainly because this boss usually had no material to dig up; he didn't touch scandals, and his private life outside of work was airtight, making him a mystery in everyone's eyes.

The more this was the case, the more it piqued curiosity. Today, a child suddenly dropped from the sky, and its power was no less than dropping a heavy nuclear bomb on a calm lake.

A glance between each other, and it took less than a second to gather together, much more efficient than an emergency assembly in military training.

"Does anyone have any inside information? What exactly is that child's identity? I'm dying of curiosity; I've been tortured all morning."

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone in the large office was attracted.

The one who had finished lunch held a coffee cup, their eyes instantly lighting up, "I don't know. But to be able to let the boss bring him to work, it can't just be helping a relative, right? Look at our President Pei, does he look like someone who would babysit for others?"

"I really can't tell. I thought he had a cold face all day, and that his function in that area was also cold. I didn't expect his child to be this big!"

"Bullshit, you sound like you've never been in a relationship and have zero experience with nightlife."

Xueyan, who was holding the registration form and wanting to hand it to his parent, suddenly heard a new notification sound.

System 444 scratched its database, not knowing how the kindergarten had already started a battle of wits between the protagonists and villains.

Could it be that his dad and the others had started some thrilling villainous operation against the Pei family in advance?!

And the Lu Ting in front of him was taking the registration form handed over by his precious, obedient child and reading it carefully.

"As expected of our child! You're just that great!"

Lu Ting had only been reading for a dozen seconds before he started rubbing the little one's head and habitually praising him crazily.

Even though Lu Ting hadn't even asked how many children in the kindergarten had been recommended to participate in the competition.

But even if all the children in the kindergarten could go to the competition, it wouldn't stop Lu Ting from thinking that his own child was the best one!

"Dad, you haven't finished reading yet."

Xueyan protested softly, pointing to the back, feeling that his dad hadn't read it carefully at all.

"Isn't that right? President Pei has broad shoulders, a narrow waist, and full pectoral muscles; he looks like the capable type. Tsk tsk tsk, what kind of fairy must one look like to be worthy of him! I don't know which young lady or young master has this good fortune."

Amidst the laughter, the topic was pulled onto the highway, unable to brake, and they became more and more excited as they chatted.

Until the young lady eating salad threw her lunch box, which was as empty as her stomach, into the trash can, and tried hard to pull the car back, "What good fortune? Don't you think about how a young lady or master would be hidden away, and the child is this big without even a title?"

"That's true too. Did any of you see him this morning? How old is that child? Does he look like our boss?"

Everyone looked at each other, and no one had seen him.

Pei Shuo had his own private elevator, which was planned when the Jiaxin Center was still in the design phase, so naturally, they hadn't seen him. Moreover, he had a reputation for being a germaphobe and hating noise, so who would dare to wander around his office door? Looking at the entire company, the only ones who could have seen that child were the few staff members in the President's Secretary Office.

The one gnawing on a sandwich stopped rushing their work progress, put down their keyboard, took out their phone, and tagged the only connection in their private small group—the little sister from the President's Office.
chapters.source_text:
因为他的幼儿园园长竞选发言，导致没被园长伯伯选上去比赛。
毕竟裴朔当众表示自己想抢工作岗位，好像确实容易让园长感到不安。
谁都不希望没有工作的。
系统444倒是觉得这段剧情似乎缺少了很多关键信息。
而当雪言拿回报名表的时候，第一个了解完情况的裴朔直接严肃地看向了身后的姜老师：“姜老师，我们必须推荐雪言报名。”
这倒是让姜娴老师乐了。
“这位领导，你又不是人家雪言的家长，你在这儿说有什么用。”
这次的姜老师虽然很想接受“野生普林斯特园长”裴朔的工作指导意见，奈何这事裴朔说了又没用。
手机到底屏幕小，用来看资料很费眼，陆雪言看了个把小时就觉得累，退出界面，主屏时间显示十一点半。
他放下手机揉了揉眉心，转过头帮儿子第三次掖好被角，而后起身走到窗边。难怪室内格外安静，窗户用的是特制三层空心隔音玻璃。刚推开一点窗缝，淅沥雨声裹着风从缝隙挤进来，紧接着巨大的雷声轰鸣而至。
陆雪言连忙把窗关回去，舔了下有些干涩的下唇。
夜宵是一碗酒酿圆子羹，钱忠爱屋及乌地觉得，他也跟小白一样喜欢甜，特意吩咐罗阿姨多加两勺桂花蜜，羹汤甜到有些发腻。其实陆雪言不喜欢甜食，平时几乎不吃，盛情难却的后果就是现在很口渴。
他纠结再三，决定下楼找水喝。出门前在脑子里倒推了一下线路图，出了房门右转穿过一个露台，左手边下楼梯，穿过偏厅，走过一条长廊，尽头就是客厅，客厅的右侧是开放式厨房。
然而刚打开卧室门，他就迟疑了，外面漆黑一片，伸手不见五指。一众珍藏名画古董摆件，此时都陷入浓重墨色中，再价贵也无法幸免。
陆雪言在附近墙壁上来回探，却找不到照明灯开关。什么好人家家里一点亮光都没啊？
耳边属于耿乐的声音回荡了下€€€€€€‘演恐怖片呢，闹鬼跑都跑不掉’。
喉结滑动，干涩地空吞了下，他只得给自己做心理建设，毕竟除了他们父子还住着包括但不限于钱忠和两个阿姨，最终决定开着手机电筒去。
手电筒的光束只能照亮脚前一隅，软木地板泛上银光。光随着步幅来回晃，陆雪言发现只定睛于脚下，心里就没那么慌了。
穿过露台和下楼梯都比想象中顺利，直到拐进连接主副建筑的回廊。
雪言身体不太好，姜老师确实担心陆家未必会同意让小家伙去参加比赛，毕竟还蛮消耗体力的。
闻言裴朔瞬间脸色闷了。
“那我是路易，雪言最最最好的好朋友，我也要求雪言必须报名参加！哇喔，到时候我要去给雪言颁奖~让我妈妈赞助比赛！她经常赞助各种活动被喊去当嘉宾颁奖！”
豪气十足的路易倒是想着雪言站在台上肯定好看。
这不比什么幼儿园汇演厉害多了？
尽管茱莉娅女士确实喜欢出资赞助一些慈善晚宴或者文体类社会活动，是打发时间的兴趣爱好，也是一种社交手段，偶尔也会把小儿子路易带去现场玩玩。
作为赞助方的混血小儿子，路易享受的绝对是不亚于小皇帝的待遇。
“路易，你可也给家里省点吧。”
姜娴老师则是真是服了，对于路易什么地方都能想出花钱的点子也是很佩服。
比赛这种事情，其他小朋友都想着报名去参加，这小子倒好，想让家里去当比赛的赞助商……幸亏没说直接让他妈给雪言开后门定个奖。
但路易并没有察觉到，自己这句话说出来后，一旁的裴朔倒是罕见没有讽刺自己，而是默默看了过来。
这一次的裴朔，突然觉得路易说得挺对的。
而且还是电视台的小主持人比赛。
陆雪言果断站起身，“我去抱他出来。”
“这边走。”钱忠忙不迭跟着起身，假意为陆雪言带路，电话拨出去，“喂，阿良，你们还没搞定吗…………这样，那还要多久…………好的，尽快。”
陆雪言跟着钱忠穿过回廊，穿过偏厅，上了二楼，穿过中空露台，终于停在一间卧室门前。门虚掩着，房内有位比罗阿姨稍年轻些的阿姨，看到钱忠来，轻手轻脚走出来，用很轻很轻的声音说：“小少爷一直没醒。”
陆雪言很想告诉她，其实不必如此，他一旦睡着楼下阿€€唱戏都吵不醒。
这时钱忠开了口，仿佛刚想起来般：“对了，刚才司机说路面还有多处落石没有清理完毕，但会加快排查速度。”
“？”陆雪言再也顾不上社交尺度 ，“刚才接我来的这辆车不是底盘足够高吗？”
钱忠换了个思路劝：“但是这么晚了，小少爷又还在睡，不如…………”
“这……不合适吧。”陆雪言大概是被某人的洁癖搞到应激，每次有所联系第一反应是不妥不合适。
钱忠马上反应过来，“合适，很合适，这有什么不合适的。”
见陆雪言没答应顾虑重重的样子，钱忠又进一步阐述：“这里房间很多，有足够的私人空间，而且今天先生不在。”
“什么？今天雪言被推荐去参加幼儿组的小主持人比赛啦！怎么这么棒的！”
事实上，当晚上百忙之中打电话视频里的蓝瑛，从儿子这里获知雪言最新动态时，确实一下子产生了兴趣。
要知道蓝瑛早已经逐渐习惯打视频电话的时候，自家儿子裴朔总得说上半天“雪言……”如何如何了。
甚至还听得兴趣盎然。
有时候听到雪言今天又咳嗽了，或者被家长接去检查身体了，蓝瑛女士也会颇为忧愁，想着要不要找找国外的医生专家推荐给陆家的。
虽然自己介绍的话，很可能被当做是间谍。
而且以陆家的关心重视程度，估计也轮不到自己推荐？应该早就能把能找到的医生或者专家都挖过去了。
“但如果雪言去参加的话，那你的小本子上又能多出来很多内容了哦。”
对于裴朔的这本《雪言观察日记》，蓝瑛发现之后尽管诧异倒是也没有阻止。
而是在几次回去带裴朔玩的时候，当做亲子活动一块帮儿子丰富起来了。
好像心事被猜中，陆雪言愣了一瞬。
钱忠瞅准时机，当机立断对阿姨说：“你去楼下知会一声，陆先生晚上留宿，准备换洗衣物和客房。再让厨房准备宵夜。”
陆雪言：“…………”
等陆雪言躺在一张宽敞舒适却陌生的床上时，才后知后觉自己好像上了个当，就算不父爱泛滥来接儿子，他也能自己过夜了。但也不算完全上当，小白中途醒了一次找爸爸，看到陆雪言在身边，翻个了身就马上又睡着了。
剩下陆雪言躺在床上干瞪眼，十点不到，其实根本不到他生物钟该睡觉的时间，他晚睡又常熬夜赶工，这会儿完全没睡意，想着要不起来工作吧，才发现电脑落耿乐车上了。
电话拨出去，对方刚接起来，陆雪言就说：“我电脑是不是跟你车一起拖走了？”
对方闷哼了一声。
陆雪言又说：“那你把博物馆资料发我邮箱吧。”他突然意识到听筒里的呼吸声十分急促，虽然经验全无但毕竟是成年人，脱口而出，“你在干嘛？”
对方沉默了会，终于恢复正常语调：“什么干嘛，玩大人晚上该玩的玩具，不行吗？你真的是一点眼力见都没，玩具都比你有意思一百倍，我真是太久没有宠幸我的玩具了，才会胡思乱想有所错觉。”
“抱歉抱歉，那你继续。”陆雪言尴尬地无以复加，听不出一点话外之音，但在挂电话前仍不忘提醒：“那你结束了记得给我发邮件啊。”
耿乐：“…………”。
至于这个小主持人比赛……蓝瑛觉得自己确实可以安排属下去问问，是哪个部门在负责。
“可是雪言不肯来参加我的生日聚会。”
只是聊到最后，裴朔还是有点闷地跟妈妈说出了自己今天最大的烦恼。
自己直接被雪言拒掉了。
听到今晚脸色一直跟个小冰块似的裴朔终于肯说出心事了，恍然大悟的蓝瑛却笑得不行。
“你单独邀请人家，还点名要来家里玩到过夜，我要是家长，我也不太放心你去同学家里这样吧。哪儿有你这么喊人家来参加生日聚会的？”
更何况对方还是陆家，知道了不揍裴朔一顿都算好事了。
不过裴朔这小子从小到大顺风顺水惯了，遇到点挫折也挺好的。
被亲妈蓝瑛狠狠嘲笑了一番，裴朔倒是抿唇有点郁闷地沉思起来。
那如果雪言家里不同意的话，怎么邀请才能同意？
这确实是一件很需要动脑筋思考的问题。
午休时间，综合办公室里气氛相对轻松许多。有动作快已经吃好午餐回来的；有减肥留在工位吃蔬菜沙拉，嚼苹果黄瓜的；还有啃着外带三明治、快餐汉堡赶工作进度的。
再严肃严谨的企业文化，都不妨碍员工有颗八卦的心。主要也是这位老板平日实在无料可挖，花边新闻不沾边，工作之裴的私生活密不透风，在所有人眼中是个谜。
越是如此，越勾人好奇。今天突然空降了个孩子，其威力无异于在平静湖面投入一枚重型核弹。
彼此间一个眼神对视，凑作堆用不了一秒钟，比军训紧急集合效率高太多。
“你们谁有小道消息啊，那孩子究竟什么身份？好奇死我了，被折磨了一早上。”
此话一出，整个大办公室的人都被吸引了过来。
吃过午餐的端着咖啡，眼睛里瞬间有了光，“不知道啊。但能让老板带着上班，总不会是帮亲戚忙吧？看我们裴总，像会给别人带孩子的人嘛。”
“真看不出来，我还以为他整天冷着脸，那方面功能也很冷淡呢，没想到孩子都这么大了！”
“屁咧，你这话一听就没谈过恋爱，毫无夜生活经验。”
正拿着报名表想递给家长的雪言，就突然又听到了新的提示音。
系统444挠了挠数据库，一时间不知道怎么幼儿园就已经开始正反派斗智斗勇了。
难不成老爸他们对裴家提前开展什么惊心动魄的反派行动了？！
而眼前的陆霆正接过自家宝贝乖崽儿递过来报名表，仔仔细细地读了起来。
“不愧是我们家崽儿！就是这么棒！”
陆霆读了十几秒，就已经开始揉着小家伙的脑袋开始习惯性地疯狂夸赞了。
哪怕陆霆都还没问幼儿园里究竟有多少小朋友被推荐参赛了。
但就算是全幼儿园小朋友都能去比赛，也不妨碍陆霆觉得自家崽就是最棒的那一个！
“爸爸，你还没读完呢。”
雪言轻声抗议地指了指背面，觉得爸爸根本就没有认真看。
“可不是嘛，裴总肩宽窄腰胸肌饱满，一看就是很能干的类型。啧啧啧，得长成什么天仙样子才能配得上啊！也不知道哪家千金还是少爷有这个福气。”
嘻嘻哈哈间，话题就被扯上了高速公路，刹不住闸，越聊越兴奋。
直到吃沙拉的小姐姐把跟肚子一样空的餐盒丢进垃圾桶，努力将车头往回拉，“福气什么啊，也不想想千金少爷会被藏着掖着，孩子这么大了连个名分都没吗？”
“也对哦。你们谁早上看见过？那孩子多大了？长得像不像咱们老板？”
众人你看看我，我看看你，没人见过。
裴朔有自己的专梯，这是嘉信中心还在设计阶段就规划好的，自然没见过。而且他洁癖怕吵的名声在外，谁敢去他办公室门口瞎转悠。放眼全公司，能见过的那孩子的也就只有总裁秘书办几个职员了。
啃三明治的工作进度也不赶了，放下键盘摸出手机，在私下小群里艾特唯一的人脉€€€€总裁办小姐妹。

“哈哈，原来还有背面啊？让爸爸看看……”
陆霆一点也不尴尬地甩了甩纸，就继续翻页看了。
“啊，什么东西？什么报名表，先让我看看€€€€！”
一旁刚刚到家的陆淮也扔下书包冲过来了，试图从老爸手里夺走弟弟的资料。
生怕又来了个什么家长会，然后老爸又偷偷摸摸卑鄙至极地自己跑去参加了。
“四哥？四哥回来了！”
不过转身看见哥哥陆淮的雪言倒是更加开心，因为自己书包里还装了一些克姆林叔叔顺手给自己的药膏。
是体检的时候特地帮哥哥要的。
虽然克姆林的表情有点狐疑，就像无声地在琢磨陆淮那伤居然还没好一样的古怪。
嘉信中心的顶次两层是嘉平拍卖行总部。
总裁办公室内窗明几净，三面环绕落地窗使视野极致开阔，可以俯瞰到整个海市最繁华的商业街区。也因五百米高空无任何建筑遮挡，是极好的观星点，窗口架着一座专业级星特朗天文望远镜。
从前由专人清洁的纯黑亮面镜身不允许有半个指纹，现在握着只小肉手。小肉手一分钟前刚吃过蛋挞，还有一点点油。
油油的小肉手把玩了一会儿望远镜，无趣地抱怨：“阿忠，这个东西好没用，一颗星星也看不到。”
钱忠手中拿着湿巾顾不上擦，双臂围在两侧，生怕人从办公椅上跌落，听闻小少爷这么抱怨，宠溺一笑，眼尾笑出很多幸福纹路，“哎呦，我的小祖宗，大白天的哪里有星星，得晚上看才行。”
小白踩在真皮办公椅上也不够高，脚尖惦着，郑重其事地拒绝：“不行哦，晚上我没空，叭叭等我回家的。”
看天空看累了，角度一换，开始看远处，小白惊叫出声：“叭叭！”他转过头一脸兴奋地对钱忠重复：“我看到我叭叭了！”
钱忠当然知道小少爷口中称呼的是谁，不扫性地凑近看了一眼，“没有啊。”
小白再次对着目镜眯起眼睛，果然看不到了，“咦，怎么不见了。”
厚重的软包办公室门被推开，裴朔刚从一场会议中脱身，对话只听到一半，“什么不见了？”
小白今天早上临时交托给他，当时急着来公司，只好安置在办公室里，吩咐钱忠照顾看管。
难不成董事长背地里又往死里抽了陆淮少爷一顿？否则以Alpha的体质不至于如此吧。
就在陆淮冲过去抢报名表的时候，大哥陆巡也不知道什么时候起站在了一旁，任由陆淮动作敏捷地一把从老爸手里抢走了报名表。
“四哥……”
雪言原本激动的语气却逐渐变得狐疑起来。
因为四哥怎么跟早上出门完全不一样了。
走的时候嘴上说没事，可身体还僵硬得完全没法动后背一样，让雪言恨不得帮四哥背书包去学校。
“老四，报名表好看吗？”
对此陆巡神色淡淡，甚至罕见关怀地伸手拍了拍陆淮的后背，就像一位真正的和蔼长兄一般。
“干嘛，没看完！喂，别装了好不好？”
陆淮恶寒地回头看了陆巡一眼，不知道大哥突然发什么疯，从小打那么多次装什么装？一个弯腰就给陆巡闪开了。
chapters.translated_text:
"Haha, so there's a backside? Let Daddy take a look..."

Lu Ting shook the paper without a hint of embarrassment and continued to flip through it.

"Ah, what is that? What registration form? Let me see it first—!"

Lu Huai, who had just arrived home, also threw down his schoolbag and rushed over, trying to snatch his younger brother's documents from his father's hands.

He was terrified that there would be another parent-teacher meeting, and that his dad would sneak off to attend it in his usual despicable, underhanded way.

"Fourth Brother? Fourth Brother is back!"

However, Xueyan was even happier when he turned around and saw his brother Lu Huai, because his schoolbag still contained some ointment that Uncle Kremlin had casually given him.

He had specifically asked for it for his brother during the physical examination.

Although Kremlin’s expression had been a bit suspicious, as if he were silently wondering why Lu Huai’s injury still hadn't healed, which was quite strange.

The top two floors of the Jiaxin Center housed the headquarters of the Jiaping Auction House.

The president's office was clean and bright, with floor-to-ceiling windows surrounding three sides, offering an incredibly expansive view overlooking the most prosperous commercial district in Haishi. Because there were no buildings obstructing the view at a height of 500 meters, it was an excellent spot for stargazing, and a professional Celestron astronomical telescope was set up by the window.

The pure black, glossy surface of the telescope, which was usually cleaned by a specialist and never allowed to have even a single fingerprint on it, was now being gripped by a small, chubby hand. The chubby hand had just eaten an egg tart a minute ago and was still a little greasy.

The greasy little hand played with the telescope for a while before complaining uninterestingly, "A-Zhong, this thing is useless. I can't see a single star."

Qian Zhong, holding a wet wipe, didn't even have time to wipe his hands; he kept his arms wrapped around both sides, terrified that the little young master would fall off the office chair. Hearing the little young master's complaint, he smiled dotingly, his eye corners crinkling with happy wrinkles. "Oh, my little ancestor, how could there be stars in broad daylight? You have to look at night."

Xiaobai wasn't tall enough even while standing on the leather office chair; he stood on his tiptoes and solemnly refused, "No, I'm busy at night. Baba is waiting for me to come home."

After getting tired of looking at the sky, he changed the angle and started looking into the distance. Xiaobai cried out in surprise, "Baba!" He turned his head and repeated excitedly to Qian Zhong, "I saw my Baba!"

Qian Zhong naturally knew who the little young master was referring to, and without dampening his spirits, he leaned in to take a look. "I don't see him."

Xiaobai squinted his eyes at the eyepiece again, and sure enough, he couldn't see him anymore. "Eh, why did he disappear?"

The heavy, upholstered office door was pushed open. Pei Shuo had just gotten away from a meeting and only heard half of the conversation. "What disappeared?"

Xiaobai had been entrusted to him temporarily this morning. Since he was in a rush to get to the company, he had to settle him in the office and instruct Qian Zhong to look after him.

Could it be that the Chairman had secretly beaten young master Lu Huai to death again? Otherwise, given an Alpha's constitution, it shouldn't be like this.

Just as Lu Huai rushed over to grab the registration form, eldest brother Lu Xun, who had been standing to the side, also moved at an unknown moment, letting Lu Huai nimbly snatch the form from their father's hands.

"Fourth Brother..."

Xueyan's originally excited tone gradually turned suspicious.

Because his fourth brother was completely different from how he was when he left this morning.

When he left, he said he was fine, but his body had been so stiff that he couldn't even move his back, making Xueyan wish he could carry the schoolbag for his fourth brother.

"Fourth, is the registration form interesting?"

Lu Xun looked calm, and even reached out to pat Lu Huai on the back with rare concern, just like a truly kind older brother.

"What are you doing? I haven't finished reading it! Hey, stop pretending, okay?"

Lu Huai looked back at Lu Xun with a chill. He didn't know what kind of madness his eldest brother was having; they had fought so many times since they were kids, what was he pretending for? With a single bend of his waist, he dodged Lu Xun.

chapters.translated_text:
Even their father, Lu Ting, who had been standing to the side and intending to say something, suddenly noticed his eldest son Lu Xun’s gaze and suspiciously turned his eyes toward his fourth son, Lu Huai.

Once Lu Ting discovered the secret between the fourth son and the little one, as well as the little one’s hesitation, he was no longer in a hurry. Instead, he raised his eyebrows slightly, leaned back into the sofa, and tapped his fingers on the armrest in his habitual, rhythmic manner.

The corners of his mouth curled into an almost imperceptible arc of someone watching a show.

In fact, the entire Lu family tended to reflect on the fact that the fourth son had the best relationship with the little one.

Over the past few decades, in a family atmosphere where no one ever submitted to anyone else, there had never been such a unified proposition: on what grounds did the fourth son, Lu Huai, manage this?

Was it just because the kid had a bad temper? Or because he always acted recklessly and did whatever he pleased?

Only Lu Huai was completely immersed in looking at the registration form, wishing he could clearly see every single word related to his younger brother.

The key was that upon looking, Lu Huai was genuinely amused.

Because the venue for the selection competition happened to be at his own school!

In just over two hours, the office had undergone a massive transformation. Colorful toys and books were scattered across the dark brown sofa, some even falling onto the carpet. There were leftover food packaging and fruit peels on the coffee table, and greasy fingerprints were visible everywhere.

Pei Shuo’s brows furrowed involuntarily.

Qian Zhong had long since mastered the art of reading every tiny expression of his boss. In the past, he would have handled things efficiently without needing to be told, but things were different now; he felt a sense of relief, as if a long-standing grievance finally had someone to back him up.

He said with unearned confidence, "Let's clean it all up after work."

Hearing the commotion, Xiaobai turned around and saw Pei Shuo had entered. He was startled, immediately slid off the chair, and sat on the sofa to read his book obediently.

Seeing this, Qian Zhong couldn't help but advise: "Look, you’re so stern that you’ve scared the child. He was playing just fine, and now he doesn't dare to speak."

Xiaobai wasn't very close to Pei Shuo. Firstly, he couldn't forget the whole "eating children" incident, and secondly, he felt his father was truly too serious and never smiled. What he disliked even more was that he couldn't tell stories—who just lies there while putting someone to sleep without chatting or patting them? But in any case, it wasn't fear; after all, he feared nothing in heaven or on earth, only that his Papa wouldn't want him.

Pei Shuo was taken aback, thinking to himself, am I really that scary? If he spent more time with his son, he would know that what he should be thinking about right now is: is Xiaobai really that timid?

The next second, the crisp sound of metal hitting the floor broke the silence.

Pei Shuo followed the sound to the window, picked up the black iron piece from the floor, and saw it was the adjustment knob for a telescope.

The next second, Xiaobai hugged his penguin backpack and hung his head, saying, "I want to go home and find Papa."

The multimedia equipment and stage infrastructure at No. 1 High School had always been luxurious. The newly built grand auditorium was more high-end than the professional stages of many media companies and had a large seating capacity, making it more than sufficient for hosting such municipal-level youth competitions.

"I agree with Little Brother participating in the competition! Doesn't that mean he can legitimately come to school?"

Just thinking about himself running to the auditorium during recess to see his little brother made Lu Huai feel happy already.

Hey, wouldn't his whole class be able to follow him to go play with the little one then?

And they could serve as the home-court cheerleading squad, the kind that claps and cheers like crazy.

Plus, he could really carry his little brother to the classroom to play after the competition, the kind where all the subject teachers could take a look at him.

"Don't you want to go play at Fourth Brother’s school? Hmm?"

Lu Huai, who had been shouting, noticed the little one had no reaction and immediately squatted down to ask.

He habitually wanted to pull the tiny Xueyan into his arms to cuddle and rub against him, the kind where no amount of affection was ever enough.

Lu Xueyan put down his phone and said helplessly, "Then what kind of stories do you like?"

"I..." Xiaobai couldn't name anything he liked; he just wanted to hear his Papa’s voice as he drifted off to sleep, but these two stories really made him sad. "Forget it, no stories today."

As he spoke, he took Lu Xueyan’s palm and pulled it to his back. "Papa, pat me to sleep."

"Okay." Adjusting the brightness of the bedside reading lamp, Lu Xueyan sighed silently in the dim light. The separation had come so suddenly, and he felt even worse inside.

After an unknown amount of time, the little thing in his arms fell fast asleep. Lu Xueyan lit up his phone screen; it was 9:00 PM. For an adult, this wasn't considered late, so sending a text message should be appropriate.

He pulled up the number Qian Zhong had given him before leaving. The blue cursor blinked, and his fingertips hovered over the keypad, weighing his words for a long time before finally typing:

The message was like a stone sinking into the ocean. Lu Xueyan checked the chat box many times but still received no reply. He was already in a bad mood, and now he couldn't sleep at all.

Lu Xueyan didn't play games and wasn't addicted to his phone, but he couldn't stop refreshing the interface. To distract himself, he casually clicked on WeChat. There was only one person in his friend list, the client he had just added this afternoon. The chat box was filled with his one-sided output. It wasn't that Lu Xueyan was putting on airs; he had just been so busy with Xiaobai’s affairs that he had forgotten to reply.

The latest few messages were photos of the studio renovation site, accompanied by a location tag.

Lu Xueyan clicked on the avatar to check the Moments. The person posted very frequently—three times a day, which fit Lu Xueyan’s first impression of him: he was very talkative.

He scrolled down, and the timeline reached a month ago.

Xueyan subconsciously raised his little head and blinked his eyes, looking toward his brother, thinking his brother had something to say to him.

"Let Brother take a few photos, okay?"

Lu Xun looked down at the cub, a smile appearing in his eyes as he spoke.

"But is it a bit too close?"

Xueyan didn't have any objections to being photographed by his brothers, because Third Brother took the most.

Although Third Brother never spoke when he took photos, the little one, who was very sensitive to the camera, could always tell that Third Brother loved to capture his various moments.

By comparison, Lu Xun’s photography skills weren't as proficient as the third brother, Lu Li’s; he just leaned in close to take a close-up of Xueyan’s head.

Lu Xueyan was embarrassed beyond measure. He could never make up nonsense to the little thing again. He only felt lucky that the person who would have caused a misunderstanding hadn't heard it.

As for Qian Zhong, having been by Pei Shuo’s side for so many years, he had long since become a master of human nature. He was very tactful, knowing how to read the room, closing his ears and mouth, and pretending nothing had happened.

Lu Xueyan was sincerely grateful for his consideration and felt slightly better. Who knew that as soon as he turned around, Pei Shuo was standing behind him, and he didn't know if he had heard Xiaobai’s performance.

But no matter how awkward it was, it couldn't reach the level of last night. He just laid flat and gave up; Lu Xueyan suspected that his horoscope was incompatible with this man’s, otherwise why would he always be so unlucky?

He pretended to be relaxed and sat in the dining chair next to his son, trying to ease the atmosphere: "You learned well, don't learn it next time. That’s clearly not what I meant."

Who knew Xiaobai wouldn't give him any face and asked the ultimate "ten thousand whys": "Then what did Papa mean?"

Pei Shuo walked over and sat down, kindly trying to smooth things over: "Don't talk while eating, don't talk while sleeping. Children should just eat properly."

Xiaobai looked serious: "But Papa said we don't care about those things in our family. Do whatever makes you happy."

The three adults: "………………"

"It’s very suitable, how is it close? It’s not close, it’s just right."

But Lu Xun looked with satisfaction at the screen of his phone, showing the image of the little one in his arms looking up at the camera in a daze.

No one could describe in words how cute the little one was right after a bath.

The milky-white hair, which had been dried bit by bit by his brother Lu Xun using a hairdryer, was now fluffy and soft. His face was flushed with a very faint, light pink from the steam of the bath, making his skin look even more translucent and delicate.

One could even smell the soft, sweet scent of the cub’s body wash.

The light blue cotton pajamas he was wearing had also been carefully selected by Lu Xun.

Except for the fact that the little one was indeed a bit thin, making the clothes slightly too big, the slipping cuffs revealed his thin, fair wrists as he drew very seriously with watercolor pens.

His attention was successfully diverted. The little cub who had previously boasted about growing up in two minutes turned his back on his words, trotting after his father: "I’m still small, I’m a little kid. Little kids can’t sleep by themselves."

In the three-hundred-square-meter house with four bedrooms, the father and son ended up squeezed into the small bed in the smallest room.

Lu Xueyan had a soft heart and couldn't be too harsh on Xiaobai. He consoled himself that he had to take it step by step and use the right methods. He would let it slide for the first night, but he had specifically prepared a bedtime story.

"The little kangaroo grew up day by day. The mother kangaroo was both happy and tired because her pouch was getting heavier and heavier, and she could no longer bear the little kangaroo’s weight. The mother kangaroo said: 'You are a big kid now, you have to learn to walk by yourself...'”
chapters.source_text:
就连一旁的老爸陆霆本想说些什么的，突然察觉到长子陆巡的目光后，才狐疑地看向了一旁的四子陆淮。
于是当陆霆也发现了老四的玄机和小家伙的迟疑后，倒也不着急了，而是轻轻挑眉，往后靠在沙发上，手指习惯性规律敲击着扶手。
嘴角几不可察地勾勒出一抹看戏的弧度。
其实老四跟小家伙关系最好这件事，陆家全家都有种反思的倾向。
过去几十年里，陆家内部这种向来谁都不服谁的和谐家庭氛围下，从来没有这么统一的命题，那就是老四陆淮他到底凭什么？
就凭这小子脾气差？凭他做事情向来肆意妄为随心所欲？
只有陆淮完全沉浸在看报名表中，恨不得把跟弟弟有关的每一个字都看清楚。
关键这一看，还真的让陆淮看乐了。
因为选拔赛的举办地点，赫然刚好在自己学校！
不过两个多小时，办公室内已然大变样，深棕色沙发上散落着五颜六色的玩具、书籍，有些还掉在地毯上。茶几上吃剩的食物包装和果皮，以及到处肉眼可见的油印子。
裴朔的眉头不自觉蹙起。
钱忠早就洞悉关于先生的一切细小表情，放在从前肯定是不等他开口就把事麻利给办妥了，可眼下不一样了，颇有种多年冤情有人撑腰出头的畅快感。
他有恃无恐地说：“等下班再一并打扫吧。”
小白听到动静，转身一看，是裴朔进来了，整个人一惊，立刻从椅子上滑下来，坐进沙发乖乖看书去了。
钱忠见状忍不住劝：“您看您这么严肃，都把孩子给吓到了，本来玩得好好的，现在不敢说话了。”
小白不太亲近裴朔，一是他老忘不掉吃小孩那档子事，二是觉得父亲实在有些严肃，都不笑。更让他嫌弃的是，还不会讲故事，哪有人哄睡就是躺在那里，不聊天也不拍拍的？但无论如何都不会是害怕，毕竟他天不怕地不怕，只怕叭叭不要他。
裴朔诧然，心想自己有这么吓人吗。如果他再跟儿子多相处相处，就会知道这会儿更应该思考的是，小白有这么胆小吗。
下一秒，金属落地的清脆响声打破沉默。
裴朔寻着声音走到窗边，捡起地上黑色铁片一看，是望远镜的调整旋钮。
再下一秒，小白抱着自己的企鹅书包，垂头表示：“我要回家找叭叭了。”
一中的校园多媒体设备和舞台基建一向很豪华，新建的大礼堂比很多传媒公司的专业舞台都要高端，观众容纳量也很大，用来举办这类市级青少年比赛绝对是绰绰有余。
“我同意弟弟参加比赛！这样不就真能名正言顺去学校了？”
陆淮光是想想自己趁着课间跑去大礼堂那边看弟弟的模样，就已经幸福上了。
嘿，到时候岂不是全班都能跟着过去找小家伙玩？
顺便担任主场啦啦队，疯狂鼓掌加油的那种。
而且真的可以把比完赛的弟弟抱去教室玩了，让任课老师们都能挨个看一眼的那种。
“难道不想去四哥学校里玩？嗯？”
呐喊出来的陆淮，发现小家伙没什么反应，瞬间蹲下询问了起来。
习惯性地想把小小只的雪言抱进怀里贴贴蹭蹭，怎么亲都亲不够的那种。
陆雪言放下手机，无奈道，“那你喜欢什么故事？”
“我……”小白说不出喜欢的，他只是想听着爸爸的声音入睡，但这两个故事实在令他难过，“算了，今天不听故事了。”
说着他拉起陆雪言的手掌，拉到自己后背处，“叭叭，你拍我睡吧。”
“好。”调整床头阅读灯亮度，昏暗中，陆雪言无声叹气，分别突如其来，他心里更不好受。
不知过了多久，怀里小东西安静睡着了。陆雪言点亮手机屏幕，晚上九点，这个时间对成年人来说不算晚，发条短信应该合乎礼节。
他翻出钱忠临走前给的号码，蓝色光标闪动，指腹在九宫格键盘上徘徊，斟酌了很久用词，最后打出：
一则信息如石沉大海，陆雪言点进对话框很多次，仍没收到回复。本来就心情不佳，这下更睡不着。
陆雪言不玩游戏没有手机瘾，但这会刷新界面停不下来。为了分散注意力，他随手点开微信，好友列表只有一个，还是下午刚加的那位客户。对话框里满屏都是他单方面输出，倒不是陆雪言拿乔摆谱，一直忙小白的事忘了回。
最新几条是工作室装修现场的照片，还附带了地址定位。
陆雪言顺着头像点进朋友圈，发得很勤，一天能发三条倒很符合陆雪言对他的初印象，话密。
滑动屏幕不断下移，时间轴来到一个月前。
雪言下意识抬起小脑袋，眨巴眼睛朝哥哥的方向看了过去，还以为哥哥有话要跟自己说。
“让哥哥拍几张照片，好不好？”
陆巡低头看着幼崽，眼底浮现笑意地说道。
“可是是不是有点太近了？”
对于被哥哥拍照片，雪言倒是没有意见，因为三哥拍的才是最多的。
虽然每次三哥拍的时候都不说话，但是对镜头很敏感的小家伙，总能发现三哥很喜欢抓拍自己的各种瞬间。
比较之下，陆巡的拍照技术就没有老三陆黎那么精通了，直接凑近拍了雪言的大头照。
陆雪言尴尬地无以复加，以后再也不能对小东西瞎编什么话了，他只庆幸会引起误会的当事人没听到。
而钱忠，跟在裴朔身边这么多年，早就混成了人精，审时度势很有分寸，闭耳闭嘴，装什么也没发生。
陆雪言由衷感激他的体贴，心里稍微好了点。谁知一转身，裴朔就站在他身后，也不知听没听到小白的表演。
但再尴尬也达不到昨晚那种程度，躺平了摆烂了，陆雪言怀疑自己跟这人八字不合天生犯冲，要不怎么一直这么倒霉呢。
他故作轻松地在儿子身边餐椅坐下，试图缓解气氛：“学得不错，下次别学了，我明明不是这个意思。”
谁知小白很不给面子，十万个为什么到底：“那叭叭是什么意思呢？”
裴朔走过来落座，好心打圆场：“食不言寝不语，小孩子吃饭就好好吃。”
小白一脸认真：“可是叭叭说在我们家不讲究这些。怎么高兴怎么来。”
三个大人：“………………”
“很合适，哪里近了？不近，刚刚好。”
但陆巡满意地看着手机屏幕上，被自己抱在臂弯里的小家伙茫然抬头看向镜头的画面。
谁也不能用语言形容出刚刚洗完澡的小家伙有多可爱。
被哥哥陆巡亲自用吹风机一点点吹干的奶白色发丝此时蓬松又柔软，脸蛋被洗澡时的水汽熏得浮起一抹极浅的淡粉色，显得皮肤更加通透细腻了。
甚至还能闻到软绵绵的幼崽沐浴露的味道。
穿着的浅蓝色纯棉睡衣，也是陆巡精挑细选的。
除了小家伙着实有点瘦，穿在身上稍微大了一点，滑落的袖口露出了细而白皙的手腕，正拿着水彩笔很认真地画画。
注意力成功被绕开，那个曾经暴言两分钟就长大的小崽翻脸不认，小跑着跟在爸爸身后，“我还小，我是小朋友。小朋友不能自己睡觉的。”
三百多平的房子，四间卧室，最终父子二人却挤在最小一间的小床上。
陆雪言心软，没法对小白太苛刻。他自我安慰，得循序渐进，得讲究方法，第一晚就先算了，但他特意准备了的睡前故事。
“小袋鼠一天天长大了，袋鼠妈妈既幸福又辛苦，因为她的育儿袋越来越重，已经没法再承受小袋鼠的重量。袋鼠妈妈说：‘你是大孩子了，要学着自己走路……”。*
chapters.title: 第51章 哥哥是大骗子
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 51: Big Brother is a Big Liar

chapters.translated_text:
Xiaobai rolled around in Lu Xueyan’s arms and half-turned, "Baba, this story isn't good. Change to another one."

"Alright." Fortunately, Lu Xueyan had come prepared and had downloaded an entire series of picture books. "Under the careful care of the children, Little Zhu gradually grew up. When its crown turned bright red, it was time for it to leave..."

"Baba, I don't like this story either. Change it again." Xiaobai rested his chin on one hand and once again used voice control to switch stories.

Lu Xun’s expression remained unchanged as he tapped the send button, sending it to Lu Huai’s account. A few seconds later, he heard a loud crash from downstairs.

Lu Huai, whose mental defenses shattered the second he received the message, dropped his phone directly onto the floor.

How could this guy Lu Xun be so smug about his petty victory?

He had held him for so long before, and he never flaunted it by pressing his face against his like this, did he?

Even though he was going to buy a new phone anyway, Lu Huai still picked it up from the floor without any backbone, tapped open the page, and re-saved the photo.

At the very least, because of the angle at which he was looking up at the lens, Lu Huai felt that after looking at it for a while, Xueyan looked as if he knew the person on the other side of the lens was him, looking at his older brother through the phone.

Sigh, why is my life so miserable?

Lu Huai felt very melancholy for a moment.

The apartment was located in an area where every inch of land was worth gold. The neighboring Jiaxin Center was a landmark building in Shanghai, and the vicinity was filled with high-end office buildings and luxury shopping districts—prosperous and bustling.

The elevator opened directly into the unit. Lu Xueyan entered the password to unlock the electronic door. With a "beep," a female electronic voice announced mechanically: "Door unlocked. Welcome home."

The warm orange ambient light strip in the foyer lit up in response. As far as the eye could see, the high-ceilinged living room was over a hundred square meters; calling it an "apartment" really did it a disservice.

This was a duplex penthouse with a perfect layout. From the hard renovation design to the soft furnishings, one could see the owner’s extraordinary taste and financial strength.

Xiaobai had no concept of luxury, but he knew it was big. "Wow~ so big! Baba, I like this new home!"

Lu Xueyan’s eyes darted away. He bent down to put down his luggage and said with hidden meaning: "We're just staying for a few days, then I’ll send you to a better place."

Xiaobai couldn't hear the implication behind the word "send" and his eyes lit up. "There’s a place even better than here!"

"There are many bedrooms here. You’ve grown up, so you need to learn to sleep by yourself." Lu Xueyan changed the subject and walked into the living room. "Let’s take a look around and help you pick one, how about that?"

Although Wei Zhili was used to sending messages to find Lu Huai at night, he was left speechless and stunned after seeing the reply from his Alpha friend.

He really wanted to take a screenshot of their conversation and post it online so the whole world could join him in condemning this guy.

To be fair, Lu Huai had been arrogant since birth; the only hardship he’d ever suffered was probably the fifty-yuan iced Americano sold in the school cafeteria, right?

And this kid actually dared to say his life was miserable!

The next message Lu Huai sent in a weak, breathless tone was even more like dancing on Wei Zhili’s nerves.

Lu Huai pondered this sentence over a dozen times and felt it was simply too profound.

He didn't need a lot of money; he just needed his younger brother's love and forgiveness!

A few seconds later, Lu Huai changed his social media signature to this sentence.

As for Wei Zhili on the other end, he no longer knew how to evaluate his brother’s late-night mental breakdown; he simply wanted to block Lu Huai immediately.

Although when Wei Zhili typed that sentence, he also had some doubts in his heart.

Lu Xueyan had nowhere to go, so he returned to the small studio he had lived in before. He had paid for three months upfront when he rented it, so there was actually a long time left before the lease expired.

On the way back, he stopped by a pharmacy to buy a bottle of Yunnan Baiyao.

When packing his luggage, he never thought he would return, let alone return alone. The room was filled with Xiaobai’s clothes, toys, and books. Lu Xueyan hadn't decided how to deal with them, so he re-sorted and packed them one by one to figure out later.

He worked until late at night, his stomach numb from hunger. Lu Xueyan picked up some toast on the dining table and took a few bites, only then remembering it was bought three days ago. Xiaobai hadn't sealed the package after sneaking a snack, and now it had dried out and become rock-hard. He threw the whole bag into the trash and thought about ordering takeout, only to find his phone was dead and wouldn't turn on.

He thought in self-abandonment, it’s a good thing Xiaobai isn't with me. He should be asleep by now. I wonder if he ate his dinner properly, and how many stories he listened to before bed...

After charging the phone for a few minutes, it finally turned on. Before Lu Xueyan could open the food delivery app, a dense stream of missed calls and new message notifications popped up, followed immediately by a call from the contact labeled "Passerby A."

The moment Lu Xueyan switched interfaces three days ago, he had completely thrown this person to the back of his mind. Now, he actually felt a bit guilty; he blamed himself for not refusing directly at the time.

The moment he answered the phone, he apologized first: "I'm really sorry. I had something come up at home these past few days and have been dealing with it. I forgot when I got busy."

He expected the other party to blame him, but unexpectedly, the person said: "If you feel sorry, then say yes to me."

Lu Xueyan was speechless. He really couldn't handle this kind of overly enthusiastic, uninhibited personality. He couldn't say anything for a long time, and finally asked: "Why are you so insistent on having me as your employee? Honestly, I can't even provide an educational qualification certificate. Are you so sure I’m qualified?"

"I hate judging people by their diplomas. I only trust my own eyes and feelings."

The members of the Lu family were all more hot-tempered and terrifying than the last, but when it came to giving money, they were absolutely domineering and generous. Even Wei Zhili was extremely envious of Lu Huai for this.

Since he was a child, Lu Huai’s cards had never once failed to go through due to lack of funds.

While his own family wasn't short on money either, before he took over the business, everything was tightly held by his parents. His usual pocket money was just enough for daily luxury expenses, and anything more was impossible.

Unlike Lu Huai, who could basically do whatever he wanted immediately.

It was no wonder Lu Huai would rather suspect the app had a bug than suspect he was out of money on his card.

As for Lu Huai, who was originally lying on the bed, he was stunned for a long time after suddenly seeing this message from Wei Zhili, then frowned and checked his balance with skepticism.

There was 0.01 yuan inside, which was just sponsored by Wei Zhili.

"Holy crap... Dad, something big happened!"

The next second, Lu Huai rushed frantically toward his father Lu Ting’s study.

Has our family account been looted by hackers?

Lu Xueyan walked out of the store, and as expected, he couldn't just walk away. Under the dim streetlights, the phone in his pocket, which had been set to silent mode, started flashing.

Lu Xueyan took it out to look. There was no name on the screen, but he could recite this string of numbers by heart—it was Pei Shuo. He decisively rejected the call.

Not long after, the screen flashed frantically again. Lu Xueyan didn't hesitate for a second; he rejected the call and blocked the number in one go.

Then Qian Zhong’s number called in. Lu Xueyan hesitated this time, worried that it might involve Xiaobai, and finally swiped the answer button with his thumb. The voice he least wanted to hear at that moment rang in his ear: "Can you see..."

Lu Xueyan didn't give Pei Shuo a chance to finish, his voice cold and deliberately stiffened with displeasure: "No." He threw the word right back at him.

But the next second, intermittent sobbing came through the receiver, followed by a heart-wrenching cry—"Baba!"

Or maybe the family trust fund collapsed and they ran off with the money!

"What hacker? What collapse?"

Lu Ting, who was sitting in the study talking to Uncle Zhang, looked at Lu Huai, who had broken in, with confusion, though he wasn't angry.

Beside him, Uncle Zhang hung his head low, feeling uncharacteristically guilty.

"I just decided, after comprehensive consideration, to temporarily suspend your pocket money for the next few months."

Lu Ting calmly announced the result.

Lu Huai: ?

Lu Xueyan just wanted to end this terrible and magical day quickly. "I don't think we are suitable to work together. Let's split the dinner bill; send the amount to my WeChat." He said, preparing to stand up.

Geng Le stood up first and grabbed Lu Xueyan’s right arm: "Wait, you can't go yet. I still have important things to say."

Lu Xueyan’s injured arm had only been sprayed with medicine, and being yanked by him, he let out a muffled groan of pain.

Seeing this, Geng Le quickly let go: "What’s wrong with you?"

Lu Xueyan didn't want to cause any more trouble, so he shook his head. "It's nothing. Do you know what time it is? I'm very tired and want to go back to sleep."

A key was shoved into his hand, and then he heard Geng Le say: "I’m going to turn off the power. Wait for me, and we'll leave together."

Geng Le walked a few steps, then turned around, shook his plaster cast, and said cheekily: "You shouldn't have the heart to make me pull the rolling shutter door by myself, right?"

He guessed the beginning right.

Lu Huai looked at his father in disbelief, as if what he had heard wasn't Chinese.

He recognized every character, but he couldn't understand them when put together.

"Your brother and I discussed it and felt that since you're an adult now, it's time for you to do some work at the company. You can't just wander around outside all the time. We really haven't paid enough attention to you before; from now on, your pocket money will be issued according to a salary standard."

Lu Ting looked at the meeting minutes in his hand and finally showed some kindness as an old father toward his fourth son, Lu Huai.

Beside him, Uncle Zhang’s head was already bowed so low in guilt it was almost touching his chest.

Young Master Lu Huai, it is I who have let you down...

I shouldn't have opened my mouth in front of the Chairman and Young Master Lu Xun back then.

A normal person would think you had left after hearing the door open and close, right?? Why are you still here???

Pei Shuo’s eyes darted away, as if he didn't know where to focus. Finally, he turned his head, picked up a blue and white paper bag on the coffee table, and said concisely: "A-Zhong bought it. Use whatever fits your symptoms."

So the sound of the door opening and closing was just Qian Zhong coming to deliver medicine.

Lack of sleep really makes one’s reaction slow and stupid. Lu Xueyan took the paper bag and thanked him coldly: "Thanks."

He turned and went into the bathroom, wanting to take a hot shower before applying the medicine.

He turned on the bathroom mirror light and looked at himself in the mirror. His temples were throbbing violently. His hand froze, and a bag of bottles and jars clattered into the white porcelain sink. No matter how imposing he had been just a moment ago, he was now completely falling apart.

Damn it! Why is my hoodie on backward............

So, was Pei Shuo’s evasive gaze just now because he was embarrassed for him?!

How many more ups and downs does this day have to go through before it ends!!!

As soon as the new notification sound came out, Xueyan, who had been drawing, silently raised his head to look at his brother behind him.

"What's wrong? Tired?"

Lu Xun was patiently holding the cub’s small hand with his large one, helping the little one draw the small animals in the textbook. When he was brushed by the soft hair as Xueyan looked up, he immediately lowered his eyes to look over.

"If you're tired, let's go to sleep."

"Brother... did you just send a photo to Fourth Brother?"

Xueyan only glanced at his brother, then lowered his head to continue drawing.

Lu Xun was a little surprised; he didn't expect the little one to guess why he had suddenly taken a photo.

Although the commotion that guy Lu Huai made was quite loud—he had sent the photo, and a loud crash followed right after.

"What? Do you want to go downstairs to see Fourth Brother?"

With a 'clatter,' the baby bottle he intended to wash fell to the ground. Lu Xueyan recoiled in shock. "What was that?!"

If Lu Xueyan were a cat, he would be in a state of bristling fur right now. All fears related to darkness were an uncrossable chasm in his life.

The living room lights turned on in response.

Good news: The 'thing' can turn on the lights.
chapters.source_text:
小白在陆雪言怀里打个了滚儿，半转过身，“叭叭，这个故事不好听，换一个。”
“好吧。”所幸陆雪言有备而来，下载了一整个系列的绘本，“小朱€€在小朋友的悉心照料下，逐渐长大，当冠顶变成朱红色，它是时候要离开了……”*
“叭叭，这个故事我不喜欢，再换一个。”小白单手托着下巴，再次声控切故事。
陆巡脸色如常地点下了发送键，发给了陆淮的账号，几秒就听见楼下的一阵巨响。
收到消息一秒破防的陆淮给手机直接摔地上了。
陆巡这家伙怎么能小人得志成这样？
自己之前抱过那么久，也没给这家伙贴脸炫吧？
尽管在重新买一台手机之前，陆淮还是非常没骨气地从地上捡起手机戳开页面，把这张照片给重新保存了。
至少因为抬头看镜头的角度，让看久了的陆淮感觉雪言就像知道镜头那一端的人是自己一样，在隔着手机看哥哥。
哎，自己命怎么会这么苦啊。
陆淮一时间很忧郁。
公寓所在地段寸土寸金，比邻的嘉信中心是海市标志性建筑，附近不是高档写字楼，就是奢侈品购物商圈，繁华热闹。
电梯直接入户，陆雪言用密码按开电子门锁，‘滴’一声，电子女音机械播报：“门已开启，欢迎回家。”
玄关处暖橘色氛围灯带应声而亮。目之所及，挑高客厅超百平，用公寓二字形容实在太委屈它了。
这是一套空中跃墅，户型完美。无论硬装设计还是软装搭配，都能看出业主的品味和经济实力不凡。
奢不奢华小白没概念，但大不大他是晓得的，“哇~好大。叭叭，我喜欢这个新家！”
陆雪言眼神躲闪，弯腰放下随身行李，话里有话地说：“暂时住几天，然后送你去更好的地方。”
小白听不出‘送’这个字的隐含意思，眼睛一亮，“还有比这里更好的地方！”
“这里有很多间卧室，你已经长大了，要学着自己睡觉。”陆雪言岔开话题，往客厅里走去，“我们参观一下，帮你选一间怎么样？”
虽然当惯例发消息晚上来找陆淮的卫之礼，看见Alpha发小回过来的这条消息后，整个人都愕然无语了。
很想把这家伙的对话截图发到网上去让全世界跟着自己一块讨伐。
有一说一，陆淮从出生嚣张到现在，唯一吃过的苦也就是学校咖啡厅里卖的五十元一杯的冰美式了吧？
这小子居然还敢说自己命苦！
下一秒陆淮气若游丝回复的消息，更是踩在卫之礼的神经上蹦迪。
陆淮反复琢磨了十几遍，觉得这句话简直太精辟了。
自己不需要很多很多的钱，只需要弟弟的爱与原谅啊！
几秒后，陆淮就把自己的朋友圈签名给换成这句话了。
至于另一边的卫之礼，已经一时间不知道怎么评价自家兄弟这种半夜抽风的行为了，单纯想给陆淮直接拉黑。
虽然卫之礼打出这句话的时候，内心也有点嘀咕。
陆雪言没地方去，还是回到之前住的小套间，租的时候一次性付了三个月，其实还有很久才到期。
回去路上，顺道在药店买了瓶云南白药。
整理打包行李时，没想过还会回来，更没想到是自己一人回来。房间里到处是小白的衣物、玩具、书籍，陆雪言没想好怎么处置，一一重新分类封装再做打算。
一口气忙到深夜，胃饿到没知觉。陆雪言拿起餐桌上的土司胡乱啃了几口，才想起来这是三天前买的，小白偷吃后没有扎紧包装，现在风干变得硬邦邦。整袋土司丢进垃圾桶，陆雪言想点个外卖，发现手机早已没电无法开启。
他自暴自弃地想，还好小白没有跟着自己，这个时间应该已经睡了，不知晚饭有没有好好吃，睡前听了几个故事……
手机充了几分钟电，终于能开机了，没等陆雪言点开外卖APP，密密麻麻的未接来电、新信息提醒跳出来，紧接着备注名‘路人甲’的电话就打了进来。
陆雪言三天前切换界面那一刻，就将这个人完全抛掷脑后，这会儿还真有点愧疚，也怪自己当时没直接拒绝。
电话接起的第一时间，他就先道歉：“实在对不起，这几天家里有事，一直在处理。忙起来就忘了。”
本以为对方会责难怪他，没想到竟说：“觉得抱歉对不起就答应我。”
陆雪言语塞，实在应付不来这种热情过头的奔放性格，半天说不出话，最终问：“为什么执着于要我当你员工？坦白说我连入职学历证明都拿不出，你就这么确定我能胜任？”
“我最烦以文凭论人，只信自己的眼光和感受。”
陆家的家庭成员一个比一个脾气暴躁恐怖，但是在给钱这方面绝对是相当霸气爽快的，这点就连卫之礼都异常羡慕陆淮。
从小到大陆淮的那几张卡，就从来没有出现过刷不出钱的情况。
而自己家里虽然也不缺钱，但在自己接班之前，都是被爸妈紧紧捏在手上的，平时零花钱也就刚好够日常稍微奢侈一点的开销，再多就不可能了。
不像陆淮，基本上想干什么，立刻就能干。
也难怪陆淮宁愿怀疑APP出BUG，也没怀疑是不是自己卡上没钱了。
至于原本正躺在床上的陆淮，冷不丁看到卫之礼发来的这条消息，先是愣了半天，随后半信半疑地蹙眉查询起来了余额。
里面还有0.01毛是刚刚卫之礼赞助的。
“卧槽……老爸出大事了！”
下一秒陆淮就疯狂冲向了老爸陆霆的书房。
我们家账户被黑客洗劫了？
陆雪言出了店门，果然做不到直接走掉。昏暗路灯下，口袋里被切至静音模式的手机闪烁起来。
陆雪言拿出来看，屏幕上没有备注名，但这串数字他能背下来，是裴朔，果断拒接。
没过多久，屏幕再次疯狂闪烁。陆雪言没有犹豫一秒，拒接拉黑一条龙。
而后钱忠的号码打了进来，陆雪言这次迟疑了，担心万一事关小白，最终拇指划开接听键。当下他最不愿听到的声音在耳畔响起：“你可不可以见……”
陆雪言不给裴朔说完的机会，不悦中是刻意绷着的冷：“不可以。”三个字原原本本还回去。
可下一秒，断断续续的哭声从听筒里传出，紧接着是撕心裂肺的一句€€€€€€€€“叭叭！”
还是家族信托暴雷卷钱跑路了！
“什么黑客暴雷的？”
正坐在书房里跟张叔谈话的陆霆莫名其妙地看了一眼破门而入的陆淮，倒也没有生气。
一旁的张叔却罕见心虚地深深垂下了脑袋。
“只是综合考虑后，暂时把你这个几个月的零用停了而已。”
陆霆淡定地宣布了这个结果。
陆淮：？
陆雪言只想快点结束这糟糕又魔幻的一天，“我觉得我们不适合共事。晚餐AA吧，账单金额发我微信。”他说着便要起身。
耿乐抢先站起来，一把拉住陆雪言右臂：“等等，你不能走，我还有重要事情没说完。”
陆雪言受伤的胳膊只简单喷过药，被他一拽，痛地闷哼出声。
耿乐见状连忙松手：“你怎么了？”
陆雪言不想再生事端，摇摇头，“没什么。你知道现在几点了吗？我很困，要回去睡觉了。”
一把钥匙塞到他手里，而后听到耿乐说：“我去关电闸，等我一起走。”
耿乐走了几步，又转过身，晃了晃石膏绷带，欠欠地说：“你应该不忍心让我一个人拉卷帘门吧。”
他猜对了开头。
陆淮不可置信地看向老爸，仿佛听到的不是中文。
每个字都认识，连起来就听不懂了。
“我跟你哥讨论了一下，觉得你小子既然也成年了，也该到公司干干事情了，不能总是在外面闲逛，之前确实对你关心不够，以后零用就按照工资标准给你发。”
陆霆看了看手里的文件纪要，最终朝着老四陆淮展露了老父亲的善意。
而一旁的张叔，脑袋已经心虚低到快按到胸口了。
陆淮少爷，是自己对不起您呐……
当时自己就不该在董事长跟陆巡少爷面前多嘴说那一句话。
正常人听到开门关门声都会认为你走了吧？？为什么还在？？？
裴朔眼神闪躲了下，好像不知道该往哪定焦合适般，最终转过头，拿起茶几上的一个蓝白纸袋，言简意赅地说：“阿忠买的，你挑症状合适的用。”
原来开关门声只是钱忠来送药。
睡眠不足真的会反应迟钝会变笨，陆雪言接过纸袋，不冷不热地道谢：“谢了。”
他转身进了洗手间，想在涂药之前洗个热水澡。
按开卫生间镜灯，陆雪言看着镜中自己，太言穴突突猛跳，手一怔，一袋瓶瓶罐罐在白瓷台盆中叮铃咣啷，刚才气势有多足，现在就有多崩溃。
淦！卫衣怎么穿反了…………
所以，刚才裴朔眼神躲闪是在替他尴尬吗？！
这一天到底要经历多少跌宕起伏才会过去啊！！！
新的提示音一出来，原本在画画的雪言，就默默抬起头看了一眼身后的哥哥。
“怎么了？困了？”
陆巡正耐心用大手握着幼崽的小手，帮着小家伙画课本上的小动物，被雪言抬头时软绵绵的发丝蹭到后，顿时垂眸看了过来。
“困了的话我们就去睡觉。”
“哥哥……你刚刚，是不是发照片给四哥了？”
雪言却只是看了一眼哥哥，就低头继续画画了。
陆巡有点意外，没想到小家伙居然猜到自己突然拍照片是为什么了。
尽管陆淮那家伙闹出来的动静也很大，自己前脚发完照片，后脚就一声巨响。
“怎么？想去楼下见四哥了。”
‘咣当’一声，打算拿出来冲洗的奶瓶掉在地上，陆雪言被吓得后退一步，“什么东西？！”
如果陆雪言是只猫，现在是炸毛状态，一切与黑暗有关的恐惧都是他这辈子无法跨越的鸿沟。
客厅照明灯应声而亮。
好消息：‘东西’会开灯。
chapters.title: 第80章

chapters.source_text:
坏消息：他没穿衣服。
惊魂未定中陆雪言下意识抱臂，又羞又气，愤恨吐出两个字：“关灯！！！”
但他不知道，关了灯也无济于事。狐狸本就习惯夜间活动，眼睛相比较普通人类，对黑暗光线有更高的敏感度，以及更清晰的分辨率。
陆雪言摸黑在行李箱中随便扯了件卫衣套上，气冲冲去开玄关不那么刺眼的辅灯，主要也因为太亮会很尴尬。
回到客厅，他生硬地问：“你为什么还在？”
陆巡看了看纸上自己带着小家伙画的小动物，不得不承认自己画技只能说是相当一般。
比起在纸上画画，自己更擅长的绝对是在纸上签字。
但陆巡不信陆淮那家伙就能画的多好看，那什么向日葵观察日记陆巡也看了，陆淮帮忙画的向日葵跟个摇头食人兽似的。
雪言却抿唇摇了摇头。
就算想四哥的话，也得等到明天早上。
否则以后四哥总是骗自己怎么办……？
关灯后正式睡觉之前，正准备阖目而眠的陆巡，最终摸了摸小家伙低语道：“也别太担心你四哥。”
“毕竟陆淮那家伙，确实平日里放的有点太过了。”
有时候小孩子记性太好也不是什么好事。一顿早餐吃得极其漫长，陆雪言都有点PTSD了，生怕儿子一张嘴就说出什么让自己社死的话。
小白喝完最后一口牛奶，说想下楼找朋友玩，大家都如释重负。最终决定让钱忠陪着下去。
经过这一通折腾，陆雪言气也消了。平心而论，裴朔这个人除了洁癖对卫生吹毛求疵，仗着有钱就想为所欲为，自大自私冷血无情之外……算了，还是挺讨厌的。但也无妨，他只要对小白好就行。自己可以把他当成难缠的甲方，不好对付的客户，一个只合作一次的猪队友。
陆雪言如此想着，更加释怀了，看开了，说话的敌意也少了，“我们还是好好讨论下，以后怎么分工。”
裴朔也是这个意思，并且心里已经有了初步方案，只是碍于对陆雪言的捉摸不透，以及搞不定儿子的无奈，这次学聪明了，“你有什么意见？”
陆雪言把吃完的食盒收拾掉一些，找来几张打印纸平铺在餐桌上，旋开笔帽，认真而平静地说：“首先，我们是独立且平等的两个个体，你对这点有异议吗？”
裴朔有一种上当了的不祥预感，但为时已晚，他只能顺着他的话承认，“没有异议。”
偶尔陆巡也会迟疑，如果不是小家伙的话，自己跟父亲陆霆或许还真的会忙到疏于察觉被完全放养的老四，私底下逐渐养出的那些脾性和爱好。
包括陆淮身边的那群所谓朋友。
让人排查了一番后才发现，里面居然藏着不少心思颇多的家伙。
有些人在自己跟父亲这边找不到空隙，倒是试图从尚且还没接触公司事务的老四这边下手了。
陆巡思及至此，脸色也愈发冷硬了许多。
“哥哥也会闭着眼睛不睡觉想事情吗？”
直到同样闭着眼睛的雪言小声说起了悄悄话，才突然在一片夜色黑暗的寂静中，打断了陆巡的千思万绪。
“我们雪言怎么知道哥哥闭着眼睛没睡觉在想事情的？”陆巡语气下意识温和道。
“嗯。”陆雪言满意点点头，边说边写，“你负责带白天，我负责带晚上。早上你来把儿子接走，晚上睡觉前送回来。”他看着裴朔微眯了下眼，继而停笔，往座椅上一靠，“如果你不满意这个提议，我们换一下也行，问题是你晚上会哄睡吗？你确定儿子跟你睡不会再哭了吗？”
将军，句句戳在痛点上。
裴朔什么时候如此任人摆布过，好整以暇地看着陆雪言，竟很好奇接下来还会发生什么，抬了抬手示意他继续。
陆雪言被他这么一看，瞬间气势跌下去大半，不自然地清了清嗓子，才得以找回思路，话却微妙地变成了：“介于白天会比晚上辛苦很多，周末可以跟我，但如果你想多亲近儿子也行，看你。”
陆雪言说完，协议也写好了，笔帽一盖，递给裴朔，“签字吧。”
裴朔拿过来一看€€€€€€
约法三章
一、进门出门都必须让我知道。
二、任何时候不准不开灯。
三、不准在我家沙发上过夜。
承诺人：
裴朔：………………
雪言却朝着哥哥怀里躲了躲。
“因为哥哥想事情的时候，一直在摸我耳朵，痒痒的。”
小家伙有点不好意思地轻声解释起来。
其实幼儿园里午睡的时候，裴朔也总是喜欢闭着眼睛装睡，等姜娴老师他们一走开，裴朔就会睁开眼睛又盯着自己看了。
就像自己的脸上有小花一样。
而陆巡哑然地抬起手，才发现自己的确下意识揉着小家伙的耳垂揉了半天。
借着窗外的月光拨开奶白色的发丝一看，都揉得有点可怜兮兮地发红了。
chapters.translated_text:
Bad news: He wasn't wearing any clothes.

Still shaken, Lu Xueyan instinctively crossed his arms. Embarrassed and angry, he spat out two words: "Turn off the light!!!"

But he didn't know that turning off the light wouldn't help. Foxes were naturally nocturnal; compared to ordinary humans, their eyes had higher sensitivity to low light and much clearer resolution.

Lu Xueyan fumbled in the dark, grabbed a random hoodie from his suitcase to put on, and marched off to turn on the dimmer auxiliary light in the entryway—mostly because it would be too awkward if it were too bright.

Returning to the living room, he asked stiffly, "Why are you still here?"

Lu Xun looked at the little animals he had drawn on the paper with the little guy, forced to admit that his drawing skills could only be described as quite mediocre.

Compared to drawing on paper, he was definitely much better at signing his name on it.

But Lu Xun didn't believe that guy Lu Huai could draw any better. Lu Xun had seen that sunflower observation diary; the sunflower Lu Huai helped draw looked like a bobble-headed man-eating monster.

Xueyan, however, pursed his lips and shook his head.

Even if he missed his fourth brother, he would have to wait until tomorrow morning.

Otherwise, what if his fourth brother kept lying to him in the future...?

Before officially going to sleep after the lights were out, just as he was about to close his eyes, Lu Xun finally touched the little guy and whispered, "Don't worry too much about your fourth brother."

"After all, that guy Lu Huai really has been letting things go a bit too far lately."

Sometimes, it’s not a good thing for a child to have too good a memory. The breakfast was excruciatingly long; Lu Xueyan even developed a bit of PTSD, terrified that his son would open his mouth and say something that would cause him to die of social embarrassment.

After finishing the last drop of milk, Xiaobai said he wanted to go downstairs to play with his friends, and everyone felt a sense of relief. It was finally decided that Qian Zhong would accompany him down.

After all this turmoil, Lu Xueyan's anger had dissipated. In all fairness, besides his mysophobia, his nitpicking about hygiene, his tendency to do whatever he wanted because he was rich, and his arrogance, selfishness, and cold-heartedness... never mind, he was still quite annoying. But it didn't matter; as long as he was good to Xiaobai, that was enough. He could just treat him like a difficult client, a troublesome customer, or a pig-teammate he only had to work with once.

Thinking this way, Lu Xueyan felt more at ease and open-minded, and the hostility in his tone lessened. "Let's properly discuss how to divide our responsibilities from now on."

Pei Shuo felt the same way and already had a preliminary plan in mind. However, hindered by his inability to read Lu Xueyan and his helplessness in dealing with his son, he had learned his lesson this time. "What are your suggestions?"

Lu Xueyan cleared away some of the finished food containers, found a few sheets of printer paper, laid them flat on the dining table, unscrewed his pen cap, and said calmly and seriously, "First of all, we are two independent and equal individuals. Do you have any objections to this?"

Pei Shuo had a foreboding feeling that he had been tricked, but it was too late. He could only follow his lead and admit, "No objections."

Occasionally, Lu Xun would also hesitate. If it weren't for the little guy, he and his father, Lu Ting, might have truly been too busy to notice the habits and temperaments that the completely "free-range" fourth brother had gradually developed in private.

Including that group of so-called friends around Lu Huai.

After having someone investigate, he discovered that there were actually quite a few schemers hidden among them.

Some people, unable to find an opening with him or his father, had instead tried to make a move on the fourth brother, who hadn't yet been exposed to company affairs.

Thinking of this, Lu Xun's expression grew much colder and harder.

"Does Big Brother also close his eyes and think about things without sleeping?"

It wasn't until Xueyan, who also had his eyes closed, whispered this that the silence of the night was suddenly broken, interrupting Lu Xun's thousand thoughts.

"How does our Xueyan know that Big Brother is thinking about things with his eyes closed?" Lu Xun asked, his tone instinctively softening.

"Mm." Lu Xueyan nodded with satisfaction, writing as he spoke. "You are responsible for the daytime, and I am responsible for the nighttime. You come to pick up our son in the morning and bring him back before bedtime at night." He narrowed his eyes slightly at Pei Shuo, stopped writing, and leaned back in his chair. "If you aren't satisfied with this proposal, we can swap, but the problem is, can you soothe him to sleep at night? Are you sure our son won't cry again if he sleeps with you?"

Checkmate. Every word hit a sore spot.

When had Pei Shuo ever been so easily manipulated? He watched Lu Xueyan with a calm, composed expression, actually curious about what would happen next, and raised his hand to signal him to continue.

Under that gaze, Lu Xueyan's momentum dropped by more than half. He cleared his throat unnaturally to regain his train of thought, though his words subtly shifted: "Given that the daytime will be much harder than the night, you can have him on weekends, but if you want to be closer to our son, that's fine too. It's up to you."

After Lu Xueyan finished speaking, the agreement was written. He capped the pen and handed it to Pei Shuo. "Sign it."

Pei Shuo took it and looked€€€€€€

Three Rules of Agreement

1. You must let me know whenever you enter or leave.

2. You are not allowed to keep the lights off at any time.

3. You are not allowed to spend the night on my sofa.

Signatory:

Pei Shuo: ………………

Xueyan, however, snuggled further into his big brother's arms.

"Because when Big Brother thinks about things, he keeps touching my ears, and it tickles."

The little guy explained softly, feeling a bit embarrassed.

Actually, during nap time at kindergarten, Pei Shuo always liked to close his eyes and pretend to sleep. As soon as Teacher Jiang Xian and the others walked away, Pei Shuo would open his eyes and stare at him again.

Just as if there were a little flower on his face.

Lu Xun raised his hand in a daze, only to realize that he had indeed been subconsciously rubbing the little guy's earlobe for a long time.

Peering through the moonlight from the window to push aside the milky-white hair, he saw that he had rubbed it until it was pitifully red.
chapters.title: 第81章

chapters.source_text:
几秒后，偌大的深色系卧室里就重新亮起了一盏小夜灯。
有点睡意朦胧的小家伙被哥哥郑重其事地抱着坐在了床边，乖乖地歪着脑袋任由哥哥检查自己的耳朵。
“耳朵疼不疼？刚刚怎么也不跟哥哥说。”
发现小家伙的耳朵被自己无意识揉红了，陆巡眼底浮现出明显的懊悔，生怕刚刚雪言明明被揉疼了却一直忍着没说话。
被哥哥问疼不疼的雪言却立即眉眼弯弯地摇了摇脑袋，耳畔软绵绵的发丝也随之晃动起来。
“只是有点痒而已。”
雪言想告诉哥哥不用这么紧张。
至于耳朵容易碰一下就变红这种事情，雪言自己也是无意中发现的。
就像在幼儿园里偶尔被滑梯不小心磕一下膝盖也会迅速红起来。再加上小家伙皮肤白得晃眼，往往就会显得格外严重。
被裴朔察觉后直接拔腿就跑去报告给姜老师，大家吓得还以为自己摔倒了。
但其实连雪言自己都记不得是什么时候磕到的了。
对此姜老师也是无奈又好笑地看了一眼“报假警”的裴朔，心想没事就是最大的幸运。
“靠，我真的有弟弟了！”
兴奋得直接一路狂奔到楼外观景台的陆亦铭才稍稍冷静了一点。
忍不住举起手把掌心里的小团子放在阳光下认真打量了起来。
奶金色的绒毛在阳光下好看极了。
边沿半透微光的模样绵软又蓬松，水润润的眸子有点憨憨地呆呆盯着自己。
仿佛还没从前一刻被抓着一路高速狂奔的速度里恢复过来似的。
头顶甚至翘起了一缕被风吹起的呆毛。
怎么会这么让人喜欢的。
陆亦铭也说不出来什么词，单纯觉得这么看着就高兴，托在自己的掌心里乖乖的模样可爱就是招人疼。
就像捧着一颗晶莹剔透的小冰块，握着怕融化，捏着怕碎。
“咳，再喊一声二哥好不好？”
冷静了半天，陆亦铭试图克制一下，顺带动作极度迅速地单手掏出了光脑。
自己之前都光顾着高兴了，都忘记应该拍个视频永远的记录下来才是！
还要发出去！最好让全世界都给自己听一遍！！！
路易也顺利洗脱了罪名，因为刚刚是自己拉着雪言去滑滑梯的，吓得路易都快学电影里那样跪下来给雪言的膝盖赔命了。
“但是……我还挺喜欢小朋友喊我一块玩的。”
雪言嘟囔完幼儿园里的这件趣事后，最终跟哥哥分享起自己心里的悄悄话。
因为大家发现自己容易受伤后，往往就不太敢邀请自己一块去玩了，连路易之后都有种小心翼翼的感觉了。
“以后想玩的当然可以玩，只是可以小心一点。”
而听完小家伙咕哝幼儿园日常趣事的陆巡，当然知道这其中的原因。
因为孵化舱顺利激活的那一天，克姆林就曾经明确告知过陆家所有人，孵化舱里被强行保下的小家伙体质注定会比寻常幼崽更加脆弱。
但是让雪言太早意识到自己注定会有这么多跟其他小朋友不一样的地方，陆巡又无论如何不想开口。
“哥哥，我好像真的困了……”
这一回困顿的小家伙说话声音越来越小，最终忍不住黏在哥哥怀里彻底睡着了。
从陆巡俯视的目光看去，小家伙长而浓密的眼睫毛低低地垂落，投落了一片小扇子般的阴影。
发丝也被压在哥哥陆巡的睡衣上，仔细一点还能感受到幼崽软软的鼻息，和小小一团依偎在怀里的温度。
这下陆亦铭真的感受到了几分不安。
这、这怎么像是……要哭了？？？？
自己做什么了吗？
难道是不喜欢拍照？？
痛苦抱头思索.jpg
“你小子跑得倒快！喊都喊不住！”
就在这时，观景台的大门被“砰€€€€”的一声一把推开，陆崇山一行人才急匆匆地追了过来。
生怕老二一激动又给做出什么出格的事情。
好在看到眼前看似平静的一幕，众人才纷纷松了口气。
只是细看又有点不对劲。
老二难得不像平日里那么意气风发，反而似乎有点理亏紧张地低头看着掌心，掌心里的小家伙却是不声不响的。
水润润的眸子看得人心都要化了。
chapters.translated_text:
A few seconds later, a small nightlight flickered on in the large, dark-toned bedroom.

The little one, still a bit drowsy, was solemnly held by his older brother and sat on the edge of the bed, obediently tilting his head to let his brother check his ears.

"Do your ears hurt? Why didn't you tell brother just now?"

Discovering that the little one's ears had been rubbed red by his own unconscious movements, Lu Xun felt a surge of obvious regret, terrified that Xueyan might have been in pain but had endured it without saying a word.

Xueyan, asked by his brother if it hurt, immediately shook his head with a curved smile, his soft hair swaying along with the movement.

"It was just a little itchy."

Xueyan wanted to tell his brother there was no need to be so nervous.

As for the fact that his ears turned red easily at the slightest touch, Xueyan had discovered it by accident himself.

Just like in kindergarten, if he accidentally bumped his knee on the slide, it would turn red immediately. Plus, the little one’s skin was dazzlingly fair, which often made it look much more serious than it was.

Once Pei Shuo noticed it, he would bolt off to report it to Teacher Jiang, scaring everyone into thinking he had fallen down.

But in reality, even Xueyan himself couldn't remember when he had bumped it.

Regarding this, Teacher Jiang would look at the "false alarm" reporter Pei Shuo with a mix of helplessness and amusement, thinking that being fine was the greatest stroke of luck.

"Damn, I really have a younger brother!"

Lu Yiming, who had been so excited that he sprinted all the way to the outdoor observation deck, finally calmed down a little.

He couldn't help but lift his hand to place the little ball in his palm under the sunlight, examining him carefully.

The milky-gold fuzz looked incredibly beautiful in the sun.

The edges, translucent and shimmering, looked soft and fluffy, and his watery eyes stared at him in a slightly silly, dazed manner.

It was as if he hadn't yet recovered from the high-speed sprint he had been carried through just a moment ago.

A single strand of hair, blown up by the wind, even stuck up on the top of his head.

How could he be so lovable?

Lu Yiming couldn't find the words; he simply felt happy just looking at him. The way he sat obediently in his palm, so cute and precious, made him want to cherish him.

It was like holding a crystal-clear little ice cube—afraid it would melt if held too tightly, and afraid it would shatter if squeezed.

"Ahem, could you call me 'Second Brother' one more time?"

After calming down for a long while, Lu Yiming tried to restrain himself, while simultaneously pulling out his light-brain with lightning speed.

He had been too busy being happy before and had forgotten that he should have recorded a video to keep forever!

And he had to post it! It would be best to let the whole world hear it for him!!!

Louis had also successfully cleared his name, because he was the one who had pulled Xueyan to the slide earlier; Louis had been so scared he almost knelt down like in a movie to apologize for Xueyan's knee.

"But... I actually quite like it when the other kids ask me to play with them."

After muttering about this interesting incident from kindergarten, Xueyan finally shared the secrets in his heart with his brother.

Because after everyone discovered he was prone to injury, they often didn't dare to invite him to play anymore, and even Louis had become somewhat cautious afterward.

"Of course you can play whenever you want in the future, just be a little careful."

Lu Xun, having listened to the little one’s mutterings about his daily life in kindergarten, naturally knew the reason behind it.

Because on the day the incubation pod was successfully activated, Kemulin had clearly informed everyone in the Lu family that the little one, who had been forcibly preserved in the pod, was destined to have a more fragile constitution than ordinary cubs.

But Lu Xun didn't want to bring up the fact that Xueyan was destined to be different from other children so early, no matter what.

"Brother, I think I'm really sleepy..."

This time, the sleepy little one's voice grew quieter and quieter, until he finally couldn't help but snuggle into his brother's arms and fall completely asleep.

From Lu Xun's downward gaze, the little one's long, thick eyelashes drooped low, casting a shadow like a small fan.

His hair was pressed against Lu Xun's pajamas, and if one looked closely, they could feel the cub's soft breathing and the warmth of the tiny bundle snuggled in his arms.

Now, Lu Yiming really felt a bit of unease.

Th-this looks like... he's about to cry????

Did I do something?

Could it be that he doesn't like taking pictures?

*Painfully holding head while thinking.jpg*

"You brat, you run fast! I couldn't even call you back!"

Just then, the door to the observation deck was pushed open with a "bang," and Lu Chongshan and his group rushed over in a hurry.

They were terrified that the second son would do something outrageous in his excitement.

Fortunately, seeing the seemingly calm scene before them, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

Only, upon closer inspection, something felt a bit off.

For once, the second son wasn't as high-spirited as usual; instead, he seemed to be looking down at his palm with a guilty and nervous expression, while the little one in his palm was silent.

Those watery eyes were enough to make anyone's heart melt.
chapters.title: 第52章 成功邀请雪言？

chapters.translated_text:
"Chirp!"

Apparently distracted by the commotion on the observation deck, especially after spotting his eldest brother Lu Jingyu behind Lu Chongshan, Lu Xueyan spread his wings the next second.

"Hey! Don't go—"

Reaching out to stroke the tips of Xueyan's hair, Lu Xun habitually used his fingers to smooth out the slightly messy locks, just as the little one liked.

Finally, mimicking the way the fourth brother usually held the little one, he lowered his head and kissed the little ear that was no longer quite as red.

Coincidentally, just as Lu Xun tucked the blanket around the little one, a new message suddenly lit up on his phone.

The next morning, Xueyan was obediently led away by his brother to wash up, still looking sleepy.

Theoretically, according to the family schedule, today was the day for the fourth brother, Lu Huai, to take the little one to kindergarten.

Having ignored his fourth brother all night, Xueyan actually couldn't help but miss him a little.

At the very least, the little one had long been accustomed to his fourth brother reading him picture books every night.

As it turned out, just as Xueyan subconsciously looked toward his fourth brother, Lu Huai, for the first time, shifted his gaze awkwardly and looked at his eldest brother instead.

"Hey, why don't you take him today...?"

It was a very short sentence, but Lu Huai said it through gritted teeth, as if it were incredibly difficult.

Xueyan's eyes widened instantly, while his eldest brother, Lu Xun, who was personally spreading jam on the bread he was feeding the little one, smiled faintly.

So, the fourth brother finally realized that without money, even going to school becomes a problem?

Not to mention taking the little one to kindergarten.

The cub was in low spirits.

The situation was very serious.

Especially when a tail feather had to be taken under these circumstances...

Everyone glanced calmly at the beautiful, creamy-gold tail feather sticking up from behind the little one's round bottom, and quickly looked away before Lu Xueyan could notice anything amiss.

"Chirp?"

Feeling slightly calmed after having his feathers smoothed by his eldest brother Lu Jingyu, Lu Xueyan turned his head curiously to stare at his tail feather, feeling that something was a bit off.

Were they all staring at him just now?

The System, having watched the whole thing, was shocked.

"It doesn't hurt. I'm not even afraid of shots or blood tests, so why is everyone praising me just for plucking a feather?"

Lu Xueyan squinted his eyes with a smile, while using his tail feather to nuzzle his eldest brother's fingers.

"Chirp chirp~!"

Besides, he really wanted to know the result.

Who knew that prophecies were such a magical thing in books!

Come to think of it, what would his own talent be?

Unlike Lu Jingyu, who couldn't hear Lu Xueyan's inner thoughts, the System was momentarily speechless.

Although the host was young this time, he seemed truly wonderful.

Looking at the lively room full of guardians and the little one jumping with joy after being praised in his palms, the System made a wish with a complex feeling for the first time.

Please keep praising him in the future.

Eldest brother Lu Xun didn't speak, but the hidden mockery in his eyes was clearly seen by Lu Huai.

Lu Huai's fists were truly clenched.

Damn it, just because you have money, you think you're something, huh!?

"Ahem."

Father Lu Ting coughed, thinking to himself that he wasn't exactly a devil, and looked at Uncle Zhang nearby.

Receiving the instruction, Uncle Zhang, following the plan finalized last night, transferred an advance payment to Lu Huai's card with a subtle expression.

Hearing his phone "ding" with a notification, Lu Huai excitedly opened it—

Wonderful, simply wonderful.

At this moment, Lu Huai, whose hopes had just been ignited only to be dashed, felt that the six-digit password protecting his four-digit balance was completely redundant!

The key was that once he paid the driver's fee, heh, it would go straight into the negative.

The undercurrents among the guardians were naturally noticed by Xueyan.

The little one looked at his father and then at his brothers with a wronged expression.

Why wasn't his fourth brother taking him to kindergarten?

Lu Yiming felt his nerves tighten inexplicably.

Only at this moment did his beastly intuition finally realize a certain indescribable possibility.

"Uh, did you fall? Are you hurt?"

Wait, what kind of nonsense was he saying? How could he get hurt falling in his palm...

Damn, so what was the correct way to communicate...??

Lu Yiming, who had always done as he pleased, realized for the first time that his ability to organize his thoughts into words seemed to be lacking.

However, what made Lu Yiming even more uneasy was that the little one, who had fallen in his palm, didn't speak this time, nor did he try to stand up.

He just curled up in the center of his palm, staring at him with a wronged and serious expression.

Lu Yiming froze for a moment, and then his palm was empty again.

In the blink of an eye, the little one had flown to his eldest brother's collar, burrowing his round body into the hair by his ear, leaving his creamy-gold tail forgotten, still sticking high up in the air.

Everyone glanced at the clearly dejected little one, and then at Lu Yiming, who was still holding his hand up.

"I swear I really didn't do anything..."

Lu Yiming retracted his hand, scratching his head frantically in an attempt to explain.

But by the end, he was clearly feeling a bit guilty himself, standing there awkwardly.

Everyone: *Indifferently listening to your excuses.jpg*

But before Xueyan could ask with confusion and disappointment, Lu Xun happened to pass a slice of bread to the little one's mouth, making Xueyan unable to speak while biting the bread.

Lu Xun thought he would just leave the fourth brother a shred of dignity.

He couldn't let the fourth brother fall so low that he had to take the little one on the subway to kindergarten.

The family cutting off the fourth brother's allowance wasn't meant to make the little one suffer by following Lu Huai around.

So, ten minutes later, Xueyan, held by his brother, leaned against the car window. As the car drove toward the city center, he accidentally caught sight of his fourth brother sprinting down the street.

"Is that the fourth brother?!"

Not far away, Lu Huai was carrying a school bag, sprinting toward the subway station like he was doing parkour.

Because his movements were fast and stylish, and his cold, handsome face was quite striking, he attracted countless gazes on the street.

It was a pity that the cool guy Lu Huai, who was doing parkour in everyone's eyes, didn't look at anyone, but jumped straight into the subway station and disappeared into the crowd, so he naturally couldn't hear Xueyan's shout.

"Why isn't the fourth brother taking the car?"

Xueyan immediately turned to ask his brother Lu Xun.

"Him? Maybe he's exercising."

Lu Xun laughed, giving a rather perfunctory reason for Lu Huai, who didn't want to be exposed.

Watching this scene, Lu Jingyu, who had remained silent after initially expressing his apologies to Claire for the "forced invitation," finally looked over.

The faint suspicion in his eyes was almost self-evident.
