W-wait... but damn it, you've always been the wild one...

After rolling nearly ten meters, the demonized mutant wolf lying by the pool finally lost its breath completely, though its final twitch looked more like it had been angered into passing out.

The scent of blood was thick to the extreme, instantly polluting the originally clear water source, staining it bit by bit.

It was just a pity that this demonized giant wolf seemed a bit too much for his cub's hunting practice.

After staring at it for a long time, Lu Chongshan sighed. The white tiger, which had been extremely fierce a moment ago, suddenly scratched its ear with a paw and let out an impatient snort from its nostrils.

If he injured it first and then brought it back to cheat, it seemed a bit too fake.

Too strong wouldn't do, and too weak didn't seem quite right either... what if it went to harass his cub again.

It would be best if it were the kind that was, um...

Looked a bit ugly, so no one would sympathize with it.

And it couldn't be too fierce, so as not to hurt his cub's confidence.

Lu Chongshan paced the heart of the forest again in distress, but unfortunately, all the animals had long since fled, and even the chirping of insects had vanished without a trace.

Should he look further south?

Glancing to the south, the white tiger looked as if it had seen something extremely unlucky, suddenly jumped off a rock, and disdainfully changed direction.

He had forgotten; further south was the territory of those dragons.

Bad luck.

The thing he hated most in this life was dragons.

A bunch of idiots with their noses in the air.

Selectively forgetting the fact that he had suffered a loss at the hands of the dragon clan tens of thousands of years ago, Lu Chongshan changed direction in a very unhappy mood.

Just that...

Just as he decided to leave, a figure lying in the jungle suddenly caught Lu Chongshan's eye.

Oh ho, look what he had found.

A subspecies dragon cub that hadn't fully developed?

Wow, it even looked a bit lame.

Deep in the jungle, a pitch-black cub dragon lay unconscious with its eyes closed.

The reason he called it a subspecies dragon was that the broken dragon horns on both sides of its forehead were undoubtedly the best proof in Lu Chongshan's eyes.

Those old immortals of the dragon clan valued bloodline above all else, and mixed-blood subspecies dragons, viewed as lowly, were usually subject to heavy discrimination.

This one looked so weak, it was probably thrown out, tsk.

Just as Lu Chongshan was about to coldly walk away after finishing his inexplicable inspection of this cub subspecies dragon, a flash of inspiration hit him, and his beast claw stopped in mid-air.

Wait, it's not strong, but it's not weak either.

It looks... definitely not cute, and its scales are pitch black, you can't even see what it looks like.

Hmm, and it's from the damn dragon clan.

This is perfect, no, this is just too damn perfect!!!

The next second, after picking up the dragon cub in his mouth, the white tiger's figure disappeared into the depths of the jungle with extreme excitement.

Gotta bring this good thing back for my son, hahahaha!!!!

And just thirty seconds later, several exceptionally powerful auras descended upon the spot.

"Lord Abraham, there are no traces of His Majesty's juvenile form here! The guidance of the star disk seems to be completely wrong."

The dragon clan, who always emphasized elegance and nobility, looked a bit disheveled after searching the entire galaxy day and night for several full days.

Especially when they discovered that the location indicated by the star disk was completely empty!

"I smell a very unpleasant scent, one that reminds me of a savage and rude fellow from tens of thousands of years ago."

The old man in the robe frowned and scanned the area, his already slightly anxious mood becoming inexplicably worse.

Everyone is a fierce beast, so he should be a fierce beast too.

After a soft chirp, he couldn't help but press his finger against his brother and rub against him, as if looking for comfort.

"Then you are."

"From now on, no one will dare to say you aren't."

Lu Jingyu tapped the little one's short beak, his final soft words sounding like both comfort and a promise so matter-of-fact that it bordered on arrogance.

"Chirp chirp?"

Vaguely hearing his big brother's affirmative reply, Lu Xueyan subconsciously crawled out of the flower basket again, looking at Lu Jingyu with curiosity and trust.

Big brother never lies.

Why is he so sure that he definitely is one?

"Dad and your second brother are currently discussing what kind of prey to catch this time; practice more, and you'll be an amazing fierce beast."

However, Lu Jingyu did not repeat the second half of his previous sentence, but simply pulled a book from the shelf and began to read.

"Chirp!"

Then he must work harder this time.

Hearing this, the little ball in the flower basket had its attention instantly diverted.

The dejection and worry from a moment ago were instantly replaced by a full sense of fighting spirit.

This teacher glanced at the kindergarten gate outside the office window, shook his head, handed an umbrella to Guan Xing, and prepared to lock the door and leave.

Even though the teacher only realized after locking the old office door that Guan Xing, holding the umbrella, was standing at the door, saying thank you in a fast and awkward tone before disappearing into the hallway.

This made the teacher feel uncomfortable for a moment.

If he were truly rotten to the core, he could be heartless enough to ignore him, but he could see that the little one's character wasn't bad; it was just that his upbringing had been bizarrely poor, and his family didn't care about him.

On the other side, Xueyan watched raindrops gradually fall on his brother's car window, and the colorful lights lighting up on both sides of the road, and subconsciously asked: "Brother, where are we going?"

"Something happened with Big Tanzi's side, so we're going straight to the kindergarten to pick up all three of them for dinner, how about that?"

Lu Huaixin thought it was fortunate that he was driving the business van today, otherwise, if it were a sports car, he would have had to let Big Tanzi climb onto the roof and hold an umbrella.

"Other kindergartens?"

Xueyan was curious about kindergartens and children outside of Prince.
chapters.source_text:
伸手摸了摸小家伙的脑袋，陆景屿罕见耐心地询问了一声。
“还是很好看的。”
“啾啾。”
才不是好看不好看的问题……
是自己可怕不可怕的问题。
然而对于陆景屿的安慰，陆雪言只是有点恹恹地团在了花篮里，眨巴着眼睛看向了桌子上的相框。
相框里俨然是那副预言之画的缩小版。
自己真的可以变成这样的猛兽么？
如果自己变成不了一只大猛兽怎么办？
回想着那只小兔子对二哥跟对自己截然不同的反应，陆雪言第一次意识到了一种说不出的紧张情绪。
万一全家只有自己，真的是一只食草系怎么办？会被嫌弃吗？会让大家失望吗……
为什么总是要跟周围人不一样呢。
陆景屿若有所思地看着小家伙失落的模样，也随之看向了相框里的预言之画。
“就这么想变成一只猛兽？”
摸了摸雪雪的脑袋，陆景屿语调平静地询问了一句。
“啾！”
当然呀。向来危险重重的星际森林腹地，此刻寂静到了一种诡异的地步。
连水滴从树叶上落下的声音，也能被听得一清二楚。
“嗷€€€€”
然而就在万物沉寂的这一刻，伴随着一阵痛苦至极的嘶吼声，一道巨型身影突然重重地从茂密的丛林里撞倒在了地上。
下一秒，另一道沉稳而又强势的身影一闪而过，远比魔化变异狼还要庞大一倍的巨兽迈着傲慢至极的步伐走到了水潭边。
黑白相间的皮毛上沾染了不少林间的泥泞，却莫名多了一种蓬勃的野性气息。
而纯黑色的兽尾正显得有点不耐地轻轻甩动，驱逐着闻着血气聚集而来的蚊蝇。
“嗷€€€€”
叫你跟老子狂，切。
老子当年狂的时候，你们这群家伙还没出生呢。
将近几万年没有转换成兽态精神体了，难得一次释放本性，倒是让陆崇山有些久违的兴奋，忍不住惊雷般地咆哮了几声。
等、等等……可他妈明明狂的一直是你啊……
连番滚动将近十米后，倒在水潭边的魔化变异狼最终彻底失去了鼻息，只不过最后一刻的抽搐更像是气得昏死了过去。
血腥的气息浓郁到了极点，瞬间污染了原本清澈的水源，一点点晕染开来。
只可惜这头魔化的巨狼，好像给自家崽用来狩猎练习也有点过分。
陆崇山盯了半天后又叹一口气，前一刻还凶悍至极的白虎突然用爪子搔了搔耳朵，鼻翼里发出一声不耐的响鼻。
先弄伤再带回去作弊，好像又有点太假了。
太强的不行，太弱的好像也不太行……万一又跑去骚扰自家崽怎么办。
最好是那种，EMMM……
看起来丑点的，不会让人同情的。
又不能太凶，免得让自家崽没有自信心。
陆崇山苦恼地在腹地再度巡视了一圈，只可惜所有的动物几乎早已逃窜流亡殆尽，就连昆虫的叫声都已经消失无踪了。
要不要再往南找一找？
看了一眼南方，白虎像是看见了什么极为晦气的东西一般，突然从石头上跳了下来，不屑地换了个方向。
自己倒是忘了，再往南就到了那群龙的地盘了。
晦气。
这辈子特么最讨厌的就是龙了。
一群眼高于顶的白痴。
选择性遗忘几万年前在龙族那里吃了亏的事实，陆崇山心情相当不愉快地换了个方向。
只是……
就在决定离开的时候，一道躺在丛林里的身影，却突然吸引了陆崇山的目光。
哦豁，让自己发现了个什么。
一只发育不完全的亚种龙幼崽？
豁，看起来还有点瘸。
丛林深处，一只通体漆黑的幼崽龙正阖目昏迷。
之所以说是亚种龙，额头两侧破碎的龙角在陆崇山眼里无疑就是最佳的证明。
龙族那群老不死的最看重血统了，而被视为低贱的混血种亚龙通常都会备受歧视。
这只看起来还这么弱，八成是被扔出来的，啧。
就在陆崇山心情莫名地打量完这只幼崽亚龙准备冷漠迈步离开时，却突然灵光一现地兽爪停在了半空。
等等，不强也不弱。
看起来……也绝对称不上惹人怜爱，鳞片也黑漆麻乌的，长啥样都看不清。
唔，还是该死的龙族。
这很完美，不对，这特么简直太完美了！！！
下一秒，叼起这只龙族幼崽后，白虎的身影便兴奋至极地飞一般消失在了丛林深处。
好东西赶紧给儿子带回去哈哈哈哈！！！！
也就在三十秒后，数道格外强大的气息瞬间降临在了此处。
“亚伯拉罕阁下，这里没有发现陛下幼年体的任何痕迹！星盘的指引似乎彻底错误了。”
向来强调优雅高贵的龙族，此刻在全星际不分昼夜地寻找了整整数日后，也显得有一丝狼狈。
尤其是当他们发现，星盘指引的位置居然空无一物！
“我闻到了一丝很不愉快的气息，让人想到了几万年前一个野蛮又粗鲁的家伙。”
长袍老者蹙眉扫了眼这里，本就略显焦虑的心情莫名变得更加不妙起来。
大家都是猛兽，自己也应该是一只猛兽才对。
轻轻叫了一声后，最后还是没忍住抵着手指轻轻蹭了蹭，仿佛在寻找安慰一样。
“那你就是。”
“以后没人敢说你不是的。”
陆景屿点了点小家伙的短喙，最后轻轻的一声，像是安慰又像是某种理所当然到有些傲慢的承诺。
“啾啾？”
模模糊糊地听到了大哥肯定的答复，陆雪言下意识从花篮里又钻了出来，有点好奇又信赖地看向了陆景屿。
大哥从来不会骗人的。
为什么这么肯定自己一定是呀？
“爸跟你二哥正在讨论这次抓一只什么猎物回来，多练练，就是只了不起的猛兽了。”
然而陆景屿却没有重复刚刚后半句话，仅仅是从书架上抽出了一册书翻阅了起来。
“啾！”
那这次自己一定要努力一点。
听到这句话，花篮里的小团子便瞬间被转移了注意力。
前一刻的失落与担忧瞬间都变成了满满的斗志。
这位老师看了一眼办公室窗外的幼儿园校门，摇了摇头，递了把伞给关星后，就打算锁门走人了。
尽管当老师关上办公室老式门锁，才发现拿着那把伞的关星站在门口，语气又快又生疏地说了一声谢谢后，才飞速消失在了走道里。
这让老师难受了一瞬。
要是真的坏得彻底，自己倒也能狠心不管了，偏偏又看得出来这小家伙性格并不坏，只是从小教育条件差的离奇，家里也不重视。
另外一边，雪言看着哥哥的车窗上逐渐落下雨点，道路两侧也亮起了五彩斑斓的灯光，下意识询问起来：“哥哥，我们要去哪儿呀？”
“大狸子弟弟那边出了点意外，我们直接去幼儿园把他们三个人都接上吃饭，好不好？”
陆淮心想还好自己今天开的商务车坐得下，否则跑车的话，似乎就只能让大狸子爬车顶撑把雨伞了。
“其他的幼儿园？”
雪言倒是对普林斯特之外的幼儿园跟小朋友好奇了起来。
chapters.title: 第87章

chapters.source_text:
陆淮瞥了一眼小家伙，就发现雪言已经把脸蛋贴到了车窗上，正睁大眼睛看向窗外。
内心又被狠狠萌了一把的陆淮连穿正装被卡着脖子的郁闷感都减淡了。
赚钱养弟弟这种事情，果然就是能让人动力满满！
当然，被弟弟拿零花钱养着的滋味也很不错啦。
陆淮€€瑟地就差哼起来了。
随着车越来越接近太阳花幼儿园，四周老城区的环境倒是让雪言莫名怀念起来。
chapters.title: 第56章 真的像洋娃娃一样
chapters.translated_text:
Lu Huai glanced at the little one and found that Xue Yan had already pressed her face against the car window, her eyes wide as she looked outside.

Lu Huai, whose heart had been fiercely melted once again, felt the stuffiness of his stiff collar in his formal suit diminish.

The task of earning money to raise his younger brother was truly enough to fill him with motivation!

Of course, the feeling of being supported by his younger brother's pocket money was also quite nice.

Lu Huai was so smug he was practically humming.

As the car drew closer to Sunflower Kindergarten, the surroundings of the old city district made Xue Yan feel a strange sense of nostalgia.

Sunflower Kindergarten is located next to a large wet market in the west of the city. The neighborhood atmosphere is very intimate, with power lines crisscrossing the streets, heavy traffic, and the noisy honking of horns audible from afar.

With economic development and the shifting of the city's center, this place has become a relic of the last century.

"Tsk, it’s just impossible to drive in a place like this; the last hundred meters are completely jammed."

Lu Huai, stuck fast in traffic, tapped the steering wheel impatiently.

He thought, why not just park the car and walk the little one to the kindergarten gate?

"Want to take a walk with brother!"

"Are you nervous? Dad should be demonstrating it first in a moment; it’s rare for him to be this serious."

After Lu Jingyu spent a long time comforting him, the little one finally crawled out of the flower basket obediently and flew back onto his shoulder, full of spirit again.

Walking through the long corridor, he looked out from time to time through the rows of floor-to-ceiling windows toward the garden.

"I heard he caught a very suitable prey."

Just didn't know what it would be.

"Chirp, chirrup?"

Lu Xueyan, hearing this, also looked curiously at his eldest brother.

"I don't know either, we'll see it when we go down."

Just as Lu Jingyu reached the foyer and the attendants on both sides slowly pulled open the grand doors, Lu Xueyan couldn't help but flap his wings to fly out first to see what was going on...

"ROAR—"

A thunderous beastly roar rushed toward them.

Struck by the incoming gust of air, his little wings flapped crookedly several times, and before he could recover from the shock, he was caught in the palm of his eldest brother's quick-acting hand.

Lu Xueyan stared blankly at what was in front of him; a massive, gargantuan beast had just finished roaring and was now carrying a cub in its mouth, charging toward them with unstoppable speed.

It was so fast that there was no time to react; in the blink of an eye, it had reached the door.

"Awooo~"

Do you like it or not?

Lu Huai asked tentatively, and Xueyan nodded in agreement without a moment's hesitation.

Hearing the little one's answer, Lu Huai couldn't help but chuckle again.

Just treat it as a walk, a bit of exercise? If he can't walk, he'll just carry him.

He then temporarily parked the car on the side of the road.

With a "click," the car door opened. The moment the tall, handsome young Alpha stepped out and opened his black umbrella, he unconsciously became the focus of attention for the entire street.

Those who didn't know would have thought some model had come for a street photoshoot!

But before the crowd could subconsciously take a few more looks at Lu Huai, a small white figure tumbled out of the car the next second.

"Brother!"

Xueyan was obediently scooped up by his fourth brother and carried out of the car.

"Why did you pounce like that? What if brother hadn't caught you and you fell?"

Lu Huai said that, but in reality, he loved the feeling of Xueyan pouncing into his arms the most.

The feeling of holding him in a full embrace, who could understand!?

Xueyan, scolded by his brother, didn't explain; he simply rubbed his cheek against his brother's, just like a kitten acting spoiled.

He knew his brother was only saying that, but wasn't actually angry at all.

Only Lu Huai felt a sense of impending doom, his scalp tingling.

Damn it, the road between the kindergarten and the wet market is full of snack stalls; if they walk all the way, wouldn't they be offered a whole basket of food!?

How could his little brother's stomach handle such a hodgepodge of bacteria!?

"Thanks, but we don't need any for now."

Before Xueyan could answer, Lu Huai reached out and picked the little one up.

The next second, he tossed three yuan at a cotton candy stall, grabbed a stick of cotton candy, shoved it into Xueyan's hand, and started sprinting.

Xueyan, holding the huge white cotton candy he had finally obtained, lay in his brother's arms and began to observe it curiously.

He sniffed it; it had a sweet scent.

It was also soft.

He wanted to take it to kindergarten tomorrow to show Pei Shuo and the others!

"Oof—!"

As Lu Huai was sprinting, he slammed hard into a small figure that was also charging recklessly.

The little one let out a muffled grunt, covered his knee without crying or making a fuss, and without even glancing at Lu Huai or Xueyan, turned and tried to keep running.

Lu Huai was so startled that he held Xueyan high up, terrified that this chaotic little cannonball would knock his brother flying.

"Dad, you really are something; you're so cool. Why haven't the brothers come down yet?"

Lu Yiming, stirred up by his father, was looking toward the upstairs impatiently.

He wondered why his eldest brother hadn't brought his younger brother down yet.

Did it really take that long to apply medicine to a tail? Q3Q?

Come to think of it, his younger brother didn't even want to pay attention to him anymore, sigh.

Thinking about it, Lu Yiming slumped back down, resting his chin on his knees.

How on earth could he stick the fur back on?

"It's fine, no rush. This time, let your dad show you how it's done! Let me demonstrate it once first."

The second after Lu Chongshan finished speaking, he transformed back into a majestic, gargantuan beast with a roar, his black and white fur looking exceptionally shiny in the sunlight.

And his pure black tail had an added, indescribable air of mystery.

Under the awestruck gazes of the crowd, Lu Chongshan impatiently picked up the little sub-dragon from the ground.

Hehehe, once the little one sees this, he'll definitely admire him.

When Lu Chongshan saw the situation inside the door, he hurriedly braked to a stop and placed the sub-dragon cub from his mouth at his own cub's feet.

The next moment, he crouched on the ground, held his head high, and flicked his pure black tail back and forth.

As the two stared at each other in silence—one chirp, one tiger—Lu Chongshan, not having received the expected exclamation, was a bit confused.

He immediately leaned his head over, trying to get a look at his little cub, or perhaps use his tongue to lick his cub's fur, wondering why he had suddenly stopped talking.

"Chirp, chirrup—"

"What the hell, what is that?"

"Brother, it seems... is that the little friend?"

Xueyan, also holding his cotton candy, stared at Guan Xing with a bit of confusion, the photo he had seen on his brother's phone the other day appearing in his mind.

It was the little brother from the picture!

"That little friend? Damn, isn't this Big Raccoon's younger brother!?"

Lu Huai was also shocked.

Wasn't Big Raccoon supposed to be picking someone up? But his brother had run off; who was he picking up?

How could there be a brother in this world even more unreliable than himself!

"Shall we go find that little friend? Brother."

Xueyan held his brother's hand and asked.

Lu Huai hesitated for only a few seconds, then, watching the figure running further and further away, decided decisively, "Chase, we must catch up! I'll send Big Raccoon a message right now."

Such a small child, and on a rainy day, if he got lost in the crowd, wouldn't that be the end of it?

If his brother got lost, Lu Huai was certain Big Raccoon would have no heart to help him work... damn, to help him build his career!

So Xueyan took the initiative to gently say hello to break the ice.

Guan Yu: !

Guan Yu was startled. Oh my god, the God of the Grasslands above, this doll can actually talk!

"Do you want to eat some cotton candy?"

Xueyan looked at the cotton candy in his hand that was about to melt, then at Guan Yu, who had been staring at it for a long time, and felt that the other child might want some.

"Then... aren't you going to eat it?"

Guan Yu was clearly tempted and very interested in the huge white cotton candy in Xueyan's hand.

"Because brother said I can't eat it."

Xueyan explained.

"Why can't you eat it? Cotton candy is so delicious!"

Guan Yu was shocked and puzzled, similar to how one would feel hearing that there are children in the world who actually like going to kindergarten.

"Maybe it's because I get sick easily, and I don't want brother to worry."

Xueyan answered honestly, even though he was a little worried that this might make the other child not want to play with him.

"You're sick?"

As a result, when Guan Yu heard this, he suddenly became worried.

Meanwhile, inside the Prince's Manor, it was unexpectedly lively.

"Holy crap, Dad, what did you catch?? It looks a bit... powerful?"

Lu Yiming looked at this pitch-black thing in shock and couldn't help but want to reach out and poke it, but for some inexplicable reason, he subconsciously pulled his hand back.

"Ahem, it's just an ordinary sub-dragon cub."

Lu Chongshan stood with his hands on his hips, reserved, letting everyone crowd around the prey he had discovered after much careful selection, and announced the answer in a flat tone.
chapters.title: 第88章
chapters.source_text:
太阳花幼儿园在城西一座很大的菜市场旁，街坊的气息十分亲切，街边电线林立，车水马龙，远处就能滴滴的嘈杂喇叭声。
随着经济发展和城市发展中心转移，这里已然成为了上个世纪的遗留产物。
“啧，这种地方就是不好开车，最后一百多米硬是堵死。”
被死死堵住的陆淮有点不耐烦地敲了敲方向盘。
心想总不能先停个车，然后牵着小家伙往幼儿园门口走走？
“想哥哥一起散步！”
“紧张吗？马上爸应该会先演示一遍，难得他这么认真。”
陆景屿安慰了半天终于让小家伙乖乖从花篮里钻了出来，重新打起精神地飞到了肩膀上。
一边在长廊里走着，一边隔着一排排落地窗遥遥地看向了花园那边。
“听说抓到了很合适的猎物。”
就是不知道会是什么。
“啾、啾啾？”
而陆雪言闻言也好奇地看向了自家大哥。
“我也不知道，下去就看见了。”
就在陆景屿走到门厅处，两侧侍者缓缓拉开大门，陆雪言忍不住扑棱起翅膀先飞出去看个究竟的时候……
“嗷€€€€”
一道惊雷般的猛兽咆哮声便扑面而来。
被迎面而来的气流冲击得小翅膀都歪歪扭扭地扑棱了好几下，惊魂未定地被自家大哥眼疾手快地托在了掌心里。
陆雪言呆呆地看着眼前，只见一只庞然巨兽在咆哮过后便从地上叼起了一只幼崽，势不可挡地飞速狂奔了过来。
快到任何反应都来不及做出，几乎眨眼间，就冲到了门口。
“嗷~”
喜欢不喜欢？
陆淮试探性地问了一句，雪言就点头同意了，一点儿没犹豫的。
听到小家伙的回答，陆淮忍不住又嘿嘿笑起来了。
就当走走路，健身运动一下？走不动的话，自己就抱着呗。
随后将车临时停靠在了路边。
“咔哒”一声车门打开，身形高大、眉眼帅气的年轻Alpha下车打开黑伞的一瞬间，直接不自觉地成为了整条街注意力的焦点。
不知道的还以为是什么模特来街拍了！
但不等众人下意识多看几眼陆淮，下一秒，车里又扑出来了一只白色的小身影。
“哥哥！”
雪言乖乖地被四哥圈住，从车上抱下来了。
“扑过来干什么？万一哥哥没接住，不就摔倒了吗？”
陆淮话是这么说，但其实最喜欢的就是被雪言这么扑到怀里的感觉了。
一把抱个满怀的滋味，谁懂！？
被哥哥说了的雪言也不解释，单纯蹭了蹭哥哥的脸颊，就跟小猫撒娇似的。
知道哥哥只是嘴上这么说，其实一点也不恼。
只有陆淮头皮发麻地感觉到了不妙。
草啊，幼儿园跟菜市场中间这条路上全是各种小吃摊，一路走过去岂不是得被送一筐！？
自家弟弟的肚子哪里受得了这种细菌大杂烩！？
“谢谢啊，我们家暂时不用了。”
不等雪言回答，陆淮就直接伸手给小家伙抱起来了。
下一秒扔了三块钱到棉花糖铺子里，逮着一根棉花糖塞到雪言手里，开始一路飞奔。
雪言倒是举着手里终于拿到手的巨大白色棉花糖，趴在哥哥怀里好奇观察起来。
嗅一嗅，是甜甜的味道。
还软软的。
想明天带去幼儿园给裴朔他们看看！
“唔€€€€！”
飞奔中的陆淮，下一秒就跟一道同样在横冲直撞的小身影猛猛撞到了一块。
这名小家伙闷哼了一声，就不哭也不闹地捂住了膝盖，看都没看陆淮跟雪言一眼，转身就想继续跑。
陆淮正吓得给怀里雪言高高举起来，生怕这胡乱吓跑的小炮弹给自家弟弟撞飞了。
“爸不愧是你，真的太酷了，哥他们怎么还没下来。”
除了陆亦铭被自家老爸搞得热血沸腾，迫不及待地看向了楼上。
奇怪大哥怎么还没带着弟弟下来。
给尾巴涂个药居然涂了这么久么Q3Q？
说起来弟弟都不愿意理自己了，唉。
想着想着，陆亦铭又有点蔫蔫地撑着膝盖蹲了回去。
到底怎么才能把毛儿给黏回去呢？
“没事，不着急，这次让你爸我亲自来教！马上先让我来演示一遍。”
陆崇山说着话的下一秒，便在一声咆哮声中重新变成了威严至极的巨兽，黑白相间的皮毛在阳光下显得格外毛色崭亮。
而纯黑色的兽尾又多了份说不出的神秘气息。
就在众人敬畏的目光下，陆崇山迫不及待地叼起了地上的小亚龙。
嘿嘿嘿，马上给崽儿看见了，肯定崇拜自己。
而陆崇山看见门内的情况后，顿时匆匆刹车停下步伐，将嘴里的亚龙幼崽摆在了自家崽儿的脚边。
下一刻，便蹲在地上高高昂起了头颅，纯黑色的兽尾一甩一甩。
一啾一虎两两对视沉默之际，没有得到预期中惊叹声的陆崇山有点困惑。
顿时将脑袋探了过去，试图看一看自家的小幼崽，或者用舌头替自家崽儿舔一舔毛毛，怎么突然不说话了。
“啾、啾啾€€€€”
“卧槽，什么东西？”
“哥哥，好像……是那个小朋友？”
同样举着棉花糖的雪言，倒是有点莫名地盯着关星，脑海里浮现了那天在哥哥手机上看到的照片。
是里面的那个小哥哥！
“那个小朋友？我去，这不就是大狸子他弟吗！？”
陆淮也惊了。
大狸子不是来接人的吗，结果他弟都溜了，这接的个什么人？
世界上居然还有比自己更不靠谱的哥哥！
“我们去找那个小朋友好不好？哥哥。”
雪言牵着哥哥询问起来。
陆淮只犹豫了几秒，看着越跑越远的身影，当机立断道“追，必须追上！我马上再给大狸子发个消息。”
这么小的小孩子，又是个下雨天，要是在人流里跑丢了，那不就完了吗。
如果弟弟跑丢了，陆淮确定大狸子绝对没心思帮自己打工……啊呸，跟自己一起搞事业了！
于是雪言主动地轻轻打了个招呼破冰了。
关雨：！
关雨被吓到了，天啊，草原之神在上，这洋娃娃居然会说话！
“你想吃棉花糖吗？”
雪言看了看手里快要融化的棉花糖，又看了看最开始盯了棉花糖好久的关雨，觉得对方小朋友可能是想吃的。
“那……你不吃吗？”
关雨明显心动了，对于雪言手里的巨大白色棉花糖非常感兴趣。
“因为哥哥说我不可以吃。”
雪言解释了一句。
“为什么不能吃？棉花糖可好吃了！”
关雨震惊不解，就类似于听到世界上有小朋友会喜欢上幼儿园一样困惑。
“可能是因为我容易生病，不想让哥哥担心。”
雪言老老实实地回答了，尽管有点担心会不会因为这样，小朋友就不敢跟自己玩了。
“你生病了？”
结果关雨听到这句话，突然担忧了起来。
而此刻的亲王府庄园内，正意外的热闹。
“卧槽，爸，你这抓的是个什么？？看起来有点……厉害？”
陆亦铭震惊地看着这团黑漆漆的东东，忍不住想伸手戳戳，只是莫名其妙地看着又下意识地收回了手。
“咳，一只普普通通的亚龙幼崽罢了。”
陆崇山矜持地插着手，任由众人围观起了自己千挑万选后发现的猎物，语气平淡地宣布了答案。

“龙！”
“天啊，一只龙族幼崽？”
“就算是亚龙也很可怕了。”
光是听到了那个禁忌般的字眼，在场的众人声音都有些变了。
纷纷敬畏地看向了这只幼崽，当然，更加敬畏地看向了陆崇山。
“没什么了不起的，一只亚龙罢了，有机会给你们抓一只真正的龙回来！”
“更何况这只亚龙看起来弱得很，给崽儿练习狩猎再合适不过了。”
陆崇山摆了摆手，并不以为意。
尽管这次在场众人闻言都在倒吸一口冷气后保持了某种微妙的沉默。
这种亚龙幼崽也就算了，毕竟龙族对亚龙鄙夷甚至不承认的态度称得上众所周知。
如果哪天真的逮住一只血统高贵的纯血龙族幼崽回来……
那毫无疑问会被极其霸道护短的龙族全体上下不惜一切代价地全星际追杀吧！！！！
生病这个词，在草原上是一个很恐怖的词。
因为医疗条件比较落后，仅有的赤脚医生往往治疗手段也极为粗暴原始，很多时候送过去治疗反而死得更快了。
关雨虽然不知道雪言生的什么病，但是关雨却知道，自己不希望雪言消失不见！
大概是因为雪言实在太好看了，好看到关雨还想每天多看几眼的那种好看。
不过看到妹妹跟雪言交谈，一旁的关星却唇角紧绷，一言不发。
因为听不太懂城里小朋友说的普通话，自然也很难跟上雪言跟妹妹的交谈，就像一条跟不上节奏的自己生自己闷气的小尾巴。
好在妹妹关雨察觉到哥哥的异样后，连忙转身用草原上的家乡话叽里呱啦地给哥哥翻译了一通。
关星的脸色这才也一点点跟着严肃又担忧起来。
眼神俨然像担心雪言下一秒就会消失似的。
不过关星确实觉得雪言有点太小小只了，就连那种刚出生的小羊羔都可以轻易把雪言给撞倒。
说话都细声细气的。
奇怪的是，就算自己听不太懂也不会觉得枯燥，反而会喜欢盯着雪言的表情，忍不住猜测这些好听的话到底是什么意思。
向来不乐意学普通话的关星，第一次觉得自己听不懂雪言说话有点可惜。
因此当察觉到小家伙不知道什么时候聚在一块的家长们，一回头看到的就是这么一幕€€€€
两只巧克力色小幼崽下意识围在白色小幼崽身侧，合起来就像一块奥利奥小饼干似的！
chapters.title: 第89章
chapters.translated_text:
"A dragon!"

"My god, a dragon cub?"

"Even a sub-dragon is terrifying enough."

Just hearing that forbidden word made the voices of everyone present change slightly.

They looked at the cub with awe, and naturally, looked at Lu Chongshan with even more awe.

"It's nothing special, just a sub-dragon. I'll catch you all a real dragon when I get the chance!"

"Besides, this sub-dragon looks quite weak; it's perfect for the cub to practice hunting on."

Lu Chongshan waved his hand, not taking it to heart.

Although everyone present gasped at his words and then fell into a subtle silence.

A sub-dragon cub was one thing; after all, the dragon race's disdain for, and even refusal to acknowledge, sub-dragons was well-known.

If one day he really caught a pure-blooded dragon cub with a noble lineage...

There was no doubt that the entire dragon race, with their extremely overbearing and protective nature, would hunt him across the entire galaxy at any cost!!!!

The word "sickness" is a terrifying word on the grasslands.

Because medical conditions are relatively backward, the few barefoot doctors available often use extremely crude and primitive treatment methods, and many times, patients sent to them for treatment end up dying even faster.

Although Guan Yu didn't know what kind of illness Xue Yan had, she knew that she didn't want Xue Yan to disappear!

Perhaps it was because Xue Yan was just too good-looking, the kind of good-looking that made Guan Yu want to look at him a few more times every day.

However, seeing his younger sister talking to Xue Yan, Guan Xing, standing to the side, kept his lips pressed tight and remained silent.

Because he couldn't quite understand the Mandarin spoken by the city kids, it was naturally difficult for him to keep up with the conversation between Xue Yan and his sister, like a little tail that couldn't keep up with the rhythm and was sulking by itself.

Fortunately, after his sister Guan Yu noticed her brother's odd behavior, she quickly turned around and translated everything for him in their native grassland language.

Only then did Guan Xing's expression gradually become serious and worried as well.

His eyes looked as if he were worried that Xue Yan would disappear in the next second.

However, Guan Xing did think that Xue Yan was a bit too small; even a newborn lamb could easily knock Xue Yan over.

Even his voice was soft and quiet when he spoke.

The strange thing was that even though he couldn't understand much, he didn't find it boring at all; instead, he liked staring at Xue Yan's expressions, unable to help but guess what those pleasant-sounding words meant.

Guan Xing, who had always been unwilling to learn Mandarin, felt for the first time that it was a pity he couldn't understand what Xue Yan was saying.

Therefore, when the parents, who had gathered together at some point, noticed the little ones, this was the scene they saw—

Two chocolate-colored little cubs subconsciously surrounding the white little cub, looking together just like a little Oreo cookie!

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 57: Xueyan as a Little Teacher!
chapters.translated_text:
The corners of Lu Huai's mouth were twitching so hard he couldn't suppress them.

He was completely and utterly handled.

The passersby secretly watching this scene never expected that behind such a handsome face on the older brother, there was an even more beautiful little cub face!

It was so out of place that it felt like it didn't belong in this area at all.

Lu Huai looked down at the sewage on the ground caused by the nearby wet market, clicked his tongue in slight disgust, and thought that the urban landscape here was really quite old.

He should have just come to pick up Da Lizi and the others himself and sent the little one to the restaurant first.

Because the moment Xueyan landed, his spotless little shoes were stained with a bit of water.

He would have to give the little one a bath and change his clothes when they got home.

Xueyan, however, curiously tapped the small puddle on the ground with his shoe, watching his reflection on the water surface ripple outward in circles.

"And my hat, Brother."

Finally, he tugged on his brother's sleeve to remind him not to forget his little hat.

Because what Xueyan was a little worried about was, would the new friends think he was weird because of his hair color?

Lu Huai skillfully took the kindergarten's small round hat, placed it steadily on his younger brother's head, and smoothed out his hair.

"Why are you so well-behaved, hmm?"

"Dad, you haven't seemed to reveal your beast form spirit body in front of your younger son before; the little one didn't recognize you."

Lu Jingyu sighed, reached out to hug Lu Xueyan, who was still tugging at his hem, and shielded his younger brother in his arms.

???

"Didn't recognize me!?"

This was almost a devastating blow to Lu Chongshan, and for a moment, his gruff voice shouted out directly.

"Chirp?"

Held in the palm of a hand, Lu Xueyan finally poked his head out, feeling a bit aggrieved and shocked, and looked up at this tiger that was truly excessively large.

How could it be so big? It was like a mountain, looming over the ground.

"Even if you didn't recognize me, don't you like this? Your dad caught this prey specifically for you, a sub-dragon!"

Lu Chongshan patted the ground with his beast paw, instantly shaking the surroundings, and the roar unique to carnivorous beasts made people's ears go numb.

"Chirp..."

Lu Xueyan’s fur trembled from the vibration, and he cautiously glanced at the little dragon on the ground.

Although he didn't know what a sub-dragon was...

But this, was this bitten to death QAQ???

"Don't be afraid, this time your dad will demonstrate for you! How to tear apart a prey!"

"It's not hard at all! It can be done easily."

Thinking his cub was a bit unconfident, Lu Chongshan decided to demonstrate his seasoned hunting skills on the spot.

Besides, no little cub could fail to be impressed by him.

Not counting the eldest, who never liked to turn into his beast form to hunt, the second one used to watch with such admiration when he was little, his eyes glowing!

"Chirp...?"

And so, before Lu Xueyan could say anything, he watched the big tiger, who seemed to be his dad, carry the cub in his mouth and rush toward the open courtyard.

Compared to Lu Chongshan's massive body, the cub dragon being carried in his mouth was indeed so small it seemed like it would be torn to pieces the next moment.

"Should we go closer and take a look?"

Lu Jingyu glanced at the prey and frowned slightly, feeling that something was subtle.

But he couldn't think of anything for a moment.

A sub-dragon? "He fell! The little brother fell! Dad! Hurry and catch him!"

"The mat, hurry up and go catch him!"

Not only was Lu Yiming, who was standing to the side, directly frightened into screaming, but even Lu Jingyu's expression changed when he saw this scene.

Even if the distance from the ground wasn't high, they were always worried about the little one falling when holding or leading him at home, let alone falling from the air to the ground!

And even if it were any other beast, the little one was congenitally frail, making one's heart ache so much that they didn't want to see any harm happen to him at all!

However, just as everyone looked up in panic at this scene, having just lifted the mat and run frantically toward the courtyard.

Even as Lu Chongshan stretched out his paws in extreme panic, trying to catch his cub—

That black dragon tail moved against its instincts, sweeping a circle in the air.

With precision that reached its peak, it used the very tip of its tail to loop around the falling golden little ball just in time.

H-he actually caught him!!!

He was actually caught by that sub-dragon's tail!?

Wasn't it said that sub-dragons were generally bad-tempered and simple-minded???

The overly bizarre scene left everyone unable to react, watching it in shock and stupor.

In the breeze, the black dragon's tail had indeed circled the milky-gold little ball, its fine, soft fluff swaying gently.

And Lu Xueyan, who had closed his eyes for a long time, not only didn't feel the expected pain, but felt himself sway in the air a few times, as if he had been caught by something.

"Chirp?"

Did I... not fall? QAQ

Lu Xueyan, who opened his eyes little by little, suddenly discovered that he was firmly circled by the tip of a black tail along the underside of his wings.

Although he was in mid-air, he felt a subtle sense of security.

Was it that cub dragon...?

Subconsciously clawing at the tail and looking up, he happened to meet the golden pupils looking down for a brief moment.

But the next second, realizing the eye contact, Pei Shuo looked away with a cold expression, leaving only Lu Xueyan's somewhat dazed gaze still fixed in place.

"Chirp——!!"

Before Lu Xueyan could speak, that black dragon tail suddenly circled him and gave a gentle flick.

Between the spinning world, Lu Xueyan instantly widened his eyes in disbelief, discovering that he had been flung out!

He... was flung out?

"Holy crap——he fell again!!!"

Damn it!

This sub-dragon is truly unreliable!!!!

The sudden, unexpected change caught everyone by surprise, but because it was so unexpected, they couldn't react in time!

After all, no one expected that even though he had been caught, he would be deliberately flung out again!!
chapters.source_text:
陆淮嘴角都快€€瑟到压不下来了。
完完全全被拿捏的彻底。
而周围悄悄看着这里的路人们，谁也没想到哥哥这么一张帅脸背后，居然还有一张更漂亮的幼崽小脸蛋！
格格不入到仿佛完全不属于这片地带。
陆淮倒是低头看了一眼地上因为周边菜市场造成的污水，略微嫌弃地啧了一声，心想这边城市界面还真是有点老旧。
早知道自己过来接大狸子他们就行了，把小家伙先送去餐厅。
因为雪言落地的这一瞬间，一尘不染的小鞋子上就被粘了点水渍。
回家之后得还得给小家伙洗澡换衣服。
雪言倒是有点好奇地用鞋子轻轻踩了踩地上的小水坑，看着水面上自己的倒影一圈圈扩散开来。
“还有帽子，哥哥。”
最后扯了扯哥哥的袖子，提醒哥哥别忘了自己的小帽子。
因为雪言有点担心的就是，新的小朋友会因为自己的头发颜色，觉得自己怪怪的吗？
陆淮熟练地拿过来幼儿园的小圆帽，给弟弟稳稳地带在了脑袋上，理了理发丝。
“怎么这么乖的，嗯？”
“爸，您以前似乎还没在弟弟面前露出过兽态精神体，小家伙没认出您。”
陆景屿叹了口气，伸手抱住了依旧扯着自己衣摆的陆雪言，将自家弟弟护在了怀里。
？？？
“没认出我！？”
这对于陆崇山而言几乎是深受打击，一时间粗声粗气的声音直接喊了出来。
“啾？”
被托在了掌心里，陆雪言才有点委屈又震惊地冒出脑袋，抬头仰视了一眼这只大得实在有点过分的大老虎。
怎么会这么大啊，就像一座山一样，雄踞在地面之上。
“就算没认出来，那不喜欢这个吗？你爸我特地抓的猎物，一只亚龙！”
陆崇山用兽爪拍了拍地面，顿时震得四周都晃颤了一下，肉食系猛兽特有的咆哮声听得人耳朵都有些麻木了。
“啾……”
陆雪言被震得毛毛都有些晃颤，小心翼翼地看了一眼地上的小龙。
虽然不知道什么是亚龙……
但这、这是被咬死了QAQ？？？
“别怕，这回你爸我先给你演示一下！如何撕碎一只猎物！”
“这一点也不难的！轻松就能做到。”
以为自家崽是有点不自信，陆崇山决定亲自当场展示一下自己炉火纯青的狩猎技术。
更何况没有任何小幼崽会不被自己震撼的。
向来不喜欢变成兽型狩猎的老大不算，老二那家伙小时候看得可崇拜了，眼睛都冒光！
“啾……？”
于是陆雪言根本来不及说些什么，便看着似乎是自家老爸的大老虎直接叼着那只幼崽冲向了开阔的庭院。
相较于陆崇山庞大的身躯，被叼起的那只幼崽龙的确小得仿佛下一刻就会被撕裂成碎片。
“我们也走近点看看？”
陆景屿看了一眼那只猎物，微微蹙眉总觉得有些微妙。
只是一时间也想不到什么。
一只亚龙？“掉下去了！弟弟掉下去了！爸！赶紧接住啊！”
“垫子，快点去接住！”
不仅是一旁的陆亦铭直接吓得大叫起来，连陆景屿看见这一幕脸色都变了。
就算距离地面并不高，但是平时在家里抱着牵着都担心小家伙摔倒，更何况是从空中掉到地上！
而且换成其他猛兽也就算了，小家伙先天性孱弱，让人心疼得根本不想看见任何伤害发生！
然而，就在所有人抬头惊慌失措地看着这一幕，刚刚举着垫子疯狂奔向庭院。
连带着陆崇山都伸出爪子慌张至极地试图接住自家崽的时候€€€€
那条黑色的龙尾巴却违背本能地在空中捞了一圈。
几乎连分秒精确到了巅峰一般，刚刚好用尾巴尖尖圈住了那只坠落的金灿灿小团子。
居、居然接住了！！！
居然被那只亚龙用龙尾巴接住了！？
不是说亚龙一般性情暴躁头脑简单的吗？？？
过于奇异的一幕，让所有人都有些没反应过来，震惊又呆滞地看着这一幕。
微风里，黑龙的龙尾巴的的确确圈住了奶金色的小团子，细软的小绒毛轻轻地晃动着。
而陆雪言闭上眼睛等了好久，非但没有预期中的疼痛，反而感觉自己在空中晃了几下，被什么东西捞住了一样。
“啾？”
自己，没有摔下去么？QAQ
一点点重新睁开眼睛的陆雪言突然发现，自己被一道黑色的尾巴尖尖，沿着翅膀下侧牢牢地圈了起来。
虽然在半空，却多了种微妙的安全感。
是那只幼崽小龙……？
下意识地扒拉着尾巴抬头看过去，刚刚好跟正在垂眸看过来的金色瞳孔对视了一瞬。
只是下一秒，意识到对视后的裴朔便面色冷淡地移开了目光，只留下陆雪言那道有点茫然的视线依然停留在原地。
“啾€€€€！！”
陆雪言还没来得及说话，那条黑色的龙尾却突然圈着自己轻轻一甩。
天旋地转之间，陆雪言瞬间睁大眼睛不可置信地发现自己被甩出去了！
自己……被甩出去了？
“卧槽€€€€又掉下来了！！！”
他妈的！
这亚龙果然不靠谱！！！！
猝不及防的异变突生，同样让所有人都大吃一惊，却又因为过于意外而根本来不及做出任何反应！
毕竟谁也没想到明明已经被接住了，却会被故意重新甩出去！！
chapters.title: 第57章 当小老师的雪言！

chapters.translated_text:
However, just three seconds later, the little fluffball spinning in mid-air was safely caught in the hands of Lu Yiming, who had been the first to run over with a cushion!

"Chirp~?"

"What the hell..."

Lu Yiming looked at his palms, his breathing somewhat constricted. Only after seeing Lu Xueyan blink his wings in a dazed, seemingly unharmed manner did he mutter the second half of his curse, still shaken.

Damn it.

What kind of creature is this sub-dragon???

For the first time in his life, Lu Yiming felt a strange, indescribable sense of fury.

The rest of the people on the scene, after confirming that Lu Xueyan in the palm of his hand was indeed safe and sound without any injuries, also subconsciously cast strange looks at the black sub-dragon still in mid-air.

Lu Yiming, in particular, looked like he wanted to point at it and drag it down for questioning.

Who the hell knows if this was a coincidence or an accident!!! If it had been off by even a millimeter!! He would have fallen to the ground!!!

Combined with the fact that this was just an injured, trashy sub-dragon, Lu Yiming highly suspected that it was purely his own good luck that he had managed to catch his younger brother just in time!!!

Pei Shuo: ...

Yet, whether it was everyone's imagination or not, the sub-dragon showed no reaction to the collective anger, and even looked down at the people on the ground with a strangely mocking gaze.

At most, it paused for a second when making eye contact with Lu Xueyan in the palm, before arrogantly retracting its gaze.

Everyone: Why is it that the more weirdly it acts, the more my fists want to clench?

Did Dad go to the dragon territory this time?

Could this be related to the emergency search warrant received just now...

However, the fat bird in the palm did not answer his brother's question for the first time, instead looking blankly at the little dragon that had been snatched away.

Just now, did I seem to... make eye contact with him?

At the very moment he was snatched from his feet by Lu Chongshan, the young dragon, who had been in a deep slumber, slowly opened his eyes; the indifferent eye contact had been completely unexpected.

A very beautiful gold.

But the next moment, Pei Shuo swept a cold glance around, frowned, and realized his current situation.

For Pei Shuo, it had been a long time since he felt such a chaotic and offensive situation.

The noisy sounds in his ears, the weightless feeling of flight...

This is not the imperial palace.

My spirit body has come out again.

Pei Shuo did not like his spirit body; he could even call it loathing.

And this chaotic, disordered feeling made one feel an indescribable irritability.

As Lu Chongshan was unconsciously preparing to demonstrate a hunt, a terrifyingly dense mental power suddenly overflowed.

It carried a childish scent, yet it appeared all the more terrifying because of it.

To have reached this point before even fully growing up, it was almost impossible to imagine what it would be like in its adult form.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp—"

However, at this critical moment, a sudden, unexpected bird cry rang out in mid-air.

Lu Jingyu’s pupils constricted slightly as he discovered that his younger brother in his palm had actually flapped his wings and flown toward the sky for the first time.

"Dad—be careful! Little brother is over there!"

Lu Yiming, standing to the side, shouted in terror.

And that mental power, which could be described as terrifying, seemed to be suddenly interrupted.

"What the hell, kid, why did you fly over here!?"

Lu Chongshan, not yet able to investigate the heart-palpitating sense of crisis from just a moment ago, widened his eyes as he looked at his son.

He actually, for God's sake, hugged the tail of this sub-dragon!???

On the tail of that pitch-black sub-dragon, a milky-gold little fluffball had somehow stuck itself on.

"Chirp, want, want to keep it..."

Lu Xueyan looked at Lu Chongshan, whose eyes were as wide as copper bells. He had no idea how to stop his dad from killing this young dragon, so he subconsciously and nervously found an excuse.

Just like how he wanted to keep a little rabbit before...

"Want to keep it!? Kid, you want to keep a piece of prey!?"

Lu Chongshan’s booming voice was one of disbelief as he stared at the scene, dumbfounded.

This was basically like a tiger wanting to keep a rabbit as a pet; how could such a thing happen!?

"Kid, you are a—" A beast!!!

"Da, daddy... like."

Just as Lu Chongshan was itching to shake his kid awake, a soft, muffled voice came out.

Every time Lu Huai looked at his younger brother, he would genuinely feel an indescribable sense of joy.

The kind where he wanted to hold him in his arms and give him a good rub.

Although Kremlin said this was because Alphas, as beasts, naturally carried a violent tendency, the unconvinced Lu Huai felt that Kremlin was clearly being sexist!

Lu Huai didn't believe that a Beta or Omega wouldn't want to hug and take a big sniff if they saw his younger brother!

On the other side, the big raccoon cat at the gate of Sunflower Kindergarten waited and waited for Guan Xing, completely unaware of a small figure in the corner.

Guan Xing was hiding at the corner of the kindergarten corridor, looking at his brother with extreme hesitation, before making up his mind to dash toward the blind spot like a vigilant little wolf cub.

At the gate of Sunflower Kindergarten, the old security guard who was drinking tea rubbed his eyes, feeling as if a shadow had just flashed by, but he hadn't seen anything clearly.

This led Guan Yun, who had waited for a long time without picking up his younger brother, to eventually have to take his younger sister inside to find the teacher.

"Guan Xing? Guan Xing already left the office; you didn't pick him up?"

As a result, in the electric bike shed, the teacher who was accidentally stopped asked back in extreme surprise.

"Could it be that brother ran away from home?"

His younger sister, Guan Yu, couldn't help but ask suspiciously.

Guan Yun's face turned pale instantly.

It was still raining today, and that brat Guan Xing hadn't even put on an extra layer of clothes; wouldn't it be over if he ran off and got lost!?

"Don't worry, we'll definitely be able to find him if we check the surveillance!"

Seeing this, the teacher also anxiously tried to comfort him.
chapters.source_text:
然而，就在三秒钟后，半空中旋转着的小团子却安全被抛到了第一个扛着垫子跑来的陆亦铭手中！
“啾~？”
“卧槽……”
陆亦铭有点呼吸不过来地看着掌心，一直看到陆雪言懵懵懂懂抖了抖翅膀似乎安然无恙后，才有点惊魂未定地喃喃骂出了后半句话。
妈的。
这亚龙是什么狗东西？？？
陆亦铭生平第一次产生了一种无法名状的诡异愤怒感。
现场其余所有人在确认了掌心里的陆雪言的确安全无虞，没有受到任何伤害后，同样下意识神色诡异地看向了依然在半空中的那只黑色亚龙。
尤其是陆亦铭，就差指着直接揪下来质问了。
这特么也不知道是巧合还是意外！！！但凡再偏这么一毫米！！都得掉到地上去！！！
再结合这只不过是一只受伤的垃圾亚龙，陆亦铭极度怀疑这完全是靠自己运气好，才刚刚好接住了自家弟弟！！！
裴朔：……
然而也不知道是不是大家的错觉，那只亚龙居然在众怒之下毫无反应，甚至莫名带着点讽刺意味地俯视了一眼地面上的众人。
顶多在跟掌心里的陆雪言对视时略微停留了一秒，便傲慢地收回了视线。
众人：诡异得让拳头越来越硬了是怎么回事？
爸这次跑到龙族领地那边去了？
这会和刚刚收到的紧急搜查令有联系吗……
然而，掌心的肥啾却第一次没有回答自家兄长的问话，而是茫然地看着那只被叼走的小龙。
刚刚，自己好像跟他，对视了一眼？
就在被陆崇山从脚边抓起来的那一刻，原本沉眠中的幼崽龙却缓缓睁开了双眼，漠然间的对视猝不及防到了极点。
很漂亮的金色。
只是下一刻裴朔有些冷漠地扫了一眼四周，便蹙眉发现了自己目前的境况。
对于裴朔而言，很久没有感受过这种混乱而又冒犯的境况了。
耳边喧闹的声音，失重的飞行感……
这里不是皇宫。
自己的精神体又出来了。
裴朔并不喜欢自己的精神体，甚至称得上厌恶。
而这种混乱无序的感觉，更让人感到一种说不出的躁郁。
在陆崇山毫无意识地准备开始演示狩猎之际，一种近乎可怖的精神力突然溢散了开来。
带着些稚气的味道，却又因此而显得更加可怖。
尚未长成便已经到了这种地步，几乎难以想象成年体的那一刻会进展到何等地步。
“啾啾啾€€€€”
然而就在一触即发的这一刻，一道猝不及防的鸟鸣声却突然响起在了半空。
陆景屿瞳孔微微缩紧，便发现掌心里的弟弟居然第一次扑棱着翅膀飞向了天空。
“爸€€€€小心！弟弟过去了！”
一旁陆亦铭都吓得大喊起来。
而那道原本称得上可怖的精神力，也仿佛被突然打断了一下。
“卧槽，崽儿，你怎么飞过来了！？”
陆崇山尚且来不及追究刚刚那种有些心悸的危机感是什么情况，便瞪大了双眼地看着自家儿子。
居然他妈抱上了这只亚龙的尾巴！？？？
那只黑漆漆的亚龙尾巴上，俨然不知道什么时候黏上了一只奶金色的小团子。
“啾，想、想养……”
陆雪言看着眼睛瞪得跟铜铃一样的陆崇山，一时间根本不知道该怎么阻止自家老爸杀掉这只幼崽龙，几乎下意识紧张地找了一个理由。
就像以前想养小兔子一样……
“想养！？崽，你想养一只猎物！？”
陆崇山轰隆隆的嗓音称得上不可置信，目瞪口呆地看着这一幕。
这特么简直等于一只老虎想养一只兔子当宠物，怎么会有这种事情发生！？
“崽，你可是€€€€”猛兽啊！！！
“粑、粑粑……喜欢。”
就在陆崇山恨不得摇醒自家崽儿的时候，一道有点软乎乎的声音传了出来。
陆淮每次看着自家弟弟，都会由衷地产生一种难以言喻的快乐感。
恨不得抱进怀里狠狠搓一顿的那种。
虽然克姆林说这是因为Alpha这些野兽天性就带着一种暴力倾向，但是不服气的陆淮觉得克姆林分明就是性别歧视！
陆淮不信Beta或者Omega看见了自家弟弟就不想抱住狠狠吸一口！
而另外一边，太阳花幼儿园门口的大狸子左等右等关星等不到，浑然没有察觉到角落里的一道小身影。
关星正躲在幼儿园走廊的拐角处，犹豫至极地看了一眼哥哥，就下定决心像一头机警的小狼崽朝着视觉死角处冲了过去。
太阳花幼儿园门口，正在喝茶的老保安揉了揉眼睛，总觉得刚刚有道影子一晃而过，却又什么都没看得清。
导致等了半天没接到幼崽的关云，最终不得不牵着妹妹去里面找老师了。
“关星？关星已经离开办公室了啊，您没接到他？”
结果电动车棚里，被意外拦住的老师诧异至极地反问了一句。
“难道哥哥离家出走了？”
妹妹关雨忍不住狐疑道。
关云的脸色瞬间白了。
今天还下着雨，关星那臭小子都没有加衣服，乱跑出去走丢了不就完了吗！？
“别着急，去调监控肯定能找得到！”
老师见状也焦急地安慰起来。
chapters.title: 第90章

chapters.source_text:
而陆淮正牵着雪言撑伞朝着幼儿园闲庭信步地走去。
走着走着，雪言就看见了菜市场街边摊上五颜六色的棉花糖。
小家伙驻足在转盘机器旁边，忍不住睁大眼睛看向了老爷爷手里的竹签，放在里面居然很快就变成了一朵大大的棉花糖！
“小朋友，要来一支吗？给你便宜点，三块钱一根，让你哥哥买一个？”
老爷爷冷不丁看见一旁抬头盯着看的雪言，也愣了半天。
只觉得从来没见过这么标致的小幼崽！
尤其这小娃娃的头发还是白色的，简直跟自己手里的白色棉花糖成精了一样。
哪天悄悄从一团棉花糖变成人跑走后，又玩腻了跑回来找自己这个老爷子了。
雪言察觉到爷爷的目光后，倒是又眨巴眨巴眼睛回看了过去，除了有点习惯性地扯了扯帽子，试图遮住自己的头发。
“但这个……”看起来爆炸不卫生啊！？
只有陆淮欲言又止地看了看老爷子连手套都没戴的手，又盯着糖渍斑斑的老旧棉花糖机，欲言又止。
然而，当裴朔看着不远处那只金色的狮子后，一时间有些沉默。
那一家的二儿子，精神体的确是性情极为凶悍的巨狮。
但……
“嗷~~”
陆亦铭变成狮子后将自家弟弟放在绒毛里跳了好几下，惹得陆雪言揪着狮子毛儿紧张又不知所措地被带着飞舞个不停。
“好玩吗？”
“啾、啾啾啾€€€€！”
就在陆雪言过山车一般玩得有些过分紧张时，陆亦铭却终于停了下来，叼着自家弟弟摆在了花篮里，下一秒便递过去了一团毛茸茸的东西。
“喏，你哥给你的，算是道歉。”
陆亦铭有点难得脸红，小心翼翼地送出了自己想了很久又问了很多人以后才得到的办法。
这玩意真的是差点把自己做得手都残废了！！！
“啾？”
陆雪言意外地歪头看向了二哥兽爪里的那团金色的毛茸茸小玩偶。
居然是用狮子毛毛扎出来的狮毛版羊毛毡！！（？）
扎成了一只Q版小狮子玩偶，小狮子怀里抱着一根奶金色羽毛！
“啾啾~”
陆雪言忍不住飞到小玩偶旁边，好奇地蹭了蹭。
狮子毛做出来的小玩偶几乎跟陆雪言一般大，站在旁边的模样意外的和谐又可爱。
“拔了你一根毛，你哥我也拔了自己一堆毛儿，这样就扯平啦。”
陆亦铭粗声粗气的说起了话，又忍不住看了看自家弟弟。
chapters.translated_text:
Meanwhile, Lu Huai was holding Xueyan’s hand, strolling leisurely toward the kindergarten under an umbrella.

As they walked, Xueyan spotted the colorful cotton candy at a street stall near the vegetable market.

The little one stopped beside the spinning machine, eyes widening as he watched the old man’s bamboo stick; it was incredible how it quickly transformed into a large cloud of cotton candy!

"Little one, want one? I'll give you a discount, three yuan each. Why don't you ask your brother to buy you one?"

The old man, catching sight of Xueyan staring up at him, was stunned for a long moment.

He felt he had never seen such a stunning little cub in his life!

Especially since the child’s hair was white, making him look exactly like a piece of his white cotton candy that had come to life.

As if it had quietly turned into a human one day, ran off, and then, bored of playing, had come back to find him.

Noticing the old man’s gaze, Xueyan blinked back at him, habitually tugging at his hat to try and cover his hair.

"But this..." It looked incredibly unhygienic, didn't it!?

Only Lu Huai looked at the old man’s ungloved hands, then at the sugar-stained, aged cotton candy machine, his expression hesitant as he held back his words.

However, when Pei Shuo looked at the golden lion not far away, he fell into a momentary silence.

The second son of that family did indeed have a giant lion with a notoriously fierce temperament as his spirit beast.

But...

"Awoo~~"

After transforming into a lion, Lu Yiming placed his younger brother into his fur and hopped around several times, causing Lu Xueyan to clutch at the lion’s mane, nervous and bewildered as he was carried along in a flurry of motion.

"Is it fun?"

"Chiu, chiu-chiu-chiu!"

Just as Lu Xueyan was getting overly nervous from the rollercoaster-like ride, Lu Yiming finally stopped, gently picked up his brother with his mouth, placed him in a flower basket, and the next second, offered him a fluffy object.

"Here, from your brother. Consider it an apology."

Lu Yiming blushed, a rare sight, as he carefully presented the solution he had thought about for a long time and consulted many people to find.

This thing had practically crippled his paws to make!!!

"Chiu?"

Lu Xueyan tilted his head in surprise, looking at the golden, fluffy little doll in his second brother’s beast paw.

It was actually a needle-felted doll made from lion fur!! (?)

It was crafted into a chibi lion doll, with the little lion holding a milky-gold feather in its arms!

"Chiu-chiu~"

Lu Xueyan couldn't help but fly over to the little doll, curiously rubbing against it.

The doll made of lion fur was almost the same size as Lu Xueyan, and standing next to it, the pair looked unexpectedly harmonious and cute.

"I plucked one of your feathers, so your brother plucked a bunch of his own fur. Now we're even."

Lu Yiming said in a gruff voice, unable to stop himself from looking at his younger brother.

chapters.source_text:
“原谅你哥了没有？”
“啾~”
在小团子啾啾声里，陆亦铭没忍住便低头轻轻蹭了蹭小家伙，瞬间让陆雪言东倒西歪地掉进了自家哥哥的狮毛里。
“你哥厉害吧！”
“啾啾啾！”
“嚯，这小子还真的想出来了？”
陆崇山也难得意外地看着这一幕，没想到自家向来粗心大意的老二居然能想出这么个办法。
“那玩意还真是用他自己身上的狮子毛戳出来的？？老二他自己真能戳得出来？？”
对此，陆景屿低头翻过了一页手里的资料，轻轻笑了一声。
“总得让他好好吃一次亏。”
这家伙向来粗心大意吵吵闹闹，难得忍着脾气安安静静待在房间里做了一整天。
只不过看起来，现在又记吃不记打了。“阿朔，那你知道我叫什么么？”
身边的奶金色小团子软乎乎地蜷缩在一侧，明显有点困倦地喃喃说着话。
一旁妥协后原本决定彻底保持沉默的裴朔听到这句，倒是难得地被勾起了几分兴趣。
说起来，自己还的确不知道这胆大包天的小家伙叫什么。
毕竟一般化形之前都很少有给幼崽起正式名字的，这一家似乎也从来没有喊过。
怎么突然提到这个。
“我叫陆雪言……雪天的雪，会有红色叶子的雪天，森林里很多小动物的雪天，原因也很特别的……”
陆雪言认真地介绍起来，只是语气又带着点困意，莫名多了种说不出的梦幻味道。
听着小家伙的介绍，裴朔黑色的龙尾巴不自觉地甩了甩。
这介绍的有点偏题，甚至称得上不着边际，却又莫名符合这小家伙的性子。
或者说，天生就像是这只小妖怪能说出来的话。
一般肉食系猛兽眼中的雪天，大概也不会只有枫叶又或者是什么小动物。
对于大多数猛兽而言，雪天是狩猎的季节，必须储存足够多的热量与物资，才能确保度过未来漫长的冬日。
这是镌刻在血液里的基因本能。
只不过……
“所以叫雪天的原因是什么？”
看着小家伙点头点着就要蜷缩着睡着了，被卡了一半话题的裴朔表情微妙地戳了戳这只小团子。
即便是龙，也不能接受话题戛然而止。
更何况这对听众而言，也是一种极为失礼的行为。
还从来没有人胆敢这样失礼的对待过自己。
“阿朔……原来你也有不知道的事情呀？”
没想到被龙尾巴戳了戳毛毛后，陆雪言反而睁开了困困的眸子，有点笑意地好奇询问了起来。
裴€€从来被长老们夸赞天才€€朔：………………
自己就算再聪明，这种事情你自己不说怎么可能会有其他人知道？！
裴朔只觉得自己平静了几百年的心境产生情绪波动的次数，前后加起来都没遇到这小妖怪后的这几天多。
关键偏偏换成任何一个人说出来都显得极为冒犯的话语，被这小妖怪认认真真地说出口，就仿佛真的只是单纯在好奇一样。
抬头认真凝视起眼前的小妖怪，裴朔第一次产生了几分淡淡的警觉。
自己从来不是能够容忍冒犯的性格。
为什么偏偏这一次一而再再而三的容忍了？
从苏醒后到被带回这一家，再到发展成眼前的现状，一切都显得过分巧合。
“因为我总觉得，你好像什么都知道一样。阿朔，你长得好聪明的样子。”
一点也不像爸爸他们说的难看才对。
就在裴朔准备起身重新警觉地审视这一切的时刻，陆雪言却认真地展开翅膀，有点笨拙地飞到了裴朔的爪子前。
抬头眼睛亮晶晶地说出了下半句话。
夸赞的语气真单纯极了。
也正是因为这份单纯，而显得格外真诚。
被小妖怪突如其来的夸赞打断了前一秒所有情绪的裴朔：……
明明这种话早就从小听到大，偏偏这一次莫名其妙地有种自己应该很荣幸的错觉？？
自己到底在警觉什么……
这种小妖怪，就算有阴谋，估计都能脸红着结结巴巴自己露馅。
“原因其实很简单的。”
不过陆雪言一整天累得不轻，再加上又自认为认真劝阻了剧情的发展，作为一只小幼崽，这一会的确已经有点困。
“因为，我是雪天被捡到的呀……”
以至于陆雪言根本没有注意到裴朔的任何情绪变化，只是认认真真地说完了最后半句话，便不自觉地窝在裴朔身边睡着了。
扇动了几下略有恢复的龙翼，裴朔蹙眉看向了这只睡着了的幼崽。
雪天被捡到的？
不是神谕赐下的吗。
更何况现在分明是夏天。
窗外的蝉鸣声一阵比一阵悠扬，却让裴朔眼底滑过了几分疑虑。
这小家伙并不是会说谎的性格。
高兴得不像样子。
“不过说起来，爸，小家伙现在还不能化形，就算送到幼稚园似乎也不太合适。”
然而也就在这时，陆景屿重新抬头看了一眼远处依旧在嬉闹的狮子跟啾啾，突然跟父亲陆崇山商议了起来。
就算不想让小家伙发现自己的不一样，让陆亦铭天天变成狮子去陪着，这一点也迟早会引发问题。
更何况，化形始终是幼崽必须学会的一件事。
哪怕是食草系幼稚园，往往也要求幼崽必须具备短暂的化形能力。
最低线也是一天二十四小时内可以有四个小时保持人形。
“唔……”
陆崇山瞬间被自家大儿子拉回了现实，顿时也苦大仇深地看了过去。
毕竟自己的狩猎教学大概是彻底失败了。
阖目养神却依旧不自觉听着这一切的裴朔，闻言若有所思地睁开眼，看向了不远处的那只小团子。
看起来，情况居然比自己看见的还要糟糕。
居然到现在连化形都不能做到。
还真是有够弱小的存在。
想起亚伯拉罕那群长老们曾经一度为这颗神赐的幼兽蛋而忧心忡忡的模样，裴朔第一次感到了一种颇为微妙的情绪。
下一秒便再度阖上了眼眸。
跟自己有什么关系。
“您考虑过医生曾经的建议吗？”
而陆景屿却淡淡地继续开口，追问了起来。
“什么建议？”
陆崇山看向了自家大儿子。
“龙血。”
“既然普通的滋养不够，那就定期拿到一瓶龙血。”
龙血里的血脉之力滋养，无疑是最为浓郁的。
最为冷感的语气，却说出了最为狂妄的计划。
“圈养一只真正的龙，定期放血？”
下一秒，陆崇山便无缝连接了起来，神色极度认真地考虑起了这个建议。
“好像也不是不行，你爸我跟老二改天去试着抓一只龙回来？”
反正亚龙抓都抓了，还怕他个真龙？
裴朔：……
这群人，在当着自己说些什么？捕捉自己的子民？？？
倒也不是没有三块钱，而是陆淮怀疑这三块钱的棉花糖吃到小家伙肚子里，家里能再花三百万把小家伙治好。
“那我不吃了？哥哥。”
雪言察觉到哥哥明显不赞同的语调，虽然有点失落，但还是立刻抬头看着哥哥表示自己不想吃棉花糖了。
陆淮被小家伙盯得完全受不了。
事实上，被雪言这种眼神盯着看，陆淮怀疑自己能把家里房子都卖光，给小家伙买任何一切想要的东西。
“可以买一根拿在手上玩，但是不能吃，行不行？”
陆淮最终提出了这么一个有点奇怪的要求。
“好€€€€！”
chapters.translated_text:
"Have you forgiven your brother yet?"

"Chirp~"

Amidst the little fluffball's chirping, Lu Yiming couldn't help but lower his head and nuzzle the little one gently, causing Lu Xueyan to tumble right into his brother's lion fur.

"Your brother is amazing, right!"

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

"Whoa, did this kid actually figure it out?"

Lu Chongshan also looked at this scene with rare surprise; he hadn't expected his usually careless second son to come up with such a method.

"Did he really pluck the lion fur from his own body to make that thing?? Can the second one really pull that off??"

Regarding this, Lu Jingyu lowered his head, turned a page of the documents in his hand, and chuckled softly.

"He needs to learn his lesson properly at least once."

This guy is usually careless and noisy; it's rare for him to suppress his temper and stay quietly in his room for a whole day.

But it seems he's already forgotten the pain before the wound has even healed. "A-Shuo, do you know what my name is?"

The milky-gold little fluffball beside him was curled up softly, murmuring in a clearly sleepy voice.

Pei Shuo, who had decided to remain completely silent after compromising, felt a rare spark of interest upon hearing this.

Come to think of it, he really didn't know what this daring little creature was called.

After all, cubs are rarely given formal names before they can shapeshift, and this family never seemed to have called one out.

Why bring it up all of a sudden?

"My name is Lu Xueyan... 'Xue' for snowy days, snowy days with red leaves, snowy days with many small animals in the forest, the reason is also very special..."

Lu Xueyan began to introduce himself earnestly, though his tone carried a hint of sleepiness, inexplicably adding a dreamy quality that was hard to describe.

Listening to the little one's introduction, Pei Shuo's black dragon tail flicked involuntarily.

This introduction was a bit off-topic, even bordering on nonsensical, yet it strangely fit the little one's personality.

Or rather, it was exactly the kind of thing this little monster would naturally say.

In the eyes of most carnivorous predators, a snowy day probably wouldn't just be about maple leaves or small animals.

For most beasts, winter is the hunting season; one must store enough calories and supplies to ensure survival through the long winter ahead.

This is a genetic instinct carved into their blood.

However...

"So, what is the reason for the name 'Snowy Day'?"

Seeing the little one nodding off to sleep, Pei Shuo, whose topic had been cut short, poked the little fluffball with a subtle expression.

Even as a dragon, he could not accept a conversation ending so abruptly.

Furthermore, for a listener, this was an extremely rude behavior.

No one had ever dared to treat him with such rudeness before.

"A-Shuo... so there are things you don't know either?"

Unexpectedly, after being poked by the dragon tail, Lu Xueyan opened his sleepy eyes and asked curiously with a smile.

Pei—who had always been praised as a genius by the elders—Shuo: ………………

No matter how smart he was, how could anyone else know something if you didn't say it yourself?!

Pei Shuo felt that the number of times his calm, centuries-old state of mind had fluctuated in the few days since meeting this little monster exceeded all his previous experiences combined.

The key was that words which would seem highly offensive coming from anyone else sounded like pure, innocent curiosity when spoken by this little monster.

Looking up and staring intently at the little monster before him, Pei Shuo felt a faint sense of vigilance for the first time.

He was never the type to tolerate offense.

Why was he tolerating it again and again this time?

From waking up to being brought back to this family, and then to the current situation, everything seemed overly coincidental.

"Because I always feel like you know everything. A-Shuo, you look so smart."

Not at all ugly like Dad and the others said.

Just as Pei Shuo was about to stand up and vigilantly re-examine everything, Lu Xueyan earnestly spread his wings and clumsily flew in front of Pei Shuo's claws.

He looked up with bright, sparkling eyes and finished the second half of his sentence.

The tone of his praise was incredibly pure.

And it was precisely because of this purity that it seemed exceptionally sincere.

Pei Shuo, whose emotions from the previous second had been interrupted by the little monster's sudden praise: ...

Even though he had heard such things since he was a child, why did he have the inexplicable illusion that he should feel honored this time??

What exactly was he being vigilant about...

A little monster like this, even if he had a conspiracy, would probably blush and stutter until he gave himself away.

"The reason is actually very simple."

However, Lu Xueyan was exhausted from the whole day, and having convinced himself that he had earnestly prevented the plot from unfolding, he was indeed feeling sleepy as a little cub.

"Because, I was picked up on a snowy day..."

Consequently, Lu Xueyan didn't notice any of Pei Shuo's emotional changes; he just finished the last half of the sentence earnestly and fell asleep, snuggled against Pei Shuo.

Flapping his slightly recovered dragon wings a few times, Pei Shuo frowned at the sleeping cub.

Picked up on a snowy day?

Wasn't he bestowed by a divine oracle?

Moreover, it was clearly summer right now.

The cicadas outside the window chirped more melodiously with each passing moment, but a trace of doubt flickered in Pei Shuo's eyes.

This little one was not the type to lie.

He was happy beyond measure.

"But speaking of which, Dad, the little one can't shapeshift yet, so sending him to kindergarten doesn't seem very appropriate."

Yet at this moment, Lu Jingyu looked up again at the lion and the chirping bird still playing in the distance and suddenly consulted with his father, Lu Chongshan.

Even if they didn't want the little one to discover his own differences, having Lu Yiming turn into a lion every day to keep him company would eventually cause problems.

Moreover, shapeshifting was something a cub had to learn.

Even herbivore kindergartens often required cubs to have basic, short-term shapeshifting abilities.

The minimum requirement was to be able to maintain human form for four hours out of twenty-four.

"Hmm..."

Lu Chongshan was instantly pulled back to reality by his eldest son and looked over with a troubled expression.

After all, his hunting lessons had likely been a total failure.

Pei Shuo, who had been resting his eyes but still unconsciously listening to everything, opened his eyes thoughtfully upon hearing this and looked at the little fluffball not far away.

It seemed the situation was even worse than he had observed.

He couldn't even shapeshift yet.

Truly a weak existence.

Recalling how the elders of Abraham had once been so worried about this god-given cub egg, Pei Shuo felt a rather subtle emotion for the first time.

The next second, he closed his eyes again.

What did it have to do with him?

"Have you considered the doctor's previous suggestion?"

Lu Jingyu continued calmly, pressing the issue.

"What suggestion?"

Lu Chongshan looked at his eldest son.

"Dragon blood."

"Since ordinary nourishment isn't enough, then get a bottle of dragon blood regularly."

The nourishment from the bloodline power in dragon blood was undoubtedly the most potent.

He spoke in the coldest tone, yet proposed the most arrogant plan.

"Capturing a real dragon and draining its blood regularly?"

The next second, Lu Chongshan caught on seamlessly and began to consider the suggestion with extreme seriousness.

"That doesn't seem impossible. How about your brother and I go try to catch a dragon one of these days?"

Anyway, they had already caught a sub-dragon, so why fear a real dragon?

Pei Shuo: ...

What are these people saying in front of me? Capturing my subjects???

It wasn't that they didn't have three yuan, but Lu Huai suspected that if the little one ate that three-yuan cotton candy, the family would have to spend three million to cure him.

"Then I won't eat it? Brother."

Xueyan sensed his brother's clearly disapproving tone; although a bit disappointed, he still looked up at his brother immediately, indicating he didn't want the cotton candy anymore.

Lu Huai couldn't handle being stared at by the little one at all.

In fact, being stared at by Xueyan with that look, Lu Huai suspected he could sell the family house to buy the little one anything he wanted.

"You can buy one to hold and play with, but you can't eat it, okay?"

Lu Huai finally proposed this somewhat strange request.

"Okay~~~~!"

chapters.translated_text:
Just when Kemulin thought time had stretched to a standstill, Lu Xun finally raised his head again and looked at him.

"Why aren't you answering? Do you mean to say that he might be gone by the age of four?"

"No, that's not it, absolutely not!"

Kemulin denied it frantically without a second thought.

Taking the money made him feel compromised, but on the other hand, Kemulin felt that if he even nodded, Chairman Lu Ting might fly into a rage, but Lu Xun represented a different kind of unknown terror.

"Since it's a rare disease, then start a new research project. Unless you want those misappropriated funds to be itemized one by one and sent to an audit, Dr. Kemulin."

The moment Lu Xun mentioned the misappropriated funds, Kemulin’s face flushed with genuine heat, and he hurriedly looked toward Lu Ting at his side.

These massive project funds were never going to be entirely clean; there would always be some blurry gray areas. To an extent, as long as he completed all the tasks, Chairman Lu Ting tacitly allowed him to take that portion of the funds.

But at this moment, Lu Ting turned a blind eye to Kemulin’s plea for help, clearly condoning his eldest son’s behavior.

"But all of this takes time..." In many cases, research into rare diseases might not yield results even after decades!

"I'm not forcing you to complete an impossible task; start from the basic project immediately."

Lu Xun cast a look of disgust at the pile of medications Kemulin had just brought out.

"A basic project?"

Kemulin grabbed onto it like a lifeline.

"At the very least, you need to innovate the medication before he starts kindergarten. For example, make the medicine into the shape of gummy bears."

Lu Xun scanned the room, his gaze finally landing on the digital billboard in the heart of the city center outside the floor-to-ceiling window, which happened to be an advertisement for a currently popular brand of children's gummy bears.

"G-gummy bear-shaped medicine?"

Kemulin swore that in his entire career, he had never heard such a bizarre instruction.

"Otherwise, when he goes to kindergarten in the future, do you want all of my brother's classmates to know that he’s different, an oddity who has to carry a bunch of pill bottles around to take medicine every day?"

Lu Xun shot Kemulin a cold glance, as if looking at an idiot who lacked basic common sense.

Author's note:

[Pricked-ear rabbit head] Big Brother’s brand of Xuebao-exclusive gummy bears! But after Xueyan says he likes Fourth Brother’s orange-scented pheromones better and wants orange-flavored gummy bears... Big Brother has to agree with a calm facade while secretly brooding and twisting inside [dog head]. Of course, Dad’s tobacco-scented pheromones were eliminated from the cub’s flavor selection zone from the very beginning, hahaha.
chapters.source_text:
就在克姆林以为时间漫长到静止的时候，陆巡终于再度抬起了头，看向了自己。
“为什么不回答？你的意思是四岁可能就不见了？”
“不、不是的，绝对不是的！”
克姆林想都不想的就疯狂否认了。
拿钱手软是一方面，另一方面克姆林觉得自己但凡点头了，陆霆董事长可能会暴怒，但陆巡就属于未知的恐怖了。
“既然是罕见病，那就进行新的立项研发。如果你不想那些被挪用的资金被一条条列出来送去审计的话，克姆林博士。”
陆巡提到挪用资金的一瞬间，克姆林是真的脸热到发红了，连忙看向一旁的陆霆。
这些巨额项目资金本来就不可能是完全干净的，多少会存在一些模糊的灰色地带，一定程度上只要自己把任务全都完成了，拿走这部分资金这也是陆霆董事长默许的。
但这一刻，陆霆对于克姆林的求救目光却视若无睹，显然默许了长子这种行为。
“可是这都是需要时间的啊……”很多时候一些罕见病的研究几十年都未必能有成果！
“我又不是在逼迫你完成不可能的任务，现在立刻从基础项目开始做起来。”
陆巡厌恶地看了一眼克姆林刚刚开出的这一堆药剂。
“基础项目？”
克姆林就像抓住了求生稻草。
“至少需要在幼儿园入学之前，把药物创新一下。比如做成小熊软糖形状的药剂。”
陆巡目光环顾了一下，最终落在了落地窗外市中心核心地带的天幕广告牌上，刚好是最近一款火爆的儿童小熊软糖糖品公司广告。
“小、小熊软糖形状的药？”
克姆林发誓自己的职业生涯之中，还从未听到过这样离奇的要求指令。
“否则将来去幼儿园了，你想我弟弟所有的同学都知道，就他不一样，是需要每天带着一堆药罐子去吃药的异类吗？”
陆巡冷冷瞥了一眼克姆林，就像是在看一个不知道基本常识的蠢货一样。
作者有话要说：
[竖耳兔头]大哥牌雪宝专属小熊软糖！结果雪言说更喜欢四哥的橘子味信息素，想要橘子味的小熊软糖后……大哥就要表面平静答应，背地里阴暗变形了[狗头]当然，老爸是烟草味的信息素，从一开始就惨遭淘汰出幼崽口味自选区了hhh
