“不行，到时候我亲自天天跟着过去，看哪个家伙敢！”
越脑补越来火的陆淮狠狠发誓。
“你真的跟个保镖一样地跟在身后，才真的会导致没人敢过来交朋友。”
尽管陆菁总觉得老四这家伙真能做出来这种莽撞的事。
“不过，的确应该每天安排人亲自送过去上学，及时关注动态。”
陆菁抵着下颌思索，或许全家人安排一个值班表比较合适？
闻言陆淮一愣。
等等，那还能有谁比自己更合适？
老爸他们一个比一个忙得不见人影，平时更是世界各地到处飞，自己见保姆司机的次数都比见他们多。
一想到可以每天牵着弟弟下车去上幼儿园，弟弟肯定还会超可爱地认真抬头跟自己说哥哥再见……
说不定还会舍不得离开哥哥狠狠亲一口脸颊，陆淮又开始忍不住嘴角上扬了。
发誓自己这一次绝对要照顾好弟弟，再也不会让弟弟生病了！
尽管陆淮完全没有察觉到老爸陆霆等人同样陷入认真思索的神态。
除了克姆林眼睁睁地看着这一家人已经连上幼儿园到底由谁来接送都讨论起来了，内心只剩下一种想法€€€€
要是小家伙没能成功去上幼儿园，估计自己也不用活了。
唯一保命的方式就是小熊软糖味道的药剂！
克姆林逐渐满脑子都塞满了这该死的小熊软糖，发誓马上就去超市里面买一堆回来！
做糖和做药某种意义上也是殊途同归？
只有陆巡眼看目的已经达到，便不再言语地垂眸看向了酣眠中的幼崽，半晌直接示意一旁的医护递来数据报告亲自审阅起来。
这无疑让一旁的医护们压力倍增，生怕里面有什么纰漏。
除了看向一旁的父亲陆霆等人，陆巡才解释了一句：“这里我来陪床就好了，正好就当倒时差。”
等等，但倒时差是这么倒的吗？
倒时差不更应该是回去睡一觉换自己来陪床的吗？
陆淮默默内心吐槽了一句，奈何大哥陆巡显然没有讨论的打算。
只可惜截至目前都不能确定，是不是都怪自己一时激动，贸然抱着弟弟疯狂兜圈才导致意外发生的。
导致此刻还在不安自责，自认为“犯罪嫌疑人”的陆淮的确没有太多的信心争辩自己也要来陪床。
于是陆霆就纳闷地看向了自己这两个儿子。
一个从来没见他对公司事务以外的事情多上心的，居然主动说要陪床？这小子连夜飞过来，到底几个晚上没睡觉了。
一个从来恨不得成天犯浑黏在弟弟身边的，居然真一言不发地离开了，尽管差不多是一步三回头。
还真是稀奇。
而另一边的保育舱里，随着发烧时脑海里那些朦胧的思绪逐渐与热度一并褪去，一条最新的系统提示也弹了出来。
【宿主请注意！人物健康值持续低于3点，将导致本次穿书提前结束，请注意及时提升。】
健康值？
刚从原本掉到2点的健康值，在治疗之后才堪堪重新升回了3点，并且眼看着稍不注意就会重新下降的模样。
原来健康值变成0的话，又会死掉吗？
陆雪言呆呆地看着这段文字，小脑袋瓜里蓦然浮现出了这个想法。
【不行啊宿主大大，我们这次不能随便再死掉！任务完成了可是有奖励的，完全可以许愿回去再看一眼奶奶啊】
系统察觉到幼崽这种危险想法，恨不得直接长出手紧紧抱住自家宿主。
尽管最开始自己作为系统的确有过私心。
比如期待在重要节点上，唆使自家宿主故意生病咳血，说不定能让这反派一家子愧疚值爆表轻松打断剧情发展……
但真的看见宿主发烧脸色红到异样的难受，系统444突然改变主意了。
什么剧情都不如自家宿主的健康更重要！
而可以去找奶奶这句话显然重新吸引了幼崽的注意力。
自己确实好想奶奶，如果真的改变原书剧情线了，就能找到奶奶了吗？
【而且我们提升健康值的方法也有很多的！】
为了证明自己没有说谎，系统444开始疯狂检索。
比如目前最直接的方式就是系统商店里的积分道具。最便宜的一瓶“活力之水”，售价1000点积分，可提升1点健康值？
系统又看了一眼健康标准。
满分10分，低于1点人物等于濒死状态，低于3点会开始出现发烧、昏迷异常反应，必须到6点才算勉强合格的亚健康。
这一千积分买1点，还是能随时掉的，是不是有点太黑心了？！
系统瞬间想飙泪。
只不过下一秒，就被幼崽试着抱住了这团正难受得想哭的光团。
没关系，我们可以攒积分的呀。
陆雪言一直觉得自己在攒东西这方面很擅长，只要认真地完成各种任务，一定可以顺利攒出好多好多积分。
被宿主抱住的444先是一愣，随后就莫名脸红了，尽管一个系统并不该脸红的。
于是下一秒这团开始害羞的光团就灵机一动，变成了一个小猪存钱罐的形状。
【那我就来当宿主大大的小猪存钱罐好了！】只不过这次存的是积分！
对此猝不及防的陆雪言：！？
就算年纪还小，发现悄悄做的那些梦也被系统看见了，还是相当窘迫的一件事。
自己梦里可还哭了的！
抱着跳进自己怀里撒娇的“存钱罐系统”，陆雪言默默羞愧地低下了小脑袋。
暗中下定决心：
如果以后能长大的话，可绝对不要随便掉小眼泪珠了。
而随着健康值顺利恢复到了3点的及格线，这具身体对外界的感知也逐渐重新变得清晰起来。
四哥说不定等着急了，想早点醒过来找四哥玩。
还想被四哥抱着兜圈！
因为身体原因总是做什么都慢慢的陆雪言，其实对于被四哥陆淮双手举着转圈圈这种玩闹格外喜欢。
奶奶虽然也愿意抱着自己玩，但是年纪大了逐渐抱不动自己了。
四哥却可以特别厉害的轻易做到！特别特别厉害！
然而让陆雪言意外的是，睁开眼睛后四哥熟悉的声音并没有响起，反而是一个从未见过的陌生人。
还好像睡着了？

chapters.translated_text:
Before the little ones returned, Lu Ting, looking at the empty glass dome in the atrium of the vast mansion, felt for the first time the strange illusion of an "empty-nester."

Why was this house so big? So big that it felt hollow and empty.

Aunt Cheng was actually quite worried too, but ever since the last time, she figured they had probably just gone out to play with their older brothers, so she managed to accept it.

As the car pulled into the garden path in front of the foyer, Lu Xun looked up the moment he walked through the door and saw his father waiting: "We're back."

Lu Ting, who was quite familiar with his children's personalities and temperaments, instantly sensed that his eldest son was in a bad mood—or rather, he was extremely annoyed.

Fortunately, the next second, Lu Ting saw the reason for his eldest son's bad mood.

It was because the fourth son, Lu Huai, was happily lifting the little one high up, spinning around in a disorderly fashion as he walked through the door.

Xue Yan, being spun around by his fourth brother, was nervous yet excited; he subconsciously held on tight, and was finally placed steadily on the ground by his brother.

Just then, the phone in Xue Yan's pocket suddenly vibrated with a new notification.

Was another item rewarded by the game previously about to take effect?

If this was real, wouldn't it implicitly mean that the effects of the "Aura" were also real?

Xue Yan hesitated for a moment, then tried clicking "Use."

A strange, brilliant light erupted before his eyes and transformed into a mirror.

The mirror displayed the fate of his good friend Lu Jie over the next ten years!

Five years later, Lu Jie’s family would suddenly become wealthy due to the demolition of their old house; however, before Xue Yan could even feel happy for him, the situation began to take a sharp turn for the worse.

Overnight, Lu Jie, now in possession of a large sum of money, was quickly "hunted" by a group of socialites who specifically targeted families displaced by demolition. They used so-called "brotherly loyalty" to lure and trick Lu Jie into trying various novel things and standing up for "friends," while they acted as intermediaries to borrow money or seize the chance to cash out.

Several million in demolition compensation was swindled away in just half a month.

By the time Lu Jie realized something was wrong, those so-called "brothers" had vanished without a trace...

The final scene in the mirror showed Lu Jie working at a construction site to pay off his debts, surrounded by several guys holding iron bars; what would happen next was almost self-evident.

Moreover, this Lu Jie, with his dull and numb eyes, was a completely different person from the vibrant, youthful Lu Jie in Xue Yan's memories.

"Xue Zai? Xue Zai?? Why did you suddenly hit the brakes? Are we not going home?"

Xue Yan was stunned for a long time before Lu Jie waving his hand in front of him finally pulled his attention back.

Coming back to his senses, Xue Yan subconsciously reached out and grabbed Lu Jie: "A-Jie, you must never get a tattoo in the future!"

The group of people who intentionally corrupted Lu Jie in the mirror's vision had first approached him by bringing up the topic of tattoos.

"Ta-tattoo? Huh? Xue Zai, how did you know I wanted to try getting a tattoo? I thought it looked cool when I saw it in a movie."

Lu Jie repeated, stuttering, feeling a bit embarrassed as his arm was held by Xue Yan.

The next second, Xue Yan turned the car around and headed toward a bookstore by the roadside; soon, Lu Jie was stuffed with a book by Xue Yan.

"I bought this set for you; make sure you finish it during the summer break." Just as Xue Yan finished his protest, the game notification rang unexpectedly, and the favorability rating jumped from 10 to 15 right before his eyes.

Xue Yan: ? On the way home, Xue Yan was still pondering the so-called "Moon God Aura," while Lu Jie was immersed in the great victory of earning money from his first-ever street stall, unable to help but exclaim how happy it was to make money.

"Xue Zai, this is the first time I've realized how happy it is to earn my own money."

Hearing this, Xue Yan, whose train of thought had been interrupted, smiled: "Then maybe you can try it in the future? Find a job and experience the feeling of earning your own money."

For the first time in his life, Lu Jie didn't retort, but instead began to think about it seriously.

In the past, when his family urged him to study, his first reaction was always impatience and resistance, but when the same words came from Xue Yan, for some reason, they didn't feel annoying at all.

He even wanted to consider it carefully.

But what could he actually do?

His brain wasn't good enough, he couldn't handle studying, maybe he should just forget it...

Xue Yan looked at the notification, then at the little "coal ball" sleeping in front of him, whose small wings were trembling slightly, and after a long moment of hesitation, he suddenly realized something.

Could it be that this little guy was already awake and just pretending to sleep?

And was likely secretly listening to him talk?

That would seem to explain why his wariness hadn't spiked rapidly again after he had picked him up and offered a word of comfort earlier.

Thinking of this, Xue Yan lowered his eyes to look at the cub who was lying motionless, pretending to sleep while actually pricking up its ears.

Even though it was pretending to sleep, why did it feel even cuter?

Could this be considered shyness?
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 63: The Little Rabbit Sticker Reading Pen
chapters.source_text:
而在小家伙们回来之前，看着空空落落的大宅中庭玻璃拱顶的陆霆，第一次诡异产生了一种空巢“老人”的错觉。
这房子怎么就这么大呢，大到感觉空落落的。
程姨其实也挺担心的，但是自从有了上次的经验，心想可能是跟着哥哥们出去玩了，倒也勉强还能接受。
随着车辆停在了门厅前的花园小路上，陆巡刚一进门就抬头看见了在等人的老爸：“我们回来了。”
相当熟悉几个儿女性格脾气的陆霆瞬间察觉到老大此刻心情不妙，甚至可以称得上非常不爽。
好在下一秒，陆霆就看到了老大心情不妙的原因。
因为老四陆淮正兴高采烈地抱着小家伙举高高，走路都没个正型的转圈进了门。
被四哥抱着转圈的雪言紧张又兴奋，下意识抱得牢牢的，最后被四哥稳稳地放在了地上。
结果就在此时，雪言口袋里的手机突然震动出现了新的提示。
游戏里之前奖励的另一个道具，居然也要产生效果了？
如果这个是真的话，岂不是变相说明光环的效果也是真的？
雪言犹豫了片刻，尝试着点击了“使用”。
一阵奇异至极的光芒在眼前爆发变成了一面镜子。
镜子里展现的居然是好友陆杰未来十年的命运！
五年后的陆杰家里老房子拆迁而陡然暴富，然而不等雪言为陆杰感到高兴，情况就开始急转直下。
一夜之间身怀巨款的陆杰很快被一伙专门盯着拆迁户的社会人士“围猎”，用所谓的兄弟义气引诱哄骗陆杰尝试各种新奇的玩意和为朋友出头，他们则居间或是借钱，或是趁机套现。
几百万的拆迁款在短短半个月内就被哄骗一空。
等到陆杰察觉到不对劲时，那伙所谓的哥们已经消失得无影无踪……
镜子里的最后一幕场景，赫然是陆杰在工地上打工还债时，被几个手持铁棍的家伙们围在了身周，接下来会发生什么几乎不言而喻。
而且这个眼神浑浊麻木的陆杰，和雪言记忆中那个带着鲜活少年气的陆杰判若两人。
“雪崽？雪崽？？你怎么突然按刹车了啊？我们不回家了吗？”
雪言愣怔了许久，才被陆杰挥手示意了半天拉回了注意力。
回过神来的雪言直接下意识伸手按住了陆杰：“阿杰，你以后绝对不可以纹身！”
镜子画面里故意带坏陆杰的那伙人，最初就是用纹身这个话题接近的陆杰。
“纹、纹身？啊？雪崽你怎么知道我想试试纹身的？看电影的时候感觉很酷。”
陆杰结巴地重复了一遍，被雪言按住的胳膊还有些不好意思。
结果下一秒，雪言直接调转车头奔向了路边的书店，很快陆杰怀里就被雪言揣了一本书。
“这套书买给你，你暑假抓紧做。”只是雪言刚刚抗议了一句，游戏提示又猝不及防地响起了，好感度从10眼睁睁跳成了15。
雪言：？另一边回家的路上，雪言依旧在思索那个所谓的月神光环，陆杰则沉浸在人生第一次摆摊赚钱的大胜利之中，情不自禁发出了赚钱很快乐的感慨。
“雪崽，我第一次发现原来自己赚钱这么开心。”
闻言被打断了思绪的雪言也笑了一下：“那以后你也可以试试？找一份工作尝试一下自己赚钱的感觉。”
陆杰生平第一次没有反驳，而是认真思索了起来。
以前被家里人劝读书的时候，自己第一反应就是很不耐烦很抗拒，但是同样的话从雪言嘴里说出来，莫名其妙就让人觉得不讨厌。
甚至还想仔细考虑考虑。
但自己可以干些什么呢。
自己脑子不够好，读书也读不动，要不然还是算了……
而雪言看看提示，又看看眼前这颗睡着了的小煤球轻轻颤了一下的小翅膀，迟疑半晌后突然反应过来了。
难道这小家伙已经醒了，只是在装睡？
而且多半还在偷偷听自己说话？
这样似乎就能解释，为什么之前自己举起来安抚了一句后，戒备心会没有再急速上涨了。
想到这里，雪言垂眸看向一动不动装睡实则在悄悄竖起耳朵的幼崽。
虽然在装睡，但感觉更可爱了怎么回事？
这算是在害羞吗。
chapters.title: 第63章 小兔子贴纸点读笔

chapters.source_text:
不过因为毛毛都是黑色的，所以害羞了也看不出来。
雪言最终将小家伙安置在了自己的床边一只棕色竹编小篮子里，顺便把盆盆奶塞到了一旁，醒过来就能喝到。
只是话又说回来，刚刚洗澡时雪言就发现煤球藏在毛毛里的那对小翅膀，似乎左边的短了一截。
雪言刚想伸手拨开软毛再看看翅膀究竟是个什么情况。
毕竟如果发现问题的话，早点干预肯定比未来长大了效果更好一点。
结果屏幕上却立刻弹出了一条最新提示：【好感度未达标，强行触摸幼崽禁忌部位，可能引发极端危险后果！】
看见这条语气严重的系统提示，雪言瞬间停下了动作。
“睡着”的小家伙则若有所感地悄悄挪了一下身子，有点小心翼翼地将翅膀藏在了绒毛里，背对着了雪言。
似乎不愿意被雪言发现翅膀的缺憾一样。
对此雪言注视了半天，自然放下了手掌。
暗中紧绷的幼崽也缓缓松弛了下来。
“啾……！”
结果下一秒，雪言的手掌突然换了个方向，轻轻揉了揉幼崽毛茸茸的脑袋。
这是好感度15刚刚解锁的新互动：RUA毛毛。
被揉脑袋的幼崽明显震惊到浑身都僵硬了一秒。
但随着雪言毫无攻击性的温柔触摸，又缓缓放松了下来，唯独藏在身下的小尾巴慌张地勾住了篮子，泄露了一丝心情。
“别紧张，等到愿意展开翅膀的那一天，再给你仔细看看吧。”
看着眼前努力装睡的煤球，雪言轻轻说了一句。
直觉告诉雪言，那一天应该不会太晚到来。
“雪崽雪崽，快过来€€€€！”
好巧不巧，此时院子里的陆杰也打完了电话，热情呼唤起了雪言。
也就在雪言起身去找陆杰时，选择关机的手机界面突然卡住了，下一秒便弹出了一连串的动画提示。
“这什么啊？《行测5000题》？”
陆杰脑子都快长出来了，雪崽怎么突然有点不对劲。
“你不是想找工作赚钱吗？考公就不错。而且我记得，你小时候不是说你想当警察？记住了，纹身过不了体检。”
雪言一本正经地劝说起来，陆杰还真被唬住了。
对哦，纹身虽然很酷，但纹了可就没法考公了。
陆杰大脑开始宕机，眼睁睁看着雪言把这套书和一堆东西结账装了起来，准备扔到三轮车后座上。
直到雪言准备开车，陆杰才终于反应过来：不对啊，自己一个霸气大哥大为什么要考公？！
瞬间悲愤抱住了这烫手的考公教材：“不行，这要是回去被他们看见了得笑死我！”
“那你丢掉？”
雪言眨巴眼睛看了过去。
这一招以退为进反而成功让陆杰又支支吾吾了起来：“……丢掉干什么，都是花钱买的！这不浪费吗？！”
看得原本有点忧心忡忡地雪言忍不住笑了。
也许是自己多虑了，至少目前的阿杰依然是自己认识的那个阿杰。
下午开车到家后，雪言将钱清点好后塞到了家里奶奶缝的布包里。
知道雪崽“辛苦”赚了钱，奶奶心疼又自豪地在厨房里面做着点心，陆杰跟一众朋友们则在院子里帮忙布置起了从超市里买回来的小火锅。
为了庆祝今天卖桃行动的大获全胜，向来寂寥的乡间小院难得热闹了一回。
“雪哥，听说你还给杰哥买了礼物！？他光炫耀都不给我们看的！”
很快有人跟雪言告状起来，觉得陆杰这次很不义气。
雪言诧异看向了陆杰，陆杰脸色顿时心虚得一塌糊涂。
不错，是礼物，但完全不好意思拿出来啊！
“等他愿意告诉你们的那天再给大家看好了，到时候我再送大家一人一份一样的礼物。”
雪言笑着解释了一句，顿时引发了全场欢呼和期待“好耶！不愧是我雪言哥！威武€€€€”。
只有陆杰脸色更怪了。
不是，你们知道是什么礼物吗就在这儿瞎高兴！？
陆杰第一次有点怀疑自家兄弟们是不是都有些缺心眼。
或许也是因为雪崽笑眯眯说出这种话，根本不会有人怀疑送的礼物会是魔鬼考试题！
一直等到雪言站定了，陆淮才松开了抱着小家伙的两只手：“开心不开心？好玩不好玩？！四哥转的圈圈厉害不厉害？”
“开心！好玩，超级厉害€€€€”
雪言笑着小喘气说道。
顿时让陆淮满意又€€瑟地再度翘起了嘴角，当着大哥陆巡的面重新站直了身体。
“老四你……”
陆霆看着老四这明显是踩着雷点在挑衅的举动，欲言又止。
算了，老四自己作死，何必管他。
反正皮实的很。
“走了走了，这都几点了，我们得去睡觉喽，乖崽。”
chapters.title: 第98章
chapters.translated_text:
However, because the fur was all black, you couldn't tell even if it was blushing.

Xue Yan finally settled the little guy into a small brown woven bamboo basket beside her bed, and conveniently tucked the milk bowl to the side so it could drink as soon as it woke up.

But then again, while bathing it just now, Xue Yan had discovered that the pair of small wings hidden in Meiqiu's fur seemed to be a bit shorter on the left side.

Xue Yan had just wanted to reach out and push aside the soft fur to see what was actually going on with the wings.

After all, if there was a problem, early intervention would definitely be more effective than waiting until it grew up.

As a result, a latest notification immediately popped up on the screen: [Affection level has not reached the threshold; forcibly touching the cub's sensitive areas may trigger extreme and dangerous consequences!]

Seeing this stern-toned system notification, Xue Yan instantly stopped her movements.

The "sleeping" little guy seemed to sense something and quietly shifted its body, carefully tucking its wings into its fluff, turning its back to Xue Yan.

It seemed as if it didn't want Xue Yan to discover the flaw in its wings.

Xue Yan stared at this for a long time, then naturally lowered her hand.

The cub, which had been tense in secret, also slowly relaxed.

"Chirp...!"

The next second, however, Xue Yan suddenly changed the direction of her hand and gently rubbed the cub's fluffy head.

This was a new interaction just unlocked at affection level 15: RUA (rubbing) the fur.

The cub, having its head rubbed, was clearly so shocked that it stiffened for a second.

But as Xue Yan's gentle, non-aggressive touch continued, it slowly relaxed again, though its little tail, hidden underneath, nervously hooked onto the basket, betraying a hint of its mood.

"Don't be nervous. When the day comes that you're willing to spread your wings, I'll take a closer look at them then."

Looking at Meiqiu, who was trying hard to pretend to be asleep in front of her, Xue Yan said softly.

Intuition told Xue Yan that that day shouldn't be too far off.

"Xue Zai, Xue Zai, come over here!"

As luck would have it, Lu Jie had just finished his phone call in the yard and was enthusiastically calling out to Xue Yan.

Just as Xue Yan got up to find Lu Jie, the phone interface, which she had chosen to turn off, suddenly froze, and the next second a series of animation prompts popped up.

"What is this? '5000 Civil Service Exam Questions'?"

Lu Jie's brain was about to explode; why was Xue Zai suddenly acting so strange?

"Don't you want to find a job and make money? Taking the civil service exam is a good option. And I remember, didn't you say when you were little that you wanted to be a police officer? Remember, tattoos won't pass the physical exam."

Xue Yan began to persuade him with a straight face, and Lu Jie was actually taken in.

Oh right, although tattoos are cool, you can't take the civil service exam if you have one.

Lu Jie's brain began to crash as he watched Xue Yan check out this set of books and a pile of other things, preparing to throw them into the back seat of the tricycle.

It wasn't until Xue Yan was ready to drive that Lu Jie finally reacted: Wait, why would he, a domineering big brother, want to take a civil service exam?!

He instantly hugged the scorching hot civil service study materials in grief and indignation: "No way, if the others see this when I go back, they'll laugh me to death!"

"Then do you want to throw them away?"

Xue Yan blinked and looked over.

This tactic of advancing by retreating successfully made Lu Jie stammer again: "...Why throw them away? I spent money on them! Wouldn't that be a waste?!"

Seeing this, Xue Yan, who had been a bit worried, couldn't help but laugh.

Perhaps she was overthinking it; at the very least, the A-Jie of the present was still the A-Jie she knew.

After driving home in the afternoon, Xue Yan counted the money and stuffed it into the cloth bag Grandma had sewn at home.

Knowing that Xue Zai had "worked hard" to earn money, Grandma, feeling both pained and proud, was making snacks in the kitchen, while Lu Jie and a group of friends were helping to set up the small hot pot bought from the supermarket in the yard.

To celebrate the overwhelming success of today's peach-selling operation, the usually quiet country courtyard was lively for once.

"Brother Xue, I heard you even bought a gift for Brother Jie!? He's just showing it off and won't even let us see it!"

Soon, someone came to complain to Xue Yan, feeling that Lu Jie was very disloyal this time.

Xue Yan looked at Lu Jie in surprise, and Lu Jie's face immediately turned guilty as hell.

It was true, it was a gift, but he was completely too embarrassed to take it out!

"Let's wait until he's willing to tell you all before showing it to everyone. By then, I'll give everyone the same gift."

Xue Yan explained with a smile, which immediately triggered cheers and anticipation from the whole crowd: "Yay! As expected of my Brother Xue Yan! Mighty!"

Only Lu Jie's expression became even weirder.

No, do you guys even know what the gift is to be cheering like this!?

For the first time, Lu Jie doubted whether his brothers were all a bit dim-witted.

Perhaps it was because Xue Zai said such things with a smile that no one would ever suspect the gift would be devilish exam questions!

Not until Xue Yan stood still did Lu Huai let go of the two hands holding the little guy: "Are you happy? Was it fun?! Was your Fourth Brother's spinning circle impressive?"

"Happy! It was fun, super impressive!"

Xue Yan said with a smile, panting slightly.

This immediately made Lu Huai satisfied and smugly raise the corners of his mouth again, standing up straight in front of his eldest brother, Lu Xun.

"Fourth, you..."

Lu Ting looked at the Fourth Brother's actions, which were clearly stepping on landmines to provoke, and stopped himself from speaking.

Forget it, the Fourth Brother is courting death himself, why bother with him.

He's thick-skinned anyway.

"Let's go, let's go, what time is it? We have to go to sleep, little one."

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 64: The Cookie Man with a Necktie
chapters.translated_text:
Hearing this, Pei Shuo finally stood up again, his gaze fixed on Modian under the bed with great dissatisfaction.

He had originally wanted Modian to perform a show for Xueyan on the spot tomorrow.

He hadn't expected Modian to be so lazy.

What if Xueyan ended up liking other small animals more by then?

At the very least, during kindergarten class today, Pei Shuo had been listening to Guan Yu vividly describe to Xueyan how they raised foals on the prairie.

She had especially widened her eyes to emphasize how she and her brother had personally touched the bloody, warm placenta of a newborn foal!

It made Xueyan feel a bit scared and nervous, yet also amazed and fascinated, feeling as if her two little friends, Guan Xing and Guan Yu, had walked right out of a prairie storybook.

After all, in Princeton Kindergarten, no other children had experienced such strange and exotic stories on the prairie.

"Aowu..."

Sensing his little master Pei Shuo's disappointment, Modian poked his fluffy head out from under the bed, the little tiger looking quite wilted.

"Aowu!"

So it was a bat?!

It just looked completely different from a real-life bat; it was essentially a black, fluffy ball with two wings attached.

As for the lack of talent, it wasn't a big deal; he hadn't expected to pull an SSR on the first try anyway.

And the hint that maxing out the affection level could unlock "strange phenomena" made Xueyan feel a bit curious.

Based on what had happened so far, it was certain that the features unlocked by this game always provided unexpected surprises or shocks; he just didn't know what this "strange phenomenon" would be.

However, when Xueyan read to the very last line, his gaze finally rested on the "Monster Notes" at the end of the description.

It sounded a bit fierce.

At the very least, "abyss" probably referred to the coal-ball's pitch-black appearance? It did indeed blend into the darkness when hiding in a corner.

But to call it a monster?

That was just nonsense.

Since when does a pitch-black abyss go "chium" at you?

"Besides, who has such a cute little monster at home?"

Xueyan couldn't help but reach out and lift the little guy up again, feeling incredibly satisfied no matter how he looked at it.

Even if it was the lowest-level encounter card exchanged for 500 gold coins, it couldn't be called a monster!

The varied cries made Pei Shuo squat down and quickly grab Modian, pinching his furry cheeks while pondering: If he can't talk, at least he should be dressed up?

Xueyan should still really like a pretty little tiger.

And so, the professional styling team that had been waiting in the parlor for a long time was stunned for a long while when they discovered that the first thing they needed to style was actually a white tiger.

Perhaps rich people just have many eccentricities!

"But, will this tiger bite people?"

The long-haired stylist among them looked at Modian with great fear.

"Aowu—"

However, just as Modian was about to bare his teeth to warn the strange person in front of him not to get close, he was grabbed by the tail by Pei Shuo in the next second: "If I don't let him bite people, he won't bite."

Did that mean if he let him bite people, he would...?

The staff members didn't dare to speak anymore and just buried their heads in their work.

While Pei Shuo was sending Modian off to be groomed and styled, Old Fu, the Pei family's always professional animal training team manager, began to think hard.

Fortunately, the reward had also doubled, becoming 100 gold coins.

Naturally, Xueyan, who always completed his daily tasks upon logging in, grabbed his basket and put on his gloves before heading out.

"Isn't it just picking herbs?"

Theoretically, with his rich experience in the fields, it shouldn't be much of a problem.
chapters.source_text:
闻言裴朔终于重新站起来了，目光盯着床底下的墨点却很不满。
自己本来还想明天让墨点给雪言当场表演展示一下节目的。
没想到墨点居然这么懈怠。
万一到时候雪言有了更喜欢的小动物怎么办？
至少今天幼儿园上课的时候，裴朔就一直听关雨在那边绘声绘色给雪言说大草原上是如何养小马驹的。
尤其睁大眼睛强调自己跟哥哥还亲手摸过刚被母马生出来的小马驹那腥气而又温热的胞衣！
听得雪言有点害怕紧张，又有点惊奇着迷，觉得关星关雨这两位小伙伴简直像是草原故事书里走出来的人物。
毕竟普林斯特幼儿园里，可不会有其他小朋友在草原上经历过这些稀奇古怪的故事。
“嗷呜……”
对此墨点从床底下探出来了毛茸茸的脑袋，似乎感受到了小主人裴朔的失望，整只老虎都有点蔫吧。
“嗷呜！”
原来是蝙蝠？！
只是长得跟三次元里的蝙蝠完全不一样，就是团黑色毛绒球多了两截翅膀。
至于没天赋问题不大，本来自己也没指望一发抽中一个SSR。
而这个好感度满值可以解锁奇异现象的提示又让雪言有点好奇。
根据目前已经发生的情况可以确信，这游戏解锁的功能总能给人一些出乎意料的惊喜或者惊吓，就是不知道这个奇异现象会是什么了。
不过，当雪言一路读到最后一行字时，目光最终停留在了这段介绍最后的“怪物笔记”上。
听起来，好像有点凶。
至少深渊应该指的是煤球黑漆漆的外表？躲在角落的时候的确和黑暗融为一体了。
但你说这是怪物？
那就有点胡说了。
哪儿有黑漆漆的深渊会对着你“啾姆”一声的？
“关键谁家能有这么萌的小怪物？”
雪言忍不住伸手再次举起来了小家伙，无论怎么看都满意得不得了。
就算是500金币兑换的最低级奇遇卡，也不能说是怪物好吧！
声调不一的叫唤，让裴朔蹲下最终眼疾手快地一把给墨点薅出来了，捏着毛茸茸的脸颊思索道：不能说话的话，至少也打扮一下？
雪言应该还是很喜欢漂亮的小老虎的。
于是在会客厅里等待许久的专业造型设计师团队，最终发现他们首先需要打扮的居然是一只白色老虎，也是错愕了半天。
可能有钱人的怪癖就是很多吧！
“但是这老虎，会咬人吗？”
其中那位留着长头发的造型师看着墨点很是害怕。
“嗷€€€€”
然而刚想龇牙警告不许眼前奇奇怪怪的人接近自己的墨点，下一秒就被裴朔揪住了尾巴：“不让他咬人是不会咬人的。”
意思是让他咬人就会咬人的吗……？
一众工作人员顿时也不敢说话了，闷头就是一个干字。
就在裴朔给墨点塞去打扮做造型的时候，一旁裴家那位向来很有职业素养的驯兽团队经理老福则努力思索了起来。
好在奖励也翻倍了，一下子变成了100金。
对此上线必做日常的雪言自然提着篮子戴上手套就出门了。
“不就是采草么？”
理论上对田野经验丰富的自己应该不是什么大问题。
chapters.title: 第64章 戴领带的饼干小人
第99章
chapters.translated_text:
However, while the imagination is beautiful, doing it alone is unexpectedly not easy.

Xue Yan discovered that within a 5-meter radius around the wooden cabin, there existed a translucent "newbie barrier," and the grey-black miasma and strange, bizarre flora and fauna outside could not enter this safe zone.

But to pick the thorn grass, one had to step out of the barrier. Once outside, if one came into contact with the miasma or got scratched, their HP would actually decrease accordingly.

Xue Yan lost 15 HP just from successfully picking the first thorn grass, and since it takes 1 minute to recover 1 HP, the difficulty had indeed doubled.

What gave Xue Yan the biggest headache was that his human height of 1.78 meters was completely insufficient in this monster forest, and many thorn grasses happened to grow in high places.

"Chium..."

Just as Xue Yan was trembling while stepping on a side branch, trying to grab a thorn grass growing on the waist of an ancient tree, Meiqiu's voice unexpectedly came from behind him.

The little guy was flapping its wings with rare effort, crookedly grabbing the thorn grass, and the next moment it bit it off and placed it in Xue Yan's palm.

After delivering the thorn grass, it silently squatted by the basket and looked up at Xue Yan.

Xue Yan looked at this scene in surprise, then looked at the precious thorn grass in his palm.

Could it be... the little cub is taking the initiative to help its old father parent with chores?!

Old Fu, full name Fu Anzong, was the head of the professional beast-tamer team arranged by the old master to take care of Mo Dian back in the day.

In his youth, Old Fu was a famous wild animal photographer active in wildlife areas around the world, until a severe arm injury in a field accident led to him being rescued by the animal protection foundation then acquired by Old Master Pei; since then, he simply retired and took a position at the Pei family.

Because he was responsible for feeding and caring for Mo Dian, he became one of the few people who could talk to the young master Pei Shuo, although this also had something to do with Old Fu's personality.

In Old Fu's view, since the young master hoped that our Mo Dian could speak at tomorrow's birthday party and shock all the children in kindergarten, then we, as the hired professional team, should of course worry about the employer's worries before they do!

"But manager, how can a tiger possibly talk?"

The nutritionist on the side whispered, feeling that the manager was being way too intense.

"Exactly, maybe the young master's kindergarten classmate was just asking if Mo Dian could talk on a whim."

Yet the young master took it seriously.

Children naturally go through a period of animism, believing that everything in the world can speak, and when they grow up a little more, they will realize that this is impossible to achieve.

"True, objectively a tiger cannot speak, which is why we need to find a way subjectively! Otherwise, what are we getting paid such a high salary for!?"

Old Fu, who had always been good at self-PUA, began to think of ways.

"Achoo—"

At this moment, Xue Yan, who was being talked about, sneezed.

After returning home, Xue Yan reopened "Demon World," originally wanting to check on Meiqiu and complete some daily tasks along the way.

The surprise was that he and Meiqiu had actually picked up a new fluffy creature from the forest during the mission!

A sleek, oily, injured, and lonely little black wolf.

Xue Yan hesitated for a moment, intending to treat it equally by giving it a simple bandage and putting it back into the forest.

If he let this fluffy creature run deep into the forest, wouldn't it accidentally enter the territory of that big lion?

"Of course, the main thing is that these are 'cheap' fluffy creatures that can be RUA-ed without spending gold coins on gacha."

As a zero-氪 (non-paying) civilian player, Xue Yan was truly grateful that the "Demon World" game gave out so many benefits; it was very conscientious.

As of now, except for Meiqiu, no other fluffy creatures had cost him a single gold coin.

"Chium."

Only Meiqiu, squatting on Xue Yan's shoulder, tilted its head and chirped upon hearing this.

Anyway, it was definitely not A-Yan's cheap fluffy creature.

If you talk about the Pei family's salary and benefits, they were indeed incredibly high; the old master was very generous in this regard, which led everyone to look at each other while also starting to think.

For example, going to a temple to pray overnight? Let the Bodhisattva show some miracles.

Let Mo Dian learn to speak overnight so that at tomorrow's birthday party, the young master could hold Mo Dian and show off the stunt to his classmates?

But then again, it was clearly Young Master Pei Shuo's birthday, so why did the birthday boy have to rack his brains to prepare a show for the classmates attending the party?

"Sigh, so which kid asked this question..."

If they hadn't asked if Mo Dian could speak, maybe there wouldn't be such a daunting task?

And Xue Yan still didn't know that because of his sentence "Can Mo Dian speak?", Pei Shuo had been tormenting Mo Dian during this time.

At this moment, Xue Yan was being led by a shop assistant to the mirror like a little doll, turning his head to look at his brother who was holding a phone to take pictures.

The eldest brother, Lu Xun, who was originally sitting on the sofa, had unknowingly squatted to one side, and the phone in his hand had almost never stopped for the entire time.

The assistant following on the side originally wanted to help with the filming, but was directly waved away by the eldest brother.

At first, Xue Yan hadn't noticed this little wolf cub; it was Meiqiu who discovered the anomaly after scouting around.

The little guy flew over directly, carefully observing for a long time, seemingly judging whether there was any danger.

"Is this stuck by a tree branch and can't get out?"

After turning around and seeing Meiqiu's movements, Xue Yan also squatted down to check the situation.

If it weren't for the system prompt, Xue Yan would have guessed that this was a grey-black Samoyed.

Stuck by the branches and unable to move, it had already lost its vigor and was curled up on the spot, dying.

Perhaps its parents and companions had left first after failing to rescue it; after all, the forest was indeed very dangerous.

Xue Yan found a machete to cut the branches and carefully reached out to hug the weak little guy out.

"The mission is finished, let's go back, Meiqiu."

Taking a look at the mission panel, the infrastructure series of daily tasks had been completed to the last link, meaning the entire mission chain would officially end today.

Theoretically, the rewards would definitely be very good, and Xue Yan was quite looking forward to it.

You have to know that although the gold coin rewards are doubled in immersive mode, making money is still not easy, and every time he buys some flower seeds or builds some decorations, the expenses are quite...

The very next sentence dealt two critical hits to Lu Huai.

Damn!

Uncle Zhang on the side was startled, looking at Lu Huai, who was suddenly so angry he turned red.

Because at this moment, Lu Huai touched his bank account balance and really couldn't confidently say that he could do it.

Damn it, you just wait for me, let's spend the eldest brother's money together first!

So the next second, Lu Xun opened the group chat again and saw the fourth brother, who could bend and stretch, starting to choose; he sent a string of numbers [1], [2], [4], no, [3] also looks good, still have to add, add... he kept sending until [11].

The little guy was taken to the fitting room to try on 11 sets of small clothes in total, and all of them were chosen by the fourth brother, Lu Huai.

Even if he didn't like the eldest brother, Lu Huai had to admit that Lu Xun's aesthetic taste was at least a little bit good; almost every set looked very suitable.

Of course, it mainly relied on Xue Yan's face!

The emotional value was very different.

Seeing the fourth brother's incompetent rage, Lu Xun, who raised his eyebrows and put down his phone, inexplicably made the big civet on the side feel that the great god's brother was in a great mood right now.

The evidence was that the corners of Lu Xun's mouth had never come down! The act of swiping the card was even terrifyingly refreshing.

Those sales clerks were like seeing big spenders; they couldn't wait to bring over all the children's clothes in the building and let Xue Yan try them on one by one.

As for the same moment, Lu Li, who was putting on makeup in the background, saw the photos in the family group on his phone. After a long silence, he saved each photo one by one, even the two identical ones, before replying in a leisurely manner.

After clicking confirm, Xue Yan thought something would happen, but this time, unexpectedly, nothing strange happened.

His nervous mood dissipated quite a bit.

Perhaps it wasn't as complicated as he imagined.

In life, where are there so many spectators who would pay attention to an unremarkable ordinary person?

"Okay, then let's just simply disinfect the wound..."

Xue Yan touched the little wolf cub, convinced that the little guy was still just sleeping, and carefully picked up the tools on the side to treat the wound.

However, what Xue Yan didn't know was that the moment he clicked confirm, countless phones in the real world that were originally off-screen vibrated and received the latest notification from the "Demon World" app.

It was clearly a very official push notification, but it seemed like it was shouting for all demons to come and see it immediately.

And the sensational effect produced by this bizarre push message was no less than dropping a nuclear bomb directly among all the monsters.

Even Pei Shuo, who was about to get out of the car, paused his movements and looked at the rare message notification on his phone.

Update live interaction?

How has this game's update efficiency been getting higher and higher lately?

It hadn't seen any movement for so long before, but recently it had been updating content one after another.

The series of analyses sent by the third brother from a professional perspective made Lu Xun ponder and compare carefully.

For a time, the family group had become a discussion group for Xue Yan's clothing coordination, and even the second sister, Lu Jing, took the time to reply a few words.

The makeup artist Chen Lan on the side rarely saw Lu Li lowering his eyes and being immersed in replying to messages. Her gaze subconsciously swept across the screen, and the next second she met the eyes of Lu Li, who looked up, almost shaking her hands in fear.

"Sorry, I didn't mean to look at your phone!"

Countless guesses flashed through Chen Lan's mind in an instant.

As the descendant who fused the eyebrows and temperament of both Lu Ting and Ye Yuan to the greatest extent in the Lu family, Lu Li was indeed the most similar to Xue Yan.

It wouldn't be like the fourth brother and the others, where outsiders couldn't see the blood relationship at all.

"Does it look good?"

Unexpectedly, not only did Lu Li not blame her, but he raised the photo on his phone a little higher.

Makeup artist Chen Lan couldn't resist the temptation of the little cub and looked at it carefully.

The little guy in the photo was wearing the latest off-white coat from H brand, with a cashmere scarf around his neck that looked like it had excellent texture. His eyebrows were so beautiful that they didn't look like a real person; if someone said he was a child model for H brand, which never looks for models or spokespersons, people would probably believe it!

Could it be a business cooperation with a child star?

"Mr. Pei, hello, hello! I didn't expect you to be so young..."

The school leaders of Luwai who were waiting on the side had already looked over with smiles on their faces, naturally not giving Pei Shuo a chance to secretly play with his phone.

In fact, the school leaders responsible for the reception were collectively surprised the first time they saw Pei Shuo, thinking they had seen the wrong person.

They had thought that this mysterious figure who returned to Lu Province from overseas to worship his ancestors would most likely be that kind of prestigious, pot-bellied middle-aged boss.
chapters.source_text:
只不过想象很美好，一个人做起来意外不轻松。
雪言发现木屋四周半径5米内存在一种半透明的新手结界，外部的灰黑色瘴气和奇异怪状动植物都是无法进入安全区的。
可是想要采摘荆棘草，就必然得迈出结界，迈出结界后一旦接触到瘴气或者被划伤，生命值居然会相应下降。
雪言光是成功采到第一棵荆棘草就被扣了15点生命值，而恢复1点生命值需要1分钟，难度确实翻倍了。
最让雪言头疼的是，自己作为人类一米七八的身高在这片魔物森林里的确完全不够用，很多荆棘草偏偏又长在高处。
“啾姆……”
就在雪言颤颤巍巍地踩在侧枝上，试图抓到长在古树腰部的一株荆棘草时，身后却出乎意料地传出来了煤球的声音。
小家伙罕见努力拍打着翅膀，歪歪扭扭地叼住了那棵荆棘草，下一刻就咬下放在了雪言掌心里。
送出荆棘草后，自己则默默蹲在了篮子边儿上，抬头看向了雪言。
雪言诧异地看着这一幕，又看了看掌心里这棵珍贵的荆棘草。
难道这是……小幼崽主动在帮忙老父亲家长干活？！
老福全名福安宗，是当年随着墨点一块被老爷子安排过来照料墨点的专业驯兽师团队负责人。
年轻时的老福是一名活跃在世界各地野生动物活动区的著名猛兽摄影师，直到一次野外事故中胳膊严重受伤，恰好被当时裴老爷子收购的动保基金会撞见救下，从此干脆退隐在裴家任职了。
还因为负责墨点喂养照料的缘故，成为了为数不多能跟小少爷裴朔说得上话的人，尽管这跟老福的性格也有点关系。
在老福看来，既然小少爷希望咱们墨点能够在明天生日宴上开口讲话，震惊一众幼儿园的小朋友们，那我们作为被雇佣的专业团队，当然也应该先雇主之忧而忧！
“但是经理，老虎怎么着也没办法说话吧？”
一旁的营养师小声说道，总觉得经理这也太卷了。
“就是，说不定小少爷的那位幼儿园同学，当初也就随口一问墨点能不能说话而已。”
结果小少爷还当真了。
本身小朋友就会有一段泛灵期，认为世界上的一切都可以开口说话，等再长大一点就会意识到这根本是不可能实现的了嘛。
“不错，客观上老虎是没办法说话，所以才需要我们主观上想办法啊！否则我们拿这么高的工资干什么吃的呢！？”
向来擅长自我PUA的老福就开始想办法了。
“啊切€€€€”
这一刻被念叨的雪言则打了个喷嚏。
回到家后雪言重新打开《魔界》，本来想看看煤球动静顺带完成一下日常任务的。
结果意外的是，自己和煤球居然在任务途中从森林里捡到了一只新的毛茸茸！
一头油光水滑的受伤落单黑色小狼。
雪言犹豫了片刻，就打算一视同仁给对方简单包扎一下放回森林里。
再让这毛茸茸往深处乱跑的话，岂不是就误入那大狮子的领地了。
“当然，最主要这可都是不用金币抽卡就能RUA到的‘便宜’毛茸茸。”
作为零氪平民玩家，雪言是真的很感激《魔界》这游戏发福利发的真挺多的，太良心了。
截至目前，除了煤球，其他毛茸茸都没花自己一分金币。
“啾姆。”
只有蹲在雪言肩膀上的煤球闻言歪着脑袋叫唤了一声。
反正自己肯定不是阿言的便宜毛茸茸。
你要说裴家的工资待遇，那还确实高得没话说，老爷子在这方面给的相当丰厚，导致大家面面相觑的同时，也开始跟着思考了起来。
比如连夜去庙里拜一拜？让菩萨显显灵。
连夜让墨点学会说话，在明天生日会上就可以让小少爷抱着墨点去同学面前展示特技？
但话又说回来了，明明是裴朔少爷的生日，为什么寿星反而还要掏空心思给参加宴会的同学准备节目展示？
“哎，所以到底是哪个小朋友的问的这句话……”
但凡不问墨点会不会说话，可能也就没有这么艰巨的任务了？
而雪言尚且不知道，因为自己的一句“墨点会说话吗？”导致这段时间的裴朔在一个劲地折腾墨点。
此时的雪言正跟个小洋娃娃似的被柜员姐姐牵到镜子面前，扭头看向了一旁举着手机拍照的哥哥。
原本坐在沙发上的大哥陆巡，不知不觉间已经半蹲在了一侧，手里举着的手机几乎全程没有停下过。
一旁跟着的助理原本想帮忙拍摄的，都被大哥直接挥退了。
起初雪言还没有注意到这只小狼崽，还是煤球四下侦查后发现的异常。
小家伙直接飞了过去，小心翼翼地打量了半天，似乎在判断有没有危险。
“这是被树枝卡住出不来了吗？”
雪言转身看见煤球的动静后，也跟着蹲下来察看情况。
如果不是系统提示，雪言估计会以为这是一只灰黑色的萨摩耶。
被树枝卡住后动弹不得，此刻已经有点没了动静，奄奄一息地蜷缩在了原地。
大概是家长和同伴营救无果后就先行离开了，毕竟森林里的确非常危险。
雪言找来砍刀将树枝砍断后，小心翼翼伸手将虚弱的小家伙抱了出来。
“正好我们任务也完成了，回去吧煤球。”
看了一眼任务面板，基建系列日常任务已经完成到了最后一环，等于整个任务链都将在今天正式结束。
理论上奖励肯定会很不错，雪言还挺期待的。
要知道沉浸模式下虽然金币奖励翻倍，但赚钱也依旧不大容易，每次买点什么花种或者搭建一些装饰物开销都很
紧接着的一句话更是给陆淮带来两个暴击。
草！
一旁的张叔吓了一跳，看向了突然气到红温的陆淮。
因为这一刻的陆淮摸着自己的银行账户余额，确实没办法理直气壮说出自己可以这句话。
可恶，你给我等着，先让我们一起来花大哥的钱吧！
于是下一秒陆巡再打开群聊，就看见老四能屈能伸地开始选了，发来了一串数字【1】、【2】、【4】，不对，【3】也好看，还是得加上加上……一直发到了【11】。
小家伙一共被牵去试衣间换了11套小衣服，全被四哥陆淮选上了。
哪怕看老大再不爽，陆淮还是不得不承认，陆巡的审美好歹还是有那么一丁点的，几乎每一套穿着都很合适。
当然，主要还是靠雪言的脸蛋！
情绪价值就很不一样。
看到老四无能狂怒后，挑眉放下手机的陆巡，莫名让一旁的大狸子感觉大神他哥现在心情好极了。
证据就是陆巡的嘴角一直没放下来过！刷卡的动作更是爽快得可怕。
那几位柜员小姐简直就像看见了开单大户一样，恨不得把整栋楼的童装全都抱过来，让雪言挨个试过去。
至于同一时刻，正在后台化妆的陆黎看见了手机上家族群里的照片，沉默半晌依次将每张照片，哪怕一模一样的两张都保存下来后，才慢条斯理地回复了起来。
点击确认之后雪言本以为会发生什么，但是这次出乎意料没有任何奇怪的事情发生。
紧张的心情倒是随之消散了不少。
也许没有想象中那么复杂。
生活里哪儿有那么多观众会关注一个平平无奇的普通人呢？
“好，那我们就先简单给伤口消个毒……”
雪言摸了摸小狼崽，确信小家伙依旧只是在昏睡，便小心翼翼地拿起一旁的工具处理起来了伤口。
然而雪言不知道的是，就在他点击确认的那一刻，现实世界里无数原本熄屏中的手机都震动收到了一条《魔界》APP的最新提示。
明明是很官方的推送，但似乎就差吆喝着所有魔速速来看了。
而这条离奇到极点的推送消息所产生的轰动性效应，不亚于直接在全部魔物堆里扔下了一颗核弹。
就连正准备下车的裴朔都动作一顿，看向了手机上罕见的消息推送。
更新直播互动？
这游戏最近的更新效率怎么越来越高了。
以前那么久没见过一次动静，最近几乎是接二连三地更新内容。
老三从专业角度发来的这一串分析，倒是让陆巡沉吟着认真对比了起来。
一时间家族群赫然变成了雪言的服装搭配讨论群，就连二姐陆菁也抽空回复了几句。
一旁的化妆师陈岚难得看见陆黎垂眸沉浸式地回复消息，目光下意识从屏幕上划过，下一秒就跟抬眼看来的陆黎对视了，差点吓到手抖。
“抱歉，我不是故意看您手机的！”
陈岚的脑海里一瞬间浮现出了无数种猜测。
陆黎作为陆家最大程度融合了陆霆和叶鸢双方眉眼气质的后裔，的确跟雪言也是相对最像的。
并不会如老四他们那样在外人看来简直完全看不出血缘关系。
“好看吗？”
出乎意料的是，陆黎非但没有责怪，反而将手机上的照片抬高了几分。
化妆师陈岚忍不住小幼崽的诱惑，仔细地看了起来。
照片上的小家伙穿着一身H家最新款的米白色大衣，脖子上还系着一看就质感极好的羊绒围巾，眉眼更是漂亮得不像真人，说是从不找模特和代言人的H家童模恐怕都有人信！
难道是有跟小童星的商务合作？
“裴先生，您好您好！没想到居然这么年轻……”
而等候在一旁的麓外校领导们早已笑容满面地看了过来，自然没有给裴朔偷玩一把手机的机会。
事实上，负责接待的校领导众人看见裴朔的第一眼，甚至集体诧异得以为看错了人。
本以为这位从海外归国回麓省祭祖的神秘人物，大概率会是那种德高望重、大腹便便的中年老总。

chapters.title: 第100章
chapters.translated_text:
Simply out of patriotism, he often returned to the country to engage in charitable donations and philanthropic endeavors despite living abroad.

Never in a million years did they expect Pei Shuo to be not only so young but also sporting a head of blonde hair, with pupils the color of a pale, beast-like gold.

His physique was so imposing that even a single glance could make one feel a sense of oppression.

At this moment, Pei Shuo was attending official scheduled events and couldn't check his phone, but the "Demon World" forum had completely exploded.

Countless swarming monsters were heatedly discussing the latest update, only to find, to their dismay, that this heartless game required 1,000 points just to open the new feature.

Isn't this too unscrupulous?

What kind of livestream could it possibly be to dare to demand so many points?

The Lu family and the Pei family were already at odds, so the idea of them meticulously preparing gifts sounded highly unlikely.

After thinking for a long time, Xue Yan took out the small cookies she had made before going to bed.

She also asked Aunt Cheng for a little bit of shredded seaweed.

"Oh my, what do you need this for?" Although Aunt Cheng was puzzled, she still found it for the little one.

And so, she watched as Xue Yan used the shredded seaweed to mimic a small necktie on the neck of the human-shaped cookie, just like she had learned in her craft class.

"Is this a cookie person wearing a necktie? How exquisite," Aunt Cheng asked with a smile as she watched the little one.

"Mm!"

Not expecting Aunt Cheng to guess it right away, Xue Yan’s eyes curved into crescents as she nodded in confirmation.

"Is this a gift too?" Aunt Cheng asked curiously.

After a black and red system notification appeared, the livestream interface opened successfully.

To An Xun's surprise, the interface wasn't empty; there was actually a livestream currently in progress.

#Treating the wounds of a little wolf cub, it's a very cute fluffy one#

The title was simple and straightforward.

After clicking into the livestream, the visuals were very familiar—the typical art modeling style of the "Demon World" app.

However, the specific environment was a bit unfamiliar; it might be in a map location he didn't know.

After all, the map of "Demon World" was so vast that it hadn't been fully explored by all players yet, and the various strategy maps shared on the forum were all fragmented.

But what surprised An Xun was that this was actually a human.

You have to know that humans never appeared in "Demon World," not even as the human forms of monsters!

At this moment, the camera was very close, showing only a fair, slender hand holding an alcohol-soaked cotton swab, carefully tending to the wounds of the wolf cub.

"Mm-hmm." This time, Xue Yan nodded as well, though she felt a bit unsure.

She wondered if this remedy was still a bit too simple.

"The little friend who receives both these gifts will surely be overjoyed. When they grow up and can tie a necktie, they can take a photo with the cookie—what a meaningful memory that would be."

Seeing the little one's mood improve, Aunt Cheng quickly coaxed her.

Xue Yan’s eyes widened slightly as she listened.

When Pei Shuo grew up a bit more, it seemed he really could become a cookie person wearing a necktie.

But by the time Pei Shuo could tie a necktie, wouldn't the cookie have gone moldy?

A flurry of strange and whimsical thoughts flooded the little one's mind.

However, these worries of Xue Yan’s didn't have the chance to become reality the next day.

Because not long after the gift was given out the next day, it was secretly eaten by Louis.
chapters.source_text:
单纯因为爱国所以身居海外也经常回到国内做一些公益性的捐赠资助事业。
万万没想到裴朔不仅如此年轻，甚至是一头金发，瞳孔的颜色则是近似兽类的淡金色。
身材高大到哪怕对视一眼，都能令人感受到一种压迫感。
此时出席官方活动行程的裴朔暂时看不了手机，《魔界》论坛可是直接炸了。
无数蜂拥而至的魔物们热议着这一次的最新更新，却坑爹地发现这黑心游戏光是打开新功能都要扣1000点积分。
这也太黑心了吧？
你得是什么直播，才敢狮子大开口收这么多积分？
陆家跟裴家本来就不对付，精心准备礼物什么的听起来就不太可能嘛。
雪言在想了很久之后，还是在睡觉之前把自己做的那份小饼干拿出来了。
又找程姨要了一点点海苔丝。
“哎呦，要这个干什么呀？”程姨虽然迷惑不解，但还是给小家伙找来了。
于是就看着雪言用海苔丝，在人形小饼干的脖子上，学着手工课拼出了一条小领带的模样。
“这是一个系着领带的饼干小人吗？可真精致呐。”程姨笑眯眯地看着小家伙询问道。
“嗯！”
没想到程姨一下子看出来了，雪言顿时眉眼弯弯地点头示意。
“这也是礼物吗？”程姨好奇地问道。
一条黑红色的系统提示出现后，直播界面顺利打开。
出乎安洵意料的是，界面并非是空的，而真的有一个直播间在开启着。
#给小狼崽处理伤口中，是一只很可爱的毛茸茸#
标题很是简单直白。
点开直播间后，画面非常熟悉，典型的《魔界》APP美术建模风格。
只不过具体环境稍微有点陌生，可能是在自己不知道的地图位置。
毕竟《魔界》地图之大，至今都没有被所有玩家探索完毕，论坛分享的各种攻略地图也都是碎片化的。
但是让安洵意外的是，这居然是一个人类。
要知道《魔界》里面从来不会出现人类，哪怕是魔物们的人类形态！
此时画面凑得很近，只能看见一只骨节分明的白皙手掌正拿着酒精棉签，小心翼翼地处理着那只幼狼的伤口。
“嗯嗯。”这一次雪言也点了点头，但有点不自信。
心想这样补救一下，会不会还是有点太简单了？
“那这两个礼物一起收到的小朋友肯定开心极了，等以后长大了能系领带了，再拿着饼干拍个合照，多有纪念意义啊。”
程姨眼看小家伙心情转好，连忙哄了起来。
听得雪言微微睁大眼睛。
等裴朔再长大一点，好像真的就可以变成系领带的饼干小人了。
但是等到裴朔能系领带的时候，饼干是不是又发霉了？
小家伙的脑袋瓜里一时间浮现出来了很多稀奇古怪的想法。
只不过雪言的这些担心，在第二天并没有机会成为现实。
因为这份礼物第二天送出去没多久，就被路易给偷偷吃了。

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 65: Beautiful Xueyan at the Birthday Party
chapters.source_text:
而陆家全家对于小家伙即将第一次被邀请去参加幼儿园小朋友生日宴这件事，也颇为心态复杂。
一方面有点担心小家伙去人多的地方会不会被传染感冒发烧，一方面也知道，这显然是上了幼儿园后自然而然会出现的集体活动。
作为老爸的陆霆，显然不会舍得让雪言看着班上其他小朋友都热热闹闹地去玩了，而只有自家乖崽一个人安安静静地坐在教室里。
光是想想那个画面，陆霆都会忍不住自我愧疚谴责半天。
小家伙玩得不开心，那当然是因为家长无能！
“哎呀，其实理论上应该问题不大，去之前做好防护什么的，然后衣服也稍微多穿点，别着凉了。”
克姆林摸着小家伙的脑袋，想着的却是自己这段时间的研究发现。
如果真的是自己所推测的这样，多让小幼崽参与正常小朋友会参加的活动，说不定反而能提高身体的适应性，促使幼崽对环境变化给身体带来的负担逐渐脱敏。
至少理论上，本该尽可能少与Alpha接触的小家伙，在家长们轮流亲自带睡之后，也并没有产生任何排斥反应。
反而活泼了不少。
“啾……”
视线中心的奶金色小团子翅膀翕动了一下，歪头眨巴了下眸子。
然而，下一秒，便在期待的目光里毫不犹豫地蹭了蹭自家大哥的脖子。
“啾啾！”
当然是大哥！
对此，不出意外地传来了一道冷哼和几声咳嗽，而陆景屿则微微勾起唇角，伸手托住了小小家伙。
“我很荣幸。”
“啾啾啾~！”
陆雪言看着自家大哥，真的好喜欢。
明明一点也不坏呐，超级让啾安心的！
尤其是每天晚上主动抱着枕头找家长晚安的模样，简直能把人的心脏都看得融化了。
“那我们家乖崽今天可得打扮得好点，让他们看看究竟谁家乖崽这么乖，是不是？”
陆霆举着怀里的小家伙，好胜心熊熊燃烧地谆谆叮嘱道。
用老爸陆霆的话来讲那就是，绝对不能给裴家那虚伪浮夸的一家子给摆谱摆成功了。
区区一个幼儿园生日宴会还搞得这么讲究排场，简直浮夸！
也不怕把那个姓裴的小崽子惯坏了。
至于自家乖崽会不会因为太过可爱，导致在生日宴上抢走了裴家那个小寿星的风头，那就不在老爸的陆霆考虑范围之中了。
呵呵，这难道不是硬实力吗？
自家乖崽的完美之处，就像一个人想打喷嚏一样，是一种藏都藏不住的客观事实！
如果作为寿星的风头被抢走了，那裴家应该首先去反思一下是不是自家实力太差，而不是责怪乖崽太过惹眼！
一旁的克姆林等人听了陆霆的傲慢冷哼，欲言又止。
系统猝不及防地一上线就跟无数双眼睛对视，吓得立刻试图推醒自己宿主崽。
天惹，看来宿主幼崽期太可爱也不是什么好事！
自己这个系统都得担惊受怕的！！
承担起本不该属于一个系统的监护人烦恼！
“啾……”
而陆雪言顿时被焦急的系统吵得颤了颤，糯米滋一般的在花丛里滚动了一圈，差点掉出花篮边沿！
“啊€€€€”
“掉出来了！”
顿时让人担心地就想伸手接住。
只是就在下一秒，小家伙便倒挂在了篮子边儿，一下子苏醒了过来，扑棱着翅膀就飞了一圈，重新立在了花篮把手上。
“啾、啾啾……？”
夹紧小翅膀，茫然地跟周围一圈正伸手挡在篮子四周的人对视起来，陆雪言突然有点以为自己没睡醒。
为什么……这么多人呐？
这是在干什么？为什么都伸着手？？
心想论浮夸跟排场，好像您也不差啊……？
可能大多数位高权重的Alpha，天生人格里都带着一种唯吾独尊的霸道感，永远只能自己看不惯别人，不准别人看不惯自己的。
而雪言对于穿什么衣服去参加裴朔的生日宴会倒是没有太多的想法，小家伙单纯在紧张裴朔会不会喜欢自己准备的礼物。
大概是裴朔这段时间实在太期待了，越是追问反而越让雪言压力很大。
一时间抱着小盒子都有点想临阵脱逃了。
“那我们出发了。”
几分钟后，牵着换好衣服的小家伙缓步走出来的陆巡，不动声色地在全家面前展现了一下自己的采购搭配成果。
难得不需要在班级活动中穿统一的幼儿园园服，雪言今天外面套着一件看起来就暖和又舒适的米色幼崽大衣。
版型极好的廓形大衣衣摆自然撑开，显得衣摆下幼崽的两条小细腿笔直又匀称，跑起来更是极为可爱。
此刻被哥哥牵在腿边的雪言，还有点不习惯地低头看一眼自己的小衣服，下意识黏在了哥哥身侧，不好意思被家长集体盯着看。
这让陆巡忍不住眼底浮现笑意，伸出另一只手替小家伙理了理发丝，想把小家伙从腿侧重新哄出来。
系统看到自家宿主醒了，顿时认真地开始告状。
只是就在陆雪言紧张地跟系统纠结时，对面的兔子忍不住抽了抽鼻子，蹦跳着跑了过来，轻轻顶了一下一旁的陆雪言。
“啾~啾啾！”
猝不及防地被小兔子用顶得差点倒下去，然而啾啾叫出来的下一秒就被小兔子小心翼翼用前JIO扶住了翅膀。
chapters.translated_text:
The entire Lu family had rather complicated feelings about the little one being invited to a kindergarten classmate's birthday party for the first time.

On one hand, they were worried that the little one might catch a cold or fever in a crowded place; on the other hand, they knew this was a natural collective activity that would inevitably arise after starting kindergarten.

As a father, Lu Ting certainly couldn't bear the thought of Xueyan watching all the other children in class go off to have fun while his own precious baby sat quietly alone in the classroom.

Just thinking about that scene made Lu Ting feel a wave of self-reproach and guilt.

If the little one wasn't having fun, it was obviously because the parents were incompetent!

"Well, theoretically, it shouldn't be a big problem. Just make sure to take precautions before going, and maybe dress her in a few extra layers so she doesn't catch a chill."

Kemulin stroked the little one's head, though he was thinking about the findings from his recent research.

If his hypothesis was correct, letting the little cub participate in normal childhood activities might actually improve her physical adaptability and help desensitize her body to the burdens caused by environmental changes.

At the very least, theoretically, the little one—who was supposed to have as little contact with Alphas as possible—hadn't shown any rejection reactions after the family members took turns sleeping with her.

On the contrary, she had become much more lively.

"Chirp..."

The milky-gold little ball at the center of everyone's attention fluttered her wings, tilted her head, and blinked her eyes.

However, the next second, she didn't hesitate to nuzzle against her eldest brother's neck under their expectant gazes.

"Chirp chirp!"

Of course it's big brother!

Unsurprisingly, this was met with a cold snort and a few coughs, while Lu Jingyu curled his lips slightly and reached out to support the tiny little one.

"I am honored."

"Chirp chirp chirp~!"

Lu Xueyan looked at her big brother; she really liked him so much.

He wasn't bad at all; he was super reassuring to her!

Especially the way he would take the initiative to hold his pillow and look for his parents to say goodnight every evening—it was enough to make anyone's heart melt.

"Then our precious baby must dress up nicely today, so we can show them whose baby is the cutest, right?"

Lu Ting held the little one up, his competitive spirit burning as he gave his earnest instructions.

In the words of her father, Lu Ting, they absolutely could not let that hypocritical and pretentious Pei family show off successfully.

To make such a big fuss over a mere kindergarten birthday party was simply extravagant!

They weren't even afraid of spoiling that little brat surnamed Pei.

As for whether his own precious baby would steal the spotlight from the little birthday boy at the party because she was too cute, that was not within Lu Ting's scope of consideration.

Heh, isn't that just a display of raw strength?

The perfection of his own precious baby was an objective fact that couldn't be hidden, just like one's inability to suppress a sneeze!

If the birthday boy's spotlight was stolen, the Pei family should first reflect on whether their own strength was lacking, rather than blaming his baby for being too eye-catching!

Kemulin and the others on the side heard Lu Ting's arrogant snort and wanted to say something, but held back.

The system, having just come online, was caught off guard by meeting countless pairs of eyes and immediately tried to wake its host cub.

Oh my god, it seems being too cute during the cub stage isn't a good thing for the host!

Even a system like itself has to be worried and scared!!

Bearing the burden of a guardian's worries that shouldn't belong to a system!

"Chirp..."

Lu Xueyan was suddenly startled by the anxious system, rolling around in the flower cluster like a piece of mochi, nearly falling off the edge of the flower basket!

"Ah—"

"She's falling out!"

Everyone immediately wanted to reach out and catch her in their worry.

But in the next second, the little one hung upside down from the edge of the basket, suddenly waking up, flapping her wings, and flying in a circle before landing back on the handle of the flower basket.

"Chirp, chirp chirp...?"

Tucking her small wings in, she looked blankly at the circle of people around her who were reaching out to guard the basket, and Lu Xueyan suddenly wondered if she hadn't woken up yet.

Why... are there so many people?

What are they doing? Why are they all reaching out their hands??

Thinking to themselves, when it comes to pretentiousness and pageantry, it seems you aren't any worse, are you...?

Perhaps most powerful Alphas are born with a sense of arrogance in their personality, where they can only look down on others and never allow others to look down on them.

As for Xueyan, she didn't have many thoughts about what to wear to Pei Shuo's birthday party; the little one was simply nervous about whether Pei Shuo would like the gift she had prepared.

Perhaps Pei Shuo had been looking forward to it so much lately that the more he asked, the more pressure Xueyan felt.

For a moment, holding the small box, she even felt like running away before the battle.

"Then we're off."

A few minutes later, Lu Xun, who was holding the hand of the little one who had changed her clothes, walked out slowly and calmly displayed the results of his shopping and styling to the whole family.

It was rare that she didn't have to wear the uniform kindergarten outfit for a class activity; today, Xueyan was wearing a beige cub coat that looked warm and comfortable.

The well-cut silhouette of the coat naturally flared out, making the cub's two thin, straight, and well-proportioned legs under the hem look even cuter when she ran.

At this moment, held by her brother at his side, Xueyan looked down at her little outfit, feeling a bit unaccustomed to it, and subconsciously clung to her brother's side, feeling shy about being stared at by all the parents.

This made a smile appear in Lu Xun's eyes; he reached out his other hand to tidy the little one's hair, wanting to coax her out from beside his leg.

Seeing that its host had woken up, the system immediately began to report the situation earnestly.

Just as Lu Xueyan was nervously struggling with the system, the rabbit opposite couldn't help but twitch its nose, hopping over and gently nudging Lu Xueyan.

"Chirp~ chirp chirp!"

Caught off guard, she was almost knocked over by the little rabbit's nudge, but the second she chirped, the little rabbit carefully used its front paws to support her wings.
chapters.title: 第65章 生日宴的漂亮雪言
第101章
chapters.translated_text:
Twitching its ears, the light tea-colored bunny affectionately licked the downy feathers of Lu Xueyan.

"Chirp?"

Having been so nervous he felt like he might fly away, Lu Xueyan was caught off guard and blushed, feeling at a loss when he realized the bunny was just kissing his head.

"Everything I think is perfectly fine seems to be completely unsuitable for my younger brother."

Scratching his head, Lu Yiming felt for the first time in his life that his brain wasn't quite enough for the task.

"Young Master, I think perhaps we could look for some less ferocious animal cubs... well, maybe ones whose appearance doesn't evoke such strong feelings of endearment..."

For example, that rabbit from earlier was clearly the wrong choice.

In the silence that filled the room, his father, Lu Ting, couldn't help but press his fist to his lips, rendered speechless by how adorable his precious child was.

Heavens above, how did Yuan'er and he manage to produce such a cute creature!?

It was enough to make any parent want to work hard for another lifetime just to earn everything in the world for the little one!

Heh, and the key point was, wouldn't he easily outshine all the other little brats in kindergarten? His own precious child was simply the best!

The more he thought about it, the happier Lu Ting became, like a proud father eager to hold his child and show him off to the whole world.

As for Lu Huai, who was currently busy taking photos and uploading them to the group chat for Lu Jing and Lu Li to admire remotely, he felt purely sour inside—so sour that for the first time, he wished he could take his eldest brother's place...

Damn it, according to Lu Huai's directorial script, the little one was supposed to be wearing the beautiful outfit that the fourth brother had personally purchased and styled to attend the kindergarten's group activity, ahhh!

Who does the eldest brother think he is??!

Lu Li, meanwhile, tried to remind his eldest brother to adjust the little one's hat to make the look more perfect.

Facing the brother who wanted to uncover his hat, Xueyan habitually clutched the brim, raising his eyes to stare at his guardian like a little white seashell that had panicked and clamped its shell shut.

Brother, please don't take the hat away, okay?

Hearing Lehman's suggestion, Lu Yiming sighed and slumped listlessly on the table, staring intently at the golden feather in his hand.

Subconsciously, he pinched the base of the feather and began to spin it gently.

The soft, milky-gold tail feather swayed nimbly into a glowing, dreamlike blur of light.

It was so captivating that one couldn't help but stare, and even feel an uncontrollable curiosity about what kind of existence the owner of this feather might be.

"When my brother grows up, he'll definitely be incredibly beautiful."

After inexplicably sighing this, Lu Yiming felt like he was losing his mind.

Even though it had already been depicted in the painting of prophecy, it was... very strange.

Looking at this feather, recalling the soft, fluffy sensation in his palm, or the way the little one would occasionally shyly preen his feathers, another image couldn't help but surface in his mind.

A snowy Christmas Eve, the little one, small and dainty, wearing fluffy rabbit-fur earmuffs, blushing as he looked up and softly called out "Second Brother," and he himself crouching down to scoop him up in a hug... ahhhhh!

Although this didn't fit the aesthetic of a beast at all...

Meanwhile, in the banquet hall's private lounge, the bright crystal chandelier scattered countless starlights into Modian's large, ink-black eyes.

Xueyan was rubbing Modian's ears, watching Uncle Fu feed the creature.

"Uncle, is this what Modian eats?"

The little one's soft, whispered inquiry made Uncle Fu feel it was inexplicably cute, and the man's somewhat fierce-looking brows tried to squeeze into a smile.

"Yes, we usually feed them before bringing them out to avoid them jumping on people. I don't know what's up with Modian today, but he seems to really like playing with you."

Uncle Fu explained with a hearty laugh.

"Maybe it's because I've met Modian before..."

Xueyan smiled and kissed Modian's ears, causing the creature to immediately flatten its ears in delight, let out an "aoo," and nuzzle against Xueyan's palm, as if wanting to rest its chin in Xueyan's hand.

The ticklish sensation made Xueyan's eyes curve into crescents; he couldn't get enough of petting him.

It was a bit like how his brothers always liked to pet his own little head?

But just thinking about it made his heart melt into a puddle.

"That's a given, Second Young Master. We all believe the Little Young Master will be exceptionally mighty; no one could fail to be amazed by it."

Looking at Lu Yiming, who was resting his chin on his hand with a strange smile, Lehman was a bit stunned and tried to respond.

The Second Young Master seemed to be getting more and more abnormal.

"Ah, my head hurts. Has Dad actually found it yet?"

Seeing the impossibly large tiger leaning its head over, Lu Xueyan, whose body had gone slightly stiff, finally began to flap his wings.

He bit hard on his eldest brother's hem and pulled, trying to urge Lu Jingyu to run away with him.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!!!"

How could a tiger suddenly break in, ahhh!???

And, and it even killed a little cub!?

Lu Chongshan missed his mark; not only did he fail to lick his child, but he also watched his child scurry away, leaving him momentarily bewildered.

He stopped wagging his tail and looked at this scene with hesitation.

What is going on here?

Aside from Pei Shuo, who was watching Modian with a gloomy look from behind, bringing Modian over today specifically for Xueyan to play with hadn't been a very wise decision.

Because Xueyan was too busy playing with Modian to play with him... no, that's not it, to play with him at all.

"Xueyan, can we open the presents now?"

So, Pei Shuo watched Xueyan pet the creature for a long time before finally unable to help himself, he leaned over and asked.

Xueyan, of course, knew the gift had to be opened, but he still hugged Modian in his arms a bit shyly, revealing only his eyes as he looked at Pei Shuo: "But what if you don't like it?"

Whatever Xueyan gave, he would like.

Unless it was a gift like a photo of Lu Yi.

Then Pei Shuo felt it might be hard for him to be willing to put it in his bedroom and see it first thing every morning.

But even if Xueyan gave such a gift, there must be a reason for it!

Thinking this, Pei Shuo finally couldn't wait to open Xueyan's gift box with his own hands.
chapters.source_text:
摆了摆耳朵，这只浅茶色的小兔子便亲昵地舔了舔陆雪言的绒毛。
“啾？”
本来紧张地都想飞起来了，结果发现小兔子只是亲了亲自己的脑袋，陆雪言一时间都有点脸红的不知所措了。
“所有我觉得完全可以的，好像给我弟就都不太可以。”
挠着脑袋，陆亦铭生平第一次觉得自己的脑子好像是不太够用。
“少爷，我觉得，或许可以找一些不太凶残的动物幼崽……唔，或许外形不要那么容易令人心生怜爱……”
比如先前那只兔子，显然就是一种错误选择。
全场一片沉默中，老爸陆霆已然忍不住握拳抵在了嘴角，被自家乖崽萌得说不出话来了。
老天在上，自己跟鸢儿是怎么能生出如此萌物的！？
简直能哄得家长恨不得再打拼上一辈子，给小家伙把全世界想要的东西都赚回来！
呵，关键还不得把幼儿园里那些其他小崽子们全都轻而易举比下去？自家乖崽就是最棒的！
越想越乐的陆霆，就像巴不得抱着自家乖崽全世界炫耀的老父亲一样。
至于正负责拍照上传到群里，给陆菁、陆黎他们两远程欣赏的陆淮，这会儿单纯内心很酸，酸到第一次恨不得将大哥取而代之……
可恶，本来按照陆淮的导演剧本，小家伙明明是应该穿着四哥亲自购买搭配的一身漂亮衣服，去参加幼儿园的集体活动的啊啊啊！
大哥他算个什么东西？？！
陆黎则试图提醒大哥帮小家伙把帽子重新摆一摆，让造型更完美。
面对想要揭开自己的帽子的哥哥，雪言却习惯性地揪住了帽檐，抬起眼眸盯着家长，就像慌乱捂住了蚌壳的白色小海贝一样。
哥哥不要拿走帽子好不好？
听到莱曼的建议后，陆亦铭叹了口气，有气无力地趴在桌子上认真地盯着手里的那根金色羽毛。
下意识地捏着羽毛根部轻轻旋转起来。
柔软的奶金色尾羽轻灵地晃动成了一团灼灼的梦幻光影。
令人看着便有些移不开眼，甚至情不自禁地好奇这根羽毛的主人会是什么样的存在。
“我弟长大了，一定可好看。”
莫名奇妙地感慨了一句后，陆亦铭又觉得自己有点病。
明明预言之画里都已经画出来了，可是……很奇怪。
看着这根羽毛，回忆着捧在手心里软绵绵的触感，又或者平日里小家伙偶尔腼腆地梳理羽毛的模样，自己脑子里就忍不住浮现出另一种画面。
飘雪的冬日平安夜，小小一只，带着一副毛茸茸的兔毛耳罩，拉着自己有点脸红地抬头轻轻喊二哥，自己就蹲下一把抱起来什么的……啊啊啊啊！
虽然这一点也不符合猛兽的审美观……
而一旁的宴会厅隔间休息包厢里，明亮的水晶灯在墨点的大眼睛里洒落了无数星星光点。
雪言正揉着墨点的耳朵，看着一旁的福叔给墨点喂食物。
“叔叔，这是墨点吃的东西吗？”
小家伙轻声细语的询问，听得福叔莫名觉得可爱，男人略显凶悍的眉眼试图挤出一个笑容。
“是啊，一般会喂饱了再带出来避免扑人，不知道今天墨点怎么回事，但是墨点似乎很喜欢跟您玩哦。”
福叔乐呵呵地解释道。
“那可能是因为我之前见过墨点……”
雪言笑着亲了亲墨点的耳朵，顿时让墨点飞机耳都出来了，“嗷”一声蹭了蹭雪言的掌心，恨不得把下巴都搁在雪言手里。
痒痒的感觉让雪言眼睛弯弯的，怎么摸都摸不够。
就有点像哥哥他们总喜欢摸自己的小脑袋一样？
但，光是想想都已经心软的一塌糊涂了。
“那必然的，二少爷，我们都相信小少爷会格外威武，没有人不会为此感到惊叹的。”
看着托腮诡异微笑的陆亦铭，莱曼有点愕然，尝试着回应了一声。
自家二少爷似乎越来越不太正常了。
“啊，头疼。爸他到底找到没有啊？”
眼看着大到不可思议的大老虎就这样探过来了脑袋，浑身有点僵硬的陆雪言终于扑棱起了翅膀。
使劲儿咬着自家大哥的衣摆往回扯，试图催着陆景屿一块儿逃跑。
“啾啾啾！！！”
怎么会有老虎突然闯进来啊啊啊！？？？
还、还咬死了一只小幼崽！？
陆崇山扑了个空，不仅没舔到自家崽儿，还看着自家崽儿一溜烟躲远了，顿时有点茫然。
尾巴也不甩了，迟疑地看着这一幕。
这是在干什么？
除了裴朔从背后阴恻恻地看着墨点，突然今天特意把墨点带过来给雪言玩也不是很明智。
因为雪言光顾着玩墨点，都不玩自己……不是，都不跟自己玩了。
“雪言，我们可以拆礼物了吗？”
于是裴朔看着雪言摸了半天，终于忍不住趴在一旁，开口询问道。
雪言当然知道这礼物拆肯定是得拆的，但还是有点不好意思地搂着怀里的墨点，露出一双眼睛看向了裴朔：“但你要是不喜欢怎么办？”
雪言送什么自己都喜欢。
除非送张路易的照片这种礼物。
那裴朔觉得那自己可能很难愿意放到卧室里，每天起床第一眼就看到。
但就算雪言送这种礼物，那也一定有雪言的用意！
这么想着的裴朔，终于迫不及待亲手拆开了雪言的礼物盒。

chapters.title: 第66章 想让雪言喊自己哥哥
chapters.translated_text:
But the next second, the sound of an electronic, mechanical voice left the entire room stunned.

Pei Shuo turned his head and saw Modian, who had suddenly pressed a plum-blossom-shaped paw onto a pet-talking button that someone had placed on the carpet at some point.

"Uh, uh, uh, Young Master, this was originally meant for you and the other little children to play with..."

After all, you’ve always hoped that Modian would be able to speak.

Faced with the century-old dilemma posed by his young employer, Uncle Fu thought it over and eventually ordered a full set of pet-talking buttons overnight.

The entire luxury gift box of talking buttons covered most common phrases.

Phrases like "eat," "sleep," "okay," "no," "bad guy," "hate," "like," and so on—it was definitely enough for Modian to play with the little ones at the birthday party.

But Uncle Fu never expected that Modian, who had been shooed away from the gifts by Pei Shuo, would discover the talking buttons on the side at this very moment.

And by sheer coincidence, it had pressed the "bad guy" button on the very edge!

Modian, inexplicably the center of attention, kept its paw on the button, looking down in confusion and curiosity at this strange device that made sounds, then looking up at its little master, whose expression had suddenly changed.

In the end, the giant wolf simply sniffed the cub in a clumsy manner, its gaze still lingering on the empty milk bowl by Xueyan's side.

Xueyan: ? Meet A-Yan?

Blinking its eyes, the cub felt a little conflicted for a moment.

Although it was still just a little one, Nemo could already vaguely sense some of Xueyan's "aesthetic preferences."

It seemed that the adult forms of its mother and the others were not the type of appearance that A-Yan liked.

What if they scared A-Yan?

"Chium chium chium...!"

And so, a few minutes later, after listening to the request Nemo had gestured about for a long time, the room full of adult Luna-tribe monsters and beasts fell into silence.

Even if A-Yan agreed, they, this group of old folks, had to show up in their cub forms to meet him?!

This... isn't this a bit too embarrassing?

"Absolutely fine."

Just as Nemo finished stating the request, Lady Aoni was actually the first to nod in agreement!

A few seconds later, a giant version of a black, fluffy "soot ball" appeared in the study.

It seemed that because of her age, even when she turned back into her cub form, she couldn't shrink down very much, and her size was scaled proportionally.

Her husband, York, who always listened to his wife, naturally followed suit and turned into a fluffy ball.

"Oh. This is a bit novel, my belly doesn't seem to be able to shrink... I'm so sorry, Nemo."

Father York quite liked drinking human beer, which had resulted in a slightly large belly.

"So does that mean I, an old man, have to do it too?"

Even looking at the scene, the old butler with the goat beard pointed at himself tremblingly.

It seemed that as long as Soot Ball gave the order, he was prepared to risk his old bones and follow along, turning into a "cub" to meet that mysterious human.

"Chium..."

And Soot Ball, looking at this scene, was also a bit dazed.

From big to small, it was like a big family of Soot Ball, Soot Ball PRO, and Soot Ball PRO MAX versions!

Seeing the other's gaze, Xueyan finally realized—could this wolf also be here to mooch a meal?

"Chium."

Soot Ball, originally full of vigilance, also let out a cry, clearly a bit speechless.
chapters.source_text:
但下一秒一道电子机械音的响起，就让全场愣住了。
裴朔扭头就看到墨点，突然一只梅花爪子按在了不知道什么时候被人铺在地毯上的宠物说话按钮上。
“呃呃呃，小少爷，这个本来是拿去给您跟小朋友玩的……”
毕竟您不是一直希望墨点能开口说话的嘛。
面对小雇主提出的世纪难题，福叔思来想去，最终连夜订购了全套的宠物说话按钮。
一整套豪华说话按钮礼盒里，涵盖了大部分常见短语按钮。
比如“吃饭”“睡觉”“好的”“不好”“坏蛋”“讨厌”“喜欢”等等，用来让墨点在生日宴上陪小家伙们玩耍绝对足够了。
但福叔万万没想到的是，被裴朔从礼物前赶走的墨点，居然在这个时候发现了一旁的说话按钮。
还巧之又巧地按到了最边儿上的“坏蛋”！
莫名成为全场关注焦点的墨点，梅花爪爪搭在按钮上，困惑又新奇地低头看看这个会发出声音的奇怪按钮，又抬头看看突然变了脸色的小主人。
最终眼前的巨狼只是动作青涩地嗅了嗅幼崽，目光还是落在了雪言手边的空盆盆奶上。
雪言：？见阿言？
眨巴眨巴眼睛，幼崽一时间有点小纠结。
虽然还是只小家伙，但是尼莫已经能隐约感觉出来雪言的某些“审美偏好”了。
妈妈他们成年后的原型，似乎不会是阿言喜欢的模样。
万一吓到阿言怎么办。
“啾姆啾姆啾……！”
于是几分钟之后，听着尼莫比划了半天后提出的要求，一屋子的鲁纳族成年魔物凶兽们都陷入了沉默。
就算阿言同意了，也必须让他们这群老家伙们以幼崽形态登录见面？！
这、这是不是有点太羞耻了。
“完全可以。”
结果就在尼莫提出要求后，奥妮夫人居然第一个点头同意了！
几秒钟后，一只巨大版本的黑色毛茸“煤球”出现在了书房里。
似乎是因为年纪大了，就算变回幼崽形态也没办法变得太小，体积被等比例放大了。
向来听老婆话的丈夫约尔克见状自然紧随其后变成了一颗毛茸球。
“噢。这还有点新奇，我的肚子好像缩小不了……真抱歉啊尼莫。”
父亲约尔克挺喜欢喝人类啤酒的，导致肚子有点点大。
“所以意思是老人家我也要吗？”
甚至看着现场画面，山羊胡子老管家都颤颤巍巍地指了指自己。
似乎只要煤球一声令下，也准备豁出去这把老骨头，跟着变“幼崽”去见那位神秘的人类了。
“啾姆……”
而煤球看着眼前这一幕，也有点呆了。
从大到小，仿佛煤球、煤球PRO、煤球PRO MAX版本大家族！
看见对方的视线后，雪言终于意识到这只狼不会也是来蹭饭的吧？
“啾姆。”
原本警惕十足的煤球也跟着叫唤了一声，明显有点小无语。
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 66: Wanting Xueyan to call him "Big Brother"

chapters.title: 第102章
chapters.translated_text:
He had completely forgotten that he himself had originally been lured out by Xue Yan with a bowl of milk. Some monsters were clearly long past the age of wearing bibs, but... as he watched, he subconsciously touched his own bare neck.

Damn it, if no one made one for me when I was a kid, can't I just buy one for myself now that I'm grown up—!?

Even the couple Aoni, who had been watching the "Demon World" livestream with vigilance and worry, now had complex expressions on their faces.

"Aoni, this human doesn't seem to have any malice toward Nemo at all. That little bib is indeed very cute; I don't think you need to be so nervous or suspicious of the other party's intentions."

Her husband, Jork, stroked his beard, his tone hesitant.

"And my lady, look at that bib—it's the one the young master brought out recently! He doesn't even let me touch it usually; so that's where it came from..."

The old butler with the goat beard standing nearby had had his eyes wide open ever since "Coalball" appeared.

He never expected his young master to have met such a human in "Demon World"!

He even felt a little jealous inside; he had accompanied the boy since he was little, and it seemed they had never been that intimate.

Amidst the surrounding commotion, only Aoni, the mother, remained silent, clutching the drawing of the cub in her hand.

This drawing was the very one Nemo had made during his language class's "you draw, I guess" game, which the teacher had photocopied and sent to the employer couple.

The human with black hair and black eyes who had come to the door, calling himself "A-RAN," was now someone Lady Aoni could confirm was the same human in "Demon World" before her.

"Does the other party know Nemo's identity? Could this be a trap, intentionally getting close to Nemo for some purpose?"

Yet, the vigilance in Lady Aoni's heart remained very intense.

Perhaps once the other party learned of Nemo's identity, they would come to negotiate certain terms with the family.

One must know that Nemo was the only pure-blooded descendant of the Luna clan in this generation.

Lady Aoni truly felt very conflicted seeing this now.

"This..."

Hearing this speculation from Aoni, the monsters around them fell silent again.

"That shouldn't be the case, right? 'Demon World' has never allowed humans to log in. Rather than saying the other party is a human player, I'm more inclined to suspect that they might be an NPC generated within the game."

"After all, 'Demon World' has had so many major updates recently."

"Perhaps we should find a way to verify the other party's identity and intentions?"

"Or should we just bring the young master back to observe him for a while?"

Just as the many Luna clan monsters were having a heated discussion in the study, the young human in the livestream suddenly acted mysteriously while the cub was looking down at the bib.

It was as if he were about to go do something in secret behind the cub's back.

"Wait, what is he planning to do?"

"My god, I knew it! Humans really are creatures with complex minds!"

A room full of parents watched as Nemo remained oblivious, playing with the bib in front of the camera, and felt a sudden surge of anxiety.

They were deeply worried about what kind of bad things that human youth was about to do.

If it weren't for the fact that "Demon World" had such a high degree of freedom and couldn't be teleported to the cub's location, the Aoni couple would have wanted to log into the game directly to snatch their cub back.

One must know that there had been countless lessons in history regarding the consequences of trusting humans too much.

Even in the chat, some sharp-eyed monsters noticed that the lower half of Xue Yan's body had left the frame, as if he had run off somewhere else.

"Then shall we share some with him? Because I prepared something extra delicious for Coalball tonight."

Xue Yan rubbed Coalball and discussed it, instantly making the little cub's eyes widen with excitement.

"Chumu?"

Because if Xue Yan remembered correctly, today just happened to be the little guy's birthday as recorded in the monster handbook.

Of course, it was worth celebrating properly.

By comparison, the bowl of milk and such couldn't be considered rare food; it was just right to feed these animals and avoid waste.

So, a few minutes later, Xue Yan generously shared a bowl of cub milk with the young wolf.

The other party quickly lowered its head and began to drink, and after finishing, it even let out a few "awoos" at Xue Yan.

Seeing this, Xue Yan was suddenly a bit curious; he tentatively half-squatted and waved at the other party.

The next second, the other party actually lowered its head and let Xue Yan pat its head.

It was just that the opportunity to pet this furry creature was very brief; as soon as Xue Yan touched it, the other party proudly raised its head, picked up the cub nearby, and ran away.

"Alright, alright, he actually left after eating and drinking his fill. But he looks like a very healthy wolf; I hope he can find food on his own next time."

Xue Yan, who didn't get a second pet, wasn't too disappointed; he still watched the beast walk away with great interest, feeling that this game was even more worth it than going to the zoo.

After all, it's hard to have such opportunities to interact with wild beasts at a zoo.

And they didn't seem to have much aggression toward him.

Was it just his imagination?

Xue Yan held Coalball and the camera in his arms, falling into deep thought for a moment.

"Chumu!"

However, seeing the other party just run off like that, Coalball was a bit angry.

Because those two guys didn't even know how to clean up the milk bowl and bottle after they finished drinking.

And A-Yan had to help wash them!

So, Coalball struggled a bit and decided to carry the bowl to the stream to rinse it clean for A-Yan himself.

"? What is this doing? Is it trying to help me wash the dishes?"

Now it became Xue Yan's turn to hold the camera from behind, watching curiously as Coalball carried a bowl bigger than itself toward the stream.

This was just too well-behaved and heartwarming.

It even knew how to care for its guardian?

For a moment, Xue Yan truly felt that raising Coalball hadn't been in vain—he was moved!

However, the already boiling chat became even more explosive.

With Xue Yan backing them up, they weren't afraid of anyone, including the little master, Pei Shuo.

"Reporting to everyone, I found him! So Xue Yan was here—"

However, the next second, the group of little cubs who had followed the butler to knock on the door finally found Xue Yan, whom Pei Shuo had hidden, and started shouting at the top of their lungs.

"Oh my, these little guests, really..."

The caught-off-guard butler turned around and found, with a mix of laughter and tears, that the little scouts led by Louis were actually smart enough to notice that his identity was different and had secretly followed him without him knowing.

And they had just happened to catch him coming to call the young master to go cut the cake with the kid named Lu Xue Yan.

Louis was the first cub to squeeze his head out from behind the butler, but the next second, several other little heads—Guan Xing, Guan Yu, and others—squeezed out from the left, right, top, and bottom of Louis.

It wasn't until they saw the beautiful Xue Yan, who was being made to laugh until he was slightly out of breath by Mo Dian not far away, that everyone subconsciously quieted down.

Xue Yan's usually overly pale face suddenly came to life, suffused with a faint, beautiful, light pink glow from his laughter.

It was like a handful of snow on the Kumas Grassland in winter, gilded with a bright, warm light by the huge, rising sun at dawn, shining in the palm of one's hand.

Guan Xing thought this subconsciously, stunned.

At this moment, Guan Xing probably wouldn't have guessed that in the future, the first semi-open-ended essay for which his language teacher would give him a perfect score—despite his usual stumbling performance in language exams—would be "My Friend, Lu Xue Yan"!
chapters.source_text:
完全忘了自己最初也是被雪言用盆盆奶引诱出来的。有些魔物明明早就超过戴围兜的年纪了，但是……看着看着，下意识就摸了摸自己空荡荡的脖子。
可恶啊，小时候没人给自己做，我们长大了自己给自己买一件还不行嘛€€€€！？
就连原本警惕担忧看着《魔界》直播的奥妮夫妇，此刻神色都变得复杂了起来。
“奥妮，这个人类看起来对尼莫完全没有恶意，那件小围兜确实很可爱，我觉得你似乎不用那么紧张和怀疑对方的用意。”
丈夫约尔克摸了摸胡子，语气迟疑。
“而且夫人您看那个围兜，就是小少爷最近带出来的那件！平时连我都不给碰，原来是从这里拿出来的……”
一旁的山羊胡子老管家自从看见“煤球”出现，眼睛就瞪得圆圆的。
万万没想到自家小少爷在《魔界》里遇到了这么一位人类！
内心还有点吃醋呢，自己从小陪到大，好像也没这么亲昵过。
周围纷纷扰扰下，唯独身为母亲的奥妮捏着手里那张幼崽画沉默不语。
这张画赫然是之前尼莫上语言课你画我猜的时候，被老师复印了一份汇报给雇主夫妇的幼崽画。
上门黑发黑眼名叫“A-RAN”的人类，此刻奥妮女士可以肯定就是眼前《魔界》里的这个人类。
“对方知道尼莫的身份吗？这会不会是一个陷阱，为了某种目的在刻意接近尼莫。”
只是奥妮夫人内心的警惕依然非常浓郁。
也许对方得知尼莫的身份后，会来和家族谈判某些条件。
要知道尼莫可是鲁纳族这一代的唯一纯血后裔。
奥妮女士看到现在的确心情非常复杂。
“这……”
听到奥妮的这个猜测，四周的魔物们又沉默了下来。
“这应该不会吧？《魔界》向来不允许人类登录，与其说对方是人类玩家，我更倾向于怀疑对方可能是个游戏内部生成的NPC。”
“毕竟《魔界》最近反常地出现了那么多次重大更新。”
“或许我们应该想办法验证一下对方的身份和意图？”
“或者还是先把小少爷带回来观察观察？”
也就在书房里鲁纳族的众多魔物激烈讨论的时候，直播画面里的那位年轻人类却趁着幼崽低头看围兜的时候，动作突然变得神秘了起来。
仿佛要背着幼崽去悄悄做些什么。
“等等，他准备干什么？”
“天呐，我就知道，人类果然都是心思很复杂的家伙！”
一屋子家长看着尼莫依旧无知无觉地在镜头前玩着围兜，内心瞬间有些焦灼。
非常担心那人类青年到底要去干什么坏事。
如果不是《魔界》自由度极高，无法定向传送到幼崽身边，奥妮夫妇甚至都想直接登录游戏去把自家幼崽抓回来了。
要知道过于信任人类这种生物的后果，历史上早就有过无数教训。
就连弹幕里也有魔物眼尖地发现雪言入镜的下半身暂时离开了画面，似乎跑去了其他地方。
“那我们也分他一点好不好？因为今晚给煤球准备了特别的好吃的。”
雪言揉着煤球商量起来，瞬间让小幼崽精神满满地睁大了眼睛。
“啾姆？”
因为雪言没记错的话，今天刚好是魔物手册上记载的小家伙的生日。
当然值得好好庆祝一下。
相比之下盆盆奶什么的也就算不上什么稀奇的食物了，正好喂给这些动物还免得浪费。
于是几分钟后，雪言非常慷慨地给这只青年小伙狼也分了一盆幼崽盆盆奶。
对方很快低头喝了起来，喝完甚至对着雪言嗷呜了几声。
见状雪言突然有点好奇，试探性地半蹲下来，朝着对方招了招手。
结果下一秒对方真的低头任由雪言摸了摸脑袋。
只是这只蹭饭毛茸茸给雪言RUA的机会非常短暂，雪言刚刚摸了一把，对方便傲娇地抬起头叼着一旁的幼崽跑远了。
“好好好，居然吃饱喝足就走掉了。不过看起来是一只非常健康的狼，希望下次他可以自己找到食物。”
没摸到第二把的雪言也没有太失落，依旧兴致盎然地目送着野兽远去，觉得这游戏做得简直比去动物园还划算。
毕竟动物园可很难有这样和野兽互动的机会。
而且他们似乎对自己都没有太大的攻击性。
是自己的错觉吗？
雪言抱着煤球跟怀里的摄像机，一时间陷入了沉思。
“啾姆！”
不过看着对方就这么跑了，煤球倒是有点生气。
因为那两个家伙喝完了都不知道要自己清理盆盆奶的碗和奶瓶。
还要阿言帮忙洗！
于是煤球挣扎了两下，就决定自己叼着碗去小溪里帮阿言冲干净了。
“？这是在干什么，是要帮我洗碗吗？”
这下反而变成雪言负责在后面提着摄像头，好奇地看着煤球叼着比自己还大的碗飞向了小溪边。
这也太乖太暖了吧。
还会心疼家长？
一时间雪言真的感觉自己没白养煤球，感动！
只不过本就沸腾的弹幕，这下更加炸裂了。
有了雪言撑腰，就谁也不怕了，包括裴朔这个小主人。
“报告大家，我找到啦，雪言原来在这里€€€€”
然而下一秒，一路跟踪来敲门的管家的一众小幼崽，终于找到了被裴朔藏起来的雪言，扯着嗓子嚷嚷了起来。
“诶呦，这些小客人们，也真是……”
猝不及防的管家一转身便哭笑不得地发现，以路易为首的一众小侦察兵，居然聪明到看出来了自己身份不一样，不知道什么偷偷跟踪过来了。
还刚好抓到了自己来喊小少爷跟那个叫陆雪言的小朋友去切蛋糕。
路易是第一个从管家背后挤出来脑袋的幼崽，但下一秒路易的上下左右就又挤出来了关星、关雨等好几个小脑袋。
直到看见不远处正被墨点逗笑到有些喘不过气来的漂亮雪言，大家才下意识都安静了下来。
雪言往日过于白皙的脸蛋突然有了生气，被笑意氤氲出了一种极淡的好看薄粉色。
就像冬日库玛斯大草原上的一捧雪，被黎明时刻初升的巨大圆日，镀上了一抹明亮的暖色光，在掌心里闪闪发光一样。
关星下意识愣怔地这样想到。
这一刻的关星恐怕不会想到，自己未来总考的磕磕绊绊的语文考试，第一篇被语文老师打了满分的半命题作文就是“我的朋友陆雪言”！

chapters.title: 第67章 意外被吃掉的饼干
chapters.translated_text:
"Bad guy—" "Bad guy, bad guy, bad guy!"

The next second, the little paws slapped down a few more times in a frenzy.

"Modian—"

Pei Shuo couldn't take it anymore; he stood up, ready to catch Modian.

As a result, when Modian raised its tail and turned to run back behind Xue Yan, it accidentally stepped on the device a few more times.

Sounds like "No," "Eat," and "Go out to play" played in a chaotic mess for a while, successfully making Pei Shuo stand there suspiciously with pursed lips, doubting that Modian might just be pressing buttons at random.

Everyone present wanted to laugh but didn't dare to, including the butler who had come to knock on the door to call Pei Shuo to cut the cake; he was struggling hard to hold back his laughter, not expecting the little ones to be having so much fun.

To think the young master could actually get into an argument with a little tiger like Modian.

Xue Yan hadn't expected the daily task to change its style this time, turning into a bib order.

The difficulty had decreased significantly, yet the gold coin reward hadn't decreased at all—in fact, it had increased.

Why does this game feel like it's getting more and more fun? The user experience is simply maxed out in terms of friendliness.

The only problem was that there wasn't enough time for the immersive mode this time.

"Daddy has to go now, Meiqiu. See you tomorrow. Don't run around at home..."

With the experience accumulated from multiple logins and offline sessions, Xue Yan skillfully gave Meiqiu one last rub before vanishing into a pale golden halo.

"Jiumu."

Meiqiu looked up and nuzzled A-Yan's fingers. After watching Xue Yan disappear, it was still holding that little triangular handmade birthday hat in its arms.

It was as if it could never get tired of playing with it.

Seeing the colorful cellophane scraps floating on the ground, Meiqiu even flew over and spent a long time picking them up, managing to fit them all inside the hat.

Holding the hat and the colorful cellophane inside, the little guy sat contentedly on the swing, swaying gently in the breeze.

It was as if it were holding the whole world. Meanwhile, in the VIP lounge at the airport, the little guy wearing black headphones and a mask poked at his phone, only to find that the final tip gift hadn't been sent successfully.

In his mind, the scene of that monster cub blowing out the candles remained.

In fact, a long time ago, An Xun had thought his own birthday should have been like that.

Although An Xun browsed the currently trending forum and quickly worked hard to read the text, learning that the black monster cub seemed to possess a very orthodox and powerful family lineage.

Their status was naturally completely different from those like them who suddenly mutated into monsters at some point in their lives.

Even when posting on the forum, mutated monsters like An Xun were much more reticent, terrified of having their true identities discovered.
chapters.source_text:
“坏蛋€€€€”“坏蛋坏蛋坏蛋！”
下一秒小爪子就又狂拍了好几下。
“墨点€€€€”
裴朔这下就忍不了，起身就要逮住墨点。
结果墨点翘起尾巴扭头就跑回雪言身后的时候，不小心又误触乱踩好几下。
什么“不行”“吃饭”“出去玩”乱响了好一阵，成功又让裴朔抿唇狐疑站在了原地，怀疑墨点可能就是乱按的。
全场众人想笑都不敢笑，包括就连一旁敲门来喊裴朔去切蛋糕的管家，都忍笑忍的很辛苦，没想到小家伙们玩的这么有趣。
小少爷还能跟墨点这只小老虎吵上架。
雪言没想到这次日常任务花样还换了，变成了围兜订单。
这难度可缩小了很多，偏偏奖励金币非但没少还变多了。
怎么感觉这游戏越来越好玩了，对玩家的体验感简直拉满友好度。
唯一问题就是这次沉浸式模式的时间来不及了。
“爸爸先走了煤球，明天再见，在家不要乱跑……”
多次登录离线经验积累下，雪言熟练地最后揉了一把煤球，便化作淡金色的光晕消失了。
“啾姆。”
煤球抬头蹭了蹭阿言的手指，看着雪言消失后，怀里依旧抱着那只三角形的手工生日小帽子。
仿佛怎么玩都玩不腻一样。
甚至看见地上飘着的彩色玻璃纸片，煤球又飞过去四下叼了半天，刚好全部装进了帽子里。
捧着帽子和里面彩色玻璃纸，小家伙心满意足地在微风里蹲在秋千上轻轻晃动着。
仿佛捧着了全世界。而在机场的贵宾候机室里，带着黑色耳机和口罩的小家伙戳着手机，却发现最后的打赏礼物并没有能够成功送出去。
脑海里依旧是那只魔物幼崽吹灭蜡烛的那一幕画面。
事实上很久之前，安洵本以为自己的生日应该是这样的。
虽然安洵翻阅着此刻热议中的论坛，很快就努力认字了解到那只黑色幼崽魔物似乎拥有非常正统且强势的家族后裔。
和他们这类在生命中的某一时刻突然变异成怪物的存在，自然地位毫不一样。
就连论坛发言，安洵这一类异变魔物都会沉默寡言得多，生怕被发现真实身份。

陆雪言心底小声地跟系统说着话，目光却好奇地落在了对方身上。
男人披着一件挺括的深色外套，双手交叠在身前，正阖目微微靠在不远处的座椅上。
就算以幼崽的审美来看，第一眼也会发现这个“陌生人”长得很好看。
挺括的眉眼带着一种不易接近的倦怠贵气感，尽管此刻阖目而眠的模样，难得让这种疏离的冷漠感消融了几分。
像一尊沉默的雕像。
但看久了之后，陆雪言又突然发现，对方的五官轮廓跟陆霆老爸格外相似，只不过是年轻版的。
【等等……别靠近，这不就是原书里的大哥陆巡吗！？】
反倒是系统一把按住了自家好奇想凑近观察的宿主，语气有点不可置信地指认出来了陆巡的身份！
尽管之前已经给幼崽看过照片认人了，但是陆巡真人身周的那种气场，远比照片的冲击力要强得多。
【天呐，其他人都去哪儿了？！难不成这家伙要做什么可怕的事情……】
就在444紧张的这一瞬间，本就睡得极浅的陆巡便轻易察觉到了保育舱里的动静。
Alpha下一秒就睁开了墨色的双眼。
奇妙的是，对视的这一刻陆雪言居然没有觉得害怕，反而努力抬头看向走近自己的家长，一直到小脑袋抬高得有点酸了。
对方个子太高了。
于是陆巡直接屈膝半蹲了下来，伸手认真地拨开了幼崽额前蓬松柔软的奶白色碎发，确认了温度。
确实退烧了，并且没有反复。
像是终于放下了一个心结，眼前的ALPHA如释重负地缓缓吐了一口气。
幼崽眨巴了好几下眼睛，才有点慌乱地意识到自己被摸额头了，甚至这个距离被对方抓走都有可能了。
但陆巡的下一句话就成功让陆雪言后退挣脱的动作卡住了：“抱歉，有事情，所以才迟到了。”
也许是因为陆雪言觉得眼前人并不擅长说抱歉，所以没有再躲开。
“会觉得不能原谅吗？”
刚从补眠中苏醒的陆巡像是在询问，却更像是在自言自语。
事实上，自己当年最厌恶的就是每次生日、家长会、甚至是毕业典礼永远会被陆霆忘记，永远事后哈哈一笑自以为没关系，送一堆所谓昂贵的礼物作为补偿。
以至于陆巡逐渐习惯了永远一个人面无表情地度过大大小小的人生重要时刻。
尽管等到陆菁、陆淮他们长大的时候，就不会这样了。
因为随着公司集团逐渐发展壮大，开始会有秘书专门负责提醒陆霆，并且把提前准备好的礼物妥善送到。
但陆巡从来觉得迟到就是迟到，事后再怎么所谓的补偿，从来都虚假至极。
可自己偏偏在弟弟出生这件事上也迟到了。
甚至回来看见的就是小家伙蜷缩在病床上的模样。
以至于陆巡觉得这或许就是一种冥冥之中的惩罚。
