Not far away, Lu Yiming saw his father suddenly pull open the bedroom door with a complex expression and stand frozen, so he couldn't help but lean in to look into the cub's room.

In an instant, he also instinctively almost crushed the door frame.

The little bun had just woken up, his fluffy fur a bit messy, and he was currently curled up by the dragon tail, looking blankly at the door.

"Da, dada..."

"Aigu~!"

The murmur-like morning greeting carried a soft, sleepy tone, making anyone who heard it feel so charmed that they swallowed the questions that had been on the tip of their tongues.

Why on earth can my son/brother be this cute, ahhhhh!???

Damn it, that black, low-class sub-dragon—sooner or later, I have to find a reason to send him away.

At this moment, the thoughts in the minds of father and son Lu Chongshan and Lu Yiming were shockingly identical.

Although Montimer, who was surrounded in the center, had a reputation for being a playboy, when everyone saw this Alpha in person, they couldn't help but sigh inwardly: This guy certainly has the capital.

However, Montimer's gaze was searching for the Lu family among the people in the venue.

Mainly because, after hearing about Louis's activities from his wife Julia, Montimer, who hadn't even returned to the country by private jet yet, had already developed an unusually strong interest in the Lu family's pretty young cub, "Lu Xueyan."

What could he possibly look like for Louis to call him a doll?

One must know that after he and Julia had Louis, people around them always felt that Louis was the standard mixed-race doll.

"Patriarch, the Pei family is not far away. Don't we need to go say hello first? Besides, if you want to talk to the Lu family, wouldn't the cocktail party after the meeting be fine?"

Sensing Montimer's vaguely unstable excitement, the golden-haired, blue-eyed old man beside him felt a bit nervous.

He prayed that Montimer, who always acted in unpredictable ways, wouldn't suddenly have a whim and cause some unexpected incident.

Approaching the Lu family rashly would definitely arouse the vigilance of the Pei family.

Hearing this, Montimer shrugged, and the next second, he happened to make eye contact with Lu Ting and the others sitting not far away.

And Lu Ting, seeing Montimer making a scene the moment he entered the venue from afar, couldn't help but think of that flamboyant, show-off little foreigner with a sour expression.

This father and son were cut from the exact same cloth!

He will be willing.

"Speaking of which, the little one is about to successfully shapeshift, so he should have a formal name."

This sentence from Lu Jingyu instantly reminded everyone in the room.

"That's right, we must give the cub an imposing name."

Scratching his head, Lu Chongshan felt this was a very serious matter.

What kind of name would be more imposing? Something worthy of his cub's future status as a fierce beast!

"It's a good thing Big Brother stopped them at the end... otherwise, wouldn't Dad and the others have headed toward the villain path again!"

In the cub's room, Lu Xueyan rolled around on the bed, his fur sticking up in a messy way.

Compared to Lu Xueyan, the system was hesitant to speak.

The system was speechless for a moment.

It didn't know whether to be happy or sympathetic.

Good grief, even professional villains aren't this professional.

"But hasn't it already been changed!? Brother said he was just inviting a family of dragons over as guests, and then trading? Why does this still count toward the family's villain score?"

Xuexue jumped up from the covers.

Thinking again that the little foreigner who had held his precious cub would grow up to be like Montimer, Lu Ting felt even more uncomfortable, with an urge to go home immediately to bathe his precious cub and change his clothes.

Thus, in an extremely foul mood, Lu Ting didn't even show a hint of a smile, leaning back in his seat with a cold expression, looking extremely impatient as he turned his watch and glanced at the time.

Lu Xun, on the side, nodded slightly, but his attitude was also cold and indifferent, his aura as a top-tier Alpha fully displayed.

"You see, the Lu family has always been arrogant and..."

The old man beside Montimer couldn't help but whisper again.

"Charles, do you need to teach me how to do things now?" But before the old man could finish, he was looked at by Montimer with a condescending, half-smiling expression.

Once the man's usually smiling, jewel-blue pupils lost their smile, they revealed the extremely cold and indifferent hardness of his brow and eyes.

Under the influence of the Montimer family's lineage, the Alphas' appearance style indeed leaned toward being aggressive.

Sometimes, even his wife Julia didn't dare to approach her husband when Montimer was in a bad mood, let alone enter Montimer's study or work area.

Julia occasionally felt that she was only chosen as a wife by Montimer because her appearance was beautiful enough and her family background happened to match.

That was why Julia hoped that the birth of Louis would make her husband Montimer different, even though Julia herself knew that this thought was somewhat naive.

There was still a bottle of extremely precious ancient dragon blood kept at home.

It had been kept there and never used.

"But why would the youngest son of that family need dragon blood? For an average cub, they shouldn't be able to bear it at all."

Out of concern for the growth of the little cub, the woman asked hesitantly.

"Perhaps he is too powerful and has been looking for an opportunity to break through since he was young? Tolancy, look at others, and then look at yourself."

Recalling the temperament of that family, Amas felt this speculation was very reasonable, and took the opportunity to educate his son.

"Then I'm not interested anymore. I don't want to feed my blood to someone else."

Taking his father's joke about feeding blood seriously, Tolancy hugged his own tail, his expression resistant.

"But I still really want to go out and play... I don't want to start school this year."

The little one threw himself into his mother's arms, his tone a bit depressed.

His mother, Sarah, smiled helplessly and stroked her son's head.

"You can already shapeshift; you have to learn to grow up. Going to school after shapeshifting is something every little cub needs to experience."

After being warned by Montimer, the old man named Charles stopped instantly, but the sense of unease in his heart grew even stronger.

Because Charles, who knew Montimer's personality well, was certain that if the Lu family, currently at a disadvantage, tried to curry favor and approach them to win this vote of support, Montimer might instead lose interest.
chapters.title: 第108章
chapters.source_text:
唯一的可能性那就是，自己的成绩还不够优秀！
否则怎么会连宋知昂这种小眼镜都能抢到帮雪言拿围巾的机会，而偏偏自己每次都倒霉失败呢？
包括小饼干也是，至少最开始，雪言只做了裴朔的小饼干！
一旁原本激动不已的茱莉娅女士听完路易的雄心壮志，突然哑火了。
自家儿子想学好固然是好事。
但目的只是为了给幼儿园小伙伴跑腿拿围巾，这是不是又有点太没出息了？
而下午正式召开的食品药品监督管理局换届预选会上，在一众媒体记者长枪短炮的镜头记录下，不少商界代表也陆续进场就座了。
会场席位里，等候上一届轮值主席上台发言的开场时间里，陆巡看了一眼身侧难得心不在焉的老爸陆霆，悄无声息投去了疑问的目光。
总觉得今天下午父亲的状态有点微妙。
“啾€€€€”
而看着家长都到了，有点依赖性的陆雪言下意识就想黏过去，扑棱着翅膀便歪歪扭扭地从龙尾巴上飞了过去。
“小心点！以后不许乱飞，我来接！”
陆亦铭连忙伸手接住了自家弟弟，下一秒就被陆雪言抵着掌心蹭了蹭。
救命，弟弟太可爱了怎么办，感觉手掌心里握住了全宇宙一样。
对于陆亦铭而言，这一刻的幸福感简直瞬间刷满了。
“咳咳咳！”
一旁的陆崇山咳嗽得惊天动地，顿时惹得陆雪言也好脾气地飞到了爸爸肩膀上，轻轻贴了贴。
而彻底醒来的裴朔看着这一幕，又冷漠地瞥了一眼自己重新变得空荡荡的龙尾巴。
终于走了。
好得很。
就是这一家子，还真是有够幼稚。
眼前看到的一切与记忆中的信息几乎称得上天差地别，以至于裴朔不得不微妙地产生了某种怀疑。
也许这根本不是亚伯拉罕跟自己提到的那一家。
陆霆揉了揉额角，最终归咎于是睡眠问题。
最近整个集团上下一众高管和公共事务部都在为新一届的FDA（食品药品监督管理局缩写）换届环节而筹备，S市更是不太平的很，堪称暗流涌动。
导致陆霆连回家的次数都少了很多，更别提亲自抱着自家乖崽带睡了。
“小家伙最近喜欢上了做饼干，程姨说做的太多了，还得给老三他们也寄过去点。”
提到雪言，陆巡倒是语气里带着几分不易察觉笑意地低声提到了这件事。
不料刚说完，老爸陆霆的脸色就又黑了几分。
又是这该死的小饼干？
陆霆总觉得今天中午做的噩梦就跟这该死的饼干有关！
也就在这时，不远处会场入口处，蒙蒂默家族众人正式到场了。
为首的老蒙蒂默，也就是路易的老爸，笑容满面地一进入会场频频挥手示意，就吸引了一众记者的闪光灯疯狂闪烁。
毕竟身为一群有着古老种族血统优势Alpha，身型高大的同时，西装革履下的金发碧眼的确气场斐然，乍一看就像在拍摄什么《教父》电影。
“啾？”
连陆雪言也茫然地睁开了眼睛，扑棱了两下翅膀却一下子从龙尾巴上滑落了下来。
只是立刻就被尚未彻底苏醒的裴朔下意识用尾巴勾回了怀里。
毕竟被抱了整整一夜，以至于尾巴都有点习惯性地被这只小团子黏上了。
而门外看着这一幕终于放下心又突然心梗的陆崇山：…………？
“爸，找到了？没有赶紧下一个啊……卧槽！”
不远处的陆亦铭看着自家老爸突然脸色复杂地拉开房门一动也不动了，忍不住也跟着凑了过来看向了幼崽房。
瞬间同样下意识差点捏碎了门框。
小团子刚刚睡醒，身上的毛茸茸也有些乱糟糟的，此刻茫然地蜷缩在龙尾巴边，呆呆地看着门外。
“粑、粑粑……”
“爱咕~！”
呢喃一般的早安声里带着一份软绵绵的睡意，听得人几乎瞬间被萌得连到了嘴边的疑问都咽了下去。
儿子/弟弟到底为什么可以这么可爱啊啊啊啊！？？？
靠，就是那个黑色的下等亚龙，迟早得给找个理由送走。
这一刻，陆崇山、陆亦铭父子俩脑海里的念头惊人地完全一致了。
被簇拥在中央的蒙蒂默尽管风流名声在外，但亲眼看见这位Alpha的时候，众人还是忍不住心下感慨：这家伙确实有一定的资本。
不过，蒙蒂默的目光却在会场众人里搜寻着陆家的身影。
主要是从妻子茱莉亚那里陆续听说路易的动态后，还未乘坐私人飞机回到国内的蒙蒂默，就已经难得对陆家的那个叫“陆雪言”的漂亮幼子产生了异常浓郁的兴趣。
到底得长成什么模样，才能让路易称作洋娃娃？
要知道自己跟茱莉娅生出路易后，周围人向来都觉得路易才像个标准的混血儿洋娃娃。
“家主，裴家就在不远处，我们不需要先去打个招呼吗？何况您想找陆家谈话的话，会议结束后的酒会也未尝不可吧？”
察觉到蒙蒂默隐隐不安定的兴奋，一旁同样金发碧眼的老人则有点紧张。
祈祷向来行事令人捉摸不透的蒙蒂默不要又突发奇想做出来一些意外事件。
贸然接近陆家，绝对会引起裴家那边的警惕的。
闻言蒙蒂默耸了耸肩，下一秒便刚好跟坐在不远处的陆霆等人对视了。
而陆霆远远看见一入会场就招摇过市的蒙蒂默，便忍不住脸色发臭地想起那个同样爱出风头的浮夸小洋人。
这父子俩简直活脱脱一个模子里刻出来的！
他会自愿的。
“说起来，小家伙即将化形成功，也应该有个正式的名字了。”
陆景屿的这句话瞬间提醒了一屋子的人。
“对啊，必须得给崽儿取个威风的名字。”
挠了挠脑袋，陆崇山觉得这是个相当严肃的问题。
取个什么名字会比较威风呢？配得上自家崽儿未来的凶兽身份！
“还好最后大哥拦住了……要不然爸爸他们岂不是又得往反派方向发展了！”
幼崽房里，陆雪言在床上打了个滚，毛儿乱糟糟地翘了起来。
比起陆雪言，系统倒是欲言又止了起来。
系统一时间都统统无语了。
不知道是该高兴，还是该同情。
好家伙，专业反派过来都没这么专业。
“可是不是已经改掉了么！？哥哥说只是邀请一家子龙族过来做客，然后交易呀？为什么这个也会算在全家的反派数值上？”
雪雪一下子从被窝里跳了起来。
再一想到那抱过自家乖崽的小洋人未来会长成蒙蒂默这样，陆霆更是浑身难受不是个滋味，有种恨不得立刻回家给自家乖崽洗澡换衣服的冲动。
于是心情极度不虞的陆霆甚至连一丝笑意都没露出，脸色冷峻地仰靠在座位上，看起来极度不耐地转了转腕表扫了眼时间。
一旁的陆巡倒是微微颔首示意，但态度也是不冷不淡的，身为极优Alpha的气场展露无疑。
“您看，陆家这一家子向来性情傲慢不……”
蒙蒂默身旁的老人忍不住再次小声道。
“查理斯，我如今做事难道还要你来教？”但老人尚且没说完，就被蒙蒂默居高临下似笑非笑地看了过来。
男人向来笑意十足的宝蓝色瞳孔一旦敛去笑意，便显露出了眉眼那种极其薄情的强硬寡淡感。
蒙蒂默家族的血统影响下，Alpha们的长相风格的确偏向强势。
有时候身为妻子的茱莉娅，都不敢在蒙蒂默情绪不对的时候接近丈夫，更别提进入蒙蒂默的书房工作区了。
茱莉娅偶尔会觉得自己只是因为外貌足够美丽，家世也刚好与之匹配，所以才被蒙蒂默选为了妻子。
所以茱莉娅才希望通过路易的诞生能让丈夫蒙蒂默有所不同，哪怕茱莉娅自己也知道这种想法多少有点天真。
家里尚且存着一瓶极为珍贵的上古龙血。
一直存着没有被启用过。
“只是那家的小儿子为什么会需要龙血？一般的幼崽而言，应该根本承受不住才对。”
出于对小幼崽成长的担忧，妇人迟疑地询问了一句。
“也许是太过强悍，从小就开始寻找突破的契机？托兰西，你看看人家，再看看你自己。”
回忆着那一家子的脾性，阿麦斯觉得这个猜测很有道理，顺带教育起了自家儿子
“那我有点不感兴趣了，我才不要把我的血喂给对方。”
对父亲喂血的玩笑信以为真的托兰西一把抱住了自己的尾巴，神色抗拒起来。
“但我还是挺想出去玩的…今年我不想开学。”
小家伙扑到了妈妈的怀里，语气有点郁闷。
母亲萨拉无奈地笑着摸了摸自家儿子的脑袋。
“你都已经会化形了，要学着长大，化形后去上学是每一个小幼崽都需要经历的事情。”
在被蒙蒂默警告一句后，这位叫做查理斯的老人瞬间顿住，内心的不妙感却愈发浓郁起来。
因为深知蒙蒂默性格的查理斯确信，如今暂时处于下风的陆家如果试图曲意讨好接近，拉拢家族的这一票支持，说不定蒙蒂默反而会感到兴致阑珊。

chapters.translated_text:
Yet, the Lu family maintained their usual arrogant demeanor; the colder and more haughty they acted, the more curious Mortimer would inevitably become...

Thus, Mortimer walked with a beaming smile toward the Lu family's seating area, and taking advantage of the fact that the surrounding seats were still empty, he sat down right next to them, acting as if they were old friends.

"I heard that my son, Louis, gave that eagle feather from my study to your little one to play with? Perhaps we should have the two children come over to our place to play together sometime?"

As soon as this intrigued question and invitation were uttered, not only did Lu Ting straighten his posture, looking at Mortimer with a scrutinizing and dangerous gaze.

Even Lu Xun’s eyes turned cold in an instant.

Pei Yonghuan, located at the far diagonal corner, certainly did not miss the scene of Mortimer taking the initiative to greet the Lu family.

Although he couldn't see the specific details, Pei Yonghuan, who appeared to be smiling calmly and looking unperturbed on the surface, was actually filled with deep suspicion inside.

Mortimer, as an ally, could never be described as reliable.

The conference organizers on the sidelines were breaking out in a cold sweat.

They had thought they had done their best to follow the unspoken rules by placing these troublesome ancestors at opposite corners, so how did they still end up crossing paths!?
chapters.source_text:
偏偏陆家摆出了一如既往的倨傲神态，越是这么冷淡倨傲，蒙蒂默绝对反而会越发好奇……
于是蒙蒂默笑容满面地大步走到了陆家席位旁，甚至趁着周围座位尚未来人，直接自来熟且热情地坐在了一侧。
“听说，我那个儿子路易把我书房里的那根鹰翎送给你们家的那位小家伙玩了？有机会让两位小朋友一起到家里来做客玩玩？”
这句兴趣盎然的问话与邀请一出，不仅陆霆直接坐直了身体，以一种审视又危险的目光看向了蒙蒂默。
连陆巡的眸色都瞬间变冷了。
远方对角线处的裴永桓当然没有错过蒙蒂默主动跟陆家打招呼这一幕。
尽管看不清具体细节，但表面看似依然在淡定微笑没有异色的裴永桓，实则内心已然产生了浓郁的疑心。
蒙蒂默这个盟友，可从来称不上可靠。
一旁的会议主办方更是冷汗涔涔。
心想都已经尽可能按照潜规矩把这容易出事的几方祖宗给分到对角线了，怎么还是碰上了！？
chapters.title: 第109章
第8章
chapters.translated_text:
Although the little one didn't realize it himself, the lethality of his gaze—when his eye corners drooped slightly and he stared at his guardians with a mix of grievance and confusion—was off the charts.

Especially when the target was his fourth brother, Lu Huai!

Everyone in the room who noticed the shift in the cub's mood subconsciously glared at Lu Huai, as if asking what on earth he had done!

Lu Huai’s brain spun at a rare, rapid speed as he tentatively looked at the little one and asked, "So, should we keep holding you? But you have to wear more clothes, and there can't be any wind, and we can't move too fast..."

"Mm!"

Even though Lu Huai added a string of restrictions, the cub's eyes instantly lit up.

Lu Huai, who was already so charmed he couldn't speak, didn't notice the sinister gaze cast by his eldest brother, Lu Xun, who was standing to the side after being pushed away.

"But did the little guy really learn to speak just now? Or was it a coincidence?"

Naturally, some nurses couldn't help but bring up that impressive scene.

The little one had returned to his brother's arms like a bird returning to its nest, stumbling out that "Fourth Brother."

The kicker was that when they tested it again, aside from Lu Huai pointing at himself—which made the cub hesitate and call out a "Fouth Bwother"—whenever anyone else leaned in, the cub would simply purse his lips and blink. If they pushed him, he would hide back in his brother's arms.

Lu Huai’s smile was practically reaching the sun; he looked like he wanted to hug his little brother and act spoiled to his heart's content.

In the words of their father, Lu Ting, he looked completely pathetic and worthless!

As for Kremlin, who arrived later and learned that the cub had actually produced syllables, he was equally surprised.

"Theoretically, this kind of conscious and accurate vocalization of corresponding nouns usually doesn't happen until at least a year old..."

But after incubating in the nursery pod for so many years, perhaps some special changes really did occur?

Or should he study further whether the artificial assisted reproduction in the nursery pod actually helps with a cub's language development?

Regardless, this undoubtedly gave Kremlin a new realization: although the little one inherited the family's genetic disease, his language skills and other intellectual faculties were completely unimpaired.

This was entirely inconsistent with the many malicious speculations from the outside world.

He even seemed much brighter than an average cub!

It led Kremlin to doubt for a moment whether the Lu family's powerful genes were manifesting once again.

Even when taking medicine for the first time, the little one only hesitated for a moment before obediently opening his mouth.

He didn't cry or make a fuss throughout the process, remaining so quiet that the nurses were stunned, while the guardians on the side looked more solemn and tense than ever.

It was as if they wished they could take the medicine for him.

[However, the special medication for this rare disease can indeed maintain the stability of his health points. It's fortunate the family can afford it. Otherwise, buying it privately would be outrageously expensive, and more importantly, it's not covered by basic medical insurance!]

System 444, which had been checking the medication for its host, suddenly felt a bit relieved. It was lucky the host had transmigrated into a major villain family.

After all, most villains start off quite wealthy.

Conversely, if he had transmigrated as a destitute orphan in some interstellar novel or a discouraged genius in a fantasy novel, wouldn't he have to watch his stats drop to zero from the start... unable to wait for a late-game rise?

While drinking water obediently after his medicine, Lu Xueyan noticed that his health points had indeed risen slightly, reaching 4 points.

Even with kindergarten-level arithmetic, it was enough for the cub to realize that this seemed to have saved a huge amount of points that would have been spent on items.

Thinking about it this way, although Uncle Kremlin was a bit strange at times, he was actually quite capable.

[In the original book, Kremlin was a very capable character with a chaotic-evil alignment; otherwise, he wouldn't have been headhunted by the Lu family for such a high price. It's just that he was actually a bit of a slippery character and never truly loyal to the Lu family in the end.]

As System 444 explained this to its host, it suddenly became curious.

If the Kremlin from the original book hadn't remained silent when the Lu family was on the verge of collapse, but instead led his team to go all out in developing medicine to overcome the crisis, would the plot have turned out differently?

But perhaps one couldn't entirely blame Professor Kremlin for that.

Regarding the system's accusation, Lu Xueyan silently defended him in his heart.
chapters.source_text:
尽管小家伙本身并没有意识到，当自己的眼尾微微下垂，有点委屈和迷茫地盯着家长看时，这种杀伤力到底有多高。
更何况还是四哥陆淮！
全场察觉到幼崽心情变化的人也都下意识盯向了陆淮，仿佛在问你这家伙到底做了什么一样！
陆淮大脑罕见飞速旋转，试探性看着小家伙询问起来：“那，继续抱一下？但是要多穿一点，而且还不能有风，也不可以速度太快……”
“嗯！”
尽管陆淮加了一连串的限制条件，幼崽眼睛还是瞬间亮晶晶了起来。
已经被萌到完全说不出话来的陆淮，完全没有察觉到大哥陆巡被推开后站在一旁投来的阴恻恻目光。
“不过小家伙刚刚是真的学会说话了吗？还是巧合？”
当然，也有护士忍不住提起刚刚那印象深刻的一幕。
小家伙简直像是小鸟归巢一样地被哥哥抱进了怀里，喊出了那声磕磕绊绊的“四哥”。
关键当全场再次实验时，除了陆淮指向自己，小家伙会犹豫喊乖乖一声“细哥”以外，其余所有人凑过来，幼崽单纯抿唇眨巴眼睛，问多了下一秒还会躲到哥哥怀里。
陆淮简直嘴角都快跟太阳肩并肩了，想抱着弟弟疯狂撒娇的那种。
用老爸陆霆的话来讲那就是一副一点儿不值钱的没出息的样子！
至于克姆林赶来后得知幼崽居然发出了音节，整个人同样很意外。
“理论上，这种有意识并且准确发出对应名词音节的行为至少也得一岁左右……”
但保育舱里孵化了这么多年，也许确实会产生一些特殊的变化？
还是自己应当再研究一下，是否保育舱的人工辅助生育实则有助于幼崽语言能力发育？
无论如何，这无疑让克姆林产生了一点认知，那就是小家伙虽然身体遗传到了家族基因病，可语言能力等智力因素却没有任何损伤。
这一点是和外界很多颇带恶意的猜测完全不符的。
甚至看起来还要毕普通幼崽更聪颖很多！
导致克姆林一时间都不太确信，这是否是陆家强大的基因再次显现了。
小家伙就连第一次吃药，都只是犹豫了一下，接着就乖乖地张嘴了。
全程没有哭闹，安静得让一众护士们都忍不住惊讶，反倒是一旁家长们的脸色一个比一个凝重紧绷。
就像恨不得替小家伙吃药一样。
【但是这种罕见病的特效药物的确可以维持健康值的稳定，还好家里养得起。否则自己购买的话贵的离奇，关键还都不在医保的基础药物里！】
一旁替自家宿主提前检测了这些药物的系统444突然又有点庆幸，幸亏宿主穿进了一个大反派家族。
毕竟大多数反派开局都相当豪横的嘛。
相反，要是穿成什么星际文里的落魄孤儿，什么玄幻文里的失意天才，岂不是开局只能眼睁睁看着数值掉光……完全等不到后期崛起？
而吃完药乖乖喝水的时候，陆雪言就发现健康值还真的又缓缓上涨了一点，变成4点了。
就算是幼儿园算术水平，也足够幼崽意识到这好像省下来了一大笔购买道具的积分。
这么想的话，这位克姆林叔叔虽然偶尔有点奇怪，但是真的很厉害。
【原书里的克姆林本来就是非常有能力的一个混邪属性角色，否则一开始也不会被陆家重金挖过来了。只不过这家伙实则有点滑头，最终也没有完全忠心于陆家而已。】
系统444积极给自家宿主讲解的同时，突然产生了一点好奇。
如果原书里的克姆林并没有在后期陆家即将垮台时沉默以对，而是带着团队全力以赴地辅助研发药物渡过危机的话，剧情是否会变得不一样呢？
但这好像也不能完全怪这位克姆林教授。
对于系统的指责，陆雪言倒是默默地在内心辩解了一句。

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 71: The Return of the Second Sister, Lu Jing
chapters.source_text:
444连忙鼓励了起来，如果主脑不给发小红花的话，444都恨不得自己去文具店里偷点红纸给自家宿主剪一朵了。
至于为什么会产生这么奇怪的判定，琢磨了半天的444觉得一名真正的高人气反派，也许就是得具备这么一种令读者完全捉摸不透的立体复杂设定！
就像很多作品里反派角色人气过高，导致评论区里一堆主角党和反派党疯狂BATTLE，一片腥风血雨中也让作品可读性客观上更高了？
不过这个危机消除卡是什么？
事实上，当这天晚上的蓝瑛在视频电话里询问小家伙考虑得怎么样，是不是真的想让路易转园的时候，裴朔低垂着眼睛没有出声。
蓝瑛看着埋头收拾书包的裴朔便忍不住笑了。
看起来又恢复了？
果然小孩子没有隔夜仇嘛。
不过不等蓝瑛说些什么，裴朔就打开了盒子里的一份小纸包，不声不响地展示给了蓝瑛，准备接着再去给墨点展示一下。
“咦，这饼干不会做的是我们小朔吧？”
被家长牵着的托兰西一进门，便睁大眼睛看向了那团金色的毛茸茸。
落地窗的阳光刚刚好洒落在楼梯上，让奶金色的绒毛微微发光一样，看上去金灿灿的耀眼极了。
“托兰西，你小子给我站住！你从小学的那些礼仪呢！？”
随着一阵噔噔噔上楼的步伐，紧随其后的就是一声焦头烂额的中年人训斥声。
只不过显然没有起到任何作用。
“你叫什么名字啊？怎么不变成人？我们可以一起€€€€”
“抱歉，托兰西少爷，我们马上还有行程，就要出门了。”
然而就在托兰西兴奋地想要扑过去之际，陆景屿却恰好出现在了楼梯之上，微笑着垂眸看向了这位小客人。
“如果要玩的话，等马上谈判的时候，可以去酒店安排的幼崽游戏室。”
陆景屿一边说着话，一边不动声色地示意侍者将楼上自家弟弟跟那只亚龙分开了。
这位小少爷的脾气的确跟资料中一模一样。
作为全族唯一一只珍贵的返祖龙，麦尔斯那一族的人根本管不住。
而且，就像那些保守派的古老龙族一样，天生极度迷恋金色的漂亮事物。
“啊……”
而向来天不怕地不怕的托兰西闻言第一次迟疑地顿住了步伐。
抬头看向了眼前拦在楼梯上的陆景屿，又不由自主地后退了几步，回头看了眼楼下的家长。
“哦，好吧，我知道了，那我马上再来找他玩？”
不知道为什么，托兰西第一次有点挠着头不敢大声说话了。
自己这位小朋友的哥哥，感觉有点可怕。
“等等，不过那是什么啊？”
然而就在侍者将陆雪言跟裴朔分开各自带走之际，想多看一眼金灿灿的托兰西还是眼尖地看到了一抹黑色的身影。
然而这一次陆雪言慢吞吞说着话的时候，裴朔却突然语气复杂地打断了这只小妖怪的嘟嘟囔囔。
预言之画。
自己的确知道科尔斯那一族的罕见精神力天赋。
也正是因为这个珍贵的天赋，本身攻击性不强的科尔斯一族曾经在历史上遭遇了灭顶之灾，一度濒临灭绝。
如今剩余的那些为数不多的族人更是全部隐居在了星际之中，没有信任的人加以引荐或者介绍，几乎不可能暴露身份。
但如果是这一家的话，能找到一位如今罕见至极的科尔斯族人给刚出世的小儿子进行预言，也并非不可能。
而且如果这是预言，并不是画师本人亲眼看见后画出来的，一切就可以被解释。
唯独无法解释的就是，怎么会预言出自己？
“所以你交出了你的尾羽，然后拿到了这张预言。”
陈述般地总结了事实，裴朔看向了自己龙尾巴上的那只小团子，平静地等待着回复。
“对、对呀，大家都说，我未来会长这样，阿朔，你怎么了……”
第一次被淡金色的威严瞳孔注视得有些不自在，陆雪言忍不住有点小结巴地回应了起来。
阿朔有的时候看起来真的好严肃。
就像不相信一样。
“所以阿朔，你是觉得……”
“我在骗你吗？”
眨了眨眼睛，原本语气软乎乎说着话的小团子突然安静了下来，半晌后抬头轻轻地询问了一声。
一如既往的柔软，只是最后半句话的声音轻极了。
像是山谷间的一缕微风，稍不注意便匆匆消逝在夜色中再不见踪影了。
也就在指过去的这一瞬间，托兰西猝不及防地跟一双金色的瞳孔对视了。
尽管转瞬即逝，却让托兰西下意识地收回了指着的手指，反而忍不住抓住了一旁的栏杆。
好、好恐怖的感觉。
不对，不是恐怖，而是一种……血脉里的，很畏惧的味道。
越是返祖的血统，在带来越是强大的力量同时，也会带来对高纯度血脉的天然臣服，这是镌刻在骨髓里的本能。
哪怕已经脱离了正统龙族那一脉也永远无法改变的事实。
“托兰西，把你的龙尾巴给我收回去！你看看你像什么样子。”
而对此毫不知情的阿麦斯简直快被这个儿子气到心梗，连忙一把拽住了托兰西，万万没想到兴奋得连龙尾龙角都能冒出来！
要知道这简直失礼极了！
“啊，我的尾巴？”“啾？”
然而陆雪言被戳了一下脑袋，倒是亲昵地抵着指腹蹭了蹭，好奇地看向了手边的图录。
“拍、拍卖……？”
原书剧情指南里，好像……还真的提到过这个呢。
是什么的呢？
但是似乎是很后期的剧情了，不应该出现在这里才对。
“嗯，拍卖。说不定还能见到你的小叔。”
陆景屿看着小家伙跳到了册页上好奇地低头看了起来，也并没有阻止，反而解释了几句。
“小叔？”
陆雪言抬头看了过去，眼眸眨了几下有些茫然。
“你倒是还没见过小叔。跟父亲不一样，小叔他常年不在帝星，但是家里的这部分事务，基本上都是他在管理。”
自己这次应该算是临时代劳。“啊啊，这怎么写了这么多字啊，像画画一样，我都看晕了。你，快点过来，我命令你给我读一下。”
“托兰西，不要说出这么肤浅的话，你看看你像什么样子。”
“什么骗我？”
“真的知道了？”
抚摸着小家伙最为柔软的小腹绒毛，陆景屿提到这位小叔后，神色却有点微妙。
“说起来，既然要化形了，也该有个很正式的名字了。”
“有想过吗？”
提到名字，陆雪言顿时扑棱着翅膀，乖乖地站在了陆景屿的掌心里。
“爸这几天都没睡好，就是在想给你取名的事情，字典都快被他翻破了。”
戏谑地提到陆崇山的事情，陆景屿难得语气轻松起来。
而陆雪言听了，诡异地有点不安地抖了抖尾羽。
虽然，爸爸基本上很靠谱的样子，但是总觉得取名会很奇怪呢。
“说是要给你取个很威风的名字，厉害得不得了才行，大家想的全被否决了……”
“雪~雪雪！”
就在陆景屿慢悠悠说着话的时候，掌心里的小团子忍不住直接开口叫唤了起来。
“啾？”
chapters.title: 第71章 二姐陆菁归来
chapters.translated_text:
444 hurriedly offered encouragement; if the Main Brain wouldn't issue a "little red flower" reward, 444 was tempted to sneak into a stationery store, steal some red paper, and cut one out for its host itself.

As for why such a strange judgment had been made, 444 pondered for a long time and decided that a truly popular villain perhaps required this kind of complex, three-dimensional setting that readers found completely unpredictable!

Just like in many works where a villain's popularity is so high that it leads to fierce BATTLES between the protagonist's fans and the villain's fans in the comments section—doesn't that bloodbath objectively make the work more readable?

But what is this "Crisis Elimination Card"?

In fact, when Lan Ying asked the little one over a video call that evening how he had considered things and if he really wanted to transfer Louis to another kindergarten, Pei Shuo lowered his eyes and remained silent.

Lan Ying couldn't help but smile as she watched Pei Shuo bury his head in packing his schoolbag.

Looks like he's recovered?

As expected, children don't hold grudges overnight.

However, before Lan Ying could say anything, Pei Shuo opened a small paper packet from the box and silently showed it to Lan Ying, preparing to go show it to Mo Dian next.

"Huh? Is this cookie supposed to be our little Shuo?"

As soon as Torrance, led by his parent, walked through the door, his eyes widened as he looked at that ball of golden fluff.

The sunlight from the floor-to-ceiling windows spilled perfectly onto the staircase, making the milky-golden fur look as if it were glowing; it looked dazzlingly brilliant.

"Torrance, you brat, stop right there! Where are the manners you've been learning since you were little!?"

Following the sound of thumping footsteps up the stairs came the exasperated scolding of a middle-aged man.

But it clearly had no effect whatsoever.

"What's your name? Why don't you turn into a human? We could go together€€€€"

"Apologies, Young Master Torrance, we have an itinerary shortly and are about to head out."

However, just as Torrance was excitedly about to pounce, Lu Jingyu happened to appear at the top of the stairs, smiling as he lowered his gaze toward the little guest.

"If you want to play, you can go to the cub playroom arranged by the hotel when the negotiations start shortly."

As Lu Jingyu spoke, he calmly signaled for the attendant to separate his younger brother from that sub-dragon.

This young master's temper was indeed exactly as described in the files.

As the only precious atavistic dragon of his entire clan, the people of Miles' clan couldn't control him at all.

Moreover, like those conservative, ancient dragons, he was born with an extreme obsession with beautiful, golden things.

"Ah..."

Torrance, who had always been fearless, hesitated and stopped in his tracks for the first time upon hearing this.

He looked up at Lu Jingyu, who was blocking the stairs, then involuntarily took a few steps back and glanced at his parent downstairs.

"Oh, okay, I get it. Can I come back and play with him in a bit?"

For some reason, it was the first time Torrance felt a bit hesitant, scratching his head and not daring to speak loudly.

His little friend's older brother felt a bit scary.

"Wait, but what is that?"

However, just as the attendant was separating Lu Xueyan and Pei Shuo to take them away, Torrance, wanting one more look at the golden fluff, caught a glimpse of a black shadow.

Yet, this time, as Lu Xueyan was speaking slowly, Pei Shuo suddenly interrupted the little monster's muttering with a complicated tone.

A prophecy painting.

He did indeed know about the rare psychic talent of the Coles clan.

It was precisely because of this precious talent that the Coles clan, which was not inherently aggressive, had once suffered a catastrophic disaster in history and had once been on the verge of extinction.

Nowadays, the few remaining clansmen all lived in seclusion throughout the galaxy; without a trusted person to introduce or refer them, it was almost impossible for them to reveal their identities.

But if it were this family, it wasn't impossible for them to find a now-extremely-rare Coles clansman to provide a prophecy for their newborn youngest son.

And if this was a prophecy, and not something the artist had seen with their own eyes and painted, then everything could be explained.

The only thing that couldn't be explained was how it could have prophesied him?

"So you handed over your tail feather and got this prophecy."

Stating the facts like a summary, Pei Shuo looked at the little ball on his dragon tail, waiting calmly for a reply.

"Ye-yes, everyone says that's what I'll look like in the future. A-Shuo, what's wrong..."

For the first time being stared at by those pale golden, majestic pupils, Lu Xueyan couldn't help but stutter a little in response.

A-Shuo looks really serious sometimes.

As if he doesn't believe it.

"So A-Shuo, do you think..."

"That I'm lying to you?"

Blinking his eyes, the little ball that had been speaking in a soft tone suddenly went quiet, and after a long while, he looked up and asked softly.

As soft as always, only the sound of the last half of the sentence was extremely light.

Like a breeze in a valley, disappearing into the night before one could notice, leaving no trace behind.

And in that very instant of pointing, Torrance caught sight of a pair of golden pupils, caught off guard.

Although it was fleeting, it made Torrance subconsciously retract his pointing finger and instead grip the railing beside him.

A-a terrifying feeling.

No, not terrifying, but a kind of... scent in the bloodline that felt deeply fearful.

The more atavistic the bloodline, while bringing greater power, it also brings a natural submission to higher-purity bloodlines; this is an instinct engraved in the bone marrow.

A fact that could never be changed, even if one had already separated from the orthodox dragon lineage.

"Torrance, pull your dragon tail back! Look at what you look like."

Amas, who was completely unaware of this, was almost driven to a heart attack by his son and hurriedly grabbed Torrance; he never expected him to be so excited that his dragon tail and horns would pop out!

You have to know, this was extremely rude!

"Ah, my tail?" "Chirp?"

However, Lu Xueyan, having been poked on the head, affectionately rubbed against the fingertip and curiously looked at the catalog in his hand.

"Au-auction...?"

In the original plot guide, it seemed... it really had been mentioned.

What was it about?

But it seemed to be a very late-stage plot point and shouldn't have appeared here.

"Mm, an auction. You might even get to see your uncle."

Lu Jingyu watched as the little one jumped onto the pages and curiously lowered his head to look; he didn't stop him, but instead offered a few words of explanation.

"Uncle?"

Lu Xueyan looked up, blinking his eyes in confusion.

"You haven't met your uncle yet. Unlike Father, he doesn't stay on the Imperial Star year-round, but he basically manages this part of the family's affairs."

I suppose I'm acting as a temporary substitute this time. "Ah, why is there so much writing here? It looks like drawings; I'm dizzy just looking at it. You, hurry up and come over, I order you to read it to me."

"Torrance, don't say such shallow things; look at what you look like."

"What lying to me?"

"You really know?"

Stroking the softest down on the little one's belly, Lu Jingyu's expression became a bit subtle when he mentioned this uncle.

"Speaking of which, since you're about to take human form, you should have a formal name."

"Have you thought about it?"

Mentioning a name, Lu Xueyan immediately fluttered his wings and stood obediently in Lu Jingyu's palm.

"Dad hasn't slept well these past few days just thinking about naming you; he's almost worn out the dictionary."

Jokingly mentioning Lu Chongshan's situation, Lu Jingyu's tone was rarely relaxed.

And when Lu Xueyan heard this, he shook his tail feathers with a strange sense of unease.

Although Dad is basically very reliable, I always feel like the name will be very strange.

"He said he wanted to give you a very majestic name, something incredibly impressive, but everyone's suggestions were all rejected..."

"Xue~ Xuesue!"

Just as Lu Jingyu was speaking slowly, the little ball in his palm couldn't help but call out directly.

"Chirp?"

chapters.title: 第110章
chapters.translated_text:
"Chirp?"

"Snowy days are lovely; they are an elegant season. I think the name Lu Xueyan is quite good. It’s catchy and rolls off the tongue."

Inside the Prince's Mansion, all the servants were currently looking at the sub-dragon raised by their young master with a sense of inexplicable dread.

It coiled upon the main seat, silently gazing at the mural on the hall wall, yet it somehow made one feel as if a youth were sitting there, his expression majestic and cold to the extreme.

Pei Shuo stared at this mural, flicking his dragon tail gently, though his gaze eventually settled on his own dragon horns.

The Painting of Prophecy never makes mistakes.

This must be something that will happen at some point in his future, but... why would there be a faint trace of gold on his dragon horns?

However, just as Pei Shuo wanted to focus, a ripple suddenly surged deep within his mental sea.

"Your Majesty, Your Majesty, can you hear this old subject's voice..."

Abraham?

Pei Shuo frowned slightly and quickly responded within his mental sea.

"What is it, Abraham?"

Hearing the familiar voice again, everyone in the Elder Council stood up in excitement.

It seems His Majesty is in good spirits? And for some reason, there’s even a sense of casualness in his tone that wasn't there before???

Abraham was also stunned for a moment; he hadn't expected the first sentence after making contact to sound so much like a child...

Wait, His Majesty hasn't reached adulthood yet, after all. Hmm, he is still a young monarch...

No, that's not right, but being too playful won't do either!

Just as Abraham was feeling uncharacteristically conflicted, Pei Shuo asked lazily instead.

"Abraham, does the Amas clan have a bottle of so-called ancient dragon blood in their possession?"

"Ah, Your Majesty, I was just about to report this to you! The traitors of the Amas clan seem to be in private contact with the heretics of the Prince's Mansion branch, and they are even conspiring over dragon blood!"

"How precious is dragon blood? How can we allow them to trade it privately? This is an open contempt for the dignity of the dragon race..."

Seeing his Majesty, Abraham couldn't help but ramble on like an old man, and when he reached the parts that displeased him, the entire Elder Council became quite indignant.

They were trying to get their Majesty to come back quickly and deal with those traitors!!!

However, as he listened, it was clear that Pei Shuo's mind had already drifted elsewhere.

So it was just a bottle of inferior dragon blood, and who knows if the lineage is even pure... He wouldn't even drink that trash for fear of getting an upset stomach.

The image of that soft, milky-gold little bun who always spoke in a gentle voice appeared in his mind, and Pei Shuo tapped the armrest with his black dragon tail, looking quite hesitant.

"I already know about this matter, Abraham; you don't need to mention it again. There is just one more thing that has always left me a bit puzzled."

It wasn't until he was tugged by his father that Toransi finally came back to his senses, staring blankly at his own dragon tail, which was frozen in mid-air.

Strange, when did his tail come out?

"That was just a small pet kept at home, an Olak beast; it has a pitch-black, hard shell."

Although there was no problem with keeping a sub-dragon, it would be somewhat inappropriate if seen by the negotiating dragon race.

Seeing this, Lu Jingyu explained faintly, his expression impeccably calm, as he turned to look at Amas.

"Lord Amas, it is a pleasure to meet you. I have often heard my father mention your past achievements."

"Cough, I know of you too. Today's young people really are promising."

Looking at the junior, Lu Jingyu, who was reaching out, Amas immediately reached out to shake his hand in return.

But comparing people is truly infuriating.

That simple-minded and brawny Lu Chongshan actually has descendants who are more outstanding than the last.

The junior before him is already the Speaker of the Central Star Region's Council at such a young age, and it is said that his second son is also in the Combat Department of the Imperial First Academy...

Thinking of this and then glancing at his own son, that failing literature report card immediately flashed before Amas's eyes.

Heart attack.jpg

Lan Ying looked at the cookie figure in Pei Shuo's palm; its black hair was styled with chocolate sauce, and she had specifically chosen two round chocolate beans for its raven-colored eyes.

The seaweed tie around its neck was made even more lively this time.

It looked exactly like a Q-version black-haired little gentleman.

"Mm."

Facing his mother Lan Ying's inquiry, Pei Shuo nodded reservedly, incidentally recounting what had happened at kindergarten today to Lan Ying.

How could Lan Ying, who had always been sharp-eyed, fail to see her son's super-deliberate nonchalance?

"Oh my, then Xueyan must be exhausted, making cookies for all the children in the class just to make up for the accident at your birthday party?"

So, playing along with her cub's intentions, she exclaimed loudly and supportively.

Hearing this, Pei Shuo immediately reached out to prop up one side of his cheek, suppressed the corners of his mouth, and turned his head to look out the window.

The little cub, who had always been a bit precocious, wanted to appear as calm as possible in front of his parents at this moment, as if he didn't care that much at all.

Lan Ying, however, couldn't stop laughing, and this time, there were even more complex emotions mixed into her smile.
chapters.source_text:
“啾？”
“雪天很好，雪天是个优雅的季节，我觉得叫陆雪言很不错。喊起来也朗朗上口。”
亲王府内，此刻所有侍者都有些莫名畏惧地看着自家小少爷饲养的那只亚龙。
盘桓在主座上，静静地凝视大厅墙面那副壁画，却莫名让人觉得那里仿佛坐着一名少年，面色却威严而又冷漠到了极点。
裴朔注视着这幅壁画，轻轻甩了甩龙尾，目光却最终落在了自己的龙角之处。
预言之画从来不会出错。
这一定是自己未来的某个时间点会发生的事情，但是……自己龙角处怎么会有一抹淡淡的金色。
然而就在裴朔想要凝视之际，精神海深处却突然漾起了一丝涟漪。
“陛下，陛下您能够听到老臣的声音吗……”
亚伯拉罕？
裴朔微微蹙眉，很快在精神海里给予了回应。
“怎么了，亚伯拉罕。”
长老院内的众人再度听到熟悉的声音，几乎激动得全体起立。
看起来陛下的状态很好？甚至不知道为什么，语气里还多了份以往从未有过的随意感？？？
亚伯拉罕也愕然了一瞬，没想到联系上后的第一句话，居然像个孩子一样……
等等，陛下本来也就没有成年才对。唔，还是一位年少君主……
不对，但是过于贪玩似乎也不行啊！
就在亚伯拉罕心绪难得纠结之际，裴朔反倒懒洋洋地询问了起来。
“亚伯拉罕，阿麦斯那一族，手上是不是有一瓶所谓的上古龙血？”
“啊，陛下，正要跟您禀报此事！阿麦斯那族的叛徒似乎与亲王府那一脉异端私下接触，甚至在密谋龙血！”
“龙血何其珍贵，怎么能够任由他们私下交易，这简直是对龙族威严的公然蔑视……”
亚伯拉罕见到了自家陛下，也忍不住像个老人一样絮絮叨叨地多说了几句，说到心情不虞的地方连带着整个长老院都颇为愤慨。
试图让自家陛下快点回来去处理掉那族的叛徒才是！！！
只不过听着听着，裴朔显然心思已经转到了别处。
原来只是一瓶劣等龙血，连血统都不知道纯正不纯正……那种垃圾喝了也不怕拉肚子。
脑海里浮现出那只说话总是软绵绵的奶金色小团子，裴朔黑色的龙尾颇为迟疑地敲了敲扶手。
“这件事我已经知道了，亚伯拉罕，你不必再提。只是还有一件事，始终让我有些困惑。”
一直到被自家父亲拽住，托兰西才回过了神，呆呆地看向了自己僵在半空的龙尾巴。
奇怪，自己的尾巴什么时候出来了。
“刚刚那是家里养的一只小宠物而已，奥莱克兽，会有漆黑坚硬的甲壳。”
虽然养一只亚龙没什么问题，但是如果被谈判的龙族看见了，总归有些不合适。
见状陆景屿淡淡地解释了一句，神色平静得无可挑剔，反而看向了阿麦斯。
“阿麦斯大人，很高兴见到您，经常听家父提到您过往的事迹。”
“咳，我也知道你，现在的年轻人还真是年少有为。”
阿麦斯看着眼前伸手的小辈陆景屿，顿时也伸手握住回礼起来。
不过这人比人是真的气死人。
陆崇山那个头脑简单四肢发达的家伙，族里的后裔倒是一个比一个优秀。
眼前的小辈年纪轻轻都已经升任中央星域的议会议长了，据说二儿子也在帝国第一学院作战系……
想着再看一眼自家儿子，阿麦斯眼前顿时浮现出了那张不及格的文学成绩单。
心梗.jpg
蓝瑛看着裴朔掌心里的这块饼干小人，黑色的头发用巧克力酱淋出来了造型，鸦色的眼眸也特地选了两颗圆圆的巧克力豆。
脖子上的海苔小领带这次也做得更灵动了。
俨然像是一个Q版黑发小绅士。
“嗯。”
面对妈妈蓝瑛的询问，裴朔矜持地点了点头，顺带不经意地把今天幼儿园里发生的事情也给蓝瑛讲了一遍。
向来眼光老辣的蓝瑛，又怎么可能看不出自家儿子此刻的超绝不经意。
“诶呦，那雪言岂不是累坏了，为了给你弥补生日宴上的意外，做了全班这么多小朋友的饼干？”
于是相当捧场地顺着自家幼崽的意思，故意大声惊叹道。
闻言裴朔顿时伸手撑住了一侧脸颊，按捺住唇角，扭头看向了窗外。
向来有点早熟的小幼崽，这一刻在家长面前想尽可能表现得波澜不惊，就像并没有那么在意一样。
蓝瑛却笑得不行，这一次的笑意里，也多了几分更为复杂的情绪。

chapters.title: 第72章 幼崽的信息素实验
chapters.translated_text:
After successfully picking up the little one, Lu Jing sped away under the gaze of the group.

She also successfully checked in on the family group chat.

The little one in the photo had clearly just arrived home when Lu Jing personally took him to Kemulin for his daily physical examination.

Lu Jing was originally looking at the materials in her hand with a cold expression, while Xue Yan, sitting on a small chair nearby, was behaving obediently without moving or making a fuss.

That was until he became a little curious about his sister's long, tied-up hair.

Recalling how Teacher Jiang braided the hair of the little girls in class, he quietly braided a small plait into a loose strand of his sister's hair.

Although the force was very, very light, like a kitten tugging at a strand of hair from behind, it was absolutely impossible for an adult Alpha not to notice.

Feeling the movement, Lu Jing lifted her eyelids and saw the little one behind her braiding her hair with intense focus, reflected in the mirror on the side.

Unable to help herself, she kept her back still and, with a curled lip, raised her phone to secretly snap a photo.

After this extremely cute photo was sent to the family group, it naturally blew Lu Huai up first in a second.

Soon, a knowledgeable monster recognized Meiqiu's species.

After all, Meiqiu's beast form was indeed very rare and precious.

Only after Xue Yan was sure the situation had stabilized did he pick up the camera from the grass, pat it, and aim it back at the "reunion" scene in front of him.

"Sorry, the photographer just ran over to help. I didn't expect it to be such a coincidence; as soon as I finished taking care of the little one, his family showed up."

"Maybe he's going to carry the little one away?"

"The strange thing is that he isn't moving at all."

For a moment, Xue Yan felt like a narrator for a nature documentary, explaining the magical things he encountered to non-existent viewers.

In fact, the interaction in the bullet comments had already exploded by this point.

In reality, the Oni couple, who had also received the news, had indeed opened the "Demon World" app for the first time in a long while, looking at the scene on the screen in disbelief.

Is this our son?

Lu Huai had been busy as hell lately.

He was grinding through his studies during the day and working on his startup at night; when he ran out of manpower, he simply dragged Wei Zhili and the others in to become shareholders.

Wei Zhili was shocked at first, never expecting that the recently viral monster newcomer team was actually being run behind the scenes by his childhood friend. He even felt that this guy Lu Huai was playing the pig to eat the tiger, and wasn't being a very good buddy.

The group immediately joined Brother Huai's commercial empire construction map with great enthusiasm.

As it turned out, this group of rich second-generation gaming enthusiasts, who were just playing around, soon painfully discovered that turning a hobby into a profession was a terrifying thing.

Just like playing games and studying how to play games—they are two completely different things.

Yet, Lu Huai was full of fighting spirit from beginning to end.

Not only did he declare that he would make the company bigger and stronger, with future business expanding from e-sports all the way to entertainment streaming, but he even planned to ring the bell for an IPO and become the number one e-sports and entertainment stock in the country!

Heh, when the time comes, he could play around as the chairman, and wouldn't he be on equal footing with his big brother? Let's see how arrogant he can be then.

Awesome, it was simply too awesome.

More and more monsters flooded into Xue Yan's live stream, and soon a monster sent the first bullet comment in disbelief:

The key point was that it was one thing for a human to sneak into the "Demon World," but he actually dared to expose his identity and live stream openly.

But soon all the monsters realized that after everyone sent their bullet comments, Xue Yan didn't seem to react at all.

The next second, a new system prompt popped up:

After reading this prompt, the monsters instantly became vigilant and suspicious:

This black-hearted game, it wouldn't be trying to find new ways to make everyone spend money again, right?

For example, spending tens of thousands of points to develop a two-way conversation message function?

Impossible, absolutely impossible!

Although the bullet comments that were originally discussing this topic shifted instantly following an accident in Xue Yan's live stream.

Although as they chatted, the thoughts of many monsters drifted away; just looking at the cute way the cub was purring was enough to guess how comfortable it was to be bathed by a young human.

What if the one being held and bathed was me...

The big raccoon and the others on the side never dared to make a sound whenever they saw Lu Huai laughing evilly like a villain with his hands crossed.

Guan Yun was even a little worried that the big god's brother's entrepreneurial incentive plan might be a bit too stimulating.

Of course, if System 444 were to appear on the side to evaluate it, it would find that Lu Huai's seemingly unrealistic vision actually had the prototype of a successful real-world case.

At the very least, the original book didn't write about things like TikTok or Little Red Book, which meant what? It meant this was a huge, fillable void.
chapters.source_text:
顺利接到小家伙后，陆菁在一行人的目光里飞驰而去。
并且在家族群里顺利打卡。
照片上的小家伙显然刚刚到家没多久，就被陆菁亲自带去克姆林那里做日常体检了。
陆菁原本正神色冷冷地拿着手里的材料在看，而坐在一旁的小椅子上雪言的也乖乖地不动不闹。
直到对姐姐扎起的长发有点好奇。
回忆着姜老师给班上的小姑娘编辫子那样，悄悄给姐姐垂落的一缕发丝也编起了一根小辫子。
虽然力度很轻很轻，就像被小猫从身后抓发丝一样，但是对于成年Alpha来讲是绝对不可能察觉不到的。
感受到异动的陆菁刚一掀起眼皮，便从一旁的镜子反射里看见了背后小家伙聚精会神编辫子的模样。
忍不住安静地保持后背姿势不动，唇角翘起地举起手机镜头偷拍了一张。
这张极其可爱的照片发到家族群里后，自然也是一秒钟就率先把陆淮给炸出来了。
很快有见多识广的魔物认出来了煤球的种族。
毕竟煤球的兽态的确非常珍惜罕见。
雪言确信情况稳定下来后，这才从草地里捡起来了摄像头拍了拍，重新对准了眼前“认亲”的这一幕。
“不好意思，刚刚摄影师跑来帮忙了。没想到还挺巧的，刚给小家伙处理完毕，家长就找上门来了。”
“也许他会把小家伙叼走？”
“奇怪的是他一动也不动。”
某一瞬间，雪言感觉自己像是动物世界的解说员，在和不存在的观众们讲解自己遇到的这些神奇的事。
事实上弹幕这会的互动早就爆炸了。
事实上，同样收到了消息的奥妮夫妇这一刻的确久违地打开了《魔界》APP，不可置信地看着屏幕上的这一幕画面。
这是自家儿子？
陆淮最近忙得要死。
白天卷学业，晚上搞创业，甚至人手不够之下，干脆把卫之礼一群人也给拽进来入股了。
卫之礼起初大惊，万万没想到最近爆火的怪物新人战队居然是自家发小幕后操盘的，还觉得陆淮这家伙多少有点扮猪吃老虎，不够哥们意思。
一群人顿时兴致冲冲地加入了淮哥的商业帝国建设版图。
结果这群玩票性质的电竞发烧友富二代很快痛苦发现，原来兴趣变成职业，是一件如此可怕的事情。
就像打游戏和研究打游戏，这也完全是两码事一样。
奈何陆淮倒是从头到尾斗志满满。
不仅表示要把公司做大做强，未来业务从电子竞技一路铺到娱乐直播，甚至还要去敲钟挂牌上市，成为国内电竞文娱第一股！
呵呵，到时候自己也当个董事长玩玩，那不就跟大哥平起平坐了？看他还怎么拽。
爽，简直太爽了。
涌入雪言直播间的魔物越来越多，很快有魔物不可置信地发出了第一条弹幕：
关键这人类混入了《魔界》也就罢了，还敢正大光明地暴露身份直播。
但很快所有魔物发现，大家的弹幕发出后，雪言似乎完全没有反应。
下一秒新的系统提示就弹出了：
读完这段提示，魔物内心便瞬间警惕产生了疑问：
这黑心游戏，不会又是想换着花样让大家氪金吧？
比如氪金个几万积分开发双向对话留言功能？
不可能，绝对不可能！
虽然原本正在讨论着的弹幕，随着雪言直播画面里一场意外发生，话题瞬间改变。
虽然聊着聊着很快有魔物的思绪飘了起来，光是看着那只幼崽呼噜的乖巧模样就能猜到被年轻人类洗澡澡有多舒服。
万一被抱着洗澡的是自己……
一旁的大狸子等人每每看见陆淮在那边双手交叉反派般地邪恶大笑，都不敢吱声的。
关云甚至有点担忧，大神他哥的这一创业激励计划，会不会激励的有点过头了。
当然，如果让系统444出现在一旁评估的话，会发现陆淮这个看似不切实际的设想还真的有现实成功案例的雏形。
至少原著里可是没有写到什么跳音、小粉书存在的，这说明什么？这说明这是一片巨大的可以填补的空白啊。

chapters.translated_text:
If our Lu family, under the leadership of Fourth Brother, successfully embarks on a path of becoming a new upstart in "Internet + Entertainment Technology," wouldn't that make us an even bigger, more formidable villain conglomerate—the kind that kills gods if gods stand in our way?

The whole family's villainous enterprise is growing bigger and stronger!

444, immersed in its fantasies, was already overjoyed, until Xueyan asked softly, "But, what is 'Tiaoyin'..."

Only then did 444 realize, oh crap, its host is too young and has never scrolled through Tiaoyin or Little Pink Book!

Well, it looks like until Xueyan grows up a bit, Fourth Brother will have to fumble around on his own for a few years—let's just call it accumulating startup experience?

Lu Jing naturally knew that the fourth one had been busy trying to start some kind of business lately.

Therefore, seeing Lu Huai spamming the family group chat with accusations, she just gave a cold laugh.

At the moment when the number of bullet comments exploded, the next second, countless monsters saw the screen filled with fluttering colorful cellophane and fell into a collective stupor.

What is this thing?

"Jiumu?"

Meiqiu stared blankly at the beautiful colored paper dancing in the sky before it, subconsciously blowing away a piece of cellophane that had landed on its nose.

"Happy birthday, Meiqiu! It's your birthday today, did you forget?"

After setting off the handmade party poppers she had prepared in advance, Xueyan contentedly placed a pointed birthday hat on the little guy's head.

How could it be so cute? It looked adorable even with the little hat on.

If she had a Polaroid, she would definitely take a bunch of cute photos of the little guy.

"It's okay that the little wolf drank the basin milk; tonight we'll have cake, a delicacy even better than basin milk."

After setting off the poppers, Xueyan even placed the small cub-sized cake she had prepared in front of it, signaling the dazed Meiqiu to hurry up and blow out the candles.

"Although I don't know how you celebrate birthdays, humans usually do it this way: you blow out the candles and make a wish. From now on, every year, our Meiqiu will become healthier and happier."

At this moment, although they could only see the waist of the human youth in front of the lens and not his face, listening to the expectant words right in their ears, many monsters suddenly felt their heartbeats skip a beat in a daze.

After coming to their senses, they were even more incredulous—this human was actually absurd enough to be celebrating the! birth! day! of a monster cub!?

An infuriated Lu Huai never expected that this was how the people in his family viewed his startup.

Lu Li, on the other hand, didn't expect to be caught in the crossfire like this. After a while, he squeezed in a reply: [Sounds good, I support it.]

Lu Huai was completely speechless.

Heh, these people are clearly just afraid that if his startup succeeds, Xueyan will really only like Fourth Brother the most.

Lu Huai gave the family group chat a disdainful middle finger.

But the next second, Lu Jing sent another photo of Xueyan, and Lu Huai instantly retracted his middle finger, impatiently opening the image.

The live photo showed Xueyan, who had just been caught by his sister secretly braiding hair, pursing his lips and smiling in admission.

The little guy was holding his sister's braid with both hands, posing obediently for the phone, as if showing off a craft project and asking his guardian if it looked good.

Only half of Lu Jing's face was in the frame, but the upturned corners of her lips looked subtle and triumphant no matter how you looked at it.

Just as Meiqiu, acting like a "little adult" with a bowl in its mouth, was about to put the bowl in the stream to start washing, Xueyan couldn't help but reach out and take it from him.

"I'll just wash it. You're a fluffy ball, how exactly were you planning to wash it?"

Xueyan poked Meiqiu's forehead, causing the little guy to twist in protest, still trying to snatch it back to help wash the dishes.

"Isn't it better if you're in charge of filming? Otherwise, if your fur gets wet while washing dishes, I'll have to give you a bath too. More importantly, your bib will get wet, and isn't the bib your favorite thing?"

Xueyan asked patiently with an amused tone. After hearing this analysis, Meiqiu blinked its eyes on the spot.

Is it more tiring for A-Yan to wash the dishes, or to wash me?

Especially my bib—if it gets wet, A-Yan will have to wash it all over again.

Meiqiu, trying to weigh the workload of both tasks, was ultimately handed the camera by Xueyan, forcing the little cub to take on the role of photography assistant.

"The little guy seemed to want to rush to help me wash the dishes. As a guardian, I'm really touched and happy. Don't you all think Meiqiu is super cute?"

Xueyan muttered to himself, adding a voiceover while cleaning the basin milk bowl.

Occasionally, there was a tiny bit of regret—if only he could really let more people see how cute Meiqiu is.

After all, showing off one's own well-behaved cub is always a very pleasant part of being a guardian!

Even Lu Xun, who had been watching the show without saying a word, had his expression change.

This made the people accompanying him to inspect the group's business think some major blunder had occurred, and they looked at each other in confusion.

As the eldest brother, Lu Xun understood the trace of madness hidden in Lu Jing's personality all too well.

To some extent, Lu Jing seemed to have lacked a part of her emotional perception since childhood; many things that only a madman could do, Lu Jing felt were perfectly normal.

At this moment, in Kemu Lin's office.

Xueyan was being led by his sister, walking toward the door with a bit of excitement.

"Can we really go to the supermarket, Sister... don't I need to take medicine?"

Xueyan had originally thought that after the routine physical examination, he would have to take medicine and get injections again.

Because every time after a check-up before, Uncle Kemu Lin would hesitate for a long time, then very cautiously prescribe medicine for the little guy, and occasionally he would need infusions and injections.

Unless necessary, Kemu Lin was very reluctant to let the little guy have an infusion.

After all, once a needle was inserted into the cub's delicate skin, it would quickly become red and swollen for a while, and anyone who saw it would feel heartbroken.

If the swelling didn't go down, Aunt Cheng would nag for half the day the next day, saying what would happen if he went to kindergarten like that, and that he would have to cover it up so other children wouldn't see anything strange.

After all, Xueyan's skin tone was so fair that any sign of injury was exceptionally obvious.

However, as soon as this bullet comment appeared, all the monsters unanimously sent countless question marks, trying to snuff out this strange idea.

"Alright, after a bath and a blow-dry, you've become a fluffy and fragrant little cub, and your color has even changed... Huh, so it was gray."

Only after Xueyan washed the little guy clean did he realize that this cub had instantly become brand new!

The color was several shades lighter, and the fur was a very beautiful silver-gray, rather than the gray-black he had previously mistaken it for.

"Awoo~"

Being rubbed on the ears by Xueyan, the little guy shook its head, but it was clearly having a lot of fun.

"But it seems it's time to send you back soon; I have to find your guardians."

Xueyan smiled and patted the little guy's head.

What Xueyan didn't know was that just as he lowered his head to coax the little cub, the bullet comments were densely packed with the words "Danger" and "Run."

Because in the forest not far away, a sturdy and powerful alpha wolf was walking toward this area with light, steady steps, its glowing eyes fixed on Xueyan, who was holding the wolf cub.

Although all the monsters were screaming, with a "Jiumu" sound, Meiqiu, who had been holding the micro-live camera, had long since dropped the camera and rushed over first.

All the monsters watching the live stream realized that this mobile camera wasn't some fully automatic flying camera, but was being held by another monster cub!

How on earth was this done!?

It was even more mind-boggling.

"Yeah, we won't take medicine for now today; let's go out for a stroll. Are you happy?"

Lu Jing looked down at the excited cub and reached out to adjust the little hat for Xueyan.

"Happy." Xueyan lowered his head to let his sister adjust his hat, then looked up with sparkling eyes, making a hint of softness appear in the depths of Lu Jing's eyes.

Kemu Lin, on the side, looked nervous: "Although it's an experimental trial, Dr. Lu Jing, we still have to be careful..."

Because after Lu Jing returned, a brief conversation led Lu Jing and Kemu Lin to unexpectedly discover that they had arrived at the same conclusion through different paths.

That is, if it is destined that the little guy cannot avoid contact with the complex outside world as he grows up, why not try to adapt to it first?

You can't keep the little guy locked in an ivory tower or a crystal house forever. Although, if Xueyan wanted to, the family could certainly manage that.

But looking at Xueyan's irrepressible excitement at this moment, Lu Jing was certain that the little guy still liked a bit of liveliness.

Before kindergarten, he could be kept at home and cared for by Aunt Cheng and the others without going out much, but now that he had started kindergarten, he already needed to have contact with the outside world.

Even for the sake of preparing for elementary school in the future, some preparatory work and risk assessment had to be started in advance.

At least the little guy who was once thought to be destined to die before the age of three is now able to make friends in kindergarten, isn't he?

Lu Jing stroked the cub's cheek, the thoughts in her eyes so complex that Xueyan couldn't quite understand them, but he subconsciously rubbed his cheek against his sister's palm.

As if to say, Sister, please don't worry, okay?
chapters.source_text:
咱们陆家万一在四哥的带领下，成功踏上一条互联网+娱乐科技发展新贵之路，那不更是成为巨无霸反派综合体，堪称神挡杀神？
全家的反派事业一路做大做强！
沉浸在幻想中的444已经乐得不行了，直到雪言轻声问了一句：“可是，什么叫跳音呀……”
444这才发现，卧槽，自家宿主年纪太小了，完全没有刷过什么跳音、小粉书！
好吧，看起来在雪言长大点之前，都得四哥先慢慢摸索几年了，就当积累创业经验？
陆菁自然也知道老四最近似乎在忙着搞什么创业。
因此看见陆淮在家族群里刷屏指责自己的留言，也是冷笑一声。
弹幕数量随之疯狂爆炸的这一刻，下一秒无数魔物们看见满屏幕纷纷扬扬的彩色玻璃纸，也陷入了集体呆滞。
这是什么东西？
“啾姆？”
而煤球更是呆呆地看着眼前漫天飞舞的漂亮彩纸，下意识吹跑了一片落在自己鼻子上的玻璃纸。
“生日快乐噢，煤球！今天是生日，你都不记得了吗？”
雪言放完提前准备的手工礼花筒，便心满意足地将尖尖的生日帽给小家伙戴到了脑袋上。
怎么这么可爱，连戴上小帽子也萌得不得了。
要是有拍立得的话，非得给小家伙拍上一堆可爱招照片。
“盆盆奶给小狼喝掉了没关系，今天晚上我们吃蛋糕，比盆盆奶更好吃的美味。”
放完礼花筒，雪言甚至把提前准备好的幼崽小蛋糕摆在了面前，示意呆呆的煤球速速过来吹蜡烛。
“虽然不知道你们怎么过生日，但是人类一般都是这么过生日的，可以吹灭蜡烛许个愿，以后每一年我们煤球都要越来越健康、开心。”
这一刻，虽然只能看见镜头前人类青年的腰身看不见脸，但是听着近在耳畔期待满满的话语，很多魔物突然朦朦胧胧心跳都跟着漏了半拍。
反应过来后更是不敢置信，这个人类居然荒谬到在给一只魔物幼崽过！生！日！？
气得陆淮万万没想到，家里这群人居然就是这么想自己的创业的。
陆黎倒是没想到自己这样也能躺枪，半晌忙里抽空回了一句【挺好，支持。】
陆淮彻底无语了。
呵呵，这群人分明就是怕自己创业成功，到时候雪言就真的只喜欢四哥一个了。
陆淮鄙夷地对着家族群竖了一个中指。
奈何下一秒陆菁又发了一张雪言的照片，陆淮瞬间按回了中指，迫不及待地打开了图片。
实况图片上，刚好是被姐姐抓包偷偷编辫子后，抿唇笑着承认了的雪言。
小家伙双手捧着姐姐的辫子，对着手机乖乖给拍照，就像在展示手工课作业一样，问家长这样好看吗？
陆菁则只入镜了半张脸，但上扬的唇角怎么看怎么微妙得意。
只是叼着碗“小大人”一样的煤球刚将碗放在溪水里准备开洗，雪言就已经忍俊不禁地伸手接了过来。
“我来洗就行了，你毛茸茸的一团到底准备怎么洗？”
雪言戳了一下煤球的额头，顿时让小家伙不服气地扭了扭，依然试图抢回来自己帮忙洗碗。
“你负责摄像不好吗？要不然洗碗毛毛弄湿了，还得帮你也洗个澡，关键围兜也会跟着弄湿，你最喜欢围兜的不是吗？”
对此雪言语气好笑地耐心询问了起来，听完这顿分析，煤球才原地眨巴了几下眼睛。
阿言是洗碗累一点，还是洗自己累一点？
尤其是自己的围兜，湿了的话阿言也要重新洗一遍。
努力衡量两者任务量轻重的煤球，最终直接被雪言递过去了摄影机，帮小幼崽强制性分配了摄影助理的任务。
“小家伙刚刚似乎是想抢着帮我洗碗，作为家长是真的很欣慰开心，大家是不是也觉得煤球超级可爱？”
雪言一边清理着盆盆奶碗，一边对着镜头自言自语着补充画外音。
偶尔也有那么一点点遗憾，要是真的能让很多人看见煤球多可爱就好了。
毕竟炫耀自家乖崽从来都是家长非常愉快的环节！
甚至就连一直在看戏没再说话的陆巡，都脸色一变。
让陪同身侧视察集团业务的众人，还以为出现了什么大纰漏，面面相觑。
对于陆菁性格里潜藏的那一丝疯劲，身为大哥的陆巡是再明白不过的。
某种程度上，陆菁从小就似乎缺失了一部分情绪感知力，很多疯子才能做出来的事情，陆菁却觉得习以为常。
此时克姆林的办公室里。
雪言正被姐姐牵着，有点雀跃地走向了门外。
“我们真的可以去逛超市吗姐姐……不用吃药么？”
雪言本来还以为惯例体检完毕后，又要吃药打针的。
因为之前每次检查好后，克姆林叔叔都会纠结犹豫很久，然后慎之又慎地给小家伙开药，偶尔还需要输液打针。
如非必要，克姆林极少愿意让小家伙输液。
毕竟幼崽细皮嫩肉的肌肤上，一旦扎了针会迅速红肿片刻，谁看了都会觉得心疼。
消不了肿的话，第二天程姨还会念叨半天，说这样去上幼儿园可怎么办呢，还得拿东西遮着免得被别的小朋友看见奇怪。
毕竟雪言肤色实在是太白了，有任何一点受伤的迹象都格外明显。
只不过这条弹幕刚一出现，所有魔物就一致地发出了无数问号，试图按灭这个奇怪的想法。
“好了，洗完澡吹干，就变成蓬松又香喷喷的小幼崽了，颜色都变了……咦，原来是灰色的。”
雪言洗干净小家伙后才发现，这只幼崽瞬间变新了！
颜色都浅了好几分，毛发是非常漂亮的银灰色的，而非之前误以为的灰黑色的。
“嗷呜~”
被雪言揉着耳朵，小家伙摇了摇脑袋，却明显玩得很开心。
“不过接下来似乎也该送你回去了，得找找你的家长。”
雪言笑着拍了拍小家伙的脑袋。
雪言不知道是，就在自己低头哄着小幼崽的时候，弹幕上密密麻麻地写满了“危险”和“快跑”两个字。
因为不远处的森林里，一只矫健威猛的头狼正步履轻健地走进了这片区域，莹莹的目光看向了抱着幼狼的雪言。
虽然所有魔物尖叫的时候，随着一声“啾姆”响起，原本叼着微型直播摄像机的煤球早就扔掉摄像机抢先一步冲了过去。
所有观看直播的魔物这才发现，原来这随时可以移动的摄像头不是什么全自动飞行摄像头，而是由另一只魔物幼崽叼着在拍摄的！
这到底是怎么做到的！？
简直更加匪夷所思了。
“嗯，今天我们暂时先不吃药了，出去逛逛，很开心吗？”
陆菁垂眸看了一眼雀跃的幼崽，伸手替雪言把小帽子扶了扶。
“开心。”雪言低头任由姐姐帮自己扶帽子后，又抬眼亮晶晶地看了过去，看得陆菁眼底也浮现了几分柔软的神色。
一旁的克姆林倒是神色紧张：“虽然是尝试性的实验，陆菁博士，但我们还是得小心吧……”
因为陆菁回来之后，短暂的谈话就让陆菁和克姆林彼此意外发现，两人居然殊途同归地产生了同一种看法。
那就是如果注定不能避免小家伙长大以后接触错综复杂的外界环境，那为什么不能尝试着先适应一下？
总不能一辈子把小家伙圈在象牙塔水晶屋里。虽然如果雪言愿意的话，家里也不是不能做到这一点。
但陆菁看着这一刻雪言藏不住的雀跃模样，确信小家伙还是喜欢热闹一点的。
上幼儿园之前可以一直养在家里由程姨他们照顾不怎么出门，如今上幼儿园开始就已经需要跟外界接触了。
就算是为了将来上小学筹备，一些准备工作和风险评估也必须提前启动。
至少曾经被认为注定会在三岁前夭折的小家伙，如今已经能够在幼儿园里交到朋友了，不是吗？
陆菁摩挲着幼崽的脸颊，眼底的思绪复杂到让雪言有点看不懂，但是下意识用脸颊蹭了蹭姐姐的掌心。
就像在说姐姐不要担心好不好？

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 73: Xue Yan lets out an "Awoo"
chapters.translated_text:
"Mommy, that doll is about to cry!" "Shall we go and take him home?" "I want this one!"

Unexpectedly, before Lu Jing could even react, the children who had been quietly watching from the side shouted out at the top of their lungs.

In truth, everyone had wanted to crowd over to get a closer look at Xue Yan. However, with Lu Jing standing by, even though she hadn't said much the whole time, the deterrent presence of a top-tier Alpha was enough to scare off quite a few children.

When Xue Yan heard this out of the blue, he felt even more aggrieved.

His long, thick eyelashes drooped, and the milky-white hair by his ears swayed slightly.

"I don't want to be taken home by you... I want to go find Fourth Brother."

Xue Yan muttered softly to himself, rejecting the invitation to be carried away by the other children.

It was as if he were trying to comfort himself.

Even though the little guy didn't actually know how to leave the supermarket to find his Fourth Brother somewhere in the world.

And when Lu Jing saw the little guy hesitate for a moment, his instinct to let go of the toy to go find the fourth one, she finally realized the severity of the situation.

He had only wandered a few steps away; how could he be so sad?

To the point that he even thought he was being abandoned?

Especially after a monster raised this question, the moods of many monsters on the forum became subtle.

You must know that the Luna clan had always maintained an image of extreme arrogance and indifference; as one of the few races in the Demon Realm with a remarkably complete heritage, they could be considered true ancient great demons.
chapters.source_text:
“妈妈，那个洋娃娃要哭了！”“我们去把他抱回家好不好？”“我想要这个！”
不料陆菁还没来得及反应，一旁始终悄悄关注着这里的小朋友们就超大声地喊了起来。
其实大家本来就挺想凑过去近距离看看雪言的。奈何陆菁站在一旁，哪怕全程没怎么说话，身为极优Alpha的威慑力都足以吓退不少小朋友了。
而雪言冷不丁听到这句话，顿时更委屈了。
长而浓密的眼睫毛垂落下来，耳畔奶白色发丝微微晃动。
“我不要被你们抱回家呀……我要去找四哥的。”
雪言轻声自言自语地念叨着，拒绝了被其他小朋友抱走的邀请。
就像在自己哄自己一样。
哪怕小家伙其实还不知道怎么从超市出发，才能在世界上的某个角落里，找到四哥。
而陆菁看到小家伙犹豫了一瞬，便下意识想松开玩具要去找老四的模样，终于察觉到问题的严重性。
明明只是走远了几步，怎么会难过到这个地步？
甚至以为自己要被丢掉了？
尤其是当有魔物提出这个疑问后，论坛里非常多的魔物都心情变得微妙起来。
要知道鲁纳族一直以来的形象都是极度高傲冷漠的，作为魔界里少有的传承极为完整的种族，可以说是真正意义上的远古大魔。

chapters.translated_text:
It is incredibly hard to believe that a race’s supreme treasure, having finally been birthed, would end up in the hands of a human.

What many monsters didn't say out loud was that if it were them in that situation, they might not have been able to resist the excitement and would have just given it away too.

That human is just too good at this!

She can practically coax a cub until it’s dizzy with happiness.

Amidst the pile of comments discussing the magic crystal, there were quite a few persistent ones asking for the same model seen in the livestream.

Of course, more of them were monsters who hadn't paid to unlock the livestream; they couldn't understand the discussion at all and were so anxious they were practically jumping up and down.

Regret, they are feeling extreme regret right now!

Regret that they didn't know to log in more often to interact and accumulate points, leaving them unable to experience the new features now that they want to!

For a time, the user activity and online duration of "Demon World" soared.

It was all monsters frantically grinding tasks, terrified that if another livestream started, they wouldn't have enough points to watch it.

"Xueyan, Big Sister just walked a few steps away to get something else, how could I possibly abandon you?"

At this point, Lu Jing had completely abandoned the idea of the experiment, half-kneeling down to scoop the little one into her arms.

The situation at hand seemed far more dangerous than failing the experiment or not getting the data.

Xueyan, held in her sister's arms again, only pursed her lips and looked at her sister upon hearing this.

It was as if she were trying to discern whether her sister was truly telling the truth.

But Sister clearly said she would accompany her to pick out toys, so why did she suddenly walk to a different shelf?

"What's wrong? Why are you so sad, hmm? Didn't we say we were going to pick out a favorite little toy together?"

Lu Jing used her fingertips to stroke the corner of the cub's eye, her tone softening as much as possible.

Even if those colleagues and staff members who were familiar with Lu Jing in daily life saw that the "Jing" they knew could actually display such vivid and natural human emotions, and even use this tone to coax a cub, they would probably be terrified, thinking the end of the world was coming.

"I don't want toys anymore, Sister."

After a long while, Xueyan, held tightly by her sister, said in a muffled voice.

Although she still looked very well-behaved, Lu Jing clearly felt that the little one was like a small clam; after briefly opening up to show her inner softness to her guardian, she had quickly closed back up after being frightened.

Just as Lu Jing frowned, feeling an unprecedented sense of unknown loss of control, the supermarket's broadcast system suddenly blared all at once.

"Chumu?"

But just as the hearts of the many monsters in the comments were in their throats, Meiqiu also realized that A-Yan had snuck away for a moment, twisted its body, and looked back.

And at that very moment of turning around, a "Pop!" sound suddenly rang out!

"Nimo!" "Young Master!!"

The group of Luna clan guardians off-camera were so pale they were practically slamming their tables and rising to their feet.

The scene of awakening a high-level talent contains extremely mysterious and vast laws of power; just by watching it for a moment, the probability of one's own awakening doubles.

"Is this for me?"

Xueyan held the cool, beautiful pale purple stone in her palm and looked hesitantly at Meiqiu in front of her.

Seeing that Xueyan wasn't holding it tightly, the little creature even nudged it further into her palm, looked up at Xueyan with its big, round eyes, and nodded.

"Chumu." As Xueyan gripped the beautiful stone, a rare series of system rewards popped up one after another.

In all the time playing "Demon World," this was definitely the first time Xueyan had received so many system notifications at once.

Moreover, the livestream that had been opened automatically closed as soon as the cub handed over that Moon-Bright Magic Crystal, as it had reached the required duration.

No matter how shocked the monsters in the comments were or how hard they tried to keep it going, this strange and mysterious livestream ended there.

At the same time, the Demon World forum undoubtedly received a massive influx of traffic.

A caught-off-guard Xueyan: ? How did our good Meiqiu suddenly turn into several of them!

This broadcast was so urgent that it played three or four times in a row, and in the last few seconds, the screens even began to cycle through photos of the little one.

At first, it was a close-up photo of Xueyan taken by her eldest brother.

In the photo, the little one was close to the lens, seemingly staring at her brother's camera and asking: Does this really look good?

The soft, transparent fuzz on her fair, flawless face could be seen clearly, not to mention the dreamy light in her light-colored pupils.

From this angle, there was the illusion that if her guardian lowered their head just a little, they could give the cub a fierce kiss.

So, as soon as this photo appeared, the entire supermarket on the basement floor of the mall seemed to freeze for a moment.

Especially the crowds pushing carts past the supermarket screens; they stared blankly at the photos, thinking this was some new type of advertising.

Although they couldn't find the product the little one was endorsing, it was just eerily tempting to buy something similar because she looked so good.

Thinking that maybe if they wore the same clothes and the same little hat, they could be just as beautiful!?

However, before the photo could be displayed for more than a few seconds, the large screen seemed to be forcibly controlled by someone and quickly switched to another photo.

It was a full-body shot of Xueyan being held in her brother's arms while holding cotton candy; the little one sitting on her brother's arm was smiling and hugging her fourth brother's neck, her milky-white hair strands sticking to her guardian's black hair.

The white cotton candy in her palm looked even more like a clean, soft cloud that would float away in the next second.

"Ah, this one is also so good-looking!"

The countless monsters watching in front of their screens personally experienced what it meant to be sour with envy.

"Why did it stop? Can't you blow out the candles?"

Xueyan looked at her smilingly; after the surprise, seeing the cub staring at her motionlessly, she couldn't help but reach out and rub Meiqiu's little head, urging the little one to make a wish.

"Chumu..."

Meiqiu blinked several times before reluctantly moving its gaze away from Xueyan and looking seriously at the small cake in front of it.

The candles on top flickered, illuminating a warm yellow halo, and even A-Yan's eyes seemed to have stars twinkling in them.

A few seconds later, the little creature, holding its breath, puffed up slightly, and in the next second, it exhaled like a little balloon to blow out the candles.

Xueyan clapped directly: "Perfect, wish granted! As expected of our Meiqiu!"

Actually, Xueyan was still a little curious about what the little creature had wished for.

But after making the wish, Meiqiu closed its eyes and gently spread its wings, and a beautiful pale purple halo slowly emerged in the small room.

It was as dreamy as moonlight spilling around them, shimmering with starlight.

Countless profound symbols and laws floated within it, running in an indescribable trajectory.

Xueyan also subconsciously looked up and around at this miraculous, cold, and dreamy scene.

Is this a phenomenon caused by Meiqiu? It's so beautiful and shocking, like the aurora at the end of the world.

Before Xueyan could recover from this shocking sight, all the pale purple radiance instantly condensed in front of the cub, finally slowly solidifying into a pale purple moon gemstone.

"Chumu."

After Meiqiu chirped, it held the moon stone containing strange power in its mouth, flapped its wings, flew up, and placed it in Xueyan's palm.

Compared to Xueyan, a human who was completely bewildered, the countless monsters watching the video understood the value of this scene much better.

"I knew it, this must be a cotton candy commercial!!"

"My god, how could you get lost like this? What on earth is this guardian doing..."

For a time, the gossiping crowd began to patrol everywhere.

At the same time, they were a little worried; such a beautiful cub could be lost by its guardian? Is it for real?

"But it can't be that they used this method just to let everyone see photos of their cub."

Although many parents are keen on posting photos crazily on social media, this method was still too shocking.

In fact, at the customer service center at this moment, Lu Huai, who had hurriedly ended the latest round of investment planning discussions with Big Li and the others, rushed to the supermarket with Big Li's group, only to see his eldest brother, Lu Xun, who had just gotten out of a car and was rushing over with a group of people.

Regarding Lu Jing taking the little one out for an experiment, the whole family felt intense suspicion and unease the moment they saw the news.

They couldn't be sure if Lu Jing would suddenly do something shocking again.

The staff at the customer service center were already shocked to see two tall, long-legged, and imposing Alpha elites at the same time.

They never expected that both of them were looking for the same younger brother!

And they soon started "arguing" over which photos to use on the screen to find the cub.

"No, who looks for someone with a close-up photo! At least put up a full-body shot so people can see the figure??"

Lu Huai thought his eldest brother was simply unreasonable.

Lu Huai fell into a deep silence, almost losing half his life from the cuteness.

What was this little mouth babbling "Awoo" about? He couldn't understand it, couldn't understand it at all, he just wanted to give her a fierce kiss.

That's what Lu Huai thought, and soon Lu Huai did just that.

"So, does our Xueyan know how a tiger bites people?"

Lu Huai asked gently.

Xueyan hesitated for a moment and honestly shook her head.

Because Mo Dian didn't seem to have bitten anyone in front of her?

He didn't bite anyone at the birthday party either; he was a very well-behaved and sensible little tiger.

"Then should Fourth Brother show you?"

Xueyan: ?!

After Lu Huai said he would demonstrate, Xueyan looked up in disbelief, not knowing how her brother was going to demonstrate a little tiger biting someone.

So Lu Huai opened his big mouth without hesitation, and in the next second, this "gaping maw" took a fierce bite of the little one's cheek, which she had proactively offered.

The little cub, who had just finished her bath, smelled absolutely wonderful; she was all body wash, sweet and warm.

It was almost the complete opposite of how she looked when she was sleeping coldly and quietly in the nursery pod.

In front of the camera, Meiqiu knew A-Yan was filming it, so it instantly turned into a little model, deliberately puffing out its chest to show off its little moon bow bib.

It's super good-looking!

Love it.

chapters.source_text:
种族至宝好不容易诞生一颗，却流入了一个人类手里，怎么看怎么不可思议。
甚至很多魔物没有说出口的是，换做是他们在那样的情况下，说不定都会忍不住一个激动就送出去了。
那个人类实在是太会了！
简直能把幼崽哄得晕乎乎的。
一堆讨论魔晶的留言里，还有不少不死心询问直播同款的留言。
当然，更多的则是没有付费开启直播的魔物，完全听不懂这些讨论的意思，急得就差上蹿下跳了。
后悔，现在就是非常后悔！
后悔平时怎么不知道多上线互动积累积分，搞得现在想体验更新的新功能都体验不了！
一时间《魔界》的用户活跃度和在线时长可谓飞跃了起来。
全是生怕下一次直播开启依然积分不够无法开启直播的魔物们疯狂肝任务的身影。
“雪言，姐姐只是走远了几步，想去拿个别的东西而已，怎么可能把你丢掉？”
至此陆菁已然彻底放弃了实验的决定，半蹲下到跟前一把抱住了小家伙到怀里。
眼下遇到的情况，似乎比完不成实验拿不到数据还要危险得多。
被姐姐重新牵住抱进怀里的雪言，闻言却只是抿唇看着姐姐。
似乎在辨别姐姐究竟是不是在说真话一样。
可姐姐明明说要陪自己选玩具的，为什么突然走到别的货架前面了。
“怎么了？到底为什么这么难过，嗯？不是说要一起挑一个最喜欢的小玩具的吗？”
陆菁用指腹摸了摸幼崽的眼尾，语气尽可能地柔和了下来。
哪怕如果平日里熟悉陆菁的那些同事和工作人员，如果见到了他们认识的“菁”居然会出现这么生动自然的人类情绪，甚至用这种口气哄幼崽，大概会惊吓到以为世界末日要来了。
“不想要玩具了呀，姐姐。”
半晌后，被姐姐抱紧的雪言才闷闷地说道。
虽然依旧是很乖的模样，但是陆菁明显感受到小家伙像是一只小蚌壳，在短暂朝着家长张开露出内里的柔软后，又在受到惊吓后迅速闭合了。
就在陆菁眉头蹙紧，感受到一种前所未有的未知失控感时，超市的广播突然集体响了。
“啾姆？”
可就在弹幕里的众多魔物心脏提到嗓子眼时，煤球也意识到了阿言似乎偷偷离开了一趟，扭了扭身子回头望了过去。
结果就在回头的这一瞬间，“啪€€€€”的一声突然响起！
“尼莫€€€€！”“小少爷！！”
镜头外一众鲁纳族的家长就差脸色苍白地拍案而起了。
觉醒高等天赋的画面蕴含着极为神秘浩瀚的法则力量，但凡多看一眼，自身能够觉醒的概率都会随之翻倍。
“是给我的吗？”
雪言握着掌心里这颗冰凉的淡紫色漂亮石头，同样迟疑地看向了眼前的煤球。
眼看雪言没有握紧，小家伙甚至扒拉着家长掌心往里推了推，抬头睁着圆乎乎的大眼睛看向了雪言点了点头。
“啾姆。”当雪言握紧这枚漂亮的石头，一连串的系统奖励便罕见至极地接连弹出了。
玩《魔界》这么久以来，雪言绝对是第一次同时收到了这么多的系统提示。
而且开启的直播也刚好在幼崽递出那枚辉月魔晶后，显示时长达标自动关闭了。
无论弹幕上的魔物们有多么的震惊或者是努力挽留，这段奇异神秘的直播还是到此为止了。
与此同时，魔界论坛毫无疑问接受了大批涌入其间的流量。
猝不及防的雪言：？我们家好煤球怎么突然变成好几颗了！
这条广播急促到一连播放了三四遍，甚至最后几秒后显示屏上还开始轮流投放小家伙的照片了。
一开始是大哥拍的雪言大头照。
照片上的小家伙凑得镜头近近的，似乎盯着哥哥的镜头在问：这样真的好看吗？
白皙无暇的脸蛋上一层软软的透明绒毛都可以看得一清二楚，更别提浅色的瞳孔里那种带着一丝梦幻感的光线了。
这个角度有种家长稍微低一下头，就能狠狠亲到幼崽的错觉。
于是这张照片一出来，整个商场负一层的超市都像是愣了一下。
尤其是推车路过几处超市投屏的人群，愣愣盯着照片还以为这是什么新型投放广告方式。
虽然也没找到小家伙代言的产品，但这么好看就是诡异地让人想买点同款。
想着是不是穿上一样的衣服和戴上一样的小帽子，就也能这么漂亮！？
不过还不等这张照片投放几秒，大屏幕就像被人强行操控了一样，又迅速切换成了另外一张照片。
刚好是雪言拿着棉花糖被哥哥抱在怀里的全身照，坐在哥哥臂弯上的小家伙笑着抱紧四哥的脖颈，耳畔奶白色的发丝都跟家长的黑发黏在了一起。
掌心里拿着的那朵白色棉花糖，更是像一朵洁白柔软的云，下一秒就会飘起似的。
“啊，这张也好好看！”
无数屏幕围观前的魔物们就这样切身体会到了什么叫做吃柠檬的酸味。
“怎么不动了？吹蜡烛不会吹吗？”
而雪言笑眯眯地看着惊喜过后，幼崽呆呆地看着自己一动不动，忍不住伸手揉了揉煤球的小脑袋瓜，催促小家伙去许愿。
“啾姆……”
煤球眨巴了好几下眼睛，才依依不舍地将目光从雪言身上移开，认真地看向了眼前的小蛋糕。
上面的蜡烛摇曳着火光，照亮了一片暖黄色的光晕，连阿言的眼睛里也像是有星星在闪烁一样。
几秒后，憋气的小家伙微微膨胀了几分，下一秒就像小气球一样地呼气吹灭了蜡烛。
雪言直接鼓掌起来：“完美，许愿成功！不愧是我们煤球！”
其实雪言还有点好奇小家伙会许愿什么。
只是许完愿的煤球闭着眼睛轻轻张开了翅膀，一阵淡紫色的漂亮光晕缓缓浮现在小屋内。
梦幻到如同月光洒落身周，泛起星星点点的光芒。
无数玄奥至极的符号与法则漂浮在其中，以一种难以描述的轨迹运行着。
雪言也下意识抬头环顾起四周这片奇迹般的清冷梦幻画面。
这是煤球引发的现象吗？好漂亮震撼，仿佛世界尽头的极光一样。
不待雪言从这种震撼奇景中回过神，所有的淡紫色光辉又瞬间凝聚到了幼崽的身前，最终缓缓凝结成了一枚淡紫色的月亮宝石。
“啾姆。”
煤球叫唤了一声后，就叼着这枚蕴含着奇异力量的月亮石头，拍打翅膀飞起递到了雪言掌心里。
比起雪言这个一脸茫然的人类，此时无数围观了视频的魔物们更加懂得这一幕的含金量。
“我知道了，这一定棉花糖的广告！！”
“天呐，这都能走丢了？这家长到底在搞什么……”
一时间议论纷纷的群众直接四处巡视了起来。
同时有点担心，这么漂亮的幼崽都能被家长找不到了？真的假的。
“那也总不能是用这种方式，就为了让所有人看看自家幼崽的照片吧。”
虽然很多家长会热衷于在朋友圈里疯狂发照片，但这种方式还是过于惊世骇俗了。
事实上，此刻的客户服务中心里，匆忙结束了跟大狸子他们新一轮投资企划讨论的陆淮，第一时间跟大狸子一行赶到超市，就看见了同样刚下车带着一群人疾步赶来的大哥陆巡。
对于陆菁要带着小家伙出来实验这件事，全家看见这条消息的第一时间，就产生了浓烈的狐疑不安。
根本不能确信陆菁会不会又突然做出点惊世骇俗的事情。
而客户服务中心的工作人员，一同时见到两位身高腿长、气场惊人的极优Alpha，已经很震惊了。
万万没想到两人还都是来找同一位弟弟的！
并且很快因为究竟用哪几张照片投屏寻崽而“吵”了起来。
“不是，哪儿有人找人拿个大头照的啊！好歹放个全身照，能让人看清身形呢？？”
陆淮觉得大哥简直不可理喻。
陆淮深深地沉默了，硬是差点被萌没了半条命。
这小嘴叽里咕噜地“嗷呜”什么呢，听不懂，完全听不懂，单纯想狠狠亲一口。
陆淮这么想的，很快陆淮也就这么做了。
“那我们雪言知道老虎怎么咬人吗？”
陆淮轻轻问了起来。
雪言犹豫了一下，老老实实地摇了摇头。
因为墨点在自己面前，好像没有咬过人？
生日宴上也没有咬人，是一只很乖很乖的懂事小老虎。
“那四哥给你表演一下？”
雪言：？！
陆淮说完要表演，雪言就有点不可思议地抬起了头，不知道哥哥准备怎么表演小老虎咬人。
于是陆淮就毫不客气地张开了大嘴，下一秒这张“血盆大口”就狠狠啃了一口主动送到跟前的小家伙的脸蛋。
刚洗完澡的小幼崽简直香极了，浑身上下都是沐浴露的味道，甜甜的，暖暖的。
几乎跟当时睡在保育舱里冷冰冰安静的模样完全相反。
镜头前煤球知道阿言在拍自己，也瞬间变成了小模特，故意挺胸露出了自己的月亮蝴蝶结小围兜。
超级好看的！
喜欢。

chapters.translated_text:
"Not only does it look great, but once the bib is on, the cub won't get milk all over its fur while drinking. You could say it's also extremely practical."

Xue Yan smiled as he reached out to straighten the bib for the cub, sharing this very practical item for cubs.

The monsters, who were already very curious, felt a secret, soft spot in their hearts inexplicably touched as they watched the interaction between Xue Yan, the bib, and the cub.

You have to understand, monsters have always raised their young in a very simple and wild manner; when have they ever seen such delicate and patient pampering?

However, Xue Yan soon reappeared, though when he turned back around, he was holding something in his hands, trying to conceal it.

Countless monsters watching the livestream zoomed in on the screen, trying to analyze what this human was fussing over and bringing back.

He only wanted to give it to A-Yan.

Just being held in a guardian's arms is a form of heartfelt comfort.

Xue Yan was caught off guard when his Fourth Brother opened his mouth wide and leaned in close, scaring him so much he wanted to hide but didn't know where to go.

It wasn't until he had been fiercely kissed by his Fourth Brother for a long time that he finally grew tired of playing and couldn't help but collapse into his brother's arms, laughing, his milky-white hair all ruffled from the play.

"Brother is a liar."

"That's not how a little tiger bites."

The little cub, who had been carried to bed by his brother, very seriously pointed out that his brother was lying to him.

If Mo Dian bit people like that, then no one would be afraid of Mo Dian. Because Mo Dian is a very beautiful and majestic little tiger, and everyone would be happy if he kissed them.

"Nonsense, that's exactly how a little tiger bites. Or why don't you come and bite Brother back?"

Lu Huai was thick-skinned and didn't admit to the little one's accusation at all; instead, he pointed to his cheek, trying to get Xue Yan to take the initiative and kiss him.

Xue Yan pursed his lips, not falling for his brother's trick at all.

Lu Huai, on the other hand, really wanted to offer himself up and let this little tiger, Xue Yan, take a bite.

Regarding this, many viewers who, a second ago, were condemning the livestream for seemingly trying to guide monsters into doing chores for humans, suddenly felt a bit embarrassed the next second when they saw Xue Yan naturally take the bowl and start washing it.

It seems everyone really did misunderstand this human!

There was a feeling of being carefully pampered.

While the live chat was buzzing with discussion and confusion, Xue Yan had just finished washing the bowl with ease and finally looked up at Meiqiu, who was diligently filming him.

The one he raised with his own hands is truly impossibly cute no matter when he looks at him.

Having filmed the little wolf cub for so long, shouldn't his own Meiqiu be filmed properly too?

Once he grows up, he won't be able to capture such an adorable look from his childhood again.

So, without hesitation, Xue Yan reached out and pulled Meiqiu over.

"Although there might not be many people watching, Meiqiu is the best-behaved little friend in my home. This bib was also made specifically for Meiqiu, and the pattern chosen is the little moon he likes very much."

In the voice-over, the love in Xue Yan's tone for the cub was almost undisguised.

It would be hard for any viewer to doubt his feelings for the cub after hearing this introduction.

"Chiu-mu~"

"What, you think Brother's meat doesn't taste good? Brother works out every day, the meat is very fragrant, there's no fat at all!"

The Alpha asked with a smile, trying to sell himself.

As a result, the next second, Xue Yan actually learned from his Fourth Brother, puffed up his cheeks, gathered his strength, let out an "Ao-wu," and gently "bit" his Fourth Brother.

Lu Huai was so happy he was about to faint.

No, how can life be this happy!?

If he were a supervillain wanting to destroy the world, at this moment, he wouldn't want to destroy the world at all; he would only want to hold his younger brother for the rest of his life.

"I want Brother to hold me while I sleep tonight... is that okay?"

Xue Yan said in a small, shy voice.

Aunt Cheng usually prepares two quilts in advance, and Xue Yan's quilt is a bit smaller so that the adults don't pull the quilt away while sleeping and cause the little one to catch a cold.

But today, Xue Yan didn't want to sleep in his own little quilt at all.

This was the first time Lu Huai had heard the little one take the initiative to say he wanted his guardian to hold him while sleeping.

"Of course you can, why wouldn't that be okay?"

Hugging the little one, Lu Huai asked very seriously and with confusion.
chapters.source_text:
“不仅很好看，戴好围兜之后，幼崽喝奶的时候也不会粘到毛毛上，可以说同样非常实用。”
雪言笑着一边伸手替幼崽摆正了围兜，一边分享着这件很实用的幼崽物品。
而本来就非常好奇的魔物们，此刻看着雪言摆弄围兜和幼崽的互动，莫名其妙就被戳中了内心隐秘的柔软点。
要知道魔物们养崽可是向来非常简朴狂野的，什么时候有过这么细腻耐心的宠爱？
不过雪言很快重新出现了，就是再次转身回来的时候，手中遮遮掩掩地拿着什么东西。
无数围观直播的魔物们纷纷放大画面，试图分析出这个人类纠结带回来了什么。
是只想送给阿言。
光是被家长抱在怀里，就是一种发自内心的安慰。
雪言猝不及防地被四哥张开大嘴凑近，吓得想躲又不知道往哪儿躲。
直到最后被四哥狠狠亲了大半天，才玩累了一样地忍不住趴在哥哥怀里笑了，奶白色的发丝都玩得乱蓬蓬的。
“哥哥骗人。”
“小老虎才不是这样咬人的。”
被哥哥抱上床的小幼崽，很认真地指出来哥哥是在骗自己。
如果墨点是这么咬人的话，那大家才不会怕墨点呢。因为墨点是一只很漂亮威风的小老虎，亲人的话大家都会很高兴的。
“胡说，小老虎就是这么咬的，要么你也来咬哥哥一下？”
陆淮脸皮很厚，一点没承认小家伙的指控，反而指着脸颊，试图让雪言也主动亲自己一口。
雪言抿唇，一点也不上哥哥的当。
陆淮倒是很想主动送上门，让雪言这只小老虎咬一口。
对此，很多前一秒还在谴责这直播似乎是想引导魔物帮人类干活的弹幕，下一秒看见雪言态度极其自然地接过碗洗起来后，顿时产生了一种怪不好意思的感觉。
大家好像还真的错怪了这个人类！
有种在被悉心宠爱着的感觉。
弹幕里议论纷纷、大为不解的同时，雪言也刚好轻松洗完了那只碗，最终抬头看向了认真拍摄自己洗碗的煤球。
自己亲手养的，真是什么时候看都可爱得不行。
拍了那么久的小狼崽，自家煤球岂不是更应该好好拍一拍？
以后长大了的话，都拍不到小时候这么萌的模样了。
于是雪言没什么犹豫地直接伸手把煤球给抱了过来。
“虽然可能没什么人看，但是煤球是我家最乖的小朋友。这件围兜也是特意给煤球做的，图案选的是他很喜欢的小月亮。”
画外音里，雪言语气里对幼崽的喜爱几乎是毫无掩饰的。
任何一名观众听完这段介绍恐怕都很难怀疑对方对幼崽的感情。
“啾姆~”
“怎么，觉得哥哥的肉不好吃？哥哥每天都健身，肉可香了，都没肥肉的！”
Alpha笑着问道，试图自我推销一下。
结果下一秒雪言就真的也学着四哥那样，腮帮子鼓鼓地蓄力“嗷呜”一声，轻轻“咬”了四哥一口。
陆淮幸福得都快要昏迷了。
不是，人生怎么可以这么幸福啊！？
如果自己是个想毁灭世界的大反派，这一刻恐怕都完全不想毁灭世界了，只想一辈子抱着自家弟弟的那种。
“今晚想要哥哥抱着睡……好不好？”
雪言有点不好意思地小声说道。
程姨一般都会提前准备两床被子，雪言的被子会小一点，这样免得大人睡觉的时候扯被子，反而让小家伙着凉了。
但是今天的雪言一点也不想睡自己的小被子了。
陆淮还是第一次听到小家伙这么主动地说要家长抱着睡。
“当然可以啊，这有什么好不好的？”
搂着小家伙，陆淮很认真又不解地询问道。
chapters.title: 第113章
第74章 如果雪言走丢了
chapters.source_text:
面对哥哥不解的询问，雪言看着近在咫尺的哥哥，小声道：“我怕打扰哥哥睡不好……上学会打瞌睡的。”
程姨说小幼崽晚上睡觉如果总是被打扰没睡好的话，白天就会打瞌睡，就听不懂老师讲的课了。
听到幼崽细声细气的解释，陆淮忍不住挑眉，直接给人托着下腋抱到跟前了。
“谁说抱着我们雪言会睡不着的？”“外面一堆人想抢着抱我们雪言睡觉那还抱不到呢！”
陆淮信誓旦旦地告诉小家伙这才不会打扰到哥哥。
事实上，担心家长打扰到雪言睡觉还差不多。
因为陆淮是真的怀疑自己会忍不住隔几秒就狠狠埋头亲一口的那种。
听到哥哥这么说的雪言反而有点害羞了。
觉得哥哥总是喜欢说这种话。
“才没有……”小家伙轻声否认了起来。
看了半天的霍格微微蹙眉，莫名有些重视起来了，莫非这是一个人类的名字？
或许这也值得跟雇主夫妇汇报一下。
新的家园访客？
这游戏里面还能有这种功能？
雪言顿时好奇起来了，想也没想地就点了【接收】。
熟悉地进入游戏后再度睁眼，雪言习惯性先找煤球。
“煤球€€€€煤、煤球？”
“啾姆！”
只见煤球超级快速地飞了过来，一下子就占据了雪言的臂弯，亲昵又热情地蹭了好几下。
不等雪言揉自己，就又拍了拍翅膀，示意雪言往后看。
而雪言目光投去，甚至怀疑自己看错了。
就像在幼儿园里，那也都是一个小朋友一张午休床的。不过裴朔好像确实试图跑过来找自己玩，但是很快就被姜老师抓走了。
雪言没告诉姜老师的是，其实自己觉得这样还挺热闹的，毕竟身为小班长总不能跟老师唱反调。
