“有的，有的，只不过我们雪言不知道自己到底多可爱，哥哥都恨不得天天抱着睡的那种，关灯了哦。”
陆淮乐得不行，抱着怀里软糯糯的一小团，就长臂一伸给灯关了。
卧室里一下子黑了起来。
陆淮的卧室空间也相当宽敞，几道双开门后面还联通了一个超大的电竞房和浴室、衣帽间等功能间。
雪言下意识有点紧张，结果下一秒就被四哥的臂弯更加紧紧地搂住了。
一点儿也不会给坏人抓走机会的那种。
黑暗里，陆淮盯着怀里有点困了的小家伙，想了想还是问了起来：“不过能不能告诉哥哥一件事，嗯？”
“嗯？”雪言学着哥哥用鼻音发出了一道疑惑的声音。
“今天在超市里，为什么会那么伤心？被吓到了？”
三颗一颗比一颗大点的“煤球”正排排站在了屋子前，眨巴眼睛看向了自己。
虽然细看又有点不一样。
比如最大的那只明显是肚子有点胖，不胖不瘦的那只莫名有点优雅高贵的味道，偏瘦的那只毛毛较长还有点发灰发白……
而且就在雪言愣住的时候，中间那只优雅“煤球”就示意一旁的大肚子“煤球”叼来了一只手提箱，递给了雪言。
雪言：？？？
“啾姆……啾姆啾姆！”
是给阿言的见面礼。
煤球飞着示意雪言打开。
雪言深深的迟疑了，但是在幼崽的示意下，还是伸手打开了。
盒子一打开，居然是满满一箱子淡紫色的矿石。
其实这是只有在鲁纳族的领地矿坑里才会出产的特殊魔石。
陆淮摸着幼崽的脸蛋，难得良心大发，打算替陆菁问一问原因。
虽然陆淮自己也很想知道就是了。
不料被问到这个问题的雪言，却很久没有说话。
一直到陆淮伸手揉了揉幼崽软软的发丝，雪言才有点不好意思地掩饰道：“没有伤心……”
“胡说，明明就是伤心了，还说没有伤心？身为小班长怎么能说谎骗哥哥呢。”
陆淮在这方面是一点不给幼崽推脱机会的，瞬间让雪言被说得脸色微微红。
因为姜老师确实说过小朋友不可以随便撒谎。
于是闷了半天的小家伙，终于在四哥面前小声坦白了：“我害怕姐姐也……我害怕姐姐不要我了。”
这个答案让陆淮怎么想都没想通，觉得陆菁那家伙踹飞大哥跟自己，都不可能不要雪言吧！？
毕竟陆菁三年前开始突然转了研究方向，甚至实习的目标院所发生改变，可都是为了小家伙的信息素紊乱症罕见病。
chapters.translated_text:
Facing her brother's puzzled inquiry, Xueyan looked at him, who was so close, and whispered, "I was afraid of disturbing you so you wouldn't sleep well... and then you'd be dozing off at work."

Aunt Cheng said that if a little cub is always disturbed and doesn't sleep well at night, they will doze off during the day and won't be able to understand the teacher's lessons.

Hearing the cub's soft-spoken explanation, Lu Huai couldn't help but raise an eyebrow, lifting her up by her underarms and pulling her right in front of him.

"Who said holding our Xueyan would make me unable to sleep?" "There are a bunch of people outside who would scramble to hold our Xueyan while sleeping if they could, but they don't even get the chance!"

Lu Huai told the little one confidently that this wouldn't disturb him at all.

In fact, it was more like he was worried about disturbing Xueyan's sleep.

Because Lu Huai truly suspected that he wouldn't be able to resist burying his face in her and kissing her every few seconds.

Hearing her brother say this, Xueyan felt a bit shy instead.

She felt that her brother always liked to say things like that.

"No, I didn't..." the little one softly denied.

Having watched for a long time, Hoge frowned slightly, inexplicably taking it seriously; could this be a human name?

Perhaps this was also worth reporting to the employer couple.

A new visitor to the home?

Could this game actually have such a feature?

Xueyan suddenly became curious and, without thinking, tapped [Accept].

After entering the game as usual and opening her eyes again, Xueyan habitually looked for Meiqiu first.

"Meiqiu—Mei, Meiqiu?"

"Jium!"

Meiqiu flew over super fast, instantly occupying the crook of Xueyan's arm, and rubbed against her affectionately and enthusiastically several times.

Without waiting for Xueyan to pet him, he flapped his wings again, signaling Xueyan to look behind her.

As Xueyan cast her gaze over, she even suspected she had seen wrong.

Just like in kindergarten, where every child has their own nap bed. Although Pei Shuo did seem to try to run over to play with her, he was quickly caught by Teacher Jiang.

What Xueyan didn't tell Teacher Jiang was that she actually thought it was quite lively; after all, as a little class monitor, she couldn't go against the teacher.

"There is, there is, it's just that our Xueyan doesn't know how cute she really is. Brother wishes he could hold you to sleep every day. Lights out, okay?"

Lu Huai was delighted; holding the soft, sweet little bundle in his arms, he reached out a long arm and turned off the light.

The bedroom suddenly went dark.

Lu Huai's bedroom was quite spacious, with several sets of double doors leading to a massive gaming room, a bathroom, a walk-in closet, and other functional areas.

Xue Yan felt a bit nervous subconsciously, but the next second, she was pulled even tighter into her fourth brother's arms.

The kind of hold that wouldn't give any bad guys a chance to snatch her away.

In the darkness, Lu Huai stared at the little one in his arms who was getting sleepy, thought for a moment, and decided to ask, "But can you tell brother one thing, hmm?"

"Hmm?" Xue Yan mimicked her brother, making a questioning sound with her nose.

"Why were you so sad in the supermarket today? Were you scared?"

Three "coal balls," each slightly larger than the last, were lined up in front of the house, blinking their eyes at her.

Although, if she looked closely, they were a bit different.

For instance, the largest one clearly had a bit of a chubby belly, the medium-sized one had an inexplicably elegant and noble air about it, and the thinnest one had longer fur that was slightly grayish-white...

And just as Xue Yan stood there stunned, the elegant "coal ball" in the middle signaled the big-bellied "coal ball" to carry over a suitcase and hand it to Xue Yan.

Xue Yan: ???

"Chum... chum chum!"

It's a welcome gift for A-Yan.

The coal ball flew around, gesturing for Xue Yan to open it.

Xue Yan hesitated deeply, but under the urging of the little creatures, she reached out and opened it.

As soon as the box opened, it was actually filled with a whole case of light purple ore.

In fact, these were special magic stones that only originated from the mines in the territory of the Luna tribe.

Lu Huai stroked the little one's cheek, his conscience finally getting the better of him, and he decided to ask for the reason on Lu Jing's behalf.

Although, truth be told, Lu Huai himself really wanted to know as well.

Unexpectedly, when asked this question, Xue Yan remained silent for a long time.

It wasn't until Lu Huai reached out to ruffle the little one's soft hair that Xue Yan shyly covered up, "I wasn't sad..."

"Nonsense, you were clearly sad, yet you say you weren't? How can a little class monitor lie to her brother?"

Lu Huai didn't give the little one any chance to make excuses in this regard, instantly causing Xue Yan's face to flush slightly.

Because Teacher Jiang had indeed said that children shouldn't tell lies.

So, after sulking for a long time, the little one finally confessed in a small voice to her fourth brother: "I was afraid that sister would also... I was afraid that sister wouldn't want me anymore."

This answer left Lu Huai completely baffled; he thought that even if that girl Lu Jing kicked their eldest brother and himself away, it was impossible for her to not want Xue Yan, right!?

After all, the fact that Lu Jing suddenly changed her research direction three years ago, and even changed the target institute for her internship, was all for the little one's rare pheromone disorder.

"Eh?"

Even though Xue Yan had only touched him for a second, Meiqiu, with his large eyes wide in panic, flapped his wings and scrambled to the side.

Mr. Yorke, having snapped back to reality, lost his composure and took half a step back, completely forgetting his initial purpose of secretly evaluating this young human.

The phrase "baby" kept looping in his brain...

Mr. Yorke, who had held a high position for too long, had almost forgotten how long it had been since anyone dared to speak to him in such a tone!

Not only did Madam Aoni, not far away, freeze in expression, but the old butler with the goat beard was also left dumbfounded.

In the eyes of the unsuspecting Xue Yan, this scene looked exactly like he had petted the large Meiqiu, and the other versions of Meiqiu had collectively bristled in shock.

This made even the slow-to-react Xue Yan realize that something was slightly off, and he cast a hesitant gaze back and forth between Meiqiu and his "friends."

"Chiu, chium..."

Meiqiu, for once, stammered as he crouched on Xue Yan's wrist, not knowing how to quickly organize his words to explain things clearly to A-Yan.

"Did I scare your little friends? I'm sorry, I just thought they were very cute and fluffy."

Xue Yan looked thoughtfully at Mr. Yorke, that fluffy ball.

It was just that Lu Jing had never mentioned it to Xue Yan at all.

Even so, it shouldn't have led to the thought that Lu Jing wanted to abandon him...

"Why would you think you'd be abandoned?"

Facing his fourth brother's persistent questioning, Xue Yan pursed his lips, feeling uncharacteristically conflicted.

He felt this question was very difficult to answer because there were parts he couldn't tell his brother, but there also seemed to be parts he could...

After thinking for a long time, Xue Yan finally spoke:

"Because I'm sick, and it costs a lot, lot of money, and I have to take very, very expensive medicine."

"Who told you that? Who said our family spends a lot, lot of money, and that the medicine is very, very expensive?"

Upon hearing the cub's words, the coldness in Lu Huai's eyes deepened, but he tried his best to remain calm as he pressed for an answer.

His first reaction was that someone must have said this in front of the cub; otherwise, Xue Yan wouldn't have been able to express such adult-like thoughts.

The medicine Kemulin provided never needed to be purchased externally, and it couldn't be bought outside anyway, so how could the little one know it was expensive?

He even knew the family spent a lot of money.

However, since it was rare for the cub to be willing to bring friends home, Xue Yan didn't have any objections at all.

If possible, packing them up and bringing them home would be totally okay!

It was equivalent to "buy one, get three free"—what kind of beautiful game perk was this?

Mr. Yorke remained in a state that was hard to express; facing the young human who treated him like a cub, he couldn't say a word for a moment.

It felt rather embarrassing.

"But it's about time for Meiqiu's meal. As his friends, would you like to eat with him?"

Seeing this, Xue Yan directly changed the subject.

In any case, there was no problem that couldn't be solved by a meal; if there was, then two meals.

Eat?

Watching this scene, System 444 scratched its database and discovered that a key villain destiny side-quest had indeed been triggered early.

Because the mole who leaked information from the Lu family later on really did seem to have risen through the ranks starting from the Kemulin team due to excellent performance, eventually being transferred to the Lu Group headquarters.

Objectively speaking, Kemulin was one of the top experts and scholars in the field of pheromone research, but in terms of team management and vetting, he was far less skilled.

Even when it came to promotions, he often valued technical ability more, ignoring character and ideology.

Discovering the latent danger in the family so early didn't seem like a bad thing?

Although, if it were any other tasker trying to successfully trigger the Lu family's vigilance this early, the effect and difficulty would likely be very different.

At this very moment, in another bedroom of the Lu family's main residence, Lu Jing stood on the balcony, one hand resting on the railing, looking at the window of the fourth brother's bedroom after the lights had gone out.

The silver-rimmed glasses on the Alpha's nose were plated with a faint, cold glint by the moonlight, forming a sharp contrast with the bottomless eyes behind the lenses.

His coat hem fluttered in the night wind, making his tall figure appear even more imposing.

Behind him, on the desk in the room, paper and pens were scattered with countless incomprehensible sketches and handwriting.

It seems this human doesn't understand the cub's habits that well after all; perhaps it was just a disguise during the livestream!

The old butler with the goat beard had just finished complaining to himself when he turned his head and widened his eyes, watching his own usually taciturn cub follow the young human around like a little follower, drinking several mouthfuls of basin-milk.

He ate as much as Xue Yan fed him, without being picky at all. After each mouthful, he would "chium" and look expectantly at Xue Yan's hand.

What kind of undignified behavior is this, Master Nemo!?

The old butler with the goat beard exhausted all his restraint just to keep from rushing over to stop the cub.

Even while feeding the basin-milk, Xue Yan habitually reached out to retie Meiqiu's little bib, his movements so familiar that it was obvious he had done it countless times before.

"The bib is going to fall off, Meiqiu, be careful not to get it on your fur."

Meiqiu, wearing the bow-tie bib, wiggled twice very naturally, clearly unable to put down the pretty bib.

"Chium!"

A-Yan said to be a hygienic little cub.

His movements while drinking the basin-milk were also cute and serious.

In fact, for the first time, the Aoni couple watched their cub eating obediently from such a close distance, their expressions unknowingly becoming dazed and soft.

Only the old butler with the goat beard looked at this scene with a strange sense of sudden realization.

No wonder Master Nemo wasn't satisfied with the bow-tie the old man tied before; it turns out the bow-tie this human tied was indeed better looking?

Had he really been disliked... was the cub he raised like spilled water?

Eventually, everything pointed to a result that logic could not deduce.

Lu Jing was certain that his fourth brother never did things with logic, let alone reason, but somehow, the things his fourth brother could achieve, he had messed up.

If he had known, he shouldn't have left for even half a step.

Or rather, he should have told the little one before leaving.

But why didn't he do that?

Lu Jing actually knew the answer.

Because once the subject is informed, it might create subtle deviations in the experimental results. Collecting data in an uninformed state is, of course, the most perfect situation.

Yet, he was the only one who didn't think about how the little one, as a subject, would feel when he discovered his "sister" was gone.

This wasn't conducting an experiment; it was parenting.

A parent shouldn't do these things, should they?

The usually arrogant Lu Jing realized for the first time that when it came to parenting, the current fourth brother, Lu Huai, was clearly more experienced and better than he was after being away for years.

"Aren't you guys drinking?"

Xue Yan looked up at the three dazed, large, fluffy balls and asked with a smile.

He felt that Meiqiu's friends seemed a bit reserved.

The group of parents, including the Aoni couple, who were immersed in observing the cub drinking milk, were all collectively startled.

They looked at the basin-milk in front of them with difficulty, and after a long while, they all shook their heads in unison with cold detachment.

If only there were no livestream and no familiar monsters seeing this scene, otherwise the entire reputation of the Luna tribe would be ruined.

"Oh... it seems you are older than Meiqiu? So you don't drink cub milk anymore?"

Xue Yan observed for a long time and keenly noticed a clue.

These three "Meiqiu Plus" versions looked like cubs at first glance, but their reactions and movements were much more mature and calm than Meiqiu's.

Could there be some special situation here?

Madam Aoni also quickly realized that their behavior had been noticed by the human in front of them, and she was preparing a draft to explain their purpose for coming.

Unexpectedly, Xue Yan didn't ask anything further, simply and earnestly giving a piece of advice:

"It's okay, anyway, you are very welcome to come and play with Meiqiu whenever you have time."

"Just one thing, don't bully Meiqiu just because you are taller; after all, he is still a very small cub, especially cute, right?"

Being earnestly praised and secretly defended by this human, even someone as cold as Madam Aoni couldn't help but soften her expression.

As for the old butler with the goat beard, he was almost nodding frantically in agreement.

His Master Nemo was naturally extremely cute; at least this young human had a good eye!

But Meiqiu... Meiqiu?

The next morning, as soon as Xue Yan rubbed his eyes and woke up, he found that his brother was gone?

"Hi-yo, let's go have breakfast! Today, Aunt Cheng made some super cute yogurt banana mini-breads!"

The next second, Lu Huai burst in, holding a steaming little snack he had just stolen from the kitchen, and tore a piece off to feed to Xue Yan's mouth.

"Brother, you're up so early!"

Xue Yan, with his hair all messy from sleep, held the little snack and couldn't help but say with a smile.

"That's a must. Your brother has to run laps every morning. When our Xue Yan gets a bit bigger, you'll run with brother too, okay? Brother runs three big laps, and you run one small lap."

Lu Huai didn't let the little one know that he had actually gone to the study to meet with his eldest brother and the others early in the morning.

Therefore, more than half an hour ago, his father and the others had already left in the car with grim expressions.

Kemulin and the special laboratory had also received notice and were on standby without knowing the full situation.

However, Lu Huai didn't want Xue Yan to notice anything wrong, so he picked up Xue Yan, let the little one sit astride his shoulders, and excitedly rushed downstairs to wash his face, brush his teeth, and have breakfast.

Xue Yan: ?

This made Xue Yan, holding his little schoolbag, blink his eyes in confusion.

"Xue Yan, you went to the supermarket with your parents yesterday and got lost!?"
chapters.source_text:
“诶？”
虽然雪言才摸了这一下，就被瞪圆大眼睛的煤球惊慌失措扑棱着翅膀一下子拱到了旁边。
反应过来的约尔克先生更是风度大失地后退了半步，就连暗中考察这个年轻人类的初始目的都忘了个一干二净。
大脑里环绕播放着那句“宝宝”……
身居高位太久的约尔克先生，都快忘了已经多久没人敢用这种语气和自己说话了！
不仅是不远处的奥妮夫人表情一顿，山羊胡子老管家更是目瞪口呆。
而这一情景落在不知情的雪言眼中，俨然就是自己摸了一把大号煤球，其他几只型号的煤球就集体炸毛震惊了。
搞得雪言再迟钝也意识到了一丝丝不对劲，迟疑的目光在煤球和他的“朋友”们身上来回打转了好几下。
“啾、啾姆……”
煤球罕见结结巴巴地蹲在雪言手腕上，不知道该怎么迅速组织语言跟阿言解释清楚了。
“是我吓到你的小伙伴了吗？不好意思，我只是觉得毛茸茸得很可爱。”
雪言若有所思地看向了约尔克先生这只毛茸团子。
只不过陆菁那家伙完全没在雪言面前提过罢了。
即便如此，也不至于觉得陆菁是想丢到自己吧……
“为什么会觉得会不要你？”
面对四哥步步紧逼的追问，雪言难得抿唇纠结了起来。
觉得这个问题很不好回答，因为有不能告诉哥哥的部分，但似乎也有可以说的部分……
在想了很久之后，雪言终于开口了：
“因为我生病了，还要花很多很多钱，吃很贵很贵的药。”
“谁告诉你的？谁说我们家花了很多很多的钱，吃的药还很贵很贵的。”
陆淮在听到幼崽这句话后，却瞬间眸底情绪一冷，又尽可能显得不动声色地追问了起来。
第一次反应就是有人在幼崽面前这么说过，否则雪言不可能会说出这种有成年人思维的话。
克姆林开的那些药，从来都不需要对外购买，在外面也根本买不到，小家伙又怎么可能知道很贵？
甚至还知道家里花了很多钱。
不过幼崽难得愿意带小伙伴回家，雪言是一点意见都没有的。
如果可以的话，打包带回家都完全OK！
约等于养一赠三，这是什么绝美游戏福利？
约尔克先生依旧处于一种很难表达的状态之中，面对眼前把自己当幼崽看的年轻人类一时间根本说不出话。
感觉还怪不好意思的。
“不过往常这个时间点也到了煤球吃饭的时间了，你们作为朋友要和煤球一起吃饭吗？”
雪言见状直接换了个话题。
总之没有什么问题是一顿饭解决不了的，如果有，那就两顿。
吃饭？
看 着这一幕的系统444则挠了挠数据库，发现还真的又提前触发了一个相当关键的反派命运点支线。
因为陆家后期有资料泄露的内鬼，似乎还真的是从克姆林团队这个口子因为表现优异一路升上去，最终被调去陆氏的集团总部任职的。
客观来讲，克姆林是信息素研究领域最为顶尖的一批专家学者，但在团队管理审核方面，就远远没有那么擅长了。
就连提拔的很多时候，也更看重技术能力，而忽略了人品思想。
这么早被家里发现潜伏着的危险，似乎也不是坏事？
虽然如果换成其他任务者想要这么早顺利引发陆家的警惕性，效果和难度估计就大不一样了。
而此时此刻，陆家主宅的另外一间卧室里，站在露台上的陆菁正单手抵着栏杆，看着不远处老四卧室熄灯后的窗台。
Alpha鼻梁上的银丝眼镜被月色镀上了一层细碎的冷芒，与镜片后深不见底的眸色形成了鲜明对比。
衣摆也在夜风中微微张扬，越发显得身形高大。
身后室内书桌上，纸笔凌乱地画着无数看不懂的草图和笔迹。
看来这个人类也不是那么了解幼崽的习惯，也许直播时候是一种伪装！
只是山羊胡子老管家刚刚腹诽了一句，转头就瞪圆眼睛看着自家平日里寡言少语的幼崽，全程跟个小跟班一样地追着那名年轻人类后面喝了好几口盆盆奶。
雪言喂多少就吃多少，一点都不带挑的。吃完一口还会“啾姆”一声，期待地往雪言手上看过去。
这是什么不值钱的模样啊，尼莫少爷！？
山羊胡子老管家光是忍住这种上前制止幼崽的冲动，就耗尽了全部的克制力。
虽然就在喂盆盆奶的时候，雪言习惯性地伸手给煤球重新扎好了小围兜，动作熟稔到一看就知道曾经这么做过无数次。
“围兜要掉了，煤球，小心点别沾到毛毛。”
而顶着蝴蝶结围兜的煤球超级自然地扭了两下，对于漂亮的围兜显然爱不释手。
“啾姆！”
阿言说要做讲卫生的小幼崽。
喝盆盆奶的动作也可爱又认真。
事实上，奥妮夫妇第一次这样近距离看着自家幼崽乖乖吃饭，神色都不知不觉变得茫然而又柔软了起来。
只有山羊胡子老管家看着这一幕倒是诡异地恍然大悟。
怪不得之前尼莫少爷不满意老人家打的蝴蝶结，原来是因为这个人类打的蝴蝶结的确更好看一点？
自己果然是被嫌弃了吗……养大的崽泼出去的水？
最终却都指向了一个逻辑无法推导的结果。
陆菁确信老四这家伙做事从来不讲逻辑，更毫无道理可言，但偏偏老四能做到的事情，自己却弄糟了。
早知道就不该离开半步的。
或者说，离开之前也应该提前告诉小家伙的。
但为什么自己没有这么做？
陆菁其实知道答案。
因为一旦告诉了受试者，说不定对实验结果就会产生微妙的偏差。在不知情的状态下收集数据，当然是最完美的情况。
可是自己却唯独没想过，作为受试者的小家伙发现姐姐不在了，会是什么样的感受。
这不是在做实验，而是在做家长。
家长是不应该做出这些事情的，不是吗？
向来自负的陆菁第一次意识到，在做家长这方面，如今的老四陆淮显然比在外几年的自己更有经验更优秀了。
“你们不喝吗？”
而雪言这时抬眼看向这三只呆呆的大毛茸球，笑着询问了起来。
感觉煤球的小朋友们好像有点拘谨。
原本正沉浸式观察幼崽喝奶的奥妮夫妇一行家长顿时集体一惊。
艰难地看了看眼前的盆盆奶，半晌又不约而同地集体高冷摇了摇头。
但愿此刻没有直播，也没有熟人魔物看见这一幕，否则整个鲁纳族的声誉就要完蛋了。
“噢……看来你们年纪应该比煤球大一些？所以已经不喝幼崽牛奶了？”
雪言观察了半天，倒是敏锐地发现了一丝端倪。
这三只煤球PLUS版本乍一看也是幼崽，但反应、动作都比煤球成熟冷静不少。
难道这里面还有什么特殊情况？
而奥妮夫人也很快意识到他们的行为举止被眼前的人类发现了异常，正打算准备腹稿说明此次的来意。
不料雪言并没有追问任何，单纯认真地叮嘱了一句：
“没关系的，总之有时间过来陪煤球玩的话非常欢迎。”
“只是有一点，不要因为你们个子高就偷偷欺负煤球，毕竟他还是很小一只的小幼崽，特别可爱对不对？”
被雪言这个人类当面认真夸奖以及暗中警示维护自家幼崽，哪怕高冷如奥妮夫人神色也情不自禁缓和了几分。
至于山羊胡子老管家就差疯狂点头表示赞同了。
自家尼莫少爷必然可爱至极，算你这个人类小伙子有眼光啊！
但是煤球……煤球？
第二天一早，雪言刚刚揉眼睛醒过来，就发现哥哥不在了？
“嗨哟，去吃早餐啦，今天程姨做了特别可爱的酸奶香蕉小面包！”
结果下一秒，陆淮就破门而入，拿着一枚刚从厨房里偷出来热气腾腾的小点心，撕开喂到了雪言嘴边。
“哥哥起的好早！”
发丝睡得乱蓬蓬的雪言抱着小点心，忍不住笑着说道。
“那必须的，你哥我每天早起都得跑圈的，等以后我们雪言大点，也跟着哥哥一块跑？哥哥跑三大圈，你跑一小圈的那种。”
陆淮并没有让小家伙知道，自己实则一早就先去书房跟大哥他们碰了面。
因此早在半个多小时前，老爸他们就已经脸色阴沉地坐车出门了。
克姆林跟专项实验室那边也是接到了通知，在不知情的情况下全员待命。
不过陆淮也不想让雪言察觉到不对劲，于是抱着雪言就让小家伙跨坐在了自己肩膀上，兴奋冲下楼去吃洗脸刷牙早饭了。
雪言：？
这让雪言抱着小书包，有点茫然不解地眨了眨眼睛。
“雪言，你昨天跟家长去逛超市，走丢了！？”
chapters.title: 第114章

chapters.source_text:
直到差点迟到冲进教室路易一声呐喊，雪言才呆住了，脸色迅速变红。
这为什么也会被班上小朋友们知道了？
“哎呀，雪言难道你还不知道吗？”
下一秒，姜娴老师也展开了手里当地的报纸。
在报纸很后面的一角社会新闻版面教育园地里，刚刚好报道了临近假期，家长们要注意幼崽安全的一则本地新闻。
新闻配图上，赫然放的那家超市大屏幕家长寻崽启示的照片，周围一群超市客户围着在看和拍照的热心模样。
虽然是黑白两色的报纸，又是画中画的大屏幕，照片已经相当模糊了，但是熟悉雪言的人一眼就能看出来，这分明就是雪言嘛！！
里面蕴含着的魔气也有着一丝丝的月亮魔力，在魔物市场里是非常受欢迎的一种通用货币。
煤球期待满满地抬头看着阿言，觉得阿言可以把房子再装修得好看一点了。
但是让煤球没想到的是，阿言似乎完全没有表达对这盒魔石的喜爱，反而目光一直直勾勾落在了叼着箱子的爸爸身上。
事实上，约尔克先生此刻也有点紧张狐疑地近距离盯着雪言这名人类。
按照妻子的吩咐，自己原本是应该考察一下这名人类的品性是否端正纯良的，又或者有没有什么用意和目的。
但是对方为什么一直直勾勾地盯着自己的肚子！？
也就下一秒，雪言这名人类的确忍不住暴露了自己的“邪恶”目的，小心翼翼地伸手摸了摸这只巨大版毛茸煤球的肚子。
“好软啊……宝宝，你们是煤球的好朋友吗？”OwO
关键这只大宝宝怎么看起来比煤球的手感还要好？
能让人整个扑过去的那种巨型毛茸茸！
这谁能忍得住不动手摸？至于盆盆奶要多少有多少，这一刻的雪言觉得自己能全部养回家！
“啾姆？”
煤球看着眼前的阿言，突然感觉到了一丝危机。
至于约尔克先生更是僵直到脸热了。
这个年轻的人类，他、他他居然喊自己宝宝€€€€！？
“雪言你昨天去逛超市了？”“后来怎么找到的呀……”“超市是不是还放广播了！”
一群小幼崽都围拢了过来，试图采访一下雪言被超市广播播放寻崽启示的感言。
裴朔则一把从姜老师接过报纸，像个领导人一样脸色严肃地展开报纸两端，上下阅读了起来。
目光最终落在雪言走丢的新闻照片上，重点记住了这家超市的名字。
早知道昨天自己也去一趟这家超市了。
如果雪言被家长弄丢了，又刚好被自己捡回了家……
那岂不是就可以名正言顺地养雪言了？！
裴朔想象了一下那个画面，都忍不住嘴角翘起。
在一众小朋友们热热闹闹的惊奇声中，唯独裴朔拿笔在报纸超市名上画了个圈，若有所思的微笑又莫名遗憾摇头的模样，让一旁的姜娴老师颇为心惊胆战。
不是，这小子的小脑袋瓜里又在胡乱想什么呢！？
chapters.translated_text:
It wasn't until Louis shouted as he rushed into the classroom, nearly late, that Xueyan froze, her face rapidly turning red.

Why did the other kids in class know about this too?

"Oh my, Xueyan, you didn't know?"

The next second, Teacher Jiang Xian also unfolded the local newspaper she was holding.

In a corner of the social news section, under the education column near the back of the paper, there was a local news report reminding parents to pay attention to their cubs' safety as the holidays approached.

The news photo clearly showed the photo of the "lost cub" notice on the supermarket's big screen, with a crowd of enthusiastic supermarket customers surrounding it, watching and taking pictures.

Although it was a black-and-white newspaper and the photo was a picture-within-a-picture of the screen, making it quite blurry, anyone familiar with Xueyan could tell at a glance that it was obviously her!!

The demonic energy contained within also held a trace of lunar magic, making it a very popular form of universal currency in the monster market.

Meiqiu looked up at A-Yan, full of anticipation, thinking that A-Yan could renovate the house to look even nicer now.

But to Meiqiu's surprise, A-Yan didn't seem to express any love for the box of magic stones at all; instead, her gaze remained fixed directly on the "dad" who was carrying the box in his mouth.

In fact, Mr. Yorke was also feeling a bit nervous and suspicious at this moment, staring at this human named Xueyan from up close.

According to his wife's instructions, he was supposed to examine whether this human's character was upright and kind, or if she had any ulterior motives or intentions.

But why was the other party staring so intently at his belly!?

The very next second, the human named Xueyan indeed couldn't help but reveal her "evil" intentions, carefully reaching out to touch the belly of this giant version of a fluffy Meiqiu.

"So soft... Baby, are you a good friend of Meiqiu?" OwO

The key was, how did this big baby feel even better to the touch than Meiqiu?

It was the kind of giant fluffiness that made you want to pounce on it!

Who could resist reaching out to touch that? As for milk, she had as much as they wanted; at this moment, Xueyan felt she could take them all home to raise!

"Chium?"

Meiqiu looked at A-Yan before him and suddenly felt a sense of crisis.

As for Mr. Yorke, he was so stiff that his face felt hot.

This young human, she, she actually called him "baby"!?

"Xueyan, did you go to the supermarket yesterday?" "How did you get found later..." "Did the supermarket really play a broadcast!"

A group of little cubs gathered around, trying to interview Xueyan about her thoughts on being the subject of a lost-cub broadcast at the supermarket.

Pei Shuo took the newspaper from Teacher Jiang, and with a serious expression like a leader, he unfolded both ends of the paper and began reading it from top to bottom.

His gaze finally landed on the news photo of Xueyan getting lost, and he made a mental note of the supermarket's name.

If only he had gone to that supermarket yesterday too.

If Xueyan had been lost by her parents and just happened to be found by him...

Wouldn't he have been able to raise Xueyan in a perfectly legitimate way?!

Pei Shuo imagined that scene and couldn't help but curl the corners of his mouth.

Amidst the lively exclamations of the children, only Pei Shuo, who was circling the supermarket's name on the newspaper with a pen, smiling thoughtfully and then shaking his head with inexplicable regret, made Teacher Jiang Xian feel quite uneasy.

No, what on earth is this kid thinking about in that little head of his again!?
chapters.title: 第115章

chapters.translated_text:
Because even he himself could notice that sometimes the guardians' attitude toward this character was too arrogant; it could hardly be called respectful.

Lu Xueyan tugged at his fourth brother's hand, wanting him to say thank you to Dr. Kremlin, but Lu Huai didn't have that awareness at all and just thought the little one was hungry.

"Hungry? Shall we go get something to eat? Or if the medicine is too bitter, have another candy! Look!"

The Alpha even pulled out a handful of specially customized candies for cubs as if presenting a treasure.

But Lu Huai quickly realized he had guessed wrong this time.

Not only did the little one turn his head away and refuse to eat, but he also looked troubled and conflicted, eventually pushing his fourth brother's palm to hand the candy to Kremlin, who was standing to the side!

"Huh? Is this... for me?"

Kremlin, who had been preoccupied with anxiety over that damn, ridiculous gummy bear medicine, was stunned for a moment, staring blankly at Lu Huai, who had been pushed toward him.

"Mm!"

Only Lu Xueyan nodded very earnestly.

Kremlin looked around in surprise and nervousness, and only after being urged by the strange gazes of Lu Huai and the others did he accept this "thank you gift" from his little patient.

"That's true, you've really worked hard these past few days, haven't you slept much?"

Lu Huai scratched his head, finally understanding a little of what the little one meant, though his tone remained somewhat blunt.

Even Lu Xun, standing to the side, rarely looked at Kremlin with a less cold expression, giving a slight nod of acknowledgment.

So, on the way back, looking at the "thank you gift" from the little patient in his palm, Kremlin felt a bit conflicted.

Perhaps he shouldn't think so much and just keep working for the Lu family.

In all fairness, the compensation provided by the Lu family was already much more generous than at many of the world's top medical research institutes.

Most importantly, perhaps he had also slowly started to look forward to seeing what the little one, who appeared like a miracle, would grow up to be.

And besides, isn't it just gummy bear-flavored medicine?

As long as the money is good, he could even make cilantro-flavored medicine for this family!

With this thought in mind, Kremlin's steps toward the laboratory felt a bit lighter.

[Ding! Congratulations on activating a major character event: Kremlin's joining! The plot influence of this event is judged as: Important. Reward: 500 points.]

[Prerequisite for unlocking the kindergarten-stage plot achieved!]

When the series of notification sounds rang out, System 444 was undoubtedly the first one to want to scream.

[Wow, what does this mean? Does it mean we can really make it to kindergarten safely!?]

Although it sounded a bit strange, it was indeed quite encouraging.

As long as the health value doesn't continuously drop below the danger line of 3, there won't be any sudden premature death.

The key is that once he grows up to the age of attending kindergarten, he will definitely be able to light up more possibilities that influence the development of the plot.

Perhaps... he might even encounter the Pei family, where the protagonist is?

Using the cheat of knowing the plot in advance, could he trip up the protagonist before he grows up? Give him a taste of his own medicine??

[Villain System Thinking.jpg]

444 perhaps didn't even realize that, as a villain system, it was becoming increasingly conscientious.

As for the cub, who had been carried from the hospital back home by his brothers, he hadn't even had time to be happy before he was directly scooped up into a tight embrace by Lu Ting, who was waiting at the front gate.

But this time, the little one didn't struggle; instead, he stayed obediently in Lu Ting's arms, as if he knew his guardians had been worried for a long time.

Behind them, the second sister, Lu Jing, and the third brother, Lu Li, watched the scene, their eyes revealing a sense of relief.

Even though they had already received the news on their phones, the significance of seeing the little one safely brought home with their own eyes was different.

"Does the medicine taste bitter? Was it uncomfortable when you had a fever? Were you scared at the hospital?"

After holding him for a long, long time, Lu Ting finally let go and asked the little one with a lingering sense of fear.

Faced with so many questions, Lu Xueyan immediately tried his best to shake his head, causing the soft hair at his temples to sway, his moist eyes filled with a desire to say so much.

It was just that although he had so many things he wanted to say, he couldn't do it because he wasn't old enough, only managing to make some stumbling syllables.

So, at this moment, the cub wanted more than ever to grow up a little bit more; once he grew up a little, he could tell his guardians everything in his heart.

Like, don't worry, I will try my best to go to kindergarten.

Like, I still need to save up lots and lots of points to make the plot different...

Although Lu Xueyan didn't know it, while he was thinking about many things in his heart, Lu Ting had also made a decision at that very moment.

That was to spare no cost to ensure the little one grew up healthy.

He would personally take his cub to kindergarten and let the whole world see how wonderful his precious cub was!

Author's Note:

The guardians are all here, and Xueyan is about to grow into a kindergarten cutie! Everyone, please get ready. I can't wait to write about the meeting of the two little ones in kindergarten [Sunglasses].

Finally, please use your nutrient solutions; we are still 100 bottles away from breaking 2,000. Any treasures willing to help little sapling Xueyan grow and head to kindergarten? [Calico Cat Head]
chapters.source_text:
因为就连自己都能发现，有时候家长们对于这位角色的态度太傲慢了，实在称不上多尊重。
陆雪言拉了拉四哥的手，想让四哥跟克姆林医生说声谢谢的，然而陆淮根本没有这种意识，还以为小家伙饿了。
“饿了我们就去吃东西？或者药太苦的话就再吃一颗糖果！看！”
Alpha甚至不知道从哪儿献宝一般地掏出来了一把特意定制的幼崽糖果。
但陆淮很快发现自己这次猜错了意思。
小家伙不仅扭开脑袋没有吃，反而神色有点为难和纠结，最后居然推着四哥的手掌，将糖果递给了一旁的克姆林！
“啊？难道……是给我的吗？”
克姆林原本满脑子还在焦虑那该死且荒谬的小熊软糖药剂，此时整个人都愣了一下，跟被推过来的陆淮面面相觑起来。
“嗯！”
只有陆雪言很认真地点了点头。
克姆林惊讶又紧张地抬头看了一圈，最终才在陆淮等人诡异的目光催促下，收下了这份小患者的“谢礼”。
“也对，这几天确实也辛苦你了，都没怎么睡觉？”
陆淮挠了挠脑袋，终于明白了一点小家伙的意思，即便如此语气还是有点生硬。
就连一旁的陆巡，也罕见神色没那么冷地看着克姆林微微颔首示意。
于是回去的路上，看着掌心里这份小患者递来的“谢礼”，克姆林心情也有点复杂。
或许自己还是别想那么多，就一口气在陆家干下去得了。
平心而论，陆家给的待遇已经比在很多世界顶级院校的医学研究所都丰厚多了。
最重要的是，也许其实自己也慢慢开始期待，像奇迹一样出现的小家伙长大后究竟会成为什么模样。
而且不就是小熊软糖味道的药剂吗？
只要钱给够，香菜味道的药剂自己都可以给这一家子做出来！
脑海里这么想着，克姆林奔向实验室的脚步都轻快了几分。
【滴€€€€恭喜您激活重要人物事件：克姆林的加盟！本次事件剧情影响力判定为：重要，奖励积分：500点。】
【获得幼儿园阶段剧情开启必要前置条件！】
一连串的提示音响起时，系统444无疑是第一个想尖叫的。
【哇，这是什么意思？意思是我们真的可以顺利活到幼儿园了！？】
虽然这话听起来有点诡异，但的确相当令人振奋。
只要确保健康值不持续掉到危险线3点之下，那就不会出现突然夭折的情况。
关键长大到能上幼儿园的年纪，绝对就能点亮更多影响剧情线发展的可能性了。
甚至……还有可能遇到主角所在的裴家？
依靠预知剧情的金手指，去提前给还没长大的主角使点绊子？给他点颜色瞧瞧？？
[反派系统思维.jpg]
444或许都没有发现，自己作为一个反派系统真是越来越尽职尽责了。
至于被哥哥们抱着从医院坐车回到家的幼崽还没来得及高兴，就已经被等在大门口的陆霆直接伸手紧紧抱住了。
但这一次的小家伙并没有挣脱开，反而乖乖地被陆霆抱在怀里，就像知道家长担心了很久一样。
身后二姐陆菁、三哥陆黎同样看着这一幕，眼底流露出几分如释重负的情绪。
哪怕已经在手机上提前得知了消息，但亲眼看着小家伙被顺利带回家的意义还是不一样的。
“会觉得吃药苦吗？发烧的时候难受吗？在医院害怕不害怕？”
抱了很久很久才松开手后，陆霆语气带着后怕地询问小家伙。
面对这么多的问题，陆雪言立刻努力摇起了脑袋，摇得耳畔软绵绵的发丝都随之晃动，润润的眼眸里更是写满了想说很多话。
只是虽然有很多很多想说的话，却又因为年纪还不够大，只能磕磕绊绊发出一些音节而没办法做到。
所以这一刻的幼崽比任何时候都更想再长大一点，长大一点，就能把心里的想法都讲给家长听了。
比如不要担心，自己会努力去上幼儿园的。
比如自己还要攒好多好多积分，让剧情变得不一样……
尽管陆雪言不知道是，就在自己心里想着许多事情的时候，这一刻的陆霆同样做出了一个决定。
那就是不惜一切代价，也要让小家伙健康长大。
自己还要亲自牵着自家崽儿去上幼儿园，让全世界都看看自家乖崽儿到底有多好！
作者有话要说：
家长到齐，即将成长为幼儿园萌物雪言！请大家做好准备，迫不及待写幼儿园两小只的相遇了[墨镜]
最后求求营养液灌溉，还差100瓶破两千，有没有宝贝助力一下雪言小树苗窜个儿上幼儿园捏[三花猫头]
chapters.title: 第11章

chapters.source_text:
“裴朔，不要在报纸上乱涂乱画，你想干什么呢。”
察觉到危险的姜娴老师轻轻没收了裴朔手里的报纸。
怀疑这小子看报纸的姿势，不会是跟家里爷爷学的吧……每天早上坐在餐桌前看报纸的那种。
而裴朔被姜老师收走了报纸也不着急，因为自己已经全都记在脑子里了。
“我在想雪言你下次准备去哪个超市。”
裴朔转而一脸认真地看向了一旁已经脸红想埋头躲在小抽屉里的雪言。
不管雪言去哪个超市，自己就跟福叔他们提前带人过去蹲一个走丢的雪言！
或者直接把雪言爱逛的超市买下来好了，这样就不用播报寻崽启示，直接作弊抱回家？
但想象了一下自己学老四这么做的画面，陆菁脸色便微妙凝重，就像遇到了这辈子最难做的一场手术。
最为不可思议的是，随着幼崽的躁动情绪溢出体外的淡紫色魔气，竟然逐渐形成了一道保护罩，牢牢护住了身下的盒子！
此时此刻，不仅是雪言意识到了这一奇妙现象，看见这一幕的奥妮、约尔克等魔物家长们更是陷入了震惊之中。
能够在觉醒天赋后如此短的时间内成功操控身周的魔气，这放在鲁纳族史上都是一件值得记录的奇迹！
但荒谬的是……
这居然是对着自己跟约尔克使用出的能力。
是觉得他们家长会强行动手从这个年轻人类手中抢走送出去的辉月魔晶吗？
奥妮女士此刻的心情可以说是从未有过的挫败茫然。
以至于这位大魔物第一次真正意识到，这里面的亲子隔阂似乎早已不知不觉深到了一种很难轻易弥补的程度。
事情也根本不是自己和约尔克一开始所想象的那样，亲自见见这名年轻人类支付足够的报酬，接着就能取走魔晶并带回幼崽那么简单。
“啾姆……”
煤球后知后觉察觉到自己身周的淡紫色魔气后，最初同样有几分迟疑，但很快摸索起了如何控制这种新生的力量。
直接将盒子往阿言怀里又使劲推了推，根本不愿意让别人碰到分毫。
雪言按照幼崽的意思抱紧盒子后，目光却忍不住一直落在煤球身上。
也不知道是不是自己的错觉，淡紫色的漂亮魔气里隐隐约约有着丝丝缕缕的黑色雾气。
尤其当煤球身周那种戾气浮现时，黑色的雾气就会随之更加浓郁几分。
哪怕这样的煤球看起来神秘危险了许多，雪言却直觉产生了一种不安。
偏偏造成这种奇怪应激反应的又是尼莫的父母，雪言感觉自己着实很难开这个口让他们后退一些。
幸运的是，就在奥妮女士愣怔失神的这一刻，约尔克先生倒是第一时间拉住了妻子，并对着情绪不对劲的幼崽主动出声了：
“尼莫，冷静一点，既然你不愿意的话，那枚石头爸爸妈妈就不带走了，跟你道歉可以吗？不要再继续催动魔气了，再这样下去你会伤到自己的……！”
约尔克先生同样察觉到了幼崽此刻的异常状态，一边后退一边语气异常小心地维稳了起来。
在没有足够控制力的状态下魔气外化，不亚于让一只尚未成年的幼崽拿到了燃烧中的深渊火种。
稍不注意就能弄糟一切！
然而煤球听到父亲约尔克的话后只是迟疑了一瞬，就好像立刻重新被这种戾气所感染。
非但没有被安抚成功，反而微微龇出小乳牙，试图继续以一种攻击性的状态试图追上去。
“煤球，不要过去€€€€！”
也就在那股黑紫色的魔气即将爆发时，直觉非常不好的雪言顾不上其他，直接伸手精准至极地一把逮住了煤球的后脖颈。
平时抓这里的时候，小家伙从来不会反抗，但会异常乖巧地停下手上的全部动作。
果不其然成功强行打断了那股黑色魔气的凝聚势态。
“啾姆！？”
危险的是，被雪言抓住毛茸团子后脖颈的那一瞬间，那股黑紫色的魔气下意识就想调转方向，冲向身后雪言这个胆大至极的人类。
只不过在最后一刻，硬生生被幼崽控制住，尽数消散了！
无数的辉芒散落一地，梦幻中又带着几分森冷。
在魔气和亮光双重冲击下，雪言早已下意识闭上眼睛，等待着疼痛的降临。
然而过了几十秒，却没有发生什么事情，预料中的攻击也并未到来。
雪言试探性地缓缓睁开眼睛后，才发现被自己提着的煤球已经恢复了正常。
小家伙圆乎乎的漂亮大眼睛重新恢复了平日里的湿润乖巧，正扭着身子试图转过来看看阿言有没有被自己伤到。
“啾姆……”
像是道歉又像是有点茫然地自我厌弃。
“没关系的，没关系的，刚刚是不是因为被吓到了？我没受伤的，别怕。”
然而下一秒，雪言便毫无隔阂地将小家伙重新抱入怀里悉心安抚起来。
手指沿着煤球的绒毛一遍又一遍地梳理，紧绷着的煤球才一点一点地彻底松弛了下来。
“啾姆。”
好像在小声说对不起一样。
在确认盒子还完好无损地呆在阿言身边后，煤球才又看着雪言叫唤了好几声。
“没有被拿走，就在身边。这件事的确是我没考虑好，明明是煤球送给我的，我却差点给别人拿走了是不是？”
雪言看着幼崽这幅做了错事的模样心软得一塌糊涂。
“啾姆……”
闻言幼崽迅速摇了摇头又点了点头。
像是在说不是阿言的错不应该道歉。
可原本有点小委屈的惊慌心情顿时又的确被哄得暖呼呼，摇着小尾巴就团在了雪言怀里。
无论如何，确信怀里的幼崽已经暂时恢复正常，雪言才起身看向了一路退到了数十米之外的奥妮夫妇。
虽然此刻这群大毛茸茸们复杂失落的心情已经显而易见了。
就跟被雨淋湿了一样，蔫吧得很明显。
跟刚来那会的神气模样判若两茸。
雪言可以确信这对毛茸茸夫妻在煤球的教育上恐怕出了非常严重的问题，但也不知道该说些什么。
chapters.title: 第75章 谁不希望养只雪言呢
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 75: Who wouldn't want to raise a Xueyan?
chapters.translated_text:
"Pei Shuo, stop doodling on the newspaper. What are you trying to do?"

Teacher Jiang Xian, sensing danger, gently confiscated the newspaper from Pei Shuo's hands.

She suspected that the way this kid was reading the paper must have been learned from his grandfather at home... the kind who sits at the dining table every morning reading the news.

Pei Shuo wasn't worried about Teacher Jiang taking the paper away, because he had already memorized everything in his mind.

"I was just thinking about which supermarket you're planning to go to next, Xueyan."

Pei Shuo turned and looked with a serious expression at Xueyan, who was already blushing and wanting to bury her head in a small drawer.

No matter which supermarket Xueyan went to, he would have Uncle Fu and the others bring people there in advance to stake out a "lost" Xueyan!

Or maybe he should just buy the supermarket Xueyan likes to shop at; that way, he wouldn't need to broadcast a missing-child notice, he could just cheat and carry her home?

But imagining himself doing what the fourth brother did, Lu Jing’s expression became subtly grave, as if he were facing the most difficult surgery of his life.

Most incredibly, as the cub’s agitated emotions caused the pale purple demonic energy to overflow, it gradually formed a protective shield, firmly shielding the box beneath it!

At this very moment, not only did Xueyan realize this miraculous phenomenon, but the monster parents like Aoni and York, who witnessed the scene, were plunged into shock.

Being able to successfully control the demonic energy around one's body so shortly after awakening a talent is a miracle worth recording in the history of the Luna race!

But the absurd thing is...

This ability was actually used against them, himself and York.

Did the cub think they, as parents, would forcibly snatch the Brilliant Moon Magic Crystal they had gifted away from this young human?

Ms. Aoni's mood at this moment could be described as frustrated and bewildered like never before.

So much so that for the first time, this great monster truly realized that the estrangement between parent and child here had already, unknowingly, deepened to a degree that was not easily mended.

Things were not at all as she and York had initially imagined—that they could simply meet this young human in person, pay sufficient compensation, and then take back the magic crystal and bring the cub home.

"Chium..."

After Meiqiu belatedly realized the pale purple demonic energy surrounding it, it was initially hesitant, but soon began to grope for how to control this newfound power.

It pushed the box even harder into A-Yan's arms, unwilling to let anyone else touch it in the slightest.

After Xueyan hugged the box tightly according to the cub's wishes, her gaze couldn't help but linger on Meiqiu.

She didn't know if it was her imagination, but there seemed to be faint wisps of black mist within the beautiful pale purple demonic energy.

Especially when the hostility around Meiqiu emerged, the black mist would become a bit denser.

Even though Meiqiu looked much more mysterious and dangerous like this, Xueyan instinctively felt a sense of unease.

Yet, since the ones causing this strange stress reaction were Nemo's parents, Xueyan felt it was truly difficult for her to ask them to step back a bit.

Fortunately, at the very moment Ms. Aoni was stunned and lost in thought, Mr. York immediately pulled his wife back and took the initiative to speak to the emotionally unstable cub:

"Nemo, calm down. If you don't want to, Mom and Dad won't take that stone. Can we apologize to you? Don't keep channeling your demonic energy; if you keep going like this, you'll hurt yourself...!"

Mr. York also noticed the cub's abnormal state and, while retreating, spoke with extreme caution to stabilize the situation.

Externalizing demonic energy without sufficient control is no different from letting an underage cub hold a burning ember from the abyss.

One slight mistake could ruin everything!

However, after hearing his father York's words, Meiqiu only hesitated for a moment before seeming to be immediately re-infected by that hostility.

Not only was it not successfully soothed, but it slightly bared its little milk teeth, attempting to continue chasing after them in an aggressive state.

"Meiqiu, don't go over there€€€€!"

Just as that black-purple demonic energy was about to erupt, Xueyan, whose intuition was screaming, couldn't care about anything else and reached out, grabbing Meiqiu by the scruff of its neck with extreme precision.

Usually, when she grabbed it there, the little guy would never resist, but would stop all its actions in an exceptionally well-behaved manner.

Sure enough, she successfully interrupted the gathering momentum of that black demonic energy.

"Chium!?"

The dangerous part was that the moment Xueyan grabbed the scruff of the fuzzy ball's neck, that black-purple demonic energy instinctively wanted to change direction and rush toward the daring human, Xueyan, behind it.

But at the very last moment, it was forcibly controlled by the cub and dissipated completely!

Countless rays of brilliance scattered on the ground, dreamy yet tinged with a chilling coldness.

Under the dual impact of the demonic energy and the light, Xueyan had already instinctively closed her eyes, waiting for the pain to come.

However, after dozens of seconds passed, nothing happened, and the expected attack did not arrive.

After Xueyan tentatively and slowly opened her eyes, she realized that Meiqiu, whom she was holding, had returned to normal.

The little guy's round, beautiful big eyes had regained their usual moist, well-behaved look, and it was twisting its body, trying to turn around to see if A-Yan had been hurt by it.

"Chium..."

It sounded like an apology, or perhaps a bit of bewildered self-loathing.

"It's okay, it's okay. Was it because you were scared just now? I'm not hurt, don't be afraid."

The next second, Xueyan hugged the little guy back into her arms without any barrier, soothing it carefully.

As she combed through Meiqiu's fur with her fingers again and again, the tense Meiqiu finally relaxed completely, bit by bit.

"Chium."

It seemed to be whispering an apology.

After confirming that the box was still safely by A-Yan's side, Meiqiu called out to Xueyan several more times.

"It wasn't taken away, it's right here. It really was my fault for not thinking it through; it was a gift from Meiqiu to me, but I almost let someone else take it, didn't I?"

Xueyan felt her heart melt completely as she looked at the cub, who looked like it had done something wrong.

"Chium..."

Hearing this, the cub quickly shook its head and then nodded.

It was as if it were saying it wasn't A-Yan's fault and she shouldn't apologize.

But the panicky feeling of being slightly aggrieved was immediately soothed into a warm glow, and it curled up in Xueyan's arms, wagging its little tail.

Regardless, convinced that the cub in her arms had temporarily returned to normal, Xueyan stood up and looked at the Aoni couple, who had retreated dozens of meters away.

Although the complex and disappointed mood of these big, fuzzy creatures was already obvious.

They looked like they had been drenched in rain, visibly wilted.

They were a far cry from the spirited appearance they had when they first arrived.

Xueyan was certain that this fuzzy couple probably had very serious problems in how they raised Meiqiu, but she didn't know what to say.

chapters.title: 第116章
chapters.translated_text:
Perhaps this is indeed not something that can be changed in the short term.

I thought about it too idealistically, to the point where it actually made things more complicated.

"It’s alright, you don’t need to comfort us. Perhaps it would be better if we left first, so as to avoid the little one having another episode."

Ms. Aoni, who finally spoke, had a somewhat dry tone.

Her gaze remained fixed on Meiqiu, but unfortunately, the cub had no intention of turning its head to look back this time.

"Actually, I know you are just worried as a parent, but I think you might want to consider what the little one truly needs."

"Nimo is actually just a slightly sensitive little cub."

Because the person before her was an elder of Meiqiu, Xue Yan, who had wanted to say more, ultimately stopped there.

Upon hearing this, Ms. Aoni couldn't help but take another look at this young human holding Nimo.

Unfortunately, she didn't wait for Nimo to look back at her and York, and the two furry figures could only disappear in silence.

Perhaps the little one was still angry; she didn't know how long it would be before she had a chance to explain again.

However, after Ms. Aoni and Mr. York left, the grey, dusty old butler Meiqiu brought over a new box.

"This was originally what the Madam wanted to use to trade for the stone with you."

"I'm sorry, but without Meiqiu's consent, I don't intend to give the stone to anyone."

Xue Yan frowned slightly, interrupting the other party.

"No, no, no. Since Master Nimo chose to give that stone to you, perhaps it was fate's arrangement. But the Madam instructed that this thing should be left with you anyway, as a token of our appreciation for taking care of the cub and an apology for our intrusion today. I hope you can forgive us."

"Of course, it would be best if you could put in a good word for Master Nimo..."

After the goat-bearded old butler mumbled a soft explanation, he didn't wait for Xue Yan's response and quickly followed the Aoni couple as they disappeared.

He was clearly very embarrassed.

"Eh?"

Left behind, Xue Yan tried to stop them to no avail, feeling very strange for a moment.

How strange, what is this like?

It’s as if I’m holding Meiqiu, this little hostage, which caused the parents to not only dare not take the item back but instead proactively 'drop gold coins' to pay protection money, all for fear that I might say bad things in front of Nimo?

Am I overestimating my influence on the cub a bit too much?

"Jiumu."

Although it was only after the parents left that Meiqiu turned its body back around, as if urging A-Yan to hurry up and open the box to take a look.

This appearance, like two different creatures before and after, made Xue Yan suddenly realize that her Meiqiu might have a bit of a devious side.

Could it be that it was intentionally ignoring people just now, scaring Ms. Aoni and the others so much that they didn't dare stay for even a moment longer?

"Jiumu."

Being watched suspiciously by Xue Yan, Meiqiu blinked its eyes and chirped, not admitting to A-Yan's suspicions at all.

And after Xue Yan carefully opened the box, she discovered that it actually contained a rose.

"So it's a flower?"

She quite liked planting flowers around the wooden cabin.

However, Meiqiu immediately recognized what kind of treasure of the Luna tribe this was; while a bit surprised, it became serious and anxiously signaled for A-Yan to take the flower out quickly.

"Don't worry, I'm coming."

Xue Yan took the flower out as the cub intended and planted it in the flower bed. Soon, the surrounding plants began to emit ripples of pale purple radiance.

The most miraculous thing was that the previously closed rose suddenly bloomed, and a golden dewdrop condensed in the center of the stamen.

"Jiumu jiumu jiu! AAAA€€€€~"

Meiqiu immediately opened its mouth and performed the action of pouring something into its mouth for a long time, trying to make A-Yan understand.

"Does it mean I should drink this drop of dew?"

Watching the cub's performance, Xue Yan was a bit hesitant. Should she just drink it like that?

"Jiumu!"

Meiqiu nodded frantically, looking incredibly cute.

And after Xue Yan was urged by Meiqiu to drink the drop of golden flower dew, she blinked, feeling that apart from being a bit sweet, there didn't seem to be any special effect.

Meiqiu, however, seemed very happy.

"Are you that happy?"

Xue Yan couldn't help but reach out to pick up the little one and ask, though deep down she was still thinking about Meiqiu's abnormal state earlier.

Could Meiqiu feel that something was wrong with itself?

Never mind, I'll just keep it all in mind.

The Alpha, who had been pondering all night, finally concluded that as long as she collected enough behavioral patterns of the Fourth Brother to analyze and summarize, she would definitely be able to replicate them as well...

Definitely.

Lu Jing silently tightened her fingers, absolutely refusing to let herself do worse than the Fourth Brother in this regard.

However, another thing that Xue Yan didn't expect was that as soon as she arrived at the kindergarten today, she became a "little star," receiving the attention of everyone.

Even Teacher Jiang Xian couldn't help but squat over, looking incredibly astonished and strangely worried.

System 444 was extremely surprised. It didn't expect that a side quest of weeding would actually lead to a change in destiny points?

You have to know that if enough villain destiny points are dissolved, the plot in the original book could truly be changed.

Just like how the Fourth Brother is very different from the violent school bully in the original book.

Now, our Fourth Brother is definitely a high-quality young entrepreneur; the kind who could be interviewed by the CCTV youth entrepreneurship segment the second he puts on a suit!
chapters.source_text:
或许这确实不是短期就可以改变的。
自己想的太理想化了一点，以至于反而让事情变复杂了。
“没关系，你不用安慰我们什么。或许我们还是先行离开会比较好，免得小家伙又出现异常。”
最终开口说话的奥妮女士语气有点干涩。
目光一直盯着煤球，可惜这次幼崽并没有转头看过来的意思。
“其实我知道您也是作为家长不放心而已，但我觉得您或许可以考虑考虑，小家伙他真正需要的是什么。”
“尼莫其实是只有点敏感的小幼崽。”
因为眼前的是煤球的长辈，本想多说点什么的雪言最终还是点到为止了。
奥妮女士闻言忍不住又看了雪言这名抱着尼莫的年轻人类一眼。
可惜最终也没等到尼莫回头看看自己和约尔克，两颗毛茸茸只能沉默消失了。
也许小家伙还在生气，不知道多久之后才能有机会重新解释。
不过当奥妮女士和约尔克先生离去后，那只灰扑扑的大煤球老管家却叼来了一只新的箱子。
“这原本是夫人想用来和您交换石头的东西。”
“抱歉，但没有煤球的同意，我不打算把石头给任何人的。”
雪言微微蹙眉，打断了对方的话。
“不不不，那枚石头既然尼莫少爷选择了交给您，或许冥冥之中就是月亮的安排。但夫人吩咐这东西还是留给您好了，就当照顾幼崽一点心意以及我们今日打扰的歉意，希望您能原谅。”
“当然，最好的话，能给尼莫少爷美言几句就好了……”
山羊胡子老管家嗫嚅着小声解释后，不等雪言回应便飞速跟着奥妮夫妇消失了。
显然非常不好意思。
“诶？”
被留在原地的雪言试图阻拦无果，一时间心情很怪。
好奇怪，这像什么。
仿佛自己手上捏着煤球这个小人质，导致家长不仅不敢取走东西了，反而主动爆金币交保护费似的，生怕自己在尼莫面前说坏话？
是不是有点太高看自己对幼崽的影响力了。
“啾姆。”
虽然等家长们都离开后，煤球才重新扭回来了身体，仿佛在让阿言快点打开箱子看看。
这前后判若两茸的模样，让雪言突然发现自家煤球好像还有点小腹黑。
刚刚不会是故意那样不理人，让奥妮女士他们吓得都不敢多留在原地片刻吧？
“啾姆。”
被雪言狐疑注视的煤球，眨巴眨巴眼睛叫唤了一声，一点不承认阿言的怀疑。
而雪言小心翼翼地打开箱子后，才发现这里面装着的居然是一株玫瑰花。
“原来是花？”
自己还挺喜欢在木屋四周种花的。
不过煤球倒是立刻认出来了这是鲁纳族的什么宝贝，有点小惊讶的同时认真了起来，焦急地示意阿言快点把花取出来。
“别着急，来了。”
雪言按照幼崽的意思取出花后种在了花圃里，很快四周的植物纷纷漾出了一圈圈的淡紫色光辉。
最奇妙的是，原本闭合的玫瑰花突然绽放了，花蕊中央凝结出来了一颗金色的露水。
“啾姆啾姆啾！AAAA€€€€~”
煤球顿时张开嘴巴，表演了半天倒到嘴里的动作试图让阿言明白。
“意思是要喝掉这滴露水吗？”
看着幼崽表演的雪言有点疑虑，就这么喝到肚子里吗？
“啾姆！”
煤球疯狂点头，萌得一塌糊涂。
而雪言被煤球硬生生督促着喝掉那滴金色花露后，眨了眨眼睛，感觉除了有点甜似乎没有特别的效果。
煤球倒是很开心的样子。
“有这么开心吗？”
雪言忍不住伸手抱起来小家伙问了一句，内心其实还在想着煤球刚刚那种异常的状态。
煤球自己会有感觉到自己的不对劲吗？
不管了，先都记着。
思索了一整晚的Alpha最终认定，只要收集到足够多老四的行为范本进行分析归纳，自己就一定也可以复现出来……
一定。
陆菁默默收紧手指，绝不允许自己在这方面做的还不如老四。
不过另外一件让雪言没想到的事情是，自己今天一到幼儿园，就变成了“小明星”，接受了所有人的注目礼。
就连姜娴老师都忍不住惊奇万分又诡异担忧地蹲了过来。
系统444惊奇异常。没想到一个剔除杂草的支线任务居然引出来了命运点改变？
要知道足够多的反派命运点被消解的话，原书里的剧情可就真的能改变了。
就像四哥跟原书里那个暴戾校霸可就很不一样了。
如今我们的四哥绝对是优质青年企业家，穿上正装下一秒能被中央台青年创业栏目组采访的那种！

chapters.title: 第76章 乖崽会主动亲人了？
chapters.source_text:
傍晚时分，在实验室里的人员依次接受审查，一场从上到下的大清洗彻底告一段落后，克姆林才小心翼翼地看向了坐镇在主座后的陆霆董事长。
“人都处理掉了？”
陆霆一句询问，让克姆林吓得不行，什么人都被处理掉了？
“嗯。”
结果身后传来了陆巡的回应，克姆林才发现出去了一趟的陆巡不知道什么时候已经回来了。
身形高大的男人一身黑色正装逆光站在门外，耳畔的墨色发丝微微垂落，低头摘下了手套扔到了一旁，动作利落到让克姆林浮现无数诡异的思绪。
说实话，在陆家干了三年多了，自己都快忘记最初对这一家子的恐惧了，现在才恍然发现，原来这群猛兽并非变了，而只是习惯性在平日里收起了獠牙！
这次事件中失职的自己，也会被这么“处理”掉吗？
陆巡瞥了一眼面色恐惧的克姆林，没有解释。
无论如何，这确实是克姆林 管理团队不严发生的情况。
约尔克先生很有自知之明，自家妻子向来说一不二，自己顶多是个腿部挂件。
“是的，我们的确是尼莫的族人，我叫做奥妮€€鲁纳€€维尔尼亚，是尼莫的母亲。”
也就在两位男士暗中讨论之际，一道语气非常冷冽的女声却响起来了，哪怕能察觉到对方似乎尽可能显得语气柔和一点。
显然是为了让雪言听得懂，这一次奥妮说出了通用语。
而雪言猝不及防看着眼前的优雅“煤球”就这样口吐人言，顿时有点震惊。
不仅真的是尼莫的家长，而且还能说话！？
声音还挺好听的，是一种很优雅的语调，哪怕有一点冷。
虽然雪言很快想起来，煤球之前也喊过自己“A-RAN”，说明小家伙只要努力学还是会说话的。
不过这句尼莫母亲的意思是……是煤球原来有名字！？
“是的，当然尼莫也是小名，小家伙全名叫做德尔莫科€€鲁纳€€阿维卡让。”
似乎察觉到了雪言的震惊，奥妮又补充了一句。
这次语调依然有点冷，但莫名能听出来一点微妙的怨念。
这名字听起来就好有来头的感觉。
给小家伙取名“煤球”的雪言突然有点汗流浃背，自己给煤球取的名字一下子显得很拿不出手是怎么回事！
“不用紧张，我们这次出现并不是想带走尼莫。”
奥妮女士这句话一出，身后的约尔克先生和老管家不敢置信他们听见了什么。
事实上，奥妮女士一开始确实是这个打算，但这一刻看着眼前的年轻人类突然改变了主意。
“你多少岁了？小家伙。”
“我？我今年二十一岁……”
出于礼貌，雪言下意识半蹲了下来，回答起了这位“大煤球”的询问。
不知道为什么，明明外表就是一颗毛茸茸，但奥妮说话的语调和神态，总能让雪言幻视出那种身居高位很久的实权女性。
虽然奥妮听完雪言的回答，罕见地多了一丝笑意。
“那看来确实还是个小家伙。尼莫今年都刚好整一百岁了。”
雪言：？
不是吧，这种提到一百岁跟幼年期一样的口吻，是个什么情况！？
关键煤球看起来就是小幼崽的反应和神志啊，一点不像一百岁的大妖怪。
“没什么好震惊的，我们的种族使然，出生会沉眠很久，按照你们人类的标准，尼莫差不多才三岁半。”
也许是雪言身上的气质确实非常令人舒适，奥妮罕见耐心十足地跟雪言解释了起来。
当然，如果奥妮不是外表是一团毛茸茸的话，雪言觉得自己可能会更容易接受一点点。
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 76: The little one is taking the initiative to kiss people?
chapters.translated_text:
In the evening, as the personnel in the laboratory were screened one by one, and a top-down purge finally came to an end, Kremlin looked cautiously at Chairman Lu Ting, who was sitting in the main seat.

"Have they all been dealt with?"

Lu Ting's single question terrified Kremlin; who exactly had been dealt with?

"Yes."

As a response came from behind him, Kremlin realized that Lu Xun, who had gone out for a while, had returned without him noticing.

The tall man stood against the light in a black suit, his dark hair falling slightly over his ears. He lowered his head, took off his gloves, and tossed them aside with a fluid motion so sharp it sent a flurry of ominous thoughts through Kremlin's mind.

To be honest, having worked for the Lu family for over three years, he had almost forgotten his initial fear of this family. Only now did he suddenly realize that these beasts hadn't changed; they had simply been in the habit of hiding their fangs during ordinary times!

Would he, having failed his duties during this incident, also be "dealt with" like that?

Lu Xun glanced at the terrified Kremlin without offering an explanation.

Regardless, this was indeed a situation caused by Kremlin's lax management of the team.

Mr. Yorke was very self-aware; his wife always had the final say, and he was, at best, a tag-along.

"Yes, we are indeed Nemo's kin. My name is Ouni-Luna-Virnia, and I am Nemo's mother."

Just as the two men were whispering to each other, a very cold female voice rang out, even though one could tell she was trying to make her tone sound as gentle as possible.

Clearly, to ensure Xue Yan could understand, Ouni spoke in the common language this time.

Xue Yan, caught off guard by the elegant "soot ball" before him suddenly speaking human words, was momentarily shocked.

Not only was it really Nemo's parent, but it could also talk!?

The voice was actually quite pleasant—an elegant tone, even if a bit cold.

Although Xue Yan quickly remembered that "Soot Ball" had called him "A-Ran" before, which meant the little guy could speak if he tried hard enough.

But what did this "Nemo's mother" mean... did Soot Ball actually have a name all along!?

"Yes, though Nemo is just a nickname. The little one's full name is Delmoko-Luna-Avikaran."

Seeming to notice Xue Yan's shock, Ouni added another sentence.

Her tone was still a bit cold this time, but one could inexplicably detect a subtle hint of resentment.

That name sounded like it had quite the pedigree.

Xue Yan, who had named the little one "Soot Ball," suddenly felt a cold sweat; why did the name he gave him suddenly feel so embarrassing!

"Don't be nervous. We didn't appear here to take Nemo away."

As soon as Ms. Ouni said this, Mr. Yorke and the old butler behind her couldn't believe what they were hearing.

In fact, Ms. Ouni had indeed intended to do just that at first, but looking at the young human before her, she suddenly changed her mind.

"How old are you, little one?"

"Me? I'm twenty-one this year..."

Out of politeness, Xue Yan subconsciously half-squatted down to answer the inquiry from this "big soot ball."

He didn't know why, but even though she looked like a fluffy ball on the outside, Ouni's tone and demeanor always made Xue Yan hallucinate the image of a high-ranking woman who had held real power for a long time.

Although, after hearing Xue Yan's answer, a rare hint of a smile appeared on Ouni's face.

"Then it seems you really are still a little one. Nemo just turned exactly one hundred years old this year."

Xue Yan: ?

You've got to be kidding me. What kind of situation is it where someone mentions a hundred years old as if it were still infancy!?

The key was that Soot Ball looked and acted exactly like a young cub; he didn't look like a hundred-year-old great monster at all.

"There's nothing to be shocked about. It's the nature of our race; we sleep for a long time after birth. By your human standards, Nemo is only about three and a half years old."

Perhaps because Xue Yan's temperament was truly very comforting, Ouni explained to him with rare patience.

Of course, if Ouni didn't look like a ball of fluff on the outside, Xue Yan felt he might have found it a little easier to accept.

chapters.title: 第117章
chapters.source_text:
三岁半的话的确更符合煤球给人的感觉。
抱着怀里的小家伙，雪言又忽然觉得有点怪，自己当着人家爸妈的面抱着人家幼崽，是不是确实有点怪？
“煤球很喜欢你。平时我都很难抱到他。”
对此奥妮女士有点微妙地补充了一句。
“呃……不过我确实有一点疑惑，您既然是尼莫的母亲，您知道尼莫最开始的状态吗？”
“我最初见到煤球的时候，他的情况很糟糕，身上都是小跳蚤和苍蝇卵，甚至翅膀都有点血肉模糊的。”
但既然提到这个话题，雪言还是忍不住认真询问了起来。
“啊，怎么会这样？尼莫少爷在家从来没有提到这种事！”
甚至还很喜欢登录《魔界》。
不料听到雪言话后，老管家第一个疑惑震惊起来。
如果在里面受伤那么严重，怎么会那么喜欢一个人呆在房间里不停登录尝试呢。
奥妮夫妇同样对视了一眼，不可置信地看向了尼莫。
“啾姆。”
唯独被雪言抱在臂弯里的煤球没有给出父母任何反应。
一片沉默之中气氛显得越发尴尬安静。
“这点可能确实是我们疏于了解的问题，也许是我们小时候从来没有遇到尼莫的这些问题，再加上平时的确非常忙碌……”
最终打破沉默的奥妮语气有点涩。
承认自己的错误和失职无疑不是那么简单的，更何况还是在一个这么年幼的人类晚辈面前。
担任深渊监察会委员长的自己和身为委员之一的约尔克，大部分时间需要前往世界各地察看魔气异动的情况，偶尔还需要配合人类监察局处理一些失控魔物暴起伤人的善后事宜。
曾经为了将一场大型意外事故处理善后成为自然灾害的模样，自己和约尔克整整五年都没回家。
造成的后果自然是和尼莫变得有点生疏起来。
“我们以后会考虑尝试一些其他方式和幼崽沟通的，不过这次前来，还有一件事是极为关键的，那就是尼莫给你的那枚辉月魔晶。”
“虽然很抱歉，但那枚辉月魔晶对于我们全族而言都至关重要，这几百年……”
奥妮女士说着说着，话题还是来到了那枚辉月魔晶上。
既然带不走自家儿子，至少退而求其次得将魔晶带回族里。
而一旁雪言抱着煤球听着奥妮认真严肃的讲解，总觉得这位母亲恐怕完全没有意识到，自己的状态好像又进入一种雷厉风行的工作状态了。
雪言又看了一眼身后的约尔克先生，性格偏弱的对方显然对妻子这种状态没有任何影响力。
煤球就这么又被忽略了。
夫妻两个就这么养崽，到底怎么可能亲近得起来？
煤球遇到危险从来不知道向家长求助的这种性格，恐怕都多少都跟这种情况有联系。
想到这里，雪言有点替煤球感到闷闷的，抱紧煤球看向了奥妮女士。
“其实您的意思我大概知道，是希望我能把那枚辉月魔晶还给您吧。”
奥妮女士也没想到自己话才说了一半，眼前的年轻人类居然打断对话，直接点破了自己的目的。
毕竟这种百年未现的族中至宝被幼崽意外凝结出后，送给了一名外族人，无论如何是整个鲁纳族无法承受的结果。
“您不用担心，其实那枚石头我保管着一直没动。”
不料气氛紧张之下，雪言却拿出来了一只小盒子，打开盖子后里面赫然就是那枚如梦似幻的淡紫色辉月魔晶。
“如果您现在是想以家长的身份，在煤球成年之前代为保管的话，我的确可以转交给您，但我有一个要求。”
可就在众人目光集体落在石头上时，雪言却重新盖上了盒子。
这样的举动反而让微妙尴尬不安的奥妮女士松了口气。
“年轻人，只要你的要求不过分，我确实有这个权限当场满足你的全部要求。当然，我们一开始也是准备了充足诚意的。”
哪怕是看在尼莫的份上。
“不，我并不是想索要什么东西，而是我希望你们能认真和煤球道个歉，并且能保证以后每个月无论多忙，都必须抽出来一天回家带着煤球出门转转。”
“这个可以做到吗？一个月一次的话，应该不会非常困难吧。”
雪言认真地思考了一下自己提出的要求可行性。
虽然雪言至今想不懂几颗黑色毛茸团子到底成天能在忙碌什么国家大事，以至于连唯一的幼崽都顾不上关心。
只是雪言说完自己的条件后，却发现现场气氛变得异常安静。
事实上，本来做好被狮子大开口索要报酬的奥妮女士，这一刻确实异常不知所措。
毕竟这点微不足道的条件可以说不在任何预料范围之中！
可即便如此，自己和约尔克还当真从未做到过……
“啾姆！”
偏偏就在这时，始终很安静的煤球突然飞了出来，一下子蹲在盖子上不许被任何人拿走。
甚至转身罕见异常生气警惕地看向了父母奥妮和约尔克。
淡紫色的危险魔气也随之一丝丝环绕在了身周。
让自己带路见阿言，原来是要谈条件拿走送给阿言的漂亮石头。
煤球的性格一向很安静，甚至可以说得上很乖。
这还是雪言第一次明确感觉到了小家伙的躁动甚至带着几分戾气的情绪。
就像是一颗炸毛的小海胆，竖起了浑身的尖刺看向了眼前的大魔物们。
“陆菁已经同意了。”
转而将手机递给了陆霆，上面赫然是与陆菁的对话，陆巡将今日发生的事情大概发送了过去，以及那段茶水间的聊天视频。
早知道每次日常体检的时候，自己就应该安排人陪在小家伙身边，这样不就能避免还在上幼儿园的小家伙无意中听到大人之间那些别有用心的谈话了？
而陆淮眼看小家伙被带去做实验了，这才看向了大哥和老爸，俨然是在问事情处理的怎么样？
“陆菁马上也会过来，到时候一块谈吧。”
陆霆揉了揉额角。
十几分钟后，就在雪言试着将彩虹色的泡泡从杯子里吹出来，却因为个子不够高频频失败的时候，下一秒就被人从身后抱起来了。
这一次，小家伙顺利地将泡泡一路吹了出来，整个实验室里都飞舞起了绚丽的泡泡，甚至其中一朵还落在了雪言的鼻尖上。
轻轻嗅了嗅鼻子，泡泡就爆炸了，让雪言下意识闭上了漂亮的大眼睛，朝着身后躲过去。
陆菁便稳稳接住了小家伙。
chapters.translated_text:
Three and a half years old does indeed feel more like the impression Meiqiu gives.

Holding the little one in her arms, Xue Yan suddenly felt a bit strange. Was it really appropriate for her to be holding someone else's cub right in front of their parents?

"Meiqiu likes you very much. Usually, I find it very difficult to hold him."

Ms. Aoni added this with a subtle tone.

"Uh... but I do have a question. Since you are Nemo's mother, do you know what Nemo's initial state was like?"

"When I first met Meiqiu, his condition was terrible. He was covered in tiny fleas and fly eggs, and his wings were even a bloody mess."

But since the topic had come up, Xue Yan couldn't help but ask seriously.

"Ah, how could that be? Young Master Nemo never mentioned such things at home!"

He even really liked logging into "Demon World."

Unexpectedly, upon hearing Xue Yan's words, the old butler was the first to look puzzled and shocked.

If he had been injured so severely inside, how could he have liked being alone in his room, logging in and trying again and again?

The Aoni couple also exchanged glances and looked at Nemo in disbelief.

"Jiumu."

Only Meiqiu, nestled in Xue Yan's arms, gave no reaction to his parents.

In the silence, the atmosphere became increasingly awkward and quiet.

"That might indeed be a problem due to our lack of awareness. Perhaps we never encountered these issues with Nemo when he was young, and besides, we are truly very busy..."

Aoni, who finally broke the silence, spoke in a slightly strained tone.

Admitting one's mistakes and neglect was undoubtedly not simple, especially in front of such a young human junior.

As the Chairperson of the Abyss Supervisory Committee, and with York as one of the commissioners, they spent most of their time traveling the world to monitor fluctuations in demonic energy, and occasionally had to assist the Human Supervisory Bureau in dealing with the aftermath of rampaging monsters.

Once, in order to make a large-scale accident look like a natural disaster, she and York hadn't returned home for five whole years.

The consequence, naturally, was that they had become somewhat estranged from Nemo.

"We will consider trying other ways to communicate with our cub in the future. However, there is another crucial matter regarding this visit: the Brilliant Moon Magic Crystal that Nemo gave you."

"Although I am sorry, that Brilliant Moon Magic Crystal is vital to our entire clan. For these past few hundred years..."

As Ms. Aoni spoke, the topic inevitably returned to the Brilliant Moon Magic Crystal.

Since they couldn't take their son home, they had to settle for the next best thing and bring the magic crystal back to the clan.

Meanwhile, as Xue Yan held Meiqiu and listened to Aoni's serious explanation, she couldn't help but feel that this mother probably didn't realize she had slipped back into her efficient, business-like state.

Xue Yan glanced at Mr. York behind her; the more soft-spoken man clearly had no influence over his wife in this state.

Meiqiu was ignored once again.

With the couple raising their cub like this, how could they ever expect to be close?

The fact that Meiqiu never knew to ask his parents for help when in danger was likely related to this situation.

Thinking of this, Xue Yan felt a bit stifled for Meiqiu, held him tighter, and looked at Ms. Aoni.

"Actually, I think I understand what you mean. You want me to return that Brilliant Moon Magic Crystal to you, right?"

Ms. Aoni hadn't expected the young human before her to interrupt and point out her purpose before she had even finished speaking.

After all, for such a clan treasure, unseen for centuries, to be accidentally condensed by a cub and then given to an outsider was an outcome the Runa clan could not accept under any circumstances.

"You don't need to worry. Actually, I have been keeping that stone safe and haven't touched it."

Unexpectedly, amidst the tense atmosphere, Xue Yan took out a small box. When she opened the lid, there lay the dreamlike, pale purple Brilliant Moon Magic Crystal.

"If you want to keep it on behalf of Meiqiu until he comes of age as his parents, I can indeed hand it over to you, but I have one request."

Just as everyone's eyes fell upon the stone, Xue Yan closed the box again.

This action actually made the subtly awkward and uneasy Ms. Aoni breathe a sigh of relief.

"Young person, as long as your request is not excessive, I do have the authority to grant all your demands on the spot. Of course, we were prepared with sufficient sincerity from the start."

Even if only for Nemo's sake.

"No, I don't want to ask for anything material. I want you to sincerely apologize to Meiqiu and promise that from now on, no matter how busy you are, you must set aside one day a month to come home and take Meiqiu out."

"Can this be done? Once a month shouldn't be too difficult, right?"

Xue Yan seriously considered the feasibility of her request.

Although Xue Yan still couldn't understand what kind of national affairs a few black, fluffy balls could be busy with all day, to the point where they couldn't even care for their only cub.

But after Xue Yan stated her condition, she found the atmosphere in the room had become exceptionally quiet.

In fact, Ms. Aoni, who had been prepared for a demand for a massive reward, was truly at a loss for words at this moment.

After all, this trivial condition was not within any of her expectations!

Yet, even so, she and York had truly never managed to do it...

"Jiumu!"

Just at that moment, the usually quiet Meiqiu suddenly flew out, landing on the lid and refusing to let anyone take it.

He even turned around and looked at his parents, Aoni and York, with rare, intense anger and vigilance.

Pale purple, dangerous demonic energy began to swirl around him.

So, letting them lead the way to see A-Yan was just so they could negotiate to take away the beautiful stone he had given her.

Meiqiu's personality had always been quiet, even obedient.

This was the first time Xue Yan clearly felt the little one's agitation, which even carried a hint of hostility.

He was like a bristling little sea urchin, raising all his spikes to face the great demons before him.

"Lu Jing has already agreed."

He turned and handed the phone to Lu Ting. On the screen was the conversation with Lu Jing; Lu Xun had sent a summary of what happened today, along with that video of the chat in the breakroom.

If only he had known, he should have arranged for someone to accompany the little one during every routine check-up. That way, he could have prevented the little one, who was still in kindergarten, from accidentally hearing those malicious conversations between adults.

Seeing the little one being taken away for an experiment, Lu Huai looked at his eldest brother and father, clearly asking how things were being handled.

"Lu Jing will be here soon, we'll talk about it all together then."

Lu Ting rubbed his temples.

Ten minutes later, just as Xue Yan was trying to blow rainbow-colored bubbles from a cup but failing repeatedly because she wasn't tall enough, she was lifted up from behind in the next second.

This time, the little one successfully blew the bubbles all the way out. Gorgeous bubbles danced throughout the entire laboratory, and one even landed on the tip of Xue Yan's nose.

She sniffed lightly, and the bubble popped, causing Xue Yan to subconsciously close her beautiful big eyes and dodge backward.

Lu Jing caught the little one steadily.

chapters.source_text:
陆霆嘴上这么说，实则心软得一塌糊涂。
“嘿嘿。”
对此一旁的陆淮挠头龇牙笑了一声，什么也没说。
谁教的几乎不言而喻。
自从那天晚上抱着小家伙，教了小老虎是怎么“嗷呜”的之后，雪言似乎就逐渐熟练掌握了这一哄家长技能。
堪称百试百灵。
还好小家伙不是什么性格顽劣什么都想要的幼崽，否则光凭这一招，显然都能让家长们连月亮都恨不得买回家，当气球栓在床头给小家伙玩。
而陆巡见状微微挑眉，沉默地看向了雪言。
似乎在说大哥难道不配拥有吗？
不过被主动要亲亲的小家伙反而有点不好意思，埋头躲在爸爸怀里不动了。
陆巡抿唇，看了一眼不远处呲着个大牙傻乐的老四，又看了看有点害羞的小家伙正要说话，就被一旁的老爸打断了。
而另一边的鲁纳族的庄园里，退出《魔界》后重新变回人形的奥妮和丈夫约尔克正沉默地看着眼前空荡荡的幼崽卧室。
随后赶到的老管家就更不敢说话了。
奥妮伸手摸了摸小家伙平常最喜欢呆着的软垫子，不得不承认这好像确实没有那个年轻的人类特意准备的小毯子柔软且更适合幼崽。
“奥妮，也许我们的确可以从这个月开始，考虑考虑那名人类小家伙的建议……”
同样心情微妙的约尔克先生拍了拍妻子的肩膀，想安慰一下对方。
虽然幼崽没有跟着回来，但约尔克先生对于雪言这名年轻人类的好感度还是相当不错的。
当然了，绝对不会是因为那句宝宝！正在沉浸式RUA毛的雪言：！？
震惊，原来亲手上阵摸，好感度加的这么爽快的吗？
要知道之前又是喂盆盆奶，又是洗澡，又是RUA毛毛的，才辛辛苦苦涨到了30，现在一口气给了20点，直接翻到50点，马上都快及格线了。
雪言不可置信地用双手抱起了小家伙举在眼前。
煤球的小尾巴便也垂了下来，眼巴巴地歪头看着眼前的雪言。
本该是暴露全部弱点下意识会挣扎的姿势，但是因为抱住自己的是雪言，煤球第一次尝试克服起了紧张情绪。
“啾姆、啾姆！”
小家伙形式主义地随便挣扎了两下。
结果就被雪言笑着点了一下脑袋。
“真的好可爱啊，宝宝。”
chapters.translated_text:
Lu Ting said so, but in reality, his heart had softened into a complete mess.

"Hehe."

Seeing this, Lu Huai, who was standing to the side, scratched his head and grinned, saying nothing.

It was almost self-evident who had taught it.

Ever since that night when he held the little one and taught the little tiger how to "roar," Xue Yan seemed to have gradually mastered this skill for coaxing his guardians.

It could be called foolproof.

Fortunately, the little one wasn't a cub with a mischievous personality who wanted everything; otherwise, based on this trick alone, the guardians would clearly be willing to buy the moon and tie it to the head of the bed like a balloon for the little one to play with.

Lu Xun raised an eyebrow at the sight and looked at Xue Yan in silence.

It was as if he were asking, "Doesn't big brother deserve to have this too?"

However, the little one, who had taken the initiative to ask for a kiss, felt a bit embarrassed and buried his head in his father's arms, refusing to move.

Lu Xun pursed his lips, glanced at the fourth brother who was grinning foolishly not far away, and then looked at the shy little one, about to speak, when he was interrupted by his father.

Meanwhile, at the Luna clan's manor, Aoni and her husband, York, having returned to their human forms after logging out of "Demon World," were silently looking at the empty cub bedroom before them.

The old butler who arrived shortly after dared not speak a word.

Aoni reached out to touch the soft cushion where the little one usually liked to stay, having to admit that it really didn't seem as soft or as suitable for a cub as the small blanket specially prepared by that young human.

"Aoni, perhaps we can indeed start considering the suggestion from that young human starting this month..."

Mr. York, feeling equally subtle, patted his wife's shoulder, trying to comfort her.

Although the cub hadn't come back with them, Mr. York's favorability toward the young human, Xue Yan, was still quite high.

Of course, it was absolutely not because of that "Baby!" Xue Yan, who was currently immersed in petting the fur: !?

Shocking, so it turns out that petting with one's own hands increases favorability this quickly?

You have to know that after feeding him milk, bathing him, and petting his fur, he had worked hard to reach 30 points, and now, with one go, he had gained 20 points, jumping directly to 50, almost at the passing mark.

In disbelief, Xue Yan picked up the little one with both hands and held him in front of his eyes.

Meiqiu's little tail drooped down, and he tilted his head, looking at Xue Yan before him with wide, expectant eyes.

It should have been a posture that exposed all his weaknesses, one that would instinctively trigger a struggle, but because it was Xue Yan holding him, Meiqiu tried to overcome his nervousness for the first time.

"Chium, chium!"

The little one struggled half-heartedly in a purely formal manner.

As a result, Xue Yan just laughed and tapped him on the head.

"You're really so cute, baby."
chapters.title: 第77章 神秘的客人到访
第118章
chapters.translated_text:
Meiqiu: !

It can only be said that in a certain sense, Xue Yan did not realize that these sweet nothings, which he blurted out and were exclusive to humans, had a cheat-level influence on the monster cub.

Holding the dazed Meiqiu in his arms, Xue Yan finally had time to stand up and look at the small wooden house not far away, pushing the door open and walking in from a first-person perspective for the first time.

"But what exactly is going on with this game?"

The interior of the LV1 wooden house was very simple; besides a wooden bed and a table, there was no extra furniture.

Meiqiu looked up at Xue Yan, then at the small wooden house, and suddenly felt that this little house was too shabby.

Want to give Xue Zai a nice, big house.

A tiny wish inexplicably popped up just like that.

Xue Yan, however, did not realize that his cub had such extravagant thoughts.

In fact, seeing the game-style wooden house with his own eyes for the first time, Xue Yan was not disgusted; on the contrary, he thought this wooden house was extremely unique.

It was like traveling to a foreign land and staying in a local specialty homestay.

And perhaps because of the immersive experience, the game operation panel also showed subtle changes.

"And to be honest, the young master seems to value that human very much."

The old butler with the goat beard added cautiously, although this was indeed very difficult for monsters to accept.

Even this time, the genuine anger seemed to have started when the Madam and the others tried to demand that the other party hand over the magic crystal in their possession in their capacity as parents.

If they wanted to make Young Master Nemo less angry, perhaps the key to the solution still lay with that human!

"At least that Moon God Rose should be very suitable for that little guy; Nemo should know it when he sees it."

Lady Aoni put down the small cushion and sighed with a headache, holding her forehead, which was a rare sight.

At first, no one expected the situation to develop into this state. The entire Demon Realm: ?

Didn't you all agree not to participate, damn it!?

Who is secretly signing up for this!

Xue Yan didn't know that his 10 bibs had been taken by "Demon Realm" to start an auction; at this moment, he was simply trying to arm himself fully to take Meiqiu to experience hunting.

Otherwise, what would happen if they couldn't catch any prey and really starved to death?

According to the hints on the map, moving towards the plains on the east side today would lead to suitable prey.

"Very well, then we will go here today, Meiqiu!"

Xue Yan tapped on the map.

Come to think of it, would anyone be willing to watch if he livestreamed the hunt?

"Jium!"

Meiqiu also poked at that spot like a soldier, letting out a cry with unusual firmness.

It had quite the feeling of "wherever A-Yan goes, I go."

Although Xue Yan had just put on his marching boots and pushed the door open, he unexpectedly saw a familiar huge figure!

The long-lost big lion was squatting not far away with a suspicious look, looking at the big one and the small one who were ready to go, its golden tail flicking carelessly in the air from time to time.

"Jium?"

Meiqiu widened its eyes all of a sudden, impatiently and full of fighting spirit, condensed its pale purple magic power, and charged over again, as if it felt it could win this time!

Pei Shuo: ?

As a result, the next second, it was intercepted by the big lion, which used its tail to swat away the magic energy and circle it.

"Jium, jium, jium!"

Trapped in the tail, Meiqiu immediately twisted and struggled, looking aggrieved, as if it were complaining to A-Yan.

"Stop fighting, both of you!"

Xue Yan caught off guard, discovered that these two furry creatures were making a scene again as soon as they met, and subconsciously reached out to grab the tip of the big lion's tail.

He was indeed a bit worried that the other party wouldn't know their own strength and might crush Meiqiu.

The items he had wanted to use to exchange for the Bright Moon Magic Crystal at the time had also been carefully selected.

The dew condensed by the Moon God Rose could, to a certain extent, have the effect of prolonging life, which was naturally quite precious and tempting for humans with short lives.

Perhaps it could also let Nemo stay by that little human's side for a while longer?

Out of consideration for life span, it is best for monsters and humans not to have too deep of contact.

But since a human appeared in "Demon Realm," there was probably some reason for it.

What's more, Nemo did indeed awaken his abilities by the other party's side, and now that he was unwilling to come back, as parents, they could only try their best to support him.

"The only thing I'm worried about is that after Young Master Nemo awakens his talent, he will gradually need to change his food. Will that young human really have the ability to hunt and bring food back for the cub?"

The old butler with the goat beard raised a key question. Xue Yan watched this scene, caught off guard, and it really was a feeling of his heart softening.

Just as Xue Yan was thinking this, the game popped up the content of this update.

Immersive interactive mode?

Regarding this latest feature after the update, Xue Yan vaguely had a guess, but felt it was a bit whimsical.

Immersive, how immersive could it be?

And the familiar syllables did indeed reawaken Nemo's memory.

Xue Yan, Xue Zai...

"Jium."

Its round, big, watery eyes looked blankly at the caretaker in front of it, and it called out twice.

After a few seconds, the system suddenly prompted:

For example, the daily task panel that Xue Yan was most familiar with was no longer the way it used to be, where clicking to arrange the schedule would automatically complete it; instead, it actually sent Xue Yan a collection basket and a pair of gloves!

That young human looked very good, but it was also obvious that he didn't seem to have any attack power.

Yet the other party dared to boldly reach out and interrupt the process of the magic energy eruption when Young Master Nemo's magic energy erupted.

Humans are truly a wonderful existence that is unfathomable to monsters.

"We can't just have us parents secretly send food over, right?" Early the next morning, the semester officially ended and the summer vacation began. After saying goodbye to his roommates, Xue Yan embarked on the road home.

As the distance from the city center increased, the surrounding scenery took on a more rural atmosphere.

Although the village where Xue Yan's hometown was located was a bit remote, the scenery was quite beautiful.

The murmuring stream flowed down, and after stepping over the old-fashioned wooden bridge across the stream, one could already faintly smell the comforting aroma of home-cooked food being prepared.

His grandmother, Huang Guiying, was famous in the village for her cooking skills when she was young, but unfortunately, she slipped and hurt her leg while picking vegetables on the mountain, so she didn't go out much anymore.

"Xue Zai, you're back? Have you finished your exams at school?"

At this moment, hearing the movement outside the house, his grandmother in the small kitchen had already wiped her hands and come out to welcome Xue Yan.

"I finished them a long time ago. Are Grandpa and Uncle still at the peach orchard?"

Xue Yan helped his grandmother back into the house, where watermelon chilled in well water had already been placed on the table.

"They just went to the city this morning to talk about selling the peaches. People still think this place is too remote and aren't very willing to come and collect the goods. It's estimated it will take a week or two before they can come back."

Regarding this matter, his grandmother muttered a few words simply.

The peaches at home had thin skin and soft flesh, and the juice overflowed with every bite; they could be said to be the dream peaches for many people.

It's just a pity that because the road wasn't repaired, the cost of external transportation was too high, and selling them nearby didn't fetch a good price. After working hard for a whole year, most of the time they just barely maintained a balance of payments.

Worried that Xue Yan would also worry, the old lady quickly added: "If it really doesn't work out, we'll continue to let your Uncle Changyue help this year. Your Uncle Changyue is a big boss with wide connections."

"Uncle Changyue?"

Hearing this, Xue Yan repeated it with a slightly raised tone.

As a legendary figure in Lu Village, Lu Changyue's ancestors were among the first batch of people to go into business and make a fortune, making him the well-deserved richest man in the village.

It's just a pity that after the family property was passed down to Lu Changyue, he lost money on whatever he invested in, characterized by appearing to be calculating but unable to calculate anything.

After several investment failures, Lu Changyue also became honest and has since become the recognized stingy person in the village.

Would he be so kind as to take the initiative to help handle the peaches?

"Oh, let the person earn a little bit at least..."

Of course, his grandmother knew that the reason for being able to move Lu Changyue was probably not that simple, but at least it was better than letting them rot in the ground.

Regarding this, Xue Yan pondered for a moment and didn't say anything for the time being. He tidied up the luggage he brought back from school and didn't have time to look at his phone until the evening.

He wondered if that little black fluffy ball had come out yet.

However, to Xue Yan's surprise, as soon as he logged in this time, he found that the basin of milk he had placed last night was actually empty!

He zoomed in on the screen with his fingers to confirm again and again; this basin of milk was licked so clean that even the bottom of the basin was clean.

"If I'm discovered, will I be misunderstood again?"

"And what if that human can't teach the little guy how to hunt?!"

A group of parents who were trying to reflect on themselves tasted for the first time what it meant to be hesitant.

"Sigh, if only we could open a livestream again, at least we could remotely see what they are doing."

In fact, at this moment, Xue Yan was studying the reward items this time.
