After all, a handsome and wealthy CEO like Caesar would have had countless interstellar pursuers throwing themselves at him in reality; where would he need to spend a million to hire someone to play his partner?

But... why was it so addictive?

Lu Xun looked at the third brother on stage, who was clearly stunned into a daze, and for once didn't spoil the mood, instead leaning down to whisper something into the cub's ear.

He was trying to coax Xueyan to come out and say a few words to his third brother as a little fan.

This scene made the cheers from the entire venue even louder.

The Lu Li fans were especially excited: "Cute, right?? Haha, such a cute little fan belongs to our family!"

The key was that one little fan could win over the whole family to support Lu Li; this was clearly a win-win deal, hahaha€€€€

Xueyan, having his brother whisper in his ear, finally looked up at the stage and realized his third brother seemed to really be looking at him!

You have to know that Xueyan had tried waving and calling for his brother before, but there were clearly too many people in the audience, and it was very difficult for Lu Li to notice the tiny speck buried in the crowd.

Even if he seemed to be looking in this direction, he might be making eye contact with countless people at the same time.

But at this moment, the third brother, Lu Li, was undoubtedly looking at Xueyan in the audience.

Actively moving out of this study. It even made people watch and couldn't help but think, maybe they could meet a Caesar too?

Among them, even a very famous interstellar lawyer's legal education livestream channel couldn't help but jump on the trend of "The Contractual Marriage."

In the livestream, a lawyer in a suit and tie directly analyzed the details of the original text of "The Contractual Marriage," delving into whether the prenuptial agreement between Caesar and Gu Bai had legal effect under Interstellar Federal Law.

And in the end, he earnestly tried to advise the netizens in the chat that if someone really proposed such a prenuptial agreement, everyone in the various star systems must be cautious about signing it!

Although the livestream chat was already completely dominated by "Hahahaha" and "Good, good, learned another useless piece of trivia."

After all, one comment was very honest: [Lawyer-dada, we would be very willing to sign such an agreement, but you clearly need to persuade a wealthy CEO like Caesar to agree first...]

"Then if we move out, how should we go about it?"

After thinking for a long while, Lu Xueyan firmed up his resolve.

And Pei Yan’s eyes widened instantly, almost jumping up on the spot.

"Ahhh, then of course we need to plan it!"

After quickly discussing the moving plan with Pei Yan and the little guy left in a rush, Lu Xueyan logged back into Star News.

After all, Brandenburg was still waiting for him.

The little pear hat on the little guy's head made Lu Li freeze for a long time; it was the first time he realized that his own merchandise could look so fitting on his younger brother...

Discovering that Lu Li was out of it, and that Fu Yao and the others were clearly not suitable for interacting with Lu Li's fans, the stage manager hurriedly took over the microphone to warm up the crowd:

Hearing this, Lu Xun also brought the offered microphone to Xueyan: "Say something to your third brother? But if you don't want to, that's fine too."

Except the third brother would probably be sad and disappointed.

Xueyan heard his brother's words and looked down at the microphone in front of him, conflicted.

The whole venue couldn't help but stare at the beautiful little pear on the screen, nervous and curious if the little guy would really speak.

After all, he was indeed not very old, still at the age where he needed to be held by his guardians.

The stage manager thought that if the cub didn't know what to say, it would be fine to let the guardians behind him take the microphone to interact instead.

Suddenly asking such a young child to speak impromptu in public might be a bit difficult.

However, just as the microphone was about to be taken away, Xueyan finally gathered his courage and held onto it, looking at the lens with moist eyes.

It was as if he was saying, "Don't go yet."

Facing Lu Xueyan, Brandenburg subconsciously put away his usual sharp-tongued temper, inexplicably feeling like he was worrying about raising a cub.

Could this be a "career mom fan"?? Pfft, "career dad fan"!

After Lu Xueyan finished reading the long text and cooperation details sent by Brandenburg, he quickly understood Brandenburg's meaning.

It was roughly that after each of his books was released, he could officially authorize Brandenburg to livestream it, and in return, Brandenburg would be responsible for promotion.

But he was still a newcomer, while Brandenburg was already a top-tier streamer.

Usually, in such cases, it would be the author who pays for promotion; the cooperation agreement in front of him was ridiculously generous!

So Lu Xueyan confirmed it once more.

Although he did indeed need popularity value right now, Brandenburg's appearance was like someone sending a pillow just as he was getting sleepy!

And after Brandenburg read this message, while feeling a mix of frustration at his lack of ambition and a strange sense of relief that this little author was genuinely honest and that he hadn't misjudged him.

"Brother, keep it up... I'm a little pear too, brother's singing is so good!"

The next second, a soft, cub-like voice came through the microphone.

Even his speech was soft and gentle, and his little trailing tone was like a fluffy tail, scratching the hearts of the listeners until they softened.

Not to mention that after speaking, Xueyan made a cheering gesture to the camera, his milky-white hair swaying along with the little sprout on his hat.

Help, this little pear is truly so cute, it could make people silly with adoration€€€€!

The key was that after Xueyan finished speaking, the Alpha guardian behind him seemed unable to suppress a laugh, which was faintly picked up by the microphone.

This caused Xueyan to instantly feel embarrassed, pursing his lips and looking up at his brother, suspecting his brother was laughing at him.

Lu Xun was resting his chin on his hand, trying hard to hide the smile at the corner of his mouth, signaling that he wasn't.

He just thought it was too cute.

He wondered how the third brother felt watching from the stage.

At the same time, both on-site and online, the popularity of this "little pear" who appeared at the concert skyrocketed.

chapters.translated_text:
After all, that little hat looked exceptionally cute on the cub's head, giving people an urge to own the same one. It was as if owning the same hat would make them just as cute!

Someone in the audience also noticed this: "Yuanyuan! Isn't this the merchandise hat you sent out? It actually got picked to be on the big screen!" The young girl was so excited she had the illusion that she had gone on "television" along with it.

Pan Yuanyuan stared blankly at the big screen, naturally realizing that this was the parent and cub she had recommended the merchandise to outside the venue.

To be honest, the impact of seeing them in person was even greater than seeing them through a screen, and the sense of familiarity became even stronger.

The stage host, seeing the soaring heat in the backstage data, decisively continued the interaction: [So, does our little Li fan have a favorite song? The lucky fan chosen can pick a song as an interactive reward!]

If this interaction went well, it might really land on the trending topics, as the buzz was already so high.

Whether it was the explosive point of the cub being a "Little Li" fan, or the mysterious identity of the parent behind them, each revelation was more shocking than the last.

Hearing this, many people looked over curiously, wanting to know which song such a cute little pear would like.

Regarding this question, Lu Xun, who originally hadn't interfered much with the concert organizer's interactions, frowned slightly.

He thought that the third brother actually didn't spend much time at home with the cub, so Xueyan might not really know which songs were his.

Besides, staring and filming for a while was one thing, but chasing them with questions was a bit unpleasant.

But just as Lu Xun lowered his eyes to look, this time Xueyan thought about it with rare seriousness before hugging the microphone excitedly: "Yes, I want to hear Brother sing that song!"

That song?

Which song was that? Lu Xun looked at Xueyan with great surprise.

Lu Li, who had been stunned, also subconsciously looked at Xueyan on the stage, wanting to know which song Xueyan was going to pick.

And Lu Xueyan couldn't help but widen his eyes slightly after hearing it.

Damn it, is this the real-life version of the legend: "Only when you grow up do you realize that my dad's ideas are called local policies"?!

If this were written into a novel, the effect would definitely be incredible.

After all, aside from business tycoons like Caesar, one could totally consider riding the interstellar hype train later and write about a military bigwig.

"Sorry, I wasn't implying that you were a mermaid disguised as a bad guy! Although if any bad guys appear in my cousin's study, the consequences are really serious, but I swear I thought you didn't look like a bad guy at all from the start!"

Pei Yan saw the mermaid Lu Xueyan's eyes widen slightly and, mistakenly thinking his words had caused a misunderstanding, immediately tried his best to explain.

Lu Xueyan could certainly understand Pei Yan's behavior.

After all, it would be quite strange for anyone to suddenly have a mermaid appear in their home.

However, he really couldn't tell this little guy about the existence of the system.

So Lu Xueyan just reached out to pat Pei Yan's head in a soothing manner, the little guy's slightly prickly hair making his palm itch.

"I promise, as long as you don't want to be discovered by others, I will definitely try super hard to help!"

Pei Yan subconsciously rubbed against Lu Xueyan's palm and said earnestly.

"And I wasn't lying to you, the fountain in my garden is really beautiful."

"So, please don't hate me, okay?"

Lu Xueyan, holding his fish tail with one hand, looked down at the little guy who was holding his palm with both hands like a furry, apologetic puppy, and couldn't help but curl his lips.

"I don't hate you at all."

However, Pei Yan's reaction did remind Lu Xueyan of one thing.

Although understanding the daily lives of interstellar bigwigs up close was crucial for accumulating writing material and fixing common sense bugs in his novel,

if this little bun was already this complicated, how dangerous would it be now that his cousin was officially back this week?

If only he could just code words and write books to earn popularity points without worrying about anything else.

Lu Xueyan, who was born hating all troubles other than writing, couldn't help but seriously consider the little guy Pei Yan's suggestion.

Having already heard it once on stage, Lu Li couldn't help but ask again in a low voice.

"Yes! I like Brother's songs so, so much, Third Brother is the best!"

As a little fanboy, Xueyan immediately repeated it to his third brother, even adding that his brother was the best!

This successfully made Lu Xun and the others feel a bit jealous for no reason.

They thought, with just one concert, the third brother's family status had soared, making him the "best"?

Could the little guy be a little face-con?

As for Fu Yao and the others on the side, they were so stunned by this scene that they couldn't speak at all.

"Brother" could be understood as what fans call him... but "Dad"? That's not something fans would call him, right?!

"Sister Hong Yan, this? What, what is going on?"

Realizing something was wrong, a red-faced Fu Yao looked at their manager, Hong Yan.

Actually, this was the first time Hong Yan felt that Fu Yao might be a bit too calculating, and she was quite suspicious in her heart.

"Fu Yao, Lu Li is younger than you, and you are the team leader, you should lead him more." Instead of competing for attention.

Besides, if it weren't for Lu Li bringing his own capital into the team, to be honest, many resources and configurations would never be as sufficient as they were now.

Hong Yan's pointed remark left Fu Yao speechless, and the stage costume he hadn't changed out of yet felt abnormally stifling.

"Why, you asked me to collect popularity points, not money, why are you suddenly so excited? Is there a reward for having more money?"

Lu Xueyan didn't expect the system to pop up.

"Well, no, but I used to be a money-collection system, so I have some muscle memory, oh wait, no... anyway, why are you refunding!"

With the system's data logic, it couldn't understand Lu Xueyan's choice.

Although its replacement of sensitive words according to world rules did seem to cause a deviation in the interstellar readers' understanding, it wasn't a bad thing.

"Because this has already caused a serious misunderstanding. I just turned into a mermaid, not injured my legs. If I accept these tips for such a reason, it's completely deceiving people's feelings."

"And don't you believe that your host can collect enough popularity points through his work until the day his legs are truly restored?"

At this moment, Lu Xueyan flicked his beautiful fish tail and asked the system with great confidence.

So much so that the system, looking at the earnest Lu Xueyan, especially those beautiful amber eyes, couldn't say a word.

Is this the consequence of having a host with too high of a beauty level?

Even arguing feels impossible! It even feels like it's being too harsh by not trusting the other party! QAQ

"Fine, fine, whatever you want! I'm done with you, but the popularity points better not drop!"

The system was depressed one second, but the next second, after secretly checking the popularity point progress, it was stunned:

"Holy crap, why did the popularity points skyrocket instead!? And they're still skyrocketing!"

It had only been a day since it checked, and it found that the host's popularity point collection had finally moved from the precarious negative numbers back onto a normal development track.

"Your comment section seems to have exploded."

The system quickly tracked the data source to the comment section and couldn't help but exclaim in admiration.

"And it looks like your rumor-clearing wasn't very effective."

The system was even a bit "schadenfreude" for a moment.

Lu Xueyan: ???

In fact, the comment section had indeed exploded after seeing such an unprecedented refund message from an author for the first time in history.

As for Xia Jue and Bo Ya behind them, they were just tired and panting after the concert ended, but now, seeing this scene, they were breaking out in a cold sweat.

No way, these aren't fans?

They're Lu Li's family!?

This is too strange, right? Why did Lu Li always avoid talking about this? It made Xia Jue think Lu Li was just like him, putting on a rich second-generation persona.

If his own family was this impressive, he would have been dying to announce it to the world.

Lu Xun, who noticed the movement here, just glanced over.

He didn't intend to deal with the third brother's affairs while Xueyan was present. Once they returned to the country, he would naturally find time to sort it out carefully.

The third brother had simply spoiled a group of people.

Having lacked nothing since childhood, he naturally didn't realize that if many things were given too much for granted, some people would eventually feel that getting a little less was an act of enmity.

Hong Yan looked at the latest trends online and, after thinking it over, reminded him: "Um... Mr. Lu, there's something I might need to tell you."

"The heat of today's concert is unexpectedly high, leading to a lot of news spreading online. Do you need to control this content?"

Just the topic #TheCutestLittleLiFanEver# was very hot, not to mention a series of topics like #LuLiNewSong# and #ExpensiveEnoughToBuyMyLife# that kept popping up.

Along with it, many of the Lu family's famous tough deeds were being popularized.

Although Hong Yan couldn't help but laugh when she saw a netizen with an IP in S City proudly introducing to many others that this was exactly a famous A-level scenic family in their S City.

Does this author even know how to make money!?

It was just that the readers' understanding in the comment section made Lu Xueyan's second wave of explanations get stuck in his throat.

It was as if no matter what else he said, these readers could instantly explain it with an "I understand, I understand" attitude.

"What exactly have they understood?"

And Lu Xueyan, amidst the system's mocking laughter, felt that this rumor-clearing had suddenly become incredibly difficult.

Could it be that he really has to come forward in the future to prove it to completely solve this?

"Hmm? Then I support it! You can totally do a live stream and show your fish tail, the popularity points you'll rake in will definitely be huge!"

The little system hesitated for a moment, but then became instantly active, its "Superstar System" attributes exploding.

Come on, this is the only mermaid in the whole universe!

Doing a live stream or something would at least cause a sensation and hit the trending topics, right!?

Not to mention this top-tier beauty!

Lu Xueyan: "...I refuse."

"You are really making me heartbroken!"

The system was simply frustrated by Lu Xueyan's performance.

chapters.source_text:
毕竟那顶小帽子出现在幼崽头上后就显得格外可爱，让人产生一种很想拥有同款的冲动。仿佛拥有同款帽子，就能一样可爱了！
场内观众席里也有人发现了这点：“媛媛！这不是你发出去的周边帽子吗？居然被抽中上大屏了！”年轻女生激动到有种自己跟着一块上“电视”的错觉。
潘媛媛愣怔地看着大屏幕，当然也意识到这就是自己场外安利到的那位家长和幼崽。
说实话，现实里看到真人的冲击力比隔着一层大屏幕还要大，熟悉感也变得更强了。
场控主持看着后台飙升的热度，当机立断继续互动起来：【那请问我们这位小梨粉有喜欢的歌吗？被选中的幸运粉丝可以点一首歌作为互动奖励的哦！】
这要是互动好了，说不定还真的能出一个热搜，毕竟话题热度太高了。
无论是幼崽作为小黎粉的爆点，还是身后家长的神秘身份，简直一个比一个爆。
闻言不少人也好奇地看了过来，想知道这么可爱的小梨子会喜欢哪首歌？
对于这个问题，原本并没有过多干涉演唱会主办方互动的陆巡却微微蹙眉。
心想老三回家陪着幼崽的次数实则不多，雪言还真的未必知道哪些歌。
而且盯着拍一会儿就罢了，追着提问就有些令人不虞了。
但就在陆巡垂眸看去时，这一次的雪言却罕见认真想了一下后，就雀跃地抱住了话筒：“有，想听哥哥唱那首歌！”
那首歌？
那首歌是哪首歌？陆巡颇感意外地看着雪言。
原本还在愣怔的陆黎，也下意识认真地看向台下的雪言，想知道雪言准备点哪首歌。
而陆雪言听完后却忍不住微微瞪圆了眼睛。
可恶，难道这就是传说中的“长大了才知道，我爸的想法在当地叫政策”现实版本吗？！
感觉写进小说里的话，这效果绝会好得不行嘛。
毕竟除了凯撒这样的商业界霸总，以后完全也可以考虑来蹭一波星际热点，写个军部大佬么。
“抱歉，我不是暗示你会是坏人伪装的人鱼啊！虽然表哥书房里一旦出现什么坏人的话，后果真的挺严重的，但是我发誓我一开始就觉得你一点也不像坏人！”
裴炎看见了陆雪言这只人鱼微微睁大的双眼，误以为是自己刚才的话让对方误会了，立刻努力解释起来。
陆雪言当然可以理解裴炎这样的行为。
毕竟任谁家里突然出现一只人鱼，其实细想还真的挺奇怪的。
不过自己也确实不能告诉这小家伙系统的存在。
所以陆雪言只是安抚般地伸手摸了摸裴炎的脑袋，小家伙有些刺啦的发丝让掌心痒痒的。
“我保证，只要你不想被别人发现，我一定超级努力地帮忙！”
裴炎下意识蹭了蹭陆雪言的掌心，认真地说着话。
“而且我没骗你，我家花园里的喷泉真的很好看。”
“所以，不要讨厌我好不好？”
陆雪言单手抱着鱼尾巴，垂眸看着眼前双手拉着自己掌心的，像个毛茸茸道歉小狗的小家伙，忍不住勾起了唇角。
“我可没有讨厌你。”
不过裴炎的反应倒是真的提醒了陆雪言一点。
虽然像现在这样，近距离了解星际大佬们的日常生活方式，对于自己积累写作素材、修正小说行文里的星际常识BUG很关键。
但这小团子都这么不简单的话，他表哥这周正式回来了，才得多危险？
要是可以单纯码字写书赚人气值，不用去担心其他的就好了。
天生讨厌码字之外所有麻烦的陆雪言，一时间忍不住认真思考起了裴炎这小家伙的提议
明明在台上已经听过一次了，陆黎还是没忍住又轻声询问了一遍。
“嗯！特别特别喜欢哥哥的歌，三哥最厉害了！”
身为小捧场王的雪言立刻给三哥重复了一遍，甚至还加了一句哥哥最厉害了！
成功让陆巡等人莫名有点吃味。
心想老三这么一场演唱会，就直接家庭地位飙升，变成最厉害的了？
小家伙莫非还是个小颜控。
至于一旁的付尧等人看着这一幕，已经错愕到完全说不出话来了。
哥哥还能理解为粉丝会喊哥哥……但是，老爸这种称呼，总不会是粉丝能喊的出来的称呼吧？！
“洪燕姐这？这、这是什么情况？”
意识到不对劲的付尧面红耳赤地看向了经纪人洪燕。
其实洪燕也是第一次有点觉得付尧心眼似乎有点多，内心颇为犯嘀咕。
“付尧，陆黎年纪还比你小点呢，你又是队长，平时应该多带带。”而不是争着表现。
何况如果不是陆黎带资进队，说实话，很多资源和配置根本不可能像现在这样充足。
洪燕一句意有所指的话直接让付尧说不出话来了，尚且没换下来的演出服都变得闷热异常。
“干嘛，你让我收集人气值，又没让我收集存款，突然这么激动？钱多了会有奖励吗？”
陆雪言也没想到这系统都跳出来了。
“那倒是没有，但是我以前干过金钱收集系统，有点肌肉记忆，啊呸不是……总之你干什么退款啊！”
以系统的数据逻辑，并不能理解陆雪言的选择。
虽然自己按照世界规则进行敏感词替换后，的确好像造成了星际读者们阅读理解上的偏差，但是也不是坏事啊。
“因为这已经造成了严重误会，我只是变成人鱼而不是双腿受伤，如果因为这种理由接受这些打赏的话，完全是欺骗感情。”
“而且你难道不相信你的宿主可以靠作品收集到足够人气值，直到真真正正恢复双腿的那一天么？”
这一刻的陆雪言甩了甩自己的漂亮鱼尾巴，相当自信地询问起了系统。
以至于系统看着眼前一脸认真的陆雪言，尤其是那双琥珀色的漂亮眼眸，都说不出话来了。
这难道就是绑定的宿主颜值太高的后果么？
吵架都感觉吵不下去！甚至还觉得自己不信任对方很过分！QAQ
“好吧好吧，随你！我不管你了，反正人气值可不能掉！”
只是系统前一秒还在郁郁寡欢，但后一秒偷偷察看了一下人气值进度后就被惊呆了：
“卧槽，人气值为什么反而暴涨了这么多！？甚至还在暴涨！”
自己只是一天没看而已，就发现宿主的人气值收集，似乎终于从之前岌岌可危的负数，重新进入了正常发展的轨道了。
“你的评论区好像炸了。”
系统很快追踪数据来源到了评论区，忍不住颇为惊叹地感慨起来。
“而且看起来，你的辟谣不太有效。”
甚至系统一时间有点“幸灾乐祸”。
陆雪言：？？？
事实上，评论区在破天荒地看见这么一条有史以来的作者主动退款留言后，的确直接炸了。
至于身后的夏觉和柏涯，原本演唱会落幕还只是累得有点喘气，这会儿撞见这一幕连后背冷汗都快出来了。
不是吧，这居然不是粉丝？
而是陆黎家里人！？
这也太奇怪了吧？为什么之前陆黎总是很避嫌谈到这点？搞得夏觉还以为陆黎这家伙跟自己一样是在搞富二代人设。
要是自己家里人这么拿得出手的，自己早就恨不得昭告天下了。
察觉到这里动静的陆巡，仅仅是瞥了一眼。
并不打算在雪言在场的时候，动手处理老三的这堆事情。等马上回国之后，自然会抽出时间来仔仔细细理一理。
老三这家伙，纯粹是把一群人胃口养大了。
从小身边什么都不缺，自然也就没有意识到很多东西如果给的太理所当然，一些人习惯后反而会逐渐觉得少给一点都是仇人了。
洪燕看着网上的最新动态，思前想后还是出声提醒了一句：“那个……陆总，有件事可能得跟您说一声。”
“今天这场演唱会热度出乎意料的高，导致网上逐渐传出来了很多消息，您需要控制一下这部分内容吗？”
光是一个#史上最萌小黎粉#的话题就热度颇高，更别提#陆黎新歌##贵到可以买我的命#等一连串话题接连不断地飘起。
连带着陆家的很多著名彪悍事迹都被科普了起来。
虽然当洪燕看到有IP为S市的网友，相当得意地为众多网友介绍€€€€这正是他们S市一款大名鼎鼎的全A级景区家庭时，还是忍不住笑了。
这作者到底会不会赚钱！？
只不过评论区里的读者们的理解，瞬间让陆雪言第二波解释的话都卡在了嘴边。
仿佛无论再说些什么，这些读者都能一副我懂我懂的态度瞬间解释。
“他们到底理解什么了？”
而陆雪言在系统的嘲笑声里，感觉这场辟谣突然变得无比艰难。
难不成自己真的得日后出面证明一下，才能彻底解决这事？
“嗯？那我支持！您完全可以去搞个直播，展示一下鱼尾巴，到时候薅到的人气值肯定也巨高！”
小系统迟疑了一下，倒是瞬间积极了起来，人气巨星系统属性大爆发。
拜托，这这可是全宇宙唯一一条美人鱼！
搞个直播什么的，少说也得轰动上个热搜吧！？
更别提这杠杠的颜值！
陆雪言：“……我拒绝。”
“您这样实在是让我太痛心疾首了！”
系统对于陆雪言这种表现，简直是恨铁不成钢。

chapters.translated_text:
However, just as Lu Xueyan was feeling a headache coming on, a flashing notification for a private message in the backend of the platform caught her attention.

A private message?

Is it a private message from the streamer Bailande?

Yet, when Lu Xueyan opened it, she discovered that besides the message request from Bailande, there was also a red system notification from the platform.

She thought to herself that this description was strangely fitting!

"Mm, I already know."

Lu Xun, however, was looking at the exploding family group chat on his phone and naturally realized that the videos and photos of Xueyan interacting with the third brother at the concert had already spread rapidly in a short amount of time.

This was because the fourth brother was currently going absolutely berserk in the group.

It was one thing for one person to go see a doctor, but four people? And they ended up at a concert?

After Lu Huai roared hysterically for a long time, he directly posted that concert video into the group.

It was clearly the video of Xueyan being held on the eldest brother's lap, earnestly saying that she was also a "Little Li" fan and liked the third brother the most.

Although Lu Jing and the others on the side didn't have their faces in the frame, to Lu Huai, one look was enough to see that the people sitting next to them were clearly Lu Jing and their dad!

No wonder there had been no one at home lately; it turns out they all secretly hopped on a plane and went abroad!

Leaving only him behind to honestly stay in the country and go to school!?

This is simply bullying an honest Alpha!

It was currently high noon in the country, and while in the middle of class, the honest Alpha Lu Huai couldn't help but slam his desk with a loud "Bang!" and stand up.

It shocked his classmates, who were stunned and thought something was wrong with Lu Huai again.

And the message that popped up the next second gave Bailande a feeling that it was no surprise.

This author is indeed quite fragile.

Could it be that she stayed up all night finishing the update and hasn't eaten anything yet??

In reality, the reason Lu Xueyan hadn't replied for so long was that the mental energy she had deliberately set aside had inexplicably been depleted because she was hungry, to the point where she had almost collapsed again just now.

Unexpectedly, the system dragged out a box of nutrient solution for Lu Xueyan to drink the next second, startling her into grabbing it.

"Where did you drag that out from again!"

It was already embarrassing enough to borrow the optical computer to write, and now she was eating what she suspected was someone else's emergency rations, which made Lu Xueyan's scalp tingle even more.

The little system was quite nonchalant:

"I just took it from the fridge in the lounge in the side room. There are plenty, all the highest-grade nutrient solution."

"Besides, it's a waste not to drink it. The logistics staff for this building come by regularly to throw them out and replace them anyway."

"A hunger state will consume mental energy to compensate."

Holding the nutrient solution in her hand, Lu Xueyan finally confirmed one thing: this little system really didn't seem to have human-like thinking; in many areas, it operated entirely on instinct.

"Although I'm very grateful that you helped me find food, it's not very good for humans to touch other people's things without permission."

Lu Xueyan tried to explain the reasoning behind it.

"But the operation of our small worlds is based on equivalent exchange; everything has a causal connection."

"Including the fact that you are currently residing in a fish tank, there will definitely be follow-up plot missions, so drinking some nutrient solution in advance is nothing."

Unexpectedly, the system responded seriously to Lu Xueyan's dilemma.

"Lu Huai, what's wrong? Are you feeling unwell?"

The homeroom teacher, Shen Huimin, adjusted her glasses and asked while clutching her chest.

"I'm not feeling well, I need to ask for leave! Teacher."

The next second, she watched as Lu Huai gritted his teeth, grabbed his school bag, and rushed out of the classroom.

"Hey, Lu Huai, where are you going—!"

Shen Huimin stared blankly as Lu Huai disappeared just like that, instinctively looking at Wei Zhili on the side, wanting to ask if he knew what was going on.

"Nothing, he's probably just having a breakdown from being left behind as a 'latchkey child'..."

Wei Zhili said gloomily.

Secondly, it might be the realization that his status as the "Number One Brother" is unstable?

After all, even Wei Zhili, watching that concert solo video that had exploded online, had to admit that this talented star third brother, Lu Huai, was damn cool, holy crap!

A complete Alpha among Alphas!

Give him a piano, and he could play music so freely and easily in front of tens of thousands of people; the radiance of his talent was bright enough to blind the audience.

Compared to Lu Huai, who stutters even when reading English on the podium, this brother versus that brother—it really is a case of "goods compared to goods, one should be thrown away," right?

Tsk tsk tsk, the competition is fierce.
chapters.source_text:
不过就在陆雪言头疼的这一刻，后台的站短私信闪烁消息确实引起了陆雪言的注意。
私信？
那个主播白兰德的私信吗？
然而陆雪言打开一看，却发现除了主播白兰德的私信申请之外，还有一条红色的站内系统短信。
心想这描述还怪贴切的！
“嗯，我已经知道了。”
只不过陆巡看着手机上已经爆炸的家族群，自然也意识到雪言在演唱会上跟老三互动的视频照片，已经在短时间内迅速传开了。
因为老四这会儿正在群里疯狂爆炸。
一个人带去看病变成四个人也就算了，看病还看到了演唱会现场？
陆淮歇斯底里咆哮半天后，直接在群里发出了那段演唱会视频。
赫然是雪言被大哥抱在腿上，认真说自己也是小黎粉最喜欢三哥的视频。
一旁的陆菁等人虽然脸没入镜，但对陆淮来讲，一看就能发现旁边坐着的人分明就是陆菁跟老爸！
怪不得最近家里又没人了，敢情全背地里坐飞机跑国外去了？
就剩自己一个人老老实实地在国内上学！？
简直是欺负老实A！
国内这会儿正是大中午，上课期间的老实A陆淮便忍不住“砰€€€€”的一声巨响拍桌而起。
吓得一旁的同学们都惊呆了，还以为陆淮又哪里不对劲了。
而下一秒弹出来的消息，便让白兰德有种不出意外的感觉。
这作者果然很脆皮。
不会熬夜更新完毕到现在还没吃饭吧？？
实际上，陆雪言之所以半天没回复，是因为原本刻意留出来的精神力居然莫名其妙因为饿肚子又用光了！以至于刚刚差点再度扑街。
没想到系统下一秒拖出了一盒子营养液让陆雪言喝掉，吓得陆雪言一把接住。
“你这又是从哪儿拖出来的！”
本来借用光脑码字已经很尴尬了，现在还吃疑似人家的储备粮，简直让陆雪言越发头皮发麻。
小系统倒是相当坦然：
“从隔间那个休息室冰箱里拿的呗，有好多呢，全是最高等级的营养液。”
“何况不喝也是浪费，这屋子的后勤定期过来扔掉更换一波的好吧。”
“饥饿状态是会消耗精神力来填补的。”
而陆雪言拿着手里的营养液，终于确认了一点，那就是这小系统似乎真的没有人类思维，很多地方完全就是本能运转。
“虽然很感谢你帮我找吃的，但是人类如果没有经过同意的话，随便动别人东西是不太好的。”
陆雪言试图解释其中的原因。
“可是我们小世界运行本来就讲究等价交换啊，一切都是有因果联系的。”
“包括你现在寄居在鱼缸里，肯定也是会有后续剧情任务的，提前喝点营养液也不算什么。”
没想到系统对于陆雪言的纠结，倒是认真回复了起来。
“陆淮，你怎么了？身体不舒服吗？”
班主任申慧敏扶了扶眼镜，捂住胸口询问道。
“身体不舒服，我要请假！老班。”
下一秒就看着陆淮咬牙切齿地拎起书包冲出教室了。
“喂，陆淮，你要去哪儿啊€€€€！”
申慧敏目瞪口呆地看着陆淮就这么消失了，本能看向一旁的卫之礼，想问问卫之礼知道不知道什么情况。
“没什么，也就是变留守儿童破防了吧……”
卫之礼幽幽说道。
其次可能就是发现，自己的“一哥”地位不稳？
毕竟就连卫之礼看着那段网上爆火的演唱会独奏视频，都不得不承认，陆淮这个才华横溢的明星三哥真他妈的帅啊我靠！
完完全全的Alpha中的Alpha！
给人家一台钢琴，就能在数万人面前那么挥洒自如的演奏音乐，天赋光芒简直明亮到刺瞎观众双眼。
比起陆淮上讲台念个英语都磕磕巴巴的，这哥哥比哥哥，好像确实货比货可扔？
啧啧啧，竞争激烈啊。
chapters.title: 第141章

chapters.translated_title: Chapter 95: The Song Written for Xueyan
chapters.source_text:
然而雪言“那个……”了半天，似乎就像找不到合适的形容词一样，最后居然鼓起勇气，对着话筒“嗯~嗯嗯~”地哼了一小段旋律。
就是自己负责敲三角铁的那首歌！
但当时哥哥还没有取名字呢，所以当然是没有名字的。
说实话听到嗯嗯声后就连老爸他们都愣了一下，没想到雪言真的主动点歌了，甚至还自己唱了一段，幼崽音软绵绵的。
小家伙都会唱歌了？
老三教的？！
“哇，唱的真不错啊宝贝！”“唱的好啊，不愧是我们梨子粉！从小培养！！”
现场的粉丝大朋友们也是相当给面子，善意的鼓掌声音瞬间响起。
“笑死，夸归夸，但到底是哪一首？？光顾着被萌死了，真的认不出来。”
只不过这首歌到底是组合的哪一首歌，一时间还真的没有粉丝认出来，导致整个场馆都变成猜猜乐了。
一直在追究内心那种熟悉感的潘媛媛，听到这段旋律后却突然激动地站了起来：
察觉到手机震动的雪言低头一看，才发现是好感度再度上升，掉落了新的奖励道具，同时游戏强制下线更新资料包了。
这免费游戏居然还有资料包更新？还是全球范围内的？
感觉很有实力的样子。
虽然雪言到最后也不知道这个“月神光环”是什么意思。
不过回忆着勋章上有着疑似煤球剪影的暗纹，雪言决定将这个理解为崽儿对老父亲的祝福。
毕竟小家伙还这么小，毛茸茸得这么可爱，难道还能害人不成？
不可能，绝对不可能！
这边雪言刚被游戏更新强制下线，阿杰也刚刚好打完电话，兴冲冲地跑回了院子里。
“雪崽，大家都说好久不见你怪想你的，明早……咦？”
只是陆杰刚刚说到一半，看向雪言的目光却顿了一下。
雪言也意识到了阿杰目光的不对劲。
自己脸上有东西？《魔界》游戏自带的论坛里，这些帖子刷新速度快到了一秒几十条，像是流水一般地翻动着。
平日里或沉默不言、或高冷潜水的家伙们，难得全员被炸了出来。
这些帖子的语气乍一看和普通人类毫无区别，但这里面的确一名正常人类都没有。
因为这是只有具备魔物血统才能注册登录的论坛。
这也是为什么很多无意中下载了《魔界》APP的人类玩家根本无法顺利登录打开必闪退的原因。
这是一款魔物专属的APP。
至于这款APP链接的空间来历也异常神秘，至今没有魔物可以说的清楚它是如何诞生的。
但有一点毫无疑问的就是，APP链接的这个奇异空间，的确为广大魔物们提供了一方极为关键的中转休憩空间。
濒临狂化失控的魔物变回原型进入其中，就能在魔气滋养下逐步恢复稳定状态。
APP自带的内部论坛则能让分布于世界各地的魔物们交流分享各种重要信息。
而且APP内的各种游戏设置也很有趣，按照既定的规则维护内部环境或者参与互动，就能获得很多有意思的功能卡和积分。
不过随着时代的发展，除了论坛偶尔还会有动静，这些开发者最初设计的互动游戏功能也逐渐无人问津了。
那些实力强悍魔物后裔们通常会选择在里面各自占据一方领土，这些领地也逐渐成为了公认禁忌般的存在。
不知道这些是否是导致魔气日益稀薄的原因。
很多魔物一度非常担忧，一旦这一所谓的魔界彻底失去其魔力所在，后果又会是什么。
或许会有越来越的魔物失去理智，彻底变成力量失控的野兽，最后被深渊委员会统一处理掉。
毕竟最近这种情况越来越多，深渊委员会处理善后的工作压力也变得很大。
偶尔甚至还会和人类那边相当克制的合作联手，避免一些过于惨烈的情况发生。
而主角之一的煤球由于年纪有点小，根本没摸到论坛，导致对这一切毫不知情。
煤球只知道，自己还想回去见到“€€”。
就在煤球团在垫子上眨巴眼睛打量手表的时候，房门突然被敲响了：“尼莫少爷，您今天还没有睡觉？”
留着山羊胡子的老管家有些诧异地看见房间里的微光。
被称呼为尼莫的煤球，顿时跌跌撞撞飞向从小陪着自己的管家。
“啾姆、啾姆啾姆……”
荷包蛋一样的大眼睛不停地眨巴，仿佛在迫切地主动和家长比划着什么。
这可是许久没有见到过的景象了。
“手表坏了吗？可是看起来没坏，只是在更新中，您等这个更新时间变成零，大概就能重新登录了。”
chapters.translated_text:
However, Xueyan "ummed..." for a long time, seemingly unable to find the right adjectives, and finally gathered the courage to hum a short melody into the microphone: "Hmm~ mmm-hmm~."

It was that song where she was in charge of playing the triangle!

But at the time, Brother hadn't given it a name yet, so of course, it didn't have one.

To be honest, even Dad and the others were stunned after hearing the humming; they hadn't expected Xueyan to actually take the initiative to request a song, and she even sang a bit herself, her cub-like voice soft and sweet.

The little one can sing now?

Did the third brother teach her?!

"Wow, that was sung really well, baby!" "Great singing, worthy of being our Pear fan! Cultivated from a young age!!"

The fans and older friends at the venue were also quite supportive, and the sound of good-natured applause erupted instantly.

"I'm dying of laughter, praise aside, which song was it exactly?? I was too busy being melted by the cuteness to actually recognize it."

However, none of the fans could immediately identify which of the group's songs it was, turning the entire venue into a guessing game.

Pan Yuanyuan, who had been searching for the source of that sense of familiarity in her heart, suddenly stood up in excitement upon hearing this melody:

Noticing her phone vibrating, Xueyan looked down and realized that her favorability had increased again, dropping a new reward item, while the game was forced to go offline to update its data package.

This free game actually has data package updates? And on a global scale?

It feels like it has some real power behind it.

Although, in the end, Xueyan still didn't know what this "Moon God Halo" meant.

However, recalling the dark pattern on the medal that looked suspiciously like a silhouette of a coal ball, Xueyan decided to interpret this as a blessing from the cub to her old father.

After all, the little one is still so small and so fluffy and cute; surely she couldn't be harmful?

Impossible, absolutely impossible!

Just as Xueyan was forced offline by the game update, A-Jie had just finished his phone call and excitedly ran back into the courtyard.

"Xue cub, everyone says they haven't seen you in a long time and miss you, tomorrow morning... eh?"

But just as Lu Jie was halfway through his sentence, his gaze toward Xueyan faltered.

Xueyan also realized that something was off about A-Jie's look.

Is there something on my face? In the forum built into the "Demon World" game, these posts were refreshing at a speed of dozens per second, flipping through like a flowing stream.

The guys who were usually silent or lurking coldly were all rarely blown out into the open.

At first glance, the tone of these posts was no different from ordinary humans, but there wasn't a single normal human in there.

Because this was a forum that could only be registered and logged into by those with demon bloodlines.

This is why many human players who accidentally downloaded the "Demon World" app could never log in successfully and would always experience crashes.

This is an app exclusive to demons.

As for the origin of the space linked by this app, it is also exceptionally mysterious; to this day, no demon can clearly explain how it came to be.

But one thing is certain: this strange space linked by the app has indeed provided a crucial transit and resting space for the vast number of demons.

Demons on the verge of losing control and going berserk can return to their original forms and enter it, where they can gradually restore stability under the nourishment of demonic energy.

The internal forum that comes with the app allows demons scattered all over the world to communicate and share various important pieces of information.

Moreover, the various game settings within the app are also quite interesting; by maintaining the internal environment or participating in interactions according to established rules, one can obtain many interesting functional cards and points.

However, with the development of the times, apart from the forum occasionally having some activity, these interactive game functions originally designed by the developers have gradually been ignored.

Those powerful descendants of demons usually choose to occupy a territory within it, and these territories have gradually become recognized as forbidden existences.

I don't know if these are the reasons why demonic energy is becoming increasingly thin.

Many demons were once very worried about what the consequences would be if this so-called Demon World completely lost its source of magic.

Perhaps more and more demons will lose their sanity, completely turning into beasts with out-of-control power, and eventually be disposed of by the Abyss Committee.

After all, this situation has been happening more and more frequently lately, and the pressure on the Abyss Committee to handle the aftermath has become very high.

Occasionally, they even cooperate and join forces with the human side in a very restrained manner to avoid some overly tragic situations.

And one of the protagonists, Coal Ball, because she is a bit young, never even touched the forum, leaving her completely unaware of all this.

Coal Ball only knows that she still wants to go back and see "€€".

Just as Coal Ball was blinking her eyes on the mat and examining the watch, the door was suddenly knocked: "Young Master Nemo, you haven't slept yet today?"

The old butler with a goatee looked at the faint light in the room with some surprise.

Coal Ball, who was addressed as Nemo, immediately stumbled and flew toward the butler who had accompanied her since she was small.

"Chium, chium-chium..."

Her big, fried-egg-like eyes blinked incessantly, as if she were urgently trying to gesture something to her guardian.

This was a sight that hadn't been seen in a long time.

"Is the watch broken? But it doesn't look broken, it's just updating. If you wait for this update time to reach zero, you should be able to log back in."
chapters.title: 第95章 为了雪言写的歌

chapters.translated_text:
The old butler, flattered and overwhelmed, hurriedly bent down to examine it carefully for a long time, confirming that this latest model of children's phone watch was not broken.

Besides, the reason for knocking on the door so late was actually for another matter:

"By the way, Master Nemo, look who has returned!"

No sooner had the old butler finished speaking than the Aoni couple, who were usually decisive and swift in their actions but now appeared a bit nervous, stood outside the door: "Nemo? Why are you still awake so late today?"

They had originally thought that by rushing back in the middle of the night, they would only be able to see the little one fast asleep.

They hadn't expected Nemo to still be awake.

But the cub before them was just as he had always been; he only tilted his head to glance at them, let out a "Chium," and then, clutching the phone watch in his mouth, wobbled and flew to the highest corner of the bedroom where no one could see him.

This immediately left the Aoni couple, who were left standing there, feeling quite embarrassed, even though this was indeed inseparable from past events.

When Nemo was first born, he was much quieter than all the other cubs, but everyone assumed it was just his nature and didn't think much of it.

By the time all the demons realized there was a problem with Nemo, it was already too late.

Because Nemo was not only perpetually reclusive and unwilling to learn the common language, but his developing young wings also had serious defects.

Even more fatal was that as a descendant of the Luna family, Nemo should have had a very strong bloodline inheritance, yet his wings were weak, he was not good with words, and his innate talents had never awakened.

This contradiction instead caused Nemo to become a complete outcast.

Cubs from other powerful bloodlines only felt cold indifference and confusion toward Nemo's weakness and silence.

As for the cubs whose bloodline inheritance was not as strong as Nemo's but who possessed exceptional individual abilities, they would instinctively seize opportunities to bite Nemo, hoping to snatch his bloodline magic.

Nemo could not resist the biting of his wings, yet he remained silent; by the time it was discovered, the fractured bones had healed in a deformed state, becoming a permanent mark on his body.

Even though the Aoni couple severely punished the relevant individuals afterward, it felt as if they had missed the best time to make amends.

No matter how they tried to communicate or compensate, the little one, while not resistant, gave very little reaction.

Occasionally, the Aoni couple had to admit that Nemo seemed to trust the butler more than he trusted them.

"York... I always feel that the little one doesn't love us at all; he doesn't even ask if we encountered any danger while we were out, or if we were tired."

Mrs. Aoni sighed, looking at her husband with a sense of being deeply hurt.

"Aoni, every demon has a different personality; perhaps Nemo is just naturally reclusive and doesn't like to talk."

York, the husband with a slightly softer personality, tried to comfort his wife.

The goat-bearded butler listened to all of this from behind, wanting to say something, but in the end, he didn't dare to speak.

Perhaps it was just like that piggy bank on Master Nemo's bedside table.

If nothing had ever been deposited into it, how could anything ever be taken out...

And the coal ball, huddled motionless in the corner, watched his parents leave until they had disappeared for a long time, before finally turning quietly toward the children's phone watch beside him.

His little tail swung back and forth like a pendulum, following the countdown on the watch.

Snow Cub?

"Chium?"

Silently reciting the syllables of "Xueyan" that he had heard Lu Jie call out when logging off, the coal ball tried to imitate the pronunciation for the first time, but as expected, he failed.

"No, Snow Cub, for a second there, I felt like you were glowing; it looked really good."

Lu Jie rubbed his eyes on the spot, suspecting he had been playing on his phone too much.

He had always known Xueyan was good-looking, but just now, it was magically as if there was a charm that made it impossible to look away.

Hearing this, Xueyan touched his face silently: "But I'm not a lightbulb, how could I be magically glowing?"

"That makes sense too..."

Hearing this, Lu Jie couldn't help but feel that his eyes had played tricks on him.

Although that night, Xueyan, lying in bed, stared at the game app that was undergoing a forced update, his mind involuntarily recalling the things he had encountered in the game over the past few days.

Despite successfully owning his first fluffy little coal ball, this game was indeed a bit too magical; otherwise, how could it make him feel the texture of the fluff?

Xueyan tried searching for the keyword "Game 'Demon World'" to see if he could retrieve any special information.

The results he found showed nothing unusual.

The encyclopedia stated that "Demon World" was an interactive game designed and developed by a small niche foreign game startup team.

Yet, such an obscure, niche team had actually managed to secure investment from the Mosheng Group, thereby gradually promoting it to major regions around the world.

Regarding the behemoth that was the Mosheng Group, even a college student like Xueyan knew it was a large multinational corporation involved in various fields.

It was just that this game was really quite niche domestically; clicking into the desolate comment section, there were only a few scattered one-star reviews, complaining about it being a trash game that crashed or exited immediately.

Fortunately, Xueyan hadn't encountered that situation.

He figured it was just a marginal investment project, so it wasn't taken very seriously?

Thinking that he had to get up at 5 o'clock tomorrow to go sell peaches, it would be best to go to sleep early tonight.

Anyway, no matter how strange this game was, the appearance of the coal ball did give Xueyan a sense of healing, as if he had been charmed by something cute.

Thinking about these things in a daze, Xueyan closed his phone and drifted off to sleep without realizing it.

The moon outside the window quietly cast its clear radiance, softly illuminating the lush vegetation in the countryside.

And at this very moment, in a manor in a foreign country across the ocean, the moonlight was cold outside the tall arched floor-to-ceiling windows, while a warm yellow glass desk lamp was lit in the cub's bedroom.

The coal ball, who had been forcibly logged out, was curled up on a small velvet cushion to the side.

The only difference from the game was probably the children's phone watch hanging around the little one's "neck."

"Chium?"

With the game's two-way forced logout, the coal ball opened his round, big eyes, still feeling somewhat dazed.

After confirming he was safe, he kept trying to sniff the fur on his body.

He was trying to find that faint scent of peach body wash.

He could even recall the feeling of his fur being gently combed and his head being rubbed by fingers.

Moreover, the forced logout after the abnormal update of the "Demon World" game had now triggered a massive wave among hidden demon groups all over the world.

"Wait, I know, it's that song! The one Lu Li wrote himself, posted on Weibo, and later didn't include in the group's album!"

She finally remembered where she had seen it: Lu Li's Weibo!

During a vacation at the time, Lu Li had uncharacteristically posted several blog posts and creative video clips in a row, in which he was clearly polishing a song repeatedly; it was super good!

But for some reason, this song didn't appear on any of the group's albums later.

The most crucial thing was that the little cub hitting the triangle in the video at the time was clearly the same one as the one in front of her—a cute, cream-colored musical mushroom!

It was just that the mushroom, who was shaking and hitting the triangle to the music back then, had worn a pear-shaped hat that covered much of his white hair.

But if Lu Li was the older brother, then who was the brother outside the venue? Could there be several brothers? No, no, wouldn't that mean the other person is also our Lu Li's brother??

Pan Yuanyuan felt as if a massive amount of information had flooded her brain all at once, and it was about to explode.

For Lu Li, the moment Xueyan hummed it softly, he had already realized which song Xueyan was talking about.

And so, a few seconds later, the entire audience saw the Alpha standing under the spotlight slowly curl the corners of his mouth, revealing a rare, extremely relieved and relaxed smile.

It was as if he had brushed away the mist floating on the forest pool, allowing people to see the dark light and shadows moving under the water for the first time.

"That song was indeed not released on the album," Lu Li explained into the microphone, and before the whole audience could feel disappointed, he added: "But I can perform it live today."
chapters.source_text:
受宠若惊的老管家连忙弯腰仔细查看了半天，确信这最新款的幼崽电话手表并没有坏。
更何况这么晚了来敲门其实是为了另一件事：
“对了，尼莫少爷，您看看谁回来了！”
老管家话音刚落，在外雷厉风行此刻却有点紧张的奥妮夫妇正站在门外：“尼莫？今天怎么这么晚还没睡？”
本来还以为今天深夜匆匆回来一趟，只能看见睡着的小家伙了。
没想到尼莫居然还没睡着。
但眼前的幼崽一如从前那样，只是歪头瞥了一眼“啾姆”了一声，便叼着电话手表，摇摇晃晃地飞到了卧室谁也看不见的最高处角落。
顿时让被晾在原地的奥妮夫妇颇为窘迫，哪怕这的确和过去的事情脱不了干系。
当初尼莫一出生就比所有幼崽要沉默许多，但大家以为就是性格使然并没有多想。
等到所有魔发现尼莫的问题后，已经大事不妙了。
因为尼莫不仅始终性格孤僻不愿意接触学习通用语，甚至发育出来的幼翅也存在严重缺憾。
更致命的是，尼莫作为鲁纳家族后裔本该血统传承极强，偏偏翅膀孱弱不善言辞，天赋更是始终未曾觉醒。
这种矛盾反而导致尼莫彻底成为了一个异类。
同为强势血统后裔的幼崽对于尼莫的弱小沉默只会感到冷漠不解。
至于血统传承不如尼莫强势，但个体能力极其出众的幼崽，看见尼莫更是会本能地伺机撕咬，以此抢夺血源魔气。
尼莫抵抗不了被撕咬翅膀却依旧不吭不响，等到被发现的时候裂开的骨头已经畸形愈合了，就此成为了身上一处永远的痕迹。
哪怕事后奥妮夫妇严厉处理了相关人员，却也像是错过了弥补的最佳时期。
无论如何尝试沟通补偿，小家伙虽然不抵触，但给出的反应都极少。
偶尔奥妮夫妇不得不承认，尼莫对管家的信任似乎都比对他们多一些。
“约尔克……我总觉得小家伙根本不爱我们，他甚至不会问问我们俩这次出门有没有遇到危险，辛苦不辛苦。”
奥妮女士叹息了一声，颇受打击地看着丈夫。
“奥妮，每个魔物性格都不一样，或许尼莫就是天性孤僻而已，也不喜欢说话。”
性格稍软一点的丈夫约尔克试图安慰妻子。
山羊胡子管家在背后听着这一切，内心想说些什么，却又最终没敢开口。
或许这就像尼莫少爷床头那只存钱罐。
从来都没有存进去过的话，又怎么可能取得出来呢……
而窝在角落里一动不动的煤球悄悄看着离去的父母直到两人消失不见许久后，最终安静地转向了身边的幼崽电话手表。
小尾巴像钟摆一样，随着手表上倒计时来回摆动着。
雪崽？
“啾姆？”
默念着下线时最后听到陆杰喊雪言的那组音节，煤球第一次主动想模仿一下发音，结果不出意料地失败了。
“不是，雪崽，上一秒感觉你身上在发光，特好看。”
陆杰原地揉了揉眼睛，怀疑自己手机玩多了。
自己一直知道雪言长得好看，但是刚刚神奇得像是有种移不开眼的魔力。
闻言雪言默默摸了摸脸：“可我又不是灯泡，怎么可能神奇地在发光。”
“说的得也有道理……”
陆杰听了也忍不住觉得自己眼花了。
虽然这一晚，躺在床上的雪言盯着强制更新中的游戏APP，脑海里的确不自觉地回想这几天游戏里遇到的事情。
尽管成功拥有了第一只毛茸茸小煤球，但这游戏的确有点过于神奇了，否则怎么会让自己能感受到毛茸茸的触感？
雪言试着搜索了一下关键词“游戏《魔界》”，想看看会不会能检索什么一些特殊的信息。
结果搜到的内容没有任何异常。
百科上显示《魔界》是一支国外小众游戏创业团队设计开发的互动游戏。
但这么一个不起眼的小众团队居然成功拿到了摩盛集团投资，从而逐步面向全球各大地区推广了起来。
关于摩盛集团这个庞然大物，就连雪言这样的大学生也知道这是一家大型跨国公司，各类领域都有所涉及。
只不过这游戏在国内真挺小众的，点开冷冷清清的评论区，只有零星几个一星评价，说什么垃圾游戏秒退闪退严重。
好在雪言倒是没有遇到这个情况。
估计也就是个边缘投资项目，所以也不是很受重视？
又想到明天5点还要起床出发去卖桃，今晚还是早点睡觉为妙。
反正不管这游戏怎么古怪，煤球的出现的确让雪言有种被萌到的治愈感。
迷迷糊糊地想着这些事情，关上手机的雪言不知不觉便阖目睡着了。
窗外的月亮却静静地挥洒清辉，柔和地照亮了乡野间的葳蕤草木。
而此时此刻，远在大洋对岸异国的一座庄园内，高大的拱形落地窗外月光泠泠，幼崽卧室却亮着一盏暖黄色的琉璃台灯。
被强制登出的煤球赫然正团在一旁的丝绒小垫子上。
和游戏里唯一不同的大概就是小家伙的“脖子”上挂了一块儿童电话手表。
“啾姆？”
游戏双向强制下线，煤球瞬间睁开圆乎乎的大眼睛尚且有些茫然。
在确认自己安全后，更是一直在努力嗅自己身上的毛毛。
试图寻找那股淡淡的桃子沐浴露味道。
甚至还能回忆起被手指轻轻梳理毛毛揉脑袋的感觉。
并且《魔界》游戏异常更新后的强制登出，此刻同样在世界各地的隐秘魔物群体里引发了轩然巨波。
“等等，我知道了，是那首歌！那首陆黎自己写的，发在微博上后来没加入团队专辑的歌！”
自己终于想起来在哪儿看过了，陆黎的微博！
当时一次假期的时候，陆黎一反常态地连续发布了好几条博文和创作视频片段，里面明显是在反复打磨一首歌曲，超级好听！
但不知道为什么，后来这首歌并没有出现在组合的任意一张专辑里。
最关键的是当时视频里敲三角铁的那只小幼崽，分明跟眼前的这只就是同一只€€€€奶油色的可爱音乐小蘑菇！
只不过当初随着音乐摇晃敲三角铁的小蘑菇，戴上了一顶梨子帽把白色的发丝给遮住了许多。
可如果陆黎是哥哥的话，那场馆外的那个哥哥又是哪个哥哥？难道还有好几个哥哥？不对不对，那对方岂不是也是我们陆黎的哥哥？？
潘媛媛只觉得自己脑子里一时间涌入了大量信息，都有点爆炸了。
对于陆黎来讲，雪言在小声哼出来的那一瞬间，就已经意识到雪言说的是哪一首歌了。
于是几秒后，全场观众就看到站在聚光灯下的Alpha嘴角缓缓勾起，罕见露出了一种极其释然轻松的笑意。
像是拂开了森林潭水上浮动的雾气，第一次被人看见了水下深色的光影浮动。
“那首歌确实没有在专辑里公布。”陆黎拿着话筒解释了一句，在全场失落之前又开口道：“但是今天可以现场弹唱一遍。”
chapters.title: 第142章
第96章 我们两个都要！
chapters.source_text:
昨晚演唱会热搜之后，本来热度和话题度就都双双小爆了一下，尤其是陆黎演唱会上的那段钢琴独奏视频，堪称视听盛宴。
这种作品一年出一首都够粉丝吹上大半年了，结果第二天一早陆黎居然就这么水灵灵地又发布了新作品？
像潘媛媛这样的老粉起床看到博文后的第一反应更是陆黎这样做实在太大胆了吧？
上一首歌的红利才刚刚浮现，远远还没到顶端。
就这么节奏极快地发布新作品，万一不如前一首那样惊艳，反而容易被人质疑的。
经纪人也不提醒一下的吗？
一时间无数人抱着一种或兴奋，或担忧，或看热闹的心情，戳进了陆黎的最新视频链接。
这次的视频陆黎并没有露脸，拍摄的角度也很随意，只能看到坐在钢琴前的上半身以及身后的环境。
不像是家里，倒像是某种奢华酒店摆放钢琴的圆厅，只不过空间极大，也没有其他的宾客。
但Alpha骨节分明的手指落在琴键上的那一瞬间，乐声便像森林里的一捧初雪坠入松枝之上簌簌落下，将所有好奇看向视频画面四周的目光全然聚集到了此处。
该死，又是这熟悉的头痛。
于是几分钟后，原本已经换上睡衣，做好协议下独自一人入睡准备的顾白，诧异地看向了突然被打开大门的卧室。
门外站着的，俨然是脸色冷冰冰的凯撒，
可他不是不想见到自己的吗？
而且协议书上明明规定了只需要外人在场的时候演戏，而不包含私下独处时的内容的……
从来没有恋爱过的顾白几乎是瞬间无措起来。
“来给我弹琴，我想听。”
只是下一秒，凯撒硬邦邦的话语瞬间落地。
原来只是深夜想听自己弹琴了。
这让顾白在松了一口气的同时，又忍不住有些果然如此的无奈。
凯撒这家伙，每次在台下那么准时的出现，是真的单纯很喜欢音乐吧。
对此，顾白几乎是没脾气地被凯撒在深夜带出卧室，来到了钢琴所在的别墅玻璃顶的花园中庭。
顾白很快惊讶地看着眼前这架气势恢宏的钢琴：
“居然是克兰蒂斯！”
chapters.translated_text:
Following the trending topics from last night's concert, the buzz and discussion had both seen a small surge, especially the video of Lu Li's piano solo at the concert, which could be described as an audiovisual feast.

A piece of this caliber would be enough for fans to brag about for over half a year if only one were released a year, yet the very next morning, Lu Li had actually gone and released a new work just like that?

The first reaction of long-time fans like Pan Yuanyuan upon waking up and seeing the post was that Lu Li was being far too bold.

The dividends from the previous song were only just beginning to show and were far from reaching their peak.

To release a new work at such a rapid pace—if it turned out to be less stunning than the previous one, it would easily invite skepticism.

Didn't his manager even bother to remind him?

For a moment, countless people, harboring feelings of excitement, worry, or just wanting to watch the spectacle, clicked on the link to Lu Li's latest video.

In this video, Lu Li did not show his face, and the shooting angle was quite casual; one could only see his upper body as he sat before the piano and the environment behind him.

It didn't look like a home, but rather a rotunda in some luxury hotel where a piano was placed, only the space was enormous and there were no other guests.

But the moment the Alpha's well-defined fingers landed on the keys, the music fell like a handful of fresh snow in a forest landing upon pine branches, rustling down, drawing all eyes that had been curiously scanning the surroundings of the video frame directly to this spot.

Damn it, this familiar headache again.

And so, a few minutes later, Gu Bai, who had already changed into his pajamas and prepared to sleep alone as per the agreement, looked in surprise at the bedroom door that had suddenly been pushed open.

Standing outside the door was none other than Caesar, his expression icy cold.

But didn't he not want to see him?

Besides, the agreement clearly stipulated that they only needed to act when others were present, and did not include any requirements for when they were alone in private...

Having never been in a relationship before, Gu Bai was almost instantly at a loss.

"Come play the piano for me; I want to listen."

But the very next second, Caesar's stiff words landed abruptly.

So, he just wanted to hear him play the piano in the middle of the night.

While this made Gu Bai heave a sigh of relief, he couldn't help but feel a sense of helpless "as expected."

This guy Caesar, appearing so punctually off-stage every time—he must truly just love music.

With that thought, Gu Bai, having almost no temper, was led out of the bedroom by Caesar in the dead of night to the villa's glass-roofed garden atrium where the piano was located.

Gu Bai quickly looked at the magnificent piano before him in astonishment:

"It's actually a Clantis!"

For anyone passionate about music, this piano is undoubtedly a magnificent work of art with unparalleled appeal.

It is just that it is incredibly expensive and extremely rare; it is simply not something an ordinary person could ever touch.

At this moment, Caesar watched Gu Bai, who couldn't help but walk forward to bow his head and admire the piano, and the corners of his mouth couldn't help but curl up triumphantly.

This guy really likes this gift.

In fact, this was something Caesar had arranged for people to go to the music holy land, Planet August, a long time ago, specifically to be transported back on a dedicated starship.

Ever since he accidentally saw Gu Bai in the backstage area holding a piano magazine, staring at the photo of this piano on the front page with bright eyes, Caesar had been planning this.

But no matter how he thought about it, just giving it to him directly seemed a bit too strange.

It would feel as if he were deliberately trying to curry favor with the other person.

For the always proud and arrogant Caesar, this was undoubtedly an unacceptable thing!

So, after the piano was transported back, it had just been sitting at home, never sent out.

It was just that after being ordered and brought back, it sat here monotonously day and night, making Caesar feel every time he passed by that there seemed to be one person missing beside the piano. If version 1.0 was a sense of pure, lighthearted joy, then version 2.0 was like trying to prove something; while using the previous framework, the musical style changed completely.

Not only was there an added sense of stimulation from constant variations, it quietly enticed every listener to immerse themselves fully in the music.

Just when the listeners were fully engaged and nodding along to the beat, the fingertips sliding and tapping rapidly on the Alpha keys would occasionally bring a string of unexpected staccato notes, giving a sense of mischievous, game-like fun.

But did Lu Li notice that his mood at this moment was also exceptionally good?

It was like playing some kind of musical game with the audience. And it even vaguely carried a kind of... a kind of unyielding, openly attention-grabbing flamboyance.

Pan Yuanyuan, wearing headphones, listened to the whole song in a daze, and then inexplicably felt her face heat up, as if she had heard that seemingly casual but actually extremely concerned question from Lu Li in her ear.

But clearly, the piece from last night was also Lu Li's work. What is the point of spending a whole night writing another variation with a completely different style to compete against himself? And having to burn a manuscript after voting is just too extravagant and wasteful!

System 444 quietly reminded him, although it didn't know why Lu Li was unwilling to play it for Xue Yan instead.

Third Brother 2.0 going crazy last night, writing manuscripts overnight and posting them online to battle himself, is actually a good thing from the perspective of the original book.

It means that from now on, fans and the outside world will consciously discover: So Lu Li can create two completely different styles of work!

The brilliance lies in the fact that this 2.0 piece is adapted on the original basis; the two styles are harmonious but different, each with its own unique characteristics, and it is clear they come from the same person.

And such small details of awkward couple interactions are almost everywhere in this latest chapter of the book.

If you are willing to dig into it, you can find so many sweet details of Caesar being unconsciously concerned and suspicious while being stubborn to the death!

But this part of the writing is precisely the most baffling point in the eyes of interstellar readers.

Because it is clearly visible that the author is writing about all the details of Caesar hating and resisting his partner, Gu Bai.

But these details...

Why is it not heartbreaking at all, and instead, the more they read, the sweeter it gets!?

How can such a fake marriage make people want to smile like an auntie more than many real marriages in books where the protagonists finally get together after hundreds of chapters?

This is simply too unscientific and too unreasonable!

And this point is also very hard for the streamer Brand, who stays up late to follow the updates, to understand.

Brand is considered a first-tier streamer in the cultural and entertainment field, and the volume of his live broadcast room can be said to be quite large.

With the word count and popularity of the book "Agreement Marriage," even if this book is currently the No. 1 on the Universal Reading New Star List, it is absolutely impossible for a big streamer like Brand to select it for his recommended book column.

Not to mention that this new author was so outrageous that he stopped updating for a full five days on the day the book started.

This kind of "pigeon" author definitely belongs to the level of being directly blacklisted and avoided by book recommendation columns.

So the reason why Brand streamed this book was naturally not because he put it in the recommended book column.

It was put in the #Shocking! A Collection of 100 Bizarre and Shocking Books# roast and content column.

Of course, there is also a bit of Brand's own selfishness in this.

Because he also fell into the trap while browsing the list for live streaming material!

It’s just that Brand himself never thought that he just wanted to share a bizarre new book by a "pigeon king" author with his readers.

No matter what, tricking a wave of readers into falling into the trap just like he did would surely make for surprisingly good live broadcast effects.

Unexpectedly, just as he was streaming on time at 8 o'clock last night, the book "Agreement Marriage" on Universal Reading actually resumed updates.

So Brand directly posted the book page link, and without further ado, started reading the latest updates with the readers in the live broadcast room.

However, it was this temporary move that caused the popularity of the live broadcast room to soar once again.

Because the fans who were reading along with Brand suddenly discovered that the book "Agreement Marriage" was actually so suitable for a group of people to read together.

Almost every line they read, whether it was a detail Brand caught or a detail he missed, could be collectively dug out by everyone in the live broadcast room.

He thought the beginning of this chapter's update would be heartbreaking, but instead, it was inexplicably sweet to the point of making his scalp tingle.

It’s much better than the situation in the later stages of the original book where the two personalities grew further apart, leading to a stronger sense of stylistic fragmentation.

It’s just that just as Xue Yan was about to take action, he was held down by his eldest brother.

"Xue Yan, didn't your teacher Jiang Xian teach you that children should do their own things? Let Third Brother clean it up himself before going to eat."

This made Xue Yan blink his eyes in embarrassment. Teacher Jiang Xian did indeed teach this sentence, but he wanted to help his brother clean it up.

"I'll clean it up myself."

The originally silent Lu Li finally spoke.

He threw things around just because he didn't care.

But if Xue Yan wanted to collect these manuscripts of his, then he would just save every single one of them; in the future, he could even let the little guy use them to fold paper airplanes.

It’s just that when Lu Li finished collecting them, he looked at the two scores held in Lu Jing's hand, and the atmosphere was silent for a moment.

"How about letting me see these two new song scores first?" Lu Jing asked, deliberately raising her eyebrows.

"No." Lu Li refused without the slightest hesitation.

However, the more Caesar thought about it, the more convinced he was that Gu Bai probably really needed the money, which was why he finally agreed to his marriage contract.

After all, no matter how much Gu Bai tried to hide it, when he handed over the card with one million in it before the wedding, the look of relief on the other person's face was something Caesar could not ignore no matter what.

How could he be like this?

Could it be that without this one million as a reward, marrying him was so unacceptable?

Am I really that bad!?

Caesar, who had always been full of pride in himself, felt annoyed and suspicious of himself for the first time in his life.

And this awkward monologue of Caesar also successfully caused the expressions of the interstellar readers to twist again.

"Heavens, I've been praying for the past few days while waiting for the update that Caesar would recall things properly, hoping he would realize that Gu Bai is not that kind of person at all... and this guy's brain came up with this after racking his brains?"

Brand felt like he couldn't even eat dinner tonight.

The person was clearly relieved just because his mother's medical expenses were settled, how did that turn into him disliking you!?

It is truly not a grievance that you don't have a wife with this brain of yours!

Just at this moment when the readers in the bullet comments were agitated and even a bit desperate, the plot in the next second took a critical turn again.

After all, a BE (Bad Ending) is definitely not going to happen. The so-called "pulling" and "tugging" must involve both.

Previously, Lu Xue Yan had already laid the groundwork in the article that Caesar suffered from mental power manic-depressive disorder.

And this kind of pain could only be relieved by Gu Bai's piano music.

Isn't this where the use comes in?

So the interstellar readers who were screaming and wailing that there was no hope for an HE (Happy Ending) a second ago, closed their mouths and widened their eyes the next second after reading the latest plot.

The article took a dramatic turn; this stubborn, tsundere demon Caesar actually appeared at the bedroom door on his wedding night for the first time in history.

And Gu Bai had already changed into his pajamas, his face instantly looking at Caesar at the door in a daze and at a loss.

After all, the agreement did not include private time alone! Lu Jing clicked her tongue, but didn't force him to keep it, instead watching Lu Li organize and clip all the manuscripts.

Although just as Lu Li took back the manuscripts and put them away, and the whole family went downstairs to eat, Lu Jing leaned over to Xue Yan's side and asked quietly: "What should we do? The original evidence was taken away by this guy playing dirty. Does this count as one time?"

Xue Yan stared at his sister, finding that this really seemed to be the first time Third Brother had been caught.

After struggling for a while, Xue Yan nodded, feeling that it should count.

Lu Jing, who was originally a bit uncertain, laughed when she saw Xue Yan's little expression: "Then if we catch Third Brother three times, we'll send him to see a doctor. What does Xue Yan think?"

The sister's tone was like she was discussing it with Xue Yan, the little referee.

So after thinking about it, Xue Yan couldn't help but learn from his sister's way, looking up with curved eyes and saying:

"Xue Yan also thinks it's okay!"

Watching this scene, Lu Jing was silent for a few seconds, but still couldn't help reaching out to hug him and kiss him hard.

Xue Yan also obediently let his sister kiss his cheek, and this scene was just seen by their father who walked over.

"Hugging and kissing early in the morning again? If Third Brother and the others see this, they'll want to kiss too, then are we still going to eat!?"

Lu Ting frowned, very dissatisfied.

In fact, Lu Ting hated two types of people in his life: one was those who kissed his precious child indiscriminately, and the other was those who didn't let him kiss his precious child!
chapters.source_text:
对于每一位醉心音乐的人而言，这架钢琴无疑是有着无与伦比吸引力的伟大艺术品。
只是价格不菲且极其罕见，根本不是常人能够触摸到的。
而这一刻的凯撒看着眼前情不自禁走上前去低头欣赏钢琴的顾白，嘴角却忍不住得意上扬起来。
这家伙果然很喜欢这礼物。
实际上，这是凯撒很久之前就安排人去音乐圣地奥古斯特星，特意用专门的星舰运回来的。
早在一次偶然看到顾白在后台拿着钢琴杂志，盯着首页上的这台钢琴照片目光亮晶晶之后，凯撒就一直在谋划着这件事。
但无论怎么想，直接出手送过去的话，都似乎有点太奇怪了。
仿佛自己在刻意讨好对方一样。
这对向来心高气傲的凯撒而言，无疑是一件难以接受的事情！
所以钢琴运回来之后，便一直摆在了家里，根本没有送出去。
只是订购回来后日日夜夜单调地摆在这里，让凯撒每次路过都觉得，钢琴边似乎少了一个人。如果说1.0版本是一种全然的轻灵喜悦感，那么2.0版本就像是为了证明什么一样，在沿用此前大框架的基础上，曲调风格却为之完全一变。
不仅多了一种随时变奏的刺激感，不动声色引诱着每一位听众全神贯注地沉浸乐声之中。
当听众全然投入其中随着节拍颔首之时，Alpha琴键上飞速滑动敲击的指尖又会不时带来一串意料之外的跳音，给人一种游戏般的恶作剧趣味。
但陆黎有发现他这一刻的心情同样极好吗？
就像在跟听众玩着某种乐曲游戏一样。而且还隐约带着一种……一种在不甘示弱、公然抢夺注意力的张扬肆意
戴着耳机的潘媛媛呆呆地听完整首歌，便莫名脸热地像是在耳畔听到了陆黎这么一句看似漫不经心、实则极其在意问话。
可是明明昨晚那首也是陆黎的作品，花一晚上再写一首风格截然不同的变奏自己跟自己打擂台，到底有什么意义？　而且投完票就必须烧掉一首的稿子，这也太奢侈，太浪费了吧！
系统444倒是悄悄提醒了一句，虽然不知道为什么陆黎反而不愿意弹给雪言听。
三哥2.0昨晚发疯连夜写稿发到网上自己BATTLE自己，从原著角度来看倒是好事一件。
等于说从现在开始，就让粉丝和外界有意识地发现：原来陆黎可以创作两种截然不同风格的作品！
妙在这曲子2.0还是在原来基础上改编的，两种风格和而不同，各有各的的特色所在，又能看得出来出自一人之手。
而诸如此类的情侣变扭互动小细节，在书中这章最新更新里几乎比比皆是。
如果愿意磕着挖的话，简直能发现好多凯撒一边不自觉的在意狐疑，又一边往死里嘴硬的细节糖！
但这一部分行文在星际读者眼里，恰恰最为是百思不得其解的一点。
因为明明看得出来，作者是在写凯撒讨厌、抗拒自己伴侣顾白的各种细节。
可这些细节……
他怎么就是一点都不虐心，甚至反而越读，他特喵的越甜！？
就这么一个假结婚，居然比起很多写了几百章主角双方终于修成正果的真结婚都让人忍不住姨母笑？
这实在是太不科学，太不合理了！
而这一点对于熬夜追更新的主播白兰德而言，同样非常想不通。
白兰德算是文娱领域第一梯队的主播，直播间的体量也可以说相当的大。
以《协议婚约》这本书的字数和人气，就算这本书是目前的寰宇阅读新星榜no.1，那也是绝无可能被大主播白兰德选入推荐书目栏目的。
更别提这新人作者还离谱到开文当天直接断更了整整五天。
这种鸽子作者对于推书栏目而言，绝对属于可以直接拉黑敬谢不敏的地步。
所以白兰德之所以会直播这本书，自然也不是放在了推荐书目栏目。
而是放在了#震惊！100本奇葩到震惊的书目大合集#的吐槽整活儿栏目。
当然，这里面也有点白兰德的私心。
因为他也在扫榜找直播素材的过程里，掉坑了！
只是白兰德自己都没有想过，自己明明只是想和读者分享一本鸽王作者的奇葩新书。
无论如何骗一波读者和自己一样掉坑的快乐，肯定直播节目效果好的出奇。
万万没想到的是，就在昨晚8点自己准时直播，寰宇阅读下的《协议婚约》这本书，居然恢复更新了。
于是白兰德直接挂上书页链接，一不做二不休，跟着直播间的读者们一起读起了最新更新。
然而就是这么一个临时举动让直播间的人气再一次飞升了。
因为跟着白兰德一起读书的粉丝们突然发现，《协议婚约》这本书原来这么适合一群人一起挤着读。
几乎是读到任何一行字，无论是白兰德磕到了的细节，又或者没有磕到的细节糖，全都能被直播间的大家集结众力地全部扣出来。
本以为这章更新的开头会很虐心虐肺，却反而莫名其妙读得酸甜到头皮发麻。
比原著后期两种人格渐行渐远，导致风格割裂感更强的情况可好太多了。
只不过雪言刚想动手，就被大哥按住了。
“雪言，你们姜娴老师没教过，小朋友都要自己的事情自己干吗？让老三他自己收拾好了去吃饭。”
这让雪言为难地眨巴眨巴眼睛，姜娴老师确实教过这句话，可是自己想帮哥哥收起来。
“我自己收拾就好。”
原本沉默不语的陆黎终于出声了。
自己乱扔只是因为不在意。
但如果雪言想要收集自己的这些稿纸，那自己就一张不落地存起来就是了，将来给小家伙拿去折纸飞机玩都可以。
只不过陆黎收到最后，看向了陆菁手里捏着的两份谱子，气氛一时间有点沉默。
“这两份新歌的谱子先给我看看怎么样？”陆菁故意挑眉问道。
“不行。”陆黎没有丝毫犹豫地拒绝了。
然而凯撒越细想越确信，顾白恐怕是真的很需要这笔钱，所以才最终答应了自己的婚约。
毕竟哪怕顾白再怎么掩饰，婚礼前自己将那张存了一百万的卡递过去的时候，对方如释重负的表情，无论如何都让凯撒无法忽视。
他怎么能这样？
难道没有这一百万作为报酬，跟自己结婚就这么难以接受？
自己真的就这么糟糕吗！？
向来对自己骄傲十足的凯撒，生平第一次对自己产生了懊恼的怀疑。】
而凯撒的这一段变扭独白，也成功再度让星际读者们的表情都跟着扭曲了起来。
“苍天，我等更新的这几天一直祈祷凯撒能好好回忆一下，希望他醒悟过来顾白根本不是那种人……结果这家伙的脑子苦思冥想就想出个这？”
白兰德感觉今晚连晚饭都吃不下去了。
人家如释重负明明只是因为妈妈的医药费有着落了，怎么就成了嫌弃你呢！？
你这脑子没有脑婆也真的不冤枉！
就在弹幕读者群情激奋甚至有些绝望的这一刻，下一秒的剧情却再度发生了关键性的转折。
毕竟BE是肯定不会BE的，所谓“拉扯”“拉扯”，那必然既有拉，也有扯。
之前陆雪言可是文章里早早埋下了伏笔，凯撒这家伙患有精神力躁郁症。
而这种疼痛，只有顾白的琴声可以缓解。
用处这不就来了吗？
于是前一秒还在尖叫哀嚎HE无望的星际读者们，下一秒读到最新剧情后，便瞬间闭上嘴巴瞪圆了双眼。
文章里几乎是峰回路转，凯撒这嘴硬傲娇狂魔，居然破天荒地主动在新婚夜出现在了卧室门口。
而顾白此刻早已换好了睡衣，脸色瞬间茫然无措地看向了门前的凯撒。
毕竟协议里面可完全没有包括私下独处这一项！陆菁啧了一声，倒也没硬是扣下来，而是看着陆黎将稿子尽数整理夹好了。
虽然就在陆黎拿回稿子收起来，全家一起下楼吃饭的时候，陆菁俯身凑在雪言身侧悄悄问了一句：“怎么办，证据原件被这家伙耍赖拿走了，这次算不算一次？”
雪言瞪大眼睛看向姐姐，发现这好像真的是三哥被捉到了一次。
纠结了一会儿，雪言点了点头，觉得还是算的。
原本其实还有点不确定的陆菁，看着雪言这幅小表情，倒是笑了一声：“那要是抓到老三三次，我们就把这家伙送去看医生，雪言觉得怎么样？”
姐姐的语气就像是在跟雪言这位小裁判商量一样。
于是思考了一下后，雪言也忍不住学着姐姐的方式，抬头眉眼弯弯说道：
“雪言也觉得可以！”
看着这一幕的陆菁硬是沉默了几秒，还是没忍住伸手抱进怀里狠狠亲了一口。
雪言也乖乖地被姐姐亲了一下脸颊，这一幕刚好被走过来的老爸看见了。
“这一大早的又抱着亲，马上被老三他们看见了也要亲，那还吃不吃饭了！？”
陆霆蹙眉很是不满。
事实上，陆霆这辈子最讨厌两种人，一种是乱亲自家乖崽的人，另一种就是不让自己亲自家乖崽的人！
