chapters.translated_text:
"Old San and the others want to kiss her too?" Lu Jing sneered, thinking it was clearly her dad who wanted to do it himself but was too embarrassed to admit it.

So, right in front of her dad, Lu Jing insisted on hugging Xueyan again and kissing her on the other cheek; it smelled sweet from the face cream she had just applied that morning.

For the first time, Lu Jing felt that the pile of face creams Old San had were actually pretty good—they even made kissing her feel sweeter.

"Let's go, come eat with big sister." After kissing her, Lu Jing stood up, helped Xueyan put on her beloved little hat, and then took her by the hand toward the dining room.

Xueyan, holding her big sister's hand, kept looking back at her father, whose face had turned dark, thinking that kissing didn't seem to conflict with eating after all.

These little brats, one after another, are simply acting recklessly!

The key is that Xueyan just indulges them; she doesn't even know how to refuse!

The problem is, what if she gets used to being kissed at home and starts letting people outside the family kiss her too? What if my precious child gets used to being kissed and doesn't know how to dodge!?
chapters.source_text:
什么老三他们也想亲？陆菁冷笑一声，觉得分明就是老爸自己想这么干又抹不开面子。
于是当着老爸的面，陆菁硬是又抱着雪言给另外半边脸蛋也亲了一下，早上刚擦过面霜香香的。
陆菁第一次觉得老三那堆面霜好像是不错，亲起来还变甜了。
“走了，跟姐姐去吃饭了。”陆菁亲完之后才起身，帮雪言把心爱的小帽子戴好后，就牵着雪言往餐厅出发了。
被姐姐牵着小手的雪言一步三回头地看了看脸色变黑的爸爸，也觉得亲亲好像跟吃饭并不冲突。
这个一个个小兔崽子的，简直就是胡来！
关键雪言还就纵着，也不知道拒绝！
问题是万一在家里被亲习惯了，遇到家外边的人也乱亲，乖崽习惯被亲了不知道躲开怎么办！？

陆霆觉得这是一个很严肃的问题，值得这趟回去之后召开一场家庭会议，严格规定不许乱亲幼崽的脸蛋，全家所有人都必须按照年龄来配额！
该死，果然又是这本古怪的未签约新书€€€€！
技术部调查你们作者存稿箱分明就是个空的好吧？关我们土豆服务器什么事！[抓狂.jpg]
而这沸腾着的一切，都随着一道猝不及防的“更新提示”在千千万万个光脑上的弹出震动，而瞬间呈现出了死一般的寂静。
更新提示？
这作者居然还敢回来冒泡了？
于是前一秒还热火朝天的评论区和投诉热线，这一刻仿佛突然空了。
一个人都没有了。
而最新更新的单章点击量，则以一种极为恐怖的速度暴增了起来。
被压抑了整整五天的恐怖读者流量，几乎瞬间涌入其中。
不负众望的是，可以说从读到更新的第一行字起，星际读者们便久违感受到了一种熟悉的滋味。
一种完全不用费力去理解什么模糊意识流，故事剧情便库库往脑子里跑，填满每一寸神经的轻松阅读快乐体验。
实在是太酸爽了。
等了整整五天，大家期待的就是这种感觉！
在前文开头几万字阴差阳错的误会下，顾白和凯撒两个人最终签订协议举办了婚礼。
然而在外人看来本该甜蜜的婚后生活，实际上一旦到了两个人独处的时刻，气氛便会变得极为微妙。而另外一边，将稿子放回房间的陆黎再度睁眼，就愣怔地发现自己手机上的消息已经爆了？
经纪人洪燕甚至一口气打了十几个未接来电。
“天啊，陆黎，你终于接电话了，公司这边都快急死了，你突然搞这种热点话题，怎么也不联系公司配合宣传一下？现在要继续推广的话……”
电话刚一接通，经纪人洪燕就连珠炮一样地说起来了话，生怕错过这波千载难逢的热度。
什么热点话题？什么推广宣传？
陆黎内心浮现一种不祥的预感，打开手机消息999+的微博一看自己账号上的最新博文，脸色都快罕见红温了。
现在删除可以吗？就当自己从来没有发过这种微博！“可是裴朔少爷的命令，小少爷您没有权限阻止的吧。”
穆尼尔秘书一时间都有些难办了。
“虽然裴朔少爷正在处理紧急公务，刚刚联系了几次都没有接通。”
“那是谁吩咐养这个鱼缸的？”
裴炎脑子迅速运转起来。
表哥不同意，那说明就说明安排鱼缸的另有其人！
“呃，是裴老将军，不过这会儿也不在中央星系，每年七八月份都会去东海湾疗养区度假的，您也知道的。”
就在裴炎听到穆尼尔解释的这一句话时，瞬间眼睛亮了。
“我要给祖父打电话！我想他了！”
至于已经睡过去的陆雪言完全没有想到的是，自己这一觉便昏迷了整整五天。
而这本只发了一个火葬场开头刮起一阵腥风血雨的《协议婚约》，自然也就随之断更了整整五天！
简直就像是在刻意炫技一样，还搞什么投票擂台。
只不过犹豫很久，陆黎的手指还是从删除键上，移动到了播放键上。
这还是那个自己第一次拍摄这种音乐视频，陆黎确实有点好奇那个自己的音乐风格会是什么样的。
随着音乐声响起，陆黎的目光也逐渐变得复杂，甚至下意识随着节拍敲击起了指节。
对此客服惯例询问：“十分抱歉，虽然我们的服务器肯定不是土豆做的，但请问您小说的信息是？我们这边方便登记一下。”
下一秒便传来了回应：而其中情绪更着急点的，已经直接怀疑起陆雪言的身份和动机了
甚至就连寰宇阅读APP的总部，都已经被这事情给惊动了。
因为在这五天里，客服部几乎收到了无数相同的投诉信息。自己必须得赶紧处理一下这波黑化值。
实际上，五天过后的评论区，也的确可以说相当混乱了。
新入坑的读者在各种渠道听说了这本书，于是或好奇或无聊地点了进来。
一读完简直宇宙观崩塌。
一如五天前第一批掉坑的那批读者一样，大脑都在爆炸。
叽叽喳喳像小鸟一样地全部聚集在评论区讨论着剧情和两位主角。
至于入坑等了五天的老读者，则已经不屑于加入新人的队伍了，而是都在疯狂讨论为什么迟迟没有更新。
作者人是心脏受不了所以决定封笔了？
还是出现了什么意外，又或者是账号密码给忘了？
但是无论怎么说，断更五天都实在令人无法接受！
客服热线都快被这么一撮锲而不舍的读者给打爆了！
直播间的星际网友们在大为震惊之下，无论之前是不是小说阅读爱好者，几乎都感受到了这股酸甜味剧情的奇妙之处。
明明想要忽视顾白，但是一旦有外人接近搭讪，凯撒这家伙却总是忍不住第一个冲上去打断。
张口讽刺顾白不会品酒，却偏偏顺理成章替顾白挡掉了全部的劝酒，反而转手扔给顾白一杯果汁。
你这到底是喜欢，还是不喜欢？
我们越读，怎么反而越甜呢！
以至于有直播间的粉丝第一次发现，原来看小说，可以这么有意思！？
诸如此类的大误解留言，时不时就在白兰德直播间的公屏上飘过。
以至于白兰德欲言又止。
毕竟你们这波刚进直播间的新粉丝，是不是根本没有来得及补上开头“协议婚约”的大前提？
真误以为这是本小情侣谈恋爱暧昧期的小甜文了！？
直播就是这点不好。
观众总是随时随地会流动着进来的，以至于很难从头到尾地了解事情真相。
而目前为止更新的前面这几段内容又刚好全是酸甜口的磕糖内容。
这波读者抱着这么盲目的错误思想去下载寰宇阅读APP收藏新书追更，读完了真的不会给自己这个主播寄刀片吗……
只是内心隐约意识到不对劲，白兰德的眼睛却又迅速被下一波剧情转折给吸引过去了。
毕竟脑子完全不够一心两用啊。
直到屏幕上的指尖悬停在琴键之上，最后一道尾音也缓缓落幕，陆黎才如梦初醒地看向了手里的手机。
Alpha陷入了罕见的沉思。
难道这真的是自己内心深处的另一面？甚至有那么一点……邪恶？
“陆黎？陆黎你有在听我讲话吗！”
经纪人洪燕说了老半天，却发现陆黎那边传来了音乐声，一时间怀疑陆黎这大少爷是不是根本没有听自己的计划！
“我无所谓。”
这一次的陆黎犹豫片刻，倒也没再坚持删除这些博文和视频。
尽管如今热度高到随便一划屏幕，就能看见网络上不少昨天演唱会上的照片。
还有雪言戴着那顶梨子帽的照片？
“为什么这么多雪言戴帽子的照片。”
陆黎一边保存各种角度的可爱照片，一边狐疑问道。
以至于人前的顾白不得不逐渐学会用微笑遮掩低落的情绪。
不过这也没有错。
一个为了一百万的报酬而轻率改口，答应下所谓协议婚约的家伙，大概也并不会有人会觉得对方值得尊重和喜欢吧。
夜晚，独自一人呆在宽阔空旷卧室里的顾白，看向了窗外的繁星。
婚约期限只有一年。
一年后这一切大概就彻底结束了。
某种意义上，自己的确应该很感谢凯撒的出现和到来。
毕竟如果没有凯撒的这份协议，妈妈这会应该已经去世了，而自己根本无力承担那么高昂的医疗费用。
只是自己曾经期待过某种好感，从自己答应这份婚约换取母亲医药费的那一刻，大概就再也不可能得到了。
像自己这样的家伙，或许本来就不该有那些不切实际的梦。】
而这么一截微妙的心理叙述，简直看得白兰德想要狠狠拍桌，却又偏偏像是被一只无形的大手给掐住了激动点。
那就是原来凯撒这家伙不是单相思？
原来顾白小天使同样朦朦胧胧心动过！
但是偏偏在残酷邪恶的作者笔下，读者刚刚得知顾白曾经同样对凯撒抱有好感的时候，顾白内心却又产生了完全相反的错误观点。
甚至还因为自己为了母亲医药费答应凯撒婚约，而在凯撒面前产生了自卑的心理。
这一幕简直让白兰德恨不得直接穿进书里，一把抱住顾白大声吼出真相：
崽儿，那家伙分明超爱的啊！他只是嘴巴又臭又硬不肯承认而已€€€€！
你怎么就看不出来呢！？
而下一秒文章笔锋一转，视角也落在了凯撒身上。“啊？你是从昨晚开始就没上网吗，因为这帽子周边也爆了啊！”
洪燕确信陆黎是真的一晚上都在写歌半点没上网了。
昨晚除了陆黎的歌曲最爆以外，那就属雪言头顶上的那顶小梨帽最火了，不少圈外人看见幼崽的照片都被萌得到处询问同款怎么买。
虽然洪燕一度觉得，这些人看中的不是帽子本身，而是戴着小帽子的幼崽整体。但买同款帽子可不代表拥有同款幼崽！
再说一个悲伤的消息，那就是雪言带火的这顶小帽子的话题数据，甚至比付尧、夏觉他们三个人加起来的话题都多……
chapters.translated_text:
Lu Ting felt this was a very serious issue, one worth calling a family meeting about once they returned, to strictly forbid anyone from kissing the cub's cheeks randomly; everyone in the family must have a quota based on their age!

Damn it, of course it’s this bizarre, unsigned new book again—!

The technical department clearly investigated and your author's draft box is completely empty, okay? What does that have to do with our potato servers! [Rage.jpg]

Yet, all this boiling chaos instantly fell into a deathly silence as an unexpected "update notification" popped up and vibrated on millions of optical computers.

An update notification?

This author actually dared to show their face again?

And so, the comment section and complaint hotlines that were red-hot just a second ago suddenly seemed empty.

There wasn't a single person left.

Meanwhile, the click count for the latest chapter surged at a terrifying speed.

The massive reader traffic that had been suppressed for five whole days poured in almost instantly.

Living up to expectations, one could say that from the very first line of the update, the interstellar readers felt a long-lost, familiar taste.

It was the effortless joy of reading, where you didn't have to struggle to understand some vague stream of consciousness, and the plot just flowed straight into your brain, filling every nerve.

It was simply too satisfying.

After waiting for five whole days, this was exactly the feeling everyone had been looking forward to!

Under the misunderstandings caused by a series of coincidences in the first few tens of thousands of words, Gu Bai and Caesar finally signed an agreement and held a wedding.

However, in the eyes of outsiders, their married life should have been sweet, but in reality, whenever they were alone, the atmosphere would become extremely subtle. On the other side, Lu Li, who had just put the manuscript back in his room, opened his eyes again and was stunned to find that the messages on his phone had exploded.

His manager, Hong Yan, had even made over a dozen missed calls in one go.

"Oh my god, Lu Li, you finally answered! The company is dying of anxiety. You suddenly created such a hot topic, why didn't you contact the company to coordinate the promotion? If we want to continue promoting it now..."

As soon as the call connected, his manager, Hong Yan, started talking like a machine gun, afraid of missing out on this once-in-a-lifetime wave of popularity.

What hot topic? What promotion?

A foreboding feeling rose in Lu Li's heart. He opened his phone to see 999+ messages on Weibo and checked the latest post on his own account; his face turned red with a rare embarrassment.

Is it okay to delete it now? Just pretend I never posted this Weibo! "But Young Master Pei Shuo's order, you don't have the authority to stop it, Young Master."

Secretary Munier found himself in a difficult position for a moment.

"Although Young Master Pei Shuo is currently handling urgent official business and hasn't answered after several attempts to contact him."

"Then who ordered this fish tank to be kept?"

Pei Yan's brain started racing.

If his cousin didn't agree, that meant someone else had arranged the fish tank!

"Uh, it was Old General Pei, but he isn't in the Central Galaxy right now. He goes to the East Sea Bay recuperation area for vacation every July and August, as you know."

The moment Pei Yan heard Munier's explanation, his eyes lit up instantly.

"I want to call Grandfather! I miss him!"

As for Lu Xueyan, who had already fallen asleep, he had no idea that this nap had left him in a coma for five whole days.

And "Agreement Marriage," which had only released a "crematorium-style" beginning that stirred up a storm, had naturally stopped updating for those same five days!

It was almost as if they were deliberately showing off, setting up some kind of voting arena.

But after hesitating for a long time, Lu Li's finger moved from the delete button to the play button.

This was the first time he had filmed a music video like this, and Lu Li was indeed a bit curious about what his own musical style would be like.

As the music started, Lu Li's expression gradually became complex, and he even subconsciously tapped his knuckles to the beat.

To this, customer service asked the usual question: "I am very sorry, although our servers are definitely not made of potatoes, may I ask for the information about your novel? It would be convenient for us to register it."

The next second, a response came: And those who were more anxious had already begun to directly suspect Lu Xueyan's identity and motives.

Even the headquarters of the Huanyu Reading App had been alarmed by this matter.

Because in these five days, the customer service department had received countless identical complaints. He had to deal with this wave of "darkening value" immediately.

In fact, the comment section after five days could indeed be called quite chaotic.

New readers who had heard about this book through various channels clicked in, either out of curiosity or boredom.

Once they finished reading, their worldview simply collapsed.

Just like the first batch of readers who fell into the trap five days ago, their brains were exploding.

They gathered in the comment section, chattering like little birds, discussing the plot and the two protagonists.

As for the old readers who had been waiting for five days, they were already too proud to join the newcomers, and were instead frantically discussing why there hadn't been an update.

Did the author's heart give out, so they decided to quit writing?

Or did some accident happen, or did they forget their account password?

But regardless, a five-day hiatus was simply unacceptable!

The customer service hotline was almost blown up by this group of persistent readers!

The interstellar netizens in the live stream were greatly shocked, and regardless of whether they were novel fans before, they almost all felt the wonder of this sweet-and-sour plot.

Clearly wanting to ignore Gu Bai, but whenever an outsider approached to chat, Caesar, that guy, couldn't help but be the first to rush over and interrupt.

He would open his mouth to mock Gu Bai for not knowing how to taste wine, yet he would naturally block all the people trying to force drinks on Gu Bai, and instead hand him a glass of juice.

Do you like him, or do you not like him?

The more we read, why does it get sweeter!

So much so that some fans in the live stream discovered for the first time that reading novels could be this interesting!?

Comments with such misunderstandings floated across the public screen of Brand's live stream from time to time.

Which left Brand speechless.

After all, you new fans who just entered the live stream, did you even have time to catch up on the premise of the "Agreement Marriage" at the beginning?

Did you really mistake this for a sweet little story about a young couple in their ambiguous dating phase!?

That's the downside of live streaming.

The audience is always flowing in and out, making it hard to understand the truth from beginning to end.

And the content updated so far just happened to be all sweet-and-sour "sugar-crushing" material.

If these readers go to download the Huanyu Reading App and follow the new book with such blind, incorrect ideas, won't they send me razor blades after they finish reading it...

Though he vaguely realized something was wrong, Brand's eyes were quickly drawn away by the next plot twist.

After all, his brain wasn't capable of multitasking.

It wasn't until his fingertips hovered over the piano keys on the screen and the final note faded away that Lu Li woke up as if from a dream and looked at the phone in his hand.

The Alpha fell into a rare state of deep thought.

Could this really be another side of his inner self? Even a little bit... evil?

"Lu Li? Lu Li, are you listening to me!"

Manager Hong Yan had been talking for a long time, only to hear music coming from Lu Li's side, and for a moment, he suspected that this young master hadn't listened to his plan at all!

"I don't care."

This time, Lu Li hesitated for a moment, but didn't insist on deleting the posts and videos.

Even though the popularity was so high now that one could see many photos from yesterday's concert just by scrolling through the screen.

And photos of Xueyan wearing that pear hat?

"Why are there so many photos of Xueyan wearing the hat?"

Lu Li asked suspiciously while saving the cute photos from various angles.

So much so that Gu Bai in front of others had to gradually learn to use a smile to cover up his low spirits.

But that wasn't wrong either.

A guy who flippantly changed his mind for a million-dollar reward and agreed to a so-called agreement marriage probably wouldn't be considered worthy of respect or love by anyone.

At night, Gu Bai, alone in the vast and empty bedroom, looked at the stars outside the window.

The marriage contract was only for one year.

After a year, all of this would probably be completely over.

In a sense, he should indeed be very grateful for Caesar's appearance and arrival.

After all, if it weren't for Caesar's agreement, his mother would have passed away by now, and he would have been unable to afford such high medical expenses.

It's just that any affection he once hoped for was probably impossible to obtain from the moment he agreed to this marriage to pay for his mother's medical bills.

A guy like him, perhaps, was never meant to have those unrealistic dreams.

And such a subtle psychological narrative made Brand want to slam the table, yet it felt as if an invisible hand was pinching his excitement point.

That is, it turns out Caesar isn't having a one-sided crush?

It turns out little angel Gu Bai had also felt a hazy attraction!

But in the hands of the cruel and evil author, just as the reader learned that Gu Bai once had feelings for Caesar, Gu Bai developed the exact opposite, incorrect viewpoint.

He even developed an inferiority complex in front of Caesar because he had agreed to the marriage for his mother's medical bills.

This scene made Brand wish he could jump directly into the book, grab Gu Bai, and shout the truth:

Little one, that guy clearly loves you so much! He’s just too stubborn and foul-mouthed to admit it—!

How can you not see it!?

And the next second, the writing style shifted, and the perspective fell on Caesar. "Ah? Have you not been online since last night? Because this hat merchandise has also exploded!"

Hong Yan was certain that Lu Li had really been writing songs all night and hadn't been online at all.

Last night, besides Lu Li's songs being the biggest hit, the little pear hat on Xueyan's head was the most popular thing. Many people outside the circle saw the cub's photos and were so charmed that they were asking everywhere how to buy the same one.

Although Hong Yan once felt that these people didn't like the hat itself, but the cub wearing the little hat as a whole. But buying the same hat doesn't mean you own the same cub!

Besides, there's a sad piece of news: the topic data for the little hat that Xueyan made popular is even higher than the topics for Fu Yao and Xia Jue combined...
chapters.title: 第144章

chapters.translated_text:
Hong Yan didn't know how to evaluate this for a moment.

Could it be that current groups aren't as good as Lu Li forming a group on the spot with the cub? One in charge of singing, the other in charge of being cute—it created a bizarre sense of déjà vu that would definitely generate countless topics.

"However, Lu Li, although the events from last night were extremely popular, some strange voices have gradually appeared this morning. Someone leaked that these were audience members played by actors arranged by the company in advance."

Hong Yan said with a strange expression.

Lu Li pondered for a few seconds, trying to understand the meaning behind this.

Does this mean that Big Brother and Xue Yan were part-time actors hired by the company? Since when did the company become so incredibly powerful...

The reason Lu Li chose Zhui Guang Entertainment in the first place was simply because among the top-tier companies, Zhui Guang had the most flexible contract and could accept him disappearing for periods of time.

Regarding this, Hong Yan hurriedly added: "Of course we know these are rumors; after all, where would the company get the budget to hire such actors! We just wanted to ask how you want to handle it."

Hong Yan thought to herself that this rumor was clearly completely backwards.

It would be better to spread a rumor that Lu Li's brother bought the company just to put on a concert for Lu Li, the nepotism hire...
chapters.source_text:
洪燕一时间不知道该怎么评价。
难道如今的组合都不如让陆黎带着幼崽原地组合出道？一个负责唱，一个负责萌，妥妥能爆出无数话题的诡异既视感。
“不过陆黎，虽然昨晚几个事件热度特别高，但是今早逐渐出现了一些奇怪的声音。有人爆料说这是公司提前安排的演员扮演的观众。”
洪燕表情古怪地说道。
陆黎硬是沉思了几秒，试图理解这其中的含义。
意思是大哥跟雪言是公司找的兼职演员？公司什么时候手眼通天到了这个地步……
陆黎当初会选择追光娱乐，单纯是因为第一梯队的大公司里，追光的合同最自由，而且能接受自己定期消失一段时间。
对此洪燕连忙补充道：“我们当然知道这些是造谣，毕竟公司哪儿有那么多经费请这种演员！现在就是想问问怎么处理而已。”
洪燕心想这谣言分明完全反过来了才是。
还不如造谣说是陆黎他哥买下了公司，专门给陆黎这个关系户搞的演唱会……
