chapters.source_text:
“喵€€€€”
要知道每周三节的语言课，从前小家伙的厌学情绪可是非常严重的。
偶尔能一直躲在房间最高处不出来，让被邀请过来的老师都束手无策。
不管如何，幼崽主动去上课这可是天大的好事一件，值得立刻通知夫人他们庆祝一番！
“而且您身上这挂着的是什么小东西。”
老管家喜出望外地跟随幼崽上楼去书房，很快发现煤球身上挂着一件很陌生的月亮小围兜。
“啾姆。”
闻言煤球倒是停下了步伐，稳稳当当地蹲在楼梯上，示意老管家帮自己系一下。
“帮您系在脖子上吗？当然可以。这小围兜还真的怪可爱的。”
老管家笑眯眯地伸手帮忙系了起来。
“啾姆啾姆！”
结果系好后，煤球却是扭了好几下，摇头示意自己想要的不是这个，而是一个漂亮蝴蝶结。
要像阿言给自己系的那样好看！
“好的好的，我重新帮您系一个漂亮蝴蝶结就是了。”
对此老管家莫名有种说不出来的奇怪心情。
这个阿言是谁？
还给尼莫少爷系过蝴蝶结？
不过看着尼莫戴着围兜乖乖飞进书房里的动作后，山羊胡子老管家终于反应过来了一件更为震惊的事情。
那就是小家伙的翅膀怎么看起来没有以前状态那么糟糕了？
甚至第一次独立飞进书房去上课了，连飞行的稳定性都似乎好转了许多。
这在以前可是从来没有发生过的奇迹！
而查理当然愿意跟雪言在一起干任何事情！
“喂喂喂，这到底什么猫啊！？”陆淮就很抓狂了，本来按照自己的剧本，不应该是自己抱着雪言去换衣服泡温泉吗？
结果现在这只猪咪怎么抢了自己的戏份？变成雪言抱着这只猫去泡温泉了。
“怎么，你还想跟一只猫抢位置？”
陆黎笑了一声，还挺想知道老四这次能干出什么事情的。
被留在原地的陆淮磨牙，怎么感觉雪言出来一趟，身边多了这么多乱七八糟的家伙。
“喂，你不是说今天要先去公司的吗？敬业工作狂大明星。”陆淮盯着朝前走去的陆黎没好气问道。
“泡完温泉再去也不迟。”陆黎语气自然地回应了起来。
某种意义上，陆黎第一次认清了一点，那就是因为工作而缺席难得的家庭集体活动，好像是会很遗憾的。
尤其是错过泡温泉的雪言。
尽管当换好衣服的陆黎，站在温泉前看到雪言的时候，还是被狠狠萌到了。
小家伙额头上不知道被谁学着电视剧里那样放了一块白色小毛巾，双手紧紧抱着泳圈，浮在了树屋前的温泉水里。
往日里略显苍白的肤色，被水雾氤氲出了一种极好看的淡粉色，眼睛也亮晶晶的，像瞬间鲜活起来了一样。
“哥哥，查理在帮我推泳圈。”
笑着的雪言还给家长展示了一下查理的绝招。
只见雪言的泳圈后面，当真浮着一只任劳任怨的猫咪，白色小爪子拨动温泉水，“喵”的叫唤了一声。
对此陆巡沉默了片刻，干脆拍下这张照片，发给了菲伦斯特。
chapters.title: 第150章
chapters.translated_text:
"Meow—"

You have to know that for the three language lessons held every week, the little one used to have a very serious aversion to studying.

Occasionally, it would hide at the highest point in the room and refuse to come out, leaving the invited tutors at a complete loss.

Regardless, the cub taking the initiative to go to class was a huge piece of good news, worth notifying the Madam and the others immediately to celebrate!

"And what is this little thing hanging on you?"

The old butler followed the cub upstairs to the study, overjoyed, and soon discovered a strange little moon-shaped bib hanging on Meiqiu.

"Chium."

Hearing this, Meiqiu stopped in its tracks, sat steadily on the stairs, and signaled for the old butler to help tie it.

"Help you tie it around your neck? Of course. This little bib is actually quite cute."

The old butler smiled and reached out to help tie it.

"Chium chium!"

As it turned out, after it was tied, Meiqiu twisted several times and shook its head to indicate that this wasn't what it wanted; it wanted a beautiful bow.

It had to be as pretty as the one A-Yan tied for it!

"Alright, alright, I'll retie it into a beautiful bow for you."

Regarding this, the old butler felt a strange, indescribable emotion.

Who is this A-Yan?

And they have tied a bow for Young Master Nemo before?

However, after watching Nemo fly obediently into the study wearing the bib, the old butler with the goatee finally realized something even more shocking.

That was, why did the little one's wings look less in such a bad state than before?

It had even flown into the study for class independently for the first time, and its flight stability seemed to have improved significantly.

This was a miracle that had never happened before!

And Charlie was, of course, willing to do anything with Xue Yan!

"Hey, hey, hey, what kind of cat is this!?" Lu Huai was going crazy. According to his original script, shouldn't he be the one carrying Xue Yan to change clothes and go to the hot spring?

But now, how did this pig-cat steal his spotlight? It turned into Xue Yan carrying this cat to the hot spring.

"What, you still want to fight a cat for a spot?"

Lu Li chuckled; he was actually quite curious to see what the fourth brother would do this time.

Left behind, Lu Huai gritted his teeth. How did it feel like Xue Yan had gained so many messy characters around him after just one trip out?

"Hey, didn't you say you were going to the company first today? You workaholic superstar," Lu Huai stared at Lu Li, who was walking ahead, and asked irritably.

"It won't be too late to go after soaking in the hot spring," Lu Li replied naturally.

In a sense, Lu Li realized for the first time that missing a rare family group activity because of work would be a great pity.

Especially missing out on Xue Yan at the hot spring.

Even though when Lu Li, having changed into his clothes, stood before the hot spring and saw Xue Yan, he was still hit hard by the cuteness.

The little one had a small white towel placed on his forehead, just like in the TV dramas, and was floating in the hot spring water in front of the treehouse, holding his swim ring tightly with both hands.

His usually slightly pale complexion was suffused with a beautiful, soft pink by the steam, and his eyes were sparkling, as if he had instantly come to life.

"Brother, Charlie is helping me push the swim ring."

A smiling Xue Yan even showed his family Charlie's special trick.

Sure enough, behind Xue Yan's swim ring, a cat was floating, working hard without complaint, paddling the hot spring water with its little white paws and letting out a "meow."

Lu Xun was silent for a moment at this, then simply took a photo and sent it to Philenster.

After Pei Shuo finished saying his name, he noticed that Lu Xueyan, who was right in front of him, had suddenly widened his eyes.

Those beautiful, already large eyes looked even more moist and bright when widened like that, as if they held countless crystal-clear little snowflakes inside.

Pei Shuo was momentarily distracted, so much so that when Lu Xueyan anxiously leaned in to brush the black bangs from his forehead, he thought the other boy was trying to start a fight.

All because he had snatched a gummy bear from him!

The key was that once he ate it, he realized this lousy candy wasn't even sweet or tasty at all!

The next second, Pei Shuo, who was about to bristle, was forced into having his forehead touched by Lu Xueyan, who was mimicking a parent checking for a fever.

"Awoo...?"

Modian was still holding Lu Xueyan’s little round hat; sensing that the atmosphere was off, he quickly dropped the hat and wanted to rush over, but suddenly didn't know which side to "help."

However, before Modian could decide which side to take, he was reflexively pressed down by the head by Pei Shuo and dragged behind him.

"No fever."

Because Lu Xueyan, having pulled his hand away, confirmed it to himself, though his eyes remained quite worried.

Pei Shuo, who had been full of confusion, immediately retorted stiffly upon hearing this: "I have never had a fever once since I was born."

In his grandfather's words, the most powerful Alpha would naturally be strong from childhood; how could he possibly catch a cold or get a fever so easily?

"Then you are amazing."

Unexpectedly, this sincere expression of envy and praise from Lu Xueyan left Pei Shuo speechless.

Was this something worth praising?

For the first time, Pei Shuo experienced what it felt like to have a conversation hit a dead end.

Even though he had always been the one to do this to others since he was little.

In fact, at this moment, Pei Shuo had completely forgotten about his attempt to defy his father, Pei Yonghuan, and his plan to run away from kindergarten with Modian.

Right now, Pei Shuo’s little head was rarely filled with all sorts of questions and doubts about the Lu Xueyan in front of him.

This curiosity was so intense that it even overcame his urge to escape from the kindergarten.

At the same time, a voice filled with relief finally rang out: "Found them! Principal, both little ones are here!"

It turned out that Miss Liqin and the others at Prince had found the two little ones hiding in the iris bushes in the small garden via surveillance.

Although both beautiful little ones looked strangely disheveled at the moment.

Not to mention Pei Shuo, even Lu Xueyan had several streaks of dust on his fair cheeks, looking like a little cat with a smudged face.

He didn't even notice the few iris petals stuck in his hair.

In fact, half an hour ago, when "Little Lu Xueyan" was called to enter the assessment classroom and no one answered, Miss Liqin had sensed something was wrong.

After rushing to the small classroom next door, she found that the hot water cup on the table had fallen to the floor for some reason, and the little one who had just taken his medicine was nowhere to be found, leaving only the back door open.

At that moment, the color almost drained from Miss Liqin's face.

It was hard to imagine that two cases of missing cubs had occurred at Prince on the same day!

Once the parents found out, the consequences would be almost unbearable.

Fortunately, they were all found quickly through surveillance; these two little ones were actually staying together and seemed to be playing.

However, when they were brought back to the principal's office separately, Pei Shuo’s expression was quite indifferent, only speaking up when asked why the two of them were together:

"I forced him to hold my hand and run; it has nothing to do with him."

"Since you two don't know each other, why did you hold hands and run away together?"

Miss Liqin frowned and stared at the cub in front of her, questioning him sternly.

"I was afraid he would scream and expose my whereabouts."

The little one answered without the slightest hesitation, as if it were true.

After firing off several quick questions, Miss Liqin soon realized that her stern face, which was usually invincible in front of cubs of this age, seemed completely useless.

The little one in front of her clearly wasn't afraid of her at all and was certain that Prince couldn't really do anything to punish him.

Although that was indeed the case.

One had to know that Prince’s first principal, Ms. Manlinye, had been a private tutor hired by the Pei family ancestors before the founding of the country and had never married.

After retiring, with the funding of the Pei family, she founded Prince and served as principal, continuing to dedicate herself to education, which had developed to this day.

However, Miss Liqin also found this attitude of the cub, who had no sense of wrongdoing, quite troublesome, convinced that if there were no punishment at all, it would be detrimental to his growth.

Wouldn't it make him think from a young age that such privileges were taken for granted?

"Very well, if things are as you say, then that is indeed clear."

So, under Miss Liqin’s methodical closing statement, Pei Shuo, who had been highly resistant, finally relaxed a little.

After all, he was still a three-year-old cub; Pei Shuo couldn't help but glance next door, wondering what his old man, Pei Yonghuan, had arranged for people to do over there.

"But one thing is that you and your little friend, whoever it may be between the two of you, have both missed the assessment, so the final score will be 0, and you will have to be assigned to Class D."

Miss Liqin closed the materials in her hand and announced the result with a regretful tone.

"On what grounds!?"

As expected, Pei Shuo bristled immediately upon hearing this, never expecting that Miss Liqin would include Lu Xueyan.

"If he missed it, you should arrange a re-test for him!"

Pei Shuo didn't think this was a serious problem at all.

"Pei Shuo, even if you don't want to attend kindergarten, when you forced little Lu Xueyan to run away with you, you should have known that you must bear the corresponding consequences and responsibilities for dragging others down."

"This isn't a question of arranging a re-test or not; it's that Prince’s rules have been this way since ancient times. Not everyone in this world is like you and can afford to not care about these things."

Miss Liqin’s tone was serious yet slightly startled; she hadn't expected the little one to become so emotionally intense at the end.

Although this order was actually given by Pei Yonghuan in a fit of rage: just let this kid go to Class D.

Yet at this moment, Pei Shuo was rarely as angry as a furious little tiger, trying to run out directly to find Lu Xueyan.

And so his name was Lu Xueyan...

In fact, after being brought back to the office, the one thing Pei Shuo regretted most was that he had forgotten to ask the other boy his name.

He didn't expect his name to be so nice as well.

And yet he had caused the other boy to miss the exam!

Consequently, before Miss Liqin could even stop him, she watched helplessly as Pei Shuo ran out with a cold face.

Looking down at the materials in her hand, Miss Liqin also felt a bit conflicted.

In fact, even if he had participated in the assessment, the Lu family's youngest son probably wouldn't have been able to go to any class other than Class D.

Because cubs noted on their files as having rare congenital diseases were meant to be assigned to Class D, which required special high-level care from teachers.

Otherwise, the little one would never be able to keep up with the high-intensity outdoor physical training courses in Class A.

And just as Pei Shuo ran out of the classroom, he widened his eyes to see Pei Yonghuan actually leading Lu Xueyan out of the classroom next door!

So Pei Shuo immediately rushed over, snatched his "friend" from his father Pei Yonghuan’s hand, and glared at the man.

Lu Xueyan, caught off guard, didn't have time to react before he was held by Pei Shuo again and pulled behind him.

Instead, Pei Yonghuan, caught off guard by seeing this kid staring at him coldly like an enemy again, felt his familiar irritation bubbling up.

This happened ten minutes ago; after the two little ones were brought back and separated into different classrooms, the reason Pei Yonghuan personally went to check on this "little unlucky one" who had been implicated by his son was purely because he intended to suppress the matter.

Family shame should not be made public.

For so many years, the Pei family had never had such a ridiculous thing as truancy; if it got out, it would simply make him a laughingstock.

In any case, this matter had to be kept under wraps.

The school staff could certainly be controlled, except for the other child, who would probably need to be coaxed to avoid his parents finding out.

The key was that when Pei Yonghuan saw the student's file, he almost had a stroke.

Who couldn't Pei Shuo have dragged along? He had to go and drag away the Lu family's youngest son!?

Of course, no matter what, Pei Yonghuan couldn't bring himself to hold a child accountable for the friction between the two families.

Moreover, the moment he saw Lu Xueyan sitting quietly in the classroom, Pei Yonghuan was stunned and began to ponder the motives of his son.

Although the relationship between father and son was quite tense, Pei Yonghuan still understood some of his son's character traits quite well.

The personal nannies and drivers had all been hand-picked since he was little; if their image wasn't proper, the kid wouldn't even pay them any mind.

As for Lu Xueyan, on one hand, he had a naturally good personality, and on the other, he felt a bit guilty seeing Pei Yonghuan.

Seeing that Pei Shuo’s parent had already come to the school, could it be that Pei Shuo had already fallen ill so quickly? Or had his bad deed of secretly feeding Pei Shuo medicine been exposed?

Would he be asked by the teacher to bring his parents...

Especially at the thought of this last point, the cub’s face turned a few shades paler.

The last thing Lu Xueyan wanted to happen was to have his parents called, especially since his father and brother had specifically cleared their schedules of many official duties today to accompany him to registration.

As it turned out, after the teachers spoke in a gentle tone, they only hoped that he wouldn't reveal to his parents that he had met Pei Shuo today, as if none of this had happened.

Lu Xueyan didn't have much interest in the pile of compensation promised by Pei Yonghuan and the teachers.

But not having to bring his parents—that was definitely the greatest reward!

Even though he felt a little regret about missing the exam and having no score, upon learning that there was still a physical fitness test, he felt that, by comparison, this seemed to be the most insignificant thing.

Perhaps because when a villain does something bad, there is bound to be some punishment?

Even if he didn't intentionally poison Pei Shuo.
chapters.source_text:
而裴朔说完自己的名字后，便发现眼前的陆雪言蓦然睁大了眼睛。
本来就已经很大的漂亮眼睛这么一瞪圆，更加显得润润亮亮的，像里面藏着无数晶莹剔透的冰晶小雪花一样。
裴朔不自觉有点走神，以至于被陆雪言着急凑过来拨开额前黑色碎发的瞬间，还以为对方是要打架。
就因为被自己抢走了一颗小熊软糖！
关键吃下去就知道，这破糖分明根本不甜也不好吃！
结果下一秒有点想炸毛的裴朔就被陆雪言硬生生学着家长那样摸着额头确认起来了温度。
“嗷呜……？”
墨点还叼着陆雪言的小圆帽呢，察觉到气氛不对劲连忙放下帽子就想冲过去，却又突然不知道该“帮”哪一方。
不过墨点还没来得及决定好跟哪一方呢，就已经被裴朔不假思索地一把按住了脑壳，拖到了身后。
“没有发烧。”
因为放下手的陆雪言自言自语地确认了一遍，眼底却还是相当担忧。
本来已经满腹疑惑的裴朔听到这句话，瞬间硬邦邦地反驳起来：“我从小就没发烧过一次。”
用爷爷的话来讲，那就是最厉害的Alpha当然会从小就身体强壮，怎么可能随随便便就感冒发烧？
“那你好厉害。”
不料陆雪言这么真心实意的一句羡慕和夸奖，反而一下子给裴朔噎住了。
这是什么值得夸奖的事情吗？
裴朔第一次尝到聊天被聊死原来是这种感觉。
哪怕从小到大向来都是自己这么对别人的。
事实上，这一会儿的裴朔已经完全忘记自己试图跟父亲裴永桓唱反调，找到墨点一块儿逃学幼儿园的事情了。
此刻裴朔的小脑瓜里罕见全部都是有关眼前陆雪言的各种问号和疑惑。
这种好奇心浓郁到甚至战胜了想要逃离幼儿园的冲动。
与此同时一道喜出望外的声音也终于响起：“找到了，校长，两个小家伙都在这里！”
原来是普林斯特的利钦小姐她们通过监控，找到了躲在小花园鸢尾丛里两个小家伙的身影。
虽然两个漂亮的小家伙这会儿都奇怪的有点狼狈。
裴朔就不说了，连陆雪言也不知道什么时候白皙的脸蛋上多了几道灰尘痕迹，跟花了脸的小猫似的。
发丝里沾了几片鸢尾花瓣都没察觉。
其实早在半个小时前，当喊到“陆雪言小朋友”进入测评教室却无人答应的时候，利钦小姐就感受到了一丝不对劲。
连忙赶往隔壁小教室后，发现桌子上的热水杯不知道为什么掉在了地上，而吃完药的小家伙更是无影无踪，只剩下了被打开的后门。
这一瞬间利钦小姐脸上的血色都快消失了。
难以想象在同一天内普林斯特居然发生了两起幼崽失踪案件！
一旦被家长知道，后果几乎是无法承受的。
好在很快通过监控全部找到了，这两个小家伙居然呆在一块儿，看起来还在玩耍。
只不过被各自分开带回到校长办公室里时，裴朔表情相当漠然，除了被问到为什么两个人会在一起的时候才突然出声了：
“是我强行牵着他跑的，跟他没关系。”
“那你们俩既然不认识，为什么要牵着对方一块儿跑呢？”
利钦小姐蹙眉略显严厉地盯着眼前的幼崽追问起来。
“我怕他会尖叫，暴露我的行踪。”
小家伙回答得没有丝毫卡顿，就像真的一样。
接连快速追问了好几个问题，利钦小姐很快发现自己在这个年龄段幼崽前无往不利的冷厉面孔，似乎完全没有派上用场。
眼前的这个小家伙显然不仅完全不怕自己，更笃定普林斯特根本做不了什么惩罚。
尽管事实也确实如此。
要知道普林斯特当初的首任校长，曼琳耶女士，建国前就是裴家祖上聘请的专职家庭教师，一生未曾结婚。
退休后在裴家的资助下，开办了普林斯特担任校长，继续致力于教育事业，并且一直发展至今。
但是对于幼崽这种毫无认错意识的态度，利钦小姐也感到颇为棘手，确信如果真的没有任何惩罚的话，反而不利于幼崽成长。
岂不是会让他从小就认为这种特权是理所当然的？
“很好，如果事情就像你说的这样，那的确已经很清楚。”
于是在利钦小姐慢条斯理的总结发言下，原本抵触情绪极强的裴朔也终于松弛了几分。
毕竟还是个三岁多的幼崽，裴朔忍不住瞥了一眼隔壁，不知道老爸裴永桓安排人跟过去干什么了。
“但有一点是，你跟你那小伙伴，无论是你们两人之中的谁，你们俩总归都已经错过了测评，所以最终分数会是0分，只能统一安排到D班去了。”
利钦小姐合拢手里的材料，语气很遗憾地宣布了这个结果。
“凭什么！？”
果不其然，闻言裴朔顿时炸毛了，完全没想到利钦小姐居然会带上陆雪言。
“错过了应该给他安排重测！”
裴朔根本不觉得这是个多么严重的问题。
“裴朔，就算你不想上幼儿园，当你强行牵着人家陆雪言小朋友跑走的时候，就应该知道你必须承担拖累别人的相应后果跟责任。”
“这不是安排重测不重测的问题，而是普林斯特自古以来的规矩就是这样，这个世界上不是所有人都跟你一样，可以不在乎这些。”
利钦小姐的语气严肃中有点错愕，没想到小家伙反而最后情绪激烈了起来。
尽管这个命令其实是裴永桓怒气冲冲下达的：就让这小子上D班好了。
偏偏这一刻的裴朔罕见生气到像一头发怒的小老虎，试图直接跑出去去找陆雪言。
而且原来他叫陆雪言……
其实被带回到办公室后，裴朔最后悔的一件事是自己忘了问对方叫什么名字了。
没想到名字也很好听。
结果自己却害得对方没参加考试！
于是利钦小姐都没来得及阻拦，就眼睁睁看着裴朔已经冷脸飞奔出去。
低头看了一眼手里的材料，利钦小姐也有点心情复杂。
其实就算参加了测评，陆家的那个小儿子恐怕也去不了D班之外的任何一个班级。
因为这种资料上提前注明患有先天罕见病的幼崽，本来就是要被安排到需要教师特殊高度关照的D班的。
否则A班的那些高强度的户外素质活动训练课，小家伙也根本不可能跟得上。
而裴朔刚刚从教室跑出来，就瞪大眼睛看见裴永桓居然牵着陆雪言从隔壁教室出来了！
于是裴朔立刻冲过去，一把把自己的“朋友”从老爸裴永桓的手里抢了过来，并且对男人怒目而视。
陆雪言懵懂地没有来得及反应，就被裴朔重新牵住拉到身后了。
反而裴永桓猝不及防看见裴朔这小子又开始冷冰冰地像仇人一样盯着自己看，熟悉的恼火差点冒出来了。
事情发生在十几分钟前，两个小家伙被带回来分开到不同教室之后，裴永桓之所以亲自出面去隔壁看了看这个被自己儿子牵连的“小倒霉蛋”，纯粹是因为裴永桓打算把这件事给压下来。
家丑不可外扬。
裴家这么多年来，就从来没有发生过逃学这种可笑的事情，一旦传出去简直会让自己沦为笑柄。
无论如何必须把这件事情按下来。
校方这边的人员当然都能控制得住，除了另外一个小孩子估计需要哄一哄，才能避免被对方家长知道。
关键当裴永桓看到学员资料的时候，差点直接脑梗。
裴朔这小子牵谁不好，居然顺手牵走了陆家的小儿子！？
当然，裴永桓再怎么样也还做不出把两家的摩擦算到一个小孩子身上这种事出来。
更何况看见安静坐在教室里的陆雪言的第一眼，裴永桓一愣就有点琢磨裴朔这小子的动机了。
虽然父子俩的感情相当紧张，但裴永桓还是相当了解自家儿子的某些性格特点的。
贴身的保姆、司机等等从小那都是挑过的，形象不够端正这小子能理都不理。
而陆雪言一方面是性格本来就好，另一方面则是见到裴永桓有点心虚。
看见裴朔的家长居然已经找上门来了，难道是裴朔已经这么快发病了吗？又或者自己偷偷喂裴朔吃了药的坏事暴露了吗？
自己会被老师要求带家长吗……
尤其是想到最后这一点，幼崽的脸蛋都白了几分。
陆雪言最不想发生的事情就是被找家长了，尤其爸爸跟哥哥今天特意推掉了好多公务过来陪自己报道。
结果老师们语气缓和地开口后，居然只是希望自己不要跟家长透露今天遇到裴朔的事情，就当这一切事情都没有发生。
对于裴永桓跟老师们许诺的一堆补偿，陆雪言并没有太多的兴趣。
但是可以不用带家长，这绝对是最大的奖励了！
甚至缺考没有了分数这件事，陆雪言虽然有点小遗憾，但在得知还有身体素质检测后，又觉得相比之下这好像是最微不足道的事情了。
也许是因为当反派做了坏事，难免会有惩罚？
哪怕自己并不是故意隐瞒给裴朔下毒的。
chapters.title: 第11章
第100章 一家子的Alpha大战
chapters.source_text:
平心而论，陆巡这次拍的这张照片好看极了，为了把查理拍进去，一点不像之前的那堆大头照。
波光粼粼的温泉池水里，雪言抱着一只鹅黄色的泳圈，像被套在了甜甜圈里的白色小汤圆，身后还粘着一团毛茸茸的查理。
从这个角度看过去，雪言的脸蛋都粉嫩得像是糯米滋一样，被泉水雾气打湿成一簇一簇的眼睫毛，又在白皙的面颊上投落了细碎的光影。
完完全全像是洋娃娃一样。
配合在后面奋力推水的查理猫猫，就更像童话世界里才会发生的一幕了。
偏偏这会菲伦斯特正在大教室里面操作投屏，试图给学生们展示自己收集到的一些图片表格材料。结果菲伦斯特操作完后，就听到了一片“wow€€€€”声。
整个大教室里的学生们，无论肤色、发色和人种都目光炯炯地盯着屏幕，连眨眼都不眨眼一下。
啧，这群小崽子们难得学的这么仔细？
也不枉费自己这几天熬夜搜集了这几张典型病例，好好记到脑子去吧，毕竟这学期最后几道期末压轴题就从这里面出。
八月底，Y大就快开学了。
裴朔在玉廷轩的工作也结束了。
最后一天下班，经理却找到裴朔，让他一天后到一场游轮陆会做服务生，两天一夜，有一千块的工资。
这场游轮陆会是玉廷轩大老板为女儿订婚办的，要调玉廷轩所有工作人员过去帮忙。
原本裴朔已经辞了职，不属于玉廷轩工作人员之内，但经理想到他即将开学需要用钱，便还是打算让他去。
裴朔明白经理的好意，于是欣然同意。
一天后，裴朔上了游轮，跟着同事小杨来到他们的员工宿舍里。
小杨第一次上游轮，很是兴奋，一路上叽叽喳喳的。
他独自说了好一会儿，却没听到裴朔回应，有些疑惑地转头询问：“小裴你怎么了，晕船吗？”
裴朔指了指嗓子，艰难开口说了一句话：“昨晚吹了风，今早起来声音就变了。”
原本清脆的声音变得沙哑，可怜巴巴的。
小杨忍不住笑了笑，道：“没事没事，显得沉稳。”
菲伦斯特得意地摸了摸发尾，就看见最底下担任助教的库里科脸色古怪地小声朝着教授喊了起来。
“老师，老师……”你的页面点错了！刚刚弹出来了一个消息框被点了！
菲伦斯特这才低头看了过去，瞬间连眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
“查理€€€€！？”
自己的查理为什么没有出现在腿边，反而跑到了手机屏幕上！
“怪不得今天没看见查理，原来被教授送去泡温泉了？”
“这也太可爱了吧，照片上的小家伙跟猫咪到底去哪儿可以领取？”
“这是哪一家温泉啊，我怎么之前从来没见过……”
整个教室里随之响起了窃窃私语，大家还以为这又是教授某种进化了的炫猫手段。
毕竟菲伦斯特教授可是有过前科的，之前在一次重要学术会议上发言，会议间隙超绝不经意露出桌面上的查理美照引发全场赞叹，大家都快习惯了。
只不过这次很快又弹出来了一条最新消息。
过了好一会儿，陆隋才收到他哥的消息：
到了中午，何管家给陆隋送来了饭。
他送的是四人份的，陆隋三个室友都有份。
陆隋和刘琮拎着几个保温饭盒回来，兴高采烈地喊了一声：
“来，裴朔，今天我家里给我们送饭了。有你爱吃的红烧带鱼。”
他打开饭盒，将色泽诱人的几道菜放到裴朔面前。
那些菜无一不是裴朔爱吃的。
然而，闻着红烧带鱼那股淡淡的腥味，裴朔深深皱起了眉。
他捂着胃，别过头去：
“呕€€€€”
全场大家：噢€€€€
怪不得，原来不是教授送过去的，而是查理自己发挥主观动能性跑过去的啊。
“索菲，快看我搜出来了什么！”
还有学生眼尖地看着一旁的温泉用品标志，用手机搜出来了这家私人山间温泉，光是店名就很高深莫测，价格更是相当高深莫测。
“上帝，查理也是过上好日子了啊……”
别说家里的猫了，就算是家里的人也舍不得去泡这种温泉好不好？
这水里面难道有金子吗！泡一晚就可以获得永生吗？否则凭什么卖这个价格。
“可能这就是有钱人的世界吧，你别忘了，罗辑师兄过去了那也是年薪百万！”
“安静！给我安静！！”
后半夜，裴朔才挪上床睡觉。
他做了个梦，梦到了派对那晚他中药倒在陆雪言怀里时，陆雪言紧皱着眉，一脸嫌恶、不耐烦地推开他。
裴朔心里一紧，想要反驳自己没有那样的想法。
可随即，他看着梦里面容不清的陆雪言，又愣住了。
他明白那不是陆雪言会做出来的事、说出来的话。
那都是他内心里希望的。
他希望陆雪言真的很讨厌他，推开他，说他恶心。
这样的话，那晚的事就不会发生了，他现在就不会那么痛苦。
chapters.translated_text:
In all fairness, the photo Lu Xun took this time was incredibly beautiful; because he had to fit Charlie into the frame, it didn't look at all like those previous close-up shots.

In the shimmering hot spring water, Xueyan was holding a goose-yellow swim ring, looking like a little white rice ball tucked inside a donut, with a fluffy lump of Charlie sticking to his back.

From this angle, Xueyan’s cheeks looked as soft and pink as mochi, and his eyelashes, dampened into clusters by the spring mist, cast delicate, fragmented shadows on his fair skin.

He looked exactly like a doll.

Coupled with Charlie the cat paddling hard behind him, it looked even more like a scene straight out of a fairy tale.

Just then, Filenster was in the large lecture hall operating the projector, trying to show his students some picture and table materials he had collected. As soon as he finished his operation, he heard a chorus of "Wow—!"

The students throughout the large lecture hall, regardless of their skin color, hair color, or ethnicity, were staring intently at the screen, not even blinking once.

Tsk, it’s rare for these little brats to study so carefully?

It was worth the sleepless nights he spent collecting these typical cases; they should memorize them well, as the final few questions on the semester exam would be based on this material.

By the end of August, Y University was about to start.

Pei Shuo’s work at Yutingxuan also came to an end.

On his last day of work, the manager approached Pei Shuo and asked him to work as a waiter at a cruise ship party in a day’s time; it would be a two-day, one-night shift with a pay of one thousand yuan.

This cruise ship party was being held by the big boss of Yutingxuan for his daughter’s engagement, and all Yutingxuan staff were being called in to help.

Pei Shuo had already resigned and was no longer part of the Yutingxuan staff, but the manager, knowing he needed money for the upcoming semester, still intended for him to go.

Pei Shuo understood the manager’s good intentions and readily agreed.

A day later, Pei Shuo boarded the cruise ship and followed his colleague, Xiao Yang, to their staff dormitory.

It was Xiao Yang’s first time on a cruise ship, and he was very excited, chattering away the whole way.

He talked to himself for a good while, but hearing no response from Pei Shuo, he turned around in confusion and asked, "Xiao Pei, what’s wrong? Are you seasick?"

Pei Shuo pointed to his throat and struggled to say a sentence: "I caught a draft last night, and my voice changed when I woke up this morning."

His originally crisp voice had become hoarse and sounded pitiful.

Xiao Yang couldn't help but laugh and said, "It’s fine, it’s fine, it makes you sound more steady."

Filenster was proudly touching the ends of his hair when he saw Kulike, the teaching assistant at the bottom, looking strange and whispering to the professor.

"Professor, Professor..." You clicked the wrong page! A message box just popped up and you clicked it!

Filenster looked down, and his eyes nearly popped out of his head.

"Charlie—!?"

Why wasn't his Charlie by his feet, but instead on his phone screen!

"No wonder we didn't see Charlie today; so he was sent by the professor to soak in a hot spring?"

"This is too cute. Where can I adopt the little guy and the cat in the photo?"

"Which hot spring is this? I’ve never seen it before..."

Whispers erupted throughout the classroom; everyone thought this was just another one of the professor’s evolved ways of showing off his cat.

After all, Professor Filenster had a history; he had once spoken at an important academic conference and, during a break, had "accidentally" revealed a beautiful photo of Charlie on his desktop, drawing admiration from the whole room. Everyone was almost used to it.

However, a new message popped up shortly after.

After a long while, Lu Sui finally received a message from his brother:

By noon, Butler He had delivered food to Lu Sui.

He had sent enough for four people; Lu Sui’s three roommates all had a share.

Lu Sui and Liu Cong carried back several insulated lunch boxes and shouted excitedly:

"Come on, Pei Shuo, my family sent us food today. There’s the braised hairtail you like."

He opened the lunch box and placed the appetizing dishes in front of Pei Shuo.

Every single dish was one that Pei Shuo loved.

However, smelling the faint fishy scent of the braised hairtail, Pei Shuo frowned deeply.

He clutched his stomach and turned his head away:

"Ugh—"

The whole class: Oh—

No wonder, so it wasn't the professor who sent him there, but Charlie who had taken the initiative to go there himself.

"Sophie, look what I found!"

Some students with sharp eyes noticed the logo of the hot spring supplies on the side and used their phones to search for this private mountain hot spring. The name alone was mysterious, and the price was even more unfathomable.

"God, Charlie is living the good life too..."

Never mind the family cat, even the people in the family wouldn't be willing to soak in this kind of hot spring, right?

Is there gold in this water? Can you gain immortality by soaking for one night? Otherwise, how could it justify this price?

"Maybe this is just the world of the rich. Don't forget, Senior Brother Luo Ji is making an annual salary of a million over there!"

"Quiet! Everyone be quiet!!"

Late at night, Pei Shuo finally moved to his bed to sleep.

He had a dream; he dreamed of the night of the party when he was drugged and fell into Lu Xueyan’s arms, and Lu Xueyan was frowning, pushing him away with a look of disgust and impatience.

Pei Shuo’s heart tightened, wanting to refute that he didn't have such thoughts.

But then, he looked at the blurry-faced Lu Xueyan in his dream and froze.

He understood that this wasn't something Lu Xueyan would do or say.

That was all what he hoped for in his heart.

He hoped that Lu Xueyan really hated him, pushed him away, and called him disgusting.

If that were the case, what happened that night wouldn't have happened, and he wouldn't be in so much pain now.
chapters.translated_title: Chapter 100: An Alpha War in the Family

chapters.source_text:
可是，他现在知道了陆雪言其实人很不错，所以连做梦都没办法欺骗自己。
裴朔哭着惊醒。
他看着酒店房间的窗户贴纸，心里一片茫然。
下一秒，听得忍无可忍的菲伦斯特就拍桌禁止全场再讨论这件事情。
“所有人拿出一张白纸，我们直接做一个限时课堂小测验，库里科你负责监考，下课之前交卷！”
菲伦斯特恼羞成怒地直接开始当场考试，瞬间让所有学生崩溃了。
老师你玩不起啊！？
查理泡温泉，我们做测试？还有没有人权了！原来人还可以过得连一只猫都不如吗？
于是回忆了一下，陆巡就打字回复过去了，发现对面又很久没有了消息。
“教授，教授您怎么了！？
几名学生看着阴暗变形的菲伦斯特教授都快吓死了。
查理，原来你是不怕水的……甚至会游泳！？
而查理这会儿正跟雪言玩得开心极了。
浮在水面上的查理偶尔一拍雪言的泳圈，雪言就摇摇晃晃地跟着飘过去了。
“喂喂喂，猫不可以跟人泡同一个池子哈。”
虽然下一秒，就被穿好泳裤的陆淮一下子跳入水中截在了跟前，强有力的臂膀轻而易举就把雪言连带着泳圈一块儿从温泉里抱进怀里了。
“哥哥！”雪言惊得小声呼喊了一句，牢牢抱住了哥哥的脖颈。
陆淮爽的一塌糊涂。
嘿嘿，软绵绵的一小团就这么贴过来了，泡温泉真爽啊€€€€还是大哥会享受！
至少每次跟着大哥出来玩全程不考虑开销也是真的，果然还是大家一起花大哥的钱最快乐。
“喵？”对此查理自然不甘示弱，微微蹙眉朝着陆淮看来，变成了邪恶猫咪的倒三角眼表情。
“啧，叫什么叫？你长得胖还有理了？水里打湿了都没瘦多少。”
身旁，创壹科技公司的老总正在说着话。
“多谢陆总，能跟陆氏合作，真是我们创壹莫大的荣幸。”
裴朔猛地坐起身。
他小脸通红，捂着脸无声地尖叫。
老小区管理不严，司机径直送裴朔到了楼下。
“陆总，要不我扶您回房间吧？”江苗站在陆雪言身边，眉头紧紧皱起。
陆雪言脸色有些苍白。
他轻咳了一声，眉头紧锁，沉声道：“我自己回去，你先回陆会厅里。”
江苗抿着唇，着急地四处张望，正好与站在那儿的裴朔对上视线。
他想了想，眼神一亮，“陆总，我找个人送您回房间。”
陆雪言皱眉，下一秒，便看见裴朔走了过来。
陆淮也不落下风地瞪了过去。
心想一只猫还敢跟自己叫板了？
健身房里经常举铁的自己，一个小拇指就能给这猪猫抬走。
“喵€€€€”
结果下一秒，随着查理亮出爪子一阵喵叫声，抱着雪言叉腰跨立在水池里得意自己毫发无伤的陆淮，三秒后就发出了一声惊天“卧槽”，连周围森林里的飞鸟都被惊起无数。
查理并没有抓人，而是精准地给陆淮温泉里的泳裤拽坏掉下来了。
“卧槽，这猫怎么抓人裤子呢我靠！？还有没有点猫德了！”
陆淮狼狈至极地提住了自己的泳裤，整个人都红温了。
虽然一整片温泉里只有家里几个人，但是裸奔也太尴尬了吧？何况自己可没什么跟陆黎他们比大小的变态兴趣。
因为不用比都知道，肯定是自己最大！
“哥哥？”
迷茫中的雪言则被姐姐陆菁一把从四哥怀里接了过来，顺带用手捂住了幼崽的漂亮大眼睛。
以免看到老四这极其不雅观的原始人裸奔一幕。
陆菁觉得菲伦斯特养的这猫是有点意思，居然刚好能治一治陆淮。
能养一只是挺不错的，免得老四这家伙平日里太狂。
一旁的陆黎则在最初的惊讶过后，就看着被迫狼狈放下雪言，狂奔上岸跑去重新换裤子的陆淮笑得不行。
于是被姐姐重新松开手的雪言，一睁眼就看到了双手松弛地朝两侧张开，身体倚靠在温泉池岩石边放声大笑的三哥陆黎。
其实陆黎平日里的情绪总是淡淡的，很少会有什么激烈的反应，无论是愤怒、喜悦都极其少见。
但陆黎大笑起来的时候格外好看。
眉峰骤然舒展，眼尾微微上扬，那双总带着一丝疏离感的桃花眼就更为惹眼起来，像里面盛着星星点点的碎芒。
胸腔里笑声溢出，连带着水珠一路从下颌滑落浸入到温泉水里漾出圈圈涟漪，完全可以现场拍摄照片发到微博上营业的程度了！
当陆黎察觉到陆菁跟雪言看过来的目光后，才下意识将笑意敛起，显得有那么一丝窘迫的不自然。
陆菁是玩味地看着这一刻的老三，有点想知道老三有没有发现，大笑起来的这一刻，曾经极其割裂的两道身影其实微妙重叠了。
而雪言单纯就是忍不住想夸哥哥了：“哥哥笑起来好好看！”
比演唱会上笑的还好看€€€€
他还以为自己长了肿瘤，没想到是长了个莫名奇妙的孕腔，里面还有个孩子。
裴朔一时都不知道，长肿瘤和怀孕了，哪一个对他来说才是坏消息。
他咬住唇，眼眶逐渐泛红。
为什么，他会怀孕呢？
裴朔颤抖着唇，企图找到一个原因：“那天晚上，你怎么不戴……”
他本想问问陆雪言，那晚为什么不戴/套。
就算不知道他会怀孕，为了健康、安全考虑，男人之间做那档子事的时候，不都要戴一下吗？
“就是我现在……有点不太想看见你。”
不想要……这个孩子吗？
裴朔皱紧眉头，放在肚子上的手渐渐收紧，将T恤布料揉成皱巴巴一团。
本来还有点不好意思的陆黎听到雪言这么一句真心实意的夸奖后，倒是神色变得复杂起来。
像是被夸得想在雪言面前多笑几下，却又本能地尚且不习惯这种举动。
于是陆黎轻松在温泉里游了过来，刚好悬停在了雪言跟前，放大的一张帅脸就这么在水面上凑近盯着幼崽。
“喂，老三？”
陆菁狐疑地看着陆黎，怀疑老三演唱会之后是不是真的被按下了什么奇怪的开关。
要知道帅而不自知可是一个Alpha最大的美德，整天一副故意让雪言盯着自己看的表情那可就油腻了。
虽然陆菁也承认，老三这家伙硬件条件摆在这里，想油腻也略有一点难度。
雪言却眨巴眨眼眼睛点了点头，伸出小手好奇地摸了摸哥哥的脸。
觉得自己长大了是不是也可以跟哥哥一样好看？
还可以在 水里不用游泳圈也可以游得很快！
何管家站在原地没动。
他踌躇片刻，问道：“少爷，你和小裴同学吵架了吗？”
不然，小裴同学住的好好的，怎么大晚上的带着行李离开。
陆雪言摘下眼镜揉了揉眉心，没有说话。
何管家见状，也不好再劝什么。眼神复杂地看了陆雪言一眼，离开了书房。
小书房里再度陷入寂静。
陆雪言看着那盒润喉糖，闭眼时，裴朔痛苦的泪眼就出现在他脑海中。
那声声质问也伴随着痛苦的泪眼一起出现。
为什么一点表现也没有？为什么制造出裴朔先醒过来的假象？
陆雪言抿紧唇。
他那晚不敢在裴朔醒过来之前先离开，后来也不敢提起那件事。
因为他心里清楚，如果让裴朔知道了他记得那晚的事，只会让裴朔离他越来越远。
可是现在的局面，就比那样要好吗？
“雪言是想学游泳吗？”陆黎察觉到雪言盯着自己游过来的动作突然问到。
其实自己今天倒是有时间教雪言游泳。
至于去经纪人洪燕那边一趟的安排，已经完全被陆黎给扔到一边去了。
“可以吗？雪言也可以游的那么快吗？”
雪言抱着泳圈，就像被哥哥用什么好吃的东西从窝里吸引出来的小动物一样。
“多练习当然可以。而且我们雪言这么聪明，肯定能一学就会。”
陆黎伸手揉着幼崽的发梢轻声道。
“那我想学游泳！查理也想，对不对？”
雪言顿时笑着举手示意起来，顺便看向了一旁的查理。
chapters.translated_text:
However, he now knew that Lu Xueyan was actually a very good person, so he couldn't even deceive himself in his dreams.

Pei Shuo woke up crying in a start.

He looked at the window stickers in the hotel room, his mind a blank.

The next second, Filenster, having reached his limit, slammed the table to forbid any further discussion of the matter.

"Everyone take out a blank sheet of paper. We are going to have a timed pop quiz right now. Kuriko, you are in charge of proctoring. Hand in your papers before the end of class!"

Filenster, embarrassed and angry, started the exam on the spot, instantly causing all the students to collapse.

Teacher, you're playing dirty, aren't you!?

Charlie is soaking in a hot spring, and we're taking a test? Is there no human rights left! Can a person really live worse than a cat?

So, after recalling the situation, Lu Xun typed a reply, only to find that there had been no message from the other side for a long time again.

"Professor, Professor, what's wrong with you!?"

Several students were scared to death looking at the gloomy and distorted Professor Filenster.

Charlie, so you aren't afraid of water... you can even swim!?

Meanwhile, Charlie was having a great time playing with Xueyan.

Floating on the water, Charlie would occasionally pat Xueyan's swim ring, and Xueyan would wobble along with it.

"Hey, hey, hey, cats aren't allowed in the same pool as people."

Although the next second, Lu Huai, having put on his swim trunks, jumped into the water and intercepted them, his powerful arms easily scooping Xueyan and the swim ring together into his embrace from the hot spring.

"Brother!" Xueyan cried out in surprise, holding tightly onto his brother's neck.

Lu Huai felt incredibly satisfied.

Hehe, a soft little ball just pressed against him like that. Soaking in a hot spring is truly great—it’s always best to enjoy things with Big Brother!

At the very least, it’s true that he never has to worry about expenses whenever he goes out with Big Brother. As expected, spending Big Brother's money together is the happiest thing.

"Meow?" Charlie naturally wasn't going to be outdone. He frowned slightly and looked at Lu Huai, his expression turning into that of an evil cat with inverted triangular eyes.

"Tsk, what are you meowing at? You're fat, and you think you're in the right? You didn't even lose much weight after getting wet in the water."

Beside him, the CEO of Chuangyi Technology was speaking.

"Many thanks, President Lu. It is truly a great honor for Chuangyi to cooperate with the Lu Corporation."

Pei Shuo sat up abruptly.

His face was flushed red, and he covered his face, screaming silently.

The management of the old residential complex was lax, so the driver took Pei Shuo directly downstairs.

"President Lu, should I help you back to your room?" Jiang Miao stood beside Lu Xueyan, his brows tightly furrowed.

Lu Xueyan's face was somewhat pale.

He coughed lightly, his brows locked, and said in a deep voice, "I'll go back myself. You go back to the Lu reception hall first."

Jiang Miao pursed his lips and looked around anxiously, just in time to meet the gaze of Pei Shuo, who was standing there.

He thought for a moment, his eyes lighting up, "President Lu, I'll find someone to take you back to your room."

Lu Xueyan frowned, and the next second, he saw Pei Shuo walking over.

Lu Huai didn't fall behind and glared back.

He thought to himself, a cat dares to challenge him?

He, who often lifts weights at the gym, could lift this fat cat away with just his pinky finger.

"Meow——"

The next second, following Charlie's meow as he bared his claws, Lu Huai—who had been standing in the pool with his hands on his hips, holding Xueyan and feeling proud that he was unscathed—let out a heaven-shaking "What the f*ck" three seconds later, startling countless birds in the surrounding forest.

Charlie hadn't scratched anyone; he had precisely pulled Lu Huai's swim trunks down.

"What the f*ck, why is this cat grabbing people's pants, damn it!? Is there any cat morality left!"

Lu Huai pulled up his swim trunks in extreme embarrassment, his whole body turning red from the heat.

Although there were only a few family members in the entire hot spring, running naked was too embarrassing, right? Besides, he didn't have any perverted interest in comparing sizes with Lu Li and the others.

Because he knew without comparing that his was definitely the biggest!

"Brother?"

The confused Xueyan was taken from his fourth brother's arms by his sister, Lu Jing, who also covered the cub's beautiful big eyes with her hand.

To avoid seeing this extremely unsightly scene of the fourth brother running naked like a primitive man.

Lu Jing thought the cat Filenster kept was quite interesting; it actually managed to discipline Lu Huai.

Keeping one would be quite nice, to prevent the fourth brother from being too arrogant on a daily basis.

Lu Li, standing to the side, couldn't stop laughing after his initial surprise, watching Lu Huai, who had been forced to put Xueyan down in a panic and was now sprinting to the shore to change his pants.

Thus, when Xueyan was released by his sister, the moment he opened his eyes, he saw his third brother, Lu Li, laughing heartily with his arms relaxed and spread to the sides, leaning against the rock of the hot spring pool.

In fact, Lu Li's emotions were usually flat; he rarely had any intense reactions, and both anger and joy were extremely rare.

But Lu Li looked exceptionally good when he laughed heartily.

His brows suddenly relaxed, the corners of his eyes lifted slightly, and those peach-blossom eyes, which always carried a hint of detachment, became even more striking, as if they were filled with tiny, shimmering specks of light.

Laughter spilled from his chest, and water droplets slid down from his chin into the hot spring, creating ripples—it was enough to take a photo on the spot and post it on Weibo for professional engagement!

When Lu Li noticed the gazes of Lu Jing and Xueyan looking over, he subconsciously reined in his laughter, appearing a bit awkwardly unnatural.

Lu Jing looked at the third brother at this moment with amusement, wondering if he had realized that the moment he laughed heartily, the two once-extremely fractured figures had subtly overlapped.

As for Xueyan, he simply couldn't help but want to praise his brother: "Brother looks so good when he laughs!"

Even better looking than when he laughs at concerts——

He thought he had grown a tumor, but it turned out to be an inexplicable pregnancy cavity with a child inside.

Pei Shuo didn't know for a moment which was the worse news for him: having a tumor or being pregnant.

He bit his lip, his eyes gradually turning red.

Why was he pregnant?

Pei Shuo's lips trembled as he tried to find a reason: "That night, why didn't you wear..."

He had intended to ask Lu Xueyan why he didn't wear a condom that night.

Even if he didn't know he would get pregnant, for the sake of health and safety, shouldn't men wear one when doing that kind of thing?

"It's just that right now... I don't really want to see you."

You don't want... this child?

Pei Shuo frowned tightly, his hand on his stomach tightening, crumpling the T-shirt fabric into a wrinkled ball.

Lu Li, who had been a bit embarrassed, saw his expression change to something complex after hearing such a sincere compliment from Xueyan.

It was as if he wanted to laugh more in front of Xueyan after being praised, but instinctively, he wasn't used to such behavior yet.

So Lu Li swam over easily in the hot spring, hovering right in front of Xueyan, his handsome face magnified as he leaned in close to stare at the cub.

"Hey, Third Brother?"

Lu Jing looked at Lu Li suspiciously, wondering if something strange had been switched on for the third brother after the concert.

You have to know that being handsome without knowing it is the greatest virtue of an Alpha; having an expression that intentionally makes Xueyan stare at him all day is just greasy.

Although Lu Jing also admitted that with the third brother's hardware conditions, it was a bit difficult to be greasy even if he wanted to.

Xueyan blinked his eyes and nodded, reaching out his little hand to curiously touch his brother's face.

He wondered if he would be as good-looking as his brother when he grew up?

And if he could swim as fast as him in the water without a swim ring!

Butler He stood where he was, not moving.

He hesitated for a moment and asked, "Young Master, did you and classmate Pei have an argument?"

Otherwise, why would classmate Pei, who was living here just fine, leave in the middle of the night with his luggage?

Lu Xueyan took off his glasses and rubbed his temples, not speaking.

Seeing this, Butler He found it difficult to persuade him further. He looked at Lu Xueyan with a complex gaze and left the study.

The small study fell into silence once again.

Lu Xueyan looked at the box of throat lozenges, and when he closed his eyes, Pei Shuo's painful, teary eyes appeared in his mind.

Those repeated questions also appeared along with the painful, teary eyes.

Why was there no sign at all? Why create the illusion that Pei Shuo had woken up first?

Lu Xueyan pursed his lips tightly.

He hadn't dared to leave before Pei Shuo woke up that night, and later, he hadn't dared to bring up the matter.

Because he knew in his heart that if he let Pei Shuo know he remembered what happened that night, it would only make Pei Shuo drift further and further away from him.

But was the current situation any better than that?

"Does Xueyan want to learn to swim?" Lu Li asked suddenly, noticing Xueyan staring at his swimming movements.

Actually, he did have time to teach Xueyan to swim today.

As for the arrangement to visit his agent, Hong Yan, it had been completely thrown to the side by Lu Li.

"Can I? Can Xueyan swim that fast too?"

Xueyan held his swim ring like a little animal lured out of its nest by something delicious from its brother.

"Of course you can with more practice. And our Xueyan is so smart, you'll definitely learn it in no time."

Lu Li reached out and ruffled the cub's hair, saying softly.

"Then I want to learn to swim! Charlie wants to too, right?"

Xueyan immediately smiled and raised his hand to signal, then looked at Charlie on the side.
chapters.title: 第151章

chapters.translated_text:
Charlie’s swimming style was like a kitten paddling through water; it was cute, certainly, but it was clearly different from Third Brother’s style.

A heart-wrenching coughing fit echoed from the third floor of the Lu residence.

Butler He arrived outside Lu Xueyan’s small study carrying the lung-nourishing soup prepared by the nanny and knocked on the door.

"Come in," a hoarse voice replied.

Butler He pushed the door open and saw Lu Xueyan staring at something in his hands.

As he walked up to the desk, he realized it was a box of throat lozenges.

Butler He placed the soup on the desk and said, "Young Master, I just saw Student Pei leave with his luggage."

Lu Xueyan’s body jolted. Only then did he shift his gaze from the lozenge box, look up, and ask, "Do you know where he went?"

Butler He shook his head.

By the time he saw him, Pei Shuo had already reached the manor gates.

By the time he chased after him out of the estate, Pei Shuo had already gotten into a taxi.

Lu Xueyan withdrew his gaze, coughed a few times, and said, "You may go."

"Meow?" Charlie wasn't nearly as guarded against Third Brother.

"What were you laughing so happily about just now? And why did that guy, Fourth Brother, suddenly run back to his room?"

Just then, Eldest Brother Lu Xun, who had finally finished his business, walked out wearing a dark bathrobe. He looked at the scene in the hot spring with mild curiosity before glancing back in the direction where Fourth Brother had sprinted away.

"Because Fourth Brother's pants broke."

Xueyan explained honestly on Charlie’s behalf.

"Pants broke?"

Lu Xun was slightly stunned, thinking that Fourth Brother was never the type to shortchange himself.

He had been eating and wearing the best since he was a child, and these swimming trunks probably weren't cheap; how could they break after only being in the water for a few seconds?

"Because Fourth Brother got into a fight with Charlie."

Pei Shuo sighed helplessly, took out the throat lozenges he had bought, and popped one into his mouth.

He glanced at Xiao Yang, shook the box of lozenges, and asked, "Do you want one?"

After talking for the entire journey, he was worried that Xiao Yang’s throat might be sore.

Xiao Yang didn't stand on ceremony, grinned, and took one.

As the whistle blew, the cruise ship slowly began to move along the river.

The job assigned to Pei Shuo was as a waiter in the restaurant—day shift, getting off at 6:00 PM, after which he was free to move about the deck.

The main event of the Lu gathering was in the evening, so the guests had all gone to the banquet hall, leaving the deck relatively empty.

The cruise ship had already reached the open sea.

It was dusk, and the sky in the west was slowly turning orange-red. Occasionally, a flock of seabirds would fly by, skimming the surface of the water to catch jumping fish.

This was Pei Shuo’s first time on a cruise ship and his first time seeing such scenery.

He stood on the deck to enjoy the sea breeze for a while and took some photos. As he turned a corner, he saw two familiar people.

Xueyan stroked Charlie, feeling a rare bit of selfishness, afraid that Charlie might be sent away for ruining Fourth Brother’s swimming trunks.

But upon hearing this, Lu Xun completely lost interest in further questioning the accidental incident involving Fourth Brother.

Getting into a fight with a cat in a hot spring?

Fourth Brother was well past the age of being a nuisance; he clearly just had too much free time.

Although Xueyan was cuddling Charlie, he noticed that Eldest Brother had no intention of getting into the water, instead sitting on a lounge chair by the hot spring in his bathrobe, casually flipping through a book.

The tranquility of the mountains and the bubbling hot spring water served as a backdrop for the Alpha, who exuded an air of authority as he lowered his eyes to turn the page, his sharp facial contours softened by the swirling mist of the spring.

"Brother, aren't you going to soak in the hot spring?"

Xueyan, however, was puzzled by his brother’s refusal to enter the water, as Teacher System 444’s mission was still pending.

He had to get his brother to do more things he wouldn't normally do!

However, seeing Fourth Brother spring up in a second, Xueyan was immediately reminded of Fourth Brother’s dark history of faking illness to deceive people.

In Xueyan’s mind, the "Fourth Brother Trust Bank" had already gone bankrupt.

"Hey, hey, hey... woo, this isn't right! Who? Who exactly spread these slanders!"

Lu Huai watched helplessly as Xueyan was pushed away by Charlie while holding a swim ring, feeling as if he had truly fallen out of favor.

According to the old pattern, shouldn't Xueyan be feeling sorry for him and kissing Fourth Brother several times!?

Meanwhile, Lu Li was on the shore replying to Hong Yan’s message, stating that he probably couldn't make it today as he was accompanying his family to soak in the hot spring on the mountain.

The thing was, Hong Yan thought the hot spring environment was absolutely stunning; it would be a total waste not to take photos there. Usually, even for standard commercial shoots, they wouldn't be able to book such a prime location.

Paired with Lu Li’s face, how bad would one's skills have to be to not get a good shot?

"Then can I? Can I help Brother take photos?"

Xueyan, who was soaking in the hot spring holding his swim ring and quietly listening to his brother talk to his agent, suddenly whispered his self-recommendation.

This made Lu Li look over instantly.

Hong Yan, on the other end of the phone, heard Xueyan’s voice and became instantly excited:

"Eh! That’s right! Why don't you let Xueyan take them? Don't tell me you don't want to see what Brother looks like through Little Pear’s lens, Lu Li!"
chapters.title: 第152章
chapters.source_text:
查理的泳姿是小猫刨水，可爱是很可爱，但跟三哥的泳姿还是明显不一样的。
陆家三楼传来一阵撕心裂肺的咳嗽声。
何管家端着保姆煮好的润肺汤来到陆雪言的小书房外，敲了敲门。
“进来。”沙哑的声音响起。
何管家推开门，看到陆雪言正盯着手里的什么东西。
他走进办公桌，发现那是盒润喉糖。
何管家将润肺汤放到桌上，道：“少爷，我刚刚看到小裴同学带着行李走了。”
陆雪言身子一震，视线这才从润喉糖盒上移开，抬头问：“知道他去了哪儿吗？”
何管家摇了摇头。
他看到的时候，裴朔都已经走到庄园大门口了。
等他追出庄园，裴朔已经坐上了出租车。
陆雪言收回视线，咳嗽几声后，道：“你出去吧。”
“喵？”查理对于三哥倒是没有那么警惕。
“刚刚什么事情笑得这么开心？老四那家伙怎么又突然跑回房间里去了。”
虽然就在这时，终于处理完事情的大哥陆巡，也披着深色的浴袍走了出来，略微好奇地看着温泉里的情况，又回头瞥了一眼老四狂奔消失的方向。
“因为四哥裤子坏了。”
雪言替查理老实地解释道。
“裤子坏了？”
陆巡微妙愣了一下，心想老四这家伙可从来不是什么会亏待自己的人。
从小到大吃的穿的那可全是挑着买就没有差的，这泳裤估计也不便宜，至于下个水才几秒就坏了？
“因为四哥跟查理打架了。”
裴朔无奈地叹了口气，拿出买好的润喉糖，吃了一颗。
他看了眼小杨，又晃了晃润喉糖盒子，问：“你要不要？”
刚才说了一路的话，他都担心小杨嗓子疼。
小杨并不客气，嘿嘿一笑拿了一颗。
随着鸣笛声响起，游轮缓缓在江面上行驶起来。
裴朔分配到的工作内容是在餐厅里做服务员，白班，晚上六点就能下班，之后可以到甲板上去自由活动。
陆会重头戏正好在晚上，此时宾客们都去了陆会厅，因此甲板上人并不多。
游轮已经行驶到了海面上。
正是傍晚时分，西边的天空慢慢变成了橙红色，偶尔有一群海鸟飞过，贴着海面捕捉跳跃出来的鱼。
裴朔也是第一次上游轮，第一次看见这样的风景。
他到甲板上吹了会儿海风，又拍了点照片，转过一个拐角，却看见了两个熟悉的人。
雪言摸着查理，难得有一点点私心，害怕因为查理弄坏了四哥的泳裤被送走。
但陆巡听到这里则彻底失去了继续追问老四这起意外事件的兴趣。
跟一只猫都能在温泉里面打架？
老四好歹也过了猫嫌狗憎的年纪，看起来还是太闲了。
虽然雪言搂着查理，就发现大哥并没有下水的意思，而是穿着浴袍坐在了温泉旁的躺椅上，随手翻开了一本书。
山间的静谧和汩汩的温泉水，都成为了带着一种上位者气息的Alpha垂眸翻开书页时的一道背景，往日的侧脸轮廓则被缭绕的泉水雾气柔化了几分。
“哥哥不来泡温泉吗？”
但雪言对于哥哥不想下水的这种行为却产生了疑惑，因为系统444老师的任务还挂着呢。
要让哥哥多做一点平时不会做的事情！
不过雪言看着一秒钟弹起来的四哥，顿时又想起了之前四哥装病骗人的黑历史。
在雪言这里的“四哥信任银行”已然严重破产。
“喂喂喂……呜，这不对啊！是谁？究竟是谁进的谗言！”
陆淮眼睁睁看着雪言抱着泳圈被查理推着划走了，总觉得自己莫非真的失宠过气了？
按照以前的模式，那不该是雪言心疼自己，亲四哥好几下吗！？
而陆黎这会在岸边回了洪燕的消息，表示自己今天估计都去不了了，正在山上陪家里人泡温泉。
关键洪燕觉得这温泉环境简直绝了，不拍照出片完全是暴殄天物啊，平时一般的商拍都舍不得订这么好的景观位置。
再配上陆黎这张脸，到底得技术烂成什么样才能不出片？
“那我可以吗？我可以帮哥哥拍照片么。”
而在一旁抱着泳圈泡在温泉里，安静听哥哥跟经纪人打电话的雪言，突然小声毛遂自荐了起来。
这让陆黎瞬间看了过去。
电话里的洪燕听见了雪言的声音顿时兴奋起来了：
“诶！对哦，你不如让雪言拍呢？难道陆黎你不想看看小梨子镜头底下的哥哥吗！”

chapters.title: 第101章 小摄影师雪言
chapters.source_text:
当陆黎产生这种想法的时候，莫名听到了一声冷笑。
明明早就开始一直占着了好吗？
整个泡温泉的时间段里，有让自己出来过一会吗？！
虽然第一次面对这个自己这么坚决不让步的态度，“陆黎”反倒也有些服气，至少不像以前那样面对什么都一副可有可无的状态了。
对此陆黎脸色微妙地抿唇不语，直接打开手机，想选几张发给洪燕的。
照片陆黎真的没要求，能拍清楚就已经很好了，不可能要求像专业摄影师那样拍出大片。
只不过看见相册里照片的那一刻，陆黎莫名愣怔了一瞬。
说实话连陆黎自己都对镜头里的这个自己都有些陌生……
几分钟后，收到照片的洪燕更是瞪圆眼睛了大半天。
以前怎么没见这家伙笑得这么……这么温柔呢！？？
雪言疼得闷哼一声，下意识伸手捂住脑袋，扶着地面坐了起来。
奇怪，是湿软的草地触感。
雪言缓缓睁开眼睛，顿时愣怔看向了眼前的一切。
古怪巨大的荆棘丛，色彩艳丽的森林夜光蝶，远处山峰之外灰粉色壮丽的火烧云落日天幕。
这分明是《魔界》游戏的游戏画面！
自己真跑到游戏里面来了？
身上的衣服也变得很有魔界游戏风格，外面是一件极为宽大的黑色暗纹斗篷，贴身衣物则是白色宽袖衬衫和勾勒出腰身的黑色长裤。
而且身为人类的雪言，出现在这片魔气压迫感十足的环境里，的确脆皮得有些格格不入。
仅仅是因为草坪上的枝叶划伤，雪言侧脸就出现了一道淡淡的血痕，略显狼狈。
“啾、啾姆……？”
而一道熟悉带着点犹疑的叫声，成功让雪言转身看了过去。
激动中的洪燕斟酌了老半天，还真就只想出来了“温柔”这么个不够准确的形容词。
其实这组照片拍得和洪燕最初想象的完全不一样！
云端树屋温泉这种特殊拍摄地点，其实很容易将本就俊美异常、身型高大的Alpha拍摄出一种让人脸红心跳的氛围。
尤其陆黎常年健身并且极爱游泳，身上一层薄而爆发力十足的肌肉线条堪称恰到好处的完美。
水珠一路沿着喉结滚落水面的那种张力，随便哪个角度拍几张，洪燕敢保证都能让粉丝们尖叫半天。
偏偏这组照片拍摄后，让人印象最深刻的不是Alpha的这种张力，反而是陆黎浑身上下那种罕见的松弛气场，比平日里在舞台聚光灯下的模样多了一丝若有若无的温柔感。
尤其是其中一张陆黎斜倚靠池边，身后便是远方云端处暮紫色的山峦起伏，Alpha眼睫被水汽氤氲后更显纤长，偏偏眼底却带着笑意地耐心朝着镜头看来。
让人看久了莫名会产生一种试图通过镜头与画中人对话的冲动。
仿佛只要你开口了，对方就会化作水中的鲛人朝你游来，出现在你身侧的那种错觉。
就连自诩已经一把年纪的洪燕看着看着，都莫名有点脸热。
“煤球？”
眼前的煤球不再是手机屏幕上的2D煤球了，而是完完全全的3D煤球了！
不对，应该说是真正的毛绒煤球。
每一根黑色的毛毛都建模得惟妙惟肖。
雪言微微睁大眼睛，半蹲下看向了眼前的黑色毛绒小团子。
“不认识爸爸了吗？”
亲眼见到自家乖崽儿的新奇震惊，甚至让雪言暂时忘记了掉进游戏里是一件多么不可思议的事情。
而原本想逃走的煤球听见熟悉的声音后，正仰着小脑袋呆呆地看着雪言，仿佛真的变成了一只毛绒小公仔一样。
眼前的人类青年墨发黑瞳，瓷白色的肌肤细腻异常，带着几分特有的东方神秘感。
眼底带着笑意朝你说话的时候，潭水般静谧温柔的眼眸似乎能让人彻底沉溺在其中。
就连被雪言屏住呼吸试探性伸手摸了摸毛茸茸的小脑袋，尼莫都忘记了挣扎。

陆黎犹豫了一会，还是回了一个句号，表示知道了。
只不过私心作祟，陆黎截下了那张最独特的照片没有公布出去，留作私人屏保了。
因为那张照片的下一秒，的确是担心拍照太久雪言会累的陆黎直接游到了雪言身边，从水中冒出来让举着手机的雪言吓了一跳，笑着往身后姐姐怀里躲的场景。
当时的自己既期待雪言的目光在自己身上停留的更久一点，又有点舍不得雪言没时间去玩水了，反而在这边给自己打工当小摄影师。
但陆黎没想到的是，原来自己眼底的这些心思在雪言的镜头下这么明显。
被完完全全捕捉到了。
就连陆黎都都有些哑口无言，没想到才发出去了一分钟不到，居然就已经被挖到这个地步了。
现在的粉丝到底是粉丝还是侦探……
不过被这么一提醒，回顾这些照片的陆黎才发现还真是这样的，因为雪言个子不够高的缘故，很多照片都只能是仰拍。
一旦被提出来这种可能性，再结合很多蛛丝马迹去判断，摄影师的身份当真呼之欲出。
一直盯着数据的洪燕更是笑到不行。
雪言摸着小家伙的脑袋，发现煤球没有逃跑或者躲开后，甚至大胆伸手将小家伙从地上抱了起来，小心翼翼摆在了臂弯里面。
煤球生疏地晃了好几下，瞬间扒拉住了雪言的袖子，软绵绵踩在了臂弯上，不知所措地抬头和雪言对视了起来。
真的好软好可爱。
对视的这一刻雪言内心默默地捂住了胸口，感觉自己要被自家崽儿萌炸了。
还好最后登录了一下，要不然岂不是体验不到这种顶级毛茸茸感觉了？
最好奇的就是这游戏到底是怎么做到的。
煤球这小毛绒团子的手感简直比之前还要完美翻倍，又软又糯叽叽的。
关键还是薅半天反抗都不知道反抗的那种，乖到原地爆炸。
性格怎么这么老实的？
此时的雪言已经完全忘记刚开始小家伙是多么警惕易炸毛了，亲爸眼的滤镜从这一刻起逐渐开始变厚。
“总之我叫陆雪言，以后你就是陆煤球了！”
由于并不知道煤球其实是有家族姓氏的，雪言就先这么自信地给小家伙取全名了。
本来洪燕还有点失望陆黎博文里面没有主动提到摄影师是家里小朋友的，毕竟那样的话题度绝对更高。
至今都有很多粉丝对演唱会上的小梨子恋恋不忘呢。
没想到陆黎没提一个字，估计是不想用雪言提高曝光，却硬是被粉丝们靠实力分分钟解码扒出来了。
不过这好像也挺正常的，不少明星都是因为这种照片上的细节被扒出来实锤恋情什么的。
而陆黎这家伙同样不走寻常路，被原地扒出来摄影师疑似小梨子了……
为什么都一副实锤的语气。
在有关雪言的事情上，陆黎抵死不从地狡辩了一句，虽然刚一抬头，就看到二姐陆菁看过来了。
“呦，大明星，爽了？”
陆菁同样关注了陆黎的微博，全程看着陆黎这条博文的数据从刚发出去就开始迅速暴增，以及丝毫不意外地被人猜出来了摄影师的身份。
毕竟陆黎但凡看看他之前的那些照片，再对比一下这组九宫格，都能发现这表情跟情绪完全不一样。
简单粗暴总结一下就是突然变得活人感十足。
而且姿势摆多久都不会不耐烦，反而忍不住频频回头看举着手机的雪言，一副想开口说话又怕打乱雪言拍摄节奏的神色。
“没有。”
出乎意料的是，这次一连串的结算提示下来，游戏系统居然发给了雪言整整400金币。
要知道当初攒了好多天金币才抽煤球的奇遇卡也才一共500金币。
而且这个熟悉的“月神”光环加成岂不是说明之前的那个奖励也和煤球有关。
真的是煤球把“好运气”传递给了自己吗？
还是这个光环有什么特殊加成作用……
完成任务后，雪言坐在木屋桌子前，抵着下颌垂眸看着眼前认真喝着盆盆奶的煤球，脑海里不由自主地想着这一切事情的来龙去脉。
虽然看见煤球喝盆盆奶的时候又无意识沾了一圈湿漉漉的白色奶渍，原本精力值耗尽累得有点困的雪言又忍不住笑了。
有机会给煤球再做个小围兜就好了，免得喝奶的时候总是沾到毛毛……
不知不觉间，雪言一边想着事情，一边因为精力值耗尽就这么趴在桌子上睡着了。
而喝着盆盆奶的煤球重新抬起头，才发现雪言睡着了。
陆黎有点不好意思地关上了手机，保持面无表情的镇定拒绝被陆菁调侃。
奈何一旁的陆淮他们都已经听到了。
“呦呦呦，火了！？我就说雪言拍的就是好看，老三这家伙纯粹沾光。”
陆淮一边阴阳怪气，一边也心有不甘地打开手机审查起来，准备看看自己抓着的那几片叶子入镜了几张。
自己没有功劳也有苦劳好吧？
“大哥你？”
陆黎阻拦不了老四，甚至眼睁睁看着不远处的大哥陆巡，都在陆菁的指导下打开手机下载APP关注了自己的账号。
并且表情意味深长地翻看起了自己的账号以及下面的留言。
有种在家人面前社死的感觉是怎么回事。
这一瞬间的陆黎很想扶额没入水里不出来了。
自己果然一开始就应该拒绝洪燕的要求。
小扇子一样的鸦色眼睫垂落，被月光在眉眼一侧照落了一片光影，温柔又静谧。
尽管因为刚刚跑去丛林里摘荆棘草的缘故，脸颊和手上都划出来了不少细密的小血痕。
雪言没在意，这会儿却略微发炎了。
“啾姆……”
煤球凑近看了看这些伤痕，低低叫唤了几声，想蹭蹭又怕弄疼雪言一样。
转身又跳去了自己的小篮子里，把那条干净柔软的蓝色小碎花毯子叼了出来，拖着想盖在雪言身上。
因为老师说过人类很脆弱，万一着凉了怎么办。
或许就连雪言也没想到，自己在煤球眼里居然反而成了被照顾的一方。
只是小家伙辛辛苦苦飞来飞去，咬着四只被角来回扯了半天，刚给雪言端端正正地盖在了肩膀上。
下一秒随着雪言待机自动下线，身体便奇迹般化作星星点点的淡金色光晕逐渐消失了。
甚至有机敏点的粉丝直接猜测性地开始隔空喊话了：【大哥在吗大哥在吗，想看看漂亮小梨子，可以放点饭吗大哥？？[求求求]】
陆黎：……！？？
说实话，演唱会之后关于陆黎的家世背景，网上也是扒了一波又一波，各种说法层出不穷。
只不过陆黎至今为止没有任何回应，各种流言蜚语无论是好是坏是真是假，都一律不肯定也不否认，似乎就想这么冷处理掉。
粉丝们再好奇也不能硬逼着陆黎开口承认，跑去问公司，公司也只能以这是艺人隐私的理由表示无可奉告。
如今陆黎自己露出来了蛛丝马迹，简直是钓着粉丝们跃跃欲试地互动了起来。
“都不要看手机了。”
陆黎连温泉都泡得有点热了，还说要教雪言游泳的，这会儿都没心情了，罕见语气认真地对着一旁低头刷手机不语的几个危险分子提醒道。
顺带心想还好雪言不知道玩手机……
还没反应过来就被雪言托着轻轻放进了篮子里。
伸手摸了摸小家伙软绵绵的脸颊，雪言说完话就发现煤球明显听懂了，“啾姆”两声后安安静静地蹲在篮子里面。
只是小家伙的目光却留意着雪言明显擦伤了的胳膊上。
接下来雪言警惕了很多，不过再也没有怪物出现了，就这样顺利采完了全部的荆棘草，就在提交任务的那一刻，新的系统提示也出来了。
碎花小毯子也就此怅然地掉落在了地上。
煤球安静地看着这一切良久，知道这大概就是离开了意思。
要再等下一次，才能见到。
安静了好一会的小家伙回忆着雪言身上的伤口，看向了不远处的森林，鼻子努力嗅了好几下。
扭头看了看自己的小翅膀犹豫了片刻，最终还是张开翅膀努力飞进了森林深处。
要去给雪崽找药。
“可哥哥自己也在玩手机。”
雪言看着不约而同拿起手机的哥哥姐姐们，也意识到肯定是发生了什么，就想也凑到哥哥手机旁边看看屏幕上到底有什么。
结果一秒钟就被陆黎关上手机扔到岸边，抱着雪言去学游泳了。
“不是说要学游泳的吗？”陆黎垂眸问到。
“可是也想看哥哥的手机！是不是哥哥姐姐们看到我的照片了呀。”雪言抱着哥哥的胳膊，小声说道。
“没有……小孩子不可以玩手机！”
陆黎避而不答直接捂住了雪言的眼睛，这让雪言有点小意见起来，觉得哥哥好小气。
虽然陆黎这边刚刚哄好雪言，就焦头烂额地发现自己的数据又爆了。
因为在那条要大哥放饭的留言下面，还真的出现了一条很显眼很奇怪的刚注册的新账号回复！
chapters.title: 第153章
chapters.translated_text:
Lu Li hesitated for a moment, but still replied with a period, indicating he understood.

However, out of a selfish impulse, Lu Li cropped out the most unique photo and didn't post it, keeping it as his personal screensaver instead.

Because the next second after that photo was taken, Lu Li, worried that Xue Yan would get tired from holding the phone for too long, had swum directly to Xue Yan's side, popping out of the water and startling Xue Yan, who was holding the phone, leading to a scene where Xue Yan laughed and hid in his older sister's arms behind him.

At the time, he was both looking forward to Xue Yan's gaze lingering on him a little longer and feeling a bit reluctant that Xue Yan didn't have time to play in the water, instead working as a little photographer for him here.

But what Lu Li didn't expect was that the thoughts in his eyes were so obvious under Xue Yan's lens.

They were completely captured.

Even Lu Li was left speechless; he hadn't expected that less than a minute after posting, it would already be dug into to this extent.

Are the fans these days fans or detectives...

However, being reminded like this, Lu Li, looking back at these photos, realized it really was the case; because Xue Yan wasn't tall enough, many photos could only be taken from a low angle.

Once this possibility was raised, combined with many clues to judge, the identity of the photographer truly became obvious.

Hong Yan, who had been staring at the data, couldn't stop laughing.

Xue Yan stroked the little guy's head, and upon finding that Meiqiu didn't run away or dodge, he even boldly reached out to pick the little guy up from the ground, carefully placing it in the crook of his arm.

Meiqiu wobbled awkwardly several times, instantly grabbed onto Xue Yan's sleeve, stepped softly onto the crook of his arm, and looked up in confusion to meet Xue Yan's eyes.

It's really so soft and cute.

At the moment of eye contact, Xue Yan silently clutched his chest, feeling like he was about to be overwhelmed by the cuteness of his own little cub.

It's a good thing he finally logged in, otherwise, wouldn't he have missed out on this top-tier fluffy feeling?

What he was most curious about was how this game managed to do it.

The texture of Meiqiu, this little fluffy ball, was even more perfect than before, soft and squishy.

The key was that it didn't even know how to resist after being petted for a long time; it was obedient to the point of exploding.

Why is its personality so honest?

At this moment, Xue Yan had completely forgotten how vigilant and easily ruffled the little guy was at the beginning; the "doting parent" filter began to thicken from this moment on.

"Anyway, my name is Lu Xue Yan, from now on you are Lu Meiqiu!"

Since he didn't know that Meiqiu actually had a family surname, Xue Yan confidently gave the little guy a full name like this.

Originally, Hong Yan was a bit disappointed that Lu Li didn't actively mention in his post that the photographer was a child from his family, as that would have definitely generated more buzz.

Even now, many fans still can't forget "Little Pear" from the concert.

Unexpectedly, Lu Li didn't mention a word, probably not wanting to use Xue Yan to increase exposure, yet he was decoded and dug out by fans based on their skills in minutes.

But this seems quite normal; many celebrities have had their relationships confirmed because of details in such photos.

And this guy Lu Li didn't take the usual path either, being dug out on the spot as the photographer suspected to be Little Pear...

Why is everyone using such a tone of confirmed truth?

Regarding matters about Xue Yan, Lu Li stubbornly argued against it, although as soon as he looked up, he saw his second sister, Lu Jing, looking over.

"Yo, big star, satisfied?"

Lu Jing also followed Lu Li's Weibo, watching the entire time as the data for Lu Li's post surged rapidly from the moment it was sent, and unsurprisingly, the identity of the photographer was guessed.

After all, if Lu Li just looked at his previous photos and compared them with this set of nine, he could see that the expressions and emotions were completely different.

To summarize it simply and crudely, it suddenly became full of the feeling of a living person.

And no matter how long he held a pose, he wouldn't get impatient; instead, he couldn't help but look back at Xue Yan holding the phone frequently, with an expression of wanting to speak but fearing to disrupt Xue Yan's shooting rhythm.

"No."

Unexpectedly, after a series of settlement prompts this time, the game system actually gave Xue Yan a full 400 gold coins.

You have to know that it took many days to save up gold coins for the Meiqiu encounter card, which only cost 500 gold coins in total.

And doesn't this familiar "Moon God" halo bonus mean that the previous reward was also related to Meiqiu?

Did Meiqiu really pass "good luck" to him?

Or does this halo have some special bonus effect...

After completing the task, Xue Yan sat at the wooden table, resting his chin on his hand, looking down at Meiqiu, who was seriously drinking its basin milk, his mind involuntarily thinking about the ins and outs of all these things.

Although he saw that Meiqiu had unconsciously stained a circle of wet white milk around its mouth while drinking, Xue Yan, who was originally exhausted and a bit sleepy, couldn't help but smile again.

It would be great to have a chance to make a small bib for Meiqiu, so it wouldn't always get its fur stained when drinking milk...

Unknowingly, while Xue Yan was thinking about things, he fell asleep on the table because his energy was exhausted.

And Meiqiu, drinking its basin milk, raised its head again, only to find that Xue Yan had fallen asleep.

Lu Li felt a bit embarrassed and turned off his phone, maintaining a blank, calm expression to refuse being teased by Lu Jing.

Unfortunately, Lu Huai and the others nearby had all heard it.

"Yo, yo, yo, it's popular!? I said Xue Yan's photos were good; this guy, the third one, is purely riding on his coattails."

While Lu Huai was being sarcastic, he also opened his phone with reluctance to inspect it, preparing to see how many of the leaves he grabbed made it into the frame.

Even if I don't have credit, I have hard work, right?

"Big brother, you too?"

Lu Li couldn't stop the fourth one, and even watched as his eldest brother, Lu Xun, not far away, downloaded the app and followed his account under Lu Jing's guidance.

And with a meaningful expression, he began to browse his account and the comments below.

What is this feeling of social death in front of family?

At this moment, Lu Li really wanted to cover his forehead and sink into the water and never come out.

He really should have rejected Hong Yan's request from the beginning.

His crow-black eyelashes, like small fans, drooped, casting a shadow on the side of his brows and eyes under the moonlight, gentle and quiet.

Although he had scratched his cheeks and hands with many fine little blood marks because he had just run into the jungle to pick thorn grass.

Xue Yan didn't pay attention, but now it was slightly inflamed.

"Chium..."

Meiqiu leaned in to look at these wounds, chirped a few times, wanting to nuzzle but afraid of hurting Xue Yan.

It turned around and jumped back into its little basket, dragged out that clean and soft blue floral blanket, and tried to cover Xue Yan with it.

Because the teacher said humans are fragile, what if he catches a cold?

Perhaps even Xue Yan didn't expect that he would become the one being taken care of in Meiqiu's eyes.

It's just that the little guy flew back and forth with great difficulty, biting the four corners of the blanket and pulling for a long time, just having covered it neatly on Xue Yan's shoulders.

The next second, as Xue Yan went into standby and automatically logged off, his body miraculously turned into faint golden halos of light and gradually disappeared.

Some sharp-eyed fans even directly guessed and started calling out into the void: [Is big brother there? Is big brother there? I want to see the beautiful Little Pear, can you post some rice, big brother?? [Begging]]

Lu Li: ...!??

To be honest, after the concert, there were waves of digging into Lu Li's family background on the internet, with all kinds of theories emerging one after another.

However, Lu Li has not responded to anything so far; all kinds of rumors, whether good or bad, true or false, are neither confirmed nor denied, as if he just wants to handle it coldly like this.

No matter how curious the fans are, they can't force Lu Li to admit it. If they go to ask the company, the company can only say they have no comment on the grounds of artist privacy.

Now that Lu Li has revealed clues himself, it's like baiting the fans to interact eagerly.

"Everyone, stop looking at your phones."

Lu Li was already a bit hot from the hot spring and had said he would teach Xue Yan to swim, but now he had no mood for it, and he reminded the few dangerous elements nearby who were bowing their heads and scrolling through their phones in silence with a rare, serious tone.

Incidentally, he thought it was fortunate that Xue Yan didn't know how to play with a phone...

Before he could react, he was lifted by Xue Yan and gently placed into the basket.

Reaching out to touch the little guy's soft cheeks, Xue Yan found that Meiqiu clearly understood after he finished speaking; after two "Chium" sounds, it squatted quietly in the basket.

It's just that the little guy's gaze was fixed on Xue Yan's obviously scraped arm.

Next, Xue Yan was much more vigilant, but no more monsters appeared. Just like that, he successfully collected all the thorn grass, and at the moment of submitting the task, a new system prompt appeared.

The floral blanket also fell to the ground in disappointment.

Meiqiu watched all this quietly for a long time, knowing that this probably meant he had left.

He would have to wait until next time to see him again.

The little guy, who had been quiet for a long time, recalled the wounds on Xue Yan's body, looked at the forest not far away, and sniffed hard several times.

Turning his head to look at his little wings, he hesitated for a moment, and finally spread his wings and flew hard into the depths of the forest.

He had to go find medicine for Xue cub.

"But brother is also playing with his phone."

Xue Yan looked at his brothers and sisters who had picked up their phones in unison, and realized that something must have happened, so he wanted to lean over to his brother's phone to see what was on the screen.

As a result, in one second, Lu Li closed the phone, threw it to the shore, and hugged Xue Yan to go learn to swim.

"Didn't you say you were going to learn to swim?" Lu Li asked, looking down.

"But I also want to see brother's phone! Did brother and sister see my photos?" Xue Yan hugged his brother's arm and whispered.

"No... children are not allowed to play with phones!"

Lu Li avoided answering and directly covered Xue Yan's eyes, which made Xue Yan a little unhappy, thinking his brother was very stingy.

Although Lu Li had just coaxed Xue Yan, he found in a panic that his data had exploded again.

Because under the comment asking the big brother to post rice, a very conspicuous and strange reply from a newly registered account had actually appeared!
